phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the two towers of the Frauenkirche stand as dark shapes against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the green copper of the Frauenkirche towers, then spreads across the Old Town rooftops.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Blue Spa pool, guests look across at the two Frauenkirche towers under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Marienplatz this morning, and the New Town Hall spire goes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, cloud shadows cross the Old Town rooftops one by one on their way to the Frauenkirche.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the green tops of the Frauenkirche towers are easy to find above the grey rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the tops of the Frauenkirche towers today, and guests at the Blue Spa pool wait for them to come back.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Olympic Tower is not visible from the terrace of the Penthouse Garden Suite today, but the Frauenkirche, one block away, is clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass roof of the Blue Spa pool, and swimmers see the Frauenkirche towers through the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Frauenkirche towers for a second, and guests behind floor-to-ceiling suite windows count until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Old Town rooftops, and the Frauenkirche towers look softer behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests in the Blue Spa pool see every line of the Frauenkirche towers.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the New Town Hall spire and the Frauenkirche tower stand sharp above the roofs, seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.very_hot: The glass roof of the Blue Spa pool is open in this heat, and guests on lounge chairs have the Frauenkirche at eye level.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace, guests sit in the warm air and look over the Old Town rooftops to the Frauenkirche towers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Frauenkirche towers gold, and guests in this hotel of 1841 look at them from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights the Olympic Tower, seen from the terrace of the Penthouse Garden Suite on the 8th floor.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit towers of the Frauenkirche glow softly above the dark rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and guests watch from their suite windows as the city lights around Marienplatz shine on wet roofs.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the clouds above the Frauenkirche take a soft glow from the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lit Frauenkirche towers stand against a black sky, with stars above their round tops.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Old Town is quiet, and the Frauenkirche towers are a darker outline against the night sky.
phrases.dusk: Guests look towards Marienplatz as the first lights come on below the New Town Hall spire, the sky still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Amstel River lies still and dark, and the sky above the Canal Ring slowly turns from black to blue.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop terrace, the Amstel River shines in the clear morning light, and the roofs of the Canal Ring stand out in sharp detail.
phrases.clear_midday: From the tables of Amstel Restaurant, guests follow the boats moving along the Amstel River under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Canal Ring this morning, and their shadows cross the Amstel River one boat at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At Amstel Brasserie, guests watch sun and cloud take turns on the Amstel River and on the boats that pass.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Amstel River turns the same grey, and the canal houses along it keep their clear outlines.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits low on the Amstel River today, and the bridges appear one by one, as if someone were still drawing them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Canal Ring is not visible today, so the view stops at the Amstel River and the nearest moored boats.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Amstel River with small circles, and guests in the heated indoor pool are the only ones happy to be wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Canal Ring, and guests behind the bulletproof glass of the Royal Suite watch lightning flash on the Amstel River.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Amstel River and disappears at once, while the moored boats and the canal houses slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, bright day, swimmers in the heated indoor pool look at the cold Amstel River from eye level.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the rooms with canal views stay by the windows and watch the boats go by on the water.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the spa's riverfront terraces lie in the sun, and the Amstel River beside them looks very inviting.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace, guests sit under the umbrellas on this warm day and count the boats passing on the Amstel River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights the historic buildings along the Amstel River, and the tall windows of Amstel Restaurant frame them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and colours the Amstel River orange, as it has done in front of these windows since 1867.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the bridge lights draw long lines across the Amstel River in front of Amstel Brasserie.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the bridge lights over the Amstel River tonight and breaks their reflections into small moving pieces.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the heated indoor pool look out at the Amstel River, calm under the bridge lights.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Royal Suite shows the Amstel River on two sides and the quiet square on the third.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Amstel River moves slowly past the moored boats, and the Canal Ring sleeps around it.
phrases.dusk: From the French balcony of the Royal Suite, guests see the first bridge lights come on and multiply on the Amstel River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over Dotonbori, and the Glico Running Man sign waits across Ebisubashi Bridge for the day to begin.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Dotonbori under a clear sky, and guests in the Dotonbori View rooms open the curtains to the Glico Running Man sign.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every colour of the Glico Running Man sign is sharp across Ebisubashi Bridge.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Dotonbori this morning, and their shadows cross Ebisubashi Bridge faster than the Glico Running Man ever will.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From rooms facing Midosuji Avenue, guests watch sun and cloud shadow take turns on the main street this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Dotonbori today, and the Glico Running Man sign keeps its colours against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Dotonbori today, and guests see the Glico Running Man sign with blurred edges across Ebisubashi Bridge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of Dotonbori is not visible today, but guests still make out the Glico Running Man sign close by across Ebisubashi Bridge.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Dotonbori; guests in the Dotonbori View rooms watch it run down the glass in front of the Glico Running Man sign.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Dotonbori, and lightning flashes above Ebisubashi Bridge while guests watch from indoors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Dotonbori, and guests watch the flakes pass in front of the Glico Running Man sign.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing clear day, guests look out at the Glico Running Man sign, in place across Ebisubashi Bridge since 1935.
phrases.cold: Cold light falls on Dotonbori today, and guests see Ebisubashi Bridge clearly from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over Ebisubashi Bridge, where crowds move slowly below the Glico Running Man sign.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests look down at people stopping on Ebisubashi Bridge to photograph the Glico Running Man sign.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun falls along Dotonbori, and the Glico Running Man sign glows warm across Ebisubashi Bridge.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over Dotonbori turn orange, and Ebisubashi Bridge catches the same light.
phrases.grey_evening: From the outdoor terrace, guests see the city buildings lit under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the neon of Dotonbori blurs on the glass, and guests in this 2006 hotel watch the colours run.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the Glico Running Man sign lights the Dotonbori View rooms from curtain-open to lights-out.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear above Dotonbori, though guests look at the neon of the Glico Running Man sign and not at the stars.
phrases.late_night: Dotonbori rests in the small hours, and guests who are still awake see a calm Ebisubashi Bridge.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the first neon of Dotonbori comes on, the Glico Running Man sign among it.

phrases.clear_predawn: A dark Mount Fuji stands on the horizon, waiting for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Curtains open in the Park Suite, and guests find the Tokyo skyline sharp in the early light.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests at Kozue eat lunch with Mount Fuji clear on the horizon beyond the city.
phrases.partly_morning: Mount Fuji appears between the clouds this morning, then disappears behind them again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows slide across the Tokyo skyline, darkening one tower and then the next.
phrases.overcast: Grey from end to end, the Tokyo skyline stretches away under a low ceiling of cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: At Kozue, guests look for Mount Fuji and find only pale haze where it should be.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Mount Fuji cannot be seen today, and the Tokyo skyline fades into pale air after the nearest towers.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass, and guests watch the Tokyo skyline turn soft and grey below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the towers of the Tokyo skyline, and the thunder follows a few seconds later.
phrases.snow: In the Park Suite, guests stay warm and watch snow fall past the glass onto the Tokyo skyline.
phrases.very_cold: Mount Fuji shows its white slopes clearly today, and guests admire them from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: Nobody at Kozue hurries from the table while Mount Fuji stays in view.
phrases.very_hot: The Tokyo skyline shimmers in the heat, and Mount Fuji is only a faint shape behind it.
phrases.warm: The Tokyo skyline runs all the way to the horizon, tower after tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests stop what they are doing as Mount Fuji darkens against the golden light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun turns the clouds around Mount Fuji orange, and the mountain slowly becomes a dark shape.
phrases.grey_evening: From the top floors of Shinjuku Park Tower, the lights of the Tokyo skyline spread out under the evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Wet streets shine far below, and the lights of the Tokyo skyline blur in tonight's rain.
phrases.mild_night: In the Park Suite, guests leave the curtains open tonight and watch the lights of the Tokyo skyline from bed.
phrases.clear_night: Guests fall asleep tonight above the lights of the Tokyo skyline, a view featured in Sofia Coppola's film Lost in Translation.
phrases.late_night: The Tokyo skyline has gone quiet, and only a guest who cannot sleep is still looking at it.
phrases.dusk: Mount Fuji is a dark outline on the still-bright horizon as the first lights come on across Tokyo.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky over Marina Bay is clear, and the Singapore Flyer is a thin dark circle against it.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the marina-facing suites wake to a clear sky and morning sun on Marina Bay, through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_midday: From Mr. Stork on the 39th floor, the clear midday sky shows Marina Bay, the Singapore Flyer and the Gateway towers in one full turn.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Marina Bay this morning, and their shadows cross the water one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the fitness centre, guests on the treadmills watch cloud and sun take turns over the city skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Gateway towers by I.M. Pei stand out clearly below Mr. Stork.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Marina Bay skyline today, and the Singapore Flyer is a faint ring in the white air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the far side of Marina Bay is not visible, though the Gateway towers below remain clear.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Marina Bay, and the Gateway towers shine wet below.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm moves over Marina Bay, and each flash of lightning shows the Singapore Flyer for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Marina Bay, and the Singapore Flyer slowly fades into the white.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, bright day, guests stay behind their room windows and look down on the Bugis shophouses.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the private dining room sit behind floor-to-ceiling windows with the city skyline in front of them.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look at the city skyline from the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day at Mr. Stork, guests walk the full circle of the rooftop, and Marina Bay keeps coming back into view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the water of Marina Bay gold, and the Singapore Flyer catches the light on one side.
phrases.partly_golden: From Mr. Stork, the last sun slips between the clouds and lights the cargo ships at anchor in the harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and the lights of the Marina Bay skyline colour its underside.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of Marina Bay blur on the glass of the marina-facing suites.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Singapore Flyer is lit against a sky without stars.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, Mr. Stork looks over city lights on every side, with Marina Bay shining among them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Marina Bay is calm and quiet below the 347 rooms, most of them asleep.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on around Marina Bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Douro River lies still below a clear sky, and Dom Luís I Bridge is an iron outline above it.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the riverside terrace, guests watch the morning sun reach the Douro River and Dom Luís I Bridge.
phrases.clear_midday: The Douro River shines under a clear midday sky, and from the Heritage Bar terrace every roof of the Gaia cellars is sharp across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Ribeira District this morning, and their shadows cross the Douro River faster than the cruise boats leaving the dock.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Vinology Wine Bar, guests see sun and shade take turns on the iron arch of Dom Luís I Bridge.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Douro River turns grey too, and Dom Luís I Bridge stands dark against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Douro River, and guests in the river-view rooms watch Dom Luís I Bridge appear and disappear.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far bank is not visible today, so the view stops at the Douro River and the Ribeira District quay below.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Praça da Ribeira, and from the balcony rooms guests watch it mark the surface of the Douro River.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls along the Douro River, and for a second lightning shows every iron beam of Dom Luís I Bridge.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Ribeira District, and the flakes vanish as they touch the Douro River.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing, clear air, guests in the bridge-view rooms can follow each iron line of Dom Luís I Bridge.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in these 16th-century buildings stay indoors and watch the Douro River slide past the Ribeira District.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the Heritage Bar terrace fills with guests in the shade, all looking at the cool Douro River.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the riverside terrace watch cruise boats leave the dock in front and head out on the Douro River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the low sun, a glass of Port wine at the Heritage Bar is the same colour as the Douro River.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and lights Dom Luís I Bridge one section at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Gaia cellars lie in long lines on the Douro River.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain this evening makes the lights of Dom Luís I Bridge run together on the Douro River, seen from Vinology Wine Bar.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, guests in this hotel made from 18 old buildings look down on the lamps of the Ribeira District.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, Dom Luís I Bridge is lit from end to end, and the Douro River carries its reflection.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Ribeira District is quiet at last, and the Douro River moves past the empty dock.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the first lights come on along the Ribeira District while guests at Vinology Wine Bar watch the sky stay bright over the Douro River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Petronas Twin Towers are two quiet outlines against a sky that is just starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on the Petronas Twin Towers, and from the 99th-floor pool they sit below the waterline.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests on the fitness center treadmills run toward the KL Tower and never get any closer.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the city skyline this morning, and the Petronas Twin Towers pass from shade to sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Exchange TRX catches the sun between clouds this afternoon, and the KL Tower waits in shade for its turn.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the KL Tower and the Petronas Twin Towers stand out clearly above the pale city skyline.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and from the pool on the 99th floor the Petronas Twin Towers look like two faint sketches.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant mountains are not visible today, but the KL Tower and the Petronas Twin Towers remain clear from the city view rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in the 252 rooms see the KL Tower slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the 75th-floor lobby watch lightning flash over the city skyline, and the KL Tower appears sharply for a second each time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the windows of the 99th-floor pool, and the Petronas Twin Towers fade to white beyond the water.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, bright day, guests stay behind the floor-to-ceiling glass and study the KL Tower in sharp detail.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the private dining room stay warm and look out at the KL Tower and the Petronas Twin Towers.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the city, and guests floating in the indoor pool keep cool while they study the Exchange TRX and the KL Tower.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests in this hotel, opened in 2025, look down on the Petronas Twin Towers from behind cool glass.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills the indoor pool late in the afternoon, and the Petronas Twin Towers glow beyond the tall windows.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and guests in the corner suites see the KL Tower in one window and the Petronas Twin Towers in the other.
phrases.grey_evening: At Cacao Mixology and Chocolate, guests drink cocktails under a cloudy evening sky and look down on the lit Petronas Twin Towers.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of the city skyline blur behind the rain, and guests at Merdeka Grill watch them from their tables.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, guests in the 75th-floor lobby look out at the lights of the city skyline and the KL Tower.
phrases.clear_night: The Petronas Twin Towers and the KL Tower shine against a clear night sky, both bright above the streets.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city is quiet, and the KL Tower is a slim outline for any guest still awake at the glass.
phrases.dusk: At dusk, the first lights come on in the Petronas Twin Towers, and the sky above the city skyline is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Bosphorus Strait lies still under a clear sky, and the ferry pier below is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast, guests look through the tall windows at the twin minarets of the Grand Mecidiye Mosque in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: The Bosphorus Strait is deep blue under the midday sun, and every ferry leaves a white trail across it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Bosphorus Strait this morning, and the water changes from grey to blue behind them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Landmark Penthouse Suite, guests see the Grand Mecidiye Mosque and the Bosphorus Strait together under a sky of sun and cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Bosphorus Strait turns the colour of steel, and the ferries are the only bright things on it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Bosphorus Strait today, and guests hear the ferries before they can see them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far shore of the Bosphorus Strait is not visible today, so guests look at the nearer water and the boats on it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Bosphorus Strait, and guests watch the drops mark the water from the tall windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the Bosphorus Strait, and for a second guests see the whole waterway in white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Bosphorus Strait, and guests in the Romantic Penthouse Suite watch the 15 July Martyrs Bridge fade behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and guests stay behind the glass to look at the bright Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in this 19th-century mansion keep warm indoors and follow the ferries along the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the Bosphorus Strait shines like metal, and guests envy the passengers on the open ferry decks.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, the balcony is the place to stand and look at the minarets of the Grand Mecidiye Mosque and the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Bosphorus Strait gold, and the minarets of the Grand Mecidiye Mosque glow against the clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sunlight comes through the clouds in long beams, and parts of the Bosphorus Strait shine while others stay dark.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening sky of low cloud, the lights of the 15 July Martyrs Bridge make a bright line above the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.wet_evening: This wet evening, the lights along the Bosphorus Strait blur on the window glass, and guests watch them from their rooms.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of passing boats slide slowly along the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit minarets of the Grand Mecidiye Mosque stand beside the black water of the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Bosphorus Strait is quiet and almost empty, and a single ship passes slowly.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is pink and purple, and the Bosphorus Strait repeats both colours as the first lights come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Golden Gate Bridge is a quiet outline above the still water of San Francisco Bay.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Golden Gate Bridge, and from the panoramic balconies guests see the full structure.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Golden Gate Bridge stands sharp against the blue, every cable easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across San Francisco Bay this morning, while the Golden Gate Bridge stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the historic rooms look across San Francisco Bay to the city skyline, where clouds and sun take turns this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Golden Gate Bridge still fills the balcony view, its towers clear against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken most of the Golden Gate Bridge today, and guests wait to see which tower comes back first.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The city skyline is not visible across the bay today, but the Golden Gate Bridge, less than one mile away, is still clear.
phrases.rain: Seen from the veranda, rain crosses San Francisco Bay and the Golden Gate Bridge turns soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over San Francisco Bay, and for a second guests see every line of the Golden Gate Bridge.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Fort Baker, and the Golden Gate Bridge fades behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, guests feel they could touch the Golden Gate Bridge above the cold bay.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, San Francisco Bay looks like steel, and guests at this former military post study the Golden Gate Bridge from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: The heat makes the air shimmer over San Francisco Bay, and the Golden Gate Bridge seems to float above the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, the rocking chairs on the veranda are all taken, and every one of them points at the Golden Gate Bridge.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Golden Gate Bridge gold, and the panoramic balconies hold it from end to end.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights one tower of the Golden Gate Bridge before the other.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit towers of the Golden Gate Bridge glow, and the city skyline shines across the bay.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of the Golden Gate Bridge blur in the rain beyond the veranda.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lights of the Golden Gate Bridge draw a bright path across the water.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests count the lights along the Golden Gate Bridge, and the city skyline glitters beyond San Francisco Bay.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, San Francisco Bay is quiet, and the Golden Gate Bridge waits in the dark for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights appear on the Golden Gate Bridge towers above the eucalyptus trees.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Higashiyama hills are a dark outline in the east, and Yasaka Pagoda is not yet easy to find.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun rises over the Higashiyama hills and reaches the Kamo River, in full sight of the Yasaka-no-Yu open-air bath.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every tier of Yasaka Pagoda stands sharp against the Higashiyama hills.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Higashiyama hills this morning, while the Kamo River below stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and shade take turns on the Higashiyama townscape this afternoon, and guests on their room terraces follow the light towards Yasaka Pagoda.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Kamo River turns the colour of slate, and Yasaka Pagoda stands plainly above the roofs.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze thins the Higashiyama hills to a faint band today, and guests search it for the tiers of Yasaka Pagoda.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Higashiyama hills are not visible today; from Sora Niwa Terrace the view stops at the Kamo River and the nearest roofs.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Kamo River, and guests watch it from the 9th floor with Yasaka Pagoda blurred beyond.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Higashiyama hills, and each flash of lightning shows Yasaka Pagoda for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Higashiyama hills, and guests in rooms with a private open-air bath watch the roofs around Yasaka Pagoda turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Steam rises from the Yasaka-no-Yu open-air bath in the freezing air, and beyond it Yasaka Pagoda stands clear against the hills.
phrases.cold: The Higashiyama hills look sharp from Sora Niwa Terrace on this cold day, and the hot-spring footbath under the counter makes perfect sense.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests at the counter of Sora Niwa Terrace keep their feet in the footbath anyway and their eyes on the Higashiyama hills.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests read on the sofas of Sora Niwa Terrace and look up often at the Kamo River and Yasaka Pagoda.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun warms the colours of the Higashiyama hills, and Yasaka Pagoda is easy to pick out from the Yasaka-no-Yu open-air bath.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun catches the clouds above the Higashiyama hills, and from Sora Niwa Terrace Yasaka Pagoda slowly loses its colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, city lights spread from the Kamo River to the foot of the Higashiyama hills, seen from the bar counter of Sora Niwa Terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in the terrace rooms watch the lights of the Higashiyama townscape shine through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud hides the stars tonight, and the lights of the Higashiyama townscape mark where Yasaka Pagoda stands.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, city lights lead from the Yasaka-no-Yu open-air bath to the Higashiyama hills under the stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Kamo River is quiet below, and the Higashiyama hills barely separate from the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Higashiyama hills as the first city lights come on along the Kamo River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale over St Ives Bay, and the harbour is still quiet below the harbour-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches St Ives harbour first, and the water of St Ives Bay turns from grey to blue.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, St Ives Bay is bright blue, and the stone quay of the harbour looks sharp against it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cross St Ives Bay this morning, and their shadows move slowly over the harbour.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Harbour View Roof Suite, guests follow patches of afternoon sun across St Ives Bay towards Godrevy lighthouse.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, St Ives Bay takes the same colour, and the white houses around the harbour stand out.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers St Ives Bay today, and the far side of the harbour is soft and pale.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests can see the harbour today, but Godrevy lighthouse and the far side of St Ives Bay are not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on St Ives harbour, and guests watch it through the windows of the harbour-facing rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over St Ives Bay, and each flash of lightning shows the whole harbour for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over St Ives harbour, and the quay slowly turns white against the grey water of the bay.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests stay behind the glass and look at a clear, bright St Ives Bay.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, St Ives Bay is steel blue, and guests in this 19th-century guest house look at it from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the sun terrace look at the harbour water and move as little as possible.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit on the sun terrace with a cold drink and look at the harbour.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the white houses of St Ives gold, and the harbour water shines below them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over St Ives Bay turn pink, and the harbour takes their colour.
phrases.grey_evening: On this cloudy evening, the lights of St Ives shine around the harbour, and the bay beyond is dark.
phrases.wet_evening: This wet evening blurs the harbour lights of St Ives, and guests watch them from dry rooms.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the harbour lights of St Ives make long reflections on the still water.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over St Ives Bay tonight, and the harbour lights shine clearly below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the harbour is silent, and St Ives Bay is a wide dark space beyond the quay.
phrases.dusk: From the sun terrace at dusk, guests see the first lights come on around the harbour while the water still holds the sky's glow.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tramuntana Mountains stand as a dark shape above the valley of vineyards under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the limestone cliffs of the Tramuntana Mountains first, then moves down to the almond groves.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 3\65 Restaurant terrace, guests see every vineyard row in the Pollença valley under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Pollença valley this morning, while the limestone peaks of the Tramuntana Mountains stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, guests on the terrace suites watch clouds move over the garden and the valley of vineyards.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Tramuntana Mountains turn a darker grey, and the olive trees keep their silver green.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Tramuntana Mountains today, and the vineyard rows fade one by one toward the cliffs.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The limestone peaks of the Tramuntana Mountains are not clear today, so guests look at the nearer almond groves and vines.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the valley of vineyards; guests in this 18th-century monastery watch it through their windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls along the Tramuntana Mountains, and lightning shows the limestone cliffs for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Tramuntana Mountains, and guests watch the vineyard rows slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the limestone cliffs of the Tramuntana Mountains look sharp and close above the bare vineyard rows.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the almond groves stand clear below the 3\65 Restaurant terrace, with the Tramuntana Mountains behind them.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool and look across at the pine-covered slopes of the Tramuntana Mountains.
phrases.warm: By the outdoor pool, books stay closed while guests look at the Tramuntana Mountains instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the limestone cliffs of the Tramuntana Mountains gold, and the almond groves below throw long shadows.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Tramuntana Mountains turn pink above the vineyard rows.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner on the 3\65 Restaurant terrace, guests can just see the Tramuntana Mountains under the evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the vineyard this evening, and guests in the villa suites watch the wet rows from inside.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Tramuntana Mountains are a darker line above the quiet almond groves.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the Tramuntana Mountains, and guests lose count somewhere over the vineyard.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pollença valley is quiet and the Tramuntana Mountains are hidden in the dark.
phrases.dusk: From the terrace suites on the 3rd floor, guests watch the Bay of Pollença lose its colour under a bright dusk sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Strip is a long quiet road under a clear sky, and the mountains behind it are just starting to show.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Terrace Pointe Café, guests look out at the garden and the pool in the clear early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Strip is sharp from end to end, each tower easy to tell apart.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the garden this morning, and guests at brunch in Tableau watch them come and go.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the Strip this afternoon, and guests in the duplex suite watch the light change from above.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the Strip today, and the towers along it take the same flat colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Strip today, and the Red Rock mountains behind the Las Vegas Valley fade to a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Strip is not visible today; only the nearest towers are clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the two-story windows of the duplex suite, and the Strip beyond them turns blurred and shiny.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Las Vegas Valley, and for a second the whole Strip stands out white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Strip, and the towers fade one by one behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the Strip and the distant mountains look close enough to touch.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Strip keeps moving far below, a steady line of traffic between the towers.
phrases.very_hot: From Eastside Lounge, guests look over Encore's pools on this very hot day, where nobody is in a hurry to leave the water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day the Strip is busy, and from the panoramic view rooms on the 31st to 63rd floors the people below look very small.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the towers of the Strip gold, and the Red Rock mountains darken against the low light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Las Vegas Valley turn pink, and the glass along the Strip catches the colour.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Sartiano's Italian Steakhouse, guests look out over Wynn Golf Club under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and guests at dinner in SW Steakhouse watch the weather move across the lake.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests at The Pier at Aft look across the water of the Lake of Dreams.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lit Strip fills the windows of the duplex suite, and the billiard table has no chance.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Strip runs on below under the night sky, and guests who are still awake have it to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests at PISCES watch the first lights come on around the Lake of Dreams.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky slowly turns pale, and the Hong Kong Skyline stands out against it tower by tower.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Cotton Tree Suite, guests see the Hong Kong Botanical Gardens in clear morning light, with the Hong Kong Skyline behind them.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a blue midday sky, guests at Popinjays, on top of the 26 floors, look across the whole Hong Kong Skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Hong Kong Park this morning, and the towers of the Hong Kong Skyline go bright and dim in turn.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At Garden Lounge, afternoon tea is served with St John's Cathedral outside, in sun one minute and under cloud the next.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Hong Kong Skyline turns the colour of steel, and the green of the Hong Kong Botanical Gardens looks stronger.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the tops of the Hong Kong Skyline today, so guests at Popinjays count the towers from the bottom up.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far towers of the Hong Kong Skyline are not visible today; from the gym, guests see only the nearest buildings and the trees.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the large square windows of the Cotton Tree Suite, and the Hong Kong Botanical Gardens shine wet and green below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city, and guests in the Penthouse Suite watch lightning flash behind the Hong Kong Skyline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Hong Kong Botanical Gardens, white on the trees, and the Hong Kong Skyline is faint behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, and each tower of the Hong Kong Skyline shows a clean edge against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay inside Garden Lounge and look out at St John's Cathedral and the gardens around it.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the city, and the Hong Kong Skyline, seen from the gym, seems to move more than the guests on the machines.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace of Popinjays, guests sit in the warm air with the Hong Kong Skyline all around them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the Hong Kong Skyline gold, and the trees of Hong Kong Park throw long shadows below.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above Popinjays turn pink, and the HSBC building and IFC tower catch the light.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests at dinner at Popinjays look out at the lit Hong Kong Skyline under an orange, cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs St John's Cathedral this evening, and guests at dinner in Garden Lounge watch it through the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests in the Cotton Tree Suite see the Hong Kong Botanical Gardens as a dark space below the lit Hong Kong Skyline.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in this 1969 building look out at the lit towers of the Hong Kong Skyline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and the Hong Kong Skyline stands still above the sleeping Hong Kong Botanical Gardens.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the first lights come on across the Hong Kong Skyline, seen from Popinjays.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the English Channel is calm and grey-blue, and Brighton Palace Pier stands unlit above the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, Brighton Palace Pier stands sharp above a blue English Channel.
phrases.clear_midday: From the corner suites above the 3rd floor, guests see Brighton Palace Pier and the West Pier ruins in one clear midday frame.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the beach this morning, while Brighton Palace Pier stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in this 1864 seafront hotel watch clouds move over the English Channel, with patches of light on the water this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: The sky and the English Channel are the same grey today, so the West Pier ruins stand out clearly on the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Brighton Palace Pier today, and its far end fades into the English Channel.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon of the English Channel is not visible today; guests see the beach and the nearer half of Brighton Palace Pier.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the beach and the seafront promenade, and Brighton Palace Pier looks blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the English Channel, and for a second Brighton Palace Pier shows clearly against the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach, and Brighton Palace Pier turns white little by little.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing clear air, the West Pier ruins look sharp enough to draw, and guests are happy to study them from indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the beach is empty, and the English Channel rolls in grey-green towards the promenade.
phrases.very_hot: The beach is full under the hot sun; guests on the sea-facing balconies look down at the crowd and stay where they are.
phrases.warm: People walk along the promenade and sit on the beach in the warm air, with Brighton Palace Pier busy behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light reaches the corner suites above the 3rd floor, where guests watch the West Pier ruins and Brighton Palace Pier turn warm in colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the English Channel turn orange and the West Pier ruins go black against them.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Cyan Brighton, guests look out at the lit seafront under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests dining at Cyan Brighton watch rain fall on the seafront this evening, its lights blurred.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of Brighton Palace Pier reflect on the English Channel.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the corner suites above the 3rd floor see the lights of Brighton Palace Pier above a black English Channel.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the beach is quiet, and only the white edge of the waves shows where the English Channel begins.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Brighton Palace Pier.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Lugano lies still and grey-blue, and Monte San Salvatore stands clear against the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in THE VIEW Fine Dining, guests look over a bright Lake Lugano under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests at lunch in THE VIEW Fine Dining, which won its Michelin star in 2022, look out at a deep blue Lake Lugano under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Lake Lugano this morning, while the top of Monte San Salvatore stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the 18 suites, each with a private terrace, the afternoon shows patches of sun and cloud crossing Lake Lugano.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Lake Lugano turns silver, and Monte San Salvatore rises green above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Lake Lugano today, and Monte San Salvatore looks like a paper cut-out behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Swiss Alps beyond the lake are not visible today; Lake Lugano and the near slope of Monte San Salvatore still are.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lake Lugano, and low cloud hides the top of Monte San Salvatore.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests count the seconds between the lightning over Monte San Salvatore and the thunder that rolls across Lake Lugano.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Monte San Salvatore, and guests watch the flakes disappear into the grey water of Lake Lugano.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Swiss Alps beyond Lake Lugano look close and sharply drawn.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the Dream Suites keep the terrace doors closed and take in the wide arc of Lake Lugano from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests sit in the shade of their private terraces and look down at the cool blue of Lake Lugano.
phrases.warm: On the panoramic terrace of THE VIEW Fine Dining, guests sit in the warm air and look across Lake Lugano.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns Monte San Salvatore gold, and Lake Lugano below it takes the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above Monte San Salvatore turn pink, and Lake Lugano copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in THE VIEW Fine Dining, guests look over the lights of Lugano reflected in Lake Lugano under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights around Lake Lugano blur in the wet evening air, and Monte San Salvatore disappears into the cloud.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the suites leave the terrace doors open to the quiet water of Lake Lugano.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above Monte San Salvatore tonight, and the lights of Lugano draw the shore of Lake Lugano.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Lugano is quiet and black, and Monte San Salvatore is only a darker outline against the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights of Lugano come on along the edge of Lake Lugano.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear and Lisbon's hills are still shadows, with São Jorge Castle only an outline above them.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun fills the river view rooms, and guests see São Jorge Castle, the Tagus River and Lisbon's hills in a single sweep.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Tagus River shines blue beyond the red roofs of the city.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Eduardo VII Park this morning, while the Tagus River beyond stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow the clouds this afternoon as they cross Lisbon's hills, putting São Jorge Castle in shade and then back in sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Tagus River turns grey too, and São Jorge Castle stands clear on its hill.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Lisbon's hills today, and guests need a moment to find São Jorge Castle among them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tagus River cannot be seen today; guests see the nearer rooftops and Marquês de Pombal Square instead.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows of this 18-floor tower, and guests watch the Tagus River blur behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Lisbon's hills, and each flash of lightning shows São Jorge Castle for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Lisbon's red roofs and on São Jorge Castle, and guests keep looking to check that it is real.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, every wall of São Jorge Castle is sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look across Eduardo VII Park and the rooftops to the Tagus River.
phrases.very_hot: On the rooftop terrace, guests lie on sun loungers in the heat and look over Lisbon's rooftops to the Tagus River.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the terrace suites on the 18th floor sit outside with São Jorge Castle and the Tagus River in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the walls of São Jorge Castle gold, and long shadows stretch across Lisbon's hills.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and guests watch patches of orange light move over Lisbon's hills.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low evening cloud, city lights cover Lisbon's hills, and the Tagus River is a dark band beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests watch the evening rain blur the lights on Lisbon's hills into soft spots of colour.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the clouds hold some of the city's glow, and guests can still follow the hills down to the Tagus River.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the lights of Lisbon run from the glass balustrade of the rooftop terrace down to the Tagus River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lisbon sleeps while São Jorge Castle keeps watch on its hill, as castles do.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests watch the first lights come on around Marquês de Pombal Square.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide dark surface, and the clear sky above Surfers Paradise Beach slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the ocean view suites, guests watch the morning sun climb above the Pacific Ocean in a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Pacific Ocean is deep blue, and each line of surf on Surfers Paradise Beach is easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pacific Ocean this morning, while the sand of Surfers Paradise Beach stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the corner windows follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the Surfers Paradise skyline towards the distant hills.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the white surf on Surfers Paradise Beach stands out more.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Surfers Paradise skyline today, and the farthest towers along the coast fade into the pale air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see Surfers Paradise Beach and the nearest towers, while the horizon of the Pacific Ocean is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Surfers Paradise Beach; guests watch it from their suite windows, the skyline slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second guests see the whole Surfers Paradise skyline in white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Surfers Paradise Beach, and guests keep looking at the white flakes above the surf to be sure.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, bright day, the Surfers Paradise skyline looks sharp, and the beach is empty sand and white surf.
phrases.cold: Guests in this 22-floor tower look at a cold Pacific Ocean today, with long lines of surf rolling onto Surfers Paradise Beach.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, Surfers Paradise Beach is full of swimmers, and guests high above look down at the striped hotel pool with some envy.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests look across to Surfers Paradise Beach, where people walk along the edge of the surf.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The late sun turns the towers of the Surfers Paradise skyline gold, and the Pacific Ocean beside them stays deep blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds above the Surfers Paradise skyline turn orange and pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit towers of the Surfers Paradise skyline give the low sky a soft glow, and the Pacific Ocean is black beside them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the lights of the Surfers Paradise skyline blur and run on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Guests from level 15 and above look out at a night Pacific Ocean without stars, with only the white surf showing on Surfers Paradise Beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the Pacific Ocean tonight, and the lit Surfers Paradise skyline shines along the coast.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pacific Ocean is quiet and dark, and guests still awake can make out pale surf on Surfers Paradise Beach.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Surfers Paradise skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Hohensalzburg Fortress is a dark shape above the Old Town roofs.
phrases.clear_morning: From the terrace of the Sacher Sky Suite, guests see Hohensalzburg Fortress and the cathedral domes in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every wall and tower of Hohensalzburg Fortress is easy to pick out across the Salzach River.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Old Town this morning, while Hohensalzburg Fortress stays in sunshine above it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests watch clouds drift over the cathedral domes this afternoon, while the Salzach River shines in patches of sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Salzach River takes the same colour, and the Old Town roofs look darker beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Old Town today, and Hohensalzburg Fortress seems to float above the Salzach River.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see the Salzach River clearly but only a faint outline of Hohensalzburg Fortress.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Salzach River, and guests see Hohensalzburg Fortress slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Old Town, and each flash of lightning shows Hohensalzburg Fortress for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Old Town, and guests watch the cathedral domes slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Hohensalzburg Fortress stands sharp against the sky, and the Salzach River looks like cold steel.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look across the Salzach River to the Old Town, where every roof stands clear in the chilly air.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the balconies look down at the Salzach River and envy it a little.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit out on the terrace of the Sacher Sky Suite, looking at the cathedral domes and Hohensalzburg Fortress.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the walls of Hohensalzburg Fortress gold, and the Salzach River carries the same colour below.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, lighting the cathedral domes first and then Hohensalzburg Fortress.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, Hohensalzburg Fortress is lit above the Old Town, and guests in this 1866 grand hotel look across the Salzach River at it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Old Town run in long streaks across the Salzach River.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit Hohensalzburg Fortress glows against the low cloud above the Salzach River.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear above the Sacher Sky Suite, and guests on its terrace see Hohensalzburg Fortress lit across the river.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Salzach River moves quietly past, and the Old Town on the far bank is asleep.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Salzach River below Hohensalzburg Fortress.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear over the Zócalo, and the towers of the Metropolitan Cathedral stand dark against the first grey light.
phrases.clear_morning: In clear morning light, the towers of the Metropolitan Cathedral are close enough to the rooftop terrace to read their stone detail.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Zócalo spreads out in full sun, with the National Palace beyond it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Zócalo this morning, a slow show for the breakfast buffet at La Terraza Gran Hotel.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The balcony of Plaza Mayor overlooks a Zócalo that goes from bright to shaded and back as the afternoon clouds move over.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the Zócalo today, and the stone of the Metropolitan Cathedral and the National Palace takes on the same quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the far side of the Zócalo, and guests in the suites facing it see the National Palace as if through thin paper.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The rooftops of the historic centre beyond the Zócalo are not visible today, but the Metropolitan Cathedral still shows clearly across the plaza.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Zócalo, and guests watch the paving darken from the big windows of the suites that face it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the towers of the Metropolitan Cathedral, and guests in this 1899 building count the seconds until thunder rolls over the Zócalo.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Zócalo, and guests in the rooms facing it watch the towers of the Metropolitan Cathedral turn white.
phrases.very_cold: From the 5th-floor rooftop terrace, the Zócalo lies under a freezing bright sky, with the National Palace in full view.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the upper-floor rooms keep to the warm side of the glass and look down on the wide Zócalo.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests choose the shade of the rooftop terrace and look out at the Zócalo, where the stone shines white in the sun.
phrases.warm: Lunch at La Terraza Gran Hotel goes slowly on a warm day, since guests keep putting down their forks to look at the Metropolitan Cathedral.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the stone of the Metropolitan Cathedral gold, and the Zócalo fills with long shadows.
phrases.partly_golden: The clouds over the National Palace turn orange in the last hour of sun, and the Zócalo glows below them.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in La Terraza Gran Hotel, guests look out at the lit Metropolitan Cathedral under a low cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain makes the Zócalo shine this evening, and the lit facades appear twice, once standing and once on the wet stone.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the lit colonial facades frame the Zócalo, and car lights draw lines along its edges.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests see the towers of the Metropolitan Cathedral lit against the black, with the Zócalo open below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Zócalo is nearly empty, a wide quiet square of stone for any guest still awake.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset as the first lights come on along the facades around the Zócalo.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Rosengarten is a dark wall under a clear sky, and the Vajolet Towers stand out first as the light grows.
phrases.clear_morning: The Rosengarten stands sharp in the clear morning light, and guests on room balconies look at it across the green meadows.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Similde Spa is quiet, and the Rosengarten fills the panoramic windows of the glass sauna under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Rosengarten this morning, while the Vajolet Towers come in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the hay barn sauna in the alpine meadow, guests watch clouds drift past the Rosengarten this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the pale limestone of the Dolomites almost matches the cloud, and the heated outdoor pool steams below it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken the Rosengarten today, and from the glass sauna guests see the meadow, the nearest trees and not much more.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Vajolet Towers are not visible today; from the Similde Spa only the lower slopes of the Rosengarten show through the dull air.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the panoramic windows of the glass sauna, and guests inside watch the Rosengarten turn grey and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls around the Dolomites, and guests in rooms facing the Rosengarten watch lightning show the rock wall for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the alpine meadow, and the hay barn sauna stands alone in the white while the Rosengarten fades in the snowfall.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the Dolomites are sharp against the sky, and guests study them from the infrared loungers, wrapped in bathrobes.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the 2,400-square-metre Similde Spa keep to the warm side of the glass and let the Rosengarten do the standing outside.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests swim slow laps in the outdoor pool with the Dolomites stretched along the horizon.
phrases.warm: From the saltwater whirlpool, guests turn their heads through a 180-degree sweep of the Rosengarten on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Antermoja Suite has its private rooftop pool aimed at the Rosengarten, and in this low sun the limestone begins to glow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and colours the Vajolet Towers one at a time, seen from the saltwater whirlpool.
phrases.grey_evening: This evening the cloud sits low, and from rooms facing the Rosengarten the Dolomites are only a darker edge above the meadow.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening and hides the Rosengarten; the wet meadow shines in the light from the house.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars on this mild night, and at 1,175 metres the Dolomites show only where the cloud breaks.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the Rosengarten tonight, and the Vajolet Towers cut small notches out of them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Dolomites keep still above the sleeping meadow, and nobody needs to check that they are there.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and from the glass sauna guests watch the Rosengarten go from rose to ember; locals call it enrosadira.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests who wake early see a thin band of light on the horizon, and the lagoon slowly turns from black to grey-blue.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun reaches the lagoon, and the water turns turquoise right up to the white sand beach.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, guests in the overwater villas look down into clear turquoise lagoon water under a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the atoll lagoon this morning, turning patches of turquoise darker and then letting them go.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the massage deck, the shallow lagoon runs out to distant islands this afternoon, each one under its own small cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, guests see the lagoon lose its turquoise and become a soft silver-green all the way to the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the line between lagoon and sky today, and the wooden jetty seems to walk out into nothing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests cannot see the distant islands today; the lagoon is clear nearby and fades into white further out.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the lagoon, and guests watch thousands of small rings spread across the grey-green water.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Indian Ocean, and guests see the whole lagoon turn white for a second with each flash of lightning.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the lagoon, and every flake disappears the moment it touches the water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold today, yet the lagoon keeps its bright turquoise under the clear sky, and the white beach is empty.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Indian Ocean looks a darker blue than the pale lagoon in front of it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests take the slide from the upper deck of their overwater villa straight into the lagoon, the quickest way into the view.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests paddle across the 5.6-kilometre lagoon, with turquoise water around them in every direction.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the sunset-facing overwater villas, guests watch the low sun turn the Indian Ocean gold along the open horizon.
phrases.partly_golden: Seen from the rooftop deck with the telescope, the last sun colours the clouds orange over the Indian Ocean.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds cover the stars this evening, and the villa lights along the jetty lay a line of gold on the dark lagoon.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain is falling on the lagoon this evening, and from the villas guests see only the nearest water, shining and moving.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lagoon is a wide black surface with a faint glow where the cloud is thinner.
phrases.clear_night: In the villas with a retractable roof, guests open the bedroom to a clear sky full of Noonu Atoll stars above the lagoon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the lagoon is black and still, and the horizon of the Indian Ocean cannot be told from the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still orange, and the first lights of the thatched overwater villas appear across the calm lagoon.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Victoria Harbour is still and dark, and the Hong Kong skyline stands quiet under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests at breakfast in Harbourside watch Star Ferry boats cross Victoria Harbour in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Reopened in 2023, the harbour-facing rooms frame the sail shape of the Bank of China Tower, sharp above Victoria Harbour at midday.
phrases.partly_morning: From Regent Club, guests have breakfast as cloud shadows move slowly across Victoria Harbour.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Over afternoon tea at The Lobby Lounge, guests watch clouds drift above the Hong Kong skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Victoria Harbour turns the colour of steel, and The Peak's green ridgeline looks darker behind the towers.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the top of the IFC today, and the Star Ferry boats seem to sail out of nowhere on Victoria Harbour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Peak is not visible today, and from The Lobby Lounge the Hong Kong skyline is only a faint outline beyond Victoria Harbour.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and guests in the harbour-facing rooms watch Victoria Harbour turn grey and soft.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Victoria Harbour, and lightning shows the Bank of China Tower for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Victoria Harbour, and from the sheltered part of The Terrace the Hong Kong skyline fades behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay behind the glass of the corner suites on this freezing day, with the IFC sharp and clear above Victoria Harbour.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep warm in The Lobby Lounge and watch the Observation Wheel turn slowly beyond Victoria Harbour.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests of the Presidential Suite stay in the rooftop infinity pool and look across Victoria Harbour to the Hong Kong skyline.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, ferries and small boats keep Victoria Harbour busy, and guests at Harbourside watch them from the water's edge.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Regent Club, guests watch Victoria Harbour change from blue-grey to gold in the late sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lights the Bank of China Tower, then the IFC, across Victoria Harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests at Nobu Hong Kong watch the lit Hong Kong skyline glow under low cloud this evening.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Victoria Harbour this evening, and the colours of the Hong Kong skyline spread across the wet glass of The Lobby Lounge.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of the Hong Kong skyline lie in long reflections on Victoria Harbour.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests at Qura Bar find the neon of the Hong Kong skyline brighter than anything in their glass.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Victoria Harbour lies almost empty below the Hong Kong skyline, and both wait for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests at Qura Bar watch the first lights come on along the Hong Kong skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Jardin des Tuileries lies dark and empty, with the Louvre a long grey outline beside it.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Paris Eiffel Tower Room, guests open the curtains to a clear morning view of the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.clear_midday: The Statue of Joan of Arc throws almost no shadow at this hour, and the Louvre opposite is bright in the sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows slide across the Jardin des Tuileries this morning while the Eiffel Tower keeps its place in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests look across at the Louvre as its facade goes from light to shade and back, with the Statue of Joan of Arc below.
phrases.overcast: From the Junior Suite Eiffel Tower, the Eiffel Tower stands dark and sharp against a flat grey sky.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Jardin des Tuileries today, and the Louvre opposite shows only as a pale shape.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Eiffel Tower is not visible in today's thick air, so guests look closer in, at the Statue of Joan of Arc and the Tuileries.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the round pond in the Jardin des Tuileries, and the Statue of Joan of Arc is wet and shining.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Eiffel Tower Suite watch the thunderstorm from behind the glass as lightning flashes around the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the Jardin des Tuileries and the Louvre, and guests watch it all turn white from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_cold: The Statue of Joan of Arc shines in the freezing air, and guests stay inside to look at it.
phrases.cold: People in coats and scarves cross the Jardin des Tuileries towards the Louvre, and guests watch them from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: Guests on the rooftop move slowly in this heat, and the Eiffel Tower seems to tremble in the hot air.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests walk past the Statue of Joan of Arc into the Jardin des Tuileries, where the Grande Roue is turning.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Louvre facade the colour of honey and gives the Statue of Joan of Arc a long shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the Junior Suite Eiffel Tower Corner, guests watch the last sun find a gap in the clouds and light one side of the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests in the Junior Eiffel Tower Suites look out at the dark shape of the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Statue of Joan of Arc this evening, and the Louvre opposite is blurred behind it.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the Jardin des Tuileries is a wide dark space beside the long shape of the Louvre.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the Parisian Suite leave the curtains open tonight, with the Eiffel Tower standing in the clear night.
phrases.late_night: Paris sleeps, but the Statue of Joan of Arc keeps watch over the quiet edge of the Tuileries.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the Louvre and the Jardin des Tuileries grow dim while the sky above them is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the bushveld below the hilltop is a dark plain under a clear sky, and the horizon shows first.
phrases.clear_morning: In clear morning light, the Klaserie Private Nature Reserve runs unbroken to the horizon beyond the hammocks on the suite decks.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the waterhole lies bright and still, seen at ground level from the sunken photographic bunker.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the bushveld this morning, easy to follow from the suite decks.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the hide, guests watch the waterhole change from bright to grey as clouds cross the afternoon sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the bushveld turns one soft green from the lodge deck to the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the bushveld today, and the trees fade into the sky well before the horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; from the lodge deck, the view ends at the waterhole and the nearest trees.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the bushveld, and guests watch from the lounge as the waterhole fills with small rings.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole bushveld for a second, and guests in the lounge wait for the next flash.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the bushveld, and from the lounge guests watch the waterhole turn white at its edges.
phrases.very_cold: The air is sharp and very clear today, and from the lounge every tree on the bushveld stands out.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the bushveld looks still from the lodge deck, and the waterhole lies flat and quiet.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool and watch the waterhole, where elephants are known to come and drink.
phrases.warm: By the pool, books stay closed while guests watch the waterhole for the next visitor.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the bushveld gold, and from the treehouse every tree throws a long shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and colours them orange above the bushveld, seen from the fire pit deck.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the bushveld is completely dark, and the campfire on the boma deck is the brightest thing in sight.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain hides the bushveld this evening, and guests watch it fall past the candles from the dry lounge.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the bushveld is only a dark shape below the hilltop, with no lights in it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the boma deck, with almost no electric light at the lodge to compete with them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the bushveld below the suite decks is dark and silent all the way to the horizon.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over the bushveld while the lodge begins lighting its 300 candles.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale behind the Göreme ridges, and the valleys below the terrace wait for the first balloons.
phrases.clear_morning: Hot-air balloons rise over Göreme in a clear sky, and the lowest pass level with the infinity pool, close enough to read their markings.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch at Lil'a, guests look across Pigeon Valley to the ridges of Göreme, sharp under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests at breakfast at Lil'a count hot-air balloons over Göreme as they drift between patches of cloud.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move slowly over Pigeon Valley this afternoon, and from the bar terrace they can be followed as far as Red Valley.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the carved rock of Uçhisar Castle stands above the terrace, and the Göreme ridges turn the colour of ash.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze fills Pigeon Valley today, and from the therapy lounge the Göreme ridges look like layers of soft paper.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Mount Erciyes and Red Valley are not visible today; from Lil'a's tables the eye stops at the near ridges of Göreme, across Pigeon Valley.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Pigeon Valley, and guests in the Divan Suite watch it blur the Göreme ridges from their windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Göreme valleys, and guests in Loggia watch lightning flash above Red Valley.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Pigeon Valley, and the heated Roman pool stays warm under the white sky, with Uçhisar Castle fading above.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Mount Erciyes stands clear beyond Red Valley, and guests admire it from the warm side of the door at Lil'a.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps guests at the windows of the Sehzade Cave Suite, where Pigeon Valley fills both the bedroom and the living room.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, swimmers stay in the infinity pool and look over its edge at Pigeon Valley, pale and still below.
phrases.warm: On the warm terrace, guests under the stone arches look out at fairy chimneys and the long ridges of Göreme.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Göreme ridges and Pigeon Valley gold, and the bar terrace takes in the whole wide sweep.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, light breaks through the clouds onto Pigeon Valley, and guests in Loggia watch the bright patches move over the rock.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests at dinner at Lil'a look past the candles to the lights of distant towns across the valleys.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain taps on the stone, and guests on the divans of the Eflatun Suite watch Pigeon Valley disappear into the wet dark.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, Uçhisar Castle is lit above the town, and from the pool of this 2003 hotel it fills the sky where stars would be.
phrases.clear_night: Stars crowd the clear sky over Red Valley tonight, and for once there are more of them than morning balloons.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the valleys are quiet, and Uçhisar Castle is a dark shape above the sleeping town.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the first lights come on at Uçhisar Castle, above the roofs of the town.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Pacific Ocean is a darker band under a clear sky, and the savannah below the crater has no colour yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light enters the gym through full-height glass, and guests on the treadmills look east over the savannah of Santa Cruz.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the infinity pool ends at the Pacific Ocean, and the two blues are easy to confuse.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Galápagos National Park savannah this morning, while the Pacific Ocean beyond stays bright.
