phrases.partly_afternoon: From the windows of the balcony rooms, guests follow patches of sun across the crater grassland, the giant-tortoise reserve and then the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of slate, while the volcanic mountains keep their green.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist covers the forest on the volcanic mountains today, and the Pacific Ocean fades into the haze before it reaches the horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Santa Fe Island and the outer islands are not visible today; the view stops at the savannah and the first strip of the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the savannah; guests in the terrace rooms watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows, the Pacific Ocean blurred behind.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm crosses the Pacific Ocean, and each flash of lightning shows the volcanic mountains and the savannah for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the crater grassland, and the Pacific Ocean beyond the infinity pool disappears behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests stay behind the glass at SUMAQ Spa and look at a sharp blue Pacific Ocean.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the jacuzzi at SUMAQ Spa is the warmest seat, and its panorama runs from the savannah to the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests float in the infinity pool and look over its edge at the savannah and the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the private terrace of the Garden Suite look across the savannah to the mist-covered volcanic mountains.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests at DNA Bar take their drinks as the low sun turns the savannah gold and the Pacific Ocean beyond the infinity pool goes pale.
phrases.partly_golden: From the Pool Suite, guests get a side view of the sunset, with the last light caught on the clouds above the extinct crater.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Evolution Restaurant, guests look out from the crater's edge at a cloudy evening sky and a Pacific Ocean that has lost its horizon.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and guests at DNA Bar see the infinity pool in front of them, the Pacific Ocean somewhere behind the rain.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars on this mild night, and the volcanic mountains are a dark shape against a slightly lighter sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the Pacific Ocean, and no other building interrupts the 31 hectares of reserve below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours nothing moves on the savannah, and the Pacific Ocean waits beyond the crater's edge for the first light.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and Santa Fe Island sits on the Pacific Ocean like a small grey stone.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky is clear and still dark over the Danube River, and the Elizabeth Bridge is only an outline against it.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Danube-facing rooms wake to the Danube River bright in the morning sun, with the Elizabeth Bridge beside it.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Danube River runs blue below the Elizabeth Bridge, and the citadel is sharp on its hill across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the forested hill this morning, while the Danube River below it stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Through the skylight windows of the top-floor rooms, guests follow the clouds drifting over the city rooftops and the Danube River this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: The sky is flat and grey today, and the Danube River under the Elizabeth Bridge has taken the colour of slate.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Danube River, and the Elizabeth Bridge seems to end halfway across.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Danube River and the near end of the Elizabeth Bridge are clear, but the citadel on the hill cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Danube River, and guests in the Danube-facing suites watch the drops run down the glass, the Elizabeth Bridge blurred beyond.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls along the Danube River, and each flash of lightning shows the forested hill and its citadel for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Danube River, and the church spires and rooftops of the city are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and the citadel on its forested hill stands out in fine detail above the Danube River.
phrases.cold: The Danube River looks like steel on this cold day, and the bare cables of the Elizabeth Bridge cross it without a sound.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the balconies of a Danube-facing suite look down at the Danube River, bright and slow below the Elizabeth Bridge.
phrases.warm: It is a warm day, and the Danube River moves slowly past the forested hill as if it had nowhere to be.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the terrace of The Duchess, the Danube River turns gold in the late sun, and the domes of the city glow with it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink and orange over the Danube River, and guests at The Duchess put their glasses down to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit cables of the Elizabeth Bridge fill the view from The Duchess, with the Danube River dark below.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests at The Duchess stay inside the lounge this wet evening and watch the lights of the Elizabeth Bridge tremble on the Danube River.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit churches of the city stand out against the sky, and the Danube River carries a little of their glow.
phrases.clear_night: From The Duchess, the Elizabeth Bridge is lit from end to end across the Danube River, under a sky full of stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and the Danube River slides under the Elizabeth Bridge with only a few sleepless guests to notice.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, from the rooftop of this 1902 palace, guests see the first lights come on along the Elizabeth Bridge while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Duomo's dome stands dark against a clear sky that slowly grows paler behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the Dome Terrace faces the Duomo and Giotto's bell tower, both sharp in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Arno River shines below the Arno Terrace, with Palazzo Pitti and Forte Belvedere beyond it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the rooftops of Florence this morning, and the Duomo goes from bright to dull and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the private terrace of the Panoramic Suite, guests watch clouds drift over the Arno River and Ponte Vecchio.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Florence today, and from the Arno Terrace guests see Forte Belvedere in the same flat light.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the skyline today, and from the Dome Terrace the Duomo looks painted in watercolour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The hills around Florence are not visible today, but the Duomo and the nearer rooftops still show clearly from the terraces.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Arno River, and guests in the Hammam Suite watch Ponte Vecchio blur behind the wet windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Duomo for a second at a time, and guests watch it from the shelter of the Winter Garden.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the rooftops of Florence, and the Duomo's dome wears a white cap above them.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing, clear air, the Dome Terrace of this 13th-century tower shows every line of the Duomo and Giotto's bell tower.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests settle in the Winter Garden and look out over the rooftops of Florence with a hot coffee.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the Arno Terrace sit with cold drinks and watch the Arno River, which looks as slow as they feel.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, TornaBuono Restaurant sets its tables on the terrace overlooking the Duomo, and the plates have to compete with the dome.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The late sun turns the Duomo's dome gold, and guests at TornaBuono Bar raise a Sunset cocktail to it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Arno River turn pink, and the water below Ponte Vecchio copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Duomo glows above the rooftops, and guests in TornaBuono Restaurant on the 6th floor keep turning towards it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights along the Arno River stretch into long reflections on the water, seen from the suites above the river.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the terrace of the Presidential Granduca Suite looks down on the lights of Via de' Tornabuoni.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit Duomo and Giotto's bell tower rise above the rooftops, seen from the Dome Terrace.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Florence is quiet, and the Arno River slides under Santa Trinita bridge with only the old tower watching.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright behind Giotto's bell tower while the first lights come on across the rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Como lies still and grey, and the mountains behind it are only dark shapes.
phrases.clear_morning: On the Lakeside breakfast veranda, guests take their coffee with the morning sun already on the lake.
phrases.clear_midday: At Ristorante Raimondi, guests eat lunch facing a lake that is blue all the way to the western shore.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows slide across Lake Como this morning while the green hillside stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Corner Suite, guests watch Lake Como change from blue to grey and back as the clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: Lake Como is the colour of pewter today, and the tall conifers stand dark green against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the western shore today, and guests in the Gran Lago Suite see the lake fade into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the mountains are out of sight and Lake Como fades to pale grey in the distance.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the lake with thousands of small rings, and guests in the Junior Suite watch them from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls between the mountains, and each flash of lightning turns Lake Como white for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling, and guests in the Lobby see the dome of Como's cathedral through the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the bar keep their hands around hot cups and their eyes on the lake, clear and bright in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: In the Garibaldi Junior Suite, guests enjoy the lake and the hilltop tower without needing a coat.
phrases.very_hot: Guests on the terrace move slowly in this heat and look at Lake Como as if planning to jump in.
phrases.warm: On the Ristorante Raimondi cobblestone terrace, guests sit out in shirt sleeves with Lake Como spread in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the western shore of Lake Como gold, and the orange and lemon groves glow with it.
phrases.partly_golden: From the Raimondi Junior Suite, guests see the last sun slip between the clouds and lay a copper stripe across Lake Como.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner guests at Ristorante Raimondi look out over the lake, dark and quiet below a low ceiling of cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the bar tonight, and guests look through it at a blurred, dark lake.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight Lake Como is dark and calm, and cloud hides the tops of the mountains around it.
phrases.clear_night: Guests crossing the Lobby tonight stop to look at the dome of Como's cathedral, a round shape in the clear night.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the few guests still awake in the Corner Suite have a dark and silent Lake Como to themselves.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Eiffel Tower stands dark against a sky that is only starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun falls on the Arc de Triomphe, and Sacré-Cœur shows white in the distance.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests in the Imperiale Suite have a clear view of the Eiffel Tower under a blue midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: This morning the Arc de Triomphe is in sunshine while clouds pass behind Sacré-Cœur.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sacré-Cœur is in sun one minute and in shade the next as clouds pass this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: The Arc de Triomphe and the Eiffel Tower stand out clearly against a grey sky today.
phrases.fog_haze: Through today's haze, Sacré-Cœur is only a pale shape, while the Arc de Triomphe remains easy to see.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today: the Arc de Triomphe is clear, the Eiffel Tower is faint, and Sacré-Cœur cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Guests in the Josephine Suite watch the rain fall over Paris and are in no hurry to go out.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Eiffel Tower for a second at a time, and guests in the Imperiale Suite keep watching for the next flash.
phrases.snow: Snow whitens the top of the Arc de Triomphe, and Sacré-Cœur disappears behind the falling flakes.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Junior Suite stay warm inside and look out over a cold, bright Paris.
phrases.cold: Guests keep indoors today and look across the rooftops to Sacré-Cœur.
phrases.very_hot: Guests in the Eiffel Junior Suite watch the Eiffel Tower tremble a little in the heat.
phrases.warm: Guests in the Terrace Suite spend the day outside in short sleeves, facing out over Paris.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Gold light climbs the Arc de Triomphe as the afternoon ends, and the Eiffel Tower glows with it too.
phrases.partly_golden: From the Avenue Terrace Junior Suite, guests watch the last sun find gaps in the clouds over Paris.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the Imperiale Suite end the evening facing a lit Eiffel Tower.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights around the Arc de Triomphe tonight, and the lit Eiffel Tower shines through it.
phrases.mild_night: A lit Sacré-Cœur shows pale across the dark rooftops of Paris tonight.
phrases.clear_night: Nothing hides the Arc de Triomphe, the Eiffel Tower or Sacré-Cœur tonight, each one standing lit above the dark city.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests still awake in the Eiffel Junior Suite see the Eiffel Tower standing over a quiet Paris.
phrases.dusk: Lights come on around the Arc de Triomphe while the sky behind Sacré-Cœur is still pale.

phrases.clear_predawn: Early risers find the Arc de Triomphe already there, a dark block against the first pale light.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast time, guests see the Arc de Triomphe standing in full morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop, the Eiffel Tower rises clear above the rooftops of Paris.
phrases.partly_morning: Sacré-Cœur turns white, then grey, then white again as the clouds pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Paris this afternoon, leaving the Eiffel Tower in shade and Sacré-Cœur in sun.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud sits low over Paris, and the Eiffel Tower stands dark and clear against it.
phrases.fog_haze: In the haze, the Arc de Triomphe stays sharp while the Eiffel Tower fades to a pale outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Sacré-Cœur is lost in the thick air today, while the Arc de Triomphe remains easy to see.
phrases.rain: Rain darkens the stone of the Arc de Triomphe, and guests are glad to watch from indoors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Paris while guests stay inside and watch Sacré-Cœur under the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Guests stay indoors and watch snow fall across the rooftops of Paris, the Eiffel Tower faint behind it.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay warm inside while the Eiffel Tower stands sharp in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: Coat weather outside, so guests stay in and look across Paris to Sacré-Cœur.
phrases.very_hot: Up on the rooftop, guests fan themselves and face the Eiffel Tower across the rooftops of Paris.
phrases.warm: Nobody hurries off the rooftop today, with the Eiffel Tower standing right in view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Arc de Triomphe turns the colour of honey in the late sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lands on Sacré-Cœur.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests end the evening with the Arc de Triomphe in view beneath a low, cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Through tonight's rain, guests can still pick out the Eiffel Tower from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the Arc de Triomphe and Sacré-Cœur share the view under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: The Eiffel Tower is easy to find tonight, standing tall over the dark rooftops of Paris.
phrases.late_night: Guests still awake have the Arc de Triomphe almost to themselves at this quiet hour.
phrases.dusk: Sacré-Cœur holds the last brightness of the day while the Arc de Triomphe turns to a dark outline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky turns pale around Sugarloaf Mountain, and Copacabana Beach lies empty below the balcony rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the rooftop pool looks along Copacabana Beach to Sugarloaf Mountain.
phrases.clear_midday: At Emiliano Rooftop, guests have lunch above Copacabana Beach, with the Atlantic Ocean bright blue under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Copacabana Beach this morning, while Sugarloaf Mountain stays in full sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon clouds drift over the Atlantic Ocean, and from the rooftop guests see Sugarloaf Mountain go in and out of shade.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the sand of Copacabana Beach looks paler beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Sugarloaf Mountain today, and from the balcony rooms Copacabana Beach fades gently into it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Sugarloaf Mountain is not visible today; the view from the rooftop stops at the near part of Copacabana Beach and the first waves.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Copacabana Beach, and guests in the oceanfront rooms watch it through their windows as the ocean turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and for a second Sugarloaf Mountain appears, then disappears again in the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Copacabana Beach, and guests check twice from behind the glass that the white on the sand is not foam.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, so Sugarloaf Mountain looks sharp from the rooftop above an empty beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Copacabana Beach is quiet, and the Atlantic Ocean sends long lines of waves to the sand.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look across Copacabana Beach, the Atlantic Ocean and Sugarloaf Mountain.
phrases.warm: Copacabana Beach is busy with people on this warm day, and guests watch them from the loungers on the rooftop.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Sugarloaf Mountain gold beyond the rooftop pool of this hotel designed by Arthur Casas.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Atlantic Ocean turn pink and orange, and Copacabana Beach glows below them.
phrases.grey_evening: At Emiliano Rooftop, dinner guests look down on the lights of Copacabana Beach under a low, cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights along Copacabana Beach stretch into long wet reflections.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit promenade of Copacabana Beach and its palm trees run beside the black Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, Sugarloaf Mountain stands as a dark shape beyond the lights of Copacabana Beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the 90 rooms are quiet, and only the white edges of the waves mark Copacabana Beach.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the ocean, and the first lights come on along Copacabana Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide grey surface under a clear sky, and white surf marks the edge of Chesterman Beach.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the balcony suites above Chesterman Beach, and the Pacific Ocean beyond the sand is a clean blue.
phrases.clear_midday: In The Pointe Restaurant, guests look through the glass at a 240-degree arc of blue Pacific Ocean.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pacific Ocean this morning, and the driftwood on Chesterman Beach goes from grey to gold and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Canopy Suite look along the full length of Chesterman Beach this afternoon, as clouds drift in from the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean takes the same colour, and only the white surf shows where the rocks begin.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Pacific Ocean today, and waves come out of the white only a short way from the rocks.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests see the rocks, the surf and the first stretch of the Pacific Ocean, then pale grey.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and guests watch the Pacific Ocean from the fireside in one of the 75 rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Pacific Ocean, and guests in The Pointe Restaurant watch the swells break on the rocks below the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the driftwood of Chesterman Beach, and the flakes disappear as they touch the grey Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: The air is sharp and clear today, and guests stay by the fireplace while the Pacific Ocean shines beyond the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests at Ancient Cedars Spa look down from the treatment rooms at Pacific surf moving over the rocks.
phrases.very_hot: In today's heat, a summer haze lies over the Pacific Ocean, and people walk along the water's edge on Chesterman Beach.
phrases.warm: Guests walk barefoot on Chesterman Beach this warm day, and the Pacific Ocean beside them looks almost calm.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the rooms facing west towards Secret Cove, guests watch the low sun turn the Pacific Ocean gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds, and the Pacific Ocean turns orange and pink around the rocks of Secret Cove.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in The Pointe Restaurant, the Pacific Ocean is a dark surface under the cloud, with white surf below the glass.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain beats on the glass of The Pointe Restaurant this evening, and guests can just see the white tops of the Pacific waves.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, little of the Pacific Ocean shows except the white edge of each wave.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Pacific Ocean tonight, and the open water runs west with Japan as the next land.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pacific Ocean is almost black beyond the glass, and the surf shows faintly on Chesterman Beach.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and the sky is still bright over the Pacific Ocean while Chesterman Beach slowly turns grey.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Olifants River shows faintly below the slope, and the bush beyond it is still without colour.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the restaurant terrace, guests look over the Olifants River in clear early light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Olifants River shines brown and wide, and the bush of the 10,000-hectare reserve stands sharp behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the bush this morning, while the Olifants River below stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the bar in the main lodge, guests follow patches of sun and shade as they cross the Olifants River.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Olifants River turns the colour of the clouds, and the green of the bush looks deeper.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Olifants River today, and the trees on the far bank look like soft drawings.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the distant bush is not visible, and the view ends at the Olifants River and its nearest trees.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Olifants River with small rings, and guests watch it from under the thatched roof of the restaurant.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Olifants River and the bush for a second at a time, and guests in the villa suites watch from their covered terraces.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Olifants River and the bush, and guests watch it through their sliding glass doors in some surprise.
phrases.very_cold: The Olifants River runs bright in very cold, clear air, and guests look at it from the bar in the main lodge.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Olifants River flows past the bank as it does all year, and the bush beside it stands still.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests in the villa suites stay in their private pools and look down at the Olifants River, where the hippos have had the same idea.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests lie in hammocks on the river bungalow terraces and wait for elephants to come down to the Olifants River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Olifants River gold, and from the restaurant terrace the bush on the far bank glows a warm brown.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in bands, lighting one stretch of the Olifants River and then another.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner on the restaurant terrace under a clouded evening sky, the Olifants River is a dark band with the bush treeline just visible behind it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the lamp light this evening, and beyond it the Olifants River shows as a wet shine in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Olifants River is a slow movement below the lodge, and the bush around it has no edges.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Olifants River tonight, and the bush treeline is black against them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Olifants River lies unlit below this lodge, opened in 1998, and the far bank cannot be told from the water.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky above the bush is still bright, and the Olifants River holds that light while the first lamps come on at the restaurant.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Adriatic Sea is a faint grey band beyond the olive grove plain, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the olive grove plain, and the Adriatic Sea shines blue behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, the Adriatic Sea draws a sharp blue line across the horizon at midday.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the olive trees this morning, while the Adriatic Sea stays bright beyond them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, clouds drift from the White City on one side to the Adriatic Sea on the other.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Adriatic Sea turns the colour of pewter, and the White City looks even whiter.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the olive grove plain today, and the Adriatic Sea fades into the sky without a clear edge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Adriatic Sea is not visible today; from the rooftop terrace, only the nearer olive trees and the White City show.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the olive grove plain, and guests in the sea view suites watch the Adriatic Sea turn grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Adriatic Sea, and guests follow the storm from the sea view suites.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the olive trees, and the Adriatic Sea has disappeared behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and clear, and the Adriatic Sea looks close enough to touch beyond the olive trees.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the sea view suites look over the olive grove plain to the Adriatic Sea.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look over the olive trees to the Adriatic Sea.
phrases.warm: At Bianca Bistrot in the garden, guests find pieces of blue Adriatic Sea above the greenery on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Rooftop Bar, the Adriatic Sea turns pink in the late sun, and the White City still shines.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and a band of gold lies on the Adriatic Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: From the rooftop terrace of this 14th-century palazzo, the lit White City stands out under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the White City this evening, and guests watch them from the suites facing the city.
phrases.mild_night: The Adriatic Sea is hidden in the mild, cloudy night, so the lit White City takes over the view.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Adriatic Sea, and the White City glows on its hill.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Adriatic Sea and the olive grove plain are one dark, quiet space.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Adriatic Sea, and the first lights come on in the White City.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Phobjikha Valley lies quiet under a clear sky, and the ridges of blue pine slowly take shape.
phrases.clear_morning: From the main lodge terrace, the Phobjikha Valley wakes below in clear morning light, its farmhouses and pine slopes easy to pick out.
phrases.clear_midday: Through the double-height glass wall of the main lodge, the 17th-century monastery and the valley floor are sharp under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift along the forested ridges this morning, while the farmhouses on the valley floor stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move slowly across the farmland of the Phobjikha Valley this afternoon, below the main lodge terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the blue pine forests turn darker, and the farmhouses stand out on the valley floor below.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist fills the Phobjikha Valley today, and from the main lodge terrace the mountain ridges seem to float above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far ridges are not visible today; guests at the glass wall of the main lodge still see the monastery and the nearest farmhouses.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Phobjikha Valley, and guests watch it from the double-height glass wall of the main lodge.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls around the valley, and lightning shows the monastery for a second through the glass wall of the main lodge.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the farmhouses and pine slopes, and guests watch the Phobjikha Valley turn white from their suite windows.
phrases.very_cold: In a deep rolltop bathtub, guests look out at the frozen Phobjikha Valley and decide the hike can wait.
phrases.cold: From the main lodge terrace on a cold day, the pine slopes of the Phobjikha Valley stand clear in the thin air.
phrases.very_hot: In strong sun, guests sit on the main lodge terrace and look down at the bright farmland of the Phobjikha Valley.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests stay out on the main lodge terrace with a book, looking up often at the pine-covered mountains.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light fills the main lodge through its double-height glass wall and warms the forested slopes of the valley.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and lights the 17th-century monastery, while the valley floor is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening sky of cloud, the Phobjikha Valley goes dark, and a few farmhouse lights show on the valley floor.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the suites, with the wood stove lit, watch the wet evening settle over the dark Phobjikha Valley.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night with no stars, the valley is a wide dark space below the main lodge terrace.
phrases.clear_night: During a candlelit dinner in the Woodshed, guests look out at a sky full of stars above the valley.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Phobjikha Valley is dark and silent, and only the outline of the mountains shows against the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright above the ridges, and guests in this 2013 farmhouse see the first lights in the valley.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear above the tent decks, and the Tmor Rung River is a grey band between two black walls of rainforest.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the boulders of the Tmor Rung River, and the rainforest on both banks turns a bright green.
phrases.clear_midday: From Landing Zone Bar, guests look straight down at Raging Big Sister Falls, white under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the rainforest this morning, while the water below Waterfall Restaurant stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lounge tent, guests watch sun and shade take turns on the rocky river this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the rainforest looks darker, and the white water of Raging Big Sister Falls stands out more from Waterfall Restaurant.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist fills the valley today, and from Landing Zone Bar guests see Raging Big Sister Falls drop into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the far bends of the Tmor Rung River are not visible; guests on their decks see the near boulders and the first trees.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Tmor Rung River, and guests under the straw roof of Landing Zone Bar watch it land on Raging Big Sister Falls.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning lights the cascade below Waterfall Restaurant for a second, then the rainforest goes grey again behind the rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Cardamom rainforest, and from their tent decks guests watch white flakes settle on green leaves, hardly believing it.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the spray of Raging Big Sister Falls hangs like smoke in front of Landing Zone Bar.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Tmor Rung River runs clear below the 15 tent decks, each one above a different stretch of water.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests sit in the Tmor Rung River itself and look up at the rainforest on both banks.
phrases.warm: On a warm day at Khmer Tonics spa, guests soak their feet in the river and watch the waterfall spray drift over the boulders.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light comes low through the trees, and guests at Landing Zone Bar look down on Raging Big Sister Falls as the white water turns gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lights patches of rainforest above the river in this 865-acre valley.
phrases.grey_evening: At Waterfall Restaurant this cloudy evening, the cascade is a pale blur below the two levels, and the rainforest has gone fully black.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the lamplight this evening, and from the lounge tent guests see only the nearest rocks of the river shining wet.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so guests on their tent decks see the nearest trees in the lamplight and a faint glimmer of white water.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, stars fill the strip of sky that the rainforest leaves open above the Tmor Rung River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the valley is dark, and the river is only a faint movement between the trees.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright above the trees, and the first tent lamps come on along the Tmor Rung River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Adige Valley lies quiet below the hill, and the ridges on both sides stand out against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the Orangerie, guests look down at the orchards of the Adige Valley while the ridgelines still hold some shadow.
phrases.clear_midday: From the panoramic terrace, the Adige Valley shows every orchard row at midday, with Merano compact on the valley floor.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the vineyards this morning, and the summits of the Texel Group come and go behind the clouds.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the balcony rooms watch clouds drift over the Texel Group, one summit in sun and the next in shade.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Adige Valley keeps its order: orchards in rows, vineyards on the slopes, Merano's rooftops in the middle.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze fills the Adige Valley today, and from the panoramic terrace Merano's rooftops look like a drawing half rubbed out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far mountains are not visible today, so guests on the hill look at the nearer orchards and at Merano below them.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Adige Valley, and the wet vineyard rows shine below the panoramic terrace while Merano turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls between the two mountain walls, and guests in this 1624 hunting lodge watch lightning light up the Adige Valley from indoors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Adige Valley, and the orchards below the hill turn white one row at a time.
phrases.very_cold: The cold air is very clear today, and the mountains above the Adige Valley show sharp edges over the bare winter orchards.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass of the Orangerie and follow the vineyard rows down towards Merano.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool and look over its edge at the vineyards and fruit trees around the hill.
phrases.warm: On the panoramic terrace, guests hold a glass of wine and forget to drink it while they look over the Adige Valley.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light runs along the Adige Valley, and the long shadows of the apple trees stripe the slopes below the panoramic terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and guests in the mountain-facing rooms among the 20 suites see the Texel Group summits glow one after another.
phrases.grey_evening: From the glass loggia of Gourmet Restaurant Prezioso, dinner guests see Merano's lights glow under low cloud in the valley.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of the Adige Valley blur behind the rain, and guests in the Orangerie watch them over dinner.
phrases.mild_night: From the valley-facing balconies, the lights of Merano run along the Adige Valley under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Adige Valley becomes a sea of lights below the Orangerie's panoramic terrace, with stars above the mountain ridges.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Adige Valley sleeps below the private hill, and even the orchards keep quiet until morning.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the mountains, and the first lights of Merano appear in the Adige Valley.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the first light shows over the Atlantic coastline to the east, and the Southern Brazil Canyons are still in shadow.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the basalt wall of Malacara Canyon stands sharp across the valley from the chalet balconies.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in Restaurante Contemplar, the wide windows frame the Southern Brazil Canyons under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly over the Southern Brazil Canyons this morning, easy to follow from ridge to ridge at the canyon viewpoint.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the valley this afternoon, while the Atlantic coastline stays in sunshine from the eastern viewpoint.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Southern Brazil Canyons turn dark green, and the glass walls of the treatment rooms at Morada SPA frame their ridges.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills the valley today, and only the flat tops of the Southern Brazil Canyons rise above it at the canyon viewpoint.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Atlantic coastline is not visible today, but the basalt wall of Malacara Canyon is still clear across the valley.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling into the valley; guests in the all-glass suites watch it blur the Southern Brazil Canyons.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls along the Southern Brazil Canyons, and each flash of lightning shows the wall of Malacara Canyon for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Serra do Faxinal rim, and the Southern Brazil Canyons fade to white behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, the Southern Brazil Canyons show every ridge, and the Atlantic coastline is in sight to the east.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay in the glass-walled indoor pool at Morada SPA and keep the canyon escarpment at eye level from the water.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the 16-metre infinity pool at Morada SPA, with the Southern Brazil Canyons beyond its edge.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests at the eastern viewpoint look past the valley to the Atlantic coastline and argue about where the sea begins.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the basalt wall of Malacara Canyon orange, directly across the valley from the 11 chalets on the rim.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Southern Brazil Canyons turn pink, and the infinity pool at Morada SPA copies the colours.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Restaurante Contemplar, the wide windows show the Southern Brazil Canyons as a dark shape under the evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the wide windows of Restaurante Contemplar this evening, and the Southern Brazil Canyons are lost in the night behind it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, no stars show, and guests on the suite balconies see the Southern Brazil Canyons as a darker line under the sky.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the stars above the Southern Brazil Canyons are too many to count from the canyon viewpoint.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the valley is black and silent, and the rim of the Southern Brazil Canyons can only just be seen against the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright above the Southern Brazil Canyons while the valley below is already turning dark.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Osorno Volcano is a dark cone against a slowly paling sky, and Lake Llanquihue lies still below it.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in AWA Restaurant, guests look straight across Lake Llanquihue to Osorno Volcano under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Osorno Volcano stands white and sharp above the blue of Lake Llanquihue at midday, in line with the private jetty.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past Osorno Volcano this morning, and their shadows move slowly over Lake Llanquihue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the bar, guests watch afternoon clouds cover and uncover the snowy top of Osorno Volcano.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Lake Llanquihue turns the colour of steel, and the snow on Osorno Volcano stays bright above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on Lake Llanquihue today and hides the end of the private jetty, so guests can only guess where Osorno Volcano stands.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Osorno Volcano is not visible today; from the floor-to-ceiling windows guests see only the near water of Lake Llanquihue.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass ceiling of the spa pool, and swimmers look out at a grey, dotted Lake Llanquihue.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Osorno Volcano for a second above Lake Llanquihue, and guests in the bar wait for the next flash.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the private beach and the jetty, and Osorno Volcano has disappeared behind the white air over Lake Llanquihue.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests stay behind the glass of the bar and look across Lake Llanquihue to the snow-covered cone of Osorno Volcano.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests float in the heated spa pool and look through its glass walls at Lake Llanquihue.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the private beach cool their feet in Lake Llanquihue and look up at the snow on Osorno Volcano.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit at the end of the private jetty with Lake Llanquihue all around them and Osorno Volcano ahead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the snow of Osorno Volcano gold, and guests in the bar watch the colour reach Lake Llanquihue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights one side of Osorno Volcano, while Lake Llanquihue is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in AWA Restaurant, the cloudy evening lets guests see only a little of Lake Llanquihue beyond the glass.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain beats on Lake Llanquihue this evening, and guests at dinner in AWA Restaurant hear it more than they see it.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests in the AWA Suite can still follow the dim shore of Lake Llanquihue through the glass.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear night sky over Lake Llanquihue, and the snow on Osorno Volcano gives off a faint glow.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Llanquihue is black and quiet beyond the bedroom glass, with Osorno Volcano somewhere in the dark.
phrases.dusk: Guests in rooms turned at an angle to the shore see Osorno Volcano turn blue against a still bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Canandaigua Lake lies flat and quiet below the balcony rooms, under a clear sky that is slowly growing lighter.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Rose Tavern, guests look through the greenhouse glass at Canandaigua Lake, bright under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Canandaigua Lake is deep blue at midday, and the far shore is sharp enough to show every tree.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Canandaigua Lake this morning, and the yoga class watches them through the glass doors.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over Canandaigua Lake this afternoon, and the water changes colour each time.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Canandaigua Lake turns the colour of metal, and the far shore looks closer than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Canandaigua Lake today, and the water fades into white a short distance from the shore.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far shore of Canandaigua Lake is not visible today, and guests see only the water near the hotel.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Canandaigua Lake, and guests in the greenhouse at Rose Tavern watch it run down the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Canandaigua Lake, and guests at Rose Tavern count the seconds before the thunder from their dry tables.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Canandaigua Lake, and guests in the cedar barrel saunas watch it through the glass end.
phrases.very_cold: In the barrel saunas at Willowbrook Spa, guests sit in the heat and look at a freezing, bright Canandaigua Lake.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 124-room resort look at Canandaigua Lake from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.very_hot: At Sand Bar, guests find a seat in the shade and look at Canandaigua Lake shining in the strong heat.
phrases.warm: On the covered patio of Rose Tavern, lunch takes longer than planned because guests keep looking at Canandaigua Lake.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns Canandaigua Lake gold in the late afternoon, and the far shore glows above the water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sunlight comes through the clouds and falls in long bands across Canandaigua Lake.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in the greenhouse at Rose Tavern, guests see the lights of the far shore across Canandaigua Lake under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Canandaigua Lake disappears behind wet glass this evening, and only a few blurred lights show where the far shore is.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and Canandaigua Lake lies dark and calm below them.
phrases.clear_night: Stars shine over Canandaigua Lake tonight, and the still water gives a few of them back.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Canandaigua Lake is black and still below the balconies of this resort rebuilt in 2020.
phrases.dusk: The sky above Canandaigua Lake is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the far shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky lobby is quiet, and the Petronas Twin Towers stand as two dark outlines against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in THIRTY8, guests look across a clear morning to the Petronas Twin Towers, sharp in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 39th-floor sky lobby, guests arriving at midday see the whole Kuala Lumpur skyline under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the Grand Club watch cloud shadows move over KLCC Park this morning, with the Petronas Twin Towers in sunshine above it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: White clouds pass the Petronas Twin Towers this afternoon, and the towers change from bright to grey and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Kuala Lumpur skyline loses its shine, but the Petronas Twin Towers still stand clear above the other roofs.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and from THIRTY8 the Petronas Twin Towers look like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: guests in the sky lobby see the Petronas Twin Towers, but the distant parts of the city are not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of THIRTY8, and guests watch the Petronas Twin Towers turn soft and grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Kuala Lumpur, and for a second guests see the Petronas Twin Towers turn white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the Petronas Twin Towers, and guests at the sky lobby windows take photos to prove it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, and the Petronas Twin Towers show every detail to guests looking out from the Grand Club.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay on the warm side of the glass in THIRTY8 and follow the full circle of the city skyline.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the city streets, while guests in the cool Grand Club look across at the Petronas Twin Towers in strong sunlight.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, KLCC Park is bright green beneath the Petronas Twin Towers, and guests in rooms facing the towers see both.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Through the windows of THIRTY8, KL Tower stands against a golden sky as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds turn orange around the Petronas Twin Towers, and guests crossing the sky lobby stop to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Petronas Twin Towers glow white, and guests in the Grand Club watch them over a drink.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the city this evening, and the lights of the Petronas Twin Towers spread across the wet glass of THIRTY8.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit Petronas Twin Towers colour the low clouds above them, seen from the suite windows.
phrases.clear_night: The Petronas Twin Towers are fully lit against a clear night sky, and guests checking in at the reception desk turn round to look.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city below is quiet, and the Petronas Twin Towers wait outside the sky lobby windows for morning.
phrases.dusk: Guests in the 411 rooms watch the first city lights come on under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear and the Angel of Independence is a dark shape against the first pale light.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Club Millésime, guests look out at the Angel of Independence in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Angel of Independence stands bright above the trees, seen from the terrace suites.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move along Paseo de la Reforma this morning, and the Angel of Independence goes from shade to sun and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the 40th floor ballroom, guests see patches of sun and cloud shadow crossing Mexico City this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, guests on the gym treadmills face the wide Mexico City skyline through tall windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Mexico City today, and from Cityzen Rooftop Bar the trees of Chapultepec fade to a pale green.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: Chapultepec Castle is not visible, but the Angel of Independence is still clear from the corner rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows of the indoor pool, and swimmers watch the Mexico City skyline turn grey and soft.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Mexico City, and guests in the Opera Suite watch the storm from the bathtub, the Angel of Independence in front of them.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Paseo de la Reforma, and guests in Club Millésime leave their coffee to watch it drift past the Angel of Independence.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is freezing and clear; guests in the indoor pool look far across Mexico City, every tower sharp.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in this hotel of 275 rooms stay behind the glass and look along Paseo de la Reforma to Chapultepec Castle.
phrases.very_hot: The heat sits over Mexico City, and guests choose to look at the bright skyline from the cool indoor pool.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the terrace of Cityzen Rooftop Bar fills up, and Chapultepec lies green beyond the treetops of Reforma.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Cityzen Rooftop Bar, guests watch the low sun turn the Reforma treetops gold, with Chapultepec beyond.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the Angel of Independence, which fills the window of the corner rooms.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Angel of Independence glows below the windows of Club Millésime.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Mexico City blur on the ballroom's tall windows, and Paseo de la Reforma shines below.
phrases.mild_night: From Cityzen Rooftop Bar on this mild night, the city lights colour the low clouds above Chapultepec.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Angel of Independence is lit above the avenue, and guests count the lights of Mexico City spreading behind it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Angel of Independence keeps its place above a quiet Paseo de la Reforma.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from Cityzen Rooftop Bar the first lights appear along Paseo de la Reforma.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dolomites stand as a dark shape at the far side of the Seiser Alm meadow, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the flat top of the Schlern first, and guests on their balconies watch the light move down the rock.
phrases.clear_midday: From the terrace, the level meadow runs unbroken to the Schlern, the Sassolungo and the Sella under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past the Sassolungo this morning, while the meadow below the terrace stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the Seiser Alm this afternoon, and the Sella goes from grey to bright and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Dolomites keep every edge, and the Sassolungo restaurant still has its peak in the windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist lies low on the Seiser Alm today, and only the jagged tops of the Sassolungo show above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Sella is not visible today; from the terrace, guests see the meadow and the pine trees and a faint outline of the Schlern.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Seiser Alm; guests watch it through the panoramic windows, the Dolomites slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls across the Seiser Alm, and lightning shows the Dolomites for a second through the glass of the indoor pool.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the meadow, and the Dolomites fade to soft grey behind it, seen from the glazed indoor pool.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so every crack in the Dolomites rock looks sharp from the spa windows.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the panoramic windows and look straight across the meadow to the Dolomites.
phrases.very_hot: In the 7-metre outdoor pool, guests cool off in the meadow's open air and look across at the Dolomites.
phrases.warm: On the terrace sofas, books stay closed while guests look at the Schlern rising beyond the pine trees.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Dolomites gold, and guests on the terrace follow the long shadows across the Seiser Alm.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and colours the Sassolungo, a show that guests in the Sassolungo restaurant see through its windows.
phrases.grey_evening: After sunset, cloud hides the tops of the Dolomites, and guests at the Sassolungo restaurant see only the lower rock above the meadow through its windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Seiser Alm this evening, and the Dolomites are lost in the dark beyond the wet meadow.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests on their balconies can still make out the Dolomites across the meadow.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the Seiser Alm at 1,800 metres, and the Dolomites cut a jagged edge into them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Seiser Alm is quiet, and the Dolomites wait in the dark across the meadow.
phrases.dusk: At dusk, the Dolomites turn pink under a violet sky, and the still water of the indoor pool reflects them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Still dark, the Arc de Triomphe is a heavy shape against a sky that is only starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the garden-facing rooms open the curtains to the Eiffel Tower standing in full morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The Arc de Triomphe stands in full sun, pale stone against a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: One minute the Eiffel Tower is in sunshine, the next in shade, as clouds cross Paris.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests see the Arc de Triomphe bright against a grey cloud, then grey against a bright one.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey ceiling of cloud, the Eiffel Tower looks drawn in pencil.
phrases.fog_haze: For guests in the garden-facing rooms, today's haze turns the Eiffel Tower into a pale outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Arc de Triomphe is pale in the thick air today, and the Eiffel Tower is only a faint shape.
phrases.rain: Guests watch the rain fall in front of the Eiffel Tower, which looks softer and further away.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests watch the thunderstorm pass over the Arc de Triomphe, which is dark under the heavy cloud.
phrases.snow: White flakes drift past the Arc de Triomphe, and guests watch from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_cold: The Eiffel Tower is sharp in the freezing air, a view that guests in the garden-facing rooms enjoy without a coat.
phrases.cold: Scarves are out on the streets today, while the Arc de Triomphe looks just as good from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the rooftops, and the Eiffel Tower seems to tremble a little behind it.
phrases.warm: A day for short sleeves, and guests take their time looking at the Arc de Triomphe.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun gives the Arc de Triomphe a warm gold colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The Arc de Triomphe catches the last sun of the day between two clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: This evening the Arc de Triomphe is a solid grey block under the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain tonight makes the Arc de Triomphe look darker and a little further away.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud hangs over the Eiffel Tower tonight, and the whole of it still shows.
phrases.clear_night: With the night so clear, the Eiffel Tower is easy to follow from its feet to its tip.
phrases.late_night: Paris has gone quiet, and the Eiffel Tower is a tall dark shape for guests who are still awake.
phrases.dusk: Guests stop to look at the Eiffel Tower in the last light, with the sky still bright behind it.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the stepped terraces, the sky over Göreme turns pale in the east, and the first hot-air balloons rise from the valley floor.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Moniq, guests watch the hot-air balloons over Göreme drift up Pigeon Valley, growing from dots into a full procession.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Pigeon Valley shows every fold of its rock from the tables of Moniq.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Pigeon Valley this morning, and the hot-air balloons over Göreme pass in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the gardens, patches of sun and shade cross the fairy chimneys one by one on their way toward Göreme.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the rock of Pigeon Valley takes the same soft colour, and the fairy chimneys stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills Pigeon Valley today, and guests in Moniq see only the tops of the nearest fairy chimneys above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Göreme is not visible from the stepped terraces today; the view stops at the near side of Pigeon Valley and its first fairy chimneys.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of the east-facing rooms, and guests look out at Pigeon Valley, where the wet rock has turned darker.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole of Pigeon Valley for a second, then the fairy chimneys disappear again behind the rain as the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Pigeon Valley, and guests in this former vineyard house watch from their windows as the fairy chimneys turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests in Moniq can follow Pigeon Valley all the way toward Göreme without going outside.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps the gardens quiet, and Pigeon Valley lies open and empty below them toward Göreme.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay under the garden umbrellas and look across at the fairy chimneys, which have no shade at all.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the sun loungers in the gardens look over Pigeon Valley and its fairy chimneys, books forgotten.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun colours the fairy chimneys of Pigeon Valley gold, and guests in the bars turn their chairs toward Göreme.
phrases.partly_golden: From the private terraces of the terrace suites, the last sun comes through the clouds and lights one side of Pigeon Valley at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, distant town lights glow beyond Pigeon Valley, seen from the stepped terraces.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and from the bars the lights in the valley below look soft and blurred.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so the few lights in Pigeon Valley are the only points to follow from the gardens.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, stars fill the sky above Pigeon Valley, and from the rooftop terrace the town lights look small beneath them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Pigeon Valley is dark and silent, and the hot-air balloons over Göreme are still some hours away.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, guests in the bars watch the first lights come on in the valley below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Burj Khalifa stands as a dark needle over the Downtown Dubai skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Urban Suite open the curtains to the Burj Khalifa, already bright in the first sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At Tapasake, guests sit facing the Dubai skyline under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Dubai Frame this morning, while Za'abeel Park stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Villa One Penthouse, guests watch the Emirates Towers go from shade to sun and back again.
phrases.overcast: The Burj Khalifa rises pale grey over the Financial District skyline today, its tip close to the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Dubai skyline today, and the Burj Khalifa shows as a faint outline above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Financial District skyline is clear enough, but the modern Marina area is not in sight.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of the Urban Suite, and guests see the Downtown Dubai skyline slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the city, and guests in the Villa One Penthouse watch the lightning above the Emirates Towers.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling across the city view, and guests in the Urban Suite stay warm inside to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: Guests keep to the warm side of the glass in the Villa One Penthouse, with the Burj Khalifa sharp in the cold air.
phrases.cold: Guests stay indoors today and look across Za'abeel Park to the Dubai Frame.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the Tapasake Pool and look out at the Dubai skyline.
phrases.warm: Guests float in the pool with the city view spread out below them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the Burj Khalifa gold, floor by floor.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights the Emirates Towers, while the Financial District skyline waits in shade.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the Financial District skyline shine through tonight's rain, each tower a little blurred.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in the Villa One Penthouse leave the curtains open tonight for the lit Burj Khalifa.
phrases.clear_night: The Burj Khalifa is lit from base to tip tonight, with the Downtown Dubai skyline bright at its feet.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests in the Urban Suite sleep while the Burj Khalifa stands as a tall shadow over the city.
phrases.dusk: The Tapasake Pool faces a Dubai skyline just starting to light up, the sky behind it still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: No sun yet, and the Tokyo skyline is a field of dark towers under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Mount Fuji stands small and sharp behind the Tokyo skyline this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At Sushi Shin by Miyakawa, guests eat lunch with a clear view of the Tokyo Skytree.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass behind the Tokyo Skytree this morning, while most of the Tokyo skyline stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sunlight travel from tower to tower across the Tokyo skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey ceiling, the Tokyo skyline shows every roof and tower in the same soft light.
phrases.fog_haze: Mount Fuji is hidden by haze today, and the Tokyo skyline grows pale beyond the nearer towers.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Tokyo skyline is not visible today; guests on the upper floors see only the nearer towers clearly.
phrases.rain: Soft and grey in the rain, the Tokyo skyline loses its far towers one by one.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the upper floors, guests watch lightning show the Tokyo skyline for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow drifts past the upper floors, and guests stay inside to watch the Tokyo skyline turn white roof by roof.
phrases.very_cold: Today the air is so clear that the Tokyo skyline can be followed all the way to Mount Fuji.
phrases.cold: On a day for staying indoors, the Tokyo Skytree stands thin and clear above the rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the upper floors of the Nihonbashi Mitsui Tower stay in the cool and look out over the Tokyo skyline.
phrases.warm: The Tokyo Skytree rises above the Tokyo skyline in the warm light, easy to find from this height.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Glass towers across the Tokyo skyline turn gold one after another as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: Low sun finds the gaps in the cloud and lights the Tokyo skyline a few towers at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Evening guests at Sushi Shin by Miyakawa see the Tokyo Skytree lit below a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight's rain softens the lights of the Tokyo Skytree for guests at dinner in Sushi Shin by Miyakawa.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the lights of the Tokyo skyline reach as far as guests on the upper floors can see.
phrases.clear_night: The Tokyo skyline is lit all the way to the horizon tonight, and the Tokyo Skytree stands bright above it.
phrases.late_night: While most guests sleep, the Tokyo skyline lies wide and quiet below the Nihonbashi Mitsui Tower.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind Mount Fuji as the first lights appear across the Tokyo skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Atlantic Ocean lies grey below the hillside, and the slope of Lion's Head is only beginning to show.
phrases.clear_morning: From the pool terrace, this clear morning shows the whole coast, from Clifton's beaches to Camps Bay.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Atlantic Ocean is a strong blue, and from the pool terrace the pool water and the horizon seem to meet.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across Lion's Head this morning, while Camps Bay stays in sunshine across the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Sculpture Garden, cloud shadows cross the Atlantic Ocean this afternoon, passing slowly behind the artworks.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlantic Ocean turns the colour of slate, and Camps Bay sits quietly in the middle distance.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so from the pool terrace the Atlantic Ocean fades into the sky without a line.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Camps Bay is not visible today; the view ends at Clifton's beaches, just below the hillside.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in the terrace suites watch it through the glass, Camps Bay blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests count the seconds after each flash that lights Bantry Bay, until thunder rolls in from the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.snow: Guests at the bay windows watch snow fall towards the Atlantic Ocean, while Lion's Head slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear today, and Camps Bay shows sharply across the water from the gym's floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the pool terrace is empty, and the Atlantic Ocean beyond it shows every wave clearly.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool of Villa Two and look across the Atlantic Ocean without leaving the water.
phrases.warm: Warm air brings guests out to the loungers on the pool terrace, where the Atlantic Ocean fills the space between the palm trees.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Atlantic Ocean gold, and guests on the ocean-facing balconies of this 1906 mansion watch it happen.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds, and from the terrace the Atlantic Ocean glows orange on the horizon.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and the lights of Camps Bay make a warm row across the dark water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass tonight, and the lights of Camps Bay shake and spread behind it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the Atlantic Ocean is dark, and the glow of Camps Bay rests under the low cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Guests looking out tonight find stars above Lion's Head and, below them, the lights of Camps Bay along the shore.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Atlantic Ocean is more heard than seen, and Lion's Head is a dark shape against the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright above the Atlantic Ocean, and from the terrace the first lights appear along the Bantry Bay coastline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon lies still under a clear sky, with the first light low over the water.
phrases.clear_morning: At Alba, guests take breakfast looking over the pool and the beach in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is bright turquoise right up to the white sand.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon this morning, changing the turquoise patch by patch.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the treatment rooms at Iridium Spa, guests watch clouds drift over the Indian Ocean this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon loses its turquoise and takes a soft silver colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so from the Whale Bar the Indian Ocean and the sky look like one sheet.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is not visible today; guests see clear water close by and a blur beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and guests in the overwater villas watch the drops land through the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Indian Ocean, and guests in the beach villas see the lightning through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and guests in all 77 villas go to the windows to believe it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold today, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon looks sharp and clear under the bright sky.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps the beach empty, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon lies quiet without a single swimmer.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests lie in the nets of the overwater villas and look down into the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the beach watch swimmers and paddleboards cross the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Whale Bar at the island's western tip, guests watch the sun drop toward the Indian Ocean in a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between clouds over the Indian Ocean, while at the Whale Bar the champagne sabre waits for its moment.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is a quiet, dark surface beyond the beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Indian Ocean this evening, and guests at dinner in the Whale Bar see only the nearest water.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hide the stars, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon shows only where the villa lights touch it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the Indian Ocean tonight, and the horizon disappears into the dark.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is nearly invisible, and only the sound of water tells guests it is there.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Indian Ocean, and guests at the Whale Bar, a WOW Architects design, stay for the colours.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is a wide dark surface beyond South Beach, and the sky above it is just starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At Veranda, guests have breakfast beside the pool while the morning sun shines on the ocean behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic is bright turquoise at midday, and the white sand of South Beach shines under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: From the wraparound balcony of the corner suite, guests watch cloud shadows move across the Atlantic this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over South Beach this afternoon, and the ocean changes from turquoise to deep blue as they pass.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic turns the colour of steel, and the red-and-white umbrellas on the sand are the brightest thing in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the ocean and the sky above South Beach look like one sheet of soft grey.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the pool terrace, guests cannot see the horizon today; only the sand of South Beach and the nearest waves are clear.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on South Beach, and from the Faena Penthouse Suite guests watch grey showers move in across the Atlantic.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic, and for a moment the wet sand of South Beach is as bright as at midday.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on South Beach, and the palm trees below look as surprised as the guests.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, and guests see a sharp blue horizon beyond the empty sand of South Beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the pool terrace is quiet, and the ocean behind it is a darker blue than usual.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay under the red-and-white umbrellas by the pool and look at the turquoise ocean beyond the sand.
phrases.warm: By the pool, guests look past Damien Hirst's golden mammoth to the warm blue water off South Beach, and the mammoth does not seem to mind.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the pool terrace late in the afternoon, and the ocean behind the palm trees turns a softer blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests in the bay view rooms watch the clouds turn orange above Biscayne Bay and downtown.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud the ocean is dark, and the lights along South Beach give the low sky a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights along South Beach blur, and the Atlantic beyond them is heard more than seen.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the surf off South Beach shows as moving white lines in the dark.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests can count stars above the Atlantic while the lights of South Beach follow the shore.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the pool is still, South Beach is empty, and the Atlantic is a black space beyond the sand.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Atlantic is still pink, and the first lights come on along South Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Mount Etna is a dark shape against a clear sky, and the Ionian Sea below is still without colour.
phrases.clear_morning: From the terrace restaurant, the Ionian Sea is calm and blue this morning, with pink bougainvillea in front of it.
phrases.clear_midday: From the terrace restaurant, the Ionian Sea, Isola Bella and the Calabrian coast are all clear under the midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Ionian Sea this morning, while Isola Bella stays in sunshine below the pool sun deck.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds gather around the top of Mount Etna this afternoon, and the rest of the mountain stays in the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the Ionian Sea turns the colour of slate, and Isola Bella is a dark green mark on it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Ionian Sea today, and from the pool sun deck Isola Bella looks faint and far below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Calabrian coast is not visible today; the view from the terrace restaurant ends at Isola Bella and the near water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Ionian Sea, and guests watch it from the spa jacuzzi, warm under the glass dome.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Mount Etna for a second at a time, and thunder rolls across the Ionian Sea.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Taormina, and guests watch from their balcony doors as Mount Etna disappears behind the white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air Mount Etna stands sharp against the sky, and guests look at it from behind the glass.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the spa jacuzzi is the popular seat, with the Ionian Sea spread out beyond it.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the pool sun deck stay under the striped umbrellas and look down at the Ionian Sea.
phrases.warm: On the pool sun deck, books stay closed while guests look at Isola Bella and the warm blue water around it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light falls on Isola Bella and its bay, and the Calabrian coast shows clearly across the Ionian Sea.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Mount Etna turn orange, and guests in this early 1900s villa stop to look.
