phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the coastal town curve around Isola Bella bay below the terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the coast this evening, and the Ionian Sea beyond them is black.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the balcony rooms guests see the coast lights along Isola Bella bay.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, lights along the Calabrian coast shine across the dark Ionian Sea.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Ionian Sea is dark and quiet, and Isola Bella is hardly visible on it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky over Mount Etna is still bright, and the first lights appear around Isola Bella bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea below the Vettica Maggiore cliffs is still and grey-blue, and Positano Hillside is only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests wake to a clear morning, with the houses on Positano Hillside showing sharply across the open sea.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sea is bright blue below the terraces of the 37 rooms, and Positano Hillside stands clear beyond it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the open sea this morning, while Positano Hillside stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace lounge, guests follow the clouds drifting over the coastal mountains and the sea this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the sea turns the colour of slate, and Positano Hillside looks quieter across the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Positano Hillside today, and the line between sea and sky is difficult to find.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Positano Hillside is not visible today; the view ends at the sea just below the cliffs.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the open sea; guests watch it from their room windows, Positano Hillside blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the sea, and each flash of lightning shows Positano Hillside for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling into the sea below the cliffs, and Positano Hillside fades behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, guests stay behind the wide window of the terrace lounge and look at the calm sea.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the lemon pergola is empty, yet the sea and the coastal cliffs beyond it are clear.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool and look up at the cliffside mountains from the water.
phrases.warm: On the dining terrace, conversation stops for a moment while guests look at the blue sea and the rocky coastline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the sea terrace of the Angelina Suite, Positano Hillside turns gold in the late sun.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests watch the last sun slip between the clouds, and a band of light crosses the sea toward Positano Hillside.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, sea and sky become one dark colour, and Positano Hillside glows between them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows tonight, and the lights of Positano Hillside tremble across the wet sea.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud hides the stars on this mild night, so the lights of Positano Hillside are the only ones over the sea.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the sea, and Positano Hillside answers with its own lights.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the sea is black and quiet below the cliffs, and Positano Hillside sleeps across the water.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests count the first lights appearing on Positano Hillside.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Positano Hillside is a dark shape above the Tyrrhenian Sea, under a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the stacked houses of the Positano Hillside, and the Tyrrhenian Sea below them is already bright blue.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Positano Hillside shows every window and every step between its houses.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Positano Hillside this morning, while the dome of the Church of Santa Maria Assunta stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the clouds keep changing the colour of the Tyrrhenian Sea, and guests on the sea-view terrace of La Sponda follow each change.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Tyrrhenian Sea turns to the colour of metal, and the stacked houses of the Positano Hillside stand out above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Positano Hillside today, and from the balcony rooms the Tyrrhenian Sea has no clear horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the Positano Hillside is faint today, so guests look at the nearer houses and the dome of the Church of Santa Maria Assunta.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Positano Hillside, and guests watch from their sea-facing rooms as the stacked houses shine with water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Positano Hillside for a second, then thunder rolls across the Tyrrhenian Sea.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Positano Hillside, and the stacked houses slowly turn white above the Tyrrhenian Sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and from a warm room guests can count the houses of the Positano Hillside one by one.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Tyrrhenian Sea is dark blue and the Positano Hillside looks sharp above it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay by the pool among the lemon trees and look across at the Positano Hillside.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the Tyrrhenian Sea is calm, and guests at the pool watch boats cross below the Positano Hillside.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the houses of the Positano Hillside gold, and guests in the terrace suites stay outside to see it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Tyrrhenian Sea turn orange, and the dome of the Church of Santa Maria Assunta shines below them.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner on the sea-view terrace of La Sponda, guests see the lights of the Positano Hillside under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Positano Hillside this evening, and guests at Aldo's Cocktail Bar and Seafood Grill watch it fall on the Tyrrhenian Sea.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night without stars, the lights of the Positano Hillside do the work, and guests at La Sponda have 400 candles to help.
phrases.clear_night: From Aldo's Cocktail Bar and Seafood Grill, guests look at a clear night sky over the Tyrrhenian Sea, and the Positano Hillside is lit beside it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Positano Hillside is a quiet outline above the Tyrrhenian Sea.
phrases.dusk: In this hotel opened in 1951, guests at dusk still stop to see the first lights come on across the Positano Hillside.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Arno River lies still and grey below the river-facing balconies, and the bridges wait for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the red dome of the Duomo first, then moves down across the rooftops to the Arno River.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in SE·STO on Arno, guests have Ponte Vecchio, the Duomo and Palazzo Vecchio in view from one table.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Arno River this morning, and Ponte Vecchio goes from bright to dull and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, clouds drift over the Duomo while the Tuscan hills beyond stay in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Arno River turns the same colour, and the red dome of the Duomo stands out above the rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Arno River today, and Ponte Vecchio looks like a pencil drawing of itself.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The hills beyond the city are not visible today, but the Duomo and the nearer bridges on the Arno River can still be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass walls of SE·STO on Arno, and guests see the Duomo slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the rooftops, and for a second the Duomo shows clearly through the glass of the 6th-floor restaurant.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the rooftops of Florence, and the red dome of the Duomo slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests stay behind the floor-to-ceiling glass of the 6th floor and see the Duomo in sharp detail.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the Arno-facing suites look at Ponte Vecchio from the warm side of the window.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Arno River hardly seems to move, and guests on the rooftop terrace look at the Duomo from the shade.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace, guests keep turning from the Duomo to the Arno River and back, in no hurry to leave.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Arno River to gold, and guests in the Penthouse Suite watch the bridges from their private terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and lights the dome of the Duomo, seen from the rooftop terrace above the city rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Ponte Vecchio shine on the Arno River, seen from the 6th floor of this 1863 hotel.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, dinner guests at SE·STO on Arno see the lit dome of the Duomo through raindrops on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the lights of the bridges follow the Arno River under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lit Duomo stands above the dark rooftops, and Palazzo Vecchio shares the same frame.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Arno River moves quietly below the windows, and the bridges are dark shapes across it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still pink over the Arno River, and the first lights come on along the bridges towards Ponte Vecchio.

phrases.clear_predawn: Notre-Dame is a dark shape above the Seine, with the first pale light showing behind the Paris rooftops.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning guests at Bonnie Restaurant look out at the Paris monuments under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests have a clear view of the Eiffel Tower at midday, with the Seine shining below.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Paris rooftops this morning, seen from the Atelier Suite.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud shadow pass over the Paris monuments, in full view of guests at Bonnie Restaurant.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Notre-Dame and the Seine are still easy to see in the wide view of Paris.
phrases.fog_haze: In today's haze, the Eiffel Tower is a faint outline and the Seine below is pale silver.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Poor visibility today leaves the Seine in view just below, while the Eiffel Tower is too faint to pick out.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the SO/ Paris Suite, and guests see the Eiffel Tower slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Atelier Suite watch lightning flash over the wet Paris rooftops.
phrases.snow: White flakes drift past Notre-Dame and vanish into the Seine, while guests stay warm behind the glass.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air makes the Eiffel Tower look very sharp, and guests in the SO/ Paris Suite enjoy it from indoors.
phrases.cold: Notre-Dame stands over the Seine in plain daylight, and guests take their time looking from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: Guests look down on the Seine, bright in the strong sun, with the Eiffel Tower standing beyond it.
phrases.warm: Guests count the Paris monuments along the Seine one by one, starting with Notre-Dame.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the stone of Notre-Dame warm and puts a long bright path on the Seine.
phrases.partly_golden: From the SO/ Paris Suite, guests see the Eiffel Tower dark against orange clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests at Bonnie Restaurant this evening look out at the Paris monuments under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests watch the rain fall on the Seine tonight, with the Eiffel Tower lit behind it.
phrases.mild_night: In the SO/ Paris Suite, guests look out at the lit Eiffel Tower under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: Notre-Dame, the Seine and the Eiffel Tower share one panoramic view tonight, each easy to find in the clear dark.
phrases.late_night: Guests still awake in the small hours see the Seine and the dark shape of Notre-Dame.
phrases.dusk: Guests watch the first lights come on along the Seine, with Notre-Dame against a still-bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Zurich lies still and grey-blue, and the Alps slowly take shape behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Lake Zurich, and from the rooftop terrace the Alps stand clear behind the water.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Lake Zurich is deep blue and the Alps look close enough to count peak by peak.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Alps this morning, while Lake Zurich keeps a patch of sunshine for itself.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in rooms facing the city watch cloud shadows move slowly across the Zurich rooftops this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Lake Zurich turns the colour of slate, and the Alps are only a faint outline.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Lake Zurich today, and from VIEW Rooftop only the near shore shows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests cannot see the Alps today; the view stops at Lake Zurich and the nearest rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Zurich rooftops, and guests watch it from their balcony rooms with the doors closed.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests watch from indoors as lightning flashes over Lake Zurich and the water turns white for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Zurich Opera House, and guests in the suite facing it watch the roof turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, the Alps look newly drawn behind Lake Zurich, every ridge easy to follow.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look through the windows at a steel-blue Lake Zurich and keep their coats for later.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the rooftop terrace look at Lake Zurich and think seriously about jumping in.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit on the rooftop terrace with a cold drink while Lake Zurich shines below the Alps.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the rooftop terrace of this neo-baroque building, Lake Zurich turns gold in the low sun, the Alps behind it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and a church spire and the city skyline glow in the golden light.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the city reflect softly on Lake Zurich.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the lights around Lake Zurich blur behind the weather.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the night sky, and Lake Zurich is a wide black space between the lights of its two shores.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests see the shore lights circle Lake Zurich, with stars above where the Alps stand.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Zurich is quiet and black, and the rooftops around it barely show.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over Lake Zurich, and from VIEW Rooftop the first lights appear along the shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the towers of the Perth skyline stand as dark shapes against a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the stone of Saint Mary's Cathedral, bright and clear for guests in the rooms facing it.
phrases.clear_midday: From the heated infinity pool, the Perth skyline stands sharp against a clear blue sky at midday.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Perth skyline this morning, and their shadows move slowly from one tower to the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Saint Mary's Cathedral sits in a patch of afternoon sun while clouds pass over the city towers behind it.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the glass towers of the Perth skyline turn grey too, and Saint Mary's Cathedral looks darker.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Perth skyline today, and the far towers look like they were drawn in pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far towers of the Perth skyline are not clear today, but Saint Mary's Cathedral is still easy to see.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of the corner suites, and the Perth skyline behind it turns soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Perth skyline, and for a second every tower stands out against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Saint Mary's Cathedral, and guests stand at their windows to watch it settle on the roof.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Perth skyline stands clear and sharp beyond the edge of the heated infinity pool.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look at the Perth skyline from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the heated infinity pool and look at the Perth skyline from the water.
phrases.warm: Guests rest by the heated infinity pool on this warm day, books closed, eyes on the Perth skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun warms the glass towers of the Perth skyline, seen from the 20-metre heated infinity pool.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds above Saint Mary's Cathedral, and guests in the corner suites stop to watch.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit towers of the Perth skyline give the low clouds a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Perth skyline spread and blur across the wet window glass.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in this 2019 hotel look out at the lit Perth skyline under a mild, cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: The Perth skyline shines under a clear night sky, each lit tower easy to tell from the next.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Perth skyline is quiet and still, and Saint Mary's Cathedral rests below it.
phrases.dusk: Guests at the edge of the heated infinity pool watch the first lights come on across the Perth skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Cascais Bay is still and dark under a clear sky, and the first light is only beginning over the Atlantic.
phrases.clear_morning: From the terrace rooms, guests open the balcony door to a clear morning over Cascais Bay.
phrases.clear_midday: The 3rd-floor infinity pool and the Atlantic share the same blue at midday, and it is not easy to say where one ends.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Cascais Bay this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Atlantic changes colour each time a cloud passes, green in the shade and blue in the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Cascais Bay turns the colour of pewter, and the Atlantic horizon is a thin line beyond it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Cascais Bay today, and from the infinity pool the Atlantic seems to end only a short way out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Cascais Bay is not visible today, and guests see only the nearer water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Cascais Bay, and guests watch the Atlantic turn grey from indoors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic, and for a second all of Cascais Bay shows white from the Royal Suite terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Cascais Bay, and guests watch the flakes vanish into the Atlantic.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear today, and every wave on Cascais Bay stands out sharply from the 9th-floor terrace of the Royal Suite.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Cascais Bay is a deep, dark blue, and guests see the Atlantic beyond it looking colder still.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look straight out at the Atlantic.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the loungers by the infinity pool forget their books and look at Cascais Bay instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Cascais Bay gold, and the 180-degree view from the Royal Suite terrace holds all of it in a single sweep.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Atlantic turn pink and orange, and Cascais Bay copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in the Gourmet restaurant, guests look out at the dark ocean under cloud and the bright lights of Cascais town.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Cascais Bay this evening, and the lights of Cascais town blur into soft spots above the black water.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of Cascais town curve around the bay, and the Atlantic beyond them is completely dark.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of Cascais town are reflected in the bay as long, trembling lines.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Cascais Bay is quiet and almost black, and the Atlantic is more a sound than a sight.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Atlantic is still bright, and the first lights of Cascais town come on around the bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky slowly turns pale above São Jorge Castle, and the Tagus River is a darker band beyond the rooftops.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the red roofs of Lisbon, and São Jorge Castle stands clear on its hill above them.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, SEEN Sky Bar shows Avenida da Liberdade below, São Jorge Castle in the middle distance and the Tagus River beyond.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests watch cloud shadows move across the rooftops this morning, while São Jorge Castle goes from sun to shade and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Presidential Suite, guests follow the clouds as they pass over Avenida da Liberdade, the city centre and the Tagus River.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Tagus River turns silver-grey, and Christ the King stands small at the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Guests looking for Christ the King find only haze today, and São Jorge Castle is a soft outline above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests on the rooftop cannot see the Tagus River or Christ the King today; the city is visible only as far as São Jorge Castle.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of the river view rooms, and downtown and the Tagus River blur into one grey picture.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Avenida da Liberdade, and each flash of lightning shows São Jorge Castle on its hill for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the trees of Avenida da Liberdade, and guests in the avenue view rooms watch the boulevard turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, every wall of São Jorge Castle looks sharp, and Christ the King is easy to find at the horizon.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps guests behind the windows of the Beatriz Costa Suite, where the city roofs spread out below.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests at SEEN Sky Bar hold cold cocktails and look at the Tagus River, which looks much cooler than the rooftop.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the open terrace of SEEN Sky Bar look across the red roofs to São Jorge Castle and the Tagus River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on São Jorge Castle late this afternoon, seen from the rooftop of a hotel that opened on Avenida da Liberdade in 1933.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Tagus River turn orange and pink, and SEEN Sky Bar faces them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, São Jorge Castle is lit on its hill, and the city lights give the low sky a soft orange colour.
phrases.wet_evening: At dinner in SEEN Lisboa, guests watch the rain fall on the lights of Lisbon below.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit walls of São Jorge Castle stand out, and the Tagus River shows only where the lights stop.
phrases.clear_night: Guests at SEEN Lisboa have Lisbon at their feet tonight, every street light sharp under a clear sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Avenida da Liberdade is quiet below, and São Jorge Castle is only a dark shape on its hill.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Tagus River, and the first lights come on along Avenida da Liberdade below SEEN Sky Bar.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Caribbean Sea is a dark, calm surface beyond the private beach, under a clear sky that is slowly turning lighter.
phrases.clear_morning: From their terraces, guests in the oceanfront swim-out suites look across an infinity-style pool to the Caribbean Sea in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Caribbean Sea turns bright turquoise behind the swim-up seats of Vistas Pool Bar.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning clouds move over the Caribbean Sea, and their shadows cross the water in front of the oval pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Docks at the main pool, guests see the Caribbean Sea change from turquoise to deep blue as afternoon clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the Caribbean Sea turns grey-green, and the golden sand of the secluded beach looks paler.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the line between sea and sky today, so the Caribbean Sea seems to have no end beyond the beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; the horizon is not visible, and guests see only the palm trees and the nearest part of the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Caribbean Sea, and the water turns grey beyond the wet palm trees of the private beach.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Caribbean Sea, and guests count the seconds before the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees and the golden sand, and the Caribbean Sea beyond them is almost hidden behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing today, and the Caribbean Sea beyond the palm trees looks sharp and blue under a bright sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look at the Caribbean Sea from behind the windows of their ocean-view suites.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the water at Vistas Pool Bar and look at the Caribbean Sea with a cold drink in hand.
phrases.warm: At the main pool, guests at Docks hold tropical drinks and forget them while they look at the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the palm trees and the private beach, and the Caribbean Sea turns a deeper blue behind them.
phrases.partly_golden: At Mixology Corner 14/50, guests watch the last sunlight colour the clouds above the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests at Mixology Corner 14/50 take their cocktails with the Caribbean Sea in front of them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Caribbean Sea this evening, and guests watch it from their tables at Vora Mar.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests on their suite terraces see the white edges of the waves on the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.clear_night: Stars shine over the Caribbean Sea tonight, and no other resort lights break the dark coastline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the secluded beach is empty and the Caribbean Sea is only a darker area under the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright above the Caribbean Sea while the first lights come on around the oval pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Nile is a wide grey curve under a clear sky, and the Zamalek embankment is only starting to take shape.
phrases.clear_morning: On this clear morning the outline of the Giza Pyramids appears behind the rooflines to the west.
phrases.clear_midday: From Botanica 25 on the upper floor, guests follow the Nile under a clear sky and find the Giza Pyramids on the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Nile this morning, and the Zamalek embankment goes from bright to dull and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the restaurant windows watch patches of sun cross the Nile between the afternoon clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky the Nile turns the colour of slate, and the Zamalek embankment stands out clearly above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Nile today, and from Botanica 25 the Zamalek embankment looks like a pencil drawing above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Giza Pyramids are not visible today; the Nile and the Zamalek embankment are clear, and the city behind them fades out.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Nile, and through the glass of Botanica 25 the Zamalek embankment looks slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole bend of the Nile for a second, then the river disappears into the storm again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Nile, and guests stand at the glass in Botanica 25 to watch the flakes vanish into the water.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air makes the Zamalek embankment sharp across the Nile, and guests admire it from behind glass.
phrases.cold: Guests in this 1975 tower look down on a cold, steel-coloured Nile and the Zamalek embankment beyond it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the private balconies last a few minutes with the Nile before the air conditioning wins.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit out on their balconies and follow the wide bend of the Nile from one end to the other.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Nile gold, and from Botanica 25 guests look west to the Giza Pyramids on the horizon.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lays strips of orange light along the Nile and the Zamalek embankment.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Zamalek embankment line the far side of the Nile.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the restaurant watch the lights of the Zamalek embankment stretch and shake on the wet Nile this evening.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night the Nile carries the reflections of the city lights around its wide bend.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and from the balcony rooms guests see the Zamalek embankment lit along the black Nile.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Nile is a broad dark band, and 665 rooms share one quiet river.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Nile, and guests in Botanica 25 see the first lights come on along the Zamalek embankment.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests in the 7 east-facing panoramic waterfront suites see the Bay Bridge as a dark shape above the water.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun rises behind the Bay Bridge, and the water in front of the Terrene patio turns bright under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Ferry Building clock tower stands sharp against the blue from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: From the terrace suites, guests watch sun and cloud take turns over the water and the North Bay this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Bay Bridge moves in and out of cloud shadow this afternoon, with patches of sunlight crossing the bay below it.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Bay Bridge and the bay take the same colour, seen from the Terrene patio.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the far end of the Bay Bridge today, so from the panoramic waterfront suites it seems to stop in mid-air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the bay is not visible today, but the Ferry Building clock tower is close enough to stay clear from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Embarcadero waterfront, and guests in the panoramic waterfront suites watch it through 180-degree windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in a treatment room at Bamford Wellness Spa see lightning flash over the water behind the Bay Bridge.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftop terrace, and the Ferry Building clock tower shows faintly through the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and guests can read the time on the Ferry Building clock tower without trying.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay in a glass-walled seating nook and look out at the Ferry Building clock tower.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the terrace of Bamford Wellness Spa rest among the plants and look out at the skyline.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit on the Terrene patio with the Bay Bridge and the Ferry Building clock tower both in sight.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Ferry Building clock tower gold, and from the Terrene patio it looks close enough to be a neighbour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the edges of the clouds above the skyline, seen from the terrace of Bamford Wellness Spa.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the fire pits on the Terrene patio glow, and the lights of the Bay Bridge cross the dark water.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in this hotel, opened in 2022 on the Embarcadero, watch the lit Ferry Building clock tower through the evening rain.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud sits over the bay tonight, and the lights of the Bay Bridge shine softly under it.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the lights of the Bay Bridge draw a bright line across the bay, with a second one reflected in the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Embarcadero waterfront is empty, and the bay lies still around the Bay Bridge.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights appear along the Bay Bridge beyond the Terrene patio.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Arabian Gulf lies still, and the first pale light grows along the horizon in front of the sea-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the Club Lounge, guests look out over the Arabian Gulf, bright blue under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The midday sun makes the Arabian Gulf shine below STK Doha, and the Doha skyline stands sharp against the blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: From the gym, guests watch cloud shadows move slowly across the Arabian Gulf while the treadmill keeps count.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Doha skyline this afternoon, and the towers pass in and out of sunshine beyond the terrace of Habanos.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Arabian Gulf takes the colour of pewter in front of B-Lounge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Doha skyline today, and from STK Doha the towers look like sketches on grey paper.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far towers of the Doha skyline are not visible today, so guests in the Club Lounge see only the nearer water of the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Arabian Gulf; guests in the Ivory Suite watch the drops run down the glass, the sea turned grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning breaks over the Arabian Gulf, and guests on the 23rd floor at STK Doha stop talking to follow the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Arabian Gulf, and guests in the Club Lounge leave their seats to watch the flakes meet the sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and the Doha skyline shows every edge to guests behind the glass at STK Doha.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay on the warm side of the gym windows, with the Arabian Gulf steel-blue beyond.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Arabian Gulf, and guests wisely admire the sea from the cool of B-Lounge.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit out on the terrace of Habanos and look across at the Doha skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the towers of the Doha skyline gold, and guests in the Quartz Suite, renovated in 2021, watch the colour deepen.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lays an orange band across the Arabian Gulf, in clear sight from the Club Lounge.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Doha skyline give the low sky a soft glow above the terrace of Habanos.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Doha skyline this evening, and guests at STK Doha watch them shine on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Arabian Gulf is a wide black space beyond B-Lounge, and the city lights mark its edge.
phrases.clear_night: From the terrace of the Katara Suite, the lit towers of the Doha skyline stand under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Arabian Gulf is quiet and almost black, and the horizon is lost between sea and sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from STK Doha the first lights come on along the Doha skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Dolomites are a dark outline across the Pustertal, and the sky behind them slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests open the balcony door to a clear morning, with the Dolomites sharp against a blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Prags Dolomites stand bright and clear across the Pustertal from the rooftop infinity pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pustertal this morning, while the Dolomites above stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the sun terraces, white clouds pass over the Dolomites this afternoon, with blue sky between them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Dolomites show every fold of their rock, and the Pustertal lies quiet below.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze fills the Pustertal today, and from the panoramic sauna the Dolomites look like a soft grey drawing behind the glass.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Dolomites are not visible today; from the balconies the view ends at the near side of the Pustertal.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the large window of the panoramic sauna, and the Dolomites behind it come and go in the cloud.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls along the Pustertal, and guests in the Dolomites Royal Suite watch lightning behind the Dolomites through its large windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Pustertal, and the Dolomites fade into white beyond the edge of the rooftop infinity pool.
phrases.very_cold: Steam rises from the heated rooftop infinity pool into the freezing air, and the Prags Dolomites stand sharp behind it.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the spa has 6 saunas to choose from, and guests pick the panoramic one for its window on the Dolomites.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the rooftop infinity pool up to their chins and look across the Pustertal at the Prags Dolomites.
phrases.warm: On the sun terraces, guests sit facing the Dolomites and forget the books they brought.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the pale rock of the Dolomites warm gold, and the south-facing balconies have it straight ahead.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lights the Dolomites peak by peak, while the rooftop infinity pool reflects the sky.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner under a cloudy evening sky, guests watch the Dolomites turn to a dark silhouette through the restaurant windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of Olang this evening, and the Dolomites are hidden behind the wet restaurant windows.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, and the lights of Olang glow below the dim Dolomites.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, stars fill the sky above the Pustertal, and the ridge of the Dolomites is easy to follow beneath them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pustertal is quiet, and the Dolomites keep their place across it until morning.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the Dolomites keep their pale light while the first lamps come on in Olang below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Tokyo Bay is still dark, and Tokyo Skytree is only a thin shape against the first pale light.
phrases.clear_morning: At Chef's Theatre, guests eat breakfast with a clear view of Hamarikyu Gardens in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The Sumida River runs bright through the city, and Tokyo Skytree stands sharp against the blue.
phrases.partly_morning: From Club mesm, guests follow cloud shadows as they slide over Hamarikyu Gardens and out across the bay area.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Tokyo Skytree goes in and out of the sun this afternoon as clouds pass over Tokyo Bay.
phrases.overcast: Cloud covers Tokyo Bay today, and the green of Hamarikyu Gardens stands out against the grey water.
phrases.fog_haze: In the haze, Tokyo Skytree is only a pale pencil line, while Hamarikyu Gardens stay green and clear below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility hides Tokyo Skytree today, and Tokyo Bay fades into pale grey before any far shore appears.
phrases.rain: In the chapter4 Suite Luxe, guests watch the rain sweep across the whole Bay Area panorama.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is crossing Tokyo Bay, and the water flashes silver every time the lightning strikes.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the trees of Hamarikyu Gardens while guests in Club mesm watch it from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_cold: Tokyo Skytree looks close enough to touch today, with the Sumida River leading the eye to it.
phrases.cold: Coats stay off in the chapter4 Suite Luxe, where guests take in the Bay Area panorama without the wind.
phrases.very_hot: Today's heat stays outside the chapter4 Suite Luxe, where guests watch the Bay Area panorama shimmer in the sun.
phrases.warm: Tokyo Bay is bright today, and the garden by the waterfront is a deep green.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Tokyo Bay is turning gold, and Tokyo Skytree catches the same low sun.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests in Club mesm watch the Sumida River go from grey to orange and back as clouds pass the low sun.
phrases.grey_evening: At Chef's Theatre, guests eat dinner facing Hamarikyu Gardens under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests at Whisk see the lights of the Tokyo waterfront go soft in the rain this evening.
phrases.mild_night: The night-time panorama runs from the lights on Tokyo Bay to a lit Tokyo Skytree under soft cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Tokyo Skytree stands lit in the clear night, and the lights of the waterfront lie on Tokyo Bay.
phrases.dusk: Lights are starting along Tokyo Bay just after sunset, and Tokyo Skytree stands dark against the bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Dotonbori lies quiet below while the Osaka skyline slowly takes shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Osaka skyline, and Dotonbori below looks calm after its long night.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests look down on Midōsuji and the city blocks around Dotonbori.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Osaka skyline this morning, and Dotonbori goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From a Wonderful Suite, guests see the whole Osaka skyline this afternoon under broken cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the city around Dotonbori turns one soft colour, roof after roof.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Osaka skyline today, and Dotonbori below looks like a sketch not yet finished.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far end of the skyline is missing, and guests see only Dotonbori and the nearer streets.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and Dotonbori below is blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests watch lightning flash over the Osaka skyline while thunder rolls above Dotonbori.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Dotonbori, and guests in this 27-floor tower watch the flakes drift down toward the streets.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and the Osaka skyline stands sharp above Dotonbori.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look down from the floor-to-ceiling windows and follow the streets of Dotonbori.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the roofs of Dotonbori, and guests seem happy to study it from indoors.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the Osaka skyline spreads out under a soft sky, and Dotonbori waits below for evening.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Osaka skyline gold, and guests in Tadao Ando's black tower watch the shadows grow over Dotonbori.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the distant mountains behind the Osaka skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, Dotonbori's neon glows below, and the low sky takes some of its colour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and Dotonbori's neon spreads into soft patches of colour on the wet streets below.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, guests on the upper floors look down on Dotonbori's neon under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and from a Wonderful Suite the lit city grid of Osaka stretches out with Dotonbori's neon below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Dotonbori rests below, and guests who are still awake have the sleeping city to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests watch Dotonbori's first neon signs come on one by one.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the San Francisco Skyline stands as a dark shape under a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights San Francisco Bay, and guests in the bay-view rooms see the water turn bright.
phrases.clear_midday: From the wraparound patio at Cavaña, guests look down into Oracle Park and straight ahead to the Bay Bridge.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across San Francisco Bay this morning, while the Bay Bridge stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the San Francisco Skyline changes every few minutes, as clouds cover one tower and then the next.
phrases.overcast: San Francisco Bay takes the grey of the sky today, and the Bay Bridge draws a darker line across it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the tops of the San Francisco Skyline, so guests count only the lower floors today.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far shore of San Francisco Bay is not visible today; the view ends at the Bay Bridge.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the San Francisco Skyline behind it looks soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over San Francisco Bay, and guests watch the storm from the Penthouse Suite on the 16th floor.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on San Francisco Bay, and the Bay Bridge fades into white halfway across.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the San Francisco Skyline looks sharp, each tower clear against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests at Cavaña stay behind the glass and look across San Francisco Bay.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the patio at Cavaña look for shade and find San Francisco Bay shining below.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit outside at Cavaña with Oracle Park directly below them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the San Francisco Skyline gold, seen from the skyline-view rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and colours San Francisco Bay orange for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests by the fire pits at Cavaña look out at the lights of the Bay Bridge.
phrases.wet_evening: Wet weather blurs the evening lights of the San Francisco Skyline into soft colours on the glass.
