phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Pacific is bright blue to the horizon, and the waves leave white lines on the sand.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the beach this morning while the sea stacks stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the oceanfront balconies, guests watch the afternoon clouds change the colour of the water from blue to green.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the ocean takes the same colour, and only the surf shows white.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the beach today, and from the covered deck one sea stack shows through it like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests on the wrap-around verandas see the beach and the first waves, not the open water beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the beach, and guests watch the grey surf through the wet glass of the ocean-facing rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Pacific, and each flash of lightning shows the sea stacks for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach, and from the wrap-around verandas the white flakes disappear into the grey waves.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and the light is clear, so guests look at the sea stacks from their oceanfront rooms.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the beach is empty, and the waves reach the sand in long, slow rows.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, people on the beach walk straight into the surf, and guests watch them from the shade of the wrap-around verandas.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, families walk along the wet sand towards the sea stacks, small against the open water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the sea stacks, and guests take their places on the wrap-around verandas to watch the sun go down.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Pacific turn orange and pink, and the wet sand shows the same colours.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening is cloudy and the ocean is almost black; the white surf still shows from the covered deck.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the dark beach this evening, and guests on the wrap-around verandas see only the nearest waves.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hide the stars, and the surf is a faint moving line beyond the lawn.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Pacific tonight, and guests on the oceanfront balconies stop counting quite early.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the beach is dark and quiet, and only the white edges of the waves can be seen.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky over the ocean is still bright, and the sea stacks turn dark against it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Brisbane River is a quiet dark band between its banks, and the sky above it is just starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Three Blue Ducks, guests watch clear morning light spread across the Brisbane River from the window tables.
phrases.clear_midday: The Brisbane River is bright under a clear midday sky, and the Story Bridge stands sharp against the blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Brisbane River this morning, and from WET Deck the water changes from bright to dull and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the river-view suites have the Brisbane River on one side and the city towers on the other, both under patchy afternoon cloud.
phrases.overcast: The Brisbane River lies flat and grey under the cloud today, and Kurilpa Bridge is the clearest thing on it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Brisbane River today, and the far bank looks like a watercolour left out to dry.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Mt. Coot-tha is not visible today, so guests in the 312 rooms look closer, at the Brisbane River just below.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Brisbane River with small rings, and guests watch it from the covered lounges at WET Deck.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Brisbane River, and for a second the whole far bank shows through the storm rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Brisbane River, and guests at the windows keep checking that it is real.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear today, and every ripple on the Brisbane River looks sharp in the sunlight.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass in Three Blue Ducks and look across the Brisbane River to QAGOMA on the other bank.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the 4th-floor pool at WET Deck and look at the Brisbane River from the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests lie on the WET Deck loungers with the Brisbane River as their backdrop.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests at WET Deck watch the low sun turn the Brisbane River gold, with a cocktail in hand.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the cloud and lights the Brisbane River in strips, bright then grey.
phrases.grey_evening: From a window table in Three Blue Ducks at dinner, guests see QAGOMA lit up across the Brisbane River under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the far bank run in long wet streaks on the Brisbane River tonight, seen through rain on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud holds the glow of the city tonight, and the Brisbane River carries the same soft light.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the city lights sit steady on the Brisbane River, and guests in the river-view rooms leave the curtains open.
phrases.late_night: The pool at WET Deck never closes, and in the small hours the Brisbane River moves quietly past it, almost empty.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Brisbane River, and the first lights come on along the far bank.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Canton Tower stands unlit against a clear sky, and the Pearl River below it is still.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Canton Tower first, then moves down to the Pearl River in front of the outdoor pool.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Canton Tower rises into a clear blue sky, directly across the water from the outdoor pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past the top of the Canton Tower this morning, and their shadows cross the Pearl River below the garden terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns on the Canton Tower this afternoon, seen across the water from the garden terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pearl River turns the same colour, and the Canton Tower looks darker against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Canton Tower today, and from the outdoor pool the far bank of the Pearl River looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The top of the Canton Tower is not visible today; guests at river level see its lower half and the Pearl River in front of it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pearl River, and guests watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows with the Canton Tower slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Pearl River, and guests stay behind the glass to watch lightning flash near the Canton Tower.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Pearl River, and the Canton Tower shows only faintly through the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and the Canton Tower looks sharp across the Pearl River from the empty garden terrace.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the Pearl River is grey and quiet, and guests in the 139 rooms look at the Canton Tower from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool and look up at the Canton Tower from the water.
phrases.warm: By the outdoor pool, books stay closed while guests on sunbeds look across the Pearl River at the Canton Tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Canton Tower gold, and the same colour spreads over the Pearl River in front of the poolside bar.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud, and from the cocktail terrace the Canton Tower is in light while the Pearl River lies in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars tonight, so the Canton Tower provides the colour, seen across the Pearl River from the cocktail terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening the lights of the Canton Tower run together in the rain, seen from the dry side of a floor-to-ceiling window.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lit Canton Tower fills the sightline from the private terraces of the Canton Tower View Suites.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the LED display of the Canton Tower reflects across the Pearl River towards the outdoor terrace.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pearl River is quiet, and a guest who cannot sleep finds the Canton Tower still there behind the curtain.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the Canton Tower's first lights come on above the Pearl River, seen from the rooftop terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Nature Park is still a dark shape before sunrise, and the ocean is only starting to show.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests at Zimbro Restaurant start the morning looking at the coastline on the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: The ocean is deep blue to the horizon, with white waves breaking along the edge of the Nature Park.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Nature Park this morning, and the land below goes dark and bright in turn.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Suite with garden terrace, guests watch cloud shadows cross the ocean.
phrases.overcast: The Nature Park lies under even grey cloud today, calm and without shadows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has moved in over the Nature Park, and the ocean shows only now and then.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the coastline on the horizon is missing from the view at Zimbro Restaurant.
phrases.rain: Rain crosses the Nature Park in grey curtains, and the ocean has faded to a pale band.
phrases.thunderstorm: Safe indoors in the Suite with garden terrace, guests watch lightning far out over the ocean.
phrases.snow: Under falling snow the Nature Park is turning white, and the ocean beside it looks darker than before.
phrases.very_cold: The pool lies still and empty today, with the Atlantic Ocean bright behind it.
phrases.cold: Guests stay inside the Suite with garden terrace today, watching the ocean roll in long white lines.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stand in the pool up to their shoulders, facing the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.warm: Doors open, guests in the Suite with garden terrace sit outside facing the ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests watch the Nature Park turn gold in the late sun, shadows growing long across the estate.
phrases.partly_golden: Through gaps in the clouds, the last sun puts patches of orange on the ocean.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner guests at Zimbro Restaurant look towards the coastline on the horizon, now a darker line under the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain is falling on the Nature Park this evening, and the ocean beyond it has disappeared into the dark.
phrases.mild_night: Without stars tonight, the Nature Park and the ocean join into one dark, quiet view.
phrases.clear_night: The Nature Park is a dark, quiet shape tonight under a sky full of stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the ocean is a dark, wide space beyond the sleeping estate.

phrases.clear_predawn: Early risers in the Park Suite find the Imperial Palace Gardens still dark as the sky begins to lighten over the Tokyo skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Imperial Palace gardens and moats, and guests in the lounge have a clear view of both.
phrases.clear_midday: At evian SPA TOKYO, guests rest with a clear view of the Imperial Palace gardens under a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Imperial Palace Plaza this morning while the Wadakura Fountain stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the Premier Suite, guests see the Imperial Palace Gardens go from sun to shade and back as the clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: From the Palace Suite, guests look out at the Wadakura Fountain and the Imperial Palace Plaza under a grey sky.
phrases.fog_haze: Tokyo Tower is only a faint shape in the haze today, but guests in the Garden Suite still see the Wadakura Fountain clearly.
phrases.reduced_visibility: With visibility low today, the Park Suite loses the far end of the Tokyo skyline and keeps the Imperial Palace Gardens.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Imperial Palace gardens and moats, and guests in the lounge watch it with no hurry to go out.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the Executive Suite, guests watch the storm pass over the Wadakura Fountain and the Imperial Palace Plaza.
phrases.snow: In the Chiyoda Suite, guests stay warm and watch snow come down on the Wadakura Fountain and the Imperial Palace Plaza.
phrases.very_cold: The Imperial Palace Gardens look sharp and clear across the moat, a view guests are happy to enjoy from indoors today.
phrases.cold: Guests in the Terrace Suite need no coat to enjoy the Wadakura Fountain and the Imperial Palace Plaza today.
phrases.very_hot: In today's heat, guests at evian SPA TOKYO keep cool with the Imperial Palace gardens in view.
phrases.warm: The Imperial Palace Gardens stretch out across the moat today, with the Tokyo skyline running from Marunouchi to Shinjuku beyond them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in the Park Suite watch the Imperial Palace Gardens turn golden as the sun drops toward Shinjuku in the west.
phrases.partly_golden: The Shinjuku skyline shows dark against the evening clouds, with the last sunlight still on the Imperial Palace Gardens.
phrases.grey_evening: At Lounge Bar Privé, the Imperial Palace gardens have given way to the city skyline, lit under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Garden Suite see Tokyo Tower as a soft glow in the distance through this evening's rain.
phrases.mild_night: The Imperial Palace Gardens are a wide dark space tonight, with the city skyline lit all around them.
phrases.clear_night: Guests at Lounge Bar Privé swap the gardens they saw by day for a clear night view of the city skyline.
phrases.late_night: Guests still up in the Premier Suite at this late hour look across at the Imperial Palace Gardens, dark and quiet.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the Imperial Palace Gardens darken first while the sky above the city skyline is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Century City towers are tall dark shapes against a sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Century City towers under a clear sky, and from the pool terrace every edge looks sharp.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the Century City towers stand straight and bright against a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: The panoramic balcony of the California Suite looks onto the Century City towers this morning, as cloud shadows move slowly across them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift behind the Century City towers this afternoon, and for a moment the towers seem to be the ones moving.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Century City towers take the same grey colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Century City towers today, and from the pool terrace they look like a drawing half rubbed out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, and guests see only faint outlines of the Century City towers, with the top floors lost from sight.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling over the Century City towers, and their upper floors fade into the low cloud.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Century City towers, and guests count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Beverly Hills, and guests look twice as white flakes cross in front of the Century City towers.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the Century City towers show sharp lines beyond the empty pool terrace.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the California Suite stay behind the glass and look at the Century City towers beyond the balcony.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the shade of the pool cabanas and look up at the Century City towers.
phrases.warm: By the pool, guests on the lounge chairs look over the water's edge at the Century City towers, and nobody hurries.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Century City towers gold, and the 5th-floor balcony of the California Suite shows them at close range.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds turn pink behind the Century City towers, as seen from the pool terrace since 1991.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit windows of the Century City towers make a soft glow on the low sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests look out at the Century City towers and see their lights blurred by the water on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and the sky is covered, so guests find no stars, only the lights of the Century City towers.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the Century City towers stand lit against a black sky, row above row of windows.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Century City towers are quiet shapes in the sky, and guests still awake have them to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on in the Century City towers.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, St Stephen's Cathedral is a tall dark shape against a clear sky that slowly turns pale behind its towers.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the towers of St Stephen's Cathedral first, and the tiled roof below them brightens a little later.
phrases.clear_midday: From Lamée Rooftop Bar, guests see the Gothic towers of St Stephen's Cathedral at eye level, every stone detail sharp under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the tiled roof of St Stephen's Cathedral this morning, and the spire stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the oval porthole windows, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the Innere Stadt roofscape.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the tiled roof of St Stephen's Cathedral is the one patch of pattern above the Innere Stadt rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens St Stephen's Cathedral today, and its spire looks like a pencil drawing above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see the towers of St Stephen's Cathedral a few streets away, while the rooftops behind them are lost from sight.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Innere Stadt; guests in the Signature Suite watch it through the panoramic windows, St Stephen's Cathedral slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral for a second at a time beyond the terrace of the event room.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Innere Stadt roofscape, and the towers of St Stephen's Cathedral appear and disappear behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, St Stephen's Cathedral stands very clear, and guests prefer to study its towers from behind warm glass.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the terrace of Lamée Rooftop Bar is quiet, and the towers of St Stephen's Cathedral still rise at eye level beyond it.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the terrace of Lamée Rooftop Bar keep to the shade of the umbrellas and look across at the towers of St Stephen's Cathedral.
phrases.warm: On a warm day at Lamée Rooftop Bar, reopened in 2024 after a full renovation, drinks wait while guests look at St Stephen's Cathedral.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight turns the stone of St Stephen's Cathedral gold, and the colour deepens in the view from the Penthouse Suite terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds behind the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral turn pink and orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests at Lamée Rooftop Bar look across to the lit towers of St Stephen's Cathedral.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of St Stephen's Cathedral shine through the rain, and the Innere Stadt rooftops below it glisten.
phrases.mild_night: The lit spire of St Stephen's Cathedral reaches towards the low clouds tonight, and guests in rooms on the 8th floor can see it from their windows.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lit towers of St Stephen's Cathedral stand against a black sky, the city lights spread out below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Innere Stadt is quiet, and the towers of St Stephen's Cathedral are only an outline above the roofs.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights come on across the Innere Stadt rooftops below St Stephen's Cathedral.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Arabian Gulf lies still under a clear sky, and Al-Maha Island is a low dark shape offshore.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the private beach, and Al-Maha Island stands clear offshore across the blue Arabian Gulf.
phrases.clear_midday: The beachfront terrace of La Mar by Gastón Acurio puts the Arabian Gulf at eye level under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Arabian Gulf this morning, while Al-Maha Island stays in sunshine offshore.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The terrace at Mykonos overlooks the pool and the beach as clouds drift across the afternoon sky.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Arabian Gulf turns the colour of metal, and Al-Maha Island sits low on the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Doha skyline today, and the towers look like pencil marks beyond the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Al-Maha Island is not visible today; guests see the private beach and the first stretch of the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Arabian Gulf, and guests in the Ocean Suite watch the water turn grey and rough.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Doha skyline for a second, and guests in the Presidential Suite wait for the next flash over the sea.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the private beach, and guests at the sea-view room windows cannot quite believe the white palm trees.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold air the Doha skyline looks sharp across the water from La Mar Beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the private beach is empty, and the Arabian Gulf runs grey-blue out to Al-Maha Island.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat guests stay in the pool at La Mar Beach and look across the Arabian Gulf to the Doha skyline.
phrases.warm: On the private beach, books stay closed while guests look at Al-Maha Island across the warm Arabian Gulf.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in the Cigar Lounge beside La Vue watch the sun go down over the city skyline in a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Arabian Gulf, and the sea-facing terrace of Belgian Café catches the light.
phrases.grey_evening: From La Mar by Gastón Acurio, guests look out at the lit Doha skyline under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass tonight, and the lights of the Doha skyline blur for guests at La Mar by Gastón Acurio.
phrases.mild_night: The Doha skyline shines under a cloudy night sky, and guests at Manko Doha look up from their drinks to see it.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the towers of the Doha skyline stand bright across the water from La Mar by Gastón Acurio.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Arabian Gulf is dark and quiet beyond the empty private beach.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Katara Cultural Village, and guests in the city-view rooms watch its first lights come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Acropolis is a dark shape above the sleeping streets of Athens.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Parthenon first, and guests on the Acropolis Terrace Suite terrace watch its columns turn from grey to gold.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Parthenon stands white and sharp on top of the Acropolis.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Lycabettus Hill this morning, while the Acropolis stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross Philopappos Hill this afternoon, one slow patch at a time.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Acropolis rock and the Parthenon above it take almost the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Acropolis today, and the Parthenon looks like a pencil drawing on the hilltop.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Lycabettus Hill is not visible today, but the Acropolis is close enough to stay in sight.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Acropolis, and guests in rooms facing the Acropolis watch the wet rock darken.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Parthenon for a second at a time, and thunder rolls around the Acropolis.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Acropolis, and the Parthenon turns white a little at a time.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and every column of the Parthenon is easy to count.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind their balcony doors and look at the Acropolis from the warm side.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the Acropolis rock seems to shake in the air above the roofs of Athens.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit out on their balconies with the Acropolis in front of them and no plan to move.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Parthenon gold, and Philopappos Hill glows green and warm beside it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and lights the Parthenon, while Lycabettus Hill is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars this evening, and guests at dinner in Acropolis Secret look across at the lit Parthenon.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and the lights of the Acropolis blur into a soft gold patch on the hill.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit Acropolis glows above the dark roofs of Athens.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests on the rooftop at Acropolis Secret see the lit Parthenon with stars above it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and the Acropolis is a plain outline against the night sky.
phrases.dusk: From the rooftop of Acropolis Secret, guests watch the first lights come on across the Acropolis under a still-bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sky Tower stands as a plain grey column against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on the Waitemata Harbour, and the masts in the marina below shine white.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 6th-floor rooftop, guests see the Waitemata Harbour bright blue under the midday sun, with the marina just below.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Waitemata Harbour this morning, while the marina stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Rooftop at QT, guests watch afternoon clouds drift behind the Sky Tower on the city side.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Waitemata Harbour turns the colour of an oyster shell, and the Sky Tower rises a darker grey above the city.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Waitemata Harbour today, and the Sky Tower looks like a thin pencil drawing above the city.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The islands beyond the Waitemata Harbour are not visible today, but the marina and the Sky Tower are still clear from the rooftop.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Viaduct; guests watch it from the picture windows of their suites, the boats blurred behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Waitemata Harbour, and for a second the Sky Tower shows white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the marina, and guests in the suites with a Sky Tower glimpse watch the tower fade behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so every mast in the marina and every line of the Sky Tower looks sharp.
phrases.cold: A cold day gives the Waitemata Harbour a steel-blue colour, and guests in the harbour-view suites enjoy it from behind warm glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the shade is the first view guests look for on the rooftop, and the Waitemata Harbour is the second.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the rooftop deck count the yachts leaving the marina for the Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light warms the city skyline, and guests with a drink at the rooftop bar watch the Sky Tower change colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and turns the Waitemata Harbour orange, while the masts in the marina catch the light.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Sky Tower colours the low sky, and the city lights spread out to the edge of the Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the marina lights stretch across the black water, and the lit Sky Tower glows softly above the city.
phrases.mild_night: A few suites in this 150-room hotel give guests a partial glimpse of the lit Sky Tower on this mild, cloudy night.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit Sky Tower stands above the city, and the Waitemata Harbour holds the reflections of the marina.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Waitemata Harbour is quiet, and the boats in the marina sleep at their berths.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the marina and up the Sky Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Tokyo Bay turns from black to grey below the Corner Suite Room as the first light arrives.
phrases.clear_morning: At Sushi Tamakagari Tempura Tamagoromo, breakfast guests watch the sun rise over Odaiba and Tokyo Bay.
phrases.clear_midday: At The Grill on 30th, guests eat lunch with a panoramic view of the city center and the Tokyo Bay area.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the Junior Suite Room wait for the clouds to move and show Mount Fuji again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Tokyo skyline is half in sun and half in shade this afternoon, and the halves keep changing.
phrases.overcast: Rainbow Bridge stands out clearly today against a grey Tokyo Bay.
phrases.fog_haze: Guests at Teppanyaki Icho see the Tokyo Bay Area in soft silver through today's haze.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tokyo skyline shows only its nearest towers today, and Mount Fuji cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: In the Family Suite Room, guests watch rain cross Tokyo Bay while Rainbow Bridge fades in and out.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Governor Suite Room count the seconds between lightning and thunder as the storm moves over the Tokyo skyline.
phrases.snow: From the Royal Suite Room, guests watch snow settle on the Tokyo skyline, one rooftop after another.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Premier Floors Corner Suite Room stay warm indoors and look out at a sharp, clear Mount Fuji.
phrases.cold: Mount Fuji is easy to find beyond the Tokyo skyline today, with its outline clear from top to bottom.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests at the bar choose a cold drink and a view of the Tokyo Bay area.
phrases.warm: Guests at GARDEN DINING take their time today, with a sea breeze coming in from Odaiba.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun puts a gold edge on the Tokyo skyline, and Mount Fuji shows as a clear dark shape.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests in the Ambassador Suite Room watch Mount Fuji darken as the last sunlight comes through the clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner guests at The Grill on 30th look out at the panoramic view of the city center after dark.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Tokyo Bay area tonight, and guests at the bar are in no hurry to leave.
phrases.mild_night: Rainbow Bridge is lit across Tokyo Bay tonight, and the Tokyo skyline glows under the cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Before bed, guests in the Junior Suite Room look out over the lights of the Tokyo skyline.
phrases.late_night: At this hour Mount Fuji is hidden in the dark, and the Tokyo skyline has gone quiet.
phrases.dusk: Rainbow Bridge lights up over Tokyo Bay while Mount Fuji still shows against the bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Caribbean Sea is still dark under a clear sky, and the sky above the water slowly grows pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the ocean-facing suites on the upper east floors, guests see the morning sun on the Caribbean Sea and the municipal pier in the same frame.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Caribbean Sea turns bright turquoise and the municipal pier stands sharp against it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Caribbean Sea this morning, with patches of turquoise between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the massage deck, the Caribbean Sea shows between the palm trees while afternoon clouds drift over the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Caribbean Sea loses its turquoise, and the municipal pier draws a pale line across the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Caribbean Sea today, and the far end of the municipal pier fades into it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; the Caribbean Sea is clear only near the beach, and the far end of the municipal pier cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the ocean-facing suites, and guests watch the Caribbean Sea turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Caribbean Sea and the municipal pier for a second, then the storm hides them again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Caribbean Sea, and the beachside cabanas are turning white, which nobody here packed for.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and the Caribbean Sea looks sharp and blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the beach is empty, and the Caribbean Sea rolls in grey-green beside the municipal pier.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the curved pool and look past the lounge chairs at the Caribbean Sea beyond.
phrases.warm: From a beachside cabana, guests look at the turquoise Caribbean Sea for so long that the cocktails on the tray get warm.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight turns the municipal pier gold, and the Caribbean Sea behind it becomes a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop suite, above its private plunge pool, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds cover the evening sky, and the Caribbean Sea shows mostly as white lines of waves near the beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain falls on the pool and the beach, and the Caribbean Sea beyond them blurs into the dark.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the Caribbean Sea is a wide dark space, with the municipal pier just visible at its edge.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Caribbean Sea tonight, and the municipal pier reaches out into the dark water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests still awake in one of the 524 suites see only a dark Caribbean Sea and a quiet beach.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky over the Caribbean Sea is still bright, and the first lights come on around the pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Lugano lies still and grey-blue under a clear sky, with the Pre-Alps just beginning to show behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light spreads over Lake Lugano, and guests in the upper-floor suites look straight across the water to the far Alpine shore.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Lake Lugano is a deep blue, and the Pre-Alps stand sharp behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Pre-Alps this morning, and their shadows move slowly across Lake Lugano.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the private terrace of the Presidential Suite, guests follow patches of sun and shade as they cross Lake Lugano this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Lake Lugano turns the colour of pewter, and the mountains around the city look closer.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Lake Lugano today, and the far Alpine shore looks like a watercolour left to dry.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Pre-Alps are not visible today; from the lake-view rooms, guests see Lake Lugano and little of the far shore.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of Lake Lugano with small rings, and guests watch them from behind the glass walls of the Splendide Lifestyle Spa pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the mountains around Lake Lugano for a second at a time, and guests in the upper-floor suites count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Lake Lugano, and swimmers in the pool of the Splendide Lifestyle Spa watch it through the large windows.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the snow-covered peaks of the Pre-Alps stand clear above the waters of Lake Lugano.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps Lake Lugano quiet, and the Pre-Alps stand behind the still water.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, the glass walls around the pool of the Splendide Lifestyle Spa stand open towards Lake Lugano, and swimmers look out at the bright water.
phrases.warm: On the terrace of La Piazzetta, guests sit in the open air with Lake Lugano in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns Lake Lugano gold, and the slopes of the Pre-Alps behind it take a warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lays long bands of orange light across Lake Lugano.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the hillside town draw a bright line along the far side of Lake Lugano.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows this evening, and the lights across Lake Lugano blur into long streaks on the water.
phrases.mild_night: Lake Lugano is black and calm under the clouds tonight, with the lights of the shore doubled in the water.
phrases.clear_night: Stars hang over the Pre-Alps on this clear night, and Lake Lugano shows a few of them back.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Lugano lies quiet in front of this 1887 palace, and the mountains are only a darker edge against the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still pink above the mountains while the first lights come on around Lake Lugano.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Chain Bridge stands quiet over the Danube under a clear sky, and the stone lions wait for their first visitors.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Chain Bridge, and guests on the river-facing balconies look straight down its axis.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Danube shines on both sides of the Chain Bridge, and Buda Castle stands sharp beyond it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Danube this morning, while the Chain Bridge stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: By the pool, guests look out over the hotel's own rooftop while afternoon clouds drift past.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Chain Bridge and the Danube take nearly the same colour, and the stone lions keep their places anyway.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Danube today, and the Chain Bridge seems to end halfway across, leaving Buda to the imagination.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Buda Hills are not visible today; the Chain Bridge is clear, and Buda Castle is only a faint outline behind it.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Chain Bridge, and guests watch from behind their balcony doors as the roadway turns shiny.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Buda Hills, and for a second every chain of the Chain Bridge stands out against the sky.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Chain Bridge, and the stone lions at its end are slowly getting white coats.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air makes everything sharp today: the Chain Bridge, the Danube and Buda Castle above them.
phrases.cold: The cold day keeps balcony doors closed, and guests in this 1906 building look through the glass at the Chain Bridge and the Danube.
phrases.very_hot: The heat slows everyone down today: tourists drift past the stone lions and onto the Chain Bridge at half speed.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests stand on the river-facing balconies with the doors open behind them, looking down the line of the Chain Bridge to Buda.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Chain Bridge golden, and Buda Castle glows above the Danube.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lights the Chain Bridge piece by piece.
phrases.grey_evening: At Gresham, guests look across to Buda Castle under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Chain Bridge this evening, and the wet roundabout below reflects them.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the lights of the Chain Bridge draw a line across the Danube towards Buda.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests see the Chain Bridge lit from end to end, with Buda Castle bright above the river.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the roundabout is empty and the Chain Bridge has the Danube to itself.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset as the first lights come on along the Chain Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean is a dark, quiet surface under a clear sky that slowly turns blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in the sea view rooms see every wave from their small balconies.
phrases.clear_midday: At Vila Foz Bar, guests look out at a bright blue Atlantic Ocean under a sky without a single cloud.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic Ocean this morning, and patches of water change from grey to blue and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon Tea at Vila Foz Bar has the Atlantic Ocean in sight, with sun and cloud taking turns over the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns the colour of steel, and only the white of the waves stands out.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic Ocean and the sky become one soft grey sheet.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests see the Atlantic Ocean close to the shore, and the water further out fades into pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in the Vila Foz Suite watch the grey water from behind the balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and for a second guests see every wave before the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests watch the flakes disappear as they touch the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Atlantic Ocean shows a sharp horizon to guests who stay warm indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests of this 19th-century manor house look at a restless Atlantic Ocean and are happy to be inside.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the balconies of the sea view suites look at the Atlantic Ocean and think about swimming.
phrases.warm: The Atlantic Ocean looks calm and blue on this warm day, and guests keep finding reasons to look at it again.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Atlantic Ocean gold, and at Vila Foz Bar guests watch the light change over a glass of Champagne.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Atlantic Ocean turn orange and pink, and the water copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests at Vila Foz Bar see the Atlantic Ocean as a darker band below the clouds, with oysters on the table.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Atlantic Ocean this evening, and guests can just see the nearest waves breaking in the wet dark.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds cover the stars, and the Atlantic Ocean shows itself only as moving lines of white foam.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and guests in the 66 rooms and suites can count them above the black water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic Ocean is almost invisible, a wide black space where the land stops.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just gone, the sky above the Atlantic Ocean is still bright, and the first lights come on along the coast.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale behind Hyde Park, and the city skyline is still a row of dark shapes.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun rises over Hyde Park, and guests in the suites watch the park turn from grey to green.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the whole Sydney skyline lies sharp and bright below the indoor pool on level 61.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Hyde Park this morning, and from this height guests can follow each one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the gym, guests on the treadmills watch clouds drift over the Sydney skyline, which makes the running feel shorter.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the CBD towers take the same colour, and Hyde Park is the one green patch among them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the CBD today, and the towers fade one behind another like layers of grey paper.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Pacific Ocean is not in sight from the corner suites, and the view ends at the nearer CBD towers.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and the CBD below turns soft and grey for guests swimming in the indoor pool on level 61.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Sydney skyline, and guests in the penthouses watch the storm from the top floors of the 230-metre tower.
phrases.snow: Snowflakes drift past level 61, and the Sydney skyline behind them turns white and faint.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is freezing, and guests stay in the heated indoor pool while the city skyline stands sharp in the cold light.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the hot tub beside the pool on level 61 is the warm seat for looking over the Sydney skyline.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the city rooftops today, and guests look down on it from the cool side of the glass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the corner suites look across the city to the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the CBD towers gold, and swimmers in the indoor pool on level 61 stop at the end of each lap to look.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Sydney skyline turn pink, and the towers below catch the same light.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hangs over the city this evening, and it takes on the neon glow of the CBD below.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the city tonight, and the neon lights of the CBD blur into soft colours.
phrases.mild_night: Seen from a tower of 77 levels, the lights of the city spread out far below under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the CBD's neon glow feels close enough to touch through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Sydney skyline rests in the dark, and the pool on level 61 waits for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the CBD, one window at a time.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Boston Harbour lies still and grey-blue under a clear sky, with the first pale light beginning over the water.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun rises over Boston Harbour, and guests in the water-side suites get its light across the whole window.
phrases.clear_midday: From the ground-level dining area, guests look out at the waterfront in full sun, with the water of Boston Harbour bright blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across Boston Harbour this morning, and their shadows slide over the water below the fitness center windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the downtown Boston skyline, which guests see through the tall windows of the indoor pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Boston Harbour turns the colour of steel and shows every ripple.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Boston Harbour today, and guests in the fitness center see the near water fade into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The downtown Boston skyline is not clear today; guests see the Seaport streets and the closest part of Boston Harbour, and little beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of Boston Harbour, and guests watch it from dry tables in the ground-level dining area.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Boston Harbour, and for a second the whole waterfront shows white before the thunder follows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Seaport, and guests in the indoor pool watch the city turn white from warm water.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, so Boston Harbour looks sharp and bright from the fitness center, where guests are glad to run indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the water of Boston Harbour looks dark blue, and the downtown towers stand clear behind the Seaport.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the waterfront, and guests in the ground-level dining area look at the bright water from the cool side of the glass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, people walk along the Seaport waterfront, and Boston Harbour shines behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the downtown Boston skyline gold, and guests in this L-shaped tower are happy on the city wing.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Boston Harbour turn pink and orange, and the water copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low evening cloud, the lights of the Seaport and downtown Boston glow against the grey.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Boston Harbour this evening, and the waterfront lights stretch into long reflections on the wet ground.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the high-floor suites look over Boston Harbour, where the waterfront lights show on the water.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the downtown Boston skyline is fully lit, and the city-side rooms get the whole panorama.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Boston Harbour is dark beyond the glass, and the harbour channel is left to itself.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky over Boston Harbour is still bright, and the first lights come on along the Seaport waterfront.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Acropolis is a quiet outline under a clear sky, seen from the Heaven Suite.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Acropolis, and the rooftop pool on the 10th floor has it in full view.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Acropolis stands sharp above the roofs of Athens, in full view from the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Athens this morning, and their shadows cross the Acropolis one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop pool, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they move from Lycabettus Hill towards the Acropolis.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Athens, and the Acropolis shows pale stone against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Acropolis today, and from the rooftop it looks like a drawing in chalk.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Acropolis is only a faint form from the rooftop and Lycabettus Hill is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Athens; guests in the rooms facing the Acropolis watch it turn darker and shine.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Athens, and each flash of lightning shows the Acropolis for a second from the rooftop restaurant.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Athens, and guests at the rooftop restaurant watch the Acropolis slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, and the Acropolis stands sharp against the sky from the 10th-floor rooftop.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the rooms facing Lycabettus Hill look at it from behind the balcony doors.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look across the water at the Acropolis.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, phones stay in bags for once, because guests are busy looking at the Acropolis.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Acropolis gold, and guests at the rooftop bar turn their chairs towards it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the Acropolis, while clouds leave Lycabettus Hill in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Acropolis glows above the city, and guests at the rooftop bar look across at it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lit Acropolis shines through the rain, seen from a dry table at the rooftop restaurant.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the Acropolis stands lit above Athens, the clouds over it faintly orange from the city.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in this hotel opened in 2023 look out at the Acropolis, lit against a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Athens is quiet, and the Acropolis rests on its rock above the sleeping streets.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the rooftop pool guests see the first lights come on at the Acropolis and on Lycabettus Hill.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky turns pale over the East River, and the Empire State Building is still a plain grey tower.
phrases.clear_morning: On the treadmills of the fitness center, guests run toward the East River and the Brooklyn skyline in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Empire State Building and the Chrysler Building stand sharp, and One World Trade Center is easy to find too.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move over Midtown this morning, and the Chrysler Building catches the sun between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests watch the afternoon clouds drift over the East River, their shadows crossing the water faster than the boats.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the East River turns the colour of steel, while the Empire State Building keeps its clear outline.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken the top of the Empire State Building today, so guests on floors 28 to 39 look out at half a skyline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: One World Trade Center is not visible today, but the Chrysler Building and the East River remain clear enough to see.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Empire State Building looks blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the East River, and for a second the whole Midtown skyline appears white in the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the windows of Kevin Roche's tower and slowly hides the Empire State Building from guests.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the Empire State Building looks close enough to touch, and guests are glad to see it from indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests swim in the indoor pool and look out over the East River under a clean sky.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the East River, and guests watch the bright water from the cool side of the glass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day the East River shines, and guests in corner suites see both the water and the Midtown towers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Empire State Building and the Chrysler Building gold, and the MetLife Building takes the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, orange clouds pass behind the Empire State Building, and guests stop to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud glows over Midtown this evening, and the lit Chrysler Building shines under it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in the soaking tub by the window watch the lit skyline and the East River below.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the Empire State Building stays lit, and the East River carries the lights of both banks.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests count the lit floors of the Empire State Building, and most lose count.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the fitness center is still open, and the East River lies quiet and black beyond its treadmills.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on in the Empire State Building and the Chrysler Building.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sky Tower stands as a dark shape over the city, and the marina below is still.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Onemata, guests look over the harbour under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Sky Tower rises over the city against a blue midday sky, sharp from the terrace of Captain's Bar.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Waitemata Harbour this morning, and guests in north-facing rooms follow their shadows toward the Auckland Harbour Bridge.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns on the marina this afternoon, seen from the edge of the infinity pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Waitemata Harbour turns the colour of steel, and the Sky Tower stands pale above the city.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and the Sky Tower fades toward its top.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Auckland Harbour Bridge is not visible across Waitemata Harbour today, though the marina below stays clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the marina, and from the covered infinity pool each boat shows through a grey curtain of water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Sky Tower, and guests watch the storm cross the city from the gym windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the marina below the terrace of Captain's Bar, and the Sky Tower turns white and faint.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and clear, and the Sky Tower looks close enough to touch above the city.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look from the gym windows at the waterfront and the city skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the 25-metre infinity pool and look down at the boats in the marina.
phrases.warm: On the terrace of Captain's Bar, guests sit in the warm air and count the masts in the marina below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Sky Tower gold, and guests in the Harbour Suite watch boats come and go on the water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and Waitemata Harbour shines in patches of orange and grey.
phrases.grey_evening: The lit Sky Tower stands under low evening cloud, seen from the terrace of Captain's Bar with the marina below.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of this 195-room hotel tonight, and the city lights spread across the wet marina.
phrases.mild_night: The Sky Tower glows under a cloudy night sky, and the marina lights rest on the dark water.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the Executive Rooftop Suite look across the city lights to the Sky Tower.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the boats in the marina sleep better than anyone still looking out at Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the marina and up the Sky Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tagus River lies dark and calm, and the 25 de Abril Bridge stands against the first pale light in the east.
phrases.clear_morning: At Cafetaria Mensagem, guests have breakfast in front of the marina, where the boats sit still in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Tagus River is bright blue all the way from the 25 de Abril Bridge to Belém Tower.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Tagus River this morning, and the terrace of the cocktail bar looks out as they reach the far bank.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace suites, guests watch the afternoon clouds drift over the Tagus River, with the 25 de Abril Bridge to the east.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Tagus River turns the colour of steel, and Belém Tower stands pale at the water's edge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far bank today, so the 25 de Abril Bridge seems to leave the Tagus River and end in the air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today: Christ the King and the 25 de Abril Bridge are not visible, but the marina and the near water of the Tagus River still are.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of the Tagus River, and guests watch it through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the lobby.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm crosses the estuary, and from inside the cocktail bar guests see lightning flash behind the 25 de Abril Bridge.

phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool, with the Tagus River and Belém Tower in front of them.

phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific loses its blue, and Diamond Head looks darker than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Diamond Head today, and guests can just make out its outline past the palm trees of Waikiki Beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon of the Pacific is not visible today and Diamond Head is only a faint outline, but Waikiki Beach is still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Waikiki Beach, and guests watch it from behind their balcony doors as the Pacific turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific, and for a second guests see Diamond Head clearly through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Waikiki Beach, and guests look twice as the flakes land on the palm trees.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear today, and every ridge of Diamond Head is easy to see from the Penthouse Diamond Suite.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Waikiki Beach is quiet, and guests look across empty sand to the grey-blue Pacific.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests sit in their balcony Jacuzzis and watch swimmers fill the water off Waikiki Beach.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests by the rooftop pool count the surfers waiting for waves off Waikiki Beach.

phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the palm trees of Waikiki Beach shine wet under the street lights.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests see no moon on the Pacific, only the pale sand of Waikiki Beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Pacific tonight, and guests in the Penthouse Diamond Suite can still find the outline of Diamond Head.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Waikiki Beach is empty, and guests who are still awake see only the white of waves coming in.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky over the Pacific is still bright, and guests watch the first lights come on along Waikiki Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon lies flat and grey, waiting for its colour.

phrases.partly_morning: Seen from the beachfront restaurant deck this morning, cloud shadows cross the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon and turn patches of turquoise darker.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the clouds leave their reflections on the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and the infinity pool by the beach copies them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon turns a soft green, and only a thin line separates water from cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon today, and guests see the far water melt into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today, so guests see the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon clearly near the beach and then only pale air.

phrases.very_cold: In the very cold air the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon looks sharp and clear, and the white beach lies empty beside it.

phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in their private infinity pools, eyes level with the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and nobody can say where the pool stops.
phrases.warm: On the white sand beach, guests lie under the umbrellas and let the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon do all the moving.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From an overwater villa deck, guests watch the sky turn orange while the private pool and the Indian Ocean take the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in gold bands, and from the beachfront restaurant deck the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon shines to the horizon.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hide the stars this evening, and guests see the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon as a darker band beyond the pale beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon this evening, and guests see only the nearest water shining through it.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon moves softly against the beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky tonight, and guests on these three private islands see them repeated on the still Maldivian Atoll Lagoon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is quiet and almost without colour beyond the sand.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon holds the bright sky a little longer than the 3.5 kilometres of coastline around it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Adriatic Sea lies quiet and grey-blue under a clear sky, and the cliffs of Lama Monachile are just taking form.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the rooftop terrace, guests sit above Lama Monachile and look out over the open Adriatic Sea under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Adriatic Sea turns turquoise inside Lama Monachile at midday, and the limestone cliffs stand bright white above it.

phrases.partly_afternoon: From the sea view suites, guests follow the clouds as they move over the Adriatic Sea and change its colour from blue to grey and back.

phrases.very_hot: In this heat, swimmers fill the cove of Lama Monachile, and the Adriatic Sea beyond them shines almost white.
phrases.warm: Guests on the rooftop terrace look down at the bathers in Lama Monachile, the same water where cliff divers have jumped from 27 metres since 2009.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the limestone cliffs gold, and the Adriatic Sea below them becomes a darker, richer blue.
phrases.partly_golden: With a glass in hand on the rooftop terrace, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over the Adriatic Sea, and nobody hurries to dinner.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the old village shine on the white houses, and the Adriatic Sea is a wide dark space beside them.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Adriatic Sea moves slowly against the foot of the cliffs, and Lama Monachile is still.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the walls of Malacara Canyon are a dark shape above the forest, and the sky behind them slowly turns pale.

phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the gym stop mid-workout when lightning flashes over the Tokyo skyline.
phrases.snow: Guests in the Panoramic Suite watch snow turn the Imperial Palace Gardens white.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the lounge can count the ridges on Mount Fuji today, sharp in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: Warm inside est, guests look out at the Tokyo Skytree above the cold city.
phrases.very_hot: While the city bakes below, guests cool off in the pool with the Tokyo skyline in front of them.
phrases.warm: The Imperial Palace Gardens spread wide and green among the towers of the city, with the Tokyo Skytree above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Mount Fuji turns to a dark outline against the orange light, and guests in the lounge put their cups down.
phrases.partly_golden: Between the clouds, the low sun picks out the Tokyo Skytree above the Tokyo skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner guests at est see the Tokyo Skytree lit against the evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: At VIRTÙ, guests watch the rain blur the lights of the Tokyo skyline.
phrases.mild_night: The Tokyo Skytree glows through thin cloud tonight, and the Imperial Palace Gardens are a wide dark space in the lit city.
phrases.clear_night: A lit Tokyo Skytree stands above the bright city tonight, with nothing in the air to dim it.
phrases.late_night: Guests still awake in the Panoramic Suite look down on the Imperial Palace Gardens, a dark quiet space in the city.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, Mount Fuji stands dark against the bright horizon while the Tokyo Skytree switches on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Berlin's skyline is a row of dark shapes under a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights Berlin's skyline, and every roof looks sharp through the tall windows of the rooftop lounge.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Berlin's skyline stretches wide and bright below the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Berlin's rooftops this morning, one district bright while the next waits its turn.
phrases.partly_afternoon: White clouds drift over Berlin's cityscape this afternoon, and the sky takes more of the rooftop lounge windows than the city does.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Berlin's skyline shows many shades of grey, and guests in the rooftop lounge can still tell the towers apart.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Berlin's skyline today, and the far towers look like light pencil lines on the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far edge of Berlin's skyline is not visible today; guests see only the nearer roofs and streets clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the rooftop lounge, and Berlin's skyline behind them looks blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Berlin's skyline, and guests high above the city count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Berlin, and guests watch the city's roofs turn white one by one.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air lies over Berlin's skyline today, and guests look at it from behind the glass of the rooftop lounge.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the rooftop terrace is quiet, and Berlin's cityscape lies clear and still below it.
phrases.very_hot: Berlin's cityscape shimmers in the heat, and guests on the rooftop terrace loungers do not plan to move.
phrases.warm: Warm air brings guests out to the rooftop terrace, where they look over Berlin's cityscape.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light slides across Berlin's skyline late in the day, and the glass of the city's towers shines back at guests.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange above Berlin's skyline, and guests at Loft14 turn their chairs to the windows.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at SkyKitchen is served beside a wide window where Berlin's city lights glow under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Wet weather blurs the SkyKitchen window this evening, and Berlin's lights spread into soft colours on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: At Loft14, guests hold a cocktail and look over Berlin's lit skyline, where the clouds carry a soft glow from the city.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, Berlin's lights fill the full width of the SkyKitchen window, and dessert has real competition.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Berlin's skyline is a low dark outline against the night sky, seen by the few guests still awake among 557 rooms.
phrases.dusk: At SkyKitchen on the 12th floor, the tables are set as the first lights come on across Berlin's skyline under a still-bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the single island is a dark shape on the Aegean horizon, and Gümbet Bay lies still below the pool terrace.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches Gümbet Bay, and the edge of the infinity pool seems to run straight into the water.
phrases.clear_midday: From the beachfront dining terrace at midday, the Aegean Sea is a strong blue, with one island in the middle of the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Gümbet Bay this morning, while the island offshore stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pool terrace, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they pass over the open Aegean Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Gümbet Bay turns the colour of pewter, and the island is a darker mark on the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Aegean horizon today, and the island looks like a faint pencil sketch above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The island is not visible today; beyond the edge of the infinity pool, only the near water of Gümbet Bay shows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Gümbet Bay, and guests in the sea-view rooms watch the island fade behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the open Aegean Sea, and for a second the island stands out sharply on the horizon.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Gümbet Bay, and from the sea-view rooms guests watch the flakes disappear into the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear today, and every hill on the island shows across the Aegean Sea.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the pool terrace is quiet, and the Aegean Sea stretches empty to the island.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and rest their arms on the edge above Gümbet Bay.
phrases.warm: At the beach club, guests lie on loungers on the wooden deck with turquoise water just below them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Aegean Sea gold, and from the infinity pool guests see the island darken against it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the beach club catches orange light off the Aegean Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in the sunken lounge look out over the dark Aegean Sea.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the sea this evening, and the Aegean horizon is lost in the dark beyond the pool terrace.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hide the stars over Gümbet Bay, and guests in the sea-view rooms see the water only close to the shore.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the open Aegean Sea tonight, right down to the horizon behind the island.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Gümbet Bay is black and quiet, and the island cannot be told from the sea.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright over the Aegean Sea, and the sunken lounge lights come on one by one.

phrases.clear_predawn: Early guests find Lake Como dark and quiet, under a clear sky that is just starting to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: One small outside area of the Breakfast area looks to Lake Como, and the water is bright blue from there this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday light fills the side view of Lake Como, blue from the near water to the far shore.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the Suite with lake view see sun and cloud shadow taking turns on Lake Como this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The side view of Lake Como keeps changing this afternoon, one stretch of water in sun and the next in shade.
phrases.overcast: Grey above and grey below: the side view of Lake Como matches the clouds today.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Lake Como for guests in the Suite with lake view, and the far shore is only a pale line.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the side view of Lake Como shows the near water and not much beyond it.
phrases.rain: Guests stay dry indoors and watch the rain turn Lake Como a soft grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the Suite with lake view, guests count the seconds between the lightning over Lake Como and the thunder that follows.
phrases.snow: The side view of Lake Como turns pale behind the falling snow, and guests watch it from the warm inside.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay behind glass with the side view of Lake Como, sharp and bright in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: Coats stay on their hangers a little longer while guests look at the side view of Lake Como from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the side view of Lake Como is all blue water, and guests cool down just by looking at it.
phrases.warm: Guests step out to the one small outside area for some warm air and a look at Lake Como.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Strip by strip, the side view of Lake Como turns gold as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests in the Suite with lake view watch the clouds over Lake Como go pink at the edges before the sun leaves.
phrases.grey_evening: Under the evening cloud, Lake Como is a wide dark shape, quiet after the day.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on a dark Lake Como this evening, and guests are glad to watch it from inside.
phrases.mild_night: Before bed, guests take a last look at the side view of Lake Como, dark water under a cloudy night.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night like this, Lake Como is black and calm, and guests look a little longer before closing the curtains.
phrases.late_night: Any guest still awake at this hour finds the side view of Lake Como dark and still.
phrases.dusk: For a few minutes after sunset, Lake Como is still bright enough to keep guests looking.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and from rooms on the 9th and 10th floors the Speicherstadt is a low dark shape beyond the rooftops.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches Hamburg's rooftops first and then the brick warehouses of the Speicherstadt.
phrases.clear_midday: On the treadmill in the 11th-floor fitness area, guests look over Hamburg under a clear midday sky and forget to count the minutes.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Hamburg this morning, and their shadows cross the rooftops toward the Speicherstadt.
phrases.partly_afternoon: After the sauna, guests rest in the relaxation room on the 11th floor and watch sun and cloud take turns over Hamburg.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Hamburg's rooftops and the brick Speicherstadt take almost the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Hamburg today, and the Speicherstadt is only a faint outline beyond the nearest rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so guests in the 11th-floor fitness area see the nearer rooftops and not the Speicherstadt.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Hamburg, and the rooftops shine wet in front of a blurred Speicherstadt.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Hamburg, and lightning shows the rooftops and the Speicherstadt for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Hamburg, and guests in the 11th-floor relaxation room watch the rooftops turn white one by one.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and sharp, and from the 11th-floor fitness area every roof in Hamburg has a clean edge.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in bathrobes look out from the 11th-floor relaxation room over Hamburg and are happy to stay inside.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat the air shimmers above Hamburg's rooftops, and guests look at it from the cool 11th-floor fitness area.
phrases.warm: A warm day gives Hamburg's rooftops a soft light, and the brick of the Speicherstadt looks warmer too.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns Hamburg's rooftops gold, and guests in rooms on the 9th and 10th floors see the Speicherstadt glow red.
