phrases.grey_evening: At BAR 11 on the 11th floor, guests look over the lit rooftops toward the Speicherstadt under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests at BAR 11 stay dry with a drink while wet weather blurs the city lights over Hamburg's rooftops.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, cloud hangs low over Hamburg and holds the glow of the city lights above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and from the floor-to-ceiling windows of BAR 11 Hamburg's lights spread out toward the Speicherstadt.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Hamburg is quiet, and the rooftops lie still below the 9th and 10th floors of this hotel with 254 rooms.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from BAR 11 guests see the first lights come on across Hamburg's rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Seville Cathedral and the Giralda Tower stand unlit against a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: In the El Torreón Suite, in the dome of this 1729 palace, guests look across their private terrace at Seville Cathedral in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the rooftop pool looks over terracotta tiles in every direction.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the old town this morning, and their shadows cross the terracotta roofs one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Giralda Tower is in sun one minute and in cloud shadow the next, seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the terracotta roofs around the rooftop pool keep their warm colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Seville Cathedral today, and the Giralda Tower looks like a pencil drawing above the roofs.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far roofs of the city are not visible today, while the Giralda Tower still shows faintly from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the terracotta roofs, and the Giralda Tower stands grey and slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the old town, and for a second the Giralda Tower shows clearly against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Seville, and the terracotta roofs around the Giralda Tower are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold air, every line of the Giralda Tower is sharp above the terracotta roofs, seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the rooftop terrace is quiet, and Seville Cathedral and the baroque church domes have it to themselves.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the Giralda Tower from the water.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop sunbeds, books stay closed while guests look at the Giralda Tower and the domes of Seville Cathedral.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Giralda Tower gold, and the terracotta tiles around the rooftop terrace turn a deeper red.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds turn pink behind the baroque church domes and the Giralda Tower.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit Giralda Tower stands out above the roofs, seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Giralda Tower shine through the rain above the dark, wet roofs.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the El Torreón Suite look across their private terrace at Seville Cathedral, lit against the dark sky.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lit Giralda Tower stands above the roofs with stars over it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the roofs of the old town are quiet, and the Giralda Tower is only a tall outline above them.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on at the Giralda Tower and among the baroque church domes.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the garden is still grey, and the surrounding hills are just beginning to show their shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Villa Alegria wake to the surrounding hills, every ridge clear this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday puts the garden and the orange grove in full light, with the hills pale behind them.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Mountain View rooms, guests see the sea go from grey to blue as the morning clouds move on.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move slowly across the garden this afternoon, and the hills behind change from light to dark green.
phrases.overcast: Guests in the Olival Rooftop Pool Suite look over the surrounding hills, soft green under flat grey cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Today's haze turns the surrounding hills into pale layers, each one fainter than the last.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The sea is not visible from the Lounge Terrace Suite today; guests see the garden clearly and the hills only as outlines.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the garden and the orange grove, and the hills behind them are grey and blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Algarve hills, and guests in the Junior Suite count the seconds after each flash.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the surrounding hills, and guests in the Villa Alegria watch them turn white from indoors.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air makes every ridge of the surrounding hills clear, and guests in the Olival Rooftop Pool Suite study them from inside.
phrases.cold: With the doors closed, guests in the Lounge Terrace Suite still have the garden, the hills and the sea in view.
phrases.very_hot: Swimmers in the pool rest their arms on the edge and look at the surrounding hills.
phrases.warm: Guests read in the garden today and look up from their books at the hills.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Seen from the pool, the surrounding hills turn gold one ridge at a time.
phrases.partly_golden: From the Junior Suite, guests watch the clouds over the Algarve hills go pink in the last hour of sun.
phrases.grey_evening: Under this evening's cloud the garden is already dark, and the hills beyond it are a low shadow.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Mountain View rooms listen to the evening rain while the hills and the sea disappear into the dark.
phrases.mild_night: Night hides the sea from the Lounge Terrace Suite, but guests can still make out the garden.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the surrounding hills tonight, and the garden below them is dark and quiet.
phrases.late_night: Nothing moves in the garden at this late hour, and the hills behind it are dark shapes.
phrases.dusk: The orange grove loses its colour first after sunset, then the garden, while the hills keep a bright edge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Brisbane River is a quiet dark band below, and the sky above the Scenic Rim mountains is only starting to turn pale.

phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Brisbane River shines between the city centre and South Bank.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across South Bank this morning, while the Brisbane River stays bright in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Altitude Suites, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift from the city towers towards the Scenic Rim mountains.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the city, and the Brisbane River takes the same quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and the bridges over the Brisbane River look like pencil lines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Scenic Rim mountains are not visible today; the Brisbane River and South Bank are still clear below.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Brisbane River, and guests in the Penthouse Collection Suites watch it run down the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the city towers, and for a second the Brisbane River turns white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Brisbane, and guests at the windows watch the flakes drift down towards the Brisbane River.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the air is very clear, and the Brisbane River is a sharp blue curve below South Bank.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the indoor pool swim beside floor-to-ceiling windows and look out at the city towers.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat the Brisbane River glitters, and guests see the far hills tremble a little in the warm air.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests open a window and look down at the Brisbane River and the green of South Bank.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights the bridges one by one, and the Brisbane River turns the colour of honey.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun the clouds turn pink and orange, and the Brisbane River copies them between its bridges.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests in the Altitude Suites, from the 65th floor up, look down on the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening the lights of South Bank blur into soft colours, and the Brisbane River is dark between them.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hang low over the city tonight, and the lights of South Bank shine on the Brisbane River.
phrases.clear_night: From the top floor, the city lights spread out below a clear night sky, with the Brisbane River winding dark between them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and the Brisbane River moves slowly past the sleeping streets.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and guests in this 73-floor tower watch the first city lights come on along the Brisbane River.

phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Albertinaplatz this morning, while the Vienna State Opera stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the window seats follow the clouds over the Vienna State Opera and the city rooftops this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Albertina and the Vienna State Opera look calm and serious, like two neighbours waiting for the evening.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog softens Albertinaplatz today, and the Vienna State Opera has lost its sharp edges.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The city rooftops fade early in the dull air today, but the Albertina, directly opposite, stays clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Albertinaplatz; guests in the Brasserie & Bakery watch it from their tables.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city rooftops, and from the Maisonette Suite guests watch lightning flash behind the Vienna State Opera.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Albertinaplatz, and the roof of the Vienna State Opera is turning white.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing, clear air, every line of the Vienna State Opera facade looks sharp, and guests are glad to study it from indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the Brasserie & Bakery keep to their hot chocolate and look out over Albertinaplatz.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, Albertinaplatz is bright in the sun, and guests choose the cool Brasserie & Bakery to look at it.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, people cross Albertinaplatz slowly, and guests in the Brasserie & Bakery have time to watch them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the facade of the Vienna State Opera gold, and the Albertina opposite catches the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the city rooftops turn orange, and guests in the Maisonette Suite watch through the double-height window.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in the Brasserie & Bakery, guests look out at the lamps of Albertinaplatz under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the Vienna State Opera shine on the wet pavement of Albertinaplatz this rainy evening.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hang low over the city rooftops tonight, and the lit Vienna State Opera looks warm beneath them.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Albertina and the Vienna State Opera are both lit, and guests in this 39-room hotel have them a street away.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Albertinaplatz is still, and the Vienna State Opera rests after its long evening.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Vienna State Opera and around Albertinaplatz.

phrases.clear_morning: In the breakfast lounge, guests watch the sun rise over the Danube River while the Hungarian Parliament Building catches the first light.
phrases.clear_midday: The Danube River is blue at midday, and the Hungarian Parliament Building stands clear on the far bank, easy to study window by window.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Danube River this morning, and the Hungarian Parliament Building goes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the river-view rooms follow the clouds this afternoon as they drift over Margaret Island and the Pest riverbank.
phrases.overcast: The sky is grey today, the Danube River is grey too, and the Hungarian Parliament Building sits calmly between them.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on the Danube River, and guests watch the Hungarian Parliament Building appear and disappear like a slow magic trick.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: the Hungarian Parliament Building is still visible across the Danube River, but Margaret Island is lost from sight.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and behind the drops the Hungarian Parliament Building looks slightly out of focus.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests count the seconds between lightning and thunder as each flash lights up the Hungarian Parliament Building across the Danube River.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Danube River, and the Hungarian Parliament Building fades to a soft white outline on the Pest riverbank.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Hungarian Parliament Building stands sharp against a pale blue sky, and the Danube River runs dark below it.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests leave their coats on the hook a little longer and look at the Danube bridges and the Pest riverbank.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Danube River shines like metal, and the Hungarian Parliament Building seems to float above it in the bright air.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests follow the Danube River with their eyes from the Danube bridges to Margaret Island.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Hungarian Parliament Building gold, and the Danube River carries the same colour below it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Pest riverbank turn pink, and guests stop what they are doing to look across the Danube River.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Hungarian Parliament Building glows across the Danube River, and the low sky takes some of its warm colour.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of the Hungarian Parliament Building stretch into long gold lines on the Danube River.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Danube River moves quietly past, and few guests are awake to see the Pest riverbank so still.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Hungarian Parliament Building and the Chain Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear above the Bay of Palermo, and Monte Pellegrino stands as a dark shape behind the pool terrace.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests take breakfast on the terrace of Florio Restaurant under a clear sky, with the Bay of Palermo bright blue in front of them.
phrases.clear_midday: From the pool terrace at midday, the full sweep of the Bay of Palermo is sharp and blue, with Monte Pellegrino behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Bay of Palermo this morning, and the boats in the marina move in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at Igiea Terrazza Bar spend the afternoon following clouds as they drift over the marina and the bay.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Bay of Palermo turns the colour of slate, and the white boats in the marina stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Bay of Palermo today, and Monte Pellegrino is only a faint outline behind the pool terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the Bay of Palermo is not visible today, so guests look at the marina and the palms in the garden instead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Bay of Palermo, and guests in the sea view rooms watch the marina through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Bay of Palermo, and guests stay inside to watch lightning flash above the dark water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Bay of Palermo, and guests at the windows watch the flakes land on the palms in the garden.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold air, Monte Pellegrino looks close and sharp above the empty pool terrace and the bright bay.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Bay of Palermo lies grey-blue beyond the terrace of Florio Restaurant, where the heaters are doing their work.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests leave the water of the pool only to look at the Bay of Palermo shimmering beyond the stone columns.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, sun loungers fill up on the terraces above the sea, and books stay closed while guests watch boats cross the bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the stone columns of the pool terrace gold, and the Bay of Palermo shines behind them in this 1900 palace garden.
phrases.partly_golden: With a glass in hand at Igiea Terrazza Bar, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over the marina and its boats.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening sky is cloudy over the Bay of Palermo, and the lights of the marina shine on the calm water below the terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: From the balcony rooms facing the sea, guests see the marina lights blur in the evening rain, with the bay black behind them.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the Bay of Palermo is a wide dark space beyond the garden pines, dotted with harbour lights.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Bay of Palermo tonight, and guests on the terrace of Florio Restaurant look across the water to the lights along the shore.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Bay of Palermo is quiet and black, and only the masts in the marina show against the water.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Bay of Palermo after sunset, and the first lights come on in the marina.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Rhône River is quiet and dark, and the first pale light shows the ridge where Fourvière Basilica stands.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Rhône River, and guests in the river-facing rooms have breakfast with the water shining below.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Part-Dieu skyline stands sharp across the Rhône River.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Fourvière hill this morning, and Fourvière Basilica goes from shade to sunshine and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow the cloud shadows as they cross the Rhône River and move over the rooftops of Lyon this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: The sky is grey from one side to the other today, and the Rhône River has taken the same quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the ridge today, and guests see Fourvière Basilica as a light outline above the city.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Part-Dieu skyline is not visible today; guests see the Rhône River and its tree-lined bank clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Rhône River, and guests in the river-view suites watch small circles spread across the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Lyon, and each flash of lightning shows Fourvière Basilica on the ridge for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Rhône River, and guests watch the rooftops of Lyon slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests can pick out every detail of Fourvière Basilica from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in this 18th-century building look at the Rhône River from behind the windows, with no wish to go closer.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Rhône River, and people on the river banks stay close to the shade of the trees.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests look down at people walking along the banks of the Rhône River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun warms the facades along the Rhône River, and guests on the balconies of the Presidential Suite have the whole river to look at.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Fourvière hill turn orange, and Fourvière Basilica stands in front of them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit Fourvière Basilica glows on its ridge above the lights of Lyon.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests watch the city lights stretch into long reflections on the Rhône River.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of the Part-Dieu skyline shine across the Rhône River.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests in the river-facing rooms see the lit Fourvière Basilica under the stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Rhône River moves silently past, and nothing else in the view is in a hurry either.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Rhône River one by one.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the walls of Aliso Canyon stand black against a sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of the canyon walls first, then moves down the green hills toward the pool.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every fold in the green hills around the pool is easy to see.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the 9-hole golf course this morning and climb the canyon walls on the other side.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From balcony rooms, guests follow patches of sun and shade moving across the wooded hillside this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits like a lid on Aliso Canyon, and the green hills look darker under it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the canyon walls today, and the hills seem to end halfway up.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of Aliso Canyon is not visible today; guests see only the nearest green hills clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Aliso Canyon, and guests watch the wet hills from the wide windows of The Treehouse.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the canyon walls for a second, then the thunder rolls between the hills on three sides.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling in Aliso Canyon, and the green hills above the golf course are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the canyon walls look sharp and close above the empty pool deck.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look at the chaparral hills from behind their balcony doors, coats still on.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool and look up at the dry canyon walls from the water.
phrases.warm: By the pool, guests leave their books closed and look at the hillside of Aliso Canyon instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the wooded hillside gold, and guests in the restaurant booths look at it across the golf course.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and lights one side of Aliso Canyon, leaving the other in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the hills around the pool lose their green and slowly become one dark wall.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Aliso Canyon this evening, and the nearest hills slowly disappear behind it.
phrases.mild_night: With no stars tonight, the hills close in on three sides and seem nearer than by day.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky between the canyon walls, and guests look up at them through their windows.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the canyon walls and the night sky are almost the same colour.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky above Aliso Canyon is still bright, while the green hills are already turning grey.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Yasaka Pagoda is a dark shape above the tiled roofs of Higashiyama, under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: In the guest lounge, guests drink their morning coffee in front of Yasaka Pagoda, which stands sharp in the clear early light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, each of the five roofs of Yasaka Pagoda is easy to count from the terrace of K36 The Bar & Rooftop.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the tiled roofs of Higashiyama this morning, and Yasaka Pagoda goes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony of the Panoramic Suite, guests look past Yasaka Pagoda to Kyoto Tower, with afternoon clouds passing behind it.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the wooden tower of Yasaka Pagoda stands out clearly against the pale cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Higashiyama today; Yasaka Pagoda is still clear above the roofs, while Kyoto Tower looks like a pencil line behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Kyoto Tower and the mountains are not visible today, so the view stops at Yasaka Pagoda and the nearest tiled roofs.
phrases.rain: Rain runs off the five roofs of Yasaka Pagoda, and guests in the pagoda-facing rooms watch it from bed.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Higashiyama, and for a second Yasaka Pagoda and the wet tiled roofs around it appear in white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the five roofs of Yasaka Pagoda, and guests in this 1933 former school watch each roof turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and Yasaka Pagoda shows every beam and roof edge to guests behind the lounge windows.
phrases.cold: The cold day keeps the air still, and Yasaka Pagoda stands above the tiled roofs of Higashiyama with Kyoto Tower small behind it.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the tiled roofs, and guests on the 4th-floor terrace of K36 The Bar & Rooftop look at Yasaka Pagoda over a cold drink and move very little.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the terrace rooms sit outside and look across the tiled roofs to Yasaka Pagoda.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At K36 The Bar & Rooftop, guests watch the low sun turn Yasaka Pagoda gold, and the aperitif waits a little.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights Kyoto Tower for a few minutes, while Yasaka Pagoda is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in the guest lounge sit with a glass and look straight at the lit Yasaka Pagoda.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the city lights this evening, and the lit Yasaka Pagoda glows softly through the falling water.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers the night sky, and the lit Yasaka Pagoda stands out above the dark roofs of Higashiyama.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests on the Panoramic Suite balcony see two lit towers: Yasaka Pagoda nearby and Kyoto Tower far behind it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, nothing moves on the tiled roofs of Higashiyama, and Yasaka Pagoda stands over them in the quiet.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the lamps come on at Yasaka Pagoda, directly beyond the rail of K36 The Bar & Rooftop.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the N'wanetsi valley is a dark shape under a clear sky, and the cliff below the suites is still black.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light fills the N'wanetsi valley, and from the rooftop terrace the bush runs to the full horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch by the two long pools, guests look down at the brown N'wanetsi River and the tall euphorbia trees beside it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the N'wanetsi valley this morning, and from the rooftop terrace they can be followed to the horizon.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the N'wanetsi River this afternoon, and the Long Bar frames the changing light.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the N'wanetsi River looks muddier, and the euphorbia trees stand out sharply on its banks.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the N'wanetsi valley today, and from the rooftop terrace the far ridges fade into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible from the rooftop terrace today; guests see the N'wanetsi River and the near side of the valley.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the N'wanetsi valley, and guests in the loft suites watch it through glass on three sides.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls down the N'wanetsi valley, and guests at the Long Bar watch lightning show the river for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the N'wanetsi valley, a sight so unlikely that guests at the Long Bar check it twice.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the air is sharp and clear, and every euphorbia tree above the N'wanetsi River stands out.
phrases.cold: The N'wanetsi River runs brown and quiet below the cliff on this cold day, under a wide Kruger sky.
phrases.very_hot: Under wide umbrellas on the pool deck, guests wait in the heat for elephants to come down to the N'wanetsi River.
phrases.warm: From the canvas deckchairs by the pool, guests watch the N'wanetsi River, a modest stream with a very loyal audience.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills the N'wanetsi valley, and guests in the 13 loft suites watch it through their glass walls.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and turns the N'wanetsi River to copper, framed by the Long Bar.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars this evening, and guests dining by the pool look past the lanterns into the black valley.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the N'wanetsi valley this evening, and the Long Bar frames nothing but water and darkness.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the N'wanetsi valley below the rooftop terrace is a wide darkness without a single light.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the N'wanetsi valley from one horizon to the other, and the rooftop terrace is open to all of them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the N'wanetsi River runs unseen below the cliff, and the glass walls of the loft suites show only night.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the western sky stays bright above the N'wanetsi valley, as it has for guests here since 2001.

phrases.clear_predawn: Yoyogi Park is still a dark shape below, while the first pale light shows behind the Tokyo skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Yoyogi Park, and guests at breakfast time look down on bright green treetops.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday every tower in the Tokyo skyline is sharp, and guests can pick out Shibuya without any help.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests start the day watching sun and shade swap places on the treetops of Yoyogi Park.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the clouds keep changing which towers of the Tokyo skyline stand in the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under the grey cloud Yoyogi Park keeps its colour, while the Tokyo skyline behind it fades to the same grey.
phrases.fog_haze: Today the haze leaves only pale outlines of the Tokyo skyline, so guests look at Yoyogi Park close below instead.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today: the far towers of the Tokyo skyline are missing, and the view ends at Shibuya and Yoyogi Park.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Yoyogi Park, and its treetops look darker and greener with the Tokyo skyline grey behind them.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the city, and guests stay indoors to watch lightning flash above the Tokyo skyline.
phrases.snow: Snow is coming down over Yoyogi Park, and guests stay indoors to watch the treetops slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Nobody is hurrying up to the infinity pool today; guests admire the sharp Tokyo skyline from indoors.
phrases.cold: A day for looking rather than walking: guests stay indoors and trace the Tokyo skyline from one end to the other.
phrases.very_hot: Swimmers in the infinity pool cool off up to their shoulders while Yoyogi Park lies green below in the heat.
phrases.warm: Guests lean on the edge of the infinity pool and look across the treetops of Yoyogi Park to the Tokyo skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light lies across the treetops of Yoyogi Park, and the green turns warmer as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the Tokyo skyline stands in warm light whenever the clouds leave a gap.
phrases.grey_evening: Yoyogi Park is a wide dark space in the view this evening, with the lights of Shibuya glowing under the cloud beyond it.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests watch the lights of the Tokyo skyline shine through tonight's rain, each one a little soft at the edges.
phrases.mild_night: The lights of the Tokyo skyline give the clouds above them a soft glow tonight.
phrases.clear_night: One more look before bed shows guests the Tokyo skyline all lit and Yoyogi Park a quiet dark shape below.
phrases.late_night: Guests who cannot sleep find Yoyogi Park a wide dark shape below, the big city around it gone quiet.
phrases.dusk: Shibuya is switching on its lights while the sky behind the Tokyo skyline is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky grows pale over the Inner Harbour before sunrise, and the causeway below is still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the Fairmont Gold lounge, guests look out at the Inner Harbour in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: The Parliament buildings stand sharp against a blue midday sky, across the water from the harbour-view rooms.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Inner Harbour this morning, and their shadows cross the moored yachts one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: During afternoon tea in the Lobby Lounge, guests look through the windows at the Inner Harbour under passing clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Inner Harbour turns the colour of slate, and the moored yachts stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Inner Harbour today, and from the Lobby Lounge the Parliament buildings are only a soft outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the Inner Harbour is not clear today, but the causeway and the nearest yachts are still easy to see.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of the harbour-view rooms, and the yachts in the Inner Harbour blur behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Inner Harbour, and guests in the Royal Suite watch lightning flash above the Parliament buildings.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the causeway and on the decks of the moored yachts, and guests watch it from the Lobby Lounge.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Parliament buildings look close enough to touch across the Inner Harbour.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 1908 hotel stay inside the Lobby Lounge and let the Inner Harbour do the moving.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, the Inner Harbour shines so brightly that guests on the terrace look at the moored yachts through half-closed eyes.
phrases.warm: On the terrace, guests sit in the warm air and count the yachts moored in the Inner Harbour.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights the Parliament buildings, and guests in the Fairmont Gold lounge look at them across the Inner Harbour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud and turns the Inner Harbour orange around the moored yachts.
phrases.grey_evening: From the bar, guests look over the Inner Harbour this evening, with the lit Parliament buildings glowing under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of the Parliament buildings stretch across the shining causeway, seen from the Governor General Suite on the 6th floor.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers the stars tonight, and the bulbs on the Parliament buildings shine over the Inner Harbour instead.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Parliament buildings are drawn in light, and the Inner Harbour repeats the picture on its water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Inner Harbour is dark and still, and only the shapes of the moored yachts show on the water.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the first of thousands of bulbs come on along the Parliament buildings.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Limmat River is a quiet dark band below, and the Old Town spires wait for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: On this clear morning, guests in rooms on the 15th floor and above catch glimpses of the Alps.
phrases.clear_midday: The Limmat River shines under a clear midday sky, and the Old Town spires stand sharp beyond it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Old Town this morning, and their shadows cross the rooftops one spire at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow the Limmat River through patches of afternoon sun and shade as the clouds drift over it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Limmat River turns the colour of slate, and the Old Town spires keep their clear outline.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Old Town today, and guests see its spires as faint shapes above the Limmat River.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today; guests see the Limmat River and the nearer Old Town spires instead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Limmat River, and guests watch the drops mark the water from the river-facing rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Old Town spires for a second, and then thunder rolls along the Limmat River.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Old Town, and guests watch the rooftops turn white around the spires.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, bright air, guests on the 15th floor and above see the Alps while holding a warm cup.
phrases.cold: Through the restaurant's large windows, guests look at the trees outside on this cold day.
phrases.very_hot: The heat is strong today, and guests look from the cool indoors at the Limmat River with some envy.
phrases.warm: On this warm day the Limmat River looks inviting from above, and guests count the Old Town spires behind it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Old Town spires gold, and from the 15th floor and above the Alps show in the same warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and guests see it land on the Limmat River in bright strips.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening of cloud, the Old Town spires light up, and guests in this 19-floor tower look across at them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lit Old Town spires blur a little, and the Limmat River carries their reflections.
phrases.mild_night: Guests end the mild night looking at the lit Old Town spires under a sky of cloud.
phrases.clear_night: The Old Town spires glow against a clear night sky, and the Limmat River runs black between the lights.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Old Town sleeps, and the Limmat River moves quietly past its unlit spires.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests watch the first lights come on around the Old Town spires.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the San Francisco skyline is a set of dark towers under a clear sky that slowly turns blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the San Francisco skyline, and guests see it through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the San Francisco skyline is sharp under a clear blue sky, every tower easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the San Francisco skyline this morning, from one tower to the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace suites, guests look at the bay this afternoon as clouds drift over the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the San Francisco skyline takes the same colour as the clouds above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the San Francisco skyline today, and guests wait at the glass for the towers to come back.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the far towers of the San Francisco skyline are not visible, only the nearest ones.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the San Francisco skyline looks blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole San Francisco skyline for a second, and then the storm hides it again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the San Francisco skyline, and guests in this 32-floor tower stop to watch.
phrases.very_cold: The cold air is very clear today, and the San Francisco skyline looks close enough to touch.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay inside and look at the San Francisco skyline in pale light.
phrases.very_hot: Heat makes the air shake above the rooftops, and the San Francisco skyline shines in the strong sun.
phrases.warm: From the bay view suites, guests see the bay bright and calm beside the city on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light falls on the San Francisco skyline, and the hills behind the towers turn warm too.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink and orange above the San Francisco skyline, and guests stay by the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the San Francisco skyline give the grey sky a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the San Francisco skyline spread in the drops on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the clouds sit low over the San Francisco skyline, and guests see its lights from bed.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the high-floor suites look at the lit San Francisco skyline and the Bay Bridge.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the San Francisco skyline is quiet, and guests who cannot sleep have it to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights come on across the San Francisco skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the dome of St Peter's Basilica stands grey against a clear sky that slowly turns pale above Rome's rooftops.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on Trinità dei Monti and Rome's rooftops, seen from the panoramic terrace.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the view from the panoramic terrace runs from the Spanish Steps to St Peter's Basilica.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Rome's rooftops this morning, and guests at Mirabelle watch the dome of St Peter's Basilica go in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The terrace suites look over Villa Borghese, where clouds pass slowly above the trees this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, guests at Mirabelle still see the clear outline of St Peter's Basilica through the windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Rome's rooftops today, and the dome of St Peter's Basilica seems to float above them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: St Peter's Basilica is not in sight from the panoramic terrace, and only the nearer rooftops and Trinità dei Monti are clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of Adèle Mixology Lounge on the 8th floor, and St Peter's Basilica turns soft and grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Rome's rooftops, and each flash of lightning shows the dome of St Peter's Basilica for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Rome's rooftops, and St Peter's Basilica fades behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests at the windows of Mirabelle see every line of St Peter's Basilica.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to the warm side of the glass at Adèle Mixology Lounge and look out at Trinità dei Monti.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the panoramic terrace stay in the shade and watch Rome's rooftops shimmer.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests in the terrace suites sit outside and look over the green trees of Villa Borghese.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late golden light warms Villa Medici and the rooftops around it, seen from the panoramic terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and turns the dome of St Peter's Basilica orange for guests at Adèle Mixology Lounge.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Mirabelle, guests look over the city lights to the lit dome of St Peter's Basilica under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests with cocktails at Adèle Mixology Lounge watch the city lights shine on Rome's wet rooftops.
phrases.mild_night: From this former 19th-century monastery, clouds glow softly above Rome's rooftops and the lit dome of St Peter's Basilica.
phrases.clear_night: Trinità dei Monti stands lit among the city lights, and stars show in the clear sky above Rome's rooftops.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Rome's rooftops are quiet, and the trees of Villa Borghese are one dark shape below the terrace suites.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on around Trinità dei Monti and the Spanish Steps.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Seville Cathedral and the Giralda Tower stand unlit above the quiet rooftops of the city.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Giralda Tower first, then moves down to the rooftops of Seville below the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_midday: From the fitness area, guests look through the windows at the Giralda Tower under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past the Giralda Tower this morning, and their shadows cross the rooftops of Seville one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, guests see the Giralda Tower change from bright to grey each time a cloud passes this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Seville Cathedral and the Giralda Tower take the colour of old stone above the city rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Giralda Tower today, and guests in the balcony rooms facing it see its outline more than its details.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the far rooftops of Seville are lost and only the Giralda Tower and Seville Cathedral remain in sight.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftops of Seville, and guests in the fitness area watch it run down in front of the Giralda Tower.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Giralda Tower for a second above Seville Cathedral, then the thunder follows across the rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Seville, and guests in the fitness area stop their exercise to see it settle on the rooftops around the Giralda Tower.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear, and every line of the Giralda Tower is sharp from the windows of the fitness area.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in rooms with balconies facing the Giralda Tower look at it from behind the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests on the rooftop terrace keep to the shade and look across at the white light on Seville Cathedral.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the rooftop terrace look over the rooftops of Seville to the Giralda Tower, in no hurry at all.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Giralda Tower and Seville Cathedral gold, and the rooftops around the rooftop terrace take the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: From a 15th-century palace, guests see the last sun slip between the clouds and light the top of the Giralda Tower.
phrases.grey_evening: On the rooftop terrace this evening, the lit Giralda Tower and Seville Cathedral stand at close range under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of Seville Cathedral and the Giralda Tower shine through a wet evening, and the rooftops below them are glossy.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud holds the glow of the lit Giralda Tower tonight, and guests in the balcony rooms keep their curtains open a little longer.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit Giralda Tower rises over the rooftop terrace with more lights on it than stars above it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Giralda Tower stands over the sleeping rooftops of Seville.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Seville Cathedral and up the Giralda Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Arno River is still and dark, and the sky slowly turns pale behind Ponte Vecchio.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun rises over Ponte Vecchio, and guests in the balcony rooms watch the first light reach the Arno River.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Arno River shines below the hotel, and every roof line of Ponte Vecchio is easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Tuscan hills this morning, and their shadows cross the Arno River one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the Arno River this afternoon, and guests see the Oltrarno rooftops change colour each time.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits low over Florence today, and the Arno River carries the same grey down past the weir.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on the Arno River, and Ponte Vecchio appears and disappears to the left like a slow magic trick.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tuscan hills are not visible today; the Arno River and Ponte Vecchio are still clear enough from the river side of the hotel.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Arno River with small circles, and guests in the river-view suites watch Ponte Vecchio turn blurry.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Ponte Vecchio for a second, and guests count the moments until thunder rolls along the Arno River.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Arno River and melts at once, while the Tuscan hills behind Ponte Vecchio slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Arno River can be followed all the way to Ponte Vecchio.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep their coffee indoors and their eyes on the Arno River, Ponte Vecchio and the Tuscan hills.
phrases.very_hot: Heat makes the Tuscan hills shimmer, and guests on The St. Regis Terrace look at the slow Arno River with a cold drink in hand.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests take a table on The St. Regis Terrace and look along the Arno River toward Ponte Vecchio.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Arno River gold, and from The St. Regis Terrace Ponte Vecchio glows at the end of it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and guests in the Presidential Suite watch Ponte Vecchio light up and fade again.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the lamps along the Arno River draw a bright line to Ponte Vecchio.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and the lights of the riverbank stretch into long reflections on the Arno River.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests open their balcony doors to the sound of the Arno River, with Ponte Vecchio glowing to the left.
phrases.clear_night: A hotel since 1866, and on a clear night Ponte Vecchio still stands lit above its own reflection in the Arno River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Arno River moves quietly past the hotel, and Ponte Vecchio is a dark shape against the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Tuscan hills, and the first lamps come on along the Arno River below The St. Regis Terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear and still deep blue, and the twin towers of the University Church stand as two dark shapes above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in SOLID Sky Bar, guests look down on the twin towers of the University Church in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The Budapest skyline is sharp under a clear midday sky, with every roof and spire easy to pick out through the huge windows of SOLID Sky Bar.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Budapest skyline this morning, and guests at breakfast on the 7th floor watch the shadows cross the twin towers of the University Church.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the city this afternoon, so the twin towers of the University Church go bright, then grey, then bright again.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Budapest skyline turns one quiet colour, and the twin towers of the University Church still stand out clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Budapest skyline today, and the twin towers of the University Church look like a pencil sketch on grey paper.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Budapest skyline is not visible today, so guests see only the twin towers of the University Church and the nearest rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the huge windows of SOLID Sky Bar, and the twin towers of the University Church look slightly blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Budapest skyline, and for a second the twin towers of the University Church show white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the downtown rooftops, and the twin towers of the University Church are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests stay behind the glass of SOLID Sky Bar and look out at a Budapest skyline sharp in the icy air.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps the roof closed, and guests on the 7th floor look through the glass at the twin towers of the University Church.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the downtown rooftops shimmer, and guests look at the shaded side of the twin towers of the University Church with some envy.
phrases.warm: On this warm day the roof of SOLID Sky Bar is open, and guests sit under the sky with the Budapest skyline all around them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the twin towers of the University Church gold, and the Budapest skyline behind them glows under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and lights the Budapest skyline from the side, leaving long shadows between the rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs low over the city this evening, and the lights of the Budapest skyline give it a soft orange glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain makes the downtown rooftops shine, and the city lights around the twin towers of the University Church spread into soft circles.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of the Budapest skyline shine on beneath a sky with no stars.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the Budapest skyline on this clear night, and guests in this 40-room hotel count church spires instead of sheep.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours downtown Budapest sleeps, and the twin towers of the University Church keep quiet company with the empty rooftops.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on across the Budapest skyline beyond the huge windows of SOLID Sky Bar.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Victoria Harbour lies still and grey-blue under a clear sky, with Kowloon waiting on the far side.

phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests in the lounge follow Victoria Harbour from Central to Kowloon and on to Island East.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Victoria Harbour this morning, and guests in harbour-view rooms watch them move toward Kowloon.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests take afternoon tea in the lounge while clouds and sunshine take turns on Victoria Harbour.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Victoria Harbour turns the colour of steel, and the Kowloon skyline stands flat behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits on Victoria Harbour today, and the Kowloon skyline is only a faint outline from the private dining room's floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: from the floors above the 21st, guests see the near water of Victoria Harbour but not the Kowloon side.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of Mirage Bar, and Victoria Harbour behind it turns soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Victoria Harbour, and guests in harbour-view rooms count the seconds before the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Victoria Harbour, and guests in the lounge leave their coffee to watch the flakes disappear into the water.
phrases.very_cold: In very cold, clear air, the Kowloon skyline looks close enough to touch across Victoria Harbour.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the outdoor pool is quiet, and the harbour skyline beyond the palm trees has the lounge chairs to itself.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool and look out at the harbour skyline shimmering beyond the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests lie under the umbrellas by the outdoor pool, with the harbour skyline spread out in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light slides across Victoria Harbour in the late afternoon, and the towers of Kowloon turn warm on the far side.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests at Mirage Bar watch the clouds over Victoria Harbour turn orange through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs low this evening, and from Mirage Bar the lights of Kowloon spread across Victoria Harbour in long reflections.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests at Mirage Bar stay dry behind the glass and watch the harbour lights blur in the rain.
phrases.mild_night: With about two-thirds of the 857 rooms facing the water, many curtains stay open tonight on a cloudy Victoria Harbour and its lights.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lights of the Kowloon skyline line the far side of Victoria Harbour, sharp from one end to the other.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Victoria Harbour is a wide stretch of quiet water, resting between one busy day and the next.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Victoria Harbour is still bright, and the first lights come on along the Kowloon side.

phrases.clear_predawn: Nothing moves on Lake Como yet; the water is dark and the day has not started.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Panoramic Suite, guests open the curtains on a bright morning, and Lake Como is already blue.
phrases.clear_midday: At L˜ARIA, guests eat lunch with a clear view of the lake.
phrases.partly_morning: The lake changes from grey to blue and back again as the morning clouds pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross Lake Como this afternoon, with sunny water between them.
phrases.overcast: Under a full cover of cloud, the lake is grey and calm all the way across.
phrases.fog_haze: Lake Como fades into white fog a short way out, and the botanical gardens look close and very green.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the lake cannot be seen today; only the water near the hotel is clear.
phrases.rain: The botanical gardens shine wet and dark green while rain clouds hang low over the lake.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Panoramic Suite count the seconds between flash and thunder as the storm crosses Lake Como.
phrases.snow: From the Thermal Area, guests watch snowflakes land on the lake and vanish.
phrases.very_cold: From the warm Thermal Area, guests look out at the lake on a freezing day.
phrases.cold: Lake Como lies quiet and almost empty on this cold day.
phrases.very_hot: Nobody at the Outdoor Pool is in a hurry to get out of the water, with Lake Como bright in front of them.
phrases.warm: Between swims, guests at the pool dry off in the sun and face Lake Como.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Long shadows stretch from the botanical gardens toward the lake as the afternoon turns gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun comes and goes between the clouds, and Lake Como turns gold each time it returns.
phrases.grey_evening: With each course at L˜ARIA, dinner guests see the lake grow a little darker.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests at dinner in L˜ARIA watch the evening rain fall on the black lake.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the curtains stay open in the Panoramic Suite, where guests look out at a dark, quiet lake.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over Lake Como tonight, and the water is calm enough to hold a few of them.
phrases.late_night: In the deep of the night the lake is black and silent while the guests sleep.
phrases.dusk: The lake keeps the pale light of dusk for a few more minutes while the botanical gardens turn dark.

phrases.clear_predawn: Dubai Creek lies still and dark, and the Burj Khalifa is a thin shape against the first pale light.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the pool and move on toward the Dubai skyline.
phrases.overcast: The Burj Khalifa looks like a pencil line today, drawn in grey on a grey sky.
phrases.fog_haze: Across Dubai Creek, haze softens the skyline into a row of pale shapes for guests in the King Skyline View rooms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the nearer part of Dubai Creek is clear today; the Burj Khalifa and the skyline behind it cannot be seen.

phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the King Skyline View rooms count the seconds between lightning over the Dubai skyline and the thunder that follows.
phrases.snow: Behind the glass of the King Skyline View rooms, guests watch snow fall on Dubai Creek.
phrases.very_cold: Nobody is on Lagoon Beach by Twiggy today, and the Dubai skyline stands sharp in the cold air.

phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool up to their shoulders and look at the Dubai skyline from the water.
phrases.warm: At Lagoon Beach by Twiggy, guests lie back with the Dubai skyline lined up in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun paints one side of the Burj Khalifa gold and leaves the other in shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: From Lagoon Beach by Twiggy, the Dubai skyline glows orange where the last sun gets through the clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: This evening the Burj Khalifa shines under a cloudy sky, with the Dubai skyline lit around it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this rainy evening, the lit Burj Khalifa glows like a lamp behind a wet curtain.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the lights of the Dubai skyline lie on the water of Dubai Creek and the marina.
phrases.clear_night: On a night this clear, the Burj Khalifa is lit from bottom to top, a bright line above the Dubai skyline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the few guests still awake find the Burj Khalifa standing tall over a quiet Dubai skyline.
phrases.dusk: From the pool, the Dubai skyline shows its first lights while the sky behind is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Table Mountain is a dark shape above the gardens, and the sky behind it is slowly turning pale.

phrases.clear_midday: Table Mountain stands sharp against a clear blue sky, rising directly behind the pink facade and the outdoor pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift across the top of Table Mountain this morning, while the gardens below stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests looking across the gardens this afternoon follow the cloud shadows as they slide over Table Mountain.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Table Mountain turns the colour of slate, and the palm trees in the gardens look greener in front of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Table Mountain today, and from the gardens its outline looks drawn in pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Table Mountain cannot be seen from the gardens today; the view ends at the palm trees and the nearest Cape Town buildings.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the gardens, and guests in the mountain view suites watch Table Mountain fade behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Table Mountain for a second above the gardens, then the storm hides it again.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the balconies, guests watch the low sun turn Table Mountain gold, with Cape Town buildings framed by palm trees below.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over Table Mountain pink, a close match for the facade that has been pink since 1918.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Cape Town glow beyond the palm trees, and Table Mountain disappears into the dark above them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the mountain view suites tonight, and the lights of Cape Town blur where Table Mountain stood by day.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, cloud covers the top of Table Mountain, and the gardens lie quiet beneath it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars sit above Table Mountain tonight, and its edge is easy to follow from the gardens.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the gardens are still, and Table Mountain keeps watch over a hotel that opened in 1899.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, guests see the sky stay bright behind Lion's Head as the first lights come on among the Cape Town buildings.

phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Spree turns the same grey, while the dome of Berlin Cathedral keeps its green.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Berlin Cathedral today, so the dome looks like a drawing on the far side of the Spree.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The city behind Berlin Cathedral is not visible today; the dome and the Spree just below it remain clear enough.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Spree, and guests in the restaurant watch the drops mark the water along the river bank.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Berlin Cathedral, and each flash of lightning shows the dome above the Spree.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Berlin Cathedral, and guests in the balcony rooms watch the green dome slowly turn white.

phrases.warm: On a warm day, tour boats pass on the Spree, and people walk around the dome of Berlin Cathedral, small but clear from here.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Berlin Cathedral gold, and the Spree carries the same colour past the outdoor terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds, and the dome of Berlin Cathedral shines for a moment above the Spree.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit dome of Berlin Cathedral glows across the Spree, a little like a fairytale.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of Berlin Cathedral shake in the Spree, and guests in the restaurant watch the river bank shine.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Spree moves quietly below, and Berlin Cathedral is a large still shape beyond it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright behind Berlin Cathedral, and the first lights come on along the Spree.

phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the sun comes and goes, and the Downtown LA skyline changes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the towers of the Downtown LA skyline take the same colour as the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Downtown LA skyline today, and the farthest towers look like pencil drawings.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests on the rooftop pool deck see the nearest towers of the Downtown LA skyline and not the far ones.

phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the city, and lightning flashes behind the towers of the Downtown LA skyline.

phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day, the Downtown LA skyline is clear in the thin air, and guests admire it from behind the large windows.

phrases.warm: On the striped loungers of the rooftop pool deck, books stay closed while guests look at the Downtown LA skyline instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the Downtown LA skyline gold, and guests on the rooftop pool deck stop talking to look.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Downtown LA skyline turn orange and the towers catch the same light.

phrases.thunderstorm: A flash of lightning shows every tower of the Tokyo skyline for one second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Tokyo skyline, and guests watch the towers slowly turn white.

phrases.very_hot: Heat turns Mount Fuji into a pale outline today, far behind the Tokyo skyline.

phrases.grey_evening: After dark, the Tokyo skyline is a wide field of lights under a cloudy sky.

phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look at South Beach through the glass, where the wind bends the palm trees.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the beach chairs look at the Atlantic and plan the short walk into it.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the cabana room terraces look over the infinity pool and the palm trees, where swimmers move slowly.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the sand of South Beach gold, and the Atlantic behind it takes a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Atlantic turn pink, and South Beach glows below them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in the city view suites look at the lights of the Art Deco district.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights along South Beach blur on the wet glass while the Atlantic disappears into the dark.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the Atlantic is a dark shape beyond South Beach, and the clouds hold the glow of the city.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show over the Atlantic tonight, and the lights of Miami Beach shine along the edge of South Beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, South Beach lies still, and only the white lines of the waves move on the Atlantic.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over South Beach, and the first lights come on along the Miami Beach skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Robson Square lies quiet and empty below, and the clear sky above the Vancouver Art Gallery is just starting to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the terrace suites, guests see the morning sun reach Robson Square below and the Vancouver Art Gallery stand in clear light.
phrases.clear_midday: The midday sun falls straight onto Robson Square, and every tree and plaza in the garden is easy to pick out from above.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Robson Square this morning, while the Vancouver Art Gallery moves in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests look down from their private balconies as patches of afternoon sun travel over the trees of Robson Square.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Vancouver Art Gallery looks calm and serious, and the trees of Robson Square give the colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs over Robson Square today, and guests see the nearest trees clearly while the Vancouver Art Gallery fades to an outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far downtown towers are not visible today, but Robson Square and the Vancouver Art Gallery stay clear just below.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Robson Square, and the wet plazas shine under the trees and the grey sky.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over downtown, and for a second the Vancouver Art Gallery and Robson Square stand out bright in the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Robson Square, and guests watch the trees and the plazas turn white one layer at a time.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, guests see every line of the Vancouver Art Gallery sharply across Robson Square, and stay inside to do it.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the plazas of Robson Square look quiet and tidy from above, with the Vancouver Art Gallery steady beside them.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the balconies watch people look for shade under the mature trees of Robson Square.
phrases.warm: Guests in this hotel of 83 rooms sit out on their balconies in the warm air, with Robson Square green below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light warms the Vancouver Art Gallery, and the trees of Robson Square throw long shadows across the plazas.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and guests see Robson Square turn gold in pieces, one plaza after another.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests see the lights of Robson Square glow softly, with the Vancouver Art Gallery lit beside them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights are reflected in the rain-covered ground of Robson Square, and each one appears twice.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests see the clouds over the Vancouver Art Gallery take a faint glow from the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the downtown towers shine with lit windows, and Robson Square is a calm garden beneath them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Robson Square is still, and any guest who is awake has the Vancouver Art Gallery to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights come on around Robson Square and the Vancouver Art Gallery.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests in the lake-view rooms see Grasmere Lake turn from black to grey under a clear sky, with the first light on the water.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in The Dining Room, every window shows Grasmere Lake bright and blue under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Grasmere Lake shines under the midday sun, and lunch guests in The Lounge sit by the huge windows with the water just outside.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Vale of Grasmere this morning, and Helm Crag goes from dark to bright and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon tea in The Lounge has competition today, as sun and cloud take turns on Grasmere Lake outside the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Grasmere Lake turns silver-grey and fills every window of the 1st-floor restaurant, The Dining Room.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Grasmere Lake today, and from The Lounge the water seems to end a short way out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Helm Crag is not visible from the valley-view rooms today, and the Vale of Grasmere fades into pale air beyond the nearest fields.
phrases.rain: Rain marks Grasmere Lake with thousands of small rings, and guests in The Lounge count them from the dry side of the huge windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Grasmere Lake, and guests in The Dining Room see lightning turn the water white for a moment.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Vale of Grasmere, and Helm Crag slowly turns white behind the moving flakes.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air makes every edge of Grasmere Lake look sharp, and guests in this 2012 hotel study it through the glass with a hot drink in hand.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Grasmere Lake is steel-coloured below The Dining Room, and the wooded hillside behind it looks darker.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests in the balcony suites sit outside above Grasmere Lake, the water bright in the sun.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the Juliet doors of the lake-view rooms stand open, and Grasmere Lake seems almost inside the room.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Grasmere Lake gold, and the light comes in through every window of The Dining Room.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Helm Crag turn orange, and long shadows cross the Vale of Grasmere.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in The Dining Room, guests see Grasmere Lake as a dark shape under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and from The Lounge Grasmere Lake is a darker patch behind the drops on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, cloud hides the stars above Grasmere Lake, and the water close below the windows shows only a faint grey.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over Grasmere Lake tonight, and on the still water a few of them appear twice.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Grasmere Lake is quiet and black, and only the outline of the far shore shows against the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright above Grasmere Lake, and the water holds the same pale colour as the lights come on in The Lounge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Hibiya Park is still a dark shape below, and the first grey light is only starting behind the Tokyo skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: At the spa, guests begin the day looking over the Imperial Palace grounds, with every tree easy to pick out.
phrases.clear_midday: Hibiya Park is bright green below, and Tokyo Skytree is easy to find above the distant rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: The Imperial Palace grounds go from bright to dull and back again as the morning clouds pass over.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Frank Lloyd Wright Suite look up from their books to find Hibiya Park in sun one minute and in shade the next.
phrases.overcast: No shadows fall on the Imperial Palace grounds today; the trees sit quiet under a flat grey sky.
phrases.fog_haze: In today's haze, Tokyo Skytree has gone missing, while Hibiya Park stays clear and close below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tokyo skyline is not visible today, so the view stops at the trees of the Imperial Palace grounds.
phrases.rain: Guests at the spa watch the rain fall on Hibiya Park from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Imperial Palace grounds for a second at a time, and guests in the Frank Lloyd Wright Suite count the seconds to the thunder.
phrases.snow: Hibiya Park is turning white under the snow, and nobody at the spa is in a hurry to go anywhere.
phrases.very_cold: Frost stays white all day on the shaded lawns of the Imperial Palace grounds.
phrases.cold: Coats stay on their hangers in the Frank Lloyd Wright Suite, where guests are happy to look at Hibiya Park from inside.
phrases.very_hot: Guests heading out into the heat look down at Hibiya Park first and choose a path under the trees.
phrases.warm: Guests look out and plan their walk: Hibiya Park one way, the Imperial Palace grounds the other.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the trees of the Imperial Palace grounds gold, and the Tokyo skyline behind them glows.
phrases.partly_golden: Between the clouds, the last sun lands on the Imperial Palace while its grounds are already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: After dark at the spa, guests look across Hibiya Park to the Tokyo skyline glowing under the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain makes the lights of the Tokyo skyline run together, and the Imperial Palace grounds lie dark and wide beside them.
phrases.mild_night: Guests closing the curtains tonight take one more look at Tokyo Skytree, lit above the city.
phrases.clear_night: In a city of lights, the Imperial Palace grounds stay dark tonight, and guests looking out see the skyline shine beyond them.
phrases.late_night: Hibiya Park is empty and still in the small hours, and the few guests awake have it to themselves from above.
phrases.dusk: Lights come on one by one along the Tokyo skyline while the sky over the Imperial Palace grounds is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, Sydney Harbour lies still, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge is an arch against the first pale light.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, guests in the harbour view suites on floors 22 to 29 see the Sydney Opera House, the Sydney Harbour Bridge and Sydney Harbour together.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is clear, and guests can count the sailboats on Sydney Harbour near the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the city skyline this morning, and their shadows move slowly across Sydney Harbour.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Sydney Opera House goes from sun to shade and back as clouds pass over Sydney Harbour.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Sydney Harbour turns the colour of steel, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge stands out clearly against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and guests look for the Sydney Opera House as a faint shape beyond the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far coastline is not visible, but the Sydney Harbour Bridge still shows across Sydney Harbour.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Sydney Harbour, and through the floor-to-ceiling windows guests watch the boats continue their crossings without complaint.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses Sydney Harbour, and each flash of lightning shows the Sydney Harbour Bridge for a second.
