phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Sydney Harbour, and guests watch the Sydney Opera House fade behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day the air is clear, and guests can follow the whole arch of the Sydney Harbour Bridge from one side to the other.
phrases.cold: It is cold outside, so guests keep a warm coffee in hand and watch the boats cross Sydney Harbour.
phrases.very_hot: The day is very hot, and Sydney Harbour shines so bright that guests on the balconies reach for their sunglasses.
phrases.warm: Warm weather brings out the sailboats, and Sydney Harbour is dotted with sails around the Sydney Opera House.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in the balcony suites share the late sun as it turns the Sydney Harbour Bridge and Sydney Harbour gold.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the city skyline turn orange, and Sydney Harbour takes the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests watch Sydney Harbour change into a display of lights this evening, with low cloud glowing above the city skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of the Sydney Harbour Bridge shine through it in soft, broken lines.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests look at the lit Sydney Opera House across the dark water.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Sydney Harbour Bridge is lit from end to end, and the city skyline shines across Sydney Harbour.
phrases.late_night: For guests still awake in the small hours, Sydney Harbour is quiet, dark water with hardly a boat moving.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on along the Sydney Harbour Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Brisbane River is a quiet grey band under a clear sky, waiting for the first colour.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Plates Restaurant, guests look out at the Brisbane River, bright under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Brisbane River shines under a clear midday sky, and the city skyline stands sharp beyond the curve.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Brisbane River this morning, and the sailboats at the marina pass in and out of sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the corner rooms, guests follow the clouds this afternoon across a wide sweep of the Brisbane River and the city skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Brisbane River turns the colour of steel, and the white sailboats stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and the Brisbane River fades into it past the bend.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The city skyline is not visible today; from the windows of Plates Restaurant, guests see only the near stretch of the Brisbane River.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Brisbane River, and guests in the corner rooms watch it run down the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm moves over the Brisbane River, and lightning shows the city skyline for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Brisbane River, and guests at the windows of Plates Restaurant watch the flakes disappear into the water.
phrases.very_cold: In very cold, clear air, the city skyline looks close beyond the Brisbane River, every tower easy to tell apart.
phrases.cold: The pool is empty on this cold day, and the Brisbane River beyond it has the scene to itself.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the pool under the palm trees and look out over the Brisbane River from the water.
phrases.warm: By the pool on this warm day, guests on the sun loungers look up from their books to the Brisbane River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Brisbane River gold, and the moored sailboats sit on the reflected sky.
phrases.partly_golden: From the Kingsford Smith Suite, guests watch the last sun break through the clouds and light the Brisbane River below.
phrases.grey_evening: Over dinner at Plates Restaurant, guests watch the city lights glow under low cloud beyond the Brisbane River.
phrases.wet_evening: The city lights blur beyond the Brisbane River on this wet evening, and the water takes their colours.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the clouds over the city skyline hold a soft glow, and the Brisbane River reflects it.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the corner rooms leave the curtains open, with the lit city skyline and the Brisbane River on show.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Brisbane River lies still and dark, and the sailboats sleep at their moorings.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set; the sky above the Brisbane River is still bright, and the first lights appear on the city skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Reunion Tower stands as a dark shape against a sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the downtown Dallas towers, and Reunion Tower stands clear against a blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool on Uptown Terrace lies under a clear sky, with the downtown Dallas towers sharp behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over downtown Dallas this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the glass towers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the suites, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they pass behind Reunion Tower.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the downtown Dallas towers take the same colour, and Reunion Tower stands out by its shape alone.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Dallas skyline today, and Reunion Tower looks like a pencil drawing of itself.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see Reunion Tower nearby while the more distant downtown towers stay out of sight.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests see Reunion Tower slightly blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over downtown Dallas, and for a second Reunion Tower shows clearly through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on downtown Dallas, and guests watch Reunion Tower fade and return between the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing day, guests on the treadmills in the fitness center look out at downtown Dallas under a clear, bright sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the heated infinity pool lies still, with the downtown Dallas towers standing behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across the water at downtown Dallas.
phrases.warm: On the lounge chairs at Uptown Terrace, guests enjoy the warm day, and the downtown Dallas towers rise in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of downtown Dallas to gold, and the ball of Reunion Tower shines with it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests in the rooms facing Reunion Tower see the clouds behind it turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the city reflect off the infinity pool at Uptown Terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the lights of Reunion Tower shine through the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hang low over Dallas tonight, and guests in one of the 68 suites look out at the lit downtown towers.
phrases.clear_night: Reunion Tower is lit against a clear night sky, with the downtown Dallas lights spread out beside it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who are still awake find Reunion Tower in the same place and downtown Dallas very quiet.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the downtown Dallas skyline beyond the rooftop pool deck.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Empire State Building is a dark shape against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in rooms facing the Empire State Building open the curtains and find it there, face to face, in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Empire State Building stands sharp against the blue, each row of windows easy to follow to the top.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move behind the Empire State Building this morning, and its top goes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows slide across the Midtown skyline this afternoon, and guests watch them climb the Empire State Building.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Empire State Building takes the same colour and still fills the view from here.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Empire State Building today, and guests are left to guess where it ends.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far towers of the Midtown skyline are not visible today, but the Empire State Building is close and still shows from top to bottom.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass, and guests in rooms facing the Empire State Building see it slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Midtown, and guests watch from indoors as lightning flashes behind the Empire State Building.
phrases.snow: Snow falls between the hotel and the Empire State Building, and the tower fades in and out behind it.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, the Empire State Building looks even closer than usual.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass and let the Empire State Building do the standing outside.
phrases.very_hot: The heat makes the air above the Midtown skyline shimmer, and the Empire State Building rises through it into a bright sky.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the balcony rooms step out onto their narrow balconies and look straight at the Empire State Building.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Empire State Building gold, and the first guests at Strand Rooftop Bar take the stools that face it.
phrases.partly_golden: From the 21st floor, guests at Strand Rooftop Bar watch the last sun catch the Empire State Building between clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud sits over Midtown this evening, and guests at Strand Rooftop Bar see the lit top of the Empire State Building glow into it.
phrases.wet_evening: Strand Rooftop Bar is enclosed in glass, so guests stay dry this wet evening and watch the lights of the Empire State Building through the streaked panes.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night the sky is not clear, and the lights of the Midtown skyline colour the cloud around the Empire State Building.
phrases.clear_night: A hotel since 2009, and the lit Empire State Building still stops guests at their windows on a clear night.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Midtown is quiet, and the Empire State Building stands as a tall outline for the few guests still awake.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests at Strand Rooftop Bar turn to look as the first lights come on in the Empire State Building.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Windermere lies still and grey-blue below the lake-view rooms, with the far shore just beginning to show.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in Lake Edge Restaurant look down Windermere under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Windermere is bright blue at midday, and the tree-lined hills on the far shore are sharp behind the lawn.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Windermere this morning, and the wooded far shore changes from dark green to light.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lounge windows, guests follow patches of sun crossing the lawn and then Windermere.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Windermere turns the colour of slate, and the lakeside gazebo stands out on the green lawn.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist sits low on Windermere today, and from Lake Edge Restaurant the far shore comes and goes.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant hills are not visible today; guests see the lawn, the gazebo and the near water of Windermere.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of Windermere with small rings, and guests watch it from the tall lounge windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls down Windermere, and each flash of lightning shows the far shore for a second from the lounge.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the lawn and the lakeside gazebo, and Windermere looks almost black behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: Frost whitens the lawn down to the shore, and Windermere lies cold and clear under a pale sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 1797 manor keep to the lounge and look across the lawn to Windermere.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the terrace sit under the umbrellas and look across the lawn to Windermere, which shines like glass.
phrases.warm: On the lakeside terrace of Lake Edge Restaurant, books stay closed because guests keep looking at Windermere.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun crosses Windermere from the far shore, and guests in the lakeside suites watch it from their terraces.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and turns Windermere gold for a few minutes in front of the lawn.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, Windermere is a wide dark space beyond the lawn, with the far shore only a darker line.
phrases.wet_evening: In Lake Edge Restaurant this evening, guests watch rain run down the glass with Windermere dark behind it.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests on the Boathouse terrace see Windermere as dark water below a grey sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above Windermere tonight, and guests in the lakeside suites look up at them from their terraces.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Windermere is quiet and black beyond the lawn, and the far shore cannot be told from the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky above Windermere is still bright, and the water holds the colour longer than the hills.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the towers of the Makati skyline are dark shapes against a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests step onto their private balconies as the first sun reaches the glass of the Makati skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Makati skyline is sharp, and each tower is easy to tell apart.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Makati skyline this morning, and their shadows slide across Greenbelt and Glorietta below.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and shade take turns this afternoon on the glass tower that rises behind the palm trees of the outdoor pool.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits low over the Makati skyline today, and the towers take the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Makati skyline today, and the glass towers lose their edges.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Makati skyline is not visible today; guests see only the nearest towers and the trees below.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Greenbelt and Glorietta; guests watch it from their balcony doors, the Makati skyline blurred behind.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Makati skyline, and for a second every tower stands out before the thunder follows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Makati skyline, and guests stop to look at the white flakes drifting past the towers.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold air, the Makati skyline looks clean and sharp, and guests admire it from behind the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the Presidential Suite, one of 19 suites, look out across the Philippine capital.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool and look up at the glass tower rising behind the greenery.
phrases.warm: On the lounge chairs by the outdoor pool, phones stay face down while guests look at the glass tower above the palms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the Makati skyline gold, and guests on the private balconies have front-row seats.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange above the Makati skyline, and the towers catch a little of it.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit towers of the Makati skyline give the low sky a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass tonight, and the lights of the Makati skyline spread into soft coloured spots.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests look down on the lights of Greenbelt and Glorietta, with the Makati skyline lit above.
phrases.clear_night: The Makati skyline is fully lit under a clear night sky, and guests in this 578-room hotel count bright floors instead of sheep.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Makati skyline is quiet, and the towers stand still against the night sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright blue just after sunset, and the first lights come on across the Makati skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the domes of Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque stand unlit above the Golden Horn.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the rooftop at Béatrice Restaurant, guests look across the Golden Horn to Hagia Sophia under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The midday sun is high over the Golden Horn, and every minaret of the Blue Mosque is easy to count across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning clouds drift over the Golden Horn, and their shadows cross the water towards Hagia Sophia.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, guests watch sun and cloud take turns over the Blue Mosque.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Golden Horn takes the same grey, and Galata Tower stands sharp against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the far side of the Golden Horn today, and Hagia Sophia looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so guests see the Golden Horn well, but the Blue Mosque is only a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Golden Horn; guests watch it from inside the rooftop restaurant, with Hagia Sophia slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm moves over the old city, and lightning shows Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Golden Horn, and the domes of the Blue Mosque slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests stay behind the tall windows of the rooftop restaurant and look out at Hagia Sophia in sharp, clear air.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps the air clean, and guests in this 1874 building look across the Golden Horn to the Blue Mosque.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the rooftop terrace hold cold drinks and look at the Golden Horn shining below.
phrases.warm: On a warm day the rooftop terrace fills up, and most chairs turn towards Hagia Sophia by themselves.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Golden Horn to gold, a fair reason for its name, and the Blue Mosque glows behind it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in long beams, and one of them rests on the dome of Hagia Sophia.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner at Béatrice Restaurant, the sky is dark and cloudy, while Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque are lit across the Golden Horn.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lit Blue Mosque shines through the rain above the Golden Horn.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from balcony rooms guests see the lights of Istanbul under a low sky.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests see Galata Tower lit nearby and Hagia Sophia glowing beyond the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Golden Horn lies still, and only the quiet outlines of the old city show beyond it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on at Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque across the Golden Horn.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Bangkok skyline stands still and quiet under a clear sky beyond the floor-to-ceiling glass of the corner rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Early runners on the fitness centre treadmills look straight out at the Bangkok skyline in clean morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the 40-metre saltwater pool holds the Bangkok skyline under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the towers of Pathum Wan this morning, and guests in the corner rooms follow them from one side of the glass to the other.
phrases.partly_afternoon: White clouds drift over the city this afternoon, and the Bangkok skyline beyond the saltwater pool moves in and out of the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Bangkok skyline beyond the saltwater pool turns to shades of silver.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Bangkok skyline today, and the far towers fade to grey outlines from the rooftop bar of Penthouse Bar & Grill.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Bangkok skyline is not visible today; from the pool level, only the nearest towers of Pathum Wan show clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and guests in the Presidential Suite watch the Bangkok skyline blur behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Pathum Wan, and guests on the fitness centre treadmills slow down to watch lightning above the Bangkok skyline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Bangkok, and guests in this hotel of 222 rooms watch the flakes drift past the glass and across the skyline.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and every tower of the Bangkok skyline looks sharp from the fitness centre treadmills.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the pool terrace is quiet, and the Bangkok skyline rises behind the still water of the saltwater pool.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the saltwater pool up to their shoulders and look at the Bangkok skyline from the water.
phrases.warm: By the pool, guests in the cabanas leave their cocktails half finished to look across the tropical greenery to the Bangkok skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light slides down the glass towers of Bangkok while guests take their first cocktail at the rooftop bar of Penthouse Bar & Grill.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lights the Bangkok skyline tower by tower, seen from the rooftop bar of Penthouse Bar & Grill.
phrases.grey_evening: Over dinner at Penthouse Bar & Grill, guests look out at the lights of Bangkok glowing under a low, cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the city this evening, and the lights of the Bangkok skyline shine through wet glass at Penthouse Bar & Grill.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the clouds above Bangkok take a soft glow from the city lights, seen across the saltwater pool.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit towers of the Bangkok skyline stretch in a wide half-circle beyond the edge of the 9th-floor pool.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, a sleepless guest on the fitness centre treadmills has the quiet Bangkok skyline all to himself.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from Penthouse Bar & Grill the first lights come on across the Bangkok skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the domes and minarets of the Blue Mosque stand unlit against a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Sera Restaurant, guests look across to the Blue Mosque in clear morning light, with the Sea of Marmara bright beyond the windows.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque and the Sea of Marmara fit in one frame under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Sea of Marmara this morning, and guests in the sea-facing rooms follow them from their windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift behind the dome of Hagia Sophia this afternoon, and the rooftop terrace has sun and shade by turns.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Sea of Marmara turns the colour of lead, and the minarets of the Blue Mosque stay sharp above the rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque today, and the Sea of Marmara fades into the sky without a clear horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the Sea of Marmara is not visible today, but the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia remain clear from the top floor.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the ruins of the Stable Gate, and guests in the rooms at the front watch the Sea of Marmara turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the minarets of the Blue Mosque for a second, then thunder rolls out over the Sea of Marmara.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the domes of the Blue Mosque, and guests watch from behind the top-floor windows as the old rooftops turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and guests in Sera Restaurant see every line of Hagia Sophia's dome from their warm seats.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 108-room hotel keep to their window seats and look out over the Sea of Marmara.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the rooftop terrace look for shade first and for the Blue Mosque second.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests stay long on the rooftop terrace, where the Sea of Marmara is blue and Hagia Sophia rises above the old rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the stone of Hagia Sophia a warm gold, and the Sea of Marmara shines below a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Blue Mosque turn orange, and the Sea of Marmara takes the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Sera Restaurant, guests see the Blue Mosque lit against low evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass of Sera Restaurant this evening, and the lights of the Blue Mosque blur into soft gold behind it.
phrases.mild_night: The lit Blue Mosque glows under a cloudy night sky, and the Sea of Marmara is a wide dark space beside it.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit domes of Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque stand out above the sleeping streets of Sultanahmet.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Sea of Marmara is quiet below the sea-facing rooms, and the Blue Mosque is only an outline of domes and minarets.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the rooftop terrace the first lights come on at the Blue Mosque, with the dome of Hagia Sophia to its right.

phrases.clear_predawn: Guests awake early in the Courtyard Red Rock View rooms find the famous Sedona Red Rocks as dark shapes against a paling sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the tops of the Red Rock Formations first and then works its way down toward Oak Creek.
phrases.clear_midday: Sedona's Red Rocks stand above the Outdoor Pool in full sun, red against blue.
phrases.partly_morning: In the Creekside Signature Studio Suite, guests watch patches of sun and shade pass over Oak Creek.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Red Rock Formations change colour all afternoon, bright red in the sun and brown whenever a cloud passes.
phrases.overcast: Today's cloud gives the Red Rock Formations a darker, quieter red from top to bottom.
phrases.fog_haze: In the haze, the famous Sedona Red Rocks fade to pale pink outlines outside the Courtyard Red Rock View rooms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Red Rock Formations show only as faint shapes in today's dull air, while Oak Creek stays easy to see.
phrases.rain: From the Creekside One Bedroom Suite, guests watch raindrops make rings on Oak Creek.
phrases.thunderstorm: Each flash of lightning shows Oak Creek for a moment to guests in the Creekside ADA Roll-In Suite.
phrases.snow: From the warm side of the glass, guests in the Courtyard Red Rock View rooms watch snow whiten the famous Sedona Red Rocks.
phrases.very_cold: The Red Rocks above the pool look sharp in today's freezing air, every ledge easy to pick out.
phrases.cold: A day for staying in: guests in the Creekside One Bedroom Suite watch Oak Creek run past.
phrases.very_hot: The Outdoor Pool is the popular place today, and swimmers there look up at Sedona's Red Rocks.
phrases.warm: Guests take their time at the pool today, with the Red Rocks in view from the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Each ridge of the Red Rock Formations throws a long shadow onto the next as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests in the Creekside Signature Studio Suite watch the low sun come and go on Oak Creek between clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: Evening cloud takes the last colour from the Red Rock Formations, leaving them a dark wall across the view.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Creekside ADA Roll-In Suite watch the evening rain fall on Oak Creek.
phrases.mild_night: The Red Rock Formations stand as black shapes tonight, a little darker than the night around them.
phrases.clear_night: At the Outdoor Fire Pit, guests look up at a night sky full of stars.
phrases.late_night: The Red Rock Formations have gone quiet and dark, waiting for the first light to give the red back.
phrases.dusk: Just now the Red Rock Formations are darker than the sky behind them, and every ridge shows as a clean line.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear above the port, and the first pale light shows the water from the 30th floor.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the infinity pool on the 30th floor, and the port spreads wide below under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At QĪN, guests look over the heritage shophouses to the skyscrapers of the financial district, bright under a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the financial district skyline this morning, and their shadows move across the shophouse roofs of Chinatown.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the gym on the 30th floor, guests watch patches of sun and shade cross the city skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the port takes the same flat colour, and the skyscrapers stand a little darker behind the shophouses.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the port today, and from the infinity pool the far water fades into the grey sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the port is not visible today, but the heritage shophouses and the nearest skyscrapers still show clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch the shophouse roofs of Chinatown turn dark and shiny.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the financial district skyline, and guests at QĪN follow the storm through the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the heritage shophouses, and guests at QĪN restaurant watch the roofs turn white below the skyscrapers.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear today, and the financial district skyline stands sharp behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass at QĪN and look across the shophouses to the skyscrapers.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the water of the infinity pool and look at the port from there.
phrases.warm: By the infinity pool, phones stay face down while guests look at the port instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the skyscrapers and the heritage district, and guests watch it from the infinity pool, 30 floors above Chinatown.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and colours the glass towers of the financial district, while the shophouses below are already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the skyscrapers glow softly above the dark roofs of the shophouses.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the financial district blur in the windows of the bar lounge, where guests sit with a drink.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the clouds above the financial district take a soft glow from the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the lights of the port stretch wide below the 30th floor.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Chinatown is quiet below, and the heritage shophouses sleep at the feet of the skyscrapers.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on in the skyscrapers behind the infinity pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Eixample grid is quiet under a clear sky, and its straight avenues wait for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the city centre rooftops, then slides down into the straight avenues of the Eixample grid.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is clear over the city centre, and the Eixample grid shows its lines like a page of squared paper.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cross the city centre this morning, and their shadows move from block to block over the Eixample grid.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the balcony rooms watch sun and cloud take turns on Ronda Universitat this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the city centre rooftops take one even colour, and the Eixample grid looks drawn in pencil.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city centre today, and the far end of each Eixample avenue fades before guests can find it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so guests see the nearest Eixample blocks well and the far city skyline not at all.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Ronda Universitat, and guests in the balcony rooms watch the wet street shine below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city centre, and lightning shows the Eixample grid for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the city centre, and guests watch from the balcony rooms as Ronda Universitat turns white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and guests see the city centre rooftops in clean detail.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep the balcony doors closed and watch Ronda Universitat through the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on Twenty One Terrace choose the shade and look out over the city centre with a cold drink.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the 9th floor Twenty One Terrace share snacks while the city centre spreads out below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Twenty One Terrace, the sun goes down in a clear sky and turns the city centre rooftops gold.
phrases.partly_golden: From Twenty One Terrace, the last sun colours the clouds above the Eixample grid orange and pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and the lit avenues of the Eixample grid give the low clouds a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the street lights of the Eixample grid shine twice, once above and once on the wet road.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the avenues of the Eixample grid glow in long straight lines across the city centre.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Eixample grid glows below the 9th floor Twenty One Terrace, avenue after avenue.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city centre finally rests, and the Eixample grid is a quiet pattern of blocks and empty avenues.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky is still bright over Twenty One Terrace and the first lights come on along the Eixample avenues.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the North Shore Mountains are a dark shape above Burrard Inlet, and the water is still.
phrases.clear_morning: The first seaplanes of the morning cross Burrard Inlet at window level, with Stanley Park clear and green behind them.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests can pick out every ridge of the North Shore Mountains above a blue Burrard Inlet.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly over Stanley Park this morning, while Burrard Inlet stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Prime Minister Suite, guests follow clouds drifting along the North Shore Mountains, with Coal Harbour bright below.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Burrard Inlet turns the colour of steel, and the living roof of the Convention Centre is the greenest thing in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Burrard Inlet today, and the seaplanes come out of it one at a time.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The North Shore Mountains are not visible today; guests can still see Coal Harbour and the near edge of Stanley Park.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Burrard Inlet; guests in corner suites watch it from the soaking tub by the window.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the North Shore Mountains for a second, then thunder rolls across Burrard Inlet.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Coal Harbour, and Stanley Park is slowly turning white across the water.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the North Shore Mountains look sharp and clear from the pool terrace, and steam rises from the heated pool.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in harbour-view rooms stay behind the glass to follow the seaplanes over Burrard Inlet.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the 6th-floor pool terrace choose the shade of a cabana and look out at the city towers.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests float in the pool with the North Shore Mountains in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Burrard Inlet gold, and Stanley Park, stretching west, becomes a dark outline against it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests in Suite X see the clouds over the North Shore Mountains turn pink above the waterfront.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights along the North Shore make a thin bright row above the black water of Burrard Inlet.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Coal Harbour stretch into long reflections on the water.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in this 48-floor tower look out on a mild, cloudy night, with Coal Harbour lit below and Stanley Park dark beyond it.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests can count the lights climbing the lower slopes of the North Shore Mountains above Burrard Inlet.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the seaplanes are asleep at last, and Burrard Inlet lies quiet between the city and the North Shore Mountains.
phrases.dusk: At dusk, the sky above the North Shore Mountains is still pink from the pool terrace, and the first city lights come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Pearl River is a dark band below, and Canton Tower stands as a thin shape against a clear sky that is slowly growing pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun fills the glass of the 74th-floor pool, and Canton Tower stands clear across the Pearl River.
phrases.clear_midday: At Catch on the 100th floor, guests look down on the city under a clear midday sky, each street easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Pearl River this morning, while Canton Tower stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the gym, guests exercise facing Canton Tower and the Pearl River as clouds drift past this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pearl River turns the colour of steel, and Canton Tower rises pale above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and from rooms facing Canton Tower guests see the tower as a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the far stretches of the Pearl River are not visible, and Canton Tower shows only as a grey outline.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass beside the 74th-floor pool, and swimmers see Canton Tower blurred across the Pearl River.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pearl River, and guests high in this 103-storey tower watch the storm cross the city.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Pearl River, and guests in a Pearl River Suite watch both banks slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: It is freezing outside, so swimmers in the indoor pool look at Canton Tower through the glass and stay where they are.
phrases.cold: A cold day is a good reason for a long bath, and the soaking tubs facing Canton Tower make it a bath with a landmark.
phrases.very_hot: Heat lies over the city today, and guests stay indoors at the 74th-floor pool with Canton Tower in front of them.
phrases.warm: On a warm day the Pearl River runs wide between its two banks, and Canton Tower rises above the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Canton Tower gold, and the Pearl River carries the same warm light through the city.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the Pearl River glow orange, and guests in the 344 rooms watch through floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.grey_evening: At Yu Yue Heen on the 71st floor, guests dine above the city lights while low cloud hangs around the lit Canton Tower.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening at Tian Bar, guests in the seats facing Canton Tower watch its colours spread across the rain on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Canton Tower glows through thin cloud tonight, and its colours reflect softly in the Pearl River.
phrases.clear_night: From the 74th-floor pool at night, the lit Canton Tower and the city lights fill the glass under a clear sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet far below, and Canton Tower stands alone across the Pearl River.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on along the Pearl River below Canton Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Brooklyn Bridge stands dark against a clear sky, and the East River below it is still.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the towers of the Manhattan skyline, seen across the East River from the rooftop infinity pool.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop infinity pool, the Brooklyn Bridge, the Manhattan skyline and the Statue of Liberty share one frame under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the East River this morning, and guests in bridge-view rooms watch them slide over the Brooklyn Bridge.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift behind One World Trade Center this afternoon, and the Manhattan skyline changes from bright to grey and back.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Brooklyn Bridge and the East River take the same colour, and the Statue of Liberty stands small in the distance.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Manhattan skyline today, and One World Trade Center fades towards its top.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Statue of Liberty is not visible today, but the Brooklyn Bridge still shows clearly from the bridge-view rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the East River, and guests in skyline-view rooms watch the Manhattan skyline blur behind wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Manhattan skyline, and for a second every tower shows against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the East River, and guests in the skyline-view suites watch Manhattan turn pale behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the Statue of Liberty and the Manhattan skyline both stand sharp from the rooftop on the 11th floor.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps the rooftop quiet, and the Brooklyn Bridge stands over the East River with no one in front of it.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the rooftop infinity pool and look at the Manhattan skyline from the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the pool deck lie on lounge chairs facing the Brooklyn Bridge, and few of them read.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun drops low behind the Manhattan skyline, and guests at Harriet's Rooftop watch the Brooklyn Bridge turn gold.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds turn orange over One World Trade Center, and the rooftop infinity pool reflects them.
phrases.grey_evening: At Harriet's Lounge on the 10th floor, guests look at the lit Manhattan skyline under low cloud, from the Brooklyn Bridge to the Statue of Liberty.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests at Harriet's Lounge watch the lights of the Manhattan skyline shine on the East River.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of the Brooklyn Bridge draw a bright curve over the East River.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lit windows of the Manhattan skyline are easy to count, though nobody finishes.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the East River is quiet, and the Brooklyn Bridge waits for morning.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright behind the Manhattan skyline, and the first lights come on along the Brooklyn Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear and pale over Lake Geneva, and the Alps slowly take shape behind the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the lake-view suites, where guests wake to the Jet d'Eau rising white against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Jet d'Eau stands tall and white over Lake Geneva at midday, with the Alps sharp behind it under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Lake Geneva this morning, and the Jet d'Eau turns from white to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on their balconies follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over Lake Geneva towards the Alps.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Lake Geneva turns the colour of slate, and the Jet d'Eau is the one white mark on it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Alps today, and the top of the Jet d'Eau fades into the pale air above Lake Geneva.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today and the far shore of Lake Geneva is faint, but the Jet d'Eau still shows clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Lake Geneva, and guests in the lake-view suites watch the Jet d'Eau blur behind the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Lake Geneva, and each flash of lightning shows the water and the waterfront for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftop, and guests at La Terrasse Alpine look out at Lake Geneva from cable cars brought from Gstaad.
phrases.very_cold: From La Terrasse Alpine on the rooftop, Lake Geneva looks sharp and blue in the freezing air, with the Alps white behind it.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the lake-view suites stay under the covers and still see the Jet d'Eau over Lake Geneva.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the Jet d'Eau looks like the coolest spot on Lake Geneva, and guests eye its spray with some envy.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace, guests lie on orange sun loungers and look over Geneva's rooftops to the Alps on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Jet d'Eau gold, and Lake Geneva carries the same colour all the way to the waterfront.
phrases.partly_golden: The clouds above the Alps turn pink in the last hour of sun, and Lake Geneva repeats the colour below them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in this 1865 hotel look out at the waterfront lights lying in long lines on Lake Geneva.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights across Lake Geneva spread into soft patches of colour.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests watch the city lights give the low sky over Lake Geneva a faint glow.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the Alps on this clear night, and the city lights shine on the surface of Lake Geneva.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Geneva is quiet and black, and guests who are still awake have it to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the waterfront across Lake Geneva.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Santa Monica Mountains are a dark shape under a clear sky that is only starting to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the towers of Century City, and guests on the private balconies see every one of them clearly.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool on the 12th floor, guests look across Los Angeles to the downtown skyline under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly over the Santa Monica Mountains this morning, while Century City stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At The Rooftop by JG, guests turn in their seats to follow the clouds from the Santa Monica Mountains to Century City.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the towers of Century City take the same grey, and the palm trees of Beverly Hills keep their green.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Santa Monica Mountains today, and from the rooftop they look like a watercolour left unfinished.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The downtown skyline is not visible today, so guests on the rooftop look at Century City, which is much closer.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Beverly Hills, and guests watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows, the towers of Century City slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the towers of Century City, and the thunder follows a few seconds later.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Beverly Hills, and the palm trees below the rooftop slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and every ridge of the Santa Monica Mountains is sharp from the rooftop.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look from the rooftop at Century City to the east and do not stay long.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop saltwater pool and look at the Santa Monica Mountains from the water.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop pool loungers, books stay closed while guests look across the palm trees to the towers of Century City.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At The Rooftop by JG, guests watch the sun go down towards the Santa Monica Mountains while the towers of Century City turn gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds above the Santa Monica Mountains, and guests at The Rooftop by JG stop talking to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit towers of Century City glow softly above the dark treetops of Beverly Hills.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Wilshire and Santa Monica boulevards this evening, and the street lights below shine on the wet road.
phrases.mild_night: Since 2017, guests on the private balconies have spent mild nights like this one looking down at the lit streets of Los Angeles.
phrases.clear_night: From the terrace of the Presidential Penthouse, the lights of the boulevard run in a straight line towards the Los Angeles skyline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Wilshire and Santa Monica boulevards are almost empty below, and Century City stands quiet to the east.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind the Santa Monica Mountains, and the first lights come on in the towers of Century City.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests in the balcony rooms see the Adriatic Sea as a calm grey sheet under a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast behind the full-height glass of Aura, guests have only the open Adriatic Sea in front of the table.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop infinity pool and the Adriatic Sea are the same blue, and the glass edge between them is difficult to find.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Adriatic Sea this morning, and from Sky Pool on the roof each one can be followed to the horizon.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony rooms, guests see the afternoon clouds drift out over the Adriatic Sea while the rocky coast of San Foca stays bright.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Adriatic Sea turns the colour of steel, and the horizon is a single straight line.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits on the Adriatic Sea today, so the water beyond the rooftop infinity pool fades into the sky without a horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Balkan mountains are not visible today; guests see the Adriatic Sea for a few kilometres and then only pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Adriatic Sea, and guests watch it from a dry table behind the full-height glass of Aura.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning strikes far out over the Adriatic Sea, and guests in the Mora Suite count the seconds before the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over San Foca, and the flakes disappear the moment they touch the grey Adriatic Sea.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the Adriatic Sea is deep blue and empty, and a faint ridge of the Balkan mountains shows on the far shore.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Adriatic Sea is a darker blue, and the rocky coast of San Foca stands out clearly against it.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests swim the 23 metres of Sky Pool and stop at the end to look at the horizon of the Adriatic Sea.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop infinity pool, cocktails get warm while guests look across the Adriatic Sea for the Balkan mountains.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight turns the rocky coast of San Foca gold, and the Adriatic Sea beyond the rooftop infinity pool becomes a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun the clouds over the Adriatic Sea turn pink, and guests at Aura's windows watch the colour reach the water.
phrases.grey_evening: This cloudy evening the Adriatic Sea is black beyond the roof, and the lights of San Foca mark where the coast begins.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests behind Aura's glass see the lights of San Foca blur in the rain, with the dark Adriatic Sea behind them.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Adriatic Sea shows only as a soft grey movement below the balconies.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Adriatic Sea tonight, and from Sky Pool on the roof the water below is one wide dark field.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Adriatic Sea is nearly invisible from the roof, a quiet darkness where the blue was all day.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the rooftop infinity pool begins to glow, and the first lights of San Foca appear beside the still-bright Adriatic Sea.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Vittoriano is a dark shape above the sleeping rooftops of the historic centre, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light shows every detail of San Marcello al Corso Church, and guests in piazza-facing rooms see the façade from their windows.
phrases.clear_midday: From NOTOS Rooftop on the 5th floor, the Vittoriano stands clear against a blue sky, with the rooftops of the historic centre running to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the rooftops of the historic centre this morning, and the Montecitorio bell tower goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift behind the Vittoriano this afternoon, while Via del Corso runs below, part in sun and part in shade.
phrases.overcast: Guests find the Vittoriano easily under today's flat grey sky, where the rooftops of the historic centre all take one soft colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the historic centre today, and the Montecitorio bell tower looks like a pencil sketch above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far rooftops are not visible today, so guests see only the nearer ones and the outline of the Vittoriano.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Piazza San Marcello; guests in piazza-facing rooms watch it run down the façade of San Marcello al Corso Church.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Vittoriano for a moment above the wet rooftops, and guests count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on San Marcello al Corso Church, and its façade slowly turns white above the piazza.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is clear today, and the Montecitorio bell tower stands sharp against the sky above the rooftops.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the piazza-facing rooms study the Baroque façade of San Marcello al Corso Church from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on NOTOS Rooftop sit among the olive trees and look at the Vittoriano over a cold drink.
phrases.warm: On NOTOS Rooftop, guests turn in their seats on this warm day to follow the full panorama, from the Vittoriano to the Montecitorio bell tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late golden light warms the rooftops of the historic centre, and from NOTOS Rooftop the Vittoriano glows at the end of the view.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and lights the Vittoriano, while Via del Corso below is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, dinner at NOTOS Rooftop faces the lights of the historic centre and the Vittoriano beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the historic centre blur in the wet evening air, and the Vittoriano fades behind them.
phrases.mild_night: Guests looking out on this mild night see clouds low over the historic centre and a soft glow on the rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above an 18th-century palazzo tonight, and the Vittoriano stands out over the lit rooftops of the historic centre.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Via del Corso is quiet and the rooftops of the historic centre lie still around the Montecitorio bell tower.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Via del Corso, seen from NOTOS Rooftop like a line drawn through the city.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Kyoto Tower stands pale and quiet above the rooftops under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the white shaft of Kyoto Tower, and guests in the tower view suites see it from bed.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Kyoto Tower is white against blue, framed in the gap of the entrance noren.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move behind Kyoto Tower this morning, and its white shaft turns bright each time the sun comes through.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, cloud shadows cross the low skyline while Kyoto Tower keeps catching the sun above it.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Kyoto Tower takes almost the same colour, a pale line above the city.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Kyoto Tower today, and from the entrance steps its spire looks drawn in pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; Kyoto Tower's white shaft is faint, and its spire cannot be seen clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the entrance steps, and guests look through the noren at Kyoto Tower, slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city, and guests in the tower view suites watch lightning flash behind Kyoto Tower.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Higashi Honganji Temple, and guests in the suite with the outdoor bath watch Kyoto Tower fade behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and every line of Kyoto Tower looks sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in this former school building look out at Kyoto Tower standing clear above the low skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, Kyoto Tower shimmers a little above the street, and guests on the entrance steps stop only for a quick photo.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, a guest in the outdoor bath has Kyoto Tower and Higashi Honganji Temple in sight, and no reason to get out.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the white shaft of Kyoto Tower gold against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds glow orange behind Kyoto Tower, and guests keep looking a little longer.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars this evening, and the lit spire of Kyoto Tower takes their place above the rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests coming in from the rain turn at the noren for one more look at the lit Kyoto Tower.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lit Kyoto Tower gives the low clouds above it a soft glow.
phrases.clear_night: Kyoto Tower's white shaft and red-lit spire stand against the clear night sky, seen from the exterior steps at the entrance.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and Kyoto Tower is a dark shape above the sleeping streets.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the spire of Kyoto Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Table Mountain stands as a dark shape under a clear sky that is slowly growing pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the 19th-floor Club Lounge, guests watch the morning sun light the cliffs of Table Mountain and Lion's Head.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the waterfront view rooms show Table Mountain, Lion's Head and the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront in one wide sweep.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Lion's Head this morning, while guests in the gym look down at Cape Town Harbour and the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross Cape Town Harbour this afternoon, and swimmers in the indoor infinity pool watch them between lengths.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, Table Mountain and Lion's Head turn a darker grey than the cloud above them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and guests in the 19th-floor sauna see its buildings fade one street at a time.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: Table Mountain is not in sight, and the view from the upper floors stops at the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass facade, and guests in the Club Lounge see Lion's Head only as a blurred grey outline.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Table Bay, and guests watch the storm from the corner hot tub of Heavenly Spa, safely behind glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the 19 floors of glass, and Table Mountain slowly turns white across the city.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and guests see the city below in sharp detail from the warm water of the heated indoor pool.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to the Club Lounge armchairs and look out at the grey-blue water of Cape Town Harbour.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Atlantic Ocean shines almost white, and guests look at it from behind floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront and the Atlantic Ocean beyond it lie bright below the waterfront view rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the golden hour, swimmers stop at the end of the indoor infinity pool to look at the sun low over Cape Town Harbour.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds over Signal Hill turn pink in the last hour of sun, and guests in the Club Lounge raise an evening drink to them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront glow below the Club Lounge on the 19th floor.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain blurs the city lights into long coloured lines on the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, cloud hides the top of Table Mountain, and the lights of Cape Town Harbour shine on the water.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the city lights climb the lower slopes of Lion's Head, and the peak above them stays black.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city is quiet, and Table Bay lies still beyond Cape Town Harbour.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright above Lion's Head just after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Santorini Caldera lies quiet below the private terraces, its water still darker than the clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches the volcanic islands in the Santorini Caldera, and the water below the cliff slowly turns blue.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool and the Aegean Sea look like one sheet of blue, with the Santorini Caldera spread out beyond the edge.
phrases.partly_morning: The lap pool looks out over the Aegean Sea this morning, where cloud shadows move slowly across the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the infinity pool, afternoon clouds drift over Thirassia island while the water of the Santorini Caldera stays bright.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Santorini Caldera turns the colour of slate, and its cliffs look darker than the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Santorini Caldera today, and the volcanic islands seem to float without a base.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Thirassia island is not visible today; from the private terraces, guests see only the near water of the Santorini Caldera and the cliffs below.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Santorini Caldera, and the cave houses, 300 years old, shine wet above the grey water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Santorini Caldera, and for a second each volcanic island shows clearly before the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Santorini Caldera, and the flakes disappear into the dark sea.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the Santorini Caldera looks sharp and close, and guests admire it from indoors.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the Aegean Sea turns a deeper blue, and the gym, set among vines and herb gardens, lets guests watch it in comfort.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across the Santorini Caldera from the water.
phrases.warm: By the infinity pool, guests lie on sun loungers under the umbrellas, and the Santorini Caldera gets more attention than any book.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the cliffs of the Santorini Caldera, and the infinity pool takes on the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the infinity pool, on magazine covers since 1997, mirrors the sky above the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.grey_evening: At Perivolas Restaurant, guests have dinner on a cloudy evening, with the Santorini Caldera a deep grey beyond the tables.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of Oia village blur above the wet Santorini Caldera.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lights of Oia village glow along the cliff, and the Santorini Caldera below is one wide dark space.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Santorini Caldera tonight, and the calm water below gives a few of them back.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Santorini Caldera is silent and black, and only its outline against the sky can be seen.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky stays bright over the Santorini Caldera, and from the terraces the first lights of Oia village appear on the cliff.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, a thin band of light opens over Lake Ontario, and the CN Tower is a plain outline against the clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests at breakfast in the Club Lounge look out at the downtown skyline, each glass tower bright in the clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Lake Ontario is a clean blue to the south under the midday sun, with the CN Tower rising alongside.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past the CN Tower this morning, and swimmers in the saltwater pool follow them between lengths.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across Lake Ontario this afternoon, turning the water from blue to grey and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Lake Ontario takes the colour of steel, and the CN Tower stands plain and clear above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken the top of the CN Tower today, and guests in the Club Lounge watch the downtown skyline fade floor by floor.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Lake Ontario cannot be seen to the south today, and only the CN Tower, close by, still shows clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in the south-facing rooms see the CN Tower slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Lake Ontario, and for a second the CN Tower shows white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the downtown skyline, and guests in the Club Lounge watch the CN Tower appear and disappear in it.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in a Simcoe Suite stay behind the glass on this freezing day, with Lake Ontario bright on one side and the city grid on the other.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps the air clean, and the CN Tower stands in sharp detail with Lake Ontario spread out beside it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests float in the saltwater pool and look at the CN Tower through the glass, with no wish to climb it.
phrases.warm: On the private balconies of the 6th-floor rooms, guests stand in the warm air and look out at the downtown skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun warms one side of the CN Tower, and Lake Ontario to the south holds a long strip of light.
phrases.partly_golden: From the saltwater pool, guests watch the last sun find gaps in the clouds and light the CN Tower in patches.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the CN Tower glows in colour, and the low sky above the city picks up some of its light.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and the coloured lights of the CN Tower spread softly in the wet air above the city.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the city grid to the north is a field of lights below the Club Level on floors 17–20.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the CN Tower stands lit against a black sky, and Lake Ontario is a wide darkness beyond the city lights.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who are still awake find the CN Tower standing over a quiet, sleeping city grid.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests in the Club Lounge see the first lights come on across the downtown skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the first pale light shows the Taurus Mountains, and the Mediterranean lies flat under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the upper-floor balconies, guests see the pool gardens, the open Mediterranean and the Taurus Mountains in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: The Mediterranean is a strong blue at midday, with the palm gardens bright green in front of it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit on the Taurus Mountains this morning, while the pool gardens and the sea stay mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the Mediterranean this afternoon, and guests on the upper-floor balconies can follow them to the horizon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Mediterranean turns silver-grey, and the palms of the gardens stand out green against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Taurus Mountains today, and the Mediterranean fades into the sky with no clear horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Taurus Mountains are not visible today; guests see the pool gardens, the palms and the nearest part of the sea.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the pool gardens, and guests in the sea-view rooms watch the Mediterranean turn grey behind the palms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Mediterranean, and for a second the whole sea shows white beyond the palm gardens.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm gardens, and the palms look as surprised as the guests watching from indoors.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold, clear air, guests see every fold of the Taurus Mountains above the still pool gardens.
phrases.cold: From the Terrace Pool, the green nature around the resort looks fresh and sharp in the cold air.
phrases.very_hot: Guests fill the pools below in the strong heat, and from the upper-floor balconies the Mediterranean shines almost white behind them.
phrases.warm: The private beach is busy on this warm day, and the open Mediterranean stretches blue behind the swimmers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Taurus Mountains gold, and the palm gardens throw long shadows across the pools.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in bands, and the Mediterranean changes from blue to orange and back.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Mediterranean is dark, and the lit pools glow blue among the palms.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain makes rings on the lit pools, and the Mediterranean is lost in the dark beyond the palm gardens.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds cover the stars, and the palm gardens are soft outlines above the pools.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the open Mediterranean tonight, and the Taurus Mountains mark where the sky ends.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the pool gardens are still, and the Mediterranean is a wide darkness beyond the palms.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, the first lights come on in the pool gardens, and the Taurus Mountains turn purple.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Osaka skyline is a row of quiet outlines under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: In the 25th-floor lounge, guests have breakfast while the morning sun climbs over the Osaka skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in La Belle Assiette, guests look out over the Osaka cityscape in clear midday light.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Osaka skyline this morning, and guests in rooms from the 24th floor up can follow the whole pattern.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon tea at THE BAR has a changing sky today, with sun and cloud taking turns over Midosuji.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Osaka skyline loses its shadows and every rooftop shows in the same soft light.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Osaka skyline today, and from the 25th-floor lounge the far buildings fade into the white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant part of the Osaka skyline is not visible today; guests in the 25th-floor lounge see only the nearer blocks clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Midosuji, and the Osaka skyline behind it looks slightly blurred through the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Osaka skyline, and guests in the corner rooms watch the storm from two sides.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Osaka, and guests watch the flakes drift past the windows towards Midosuji far below.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, so the Osaka skyline looks sharp from the warm side of the glass in the 25th-floor lounge.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests sit behind the wide windows of THE BAR with a hot tea and look down at Midosuji.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Osaka rooftops, and guests are happy to study the skyline from the cool 15th-floor tables of La Belle Assiette.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, Midosuji runs bright and busy below, and the Osaka skyline stands clear around it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Osaka skyline gold, and at THE BAR the afternoon tea goes quiet while guests look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lights the Osaka skyline one building at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in La Belle Assiette, guests look out at the Osaka night view, its lights glowing under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests at THE BAR watch the lights of Midosuji stretch into long reflections on the road.
phrases.mild_night: From the soaking tub by the window, guests look over the lit Osaka skyline under a cloudy night sky, and the bath water cools unnoticed.
phrases.clear_night: The lit Osaka skyline spreads wide under a clear night sky, and the 25th-floor lounge gives guests a long look at it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Midosuji is almost empty far below, and the Osaka skyline rests quietly around it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and from the 25th-floor lounge guests watch the first lights come on across the Osaka skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the towers of the Toronto skyline stand grey and still under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the glass towers of the Toronto skyline, and guests in the fitness center look out at them through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_midday: From the saltwater infinity pool on the 31st floor, guests look down at Toronto's street grid, sharp and clear under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Toronto skyline this morning, and one tower after another returns to sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At Louix Louis, guests sit by the tall windows while sun and cloud take turns on the Toronto skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the glass towers of the Toronto skyline take the same colour as the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the tops of the Toronto skyline today, and guests in the Iridium Spa see only the nearest towers.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so only the closest towers of the Toronto skyline are clear and the farther ones cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the oversized windows, and guests see the downtown towers slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Toronto skyline, and guests at Louix Louis watch the storm from their leather seats.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Toronto skyline, and guests in the Iridium Spa watch it drift past the towers.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, and every edge of the Toronto skyline looks sharp from the fitness center windows.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the tall windows of Louix Louis and look across the Toronto skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the saltwater infinity pool and look at the Toronto skyline from the water.
phrases.warm: By the saltwater infinity pool, books stay closed while guests look down at Toronto's grid on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light covers the downtown skyscrapers, and guests in the John Jacob Astor Suite watch the glass turn warm.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes low between the clouds, and the towers of the Toronto skyline throw long shadows across the grid.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit office floors of the Toronto skyline glow in neat rows above the streets.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Toronto skyline run together on the window glass at Louix Louis.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hang low over the Toronto skyline tonight and hold a soft glow from the city lights below.
phrases.clear_night: The sky is clear tonight, and guests in the Caroline Astor Suite on the 30th floor look out at the lit towers of downtown.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Toronto skyline is quiet, and its towers are tall dark shapes against the night sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the Toronto skyline; in the saltwater infinity pool, nobody hurries to get out.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Palau Reial Major and the Basilica of Santa Maria del Mar are dark shapes under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the stone of the Palau Reial Major, and the rooftop infinity pool frames it against a clear blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is clear, and the Basilica of Santa Maria del Mar rises sharp above the rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Grand Suite on the 5th floor, guests watch cloud shadows move across the Palau Reial Major this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Gothic Quarter this afternoon, and from the rooftop terrace the low rooftops go from bright to grey and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the stone of the Palau Reial Major and the Basilica of Santa Maria del Mar takes the same quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Gothic Quarter today, and from the rooftop infinity pool the Basilica of Santa Maria del Mar looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: from the rooftop terrace the nearest roofs are sharp, and the Basilica of Santa Maria del Mar is only a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Gothic Quarter; guests in the Grand Suite watch it wet the walls of the Palau Reial Major.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Gothic Quarter, and guests at the Grand Suite windows see the Palau Reial Major in each flash of lightning.
