phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftops of the Gothic Quarter, and the Palau Reial Major slowly turns white at the edges.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, so the Palau Reial Major stands out in fine detail from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the Grand Suite stay by the window and look across at the medieval Palau Reial Major.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop infinity pool up to their chins and look at the Basilica of Santa Maria del Mar from the water.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop infinity pool, guests lie in the warm air, and the Palau Reial Major does the standing for everyone.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Basilica of Santa Maria del Mar gold, and the rooftop infinity pool holds the same colour on its surface.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Gothic Quarter turn pink, and the Palau Reial Major glows below them.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hide the stars this evening, but the lights of the Gothic Quarter shine below the rooftop infinity pool.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the rooftops of the Gothic Quarter shine with rain, and the Basilica of Santa Maria del Mar is blurred behind them.
phrases.mild_night: A 1920s building with a medieval neighbour: tonight the Palau Reial Major rests under a soft, cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: From the rooftop, the Basilica of Santa Maria del Mar stands against a clear, starry sky tonight.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Gothic Quarter is quiet, and the Palau Reial Major stands unlit above the sleeping rooftops.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the Gothic Quarter.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the English Channel is a wide grey sheet, and the West Pier ruins stand black against it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights Brighton Beach, and guests in the balcony rooms see the West Pier ruins sharp against blue water.
phrases.clear_midday: At The Salt Room, the menu waits while guests look at the English Channel, blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Brighton Beach this morning, while Brighton Palace Pier stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the bar, guests follow patches of sun as they move across the sea towards Brighton Palace Pier.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the English Channel turns the same colour, and the West Pier ruins look like a drawing in ink.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the West Pier ruins seem to float between sea and sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Brighton Palace Pier is not visible today; guests see Brighton Beach, the first waves and a faint outline of the West Pier ruins.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the covered terrace of The Salt Room, and guests watch the grey English Channel from under it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the English Channel, and for a second the West Pier ruins show clearly from the sea-view rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Brighton Beach and vanishing into the grey sea beyond.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and guests in the bar see Brighton Palace Pier in sharp detail above a steel-blue sea.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Brighton Beach is empty, and the waves have the West Pier ruins to themselves.
phrases.very_hot: Brighton Beach is crowded in the heat, and guests on the balconies look over the towels to the cool blue English Channel.
phrases.warm: On the covered terrace of The Salt Room, guests sit in the warm air and watch swimmers off Brighton Beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in this 1890 hotel step onto their balconies as the low sun turns the West Pier ruins and the sea to gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun breaks through the clouds, and Brighton Palace Pier shines for a few minutes above a darker sea.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Brighton Palace Pier glow over the dark beach.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in the bar see the lights of Brighton Palace Pier blurred through the rain on the windows.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, sea and sky are one darkness, and Brighton Palace Pier draws a line of light across it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the English Channel tonight, and the West Pier ruins are just visible against the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the seafront is quiet, and guests still awake see only the slow white lines of waves on Brighton Beach.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Brighton Palace Pier.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the River Thames lies dark and still, with Waterloo Bridge a plain black line across it.
phrases.clear_morning: At The River Restaurant, guests eat breakfast while the morning sun shines on the River Thames.
phrases.clear_midday: Every capsule of the London Eye stands out sharply at midday, with Big Ben small and clear behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: The London Eye turns in and out of the sunshine this morning as clouds pass over the river.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Lunch guests at The River Restaurant watch the Thames change from grey to silver each time the sun comes out.
phrases.overcast: Hungerford Bridge and the River Thames share one shade of grey today, as if Monet had painted them both.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the top of the London Eye today, and the Thames below it looks pale.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Big Ben is not visible today, but the London Eye and the near bank of the Thames are clear enough.
phrases.rain: Rain dots the surface of the Thames, and the London Eye keeps turning behind a grey curtain.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the London Eye, and for a second the whole wheel shows white above the river.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Thames, and Cleopatra's Needle stands dark against the white.
phrases.very_cold: Guests keep to the warm side of the glass and count the few brave walkers on Hungerford Bridge.
phrases.cold: Guests stay indoors today and watch the London Eye turn slowly above the grey-green Thames.
phrases.very_hot: The Thames barely moves in this heat, and the London Eye seems to turn more slowly than usual.
phrases.warm: The Thames is bright all the way to Waterloo Bridge today, with the London Eye sharp on the far side.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Thames gold, and the capsules of the London Eye flash one by one.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun reaches the Thames between the clouds, and Waterloo Bridge turns the colour of honey.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner guests at The River Restaurant look out at the Thames, dark under the clouds this evening.
phrases.wet_evening: Through the rain tonight, the lit London Eye is a soft blurred ring above the wet river.
phrases.mild_night: Guests go to sleep tonight above the Thames, the same river view that Claude Monet painted in 1899.
phrases.clear_night: The London Eye glows over the black Thames tonight, with Big Ben lit in the distance.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Thames runs dark and quiet past Cleopatra's Needle.
phrases.dusk: The London Eye switches on its lights while the Thames still holds the last brightness of the day.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Frauenkirche towers stand over the roofs of Karlsplatz against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in GRETA OTO on the 9th floor, guests look over Munich's rooftops to the Frauenkirche under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The sky is clear at midday, so the Alps appear beyond Munich's rooftops from the private spa pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Karlsplatz this morning, and their shadows move across the roofs towards the Frauenkirche.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Panorama Suites, guests watch the afternoon clouds pass over Karlsplatz, with the Frauenkirche above the roofline.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Frauenkirche towers still rise clearly above the roofs of Karlsplatz.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the roofs of Munich today, and the Frauenkirche towers look like a pencil drawing above Karlsplatz.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today; guests in the private spa pool see Munich's rooftops and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Karlsplatz, and guests in the Panorama Suites watch the trams and umbrellas cross the square below.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is passing over Munich, and from GRETA OTO guests watch lightning flash behind the Frauenkirche towers.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the roofs around Karlsplatz, and the Frauenkirche towers turn faint behind it.
phrases.very_cold: Guests swim in the private spa pool while the freezing air outside keeps the Alps sharp beyond Munich's rooftops.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Frauenkirche towers show in clear detail above the roofline of Karlsplatz.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests keep to the private spa pool and look out over Munich's rooftops from the water.
phrases.warm: On the GRETA OTO terrace, guests sit in the warm air with the Frauenkirche towers on the skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns Munich's rooftops gold, and guests watch from the private spa pool on the upper floors.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the Frauenkirche towers above the roofline of Karlsplatz.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in GRETA OTO, guests see the lit Frauenkirche towers and the city lights under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of Karlsplatz shine on the wet square this evening, seen from the Panorama Suites.
phrases.mild_night: The lit Frauenkirche towers stand above the roofs of Karlsplatz on this mild night, under a sky full of cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in this 2024 building look across the lights of Karlsplatz to the lit Frauenkirche.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Karlsplatz lies quiet below the Panorama Suites, and for once the square is not in a hurry.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on around Karlsplatz below the Frauenkirche towers.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Danube River lies still below the castle district, and the sky slowly turns pale above the bridges.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Matthias Church early, and guests in the church-facing rooms see its spire bright against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From White Raven, the Danube River shines under a clear midday sky, and every bridge across it is easy to count.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the red roofs this morning, while the Danube River stays bright below the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at White Raven follow the clouds this afternoon as they drift over the city, the Danube River and its bridges.
phrases.overcast: The Danube River lies grey under a grey sky today, and the bridges stand out clearly across it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Danube River today, and from the rooftop terrace the far bank looks like a faded photograph.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today; from White Raven guests see the Danube River and the nearest bridges, but the far side of the city is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Matthias Church, and guests watch it run off the roof from their room windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the castle district, and each flash of lightning shows the Danube River and its bridges for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the castle district, and guests in the church-facing rooms watch Matthias Church turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and from White Raven the Danube River and its bridges look sharp enough to draw.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Danube River looks like steel, and the red roofs of the city sit close together around it.
phrases.very_hot: Guests on the rooftop terrace look at the Danube River in this heat and wish it were a little closer.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit in the woven chairs on the rooftop terrace, with the Chain Bridge and the Danube River in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Danube River gold, and the Hungarian Parliament Building glows beside it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests on the rooftop terrace watch the clouds turn pink above the Danube River and the distant hills.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit bridges make the Danube River easy to follow from White Raven.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening lights of the city, and the Danube River shows only as a dark band between them.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lights of the Chain Bridge sit in a soft row above the Danube River.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Hungarian Parliament Building is lit across the Danube River, and guests leave their curtains open for it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city is quiet, and the Danube River moves slowly under its bridges.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the bridges of the Danube River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tramuntana Mountains stand as a dark shape behind the harbor of Port de Sóller, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the pine-covered Tramuntana Mountains first, then moves down to the horseshoe harbor below the cliff.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Mediterranean is a strong blue from the clifftop, and every peak of the Tramuntana Mountains is sharp against the sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Tramuntana Mountains this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the pine slopes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Beyond the glass railing of the outdoor pool, forested hills and the Tramuntana Mountains lie half in sun and half in cloud shadow.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Mediterranean turns the colour of slate, and the Tramuntana Mountains look darker green than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Tramuntana Mountains today, so the ridges look like layers of grey paper behind the harbor.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far peaks of the Tramuntana Mountains are not visible today; guests see only the nearer pine slopes and the harbor below the cliff.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Port de Sóller, and guests watch it cross the harbor from their rooms, the Tramuntana Mountains blurred behind.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the outline of the Tramuntana Mountains for a second, then the storm hides them again above the harbor.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Tramuntana Mountains, and guests watch the pine slopes turn white above the grey harbor.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Tramuntana Mountains look close enough to touch above the still harbor.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the outdoor pool lies still, and the forested hills and the Tramuntana Mountains are reflected in its water.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool and look at the cool green pines on the Tramuntana Mountains.
phrases.warm: By the outdoor pool, books stay closed on this warm day while guests look at the peaks of the Tramuntana Mountains instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the outdoor restaurant terrace, guests see the bay and the Tramuntana Mountains turn gold as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights one ridge of the Tramuntana Mountains at a time, like a slow lamp.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Port de Sóller curve around the horseshoe harbor below the Tramuntana Mountains.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the harbor lights of Port de Sóller shine on the dark water, and the Tramuntana Mountains are lost in the weather.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight, guests on their terraces see the lights of Port de Sóller around the bay, with cloud resting on the Tramuntana Mountains behind.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Tramuntana Mountains tonight, and guests on the sea-facing balconies see the harbor lights of Port de Sóller below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Tramuntana Mountains are only a darker edge against the night sky, and the harbor below is quiet.
phrases.dusk: At dusk the Mediterranean turns deep blue, and guests in the 121 rooms and suites see the first lights come on around the harbor.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean is still dark, and a thin band of light grows along the horizon beyond South Beach.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge, guests look over South Beach under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic Ocean is bright blue at midday, and lunch at DiLido Beach Bar is served right in front of it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across South Beach this morning, while the Atlantic Ocean beyond the pool stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the oceanfront suites watch clouds drift over the Atlantic Ocean this afternoon, with patches of sun on the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the white sand of South Beach looks brighter beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Art Deco Historic District today, and the Atlantic Ocean fades into the sky with no clear horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the pool, guests see South Beach and the nearest waves of the Atlantic Ocean today; the water farther out is lost in the dull air.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on South Beach, and guests watch it from The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge as the Atlantic Ocean turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in the balcony rooms watch the storm from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees of South Beach, and guests in The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge take a second look to be sure.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Atlantic Ocean shows a sharp horizon beyond the empty pool deck.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the spa treatment rooms are turned towards the Atlantic Ocean, and guests are glad to see the waves from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: By the pool, guests stay under the white umbrellas and look at the Atlantic Ocean, which seems cooler than the air.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests at DiLido Beach Bar watch the waves of the Atlantic Ocean come in on South Beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in this 1953 building look at the Art Deco Historic District as the low sun turns its walls gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink over the Atlantic Ocean, seen from the pool of this hotel designed by Morris Lapidus.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds cover the evening sky, and the lights of the Art Deco Historic District glow under them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of The Ritz-Carlton Suite tonight, and the lights of South Beach blur behind it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests at their windows see the lights of South Beach, and the Atlantic Ocean beyond is a dark shape.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show over the Atlantic Ocean on this clear night, and the lights of the Art Deco Historic District shine along the shore.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, South Beach is quiet, and the Atlantic Ocean keeps moving against the empty sand.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along South Beach as the Atlantic Ocean turns deep blue.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Oriental Pearl Tower stands as a dark shape against a sky that is slowly turning pale behind the Pudong Skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: In clear morning light, guests in the Bund view rooms see the historic waterfront and the Oriental Pearl Tower at the same time.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Bund and the Pudong Skyline fit into one frame from La Terrazza, with only the Huangpu River between them.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pudong Skyline this morning, and the Oriental Pearl Tower passes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From The Bvlgari Bar, guests follow patches of afternoon sun as they travel slowly along the Bund riverfront.
phrases.overcast: The sky is flat and grey today, yet the whole length of the Bund remains clear to see.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Pudong Skyline today, and the Oriental Pearl Tower looks like a sketch that someone has not finished.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Bund is still clear from La Terrazza, but the far towers of the Pudong Skyline cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Huangpu River; guests in the Bvlgari Suite watch it from above, the Pudong Skyline blurred behind.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Pudong Skyline, and for a second the Oriental Pearl Tower shows clearly through the storm rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Bund, and guests in the rooms of this 48-story tower watch the flakes drift down toward the Huangpu River.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay on the warm side of the glass, where the freezing, clear air makes every tower of the Pudong Skyline look sharp.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, The Bvlgari Bar gives guests the Bund riverfront and the Pudong Skyline together, with no need for a coat.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Huangpu River, and the few guests on La Terrazza look at the Pudong Skyline with a cold drink in hand.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on La Terrazza turn slowly in their seats, since the Bund and the Pudong Skyline are on every side.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills Il Ristorante – Niko Romito, where the tables are set and the Oriental Pearl Tower glows beyond the glass.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests at The Bvlgari Bar see the clouds over the Bund riverfront turn orange and pink.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Il Ristorante – Niko Romito, guests look up from their plates to see the lights of the Pudong Skyline glow under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lit Oriental Pearl Tower shines through the rain on the glass of Il Ristorante – Niko Romito on the 47th floor.
phrases.mild_night: From The Bvlgari Bar, the lights of the Bund riverfront run along the Huangpu River under a soft, cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lit Pudong Skyline stands across the Huangpu River, and guests in the suites leave the curtains open.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Huangpu River is quiet and the Bund sleeps; only a guest who cannot sleep is looking at the Pudong Skyline.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Bund while the Pudong Skyline follows, tower by tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear above the terracotta rooftops, and the marina below them is still and quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: From the sea-facing balconies, guests look over terracotta rooftops to the marina, where the morning sun is bright on the water.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, the marina and the blue bay lie open under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the terracotta rooftops this morning, while the marina beyond stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the lounge see the sea through the window, blue in some places and grey where the afternoon clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the terracotta rooftops keep their warm colour, and the sea behind them takes the colour of the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the marina today, and the boats beyond the terracotta rooftops lose their edges.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The open sea is not visible today; the view stops at the terracotta rooftops and the nearest boats in the marina.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the terracotta rooftops, and guests in the sea-view rooms watch the marina turn grey behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the bell tower of Saint-Tropez for a second, then thunder rolls over the rooftops toward the sea.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the old village, and the terracotta rooftops turn white one by one above the marina.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and the bell tower of Saint-Tropez stands sharp against the sky above the rooftops.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in this 18th-century townhouse stay behind the lounge window and look at the sea from there.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the "Romeo" terrace keep to the shade and look across the garden to the bell tower of Saint-Tropez.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace, guests lie on the sun loungers, and the marina gets more attention than their books.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the terracotta rooftops a deeper orange, and the marina shines gold below them.
phrases.partly_golden: From the "Romeo" terrace, the last sun colours the clouds above the bell tower of Saint-Tropez.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the marina shine beyond the rooftops of the old village.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the village tonight, and the lights of the marina tremble in the wet glass of the sea-facing windows.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and the sky is covered, so the marina lights are the only stars guests find beyond the rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the lit marina shows beyond the sea-facing balconies, close enough for the boats to be heard.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the village sleeps: the rooftops are dark, the sea is darker, and nothing moves in the marina.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on in the marina below the rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the bay is still and grey-blue under a clear sky, and the mountain ridge slowly separates from it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the forested hillside first, and from the pool terraces the Andaman Sea turns turquoise close to Layan Beach.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Andaman Sea is bright blue to the horizon under a clear sky, and the forested hillside throws almost no shadow.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the hills this morning, while the bay in front of the pool terraces stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the west-facing rooms, guests see the ocean and the mountain ridge in one sightline, with clouds building over both.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky the Andaman Sea loses its turquoise, and the forested hillside looks darker green than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the bay today, so the hills beyond look like layers of grey paper from the pool terraces.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The sea horizon is not visible today; the bay and the nearest forested slopes are clear, and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the bay, and guests watch from their private balconies as the hillside turns a deeper green.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole mountain ridge for a second, and thunder rolls in from the Andaman Sea over the bay.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Layan Beach, and guests at their balcony doors look twice at the palm trees and the white hillside.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so every tree on the forested hillside stands out above a cold blue bay.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the sea in the bay is a flat steel blue, and the ridge behind it looks close and sharp.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look out at the sea horizon from the water.
phrases.warm: By the infinity pool, guests on sun loungers look past the palm trees to the turquoise water of the bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the late afternoon, low sun turns the ocean gold, and from the west-facing rooms the mountain ridge stands dark green beside it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds over the Andaman Sea, and the hills above the bay turn gold between the shadows.
phrases.grey_evening: After sunset, under cloud, the bay is a wide dark space and the hills around it are hardly separate from the sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and the bay below the hillside can be heard more than seen.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night clouds hide the stars, and the forested hillside is a black mass above the slightly paler sea.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Andaman Sea tonight, and the mountain ridge cuts a clean black edge along the bottom of the sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the bay is quiet and almost black, and small waves show faintly along Layan Beach.
phrases.dusk: Minutes after sunset the sky over the bay is still orange, and from the pool terraces the hills slowly lose their colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Bosphorus Strait is a wide band of still water under a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The Bosphorus Strait shines in clear morning light, and the Asian shore is sharp on the far side.
phrases.clear_midday: At Delma Grill Bar, lunch is served beside a wide view of the Bosphorus Strait, bright blue under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Bosphorus Strait this morning, and the treetops of Gezi Park go from bright to dark green.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Loft Suite, guests follow the afternoon clouds over the Bosphorus Strait and Gezi Park.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Bosphorus Strait turns the colour of steel, and the Asian shore stays clear behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Bosphorus Strait today, and the Asian shore is only a faint outline behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Asian shore is not visible today; the Bosphorus Strait fades into pale air a short way out.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Bosphorus Strait, and guests at Delma Grill Bar watch the water turn grey and rough.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Bosphorus Strait, and for a second the whole Asian shore appears, then disappears again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Bosphorus Strait, and the trees of Gezi Park are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests can pick out single buildings on the Asian shore across the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests at Delma Grill Bar stay inside and look out at the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, the Bosphorus Strait looks almost white, and guests look at it from the shower instead of the street.
phrases.warm: On the private terraces of the terrace suites, guests sit in the warm air above the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in this 17-floor building see low golden light on the Bosphorus Strait, and the windows on the Asian shore shine.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink and orange, and the Bosphorus Strait below repeats the same colours.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Delma Grill Bar, guests look at the lights of the Asian shore across the Bosphorus Strait under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights along the Bosphorus Strait blur in the rain, and guests at Delma Grill Bar watch them from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so the lights on both shores of the Bosphorus Strait do the work instead.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the lights of the Asian shore draw long lines on the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Bosphorus Strait is quiet and wide below the 56 rooms and 11 suites.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along both shores of the Bosphorus Strait.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dolomites are a faint jagged edge at the far end of the Valle Aurina, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the green floor of the Valle Aurina, and from the sky pools guests follow it down to the Dolomites.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Dolomites stand clear and jagged above the green valley, seen through the glass of the panoramic sauna.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the wooded slopes this morning, while the Dolomites stay bright at the end of the valley.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Sky Garden, guests watch cloud shadows cross the mountains that rise on every side of the rooftop.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the chalets and wooded slopes of the Valle Aurina look darker, and the Dolomites turn grey above them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze fills the Valle Aurina today, and from Panorama Sky Lounge the Dolomites are only a soft outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Dolomites are not visible today; guests in the panoramic sauna see the valley floor, the chalets and the nearest wooded slopes.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the panoramic sauna, and guests watch the Valle Aurina turn a deeper green behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls between the slopes of the Valle Aurina, and guests in Panorama Sky Lounge watch lightning flash over the mountains.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Valle Aurina, and guests in the panoramic sauna watch the chalets turn white with heat at their backs.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the Dolomites look sharp at the end of the valley, a view guests wisely take from inside the panoramic sauna.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the mountains around Sky Garden stand out clearly, and guests look at them from the Swiss pine cabins.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat guests stay in the sky pools, looking down the green Valle Aurina to the pale Dolomites.
phrases.warm: Warm air lies over the valley, and swimmers in the 25-metre pool glide from indoors out to the forested peaks.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Dolomites gold at the end of the valley, and the wooded slopes below them fall into shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and catches the Dolomites, and from the sky pools the swimming stops for a moment.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, chalet lights mark the floor of the Valle Aurina, and the Dolomites have gone into the dark.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening the lights of the chalets shine blurred through the glass of Panorama Sky Lounge.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the mountains around Sky Garden are only black shapes on every side of the rooftop.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Valle Aurina tonight, and the chalet lights below look small under the Dolomites.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Valle Aurina is quiet, and its wooded slopes are darker than the sky above them.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright behind the Dolomites, and the first chalet lights come on along the valley.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic and Marapendi Lagoon are two quiet sheets of water under a clear sky that slowly grows lighter.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the Grand Club Lounge on the top floor, guests look out at Barra da Tijuca Beach and Marapendi Lagoon, both in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Atlantic turns turquoise beyond the sand of Barra da Tijuca Beach.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Marapendi Lagoon this morning, and the hills beyond it move in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: During the afternoon cocktail hour in the Grand Club Lounge, guests watch clouds drift above both the beach and the lagoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Atlantic loses its turquoise, and Barra da Tijuca Beach becomes a long pale strip beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the hills behind Marapendi Lagoon today, and the mangroves on its shore look like a soft green edge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Atlantic horizon is not visible today, and guests in the corner rooms with wrap-around balconies see only the nearer water of the ocean and the lagoon.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Marapendi Lagoon, and guests in the lagoon-view rooms watch the drops mark the calm water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Through the glass doors of the Ocean Lagoon Suite, guests see lightning over the Atlantic on one side and over Marapendi Lagoon on the other.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Barra da Tijuca Beach, to the surprise of the palm trees, and the Atlantic takes every flake without a trace.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, bright day, the sand of Barra da Tijuca Beach is empty, and the Atlantic is sharp and blue behind it.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass of the Grand Club Lounge with a coffee and look down at Marapendi Lagoon and its hills.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests at the outdoor pools look past the white umbrellas to the Atlantic, which seems cooler by the minute.
phrases.warm: Parasols dot Barra da Tijuca Beach on this warm day, and swimmers are small figures in the Atlantic surf.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Atlantic gold, and guests in the ocean-view rooms step onto their balconies to watch it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Marapendi Lagoon turn pink, and the calm water copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Shiso on the 16th floor, guests look through floor-to-ceiling windows at Marapendi Lagoon under a low, cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the tall windows of Shiso this evening, and Marapendi Lagoon is a blur of wet grey behind the omakase.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky on this mild night, and only the white surf shows where Barra da Tijuca Beach meets the Atlantic.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests at Shiso see stars above Marapendi Lagoon and the black outline of the hills beyond.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Marapendi Lagoon is still and black, and the sound of the Atlantic arrives from the other side.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over the Atlantic while the first lights appear along Barra da Tijuca Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: A thin band of light grows on the horizon over the Atlantic, and the east-facing rooftop terrace is the place to wait for the sun.
phrases.clear_morning: At Venn Bar, guests have breakfast while the morning sun lays a bright path across the Atlantic.
phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic is a clear blue at midday, and from the 12th-floor fitness center guests can follow each wave to the sand.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic this morning, in plain sight through the glass railings of the oceanfront balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop, guests see the coast run away in both directions, with patches of sun and shade on the sand.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic turns the color of steel, and the white lines of surf stand out more clearly on the beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Atlantic today, and the far end of the beach fades away before the eye gets there.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; from the rooftop, guests see the beach and the nearest waves, and then the coast disappears.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic, and guests watch it from behind floor-to-ceiling windows as the drops run down the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay inside as a thunderstorm crosses the Atlantic, and each flash of lightning shows the waves for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Atlantic and on the palm trees below, and guests look twice before they believe it.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, bright day, guests work out in the 12th-floor fitness center with the Atlantic wide and sharp in front of them.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the beach is almost empty, and from Venn Bar guests see long, clean waves roll in from the Atlantic.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests keep to the shade of the striped umbrellas on the oceanfront terrace and look out at the bright Atlantic.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the rooftop turn their chairs to the Atlantic and count the people walking on the beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the west-facing rooftop terrace, guests watch the sun sink low over the city, while the Atlantic behind them turns a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun turns the clouds above the Atlantic pink, while rooms facing the city get the sunset itself.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds cover the evening sky, and from the rooftop the lights of Daytona Beach follow the coast into the distance.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights along the shore shine blurred on the wet glass railings of the balconies.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Atlantic shows itself mainly as white foam where the waves break on the beach.
phrases.clear_night: The stars are out over the Atlantic tonight, and the horizon is easy to find where they stop.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the beach is empty and the Atlantic lies wide and dark beyond the sand.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Atlantic, and the first lights come on along the coast.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Atlantic is a wide grey sheet, and the Serra de Sintra slowly takes shape behind the coast.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Arribas Terrace, guests look over the Atlantic under a clear sky, with Cape Roca sharp across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: Over lunch at Arribas Terrace, guests watch a bright blue Atlantic break white on the shore below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Serra de Sintra this morning, while Cape Roca and the open Atlantic stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the Atlantic this afternoon, and guests in any of the 60 rooms can follow them from a balcony to Cape Roca.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlantic turns the colour of slate, and the Serra de Sintra rises quiet behind the coast.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Cape Roca today, and the Atlantic fades into the sky with no clear horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Cape Roca cannot be seen today, and the view stops at the surf on Praia Grande and the nearest cliffs.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic; from the sliding balcony doors, guests watch grey waves come in below a blurred Cape Roca.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Atlantic for a second at a time, and the thunder rolls in over Cape Roca.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sand of Praia Grande, and the flakes vanish as they touch the Atlantic waves.
phrases.very_cold: The cold air makes Cape Roca look close enough to touch, and the long saltwater pool, here since 1966, lies still below.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the indoor dining room of Arribas Terrace is the place to watch the Atlantic waves break on the shore.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, swimmers fill the 100-metre saltwater pool, and the Atlantic just beyond it shines almost white.
phrases.warm: On a warm day guests take an outdoor table at Arribas Terrace and look across the Atlantic towards Cape Roca.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Master Suite, guests see the whole sunset over the Atlantic, with Cape Roca turning gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and paints the cliffs of Praia Grande orange, with the Serra de Sintra behind them.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Arribas Terrace, guests look out at a cloudy evening where the Atlantic and the sky share one dark grey.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and behind the balcony doors guests watch the weather blow in from the Atlantic over Praia Grande.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night the Serra de Sintra disappears into the sky, and the Atlantic is known by its white surf.
phrases.clear_night: Stars come out over the Atlantic on a clear night, and Cape Roca is a low black line at the end of the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Atlantic is more heard than seen, the waves still arriving on Praia Grande below the Serra de Sintra.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky above the Atlantic stays bright, and Cape Roca becomes a dark shape as the first lights come on along the coast.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Pena Palace is a small dark shape on the hilltop above the outdoor pool.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Pena Palace first, and guests see it from the indoor infinity pool through the tall windows.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is clear, and Pena Palace stands sharp on its hilltop above the green Sintra hills.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Sintra hills this morning, and Pena Palace goes in and out of the sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From their terraces, guests in the mountain-view suites watch cloud shadows cross the hills below Pena Palace this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the green Sintra hills look darker, and Pena Palace sits quietly on top.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Sintra hills today, and Pena Palace appears only for a moment when it thins.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Pena Palace is not visible today, and guests at the indoor infinity pool see only the nearest green hills.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows of the indoor infinity pool, and Pena Palace is blurred on its hilltop.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Sintra hills, and for a second Pena Palace shows clearly through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Sintra hills, and guests in the lobby watch the green slopes fade behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day guests stay in the indoor infinity pool and look at Pena Palace in the clear air.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests at Inevitável Restaurant look across the hills to Pena Palace from their lunch tables.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool up to their shoulders and look up at Pena Palace.
phrases.warm: By the outdoor pool, guests lie in the warm air, and Pena Palace fills the horizon above the trees.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Pena Palace gold on its hilltop, and the still outdoor pool holds its reflection.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds, and guests at the indoor infinity pool see Pena Palace glow for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hide the stars this evening, and guests at dinner in Inevitável Restaurant look out at the dark Sintra hills.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the mountain-view terraces this evening, and the Sintra hills disappear into the wet dark.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests on the mountain-view terraces can just see the line of the Sintra hills.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Sintra hills tonight, and guests look for the outline of Pena Palace on its hilltop.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the outdoor pool lies still, and the Sintra hills are only a darker line against the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and guests in this 146-room resort see Pena Palace as a clear outline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Back Bay skyline stands out against a sky that is slowly turning from black to deep blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Copley Square, and guests in the Sky Lobby watch the light move across the Back Bay rooftops.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in Long Bar & Terrace, guests look out over the Boston skyline under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Charles River this morning, while the Back Bay skyline stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the fitness center, guests on the treadmills follow the clouds as they drift over the downtown Boston skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Copley Square and the Back Bay rooftops share one quiet colour in the Sky Lobby windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits low on Back Bay today, and only the tops of the towers rise above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Charles River is not visible today; the view from the Sky Lobby stops at Copley Square and the nearest Back Bay towers.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and guests in their rooms watch Copley Square shine wet below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Back Bay skyline, and guests in the Sky Lobby on the 17th floor have a dry seat for the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Copley Square, and guests in the Sky Lobby Suites watch the Back Bay rooftops turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, so swimmers in the indoor pool see every line of the downtown Boston skyline from warm water.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Charles River looks like grey steel beyond the Back Bay rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Back Bay rooftops, and guests on the terrace of Long Bar & Terrace keep cold drinks close while they look at the skyline.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit outside at Long Bar & Terrace with the Boston skyline all around them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass towers of Back Bay gold, and the Sky Lobby fills with the same warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: From Long Bar & Terrace, guests with cocktails watch the last sun colour the clouds above the Boston skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Back Bay skyline give the low sky a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the city lights tonight, and from the indoor pool the downtown Boston skyline looks like a painting that is still wet.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in this 2023 tower end the day at the floor-to-ceiling glass, with the lights of Back Bay under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lights of the Back Bay skyline look close enough to count, window by window.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Copley Square lies empty and still, far below the suite windows.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Charles River as the first lights come on across Back Bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Chao Phraya River is a wide dark band below the rooftop, and the sky behind Wat Arun is still deep blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the river-facing rooms open the curtains to the Chao Phraya River shining under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the 28-metre rooftop infinity pool and the Chao Phraya River below it share the same strong light.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Chao Phraya River this morning, while Wat Arun on the opposite bank stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the Chao Phraya River towards the Bangkok skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Chao Phraya River turns the colour of milky tea, and Wat Arun stands out clearly on the opposite bank.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Chao Phraya River today, and from the rooftop Wat Arun is a soft outline on the opposite bank.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so Wat Arun is not visible from the rooftop, and guests look at the nearer Chao Phraya River instead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Chao Phraya River; guests watch it from their suite windows, the Bangkok skyline blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Chao Phraya River, and guests count the seconds to the thunder from behind their floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Chao Phraya River, and Wat Arun on the opposite bank slowly disappears behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and Wat Arun shows every detail across the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Chao Phraya River looks like grey steel from the rooftop, and Wat Arun stands sharp against the sky.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop infinity pool up to their chins and look out over the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.warm: On the pool deck, guests lie on the lounge chairs in the warm air, and the Chao Phraya River stretches out beyond the pool's edge.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on Wat Arun in the late afternoon, and the Chao Phraya River below the rooftop turns the colour of honey.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Chao Phraya River turn pink and orange, and the rooftop infinity pool copies every colour.
phrases.grey_evening: At SEEN Restaurant & Bar, guests have dinner on the alfresco deck under a cloudy evening sky, with the lit Chao Phraya River below.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Chao Phraya River this evening, and the lights of the opposite bank stretch into long wet reflections.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hang low over the Chao Phraya River and glow faintly with the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests at SEEN Restaurant & Bar look from the alfresco deck to Wat Arun, lit on the opposite bank.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Chao Phraya River is quiet below all 250 rooms, and only the slow water moves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Chao Phraya River and across the Bangkok skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Tokyo skyline is a dark line of towers against the first pale light before sunrise.
phrases.clear_morning: The Tokyo Skytree stands sharp this morning, with every level of the tower easy to pick out.
phrases.clear_midday: Far beyond the Tokyo skyline, Mount Fuji shows above the distant silhouettes of mountains.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests who order breakfast from In-Room Dining eat it facing the Tokyo skyline, part in sun and part in cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift past the top of the Tokyo Skytree, and for a moment the tower seems to be the one moving.
phrases.overcast: The Tokyo Skytree rises pale into the low cloud, a little lighter than the grey city around it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze flattens the Tokyo skyline into layers, each row of towers paler than the one in front.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only a faint outline of the Tokyo Skytree shows in today's poor visibility, and Mount Fuji cannot be seen at all.
phrases.rain: The Tokyo skyline turns soft and grey in the rain, and its farthest towers are almost gone.
phrases.thunderstorm: Each flash of lightning shows guests in the spa the distant silhouettes of mountains for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the city, and guests in the Fitness Centre watch Tokyo's skyline fade behind it.
phrases.very_cold: From the warmth of the spa, guests can count each ridge in the distant silhouettes of mountains.
phrases.cold: Guests stay warm on the upper floors of the Nihonbashi Mitsui Tower and look across at the Tokyo Skytree.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests swim slow lengths in the pool with the Tokyo skyline in front of them.
phrases.warm: On this warm day the Tokyo Skytree stands tall over the roofs of the city.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun paints one side of the Tokyo Skytree gold and leaves the other side in shade.
phrases.partly_golden: From the pool, guests see the Tokyo skyline turn orange tower by tower as the clouds let the last sun through.
phrases.grey_evening: Lit for the evening, the Tokyo Skytree is a thin bright column above the dark roofs of the city.
phrases.wet_evening: The city shines wet tonight, and guests at dinner in Sense see it from the 37th floor.
phrases.mild_night: Some guests order from In-Room Dining tonight and stay in, facing the lights of the Tokyo skyline.
phrases.clear_night: From the Fitness Centre, guests see the lights of Tokyo's skyline reach far across the city on this clear night.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Tokyo skyline is quiet, with only a few windows still bright.
phrases.dusk: One by one the levels of the Tokyo Skytree light up, while the city under it is still blue with dusk.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the windmills stand quiet above Little Venice while the Aegean Sea is still grey-blue.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast at Epico, guests look across a bright Aegean Sea to Delos under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The infinity pool and the Aegean Sea share one blue at midday, with the windmills bright in the sun below.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move over Mykonos Town this morning, and the windmills go from bright to dull and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pool terrace, guests follow the afternoon clouds over the old harbour, while Syros and Tinos show between them.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Aegean Sea turns the colour of slate, and Little Venice and the windmills stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides Syros and Tinos today, so the view from the pool terrace stays closer in, on the windmills and Little Venice.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Delos is not visible today; the view stops at the old harbour and the windmills, which stay clear above Mykonos Town.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Mykonos Town, and guests watch it from the lounge, where the glass doors show a grey Aegean Sea.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Aegean Sea, and for a second the windmills show sharp above Little Venice.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Mykonos Town, and from their terrace doors guests watch the windmills slowly lose their outline.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, so Delos, Syros and Tinos all show sharply across the Aegean Sea.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the 180-degree view from Epico Bar still runs from the windmills to Delos, and the sea between them looks dark blue.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in their private plunge pools and look at the windmills from the water, which seems a sensible plan.
phrases.warm: By the infinity pool, guests on sunbeds look past the water's edge to the old harbour and the Aegean Sea on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Epico Bar, guests hold their cocktails and watch the low sun turn the Aegean Sea and the windmills gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in strips, and from the Lamda Suite terrace Mykonos Town glows one piece at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner at Epico Restaurant, guests look down at the lights of Mykonos Town under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of Mykonos Town this evening, and the old harbour shines wet through the glass doors of the lounge.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of Little Venice follow the edge of the water below the windmills.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, stars hang over the Aegean Sea, and Mykonos Town glimmers below the tables of Epico Restaurant.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Aegean Sea is quiet and wide, and the windmills are only shapes above Little Venice.
phrases.dusk: Opened in 2024, and already the dusk routine is fixed: guests watch the first lights come on in Little Venice below the windmills.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Hohensalzburg Fortress is a dark shape above the Old Town, and the sky behind the Gaisberg is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Sky Restaurant, guests watch the morning sun reach Hohensalzburg Fortress and the Untersberg behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Hohensalzburg Fortress stands out above the Old Town, with the Tennengebirge and Hagengebirge mountains sharp behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Gaisberg this morning, while Hohensalzburg Fortress stays in sunshine above the city.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the 12th-floor corner rooms, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift from the Untersberg towards Hohensalzburg Fortress.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits low over Salzburg, and Hohensalzburg Fortress looks almost white against the darker mountains.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and Hohensalzburg Fortress seems to float above the Old Town with no hill under it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tennengebirge and Hagengebirge mountains are not visible today, and Hohensalzburg Fortress is only a faint outline above the city.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of Sky Restaurant, and guests see Hohensalzburg Fortress slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Untersberg, and guests on the 15th floor see Hohensalzburg Fortress appear for a second in the white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Salzburg, and Hohensalzburg Fortress slowly fades behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is clear and icy today, and guests in this 117-room glass tower can count the white ridges of the Tennengebirge from the warmth indoors.
phrases.cold: From Jägerstüberl on the 14th floor, Hohensalzburg Fortress stands clear above the city in the cold light.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, Hohensalzburg Fortress shimmers a little above the roofs, and guests look at it from the cool air of their rooms.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the ground-floor conference rooms look out at the green park in full daylight.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun colours the walls of Hohensalzburg Fortress, and the Untersberg behind it turns a deep blue.
phrases.partly_golden: From Sky Terrace, guests watch the last sun turn the clouds orange over Hohensalzburg Fortress and the mountains beyond.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Sky Restaurant, guests see Hohensalzburg Fortress lit under low cloud, with the city lights spread out below.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the evening city, and the lights of Hohensalzburg Fortress run into soft streaks on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: The lights of Salzburg glow under a cloudy night sky, and Hohensalzburg Fortress stands lit above them.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, Hohensalzburg Fortress is lit above the Old Town, and stars show over the Untersberg.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and guests who are still awake can just make out the long ridge of the Gaisberg.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind the Hochstaufen, and the first lights come on around Hohensalzburg Fortress.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests who wake early see the first grey light over the Adriatic Sea, with the old town of Ostuni still colourless on its hill.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the white old town first, and to its right the Adriatic Sea shows as a thin blue strip.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, guests see the old town bright white under the midday sun, with a sliver of the Adriatic Sea beyond its right edge.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the white houses of Ostuni this morning, while the Adriatic Sea stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests looking past the old town this afternoon find the Adriatic Sea changing between blue and grey as the clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the old town still looks white, and the Adriatic Sea takes the colour of the clouds above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Adriatic Sea today, so guests on the rooftop terrace look at the white old town alone.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Adriatic Sea, 8 kilometres away, is not visible today; the white old town on its hill is still easy to see.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftops of Ostuni, and guests see the white walls turn a darker, wet grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests count the seconds between the lightning over the old town and the thunder that follows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Ostuni, and guests see the white town become whiter, one roof at a time.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests can pick out every roof of the old town, and the Adriatic Sea draws a sharp horizon behind.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the cathedral stands clearly at the top of the old town, with the Adriatic Sea low on the right.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the rooftop terrace narrow their eyes at the white town, and the distant Adriatic Sea looks very inviting.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests stay on the rooftop terrace and follow the hill with their eyes, from the white old town down to the Adriatic Sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the white walls of the old town gold, and the Adriatic Sea beside them goes a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights one part of the old town at a time, like a slow lamp.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit rooftops of Ostuni glow softly, and the Adriatic Sea is a darker seam behind them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lamps of the old town tonight, and guests see the wet rooftops shine under them.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit houses of the old town climb the hill toward the cathedral.
phrases.clear_night: Above the hotel's 34 rooms, guests look across to the lit rooftops of Ostuni under a sky full of stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the old town rests as a pale shape on its hill, and the Adriatic Sea is lost in the darkness.
phrases.dusk: From the rooftop terrace, guests watch the old town turn from white to grey as the first lamps come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the dome of St Stephen's Basilica is a dark shape above Erzsébet Square, and the sky behind it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: In the clear morning light, guests in Basilica-facing rooms see the dome of St Stephen's Basilica sharp above Erzsébet Square.
phrases.clear_midday: The Budapest Eye turns slowly against a clear blue sky, directly across the street.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Erzsébet Square this morning, and their shadows cross the park and the Budapest Eye.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Swimmers in the spa pool look through the windows at the city, where sun and cloud shadows take turns this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the dome of St Stephen's Basilica keeps a clear outline above Erzsébet Square.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken the top of the Budapest Eye today, so the cabins rise into white and come back down again.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: from the upper floors the Budapest Eye across the street is clear, but the dome of St Stephen's Basilica is only a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Erzsébet Square, and guests in park view rooms watch the Budapest Eye turn behind wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over the city centre, and guests in the fitness centre stop their exercise to watch lightning in the sky over Budapest.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Erzsébet Square, and the dome of St Stephen's Basilica fades softly behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests choose the warm spa pool and look out over the city under a bright, icy sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass on the upper floors, with the Budapest Eye turning across the street.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot, and guests at the outdoor tables on Fashion Street watch the city centre move slowly around them.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, lunch on the two-storey terrace of ÉS Bisztró has the city centre as its view, and nobody hurries dessert.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun gives a golden colour to the dome of St Stephen's Basilica above Erzsébet Square.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Budapest Eye turn pink, and the cabins keep turning through the colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars this evening, but the lit Budapest Eye turns over Erzsébet Square like a wheel of small lamps.
phrases.wet_evening: It is a wet evening, and the lights of the Budapest Eye make long reflections on the ground of Erzsébet Square.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the patio of Blue Fox The Bar looks onto the lights of the city centre.
phrases.clear_night: Guests looking out on this clear night see the lit Budapest Eye in front of the dome of St Stephen's Basilica.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Erzsébet Square is quiet, and even the Budapest Eye seems to be resting.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on along the Budapest Eye across the street.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Swan River lies still and grey-blue under a clear sky that is slowly growing lighter.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Swan River, and guests in the river view suites see the water change from silver to blue.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Swan River is bright blue under a clear sky, wide and open beyond the outdoor pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Swan River this morning, with sunny patches of water between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the suites on the skyline side, guests see the Perth city towers go in and out of the sun as clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: Under a full cover of cloud, the Swan River turns the same soft grey as the sky above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Swan River today, and the far bank is only a faint outline behind the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today; guests can see the near water of the Swan River, while the far bank is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Swan River, and guests watch the drops mark the water from behind the glass of the river view suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Swan River, and for a second the whole width of the water turns white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Swan River, and the flakes disappear the moment they touch the dark water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, and the Swan River shines sharply under a pale sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, steam rises from the heated outdoor pool, and the Swan River lies wide and calm beyond it.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool up to their shoulders and look across at the Swan River.
phrases.warm: By the outdoor pool, books stay closed on this warm day while guests look at the Swan River instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Swan River gold, and the outdoor pool takes the same warm colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Swan River turn orange and the water copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the Swan River is dark and the lights along its banks draw two thin bright rows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass tonight, and the lights of the Perth skyline spread into soft coloured spots.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky on this mild night, and the lit Perth skyline gives them a faint glow.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in this 488-room hotel see the lights of the Perth skyline stand out clearly under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Swan River is a wide, quiet space of black water, and nothing moves on it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights come on beside the Swan River.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Eiffel Tower is still a dark shape against the first pale sky, seen from the Eiffel Tower Suite.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests waking in the Prestige Suite find the Basilica of the Sacré-Cœur clear in the first sun of the day.
phrases.clear_midday: The Louvre stands in full midday sun, every line of it clear.
phrases.partly_morning: The Eiffel Tower goes from bright to grey and back this morning as clouds cross the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the Rooftop Suite, guests watch cloud shadows cross the Palais Royal Gardens while Sacré-Cœur Basilica stays in the sun.
phrases.overcast: No shadows fall on the Louvre today; the whole building sits in the same soft grey light.
phrases.fog_haze: Sacré-Cœur is only a pale outline in today's haze, and the Louvre looks softer than usual.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests in the Eiffel Tower Suite see the Palais Royal Gardens clearly and the Eiffel Tower only faintly.
phrases.rain: Guests in the Junior Suite watch the rain come down over the Palais Royal monument and the city behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Eiffel Tower for a second, and guests in the Rooftop Suite wait for the next flash.
phrases.snow: From the warm side of the glass, guests in the Prestige Suite watch snow fall over the Basilica of the Sacré-Cœur.
phrases.very_cold: The Eiffel Tower stands sharp in the freezing air while guests in the Eiffel Tower Suite stay inside to look at it.
phrases.cold: Sacré-Cœur and the Louvre both stand clear today, and guests are happy to admire them from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: On the balcony of the Suite with Balcony, guests look for shade and find the Palais Royal monument instead.
phrases.warm: Guests on the balcony of the Junior Suite with Balcony take their time over the Palais Royal monument and the city behind it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Louvre and the Eiffel Tower share the same gold light as the afternoon ends.
phrases.partly_golden: Sacré-Cœur Basilica catches the last sun between the clouds, and guests in the Rooftop Suite stop to look.
phrases.grey_evening: The Louvre is lit for the evening while the clouds above it stay dark.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the Eiffel Tower shine through tonight's rain for guests in the Eiffel Tower Suite.
phrases.mild_night: Sacré-Cœur and the Louvre are both lit under the clouds tonight, and guests take a last look before sleeping.
phrases.clear_night: From the Rooftop Suite, guests can see both the Eiffel Tower and Sacré-Cœur Basilica lit in the clear night.
phrases.late_night: Paris has gone quiet around the Louvre, and guests still awake see it dark and still.
phrases.dusk: The first lights come on at the Louvre while the sky behind the Eiffel Tower is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale behind the Alps, and guests in the panorama rooms watch Lake Zurich slowly take shape.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Tower Suite, the clear morning shows the full circle: Lake Zurich, the rooftops of Zurich and the Alps.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in the restaurant, guests look over the rooftops of Zurich to Lake Zurich, bright blue under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Lake Zurich this morning, while the forest on Uetliberg Mountain stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the viewing tower, guests follow the clouds drifting over Zurich towards the Alps this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Lake Zurich looks like dull silver from the panorama terrace, with the rooftops of Zurich clear beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies over Zurich today, and from the panorama terrace only the top of Uetliberg Mountain and the distant Alps rise above the white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today; guests on the viewing tower see the city rooftops and the near part of Lake Zurich, then the air turns white.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the restaurant windows, and Lake Zurich is a soft grey band beyond the wet rooftops of Zurich.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Lake Zurich, and guests in the Tower Suite have the storm on every side.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the forest of Uetliberg Mountain, and Lake Zurich appears and disappears between the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and at the turret telescope guests pick out single peaks of the Alps above Lake Zurich.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look out from the warm restaurant, where Lake Zurich and the rooftops of Zurich go well with a hot drink.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the panorama terrace choose the shade and look down at Lake Zurich, which seems the coolest place in sight.
phrases.warm: On the panorama terrace, cold drinks arrive and conversations stop for a moment, because Lake Zurich, the city and the Alps fill half the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the forest of Uetliberg Mountain gold, and guests on the viewing tower see Lake Zurich shining below.
phrases.partly_golden: The clouds above Lake Zurich turn pink and gold in the last hour of sun, and at 871 meters guests feel close to them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Zurich gather around Lake Zurich, which stays the one dark space among them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests at dinner in the restaurant see the lights of Zurich blurred into soft gold through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of Zurich glow below Uetliberg Mountain like a second sky.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests on the viewing tower see the city lights stretch along the shores of Lake Zurich.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Uetliberg Mountain is quiet, and Lake Zurich lies still far below the panorama rooms.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Alps, and from the panorama terrace the first lights of Zurich come on beside Lake Zurich.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, a press of a button lifts the blinds in the harbour view rooms, and Waitemata Harbour lies dark and still under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Club InterContinental, guests look out at Waitemata Harbour, bright blue under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Waitemata Harbour shines under the midday sun, and the cruise ships at the terminal stand out clearly against the blue water.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Waitemata Harbour this morning, with patches of sunlit water between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon tea in Club InterContinental has competition today, as sun and cloud keep changing the colour of Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Waitemata Harbour turns the colour of steel, calm and wide beyond the waterfront.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Waitemata Harbour today, and the cruise ships at the terminal seem to float in pale air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Waitemata Harbour is not visible today; guests see the near water and the waterfront, and little beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in the harbour view rooms watch Waitemata Harbour turn grey under the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above Waitemata Harbour, and from Club InterContinental on the 3rd floor guests watch the storm cross the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Waitemata Harbour, and each flake disappears the moment it touches the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, Waitemata Harbour looks sharp and bright, and guests are happy to admire it from indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the spa look through floor-to-ceiling windows at the city skyline and Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, people walk slowly along the waterfront below, while Waitemata Harbour shimmers in the white light.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests stand on a balcony and look over the waterfront to Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns Waitemata Harbour gold, and the city skyline is reflected in the water.
