phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Waitemata Harbour turn pink and orange, and the water copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in Club InterContinental see the waterfront lights stretch in long lines across Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the waterfront lights this evening, and Waitemata Harbour shines like wet black glass beyond them.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the city lights give the clouds a soft glow above Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above Waitemata Harbour tonight, and the lights of the city skyline shine on the calm water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Waitemata Harbour is quiet, and the night sky sits low over the dark water.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky above Waitemata Harbour is still bright, and the first lights of the waterfront come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests in the bay-facing rooms see Manila Bay as a wide, quiet surface under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light fills Manila Bay, and the line where the infinity pool ends and the bay begins is not easy to find.
phrases.clear_midday: From the corner windows of the Bay View Diplomatic Suite, guests see Manila Bay at its widest angle, blue to the horizon under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Manila Bay this morning, and guests in the lobby follow them through the glass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Executive Lounge on the top floor, guests look down over the pool and across to a part of Manila Bay, with clouds drifting above.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Manila Bay takes the same colour, and the SM MOA Eye is a neat circle against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Manila Bay today, and the fishing boats seem to float between water and sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon of Manila Bay cannot be seen today, and from the infinity pool terrace only the nearer water is clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Manila Bay, and guests watch it cross the water from the dry side of the lobby glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole width of Manila Bay for a second, and guests in the Bay View Diplomatic Suite get the widest share of the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Manila Bay, and guests in the Executive Lounge watch the flakes come down on the pool below and the grey water beyond.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air makes Manila Bay look sharp and clear, and guests in this 347-room hotel keep to the warm side of the lobby windows.

phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look out over Manila Bay, where the water shines white.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: The afternoon sun comes low across Manila Bay and straight into the Bay View Diplomatic Suite, where the corner windows turn gold.

phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, Manila Bay darkens, and guests see the lights of the rides across the road shine in front of it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in the Executive Lounge look down at the lit pool dimpled by rain, with Manila Bay black behind it.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud hides the stars tonight, and Manila Bay is a wide black space beyond the lit edge of the infinity pool.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over Manila Bay tonight, and guests in the lobby look out on water as dark as the sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Manila Bay is quiet and black, and even the rides across the road have gone still.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Manila Bay is still bright, and the infinity pool lights come on beside it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Prudential Center stands as a dark tower against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun fills the indoor pool, and swimmers look through floor-to-ceiling glass at the Back Bay.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Prudential Center, Christian Science Plaza and Fenway Park are all sharp and easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Back Bay rooftops this morning, while the Prudential Center stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Back Bay Corner Suite, guests follow patches of afternoon sun as they move across the whole neighborhood.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Christian Science Plaza and the Back Bay streets share the same soft, even light.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Boston skyline today, and Fenway Park is only a faint outline past the Back Bay rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Fenway Park cannot be seen today, but the Prudential Center across the street is still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch the Back Bay blur from their soaking tubs.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Prudential Center, and swimmers in the indoor pool stop to watch the storm over the Back Bay.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Christian Science Plaza, and the Back Bay rooftops are turning white one by one.
phrases.very_cold: From the 7th-floor indoor pool, guests in swimsuits look at a freezing Back Bay and feel no need to go out.

phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the Charles Suite terrace look over the clear glass rail at a Back Bay shimmering in the sun.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, Fenway Park is in plain sight, and guests on the higher floors can check on the field without a ticket.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Prudential Center gold, and long shadows stretch across Christian Science Plaza.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Fenway Park turn orange, and guests in the indoor pool swim slower to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Back Bay glow from below, and the low sky takes a little of their color.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Prudential Center spread into soft colors on the glass of the indoor pool.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, guests in this 2019 tower look across a Back Bay full of lit windows under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the Boston skyline shines in rows of lights around the Prudential Center.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Back Bay is quiet, and Christian Science Plaza lies empty and still.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky is still bright and the first lights come on in the Prudential Center.

phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast at Les Toits, guests look over the village in clear morning light, with the Mediterranean bright behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, the Mediterranean is deep blue at midday, wide open past the roofs of the village.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cross the Gulf of Saint-Tropez this morning, and from the rooftop pool their shadows can be followed slowly over the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon clouds drift over the village, and from the rooftop patches of sun can be seen moving across the Mediterranean.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Mediterranean turns silver, and the village rooftops make a clear edge in front of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Gulf of Saint-Tropez today, and from the rooftop the sea and the sky seem to be one colour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the Gulf of Saint-Tropez is not visible today; from the rooftop pool the eye reaches the village roofs and the nearest water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Gulf of Saint-Tropez; guests watch it from their windows, the far water slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the Gulf of Saint-Tropez, and guests in the Dolce Vita Suite watch the lightning over the sea from indoors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the village rooftops, and the Mediterranean behind them is a quiet grey.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Mediterranean looks sharp and blue from the rooftop.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the heated rooftop pool lies still, and the Gulf of Saint-Tropez stretches out quietly behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look at the Mediterranean from the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the terrace suite's terrace look down at the life of Place de la Gendarmerie.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Les Toits Lounge Bar, guests hold sunset cocktails while the Mediterranean turns gold in the low sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and colours the Gulf of Saint-Tropez pink, seen from the rooftop of this 1931 hotel.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner at Les Toits on a cloudy evening, guests have the lights of the village below them and the sea in darkness further out.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the village this evening, and the lamps of the narrow lanes shine on the wet stones below.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lights of the marina reach the rooms that face it, and the yachts glow softly.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the village sleeps, and the Mediterranean is only a wide stillness past the roofs.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Mediterranean, and the first lights come on across the village below the rooftop.

phrases.clear_morning: Guests take a first coffee at Cocktail Bar while the morning sun lights the full length of Brighton Palace Pier.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Brighton Palace Pier stands sharp against a blue English Channel.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Brighton Beach this morning, and guests in the 4th-floor balcony rooms watch them move out to sea.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over Brighton Palace Pier this afternoon, and the sea changes colour with them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the English Channel turns the colour of pewter, and Brighton Palace Pier stretches out across it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the English Channel today, and the far end of Brighton Palace Pier fades into it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon over the English Channel cannot be seen today, though Brighton Palace Pier and Brighton Beach stay clear.
phrases.rain: In the rooms with a bathtub by the window, guests watch rain fall on Brighton Beach from warm water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Brighton Palace Pier for a second at a time, and thunder rolls in off the English Channel.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Brighton Palace Pier, and guests in this pair of 1820s townhouses watch it settle on the beach.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and Brighton Palace Pier shows every detail above Brighton Beach.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay in Cocktail Bar with a hot drink and watch the waves roll onto Brighton Beach.

phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the rooftop balconies look down at people walking along Brighton Beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests at Cocktail Bar watch the low sun turn the English Channel gold around Brighton Palace Pier.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and colours them pink above Brighton Palace Pier.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Brighton Palace Pier glow over the dark water, seen from Cocktail Bar.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of Brighton Palace Pier this evening, and their colours run across the wet road of Marine Parade.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and Brighton Palace Pier draws a line of lights out into the English Channel.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the English Channel tonight, and guests at Cocktail Bar look from them down to the lights of Brighton Palace Pier.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Brighton Beach is quiet, and only the white edge of the waves shows where the English Channel begins.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the English Channel as the first lights come on along Brighton Palace Pier.

phrases.clear_predawn: The clear sky begins to pale before sunrise, and the Rialto Bridge slowly takes shape over the Grand Canal.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the white stone arch of the Rialto Bridge, and guests in the canal-view rooms see it framed in the window.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the terrace restaurant looks over a Grand Canal busy with gondolas and water taxis under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning clouds drift over the Rialto Bridge, which faces the ground-floor terrace where breakfast is served from April to October.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the panoramic terrace, cloud shadows cross the Grand Canal this afternoon while boats keep passing under the Rialto Bridge.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Grand Canal turns the same grey, and the white Rialto Bridge stands out more clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Grand Canal today, and gondolas come out of it one by one in front of the Rialto Bridge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far bends of the Grand Canal are lost, but the Rialto Bridge stays clear at close range.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Grand Canal with small circles, and guests watch umbrellas cross the Rialto Bridge from the canal-view windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Grand Canal, and for a second lightning turns the Rialto Bridge bright white.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the Rialto Bridge, and guests in the Honeymoon Suite watch it fall on the Grand Canal from behind the balcony doors.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, clear day, every edge of the Rialto Bridge looks sharp above a quiet Grand Canal.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in 28 of the 79 rooms keep the Grand Canal in sight without leaving the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests at the terrace bar sit with cold drinks and let the gondolas on the Grand Canal do the moving.
phrases.warm: Warm air brings guests out to the panoramic terrace, where they count the gondolas passing under the Rialto Bridge.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Rialto Bridge gold, and the Grand Canal below carries the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink above the Rialto Bridge, a scene the terrace restaurant faces directly.
phrases.grey_evening: On this cloudy evening, the terrace bar looks across at the lit Rialto Bridge.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and the lights of the Rialto Bridge break into long reflections on the Grand Canal.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lit Rialto Bridge shines white over the dark Grand Canal.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show over the Grand Canal tonight, and a late vaporetto slides under the lit Rialto Bridge.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Grand Canal is almost empty, and the Rialto Bridge has the water to itself.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on along the Grand Canal beside the Rialto Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Llandudno Bay is a wide sheet of dark, quiet water under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the dining room, guests look straight across Llandudno Bay under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Llandudno Bay is bright blue at midday, and every line of the headland is sharp.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Llandudno Bay this morning, and guests in the dining room follow them over breakfast.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over Llandudno Bay this afternoon, so the water changes colour every few minutes.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Llandudno Bay turns the colour of Welsh slate.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits on Llandudno Bay today, and from the dining room the sea and the sky look like one soft grey sheet.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Llandudno Bay is not visible today; guests see the promenade and the nearest water, and little beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Llandudno Bay, and guests in the bay window rooms watch it cross the water in grey bands.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Llandudno Bay, and lightning shows the headland for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Llandudno Bay, and the promenade below is turning white while the sea stays grey.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, bright day, guests in the rear rooms look out at the Snowdonia Mountains, clear in the cold air.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, Llandudno Bay looks steel blue, and guests in the sea-facing rooms watch it with a cup of tea in hand.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, Llandudno Bay lies flat and shining, and the walkers on the promenade below move slowly.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests in the bay window rooms pick up the binoculars and follow the people walking beside Llandudno Bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Llandudno Bay gold, and the headland glows above the water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Llandudno Bay turn pink, and the water copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the promenade curve along the edge of Llandudno Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Llandudno Bay this evening, and the promenade lights shine on the wet ground below.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, Llandudno Bay is a soft black space beyond the lights of the shore.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above Llandudno Bay tonight, and the water below them is black and still.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, nobody is watching Llandudno Bay, and the sea keeps moving all the same.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Llandudno Bay is still bright, and the first lights appear along the promenade.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Washington Monument is a thin dark shape against a sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at Sakura Club on the 10th floor has a wide view of Washington, D.C. in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Washington Monument stands sharp above the city rooftops, and the dome of the United States Capitol is easy to find.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the city this morning, and the dome of the United States Capitol goes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in rooms facing the Washington Monument watch the afternoon clouds drift past its tip.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Washington Monument and the dome of the United States Capitol stand in quiet, even light.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and the Washington Monument looks like a faint pencil line above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the United States Capitol is not in sight, and the view stops at the nearby rooftops and streets.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch the Washington Monument turn soft and grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city, and each flash of lightning shows the Washington Monument for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Washington, D.C., and from Sakura Club on the 10th floor guests watch the rooftops turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and bright, and the dome of the United States Capitol stands sharp against the winter sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Washington Monument rises over the rooftops in thin light, and guests in this 360-room hotel are glad to look at it from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests at Summit hold cold drinks and look from the Washington Monument to the United States Capitol without leaving their stools.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit under the umbrellas at Summit, and the Washington Monument rises over the rooftops in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Summit on the 11th floor, the low sun turns the Washington Monument gold while the streets below are already in shadow.

phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Sakura Club has the lights of Washington, D.C. spread out below a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights shine on the streets below, and guests in the Presidential Suite look for the United States Capitol through the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hang over the city, and guests look across the lights of the streets toward the Washington Monument.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the streets are almost empty, and the Washington Monument keeps its place above the sleeping city.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, the first city lights come on, and the Washington Monument stands clear against the glow.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Santorini Caldera lies still under a clear sky, and the water below the cliff is only a little darker than the air.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast includes champagne, and guests drink it slowly while the Santorini Caldera turns blue in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool on its 92-metre cliff seems to pour straight into the Santorini Caldera below.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Santorini Caldera this morning, and guests on their private verandas watch them move over the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Katikies Lounge, guests look at the volcano on one side and the village of Oia on the other as afternoon clouds drift across both.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Santorini Caldera takes the colour of slate, and the volcano sits low and dark on the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Santorini Caldera today, and the Aegean and the sky look like one sheet of pale paper.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The volcano is not visible from Katikies Lounge today; guests see the cliffs of Oia and the nearest water of the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Santorini Caldera, and guests watch from their suite doors as the drops mark the grey water far below.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the Santorini Caldera, and each flash of lightning shows the volcano for a second before it disappears again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Santorini Caldera, and the flakes vanish into the Aegean below the cliff.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Santorini Caldera looks sharp and very blue, and guests admire it from behind the glass doors of their suites.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Santorini Caldera is steel blue and empty, and the cliffs of Oia stand out clearly above it.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills the Santorini Caldera late in the afternoon, and the white walls of Oia turn the colour of honey.

phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Oia shine along the cliff, and the Santorini Caldera is a wide dark space beside them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Santorini Caldera this evening, and the lights of Oia look blurred and soft through it.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the Santorini Caldera shows no stars and no horizon, only a deep darkness beyond the edge of the infinity pool.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the Santorini Caldera tonight, and guests at Katikies Lounge look up more often than down.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Santorini Caldera is quiet and black, and only the sound of the sea says how far down it is.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over the Santorini Caldera, and from Katikies Lower Deck Lounge guests watch the first lights of Oia come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Mediterranean is still and grey-blue before sunrise, and the Frioul Islands are just starting to show on the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests on the sea-view balconies of this hotel, renovated in 2018, wake to a clear morning over the Mediterranean and the Frioul Islands in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in Les Bains, guests look out at a bright blue Mediterranean under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Mediterranean this morning, and the Frioul Islands go in and out of sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Sky Bar terrace on the 3rd floor, clouds drift over the sea toward the Château d'If.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky the Mediterranean turns grey-green, and the rocks of the Corniche Kennedy coastline look paler beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the sea today, and the Château d'If looks like a small sketch on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Frioul Islands and the Château d'If are not visible today; the view stops at the rocks of the Corniche Kennedy coastline and the nearest water.

phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over a dark Mediterranean and the Frioul Islands, then the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Corniche Kennedy coastline, and guests in the Penthouse watch the flakes disappear into the Mediterranean.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the Château d'If stands out sharply against the Mediterranean from the Sky Bar windows.

phrases.very_hot: By the outdoor pool, guests stay under the yellow and white umbrellas and look at the rocky coastline shimmering in the heat.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests at Sky Bar hold their cocktails and watch the low sun turn the Mediterranean gold around the Frioul Islands.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the Château d'If, while the sea around it is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Les Bains, guests look out at a cloudy evening sea where the Frioul Islands have faded into the night.

phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the lights of the Corniche Kennedy curve along the coast and the Mediterranean stays black beside them.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Mediterranean, and the low outline of the Frioul Islands can be picked out from the Sky Bar terrace.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Mediterranean is black and quiet, and only the white edge of the waves shows on the rocks below.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky over the Mediterranean is still bright, and the first lights appear along the Corniche Kennedy coastline.

phrases.clear_midday: Mont Blanc is easy to find at midday, far behind the roofs of Lyon under a clean blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Fourvière and the old city this morning, and guests follow them from the rooms facing that side.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the fitness room, guests see the city skyline in patches of sun and shade this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Lyon spreads out in every direction below Celest Bar & Restaurant, and the massifs draw a soft edge around it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over Lyon today, and Fourvière shows as a soft outline above the old city.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps and Mont Blanc do not show today, so guests look at the nearer streets and roofs of Lyon instead.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the panoramic windows of Celest Bar & Restaurant, and Lyon shines wet about 150 metres below.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses Lyon, and guests in the pencil-shaped tower watch lightning over the city roofs from a dry seat.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Lyon, and guests watch the flakes drift down onto the old city from the rooms facing Fourvière.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the Alps look sharp behind Lyon, and guests enjoy them from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the reception rooms look out over the roofs of Lyon.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the roofs of Lyon, and guests look at it from high above the hot streets.
phrases.warm: A warm day fills Lyon with light, from the old city to the massifs around it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Alps golden, and guests in Celest Bar & Restaurant stop talking for a moment to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the Monts d'Or, seen from the rooms facing those hills.

phrases.wet_evening: Wet weather blurs the lights of Lyon this evening, and the streets below glow through the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the lights of Lyon spread out under the clouds as far as guests can see.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the city lights of Lyon reach to the dark line of the massifs.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lyon is quiet far below, and guests who cannot sleep have the whole city to look at.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights of Lyon come on below Fourvière.

phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights St Stephen's Cathedral, and guests in the cathedral-view rooms see its spire fill the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_midday: From Das LOFT on the 18th floor, guests follow the Danube Canal across the city under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move over the Innere Stadt rooftops this morning, and the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral goes in and out of the sun.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Innere Stadt rooftops, and guests watch St Stephen's Cathedral slowly turn white from the cathedral-view rooms.

phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at dinner in Das LOFT look across the lit rooftops to the glowing spire of St Stephen's Cathedral.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Danube Canal stretch into long reflections, seen from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.mild_night: The Presidential Suite gives guests a 270-degree view of Vienna at night, with city lights glowing under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests with a drink at Das LOFT can pick out the lit spire of St Stephen's Cathedral above the city lights.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and St Stephen's Cathedral rests among the rooftops while most guests sleep.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Danube Canal and around St Stephen's Cathedral.

phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes under the clouds and lights Christ the King, across the Tagus River from the rooftop.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at BAHR see the lights of the castle quarter beyond the Lisbon rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the 25 de Abril Bridge blur over the Tagus River, and guests at BAHR are happy to be inside.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lamps of Luís de Camões Square shine below the windows of the Chiado Suite.
phrases.clear_night: From the rooftop of this building renewed by Eduardo Souto de Moura, the lights of the 25 de Abril Bridge cross the Tagus River under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Tagus River is a quiet dark band, and the Lisbon rooftops sleep in front of it.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and from the rooftop the first lights come on along the 25 de Abril Bridge under a still bright sky.

phrases.clear_midday: Each tower of the City skyline is easy to pick out at midday, with the Thames shining in front.
phrases.partly_morning: The Thames changes from silver to blue and back this morning as the clouds pass over.

phrases.snow: Tower Bridge wears white on its towers today, and the snow vanishes the moment it touches the Thames.

phrases.cold: Today the City skyline stands clear beyond the Thames, and guests enjoy it from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: Tower Bridge trembles a little in the heat haze over the Thames today.
phrases.warm: People in shirt sleeves cross Tower Bridge today, small figures high above the Thames.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the stone of Tower Bridge the colour of honey above the Thames.
phrases.partly_golden: The glass of The Shard catches the last sun between the clouds, while the Thames is already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests at dinner time see Tower Bridge twice this evening, once lit above the Thames and once reflected in it.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain turns the lights of Tower Bridge into long streaks on the Thames.
phrases.mild_night: The lights of the City skyline lie in long lines on the dark river tonight.
phrases.clear_night: Guests end the evening looking at Tower Bridge, lit above the black Thames.
phrases.late_night: The Thames slides quietly past in the small hours, and guests who are still awake have the river to themselves.
phrases.dusk: For a few minutes after sunset the Thames stays pale, while lights begin to show in the City skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky turns pale over Shenzhen Bay, and the towers of the city stand grey and still against it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the glass towers one by one, and guests in the lobby watch the city wake as far as Shenzhen Bay.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests on the Free Sky observation deck on the 116th floor see the whole city down to Shenzhen Bay.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the towers of Futian this morning, while Shenzhen Bay stays bright behind them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Swimmers in the indoor pool stop at the end of a lap to watch clouds pass between the Shenzhen skyscrapers.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the glass towers of Shenzhen take the same colour, and Shenzhen Bay is a flat silver band behind them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the skyline today, and from the corner suites Shenzhen Bay fades into the sky without a clear edge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The hills of Hong Kong are not visible today, and Shenzhen Bay shows only as a lighter patch beyond the nearest towers.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the lobby, and the Shenzhen skyline behind it looks like a wet ink painting.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Shenzhen Bay, and guests in the lobby count the seconds until thunder rolls between the towers.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the room windows, and the towers of Shenzhen appear and disappear behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests stay behind the tall windows of the indoor pool and look at the Shenzhen skyscrapers under a cold, bright sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day in Shenzhen, guests in this 2017 tower look from their rooms down at the city streets and across to Shenzhen Bay.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the streets far below, while guests look at Shenzhen Bay from the cool side of the lobby glass.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests swim laps in the indoor pool with the Shenzhen skyscrapers standing in every tall window.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass towers gold, and Shenzhen Bay shines behind them like polished metal.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Shenzhen Bay turn pink and purple, and guests watch them from the Free Sky observation deck.
phrases.grey_evening: At The Attic, guests end the evening with the city lights spread out below a low, cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of Shenzhen blur into long coloured streaks on the windows of The Attic.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hold the glow of the city tonight, and the KK100 tower stands lit among its neighbours.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests at The Attic look well beyond the city grid, past the lit towers to the dark water of Shenzhen Bay.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the towers are quiet, and a guest awake in one of the 171 rooms has Shenzhen Bay almost alone.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on in the streets and towers on the way to Shenzhen Bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean is a wide dark surface under a clear sky, with a thin band of light growing on the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the Sessions terrace, guests look out at the Atlantic Ocean under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic Ocean runs the full length of the horizon at midday, blue under a sky without one cloud.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Atlantic Ocean this morning, and the oceanfront balconies give a clear line out to the horizon.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Sessions terrace this afternoon, guests see the Atlantic Ocean change from blue to grey each time a cloud passes.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean takes the same colour, and only the white surf shows where the beach begins.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic Ocean fades into the sky a short way beyond the beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far horizon is not visible today; guests see the wide sandy beach and the nearer waves of the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in the oceanfront rooms watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests watch the storm from behind the glass of their oceanfront rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the wide sandy beach, and the Atlantic Ocean looks dark grey behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Atlantic Ocean looks sharp and deep blue, and guests look at it through the glass instead of from the balcony.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the wide sandy beach is almost empty, and the Atlantic Ocean rolls in with long white lines of surf.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the water of the oceanfront pool and look across the sand to the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.warm: By the oceanfront pool, guests leave the music to the hotel and watch the waves of the Atlantic Ocean instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight turns the wide sandy beach gold, and the Atlantic Ocean beyond it becomes a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Atlantic Ocean turn pink, and guests on the Sessions terrace see the water turn pink too.
phrases.grey_evening: From Wave Terrace, guests look over the waterfront stage this evening, with the Atlantic Ocean dark under the clouds behind it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the beach this evening; guests in this 200-room hotel hear the Atlantic Ocean more clearly than they see it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the white surf of the Atlantic Ocean still shows from the oceanfront terraces, under a sky without stars.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and guests look for the place where the black water meets the sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the beach is empty, and the Atlantic Ocean is only a faint moving line of white surf.
phrases.dusk: At dusk the fire pits on the terrace begin to glow, and the Atlantic Ocean horizon lies under a deep blue sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pearl River is a dark band through the city, and the sky behind Canton Tower begins to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Pearl River, and guests in the river rooms see it shine across the whole window wall.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Pearl River runs bright through the city, with the IFC far below.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pearl River this morning, and swimmers in the indoor pool at Asaya Active follow them between lengths.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At afternoon tea in The Butterfly Room, guests look up from the cakes to watch clouds drift over the city.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pearl River turns the colour of steel, and Canton Tower stands thin and clear above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and from the indoor pool the Pearl River looks like a faint silver ribbon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far bends of the Pearl River are not visible today; guests see the nearest stretch of water and the IFC below.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the window wall of the river rooms, and the Pearl River below shows grey through the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pearl River, and guests more than 400 metres up watch the storm from very close.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the city, and guests at the indoor pool watch the flakes drift down towards the Pearl River.
phrases.very_cold: In this cold, clear air, guests in rooms facing Canton Tower can follow every line of it above the Pearl River.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in The Butterfly Room keep their hands around a cup of tea and their eyes on the city.
phrases.very_hot: The heat sits over the city, and guests swim in the cool indoor pool on the 93rd floor with the Pearl River in view.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the terrace suites step outside and look over the city skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Pearl River gold, and the glass of the IFC far below catches the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds, and warm light lies on the indoor pool at Asaya Active as the Pearl River glows beyond.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights spread out far below, and the Pearl River winds through them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening lights of the city, and Canton Tower glows softly through the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud hangs low over the city on this mild night, and the lights along the Pearl River shine beneath it.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and Canton Tower stands lit above the Pearl River, a good reason to leave the curtains open.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet far below, and the Pearl River moves slowly through it.
phrases.dusk: From the bar lounge, guests watch the first lights come on along Canton Tower while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dallas skyline stands still against a clear sky that is slowly turning from black to deep blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Dallas skyline, and guests in the club lounge can pick out each tower against the clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the flat Dallas cityscape runs out toward the western suburbs with nothing to interrupt it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Dallas skyline this morning, and the towers go from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the Dallas skyline.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the Dallas skyline today, and the towers take the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Dallas skyline today, and the farthest towers are only faint outlines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The western suburbs are not visible today; from the windows, guests see the flat Dallas cityscape fade out early.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the club lounge windows, and the Dallas skyline behind it looks slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Dallas skyline, and guests in the club lounge watch the storm from a dry seat.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Dallas, and guests in the club lounge watch the skyline turn white and faint.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the Dallas skyline looks sharp from the warm club lounge, 30 floors above Market Center.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass and look at the Dallas skyline from the club lounge.
phrases.very_hot: The heat lies over the flat Dallas cityscape, and guests on the rooftop terrace look out toward the western suburbs.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace, guests sit back in the blue Adirondack chairs and let the Dallas skyline do the entertaining.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights the flat Dallas cityscape, and guests in rooms facing the western suburbs see it go down.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun turns the clouds pink above the Dallas skyline, a wide picture from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit Dallas skyline glows, and the low clouds above it take some of the colour.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Dallas skyline spread into soft patches of colour on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: From the rooftop terrace on this mild night, guests see the lit Dallas skyline under a sky with no stars.
phrases.clear_night: The lit Dallas skyline stands out against a clear night sky, and guests in this 30-floor hotel can count the towers.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Dallas skyline is quiet under the night sky, and guests still awake have it to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights come on across the Dallas skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the dome of St Peter's Basilica is a quiet grey shape below Monte Mario hill, and the sky behind it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the dome of St Peter's Basilica, and guests in the balcony rooms can follow the roofs of Rome from the Vatican to the Colosseum.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, St Peter's Basilica, the Altare della Patria and the Colosseum are all easy to find from Monte Mario hill.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the seven hills this morning, while the dome of St Peter's Basilica stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests of the Imperial Club take a balcony seat and watch sun and cloud take turns over the roofs of Rome.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Rome lies in one soft colour below the hill, and the dome of St Peter's Basilica is still the first thing guests find.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the city today, and the dome of St Peter's Basilica seems to float above it without a church below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Colosseum and the far hills are not visible today; guests in the rooms facing Rome can still make out St Peter's Basilica.
phrases.rain: Rain falls over Rome, and from the Imperial Club guests watch the roofs of the city fade behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: When lightning flashes over the seven hills, guests in the Vista Suite see St Peter's Basilica and the Altare della Patria appear for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Rome, and from 150 metres above the city guests watch it settle around the dome of St Peter's Basilica.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, St Peter's Basilica looks closer than it is, and the hills behind Rome show every line.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Penthouse Suite's panoramic terrace still has all of Rome below it, from the Vatican to the Colosseum.
phrases.very_hot: On the Tiepolo Terrace, sunglasses stay on, and guests watch the pines sway around the glittering pools, high above Rome's heat.
phrases.warm: On the shaded jogging trail, guests stop at the exercise stations, look at Rome below, and forget the press ups.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light settles on the dome of St Peter's Basilica, and the Altare della Patria catches the same light further across the city.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Rome turn orange, and guests at the Imperial Club stay on the balcony a little longer.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at La Pergola look through the large windows at the city lights of Rome and one golden dome.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of La Pergola tonight, and the lights of Rome spread into soft gold below the tables.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit dome of St Peter's Basilica glows under the low sky and marks the Vatican for anyone looking down.
phrases.clear_night: At La Pergola, where Heinz Beck has led the kitchen since 1994, the clear night shows the lights of Rome and a golden dome.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Rome is quiet below Monte Mario hill, and St Peter's Basilica waits for morning as a dark dome among the roofs.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind the dome of St Peter's Basilica as the first lights of Rome come on below the large windows of La Pergola.

phrases.clear_predawn: In the Eiffel Imperial Suite, early risers find the Eiffel Tower as a dark outline before the day begins.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Prestige Junior Suite open the curtains this morning and find the Eiffel Tower already in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The Eiffel Tower stands clear from base to tip at this hour, with nothing in front of it.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the Prestige Suite watch cloud shadows slide over the rooftops this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Eiffel Tower goes from bright to grey and back again as the clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: From the Duc de Morny Suite, guests look out on a Paris in soft greys, calm and without shadows.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist wraps the Eiffel Tower today, and its top fades softly into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor over Paris today, so the Eiffel Tower is only a faint grey shape and the city behind it is hidden.
phrases.rain: In the Grand Palais Suite, guests stay dry and watch the rain run down the glass with Paris blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Paris, and guests in the Eiffel Presidential Suite count the seconds after each flash.
phrases.snow: Guests in the Elysée Suite stay warm inside and watch the snow settle on the roofs.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Eiffel Suite keep warm behind the glass, with the Eiffel Tower standing clear in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: From the Eiffel Imperial Suite, guests look at the Eiffel Tower in the cold and are happy to stay indoors.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the Eiffel Tower stands pale in the white light of the day.
phrases.warm: The Junior Suite Terrace lives up to its name today, with guests sitting outside facing the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Gold is the colour of the Eiffel Tower for this last part of the afternoon, from base to tip.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day reaches the Eiffel Tower through a gap in the clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the Eiffel Suite have the lit Eiffel Tower in front of them this evening, bright under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight's rain smears the lights of the Eiffel Tower into long gold streaks.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud over Paris tonight turns a soft gold above the lit Eiffel Tower.
phrases.clear_night: On a night like this, guests in the Eiffel Presidential Suite could count the lights on the Eiffel Tower, if they had nothing better to do.
phrases.late_night: Those still awake in the Duc de Morny Suite have the Eiffel Tower to themselves, a tall shadow over sleeping streets.
phrases.dusk: The first lights appear on the Eiffel Tower, and guests in the Prestige Junior Suite leave their own lamps off a little longer.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale behind the Old Town, and the Frauenkirche towers slowly take form.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests who open the curtains early see the morning sun on the Frauenkirche towers and on the Old Town roofs around Marienplatz.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop Terrace, guests turn a full circle under a clear midday sky and count the church towers of the Old Town.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Old Town roofs this morning, while the Frauenkirche towers stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Tower Suite, guests follow the clouds across a wide half-circle of the historic centre this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the green domes of the Frauenkirche keep their colour above the Old Town.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Old Town today, and from the rooftop Terrace the Frauenkirche towers look like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant Alps are not visible today, but the Frauenkirche and Alter Peter remain clear above the nearby roofs.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Old Town roofs; guests in the Bavaria Suite watch it from the circular sitting room, the Frauenkirche slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Frauenkirche towers for a second at a time, and guests watch the storm over the Old Town from their suite windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Old Town roofs, and guests watch the domes of the Frauenkirche turn a little whiter each minute.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, and from the rooftop Terrace the Frauenkirche and Alter Peter stand sharp above the Old Town.
phrases.cold: Cold air sits over the historic centre today, and the Frauenkirche towers rise above the roofs towards Marienplatz.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests in the rooftop pool look across the city skyline from the Frauenkirche to the distant Alps.
phrases.warm: At the rooftop pool bar, drinks get warm while guests look at the twin towers of the Frauenkirche.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Frauenkirche towers gold, and the Old Town roofs around Marienplatz glow with them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and lights Alter Peter, then the Frauenkirche, one tower at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests see the city lights draw the Old Town skyline, with the lit Frauenkirche towers above it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain makes the lights of the Old Town shine on the wet roofs tonight, and the lit Frauenkirche glows through it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the cloud above Marienplatz takes a soft glow from the city lights below.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the rooftop Terrace gives a full circle of city lights around the lit Frauenkirche.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Old Town is quiet, and the Frauenkirche towers are two dark shapes against the sky.
phrases.dusk: At dusk, the first lights come on across the Old Town, and from the rooftop Terrace the skyline turns sharp against the still-bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear and the coastline is a dark curve from the Coolangatta rock wall towards Surfers Paradise.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light shows the whole coastline, about 40 kilometres from the Coolangatta rock wall to the Surfers Paradise skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, guests on the oceanfront balconies look north along the sand to the Surfers Paradise skyline, sharp under a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the ocean this morning, while Kirra Beach stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift along the coast towards the Surfers Paradise skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the ocean off Kirra Beach turns grey-green, and the Surfers Paradise skyline stands pale where the coast ends.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the coast today, and the Surfers Paradise skyline looks like a faint pencil drawing above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests cannot see the Surfers Paradise skyline today; the coastline fades out well before it, and Kirra Beach is the clear part of the view.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Kirra Beach, and guests watch it from the oceanfront apartments while the coastline disappears behind the showers.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the ocean, and for a moment guests see the whole coastline as far as Surfers Paradise.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Kirra Beach, and guests look twice at the white flakes landing on the sand.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear today, so the towers of the Surfers Paradise skyline stand out across the water.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay indoors and watch long waves roll onto Kirra Beach.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, swimmers fill the water at Kirra Beach, and the far Surfers Paradise skyline shimmers above the sand.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests look down at people walking along Kirra Beach, then along the coast to Surfers Paradise.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Surfers Paradise skyline gold, and guests in this 118-apartment resort watch from the north-facing balconies.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the ocean turn pink, and the long curve of sand to Surfers Paradise takes the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Surfers Paradise skyline glow at the far end of the coast.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests see the lights of the coast blur in the evening rain, while the Surfers Paradise skyline comes and goes behind it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests on the balconies of the oceanfront apartments look at the string of lights running north to Surfers Paradise.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the Surfers Paradise skyline is a small bright cluster where the coastline ends, with stars above the ocean.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the ocean is black, and guests who are still awake see the surf break white on Kirra Beach.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright, and the first lights appear along the coast towards the Surfers Paradise skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: The rolling hills are still dark shapes before sunrise, with the Java Sea a paler band behind them.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast guests at MiMPi Restaurant look out at the mountains, clear in the morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: From the pool, the rolling hills run down green to a blue Java Sea.
phrases.partly_morning: In the Two-Bedroom Pool Villa, guests wake to clouds moving over the rainforest and the Java Sea.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some of the rolling hills are in shade this afternoon, while the Java Sea beyond them stays in sun.
phrases.overcast: From the One Bedroom Villa with Jacuzzi, guests look over the lush hills to a grey sea under an even layer of cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the line where the Java Sea meets the sky, and the rolling hills look paler than usual.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the One-Bedroom Pool Villa, the nearest rolling hills are visible today, but the Java Sea and the mountains are not.
phrases.rain: Guests in the Five-Bedroom Pool Villa watch the rain fall on the rainforest, with the North Bali coastline blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Each flash of lightning shows the rolling hills and the Java Sea for a moment, then the storm hides them again.
phrases.snow: Snow is whitening the rolling hills, and guests in the One-Bedroom Pool Villa watch it from indoors.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Two-Bedroom Pool Villa stay inside and look out at the mountains and the distant skyline, both sharp in the cold air.
phrases.cold: Behind the glass of the One Bedroom Villa with Jacuzzi, guests keep warm and look out over the lush hills to the sea.
phrases.very_hot: Nobody in the pool is in a hurry to get out today, with the rolling hills and the Java Sea to look at.
phrases.warm: Guests of the One-Bedroom Pool Villa spend the day outside, with the rolling hills and the Java Sea in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Sunset Bar, guests find a seat as the low sun makes the ocean shimmer beyond the North Bali hills.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day comes between the clouds and colours the Java Sea orange.
phrases.grey_evening: The mountains are only a dark outline this evening for guests at dinner in MiMPi Restaurant.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain hides the North Bali coastline tonight, and guests in the Five-Bedroom Pool Villa see only the wet rainforest.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the rolling hills are soft dark shapes and the Java Sea is barely visible beyond them.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the Two-Bedroom Pool Villa see the mountains as black shapes under the stars, with the Java Sea dark beyond.
phrases.late_night: While the villas sleep, the rolling hills and the Java Sea lie dark beyond the still pool.
phrases.dusk: The sunset is over at Sunset Bar, yet the ocean still holds some light while the North Bali hills turn dark.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Boston Common is a wide dark space below the park-facing rooms, and the sky behind the downtown skyline begins to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the trees of Boston Common stand out sharply, with the downtown skyline rising behind them.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Ballroom on the 2nd floor, guests look straight out over Boston Common under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Boston Common this morning, while the downtown skyline goes in and out of sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Presidential Suite watch clouds drift above the city skyline through floor-to-ceiling windows, with Boston Common spread out below.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the downtown skyline takes the colour of the clouds, and Boston Common is the open space in front of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over Boston Common today, and the downtown skyline shows only as soft outlines behind the trees.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: Boston Common is clear enough below, but the farther towers of the downtown skyline cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Boston Common, and guests in the park view suites watch it through expansive windows, the skyline blurred behind.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole downtown skyline for a second, and then thunder rolls over Boston Common.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Boston Common, turning the open ground white, and the downtown skyline fades behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing, clear air, the downtown skyline looks sharp behind Boston Common, and guests are glad to study it from indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in this hotel of 193 rooms and suites look over a quiet Boston Common towards the skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, people in Boston Common look for shade under the trees, and guests watch them from the cool side of the glass.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, Boston Common fills with walkers, and from the park-facing rooms on the upper floors they look very small.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the downtown skyline gold, and the trees of Boston Common throw long shadows across the grass.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above Boston Common turn pink, and guests in the Ballroom stop talking to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the bright marquees of the Theater District line up in a straight view from the hotel entrance.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of the downtown skyline blur behind Boston Common, which lies dark in front.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the clouds hold the glow of the city, and the downtown skyline stands lit behind the trees of Boston Common.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests turn from the lit skyline behind Boston Common to the Theater District, where the marquees take over.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Boston Common is still and empty, and guests who are awake have the downtown skyline to themselves.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Theater District, and from the hotel entrance the first marquees switch on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over Ornos Bay, and the jetty and its small lighthouse slowly take shape above still water.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the terrace of Elais, guests look across Ornos Bay under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool and Ornos Bay share the same blue, and it is not easy to see where one ends.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Ornos Bay this morning, while the private beach below stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the windmill suite, renovated in 2017, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the whole of Ornos Bay.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Aegean Sea turns the colour of slate, and the small lighthouse on the jetty stands out clearly against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Ornos Bay today, and from the balconies of the sea-view suites the yachts look like sketches on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The nearby islands are not visible today; from the infinity pool, only Ornos Bay itself can be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Ornos Bay, and guests in the sea-view suites watch the drops mark the water from their windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning lights up Ornos Bay for a second, the yachts white on black water, then thunder rolls over the peninsula.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Ornos Bay, and the private beach below the closed resort has no umbrellas to catch it.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, bright day, the Aegean Sea below the cliff is a sharp, deep blue.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, Ornos Bay stays calm on three sides of the peninsula, and the small lighthouse stands alone on the jetty.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests leave their deckchairs on the private beach and look at Ornos Bay from inside it.
phrases.warm: On a warm day at Buddha-Bar Beach, guests sit at the water's edge and count the yachts anchored in Ornos Bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late golden light fills Ornos Bay, and from the edge of the infinity pool the anchored yachts shine in it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lays gold patches on Ornos Bay, seen from the terrace of Elais.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner at Buddha-Bar Beach, guests look from the water's edge at the yacht lights under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain blurs the lights of the yachts in Ornos Bay, seen from the windmill suite.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, Ornos Bay is wide, dark water below this resort from the 1970s, and the jetty reaches out into it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over Ornos Bay tonight, and from Buddha-Bar Beach guests see the yacht lights answer them on the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Ornos Bay is dark and quiet on three sides of the peninsula, and the private beach below is empty.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Ornos Bay is still bright, and the first lights come on aboard the yachts below the infinity pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the Penthouse Suite, the panorama of Paris is still dark, with a first pale line of light at its edge.
phrases.clear_morning: Early risers in the Four Seasons Suite find the top of the Eiffel Tower already in sunshine.
phrases.clear_midday: At this hour the Eiffel Tower looks drawn in fine pencil, every line of iron clear.
phrases.partly_morning: In the Four Seasons Suite, guests watch small clouds pass behind the top of the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Across the Penthouse Suite's panorama, some parts of Paris sit in shade while others are bright.
phrases.overcast: The Eiffel Tower is a clean dark outline today, with no shine on the iron.
phrases.fog_haze: Guests in the Four Seasons Suite see the top of the Eiffel Tower fade in and out of the fog.
phrases.rain: Rain turns the Eiffel Tower a darker grey, and guests stay dry while they look.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole panorama for a second, and guests in the Penthouse Suite wait for the next flash.
phrases.snow: Through the falling snow, the Eiffel Tower is a pale grey shape for guests watching from indoors.
phrases.very_cold: Coats stay on their hangers while guests look at the Eiffel Tower, sharp in the freezing air outside.
phrases.cold: A warm drink in hand, guests in the Four Seasons Suite look across at the top of the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.very_hot: White sunlight covers the Eiffel Tower, and its iron seems to tremble a little in the heat.
phrases.warm: Nobody hurries today, and guests look out at the Eiffel Tower a little longer than planned.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the iron of the Eiffel Tower from brown to gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and paints the city panorama orange in patches.
phrases.grey_evening: Lit for the evening, the Eiffel Tower puts a soft glow on the clouds above it.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests see the lit Eiffel Tower through wet glass this evening, its lights blurred by the rain.
phrases.mild_night: The city panorama glows under the clouds tonight, thousands of small lights and no stars.
phrases.clear_night: Whichever way guests look across the lights of Paris tonight, their eyes return to the lit Eiffel Tower.
phrases.late_night: Most guests are asleep now, and the Eiffel Tower stands dark above the quiet streets.
phrases.dusk: Lights come on across the city one by one, while the top of the Eiffel Tower still stands against a bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear over South Beach, and the Atlantic Ocean is a wide dark surface beyond the palms of Lummus Park.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests have breakfast on the deck above Ocean Drive, with clear morning light on Lummus Park and the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, the Atlantic Ocean is bright blue at midday, and the sand of South Beach looks almost white.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over South Beach this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the sand and the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, guests look over the palm trees at an Atlantic Ocean that is partly in sun and partly in cloud shadow.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns grey too, and the palms of Lummus Park are the only green in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens South Beach today, and from the rooftop pool the horizon of the Atlantic Ocean is difficult to find.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far Atlantic Ocean is not visible today, so guests on the deck look at Ocean Drive and the nearest palms of Lummus Park.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lummus Park, and guests in the Royal Ocean View Suite watch it through the panoramic windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Atlantic Ocean, and lightning shows the empty sand of South Beach for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees of Lummus Park, and guests at the ocean-view windows take photos as proof.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold under a clear sky, and the Atlantic Ocean is a sharp blue beyond the sand of South Beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the rooftop pool is quiet, and the Atlantic Ocean beyond it has small white waves.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the Atlantic Ocean from the water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the blue hotel umbrellas on South Beach are open, and guests under them face calm turquoise water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun turns the palms of Lummus Park gold, and the Atlantic Ocean behind them becomes a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop pool, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over the Miami skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: From the Royal Ocean View Suite, the lights of Ocean Drive shine under a cloudy evening sky, with Lummus Park dark behind them.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and the lights of Ocean Drive are reflected on the road below the deck.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the deck guests see the lights of Ocean Drive glow under the low clouds.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and guests in this hotel renovated in 2006 see them from the ocean-view rooms.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, South Beach is empty, and the Atlantic Ocean is only a sound and a darker area beyond Lummus Park.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the rooftop pool guests see the first lights come on along Ocean Drive.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the mountains show as a dark line behind the Strip.
phrases.clear_morning: At Club 66, guests take their continental breakfast above Las Vegas, with the morning sun clear on the valley.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Strip runs from north to south with nothing in the way.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Las Vegas Valley this morning, and the Strip passes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the upper floors, guests follow the Strip from one end to the other while clouds drift over the mountains this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Las Vegas today, and guests at Club 66 look out over a city in one soft colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Strip today, and its far towers fade into the pale sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The mountains around the valley are not visible today, and only the nearer part of the Strip is clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Strip, and guests watch the wet boulevard from high above, glad to be indoors.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the Las Vegas Valley, and lightning shows the mountains for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Strip, and guests in the Entertainment Suite watch the desert valley turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and the mountains around the valley look sharp behind the Strip.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Strip looks clean and still, and the desert landscape beyond it is easy to read.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the desert landscape shimmers, and the Strip seems to float above the valley floor.
phrases.warm: On the terrace of the Chairman's Villa, 65 floors above, guests sit in the warm air and look down on the Strip.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Strip gold, and the mountains behind the valley take a warm colour.
phrases.partly_golden: From the upper floors, guests watch the last sun slip between the clouds and touch the Strip from north to south.
phrases.grey_evening: At the high-floor bar, guests point the brass telescope at the lit Strip under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Strip this evening into long streaks of colour on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the lights of the Strip give the low clouds a soft glow.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests at the high-floor bar look over the bright Strip to the mountains, and nobody asks for the television.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Strip lies long and quiet below, and guests who are still awake have the valley to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Strip one by one.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Mediterranean is a still, dark surface, and the Belek coastline is only starting to take shape.
phrases.clear_morning: From upper-floor balconies, guests see the Mediterranean reach the horizon without a break, with the Taurus range clear in the distance.
phrases.clear_midday: From the beachfront terrace of this WATG-designed resort, guests see the Mediterranean turquoise near the sand and deep blue further out.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Mediterranean this morning, and the water changes from turquoise to grey-blue and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the beachfront terrace, guests follow patches of sun and shade along the Belek coastline this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Mediterranean loses its turquoise, and the horizon is a thin line between two greys.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Mediterranean seems to end a little way beyond the beach cabanas.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Taurus range is not visible today, and the Mediterranean fades out before it reaches the horizon.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the lagoon, and guests in the Lagoon Suites look across it to a grey Mediterranean.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows over the Mediterranean, and guests count the seconds to the thunder from behind their sliding balcony doors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Belek coastline, and the flakes disappear the moment they touch the Mediterranean.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and the Taurus range stands sharp in the distance today.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the view from the beachfront terrace is 200 yards of empty private sand and a quiet Mediterranean.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay under the thatched roofs of the beach cabanas and look at the Mediterranean rather than walk to it.
phrases.warm: From the beach cabanas, guests look between white curtains at calm blue sea and sandy shore.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Mediterranean gold, and from the upper floors guests see the Taurus range in warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and lays bright strips on the Mediterranean off the Belek coastline.
phrases.grey_evening: After sunset under cloud, sea and sky become one dark surface beyond the private beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and from the beachfront terrace guests see only the white edges of the nearest Mediterranean waves.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, and the thatched beach cabanas stand in a row in front of a black Mediterranean.
phrases.clear_night: Stars hang over the Mediterranean tonight, and the horizon is still easy to find from the beachfront terrace.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Belek coastline is quiet, and the Mediterranean moves slowly against the empty private beach.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the Mediterranean holds a pink light as the first resort lights come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Brighton Palace Pier is a still shape over the water, and the sky behind it slowly turns from black to blue.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in HarBAR + Kitchen, guests look through the floor-to-ceiling windows at the promenade and a bright, clear beach.
phrases.clear_midday: Brighton Palace Pier stands sharp against a blue sky, and guests in the sea view rooms can pick out its rides with the binoculars.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the beach this morning, while Brighton Palace Pier moves in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Panoramic Suite follow patches of light as they travel across the English Channel between the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the English Channel takes the same colour, and Brighton Palace Pier is the one clear form on it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the beach today, and the far end of Brighton Palace Pier fades into the white air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests see the beach and the nearer half of Brighton Palace Pier, and then the sea simply stops.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of HarBAR + Kitchen, and behind it the promenade and the beach shine wet and empty.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows over the English Channel, and for a second Brighton Palace Pier stands out white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach, and guests watch from the bay windows as the pebbles slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing, bright day, guests keep to the warm side of the glass in HarBAR + Kitchen and study the empty beach.
phrases.cold: The English Channel looks steel grey in the cold light, and the promenade below the sea view rooms is quiet.
phrases.very_hot: The beach is full of towels and swimmers in the heat, and from the sea view rooms the whole crowd fits into one pair of binoculars.
phrases.warm: Warm weather brings people onto the pebbles, and guests at the window tables in HarBAR + Kitchen watch them walk along the promenade.
