phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the beach gold, and Brighton Palace Pier throws a long shadow across the water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes under the clouds and colours them orange above Brighton Palace Pier, while the sea below is already darker.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Brighton Palace Pier are the brightest thing guests see, reflected in the black water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of Brighton Palace Pier this evening, and guests at dinner in HarBAR + Kitchen see them shake on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so the lit outline of Brighton Palace Pier does the job instead.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show over the English Channel on this clear night, and the lights of Brighton Palace Pier lie in a bright row on the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the beach is empty, and guests who are still awake see only the pale edge of the waves on the pebbles.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from this 79-room seafront hotel guests see the first lights come on along Brighton Palace Pier.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gran Vía skyline is a row of quiet rooftops under a clear, slowly paling sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Gran Vía skyline, and from the rooftop pool every roof looks freshly drawn.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Gran Vía skyline stands sharp beyond the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Madrid this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the rooftops of Gran Vía.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace suites, guests follow patches of afternoon sun as they cross the roofs of Madrid.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Madrid today, and the Gran Vía skyline keeps its outline against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Gran Vía skyline today, and the far rooftops fade into the pale sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far rooftops of Madrid are not visible today; from Rooftop Pool & Terrace, guests see only the nearest buildings of Gran Vía.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Gran Vía, and guests in the city-view rooms look down on wet, shining streets.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Gran Vía skyline, and for a second every rooftop is clear against the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Madrid, and the rooftops along Gran Vía turn white one after another.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Gran Vía skyline looks very sharp, each roof edge clear against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the gym look across at a classic Madrid street facade through the large windows.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the Gran Vía skyline from the water.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, books stay closed on this warm day while guests look at the Gran Vía skyline instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Gran Vía skyline gold, and guests at Rooftop Pool & Terrace stop talking to look at it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the rooftops of Gran Vía glow and fade in turn.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at Rooftop Pool & Terrace look over the lights of Gran Vía with a cocktail in hand.
phrases.wet_evening: From the balcony rooms, guests watch the evening rain fall on the streets of Madrid, the city lights blurred.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds above Madrid take a soft glow from the city lights below Rooftop Pool & Terrace.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear over Madrid, and from the rooftop bar the lights of Gran Vía shine below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests in this early 20th-century building look down on a quiet Gran Vía.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over the rooftop pool while the first lights come on along Gran Vía.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Edinburgh Castle is a dark shape on Castle Rock above the quiet gardens.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Brasserie Prince, guests look out at the New Town under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Edinburgh Castle stands sharp against a blue midday sky, every wall on Castle Rock easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Edinburgh Castle this morning, and patches of sun cross Princes Street Gardens below it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From west-facing rooms, guests watch cloud shadows pass over the Scott Monument and then Edinburgh Castle this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Edinburgh Castle and Castle Rock take the same stone colour, and Princes Street Gardens are the only green.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides Castle Rock today, so Edinburgh Castle seems to float above Princes Street Gardens.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: Edinburgh Castle is only a grey outline, and the far end of Princes Street cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Princes Street Gardens; guests in castle view rooms watch Edinburgh Castle turn darker on its wet rock.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city, and each flash of lightning shows Edinburgh Castle for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Edinburgh Castle and The Mound, and Princes Street Gardens are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing bright day, guests stay indoors and study Edinburgh Castle in very clear air.
phrases.cold: It is a cold day, and guests in this 1902 railway hotel are happy to look at Edinburgh Castle from the warm side of the window.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, people look for shade in Princes Street Gardens, while Edinburgh Castle sits in full sun above them.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, people sit out in Princes Street Gardens, and guests look over them to Edinburgh Castle.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the stone of Edinburgh Castle gold, and guests in the castle view suites have it straight ahead.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights the Scott Monument, leaving Edinburgh Castle in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud sits low over the city this evening, and guests at dinner in Brasserie Prince look out at the lights of the New Town.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of Princes Street shine on the road, and Edinburgh Castle is blurred behind the rain.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Scott Monument rises tall over Princes Street.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Edinburgh Castle tonight, and guests have a good reason to go to bed a little later.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Princes Street is empty and quiet, and Edinburgh Castle keeps its place on Castle Rock.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind Edinburgh Castle just after sunset, and the first lights come on along Princes Street.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Forbidden City is a low dark shape under a clear sky, seen from rooms facing it.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast, guests look through floor-to-ceiling windows at Beijing rooftops in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the gilded rooftops of the Forbidden City shine in front of the rooftop garden.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Jingshan Park this morning, and guests in the quiet room at the end of the lobby watch them pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, the five terraces show the historic city from different angles, part in sun and part in cloud shadow.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Forbidden City's roofs keep a clear shape, seen from the rooftop garden.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Forbidden City today, and guests in rooms facing it see the rooflines fade one behind another.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so only the nearest roofs of the Forbidden City show from the rooftop garden, and the far ones do not.
phrases.rain: In The Lobby Lounge, guests watch rain fall on the trees through the framed window.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Forbidden City's rooflines for a second, and guests in rooms designed by Ole Scheeren count until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the roofs of the Forbidden City, and from the terraces the historic city slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the bare trees outside The Lobby Lounge stand sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the quiet room at the end of the lobby look straight at Jingshan Park without going outside.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the tree canopy outside the bar's floor-to-ceiling windows looks cool and shady.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests stand in the rooftop garden and look at Jingshan Park's pavilions and the Forbidden City's gilded rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the terraces, the rooftops of the Forbidden City turn deep gold in the late sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, light breaks through the clouds onto Jingshan Park's pavilions, seen from the rooftop garden.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at the bar see the tree canopy as a dark mass beyond the tall windows.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, rain runs down the windows of rooms facing the Forbidden City, and the city lights blur behind it.
phrases.mild_night: City lights spread low across the historic city under a cloudy night sky, seen from the terraces.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, city lights surround the wide, quiet space of the Forbidden City, seen from the terraces.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the historic city below the terraces is still, and the Forbidden City rests in the dark.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the Forbidden City's gilded rooflines still glow under a bright sky, seen from the rooftop garden.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dolomites are a dark outline under a clear sky, and the Puster Valley below is still quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sunlight reaches the Dolomites first, while the floor of the Puster Valley stays in shadow a little longer.
phrases.clear_midday: The two heated infinity pools face the Puster Valley, and under a clear midday sky the Dolomites stand sharp above it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Puster Valley this morning, and guests follow them from the spa relaxation room.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, clouds move over the Dolomites and open now and then to show a slope in sunlight.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the Puster Valley, and the Dolomites look darker and closer under it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Dolomites today, and from the spa relaxation room the slopes look like a faded drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Dolomites are not visible today; guests in the valley-facing rooms see the Puster Valley and little beyond it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Puster Valley, and guests watch it through the full-height glass of the spa relaxation room.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls along the Puster Valley, and guests watch the storm from behind the glass of the spa relaxation room.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Puster Valley, and from the Chalet the forest and the village are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: Steam rises from the heated infinity pool into the freezing air, and the Dolomites stand sharp behind it.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests sit inside the Finnish sauna, which faces the Puster Valley, and look at it from the warmth.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the outdoor infinity pools and look across the Puster Valley from the water.
phrases.warm: By the outdoor infinity pools, books stay closed while guests look at the Puster Valley instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light falls across the Dolomites, and guests in this 11th-century castle watch it from the bathtub windows.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and colours the Dolomite slopes, seen from the mountain-view suites.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the Dolomites fade into the dark, and the Puster Valley lies quiet below.
phrases.wet_evening: The Puster Valley is dark and wet this evening, and the rain hides the Dolomites above it.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night with cloud above, the Puster Valley is dark and still beyond the castle walls.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests look out at the Dolomites, a dark shape above the Puster Valley.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Puster Valley sleeps, and the 29 rooms above it are probably doing the same.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright behind the Dolomites, and the Puster Valley is turning blue.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tagus River is a pale band beyond the dark rooftops, and the sky above it slowly lightens.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun lights São Jorge Castle, and guests in the castle view rooms see it across the rooftops while the city wakes.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Tagus River shines blue beyond the terracotta rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Gothic ruins of the Carmo Convent this morning, seen from the terrace of Maria do Carmo.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Tagus River this afternoon, and patches of sun and shade cross the rooftops in turn.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Gothic ruins of the Carmo Convent look even older from the terrace of Maria do Carmo.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the hill today, and São Jorge Castle looks like a pencil drawing above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tagus River does not show clearly today; the near rooftops and the outline of São Jorge Castle are what guests see.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Largo do Carmo, and from the terrace of Maria do Carmo the Carmo Convent ruins look dark and wet behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the rooftops, and guests on the upper floors watch lightning flash above the Tagus River.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the rooftops, and São Jorge Castle slowly turns white behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, São Jorge Castle stands sharp above the rooftops, every line of its walls easy to follow.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to the upper floors and look at the Tagus River through closed windows.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests sit under the umbrellas on the terrace of Maria do Carmo and look at the Carmo Convent ruins without moving much.
phrases.warm: On the terrace of Maria do Carmo, glasses stay full a long time while guests look across Largo do Carmo at the Carmo Convent.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the terracotta rooftops orange, and the Tagus River beyond them shines like metal.
phrases.partly_golden: From an attic bathtub, guests see São Jorge Castle through one window and the Tagus River through the other, both under pink clouds in the last sun.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, city lights spread across the rooftops, and the sky over the Tagus River takes a faint glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening on Largo do Carmo, and the lights of the square reflect on the wet ground in front of the Carmo Convent ruins.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from this 46-room hotel the Tagus River is a dark band beyond the lit windows of the city.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, São Jorge Castle is lit on its hill, and the Tagus River carries a few lights of its own.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the rooftops are quiet and the Tagus River lies still beyond them, while São Jorge Castle waits for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the rooftops toward the Sé Cathedral towers and the Tagus River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, under a clear sky, the Royal Bangkok Sports Club racecourse is a wide dark oval below the rooms that face it.
phrases.clear_morning: The Bangkok skyline lies clear on the still water of the 16th-floor pool this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, guests in The Loft on the 56th floor can follow every curve of the Royal Bangkok Sports Club racecourse below.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests on the gym's cardio machines watch cloud shadows move across the Bangkok skyline this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Bangkok this afternoon, and patches of sun cross the racecourse below the Champagne Bar.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the green of the Royal Bangkok Sports Club racecourse is the brightest colour in the view from the corner rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Bangkok skyline today, and from The Loft the far towers look like pencil sketches.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the city is not visible today, and the view from the 16th-floor pool stops at the racecourse and the nearest towers.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of The Loft, and the racecourse below turns a deeper green.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Bangkok skyline, and guests in The Loft watch the storm cross the city from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Bangkok, and guests in the gym stop their machines to watch it drift across the Bangkok skyline.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, so guests stay inside The Loft and count the towers on the Bangkok skyline.
phrases.cold: On this cold day nobody swims, and the Bangkok skyline stands sharp beyond the geometric central pillar of the 16th-floor pool.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the 16th-floor pool up to their shoulders and look at the Bangkok skyline from water level.
phrases.warm: A warm day brings guests to the Champagne Bar on the 57th floor, where Bangkok stretches beyond the racecourse.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the towers of Bangkok gold, and long shadows cross the racecourse below the corner rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: From the Champagne Bar, the last sun colours the clouds above the Bangkok skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights of Bangkok glow around the dark racecourse, seen from the New York Art Deco setting of The Loft.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lit skyline tonight, and the gym's windows show Bangkok as soft points of colour.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the lit Bangkok skyline spreads out from the Champagne Bar, with low cloud resting above the towers.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and from the 57th floor the lights of Bangkok run to the horizon beyond the racecourse.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet below the suite windows, and the racecourse is a wide empty space among the towers.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across Bangkok below the Champagne Bar.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Grand Canal lies still and empty, and the dome of Santa Maria della Salute stands grey against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Club del Doge, guests watch the first gondolas cross the Grand Canal in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: The dome of Santa Maria della Salute stands sharp under a clear midday sky, and the Grand Canal in front of it is busy with gondolas.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move over the Grand Canal this morning, and the palazzos on the other side take turns in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooms facing the Grand Canal, guests follow the water from the dome of Santa Maria della Salute to the Peggy Guggenheim Collection as clouds drift over.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky the Grand Canal turns the colour of pewter, and the gondolas are black strokes on it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Grand Canal today, and from the Gritti Terrace the dome of Santa Maria della Salute is only a soft outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today: guests see the boats on the Grand Canal clearly, but the palazzos further along the water fade out of sight.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Grand Canal with small rings, and guests in Club del Doge watch it from a dry table by the window.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Grand Canal, and guests in the Hemingway Suite watch the lightning from behind the tall French doors.
phrases.snow: Snow falls into the Grand Canal and vanishes, but it settles on the moored boats and the palazzos across the water.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing bright day, guests keep to the windows of their Grand Canal rooms and count the gondolas that still go out.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the rooftop terrace looks over the roofs of Venice to St Mark's Campanile.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the Gritti Terrace sit with a cold spritz and watch the gondolas pass slowly on the Grand Canal.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests on the Gritti Terrace watch the Grand Canal from the front row of a 15th-century palazzo.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Grand Canal gold, and from the Gritti Terrace the dome of Santa Maria della Salute glows across the water.
phrases.partly_golden: At Riva Lounge, guests watch the last sun come through the clouds and colour the Grand Canal, one cocktail longer than planned.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at dinner in Club del Doge look across the Grand Canal at the lit palazzos on the other side.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and the lights across the Grand Canal stretch into long broken reflections on the water.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night the lit dome of Santa Maria della Salute stays in view across the Grand Canal, and a late gondola passes in front of it.
phrases.clear_night: From the balconies of the Hemingway Suite, guests look down at the Grand Canal under a clear night sky, the water below black and calm.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Grand Canal goes quiet in front of the palazzo, as it has done every night since 1475.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the Gritti Terrace the first lights come on along the Grand Canal and on the dome of Santa Maria della Salute.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Aegean Sea is still and grey-blue, and the horizon is only starting to show beyond Paradise Bay.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Paradise Bay, and guests in the sea-view suites on the upper floors have the widest stretch of the Aegean Sea.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Aegean Sea is a strong blue from the sandy beach of Paradise Bay all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Paradise Bay this morning, and the water changes from turquoise to dark blue as they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the pool this afternoon, the Aegean Sea is part sunlit and part in cloud shadow.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky the Aegean Sea turns silver-grey, and the horizon is a thin line between two greys.
phrases.fog_haze: Guests look for the horizon today and find haze instead, with the sea and the sky joined over Paradise Bay.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests see the near water of Paradise Bay and the olive trees and pines around it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Paradise Bay, and guests watch it mark the Aegean Sea through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Aegean Sea, and lightning shows the whole of Paradise Bay for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Paradise Bay while the hotel is closed for the winter, and the Aegean Sea lies grey beyond the empty terrace.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air the Aegean Sea is a deep blue, and every ripple on Paradise Bay shows sharply.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the Aegean Suite stay behind the glass and look across Paradise Bay to the open sea.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool up to their shoulders and look out over the Aegean Sea.
phrases.warm: From the Royal Villa terrace, guests look over the calm water of Paradise Bay on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the terrace, the sun is low over an open horizon, and the light on the Aegean Sea grows warmer.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and lays bands of gold across Paradise Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: This evening the cloud hides the stars, and the Aegean Sea is a wide dark surface below the terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain keeps falling on Paradise Bay tonight, and from indoors guests can see the Aegean Sea only close to the shore.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the line between the Aegean Sea and the sky disappears over Paradise Bay.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the open Aegean Sea tonight, with nothing between the terrace and the horizon to compete with them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Paradise Bay is quiet, and the Aegean Sea is only a darker area under the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright over the Aegean Sea, and the fire pit on the terrace begins to glow.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky begins to pale behind the Melbourne Skyline, and the Yarra River is still dark.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on Flinders Street Station across the street, and the Yarra River shines behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Eureka Tower and Australia 108 stand sharp above the Yarra River.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Melbourne Skyline this morning, and their shadows cross Flinders Street Station one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Yarra View Suite with Balcony, guests follow patches of afternoon sun as they move along the Yarra River and the Southbank skyline.
phrases.overcast: The sky is grey over Melbourne today, so guests look lower, at Flinders Street Station and the slow Yarra River behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the tops of Eureka Tower and Australia 108, while Flinders Street Station stays clear just across the street.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The MCG and the far end of the Melbourne Skyline are not visible today; guests see Flinders Street Station and the near bank of the Yarra River.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Flinders Street Station, and guests in the corner rooms watch it run down the floor-to-ceiling windows with the Yarra River blurred behind.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Melbourne Skyline, and for a second guests see every tower above the Yarra River.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Flinders Street Station, and guests stop to look at the white flakes drifting down to the Yarra River.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests can pick out St. Paul's Cathedral and the Arts Centre Melbourne in sharp detail.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Yarra River looks like steel, and guests can read the time on the Flinders Street Station clock tower across the street.
phrases.very_hot: The heat makes the Southbank skyline shimmer above the Yarra River, and guests are glad to look at it from indoors.
phrases.warm: Warm air brings guests out to the suite balcony, where Flinders Street Station, the Yarra River and the Melbourne Skyline line up in one look.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the towers of the Melbourne Skyline gold, and the Yarra River carries the same colour below them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds over the Yarra River turn orange behind Flinders Street Station.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests look at Flinders Street Station lit across the street, with the lights of the Melbourne Skyline behind it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain this evening makes the lights of Flinders Street Station run together, and the Yarra River behind is a dark band.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests see the lights of the Southbank skyline reflected in the Yarra River.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, Flinders Street Station is lit in purple, seen from the suite balcony with the Yarra River and the Melbourne Skyline beyond.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Flinders Street Station rests across the street, and guests who are still awake have the Yarra River to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays orange and blue for a few minutes after sunset while the first lights come on at Flinders Street Station.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Li Galli islands are a dark shape on a sea that is only starting to turn blue.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on Terrace Regina, guests look across clear water to the Li Galli islands and Fornillo Tower.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, the Li Galli islands and Fornillo Tower stand sharp against a clear blue sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the sea this morning, while Fornillo Tower stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on Terrace Regina watch the clouds pass over the Li Galli islands, one island in shade at a time.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the sea of Positano turns silver and the Li Galli islands look darker than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the sea today, and the Li Galli islands look like a pencil drawing on the horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Li Galli islands are not visible today, so guests look at Fornillo Tower and the nearer water instead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the sea of Positano, and guests watch Fornillo Tower blur behind it from their balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Li Galli islands for a second, then the storm hides them again over the sea.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the sea of Positano, and Fornillo Tower is turning white as guests watch from indoors.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Li Galli islands look close enough to count their rocks from Terrace Regina.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the sea-view rooms look at the colourful houses of Positano through closed glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look at the Li Galli islands.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, books stay closed while guests look across warm blue water to Fornillo Tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on Fornillo Tower, and guests in the terrace suites watch it from their outdoor hot tubs.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the Li Galli islands, and Terrace Regina goes quiet.
phrases.grey_evening: The lights of Positano shine under a cloudy evening sky, and the sea below them is almost black.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the dark sea this evening, and the lights of Positano look soft and wet from the balconies.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hide the stars, but the lights of Positano still mark the hillside above the sea.
phrases.clear_night: The moon lies on the sea of Positano tonight, and guests on Terrace Regina can follow its path across the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the sea of Positano is quiet and dark below the balconies of the 18 rooms.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Li Galli islands, and the first lights of Positano come on along the hillside.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Darling Harbour lies still under a clear sky, and Pyrmont Bridge is a dark line across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Darling Harbour, and guests in the harbour-facing suites look down on Pyrmont Bridge from above.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the water of Darling Harbour is bright blue under a clear sky, with the city skyline standing sharp behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Living Room, guests watch cloud shadows move slowly across Darling Harbour this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the city skyline this afternoon, and the rooftop infinity pool looks out at towers in sun and shade.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Darling Harbour turns the colour of steel, and the moored yachts in the marina stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and the towers across Darling Harbour look like a faint drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far towers of the city skyline are not visible today; guests see Darling Harbour and Pyrmont Bridge just below instead.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the harbour-view rooms, and Darling Harbour blurs into grey behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the city skyline, and guests in the Living Room watch the storm cross Darling Harbour from a dry seat.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Darling Harbour, and guests stop in the Living Room to watch it settle on Pyrmont Bridge.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so every span of Pyrmont Bridge shows in detail from the harbour-facing suites.
phrases.cold: Darling Harbour looks quiet on this cold day, and guests study the marina from a building that opened in 2023.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop infinity pool and look across Darling Harbour from the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests rest in the cabanas by the rooftop infinity pool, and the city skyline does the entertaining.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass towers of the city skyline gold, and the light spreads across Darling Harbour below.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Darling Harbour turn orange, and guests in the Living Room put their phones down for once.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the city skyline give a soft glow to the sky above Darling Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights around Darling Harbour stretch into long reflections on the water.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the harbour-facing suites, among 588 rooms and suites, guests look down on the lights along Pyrmont Bridge.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the lit city skyline shows through the tall windows beside the rooftop infinity pool.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Darling Harbour is quiet, and the moored yachts in the marina barely move on the water.
phrases.dusk: At dusk, the first lights of the city skyline come on, one by one, beyond the rooftop infinity pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: In the Suncatcher Rock View rooms, early risers see the red rock formations as dark shapes against a paling sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests at Rascal start the morning with red rock views, every ridge sharp in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The sun stands high over the red rock formations, and their shadows have shrunk to almost nothing.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Grove Red Rock View rooms, guests watch one red rock formation go dark under a cloud while the next stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At Rascal, guests look up from their plates each time a cloud shadow crosses the red rock views.
phrases.overcast: The red rock formations show one deep, even red today behind the Grove Gardens.
phrases.fog_haze: Layer by layer, the red rock formations fade into the haze.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the farther red rock formations are missing from the view, and the closer ones look pale.
phrases.rain: Guests in the Suncatcher Rock View rooms watch the rain darken the red rock to the colour of wet clay.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the Grove Red Rock View rooms, guests watch the storm cross the red rock formations, one flash at a time.
phrases.snow: White on red: guests in the Suncatcher Rock View rooms watch snow collect on the ledges of the red rock formations.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Grove Red Rock View rooms keep their hands around a warm cup and their eyes on the red rock formations.
phrases.cold: In the crisp air, the red rock formations look close enough to touch above the Grove Gardens.
phrases.very_hot: The red rock formations seem to shimmer in the heat, and the shade of the Grove Gardens looks very inviting.
phrases.warm: The Grove Gardens are green and still today, with the red rock formations standing warm-coloured behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The red rock glows orange in the low sun, and guests in the Suncatcher Rock View rooms stop to look.
phrases.partly_golden: A gap in the clouds lights one red rock formation at a time, like a slow spotlight.
phrases.grey_evening: The outlines of the red rock formations are the last thing to disappear into this cloudy evening.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests at Rascal tonight see the red rock views only as dark shapes through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud hides the stars tonight, and the red rock formations stand as black shapes at the edge of the view.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the Grove Red Rock View rooms switch off the lamps to see the red rock outlined against the night.
phrases.late_night: At this hour the red rock formations are just a darker black against the night.
phrases.dusk: For a few minutes the sky stays bright and the red rock formations become dark cut-outs in front of it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the CCTV Headquarters stands as a dark shape against a sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in San Wu Tang, guests look past the open kitchen to the CCTV Headquarters in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: The China World Trade Center rises into a clear blue sky, bright in the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Guomao business district this morning, and the CCTV Headquarters goes from bright to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lounge, guests watch clouds drift behind the CCTV Headquarters through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the CCTV Headquarters and the China World Trade Center look like a pencil drawing of themselves.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Beijing skyline today, and the top of the China World Trade Center fades into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the far towers of the Beijing skyline are not visible, and the CCTV Headquarters shows only faintly.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass at San Wu Tang, where guests see the China World Trade Center slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the skyline rooms watch lightning flash behind the CCTV Headquarters, dry behind 3.8-metre windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling between the towers of the Guomao business district, and guests in the lounge watch it cross the CCTV Headquarters.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear today, so every line of the CCTV Headquarters is sharp from the skyline rooms.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests on the treadmills of Trainyard Gym stay warm and look out at the downtown Beijing skyline.
phrases.very_hot: Heat lies over the Guomao business district, while guests look at the CCTV Headquarters from the cool of San Wu Tang.
phrases.warm: Warm light fills the Guomao business district, and nobody in the skyline rooms closes the curtains on the CCTV Headquarters.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the CCTV Headquarters, the building that one visitor said looks like a pair of trousers.

phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in San Wu Tang, guests see the lit CCTV Headquarters and China World Trade Center under low evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the Guomao business district spread across the wet glass tonight, and the CCTV Headquarters glows behind it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night under cloud, the lit Beijing skyline fills the tall windows of the skyline rooms.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit China World Trade Center stands over the city lights of Guomao.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the CCTV Headquarters stands over the quiet Guomao business district, with almost no one awake to look at it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on in the CCTV Headquarters.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean lies calm under a clear sky, and the Miami Skyline waits in the distance.
phrases.clear_morning: From their private balconies, guests in the ocean suites watch an unobstructed sunrise over the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch at Ocean Grill, guests look across the beach to a blue and turquoise Atlantic Ocean under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic Ocean this morning, while the Miami Skyline stays bright in the distance.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Miami Skyline this afternoon, and the Atlantic Ocean changes from turquoise to blue beneath them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean loses its turquoise, and the Miami Skyline stands plainly against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Miami Skyline today, and its distant towers look half erased.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Miami Skyline is not visible today; guests see the beach and the first waves of the Atlantic Ocean, then only grey air.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the private infinity pool of the Penthouse Suite, and the Miami Skyline beyond it is blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and for a second the Miami Skyline shows clearly through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees and the beach, and guests stare at the white Atlantic shore as if someone had made a mistake.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, bright day, guests stay indoors and look at an empty beach and a sharp Atlantic horizon.
phrases.cold: The cold air makes the Miami Skyline sharp today, and guests can pick out single towers in the distance.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests at Ocean Grill watch swimmers cool off in the turquoise Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the Penthouse Suite's private pool on the 40th floor look down at the people on the sand and out over the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light reaches the Miami Skyline late in the afternoon, and guests in this 2005 tower see every distant tower glow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Atlantic Ocean turn pink, and guests at Ocean Grill stop talking to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Under the evening cloud, the lights of the Miami Skyline shine in the distance, and the cloud above them glows too.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and guests at dinner at Ocean Grill watch the Atlantic Ocean fade into the dark.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Atlantic Ocean is mostly a sound, with one line of white surf showing beyond the beach.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the Penthouse Suite look from the private rooftop pool to the glittering lights of the Miami Skyline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the beach is empty, and the Atlantic Ocean keeps moving quietly below.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Atlantic Ocean, and the first lights come on along the Miami Skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Yasaka Pagoda is a dark shape above the tiled rooftops, under a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: In Tau-yasaka, the private bath on the 3rd floor, the first guests of the day soak while the Yasaka Pagoda stands clear in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, each of the five roofs of the Yasaka Pagoda is easy to count above the low tiled rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the tiled rooftops of Higashiyama this morning, and the Yasaka Pagoda goes from bright to dark and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace rooms, guests look over the Kyoto townscape this afternoon, under white clouds with wide gaps of blue between them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the dark timber of the Yasaka Pagoda and the roof tiles around it take almost the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Kyoto townscape today, and the Yasaka Pagoda looks like an ink drawing above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The hills beyond the city are not visible today; the Yasaka Pagoda and the nearest tiled rooftops are still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Kyoto townscape; guests watch it from the terrace rooms as the tiled rooftops turn dark and shiny.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Higashiyama, and each flash of lightning shows the Yasaka Pagoda for a moment above the rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the five roofs of the Yasaka Pagoda, and the tiled rooftops below it are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing day, guests in Tau-yasaka sit in warm yuzu water and look at the Yasaka Pagoda in the cold, clear air.
phrases.cold: The cold air keeps the private terraces empty, but the Kyoto townscape beyond them is sharp, from the nearest roof tiles to the far streets.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, the air shimmers over the tiled rooftops, and the Yasaka Pagoda seems to stand very still above them.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests step out onto their private terraces and look over the Kyoto townscape, rooftop after rooftop.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun turns the timber of the Yasaka Pagoda a warm brown, and guests in Tau-yasaka have it framed in the bath window.
phrases.partly_golden: The clouds above the Yasaka Pagoda turn orange in the last hour of sun, and the tiled rooftops catch some of the colour.
phrases.grey_evening: On a cloudy evening, the lights of the Kyoto townscape glow under a low sky, and the Yasaka Pagoda stands dark above them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Higashiyama shine back from the tiled rooftops below the Yasaka Pagoda.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Yasaka Pagoda is a quiet outline above the lit streets of Higashiyama.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests lie back in the 3-metre tub of Tau-yasaka, and nobody has to fight for the side with the Yasaka Pagoda.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Higashiyama sleeps, and the Yasaka Pagoda keeps its place above the quiet rooftops.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright behind the Yasaka Pagoda while the first lights come on among the rooftops; guests in Tau-yasaka see both.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Manila skyline stands as dark towers against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Over breakfast in Horizon Club Lounge on the 40th floor, guests look across the Manila skyline in clear early light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Manila skyline is sharp, and the distant mountains show behind the towers.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Bonifacio Global City skyline this morning, one tower at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Horizon Club Lounge, guests watch the afternoon clouds drift above the Manila skyline.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Manila, and the glass towers of the skyline take the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Manila skyline today, and the farthest towers fade into the white air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant mountains are not visible today, and the Manila skyline ends a few streets sooner than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the 40th-floor windows of Horizon Club Lounge, and the Manila skyline behind it turns grey and soft.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Manila skyline, and guests in the Shangri-La Suite watch the storm cross the city.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Manila today, and guests look twice as the white flakes drift past the towers of the skyline.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the mountains stand out sharply behind the Manila skyline.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass and look at the Manila skyline with a warm drink.
phrases.very_hot: The heat makes the Manila skyline shimmer, and guests in the upper-floor rooms look down at the pools shining far below.
phrases.warm: On a warm day in this hotel of 576 rooms, guests look from their windows at the Bonifacio Global City skyline and the green belt below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills the glass towers of the Bonifacio Global City skyline as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Manila skyline turn orange, then pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit windows of the Manila skyline glow in rows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Manila this evening, and the city lights spread into soft colours on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: Low clouds over Manila catch the glow of the city, and the skyline shines beneath them.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the specialty suites see the lights of the Manila skyline reach to the horizon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the towers of Manila are quiet shapes, and the city seems to sleep at last.
phrases.dusk: From Horizon Club Lounge, guests watch the first lights come on across the Manila skyline while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Porta Nuova Skyline stands in grey outline beyond the empty rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the glass towers of the Porta Nuova Skyline first, then the rooftops below them.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Penthouse Suite terraces, the Alps show clearly behind the Milanese skyline under a blue midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past the Porta Nuova Skyline this morning, and their shadows move slowly over the glass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, guests watch the afternoon clouds cross the towers of the Porta Nuova Skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Porta Nuova Skyline turns the same grey, with every tower still easy to pick out.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Porta Nuova Skyline today, and the tallest towers lose their tops in it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today; from the rooftop terrace, guests see the Porta Nuova Skyline and little beyond it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Milan, and guests in the higher-floor suites watch the Porta Nuova Skyline blur behind wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Porta Nuova Skyline, and for a second every tower stands out sharply against the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Porta Nuova Skyline, and the towers fade to soft grey shapes behind it.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, the Alps stand white and sharp beyond the Milanese skyline from the Penthouse Suite terraces.
phrases.cold: On a cold day like this, the Porta Nuova Skyline looks clean and sharp from the higher-floor suites.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the rooftop terrace look for shade and watch the Porta Nuova Skyline shimmer in the hot air.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace, phones stay on the table while guests look at the Porta Nuova Skyline in the warm air.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the glass of the Porta Nuova Skyline gold, one tower after another.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop terrace, the last sun slips between the clouds and the Porta Nuova Skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: The lit towers of the Porta Nuova Skyline glow under low cloud this evening, bright against a dull sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests watch from their suite windows as the lights of the Porta Nuova Skyline run and blur through the wet evening.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, cloud hangs just above the Porta Nuova Skyline and takes a soft glow from the towers.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lit floors of the Porta Nuova Skyline are easy to count from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Porta Nuova Skyline is a quiet row of tall shapes above the sleeping streets.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright at dusk, and the first lights come on across the Porta Nuova Skyline, seen from a hotel opened in 2021.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the 25 de Abril Bridge is a quiet outline over the Tagus River under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool, the 25 de Abril Bridge stands sharp against a blue morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the Christ the King statue stands clear above the Tagus River under a cloudless sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the library watch cloud shadows move along the 25 de Abril Bridge, which fills the window this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Tagus River this afternoon, and the water changes from blue to silver and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Tagus River turns the same grey, and the 25 de Abril Bridge crosses it in one long line.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Tagus River today, and only the upper part of the 25 de Abril Bridge rises out of it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: guests on the rooftop pool terrace can see the 25 de Abril Bridge, but not the Christ the King statue.
phrases.rain: Rain crosses the Tagus River in grey curtains, and the 25 de Abril Bridge is blurred behind them.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Tagus River, and for a second the whole 25 de Abril Bridge appears in the library window.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the Tagus River, and guests in the 18th-century palace watch the 25 de Abril Bridge fade behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the Christ the King statue looks close enough to touch.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests sit in the library with a book and look up often at the 25 de Abril Bridge.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the Tagus River from the water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests rest by the rooftop pool with the 25 de Abril Bridge and the Tagus River in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light covers the rooftop pool terrace, and the 25 de Abril Bridge and the Christ the King statue glow over the Tagus River.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Tagus River turn orange and the 25 de Abril Bridge darkens against them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the 25 de Abril Bridge draw a bright line over the Tagus River.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the 25 de Abril Bridge shine through the rain and spread across the Tagus River.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Tagus River is a wide dark band under the lit 25 de Abril Bridge.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Tagus River tonight, and the hotel's 64 rooms share one bright neighbour, the 25 de Abril Bridge.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Tagus River is still, and the 25 de Abril Bridge waits over it for morning.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, guests on the rooftop pool terrace watch the first lights come on along the 25 de Abril Bridge under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Red Sea lies still and grey-blue below the balconies, with the sky clear above it.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the Red Sea shines blue beyond the arched windows of the lobby.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Red Sea is bright blue under a clear sky, and guests see it from every one of the 421 rooms.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Red Sea this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the three coves.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pool terrace, the Red Sea beyond the palm trees is half in sun and half in cloud shadow.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the Red Sea turns a soft grey, and the palm trees by the pool stand out green against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Red Sea today, and the line between water and sky is difficult to find.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far horizon is not visible today, and from the outdoor restaurant terraces only the nearest stretch of the Red Sea shows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Red Sea, and guests watch the drops mark the water from behind the arched lobby windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the Red Sea, and guests in the lobby watch lightning flash over the water through the arched windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Red Sea, and guests stand at their balcony doors to watch the flakes meet the water.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, guests keep to the lobby and look at a sharp, bright Red Sea through its arched windows.
phrases.cold: The Red Sea is a deep, cool blue on this cold day, and the three coves below are empty and quiet.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the pool by the rock waterfall and look out over the palm trees to the Red Sea.
phrases.warm: On the terrace of Beachhouse, guests sit under the metal pergola on this warm day and look over a calm, blue Red Sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The late sun turns the Red Sea gold behind the palm trees, as seen from the curved pool with its rock waterfall.
phrases.partly_golden: From the terrace of Beachhouse, the last sun colours the clouds over the Red Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: The candlelit restaurant terraces sit above a Red Sea that is dark under the evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: This wet evening, the Red Sea is only a dark space beyond the restaurant terraces, and the rain is easier to hear than to see.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the Red Sea lies black under the clouds below the balconies.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear night sky over the Red Sea, and the water below the restaurant terraces is black and calm.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the three coves are silent, and the Red Sea is a wide stretch of darkness beyond the pool terrace.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky over the Red Sea is still bright, and the first lanterns are lit on the restaurant terraces above the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Herengracht lies still under a clear sky, and the canal houses on both banks are only outlines.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the canal houses on the far bank of the Herengracht, and guests in the balcony rooms watch it from above the water.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Herengracht shows the canal houses of both banks twice, once in brick and once in the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Canal Ring this morning, and their shadows cross the Herengracht from one bank to the other.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests looking along the Herengracht this afternoon see sun on one row of canal houses and cloud shadow on the next.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Herengracht turns the same grey, and the brick canal houses keep their colour on both banks.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Herengracht today, and guests see the canal houses opposite as soft shapes above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the canal houses across the Herengracht are easy to see, while the far end of the canal is not.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Herengracht with small rings, and guests in the canal-facing rooms watch them spread below the windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Canal Ring, and each flash of lightning shows the canal houses of the Herengracht for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the roofs of the canal houses and on the bicycles parked along the Herengracht, while the water stays dark.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day guests stay behind the glass and look at the Herengracht, where the canal houses stand sharp in the cold air.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps the Herengracht quiet, and guests look down at the rows of parked bicycles waiting beside the water.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the balcony doors stand open, and guests look down at the Herengracht, bright and slow between its two rows of canal houses.
phrases.warm: On a warm day guests sit on the small balconies above the Herengracht and count the canal houses on the far bank.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the brick of the canal houses gold, and the Herengracht carries the same colour along the Canal Ring.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds over the Canal Ring turn pink above the canal houses.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening of cloud, the lit windows of the canal houses lay yellow squares on the Herengracht.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening guests see the lights of the canal houses blurred and broken on the Herengracht.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, guests look out from five joined canal houses at the lit windows on the far bank.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the Canal Ring tonight, and the lights of the canal houses repeat in the still water of the Herengracht.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Herengracht is quiet and black, and the canal houses on both banks have gone to sleep before the guests.
phrases.dusk: The sky over the Herengracht is still bright after sunset, and the first windows light up in the canal houses on both banks.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky turns pale behind the China World Trade Center, and the towers around it slowly take form.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in China Grill, guests look through the glass pyramid at a clear blue sky and the CCTV Headquarters in sharp morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the 360-degree panorama from China Grill on Level 66 shows the whole central business district, tower after tower.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the towers of the central business district this morning, and swimmers in Sky Pool follow them between laps.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the lobby stop at the glass this afternoon to see clouds drift over the city far below.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the China World Trade Center today, and its glass takes the same flat colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the central business district today, and from the fitness centre the skyline looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far parts of the city are not visible today, but guests in rooms opposite the CCTV Headquarters still see it clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass pyramid above China Grill, and the China World Trade Center turns soft and grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the central business district, and the CCTV Headquarters shows for a second each time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the large windows of the rooms, and the towers of the central business district fade to white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold today, and guests in the heated Sky Pool look out at a sharp, clear skyline.
phrases.cold: Cold light falls on the CCTV Headquarters today, and every line of the building is easy to follow from the top of this 250-metre complex.
phrases.very_hot: The heat makes the air shake above the roads of the central business district, and guests watch it from the cool side of the glass.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, runners in the fitness centre have the skyline in front of them and no reason to hurry.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the China World Trade Center gold, and guests in the suites watch the colour move up the tower.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud, and from China Grill the skyline is half gold and half grey.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit skyscrapers of the central business district glow, and China Bar has the whole city around it.
phrases.wet_evening: Wet weather blurs the evening lights of the central business district, and from China Grill the roads below are bright lines.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud hangs low over the city tonight, and the lit top of the China World Trade Center seems close from the rooms.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lit skyscrapers and busy roads of the central business district spread out below Sky Pool.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the central business district is quiet, and the CCTV Headquarters is a dark shape against the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on in the China World Trade Center as guests arrive at China Bar.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Niagara Falls is a grey shape under a clear sky, and the mist above it is the first thing to turn light.
phrases.clear_morning: From the 14th-floor observation lounge, guests look down at the Horseshoe Falls in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Niagara Falls fills the floor-to-ceiling windows, with the Horseshoe Falls and the American Falls in one frame.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Niagara River this morning, while the Horseshoe Falls stays bright below the observation lounge.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the falls view rooms watch the afternoon clouds drift over the American Falls and the Horseshoe Falls.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Horseshoe Falls looks bright white from the 14th-floor observation lounge.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Niagara Falls today, and from the windows it is not easy to say where the mist of the falls ends.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Horseshoe Falls is still in sight today, and the American Falls is only faint in the dull air.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the observation lounge, and guests on the couches watch the Horseshoe Falls through it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Horseshoe Falls for a second at a time, and guests in this 189-room hotel stay close to the windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Niagara Parks, and guests in the observation lounge watch it drift down towards the Horseshoe Falls.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing day, the mist of the Horseshoe Falls stands white against the sky, and guests enjoy it from behind warm glass.
phrases.cold: Guests in the river view rooms look out at the Niagara River and the Niagara Escarpment on this cold day.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the mist of the Horseshoe Falls looks very inviting from the falls view rooms.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, Niagara Parks and the Horseshoe Falls lie below the 14th-floor observation lounge.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun catches the mist over Niagara Falls, and guests in the observation lounge leave their phones on the couch.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds over the Niagara River, and the American Falls takes a little of that colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, Niagara Falls shows as a wide grey-white curve beyond the windows.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the Horseshoe Falls is a blur of white beyond the wet glass of the observation lounge.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the white water of Niagara Falls still shows faintly from the falls view rooms.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the white edge of the Horseshoe Falls curves through the dark below the observation lounge.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Niagara Falls is a faint white band in the dark, still falling while the hotel sleeps.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over Niagara Falls, and the first lights come on in Niagara Parks below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Makati skyline stands still under a clear sky that is just starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The Makati skyline is sharp against a clear morning sky, seen across the edge of the heated infinity pool.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, guests behind floor-to-ceiling windows see the Makati skyline in full sun under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Makati City this morning, and their shadows slide from one office tower to the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon clouds drift behind the Makati skyline, and the 20-metre infinity pool reflects the patches of blue between them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, guests in the Primea Suite see the towers of Makati City take the same colour from their bedroom windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Makati skyline today, and the far towers look only half drawn.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Makati skyline is not visible today; guests see only the nearest towers clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch the Makati skyline blur behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Makati City, and guests in the lobby lounge watch the storm through the sheer curtains.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Makati City, and guests look twice at the white towers of the skyline.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, guests keep to the lobby lounge and look out through its tall windows at the towers of Makati City.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the heated infinity pool lies empty and calm in front of the Makati skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their chins and study the Makati skyline from the water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests rest their arms on the edge of the infinity pool and look over the quieter side of Makati City.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass towers of Makati gold, and guests in this Kenzo Tange tower watch the colour climb the skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Makati skyline turn orange, and the pool deck takes the same light.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the office lights of Makati glow, and the low cloud above the skyline takes some of their colour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Makati City this evening, and guests see the lights of the skyline spread across the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Makati skyline is a wall of lit offices, and guests count the floors still at work.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the lights of Makati's towers stand in neat rows across the horizon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Makati City is quiet, and guests who cannot sleep find the skyline resting too.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, guests in this 68-story tower watch the first lights come on across the Makati skyline while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Fernsehturm is a tall dark shape against a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: In the clear morning light, guests in the Sky Suites find the Fernsehturm at eye level, above the 20th floor.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests look down on Alexanderplatz and across to the Fernsehturm, every detail sharp.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past the Fernsehturm this morning, and their shadows move slowly across Alexanderplatz below.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, the afternoon shows the Fernsehturm between passing clouds, bright one minute and grey the next.
phrases.overcast: The sky is grey from edge to edge today, and the Fernsehturm stands out against it like a pin on a board.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Fernsehturm today, so guests in the Sky Suites see only its lower part rising into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests cannot see the far Berlin skyline today, but the Fernsehturm is close enough to stay clear above Alexanderplatz.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests see the Fernsehturm slightly blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Berlin, and for a second guests see the Fernsehturm white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Alexanderplatz, and guests watch the Fernsehturm fade in and out behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and from the rooftop terrace the Fernsehturm looks close enough to touch.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass of the Sky Suites and look straight across at the Fernsehturm.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the rooftop terrace ride the swing 120 metres above Alexanderplatz and look at the Fernsehturm from the air.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests gather on the rooftop terrace of this 37-floor tower to look across at the Fernsehturm and the Berlin skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Fernsehturm gold, and its long shadow stretches over the roofs of Berlin.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds behind the Fernsehturm turn pink and orange above the rooftop terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Fernsehturm glows over Berlin, and the city lights spread out below it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Alexanderplatz reflect on the ground below, and the lit Fernsehturm glows softly above them.
