phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and guests count stars above the Fernsehturm, though the tower's own lights win easily.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Alexanderplatz lies quiet far below, and the Fernsehturm stands alone above the sleeping city.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on at the Fernsehturm and around Alexanderplatz.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Chapultepec Forest is a wide black area below, and the sky above the city skyline is just starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun reaches the city skyline first and then moves down onto the treetops of Chapultepec Forest.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Chapultepec Forest is a deep green carpet, and the towers of the city skyline rise sharply above it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the canopy of Chapultepec Forest this morning, while the towers behind it stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, guests in the rooms facing Chapultepec Forest see sun and shade take turns on the city towers.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Chapultepec Forest keeps its dark green colour, and the city skyline above it turns the same grey as the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and the treetops of Chapultepec Forest fade little by little into the white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far towers of the city skyline are not visible today, and the nearer ones are faint, but Chapultepec Forest below is still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Chapultepec Forest, and guests on the high floors watch the wet canopy darken while the city skyline blurs behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the city skyline, and for a second every tree in Chapultepec Forest shows below.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Chapultepec Forest, and guests stand at the tall windows to watch the green canopy slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear today, so the city skyline looks close and each tower stands out above the canopy of Chapultepec Forest.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay warm behind the glass and look down on Chapultepec Forest, where the canopy does not move.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the city skyline shimmers above Chapultepec Forest, and the green canopy looks like the only cool place in sight.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests follow the tree-lined streets below with their eyes, all the way to the edge of Chapultepec Forest.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late in the afternoon, golden light falls across the treetops of Chapultepec Forest, and the glass towers of the city skyline shine above them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the city skyline turn orange and pink, and Chapultepec Forest below is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: At the Living Room bar, guests sit through the cloudy evening with the lit city skyline in front of them and the black space of Chapultepec Forest below.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the Living Room bar this evening, and the lights of the city skyline spread into soft colours on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night under cloud, guests on the high floors see the city lights glow against the low sky, and Chapultepec Forest stays completely dark.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, Chapultepec Forest is the one place with no lights, and guests at the Living Room bar find that this makes the city skyline look even brighter.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Chapultepec Forest and the sky are equally black, and the city skyline sits quietly between the two.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright, the first office towers of the city skyline light up, and Chapultepec Forest is already going dark.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the lake and the Strip wait for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Strip, and the lake below the fountain-facing suites is flat and blue.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests can pick out each tower along the Strip against the blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the lake this morning, while the Eiffel Tower replica at Paris Las Vegas stays in sunshine across the Strip.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests watch clouds drift over the Strip this afternoon, and the lake changes colour each time one passes.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the Strip today, and the lake takes the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Strip today, and the Eiffel Tower replica at Paris Las Vegas looks like a sketch beyond the lake.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant mountains are not visible today, so guests see only the lake and the nearest towers of the Strip.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the lake with small rings, and guests in the Executive Hospitality Suite watch the Strip turn grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the Strip, and for a moment guests see the whole lake lit white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the lake and the Strip, a sight that makes guests look twice.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear today, and guests see the distant mountains in sharp detail beyond the Strip.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the outdoor dining terrace is quiet, but its outlook on the lake and The Cosmopolitan tower is unchanged.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above the Strip, and guests on the outdoor dining terrace look at the lake with some envy.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests look over the lake to Planet Hollywood on the far side of the Strip.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the lake gold, and the towers along the Strip glow in the same warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds over the Strip turn pink above The Cosmopolitan tower.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Le Cirque, guests watch the lit fountains rise under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening the fountains still rise from the lake, and the rain makes the lights of the Strip shimmer behind them.
phrases.mild_night: Twice an hour on this mild, cloudy night, the fountains perform directly below the suites that face them, the Strip bright behind.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in this 1998 hotel see the lit fountains, with the Eiffel Tower replica at Paris Las Vegas shining across the Strip.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the lake is calm, and even the Strip looks a little sleepy.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset as the first lights come on along the Strip, and guests wait at the lake-facing suite windows for the fountains.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea below the terrace rooms is still and dark, and the houses of Positano wait for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool, the morning is clear all the way from Amalfi to Punta Campanella.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch at GOLD Sky Bar & Restaurant, guests sit between a blue sky and a blue sea, with the colourful houses of Positano below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Lattari Mountains this morning, while the colourful houses of Positano stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the bay this afternoon, and guests on the rooftop terrace follow them towards the Li Galli islands.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the sea turns silver, and the colourful houses of Positano are the brightest thing in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the coast today, and the Li Galli islands look like pencil marks on the sea.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Amalfi and Punta Campanella are not visible today; from the rooftop terrace, guests see the houses of Positano and the sea close to the shore.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the bay, and guests at O’RO Bar Lounge watch it through the large windows as Spiaggia Grande turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is crossing the sea, and each flash of lightning shows the Li Galli islands for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Positano, and the colourful houses look paler through the flakes above a grey sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and the Lattari Mountains stand sharp behind the houses of Positano.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the large windows of O’RO Bar Lounge and look down at Fornillo beach.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look across the sea to the Li Galli islands without moving much.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the colourful houses of Positano, and guests in the terrace rooms watch the whole bay change colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds, and from GOLD Sky Bar & Restaurant the sea shines towards Punta Campanella.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Positano climb the hillside above a dark sea.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the glass ceiling of LI GALLI Restaurant this evening, and guests at its 7 tables look out at a dark, wet sea.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the lights of Positano glow under the clouds, and the sea beyond them is black and quiet.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the terrace rooms have the stars above them and the lights of Positano below, as they have since the early 1940s.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the sea below the rooftop terrace is quiet and dark, and Positano sleeps on its hillside.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the sea, and from the rooftop pool guests count the first lights in the houses of Positano.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Cascais Bay lies calm and grey-blue below the cliff, and the sand of Conceição Beach is still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast in the panoramic restaurant has Cascais Bay as its backdrop, bright under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the terrace of the bar, which juts out over the water, guests look across a blue Cascais Bay under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Cascais Bay this morning, and guests at the restaurant's window tables follow them over Conceição Beach.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the Atlantic this afternoon, and Rainha Beach changes from gold to grey and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Cascais Bay takes the same colour, and the sand of Conceição Beach looks paler than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Cascais Bay today, and from the restaurant windows the Estoril coast is only a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Estoril coast is not visible from the restaurant windows today; Conceição Beach, right below, is still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Cascais Bay, and guests watch it from the panoramic restaurant while the water turns dull silver.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Atlantic, and lightning flashes above Cascais Bay and the two beaches below the cliff.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Cascais Bay, and guests in this 1873 summer house stand at the windows to watch it land on Conceição Beach.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy on the clifftop today, and Cascais Bay looks sharp and deep blue from the sea-view rooms.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the library look through its tall windows at the Atlantic and an almost empty Conceição Beach.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests by the seaside pool look over the edge of the rock at the swimmers in Cascais Bay.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the sand of Conceição and Rainha beaches a deep gold, and Cascais Bay shines beside them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights Cascais Bay in patches, which guests on the balconies of the sea-view rooms watch.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, Cascais Bay is dark, and guests on the bar terrace look at the lights along the Estoril coast.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the restaurant windows this evening, and the lights of the Estoril coast blur beyond the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the bar terrace Cascais Bay is a wide dark space below.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Cascais Bay is quiet and dark below the cliff, with Rainha Beach only a pale strip.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over Cascais Bay, and the first lights appear behind Conceição and Rainha beaches.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sky Tower is a thin dark shape to the east, and the sky behind it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun rises behind the Sky Tower, and guests on the private terraces see Victoria Park turn bright green directly below.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Waitemata Harbour is a wide blue band to the north.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Victoria Park this morning, while the Sky Tower stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the elevated outdoor deck of The Oakroom, guests watch sun and cloud take turns over Victoria Park this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Waitemata Harbour takes the same colour, and the green of Victoria Park is the brightest thing in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the top of the Sky Tower today, so guests see a tower that seems to have no end.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Waitemata Harbour is not visible to the north today, but Victoria Park is still clear directly below.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Victoria Park, and guests watch from behind their terrace doors as the Sky Tower fades into grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Sky Tower, and for a second the whole tower shows white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Victoria Park, and guests stay indoors to watch the park turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear, and guests can follow every line of the Sky Tower from base to tip.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Waitemata Harbour looks like grey steel to the north, and guests enjoy it from the warm side of the glass.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Sky Tower gold, and the light stays on it longer than on the streets below.

phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Sky Tower puts a soft glow on the low sky to the east.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights of the Sky Tower spread into soft circles of colour.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the top of the Sky Tower goes in and out of the cloud, and its lights go with it.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Victoria Park lies quiet directly below, and nothing moves there.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Sky Tower and in the streets around Victoria Park.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Porta Nuova skyline stands grey and sharp against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.

phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Porta Nuova skyline shows every glass tower in sharp detail.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning clouds drift behind the Porta Nuova skyline and show white between the towers.

phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Porta Nuova skyline, and for a second every tower stands out against the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Piazza della Repubblica, and the trees below the suite windows are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, the Porta Nuova skyline looks close enough to touch from the 10th floor.

phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at Radio Rooftop look across at the lit windows of the Porta Nuova skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of the Porta Nuova skyline blur in the rain beyond the 10th floor.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Porta Nuova skyline is a group of tall, quiet shapes above the sleeping city.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights come on across the Porta Nuova skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Cascais Bay is still and grey-blue, and the masts in Cascais Marina slowly take shape under a clear sky.

phrases.clear_midday: Cascais Bay is bright blue at midday, and every boat in Cascais Marina is easy to count under a cloudless sky.
phrases.partly_morning: From the marina-view rooms, guests watch cloud shadows move across the yacht basin this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Atlantic this afternoon, while the Santa Marta Lighthouse stays in sunshine beyond the rooftop pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Cascais Bay takes the same grey colour, and the masts of Cascais Marina stand out clearly against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Cascais Bay today, and from the rooftop pool the Santa Marta Lighthouse is only a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The open Atlantic is not visible today; from the marina-view rooms, guests see the yacht basin and the near water of Cascais Bay.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Cascais Marina, and guests watch it from the indoor pool, where the marina views stay dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Cascais Bay, and guests in this 16th-century fortress watch the lightning over the Atlantic from behind thick walls.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Cascais Marina, and guests in the fitness center stop to watch it land on the boats.

phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the Santa Marta Lighthouse, while Cascais Bay is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the marina lights glow below, and Cascais Bay beyond them is a wide dark space.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass doors of the marina-view rooms tonight, and the lights of Cascais Marina blur into long streaks.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Cascais Bay is quiet and black, and even the yachts in the marina seem to be asleep.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Cascais Marina, one boat at a time.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Hudson River is still and grey-blue, and the Empire State Building stands sharp against the first light.

phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and guests watch the Hudson River turn grey behind it.

phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening at The Top of the Standard, guests watch the lights across the Hudson River blur into long streaks on the water.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Hudson River is a wide dark band, and the city beside it is finally quiet.

phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests at AER look over the lights of the Mumbai skyline as far as the bay.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city is quiet, and the Arabian Sea lies black and still beyond the towers of Worli.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from AER guests see the first lights come on across the Mumbai skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Río de la Plata is a wide dark surface beyond Puerto Madero, and the sky above it is just starting to pale.

phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Río de la Plata turns the same grey, and the Ecological Reserve is the one strip of green in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Puerto Madero today, and the far edge of the Río de la Plata disappears into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Río de la Plata is not visible today, and guests on the rooftop terrace see no further than the Puerto Madero waterfront.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass walls, and guests in the high-floor rooms watch the Ecological Reserve turn a deeper green.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Río de la Plata, and guests watch the storm cross Puerto Madero from behind floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Puerto Madero, and the rooftop sundeck is turning white above the waterfront.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, guests in the river-side rooms see the Ecological Reserve and the Río de la Plata in sharp detail.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the rooftop terrace is quiet, and the city skyline stands sharp beyond Puerto Madero.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the Puerto Madero waterfront from the water.
phrases.warm: Guests lie on the rooftop sundeck in the warm air, with the Puerto Madero waterfront below them and nowhere else to be.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills the rooftop pool, and the city skyline behind it turns warm before sunset.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the Ecological Reserve in strips, while Puerto Madero is already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Puerto Madero glow below the rooftop terrace, and the Río de la Plata is a dark band beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of Puerto Madero this evening, and the glass walls are covered in small bright drops.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the clouds over Puerto Madero take a soft glow from the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show over the Río de la Plata tonight, and from the high-floor rooms the Ecological Reserve is the one place with no lights.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Puerto Madero is quiet, and the Río de la Plata lies wide and silent beyond the waterfront.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests watch the first lights come on along the Puerto Madero waterfront.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear over the Caribbean Sea, and from the balconies Isla Mujeres is a low dark shape on the water.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the terrace of Viña del Mar, guests look across a clear, turquoise Caribbean Sea.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests at lunch under the palapa of Isla Contoy have the white sand and the Caribbean Sea in front of them.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Caribbean Sea this morning, and guests in the fitness center follow them through the glass wall.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the upper floors, guests see patches of sun and shade move along the beach toward Isla Mujeres this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Caribbean Sea takes the same grey, while the meandering pool below stays blue.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the horizon today, and Isla Mujeres almost blends into the sea beyond the beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Isla Mujeres cannot be seen today; the view ends a short way past the beach, with the pool and the sand still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the meandering pool and the beach, and Isla Mujeres disappears behind a grey curtain over the sea.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Caribbean Sea, and guests behind their balcony doors count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach at Punta Cancun, and guests in the fitness center stop their bikes to look at white flakes over the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and Isla Mujeres stands out sharply across the water from the terrace of the 12th-floor Penthouse Suite.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to the indoor dining room of Viña del Mar and look at the Caribbean Sea from there.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the meandering pool and look over its edge at the beach and the bright Caribbean Sea.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the sand look along the beach toward Isla Mujeres, with the pool just behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the white sand gold, and the Caribbean Sea darkens to deep blue in front of Isla Contoy.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun turns the clouds above Isla Mujeres pink, and the meandering pool repeats the colour.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner on the terrace of Viña del Mar, guests look at a cloudy evening sky and a few lights on Isla Mujeres across the dark sea.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs off the palapa at Isla Contoy this evening, and guests at dinner watch the wet beach and the dark Caribbean Sea beyond it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit pool winds toward the beach, where small waves from the Caribbean Sea catch the light.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill a clear sky over the Caribbean Sea tonight, and the lights of Isla Mujeres sit low on the horizon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the beach is a pale line beyond the pool, and the Caribbean Sea is heard more than seen.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Caribbean Sea, and the first lights come on around the pool and on Isla Mujeres.

phrases.clear_predawn: In the River View rooms, early risers find the Chicago River still dark and quiet before the day begins.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Fitness center start the day facing Navy Pier, bright in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Every tower of the Chicago Skyline has a clean edge at this hour, and Lake Michigan is one flat blue line beside it.
phrases.partly_morning: The Chicago River goes bright, then dull, then bright again as the morning clouds pass over.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the Chicago Skyline this afternoon, so one tower is in sun while the next is in shade.
phrases.overcast: Guests in the River View rooms look down on a Chicago River the same grey as the cloud above it.
phrases.fog_haze: From the Fitness center, guests can just make out Navy Pier as a pale shape in the fog.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Chicago River is clear to see today, but the far towers of the Chicago Skyline are lost in the dull air.
phrases.rain: Lake Michigan and the rain have become one grey wall, with Navy Pier just visible in front of it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls between the towers, and each flash shows the Chicago Skyline and Lake Michigan for a second.
phrases.snow: Warm in the River View rooms, guests watch the snow drift down to the Chicago River and vanish.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Fitness center warm up indoors while Navy Pier stands in bright, freezing air.
phrases.cold: Lake Michigan is a dark, cold blue today, and the Chicago Skyline stands sharp beside it.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Chicago Skyline, while Lake Michigan lies flat and blue beyond Navy Pier.
phrases.warm: Guests in the River View rooms leave the curtains wide open today, with the Chicago River moving slowly below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Gold light climbs the towers of the Chicago Skyline as the sun gets low, while Lake Michigan stays deep blue.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests finishing a workout in the Fitness center see the clouds above Navy Pier turn orange in the last sun.
phrases.grey_evening: The windows of the Chicago Skyline glow under low cloud this evening, and the Chicago River carries their reflections.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the Chicago Skyline blur in tonight's rain, and Lake Michigan beyond them is completely dark.
phrases.mild_night: Navy Pier is a line of lights tonight, and Lake Michigan behind it is one wide dark space.
phrases.clear_night: Sleepless guests can count lit windows on the Chicago Skyline tonight instead of sheep.
phrases.late_night: At this late hour the Chicago River is black and still, and Lake Michigan cannot be told from the dark above it.
phrases.dusk: The first lights appear along the Chicago River while the sky behind the Chicago Skyline is still pale.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is a wide grey surface under a clear sky, and the horizon slowly becomes a line.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests eat breakfast on the sun terrace in clear morning light, with open Atlantic in front of them.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Atlantic is deep blue, and white surf marks the foot of Pentire Headland.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Atlantic this morning, and guests at the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows follow them towards the horizon.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the beer garden, patches of sun and shade can be seen moving over the sea and the Cornish cliffs.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Atlantic takes the same colour, and only the surf below the cliffs stays white.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Atlantic today, and the horizon is hidden where sea and sky meet.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant headland is not visible today; from the sun terrace, only the nearer cliffs and the surf below them can be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the restaurant, and the Atlantic behind them is grey and blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the restaurant watch lightning over the open Atlantic through the floor-to-ceiling windows, glad to be on the dry side.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Pentire Headland, and guests in the oceanside rooms watch the flakes disappear into the grey Atlantic.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Atlantic horizon is a sharp line, and guests look at it from the restaurant's tall windows.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the sun terrace is quiet, and the Atlantic rolls in white lines towards the cliffs.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests in the beer garden sit with cold drinks and look at the turquoise sea below the cliffs.
phrases.warm: On the sun terrace, guests sit in the warm air, and conversations stop each time a big wave breaks on the cliffs.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light falls across Pentire Headland, and the cliffs turn warm above the Atlantic.
phrases.partly_golden: From the beer garden, the last sun colours the clouds over the Atlantic.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests at dinner in the restaurant look through the glass at a dark Atlantic under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and from the restaurant windows guests see only rain on the glass and white surf below.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, sea and sky are one black space, and guests in the oceanside rooms hear the waves more than see them.
phrases.clear_night: From the terrace, stars fill the clear sky, and the Atlantic is black all the way to the horizon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic is almost invisible from the sea-facing rooms, apart from faint white surf at the cliffs.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Atlantic is still bright, and the horizon holds a last band of colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Cathedral of Barcelona stands unlit and still across the square, its bell towers dark against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the balcony rooms open their doors to a clear morning and the Cathedral of Barcelona right across the square.
phrases.clear_midday: At L’Àtic, lunch is served level with the bell towers of the Cathedral of Barcelona under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move behind the spires of the Cathedral of Barcelona this morning, and the rooftops of the Gothic Quarter turn bright and dull in turn.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the two cathedral-facing balconies of the Grand Master Suite, guests watch cloud shadows cross the Cathedral of Barcelona.
phrases.overcast: Through the enormous windows of Cathedral 1951, guests see the Cathedral of Barcelona under a flat grey sky, its stone a shade darker today.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Gothic Quarter today, and the spires of the Cathedral of Barcelona seem drawn in pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far rooftops of the city are not visible from L’Àtic today, but the Cathedral of Barcelona, just across the square, is still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the enormous windows of Cathedral 1951, and behind it the square and the Cathedral of Barcelona shine wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the bell towers of the Cathedral of Barcelona, and guests count the seconds to the thunder from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Gothic Quarter, and the spires of the Cathedral of Barcelona slowly turn white at the edges.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and from L’Àtic each bell tower of the Cathedral of Barcelona stands sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Cathedral of Barcelona fills the windows of Cathedral 1951, and guests are happy to look at it from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests at L’Àtic sit under the umbrellas and look across at the bell towers of the Cathedral of Barcelona.
phrases.warm: On the street-level terrace of Cathedral 1951, guests have a drink on a warm day and watch visitors look up at the Cathedral of Barcelona.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the stone of the Cathedral of Barcelona gold, a show that the 2024 renovation by Espai 31 wisely left unchanged.
phrases.partly_golden: The terrace suites look over the city rooftops as the last sun colours the clouds above them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Cathedral of Barcelona is the backdrop for drinks at L’Àtic.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of the Cathedral of Barcelona are reflected in the square below.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lit spires of the Cathedral of Barcelona glow against the low sky above the Gothic Quarter.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Cathedral of Barcelona stands lit across the square, close enough to feel like a neighbour.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the square is empty and quiet, and the Cathedral of Barcelona keeps watch over the Gothic Quarter alone.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the first lights come on across the Cathedral of Barcelona, seen at eye level from L’Àtic.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over the Golden Mile, and the Indian Ocean slowly turns from black to grey.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast in Sky Lounge on the top floor has the Golden Mile below: palms, sand and the pier in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests in sea-view rooms can follow the coast from Umhlanga Rocks down to the Bluff.
phrases.partly_morning: From the breakfast buffet in Sky Lounge, guests watch cloud shadows move across North Beach and the breaking surf.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Indian Ocean this afternoon, and the palms along the Golden Mile promenade stand in and out of sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the Indian Ocean turns grey, and the white surf on North Beach stands out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Golden Mile today, and the pier seems to end in the middle of nowhere.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Umhlanga Rocks and the Bluff are not in sight; guests still see the promenade and North Beach.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Golden Mile, and guests in sea-view rooms watch the promenade shine wet between the palms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Indian Ocean, and guests watch lightning flash above the pier from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Golden Mile, and from the terrace the palms along the promenade are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, the Golden Mile promenade is almost empty, and the surf breaks on North Beach with nobody watching.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the ocean glass of Sky Lounge and look down at the sand of North Beach.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, North Beach fills with swimmers, and guests watch them from sea-view rooms with some envy.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the terrace look over the Golden Mile, where people walk under the palms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the sand of North Beach gold, and the palms throw long shadows across the Golden Mile promenade.
phrases.partly_golden: From the terrace in the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Indian Ocean turn pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Golden Mile promenade draw a bright curve beside a black ocean.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lamps of the Golden Mile are blurred by rain, and the Indian Ocean is lost in darkness.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests in this 11-storey building look down at the lit promenade of the Golden Mile.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, city lights follow the coast, and guests can trace the Golden Mile far along the shore.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Golden Mile is quiet, and only the white edge of the surf moves on North Beach.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Indian Ocean, and the first lamps come on along the Golden Mile.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Space Needle stands as a dark shape against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The Space Needle stands clear against a blue morning sky, in a direct line from the Space Needle view rooms.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Space Needle rises above the downtown skyline, every detail of its top easy to see.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past the Space Needle this morning, and their shadows move slowly over the downtown towers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, guests watch the sun and the clouds take turns on the Space Needle.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Space Needle keeps its clean outline above the downtown rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the downtown streets today, and guests look for the top of the Space Needle above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today; the nearest downtown towers are easy to see, while the Space Needle is only a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Space Needle looks slightly blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Space Needle for a second, and guests stay at the glass to wait for the next flash.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over downtown Seattle, and the Space Needle appears and disappears behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, and the Space Needle looks sharp from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay in the seating area by the window and look out at the Space Needle.
phrases.very_hot: The downtown towers shine in the strong heat, and guests look at the Space Needle from their cool rooms.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, the sheer curtains stay open and the Space Needle fills the middle of the window.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Space Needle gold, and the glass of the downtown skyscrapers shines around it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds behind the Space Needle turn orange and pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Space Needle rises above glowing streets and towers.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the lights of the Space Needle spread softly across the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the clouds over downtown take a soft glow from the city, and the Space Needle shines below them.
phrases.clear_night: From a high floor of this 34-floor hotel, guests see the lit Space Needle under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the downtown streets are quiet, and guests who are still awake can find the outline of the Space Needle.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests watch the first lights come on around the Space Needle.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral stands unlit against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Neue Hoheit Restaurant, guests look over the baroque old town to the copper dome of Peterskirche in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral rises against a blue sky above the medieval streets of the Innere Stadt.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Innere Stadt this morning, and from the rooftop terrace the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral moves in and out of sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the Graben this afternoon, and guests in the Graben House look down on the stately buildings along the pedestrian street.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, guests in the Garden Room look over the historic neighbourhood in soft, flat light.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Innere Stadt today, and from the rooftop terrace the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral looks like a pencil sketch.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the far rooftops of the Innere Stadt are missing, but St Stephen's Cathedral spire can still be seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the St. Peter's Suite, and guests watch the dome of Peterskirche shine wet just outside.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Innere Stadt, and guests in the Hofburg Suite watch the storm clouds gather over the Hofburg.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the baroque old town, and behind the glass of Neue Hoheit Restaurant guests watch the dome of Peterskirche turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral stands sharp above the roofs of the Innere Stadt.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay warm in the relaxation lounge of Asaya Spa and look through the skylight windows at the dome and bell tower of Peterskirche.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the rooftop terrace look for shade first, then for the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral above the roofs of the Innere Stadt.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests stay long on the rooftop terrace, with the dome of Peterskirche beside them and St Stephen's Cathedral spire a little further off.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the stone of St Stephen's Cathedral gold, and guests in the St. Stephen's Suite see it over the Old City from this 19th-century palazzo.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, light breaks through the clouds onto the city rooftops and the green copper spire seen from Neue Hoheit Bar on the 6th floor.
phrases.grey_evening: At THE1835, named after the year the house was built, guests take an aperitif while Vienna's skyline glows under low cloud beyond the glass.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the old town rooftops tonight, and at dinner in Neue Hoheit Restaurant guests see the lit dome of Peterskirche through wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit spire of St Stephen's Cathedral stands above the Innere Stadt, and the clouds behind it take a little of its light.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests at THE1835 look across Vienna's skyline, with stars above the cobbled streets.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Innere Stadt is quiet, and the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral is a tall outline above the roofs.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright behind St Stephen's Cathedral spire, and the first lights come on across the Innere Stadt.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon lies still and grey-blue, with the first light low over the Indian Ocean.
phrases.clear_morning: In their villas, guests eat breakfast while the sun climbs over the Indian Ocean in a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At Rabarbaro, lunch goes slowly because the Indian Ocean beyond the pool is bright blue under a cloudless sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon this morning and turn the turquoise water dark in patches.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From One&Only Spa, which faces the sea, guests watch white clouds drift over the Indian Ocean this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon keeps a soft green colour, and the open ocean behind it turns silver.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon and the sky seem to join in one pale colour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today and the far Indian Ocean horizon is not visible, though the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon near the beaches is still clear turquoise.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and guests in the water villas watch thousands of small rings spread on the surface.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Indian Ocean, and lightning turns the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon white for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and the flakes disappear as they touch the water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and the sky clear, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon shines a sharp turquoise against the empty white beaches.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the beaches are quiet, and the Indian Ocean rolls in with nothing else in sight.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests on the 12 beaches stay under the palms and look at the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, which seems to be the only cool thing around.
phrases.warm: Guests cycle from beach to beach on this warm day, and each one opens onto the same wide Indian Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At TAPASAKE, guests watch the low sun turn the Indian Ocean gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and colours the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon pink and orange around the water villas designed by Jean-Michel Gathy.
phrases.grey_evening: From TAPASAKE this evening, the Indian Ocean is a wide dark surface under cloud, with no stars above it.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain drums on the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and the Indian Ocean beyond it disappears in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, cloud hides the moon and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon moves softly, a little lighter than the sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the beaches, and the Indian Ocean below them shows no other light.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is quiet and dark, and only the sound of waves says where the Indian Ocean begins.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and the first lights come on along the water villas.

phrases.clear_predawn: The desert is still a dark line on the horizon, and the Burj Khalifa stands as a tall shape against the first pale light.
phrases.clear_morning: The Rooftop suspended infinity pool lies flat and blue this morning, with the desert sharp behind it all the way to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: The Burj Khalifa stands clear from base to tip in the midday light, and guests lean back to follow it all the way up.
phrases.partly_morning: Small clouds drift past the Burj Khalifa this morning, and the tower is in sun one minute and in shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of shade drift over the desert beyond the pool, and the horizon stays bright between them.
phrases.overcast: The Burj Khalifa stands grey against a grey sky today, and the desert behind it runs pale to the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: The desert fades into haze long before the horizon today, and the Burj Khalifa stands pale and soft.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon and most of the desert are not visible today; guests can still pick out the Burj Khalifa as a grey outline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the desert beyond the pool today, a sight that guests stop to photograph.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests count the seconds between lightning and thunder as the storm moves around the Burj Khalifa.
phrases.snow: Snow is coming down on the desert today, and guests stay indoors and take photos through the glass.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay inside today and look out at the Burj Khalifa, with the desert clear all the way to the horizon.
phrases.cold: The Burj Khalifa stands sharp in today's cool air, and guests enjoy it from indoors with something hot in hand.
phrases.very_hot: Guests in the Rooftop suspended infinity pool stay up to their shoulders in water while the desert shimmers in front of them.
phrases.warm: At the edge of the pool, swimmers rest their arms and look across the desert to the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Gold light spreads across the desert below the Rooftop suspended infinity pool as the sun sinks toward the horizon.
phrases.partly_golden: For the last hour of sun, guests watch the Burj Khalifa turn gold whenever the clouds let the light through.
phrases.grey_evening: The top of the Burj Khalifa disappears into low cloud this evening, and guests at dinner can see the lights on the floors below.
phrases.wet_evening: Wet glass turns the lights of the Burj Khalifa into long bright streaks for guests watching this evening's rain.
phrases.mild_night: The lit Burj Khalifa glows against a cloudy night, and the desert beyond it is simply black.
phrases.clear_night: Nobody needs a night light with the Burj Khalifa shining this clearly in the dark.
phrases.late_night: The desert lies completely dark at this hour, a wide black space where the horizon should be.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Empire State Building stands as a tall grey outline against a sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in The Langham Club on the 4th floor, guests look down on Fifth Avenue in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: The Empire State Building rises into a clear blue sky, each row of its windows easy to count from here.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move behind the Empire State Building this morning, and its spire passes from shade to sunshine and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the private dining spaces, guests watch cloud shadows slide along Fifth Avenue this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Empire State Building takes the colour of the clouds, and the Midtown skyline looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Empire State Building today, so guests in the rooms facing it see a tower with no end.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far Midtown skyline is not visible today, but the Empire State Building is close enough to stay clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Empire State Penthouse, and the Empire State Building looks soft behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Empire State Building, and guests in the Empire State Presidential Suite watch the storm from the highest floor.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the Empire State Building, and its spire comes and goes in the white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, and guests stay indoors to study the Empire State Building, sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in The Langham Club keep a hot drink in hand and watch coats hurry along Fifth Avenue.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above Fifth Avenue, and the Empire State Building shines in the strong sun.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the terrace suites sit outside and watch Fifth Avenue move below them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Empire State Building gold, a fair match for the golden crown that Gwathmey Siegel gave this hotel.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and the top of the Empire State Building glows orange above the Midtown skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening is grey, yet the Empire State Building is lit and the Midtown skyline fills with small lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Below the private dining spaces, the street lights of Fifth Avenue shine on a road that is anything but dry this evening.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the lit spire of the Empire State Building disappears into low cloud and makes it glow.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the Empire State Building is lit from base to spire, so close that curtains seem a pity.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Fifth Avenue is quiet, and the Empire State Building stands over the sleeping blocks of Midtown.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the first lights come on in the Empire State Building, and guests stop to watch.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean is a wide grey surface below a clear sky, and the pine trees are still black.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the terrace, guests look through the pine trees to a bright blue Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic Ocean is deep blue at midday, and the horizon is a sharp line beyond the saltwater outdoor pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic Ocean this morning, while the saltwater outdoor pool stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony rooms, guests follow patches of light and shade as they cross the Atlantic Ocean this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean takes the same colour, and only the pine trees stay green.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic Ocean and the sky look like one pale sheet behind the pines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far part of the Atlantic Ocean is not visible today; guests see the pine trees and the water close to shore.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic Ocean, and guests watch it from the covered terrace of Terrassa restaurant.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Atlantic Ocean for a second at a time, and guests watch the storm from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling through the pine trees, a rare sight here, and the Atlantic Ocean behind them is dull grey.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and the Atlantic Ocean shows a sharp horizon beyond the empty outdoor pool.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Atlantic Ocean is a calm blue-grey beyond the pine trees and the terracotta roofs.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the saltwater outdoor pool and look over its edge at the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.warm: By the outdoor pool, books stay closed under the white umbrellas while guests look at the Atlantic Ocean instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sunlight colours the pine trunks, and guests on the terrace of Terrassa restaurant see the Atlantic Ocean shine behind them.
phrases.partly_golden: From the terrace suites, guests watch the last sun turn the clouds orange and pink over the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.grey_evening: The Atlantic Ocean is a dark space beyond the pine trees this evening, with no stars above it.
phrases.wet_evening: From the covered terrace of Terrassa restaurant, guests look out at evening rain and a black Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky tonight, and guests hear the Atlantic Ocean beyond the pine trees more clearly than they see it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and the saltwater outdoor pool lies still below the pines.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic Ocean is hidden in the dark, and the pine trees are all that can be seen.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Atlantic Ocean just after sunset, and the saltwater outdoor pool holds its colours.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tagus River is a pale band beyond the city, and Eduardo VII Park is still dark below.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the east-facing park-view rooms watch the sun climb above Lisbon's Old Town in a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in Varanda, guests look out at Eduardo VII Park under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Lisbon's rooftops this morning, while the Tagus River stays bright from the rooftop running track.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the corner suites, Eduardo VII Park and the Tagus River share one frame, with afternoon clouds drifting over both.
phrases.overcast: From the rooftop fitness centre, the city spreads out under a flat grey sky, and the treadmill screen suddenly has competition.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Tagus River today, and from the rooftop running track the city hills fade one behind another.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tagus River is not visible today; from Varanda the view ends at Eduardo VII Park, which stays clear and green.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Eduardo VII Park; guests in the corner suites watch it through the glass, the Tagus River blurred behind.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Tagus River for a second at a time, and thunder rolls over the city's rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Eduardo VII Park, and guests in Varanda watch the park turn white while the Tagus River hides behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air makes everything sharp today: from the rooftop running track, the Tagus River shows clearly beyond the city.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay inside Varanda and look at Eduardo VII Park through the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, runners on the rooftop running track slow down, and the Tagus River gives them a good excuse to stop and look.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests circle the rooftop running track with Lisbon's rooftops and the Tagus River around them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Tagus River gold beyond the rooftops, as it has for this hotel since 1959.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests in Varanda watch the clouds above Eduardo VII Park turn pink.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Varanda, guests see the city lights glow beyond Eduardo VII Park under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: City lights shine through the evening rain, and the Tagus River is lost in the dark beyond them.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hold the glow of the city tonight, and the Tagus River shows only as a dark gap between the lights.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the corner suites, among the 282 rooms here, see the city lights run down to the Tagus River under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Eduardo VII Park is quiet and dark, and the Tagus River waits beyond the city for morning.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Tagus River, and the first lights appear across the city below the rooftop running track.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky slowly pales behind the distant desert mountains, and the Strip lies quiet below.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests press one button, the curtains open, and the Strip appears in clear morning sun behind floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Strip looks sharp and bright, and the MGM Grand is easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Strip this morning, while the desert mountains behind it stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Sky Suites, guests watch patches of sun and shade drift along the Strip this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the Strip today, and the towers of New York-New York stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Strip today, and the desert mountains are only a faint outline beyond it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The desert mountains are not visible today, so guests look at the nearer part of the Strip instead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Strip, and guests in this 2009 tower watch the road turn shiny and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the desert mountains, and for a second the whole Strip is bright under the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Strip, and guests stop what they are doing to watch the flakes pass the MGM Grand.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and guests see the Strip in sharp detail as far as the desert mountains.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay warm indoors and study the Strip from one end to the other.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above the Strip, and guests in the Sky Suites look down at it from cool rooms.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, people walk along the Strip in the sun, small as dots from up here.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights the Strip, and the desert mountains behind it turn a warm orange.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds over the Strip turn pink, then gold.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Strip gives the sky a soft glow, and New York-New York shines with it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Strip blur in the rain, and guests watch the colours run together.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight, guests in the Sky Suites look along the neon-lit Strip under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in this tower designed by Cesar Pelli look out at a clear night and the Strip full of neon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, few cars move on the Strip, and guests still awake have the long road to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Strip, one sign after another.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Aegean Sea is a wide, still surface below the villa terraces, and the sky above Delos Island slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The Aegean Sea is bright blue under a clear morning sky, and Delos Island is easy to see from the private pool decks.
phrases.clear_midday: At the Panoptis Escape Restaurant, guests look down at the midday sun on the Aegean Sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Mykonian hills this morning, while Elia Beach below stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the villa terraces, guests follow patches of sun and shade as they cross the Aegean Sea towards Delos Island.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Aegean Sea turns silver, and the Mykonian hills look darker around the estate.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Aegean Sea today, and Delos Island is only a faint outline on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Delos Island is not visible today; guests on the terraces see Elia Beach and the nearest part of the Aegean Sea.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Aegean Sea, and guests watch it cross the bay from the dry side of their bedroom glass doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Aegean Sea, and guests at the Panoptis Escape Restaurant see the whole storm from above.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Mykonian hills, and the Aegean Sea below is grey behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and clear, and guests behind their bedroom windows see Delos Island sharp against the Aegean Sea.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Aegean Sea is dark blue with white lines of foam, and the Mykonian hills are clear.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in their private pools and look across the Aegean Sea from the water.
phrases.warm: Guests lie on the pool decks in the warm air, and Elia Beach and the Aegean Sea spread out below them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Mykonian hills, and guests on the villa terraces see the Aegean Sea turn from blue to gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and colours the Aegean Sea orange, with Delos Island dark against it.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening is cloudy, and from the terraces the Aegean Sea is a darker band below a dark grey sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests at dinner in the Panoptis Escape Restaurant look out at evening rain falling on the black Aegean Sea.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests on their private verandas look out at the Aegean Sea, a wide dark space below the estate.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Aegean Sea, and guests on the 12 private pool decks have a lot of them to count.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Aegean Sea is quiet and black below the villas, and the Mykonian hills merge with the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Aegean Sea just after sunset, and the first terrace lamps come on above Elia Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Nile lies quiet around the island, and the sky slowly grows pale above the far bank.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the outdoor terrace of Casa Mia has the Nile just below the tables, bright under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool and the Nile share the same blue, and only the pool's edge shows where one ends.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Cairo skyline this morning, and their shadows move slowly across both arms of the Nile.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the riverside terrace, boats cross the Nile as sun and cloud take turns over the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the Nile turns the colour of slate, and the palm trees at the infinity pool stand out green against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Cairo skyline today, and the stone bridge beyond the infinity pool looks half drawn on the Nile.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far Cairo skyline is not clear today, so guests in the balcony rooms look at the nearer Nile and its two banks.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Nile, and guests watch it mark the water from the large glass windows of the atrium.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses Cairo, and each flash of lightning shows the Nile and the Cairo skyline for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Nile today, and guests in this 433-room tower stop at the windows to watch it meet the water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and from the 18th-floor suite the pyramids stand sharp beyond the Nile.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the garden on the bank is quiet, and the boats crossing the Nile have the river almost to themselves.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat guests stay in the infinity pool, arms on the edge, looking across the Nile to both banks.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the loungers under the palm trees watch boats pass on the Nile beyond the infinity pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the restaurant terraces, the Nile turns gold as the sun goes down in a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and colours the Nile orange and pink on both sides of the island.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the boats move along the Nile in front of the restaurant terraces.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Cairo skyline tonight, and they run in long streaks across the Nile around the island.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night with cloud overhead, the garden on the bank looks out on a dark Nile with city lights along its edges.
phrases.clear_night: The sky is clear tonight, and from the balcony rooms the lit Cairo skyline shines above both arms of the Nile.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Nile moves quietly past the southern tip of the island, with no boats on the water.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright over the Nile, and the first lights of the Cairo skyline come on beyond the infinity pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky grows pale over Llandudno Bay, and the Great Orme Headland slowly takes shape.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Thyme Restaurant & Lounge, guests look out at the sea in Llandudno Bay, bright blue under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, guests follow the full arc of North Shore beach and the pier under a cloudless midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Great Orme Headland this morning, while Llandudno Bay below stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon tea in the terrace lounge has a view of Llandudno Bay, where sun and cloud take turns on the water.
phrases.overcast: Llandudno Bay and the sky share one grey today, and the pier stands out clearly against both.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Great Orme Headland today, and from the balcony rooms it looks like a drawing in soft pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Great Orme Headland cannot be seen today; from the rooftop terrace the view stops at North Shore beach and the nearest part of Llandudno Bay.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Llandudno Bay, and guests watch it on the sea from their tables in Thyme Restaurant & Lounge.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Llandudno Bay, and guests in the balcony rooms watch the lightning above the Great Orme Headland from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Llandudno Bay, and from the terrace lounge guests watch the shore slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and from the rooftop terrace every line of the Great Orme Headland is sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay warm in the terrace lounge and watch the waves come in across Llandudno Bay.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, North Shore beach fills with people, and guests on the rooftop terrace count the swimmers in Llandudno Bay.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit out on their balconies, with Llandudno Bay and the Great Orme Headland in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light falls on the Great Orme Headland, the same view guests have had here since 1854.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Llandudno Bay turn pink and orange, and the pier glows below them.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Thyme Restaurant & Lounge, the lights of the town shine through the large windows under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows this evening, and the promenade lights shine twice, once in the air and once on the wet ground.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lights of the town follow the edge of Llandudno Bay, and the water beyond them is black.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Llandudno Bay tonight, and the Great Orme Headland is a dark shape below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Llandudno Bay is quiet, and guests awake in the 82 bedrooms hear the sea more than they see it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the rooftop terrace guests see the first lights come on along the promenade.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear, and the downtown Seoul skyline shows as plain grey shapes outside the suite windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the roof of Hwangudan Shrine, and guests in the rooms facing it see the old pavilion clearly.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, swimmers in the indoor pool look out past the white columns to the city buildings.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over downtown Seoul this morning, and their shadows cross the mid-rise skyline one block at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the fitness center, guests on the treadmills watch patches of sun and cloud pass over the city buildings.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over downtown Seoul, and the mid-rise blocks take the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens downtown Seoul today, and the far end of the skyline looks drawn in chalk.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant mountains behind the city skyline are not visible today; from a low-floor dining room, guests see only the nearer buildings.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in the city-view suites watch downtown Seoul turn shiny and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over downtown Seoul, and each flash of lightning shows the whole skyline for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Hwangudan Shrine, and guests in this hotel of 1914 watch the pavilion roof turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and from the heated indoor pool the city buildings look sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the fitness center warm up on the ellipticals while looking over the city buildings.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above downtown Seoul, and the skyline seems to move slightly in the bright light.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, the city skyline and the distant mountains behind it fill the window of a dining room on a low floor.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the buildings of downtown Seoul gold, one side bright and the other already in shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the city turn orange, and guests in the indoor pool stop swimming to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of downtown Seoul give the low clouds a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the city lights blur into soft circles behind the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lit skyline of downtown Seoul fills the floor-to-ceiling windows of the city-view rooms.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear over downtown Seoul, and the lit windows across the skyline outnumber the stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, downtown Seoul is quiet, and the skyline waits in the dark for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on one by one across downtown Seoul.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the first grey light picks out the Dolomites beyond the quiet valley.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun fills the chalet windows, and the Dolomites stand clear at the southern end of the valley.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the green floor of the Tauferer Ahrntal leads down to the Dolomites.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the green floor of the Tauferer Ahrntal this morning, while the Dolomites stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the outdoor pool at the SPA HOUSE, guests see clouds drift over the mountains this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the forested slopes on either side of the valley turn a deeper green.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze fills the valley today, and the Dolomites are only a faint outline behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Dolomites are not visible today; the view ends at the nearer forested slopes.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Tauferer Ahrntal, and guests watch it from the indoor pool at the SPA HOUSE.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls along the valley, and lightning shows the forested slopes for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the forested slopes, and guests watch it through the glass of their chalets with the fireplace behind them.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the mountains behind the outdoor pool at the SPA HOUSE stand sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass and look down the valley to the Dolomites.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool at the SPA HOUSE and look up at the mountains.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit in the whirlpools on the terraces of the 23 chalets and look down the green valley.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The near slopes turn dark first, while the Dolomites hold the last golden light at the southern end of the valley.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Dolomites turn pink and the valley floor is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Dolomites are gone from sight, and the valley slopes are black against a dark grey sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the Tauferer Ahrntal is dark, and rain runs down the glass in front of it.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the forested slopes across the valley can just be made out from the chalet terraces.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the valley, and the Dolomites are a black edge below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the valley is quiet, and the forested slopes are only dark shapes on either side.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright above the Dolomites, and the first chalet lights come on along the forested hillside.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the towers of the City skyline are dark shapes in front of the Devonshire Suite.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Executive City View rooms, guests open the curtains and find the City skyline already bright in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the City skyline is sharp enough to count its towers one by one.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the Walbrook City View rooms watch sun and cloud shadow take turns on the towers of the City skyline this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Half of the City skyline is in sun and half in shade, and the two halves keep changing places.
phrases.overcast: From the Bishopsgate Suite, guests see the City skyline in soft grey light with every tower still clear.
phrases.fog_haze: The farthest towers of the City skyline are only pale outlines in today's haze.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests in the Pan Pacific Suite see only the nearest towers today; the rest of the City skyline is lost in the dull air.
phrases.rain: Raindrops run down the glass of the Bishopsgate Two Bedroom Suite, and the City skyline behind them looks slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the City skyline, and guests in the Devonshire Suite wait for the next flash behind the towers.
phrases.snow: White flakes drift past the Executive City View rooms, and guests watch the City skyline slowly fade behind the snow.
phrases.very_cold: The City skyline looks sharp in the freezing air, and nobody in the Walbrook City View rooms needs to go outside to check.
phrases.cold: With a hot drink in hand, guests in the Bishopsgate Suite take their time over the City skyline.
phrases.very_hot: The City skyline shimmers in the heat, its glass throwing the sun back at the streets.
phrases.warm: Windows across the City skyline flash in the sun on this warm day, seen from the cool of the Bishopsgate Two Bedroom Suite.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The City skyline goes from silver to gold as the afternoon ends.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests in the Devonshire Suite watch the last sun find a gap in the clouds and light the tops of the City skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: The City skyline stands lit against low cloud this evening, its towers bright from top to bottom.
phrases.wet_evening: From the Pan Pacific Suite, guests see the evening lights of the City skyline spread and blur in the rain.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in the Walbrook City View rooms leave the curtains open tonight with the City skyline as their night light.
phrases.clear_night: Every lit window in the City skyline is easy to see on this clear night.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the City skyline is quiet, and guests in the Executive City View rooms sleep through it.
phrases.dusk: Lights start to appear across the City skyline while the sky behind the towers is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the lagoon channels lie still under a clear sky, and the mangrove is a dark edge along the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From Sands Beach Club, the Caribbean Sea is a clear blue this morning beyond the palm trees.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is clear, and the mangrove stands deep green on both banks of the lagoon channels.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Caribbean Sea this morning, and their shadows cross the water in front of the beach villas.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the lagoon channels this afternoon, and the mangrove changes from dark green to bright green and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Caribbean Sea turns a quieter blue, and the palm trees at Sands Beach Club stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the lagoon channels today, and the mangrove on the far bank looks soft and pale.
