phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Barcelona, and the Sagrada Família slowly fades behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, bright day, guests look at Passeig de Gràcia from behind their room windows.
phrases.cold: It is a cold day on the rooftop, and the Sagrada Família stands sharp above the Eixample grid.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look across at the Sagrada Família.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the sunbeds at La Pajarera Sky Lounge look out over the rooftops of Barcelona.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the towers of the Sagrada Família gold above the Eixample grid, in full sight from the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_golden: With a cocktail at La Pajarera Sky Lounge, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over Barcelona.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs low over Barcelona tonight, and the lit Sagrada Família glows under it.
phrases.wet_evening: From the terrace rooms, guests see the lights of Plaça de Catalunya reflected in the wet paving this evening.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Couture Penthouse has the lights of Barcelona on every side.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the lit towers of the Sagrada Família stand above the dark Eixample grid.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Plaça de Catalunya lies almost empty below the 119 rooms.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Passeig de Gràcia.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the CN Tower is a tall dark shape against a clear sky that slowly turns blue over Lake Ontario.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in KŌST, guests see the CN Tower and Lake Ontario together in the same south-facing frame, under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The CN Tower stands sharp against a blue midday sky, and Lake Ontario shines behind it all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Lake Ontario this morning, while the CN Tower stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terraces of the 7th-floor Kravitz suites, guests follow the clouds drifting past the CN Tower this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Lake Ontario turns the colour of steel, and the CN Tower rises in front of it like a needle.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken the top of the CN Tower today, and guests at KŌST wait to see when it will give it back.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the CN Tower is clear from the floor-to-ceiling windows, but Lake Ontario behind it cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests see the CN Tower through it, slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Lake Ontario, and for a second the CN Tower shows white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the city grid, and from KŌST on the 44th floor the CN Tower fades in and out of the white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests behind the glass see every line of the CN Tower and a deep blue Lake Ontario.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the Kravitz suites look at the CN Tower and Lake Ontario from inside, with the terrace door closed.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the rooftop infinity pool and look over its edge to the CN Tower and Lake Ontario.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop infinity pool, phones come out, because the CN Tower rises directly behind the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the CN Tower gold, and the Rogers Centre dome below it catches the same light, with Lake Ontario behind.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Lake Ontario turn orange and pink, and the CN Tower stands in front of them.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in KŌST, guests look at the lit CN Tower under low cloud, with the city lights spreading east.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the CN Tower spread into soft colours on the glass, and Lake Ontario is lost in the night.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hang low tonight and take the glow of the city, while the CN Tower shines among them.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests see the CN Tower lit against a black sky, and Lake Ontario is the wide dark space behind it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city grid is quiet, and guests who are still awake find the CN Tower standing over empty streets.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the first lights come on along the CN Tower and across the city grid to the east.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Ayung River is a dark, rushing band under the first pale light.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Riverfront One Bedroom Villa, guests wake to the river running bright in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: With the sun high, the Ayung River rushes past in full light.
phrases.partly_morning: The Ayung River goes from bright to dull and back again as clouds pass this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Two Bedroom Villa spend the afternoon facing out as sun and shade take turns.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Ayung River runs the same grey through the gorge.
phrases.fog_haze: From the Riverfront One Bedroom Villa, guests see the river turn pale under today's haze.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the nearest stretch of the Ayung River is clear today, and the rest of the gorge is lost in grey air.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Ayung River, and the rushing water turns dull under it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Riverfront One Bedroom Villa watch the river from indoors while thunder passes over.
phrases.snow: Indoors and warm, guests watch snow fall onto the rushing Ayung River.
phrases.very_cold: The pool lies empty and still above the river, bright in the cold sunshine.
phrases.cold: Guests in the Two Bedroom Villa stay inside in the warm today and enjoy the view through the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the pool, guests stay up to their necks and watch the Ayung River rush by below.
phrases.warm: Guests lie beside the pool with a book, looking up now and then to check the river is still rushing.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Ayung River gold for a short while.
phrases.partly_golden: The river catches a strip of orange light between cloud shadows as the day ends.
phrases.grey_evening: Evening guests in the Riverfront One Bedroom Villa can just make out the river as a grey band below.
phrases.wet_evening: The river is lost in the dark and the evening rain, rushing on unseen.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in the Two Bedroom Villa face out into a soft, cloudy night before bed.
phrases.clear_night: The river runs dark and quick under a clear night, with nothing else moving.
phrases.dusk: Day is ending in the gorge, and the river is now a pale line between dark banks.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear over Bodrum Bay, and Bodrum Castle is a dark shape above the still harbour.
phrases.clear_morning: From the free-form pool, the clear morning shows Bodrum Bay, Bodrum Castle and Kos in one wide frame.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the bay is turquoise under a clear sky, and the sailboats in the harbour are easy to count.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests on the south-facing balconies see cloud shadows move across Bodrum Castle and the bay this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Aegean Sea this afternoon, while Kos stays clear on the horizon beyond the free-form pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the whitewashed houses of Bodrum look brighter than the sea, with Bodrum Castle grey above the harbour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Bodrum Bay today; Bodrum Castle is a pale outline, and Kos has left the horizon for now.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Kos cannot be seen today, and guests by the free-form pool look out over the nearer white houses of Bodrum instead.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Aegean Sea, and guests in the sea-view rooms watch it cross Bodrum Bay.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Bodrum Bay, and for a second Bodrum Castle and every mast in the harbour show clearly.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the harbour, and from the hillside Bodrum Castle shows grey through the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear, and Kos stands sharp on the horizon beyond Bodrum Bay.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the free-form pool is quiet, and its wide sweep of the bay, Bodrum Castle and Kos has no one in the way.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the free-form pool and look at Bodrum Castle from the water.
phrases.warm: At Pool Bar, guests sit with cold drinks and look across the Aegean Sea on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the stone of Bodrum Castle gold, and the harbour water below it shines.
phrases.partly_golden: At Tuti Bar & Lounge, guests watch the last sun find gaps in the clouds and light Bodrum Castle.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner on the terrace of Tuti Restaurant, guests look over the lights of Bodrum and a dark Aegean Sea under cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of Bodrum this evening, and guests at Tuti Bar & Lounge watch them tremble on the harbour water.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests on their balconies see the town lights follow the edge of Bodrum Bay.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Aegean Sea tonight, and guests at Tuti Bar & Lounge look across to Bodrum Castle.
phrases.late_night: Bodrum Bay is quiet in the small hours, and the boats in the harbour hardly move.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays pink and blue over the bay while the first town lights come on around the harbour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlas Mountains appear slowly as a dark ridge on the southern horizon, above the still olive groves.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Atlas Mountains first, and guests in the suites see the ridge sharp between the wooden beams of their terraces.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Atlas Mountains run along the whole southern horizon above the palm groves.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit on the highest peaks of the Atlas Mountains this morning, while the olive and palm groves below stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the Atlas Mountains this afternoon, and the ridge changes colour above the gardens.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, guests at Salon Berbère look out over the gardens, where the palms keep their strong green.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the foot of the Atlas Mountains today, so the ridge seems to float above the olive groves.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Atlas Mountains are not visible today; the view stops at the palm and olive groves of the estate.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the gardens, and guests watch it from the indoor pool while the wet palms shine outside.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Atlas Mountains for a second at a time, and guests watch the storm from their suites, behind the wooden beams of the terraces.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the palm and olive groves, and the Atlas Mountains disappear behind the white sky.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and the snow on the Atlas Mountains looks close from across the 20 hectares of groves.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the gardens seen from Shirvan are quiet, with the palms moving a little against the sky.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the main pool and look at the Atlas Mountains, which shimmer far away over the groves.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests float in the main pool with the Atlas Mountains in front of them, and nobody is in a hurry.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the rooftop plunge pool, the low sun turns the Atlas Mountains gold above the palm-dotted city.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lights the Atlas Mountains in patches, a slow show for the suite terraces.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Atlas Mountains fade from sight, and the garden lamps under the palms become the view.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain marks the surface of the main pool, and the Atlas Mountains stay hidden in the dark behind it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the palm groves are quiet outlines, and the Atlas Mountains keep out of sight until morning.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Atlas Mountains are a dark shape below the stars, as wide as the horizon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the estate sleeps, and only the palms stand against the sky where the Atlas Mountains will return.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright behind the Atlas Mountains, and the first lights come on among the 56 pool villas.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Paris rooftops are still dark shapes, with the Eiffel Tower a taller one behind them.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests start the day with the Eiffel Tower standing clear above the Paris rooftops.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop, the Eiffel Tower shows its full height against a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: The Eiffel Tower goes from bright to dull and back again as the clouds pass this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun travel across the Paris rooftops this afternoon, and the Eiffel Tower stands above them all.
phrases.overcast: The Paris rooftops and the cloud above them are almost the same colour today, and the Eiffel Tower stands dark between them.
phrases.fog_haze: The Eiffel Tower is a pale grey shape in the haze today, with the Paris rooftops clearer in front of it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Eiffel Tower is only a faint outline today, and the city behind it cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: The Paris rooftops shine wet in the rain, and the Eiffel Tower behind them has lost its sharp edges.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay well inside and watch the storm move across the city, the Eiffel Tower showing in each flash.
phrases.snow: Guests watch from indoors as the Paris rooftops turn white and the Eiffel Tower fades behind the falling snow.
phrases.very_cold: The Eiffel Tower stands sharp in the freezing air, and guests admire it from inside.
phrases.cold: The Eiffel Tower rises over the Paris rooftops today, a view that guests enjoy from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: On the rooftop, guests look for shade first and the Eiffel Tower second.
phrases.warm: Guests on the rooftop sit outside in the warm air with the Eiffel Tower in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Eiffel Tower turns gold in the late afternoon sun, high above the Paris rooftops.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests see the Eiffel Tower catch the last sun of the day between the clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: This evening guests look across the city's lights to the Eiffel Tower, under a low cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain is falling over the city, and guests indoors see the Eiffel Tower through it.
phrases.mild_night: Guests take a last look at the Eiffel Tower before going to bed tonight.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Eiffel Tower stands in full view over the city's lights, with no cloud near it.
phrases.late_night: While most of the city sleeps, the Eiffel Tower keeps its place above the Paris rooftops.
phrases.dusk: The city begins to switch on its lights, and the Eiffel Tower stands against a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Windermere lies grey and still below the gardens, and the Coniston mountains slowly take shape behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Coniston mountains first, then Lake Windermere turns blue below the terraced gardens.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in 1909 Restaurant, guests look out over Lake Windermere to the Coniston mountains under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the fells this morning, while Lake Windermere stays bright in the gaps of sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the bay window seat in the lounge, guests follow the clouds over the garden terrace and the distant fells.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Lake Windermere turns the colour of slate, and the fells behind it are a darker grey.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist lies on Lake Windermere today, and from the terrace only the tops of the fells show above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Coniston mountains are not visible today; from the lake-facing rooms, the view ends at Lake Windermere and its near shore.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the garden terraces, and guests in the lounge watch it from the bay window, the distant fells blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the fells, and each flash of lightning shows Lake Windermere for a second from the windows of 1909 Restaurant.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the garden terraces, and Lake Windermere is a grey band behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and guests in the Thirlmere room see each ridge of the Coniston mountains across Lake Windermere.
phrases.cold: The terrace is empty on this cold day, but Lake Windermere and the fells are spread below it all the same.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests sit on the terrace and look down at Lake Windermere, which looks cooler than anywhere else.
phrases.warm: Afternoon tea is on the terrace today, and the scones compete with Lake Windermere and the fells for attention.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The late sun lights the Coniston mountains, and Lake Windermere turns gold below the terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the fells turn pink, and guests in the Grasmere room have two large windows to watch them.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in 1909 Restaurant, guests watch Lake Windermere fade under the evening cloud until only the outline of the fells remains.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows this evening, and guests can just make out Lake Windermere beyond the dark gardens.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the fells are a dark shape above Lake Windermere, and the gardens between are quiet.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Coniston mountains tonight, and Lake Windermere shows faintly below them.
phrases.late_night: Lake Windermere and the fells wait in the dark below this 1907 house, ready for the first guest who wakes.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright above the Coniston mountains, and Lake Windermere holds the last light.

phrases.clear_predawn: The outline of Mount Agung already shows in the view, well before the sun is up.
phrases.clear_morning: Early guests find Mount Agung clear from top to bottom this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Mount Agung stands in full view at midday, with not one cloud near it.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning clouds drift past Mount Agung, hiding the top for a few minutes and then showing it again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Each time guests look up this afternoon, a different part of Mount Agung is in cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey ceiling of cloud, Mount Agung is a darker grey shape in the view.
phrases.fog_haze: Today's haze leaves Mount Agung as a pale shape in the distance.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Mount Agung cannot be seen today because visibility is low.
phrases.rain: Rain hides most of Mount Agung for now, and guests watch from indoors for it to come back.
phrases.thunderstorm: Mount Agung appears with each flash of lightning and is gone again before the thunder.
phrases.snow: Guests stay inside and rub their eyes as snow falls across the view towards Mount Agung.
phrases.very_cold: In this freezing air Mount Agung looks sharp and near, and guests enjoy it from inside.
phrases.cold: On a day this cold, guests look at Mount Agung from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests outside choose the shade and look across at Mount Agung from there.
phrases.warm: Out in the open air, guests take their time looking at Mount Agung.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: As the afternoon ends, Mount Agung turns gold in the low sun.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests stop talking for a moment as the clouds around the top of Mount Agung turn pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Somewhere in the cloudy dark, Mount Agung is still there, and guests keep looking for it.
phrases.wet_evening: With Mount Agung lost in tonight's rain, guests listen to the weather instead.
phrases.mild_night: Only a faint, darker shape under the night cloud shows where Mount Agung stands.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the view tonight, except for the dark triangle that is Mount Agung.
phrases.late_night: While guests sleep, Mount Agung stands unseen in the dark.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, Mount Agung is a black shape on a still-bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the ocean in front of the Ocean View rooms slowly changes from black to grey.
phrases.clear_morning: The first sun reaches Palm Jumeirah, and the whole island stretches away below the hotel.
phrases.clear_midday: Palm Jumeirah lies in full sun from the hotel at its top, with the ocean blue around it.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the Grand Atlantis Suite open the curtains on a morning of sun and passing cloud.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of shade drift down Palm Jumeirah while the ocean around it stays bright.
phrases.overcast: Grey ocean meets grey cloud today, and guests in the Ocean View rooms try to find the line between them.
phrases.fog_haze: Today's haze leaves the near fronds of Palm Jumeirah clear and turns the far ones pale.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Palm Jumeirah is clear close to the hotel today, but its far end is not visible.
phrases.rain: Raindrops run down the glass of the Ocean View rooms, and the ocean behind them is a darker grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over the top of Palm Jumeirah, and guests in the Grand Atlantis Suite watch it from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Palm Jumeirah, and guests in the Grand Atlantis Suite take photographs to prove it.
phrases.very_cold: The ocean looks cold enough today that guests in the Ocean View rooms are happy to admire it through glass.
phrases.cold: On a day for staying in, guests in the Grand Atlantis Suite have Palm Jumeirah to look at.
phrases.very_hot: Even the ocean around Palm Jumeirah looks warm today, flat and bright in the sun.
phrases.warm: Guests outside in the warm air take their time looking over Palm Jumeirah.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Palm Jumeirah takes on a warm gold colour as the day ends, right down to its far tip.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds over the ocean change colour faster than they can photograph them.
phrases.grey_evening: After dark, the lights of Palm Jumeirah run away from the hotel under a low, cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight's rain softens every light on Palm Jumeirah.
phrases.mild_night: Guests still awake see Palm Jumeirah as lines of lights with the black ocean on every side.
phrases.clear_night: Palm Jumeirah at night is a long path of lights that ends in the dark ocean.
phrases.late_night: Very little moves on Palm Jumeirah at this hour, and the ocean around it is completely dark.
phrases.dusk: Lights come on along Palm Jumeirah one after another, and the ocean is still pale from the day.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the San Francisco Skyline stands as a dark outline against a sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the San Francisco Skyline, and Salesforce Tower catches the light before the streets below do.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every tower of the San Francisco Skyline has sharp edges, and Salesforce Tower rises above the rest.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the San Francisco Skyline this morning, and their shadows move slowly from one tower to the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the city-view rooms watch the afternoon sun come and go on the glass of Salesforce Tower.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the San Francisco Skyline, and the towers take the same quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the top of Salesforce Tower today, so the San Francisco Skyline looks a few floors shorter.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today; the nearest downtown rooftops are plain to see, while the far towers of the San Francisco Skyline are missing.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the city-view suites, and the San Francisco Skyline behind it looks soft and blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole San Francisco Skyline for a second, then the towers go back into the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the San Francisco Skyline, and guests stay close to the glass to watch the downtown rooftops turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The cold air is very clear today, so guests can count the towers of the San Francisco Skyline one by one.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in this 1915 hotel look out at the San Francisco Skyline from their city-view rooms.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the downtown rooftops shimmer, and the San Francisco Skyline seems to move a little in the bright air.
phrases.warm: The warm day gives a soft light to the San Francisco Skyline, and the downtown rooftops look bright in the afternoon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the San Francisco Skyline gold, and the glass of Salesforce Tower shines like a lamp that someone forgot to turn off.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds, and for a few minutes the San Francisco Skyline is half orange, half grey.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the San Francisco Skyline give the low clouds a pale glow.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the San Francisco Skyline run together into long bright lines on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hang low over the San Francisco Skyline tonight, and the lit city hills appear in the distance between the buildings.
phrases.clear_night: From the One-Bedroom suite, guests look at the lit San Francisco Skyline under a clear night sky, with Salesforce Tower above the other towers.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the San Francisco Skyline is quiet, and the streets between the towers are almost empty.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the San Francisco Skyline, one floor at a time.

phrases.clear_predawn: In the Junior Suite, early risers open the curtains to the City skyline, still dark against a paling sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Tower Bridge starts the day in full sun, clear against a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Suite with King Bed and Sofa Bed, guests watch cloud shadows slide across the City skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Tower Bridge goes from bright to grey and back again as the clouds pass over it.
phrases.overcast: No shadows fall on the City skyline today, only tower after tower in the same soft grey.
phrases.fog_haze: The City skyline is soft in the haze today, its towers fading into white the higher they go.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the nearest part of the view is clear today, and Tower Bridge shows as a faint grey outline.
phrases.rain: Guests in the Junior Suite stay dry and watch the rain sweep across Tower Bridge.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the City skyline and, for a second, every tower stands out in black.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the towers of Tower Bridge while guests in the Suite with King Bed and Sofa Bed stay warm indoors.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Junior Suite count the towers of the City skyline from under a blanket.
phrases.cold: In the Suite with King Bed and Sofa Bed, guests leave their coats on the hook a little longer and look out at Tower Bridge.
phrases.very_hot: Pale and still in today's heat, the City skyline looks like it is waiting for the evening.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late in the afternoon, Tower Bridge stands in golden light against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: A gap in the clouds lets the last sun light a few towers of the City skyline while the rest stay in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the Junior Suite see Tower Bridge lit under the evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls across the City skyline tonight, and the lights of its towers look soft and blurred.
phrases.mild_night: Lights are still on across the City skyline tonight, under a sky with no stars.
phrases.clear_night: Tower Bridge is lit tonight, bright against a clear black sky.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Suite with King Bed and Sofa Bed who wake in the small hours find the City skyline dark and quiet.
phrases.dusk: Window by window, the City skyline switches on while the sky behind it is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Potomac River lies still and grey under a clear sky, with Key Bridge a dark line across it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Potomac River, and guests in the balcony rooms open their curtains to find it directly below.
phrases.clear_midday: From Top of the Gate, the Washington Monument stands sharp against the clear blue sky above the city.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly down the Potomac River this morning, and Key Bridge goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony rooms, guests follow the clouds drifting over the Potomac River towards the Georgetown waterfront.
phrases.overcast: The Potomac River turns grey under the overcast sky, and the Arlington skyline behind it looks drawn with the same pencil.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Georgetown waterfront today, and the Washington Monument is only a faint shape in the distance.

phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Potomac River, and each flash of lightning shows Key Bridge for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Potomac River, and guests in this 1967 building watch the Georgetown waterfront turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests stay behind their balcony doors and look down at the Potomac River shining in the cold sun.

phrases.dusk: At Top of the Gate, guests turn a slow full circle as the first lights come on along the Potomac River under a still-bright sky.

phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Perth skyline this morning, and their shadows cross His Majesty's Theatre one at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the corner rooms see His Majesty's Theatre and the city towers together, with afternoon clouds passing above both.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the glass towers of the Perth skyline take the grey of the clouds behind His Majesty's Theatre.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Perth skyline today, so His Majesty's Theatre in the foreground has the scene almost to itself.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far towers of the Perth skyline are not visible today; from Club InterContinental, guests see only the nearest buildings and His Majesty's Theatre.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the west-facing windows, and guests watch it fall on His Majesty's Theatre below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Perth skyline for a second at a time, and guests in Club InterContinental count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Hay Street, and guests inside Loft Lounge & Bar watch it come down over the King Street precinct too.

phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass of Club InterContinental and look over the city with something warm to drink.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the terrace of Loft Lounge & Bar hold a cold cocktail and look along Hay Street without moving much.

phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit windows of the Perth skyline give the sky above the city a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Hay Street shine twice, once on the buildings and once on the wet road.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the clouds hide the stars, so the lights of the Perth skyline do that job for guests on the upper floors.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in Club InterContinental look across the lit Perth skyline to a sky full of stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, His Majesty's Theatre is quiet, and Hay Street beside it is almost empty.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Hay Street below the terrace of Loft Lounge & Bar.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Mediterranean Sea lies still and grey-blue under a clear sky, right below the sea view rooms.

phrases.clear_midday: At lunch on the terrace of Restaurant L'Antica Cartiera, guests look out at the blue of the Mediterranean Sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Marmorata bay this morning, and the water changes from dark blue to turquoise as they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the beach club, guests watch patches of sun and shade move slowly over the Mediterranean Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Mediterranean Sea turns the colour of slate all the way to the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Amalfi Coast today, and the mountains along it fade one behind the other.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Amalfi Coast is not visible today, and guests see only the rocks and water of Marmorata bay.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Marmorata bay, and guests in the sea view rooms watch the drops mark the grey water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Mediterranean Sea, and lightning shows the cliffs of the Amalfi Coast for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Marmorata bay, and the flakes disappear the moment they touch the sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the mountains of the Amalfi Coast stand out sharply above the dark blue sea.

phrases.warm: Guests lie on the sun beds of the beach club and look across Marmorata bay, their books still closed.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Mediterranean Sea to gold, and the cliffs of the Amalfi Coast take a warm colour above it.
phrases.partly_golden: On the terrace of Restaurant L'Antica Cartiera, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over the Amalfi Coast.

phrases.mild_night: From the small terraces of the terrace suites, guests see a mild, cloudy night over the black water of Marmorata bay.
phrases.clear_night: From the terrace of Restaurant L'Antica Cartiera, guests see the moon over the Mediterranean Sea and its light on the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Mediterranean Sea is a wide dark surface below the windows of this 15th-century paper mill.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Mediterranean Sea, and the first lights come on along the Amalfi Coast.

phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights Jacarepaguá Lagoon, and guests in the lagoon-facing rooms see the water turn from grey to blue.

phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Jacarepaguá Lagoon takes the same colour, and the mountains behind it look darker than usual.

phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Jacarepaguá Lagoon, and the far shore fades behind it little by little.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Pedra da Gávea for a second at a time, and guests follow the storm from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of their rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Jacarepaguá Lagoon, and guests look twice at the white flakes above the grey water.

phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the boulevards run between the palm trees, and Jacarepaguá Lagoon is a dark space beyond them.

phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, guests on the suite balconies look over the lit boulevards and palm trees, with the mountains hidden in cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, Pedra da Gávea stands black against the stars, and the city lights spread out below it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Jacarepaguá Lagoon is a wide black surface, and nothing moves on it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, Pedra da Gávea stands out against a bright sky as the first lights come on along the boulevards.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Chicago Skyline stands dark against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lies on the Chicago River, and the towers along it are bright on one side.
phrases.clear_midday: The Chicago Skyline is sharp against a blue sky, and guests can count the floors on the nearest towers.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests watch the Chicago River change from bright to dull and back as the morning clouds pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Half of the Chicago Skyline is in sun and half in shade, and the two keep trading places.
phrases.overcast: The Chicago River takes its colour from the cloud today, a calm grey between the buildings.
phrases.fog_haze: Guests see the Chicago Skyline as soft outlines in the fog, with only the nearest towers clear.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the far end of the Chicago cityscape is lost in thick air, though the Chicago River below stays clear to see.
phrases.rain: Rain dots the whole surface of the Chicago River while the towers above it fade into grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Chicago Skyline for a second at a time, and guests wait for the next flash.
phrases.snow: Snow falls between the towers of the Chicago Skyline, and guests watch it from indoors.
phrases.very_cold: Guests leave their coats on the hook and watch the Chicago River from the warm side of the glass.

phrases.very_hot: At Raised An Urban Rooftop Bar, guests hold cold drinks and look down at the Chicago River.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Chicago River turns gold between the towers as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights one side of the Chicago Skyline.

phrases.wet_evening: Guests watch tonight's rain turn the lights of the Chicago cityscape into soft, shining spots.

phrases.late_night: Guests who are awake in the small hours see the Chicago River lying dark and quiet between the buildings.
phrases.dusk: For a few minutes the Chicago Skyline is both dark shape and bright window, as the day ends.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Danube River is still and dark, and the Hungarian Parliament Building stands unlit under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the long front of the Hungarian Parliament Building, clear in every detail across the Danube River.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in art'bistrobar, guests look out at the Danube River, bright blue under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Danube River this morning, and the Chain Bridge goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in art'bistrobar take coffee and cake this afternoon while clouds drift over the Danube River.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Danube River turns the colour of steel, and the Hungarian Parliament Building looks paler than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Hungarian Parliament Building today, and the Chain Bridge seems to hang over the Danube River without its ends.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see the Danube River clearly but the Hungarian Parliament Building on the other bank only faintly.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Danube River with small circles, and the Chain Bridge turns dark and shiny.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Danube River, and for a second the Hungarian Parliament Building appears white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Danube River, and guests in the castle-view rooms watch Buda Castle turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Hungarian Parliament Building looks sharp enough to cut paper across the Danube River.

phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lit Chain Bridge draws a line of light across the Danube River.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Danube River is quiet and wide, and the Chain Bridge crosses it with no one looking but the sleepless.
phrases.dusk: From the balconies, the first lights come on along the Chain Bridge under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Acropolis is a quiet outline against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.

phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Acropolis stands sharp and white under a clear blue sky, with nothing in front of it from the roof garden.

phrases.partly_afternoon: From the roof garden, guests look past the olive trees to the Acropolis under a sky of sun and passing cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Acropolis takes a soft stone colour and the Parthenon looks calm and heavy.

phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and clear, and from the heated hot tubs on the roof garden the Acropolis looks close enough to touch.

phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests cool off under the water spray on the roof garden and look up at the Acropolis.
phrases.warm: On this warm day guests sit in the two hot tubs on the roof garden, and the guidebooks stay closed because the Acropolis is right there.

phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the Acropolis in patches above the roof garden.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner at Point A, guests look across to the floodlit Acropolis, bright under a low cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening the floodlit Acropolis shines through the rain, a little blurred, for guests in rooms facing the rock.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Puerta de Atocha, and from the rooftop bar the station slowly turns white.

phrases.very_hot: Heat makes the air tremble above the forecourt of Puerta de Atocha, and guests at the rooftop bar watch the parked cars shine in the sun.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Madrid rooftops gold, and the rooftop terrace catches the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: At the rooftop bar, guests watch the last sun slip between clouds above Puerta de Atocha, and the drinks wait a moment.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and Madrid's city lights stretch to the horizon from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the city lights of Madrid blur on the glass of the top-floor restaurant.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of Puerta de Atocha glow in the foreground, and the low clouds take some of their colour.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Madrid is quiet, and the forecourt of Puerta de Atocha lies almost empty below.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first city lights come on below the rooftop terrace.

phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the pool terrace this evening, and the Santorini Caldera fades into the wet night beyond the lit pools.

phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the Santorini Caldera, and the cliffs toward Oia show faintly from the suite terraces.

phrases.clear_midday: From the infinity pool, the Santorini Caldera is a wide half-circle of blue at midday, with the volcano in its centre.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Santorini Caldera this morning and pass over the volcano one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the highest point of Imerovigli, guests follow patches of sun and cloud shadow as they move across the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Santorini Caldera turns the colour of steel, and Fira village stands out on the cliffs.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Santorini Caldera today, and the volcano seems to float without a base.

phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening lights along the cliffs, and a lit cruise ship glows on the Santorini Caldera below.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Santorini Caldera is black and still, and the volcano can only be guessed at.
phrases.dusk: On the terrace, candles are lit while the sky is still orange over the Santorini Caldera, and the first lights appear in Oia.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over Sydney Harbour, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge is a dark arch above still water.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Me-Gal, guests look over the tree canopy to Sydney Harbour and the sails of the Sydney Opera House.
phrases.clear_midday: The Sydney Harbour Bridge stands sharp against a blue midday sky, and the Sydney Opera House sits clear across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: From the animal view rooms, guests watch cloud shadows cross The Sanctuary, where the animals climb and perch among the branches.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the city skyline this afternoon, and patches of sun move slowly across Sydney Harbour.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Sydney Harbour turns the colour of steel, and the Sydney Opera House looks whiter against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Sydney Harbour today, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge looks like a pencil drawing behind the trees.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The city skyline is not clear today, but guests at N'Gurra Lounge can still make out the Sydney Opera House across the water.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the tree canopy below Me-Gal, and Sydney Harbour turns grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Treetop Suites watch lightning flash over Sydney Harbour while thunder rolls across the water.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Sydney Harbour, and guests at N'Gurra Lounge watch the Sydney Harbour Bridge fade behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and from Me-Gal every line of the Sydney Harbour Bridge shows above the water.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests at N'Gurra Lounge stay with their drinks and look out across Sydney Harbour to the Sydney Opera House.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, Sydney Harbour glitters, and guests on the terrace look for shade before they look at the Sydney Opera House.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit on the terrace and look across Sydney Harbour to the Sydney Opera House and the city skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From N'Gurra Lounge, guests watch the sun drop towards the city skyline as Sydney Harbour turns gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds above the Sydney Harbour Bridge, and the terrace of this 62-room retreat faces all of it.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hang low this evening, and at Me-Gal the dinner tables face the lit Sydney Opera House across the dark water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass at Me-Gal tonight, and the lights of the Sydney Harbour Bridge blur across the wet harbour.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the city lights shimmer across Sydney Harbour in front of N'Gurra Lounge.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Sydney Harbour Bridge and the Sydney Opera House shine across the water, and the bushland below stays dark.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Sydney Harbour lies quiet beyond the harbour view rooms, and the Sydney Opera House waits for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Sydney Harbour Bridge and the city skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Arabian Gulf lies still and grey-blue beyond the private beach, and the sky above it slowly grows paler.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun brightens the Arabian Gulf, and the Doha skyline stands sharp across the water from the sea-view balconies.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Arabian Gulf turns a strong blue, and the 400-meter private beach lies bright along its edge.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Arabian Gulf this morning, while the Doha skyline stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Parisa Persian Restaurant, guests see the Arabian Gulf change from blue to silver each time a cloud passes.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Arabian Gulf takes the colour of pewter, and the Doha skyline stands in a darker grey behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the far side of the bay today, so the Doha skyline is only a faint row of shapes above the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Doha skyline is not visible today; from the private beach the view ends at the palms and the nearest water of the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Arabian Gulf, and guests watch it from their shaded balconies as the Doha skyline fades.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests see the Doha skyline for a second in each flash of lightning, then the storm closes over the Arabian Gulf again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palms of the private beach, and the Arabian Gulf behind them has turned grey and soft.
phrases.very_cold: In icy, clear air, guests inside Parisa Persian Restaurant can count the towers of the Doha skyline across the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the private beach is empty, and the Arabian Gulf rolls in steel blue beyond the palms.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the private beach keep to the shade and look out at a shimmering Arabian Gulf.
phrases.warm: Warm air, calm water: guests on the private beach watch kayaks cross the Arabian Gulf in front of the Doha skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Royal Suite terrace, guests watch the low sun turn the Doha skyline gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and paints orange stripes on the Arabian Gulf below the Gulf-facing terraces.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at dinner in Parisa Persian Restaurant look over the dark Arabian Gulf to the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Doha skyline tonight, and the Arabian Gulf carries them in long broken streaks.
phrases.mild_night: No stars tonight at the outdoor tables of Parisa Persian Restaurant, so the lit Doha skyline across the Arabian Gulf takes their place.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show clearly over the Arabian Gulf tonight, and from Parisa Persian Restaurant the water below them is black and calm.
phrases.late_night: While the 174 rooms sleep, the Arabian Gulf lies almost black beyond the palms of the private beach.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright over the Arabian Gulf, and guests see the first lights come on along the Doha skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear and still dark blue over the city, and the pool lies flat as glass in the garden below.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the French Embassy facade, and guests in La Mansión suites see it bright across the garden.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the city lies clear and sharp below the Tower rooms, under a sky without a cloud.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the city this morning, and guests watch their shadows cross downtown Buenos Aires.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the pool, the Belle Époque facade of La Mansión is bright one minute and shaded the next as clouds pass this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the French Embassy facade loses its shadows, and guests can study every detail across the garden.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens downtown Buenos Aires today, and the far buildings fade into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far parts of the city are not visible today; the garden, the pool and La Mansión below are still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the garden and the pool, and guests watch it from their suite windows, the French Embassy facade wet across the way.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over downtown Buenos Aires, and guests watch the storm from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the garden, and the French Embassy facade turns faint behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The very cold air makes the city sharp today, and guests stay indoors to look at the garden and the French Embassy facade.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the pool lies quiet in the garden, and La Mansión, a 3-floor Belle Époque house, stands over the water.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the pool and look up at the Belle Époque facade of La Mansión.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the pool loungers have the garden around them and La Mansión's facade in front, and nobody hurries.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the French Embassy facade gold, and the garden in front of it falls slowly into shade.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests on the top floor of the 12-floor Tower see the pool, La Mansión and downtown Buenos Aires under orange clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds sit low over the city this evening, and guests see the lights of downtown Buenos Aires glow under them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the city lights turn into soft dots.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the pool and La Mansión lie quiet below while the city lights shine further out.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and guests count the lights of downtown Buenos Aires instead of sleeping.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the garden is silent, and the French Embassy facade waits across it for morning.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first city lights come on beyond the garden.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Stadtpark is a dark shape below the 13th-floor sun terrace, and the clear sky above it is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the 12th floor, guests look across the rooftops of Vienna to the Schneeberg mountains under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 13th-floor sun terrace, the Ringstrasse runs past the Stadtpark under a wide blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the 12th-floor breakfast room watch cloud shadows move slowly over the rooftops of Vienna as the city wakes up.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the 11th-floor lounge take coffee and cake while clouds drift over the city centre.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Stadtpark and the Ringstrasse lie in even light below the 13th-floor sun terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the rooftops of Vienna today, and St. Stephen's Cathedral looks like a pencil drawing above them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Schneeberg mountains are not visible today; the view stops at the nearer rooftops and the Stadtpark below.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Ringstrasse, and guests watch it from the dry side of the 11th-floor lounge windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the rooftops of Vienna, and guests on the top three floors watch the storm from their rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Stadtpark, and from the balcony rooms its paths and trees slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, St. Stephen's Cathedral stands sharp above the rooftops from the balcony of the Stephansdom Suite.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 55-room hotel keep to the 11th-floor lounge and look down on the Ringstrasse.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the 13th-floor sun terrace find a chair and look down at the shade of the Stadtpark.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit out on the 13th-floor sun terrace with open sky above and the Ringstrasse below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the rooftops of Vienna gold, and St. Stephen's Cathedral catches the light above them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and lights the Stadtpark and the Ringstrasse in patches.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights spread out below the top three floors, and guests find them better than television.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Ringstrasse this evening, and the Stadtpark is a dark shape beside them.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hang low over the lit rooftops of Vienna, and the Ringstrasse draws a line of lamps through them.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of the city centre spread out in every direction from the 13th-floor sun terrace.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Ringstrasse is nearly empty, and the city centre lies quiet far below.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Stadtpark, and the first lights come on along the Ringstrasse.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Buda Castle is a dark shape on Castle Hill, and the sky above it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the Club Lounge, guests look through full-length windows at the Chain Bridge in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: The Danube shines under a clear midday sky, and barges pass slowly below Buda Castle.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Castle Hill this morning, while the Chain Bridge stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From river-facing rooms, guests follow the clouds as they drift over Buda Castle and Fisherman's Bastion.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Danube takes the same grey, and the Chain Bridge stands out clearly across it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Danube today, and from the lobby's full-length windows Castle Hill looks soft and far away.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Chain Bridge is clear from the 1st-floor Club Lounge, while Buda Castle across the river is only a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Danube with small circles, and guests at Corso Restaurant watch it from a dry table.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind Buda Castle, and the thunder rolls along the Danube a moment later.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Danube, and guests in the lobby watch Castle Hill turn white on the other side.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the air is clear, and Buda Castle shows every detail of its dome across the Danube.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests keep to the velvet armchairs of the Club Lounge and watch the Chain Bridge over a warm drink.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the Corso Bar terrace move slowly, and the tree-covered Buda Hills across the river look green and cool.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit outside on the Corso Bar terrace and watch the trams pass in front of the Danube and Buda Castle.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Buda Castle gold, and guests in the river-facing rooms of this 402-room hotel stop to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights Fisherman's Bastion, while the Chain Bridge is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: The pianist plays in the lobby this cloudy evening, but guests turn their chairs towards the lights on Castle Hill.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Buda Castle blur on the glass of the river-facing rooms.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of Buda Castle are reflected in the Danube below Castle Hill.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Chain Bridge is a line of lights across the Danube, and Buda Castle glows on the hill above it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, nothing moves on the Danube, and the Chain Bridge has the river to itself.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind Buda Castle, and from the Corso Bar terrace the first lights appear on the Chain Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Victoria Harbour lies still under a clear sky, and the Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: At Café on M, guests have breakfast with Victoria Harbour bright behind the table.
phrases.clear_midday: Victoria Harbour is sharp blue at midday, and from the harbour view rooms every ferry on it is easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Victoria Harbour this morning while breakfast goes on at Café on M beside the water view.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at The Mistral look out over Victoria Harbour as clouds drift across the afternoon sky.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, Victoria Harbour turns grey, and the Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront draws a clean edge along it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Victoria Harbour today, and the Hong Kong Island skyline fades to pale outlines above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far shore of Victoria Harbour is not visible today; guests see the Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront and the water close to it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Victoria Harbour, and guests in the Victoria Harbour View Suites watch it from their windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Victoria Harbour, and lightning shows the water for a second through the windows of The Mistral.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Victoria Harbour, a rare sight, and the Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront turns white at the edges.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests stay behind the glass at Café on M and look across Victoria Harbour.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront is quiet, and Victoria Harbour looks like steel beyond it.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, Victoria Harbour shines white, and guests choose the cool tables of The Mistral to look at it.
phrases.warm: People walk along the Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront in the warm air, with Victoria Harbour beside them all the way.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns Victoria Harbour gold, and the Victoria Harbour View Suites, among 572 rooms and suites, face it at eye level.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds over Victoria Harbour, and the Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront glows below them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at The Mistral see the lights of the Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront shine on Victoria Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and the lights along the Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront blur into long streaks on Victoria Harbour.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, low cloud takes the glow of the city and holds it over Victoria Harbour.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the harbour view rooms keep the curtains open tonight, because the city lights lie bright across Victoria Harbour.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Victoria Harbour is quiet, and the Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront waits for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Victoria Harbour, and the first lights come on along the Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Venetian Lagoon is still and grey-blue, and San Giorgio Island is a dark shape across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests wake to clear light on the Venetian Lagoon, with San Giorgio Island sharp across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At Caffè Baglioni, guests face a bright blue Venetian Lagoon under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move over the Venetian Lagoon this morning, while San Giorgio Island stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Tiziano Lagoon View Suite, guests watch patches of sun and cloud shade cross the wide water of the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the Venetian Lagoon takes the same colour, with San Giorgio Island as the one firm line in it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Venetian Lagoon today, and San Giorgio Island comes and goes like a rumour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so San Giorgio Island cannot be seen and the Venetian Lagoon fades out a short way from the hotel.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Venetian Lagoon with small circles; guests watch from the San Giorgio Terrace Suite, the island blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests see San Giorgio Island for one second in the lightning, then the storm over the Venetian Lagoon hides it again.
phrases.snow: Snow falls quietly into the Venetian Lagoon, and San Giorgio Island turns pale behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and San Giorgio Island shows every detail across the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.cold: On this cold day guests stay inside Caffè Baglioni and look out at the Venetian Lagoon, grey-green and restless.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the Venetian Lagoon shines like metal, and guests on the terrace of the San Giorgio Terrace Suite study it from whatever shade they can find.
phrases.warm: The building has received travellers since 1118, and on a warm day like this the Venetian Lagoon is still what they come to look at.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Venetian Lagoon gold, and St Mark's Campanile glows above the rooftops.
phrases.partly_golden: At Caffè Baglioni, guests watch the last sun slip between clouds and colour the Venetian Lagoon pink and orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of San Giorgio Island lie in long lines on the Venetian Lagoon in front of Caffè Baglioni.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Venetian Lagoon tonight, and the lights of San Giorgio Island tremble on the wet, dark water.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars on this mild night, so the lights of San Giorgio Island do the job across the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Venetian Lagoon on this clear night, and lit San Giorgio Island seems to float on the black water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Venetian Lagoon is black and silent, and San Giorgio Island is only a darker outline.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the San Giorgio Terrace Suite guests see the first lights come on at San Giorgio Island.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Caribbean Sea lies still and colourless under a clear sky, and the mangrove canopy has not yet turned green.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light fills the private terraces, and the Caribbean Sea beyond them is blue to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: From the main infinity pool, the reserve stretches south under a clear midday sky, one green treetop after another.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move over the mangrove canopy this morning, while the Caribbean Sea behind it stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the reserve and the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Caribbean Sea turns the colour of slate, and the mangrove canopy becomes the brightest thing in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze blurs the line between the Caribbean Sea and the sky today, so guests see one soft blue wall beyond the mangroves.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests see the mangrove canopy clearly and only the nearest strip of the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the mangrove canopy, and guests watch it from their rooms as the Caribbean Sea fades to grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Caribbean Sea, and for a second guests see every treetop of the reserve in white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the mangrove canopy, and guests look twice at the Caribbean Sea turning white behind it.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold, bright day, guests look at the Caribbean Sea through the floor-to-ceiling windows of their suites, and it still looks warm.
phrases.cold: A cold day leaves the main infinity pool empty, and the reserve to the south has the whole scene to itself.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the main infinity pool up to their shoulders and look south over the reserve.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests in this 124-room resort float in their plunge pools with the Caribbean Sea straight ahead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the mangrove canopy gold, and guests see the Caribbean Sea deepen to a darker blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds over the Caribbean Sea turn pink one by one.
phrases.grey_evening: On a cloudy evening, guests see the Caribbean Sea as a wide dark surface, with no stars above it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain hides the Caribbean Sea this evening, and guests see only the nearest wet trees of the mangrove canopy.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the 620-acre reserve is completely dark, and guests can only guess where the forest ends and the Caribbean Sea begins.
phrases.clear_night: Guests count stars in the clear night sky over the Caribbean Sea, above the black mangrove canopy.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the mangrove canopy and the Caribbean Sea are one quiet darkness, and nothing moves.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the reserve, and the main infinity pool holds the last colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Caribbean Sea is still dark, and a first band of light grows slowly along the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: From the docks of the overwater lagoon suites, guests see the lagoon, the mangrove and the Caribbean Sea together under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Caribbean Sea turns turquoise in front of Punta Bonita, and the white sand shines in the strong light.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the lagoons this morning, and the mangrove changes from dark green to bright green and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Aquí Me Quedo, guests watch patches of sun and shade cross the Caribbean Sea all afternoon.
phrases.overcast: The lagoon keeps its green colour under a grey sky, while the Caribbean Sea beyond the mangrove turns silver.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the lagoons today, and guests in the Lagoon Loft Suite see the mangrove soften behind the tall glass.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; from Punta Bonita, guests see the white sand and the first waves of the Caribbean Sea, then only pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the water channel with small circles, and guests in the overwater lagoon suites watch it from just above.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Caribbean Sea for a second, then the storm takes it back.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the mangrove and the lagoons, and the white flakes disappear as they touch the green water.
phrases.very_cold: From Punta Bonita, the Caribbean Sea stays turquoise in the icy air, and guests look at it from behind warm cups.
phrases.cold: The white sand beach is empty on this cold day, and the Caribbean Sea rolls in grey-blue with nobody in it.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests at Aquí Me Quedo look at the Caribbean Sea from the shade and move very little.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the white sand beach look out at the turquoise Caribbean Sea, and nobody seems in a hurry to leave.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the mangrove gold, and the lagoons hold the light like long mirrors.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests at Punta Bonita watch the clouds over the Caribbean Sea turn pink and orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at Aquí Me Quedo follow the white edge of the waves along the beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain falls on the lagoons, and the lights of the resort shake on the wet surface of the channel.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the mangrove becomes a dark wall along the lagoon, and the water below it stays perfectly still.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the Caribbean Sea tonight, and guests at Punta Bonita look up as often as they look out.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the 130 suites are quiet, and the lagoon lies black and still between the mangrove banks.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright over the lagoon, and the first lights come on along the docks of the overwater lagoon suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Yarra River lies dark and still, and the sky begins to pale behind the Melbourne skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Pacific Club Lounge, guests watch clear morning light spread along the Melbourne skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Port Phillip Bay shows as a wide blue band at the edge of the city.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Melbourne skyline this morning, and the Yarra River shines where the sun gets through.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the bay view suites watch patches of afternoon sun and cloud cross Port Phillip Bay.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Yarra River turns the colour of steel, and the Melbourne skyline stands out clearly against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Guests look for the tops of the Melbourne skyline today and find only haze.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests cannot see Port Phillip Bay today, while the Yarra River and the nearest towers of the Melbourne skyline stay clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the two glass walls of the Panoramic Suite, and the Yarra River below turns grey and dotted.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Port Phillip Bay, and guests count the seconds before the thunder reaches the Yarra River.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Melbourne skyline, and guests in Pacific Club Lounge leave their coffee to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Melbourne skyline is sharp in every detail, and Port Phillip Bay is a clear, cold blue.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay in Pacific Club Lounge and study the Melbourne skyline with a hot drink.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above the Yarra River, and the walkers on its banks keep to the shade.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, people stroll along the Yarra River below, and Port Phillip Bay shines in the distance.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Panoramic Suite, guests see the Yarra River turn gold on two sides as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink above Port Phillip Bay, and the towers of the Melbourne skyline catch the same light.
phrases.grey_evening: During evening cocktails in Pacific Club Lounge, guests look at the lit Melbourne skyline under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the city lights tonight, and the Yarra River carries their colours in long broken lines.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the clouds above the Melbourne skyline glow softly with the light of the city.
phrases.clear_night: With the lamps off in the Panoramic Suite, guests get the lit Melbourne skyline and the Yarra River as their night show.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Yarra River is quiet and dark, with no boat moving on it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights of the Melbourne skyline and its Ferris wheel appear in the Yarra River.
