phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, so guests in the upper-floor corner rooms can count the lit floors of the Empire State Building.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Manhattan skyline is quiet, and the Empire State Building is a tall shape above the sleeping rooftops.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright blue behind the Manhattan skyline, and the first windows light up one by one.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Metrópolis Building dome is a quiet outline above the Gran Vía rooftops under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Metrópolis Building dome first, and guests in the suite facing it see every detail of the cupola.
phrases.clear_midday: From La Terraza, the Gran Vía rooftops lie sharp under a clear midday sky, with the Metrópolis Building dome standing above them.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Madrid skyline this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the rooftops below the terraces.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terraces of Ático Restaurant on the 6th floor, guests look over Madrid as sun and cloud take turns on the rooftops.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Gran Vía rooftops turn the same grey, and the Metrópolis Building dome stands out all the more.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Madrid skyline today, and from La Terraza the Metrópolis Building dome looks like a sketch not yet finished.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Madrid skyline is not visible today, but the Metrópolis Building dome and the nearest Gran Vía rooftops still show clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Gran Vía; guests in the suite facing the Metrópolis Building dome watch the cupola shine wet through the window.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Madrid skyline, and for a second each rooftop along Gran Vía shows clearly from Ático Restaurant.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Gran Vía rooftops, and the Metrópolis Building dome slowly gets a white cap.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, guests look from the suite facing the Metrópolis Building dome at the cupola, every line of it sharp.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look from Ático Restaurant at Gran Vía and the rooftops of Madrid.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on La Terraza choose the hammocks and look at the Metrópolis Building dome from a horizontal position.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the 6th-floor terrace look over Gran Vía and follow the street between its rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Metrópolis Building dome warm gold above the Gran Vía rooftops, a colour no cocktail list can match.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the Gran Vía rooftops one by one, seen from the terraces above the street.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Gran Vía glow below the terraces, and the rooftops of Madrid fade into the grey.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening on Gran Vía, and from Ático Restaurant guests watch the street lights shine on the wet rooftops.
phrases.mild_night: From La Terraza, the Gran Vía rooftops spread under a cloudy night sky, with the city lights reflected in the clouds.
phrases.clear_night: Gran Vía's lights run below the terraces, and the Metrópolis Building dome rises above them into a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Gran Vía is quiet, and guests awake in the suite facing the Metrópolis Building dome have the cupola to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Gran Vía below the Metrópolis Building dome.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the CN Tower stands as a tall grey shape above the quiet city.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the CN Tower first, and Lake Ontario shines behind it under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From Harriet's Rooftop Bar, the CN Tower stands so close under the midday sun that guests can study its structure.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past the CN Tower this morning, and their shadows move slowly over the city skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the city skyline this afternoon, seen from the terrace suites.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Lake Ontario turns the same colour, and the CN Tower rises plainly in front of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and the CN Tower fades slowly into the white as it rises.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Lake Ontario is not visible today; the CN Tower and the nearest buildings of the skyline still show.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the city, and guests watch the CN Tower turn grey and blurred behind the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the city skyline, and for a second the CN Tower stands out clearly against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the city, and the CN Tower appears and disappears between the white showers.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and the CN Tower looks sharp against the sky above the skyline.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the Birch House suite look at the CN Tower through floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look across the water at the CN Tower.
phrases.warm: On warm days, guests at the rooftop pool lie back on their loungers and look out at the city skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the CN Tower and on Lake Ontario behind it, seen from the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_golden: From Harriet's Rooftop Bar, guests watch the clouds turn pink and orange above the city in the last hour of sun.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the city lights glow below Harriet's Rooftop Bar, and the CN Tower shines above them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the CN Tower and the city skyline shine softly through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, low cloud catches the glow of the city, and the CN Tower stands lit above the skyline.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests at Harriet's Rooftop Bar look at the lit CN Tower rising above the city lights.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, the CN Tower keeps its place above the sleeping streets, with Lake Ontario unseen behind it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright behind the CN Tower, and the first city lights come on below it.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Burj Al Arab is still only a dark shape while the first pale light of the day arrives.
phrases.clear_morning: Dubai Marina stands bright and clear in the morning sun, a good first sight for guests starting their day.
phrases.clear_midday: Palm Jumeirah lies spread out under the midday sun, its whole shape easy to read.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests starting the day see the Burj Al Arab in sunshine while a passing cloud shades Palm Jumeirah.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests see Dubai Marina go from bright to shaded and back as the clouds pass this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Dubai Marina and the Burj Al Arab stand in plain grey light today, their outlines still clear to guests.
phrases.fog_haze: In today's haze, guests find Palm Jumeirah pale and soft at the edges.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see Dubai Marina only as faint outlines and cannot see the end of Palm Jumeirah.
phrases.rain: Palm Jumeirah shows as a grey blur through the rain, and guests are glad to watch it from the dry side.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Burj Al Arab, and guests count the seconds after every flash.
phrases.snow: Guests stay indoors and watch, with some surprise, as snow falls between them and Dubai Marina.
phrases.very_cold: Guests keep warm indoors today and still follow every line of the Burj Al Arab.
phrases.cold: It is a day for staying inside, where guests look out over Palm Jumeirah and across to Dubai Marina.
phrases.very_hot: On a day made for shade, guests outside keep their sunglasses on and their eyes on Palm Jumeirah.
phrases.warm: Guests spend time outside today, looking across to Dubai Marina without any hurry.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Burj Al Arab gold, and guests stop what they are doing to look.
phrases.partly_golden: Palm Jumeirah glows orange between long cloud shadows as the day runs out.
phrases.grey_evening: The lights of Dubai Marina glow under low cloud this evening, with the lit Burj Al Arab standing against the grey.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests watch the evening rain fall across the lights of Palm Jumeirah and the Burj Al Arab.
phrases.mild_night: Under tonight's cloud, the lights of Dubai Marina hold guests' attention a little longer before sleep.
phrases.clear_night: The lit Burj Al Arab stands against a clear black night, with nothing to blur its outline.
phrases.dusk: For a few minutes after sunset, guests see Palm Jumeirah and the Burj Al Arab as dark outlines on a still-bright horizon.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Keizersgracht lies still, and the canal houses across the water are grey shapes under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the brick fronts across the Keizersgracht, and guests in canal-facing rooms open the curtains to a blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Keizersgracht shows the blue sky and the gables of the Canal Ring upside down on its water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Canal Ring this morning, and their shadows cross the Keizersgracht one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the large windows of the lounge, guests watch sun and cloud take turns over Amsterdam this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Keizersgracht turns the colour of slate, and the arched bridges stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Keizersgracht today, and guests see the far end of the canal fade into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the far stretch of the Canal Ring is not visible; the houses directly across the Keizersgracht still are.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Keizersgracht with small circles, and guests in canal-facing rooms watch them spread across the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Canal Ring, and each flash of lightning turns the Keizersgracht white for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the gabled roofs of the Canal Ring, and guests watch the Keizersgracht turn dark between its white edges.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests check from the canal-facing rooms whether the Keizersgracht has a skin of ice yet.
phrases.cold: A cold light lies on the Canal Ring today, and the Keizersgracht water looks like polished metal.
phrases.very_hot: The heat makes the air shimmer over the Keizersgracht, and guests look at the water with some envy.
phrases.warm: Only 40 rooms share this address, and on a warm day the canal-facing ones look straight across the bright Keizersgracht.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the brick houses of the Canal Ring gold, and the Keizersgracht carries the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests see the clouds above the rooftops of the Canal Ring go orange, then red.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests see lit windows across the Keizersgracht, each one doubled in the dark water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Canal Ring tonight, and the lights along the Keizersgracht stretch into long lines on the water.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of the Canal Ring glow softly on the low cloud above the Keizersgracht.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests can follow the line of lights along the Keizersgracht deep into the Canal Ring.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours nothing moves on the Keizersgracht, and guests who are still awake have the Canal Ring to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky over the Keizersgracht is still bright, and the first lamps come on along the Canal Ring.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Victoria Harbour lies dark and quiet below the suite windows, and the sky above Hong Kong Island slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Club guests take breakfast at Above & Beyond Club Lounge on the 28th floor, with Victoria Harbour clear and blue below.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in Above & Beyond, the skyline across Victoria Harbour stands sharp under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Victoria Harbour this morning, and the Star Ferry crosses from one patch of sun to the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at Timeless Lounge follow the traffic into the Hung Hom Tunnel while clouds drift over Victoria Harbour.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Victoria Harbour turns the colour of steel, and the ships crossing it are easy to follow.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Victoria Harbour today, and the junk boats look like small brush strokes on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The skyline of Hong Kong Island is faint today, so guests look at the near water of Victoria Harbour instead.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the Vivienne Tam Suite, and Victoria Harbour blurs into soft grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Victoria Harbour, and for a second the whole skyline shows through the glass of Timeless Lounge.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Victoria Harbour, and guests in the harbour suite watch it drift across their 280-degree view of the water and Kowloon.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Victoria Harbour looks sharp and bright from the rooftop pool, which has more view than swimmers today.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass at Above & Beyond and watch the ferries cross Victoria Harbour.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the water of the rooftop pool and look out over Victoria Harbour.
phrases.warm: Guests swim slow laps in the rooftop pool on this warm day, with Victoria Harbour and the skyline at the far end.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns Victoria Harbour gold, and from the harbour-facing rooms guests see every passing boat leave a bright trail.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and guests at Timeless Lounge watch Victoria Harbour change colour during happy hour.
phrases.grey_evening: From the bar of Above & Beyond Club Lounge, the lights of the Island glow under low cloud across Victoria Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, dinner guests at Above & Beyond see the skyline lights run together on the rainy glass above Victoria Harbour.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the neon colours of the skyline float on Victoria Harbour under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the skyline tonight, and the city lights shine back from Victoria Harbour below Timeless Lounge.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Victoria Harbour is almost empty, and a single late ship moves slowly across the black water.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Victoria Harbour, and from the rooftop pool the first lights come on along the skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Guests awake before sunrise see the IJ River still and grey under a clear sky, while the Eye Film Institute slowly takes shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the cantilevered form of the Eye Film Institute, sharp against a clear blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows show the city under a clear sky, every rooftop in full light.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cross the IJ River this morning, and their shadows slide over the water and the moored boats.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From upper-floor rooms, guests watch patches of afternoon sun travel across the IJ River towards the Eye Film Institute.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the IJ River turns the colour of steel, and the Eye Film Institute keeps its sharp angles.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the IJ River today, and the Eye Film Institute appears and disappears like a slow film of its own.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the church spires of the city are not visible, and the IJ River fades soon after the nearest boats.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and guests watch the drops dot the IJ River below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Eye Film Institute for a second, then the storm over the IJ River takes it back.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the IJ River, and the Eye Film Institute turns pale behind the falling flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air makes everything sharp today: the IJ River shines, and each angle of the Eye Film Institute is easy to see.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the restaurant stay warm behind the glass and look out at the city skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat the IJ River flashes with light, and guests in upper-floor rooms watch it from behind the glass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the corner suites have the city's rooftops and church spires in full view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the IJ River to gold, and the Eye Film Institute's cantilevered silhouette stands out against the bright sky.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the city turn pink and orange behind the church spires.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights colour the sky a soft orange, and the IJ River carries their reflections.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in the restaurant watch the city lights blur through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the IJ River moves quietly past this artificial island, with city lights resting on the water under the cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests find the Eye Film Institute's silhouette above the black water of the IJ River, then start counting stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the IJ River is quiet, and the water is the only thing still moving.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset as the first lights come on along the IJ River, and guests in upper-floor rooms leave their lamps off.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Acropolis stands unlit above Syntagma's rooftops before sunrise, and the clear sky behind it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Acropolis first, then moves down over Syntagma's rooftops one by one.
phrases.clear_midday: From Tudor Hall on the 7th floor, the Acropolis stands sharp against a clear midday sky, with Syntagma's rooftops bright below it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Syntagma's rooftops this morning, while the Acropolis stays in sunshine above them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon clouds drift behind the Acropolis, and the Parthenon changes shade each time one passes.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Acropolis and Syntagma's rooftops take the same soft colour, and the Parthenon is still easy to pick out on top.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Acropolis today, and from Tudor Hall it looks like a pencil drawing above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Athens coastline is not visible from Tudor Hall today, but the Acropolis is close enough to stay clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Syntagma's rooftops; guests watch it from the balcony rooms, the Acropolis grey behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in Tudor Hall see lightning flash over Syntagma's rooftops, and for a second the Acropolis appears clearly through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Acropolis, and guests in this 102-room hotel stand at the windows to watch Syntagma's rooftops turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is clear today, and the Acropolis shows every edge above Syntagma's rooftops.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the rooftop pool is left to itself, and the Acropolis behind it has no competition for attention.
phrases.very_hot: By the rooftop pool, guests stay in the water in the strong heat and look across to the Acropolis, glad they are not climbing it today.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests step out on the twin balconies of the 6th-floor rooms and find the Acropolis straight ahead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Tudor Hall, guests watch the late sun turn the Acropolis gold above Syntagma's rooftops, and conversation slows down.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds, and the Parthenon glows on top of the Acropolis while the rooftops below are already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, so guests at dinner in Tudor Hall keep turning toward the lit Acropolis.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Acropolis blur in the rain on the glass, and guests on the upper floors watch them from the dry side.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Acropolis glows above the city roofs, and the low clouds pick up a little of its light.
phrases.clear_night: Guests look out at a clear night sky, where the lit Parthenon sits on the Acropolis like a lamp left on for the city.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Syntagma's rooftops are quiet, and the Acropolis waits above them for morning.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the rooftop pool glows blue under a still-bright sky, and the first lights come on at the Acropolis.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Mount Etna stands as a dark shape above the still water of Taormina Bay.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the Principe Cerami terrace is served under a clear sky, with the Ionian Sea calm and blue below the tables.
phrases.clear_midday: From the clifftop infinity pool, Mount Etna and Taormina Bay share the same view under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Mount Etna this morning, while the convent gardens and Taormina Bay stay mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At Rosso, guests look out at Mount Etna and Taormina Bay while cloud shadows move slowly across the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Taormina Bay takes the same colour, and Mount Etna stands darker behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Taormina Bay today, and the cruise ships far below look like small white marks on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Mount Etna is not visible today, and from the infinity pool guests see only the near part of Taormina Bay.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Taormina Bay, and guests watch it from the sea-view rooms, Mount Etna blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Mount Etna for a second at a time, then the storm closes over Taormina Bay again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the convent gardens, and guests in this 14th-century convent watch Taormina Bay turn white and soft.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and from the convent gardens every ridge of Mount Etna shows above Taormina Bay.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the hotel terraces are quiet, and Taormina Bay lies wide and empty below them, with Mount Etna behind.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests in the plunge pool suites stay in the water and look across Taormina Bay from there.
phrases.warm: At Anciovi on the pool terrace, guests sit in the warm air and look at the hilltop town of Taormina and Taormina Bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on Mount Etna late this afternoon, and from the 21-metre infinity pool Taormina Bay turns a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds around Mount Etna, and guests on the terraces of the plunge pool suites watch Taormina Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: From Bar & Chiostro, guests look at the sea under a cloudy evening sky, a drink in hand and nowhere else to be.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Taormina Bay this evening, and the coast lights below the hotel shine blurred through it.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and the lights of the coast draw a bright line around Taormina Bay.
phrases.clear_night: Dinner on the Principe Cerami terrace is served under a clear night sky, with the lit coastline visible beyond the railing.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Taormina Bay lies quiet and dark below the cliff, and Mount Etna keeps its own counsel.
phrases.dusk: From the pool terrace, guests see the first lights come on around Taormina Bay while the sky behind Mount Etna stays bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Riddarfjärden lies still and grey-blue, and Gamla Stan is a dark outline beyond the water.
phrases.clear_morning: In the dining room, morning sunlight falls on the Stockholm City Hall tower beyond the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Riddarfjärden is bright blue, and the Gamla Stan skyline stands sharp beyond the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests on the upper floors watch cloud shadows cross Riddarfjärden this morning, while Gamla Stan stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Lake Mälaren this afternoon, and guests follow their shadows across the water towards Stockholm City Hall.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, guests in the dining room look out at the Stockholm City Hall tower, standing dark against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Riddarfjärden today, and the Gamla Stan skyline comes and goes behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so guests see Riddarfjärden clearly but only a faint outline of Gamla Stan beyond it.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in the lake-view rooms watch Riddarfjärden turn rough and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Riddarfjärden, and for a second guests see every roof of Gamla Stan.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Riddarfjärden, and guests watch the roofs of Gamla Stan slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Gamla Stan looks sharp and close across Riddarfjärden, and guests are happy to admire it from behind glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the dining room stay by the windows a little longer, looking at the Stockholm City Hall tower.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, Riddarfjärden shines like metal, and guests look at the water with some envy.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests look out over Stockholm's waterways, and Gamla Stan stands bright above the blue water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in the suites watch the late sun turn Gamla Stan gold, the Riddarholmen Church spire catching the light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and Riddarfjärden turns orange and pink in front of Stockholm City Hall.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low evening cloud, the lights of Gamla Stan glow in a long row across Riddarfjärden.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests watch the lights of Stockholm City Hall blur and stretch on Riddarfjärden.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in this hotel of 414 rooms look from the upper floors at Gamla Stan lit beyond the water.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of Gamla Stan are doubled in the still water of Riddarfjärden.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Riddarfjärden is quiet and dark, and Gamla Stan sleeps beyond it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights of Gamla Stan appear on Riddarfjärden.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky turns pale over the Indian Ocean, and the Golden Mile is still a quiet strip of sand below the balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Versailles Restaurant, guests look out at the Indian Ocean, bright under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop infinity pool, Battery Beach lies directly below, its sand almost white under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move along the Golden Mile this morning, crossing the promenade and the palms one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon tea in the Florida Lounge has the Indian Ocean in front of it, with patches of sun and cloud on the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Indian Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the New Pier stands out clearly from the balcony rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the Golden Mile today, so the hotels along the coast fade one by one toward the Bluff.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Bluff is not visible today; from the rooftop bar, guests see only the nearest stretch of the Golden Mile.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Battery Beach, and guests in Versailles Restaurant watch the Indian Ocean turn grey behind wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Indian Ocean, and guests in the sea-facing rooms watch the storm move along the Golden Mile.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Golden Mile, and from the Florida Lounge the palms on the promenade look quite surprised.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear, and from the rooftop guests can follow the Golden Mile all the way to the Bluff.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the Florida Lounge stay warm and watch the waves of the Indian Ocean roll onto the sand.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop infinity pool and watch the surfers in the waves off Battery Beach.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the loungers by the rooftop infinity pool look past the glass edge to the open Indian Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At the rooftop bar, guests watch the late sun colour the coastline to the south, where the hotels of the Golden Mile glow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Golden Mile turn pink, and the rooftop infinity pool takes the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Golden Mile draw a bright line along the coast below the rooftop of this 262-room tower.

phrases.grey_evening: From the Sky Penthouse, guests see the lights of the Miami skyline glow under low cloud, with the Atlantic Ocean dark on the other side.

phrases.mild_night: From the rooftop on this mild, cloudy night, the Atlantic Ocean is more sound than sight, and South Beach is a pale band below.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and the white edges of the waves are still visible on South Beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, South Beach is empty and quiet, and the Atlantic Ocean keeps moving along the 600 feet of shore in front of the hotel.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Atlantic Ocean is still bright, and the first lights come on along South Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Napa Valley vineyards lie dark and quiet below the private terraces, under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Napa Valley vineyards row by row, and the Mayacamas Mountains stand sharp against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch on the terrace of The Bar, guests look down on the Napa Valley vineyards, bright green under a cloudless sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Napa Valley vineyards this morning, while the Mayacamas Mountains stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the open-air terrace of The Restaurant, guests watch the afternoon clouds drift over the valley floor, their shadows crossing one vineyard and then the next.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Napa Valley vineyards turn a deeper green, and the Mayacamas Mountains look closer than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills the valley floor today, and from the terrace of The Restaurant the Napa Valley vineyards appear and disappear between the white patches.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Mayacamas Mountains are not visible today, so the view from the private terraces ends at the nearest Napa Valley vineyards.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Napa Valley vineyards; guests watch it from behind their French doors, the valley floor slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the Mayacamas Mountains, and for a second every row of the Napa Valley vineyards shows clearly through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the hillside olive trees, and the Napa Valley vineyards below slowly turn white, row after row.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the air is so clear that guests can follow every ridge of the Mayacamas Mountains from their terrace doors.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Napa Valley vineyards look still and tidy from the terrace of The Restaurant, with the Mayacamas Mountains clear behind them.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay under the cream umbrellas on the pool deck and look out over the Napa Valley vineyards and the rolling hills.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests having a poolside meal at La Plage look across the Napa Valley vineyards to the Mayacamas Mountains.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light fills the Napa Valley vineyards, and guests on the terrace of The Bar watch the sun sink toward the Mayacamas Mountains to the west.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and paints the valley floor gold, a show that guests in the private maisons follow from their trellised terraces.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening sky full of cloud, the Napa Valley vineyards are dark, and guests at dinner on the terrace of The Restaurant look out over the wide valley floor.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the valley floor this evening, and the Napa Valley vineyards fade into the wet dark beyond the private terraces.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hide the stars, and the valley floor lies wide and dark below the private terraces.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the Mayacamas Mountains, and the Napa Valley vineyards lie dark and still on the valley floor.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Napa Valley vineyards rest in darkness, and only the outline of the Mayacamas Mountains separates land from sky.
phrases.dusk: From the terrace of The Restaurant, which Claude Rouas opened in 1981, guests see the Napa Valley vineyards darken under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Early risers in the Pinnacle Lake View rooms see Lake Michigan still dark, with a thin pale line where the day will start.
phrases.clear_morning: The Chicago River catches the morning sun between the towers of the city skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: Lake Michigan is blue all the way to the horizon, and Navy Pier stands out clearly against the water.
phrases.partly_morning: In the Pinnacle River View rooms, guests open the curtains to a Chicago River half in sun and half in cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows drift over Lake Michigan this afternoon, while Navy Pier stays in the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Chicago River looks like dark green glass between the towers.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of Lake Michigan today, and guests in the Pinnacle Lake View rooms see the water fade into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Navy Pier is only a faint shape today, and Lake Michigan has no horizon at all.
phrases.rain: From the Pinnacle River View rooms, guests watch rain draw rings on the Chicago River.
phrases.thunderstorm: For a second, lightning shows the whole city skyline above the Chicago River, then the storm closes in again.
phrases.snow: Millennium Park turns white under the falling snow, and Lake Michigan is lost in the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: Lake Michigan is a deep winter blue today, and guests in the Pinnacle Lake View rooms enjoy it from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: Guests in the Pinnacle River View rooms stay inside a little longer today, looking down at the Chicago River and the city skyline.
phrases.very_hot: Lake Michigan lies flat and blue beyond the city, and it looks cool from up here.
phrases.warm: Sun fills the Pinnacle River View rooms, and the Chicago River below is bright from bank to bank.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the city skyline orange, and the Chicago River carries the same colour between the towers.
phrases.partly_golden: In the Pinnacle Lake View rooms, guests watch the last sun slip between clouds and lay a pink strip on Lake Michigan.
phrases.grey_evening: Chicago's most famous landmarks glow under low cloud tonight, their lights doubled in the Chicago River.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass tonight, and the lights of Navy Pier look soft across a dark Lake Michigan.
phrases.mild_night: The Chicago River is a dark line tonight between the lights of the city skyline.
phrases.clear_night: Nobody closes the curtains tonight, with the city skyline lit and sharp above the Chicago River.
phrases.late_night: Guests who cannot sleep look out over Lake Michigan, wide and dark at this late hour.
phrases.dusk: Navy Pier switches on its lights while Lake Michigan still holds the last blue of the day.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Empire State Building is a tall grey shape in a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the panoramic view rooms wake with the bed against the glass and the Empire State Building in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, guests at cloudM see the Manhattan skyline sharp under a blue sky, with One World Trade Center easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the rooftops of the Lower East Side this morning, and the Empire State Building goes from bright to grey and back.

phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, guests in the lounge see the Empire State Building take almost the same colour as the cloud behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Empire State Building today, so guests in the lounge study the nearer Manhattan rooftops instead.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: from cloudM the streets of Chinatown and SoHo are clear, but One World Trade Center cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Empire State Building is blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests watch the storm from bed, as lightning shows the Manhattan skyline for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the rooftop terrace of cloudM on the 20th floor, and the Manhattan skyline behind it fades to white.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing bright day, guests stay inside at cloudM and look out at the Empire State Building, sharp in the cold air.
phrases.cold: Cold air leaves the Manhattan skyline clear today, with One World Trade Center standing above the downtown rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests on the rooftop terrace choose a red chair and watch the Manhattan skyline shimmer in the hot air.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit outside at cloudM with SoHo and Chinatown below and the Manhattan skyline in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights one side of the Empire State Building, and the rooftops below it turn warm orange.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over One World Trade Center turn pink and the tower catches the light.
phrases.grey_evening: At cloudM, guests drink cocktails under a cloudy evening sky while the lights of the Manhattan skyline glow against the low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of the Empire State Building spread softly across the drops on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night with cloud, the lit top of One World Trade Center glows above the street lights of Chinatown.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the panoramic view rooms fall asleep late, because the lit Empire State Building is right beyond the bed.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Manhattan skyline is a quiet row of towers, and the streets of the Lower East Side below are still.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests watch the first lights come on in the streets below the Manhattan skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Alster Lakes lie still and grey-blue under a clear sky, the tree line on the bank only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Alster Lakes, and guests in rooms on the 6th floor and above see the water over the treetops.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, the green church spire stands sharp against a blue sky, with the city spread around it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Alster Lakes this morning, and the water changes from silver to blue and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Heritage restaurant on the 9th floor, guests follow patches of sun as they cross the Alster Lakes.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Alster Lakes turn the colour of steel, wide and calm beyond the tree line.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Alster Lakes today, and guests look for the far bank without finding it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: from the rooftop terrace the green church spire is faint, and the city behind it cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain draws small rings on the Alster Lakes, and the far bank fades behind the falling water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the Alster Lakes, and for a second the water turns white beyond the glass of the Prestige Lake Suite.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Alster Lakes, and guests in the balcony rooms watch the flakes vanish as they touch the water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and every edge of the Alster Lakes is sharp below the 9th-floor windows of Heritage restaurant.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the rooftop terrace is quiet, yet the green church spire and the city still stand clear from it.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Alster Lakes, and the sailboats on the water seem in no hurry at all.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the 18-metre balcony of the Prestige Lake Suite count sailboats on the Alster Lakes.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Alster Lakes gold, and guests at the rooftop bar watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the city skyline turn orange, and from the rooftop bar a tower stands dark against them.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Heritage restaurant, guests look out at the Alster Lakes, black under a cloudy sky with city lights at the edges.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass at Heritage restaurant this evening, and the lights around the Alster Lakes blur into soft dots.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so the city lights do the work, lying in long lines on the Alster Lakes.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in this hotel of 261 rooms see the city lights doubled in the Alster Lakes.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Alster Lakes are a wide, quiet darkness beyond the trees.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky stays bright over the Alster Lakes, and the first lights appear along the bank.

phrases.clear_predawn: Still without its lights, the Eiffel Tower is a dark outline waiting for the first light of day.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Suite Eiffel, guests open the curtains and find the Eiffel Tower already in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Every iron beam of the Eiffel Tower is easy to follow from here, right up to the top.
phrases.partly_morning: Breakfast time brings passing clouds, and the Eiffel Tower goes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Shadow and sun take turns on the Eiffel Tower this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Against today's pale cloud, the Eiffel Tower shows its full iron shape to guests in the Suite Eiffel.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken the top of the Eiffel Tower, and guests are left guessing where it ends.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the Eiffel Tower is clear in today's thick air; the city behind it cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Umbrellas stay closed in the Suite Eiffel, where guests watch the rain cross in front of the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests count the seconds between lightning and thunder as the storm passes over the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.snow: Warm indoors, guests watch the snow fall across the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.very_cold: The Eiffel Tower looks sharp in the frozen air, with every line of iron clear.
phrases.cold: It is a coat day in Paris, so guests in the Suite Eiffel enjoy the Eiffel Tower with the heating on.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the Eiffel Tower seems to tremble a little in the bright air.
phrases.warm: Guests plan their walk to the Eiffel Tower by simply looking at it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Eiffel Tower turns the colour of honey as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests watch the last hour of sun slip between the clouds and touch the Eiffel Tower in patches.
phrases.grey_evening: Lit in gold, the Eiffel Tower glows under a low ceiling of cloud this evening.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight's rain turns the lit Eiffel Tower into a soft golden blur for guests staying in.
phrases.mild_night: Guests leave the curtains open tonight, with the lit Eiffel Tower as their night light.
phrases.clear_night: Nothing stands between guests and the golden Eiffel Tower tonight, and every light on it is sharp.
phrases.late_night: A guest who cannot sleep finds the Eiffel Tower still standing guard, a tall dark shape over quiet Paris.
phrases.dusk: One by one, the Eiffel Tower's lights come on while the sky behind it is still pale.

phrases.clear_predawn: Early risers see Dubai Marina before the sun does, its water still dark and quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: At JW Kitchen, guests eat breakfast with a clear view of the marina.
phrases.clear_midday: From The Wane by Somya pool, the marina is bright and clear from one end to the other.
phrases.partly_morning: Sun and cloud take turns over Dubai Marina this morning, and the water changes colour with them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in Elvi Lounge see the marina go from shade to sun and back this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a full cover of cloud, Dubai Marina looks calm, its water grey and without glare.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Dubai Marina today, and the city behind it is only a faint shape.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From JW Kitchen, the marina is plain to see today, but the city further away is not.
phrases.rain: Dubai Marina is grey under the rain today, and guests in Elvi Lounge watch it fall on the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Dubai Marina, and lightning shows the water for a moment at a time.
phrases.snow: It is snowing over Dubai Marina, and guests watch from JW Kitchen.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold, Dubai Marina is a view to enjoy from indoors.
phrases.cold: Elvi Lounge is the place to sit today, with the marina in view.
phrases.very_hot: The pool is where guests want to be today, in the water with the marina in front of them.
phrases.warm: At The Wane by Somya pool, guests rest by the water and look out over the marina.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Gold light spreads over Dubai Marina as the sun goes down.
phrases.partly_golden: The clouds over Dubai Marina catch the last sun, and the water below picks up some of their colour.
phrases.grey_evening: At JW Kitchen, guests eat dinner with the lit marina in view.
phrases.wet_evening: In tonight's rain, the lights of Dubai Marina look soft and a little blurred.
phrases.mild_night: From Elvi Lounge, guests look out over the lit marina tonight.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight Dubai Marina is lit and clear, with the city lights behind it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Dubai Marina is quiet, its water dark and still.
phrases.dusk: Lights begin to show across Dubai Marina while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Boston Harbour is a wide dark sheet beyond the Seaport rooftops, and the sky above it starts to turn pale.

phrases.clear_midday: At Lifted Rooftop Restaurant & Bar, lunch is served under a clear sky with the Boston skyline in sharp detail.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Boston skyline this morning, and their shadows slide across the rooftop pool on the 5th floor.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun and shade cross Boston Harbour this afternoon, changing the colour of the water from blue to grey.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Boston Harbour turns the colour of steel beyond the Boston Convention Center.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Boston Harbour today, and only the Boston Convention Center across the street stays clear.

phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Boston skyline for a second, then the storm closes over it again; guests watch from their city-view rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Boston Convention Center, and the red-brick factories behind it slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The heated rooftop pool steams in the freezing air, with the Boston skyline clear and sharp behind the steam.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the air is clear over Boston Harbour and the water looks dark blue and still.

phrases.warm: Guests on the pool deck turn their loungers towards the Boston skyline, drinks from Lifted Rooftop Restaurant & Bar in hand.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Boston skyline gold, and the rooftop pool deck has a clear line of sight to it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Boston Harbour go pink and the water below them does the same.
phrases.grey_evening: At Lifted Rooftop Restaurant & Bar, dinner guests look at the lights of the Boston skyline under a low, cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of the Seaport district shine on the wet streets, and Boston Harbour is black beyond them.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, very little moves between the Boston Convention Center and Boston Harbour.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Boston Harbour is still bright while the first lights come on along the Boston skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Walt Disney Concert Hall is a quiet grey shape opposite the lobby terrace, under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.

phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the downtown Los Angeles skyline, and guests in the Presidential Suite watch the storm pass between the towers.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Walt Disney Concert Hall, and from the lobby terrace its steel curves slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, every tower of the downtown Los Angeles skyline looks close from the restaurant terrace.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the fire pit seating on the rooftop terrace faces the Walt Disney Concert Hall, where the steel looks as cold as the air.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Walt Disney Concert Hall gold, and guests admire Frank Gehry's curves from a building he also designed.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the downtown Los Angeles skyline turn orange, and the towers copy the colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the downtown Los Angeles skyline glow around the rooftop pool.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, city lights stretch across the shining steel of the Walt Disney Concert Hall, directly opposite the lobby terrace.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild, and from the restaurant terrace the clouds above the downtown Los Angeles skyline hold the glow of the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit towers of downtown Los Angeles rise behind the Walt Disney Concert Hall, and guests look at both from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Walt Disney Concert Hall rests in silence opposite the suites, its curves a soft outline for guests who are still awake.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Nile is a wide, quiet band under a clear sky, and Cairo Tower stands still beyond it.

phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Nile takes the same colour, and Cairo Tower stands pale beyond it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the Nile today, and Cairo Tower fades in and out beyond the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Giza Pyramids are not visible from Nox today; the Nile below and the Egyptian Museum are still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Nile, and guests in the Presidential Suite watch it run down the floor-to-ceiling window.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Nile and Cairo Tower for a second at a time, then thunder rolls over the river.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Tahrir Square and the Egyptian Museum, and guests in the city-side rooms stay at their windows to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold, bright day, guests keep to the warm Club Lounge and follow the Nile through the glass.
phrases.cold: Cold air sits over the Nile today, and guests in this 329-room hotel pick out Cairo Tower above the river.
phrases.very_hot: The Nile shines almost white in the heat, and guests in the Club Lounge look at it from the cool side of the glass.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit out on the suite balconies, with the Nile and Cairo Tower on one side and Tahrir Square on the other.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Nox, guests watch the sun go down toward the western horizon, where the Giza Pyramids stand in gold light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and sets into the Nile, and guests in Bar'Oro turn their chairs to the window.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in Bab El-Sharq look over the Egyptian Museum and the city lights around it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the city lights on the Nile this evening, and guests in Vivo see Cairo Tower through wet glass.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Salish Sea is a wide, quiet grey beyond the seawall, and the sky above it slowly grows lighter.

phrases.partly_afternoon: The Boathouse Spa terrace sits over the water, where cloud shadows move slowly across the channel this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Guests in the window-lined fitness room look over the pools to a Salish Sea as grey as the sky.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the horizon today, so the Salish Sea seems to end a short way past the seawall.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Mount Baker cannot be seen today; the view from the oceanfront balconies stops at the sailboats in mid-channel.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Salish Sea, and from the oceanfront rooms the sailboats are only soft grey shapes.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the channel, and lightning turns the Salish Sea white for a moment beyond the seawall.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the seawall and disappearing into the Salish Sea, while steam rises from the heated mineral pools.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Mount Baker's snow cone looks sharp on the horizon, and the Salish Sea below it is deep blue.

phrases.partly_golden: From the terrace above the pools, the last sunlight colours the clouds over the Salish Sea.

phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the lobby's tall windows this evening, and the waterfront beyond them is dark and shining.

phrases.cold: It is a cold day on the Canal Ring, and the Prinsengracht looks like steel between its two rows of houses.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on Advocatuur Terrace look down at the Prinsengracht with a little envy for the people on the boats.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, boats fill the Prinsengracht, and guests in the canal view rooms open the French doors to watch them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun warms the brick canal houses, and the Prinsengracht shows them again, upside down.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Prinsengracht turn orange and pink, and Advocatuur Terrace faces the canal.
phrases.grey_evening: From Advocatuur Terrace this evening, the lit windows of the Prinsengracht shine under a cloudy sky, and guests watch them from inside the bar.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the canal houses stretch into long wet lines on the Prinsengracht.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lamps along the Prinsengracht put small circles of light on the water.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Prinsengracht is black and calm, and the lit windows of the canal houses shine in it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Prinsengracht is empty of boats, and the water lies flat in front of a building from 1665.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on in the canal houses along the Prinsengracht.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear and Osaka Bay shows as a wide dark surface beyond the sleeping city.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches Osaka Bay, and guests in the bay-view rooms see the water bright all the way to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 30th-floor infinity pool, Osaka Bay lies bright blue under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Osaka Bay this morning, and the city skyline takes the sun in turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, sun and cloud share the afternoon over the city skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Osaka Bay turns silver-grey, and the water at the edge of the infinity pool matches it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Osaka Bay today, and the ships seem to float without a horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Osaka Bay is not visible today; guests see the nearer water and the city skyline below.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the corner suites, and guests see Osaka Bay through it as soft grey water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above Osaka Bay, and guests count the seconds to the thunder from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the city skyline, and Osaka Bay disappears behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is clear, so guests staying warm indoors can see far across Osaka Bay.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the private dining room look out at a city skyline with crisp edges.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look at Osaka Bay over its edge.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace, guests sit under the amber umbrellas on this warm day and look across the city skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns Osaka Bay gold, and the infinity pool takes the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Osaka Bay turn orange and pink, and guests in the corner suites see them on every side.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights colour the sky, and Osaka Bay is the one quiet dark area beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights blur on the glass, and Osaka Bay is lost behind them.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night under cloud, guests from the 31st floor up look down on city lights that run to the edge of Osaka Bay.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, ship lights cross Osaka Bay slowly, like small stars that lost their way.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who cannot sleep find Osaka Bay still there, calm and very quiet.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights appear across the city skyline, with Osaka Bay still pale beyond it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide grey surface under a clear sky, and only the white of the breaking waves stands out.
phrases.clear_morning: At The Deck, guests drink sunrise coffee above the breaking waves, with the Pacific Ocean clear and blue in front of them.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Pacific Ocean is bright blue, and Pismo Beach Pier runs straight out into it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pacific Ocean this morning, while Pismo Beach Pier stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Topside, the 3rd-floor deck, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean takes the same colour, and the waves draw white lines across it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Pacific Ocean today, and the far end of Pismo Beach Pier fades into it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests on the oceanfront balconies see the beach and the first waves of the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pacific Ocean, and guests watch it from the indoor dining room of The Deck, Pismo Beach Pier slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is passing over the Pacific Ocean, and guests in the beachfront rooms watch lightning brighten the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Pismo Beach, and guests stand at their windows to watch it meet the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, and the horizon of the Pacific Ocean is a sharp line.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the fire pit tables at The Deck are the place to look at the Pacific Ocean over the boardwalk.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, the Pacific Ocean shines almost white, and guests can count the swimmers in the waves below.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, walkers fill the boardwalk and Pismo Beach Pier, and the Pacific Ocean behind them is calm and blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Pacific Ocean gold, and the wet sand near Pismo Beach Pier reflects the warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: At The Deck, guests see the clouds turn cotton candy pink as the sun goes down over the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.grey_evening: After 40 years on this beach, the evening picture is the same: the Pacific Ocean going dark under cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the Pacific Ocean is hidden in the dark, and only the nearest white waves show through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: From the 3rd-floor balconies of the pier-view suites, guests see the Pacific Ocean as a dark surface under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: Under the market lights of Topside, guests look out at stars above the black Pacific Ocean.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pacific Ocean is almost invisible from the balconies, apart from the white edge of each wave.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Pacific Ocean, and the first lights come on along the boardwalk.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky turns pale over the Atlantic before sunrise, and to the south the South Beach skyline is still only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lies bright on the Atlantic, and guests in the oceanfront rooms watch the water turn from gold to blue.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests look down a long line of sand to the South Beach skyline, sharp in the south.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic this morning, while the adult pool stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the upper floors, guests follow the clouds along the coast, north to Bal Harbour and south to the South Beach skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the Atlantic turns grey-green, and the South Beach skyline is a pale row of towers to the south.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the South Beach skyline today, and from the family pool the Atlantic fades into the sky with no clear horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The South Beach skyline is not visible today; guests on the upper floors see the beach, the palms and the first stretch of the Atlantic.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the dining terrace, and beyond its stone balustrade the palms and the Atlantic turn grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning opens over the Atlantic, and for a second guests see the whole coast as far as the South Beach skyline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees by the pools, and guests look twice before they look at the Atlantic behind them.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear, and from the pools the South Beach skyline looks close enough to count its towers.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the beach loungers stay empty, and the Atlantic rolls in beyond them in long grey-blue lines.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the adult pool and look over its edge at the Atlantic, which looks cooler still.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the beach loungers look past the white umbrellas to the turquoise Atlantic.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the South Beach skyline gold, and guests in the Richard Meier tower follow the light along the coast from their balconies.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Atlantic turn pink, and the family pool below them holds the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the South Beach skyline glow to the south, and the Atlantic beside them is almost black.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain blurs the lights of the South Beach skyline, and the Atlantic can be heard more than seen.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the clouds over South Beach take a soft glow from the city, and the Atlantic moves quietly below.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests can follow the coast by its lights, from Bal Harbour in the north to the South Beach skyline in the south.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic is the only thing still moving, as it has been since the club opened here in 1930.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright over the Atlantic, and guests watch the first lights appear along the South Beach skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Cascais Bay lies quiet under a clear sky, and the first light shows the rocks below the balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: From the restaurant deck at breakfast time, Cascais Bay is calm and blue under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Cascais Bay shines blue in the midday sun, and the saltwater pool seems to continue into the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Cascais Bay this morning, and guests follow them from the reception windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sailing boats cross Cascais Bay between sun and cloud, in plain sight of the restaurant deck.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Cascais Bay takes the same colour, and the cargo ships heading for Lisbon are easy to follow.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Cascais Bay today, and from the reception guests see only the rocks and the nearest waves.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Cascais Bay is not visible today, and the Atlantic Ocean ends in a soft grey band.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Cascais Bay, and guests in the reception watch it move across the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Cascais Bay, and guests watch the storm through the wall of glass in the dining room.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rocks and melting into the Atlantic Ocean, a rare sight from the balcony rooms.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and clear over Cascais Bay, and guests choose the glass wall of the dining room to look at it.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Cascais Bay is steel blue, and guests look at it from the reception with their coats still on.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the saltwater pool and look over its edge at the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.warm: By the saltwater pool, books stay closed while guests watch sailing boats cross Cascais Bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns Cascais Bay gold, and the rocks below the restaurant deck glow a warm brown.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink over Cascais Bay, and guests in this 19th-century mansion stop to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, Cascais Bay is dark, and guests at dinner see ship lights through the dining room glass.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the dining room glass this evening, and the lights on Cascais Bay turn soft and blurred.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and only a few boat lights show where Cascais Bay is.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Cascais Bay, and guests in the sea-view rooms look at them above the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic Ocean is black, and only the white of the waves on the rocks is visible from the balconies.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Cascais Bay, and the first boat lights come on beyond the saltwater pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the CN Tower is a thin dark shape behind the Toronto skyline, under a clear sky slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Rosedale tree canopy, and guests in the higher-floor suites on that side see it at eye level.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the CN Tower rises sharp behind the Toronto skyline, each tower in front of it easy to tell apart.
phrases.partly_morning: On the treadmills in the fitness centre, guests watch cloud shadows move across city buildings and treetops this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift past the CN Tower this afternoon, and patches of sun move along the Toronto skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the Toronto skyline turns one quiet grey, and the CN Tower stands a shade darker behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken the top of the CN Tower, and guests count how many towers of the Toronto skyline are still showing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The CN Tower is not visible in today's thick air; guests see the Rosedale treetops and the nearest Yorkville towers.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Toronto skyline behind it turns soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Toronto skyline, and for a second the CN Tower stands out clearly against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Rosedale canopy, and guests in this 2012 tower watch the branches slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, the CN Tower stands sharp behind the Toronto skyline, and guests are glad to admire it from indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the fitness centre warm up on the treadmills with treetops and city buildings in front of them.
phrases.very_hot: Heat haze hangs over the Toronto skyline, while the Rosedale tree canopy stays a deep, cool-looking green.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the Rosedale side look across the green tree canopy to the Toronto skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun catches the glass of the Toronto skyline, and the CN Tower takes on the same warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds behind the CN Tower turn orange, and guests stop to look through the floor-to-ceiling windows by Architects-Alliance.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Toronto skyline glow against the low sky, and Yorkville grows quiet below.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Toronto skyline blur, and the CN Tower fades in and out of view.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the cloud hides the stars, so guests look at the lit windows of the Toronto skyline instead.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the CN Tower stands high above the lights of the Toronto skyline, with a few stars beside it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the CN Tower is a dark line behind the sleeping Toronto skyline.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on across the Toronto skyline below the CN Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear and the Sydney Opera House is a quiet outline across Circular Quay.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the Executive Club on the 32nd floor, guests look out at the Sydney Harbour Bridge under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The roof of the Sydney Opera House stands sharp against the blue harbour at midday, every curve easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Sydney Harbour Bridge this morning, and their shadows cross the harbour towards the Sydney Opera House.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Executive Club, guests watch sun and cloud take turns on the Sydney Harbour Bridge this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the harbour turns the same grey, and the Sydney Opera House looks paler above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Sydney Harbour Bridge today, and its arch looks like a pencil drawing over the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Sydney Opera House is clear across Circular Quay, but the far side of the harbour is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of the Full Harbour Suite, and the Sydney Opera House and Sydney Harbour Bridge blur behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Sydney Harbour Bridge, and guests in the 34-floor tower watch the storm cross the harbour.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Circular Quay, and the Sydney Opera House fades to a soft grey behind it.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, guests keep to the window seats and study the Sydney Opera House through the binoculars in their room.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests take a coffee in the Executive Club and watch the Sydney Harbour Bridge from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, people on Circular Quay look for shade, while the Sydney Opera House stands in full sun.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, people walk along Circular Quay towards the Sydney Opera House, small figures from this height.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Sydney Opera House in the late afternoon, and guests in the Executive Club turn their chairs towards it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and colours the steel of the Sydney Harbour Bridge orange for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs low this evening, and guests at Grain Bar keep the lit Sydney Opera House and Sydney Harbour Bridge in view.
phrases.wet_evening: In this evening's wet weather, the lights of Circular Quay spread across the glass, and the Sydney Opera House glows behind them.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lit Sydney Harbour Bridge gives the low clouds a soft glow.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Sydney Opera House is lit across Circular Quay, and from the Full Harbour Suite the Sydney Harbour Bridge shines beside it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Circular Quay is still, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge is a dark arch over the water.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays deep blue while the first lights come on in the streets below and along the Sydney Harbour Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the dome of St Peter's Basilica stands grey against it across the sleeping rooftops.
phrases.clear_morning: In clear morning light, guests on the 7th-floor terrace can pick out St Peter's Basilica, the Pantheon and the trees of Villa Borghese.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Spanish Steps lie bright in the sun, and the sky above St Peter's Basilica is blue from edge to edge.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Rome this morning, and their shadows move across the rooftops between the Spanish Steps and St Peter's Basilica.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace of the San Pietro Presidential Suite, guests watch afternoon clouds pass behind St Peter's Basilica and the Altar of the Fatherland.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the dome of St Peter's Basilica keeps its outline, and the Spanish Steps look paler than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over Rome today, and from the 7th-floor terrace St Peter's Basilica looks like a soft drawing of itself.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: St Peter's Basilica is missing from the skyline, but the Spanish Steps and the twin domes of Trinità dei Monti church remain clear.
phrases.rain: Rain darkens the stone of the Spanish Steps, and guests in the rooms facing them watch it from behind dry windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses Rome, and guests watch each flash of lightning show the dome of St Peter's Basilica for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the terrace of the Villa Medici Penthouse, and the twin domes of Trinità dei Monti church slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing, clear air, every dome between the Spanish Steps and St Peter's Basilica has a sharp edge today.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the 7th-floor terrace is quiet, and the Pantheon and the trees of Villa Borghese stand clear beyond it.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat the Spanish Steps shine almost white, and guests on the 7th-floor terrace look for shade before they look for St Peter's Basilica.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests stay long on the 7th-floor terrace with a cocktail, looking from the green of Villa Borghese to the dome of St Peter's Basilica.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Spanish Steps and the rooftops around them the colour of honey, as far as St Peter's Basilica.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests on the terrace of the Trinità dei Monti Presidential Suite see the church glow pink under broken cloud, almost within reach.
phrases.grey_evening: At Imàgo on the 6th floor, dinner guests look over the lights of Rome under a cloudy sky, with the lit dome of St Peter's Basilica among them.
phrases.wet_evening: The wet Spanish Steps reflect the street lamps this evening, and the lights of Via Condotti shine beyond them in the rain.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the lights of Rome spread out from the 7th-floor terrace, and the clouds above St Peter's Basilica glow a little from the city.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lit dome of St Peter's Basilica stands on the horizon beyond Piazza di Spagna and its bright streets.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Spanish Steps are empty at last, and the city beyond them is quiet under the night sky.
phrases.dusk: Since 1890 dusk has looked like this from the top of the Spanish Steps: a bright sky, the first lights, and St Peter's Basilica still easy to find.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Bosphorus Strait lies still under a clear sky, and the 200-metre terrace is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From their private terraces, guests in the Palace Bosphorus rooms see the 15 July Martyrs Bridge in the first clear light over the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.clear_midday: The marble infinity pool mirrors the Bosphorus Strait at midday, blue above blue under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Bosphorus Strait this morning, seen from the waterside terrace where breakfast is served.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the Bosphorus Strait this afternoon, and the Asian shore changes colour each time.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Bosphorus Strait turns the colour of pewter along the whole terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Bosphorus Strait today, and the Asian shore looks like a faint watercolour behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far shore of the Bosphorus Strait is not visible today; from the terrace, only the water close by can be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Bosphorus Strait, and guests watch it through the arched windows of their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Bosphorus Strait, and guests stay behind the arched windows to watch lightning above the Asian shore.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Bosphorus Strait, and guests in this 19th-century Ottoman palace watch the Asian shore turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, and every wave on the Bosphorus Strait looks sharp.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Bosphorus Strait looks steel blue beyond the edge of the marble infinity pool.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay under the red-and-white striped umbrellas by the outdoor pool and look at the cooler Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.warm: By the marble infinity pool, guests leave their books closed and look at the Bosphorus Strait on this warm day.
