phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Bosphorus Strait gold, and the Asian shore glows in the afternoon light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Bosphorus Strait turn pink, almost the colour of the palace walls.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, city lights show across the Bosphorus Strait from the waterfront terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the city lights across the Bosphorus Strait tonight, and guests watch from their rooms.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Bosphorus Strait carries long reflections from the lights on the Asian shore.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of the Asian shore shine sharply across the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Bosphorus Strait is a wide, quiet band of dark water beside the palace.
phrases.dusk: At dusk the sky is still bright over the Bosphorus Strait, and the first lights appear across the water from the waterfront terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over the Spanish Steps, and the Sallustiano Obelisk stands dark at the top.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of the Spanish Steps first, then moves down towards Piazza di Spagna.
phrases.clear_midday: From the two panoramic terraces, guests see the Spanish Steps in full midday light under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Piazza di Spagna this morning, while Trinità dei Monti stays bright at the top of the steps.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the panoramic terraces, guests see clouds drift over the rooftops of Rome this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the ochre buildings beside the Spanish Steps keep their warm colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Trinità dei Monti today, and the Sallustiano Obelisk looks like a pencil line in front of it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far rooftops of Rome are not visible from the panoramic terraces today, yet the Spanish Steps remain clear and close.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the Spanish Steps, and guests in the rooms facing Piazza di Spagna watch the square shine with water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Trinità dei Monti for a second, then the storm closes over the Spanish Steps again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Spanish Steps, and guests watch from their windows as each step turns white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Spanish Steps look sharp and clean, and every step is easy to count from here.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look at the Spanish Steps from the rooms facing Piazza di Spagna, behind warm glass.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, the Spanish Steps turn almost white, and people in Piazza di Spagna look for the shade.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the panoramic terraces watch people climb the Spanish Steps slowly, in no hurry at all.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the panoramic terraces, guests watch the low sun turn the rooftops of Rome gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and catches Trinità dei Monti, while the Spanish Steps below fall into shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests see the lamps of Piazza di Spagna shining at the foot of the Spanish Steps.
phrases.wet_evening: The wet Spanish Steps shine under the street lamps tonight, and guests follow the rain from their windows.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Spanish Steps rise from Piazza di Spagna towards Trinità dei Monti, in front of this 19th-century residence.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the city lights spread across the rooftops of Rome from the terrace overlooking the Spanish Steps.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Spanish Steps are finally empty, and guests still awake have them all to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright above Trinità dei Monti, and the first lights come on along the Spanish Steps.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky turns pale behind Osorno Volcano, and Lake Llanquihue below is still and grey.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast, guests look over Lake Llanquihue in clear morning light, with Osorno Volcano on the far shore.
phrases.clear_midday: Lunch at Mirador del Lago has the bay of Puerto Varas under the windows and Osorno Volcano clear across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past Osorno Volcano this morning, and their shadows move slowly across Lake Llanquihue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the private hot tub, Lake Llanquihue is blue where the sun reaches it this afternoon and grey under the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Lake Llanquihue fills the view alone, since low cloud covers Osorno Volcano.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far shore today, so Lake Llanquihue seems to have no end beyond the rooftops of Puerto Varas.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Osorno Volcano is not visible today; guests in the 6th-floor bar and cafeteria see only the near waters of Lake Llanquihue.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Lake Llanquihue, and guests watch it from the heated indoor pool through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Lake Llanquihue, and guests follow the storm from their room windows on the hill.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Puerto Varas, and Lake Llanquihue shows dark grey between the white rooftops below.
phrases.very_cold: Osorno Volcano stands white and sharp in the freezing air, while guests in the heated indoor pool look at Lake Llanquihue over the rooftops.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests keep to the 6th-floor bar and cafeteria, with coffee, kuchen and Lake Llanquihue in the windows.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on Terraza Ailén choose the shade and look out at Lake Llanquihue, bright under the sun.
phrases.warm: A warm day brings guests out to Terraza Ailén, where Lake Llanquihue lies blue beyond the grill.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the snow on Osorno Volcano gold, and in the 6th-floor bar and cafeteria guests put down their glasses to look at Lake Llanquihue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and colours Lake Llanquihue pink and orange for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Puerto Varas curve around the bay, and Lake Llanquihue is dark beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows at Mirador del Lago tonight, and the lights along the bay are blurred.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests looking from the lake-view rooms see the lights of Puerto Varas reflected in the bay.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over Lake Llanquihue, and Osorno Volcano is a faint cone across the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Llanquihue lies quiet below the hill, and guests in this hotel, family-run since 1980, mostly sleep through it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright above Osorno Volcano while the first lights come on around Lake Llanquihue.

phrases.clear_predawn: Early risers look for the dark shape of Mount Agung before the sun is up.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests start the day with Mount Agung in full, clear view.
phrases.clear_midday: High above Candidasa Bay, the view runs clear to Mount Agung in the midday light.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests watch Mount Agung come and go between the morning clouds.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns on Mount Agung this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Mount Agung stands grey and quiet today, seen from the cliff above Candidasa Bay.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze turns Mount Agung into a pale outline today.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The view from the cliff stops short today, and Mount Agung is not visible.
phrases.rain: Guests watch the rain come down where Mount Agung usually stands.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm has taken Mount Agung out of the view for now.
phrases.snow: Snow in Bali keeps guests inside, looking for Mount Agung through the white.
phrases.very_cold: From inside, guests have a sharp view of Mount Agung on this freezing day.
phrases.cold: It is a day for staying inside, with Mount Agung still there to look at.
phrases.very_hot: Guests out on the cliff move slowly today, and Mount Agung does not move at all.
phrases.warm: Perched above the waters of Candidasa Bay, guests sit outside facing Mount Agung.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the colour of Mount Agung in the last hours of the day.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lands on Mount Agung.
phrases.grey_evening: After sunset, guests can just make out Mount Agung as a darker shape under the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain this evening hides Mount Agung, and guests listen to it instead.
phrases.mild_night: Mount Agung is somewhere out in the cloudy dark tonight.
phrases.clear_night: Against the clear night, the outline of Mount Agung is easy to follow from the cliff.
phrases.late_night: The cliff is quiet above Candidasa Bay, and Mount Agung waits in the dark for morning.
phrases.dusk: The view holds its light a few minutes after sunset, with Mount Agung turning dark in front of it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sydney Harbour Bridge is a dark arch against a sky that slowly turns pale over Lavender Bay.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in LB’s Restaurant, guests look through the tall windows at the Sydney Harbour Bridge under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The midday sun lights every steel beam of the Sydney Harbour Bridge, and Lavender Bay is bright blue below it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Lavender Bay this morning, while the Sydney Harbour Bridge stays in sunshine above the moored boats.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Deck 17, guests watch the afternoon clouds drift over the harbour and behind the arch of the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Sydney Harbour Bridge looks darker, and the water of Lavender Bay takes the colour of the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Sydney Harbour Bridge today, and the city skyline behind it is only a row of faint towers.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the city skyline is missing, but the Sydney Harbour Bridge still shows above Lavender Bay.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lavender Bay; guests in LB’s Restaurant watch it through the tall windows, the Sydney Harbour Bridge slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the harbour, and for a second the whole arch of the Sydney Harbour Bridge stands out against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Lavender Bay, and guests in the Harbour View Suites watch the Sydney Harbour Bridge turn white at the edges.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, the Sydney Harbour Bridge looks sharp, and guests stay behind the glass at LB’s Restaurant to look at it.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the bridge-facing rooms sit at the table by the window and look out to the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.very_hot: The harbour shines in the strong heat, and guests on Deck 17 choose a seat in the shade facing the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests take their cocktails outside to Deck 17, where the harbour and the Sydney Harbour Bridge lie below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the steel of the Sydney Harbour Bridge gold, and guests on Deck 17 put their phones down to watch.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink and orange behind the Sydney Harbour Bridge, and the boats in Lavender Bay glow for a moment.
phrases.grey_evening: The lit arch of the Sydney Harbour Bridge glows under low cloud this evening, in front of guests at dinner in LB’s Restaurant.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Sydney Harbour Bridge run down the windows of LB’s Restaurant with the raindrops.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, so the lit Sydney Harbour Bridge and the city skyline are the brightest things in sight.
phrases.clear_night: From the Harbour View Suites on the highest floors, guests see the lit Sydney Harbour Bridge and the city lights under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the harbour is quiet, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge keeps its place above the still water of Lavender Bay.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the bridge-facing rooms guests see the first lights come on along the Sydney Harbour Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the towers of the Melbourne skyline stand still against a sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the glass towers of the Melbourne skyline first, then moves down to the Yarra River.
phrases.clear_midday: From Grand Club on the 31st floor, guests turn a full circle and find the Melbourne skyline clear on every side.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Yarra River this morning, while the Arts Centre spire stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the corner window of the Diplomatic Suite, guests follow the clouds from the Arts Centre spire to the Melbourne skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Yarra River turns the colour of the cloud, and the Arts Centre spire stands pale above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Melbourne skyline today, and each row of towers is a little fainter than the one in front.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far edge of the Melbourne skyline is not visible today; guests in Grand Club see the nearer towers and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Yarra River, and the Melbourne skyline turns grey and soft behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows every tower of the Melbourne skyline for a second, and guests in Grand Club wait for the next flash.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Melbourne skyline, and guests in Grand Club watch the tower tops disappear into white.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air makes the Melbourne skyline sharp today, every tower edge clear against the sky.
phrases.cold: The Yarra River looks cold today even from indoors, a steel-coloured band below the Arts Centre spire.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Melbourne skyline, and guests are happy to study it from the cool side of the glass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the Yarra River shines in the light, and guests in the Diplomatic Suite keep the curtains wide open.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass towers of the Melbourne skyline gold, and the Yarra River carries the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights the Arts Centre spire, while the rest of the Melbourne skyline waits in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: With cocktails and canapés in Grand Club on the 31st floor, guests look over the lit Melbourne skyline under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lit towers this evening, and the Melbourne skyline shines twice, once in the air and once on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds over the city glow faintly tonight, and the lit Arts Centre spire stands out above the Yarra River.
phrases.clear_night: From the soaking tub beside the floor-to-ceiling windows, guests look at the lit Melbourne skyline under a clear night sky, and nobody hurries the bath.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Melbourne skyline is quiet, and the Yarra River moves through the city almost unseen.
phrases.dusk: By the fireplace in the lounge bar, guests watch the first lights come on across the Melbourne skyline under a still-bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Niagara Falls is a pale band of moving water under a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Niagara Falls, and the spray rises white into a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From Fallsview Rooftop Pool & Bar, guests see Niagara Falls under a clear midday sky, every edge of the water sharp.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Niagara Falls this morning, and guests in the falls-view corner suites watch the water change from grey to white.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the infinity hydrotherapy tub at Christienne Fallsview Spa look out at both parts of Niagara Falls while clouds drift over them this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Niagara Falls stays white under a flat grey sky, and it is only across the street.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of Niagara Falls today, and guests are left guessing where the spray ends and the fog begins.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today; guests can see the near edge of Niagara Falls, but the far side of the water is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass, and guests joke that the spray from Niagara Falls has finally come through the window.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Niagara Falls, and for a second guests at the windows see the whole white wall of water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Niagara Falls, and guests watch the flakes disappear into the rising spray.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the spray from Niagara Falls stands in a tall white column in the clear air, and guests are glad of the glass.
phrases.cold: From a soaking tub beside a wide window, guests look at Niagara Falls and the Niagara River gorge on a cold day.
phrases.very_hot: At Fallsview Rooftop Pool & Bar, guests stay in the water on this very hot day and look across at Niagara Falls.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, the lounge chairs at Fallsview Rooftop Pool & Bar fill up, and guests look at Niagara Falls over their closed books.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the spray over Niagara Falls gold, and guests open their Juliette balcony doors to hear the water too.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over Niagara Falls turn pink above Fallsview Rooftop Pool & Bar, and the water takes some of the colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Through the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows, guests see Niagara Falls lit against a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in this 669-room hotel watch the wet evening from indoors, with the lights around Niagara Falls blurred by rain on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the falls-view corner suites still see the white of Niagara Falls from bed.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Niagara Falls tonight, and the spray below them drifts up like slow smoke.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Niagara Falls keeps moving in the dark, a pale shape that never stops for the night.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, Niagara Falls sits in blue evening light, and the first lights come on around it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests on the oceanfront balconies see the Atlantic change slowly from black to deep blue.
phrases.clear_morning: In the fitness center, guests start their workout facing a bright blue Atlantic under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic is a wide, even blue at midday, and the horizon is a sharp line from end to end.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic this morning, and the water changes from green to blue as they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace, the afternoon clouds drift out over the Atlantic and leave long patches of sunlit water between them.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky the Atlantic turns grey, and the waves show as white lines from the fitness center.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic seems to fade into the sky without an edge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the nearest waves are clear, but the far Atlantic and the horizon cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the fitness center windows, and guests watch a grey Atlantic through the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic, and for a second each time the whole dark ocean shows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach, and the flakes vanish as soon as they touch the Atlantic waves.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, bright day, guests enjoy a sharp dark-blue Atlantic from the warm side of the fitness center glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Atlantic is steel blue, and the waves break on an empty beach.
phrases.very_hot: The heat makes the air shimmer above the Atlantic, and guests on the balconies stay in the shade to look at it.
phrases.warm: On this warm day the Atlantic is calm and green-blue, and guests on the terrace take their time looking at it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the colour of the Atlantic, and guests on the high-floor balconies watch the blue deepen.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Atlantic turn pink and orange, and the water copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: From the terrace with its fireplace, the Atlantic this cloudy evening is a wide dark surface crossed by white surf.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Atlantic this evening, and only the white foam of the nearest waves shows through it.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky the Atlantic is nearly black, and the surf marks where the water begins.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the Atlantic tonight, and the horizon is only just visible between sky and water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Atlantic keeps moving below the balconies, and guests who cannot sleep have something calm to look at.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky above the Atlantic is still bright, and the water holds a blue-pink light.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests in the Panoramic Ocean Villa see the Indian Ocean as a dark line under the first pale light.
phrases.clear_morning: The tropical garden is in full sun, and guests in the Garden Villa open their doors to it.
phrases.clear_midday: At Akasa Restaurant & Bar, lunch guests look out over an ocean that is blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows slide across the tropical garden while the Indian Ocean stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Ocean Villa, guests follow patches of sun and shade moving over the ocean vistas.
phrases.overcast: The Indian Ocean lies grey under the cloud today, and the tropical garden looks greener for it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the panoramic coastline today, and guests in the Sunset Villa with Private Pool see it fade pale into the distance.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From Maja Sunset Lounge the Indian Ocean shows only its nearer waves today, the horizon lost in the thick air.
phrases.rain: Rain drums on the tropical garden, and guests in the garden-facing rooms watch the drops make rings on the garden creek.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Indian Ocean white for a second to guests safe inside the Two Bedroom Oceanfront Villa with Private Pool.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the tropical garden, and guests in the Two Bedroom Garden Villa stay indoors to watch the verdant gardens turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The Indian Ocean is sharp and blue in the freezing air, and guests in the Panoramic Ocean Villa admire it from under a blanket.
phrases.cold: Guests in the Two Bedroom Oceanfront Villa with Private Pool stay indoors today and look out at the Indian Ocean through the glass.
phrases.very_hot: Guests at the Sunset Villa with Private Pool stay in the water up to their chins, with the panoramic coastline in front of them.
phrases.warm: Doors stand open at the Two Bedroom Garden Villa, and guests sit outside facing the verdant gardens.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Seats at Maja Sunset Lounge fill up as the Indian Ocean turns gold.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests in the Sunset Villa with Private Pool watch the sunset arrive in pieces between the clouds over the panoramic coastline.
phrases.grey_evening: At Akasa Restaurant & Bar, guests have dinner facing a dark ocean with no stars above it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain is falling on the tropical garden this evening, and the garden-facing rooms look out on a garden creek running full.
phrases.mild_night: The Garden Villa looks out on a tropical garden of soft dark shapes tonight.
phrases.clear_night: From the Ocean Villa, the ocean is a wide dark space tonight with stars above it.
phrases.late_night: The tropical garden is dark and still in the small hours, and only the Indian Ocean beyond it keeps moving.
phrases.dusk: A last band of light lies on the Indian Ocean in front of Maja Sunset Lounge, a few minutes after sunset.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Copenhagen Harbour lies still and dark blue under a clear sky, with no boats moving yet.
phrases.clear_morning: At The Harbour Breakfast Restaurant, guests eat breakfast while the first boats cross Copenhagen Harbour in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Copenhagen Harbour is bright blue, and boats pass close to the harbour-facing balconies.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the city's rooftops this morning, and their shadows cross Copenhagen Harbour one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the fitness center, guests look through floor-to-ceiling windows at city buildings in changing sun and shade.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Copenhagen Harbour takes the same colour, and the glass buildings on the canal lose their shine.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Islands Brygge on the opposite side of the canal, and the boats look like pencil marks on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The city's rooftops are not visible today; guests see the harbour water near the island and little beyond it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Copenhagen Harbour, and guests in the 331 rooms watch the drops make small rings on the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the city's rooftops for a second, and then thunder rolls across the dark water of Copenhagen Harbour.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Copenhagen Harbour, and each flake disappears as soon as it touches the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Copenhagen Harbour looks sharp and clear, and guests admire the harbour bath from behind glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, only a few boats cross Copenhagen Harbour, and the water around the island stays grey and quiet.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the balconies look at swimmers in the harbour bath with some envy.
phrases.warm: From the balconies, guests watch swimmers in the harbour bath and small boats heading for the canals on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun turns the glass buildings along the canal to orange, and the water of Copenhagen Harbour copies them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the city's rooftops turn pink, and so does the harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Islands Brygge shine across the canal and stretch in long lines on the water.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights blur across Copenhagen Harbour, and the water breaks them into small pieces.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and the sky is covered, and the city lights give the low clouds a soft glow above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, stars stand above Copenhagen Harbour, and the city lights lie on the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the water around the island is black, and Islands Brygge is quiet on the opposite side of the canal.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Islands Brygge across the canal.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Arabian Gulf is a still, dark sheet around the island, and the sky above it is just starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun turns the Arabian Gulf turquoise along the private beach, with no mainland anywhere on the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: From the overwater villas, guests look straight down into the Arabian Gulf, bright and clear under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows drift across the Arabian Gulf this morning, and from the padel court the sea beyond changes from turquoise to deep blue and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the floating villas turn in a full circle this afternoon and find the Arabian Gulf under patchy cloud on every side.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Arabian Gulf turns silver, and the white sand of the private beach is the brightest thing in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the line between sea and sky today, so the Arabian Gulf seems to continue upward into the air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; from the balcony rooms, guests see the Arabian Gulf for a short distance before it fades into pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Arabian Gulf; guests at Anantara Spa watch it through the large windows of a treatment room.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning strikes far out over the Arabian Gulf, and guests watch each flash light up the open water from indoors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Arabian Gulf, and guests on this 13-hectare island watch the flakes vanish into the water.
phrases.very_cold: In very cold, clear air, guests see the horizon of the Arabian Gulf as a sharp edge all around the island.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the private beach is empty, and the Arabian Gulf has the 800 m of golden shoreline to itself.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the lagoon pool and look across the white sand to the overwater villas standing in the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.warm: At the surf pool, guests waiting for their turn look past the wave to the sandy beach and the turquoise Arabian Gulf.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Arabian Gulf gold, and from the overwater pool terrace the infinity pool seems to run straight into the sea.
phrases.partly_golden: From the private beach, the last sun slips between clouds and lays an orange path across the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and guests looking out from the island see the Arabian Gulf as a wide darkness with no city lights in it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Arabian Gulf this evening, and guests see only the nearest stretch of wet sea before the dark takes the rest.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the Arabian Gulf and the sky are the same soft black, and guests find the shoreline only by its pale sand.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Arabian Gulf tonight, with no skyline to compete with them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Arabian Gulf lies quiet around the island, and the only thing moving is the water against the beach.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Arabian Gulf, and the first lanterns come on along the overwater villas.

phrases.clear_predawn: Daylight has not yet reached the sandy beach, a pale strip beside a still-dark ocean.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Private beach, the cerulean gulf shows its full colour this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests in the Harmony Oceanfront Master Suite look out at a blue ocean that meets the horizon in one sharp line.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the sandy beach this morning, one at a time, on their way out to the ocean.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The ocean is two colours this afternoon, bright where the sun reaches it and darker under the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under full cloud, the sandy beach and the ocean seen from the Main family swimming pool share one soft grey tone.
phrases.fog_haze: From the Harmony Oceanfront Master Suite, guests see the ocean turn pale and fade into today's haze.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The sandy beach is easy to see today, but the ocean beyond it disappears into pale air after a short distance.
phrases.rain: Small dots of rain cover the sandy beach, and the ocean behind it has turned grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Gulf shows the whole ocean for a moment, then thunder rolls in across the sandy beach.
phrases.snow: Guests in the Fitness center watch snow come down on the hotel gardens today.
phrases.very_cold: From the Harmony Oceanfront Master Suite, guests keep indoors and watch small waves cross a bright ocean.
phrases.cold: The ocean rolls slowly onto a quiet sandy beach today.
phrases.very_hot: At the Main family swimming pool, guests stay in the water up to their shoulders and look across the sandy beach to the ocean.
phrases.warm: On the Private beach, guests walk slowly into the cerulean gulf, and nobody seems in a hurry to come out.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Seen from the pool, the sandy beach turns the colour of honey while the ocean behind it takes on gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and lays strips of gold on the ocean.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening of cloud, the ocean is dark and the sandy beach is a pale line beside it.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Harmony Oceanfront Master Suite watch this evening's rain fall on a dark ocean.
phrases.clear_night: The ocean is fully dark tonight, with only the white edges of its waves showing where the sandy beach begins.
phrases.late_night: The sandy beach has the small hours to itself, and the ocean keeps moving in the dark.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the ocean still holds some light from the sky while the sandy beach begins to darken.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky over the Strip is clear, and the first pale light grows above the towers.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Strip, and from the terrace suites guests look directly across at the Bellagio fountains.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Boulevard Pool on the 14th floor, the Strip runs below under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly along the Strip this morning, and the Bellagio fountains go in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Boulevard Pool this afternoon, guests look along the Strip under white clouds with wide blue gaps between them.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the Strip today, and the water of the Bellagio fountains takes the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Strip today, and guests can count the far hotels as they fade one by one into the pale air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The mountains behind the Strip are not visible today, while the Bellagio fountains directly across remain clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Strip; guests watch it from their suite windows, the Bellagio fountains slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests see lightning flash above the Strip, and for a second every tower stands out against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Strip, and guests in the terrace suites watch the flakes pass their balconies toward the Bellagio fountains.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, every building along the Strip has sharp edges.
phrases.cold: Cold air sits over the Strip today, and the Bellagio fountains go on with their choreography as if nobody told them.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests at the Boulevard Pool stay in the water and look out at the Strip from there.
phrases.warm: On the wrap-around balconies of the terrace suites, guests sit outside in the warm air, eye level with the Bellagio fountains.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the towers of the Strip gold, and the Bellagio fountains shine in the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds above the Strip, and from the Boulevard Pool the Paris tower stands out against them.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hang low over the Strip this evening and take on the colour of its lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of the restaurant, guests watch the lit Bellagio fountains through this wet evening.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Strip stays bright below the Boulevard Pool.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests look along the Strip as one long line of lights, with the Bellagio fountains lit directly across.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Strip finally slows down, and the Bellagio fountains take their rest.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests see the first lights come on along the Strip and around the Bellagio fountains.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear and the Pacific Ocean slowly turns from black to deep blue below the main terrace.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the Mediterranean Room, guests look out at the Pacific Ocean, blue and sharp under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Pacific Ocean lies bright blue to the horizon at midday, and the whole curve of La Jolla Cove is easy to follow from the main terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across La Jolla Cove this morning, while the Pacific Ocean behind it stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lounge, guests see palm trees and the Pacific Ocean framed in a tiled window, with white clouds crossing the afternoon sky.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pacific Ocean turns silver, and the cliffs of La Jolla Cove stand out clearly from the main terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Pacific Ocean today, and from the pool the palm trees are clear while the horizon is gone.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; the main terrace shows La Jolla Cove and only the nearest part of the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on La Jolla Cove, and guests in the Mediterranean Room watch it draw grey lines across the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the Sky Suite on the 10th floor, guests watch lightning over the Pacific Ocean in a wide sweep of stormy sky.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over La Jolla Cove, and guests at the terrace doors watch the flakes disappear into the grey Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear today, and from the ocean-facing rooms the horizon of the Pacific Ocean looks like a ruled line.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the lounge windows and look past the palm trees to the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the pool, added in 1950, and look from the water straight out to the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.warm: At Cabana Bar, guests sit under the palms with a frozen cocktail and look past the pool to the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on La Jolla Cove in the late afternoon, and guests in The Whaling Bar start their first drink with the Pacific Ocean still bright.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and paints the Pacific Ocean orange and pink below the ocean-view villas.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in the Mediterranean Room, the cloudy evening sky and the Pacific Ocean have become one deep grey.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows this evening, and La Jolla Cove shows only as a dark shape beyond the wet palm trees.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the night sky, and from the main terrace the Pacific Ocean shows only in the white lines of waves in La Jolla Cove.
phrases.clear_night: From the bay window of the Pacific Suite, guests see stars over the Pacific Ocean on this clear night.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, La Jolla Cove is still, and the Pacific Ocean beyond it is one wide dark surface under the night sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Pacific Ocean is still bright, and the first lights come on around La Jolla Cove.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Río de la Plata is a wide dark surface beyond Puerto Madero, and the sky above it is just starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun crosses the Río de la Plata and reaches the green Ecological Reserve first, then the towers of Puerto Madero.
phrases.clear_midday: From the indoor pool on the 19th floor, guests look through the glass wall at the city skyline and the river under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Ecological Reserve this morning, while the Río de la Plata behind it stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the river view suites watch clouds drift over the Río de la Plata this afternoon, with patches of sun on the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Río de la Plata and the clouds are almost the same colour, and the Ecological Reserve is a strip of green between them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Puerto Madero today, and the Río de la Plata fades into the sky with no clear edge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so guests see the Puerto Madero docks and the near side of the Ecological Reserve, but not the river beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the large windows of Kayla Restaurant on the 31st floor, and the city skyline behind them is blurred and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Río de la Plata, and guests in the spa watch the storm through the glass wall on the 19th and 20th floors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Puerto Madero, and guests stand at their windows to watch it settle on the Ecological Reserve.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear today, and from the heated indoor pool the city skyline looks sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay in the warm spa and look down at the city and the Río de la Plata from the 19th floor.
phrases.very_hot: By the outdoor pool, guests stay in the water in this heat and look across at the docks of Puerto Madero.
phrases.warm: The outdoor pool is busy on this warm day, and swimmers rest at the edge to look at the Puerto Madero docks.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Crystal Bar on the 32nd floor, guests watch the low sun turn the city skyline gold while the Ecological Reserve falls into shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the city turn orange, and guests at Crystal Bar look from the skyline to the river and back.
phrases.grey_evening: The lights of Puerto Madero glow under a cloudy evening sky, and guests in Kayla Restaurant look out at them through the large windows.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the city lights spread and shine in the rain on the windows of Crystal Bar, 32 floors above Puerto Madero.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, the clouds over Buenos Aires hold a soft glow from the city, and the Ecological Reserve is a wide dark space beside the lit streets.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests at Crystal Bar see the bright city on one side and the dark Río de la Plata on the other.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Puerto Madero is quiet below the windows, and the Río de la Plata cannot be told from the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Río de la Plata is still bright, and the first lights come on along the Puerto Madero docks.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean is a wide, dark surface under a clear sky, and the shoreline is just starting to show.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests step onto their private balconies this clear morning and find the Atlantic shoreline running out of sight in both directions.
phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic Ocean is bright blue at midday, and every wave on the shoreline below is easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Atlantic Ocean this morning, while the beach stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon clouds gather and part over the Atlantic Ocean, and the water changes from blue to grey and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns the color of steel, and the white surf marks where the beach begins.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic Ocean and the sky look like one soft sheet beyond the beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the far ends of the shoreline are not visible, and only the nearest stretch of beach and surf is clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic Ocean; guests watch it from oceanfront balconies, the shoreline blurred at both ends.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and for a second the whole shoreline shows white before the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach, and guests look through their balcony doors at flakes disappearing into the Atlantic surf.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the horizon of the Atlantic Ocean looks sharp enough to cut paper.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the wide beach lies empty, and the Atlantic waves have the shoreline to themselves.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool and look over the sand to the Atlantic Ocean, which shimmers in the sun.
phrases.warm: On the oceanfront pool deck, drinks get warm while guests look at the beach and the Atlantic waves instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the beach gold, and from the outdoor pool the Atlantic Ocean looks deep blue behind it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colors the clouds pink over the Atlantic Ocean, and the wet sand along the shoreline copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and the lights along the shoreline show where the beach ends and the dark Atlantic begins.
phrases.wet_evening: This wet evening, the Atlantic Ocean is heard more than seen, with only the nearest white surf showing through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Atlantic Ocean is one dark field, and the surf draws a pale line along the beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and guests on balconies as high as the 15th floor have them almost at eye level.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the beach is quiet, and the Atlantic Ocean keeps moving in the dark, wave after wave.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright above the Atlantic Ocean, and the first lights come on along the Myrtle Beach shoreline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Seneca Lake lies still and grey-blue below the hill under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is served on the wrap-around porch this clear morning, with Seneca Lake bright below the table.
phrases.clear_midday: Seneca Lake is a strong blue at midday, and its southern tip is easy to follow from the wrap-around porch.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Seneca Lake this morning, while the lawn and formal gardens stay mostly in sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon clouds drift over the grand lawn towards Seneca Lake, and the water below the hill turns from blue to silver and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Seneca Lake takes the same colour, and the wooded hills around it turn a darker green.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Seneca Lake today, and the far wooded hills fade into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of Seneca Lake is not visible today; from the wrap-around porch, only the water closest to the hill shows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Seneca Lake, and guests watch it from the sunrooms, the water marked with small rings.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay in the sunrooms while lightning flashes over Seneca Lake and thunder rolls across the wooded hills.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the lawn and the formal gardens, and Seneca Lake shows only as a grey band behind it.
phrases.very_cold: From the turret room, guests look down on a sharp, steel-blue Seneca Lake in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the sunrooms look over the bare gardens to Seneca Lake below.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests keep to the shade of the wrap-around porch and look down at the cool water of Seneca Lake.
phrases.warm: On the lawn, books stay closed while guests look down the hill at Seneca Lake instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light crosses the lawn and the gazebo, and Seneca Lake shines below this 1892 summer house.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink and orange, and Seneca Lake glows beyond the trees.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, Seneca Lake is a dark sheet below the hill, and the lit gazebo glows on the lawn.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, Seneca Lake is lost in the dark below the hill, and the wet lawn shines in the lights of the house.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests look out from lake-view rooms at a wide, dark Seneca Lake under a starless sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over Seneca Lake tonight, and the water below the hill holds a faint shine.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, nothing moves on Seneca Lake, and the hill above it is quiet.
phrases.dusk: With no television in any of the 15 rooms, guests watch the last light leave Seneca Lake instead.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before the sun is up, the Chicago Skyline shows as dark towers against a slowly paling sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Early risers find the Chicago Skyline sharp-edged in the first sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Chicago Skyline stands clear from its nearest tower to its farthest.
phrases.partly_morning: This morning the clouds put one part of the city in sun and the next in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sunlight moves from building to building along the Chicago Skyline as the clouds drift through the afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the city today, and the towers of the Chicago Skyline look almost the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers most of the Chicago Skyline, and guests wait to see which tower appears again first.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the nearer city blocks are easy to see but the far towers are not.
phrases.rain: Rain blurs the Chicago Skyline into soft grey shapes, one tower running into the next.
phrases.thunderstorm: Storm clouds sit low on the city, and guests count the seconds between flash and thunder.
phrases.snow: Guests stay warm indoors while the city's roofs turn white one by one under the snow.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay behind the glass today and look out at a Chicago Skyline with very clean edges.
phrases.cold: On a day this cool, guests stay inside and take their time over the wide view of the city.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the Chicago Skyline looks a little pale, and guests are in no hurry to go out.
phrases.warm: The city spreads out bright and busy below the towers, a day made for leaving the jacket behind.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late in the afternoon, the low sun turns the towers of the Chicago Skyline gold.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests watch the clouds turn pink behind the towers while the city below slips into shade.
phrases.grey_evening: After dark the cloud hangs low over the Chicago Skyline, and guests look out at the city lights below it.
phrases.wet_evening: Through tonight's rain, the lights of the city look soft and a little blurred.
phrases.mild_night: Guests leave the curtains open tonight and let the Chicago Skyline be the night light.
phrases.clear_night: Nothing hides the Chicago Skyline tonight, each tower standing clear against the dark.
phrases.late_night: Even the city is nearly asleep now, its streets almost empty under the dark towers.
phrases.dusk: Guests catch the short moment when the Chicago Skyline is lit and the sky behind it has not gone dark yet.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Taormina Bay lies still and grey-blue between the two wooded headlands, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the terrace looks over Taormina Bay, where the morning sun lights the water under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the water of Taormina Bay turns bright blue directly below the balconies.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Taormina Bay this morning, and the two limestone headlands go from bright to dim and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The pool terrace looks at Taormina Bay between its two headlands this afternoon, with white clouds moving above them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, guests see Taormina Bay take the colour of slate, with the wooded headlands a darker green on each side.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Taormina Bay today, and from the terrace of Almarè Bar the far headland looks like a faint pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The open sea beyond Taormina Bay is not visible today; guests see the near water and the two headlands, and little past them.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of Taormina Bay with small rings, and guests watch them from behind the balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls between the headlands, and lightning shows Taormina Bay in white for a second before the rain hides it again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Taormina Bay, and guests watch the flakes vanish as they touch the water between the two headlands.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear over Taormina Bay, and every tree on the limestone headlands stands out sharply.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the panoramic terrace of Armònia looks over a calm Taormina Bay under a pale sky.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests lie on the private beach and look at the rocky islet across the still water of Taormina Bay.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests float in the pool and look past its edge at Taormina Bay between the two headlands.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Almarè Bar, guests hold a cocktail and watch the low sun turn the limestone headlands gold above Taormina Bay.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Taormina Bay turn pink, and the water below the balconies copies them as well as it can.
phrases.grey_evening: At BLUM, the tables stand over the water, and guests look at Taormina Bay turning dark under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Taormina Bay this evening, and the shore lights stretch into long blurred lines on the water.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds cover the stars, and Taormina Bay shows only the reflections of the lights around it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the two headlands tonight, and guests on their balconies hear Taormina Bay more than they see it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Taormina Bay is quiet and almost black, and the two headlands are only darker shapes beside it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Taormina Bay is still bright, and the first lights come on along the shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide dark surface under a clear sky, with the first light growing behind the coastline.
phrases.clear_morning: From the top-floor oceanfront suites, guests watch the clear morning light spread across the open Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Pacific Ocean is deep blue, and Pismo Beach Pier stands out sharply against it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pacific Ocean this morning, and the view from the pool deck follows them out to the horizon.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the bluff, waves roll in below while afternoon clouds cross the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the Pacific Ocean turns grey, and the white lines of the waves are easy to see.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Pacific Ocean today, and from the bluff only the nearest waves appear and disappear.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the 22 miles of coastline is not visible today; guests see the Pacific Ocean near the cliffs and little more.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pacific Ocean, and guests watch it from behind the glass of the oceanfront suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second the whole surface of the water turns white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Pacific Ocean, and guests come to their windows to watch it meet the waves.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the horizon of the Pacific Ocean looks as if drawn with a ruler.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, steam rises from the hot tub, and beyond the railing the Pacific Ocean is restless.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the oceanfront pools and look out over a bright, shining Pacific Ocean.
phrases.warm: On the Play Deck, the mini-golf slows down each time a player stops to look at the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on their balconies watch the golden light on the Pacific Ocean, and nobody is in a hurry to go inside.
phrases.partly_golden: From the pool deck, the last sun colours the clouds orange and pink, and the calm Pacific Ocean reflects them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Pacific Ocean is a darker grey than the sky, and Pismo Beach Pier is a thin shape above the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the balcony doors this evening, and the Pacific Ocean beyond them is almost black.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests see the white edges of the waves on the Pacific Ocean below the cliffs.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the Pacific Ocean, and guests hear the waves below more than they see them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pacific Ocean is difficult to tell from the sky, and the horizon is lost until morning.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky above the Pacific Ocean is still bright, and Pismo Beach Pier turns to a silhouette.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Andaman Sea is a wide grey surface below the hillside, and the bay is quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun lights the bay below, and each private infinity pool seems to run straight into the Andaman Sea.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Andaman Sea is turquoise along the coast and deep blue further out.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the bay this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the Andaman Sea.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the private pool decks, guests look over the treetops to an Andaman Sea marked with sun and cloud shadow.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Andaman Sea turns the colour of steel, and the headland is deep green against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Andaman Sea today, and from the private pools the horizon fades into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant hills are not visible today; guests see the bay, the treetops and the nearest stretch of the Andaman Sea.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the bay, and guests in the ocean front pool villas watch it cross the Andaman Sea.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Andaman Sea, and lightning shows the bay for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Andaman Sea, and guests on the hillside watch the white flakes meet the bay.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold today, and the Andaman Sea looks sharp and clear from behind the villa windows.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to their villa living rooms and look over the treetops to the Andaman Sea.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in their private infinity pools, eyes on the Andaman Sea just beyond the edge.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the Andaman Sea is calm and blue below the hillside, and a lone boat crosses the bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun is low over the Andaman Sea, and guests in all 39 pool villas have the gold light on their decks.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in long beams, and the Andaman Sea turns gold in patches.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Andaman Sea is a dark surface below the hillside, and the bay has no bright lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the pool decks this evening, and the Andaman Sea beyond them is heard more than seen.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hide the stars, and the Andaman Sea is a soft dark space below the villas.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Andaman Sea tonight, and with no neighbour in the sightline, guests get them all.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the bay is dark, and the Andaman Sea shows only where waves break on the shore.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and the sky over the Andaman Sea stays bright while the headland turns dark.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the harbour lies still, and the Royal Palace of Stockholm is a dark shape under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the Royal Palace of Stockholm stands sharp above the harbour water.
phrases.clear_midday: From the floor-to-ceiling windows on the higher floors, guests see the harbour, the Royal Palace of Stockholm and Riddarholmen Church in one sweep at midday.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the harbour this morning, and the spire of Riddarholmen Church goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the Royal Palace of Stockholm and on across the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the harbour turns the colour of slate, and the Royal Palace of Stockholm keeps its long, calm outline.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the harbour today, so guests see Riddarholmen Church as a spire without a base.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the harbour is clear to see, but the Royal Palace of Stockholm is only a faint outline behind it.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch the Royal Palace of Stockholm blur behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the harbour, and for a second the Royal Palace of Stockholm shows clearly through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the harbour, and guests watch the Old Town rooftops turn white one by one.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the Royal Palace of Stockholm looks close enough to touch, and guests are glad to study it from indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the harbour is steel grey, and Riddarholmen Church stands very clear above the water.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests in balcony rooms stay in the shade and look at the harbour water with some envy.
phrases.warm: On a warm day guests take drinks out to their balconies and look over the harbour and the city rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the harbour gold, and the Royal Palace of Stockholm glows warm above the water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds turn pink above the spire of Riddarholmen Church.
phrases.grey_evening: City lights shine under low cloud this evening, and the Royal Palace of Stockholm stands above their reflections in the harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, rain falls on the harbour, and the lights around it stretch into long streaks on the water.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests in this 460-room hotel find the Royal Palace of Stockholm by the lights along the water.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the Royal Palace of Stockholm tonight, and the harbour below is black and calm.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the harbour is quiet, and guests who cannot sleep have the Royal Palace of Stockholm to themselves.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on along the harbour below Riddarholmen Church.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale over the Øresund, and the 16th-floor observation deck is quiet above Nordhavn.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the harbour, and from the 16th-floor observation deck Nordhavn stands sharp against the blue Øresund.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Øresund wind turbines are easy to count from the rooftop sauna.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Nordhavn this morning, while the Øresund behind it stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, cruise ships lie in the harbour this afternoon while clouds drift over them.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Øresund takes the same colour, and the waterfront buildings of Nordhavn stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the harbour today, and the wind turbines on the Øresund fade in and out of sight.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Øresund is not visible today; from the upper floors, guests see the harbour and the nearest part of Nordhavn.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the harbour, and guests in the rooftop sauna watch Nordhavn turn grey through the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Øresund, and for a second Nordhavn shows clearly from the penthouse windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Nordhavn, and the harbour slowly disappears behind it.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing day, guests warm up in the rooftop sauna and look at the cold, bright harbour below.
phrases.cold: The air is cold and clear, and a DFDS ferry sits white against the dark water of the harbour.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the rooftop terrace look at the cruise ships and envy anyone near the water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit in the wicker chairs on the rooftop terrace with the harbour in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun reaches the 16th-floor observation deck, and the Øresund wind turbines shine white.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun turns the clouds orange above the city rooftops, and guests watch from their window seats.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Nordhavn mark the edge of the harbour, and the Øresund beyond is black.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of Nordhavn shine on the harbour water and blur in the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, guests in this 2004 tower look from their balcony rooms at Nordhavn, lit along the harbour.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the Øresund tonight, and the harbour lights draw the shape of Nordhavn below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the harbour is still, and a ferry waits at its quay for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays pink over the harbour just after sunset, and the first lights come on across Nordhavn.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Michigan lies dark and flat under a clear sky that is just starting to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Chicago Skyline, and every tower stands sharp against the blue.
phrases.clear_midday: Lake Michigan is blue all the way to the horizon at this hour.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Indoor pool, swimmers look out at the city under a sky of sun and passing cloud.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Chicago Skyline this afternoon, with the Magnificent Mile running below.
phrases.overcast: Under a full cover of cloud, Lake Michigan and the sky are almost the same grey.
phrases.fog_haze: Somewhere behind the fog is the Chicago Skyline; guests can see only its nearest towers.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Lake Michigan fades out long before the horizon.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Magnificent Mile, and the Chicago Skyline behind it looks blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Lake Michigan, and guests watch the lightning from indoors.
phrases.snow: While snow falls on the city outside, swimmers at the pool stay warm and keep watching.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay indoors and look out at Lake Michigan, bright and clear in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: Coats stay on their hangers a little longer while guests look across the Chicago Skyline from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the horizon of Lake Michigan is soft and pale.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests look at Lake Michigan and start thinking about a walk outside.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Chicago Skyline gold, one glass tower after another.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests watch the last sunlight come through the clouds and touch the Chicago Skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: The Chicago Skyline is lit under low cloud tonight, and guests look across it after dinner.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening the lights of the Chicago Skyline are blurred, and Lake Michigan is lost in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: Lake Michigan is a wide dark space tonight beside the lights of the city.
phrases.clear_night: The Chicago Skyline shines in the clear night, and guests can count the lit floors instead of sheep.
phrases.late_night: Michigan Avenue is quiet below, and the Chicago Skyline stands dark and still for guests who are awake.
phrases.dusk: For a few minutes after sunset, Lake Michigan keeps the colour of the sky while the skyline lights come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: In the Junior King Suite, early risers see the Chicago skyline as dark shapes against the first pale light.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight reaches the top floors of the Chicago skyline first and then works its way down to Michigan Avenue.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the city vistas from the Grand Deluxe Landmark View rooms are sharp, with sunlight on the glass of the towers.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Magnificent Mile this morning, and the towers of the Chicago skyline go in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Junior King Suite with Terrace watch the Chicago skyline change from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.overcast: Without shadows, every tower of the Chicago skyline shows its true colour today.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the upper part of the Chicago skyline today, and the towers seem to end in the cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The city vistas from the Grand Deluxe Landmark View rooms are pale today, and the far part of the city is not visible.
phrases.rain: Michigan Avenue shines wet in the rain, and the Chicago skyline behind it has gone soft at the edges.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Junior King Suite with Terrace keep the terrace door shut and watch the storm cross the Chicago skyline.
phrases.snow: Guests in the Grand Deluxe Landmark View rooms stay indoors and watch the snow fall across the city vistas.
phrases.very_cold: The Chicago skyline stands clear in the freezing air, and guests in the Junior King Suite enjoy it from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: Guests in the Grand Deluxe Landmark View rooms take in the city vistas with a hot drink in hand today.
phrases.very_hot: Up on the rooftop at Upstairs at The Gwen, guests look at a Chicago skyline that shimmers a little in the heat.
phrases.warm: Guests in the Junior King Suite with Terrace sit outside today and look across at the Chicago skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in the Junior King Suite watch the glass of the Chicago skyline turn gold floor by floor.
phrases.partly_golden: The low sun slips between the clouds and picks out the towers of the Chicago skyline one at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: The lit towers of the Chicago skyline give the low cloud a soft orange colour tonight.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the Magnificent Mile stretch into long reflections on the wet street this evening, under a skyline half lost in rain.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in the Junior King Suite with Terrace turn off the lamps and let the Chicago skyline light the room.
phrases.clear_night: From Upstairs at The Gwen, guests could count the lit windows of the Chicago skyline tonight, if they had the patience.
phrases.late_night: Most of the city's windows have gone dark, and the skyline is a quiet row of shapes for anyone still awake.
phrases.dusk: Lights come on along Michigan Avenue while the Chicago skyline still stands against a bright evening sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the water of Finlayson Arm shows faintly between the forest slopes as the sky above the ridge starts to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Alpina Restaurant, guests watch the early sun move down the forested slopes to the water of Finlayson Arm.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the snow on Mount Baker shows white far beyond the green water of Finlayson Arm.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly down Finlayson Arm this morning, and guests in the balcony rooms follow them from fir to fir.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the decks of Alpina Restaurant, the Saanich Inlet lies half in sunshine and half in cloud shadow this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Finlayson Arm turns the colour of slate, and the Douglas firs on both sides look almost black.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills Finlayson Arm today like milk in a bowl, and only the tops of the Douglas firs stand above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Mount Baker and the Olympic Mountains are not visible today; guests see only as far as the forest walls of Finlayson Arm.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Saanich Inlet, and guests in Alpina Restaurant watch the far shore fade and return between showers.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls along Finlayson Arm, and guests in the terrace suites watch from behind the glass as lightning lights the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Douglas firs below, and Finlayson Arm is a dark ribbon of water between white slopes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Olympic Mountains stand sharp and white beyond Finlayson Arm, every ridge clear from the windows of Alpina Restaurant.
phrases.cold: Steam rises from the spa's heated outdoor pool on this cold day, with Finlayson Arm lying still and green far below.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests float in the heated outdoor pool at Tuscan Spa and watch bald eagles circle below them over Finlayson Arm.
phrases.warm: On the patios of Alpina Restaurant, guests sit in the warm air and look across the Saanich Inlet to Mount Finlayson and distant Mount Baker.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Since 1991 guests have come up this ridge for this: low golden light on Finlayson Arm, with the Olympic Mountains glowing behind it.
phrases.partly_golden: From the Cielo Penthouse, 300 feet above the rest of the resort, guests see the last sun catch the clouds over Mount Baker.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the slopes around Finlayson Arm fade into the night, and only the water still holds a little grey light.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain taps on the balcony doors this evening, and Finlayson Arm has disappeared into the wet dark beyond the first row of firs.
phrases.mild_night: No stars tonight; cloud sits low on the Malahat ridge, and the Saanich Inlet is only a faint paler patch far below.
phrases.clear_night: The clear night sky above Finlayson Arm is full of stars, and guests give up counting them quite early.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Finlayson Arm lies silent and unlit between its forests, and the eagles are asleep somewhere in the firs.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays bright over the Olympic Mountains just after sunset, while Finlayson Arm below is already in shadow.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Chicago River lies dark and still below the One Bedroom Royal Suite - King.
phrases.clear_morning: Early risers in the River View rooms open the curtains to a bright Chicago River.
phrases.clear_midday: The Chicago River shines right below the hotel, with the city standing sharp behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: From the One Bedroom Suite - King, guests see patches of sun travel along the Chicago River.
phrases.partly_afternoon: One bend of the Chicago River is in sunshine this afternoon, and the next is under a cloud.
phrases.overcast: City buildings and cloud share one colour today, with the Chicago River running quietly below them.
phrases.fog_haze: The One Bedroom Lasalle Suite - King faces out into fog today, and the city comes and goes.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the River View rooms, the Chicago River is clear below, but the far buildings of the city are not visible today.
phrases.rain: Guests in the One Bedroom Suite - King watch rain make small rings on the Chicago River.
phrases.thunderstorm: In the Skyline Suite - King, guests count the seconds between lightning and thunder.
phrases.snow: Guests in the Junior Suite - King - Family stay warm inside and watch the snow fall past.
phrases.very_cold: The Chicago River looks like steel today, and guests in the River View rooms are happy to see it through glass.
phrases.cold: Guests in the One Bedroom State Suite - King are in no hurry to go out today.
phrases.very_hot: On a day this hot, guests in the One Bedroom Royal Suite - King look down at the Chicago River and think about swimming.
phrases.warm: The Chicago River moves slowly through the warm afternoon, with the city standing above it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lays long building shadows across the Chicago River below the One Bedroom Suite - King.
phrases.partly_golden: In the Two Bedroom Michigan Suite - King, guests watch the last sun slip in and out of the clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: City lights lie in long lines on the Chicago River tonight, under a low cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the city lights tonight, and guests in the Junior Suite - King stay in and watch.
phrases.mild_night: Lit windows of the city shine on the Chicago River under a soft, cloudy night.
phrases.clear_night: Every city light shows twice tonight, once above the Chicago River and once on its dark water.
phrases.late_night: The Chicago River keeps moving through the small hours, and almost nobody in the River View rooms is awake to see it.
phrases.dusk: The Chicago River holds the last brightness of the day as lamps come on across the city.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear, and the Copenhagen skyline waits in the half-light beyond the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_morning: From the bridge between the two towers, guests see rooftops, canals and the harbor in one sweep under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is clear, and the green parkland below the high-floor lounge runs out to the city skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the rooftops and canals this morning, while the Copenhagen skyline behind them stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the high-floor lounge take turns at the brass telescope, following the clouds as they drift over the city skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the canals take the same colour, and the rooftops of Copenhagen stand out darker between them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Copenhagen skyline today, and from the bridge the canals show only as faint lines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The harbor is not visible today; guests see only the parkland and the nearest rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the angled floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in the high-floor rooms see the city skyline slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Copenhagen skyline, and guests on the bridge between the towers watch the storm move across the rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the green parkland, and from the high-floor lounge it is slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, the air is clear, and the rooftops of Copenhagen look sharp from the high-floor lounge.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass of the high-floor restaurant, with the highways and the city spread out below.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the parkland below the towers looks greener, and guests enjoy it from the cool side of the glass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the suites look through angled windows at green parkland and the city skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the canals to gold, and guests on the bridge follow them across the rooftops to the harbor.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the city skyline, and guests in the high-floor lounge watch it move from roof to roof.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an overcast evening sky, city lights stretch to the horizon from the upper floors of the towers.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the highways below the high-floor restaurant shine, and the city lights blur behind the angled windows.
