phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the clouds sit low over Copenhagen, and the lights of the highways draw bright curves below the high-floor restaurant.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and guests on the bridge between the two towers see the city lights reach to the harbor.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the bridge between the towers is quiet, and the rooftops and canals of Copenhagen lie still below.
phrases.dusk: From a tower that leans at a 15-degree angle, guests watch the first city lights come on under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the lagoon lies flat and dark under a clear sky, and the mangroves around it are still.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the lagoon, and birds start moving along the mangrove edge.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Caribbean Sea is turquoise beyond the white sand and the palm trees.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the El Camaleón Golf Course this morning, and their shadows cross the fairways one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the beachfront terrace, guests see sun and cloud take turns over the Caribbean Sea this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the lagoon turns a soft green, and the mangroves around it look darker.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the lagoon today, and the far mangroves fade into a soft grey-green band.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Caribbean horizon is not visible today; guests on the beachfront terrace see the white sand and the first waves.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the lagoon, and guests in the lagoon-view casitas watch the rings spread across the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Caribbean Sea, and guests in the Camaleón Presidential Suite watch lightning flash above the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the mangroves and the lagoon, a sight that even the 160 bird species here must find strange.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold, bright day, the lagoon lies calm and clear, and the mangroves are sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the beach is empty, and the Caribbean Sea rolls in grey-blue beyond the palm trees.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay under the palapa umbrellas and look out at the turquoise Caribbean Sea.
phrases.warm: On the warm sand, guests lie under palapa umbrellas, and the calm Caribbean Sea gets all their attention.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights the palm trees along the beach, and the Caribbean Sea turns a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange and pink above the white sand and the beachfront terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the string lights of the overwater dining decks shine on the calm lagoon.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the lagoon this evening, and the lights of the dining decks break into small pieces on the water.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests on their terraces can still see the lagoon between the mangroves.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the lagoon, and guests look up from the wrap-around balconies of the casita suites.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the lagoon and the mangroves are quiet, and the 160 bird species seem to have gone to sleep.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the lagoon holds the last bright sky, and the first string lights come on along the dining decks.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gangnam grid lies still under a clear sky, and the towers along Teheran-ro stand out against the first pale light.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Gangnam grid, and from The Lounge on the 24th floor every block is sharp through the glass.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests on the cardio machines in the fitness center look out at the glass towers of Gangnam.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Gangnam grid this morning, and the glass towers along Teheran-ro change from bright to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Park Suite, guests see Teheran-ro on two sides this afternoon, with clouds passing above the office towers.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the glass towers of Gangnam take the same colour, and Teheran-ro stays busy far below.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Seoul skyline today, and from The Lounge the far towers of Gangnam look like pencil drawings.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Seoul skyline is not visible today, but the Gangnam grid and the near towers on Teheran-ro remain clear from the corner suites.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of The Lounge, and the Gangnam grid below looks blurred and shiny.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Seoul skyline, and guests in this 24-floor tower watch the storm cross Gangnam from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Gangnam, and swimmers in the indoor pool watch the flakes drift past the glass wall towards the streets.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear over Gangnam, and guests look at the sharp Seoul skyline from the heated indoor pool.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests keep warm in the fitness center and study the neighbourhoods of Gangnam through the glass.
phrases.very_hot: The glass towers of Gangnam shine in the strong heat, and guests look down at Teheran-ro from the cool side of the windows.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the people on the pavements of Teheran-ro look very small from The Lounge on the 24th floor.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights the glass towers along Teheran-ro, and the whole Gangnam grid glows with them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken clouds, and guests in the bathtub by the glass watch the Seoul skyline turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: City lights spread across the Gangnam grid under a cloudy evening sky, and guests at The Lounge watch them over dinner.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the car lights on Teheran-ro stretch into long red and white lines on the shining road.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit towers of the Seoul skyline give the low clouds over Gangnam a soft glow.
phrases.clear_night: The lit towers of Gangnam stand clear against the night sky, and in all 185 rooms guests have them framed in glass.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the long straight line of Teheran-ro is nearly empty, and Gangnam finally looks like a district that sleeps.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first office lights come on across the Gangnam grid, floor by floor.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Copenhagen Opera House is a quiet outline across the still inner harbor.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the restaurant, guests look through floor-to-ceiling windows at the harbor water shining in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The Copenhagen Opera House stands sharp against a blue sky, directly across the water from the harbor-facing rooms.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the inner harbor this morning, and the Copenhagen Opera House goes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from Admiral Terrace, clouds drift over the inner harbor while patches of sun move across the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the inner harbor turns the colour of steel, with the Copenhagen Opera House calm on the far side.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the inner harbor today, and the Copenhagen Opera House looks like a pencil drawing across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the inner harbor is not visible today; the Copenhagen Opera House is still there across the water, with softer edges.
phrases.rain: Rain draws small rings on the inner harbor, and guests in this 1787 warehouse watch it through the arched windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the inner harbor, and for a second the Copenhagen Opera House shows white across the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the inner harbor, and guests in the Tower Waterfront Suite watch it come down across a wide sweep of water.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air makes everything sharp today, and the Copenhagen Opera House shows every line across the inner harbor.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the restaurant choose a table by the glass and look out at the grey-blue harbor water.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on Admiral Terrace sit just above the harbor water and look across at the Copenhagen Opera House.
phrases.warm: On Admiral Terrace, which reaches out over the water, glasses stay half full while guests look across the inner harbor.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Admiral Terrace, the inner harbor turns gold in the low sun, and the water changes colour by the minute.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and guests in the Admiral City Suite see the city's rooftops light up one group at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening sky is low and grey, and the lights of the Copenhagen Opera House make long reflections on the inner harbor.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests at dinner in the restaurant watch the harbor lights blur on the water outside.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so the inner harbor borrows its light from the quays and the Copenhagen Opera House.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the inner harbor, and guests count more lights on the water than in the sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the inner harbor is dark and quiet, and guests who cannot sleep find the water barely moving.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from Admiral Terrace the first lights come on across the inner harbor.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon lies still and colourless under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and guests in the overwater villas see turquoise water from the bedroom to the deck.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is bright turquoise under a clear sky, with open ocean beyond it on every side.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon this morning, and the water changes from turquoise to deeper blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the overwater spa, guests look through floor-to-ceiling windows at the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, partly in sun and partly in cloud shadow.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, guests at SEA look through the glass walls at reef fish that keep all their colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon and the sky look like one pale surface.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The open ocean beyond the reef is not visible today, and only the near turquoise water of the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and guests watch thousands of small rings spread across the water from their overwater villas.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the open ocean, and for a second the whole Maldivian Atoll Lagoon turns white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and each flake disappears as it touches the turquoise water.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air sits over the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon today, and guests look at the bright turquoise water from behind the glass of the overwater spa.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon stays turquoise, and guests look at it from inside their villas with the deck doors closed.
phrases.very_hot: In this strong heat, guests sit in the shade on their swing seats and look at the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, which shines almost white.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests walking on the white sandbar have the turquoise Maldivian Atoll Lagoon on both sides.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun crosses the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and the turquoise water slowly turns the colour of honey.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the open ocean turn orange and pink, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: No stars show on this cloudy evening, and from the overwater deck the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is a darker band under a dark sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, dinner at SEA stays dry under the ocean, and guests watch reef fish swim past the glass walls.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is a quiet dark surface around the 80 villas.
phrases.clear_night: At SKY, the overwater observatory, guests look up at a clear sky full of stars above the black Maldivian Atoll Lagoon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is more a sound than a sight, with small waves moving in the dark.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the calm ocean, and the first string lights come on above the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Giralda Tower is a dark shape against a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of the Giralda Tower first, and the light moves slowly down the stone.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Seville Cathedral and the Giralda Tower stand sharp above the rooftops of Santa Cruz.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass behind the Giralda Tower this morning, while Santa Cruz church stays in sunshine below the roof terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony rooms, guests follow cloud shadows as they cross the Giralda Tower this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the stone of Seville Cathedral looks darker, and every detail of the Giralda Tower stays clear.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Giralda Tower today, and Seville Cathedral looks like a pencil drawing behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far rooftops of the city are not visible today; Santa Cruz church and the Giralda Tower still show clearly from the roof terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Santa Cruz; guests watch it from their balcony rooms, the Giralda Tower slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Giralda Tower for a second at a time, and guests count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Seville Cathedral, and guests in the balcony rooms photograph the Giralda Tower turning white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Giralda Tower shows every line against the sky.
phrases.cold: Cold air sits over Santa Cruz today, and Seville Cathedral looks pale and still beside the Giralda Tower.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests on the roof terrace look for shade, then look at the Giralda Tower from there.
phrases.warm: On the warm roof terrace, books stay closed while guests look at Seville Cathedral and the Giralda Tower instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Giralda Tower gold above the roof terrace of this 17th-century house, and the colour deepens toward sunset.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the Giralda Tower, while Santa Cruz church is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Giralda Tower stands above the roof terrace, pale gold against a grey sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of the Giralda Tower shine on the rain, seen from the dry side of a balcony door.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lit Giralda Tower is the brightest thing above the roofs of Santa Cruz.
phrases.clear_night: A clear night sky hangs over Seville Cathedral, and the lit Giralda Tower takes more attention than the stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Seville Cathedral and the Giralda Tower are quiet outlines above the sleeping streets of Santa Cruz.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on at the Giralda Tower and Seville Cathedral.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sassongher peak is a dark shape above the roof, and the sky over the Sella group slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the east-facing balcony of the Cinderella Suite, where guests look at the Sassongher and Sasso Croce peaks.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Sella group stands sharp across the valley, with Corvara's rooftops just below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the Sella group this morning, and guests in the restaurant follow them through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the panoramic terrace, cloud shadows slide over Corvara and up the slopes of the Dolomites.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits low over the Dolomites today, and the rock of the Sassongher peak takes almost the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills the valley, so Corvara is gone for now and only the top of the Sella group shows above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Sella group cannot be seen across the valley today; from the balconies, guests see only Corvara's rooftops and the nearest slopes.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall restaurant windows, and guests watch the Dolomites turn grey and soft behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls between the peaks, and guests in the Sky Spa watch lightning flash over the Dolomites from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Corvara, and the rooftops below turn white one by one while the Sella group fades behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, every ridge of the Dolomites is clear, and guests admire them from the warm sauna in the Sky Spa.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, steam rises from the whirlpool on the panoramic terrace, with the Sella group clear behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests sit in the whirlpool on the panoramic terrace and look at the green meadows below the Dolomites.
phrases.warm: On the south-facing balcony of the Sissi Suite, guests enjoy the warm air and look over Corvara to the Sella group.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the pale limestone of the Sassongher peak gold, all 2,665 metres of it, directly behind the roof.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights the Sella group, and guests in the restaurant stop talking to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hide the peaks this evening, so the lights of Corvara become the view, as they have for guests here since 1933.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the valley tonight, and the lights of Corvara shine blurred through the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the Dolomites disappear, and from the panoramic terrace only the lights of Corvara mark the valley.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the sky above the Sassongher peak tonight, and guests on their balconies look up before they look out.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Corvara sleeps below, and the Dolomites are only a darker line against the night sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind the Sella group, and the first lights come on in Corvara below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Empire State Building stands quiet against a clear sky that slowly turns pale behind the Manhattan skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Empire State Building, and guests see it from bed through floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Hudson River shines on one side of the tower and the Manhattan skyline stands sharp on the other.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Manhattan skyline this morning, and One World Trade Center goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the clouds drift over the Hudson River, and their shadows cross the water slowly.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Hudson River looks like brushed steel and the Empire State Building keeps its clear outline.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Manhattan skyline today, and the Empire State Building looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far bank of the Hudson River is not visible and the Chrysler Building is missing from the Manhattan skyline.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and guests watch the Empire State Building blur behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the Hudson River, and guests watch the lightning flash behind the Manhattan skyline from 45 floors of glass.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the Manhattan skyline and hides the top of the Empire State Building, while the Hudson River turns white-grey.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air makes every tower in the Manhattan skyline look sharp, and guests enjoy the sight from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the 7th-floor pool terrace is closed for the season, and the Manhattan skyline stands sharp above the empty loungers.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests take a cabana at Terrace on 7 and look up at the Manhattan skyline from the shade.
phrases.warm: At Terrace on 7, guests float in the pool on this warm day with the Manhattan skyline rising all around them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills the corner suites, and the Manhattan skyline glows through their wraparound windows.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and paints the Hudson River orange, then pink, as guests watch from above.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hangs over the Manhattan skyline this evening, and the lights of the Empire State Building colour it from below.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights blur in the rain, and the Empire State Building shines through it.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lit Manhattan skyline gives the low sky a soft orange colour.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night the Empire State Building stands lit above the Manhattan skyline, with every lit floor easy to count.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Hudson River lies still and black below the tower, and the Manhattan skyline rests.
phrases.dusk: At dusk guests watch from the tub in a corner suite as the first lights come on across the Manhattan skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Venetian Lagoon lies still and grey-blue, and San Giorgio Island is a dark shape on the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the rooms facing the San Marco basin open their curtains to morning sun on the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Venetian Lagoon shines blue beyond the outdoor tables of VERO Restaurant.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over San Giorgio Island this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lounge, guests look through the gridded window at Venice's waterfront, where sun and cloud take turns this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Venetian Lagoon turns the colour of pewter all the way to San Giorgio Island.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Venetian Lagoon today, and San Giorgio Island comes and goes like a rumour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the Venetian Lagoon is not visible today, but the water in front of VERO Restaurant is still clear to see.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Venetian Lagoon with small rings, and guests watch it from the dry side of the 430 windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Venetian Lagoon, and lightning shows San Giorgio Island for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Venetian Lagoon and melts as it lands, while San Giorgio Island fades behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Venice's waterfront looks sharp and bright through the gridded window of the lounge.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the air is clear above the private terrace of the Altana Suite, and San Giorgio Island stands sharp across the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests take the outdoor tables at VERO Restaurant, where the Venetian Lagoon lies flat and bright beside them.
phrases.warm: On the private terrace of the Altana Suite, guests turn a full circle on a warm day and find the Venetian Lagoon on every side.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Venetian Lagoon gold, and San Giorgio Island stands in clear outline across the water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between clouds, and guests in the rooms facing the San Marco basin watch the water change from gold to pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at VERO Restaurant has the Venetian Lagoon beside it tonight, quiet under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests stay inside this wet evening and watch the waterfront lights shake on the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Venetian Lagoon is a wide dark surface with a few lights moving on it.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Venetian Lagoon lies calm in front of the old monastery that Patricia Urquiola converted in 2021.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Venetian Lagoon is black and quiet in front of the hotel, and even the water seems to sleep.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the terrace tables of VERO Restaurant San Giorgio Island faces the first lights on the Venetian Lagoon.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Strip is a long, quiet line with the desert mountains just showing behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Strip, and the Eiffel Tower replica stands framed in the Strip-view suites.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests on the top floors look straight down the length of the Strip.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move along the Strip this morning, passing over the Luxor and New York-New York.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Between passing clouds, guests count the landmarks of the Strip: the Luxor, New York-New York and the Eiffel Tower replica.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Strip loses some of its colour, but the Eiffel Tower replica is still easy to find.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Strip today, and the Eiffel Tower replica looks like a light sketch on grey paper.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The desert mountains are not visible today, and the far part of the Strip fades before the High Roller.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch the Strip turn wet and shiny below.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Strip, and guests watch lightning flash behind the Eiffel Tower replica.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Strip, and guests in the Strip-view suites watch the Eiffel Tower replica fade behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and the desert mountains stand sharp behind the Strip.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay indoors and follow the Strip as far as the Eiffel Tower replica.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the Strip shimmers below, and guests are glad of the tinted windows that cut the glare.
phrases.warm: At Veranda, guests look out over the private pool, where the lounge chairs fill on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on floors 35 to 39 watch the late sun turn the Strip gold, the Eiffel Tower replica included.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the towers of the Strip one at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, so the neon lights of the Strip have no stars to compete with.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening lights of the Strip, and guests in the Strip-view suites see every colour twice, once in the wet road.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests stand at the window for a while before going out, the lit Strip stretching ahead.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the Strip is one long row of lights, and the Eiffel Tower replica glows in the frame.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Strip lies quiet below the top floors, and most guests in the 424 rooms have stopped looking at it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first casino signs come on along the Strip.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear and the Bosphorus Strait lies still and colourless beyond the rooftops of Istanbul.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Bosphorus Strait, and guests in the Bosphorus view rooms can follow each ship along the water.
phrases.clear_midday: From a 34-floor tower above Mecidiyeköy, guests look over the rooftops of Istanbul to a bright blue Bosphorus Strait at midday.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly over the Istanbul skyline this morning, while the Bosphorus Strait stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the Gold Lounge, guests watch clouds cross the wide panorama of Istanbul while the afternoon canapés wait their turn.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Bosphorus Strait turns the colour of steel between the city rooftops and the Asian shore.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Bosphorus Strait today, and the Asian shore skyline looks like a faint sketch behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Asian shore is not visible today; the view stops at the nearer rooftops of Istanbul, with only a hint of the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch the Bosphorus Strait blur behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Istanbul, and each flash of lightning shows the Bosphorus Strait for a second before the rain hides it again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Istanbul, and from the rooftop terrace the Bosphorus Strait is a grey shape behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, bright day, guests in the 15th-floor Gold Lounge see the Istanbul skyline in sharp detail from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: The cold air is clear today, and guests in the Gold Lounge see the Bosphorus Strait shine like polished metal beyond the rooftops of Istanbul.
phrases.very_hot: The heat lies heavy on Istanbul, and from the rooftop infinity pool the Bosphorus Strait looks like the only cool thing in sight.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, swimmers rest their arms on the edge of the rooftop infinity pool and study the Asian shore skyline across the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light warms the rooftops of Istanbul, and from the balcony of the Presidential Suite the Bosphorus Strait turns from blue to gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and from the Bosphorus Terrace Suite guests see bright patches drift across the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.grey_evening: Through the tall windows of the rooftop restaurant, the lit Istanbul skyline glows under low cloud this evening.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Istanbul this evening, and the city lights spread into soft colours all the way down to the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of the Asian shore make a thin bright chain beyond the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests look down on a carpet of city lights that ends at the black water of the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Istanbul is quiet below, and the Bosphorus Strait is a calm gap between two sleeping shores.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the rooftop terrace the first city lights appear along the Bosphorus Strait.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests in the sea-view rooms see the sky turn from black to deep blue over Pampelonne Beach.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast at La Table de La Messardière, guests look beyond the gardens and the pine trees to a bright Mediterranean.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Belvedere pool, the Gulf of Saint-Tropez lies deep blue under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Ramatuelle vineyards this morning, while Pampelonne Beach stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Airelles Spa, guests watch clouds and patches of sun take turns over Pampelonne Beach.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Gulf of Saint-Tropez turns the colour of slate, seen through the stone arches of the open-air fitness terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Provence mountains today, and Pampelonne Beach fades into the sea without a clear edge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Provence mountains are not visible today; from the panoramic terrace of La Table de La Messardière, the view stops at the pines and a dim Pampelonne Beach.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the umbrella pines and cypress trees of the park; guests watch it from their terrace doors, Pampelonne Beach grey beyond.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Mediterranean, and for a second Pampelonne Beach shows white below the hill.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the umbrella pines around this 19th-century castle, and Pampelonne Beach disappears behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and the Provence mountains stand sharp behind the Ramatuelle vineyards.
phrases.cold: The Mediterranean is steel blue on this cold day, and the long sand of Pampelonne Beach looks wide and quiet from the hill.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the terrace pool and look over the gardens to a shimmering Pampelonne Beach.
phrases.warm: At Jardin Tropezina, guests under their parasols look at the Mediterranean from the sand of Pampelonne Beach, books open but unread.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls across Pampelonne Beach, and the terrace of Matsuhisa looks straight over it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the southern hills turn orange and pink, seen through the trees from Palladio.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner at Les Tables du Jardin, guests at the table set high above the bay see the lights of Pampelonne Beach under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner guests at La Table de La Messardière watch the rain cross the gardens, the lights of Pampelonne Beach blurred beyond the pines.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lights along Pampelonne Beach glow beyond the black pines, seen from the private terraces.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in this castle, restored in 1989, see stars above the Mediterranean and a chain of lights on Pampelonne Beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Mediterranean is black and still from the sea-view rooms, and Pampelonne Beach sleeps somewhere below.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Pampelonne Beach below the rooftop terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Delos and Rineia Island are two dark shapes on the Aegean horizon, and the sky above them slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the infinity pool, and Delos and Rineia Island stand clear across the strait.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool and the Aegean Sea share one blue, and only Delos and Rineia Island show where the horizon is.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the strait this morning, covering Rineia Island for a minute and then Delos.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests look down at Tourlos Marina this afternoon, where the boats sit in sun one moment and under cloud the next.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Aegean Sea turns the colour of slate, and Delos and Rineia Island sit low on the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Aegean horizon today, and guests can only just make out the outline of Rineia Island.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Delos and Rineia Island are not visible today; the view from the infinity pool ends at Tourlos Marina and the nearer water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Aegean Sea, and guests watch it from their terrace suites while Delos fades behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the strait, and guests stay indoors as lightning shows Delos and Rineia Island for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Tourlos Marina, and guests in this 2018 hotel watch the flakes disappear into the Aegean Sea.
phrases.very_cold: The very cold air is clear today, and guests see Delos and Rineia Island sharply across the strait.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the Signature Spa Pool Suite keep the doors closed and still have the whole Aegean Sea in front of them.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across the water at Delos.
phrases.warm: It is warm today, and guests swim to the edge of the infinity pool to look at Rineia Island across the strait.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls across the strait late this afternoon, and Delos and Rineia Island glow on the horizon.
phrases.partly_golden: The sun drops towards the Aegean Sea, and the clouds above Tourlos Marina turn orange one after another.
phrases.grey_evening: No stars this evening; guests look instead at the lights of Tourlos Marina under the low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of Tourlos Marina blur on the wet glass of the terrace doors.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night cloud hides the stars, and the Aegean Sea is a wide dark space beyond the lit infinity pool.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the strait tonight, and guests try to find where Delos ends and the night begins.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Aegean Sea is heard more than seen, and Delos and Rineia Island wait out of sight for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sun has gone, the sky over the Aegean Sea is still bright, and the first lights come on in Tourlos Marina.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is still dark, and a thin band of light is growing along the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the oceanfront balcony rooms step outside to a clear morning and the Atlantic bright in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Atlantic turns turquoise right behind the Art Deco-era pool, which sits directly on the sand.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic this morning, and the private beach goes from bright to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Oceanfront Balcony Penthouse, guests follow the afternoon clouds north and south along the coastline.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the Atlantic turns grey-green, and the surf along the beach stands out in white.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic seems to end a short way past the beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the pool, the sand and the first waves are clear, but the far Atlantic and its horizon are not visible today.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic, and guests in the corner suite watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows on two sides.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Atlantic, and guests see the waves for a second in each flash of lightning.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sand and the Atlantic, and this time it is real, unlike the 25 tons of artificial snow brought here in 1958.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and the sky is bright, so the Atlantic looks sharp and deep blue beyond the quiet pool deck.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the city-view rooms look out over Miami Beach and its low-rise and mid-rise buildings.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests keep to the shade of the cabanas that Morris Lapidus added and look across the pool at the Atlantic.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the chaise lounges on the sand have the Atlantic right in front of their feet.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight turns the sand gold and the Atlantic a deeper blue, with the original diving platform standing above the pool.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds over the Atlantic turn pink and orange, and the water takes the same colours.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Atlantic and the sky become one dark grey, and lights along the coastline show where the land ends.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the pool deck this evening, and the Atlantic beyond it disappears into the dark.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Atlantic is mostly a sound, and only the white edges of the waves show near the beach.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, stars sit above the Atlantic, and the lights of Miami Beach run along the coast on both sides.
phrases.late_night: With every chaise lounge empty in the small hours, the Atlantic has the beach to itself.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the rooftop terrace, and the first lights come on across Miami Beach's low-rise skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Washington Monument stands unlit against a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of the Washington Monument first, then moves down the stone.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the White House looks closer from VUE Rooftop than it ever does on television.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the National Mall this morning, while the Washington Monument stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the monument view suites, guests watch clouds drift behind the Washington Monument all afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Washington Monument turns almost the same colour as the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Washington Monument today, and its top fades into the white sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the National Mall is not visible today, but the White House is still clear two blocks away.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass at VUE Rooftop, and the White House sits slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Washington Monument, and guests at VUE Rooftop count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the White House lawn, and the roof slowly turns the same white as the walls.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Washington Monument stands sharp against the sky, every edge easy to follow.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the spa look out over Washington, DC from a warm, bright room.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the National Mall, and the Washington Monument seems to tremble a little in the distance.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the trees around the White House look deep green from the 11th floor.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills the glass-walled terrace of VUE Rooftop and turns the Washington Monument the colour of honey.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the Washington Monument changes from gold to pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the White House glows white, and guests in this 1917 hotel look across at it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the White House stretch into long reflections on the streets below.
phrases.mild_night: The lit Washington Monument rises into low cloud tonight and gives the sky above it a soft glow.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the Presidential Suite see the lit Washington Monument against a black sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests still awake in the monument view rooms find the Washington Monument keeping them company.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset as the first lights come on at the White House, seen from VUE Rooftop.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Nhlaralumi riverbed is a faint band of sand below the suite decks, under a sky still full of stars.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Nhlaralumi riverbed, and guests in the secluded hide look along the sand for any game walking through.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the sand of the Nhlaralumi riverbed is bright, right below the wide decks of the split-level lounge.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly along the Nhlaralumi riverbed this morning, crossing the sand below the bar.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun and shade take turns on the Nhlaralumi riverbed this afternoon, below the private decks of the suites.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Nhlaralumi riverbed keeps its sand colour, and the bush on both banks looks darker.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the far bank of the Nhlaralumi riverbed today, and from the secluded hide the sand seems to end early.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far bends of the Nhlaralumi riverbed are not visible today; guests in the split-level lounge see only the sand just below.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Nhlaralumi riverbed, and guests in the split-level lounge watch the sand darken and wonder if the river will run.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Nhlaralumi riverbed for a second, and guests watch the storm from behind the glass of their suites.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Nhlaralumi riverbed, and guests at the bar watch white flakes land on the sand.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and the Nhlaralumi riverbed looks sharp in every detail from the split-level lounge.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the secluded hide sit close together and keep their eyes on the Nhlaralumi riverbed.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in their plunge pools and watch the Nhlaralumi riverbed from water level.
phrases.warm: Since 1978, guests at this camp have spent warm days like this one on a deck, looking at the sand of the Nhlaralumi riverbed.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the sand of the Nhlaralumi riverbed gold, and guests at the bar watch the colour change.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the Nhlaralumi riverbed below the split-level lounge one stretch at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the Nhlaralumi riverbed is a pale line in the dark, seen from the split-level lounge.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the decks this evening, and guests at the bar watch the Nhlaralumi riverbed disappear into the wet dark.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and the Nhlaralumi riverbed shows only where the lamps on the lounge decks reach the sand.
phrases.clear_night: On some clear nights like this one, dinner is laid on the sand of the Nhlaralumi riverbed, with the stars above the table.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the camp is quiet, and the Nhlaralumi riverbed belongs to the game that walks along it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the sand of the Nhlaralumi riverbed holds the light longer than the bush around it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Sugarloaf Mountain is a dark shape above Guanabara Bay, and the sky behind it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the pool, guests see Sugarloaf Mountain in clear morning light, with Guanabara Bay bright below it.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch on the terrace of Beatriz Restaurant, guests look over the city to Sugarloaf Mountain under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Guanabara Bay this morning, while Sugarloaf Mountain stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the garden, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they pass over the city and Sugarloaf Mountain.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Guanabara Bay turns the colour of metal, and Sugarloaf Mountain stands out darker against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Guanabara Bay today, and the boats at Botafogo look like small pencil marks on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Guanabara Bay is not visible today, but from the terrace Sugarloaf Mountain still shows in soft grey.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Guanabara Bay, and guests in the Claudia Suite watch Sugarloaf Mountain blur behind the bathroom window.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Sugarloaf Mountain for a second, then the storm clouds close over Guanabara Bay again.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the hilltop gardens, and Sugarloaf Mountain turns faint and white above Guanabara Bay.
phrases.very_cold: The air is sharp and clear today, and from the terrace every ridge of Sugarloaf Mountain shows across Guanabara Bay.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass walls of the living room, where Sugarloaf Mountain stands above a grey-blue Guanabara Bay.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool up to their shoulders and look at Sugarloaf Mountain across the bright water of Guanabara Bay.
phrases.warm: By the pool, books stay closed on the sunbeds while guests look at Sugarloaf Mountain instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns Sugarloaf Mountain gold, and guests in the garden stop to watch the light change on Guanabara Bay.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights Sugarloaf Mountain in orange, seen from a house built in the 70s.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Botafogo shine below the terrace, and Sugarloaf Mountain is a darker shape behind them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass tonight, and the lights of Botafogo spread into soft yellow lines along Guanabara Bay.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests on their suite balconies look at the lights of Botafogo around the edge of Guanabara Bay.
phrases.clear_night: From the balcony suites, guests see Sugarloaf Mountain under a clear night sky, with the airport lights shining beside Guanabara Bay.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Guanabara Bay lies still and black below the 7 suites, and Sugarloaf Mountain stands quietly above it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind Sugarloaf Mountain, and the first lights of Botafogo come on along Guanabara Bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over South Beach, and the Atlantic Ocean is still darker than the sand.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Victoria Penthouse terrace, guests see Lummus Park and the Atlantic Ocean together in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Atlantic Ocean is turquoise beyond the white sand of South Beach, under a sky with no clouds.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the sand of South Beach this morning, while the Atlantic Ocean stays bright further out.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony rooms, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the palm trees and South Beach.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns grey too, and the white sand of South Beach is the brightest thing in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic Ocean and the sky look like one sheet behind South Beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far part of the Atlantic Ocean is not visible today; guests see the palm trees of Lummus Park and the near sand of South Beach.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on South Beach, and guests in this 2004 hotel watch it darken the sand from behind their windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and for a second South Beach shows white under the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on South Beach, and guests on the balconies watch it land on the palm trees.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing under a bright sky, and South Beach lies empty beside a sharp blue Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the palm trees of Lummus Park stand in front of South Beach, and guests look past them to the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the Victoria Penthouse terrace sit in the plunge pool and look over Lummus Park to the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.warm: Blue umbrellas dot the white sand of South Beach on this warm day, and swimmers share the calm Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight turns the sand of South Beach gold, and the palm trees throw long shadows across it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Atlantic Ocean turn pink, and South Beach lies in soft light below them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights along the promenade show the palm trees, and South Beach fades into the dark behind them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, rain blurs the promenade lights, with South Beach lost in the dark beyond.
phrases.mild_night: Guests on the balconies look across the palm-lined promenade to South Beach, a wide grey strip under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and South Beach is a long pale band below the Victoria Penthouse terrace.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours South Beach is empty, and the Atlantic Ocean is only a darker space beyond the sand.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky over the Atlantic Ocean is still bright, and the first lights come on along the edge of South Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Haystack Rock stands as a dark shape above the pale sand of Cannon Beach.
phrases.clear_morning: In the clear morning light, guests in oceanfront rooms can read the texture of Haystack Rock from their windows.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Pacific Ocean is blue to the horizon, and Haystack Rock stands sharp against it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Cannon Beach this morning, while Haystack Rock moves in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the living room's floor-to-ceiling windows, guests follow the clouds drifting over Haystack Rock this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: The grey sky and the grey Pacific Ocean meet without a clear line today, and Haystack Rock stands between them.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Cannon Beach, and Haystack Rock appears and disappears like a slow magic trick.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon of the Pacific Ocean is not visible today, and Haystack Rock shows only as a soft outline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Cannon Beach; guests watch it from oceanfront rooms, with Haystack Rock grey behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second Haystack Rock stands out against the white sky.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Cannon Beach, and guests in the living room watch the flakes drift past Haystack Rock.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay by the living room fireplace and look out at Haystack Rock in the clear, freezing air.
phrases.cold: The cold air keeps Cannon Beach quiet today, and long lines of Pacific waves roll in beside Haystack Rock.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the oceanfront balconies look at the Pacific Ocean the way others look at a cold drink.
phrases.warm: Warm weather brings walkers onto Cannon Beach, small figures on the sand under Haystack Rock.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At the afternoon wine tasting, guests hold their glasses and watch the sun drop toward the Pacific Ocean beside Haystack Rock.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and colours the sky orange behind Haystack Rock.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Pacific Ocean is almost dark, and guests in the living room can still pick out Haystack Rock.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the oceanfront windows tonight, and Haystack Rock is only a blur beyond Cannon Beach.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the white edges of the Pacific waves still show on Cannon Beach near Haystack Rock.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests on the oceanfront balconies find Haystack Rock lit by the moon above the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Haystack Rock is only a deeper black against the sky, and the sound of the tide fills in the rest.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Pacific Ocean stays bright, and Haystack Rock stands in front of the last colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Taormina Bay is quiet and dark blue, and Mount Etna slowly takes shape on the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: From the panoramic pool, Mount Etna stands clear on the horizon this morning, beyond the Taormina cliff.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the water of Taormina Bay is bright blue, and guests at the panoramic pool look across it to the Taormina cliff.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Mount Etna this morning, while Taormina Bay stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From their sea-facing balconies, guests watch cloud shadows move slowly across Taormina Bay this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Taormina Bay turns the colour of pewter, and the Taormina cliff stands dark above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Taormina Bay today, and Mount Etna is only a faint outline on the horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Mount Etna is not visible today; guests at the panoramic pool see Taormina Bay and the Taormina cliff, and little beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Taormina Bay, and guests in the Mare Suite watch the water turn grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Taormina Bay, and for a second the Taormina cliff shows white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Taormina Bay, and the flakes disappear as they touch the sea.
phrases.very_cold: The cold air is very clear today, and Mount Etna looks sharp on the horizon across Taormina Bay.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests on the outdoor spa terrace look out over a calm, grey-blue Taormina Bay.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the panoramic pool and look across Taormina Bay to a pale Mount Etna.
phrases.warm: By the panoramic pool, books stay closed on this warm day while guests look at Mount Etna on the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light warms the Taormina cliff late this afternoon, and Taormina Bay below it turns a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds above Mount Etna pink, and guests watch from their sea-facing balconies.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests dining at Ristorante Sant’Andrea look out at a dark Taormina Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Taormina Bay this evening, and the lights along the shore blur on the wet water.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, yet a few lights along the shore still mark the curve of Taormina Bay.
phrases.clear_night: From a villa built in 1919, guests look out at stars above Taormina Bay tonight.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Taormina Bay is black and still, and nothing moves on the water.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright above Mount Etna, and the first lights come on around Taormina Bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sydney Harbour Bridge is a dark outline over still water, and the sky behind it begins to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: In Opera House view rooms, guests take breakfast in bed while the morning sun lights the Sydney Opera House.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Sydney Opera House stands bright against the blue harbour.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the harbour this morning, and guests watch them slide over the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Bridge view rooms, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift behind the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Circular Quay, and the Sydney Opera House keeps its clear shape against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the harbour today, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge seems to float above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the harbour is not visible today; guests can still make out the Sydney Opera House, a little faded.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Circular Quay, and guests watch the Sydney Harbour Bridge turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the harbour, and for a second the Sydney Opera House shows clearly under the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the harbour, and guests look for the Sydney Harbour Bridge through the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the Sydney Opera House looks sharp, and guests admire it from the warm side of the glass.

phrases.warm: On this warm day, the Sydney Harbour Bridge and the Sydney Opera House share the harbour, one on each side of the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests watch the sun go low over the harbour, and the Sydney Opera House turns gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge glows and fades by turns.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Sydney Harbour Bridge draws a line of light across the dark harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening lights, and guests see the Sydney Opera House glow softly through the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: From the Presidential Suite, guests look over the night harbour, where the lights of the Sydney Harbour Bridge shine under low cloud.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Sydney Harbour Bridge stands over a quiet harbour, seen from a tower that opened in 1989.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on in the office towers of the city skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, a thin band of light grows on the horizon of the Mediterranean, and the beach below is still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun comes off the Mediterranean, and guests in the corner suites on the highest floors see the sea and the Barcelona skyline at once.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Mediterranean is deep blue to the horizon from this 44-storey tower, and the W hotel stands small in the distance.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Barcelona skyline this morning, while Sagrada Familia stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the infinity pool, clouds drift over the marina and the Mediterranean beyond it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Mediterranean turns the colour of steel, and El Peix, Frank Gehry's fish sculpture, stands out against it from the pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Guests looking for Sagrada Familia in today's haze find only a soft outline in the Barcelona skyline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the horizon of the Mediterranean is not visible, and guests see only the nearest streets of Barcelona.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of the infinity pool, and behind it the marina and the Mediterranean are the same wet grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Mediterranean, and the corner suites on the highest floors give guests the storm on the sea side and the city side.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Barcelona skyline, and Sagrada Familia fades behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Mediterranean shows a sharp horizon from the sea-facing rooms.

phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look at the Mediterranean from the water.
phrases.warm: On the pool loungers, guests look past El Peix to the Mediterranean, and nobody hurries.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun fills the city side with orange light, and Sagrada Familia stands clear above the rooftops of Barcelona.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds over the Mediterranean, and the beach below turns gold.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds sit low over the Barcelona skyline this evening, and the city lights glow under them, street after street.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights of the marina shine blurred on the wet quays.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Mediterranean is black, and the lights along the beach mark where the land ends.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and guests can pick out Sagrada Familia among the lights of the Barcelona skyline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Barcelona skyline is quiet, and the Mediterranean beside it is one wide dark surface.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Mediterranean, and guests in the corner suites watch the first lights come on across the Barcelona skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky above Victoria Harbour turns from black to deep blue, and the water slowly follows.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Through the lobby's floor-to-ceiling windows, sun and cloud take turns over Victoria Harbour this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Victoria Harbour turns the colour of steel, and the Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront draws a neat edge along it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits on Victoria Harbour today, and the towers of Hong Kong Island fade into it floor by floor.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today: the Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront is clear below, but the far side of Victoria Harbour is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass, and guests watch Victoria Harbour turn grey from their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Victoria Harbour, and guests in the lobby stop to watch the storm cross the water.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront, and Victoria Harbour beyond it is pale and quiet.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing, clear day, guests warm their hands on coffee in Birdsong and look out over a sharp, bright Victoria Harbour.

phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders, with Victoria Harbour shining beyond the edge.
phrases.warm: On the loungers by the rooftop pool, guests face Victoria Harbour in the warm air, and nobody hurries to leave.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Victoria Harbour gold, and all 495 rooms get the same show.
phrases.partly_golden: In Birdsong, guests hold a drink and watch the last sun break through the clouds onto Victoria Harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: From Swim Club, the city lights across Victoria Harbour glow under low evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening lights across Victoria Harbour, and the water carries their colours in long streaks.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront is a line of lights below, and Victoria Harbour is dark beyond it.

phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on along the Hong Kong Island skyline across Victoria Harbour.

phrases.partly_afternoon: From Firn, sunny patches drift across Elliott Bay this afternoon, beyond the roofs of the Railspur District.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Elliott Bay turns the colour of steel, and the brick of Pioneer Square looks redder below.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Elliott Bay today, and Smith Tower shows only in part above the Pioneer Square roofs.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Olympic Mountains are not visible today, and Elliott Bay fades into pale air a short way from the shore.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Pioneer Square, and guests in the corner rooms watch the streets shine through two wide windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Elliott Bay, and guests count the seconds until thunder rolls across the Railspur District.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Railspur District, and Elliott Bay is only a grey band behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Elliott Bay is sharp and blue, and the Olympic Mountains look close enough to count.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, Elliott Bay lies still and pale beyond the Railspur District, a sight that goes well with a hot drink.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests at Firn take the shaded seats and look out at Elliott Bay, which shimmers.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns Elliott Bay gold, and from Firn, Smith Tower glows on one side.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds, and Elliott Bay shows orange and grey in long bands.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the downtown Seattle skyline is lit above the rooftop, with Elliott Bay dark beside it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the waterfront lights this evening, and guests watch from the covered areas at Firn as Elliott Bay disappears.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests in this 1907 building who are still awake look out at the empty streets of Pioneer Square.

phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean loses its turquoise, and Waikiki Beach looks paler than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Diamond Head today, and the crater looks like a faded drawing behind Waikiki Beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Diamond Head is not visible today; guests see Waikiki Beach and the first waves, and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Waikiki Beach and darkens the sand, and the Pacific Ocean turns grey under the shower.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Waikiki Beach, and guests on the Mailani Tower balconies can hardly believe the white palm trees.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and clear, the sand of Waikiki Beach lies empty, and Diamond Head stands sharp beyond it.

phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests in the shaded beachfront cabanas look at swimmers cooling off in the sea at Waikiki Beach.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Mai Tai Bar, guests watch the sun sink towards the Pacific Ocean while the sand of Waikiki Beach turns gold.

phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening of cloud, guests at Mai Tai Bar see the lights of Waikiki reflected on the wet edge of the sand.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights along Waikiki Beach tonight, and the Pacific Ocean beyond them is black.

phrases.clear_night: Stars shine over the Pacific Ocean tonight, and the shore lights of Waikiki Beach glitter below them.

phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, Shakusui-en is quiet, and the Higashiyama Mountains merge with the sky behind it.
phrases.clear_night: City lights spread out in front of the city-facing suites under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Shakusui-en is dark and silent, and even the carp seem to be asleep.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Higashiyama Mountains is still bright, and the first lanterns come on along the garden path.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Prague Castle is a dark shape above the Vltava River under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Ginger & Fred on the 7th floor, guests look across the Vltava River to Prague Castle in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Lunch at Ginger & Fred has a wide panorama of Prague today, with Prague Castle sharp against a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move over Petřín Hill this morning, while Prague Castle stays in sunshine above the Vltava River.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the river-view rooms, guests follow the clouds as they drift along the Vltava River towards Petřín Hill.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Vltava River turns the colour of steel, and Prague Castle stands above it in the same quiet tone.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on the Vltava River today, and Prague Castle seems to float above it with no hill underneath.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Prague Castle is not visible from the observation terrace today; the Vltava River and the nearest bank are all that can be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Vltava River, and guests in the Ginger Suite watch Prague Castle blur behind the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Prague, and each flash of lightning shows Prague Castle for a second above the dark Vltava River.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Vltava River, and from Ginger & Fred the roofs of Prague Castle are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Prague Castle looks close enough to touch, and the Vltava River shines like metal below it.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests at Dancing House Café stay by the window with hot drinks and watch the Vltava River go by.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the terrace look for shade first and for Prague Castle across the Vltava River second.
phrases.warm: On the terrace of Ginger & Fred, guests sit in the warm air with a cocktail and look across the Vltava River to Prague Castle.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Vltava River to gold, and from the rooftop bar Prague Castle glows above the water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights Prague Castle in pieces, one tower at a time, above the Vltava River.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests at the rooftop bar see Prague Castle lit above the dark Vltava River.
phrases.wet_evening: From the Ginger Royal Suite, guests look at the lit Prague Castle through the rain, with the wet Vltava River in front.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lights of Prague Castle colour the low clouds, and the Vltava River carries the same glow.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in this building by Frank Gehry and Vlado Milunić see the lit Prague Castle under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Vltava River moves quietly past, and Prague sleeps on both of its banks.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the rooftop bar guests watch the first lights come on at Prague Castle.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Naama Bay is a calm grey arc below the terraces, and the sky above it is only starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Naama Bay, and from their balconies guests see the water shine below the Arabesque terraces.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the infinity pool appears level with Naama Bay, and the line between them is difficult to find.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Naama Bay this morning, and guests follow them from Liwa Restaurant.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Beyond the edge of the infinity pool, Naama Bay changes from bright blue to deeper blue each time an afternoon cloud passes.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Naama Bay takes the same colour, and its curve stays clear from the Liwa Restaurant terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over Naama Bay today, and the water and the sky are almost one colour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests can see the near water of Naama Bay today, but the far ends of the bay are not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Naama Bay, and guests watch the drops mark the water from the shelter of their balconies.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole arc of Naama Bay for a second, and guests behind their balcony doors count the seconds to the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Naama Bay, and from Liwa Restaurant guests watch the flakes disappear into the water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and Naama Bay looks sharp from end to end below the terraces.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the infinity pool is quiet, and Naama Bay lies still just beyond its edge.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look out over the arc of Naama Bay.
phrases.warm: On the terrace of Liwa Restaurant, guests sit in the warm air and look down at the bay curving away in both directions.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light falls on Naama Bay, and guests in the 289 rooms see it from their balconies.
phrases.partly_golden: From the open-air Horizon pavilion, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds and the water of Naama Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the promenade lights draw the curve of Naama Bay, and guests at Liwa Restaurant follow it from their tables.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the promenade lights tonight, and their reflection in Naama Bay breaks into small pieces.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of the promenade settle into the water of Naama Bay.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Naama Bay tonight, and the infinity pool lies like a still mirror beside the bay.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Naama Bay is quiet below the terraces, and only the edge of the water is easy to make out.
phrases.dusk: The sky over Naama Bay is still bright, and the first promenade lights appear along the edge of the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Caribbean Sea is a wide dark surface under a clear sky, and the two private beaches are empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light shows the Mesoamerican Barrier Reef as a darker band in the turquoise Caribbean Sea.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests at La Punta Grill & Lounge look across bright Caribbean water to the reef.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly over the Caribbean Sea this morning, and the white sand of the beach stays bright between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the outdoor tables of La Punta Grill & Lounge, guests follow patches of sun and shade crossing the water above the reef.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky the Caribbean Sea loses its turquoise and turns the colour of slate.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Caribbean Sea today, and the water and the sky become one pale colour off the two private beaches.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; only the near water of the Caribbean Sea shows from the beach, and the reef line stays hidden.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Caribbean Sea, and guests in the master suites watch it dot their infinity pools.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Caribbean Sea, and guests at Bar A-Kan watch the storm from this oceanfront space.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the white sand of the two private beaches, and for once the Caribbean Sea is the darker of the two.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing air the Caribbean Sea looks sharp and clear, and the horizon is a clean line beyond the turquoise water.
phrases.cold: The cold day leaves the Caribbean Sea clear and bright, and the Mesoamerican Barrier Reef shows as a line just offshore.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the beach stay under the palms and look at the turquoise water instead of their books.
phrases.warm: On this warm day guests lie on the white sand of the two private beaches and look out to the reef.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Penthouse terrace on the 5th floor, guests see the Caribbean Sea turn gold in the last clear light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken clouds, and the palms on the beach throw long shadows across the white sand.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening sky is cloudy with no stars, and guests at La Punta Grill & Lounge sit beside a dark Caribbean Sea.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the dark Caribbean Sea this evening, and guests in the master suites listen to it on their terraces.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars on this mild night, and from the ocean-view terraces the Caribbean Sea shows only as a faint white line of surf.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Caribbean Sea tonight, and from Bar A-Kan guests can still find the horizon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Caribbean Sea is more sound than sight, small waves reaching the two private beaches.
phrases.dusk: At Bar A-Kan, guests hold a first cocktail while the sky over the Caribbean Sea turns pastel just after sunset.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dallas skyline stands grey and still against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Dallas skyline, and from the top-floor terraces on the 11th and 12th floors nothing stands in the way of it.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Dallas skyline is sharp, and each tower is easy to tell apart from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Dallas skyline this morning, and guests on the 12th floor follow them from one tower to the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Presidential Suite look out at the Dallas skyline as afternoon clouds drift slowly behind the towers.
