phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Dallas skyline loses its shine, though its full outline remains clear from the top-floor terraces.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Dallas skyline today, and the towers farther away look like a drawing half rubbed out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far towers of the Dallas skyline are not visible today, and guests see only the nearer part of the city clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Dallas; guests in the Penthouse Suite watch it through the windows, the skyline slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Dallas skyline, and guests indoors count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Dallas, and guests in this 1923 hotel watch the skyline fade to white behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, so the Dallas skyline looks very sharp from the top-floor terraces, and most guests admire it through the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Dallas skyline stands clean against the sky, and the Uptown buildings in front of it show every detail.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the city, and guests on the rooftop terrace keep to the shade of the pergola while they look at the Dallas skyline.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace, guests sit back in the lounge chairs and let the Dallas skyline do the entertaining.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the Dallas skyline gold, and the top-floor terraces catch the same warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Dallas skyline turn orange and pink, a slow show seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: The clouds over Dallas take an orange glow from the city lights this evening, and the skyline shines below them.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the Dallas skyline run together on the wet windows this evening, and guests watch from the dry side.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit Dallas skyline fills the view from the top-floor terraces.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the Presidential Suite see the Dallas skyline lit from end to end.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Dallas skyline is quiet, and the few guests still awake have it to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the Dallas skyline beyond the rooftop terrace and its fire pit.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Plaza Cibeles is quiet under a clear sky, and the Madrid rooftops are only outlines.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the private terraces on the 5th floor, and Palacio de las Cortes stands sharp against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From Ático on the 11th floor, Plaza Cibeles lies in full midday light under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit above the Madrid skyline this morning, and the rooftops stay bright between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the 11th-floor lounge, guests watch patches of sun and shade take turns on Plaza Cibeles this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the rooftops of Madrid take the same colour, and Plaza Cibeles looks calm.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Madrid skyline today, and Plaza Cibeles appears from the 11th floor like a faded photograph.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far edge of the Madrid skyline is not visible today, but Palacio de las Cortes stays clear from the terrace suites.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Palacio de las Cortes; guests in the terrace suites watch it from indoors, the roofs around it shining wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Madrid rooftops, and each flash of lightning shows Plaza Cibeles for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Madrid rooftops, and guests in this 1956 hotel watch Plaza Cibeles slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so every rooftop on the Madrid skyline has a sharp edge today.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the terrace suites look at Palacio de las Cortes through the glass, coffee in hand.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests at Ático keep a cold drink close while Plaza Cibeles shimmers in the bright light.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, the couches at Ático fill up, and the conversation keeps stopping for the Madrid skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests at Ático take their cocktails as the low sun turns Plaza Cibeles and the rooftops gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and paints the Madrid skyline orange, one rooftop at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Plaza Cibeles glow, and the clouds above Madrid take a little of their colour.
phrases.wet_evening: In this evening's wet weather, the lights of Madrid blur, and Plaza Cibeles shines like a mirror.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the city lights spread from Plaza Cibeles across the Madrid skyline.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, Palacio de las Cortes is lit, and the rooftops around it are still.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests still awake in this 123-room hotel find Plaza Cibeles almost empty.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky above Madrid is still bright, and the first lights come on around Plaza Cibeles.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Grand Canal lies still and almost empty, and the Rialto Bridge shows as a pale arch above it.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the Grand Canal, guests watch the first boats pass in clear morning light, with reflections moving across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests at lunch in Venice M'Art face the Rialto Bridge and the market area, both sharp under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Grand Canal this morning, and the Rialto Bridge goes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the Altana, the Grand Canal bends beneath the Rialto Bridge while clouds drift over terracotta rooftops and domes.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the Grand Canal takes the same colour, and guests can pick out the arch of the Rialto Bridge against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Grand Canal today; boats appear from nowhere, and the Rialto Bridge is only a soft outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Dolomites cannot be seen from the Altana today and the far bell towers are faint, but the Rialto Bridge remains clear.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Grand Canal with small circles, and guests in rooms facing the Rialto Bridge watch its arch shine wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: From behind the large windows, guests watch lightning show the Rialto Bridge and the Grand Canal for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Grand Canal and melts at once, but it stays on the Rialto Bridge and on the rooftops below the Altana.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing day with air this clear, the Altana shows the snow-capped Dolomites far beyond the domes and bell towers.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests inside Venice M'Art look across the Grand Canal to the Rialto Bridge and the market area.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the Grand Canal terrace move very little and let the boats on the water do all the work.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests in rooms with Grand Canal balconies step outside to watch gondolas pass towards the Rialto Bridge.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the palazzos along the Grand Canal gold, and from the Grand Canal terrace the boats pull long shadows over the water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lights the bell towers one at a time, as seen from the Altana above the Grand Canal.
phrases.grey_evening: At Francy's, guests have dinner facing the Grand Canal, where the lights of the palazzos sit on the water under a clouded sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests in The Venice Bitter Club look over the Grand Canal through rain on the glass, cocktails in hand.
phrases.mild_night: The lit Rialto Bridge is reflected in the Grand Canal on this mild, cloudy night, as it has been many times before this 13th-century palazzo.
phrases.clear_night: From the Altana, the lit Rialto Bridge and the winding Grand Canal lie below a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Rialto Bridge stands alone over a Grand Canal that barely moves, while the 43 rooms sleep.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still deep blue, and guests see the first lights come on along the Rialto Bridge and the Grand Canal.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Marina Bay lies still under a clear sky, and guests in city-facing rooms watch the first colour arrive on the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Sands SkyPark Observation Deck, the clear morning sun lights Marina Bay and the city towers standing around it.
phrases.clear_midday: From the infinity pool on the 57th floor, the city stands sharp on three sides at midday, with Marina Bay bright blue below.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Marina Bay this morning, and guests at breakfast in Club55 watch them move over the city.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Gardens by the Bay this afternoon, and the Supertrees go from shade to sun below the garden-facing balconies.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Marina Bay turns the colour of steel, and the Merlion is still easy to find across the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and from the infinity pool the towers across Marina Bay look like a faded photograph.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the Sands SkyPark Observation Deck shows Marina Bay and the nearest towers, while the far side of the city is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Marina Bay, and guests in Club55 watch the city skyline blur behind the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: The infinity pool closes for the storm, so guests watch lightning over Marina Bay from the city-facing windows instead.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Marina Bay, and from the Sands SkyPark Observation Deck the city towers fade slowly into white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, the city skyline is sharp across Marina Bay, and guests study it from the warm side of the glass in Club55.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Sands SkyPark Observation Deck still gives the full circle of Marina Bay, the city and Gardens by the Bay.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look over the edge at the city above Marina Bay.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the loungers by the infinity pool look out to the sea, books left closed.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the city towers gold across Marina Bay, seen from the building Moshe Safdie designed.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Marina Bay turn orange, and guests in Club55 watch the colour reach Gardens by the Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Spectra light show colours Marina Bay, and the low sky holds some of the glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the city-facing windows tonight, and the lights around Marina Bay spread into soft colours.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the city lights sit in a ring around Marina Bay, with no stars to compete with them.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the city skyline shines across Marina Bay, and the water doubles every light.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Marina Bay rests, a wide calm water with the sleeping city around it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over Marina Bay while the first lights come on in the city, seen from the infinity pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over Göreme grows pale behind the fairy chimneys, and the panoramic terrace is the place to wait for the balloons.
phrases.clear_morning: Hot-air balloons drift over Göreme in clear morning light, and breakfast on the terrace goes slowly because of them.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Uçhisar Castle rises directly behind the rooftop pool, every carved opening easy to count.
phrases.partly_morning: From the terrace of a Royal Cave Suite, the balloons over Göreme pass between patches of morning cloud.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move slowly across the rock face of Uçhisar Castle this afternoon, seen from the rooftop pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Uçhisar Castle keeps every detail of its carved face, seen from the panoramic terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze fills the valley toward Göreme today, and from the panoramic terrace the fairy chimneys fade one row at a time.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Göreme and the far fairy chimneys are not visible today, but Uçhisar Castle, 300 metres away, stays clear from the rooftop pool.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Uçhisar valley; guests in valley-view rooms watch the fairy chimneys turn a darker shade.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Uçhisar Castle for a second at a time from the panoramic terrace, and thunder rolls across the valley.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the fairy chimneys, and from the panoramic terrace Uçhisar Castle slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, Uçhisar Castle looks close enough to touch from the panoramic terrace.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 18-room cave hotel look out from valley-view rooms at the fairy chimneys.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look up at the carved rock of Uçhisar Castle behind the water.
phrases.warm: On the loungers by the rooftop pool, guests read one page and then look at the cave rooms of Uçhisar Castle again.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Aside Garden, the low sun turns the Uçhisar valley and its fairy chimneys gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights the top of Uçhisar Castle, while the rooftop pool is already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, Uçhisar Castle is a dark shape from the panoramic terrace, and the valley below is quiet.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Uçhisar valley this evening, and guests in the Royal Cave Suites listen to it with the fairy chimneys lost in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the night sky, and from the panoramic terrace the outline of Uçhisar Castle is just visible against them.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear night sky above Uçhisar Castle, and the panoramic terrace has a wide view of both.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the valley toward Göreme is still, and the balloons that will fill this sky are not yet unpacked.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright behind Uçhisar Castle, and the first lights appear in the valley below Aside Garden.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Saadiyat shores are a pale line of sand beside the still-dark Arabian Gulf.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast guests at Beach House look out at the beach in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: From the lounge on the rooftop, guests see the Arabian Gulf lying blue and flat to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows drift along the Saadiyat shores while the landscaped gardens of the Three-Bedroom Villa stay in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Park Suite watch patches of sun and shade trade places on the Arabian Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey cover of cloud, the Arabian Gulf and the Saadiyat shores share one soft silver colour.
phrases.fog_haze: The Saadiyat shores look pale in today's haze, and the Arabian Gulf beyond them is a soft grey.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Saadiyat shores are clear to see, the Arabian Gulf fades early, and the horizon is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain dots the sand of the Saadiyat shores, and for once the beach has no footprints.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Arabian Sea in short flashes to guests watching from the Park Suite.
phrases.snow: From inside the Three-Bedroom Villa, guests watch snow fall on the landscaped gardens and the ocean beyond.
phrases.very_cold: Inside the Park Suite, guests hold warm cups and look at a bright, empty Arabian Sea.
phrases.cold: Today the Saadiyat shores are a view to enjoy from indoors, with the Arabian Gulf beyond them.
phrases.very_hot: The Arabian Gulf is busy with swimmers today, as guests on the Saadiyat shores leave the hot sand for the water.
phrases.warm: Barefoot guests follow the waterline along the Saadiyat shores, with the Arabian Gulf washing over their feet.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Shala Beach Lounge, guests turn their chairs toward the sunset over the beach.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds over the Arabian Gulf turn orange, and Shala Beach Lounge has the sunset over the beach in full view.
phrases.grey_evening: After dark the Saadiyat shores are a pale strip under the clouds, and the Arabian Gulf beyond them has gone black.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight's rain falls on the Saadiyat shores, and the Arabian Gulf is dark behind it.
phrases.mild_night: From the Three-Bedroom Villa tonight, the ocean is a dark band beyond the landscaped gardens.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the lounge look out over a dark Arabian Gulf on this clear night.
phrases.late_night: While the hotel sleeps, the Arabian Gulf keeps moving quietly against the Saadiyat shores.
phrases.dusk: A little pink stays on the Arabian Gulf after sunset while the Saadiyat shores go slowly grey.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Sydney Harbour lies quiet below the balconies, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge is a faint shape on the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights Sydney Harbour, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge stands clear on the horizon beside the city skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Beach Club terrace, a bright blue Sydney Harbour stretches past the striped umbrellas to the city skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Sydney Harbour this morning, while the city skyline across the water stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the wrap-around balconies of the Grand Harbour Suites, guests follow clouds drifting over the city skyline and the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Sydney Harbour turns silver, and the moored sailboats barely move.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Sydney Harbour today, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge is only a faint curve on the horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Sydney Harbour Bridge and the city skyline are not visible today; the moored sailboats in Watsons Bay are the view.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Sydney Harbour, and the city skyline blurs behind it across the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Sydney Harbour, and for a second the Sydney Harbour Bridge shows on the horizon.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Sydney Harbour, a sight so rare here that guests check twice before believing it.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Sydney Harbour Bridge and the city skyline look sharp across the steel-blue harbour.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the balcony doors and watch the ferry cross Sydney Harbour.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests at Beach Club keep to the shade of the striped umbrellas and look out at the glittering harbour.
phrases.warm: On a warm afternoon at Beach Club, the seafood platter has to compete with the sailboats on Sydney Harbour.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills Sydney Harbour, and from Beach Club the city skyline begins to glow across the water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and guests on the harbour-facing balconies watch Sydney Harbour turn orange and pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights across Sydney Harbour shine softly, and the lit Sydney Harbour Bridge closes the horizon.
phrases.wet_evening: Through the evening rain, the lights of the city skyline spread into long reflections on Sydney Harbour.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the cloud above the city skyline glows faintly, and Sydney Harbour lies black below it.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Sydney Harbour Bridge and the city skyline shine across the dark harbour.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Sydney Harbour is still and dark, and the bay has the night to itself.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky behind the Sydney Harbour Bridge stays bright, and the first lights appear along the city skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, La Pedrera is a dark curling shape, and the Sagrada Família towers wait behind it for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Sagrada Família towers first, then moves down onto the stone curves of La Pedrera.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch on The Rooftop at Sir Victor, guests look across to La Pedrera under a clear blue sky, the Sagrada Família behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift behind the Sagrada Família this morning, while the facade of La Pedrera stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lobby on the ground floor, guests watch cloud shadows and shoppers cross Passeig de Gràcia this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the stone of La Pedrera turns the same colour as the clouds, and its curves look softer from the wooden rooftop.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Sagrada Família today, and its towers look like pencil lines behind La Pedrera.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Sagrada Família is difficult to see in the thick air today, but La Pedrera remains clear from the rooftop.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Passeig de Gràcia, and guests watch the umbrellas go by from the lobby.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city rooftops, and for a second lightning shows the towers of the Sagrada Família behind La Pedrera.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the curling stone of La Pedrera, and the Sagrada Família is faint behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and each tower of the Sagrada Família stands out behind La Pedrera.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the suites facing Passeig de Gràcia stay in the reading nook and watch people in coats walk along the boulevard.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look at La Pedrera from the water.
phrases.warm: On the loungers by the rooftop pool, books stay closed while guests look at the curves of La Pedrera instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the stone of La Pedrera gold, and guests at the marble bar of The Rooftop at Sir Victor forget their cocktails for a moment.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the Sagrada Família towers, while La Pedrera is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit facade of La Pedrera glows against the grey sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Passeig de Gràcia shine on the pavement, and guests watch from the dry side of the lobby windows.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, guests on their balconies above Passeig de Gràcia watch the boulevard lights under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the lit towers of the Sagrada Família stand behind the curves of La Pedrera.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Passeig de Gràcia is almost empty below the balconies, and only a few taxis pass.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the facade of La Pedrera, with the Sagrada Família behind.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Huangpu River is a quiet grey band, and the Pudong skyline stands unlit against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on the Oriental Pearl Tower, and guests in rooms with panoramic Bund views follow the Huangpu River bend by bend.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Pudong skyline is sharp in every detail, and its towers shine above the Huangpu River.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Pudong skyline this morning, and their shadows cross the Huangpu River one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Shanghai John Jacob Astor Suite, guests watch patches of sun and cloud move across the Bund and the Pudong skyline this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: From the high-floor restaurant terrace, the Huangpu River takes the grey of the sky, and the Oriental Pearl Tower stands out clearly across the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Pudong skyline today, and the Oriental Pearl Tower looks like a pencil sketch above the Huangpu River.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so guests see the Huangpu River and the nearest towers, while the rest of the Pudong skyline is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Huangpu River, and guests in the corner rooms watch the Oriental Pearl Tower blur behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pudong skyline, and for a second guests see every tower outlined above the dark Huangpu River.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Huangpu River, and the Oriental Pearl Tower fades in and out behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests can pick out each tower of the Pudong skyline from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests swim lengths in the indoor pool and look out at the trees beside it.
phrases.very_hot: Guests with a cold drink at the rooftop bar watch the heat shimmer over the Huangpu River and the Pudong skyline.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests stand on the restaurant terrace and follow the boats on the Huangpu River below the Oriental Pearl Tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Pudong skyline gold, and guests in this hotel, opened in 2024, watch the colour slide down to the Huangpu River.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Oriental Pearl Tower turn pink, and the Huangpu River takes the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: From the rooftop bar, evening cloud hangs low over the Huangpu River, and the lit Pudong skyline colours it from below.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Oriental Pearl Tower run in long streaks across the Huangpu River, and guests in the Shanghai John Jacob Astor Suite stay close to the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the Pudong skyline glows under cloud, and guests in this hotel of 192 rooms have the lit Oriental Pearl Tower for company.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lit Oriental Pearl Tower and the Pudong skyline lie doubled in the Huangpu River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Huangpu River moves slowly past, and the Pudong skyline is a dark shape that seems to sleep standing up.
phrases.dusk: At the rooftop bar, the sky is still bright as the first lights come on along the Pudong skyline and the Oriental Pearl Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the River Tiber is a dark band beyond the rooftops, and the sky above it is just starting to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun falls on the Mausoleum of Augustus, and guests in the rooms facing it watch the old stone brighten.
phrases.clear_midday: From La Terrazza, the view runs under a clear sky from Villa Medici to the River Tiber, with every dome sharp in between.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the rooftops this morning, and the River Tiber is bright one minute and dull the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At lunch in Il Ristorante – Niko Romito on the 5th floor, guests look down on Piazza Augusto Imperatore as sun and shade take turns on it.
phrases.overcast: The sky is flat and grey today; the River Tiber is grey as well, and the dome of St Carlo al Corso rises above the rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the River Tiber today, and from La Terrazza the domes beyond look like they were drawn in soft pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: Villa Medici cannot be seen from La Terrazza, and the River Tiber is only a faint line beyond the nearest rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain falls across the rooftops and runs down the domes, and the River Tiber beyond them is a little blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city, and each flash of lightning shows the River Tiber and the domes for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Mausoleum of Augustus, and from the terrace of the Bvlgari Suite the old walls slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and beyond the rooftops the River Tiber gives a cold, bright shine.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass at Il Ristorante – Niko Romito and look over Piazza Augusto Imperatore from the warm side.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on La Terrazza stay under the parasols and look across the sunlit rooftops to the River Tiber.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, drinks on La Terrazza go slowly, because the view from Villa Medici to the River Tiber takes all the attention.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Since 2023, La Terrazza has offered this hour: low golden sun on the domes and the River Tiber shining beyond them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the River Tiber turns gold in pieces while the dome of St Carlo al Corso glows.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Il Ristorante – Niko Romito, guests look out over Piazza Augusto Imperatore, lit under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and the lights around the River Tiber blur into soft yellow spots beyond the rooftops.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the terrace of the Bvlgari Suite the Mausoleum of Augustus sits quiet under a sky with no stars.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the city tonight, and the lights along the River Tiber mark its curve past the domes.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and the River Tiber keeps moving beyond the sleeping rooftops, with nobody awake to check.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky stays pink over Villa Medici, and the first lights come on along the River Tiber.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the minaret of the Koutoubia Mosque is a dark shape above the pool's hedges, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of the Koutoubia Mosque minaret first, then moves down to the hedges at the edge of the outdoor pool.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Koutoubia Mosque minaret stands sharp above the medina from the panoramic terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass behind the Koutoubia Mosque this morning, and from the rooftop terrace the minaret seems to move instead.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop sky bar, guests follow the cloud shadows that slowly cross the medina this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Koutoubia Mosque minaret still stands out above the clipped hedges of the outdoor pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the medina today, and from the rooftop terrace the Koutoubia Mosque minaret looks like a pale drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the medina is not visible from the rooftop sky bar today, but the Koutoubia Mosque, 350 metres away, still is.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the outdoor pool, and the minaret of the Koutoubia Mosque rises slightly blurred to its right.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the rooftop suites watch the storm from behind the glass, as lightning shows the Koutoubia Mosque minaret for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the rooftop terrace, and the Koutoubia Mosque minaret turns faint behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing bright day, the Royal Suites keep their open view of the Koutoubia Mosque from a terrace with a fireplace.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests look at the Koutoubia Mosque through the windows of the rooftop suites and leave the private terraces for later.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool and look up at the Koutoubia Mosque minaret from the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit a little longer on the panoramic terrace, with the Koutoubia Mosque in view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the landscaped terraces of the Royal Suites, the Koutoubia Mosque minaret turns gold in the late sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights the medina in patches, seen from the rooftop sky bar.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the medina spread out below the rooftop sky bar.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain breaks up the warm lights reflected in the outdoor pool this evening, with the Koutoubia Mosque minaret dim beyond the hedges.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the rooftop terrace the Koutoubia Mosque minaret rises above the medina.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the Koutoubia Mosque, and guests at the rooftop sky bar have the medina at night below them.
phrases.late_night: The 108 rooms sleep in the small hours, while the Koutoubia Mosque minaret keeps its place above the quiet medina.
phrases.dusk: On the rooftop terrace the lanterns come on, and the Koutoubia Mosque minaret stands against a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale behind Naxos, and the open water between the islands is still dark.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun lights the Aegean Sea in front of the sea-view suites, with Naxos clear across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Aegean Sea is a deep blue beyond the pools, and every ridge on Naxos is easy to make out.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move over the open water this morning, while Naxos stays in sunshine on the other side.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon clouds sit on the Naxos mountains, and guests watch them change shape above the Aegean Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Aegean Sea turns the colour of slate, and Naxos stays in plain sight across it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies on the water today, so Naxos is only a faint outline beyond the pools.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Naxos cannot be seen today, and the Aegean Sea fades into pale air a short way from the coast.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Aegean Sea, and guests in the sea-view suites watch Naxos come and go behind the showers.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Naxos mountains for a second, then the storm closes over the open water again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the pools, and the flakes vanish into the Aegean Sea while Naxos hides behind them.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Naxos stands sharp across the water, and guests admire it from indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day guests see the Aegean Sea run dark blue all the way to Naxos.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat guests stay in the pools up to their shoulders, looking across the open water to Naxos.
phrases.warm: By the pools, guests keep their sunbeds turned towards Naxos, and nobody seems in a hurry to leave.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the Naxos mountains gold, and the pools facing them take the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights one Naxos mountain at a time, like a slow spotlight.
phrases.grey_evening: This evening cloud covers the stars, and Naxos is a low dark shape beyond the open water.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain crosses the Aegean Sea, and guests in the suites with private pools watch the drops break the water's surface.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds drift over the Aegean Sea, and Naxos shows whenever the moon gets through.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Aegean Sea tonight, and guests can still find Naxos below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the open water is quiet and black, and Naxos waits across it for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sun has set, the sky is still bright over the Aegean Sea, and Naxos turns violet across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, a thin band of light grows where the Pacific meets the sky, and Coogee Beach is still grey and empty.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Shutters Restaurant, every table looks out across the Pacific, bright blue under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the infinity pool, Coogee Beach lies directly below, its sand bright under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Under scattered cloud, guests at breakfast in Club InterContinental keep one eye on the Pacific, where humpback whales have been seen leaping behind Coogee Beach.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over Coogee Beach this afternoon, and the sand changes colour below the infinity pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, guests at Shutters Restaurant look through the shuttered windows at a Pacific the colour of steel.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze blurs the line between the Pacific and the sky today, and the headland beyond Coogee Beach is only a soft outline from the balconies.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far Pacific is not visible today; from the pool deck, the view stops at Coogee Beach and the first lines of surf.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Coogee Beach and the Pacific behind it; guests at Shutters Restaurant watch from dry tables.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific, and the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites show the whole storm above Coogee Beach.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Coogee Beach, and the Norfolk pines on Arden Street turn white in front of a grey Pacific.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, bright day, the Pacific looks sharp and deep blue from behind the glass of Shutters Restaurant.
phrases.cold: The heated infinity pool stays calm on this cold day, while beyond its edge the waves roll in to Coogee Beach.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and watch the swimmers on Coogee Beach below.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the pool deck sun lounges let their drinks go warm while they watch the Pacific.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late in the afternoon, golden light falls on the Norfolk pines and the Pacific beyond, a view the 198 rooms and suites share.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Pacific turn orange, and the infinity pool takes the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars this evening, and from the balconies the Pacific is a dark space beyond the lights of Coogee.
phrases.wet_evening: At dinner in Shutters Restaurant, the windows are wet and the Pacific beyond them is black, with only the white surf showing.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the pool deck looks out on the lights around Coogee Beach and a Pacific with no horizon.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Club InterContinental terrace faces a Pacific with stars above and nothing except dark water below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Norfolk pines on Arden Street stand in front of the Pacific, and only the surf at Coogee Beach keeps moving.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Pacific is still bright, and the first lights come on along Coogee Beach, seen from the Club InterContinental terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Tidal Basin is still and dark, and the Jefferson Memorial is a quiet outline beyond it.
phrases.clear_morning: At The Lounge, morning coffee is served under tall windows, and the Potomac River shines in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The dome of the Jefferson Memorial stands sharp under a clear midday sky, and the Tidal Basin below it is bright blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Potomac River this morning, and the Lincoln Memorial moves in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the heated indoor pool, swimmers watch clouds drift over the Potomac River between lengths.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Tidal Basin turns the colour of slate, and the Jefferson Memorial dome looks paler above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Potomac River today, and the Lincoln Memorial is only a soft grey form behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Tidal Basin is clear from the water view rooms, while the Lincoln Memorial cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Tidal Basin with small rings; guests watch from the water view rooms, the Jefferson Memorial slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Potomac River, and guests follow the lightning through the tall windows of The Lounge.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Tidal Basin, and the Jefferson Memorial dome slowly fades behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air the Lincoln Memorial looks sharp and close, and nobody hurries outside to check.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the spa look out over the grey-blue Potomac River from the steam and sauna rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Tidal Basin, and guests in balcony rooms look at the Jefferson Memorial from the shade.
phrases.warm: In the warm air, guests gather on the outdoor event space and look over the Potomac River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Jefferson Memorial gold, and guests in this 373-room hotel stop at the windows to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and paints a bright path across the Potomac River.
phrases.grey_evening: At The Lounge, guests hold evening cocktails and watch city lights spread along the Potomac River under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass tonight, and the lights along the Potomac River stretch into long wet lines.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the Lincoln Memorial glows softly beneath a sky with no stars.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Tidal Basin tonight, and the Jefferson Memorial is bright against the clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Potomac River is black and quiet, and only the slow current moves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights appear along the Tidal Basin beside the Jefferson Memorial.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon lies still and grey-blue beyond the private beach, with no other resort in sight.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the white sand of the private beach, and the lagoon beyond it turns turquoise.
phrases.clear_midday: From the overwater villas, guests see the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon bright turquoise under a clear midday sky, with nothing but horizon in front.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the lagoon this morning, changing the turquoise water to dark blue and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the treehouse dining deck, guests look over the jungle canopy while afternoon clouds drift above the treetops.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the lagoon keeps a soft green colour and meets the clouds at the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the lagoon and the sky seem to join in one pale colour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far horizon is not visible today, and from the private beach the lagoon is clear only close to the shore.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and guests in the overwater villas watch the drops mark the water below their decks.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the lagoon, and for a second the whole private beach shows white against the dark jungle.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees and the lagoon, and guests look twice to be sure.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold today, and the lagoon keeps its turquoise colour under a bright sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the private beach is empty, and the lagoon lies clear and calm in front of the 65 beach villas hidden in the jungle.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the shade at the edge of the jungle and look out at the bright lagoon.
phrases.warm: On the private beach, guests walk barefoot along the warm sand and watch the lagoon change between green and blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: On the sunset side of the island, guests watch the sun go down towards the lagoon, and the water turns gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in long rays, and the jungle canopy around the treehouse dining deck glows green and orange.
phrases.grey_evening: From the treehouse dining deck this evening, guests see the jungle canopy fade into a cloudy sky with no stars.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain falls on the lagoon, and the water is visible only where the island's lights reach it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night the lagoon is quiet and almost black under the clouds, with a slightly lighter sky above it.
phrases.clear_night: At The Observatory, guests look up at a clear sky full of stars above the trees of Kunfunadhoo Island.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the lagoon lies still under the night sky, and the jungle beside it is one mass of black leaves.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky stays bright over the lagoon, and the first lights come on along the jetty of the overwater villas.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Caribbean Sea is a wide dark surface under a clear sky, and the first grey light shows where the water ends.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests on the gym treadmills run towards the arched windows this morning, and the Caribbean Sea is bright and turquoise behind the glass.
phrases.clear_midday: From the private balconies on the 12th and 14th floors, the Caribbean Sea is turquoise all the way to a sharp horizon under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Caribbean Sea this morning, turning the turquoise water dark blue in patches.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, guests in the panoramic lounge watch sun and cloud take turns over the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Caribbean Sea loses its turquoise and takes the colour of the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Caribbean Sea today, and its turquoise fades to a milky pale blue.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the Caribbean Sea is clear near the shore, while the far water and the horizon cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Caribbean Sea, and guests watch it through the arched windows of their suites as the water turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Caribbean Sea, and for a second guests in the panoramic lounge can see every wave.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Caribbean Sea, and guests in the panoramic lounge shared by 80 suites watch the flakes disappear into the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: The cold air is very clear today, and the Caribbean Sea is a deep, sharp blue as far as the horizon.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the gym warm up on the treadmills and look out through the arched windows at the Caribbean Sea and the empty beach.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests sit on their private balconies and look at the Caribbean Sea, which shines brightly under the sun.
phrases.warm: On the balconies facing the Caribbean Sea, guests leave their books closed on a warm day and follow the lines of surf instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late in the afternoon, golden light falls across the Caribbean Sea, and the turquoise water slowly turns a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: At Sasi Thai, the first dinner guests sit outdoors and watch the last sun colour the clouds above the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: From the outdoor tables at Sasi Thai, dinner guests look out at a Caribbean Sea that is almost black under the evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Caribbean Sea this evening, and the dark water beyond the white surf is blurred in the wet air.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the panoramic lounge look out at a black Caribbean Sea where the white surf is the only thing moving.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests start counting the stars over the Caribbean Sea and soon lose count.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Caribbean Sea is only a darker band below the sky, with thin white lines where the waves break.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky is still bright above the Caribbean Sea, and the turquoise water slowly loses its colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Below the Junior Suite Village View rooms, the hotel garden waits in the dark for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Curtains open in the Junior Suite Sea View rooms, and the Atlantic Ocean is already blue in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Seen from the pool, the Atlantic Ocean lies blue and bright as far as the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: From the garden-facing rooms, guests see sun and shade take turns on the hotel garden, with the ocean in the distance.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sunlight travel across the ocean, and guests at VISTA Restaurant follow them from their tables.
phrases.overcast: The hotel garden keeps its green under a flat grey sky, seen from the Junior Suite Village View rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: From the Junior Suite Sea View rooms, the Atlantic Ocean fades into haze before it reaches the horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the garden-facing rooms, guests see the garden clearly today, but the ocean in the distance is hidden.
phrases.rain: Small rings spread across the pool in the rain, with the Atlantic Ocean grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: In the Junior Suite Sea View rooms, guests watch lightning flash over the Atlantic Ocean from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.snow: Guests in the Junior Suite Village View rooms stay indoors and watch the hotel garden slowly turn white under the snow.
phrases.very_cold: Inside VISTA Restaurant, guests look at the ocean today and are happy to stay where it is warm.
phrases.cold: Guests in the garden-facing rooms stay inside today, looking over the garden to the ocean in the distance.
phrases.very_hot: Guests cool off in the pool this afternoon, with the Atlantic Ocean in front of them.
phrases.warm: Guests walk slowly through the hotel garden, in no hurry to be anywhere else.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in the Junior Suite Sea View rooms watch the low sun lay a gold path across the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sunlight slips between clouds and warms the colours of the hotel garden below the Junior Suite Village View rooms.
phrases.grey_evening: From VISTA Restaurant this evening, guests look out at a dark ocean under a low cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight's rain falls steadily on the hotel garden, and guests in the garden-facing rooms watch it before bed.
phrases.mild_night: Beyond the cliffs of Praia da Rocha, the Atlantic Ocean is more heard than seen under tonight's cloud.
phrases.clear_night: The Atlantic Ocean lies black under the stars tonight, with the horizon still easy to find.
phrases.late_night: At this hour the hotel garden is dark and still, and nearly every guest is asleep.
phrases.dusk: The pool holds the last brightness of the sky while the Atlantic Ocean beyond it grows darker.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Venetian Lagoon is still and grey-blue, and San Giorgio Maggiore island waits across the water under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Venetian Lagoon, and guests at their balcony doors watch the first gondolas pass below.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, the Venetian Lagoon is blue at midday and the Salute dome stands sharp against the clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over San Giorgio Maggiore island this morning, and their shadows cross the Venetian Lagoon one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: White clouds drift above the Venetian Lagoon this afternoon, and guests follow the gondolas gliding past San Giorgio Maggiore island.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the Venetian Lagoon turns silver-grey, and the Salute dome stays clear to the west.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on the Venetian Lagoon today, and San Giorgio Maggiore island comes and goes like a rumour across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the Salute dome cannot be seen, and the Venetian Lagoon is clear only close to the Riva degli Schiavoni.
phrases.rain: Rain draws small rings on the Venetian Lagoon, and guests watch from their balcony doors as San Giorgio Maggiore island turns soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Venetian Lagoon, and with each flash of lightning guests see San Giorgio Maggiore island for one second.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Riva degli Schiavoni and disappears into the Venetian Lagoon, while San Giorgio Maggiore island fades behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, and every line of San Giorgio Maggiore island is sharp above the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Venetian Lagoon is quiet, and guests count only a few gondolas passing the Riva degli Schiavoni.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the veranda of Londrabar look across the Riva degli Schiavoni to the glittering Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.warm: On this warm day guests sit on their balconies above the gondolas, with the Venetian Lagoon and San Giorgio Maggiore island in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the rooftop terrace, the low sun turns the Venetian Lagoon gold, and the Salute dome glows to the west.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and the balconies of the 52 rooms face a pink and orange Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud the Venetian Lagoon is black, and the lights of passing boats draw slow lines across it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Venetian Lagoon this evening, and the lights of the Riva degli Schiavoni shine twice, once in the air and once on the wet stone.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the rooftop terrace looks over a wide Venetian Lagoon, dark under the low cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky the Salute dome stands against the stars to the west, and small lights tremble on the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the gondolas are gone, and the Venetian Lagoon lies silent in front of this 1853 building.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright behind the Salute dome, and guests see the first lights appear along the Venetian Lagoon.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a faint grey band under a clear sky that is slowly growing pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast, guests look over the Galapagos National Park to the Pacific Ocean, bright blue under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The midday sun stands high over the infinity pool, and the Pacific Ocean shines beyond the forest canopy.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Galapagos National Park this morning, while the Pacific Ocean beyond stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the tent balconies, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift out over the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns silver, and the palo santo canopy below the infinity pool looks greener.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist hangs in the scalesia trees today, and from the panoramic dining room the Pacific Ocean is only a soft brightness.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Pacific Ocean is not visible today; from the infinity pool, guests see the forest canopy and then a pale sky.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the forest canopy, and from the Family Suite guests see the Pacific Ocean blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and guests in the panoramic dining room count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palo santo and scalesia trees, and the Pacific Ocean fades to white behind them.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear today, and the Pacific Ocean draws a sharp blue band beyond the Galapagos National Park.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to the panoramic dining room and look over the forest canopy to the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look over the forest canopy to the long band of the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.warm: On this warm day by the infinity pool, a giant tortoise walks slowly past the guests, and nobody looks at the Pacific Ocean for a full minute.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At the Viewpoint, guests watch the sun go down in a clear sky, a drink in hand from the small bar menu.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun turns the clouds orange over the Pacific Ocean, a sight guests at this camp have enjoyed since 2007.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening is cloudy and the Pacific Ocean is dark; no lights show between the camp and the coast.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls outside the panoramic dining room at dinner, and the Pacific Ocean is hidden in the wet night.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and beyond the forest canopy the Pacific Ocean shows only as a darker band under the clouds.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the tents, and the Pacific Ocean lies black and quiet below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the camp sleeps 480 metres above sea level, and the Pacific Ocean waits unseen beyond the trees.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the Pacific Ocean holds the last colour beyond the infinity pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over the Caribbean Sea, and the private beach is a quiet strip of sand beside the mangrove.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Caribbean Sea, and guests on their room terraces look at it through the palm trees.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Caribbean Sea is bright turquoise beyond the pool deck, under a sky with no clouds.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the mangrove this morning, while the Caribbean Sea stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pool deck, guests watch cloud shadows move across the private beach and out over the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Caribbean Sea turns from turquoise to grey-green, and the palm trees stand still in front of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Caribbean Sea today, and the far end of the private beach fades into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests see the palm trees, the private beach and only the nearest part of the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the palm trees, and guests watch it from the open-air lobby, the still pool dotted with drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Caribbean Sea, and guests in the suites watch the storm through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the green lawn and the infinity pool, and from the wooden deck the Caribbean Sea is grey behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold today, and guests look at the bright Caribbean Sea from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of their suites.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the pool deck is empty, and the Caribbean Sea beyond it is a clear, sharp blue.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the pool deck stay under the umbrellas and look out at the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.warm: It is a warm day, and from the wooden deck guests look over the infinity pool and the green lawn to the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the palm trees gold, and the Caribbean Sea behind them becomes a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Caribbean Sea, and guests in this resort opened in 2023 look at them from the pool deck.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds cover the evening sky, and from the wooden deck guests see the Caribbean Sea as a dark surface beyond the lawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening, and beyond the pool deck the private beach and the Caribbean Sea merge into one darkness.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests on their room terraces see the palm trees against the dark Caribbean Sea.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Caribbean Sea, and the private beach is a faint pale band below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the mangrove and the Caribbean Sea are both dark, and only the palm trees closest to the building can be seen.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and from the wooden deck guests watch the Caribbean Sea turn from turquoise to violet.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sydney Harbour Bridge is a quiet arch over still water, and the sky behind it is only starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the harbour view studios wake up to the Sydney Harbour Bridge and the Sydney Opera House under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Sydney Opera House is bright white against blue water, and every sail on its roof is easy to count.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Sydney Harbour this morning, and the Sydney Opera House goes from white to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests look from the harbour view studios across to the North Sydney skyline, where clouds and sailboats cross the afternoon at the same slow speed.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Sydney Harbour Bridge and the water below it take almost the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Sydney Harbour today, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge looks like a pencil drawing of itself.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Sydney Harbour is not visible today, and guests see only the nearest part of the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Sydney Harbour, and guests watch the Sydney Opera House turn slightly blurred behind the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the arch of the Sydney Harbour Bridge for a second, and then the storm closes over the harbour again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Sydney Harbour, and guests look twice at the Sydney Harbour Bridge behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air over Sydney Harbour is freezing and very clear, and the steel of the Sydney Harbour Bridge looks sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the harbour view studios keep their coffee warm and their eyes on the Sydney Opera House.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Sydney Harbour Bridge shimmers above the bright water of Sydney Harbour, and guests watch it from behind the glass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, sailboats spread across Sydney Harbour, and guests follow them as they pass in front of the Sydney Opera House.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Sydney Opera House gold in the late afternoon, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge goes dark behind it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Sydney Harbour Bridge turn orange, and the water below copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Sydney Harbour Bridge and the city skyline glow, and the low sky holds some of their light.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests see the lights of the Sydney Harbour Bridge run in long lines down the window glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, guests look past the lit Sydney Opera House to the city skyline under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: The lit arch of the Sydney Harbour Bridge stands clear tonight, seen from one of 126 rooms on Macleay Street.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Sydney Harbour is still, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge waits over the water for the first ferry.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays deep blue and orange behind the city skyline, and the first lights come on along the Sydney Harbour Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is still and almost black, and a thin band of light begins on the horizon in front of the balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun climbs over the Atlantic under a clear sky, and the light spreads along the coast toward South Beach.
phrases.clear_midday: At Artisan Beach House, guests look across the Atlantic at midday, its blue bright under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the inlet this morning, while the coastline south toward South Beach stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Atlantic this afternoon, and patches of light move slowly along the shore toward South Beach.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic turns the colour of steel, and the jetty draws a pale line into it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the coastline today, and South Beach is only a guess at the end of the curve of sand.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so Fort Lauderdale to the north and South Beach to the south are both out of sight, and only the nearest waves of the Atlantic show.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic; guests watch it from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows, the horizon blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic, and thunder rolls along the coast toward South Beach while the waves turn white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Atlantic, and guests behind the glass balcony doors watch the flakes vanish into the waves.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, and the coastline shows in sharp detail far down toward South Beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the sand is empty, and the Atlantic rolls in grey-green rows below the elevated pools.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the elevated pools and look over the sand at the Atlantic, which looks cooler than anything on the menu.
phrases.warm: From the dog park, guests see the Atlantic through the palm trees on this warm day, and the dogs seem to approve.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late golden light falls on the Miami skyline in the distance and on the high-rises along the shore toward South Beach.
phrases.partly_golden: With just 2 rooms on each floor, guests on the balconies have the pink clouds over the Atlantic almost to themselves in the last hour of sun.
phrases.grey_evening: From the terrace with the fire pit, the Atlantic is dark under the evening clouds, and the lights of the coast run south toward South Beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and from Artisan Beach House the Atlantic shows only as white lines of surf near the shore.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, yet the lights of the Miami skyline still glow in the distance beyond the inlet.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, stars hang over the Atlantic, and the water below them stays black to the horizon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic is nearly invisible, and the coast toward South Beach has gone quiet.
phrases.dusk: The sun is down, the sky is still bright over the Atlantic, and the first lights come on along the coast toward South Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Napa Valley Vineyards are rows of grey under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls along the Napa Valley Vineyards, and every row has a long shadow beside it.
phrases.clear_midday: The main pool looks out over the Napa Valley Vineyards, and at midday every row is sharp under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Napa Valley Vineyards this morning, row after row, before the sun returns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the Napa Valley Vineyards this afternoon, seen from the main pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Napa Valley Vineyards keep their straight lines, and the Palisades Mountains look darker behind them.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on the Napa Valley Vineyards today, and only the nearest rows are visible.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Palisades Mountains are not visible today, so the view ends at the far edge of the Napa Valley Vineyards.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Napa Valley Vineyards, and guests watch it through the retractable glass doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Napa Valley Vineyards for a second at a time, and thunder follows each flash.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Napa Valley Vineyards, and guests watch each row turn white from the fireside in their rooms.
phrases.very_cold: Steam rises from the vineyard-facing hot tub at Spa Talisa, and beyond it the Napa Valley Vineyards stand clear in freezing air.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the main pool is quiet, and the Napa Valley Vineyards beyond it have the scene to themselves.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests stay in the main pool and look over the Napa Valley Vineyards from the water.
phrases.warm: By the main pool, books stay closed while guests look at the Napa Valley Vineyards instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Napa Valley Vineyards gold, and the private pools of the Premier Villas above them catch the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud, lighting some rows of the Napa Valley Vineyards and leaving others in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: At Auro, guests look past the vineyard-facing terrace to the Napa Valley Vineyards under an evening sky of cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: From the dinner tables at Auro, guests see rain fall on the nearest rows of the Napa Valley Vineyards.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, cloud hides the stars, and the Napa Valley Vineyards are a dark field below it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Napa Valley Vineyards, and the rows below are just visible in their light.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Napa Valley Vineyards lie still and dark, with nothing moving between the rows.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over the Napa Valley Vineyards, where 85 rooms and villas begin to light up.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky slowly turns pale behind the Reforma skyline to the east, seen from the tall room windows.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Club Lounge, breakfast is served in front of Chapultepec Castle, sharp in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the treetops of Chapultepec Park are bright green, and the Reforma skyline stretches away to the east.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly over the treetops of Chapultepec Park this morning, and guests at Samos Sabores Míos follow them through the glass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the meeting rooms, guests see sun and cloud take turns on Chapultepec Castle this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Chapultepec Park keeps its deep green, and the Reforma skyline turns the colour of the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Reforma skyline today, and the far towers fade one by one into the white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the skyline is not visible today; Chapultepec Castle and the nearest trees of the park are still clear from Carlotta Reforma.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows of Samos Sabores Míos, and Chapultepec Castle looks slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in this 58-storey tower watch lightning flash over the Reforma skyline, and thunder follows across Chapultepec Park.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Chapultepec Park, and guests in the terrace suites watch the treetops slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear today, and from behind the glass of Carlotta Reforma guests can pick out each tower along Paseo de la Reforma.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests keep to the warm side of the glass at Samos Sabores Míos and look out over Chapultepec Castle.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the private terraces look down at the shade of Chapultepec Park with some envy.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit out on the Club Lounge terrace with Chapultepec Castle in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass towers of the Reforma skyline gold, and guests at Carlotta Reforma on the 38th floor raise a glass to it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and lights Chapultepec Castle for a few minutes, and guests in the Club Lounge stop talking to watch.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and the lit city below Carlotta Reforma spreads all the way to the horizon.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the city this evening, and the lights of Paseo de la Reforma blur into long streaks of colour below Samos Sabores Míos.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, Chapultepec Park is a wide area without lights, and the lit city begins again on its far side.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lights of the Reforma skyline stretch east, and guests at Carlotta Reforma find it difficult to leave their seats.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city is quiet below, and guests who cannot sleep have Chapultepec Park and the sky to themselves from their room windows.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Paseo de la Reforma below Carlotta Reforma.

phrases.clear_predawn: Canary Wharf's towers stand dark and sharp before sunrise, with the River Thames still grey below them.
phrases.clear_morning: At Quadrato, guests eat breakfast with a clear view of the River Thames.
phrases.clear_midday: The glass towers of Canary Wharf stand against a clear blue sky, with the River Thames wide and blue below.
phrases.partly_morning: One Canary Wharf tower is in sun and the next in shade this morning, as clouds move over the River Thames.
phrases.overcast: Swimmers at the Riverside pool look out at a grey River Thames under a sky full of cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: The tops of Canary Wharf's towers fade into the haze today, while the River Thames stays clear below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant skyline cannot be seen today, but the River Thames and the nearest Canary Wharf towers are still in view.
phrases.rain: From the river-facing rooms, guests watch rain dot the River Thames and blur the far bank.
phrases.thunderstorm: Storm over Canary Wharf: guests count the seconds between lightning and thunder as it moves along the River Thames.
phrases.snow: Guests in the river-facing rooms stay warm and watch snow fall onto the River Thames.
phrases.very_cold: Canary Wharf's towers show every sharp edge in today's freezing air, with the Thames bright beneath them.
phrases.cold: The River Thames looks cold today, and guests in the river-facing rooms are happy to watch it from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: Swimmers at the Riverside pool cool down with the River Thames in front of them.
phrases.warm: Guests at the pool spend the day deciding between one more swim and one more look at the Thames.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the terrace, the sun drops toward the River Thames and paints a long gold line across the water.
phrases.partly_golden: Low sun comes through a gap in the clouds and turns the glass towers of Canary Wharf orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Over dinner at Quadrato, guests see the River Thames turn black under tonight's cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs across the River Thames tonight, and the lights of Canary Wharf blur behind it.
phrases.mild_night: Under tonight's cloud, the River Thames carries the reflection of a lit Canary Wharf.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the lit windows of Canary Wharf stand in rows above the dark Thames.
phrases.late_night: Guests still awake in the river-facing rooms see the River Thames dark and quiet.
phrases.dusk: Lights come on across Canary Wharf one window at a time, while the Thames is still bright from the day.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Aegean Sea is a wide grey surface below the suites, and the horizon slowly becomes clear.
phrases.clear_morning: The Aegean Sea is bright blue this morning, and the edge of the infinity pool seems to join it.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the horizon of the Aegean Sea is one straight blue line beyond the infinity pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Aegean Sea this morning, changing the blue from light to deep.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the cave pool suites, guests look through the rock openings at the Aegean Sea under passing clouds.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the Aegean Sea today, and the water takes a quiet silver colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Aegean Sea today, and passing ships look like faint drawings on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon of the Aegean Sea is not visible today; from the infinity pool, guests see only the nearest water.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Aegean Sea, and guests watch the drops mark the grey water from behind their glass doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Aegean Sea, and for a second the whole dark water turns white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Aegean Sea, and the white flakes disappear into the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, the Aegean Sea is a deep blue, and the horizon is a clean line beyond the infinity pool.
phrases.cold: The air is cold today, and the Aegean Sea shows a darker blue under the pale light.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look at the Aegean Sea with only their heads above water.
phrases.warm: On the sunbeds by the infinity pool, guests forget their phones and count the ships on the Aegean Sea instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Aegean Sea to gold, and guests at the infinity pool watch the horizon line grow sharper.
phrases.partly_golden: From the terrace suites, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds orange above the Aegean Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening sky of cloud, the Aegean Sea is dark, and the lights of a passing ship cross it slowly.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening view of the Aegean Sea, and ship lights shine softly through the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the Aegean Sea is a dark, calm surface under the clouds, with a few ship lights far out.
phrases.clear_night: Stars shine above the Aegean Sea tonight, and guests in the villas see them reflected in their private pools.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Aegean Sea is almost black below the suites, and the horizon cannot be told from the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and the sky above the Aegean Sea turns pink and violet behind the lit infinity pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean lies quiet under a clear sky, and the first light grows along the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in The Placery, guests look straight out at the Atlantic Ocean under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the oceanfront rooms on the 6th floor and above, the Atlantic horizon is a clean line between two blues.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic Ocean this morning, and the wide sandy beach turns bright again after each one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, guests follow the clouds as they drift out over the Atlantic Ocean this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean seen from The Placery takes the colour of steel, and the sandy beach looks paler beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Atlantic horizon today, so the ocean and the sky seem to be one soft grey wall.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far Atlantic horizon is not visible today; guests see the sandy beach and the first lines of waves.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic Ocean, and every drop leaves a small mark on the grey water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests stay behind the balcony doors to watch the lightning far out.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sandy beach, and the flakes vanish as they reach the Atlantic Ocean.
