phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Edinburgh today, and the Firth of Forth looks cool and blue from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests on the rooftop terrace look across Edinburgh to the Firth of Forth and stay a little longer.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the New Town rooftops gold, and the Firth of Forth shines behind them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Edinburgh skyline turn pink, and St Andrew's & St George's West catches the light.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the New Town spread out towards the Firth of Forth, which is now dark.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of George Street shine twice, once in the air and once on the wet road.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the clouds over the Edinburgh skyline glow a little from the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests in east-facing rooms see stars above St Andrew's & St George's West.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, George Street is quiet, and guests who are still awake have the New Town to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sun has set, the sky is still bright, and guests see the first lights come on along George Street.

phrases.clear_predawn: In the Eiffel Penthouse, early risers find the Eiffel Tower dark and sharp against a sky that is just turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At FRAME brasserie, guests start the day facing the Eiffel Tower in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The Eiffel Tower stands whole from base to tip outside the Trocadro Suite, its iron bright in the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: In the Family Junior Suite, guests see sun and shade take turns on the garden and the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun travel up the Eiffel Tower this afternoon, in plain view from FRAME brasserie.
phrases.overcast: The Eiffel Tower fills the windows of the Trocadro Suite, its iron dark against the pale grey.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the top of the Eiffel Tower today, and guests in the Eiffel Penthouse see only its lower half.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From 10me Ciel, the Eiffel Tower is still visible today, but most of the Parisian skyline is not.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the Trocadro Suite, and the Eiffel Tower behind it turns soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: In the Signature Suite Eiffel Tower view, guests stop talking each time lightning whitens the sky behind the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.snow: Snow whitens the garden outside the Family Junior Suite, and guests stay in the warm to watch the Eiffel Tower fade behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: No coat is needed in the Eiffel Penthouse, where guests keep the Eiffel Tower in sight from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: Guests at FRAME brasserie stay at their tables a little longer today, with the Eiffel Tower and the City of Light outside the glass.
phrases.very_hot: Up at 10me Ciel, guests look for shade first and the Eiffel Tower second in this heat.
phrases.warm: Guests take their time at 10me Ciel today, with the Eiffel Tower and the Parisian skyline open in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Eiffel Tower gold for guests in the Signature Suite Eiffel Tower view.
phrases.partly_golden: From 10me Ciel, the Parisian skyline darkens under cloud while the Eiffel Tower holds the last sun.
phrases.grey_evening: At FRAME brasserie this evening, guests look out at the Eiffel Tower and the City of Light under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the illuminated Eiffel Tower seen from the Terrace and Bar With Views, its lights spreading in the wet air.
phrases.mild_night: From the Terrace and Bar With Views, the illuminated Eiffel Tower glows against a clouded night.
phrases.clear_night: Every light on the illuminated Eiffel Tower is sharp tonight from the Terrace and Bar With Views.
phrases.late_night: Guests still awake in the Family Junior Suite have the Eiffel Tower to themselves at this hour.
phrases.dusk: Guests in the Signature Suite Eiffel Tower view watch the Eiffel Tower's lights come on while there is still colour in the sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Mediterranean Sea lies quiet and grey-blue beyond Cala Major beach, and the sky above it is clear.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the sand of Cala Major, and the Mediterranean Sea turns turquoise close to the shore.
phrases.clear_midday: From the pool terrace, guests look straight down at Cala Major beach and its clear turquoise water under a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Mediterranean Sea this morning, with bright turquoise water between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the rocky coastline this afternoon, and guests watch the Mediterranean Sea change colour with them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Mediterranean Sea loses its turquoise, and the palm trees keep their green above Cala Major beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the Mediterranean Sea today; from the pool terrace, guests can see the sand of Cala Major below but no horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The open Mediterranean Sea is not clear today, so guests see only the sand, the palm trees and the nearest water of the bay.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Cala Major beach, and guests in the spa thermal circuit watch it mark the sea from warm water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests watch the thunderstorm from behind their balcony doors as lightning shows the Mediterranean Sea for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees above Cala Major beach, and guests come to their balcony doors to look at it.
phrases.very_cold: The Mediterranean Sea is a sharp, bright blue in the freezing air, and guests admire it from the heated spa thermal circuit.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the sand of Cala Major lies empty below the pool terrace, and beyond it there is only open water and rock.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the pool terrace look down at swimmers in the turquoise water of Cala Major and think about joining them.
phrases.warm: Sun loungers fill up on Cala Major beach on this warm day, and guests look past the palm trees to the turquoise water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the rocky coastline gold, and the sand of Cala Major glows below the pool terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Mediterranean Sea, and guests keep looking until it ends.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars this evening, and guests can still make out a pale strip of sand at Cala Major beach.
phrases.wet_evening: The Mediterranean Sea has disappeared into the wet night, and guests see only rain falling on the nearest sand of Cala Major.
phrases.mild_night: In the mild night air, guests leave their balcony doors open towards the Mediterranean Sea, which lies black under the clouds.
phrases.clear_night: Stars hang over the open Mediterranean Sea tonight, and guests on the sea-facing balconies have a full sky of them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Mediterranean Sea is a wide dark space beyond the sand, and the bay of Cala Major is still.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays bright for a few minutes after sunset, and the Mediterranean Sea below the pool terrace holds the same soft colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gothic Quarter is a field of quiet roofs under a clear sky, and the Mediterranean Sea has not yet taken its colour.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the wavy, colourful roof of Santa Caterina Market, seen from the rooms that face it.
phrases.clear_midday: From The Roof on the 10th floor, guests see the blue of the Mediterranean Sea beyond the roofs of El Born.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Gothic Quarter this morning, one street of roofs at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At The Roof, guests watch sun and cloud take turns over Santa Maria del Mar this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the roof of Santa Caterina Market keeps all its colours, as if nobody told it about the weather.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens El Born today, and Santa Maria del Mar is a faint outline above the roofs.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Mediterranean Sea cannot be seen today; from the rooftop pool, the roofs of El Born end in pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Gothic Quarter, and guests at The Roof watch it from behind the closed glass walls.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the roofs of the Gothic Quarter for a second, then the storm hides them again.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the roofs of El Born, and guests in the suites watch it from large bathroom windows.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing, clear air, guests at The Roof stay behind the glass walls and count the roofs as far as Santa Maria del Mar.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps the terraces empty, while the roof of Santa Caterina Market stays bright below the windows.
phrases.very_hot: In the rooftop pool, guests stay in the water up to the shoulders and look over the hot roofs of El Born to the Mediterranean Sea.
phrases.warm: On the private terrace of the Barcelona Penthouse Suite, guests sit in the warm air with the city roofs on two sides.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the stone of Santa Maria del Mar gold, and the old buildings of El Born throw long shadows.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests at The Roof watch the last sun slip between clouds and light the Gothic Quarter in patches.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the windows of the Gothic Quarter glow yellow, and the sky above them stays a dull grey.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of El Born blur in the glass walls of The Roof, where the candles are still lit.
phrases.mild_night: From the Barcelona Penthouse Suite, guests look through floor-to-ceiling glass at the city lights under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear over the old town, and the lit streets draw thin bright lines between the roofs of the Gothic Quarter.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the roofs of El Born lie still, and Santa Caterina Market sleeps under its wavy roof.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright above Santa Maria del Mar, and the first lights come on in the streets of El Born.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Prague Castle is a dark shape above the Old Town rooftops under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Mucha Suite on the top floor, guests see Prague Castle in clear morning light, close enough to study its architecture.
phrases.clear_midday: At the top of the spiral staircase in the Tower Suite, guests turn slowly through an all-round view of central Prague under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Old Town rooftops this morning, while Prague Castle stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Petřín Hill this afternoon, and guests in the Tower Suite follow them without leaving the bed.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Prague Castle and the Old Town rooftops take the same quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Prague Castle today, and the Old Town rooftops fade one row after another.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Prague Castle is not visible today; guests see the nearest Old Town rooftops and the Municipal House across the street.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Old Town rooftops, and Prague Castle looks slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Prague Castle for a second, then the storm closes over the Old Town again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Old Town rooftops, and Prague Castle is a faint outline behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Prague Castle looks sharp and near above the Old Town rooftops.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep the windows closed and look across to the Municipal House.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Old Town rooftops shimmer, and Prague Castle seems to float above them.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests step out onto the little balcony of the Mucha Suite and look across the Old Town to Prague Castle.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Old Town rooftops gold, and Prague Castle stands clear against the sky.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above Prague Castle turn pink, and guests in this 1904 building stay at the windows.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Týn Church towers rise over the Old Town rooftops, with Prague Castle glowing behind them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Old Town run together on the window glass, and Prague Castle glows through the drops.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, guests in the balcony rooms look out at the lit Municipal House under a sky without stars.
phrases.clear_night: Prague Castle is lit against a clear night sky, and from the Mucha Suite it seems close enough to touch.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Old Town rooftops lie quiet, and Prague Castle is a still outline above them.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Prague Castle and across the Old Town.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the South Mumbai skyline is a row of quiet towers under a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the South Mumbai skyline, and guests in the city view rooms see each tower clearly from the day bed by the window.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the South Mumbai skyline stands sharp under a blue sky, and from Point of View the Arabian Sea shines behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the city this morning, and their shadows cross the South Mumbai skyline one tower at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace beside the POV Meeting Room, guests look at the city and the Arabian Sea under a sky of sun and cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the South Mumbai skyline loses its colour, and the Arabian Sea behind it turns the same grey.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the South Mumbai skyline today, and the far towers look like pencil drawings.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so guests at Point of View see the nearer towers of the city but not the Arabian Sea.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows of the pool, and the city skyline behind them is blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole South Mumbai skyline for a second, then the storm closes over the city again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Mumbai, and guests at the windows watch the skyscrapers of the city go white and faint.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold air the skyscrapers of South Mumbai look close and clear, and guests look at them from behind warm glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day guests stay inside at Point of View, where the city and the Arabian Sea fill the view on every side.
phrases.very_hot: Heat makes the air shake above the rooftops, and the towers of the South Mumbai skyline seem to move a little.
phrases.warm: A few guests stand on Terrace Gardens on this warm day and look across to the city skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the towers of the South Mumbai skyline gold, and guests at Point of View follow the light as far as the Arabian Sea.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds, and only some towers of the South Mumbai skyline catch the light.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the South Mumbai skyline give the low sky a soft orange colour.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening guests in the city view rooms see the lights of Mumbai spread and shine on the window glass.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in this 22-storey hotel look out on a mild night and see the city lights under a sky with no stars.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lit towers of the South Mumbai skyline stand in sharp detail against the black sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the streets are quiet, and the South Mumbai skyline stands still against the night sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the city skyline seen from Terrace Gardens.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide grey sheet under a clear sky, and Surfers Paradise Beach lies empty beside it.
phrases.clear_morning: From the upper floors, guests see Surfers Paradise Beach, the Pacific Ocean and the skyline together in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Pacific Ocean is deep blue, and the white sand of Surfers Paradise Beach runs along its edge.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Surfers Paradise Beach this morning, while the skyline towers stay bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon clouds drift over the Pacific Ocean, and the swimming pool looks out on sand and surf in changing light.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the surf draws white lines along Surfers Paradise Beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the skyline today, and the far end of Surfers Paradise Beach fades into the pale air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon of the Pacific Ocean is not visible today; guests see the nearer surf and the closest towers of the skyline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Surfers Paradise Beach, and guests on the upper floors watch it blur the skyline.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and guests in the Signature Collection Sub-Penthouses watch the storm cross the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Surfers Paradise Beach, and nobody quite believes the white flakes above the surf.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, so each tower of the skyline has sharp edges against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day Surfers Paradise Beach is almost empty, and guests watch the long lines of surf from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay by the swimming pool and look out across the sand and surf of Surfers Paradise Beach.
phrases.warm: At Hyde Paradiso on level 1, guests watch the surf break on Surfers Paradise Beach on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the skyline gold, while the Pacific Ocean stays deep blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Pacific Ocean turn pink above the sand and surf seen from the swimming pool.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the skyline lights glow, and the Pacific Ocean is a dark space beside them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the skyline lights spread into soft colours.
phrases.mild_night: From the upper floors of this 77-storey tower, guests look down on the lit skyline and the surf of Surfers Paradise Beach under night cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show over the Pacific Ocean tonight, and the lit skyline follows Surfers Paradise Beach into the distance.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the white lines of surf show where Surfers Paradise Beach meets the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the skyline, one tower at a time.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Swan River is a dark band below a clear sky, and the Perth Hills are a low line behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Swan River first, and guests in upper-floor rooms see it shine between the towers of the Perth skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: From Rooftop at QT on the 18th floor, the Swan River lies bright blue under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Swan River this morning, while the Perth Hills stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of afternoon sun cross the Perth skyline, and guests follow them as far as the Swan River.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Swan River turns the colour of steel, and Optus Stadium stands pale beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Swan River today, and the Perth Hills are only a faint shape behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Perth Hills are not visible today; guests see the Perth skyline and the Swan River below it.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the large windows of Rooftop at QT, and the Swan River shows grey and blurred behind the towers.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the Perth skyline, and for a second the Swan River shines white below the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Perth skyline, and guests watch the Swan River fade behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests can pick out each ridge of the Perth Hills beyond the Swan River.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Swan River looks sharp and still from the upper-floor rooms, with Optus Stadium clear on its bank.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Perth skyline, and guests look to the Swan River for a cooler thought.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit among the plants on the outdoor area of Rooftop at QT and look over the skyline to the Swan River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun warms the glass towers of the Perth skyline, and the Swan River turns the same colour behind them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds amber above the Perth skyline, and guests at the rooftop's high tables turn their stools to watch.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Perth skyline glow, and the low cloud above them takes a little of their colour.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests at Rooftop at QT watch the wet evening through the large windows, where the skyline lights spread on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests in upper-floor rooms see the city lights stop where the Swan River begins.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear above the Swan River, and Optus Stadium glows on the far bank.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Swan River lies quiet and dark beyond the sleeping towers of the city.
phrases.dusk: From the rooftop of this 18-floor hotel, guests see the first lights come on across the skyline while the Swan River still holds the bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky turns slowly pale behind Namsan Mountain, and N Seoul Tower waits for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the green slopes of Namsan Mountain, and N Seoul Tower stands sharp against a clear blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From north-facing rooms, guests see the high-rise skyline of Seoul under a clear midday sky, every glass tower bright.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past N Seoul Tower this morning, and their shadows move slowly across Namsan Mountain.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Floating, the rooftop bar, guests see N Seoul Tower on one side and the high-rise skyline on the other, with afternoon clouds above both.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, N Seoul Tower looks like a pin pushed into the top of Namsan Mountain.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Namsan Mountain today, and N Seoul Tower seems to float above it without a hill beneath.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see only a faint outline of N Seoul Tower, and the far towers of the skyline are not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Namsan Mountain; guests in south-facing rooms watch N Seoul Tower through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is passing over Seoul, and lightning shows N Seoul Tower for a second before the rain hides it again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Namsan Mountain, and N Seoul Tower fades in and out behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and guests can pick out each bare tree on Namsan Mountain below N Seoul Tower.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass and look at N Seoul Tower above the brown and green slopes of Namsan Mountain.
phrases.very_hot: In this strong heat, guests at Floating choose the shade and look at N Seoul Tower through the shimmering air.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests stay a long time on the rooftop at Floating, looking from the skyline towers to N Seoul Tower and back.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun warms one side of N Seoul Tower and leaves long shadows on Namsan Mountain.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun turns the clouds orange behind the high-rise skyline, and the glass towers reflect the colour back.
phrases.grey_evening: At Floating, guests have a cocktail under a cloudy evening sky, with lit N Seoul Tower and the bright skyline in the same frame.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows tonight, and the lights of N Seoul Tower spread into soft colours on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud glows over Seoul on this mild night, and N Seoul Tower shines just under it.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests see N Seoul Tower lit above the black slopes of Namsan Mountain.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Namsan Mountain is a quiet black mass, and N Seoul Tower is only a thin outline above it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the high-rise skyline and on N Seoul Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before the sun is up, guests awake early can already make out the round shape of The Bean in Millennium Park.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests who wake early see The Bean catch the first sun while Millennium Park is still half in shadow.
phrases.clear_midday: The Bean shines silver in the middle of Millennium Park, and the lawns around it are bright green.
phrases.partly_morning: Millennium Park goes from shade to sun and back this morning, and The Bean changes with it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests looking out this afternoon can follow one cloud all the way across Millennium Park.
phrases.overcast: Under even grey light, The Bean shows its full shape, and guests find it at once in Millennium Park.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Millennium Park today and turns The Bean into a pale shape without edges.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see The Bean and the near side of Millennium Park, and the rest fades into grey.
phrases.rain: Rain runs off The Bean and leaves Millennium Park shining wet, a show guests watch from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm darkens Millennium Park, and guests stay at the glass to watch the rain sweep across it.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Millennium Park, and guests watch from indoors as The Bean slowly turns white on top.
phrases.very_cold: The Bean shines in the winter sun, and the paths of Millennium Park around it are almost empty.
phrases.cold: Guests take their time indoors today, looking down on Millennium Park and the small figures walking past The Bean.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests looking out see the crowd in Millennium Park keeping to the shade of the trees.
phrases.warm: Millennium Park lies green and bright in the view today, with The Bean shining in the middle of it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Gold light slides across Millennium Park, and The Bean looks like a coin someone dropped there.
phrases.partly_golden: Between the clouds, the last sun picks out The Bean for a minute, then moves on across Millennium Park.
phrases.grey_evening: The Chicago Theatre marquee is lit below a cloudy sky tonight, and guests can pick it out easily before dinner.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain is falling tonight, and guests see the lights of the Chicago Theatre marquee blurred through the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: Guests looking out tonight see the dark shape of Millennium Park under a sky without stars.
phrases.clear_night: On a night this clear, guests find The Bean easily, a small bright curve in Millennium Park.
phrases.late_night: Guests who are still awake at this hour look out over Millennium Park with the whole view to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The Chicago Theatre marquee starts to glow while Millennium Park still holds the last brightness of the day.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlas Mountains are a dark shape beyond the horse paddocks, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun lights the Atlas Mountains, and the formal gardens run in a straight line toward them.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the three pools face the Atlas Mountains under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Atlas Mountains this morning, while the horse paddocks below stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, cloud shadows cross the Atlas Mountains, and guests at La Terrasse by Jean-François Piège follow them over the horse paddocks.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlas Mountains lose their colour, and the formal gardens look greener in front of them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Atlas Mountains today, and the horse paddocks seem to end in pale air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Atlas Mountains are not visible today; the view from the pools stops at the horse paddocks.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the 80-metre pool and the Andalusian gardens, and guests watch it from their suite terraces.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm hides the Atlas Mountains, and guests in the garden-facing rooms watch the rain fall on the palms.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the horse paddocks, and the Atlas Mountains are lost in white behind them.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, the Atlas Mountains stand sharp and clear at the end of the formal gardens.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the terrace of La Terrasse by Jean-François Piège still faces the Atlas Mountains across the horse paddocks.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the three pools and look at the Atlas Mountains from the water.
phrases.warm: At Le Pavillon Restaurant, guests look over the paddocks and the stud farm in the warm air, and the Arabian horses do not look back.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From La Terrasse by Jean-François Piège, guests watch the low sun turn the Atlas Mountains gold beyond the paddocks.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Atlas Mountains turn pink, and the three pools reflect them.
phrases.grey_evening: The cloudy evening hides the Atlas Mountains, and from the suite terraces the long pool leads the eye through the Andalusian gardens.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in the rooms facing the 80-metre pool watch the rain break its surface.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, La Terrasse by Jean-François Piège faces a sky with no stars and the Atlas Mountains hidden in the dark.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear night sky above La Terrasse by Jean-François Piège, and the Atlas Mountains are a black edge below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the paddocks lie quiet in front of the three pools, and the Atlas Mountains cannot be seen.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays bright behind the Atlas Mountains for a few minutes, while the first lights come on along Jacques Garcia's formal gardens.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Nile River is a wide dark band below the Nile view rooms, and the Cairo skyline waits for first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches the Nile River, and from Sky Pool the Giza Pyramids appear small and clear on the western skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky the Nile River shines below the Gold Lounge, and guests keep looking up from their work.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests on the treadmills in the fitness center watch cloud shadows move across the Nile River and the Cairo skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Cairo skyline this afternoon, while the Nile River below Sky Pool stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the Nile River takes the same colour, and the Cairo skyline looks quiet above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Cairo skyline today, and the far bank of the Nile River looks like a faded drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Giza Pyramids are not visible from Sky Pool today; the Nile River and the nearer Cairo skyline are still plain to see.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Nile River, and guests in the Gold Lounge watch the far bank blur behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Cairo skyline, and guests watch the storm cross the Nile River from behind the tall windows of the fitness center.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Cairo, and guests in the Presidential Suite watch the flakes drift down toward the Nile River.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and the Giza Pyramids show sharp on the western skyline beyond the Nile River.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Gold Lounge is the comfortable place to look at the Nile River, with glass between guests and the wind.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water at Sky Pool and look at the Nile River from there, which seems the sensible plan.
phrases.warm: On the sun loungers at Sky Pool on the 25th floor, books stay closed while guests look across the Cairo skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Nile River gold, and guests on the balconies see the Cairo skyline in the same warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between clouds over the western skyline, and from Sky Pool the Giza Pyramids show for a moment.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, Cairo city lights spread out below the rooftop lounge, and the Nile River carries their reflections.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights of the Cairo skyline shake on the Nile River below this 562-room hotel.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the Nile River is a dark ribbon between two banks of city lights, seen from the Gold Lounge.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and guests in the Nile view rooms see the city lights of Cairo run along both banks of the Nile River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Nile River lies quiet below, and the only guests still looking are in the fitness center that never closes.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the rooftop lounge the first Cairo city lights appear along the Nile River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Taurus Mountains are a dark ridge against a clear sky, and the Mediterranean Sea lies still and grey.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the dual-panorama suites, where guests wake to the Mediterranean Sea and the Taurus Mountains at once.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, the Gulf of Antalya is bright blue at midday under a sky without a cloud.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Taurus Mountains this morning, while the Mediterranean Sea stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, afternoon clouds drift off the Taurus Mountains and out over the Gulf of Antalya.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Mediterranean Sea turns the colour of steel, and the Taurus Mountains look darker than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far end of the Gulf of Antalya today, and guests see the Taurus Mountains only as a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Taurus Mountains are not visible today, so guests look at the beach and the nearer water of the Mediterranean Sea.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down both glass walls of the dual-panorama suites, and guests watch the Mediterranean Sea and the Taurus Mountains blur together.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Gulf of Antalya, and for a second guests see the whole ridge of the Taurus Mountains lit white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Gulf of Antalya, and guests watch the flakes vanish into the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and guests can pick out each fold of the Taurus Mountains from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests prefer to look at the Mediterranean Sea from indoors, where it looks just as wide.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, swimmers at the beach stay in the Mediterranean Sea, and the Taurus Mountains shimmer in the bright air.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace, guests on the loungers have a simple choice: look at the Taurus Mountains or look at the Mediterranean Sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Taurus Mountains gold, and guests in the balcony rooms look across the beach to the Mediterranean Sea.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lays strips of orange light on the Gulf of Antalya.
phrases.grey_evening: The Mediterranean Sea goes dark under the evening cloud, and the city lights of Antalya mark where the coast is.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and guests see the city lights of Antalya as soft spots on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Gulf of Antalya seen from the rooftop terrace is black water under a sky with no stars.
phrases.clear_night: Stars come out over the Taurus Mountains, and guests in the dual-panorama suites switch off the lamps to see them better.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Mediterranean Sea and the sky are the same deep colour, and it is not easy to say where the water ends.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright above the Taurus Mountains while the first city lights of Antalya come on along the shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Night is ending over the Arabian Gulf, and from the Observation Deck at 300 the Abu Dhabi skyline is a row of dark towers.
phrases.clear_morning: Early light reaches the Abu Dhabi skyline first, then spreads along the coastline below.
phrases.clear_midday: The Arabian Gulf is calm and blue at midday, and the untouched islands are easy to see across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests crossing the lobby see the city skyline half in sun and half in cloud shadow this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the marina is in cloud shadow, while the Abu Dhabi skyline behind it stays in the sun.
phrases.overcast: From the Observation Deck at 300, guests see the Arabian Gulf and the Abu Dhabi skyline in the same soft grey.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Abu Dhabi skyline into pale shapes, and the Arabian Gulf fades out before the horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The untouched islands are not visible today; the view stops at the marina and the nearest stretch of coastline.
phrases.rain: Guests in the Royal Etihad Suite watch the rain fall outside their windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the thunderstorm, each flash of lightning shows the Abu Dhabi skyline clearly for a second above the dark Arabian Gulf.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the city skyline, and surprised guests in the lobby stop to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Royal Etihad Suite enjoy the wide view from inside today, with no reason to open a door.
phrases.cold: Jackets stay on in the lobby, where guests stop to look at the city skyline before going anywhere.
phrases.very_hot: Guests step onto the terrace, photograph the Arabian Gulf fast and return indoors to cool down.
phrases.warm: Guests linger on the terrace, turning from the Arabian Gulf to the Abu Dhabi skyline and back again.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The towers of the Abu Dhabi skyline shine gold in the low sun, and the Arabian Gulf is gold too.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the cloud and lays bright strips on the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.grey_evening: The towers of the Abu Dhabi skyline are lit this evening, their tops reaching up into low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain blurs the lights of the Abu Dhabi skyline into long streaks for guests watching from the Observation Deck at 300.
phrases.mild_night: Marina Mall and the marina glow below, and the Arabian Gulf beyond them is simply dark.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Abu Dhabi skyline is sharp enough to count tower by tower, with the dark coastline curving away from it.
phrases.late_night: While most guests sleep, the Arabian Gulf lies wide and black beside the quiet coastline.
phrases.dusk: First lights come on along the Abu Dhabi skyline while the Arabian Gulf still holds the last brightness of the day.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Diamond Head is a dark shape above the quiet Pacific.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Kuhio Beach, and from a high-floor lanai guests look across the turquoise Pacific to Diamond Head.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Waikiki Beach is a bright strip of sand with the turquoise Pacific beside it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Diamond Head this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the Pacific.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace, guests see the ocean framed by tall palm trees, with afternoon clouds drifting over it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pacific loses its turquoise, but the crater of Diamond Head stays sharp.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Diamond Head today, and the rock breakwater off Kuhio Beach looks like a thin mark drawn on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: guests can see Kuhio Beach below, but the horizon of the Pacific and most of Diamond Head are not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Waikiki Beach, and guests in the Presidential Suite watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific, and for a second Diamond Head appears clearly before it goes back into the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Waikiki Beach, and guests look twice as the flakes cover the sand and hide Diamond Head.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, bright day Waikiki Beach is empty, and the air is clear all the way to Diamond Head.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this tower of 40 floors look far out over the Pacific, where the horizon is easy to follow from end to end.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, swimmers fill the calm water behind the breakwater at Kuhio Beach, small as dots from a high-floor lanai.
phrases.warm: Waikiki Beach is busy on this warm day, and guests count the beach umbrellas from above instead of renting one.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the private lanais, guests watch the late sun turn Diamond Head gold above Kuhio Beach.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds over the Pacific in orange, and Waikiki Beach glows below them.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and the lights along Waikiki Beach end where Diamond Head begins.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain falls over Kuhio Beach, and the lights along the shore blur into soft spots above the wet sand.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night clouds hide the stars, and guests look down on Waikiki Beach, where the white surf still shows.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Pacific tonight, and the outline of Diamond Head is easy to find under them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Waikiki Beach is quiet, and the Pacific moves slowly under the night sky.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky over the Pacific is still bright, and the first lights of the Honolulu skyline come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Frauenkirche towers are a dark shape above the Old Town roofs, seen from the upper street-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Over breakfast at Schwarzreiter Tagesbar, guests look out at Maximilianstrasse in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, the Frauenkirche and the Old Town roofs stand sharp under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Old Town roofs this morning, while guests at the rooftop pool see the Frauenkirche in full sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests with a coffee at Schwarzreiter Tagesbar watch sun and shade take turns on Maximilianstrasse this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Old Town roofs look one shade darker, and the Frauenkirche towers rise above them from the street-facing rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Munich skyline today, and from the rooftop pool the Frauenkirche towers look like a pencil sketch.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Frauenkirche is not visible from the upper rooms today; guests see Maximilianstrasse below and the nearest Old Town roofs.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of Schwarzreiter Tagesbar, and Maximilianstrasse shines wet outside.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests at the heated rooftop pool watch lightning flash behind the Frauenkirche and are glad to be indoors.
phrases.snow: From the heated Talstation gondolas in front of the hotel, guests watch snow fall on Maximilianstrasse.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, the Frauenkirche towers look close enough to touch from the Ludwig Suite on the top floor.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay in the warm at Schwarzreiter Tagesbar and look out at Maximilianstrasse.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Old Town roofs, and guests look at the Frauenkirche from the water of the rooftop pool.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, shoppers stroll along Maximilianstrasse, and guests at Schwarzreiter Tagesbar count the shopping bags.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: On Maximilianstrasse since 1858, and the late sun still turns the Old Town roofs and the Frauenkirche gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the Frauenkirche towers for a moment above the Old Town roofs.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Schwarzreiter Restaurant, guests look out at Munich's architecture on Maximilianstrasse under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Maximilianstrasse this evening, and each street light shines twice, once above and once on the wet pavement.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds sit low over the Munich skyline tonight, and the city lights give them a soft glow.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests at the rooftop pool look over the lights of the Old Town to the Frauenkirche.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Maximilianstrasse is quiet below, and the Old Town roofs are a dark line against the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright behind the Frauenkirche while the first lights come on across the Old Town.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Petronas Twin Towers stand as two tall outlines against a sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in MO Club Lounge, guests see the Petronas Twin Towers in full morning sun above KLCC Park.
phrases.clear_midday: From the outdoor pool, the Petronas Twin Towers rise directly ahead under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the trees of KLCC Park this morning, seen from AQUA Restaurant & Bar.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Over afternoon tea in MO Club Lounge, guests follow the clouds drifting behind the Petronas Twin Towers.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Petronas Twin Towers take on the colour of the clouds, and KLCC Park looks greener below them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Petronas Twin Towers today, and from the towers view rooms the Skybridge is a faint line between them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far city skyline is not visible from MO Club Lounge today, but the Petronas Twin Towers remain clear at close range.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on KLCC Park; guests at AQUA Restaurant & Bar watch the trees darken and the city skyline blur.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Petronas Twin Towers, and guests in the Twin Towers suites watch the storm from their corner living rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the canopy of KLCC Park, and the Petronas Twin Towers fade to white beyond the outdoor pool.
phrases.very_cold: The outdoor pool lies still in the very cold air, and the Petronas Twin Towers stand sharp against the sky beyond it.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass of their towers view rooms, where the Skybridge is close enough to study in detail.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the water of the outdoor pool and look across the park canopy to the Petronas Twin Towers.
phrases.warm: Swimmers at the outdoor pool on this warm day float on their backs to see the tops of the Petronas Twin Towers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Petronas Twin Towers gold, and the trees of KLCC Park throw long shadows below AQUA Restaurant & Bar.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests in MO Club Lounge watch the clouds turn orange across a 270-degree sweep of the city.
phrases.grey_evening: Over dinner at AQUA Restaurant & Bar, guests look out at the city skyline glowing under low evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests dining in their rooms watch the lights of the Kuala Lumpur skyline shine through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud catches the glow of the Petronas Twin Towers tonight, and their tops come and go inside it.
phrases.clear_night: The lit Petronas Twin Towers stand white against a clear night sky, and the Skybridge joining them is easy to pick out.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, KLCC Park is quiet and dark, and the Petronas Twin Towers rise above it in the still air.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset as the first lights come on along the Petronas Twin Towers and the city skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Rhône River is a dark band below the river-facing rooms, and the sky above it is clear and still.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Les 3 Dômes on the 8th floor, guests look across the Rhône River to Fourvière Basilica under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Fourvière Basilica stands on its ridge under a clear midday sky, and the Rhône River shines below the city rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move over the city rooftops this morning, while the Rhône River stays bright in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the river-facing rooms watch clouds drift over Fourvière Basilica, with the ridge in sun one minute and in shade the next.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Rhône River turns the colour of slate, and Fourvière Basilica is a pale shape on the ridge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the ridge today, and Fourvière Basilica looks like a light sketch above the Rhône River.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far ridge is not clear today, so guests see the Rhône River and the nearest rooftops, with Fourvière Basilica only faint.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Rhône River; guests watch it from the river-facing rooms, Fourvière Basilica slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the city rooftops, and for a second Fourvière Basilica stands out sharply above the Rhône River.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Rhône River, and guests at the windows of Les 3 Dômes watch the city rooftops turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and from the 8th floor guests see Fourvière Basilica sharp on its ridge.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Rhône River looks like steel, and guests are happy to study it from behind the glass of Bar Le Melhor.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Rhône River glitters below the city rooftops, and guests on the Light Bar terrace look for a little shade.
phrases.warm: On the Light Bar terrace, guests stand in the warm air with the Rhône River and the city rooftops spread out below them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on Fourvière Basilica late in the afternoon, and the Rhône River carries the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the city rooftops glow for a few minutes below the 8th floor.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Les 3 Dômes, guests look over the lights of the city rooftops, with a lit church tower under the cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the tall windows of Bar Le Melhor this evening, and the lights along the Rhône River become long streaks.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the city lights lie in broken lines on the Rhône River.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in this hotel of 164 rooms and suites look from Bar Le Melhor at the lit skyline along the Rhône River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Rhône River moves quietly past the dark rooftops, and nobody is awake to count them.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights come on across the city rooftops and along the Rhône River.

phrases.clear_predawn: The rainforest is still one dark shape before sunrise, with the first treetops just starting to show.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of the rainforest first and works its way down, leaf by leaf.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests look out at midday and find green in every direction, the rainforest bright under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows slide over the rainforest this morning, turning patches of green dark and then bright again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests spend a slow afternoon watching sun and shade trade places on the treetops.
phrases.overcast: With no shadows today, the rainforest shows every shade of green it has.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs between the trees, and the rainforest fades from green to pale grey with distance.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the nearest trees are clear today; the rest of the rainforest fades into the pale air behind them.
phrases.rain: Guests watch from indoors as rain runs off the leaves and the rainforest turns a darker, wetter green.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm darkens the rainforest, and guests stay indoors watching the treetops bend in the rain.
phrases.snow: Snow lies white on the rainforest treetops, and guests stay indoors to watch it fall.
phrases.very_cold: Guests keep indoors today, looking out at a rainforest that stands bright and very still in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: The rainforest stands quiet and deep green in the cool air, and guests are content to watch it from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the rainforest hardly moves, and guests outside keep to the shade of the trees.
phrases.warm: Guests sit outside in the warm air and look into the rainforest, green from the ground to the treetops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Gold light comes in sideways through the rainforest, and every trunk throws a long shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests watch the last sun catch the highest treetops while the clouds above the rainforest turn pink.
phrases.grey_evening: After dark the rainforest becomes a black wall around guests sitting down to dinner.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight the rain is heard more than seen, falling on a rainforest that has gone dark.
phrases.mild_night: Guests go to sleep tonight with the rainforest close on every side and no stars to count.
phrases.clear_night: Above the black line of the rainforest, the stars are out and easy to count tonight.
phrases.late_night: In the deep of the night the rainforest is a black shape all around, and guests sleep hidden inside it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the trees turn to black shapes one by one, while the light above them holds a little longer.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Sugarloaf Mountain is a dark shape against a sky that is slowly turning pale over Copacabana Beach.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the restaurant, guests look through the large windows at the palm trees and Copacabana Beach in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, Copacabana Beach stretches below, and the Cagarras Islands stand sharp on the blue horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past Sugarloaf Mountain this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the sand of Copacabana Beach.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the sea-view rooms watch patches of sun and shade cross the Atlantic towards the Cagarras Islands.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic turns the colour of steel, and the mosaic promenade below looks even bolder.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Sugarloaf Mountain today, and guests at the rooftop pool see its outline on the horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Cagarras Islands are not visible today, but the long curve of Copacabana Beach is still clear from the rooftop.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Copacabana Beach, and guests watch the empty sand from the dry side of the restaurant's large windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic, and for a second Sugarloaf Mountain shows clearly through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Copacabana Beach, and guests in the sea-view rooms watch the sand turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Sugarloaf Mountain stands very sharp, and Copacabana Beach lies almost empty below the rooftop.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to the restaurant windows and look past the palm trees to Copacabana Beach.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look down at the crowded sand of Copacabana Beach.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, guests leave their books closed and look across to Sugarloaf Mountain on the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Sugarloaf Mountain gold, and the sand of Copacabana Beach glows under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Cagarras Islands turn pink, and guests watch them from the corner suites.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights along the promenade draw the curve of Copacabana Beach from the rooftop to the far end.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights along Copacabana Beach tonight, and the wet mosaic promenade shines below the windows.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests on the rooftop follow the line of lights along Copacabana Beach towards Sugarloaf Mountain.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of Copacabana Beach stop at the sand, and the Atlantic beyond is black.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Copacabana Beach lies quiet and empty, and only the white lines of the waves keep moving.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright behind Sugarloaf Mountain, and the first lights come on along Copacabana Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky turns pale behind the Mexico City skyline, and the Bosque de Chapultepec is still without colour.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the Club Lounge on the 40th floor, guests look over the Bosque de Chapultepec under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The midday sun stands high over the Bosque de Chapultepec, and every treetop shows its own green from the park-facing rooms.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Bosque de Chapultepec this morning, while the towers of the Mexico City skyline stay in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the sundeck beside the pool, the Bosque de Chapultepec fills the foreground, and white afternoon clouds drift above its treetops.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Bosque de Chapultepec keeps its deep green, and the Mexico City skyline stands plain and sharp above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Mexico City skyline today, and guests in the Club Lounge see the distant towers as faint grey outlines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Mexico City skyline is not visible today, so guests in the top-floor suites look at the nearer trees of the Bosque de Chapultepec instead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Bosque de Chapultepec, and guests watch it from the Club Lounge as the skyline blurs behind the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Mexico City skyline, and guests in the park-facing rooms count the seconds until the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Bosque de Chapultepec, and guests stand at the Club Lounge windows to watch the treetops turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and the Mexico City skyline shows sharp edges beyond the still trees of the Bosque de Chapultepec.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to the warm side of the glass and study the Bosque de Chapultepec from above, tree by tree.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the sundeck beside the pool look down at the Bosque de Chapultepec and envy its shade.
phrases.warm: Warm air lies over the Bosque de Chapultepec, and guests on the sundeck by the pool rest on loungers with the treetops in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the towers of the Mexico City skyline gold, and the Bosque de Chapultepec throws long shadows across itself.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Mexico City skyline turn orange, and guests on the 40th floor stop to look.
phrases.grey_evening: With evening cocktails in the Club Lounge, guests look out at the lights of the Mexico City skyline glowing under a low cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows this evening, and the lights of the Mexico City skyline spread into soft bright spots.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the clouds hold the glow of the city, and the Bosque de Chapultepec lies below as one large unlit shape.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of the Mexico City skyline reach to the horizon, and guests in the top-floor suites leave the curtains open.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, few guests are awake to see the Bosque de Chapultepec resting quietly under the night sky, far below.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Mexico City skyline around the darkening Bosque de Chapultepec.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky over western Berlin is clear, and the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church tower is a dark shape above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the 11th-floor suite open the curtains on a clear morning and find western Berlin spread wide below, as far as the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is clear, and every rooftop is sharp as far as the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the rooftops of western Berlin this morning, and the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church tower goes from light to shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests count the clouds passing behind the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church this afternoon, then lose count and start again.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church tower and the city rooftops share the same grey through the tall windows of a room.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over western Berlin today, and the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church tower looks like a soft pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of western Berlin is not visible today; guests see the nearest rooftops and the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church tower, and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass, and guests watch the rooftops of western Berlin shine wet around the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church tower for a second, then thunder rolls over the rooftops of western Berlin.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on western Berlin, and guests watch the rooftops turn white one by one around the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests stay warm inside and look at the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church tower, sharp in the icy air.
phrases.cold: It is a cold day in Charlottenburg, and guests behind the Art Deco facade by Jan Kleihues look out at the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church tower.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above the rooftops of western Berlin, and guests admire the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church from an air-conditioned room.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the trees near the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church make green patches between the rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the rooftops of western Berlin gold, and guests in the 11th-floor suite follow the light from one side of the wide panorama to the other.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church turn pink and orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the floodlit Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church tower stands out, and the lights of western Berlin spread around it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the floodlit Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church tower blurred through drops on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the clouds hold the glow of the city, and guests look from the 11th floor to the floodlit Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church tower.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and from this 17-floor hotel guests follow the city lights of western Berlin to the horizon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours western Berlin is quiet, and the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church tower is only an outline against the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still deep blue after sunset when the floodlights come on at the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Aegean Sea lies dark and still beyond Psarou Beach, and the yachts in the bay are only outlines.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Aegean Sea, and from the waterfront bungalows the private pools, 20 in all, seem to run straight into it.
phrases.clear_midday: At L'Archipel, lunch is served under a clear sky, and guests look across the blue Aegean Sea between courses.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Psarou Beach this morning, while the cave pool above it stays bright and blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Grand Blu Suite watch patches of sun and shade cross Psarou Beach this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Aegean Sea loses its blue, and the white yachts off Psarou Beach stand out more clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so from the infinity pool the Aegean Sea seems to have no end at all.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The open Aegean Sea is not visible today; guests see only Psarou Beach and the nearest yachts.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Psarou Beach, and each drop makes a small ring on the infinity pool above it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Aegean Sea, and guests watch from the sea-view suites as the yachts pull at their anchors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sand of Psarou Beach and melts as it touches the Aegean Sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and clear today, and the Aegean Sea off Psarou Beach is a deep, sharp blue.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Psarou Beach is quiet, and the waves of the Aegean Sea are the only movement on the sand.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the cave pool up to their shoulders and watch the yachts off Psarou Beach from the water.
phrases.warm: At Little Bars, one at each level of the resort, guests sit with a cold drink and look out over the Aegean Sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the rooftop bar, guests watch the low sun turn the pool and Psarou Beach gold.
phrases.partly_golden: At Delos Lounges, the sun goes down over Psarou Beach between the clouds, and the spritz glasses take the same orange colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under the evening cloud, the cave pool glows in cobalt and turquoise, with the dark Aegean Sea behind it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the bay this evening, and the yacht lights off Psarou Beach are blurred on the wet sea.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, and guests at Delos Lounges look out over the dark Aegean Sea beyond Psarou Beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Aegean Sea, and from the rooftop bar guests can count the lit yachts off Psarou Beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Psarou Beach is empty, and the Aegean Sea is heard more than seen.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Psarou Beach after sunset, and the first lights come on along the yachts in the bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, a thin band of pale sky sits on the horizon of the Caribbean Sea, and the beach below is still grey.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun comes up straight out of the Caribbean Sea, and guests on their private terraces have a front-row view of it.
phrases.clear_midday: From the main infinity pool, the turquoise Caribbean Sea seems to start where the pool's edge ends, under a sky without a cloud.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Caribbean Sea this morning, turning patches of turquoise to dark blue and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the open-air restaurant terrace, the Caribbean Sea shows beyond the white umbrellas, and sun and cloud take turns on the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Caribbean Sea loses its turquoise and turns the colour of slate, with white surf still breaking on the wide beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Caribbean Sea and the sky run into each other beyond the palm trees.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Hotel Zone beach is not visible today, but the surf and the nearest palms are clear from the open-air lobby.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Caribbean Sea, and guests in the café watch it through the floor-to-ceiling windows, the palms shining wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Caribbean Sea, and from the open-air lobby guests see the waves turn white for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees, and guests in the café watch white flakes land on white sand through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.very_cold: From the treadmills in the fitness center, guests look through floor-to-ceiling windows at the poolside terrace, bright and empty in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the wide beach is empty, and the Caribbean Sea rolls in long lines of surf below the wooden beachfront deck.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the main infinity pool up to their shoulders and look straight out at the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.warm: In the open-air palapa, guests hold a yoga pose and look at the Caribbean Sea, which makes balance a little more difficult.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the wide beach gold, and from the private terraces the Caribbean Sea goes from turquoise to deep blue.
phrases.partly_golden: From the wooden beachfront deck, the clouds above the Caribbean Sea turn pink in the last sun, framed by two palm trees.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in this resort of 310 suites look from their terraces at white surf, the only part of the Caribbean Sea still visible.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the lights of the pool deck this evening, and behind them the Caribbean Sea is only a sound of waves.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, and guests in the open-air lobby look out at the lines of surf arriving on the Hotel Zone beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Caribbean Sea tonight, and the water of the main infinity pool lies flat and lit in front of it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Caribbean Sea is a dark surface beyond the empty beach, with only the surf showing.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on around the main pool while the Caribbean Sea turns violet.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean below the cliff is a dark surface under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests look from their panoramic balconies over the Atlantic Ocean in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic Ocean stretches to the horizon beyond the edge of the infinity pool under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the hills filled with banana plantations this morning, while the village of Ponta do Sol stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the veranda of Poolside Kabo Bar, guests follow cloud shadows moving across a wide half-circle of the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.overcast: Through the indoor pool windows, guests see a green coastal cliff under a flat grey sky.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Atlantic Ocean today, and the horizon is difficult to find from the infinity pool.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The mountains along the southern coastline are not visible today; the terraced hills near the infinity pool still show.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the banana plantations and the village below, and guests watch it through the big panoramic windows of their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in the restaurant watch the storm move along the hills opposite.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in the restaurant watch it drift past the hills opposite.
phrases.very_cold: In very cold, clear air, the mountains along the southern coastline stand sharp behind the infinity pool.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Atlantic Ocean lies clear to the horizon beyond the jacuzzi at the cliff edge.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look over its edge at the Atlantic Ocean far below.
phrases.warm: On a warm afternoon, guests sit on the veranda of Poolside Kabo Bar with a cocktail and the Atlantic Ocean in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the terraced hills, and the infinity pool takes the same warm colour.
phrases.partly_golden: From the Lobby & Lounge Bar terrace, the last sun colours the clouds over the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the village of Ponta do Sol shine below the restaurant.
phrases.wet_evening: At dinner in the restaurant, guests watch the rain blur the lights of the village of Ponta do Sol below.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars on this mild night, and the banana plantations below the balconies sit in shadow.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and guests in this renovated quinta count them from their balconies.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the hills filled with banana plantations and the sky above them are the same dark colour.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays pink and blue over the calm Atlantic Ocean, and the first lights come on in the village of Ponta do Sol.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean turns slowly from black to deep blue, and the volcanic rock formations begin to appear below the balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the natural lava pools, and from the restaurant terrace their water looks calm beside the open Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop solarium, guests look north over the Atlantic Ocean, blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the volcanic rock formations this morning, while the Atlantic Ocean stays bright behind them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the rooftop jacuzzi watch clouds drift over the green mountains, then turn back to the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns grey as well, and the black volcanic rock of the pools stands out more sharply.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon of the Atlantic Ocean today, and the natural lava pools become the clearest part of the picture.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; from the balconies guests see the natural lava pools and the nearest stretch of the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of the natural lava pools, and the Atlantic Ocean behind them fades into grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the volcanic rock formations for a second at a time, and guests on the suite balcony watch the storm cross the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the natural lava pools, white flakes against black volcanic rock, and the restaurant terrace looks straight down on it.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold, clear air, the Atlantic Ocean looks sharp and dark blue, and the waves break white on the volcanic rock.
phrases.cold: The cold day leaves the natural lava pools quiet, and the Atlantic Ocean keeps rolling in behind them without an audience.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, swimmers fill the natural lava pools, and guests on the restaurant terrace watch them with the open Atlantic Ocean behind.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sunbathe on the rooftop solarium and look down at the swimmers in the natural lava pools.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in this 25-room hotel watch the sun go low over the Atlantic Ocean from the rooftop jacuzzi.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange above the Atlantic Ocean, and the lava pools below the restaurant terrace hold the same light.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the promenade lights outline the natural lava pools, and the Atlantic Ocean beyond is a wide darkness.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and the lights by the lava pools shine on wet black rock.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the rooftop solarium the Atlantic Ocean shows only where waves break white on the rocks.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, stars fill the sky over the Atlantic Ocean, and the lava pools lie black below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests awake in the balcony rooms see the natural lava pools empty and still, the Atlantic Ocean moving quietly beyond.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over the Atlantic Ocean, and the first lights come on along the coastal promenade.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Atlantic Ocean is still dark before sunrise, and a thin band of light is growing along the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balconies, guests see the morning sun shining on the Atlantic Ocean and the beach below.
phrases.clear_midday: From the gym on one of the highest floors, guests look out over a bright blue Atlantic Ocean under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Atlantic Ocean this morning, while the beach stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Beyond the railing of the pool deck, the Atlantic Ocean shows sunny patches between the clouds this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns grey as well, and the white edge of the waves shows clearly along the beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so from the gym windows the Atlantic Ocean and the sky look like one soft wall.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests on the balconies see the beach and the first waves of the Atlantic Ocean, and little beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic Ocean, and guests watch it from the suite windows while the beach turns a darker colour.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in the gym on one of the highest floors stop their exercise to watch the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach and melting where the waves of the Atlantic Ocean reach the sand.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Atlantic Ocean shows a sharp blue horizon through the gym windows.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look at the long waves of the Atlantic Ocean from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the two seaside pools and look at the Atlantic Ocean beyond the railing.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the pool deck look over the railing at people walking along the beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight turns the beach gold, and the Atlantic Ocean becomes a deeper blue beside it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Atlantic Ocean turn pink, and guests in the gym run a little slower to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds cover the evening sky, and from the pool deck the Atlantic Ocean looks dark grey, without a clear horizon.
