phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening on the pool deck, and beyond the railing the Atlantic Ocean is only a darker shade behind the rain.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the Atlantic Ocean and the sky are the same black, and only the white waves mark where the beach begins.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and the beach is a pale strip beside the dark water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the beach is empty, and the Atlantic Ocean keeps sending waves that nobody is awake to count.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Atlantic Ocean is still bright, and the first lights come on around the pool deck.

phrases.clear_predawn: The horizon is only starting to show before sunrise, and the Arabian Gulf in front of it is still dark.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests can follow the Arabian Gulf all the way out to the horizon this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the horizon is a clean line across the view, with nothing in front of it but open water.
phrases.partly_morning: Sun and passing cloud take turns over the Arabian Gulf this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests looking out this afternoon find a few clouds above the horizon and open water below it.
phrases.overcast: Today's cloud sits over the Arabian Gulf from Saadiyat Beach out to the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the Arabian Gulf today, and guests see Saadiyat Beach more clearly than the water beyond it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; the view ends early, somewhere out on the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling over the Arabian Gulf, and guests watch it from indoors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls in from the Arabian Gulf, and guests watch the storm from behind glass.
phrases.snow: Guests stay inside and watch snow come down over Saadiyat Beach and the water behind it.
phrases.very_cold: Guests see the horizon perfectly well from indoors today, and indoors is where they stay.
phrases.cold: Saadiyat Beach and the Arabian Gulf fill the view today, and guests enjoy both from inside.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests look at the Arabian Gulf and think about a swim.
phrases.warm: Out in the warm air, guests look past Saadiyat Beach to the line of the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light lies on the Arabian Gulf, and guests stop for a moment to look.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the horizon take on colour while guests look on.
phrases.grey_evening: The horizon has gone with the daylight, and the Arabian Gulf is one wide dark space under the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain this evening closes the view early, and guests see the Arabian Gulf only as dark water near the shore.
phrases.mild_night: Night has taken the horizon away, leaving guests a dark Arabian Gulf to look at.
phrases.clear_night: The Arabian Gulf is dark tonight, and the horizon is a line guests can guess more than see.
phrases.late_night: Most guests are asleep, and the Arabian Gulf stays dark out to a horizon nobody can see yet.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Prinsengracht lies still under a clear sky, and the moored boats do not move.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on the Prinsengracht, and guests in the canal view rooms watch it from the yellow tulip chairs.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in Prins & Aap, among the designs of Marcel Wanders, guests still look out at the Prinsengracht under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Canal Ring this morning, and guests passing the reception area stop to look at the Prinsengracht.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud shadows take turns on the canal houses this afternoon, and the Prinsengracht changes colour with them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Prinsengracht takes the same colour, and the gabled houses across the water look sharper for it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Canal Ring today, and the gabled houses across the Prinsengracht look like a faded drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Prinsengracht in front is clear, but the far end of the canal cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain makes small rings on the Prinsengracht, and guests in the canal view rooms watch them through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Canal Ring, and guests in the reception area watch the lightning light up the Prinsengracht.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the moored boats of the Prinsengracht, and the former public library has a quiet canal to read today.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing, bright day, the yellow tulip chairs in the canal view rooms are the warm way to watch the Prinsengracht.
phrases.cold: Cold air hangs over the Canal Ring today, and the Prinsengracht runs slow between its gabled houses.
phrases.very_hot: Heat lies over the Canal Ring, and guests on the terrace of the Prinsengracht Suite look down on the slow canal.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in Prins & Aap look out at the Prinsengracht and its moored boats, in no hurry to leave.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lies along the Prinsengracht, and the gabled houses throw long shadows on the water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, light breaks through the clouds, and guests in the reception area see the Prinsengracht shine.
phrases.grey_evening: Over dinner in Prins & Aap, guests watch the lights of the canal houses on the Prinsengracht under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: It is a wet evening on the Canal Ring, and the lights along the Prinsengracht blur on the water.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lit windows along the Prinsengracht are doubled in the calm water.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear over the Canal Ring, and guests with a late drink in Prins & Aap look out at the lit Prinsengracht.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Prinsengracht is dark and quiet, and the Canal Ring waits for morning.
phrases.dusk: From the rooftop terrace, the city skyline stands against a still bright sky as the first lights come on along the Canal Ring.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Chicago Skyline is a row of dark shapes before sunrise, every tower edge easy to trace.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Grand Lake View rooms start the morning with Lake Michigan bright and blue in front of them.
phrases.clear_midday: Lake Michigan lies blue and still to the horizon, the line between water and sky easy to find.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows slide down the towers of the Chicago Skyline, one building bright and the next one grey.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Junior Suite watch patches of sunlight cross the cityscape block by block.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey ceiling of cloud, Lake Michigan turns the colour of steel.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the tops of the towers today, so only the lower half of the Chicago Skyline is in view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests in the One Bedroom Lake View rooms see the near water of Lake Michigan but not the horizon.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the Junior Suite with Terrace, and guests watch the cityscape soften behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Penthouse Suite stay behind the glass and watch lightning flash across their lake view.
phrases.snow: Snow blows across Lake Michigan, and guests in the Grand Lake View rooms watch the water disappear into white.
phrases.very_cold: In the bitter cold, the Chicago Skyline stands sharp and clear while guests admire it from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: Guests in the One Bedroom Lake View rooms stay indoors today and watch Lake Michigan from their windows.
phrases.very_hot: Even in this heat, Pandan on the rooftop draws guests upstairs for the city views.
phrases.warm: At Pandan, guests spend the afternoon on the rooftop looking out at the city views.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the Chicago Skyline to gold, window by window.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and paints Lake Michigan pink and orange for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: The lights of the Chicago Skyline give a soft orange colour to the low clouds this evening.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight's rain turns the lights of the cityscape into long gold streaks for guests in the Junior Suite.
phrases.mild_night: From the Penthouse Suite, guests see the lake view as one wide dark space beside the glow of the city.
phrases.clear_night: Nobody needs to count the lit windows of the Chicago Skyline tonight, but in this clear air it is possible.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests in the Grand Lake View rooms sleep beside a dark and quiet Lake Michigan.
phrases.dusk: Lights come on one floor at a time across the Chicago Skyline while the sky behind is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Venetian Lagoon lies still and grey-blue, and the Doge's Palace waits across the water for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Cip's Club deck, the morning sun turns the Venetian Lagoon gold, with St. Mark's Square clear on the other side.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in Oro, renovated by Peter Marino, guests have the Venetian Lagoon bright and blue in front of their tables.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Venetian Lagoon this morning, and the Doge's Palace goes from bright to dull and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the balcony rooms watch clouds drift over the Venetian Lagoon while boats cross below in patches of sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Venetian Lagoon turns the colour of steel, and St. Mark's Square sits quietly across it from Cip's Club.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist lies on the Venetian Lagoon today, and from the Cip's Club deck the Doge's Palace appears slowly, like a painting still drying.
phrases.reduced_visibility: St. Mark's Square is not visible across the water today; the Venetian Lagoon fades into pale air a short way from the shore.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Venetian Lagoon with small rings, and guests watch it from the lagoon-facing rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Venetian Lagoon, and each flash of lightning shows the Doge's Palace for a second across the water.
phrases.snow: Snow falls onto the Venetian Lagoon and disappears at once, while St. Mark's Square turns white across the water.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Venetian Lagoon is sharp and bright, and the Doge's Palace stands out clearly on the far side.
phrases.cold: The cold keeps the Fondamenta Terrace quiet today, yet St. Mark's Square is still there across the Venetian Lagoon, waiting to be looked at.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the pool terrace look past the gardens to the Giudecca Canal, where the water at least looks cool.
phrases.warm: On the Cip's Club deck, guests take a long lunch over the water while St. Mark's Square shines across the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in the Palladio Suite watch the low sun lay warm light across a wide half-circle of the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and colours the Venetian Lagoon orange, seen from the rooftop terrace over the domes of Venice.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Ristorante San Giorgio, guests look over the Venetian Lagoon under low cloud, the city lights soft on the water.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests dining in Oro see the lights of Venice run together on the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so the lights of St. Mark's Square do the work instead, seen from Cip's Club across the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit Doge's Palace is doubled in the black water of the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Venetian Lagoon is quiet and wide, and the water moves slowly past the tip of the island.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over the Venetian Lagoon, and the first lamps come on around St. Mark's Square.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Lake Ontario lies dark and flat beyond the quiet Toronto skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Sakura Lounge, guests look over the Toronto skyline under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The CN Tower stands sharp against a blue midday sky, with Lake Ontario bright behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Toronto skyline this morning, while Lake Ontario stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Nobu Villa follow the afternoon clouds as they drift past the CN Tower and out over Lake Ontario.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Lake Ontario takes the same colour, and the CN Tower rises plainly above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Toronto skyline today, and Lake Ontario fades into the pale sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Lake Ontario is not visible today; guests see the CN Tower and the nearest towers of the Toronto skyline, and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and the CN Tower looks slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests watch lightning over Lake Ontario from behind the glass, and the Toronto skyline flashes white for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the 41st to 45th floors, and the Toronto skyline fades tower by tower into white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the Toronto skyline looks very sharp, and guests study it from a warm hinoki soaking tub by the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Lake Ontario is a steel grey and the CN Tower looks close enough to touch.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above the Toronto skyline, and guests admire blue Lake Ontario from the cool side of the glass.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests in the Mizu Lake View Suite look out over Lake Ontario to the CN Tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun catches the glass of the Toronto skyline, and the CN Tower throws a long shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over Lake Ontario, and guests in the Miyabi Suite stop to look up from their books.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Toronto skyline give the sky a soft glow above the CN Tower.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the lights of the Toronto skyline spread into soft colours on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: The CN Tower is lit against a cloudy night sky, and Lake Ontario is a wide black space beyond it.
phrases.clear_night: From one of only 36 suites, guests look across the bright Toronto skyline to the lit CN Tower under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who cannot sleep find the Toronto skyline quiet and Lake Ontario completely black.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Lake Ontario, and the first lights come on across the Toronto skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Early risers in the Junior Suite find downtown Chicago still a row of dark shapes against a paling sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light lies on Lake Michigan, flat and bright all the way to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests in the Signature Suite have the city spread out in front of them, clear in every detail at this hour.
phrases.partly_morning: In the Prestige Suite, guests watch patches of sun move slowly across downtown Chicago.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud and sun share Lake Michigan this afternoon, leaving the water bright in some places and dark in others.
phrases.overcast: Grey water meets grey cloud on Lake Michigan today, and the horizon is anyone's guess.
phrases.fog_haze: From the Magnifique Suite, guests see the towers of downtown Chicago disappear into the fog halfway up.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the near water of Lake Michigan is visible today; the horizon is lost in the dull air.
phrases.rain: Downtown Chicago looks softly out of focus from the Junior Suite as rain runs down the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Signature Suite count the seconds between flash and thunder as the storm crosses the city.
phrases.snow: Snowflakes drift past the Prestige Suite, where guests stay warm and watch downtown Chicago turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Lake Michigan looks like blue steel today, a view best enjoyed from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: Guests in the Magnifique Suite take a long look at downtown Chicago before deciding which coat to wear.
phrases.very_hot: Lake Michigan lies wide and blue beyond the Gold Coast neighborhood, and it looks cool even in this heat.
phrases.warm: Lake Michigan is a calm, bright blue today, with the Gold Coast neighborhood in front of it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in the Junior Suite watch the glass of downtown Chicago turn from silver to gold.
phrases.partly_golden: Lake Michigan turns pink and grey in stripes as the last sun slips through the clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the Signature Suite see the city lights colour the low cloud a soft orange tonight.
phrases.wet_evening: In the Magnifique Suite, guests watch tonight's rain turn the lights of downtown Chicago into long bright streaks.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in the Prestige Suite leave the curtains open tonight, with downtown Chicago glowing under the clouds.
phrases.clear_night: Lake Michigan is completely dark tonight, and the lights of the Gold Coast neighborhood stop at its edge.
phrases.late_night: The city has gone quiet below, and Lake Michigan is only a darker shade of night beyond it.
phrases.dusk: Lake Michigan is still pale blue just after sunset, while the first lights come on in the Gold Coast neighborhood.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Potomac River is a dark band between Arlington and Washington, and the sky above the DC skyline slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: In the 18th-floor Club Lounge, guests drink morning coffee while clear sunlight reaches the Potomac River and the DC skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Potomac River shines blue between the Pentagon and the Washington DC skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pentagon this morning, while the Potomac River stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in upper-floor rooms watch afternoon clouds drift over the Washington DC skyline and their shadows cross the Potomac River.
phrases.overcast: The Potomac River turns the same grey as the sky today, and the DC skyline stands flat and quiet above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Potomac River, and from the Club Lounge the monuments of Washington look like a faint pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The DC skyline is not visible today; guests in the Club Lounge can see the Pentagon and only a pale strip of the Potomac River.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Pentagon Row, and guests at Sante watch the wet street shine from a dry table.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Potomac River, and for a second guests at the windows see the whole DC skyline in white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Potomac River, and the roof of the Pentagon slowly turns white below the upper-floor rooms.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests can count the monuments across the Potomac River from the warm Club Lounge.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Potomac River looks like steel, and the Washington DC skyline stands sharp behind it.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Pentagon today, and guests are glad to look at the Potomac River from indoors.
phrases.warm: Warm light fills Pentagon Row, and guests at Sante look out at it over afternoon tea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Potomac River gold, and the Washington skyline glows beyond it for guests in the Club Lounge.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds, and for a few minutes the Pentagon and the Potomac River are the same warm orange.
phrases.grey_evening: In the 18th-floor Club Lounge, guests hold evening cocktails and watch the lit monuments of Washington under a low cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass tonight, and the lights of the DC skyline spread into soft colours over the Potomac River.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the lights of Washington still reflect in the Potomac River.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests can follow the Potomac River by the city lights on both banks, from the Pentagon to the DC skyline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Potomac River lies still, and guests who cannot sleep have the whole DC skyline to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the DC skyline above the darkening Potomac River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Cascais Bay is a quiet dark sheet of water under a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights Cascais Bay, and guests on the sea-view balconies look straight out over the Atlantic.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool on the 7th floor, the Atlantic opens wide and blue across Cascais Bay.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Cascais Bay this morning, and the Atlantic changes from grey to blue and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the gym at Wellness by SAYANNA, guests follow the clouds drifting over the Atlantic between one exercise and the next.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Cascais Bay takes the same colour, and the horizon is difficult to find.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Cascais Bay today, and the Estoril coastline fades a little more with each headland.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Cascais Bay is not visible today; guests see the nearest stretch of Atlantic and the Estoril seafront below.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Cascais Bay, and guests watch it from the indoor pool at Wellness by SAYANNA.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic, and guests follow the storm across Cascais Bay from behind the balcony doors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Cascais Bay, and guests in the sauna at Wellness by SAYANNA watch the flakes disappear into the Atlantic.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and from the steam room at Wellness by SAYANNA the Atlantic looks sharp and bright.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Cascais Bay is a deep, steady blue, and the rooftop terrace gives guests a wide look at it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look out over the Atlantic.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop sun loungers, books stay closed while guests look at Cascais Bay instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light crosses the rooftop pool, and the Atlantic beyond its edge turns the colour of honey.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and guests at The Upper Deck watch Cascais Bay turn gold in patches.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the Atlantic is black, and the lights of the coast draw the curve of Cascais Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights around Cascais Bay blur in the rain, and the Atlantic beyond them is lost in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars on this mild night, and from the rooftop pool the Atlantic and the sky over Cascais Bay are the same dark.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests on their balconies look across Cascais Bay to the lights of the coast.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Cascais Bay is dark and still, and the Atlantic is only a deeper black beyond it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Atlantic, and guests in this 2024 hotel watch the first lights come on along Cascais Bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Guests awake early in the Junior Suite see Big Ben and the London Eye standing against a sky that is just starting to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Junior Suite, guests open the curtains to Big Ben and the London Eye in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The London Eye turns slowly above the River Thames, each capsule easy to count, with Tower Bridge clear in the view.
phrases.partly_morning: In the Junior Suite with London Eye view, guests watch sun and shade take turns on the London skyline this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Tower Bridge goes in and out of the sun this afternoon, and the River Thames changes colour with it.
phrases.overcast: The London Eye keeps turning on a grey day, and the River Thames below takes the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the view today: the London Eye is a pale circle, and Tower Bridge is only a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the River Thames and the London Eye are clear, but Tower Bridge and The Shard are missing from the view.
phrases.rain: Guests in the Junior Suite watch the London Eye turn through the rain, Big Ben grey beside it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls along the River Thames, and each flash shows Tower Bridge for a second.
phrases.snow: From the Junior Suite with London Eye view, guests stay warm and watch snow fall across the London Eye and the skyline behind it.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air makes the view very clear today, with Tower Bridge sharp above the River Thames.
phrases.cold: A day for staying in: guests in the Junior Suite watch the London Eye turn beside Big Ben.
phrases.very_hot: Out on the terrace in this heat, guests look along the River Thames from the London Eye to Tower Bridge.
phrases.warm: Nobody on the terrace is in a hurry this afternoon, with boats passing on the River Thames and Tower Bridge in view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Seen from the terrace, the London Eye glows orange in the low sun, and Tower Bridge catches the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: Between the clouds, the last sun catches the London Eye and leaves the River Thames in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Tower Bridge is lit this evening, a bright shape over the River Thames below the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Junior Suite with London Eye view watch tonight's rain fall past the lit London Eye.
phrases.mild_night: The London Eye and Tower Bridge are lit tonight, and the River Thames runs dark between them under the cloud.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests in the Junior Suite with London Eye view see the lit London Eye in front of the London skyline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the River Thames is quiet, with the London Eye and Tower Bridge as dark shapes above it.
phrases.dusk: Tower Bridge and the London Eye show their first lights while the sky over the River Thames is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Washington Monument is a plain grey column against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Washington Monument, and guests in the Executive Lounge see it bright at the end of Pennsylvania Avenue.
phrases.clear_midday: The United States Capitol fills the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Presidential Suite, sharp under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move down Pennsylvania Avenue this morning, while the Washington Monument stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the corner-window rooms follow the clouds this afternoon as they drift over the National Mall and behind the Washington Monument.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Washington Monument is almost the same colour as the clouds, a pale line above the avenue.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the far end of Pennsylvania Avenue today, and the Washington Monument looks like it was drawn in pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests in the Executive Lounge see Pennsylvania Avenue clearly but only a faint outline of the Washington Monument.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows of the Presidential Suite, and the United States Capitol is blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Washington Monument, and for a second the whole of Pennsylvania Avenue turns white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Pennsylvania Avenue, and guests in the Executive Lounge watch the Washington Monument fade in and out behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay behind the glass on this freezing day and look down Pennsylvania Avenue to the Washington Monument, sharp in the clear air.
phrases.cold: The rooftop dining terrace is quiet on this cold day, and the Washington Monument stands behind it with no one in the way.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests in this 777-room hotel choose the cool Executive Lounge and look at the Washington Monument shimmering above the avenue.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the terrace suites open the French doors and look at the Washington Monument from outside.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the 12th-floor Executive Lounge, guests watch the low sun turn Pennsylvania Avenue gold all the way to the Washington Monument.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken clouds, and the Washington Monument turns orange beyond the rooftop dining terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the Executive Lounge see the lit Washington Monument under low evening cloud, at the end of a long line of street lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Wet weather makes Pennsylvania Avenue shine tonight, and the car lights stretch toward the Washington Monument.
phrases.mild_night: Guests look out on this mild, cloudy night and find the United States Capitol glowing under the low sky.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lit Washington Monument stands against a black sky with a few stars above it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours even Pennsylvania Avenue sleeps, and the Washington Monument is a tall dark shape at its end.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Pennsylvania Avenue below the Washington Monument.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the arch of Sydney Harbour Bridge stands grey against a clear sky that is slowly growing pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on the sails of Sydney Opera House, and guests in the suites facing Sydney Harbour Bridge see both from their windows.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests at lunch in Epicurean look out at Sydney under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Sydney Harbour this morning, and the ferries pass from shade to sun and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon clouds break apart over Western Harbour, and patches of sun light Sydney Opera House, then Sydney Harbour Bridge, then the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Sydney Harbour turns the colour of steel, and the white Sydney Opera House stands out more clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits low on Sydney Harbour, and from a tower 271 metres tall the arch of Sydney Harbour Bridge seems to float above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Sydney Opera House cannot be seen clearly today; Sydney Harbour Bridge is a faint outline, and only the near water of Sydney Harbour is sharp.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the villas, and Sydney Harbour behind them turns soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Sydney Harbour, and for a second Sydney Harbour Bridge shows clearly against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: From Epicurean, guests watch snow fall over Sydney and forget their plates for a moment.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so every steel line of Sydney Harbour Bridge looks sharp over the blue water.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the angled windows of the fitness centre and watch the wind mark Sydney Harbour.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests lie on the in-water loungers of the infinity pool and look across Darling Harbour without moving much.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit out on the villa terraces with Sydney Harbour open below them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on Sydney Harbour Bridge and Sydney Opera House, and from Cirq guests see both in one frame.
phrases.partly_golden: From the tower designed by Wilkinson Eyre, guests watch the clouds over Western Harbour turn orange in the last hour of sun.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars this evening, but from Cirq the lights of Sydney Harbour Bridge still cross the dark water.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of Sydney Opera House blur in the rain, and Cirq guests take their time over their drinks.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the infinity pool glows blue, with Anzac Bridge and the lights of Darling Harbour behind it.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, Cirq looks out on the lit arch of Sydney Harbour Bridge and the bright sails of Sydney Opera House.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who are still awake see Sydney Harbour wide, quiet and empty of ferries.
phrases.dusk: At dusk, the sky stays bright over Western Harbour while the first lights come on along Sydney Harbour Bridge, seen from Cirq.

phrases.clear_predawn: Lake Michigan is still dark before sunrise, under a clear sky that is slowly getting lighter.
phrases.clear_morning: At NoMi Kitchen, guests start the morning with the Water Tower and Lake Michigan both in clear view.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Lake Michigan is easy to follow all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Lake Michigan changes colour patch by patch this morning as the clouds move over it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and shade take turns on the Water Tower this afternoon, and guests at NoMi Kitchen watch it happen.
phrases.overcast: Lake Michigan and the clouds are the same grey today, and guests in the lake-facing rooms look for the line between them.
phrases.fog_haze: Lake Michigan is somewhere behind the fog today, and the city in front of it has gone soft and grey.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests in the lake-facing rooms see the first stretch of Lake Michigan today, but not the horizon.
phrases.rain: The Water Tower is wet and shining in the rain, and Lake Michigan has turned grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Lake Michigan for a second at a time, and guests in the lake-facing rooms keep watching for the next flash.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the city, and Lake Michigan shows only as a pale grey band behind it.
phrases.very_cold: Warm inside the lake-facing rooms, guests look out at Lake Michigan shining in the cold sunlight.
phrases.cold: The city and Lake Michigan share the view today, the buildings in front and the wide water behind.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, Lake Michigan is the part of the view that looks cool.
phrases.warm: Beyond the city, Lake Michigan stretches wide and open to the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun warms the colours of the Water Tower and the city as the afternoon ends.
phrases.partly_golden: One by one, the clouds over Lake Michigan turn pink as the day ends.
phrases.grey_evening: Evening guests at NoMi Kitchen see the Water Tower and the city lights under the clouds.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight's rain blurs the city lights, and Lake Michigan is only a dark space beyond them.
phrases.mild_night: Guests still awake find the Water Tower lit and the city bright under tonight's clouds.
phrases.clear_night: Lake Michigan keeps its lights off tonight, and the city beside it stays bright.
phrases.late_night: Deep in the night, Lake Michigan and the dark above it look like one thing.
phrases.dusk: Guests see the Water Tower light up just after sunset, while Lake Michigan still holds some of the day's light.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over the Atlantic Ocean, and Copacabana Beach lies empty below the balcony rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Restaurant La Finestra, guests look out over Copacabana Beach under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests having lunch at Bossa Lounge see Copacabana Beach in front and Christ the Redeemer behind, under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the sand of Copacabana Beach this morning, seen from the breakfast tables of Restaurant La Finestra.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop pool, guests watch clouds drift over the Atlantic Ocean this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns the colour of steel, and Copacabana Beach draws a pale curve beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Copacabana Beach today, and the far end of the sand fades into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Christ the Redeemer is not visible from Bossa Lounge today, but Copacabana Beach is still clear below.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Copacabana Beach, and guests watch it from the panoramic windows of their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the Atlantic Ocean, and guests follow the lightning over Copacabana Beach from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Copacabana Beach today, and even the Atlantic Ocean seems surprised.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and bright today, and Copacabana Beach looks sharp from the panoramic gym on the 20th floor.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the sand of Copacabana Beach is quiet, and the Atlantic Ocean sends in long white waves.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look down at the umbrellas on Copacabana Beach.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, books stay closed while guests look at Copacabana Beach and the Atlantic Ocean instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on Copacabana Beach, and guests at Bossa Lounge watch the sun go down to the sound of bossa nova.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Atlantic Ocean, and long shadows reach across the sand of Copacabana Beach.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights along Copacabana Beach run around the windows of Restaurant La Finestra during dinner.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass at Restaurant La Finestra tonight, and the lights of Copacabana Beach shine blurred behind it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Atlantic Ocean is almost black, and the lamps of the promenade mark the edge of Copacabana Beach.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lights of Copacabana Beach follow the bay under the stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Copacabana Beach is still, and only the white line of the waves moves below the 117 rooms.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Atlantic Ocean, and the first lights come on along Copacabana Beach below the suite balconies.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sky Tower is a thin dark shape against the clear sky, and Waitemata Harbour lies still and grey beyond it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of the Sky Tower first, then moves down over the city skyline to Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.clear_midday: From corner rooms above the 20th floor, guests see Albert Park, the Sky Tower and Waitemata Harbour together under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the Executive Lounge drink their morning coffee while cloud shadows move slowly across Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift behind the Sky Tower this afternoon, and patches of sunlight cross the city skyline towards Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Waitemata Harbour turns the colour of steel, and the Sky Tower stands out clearly against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Sky Tower today, so guests in the Executive Lounge on the 28th floor can only guess where it ends.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Sky Tower is clear from the Executive Lounge, but Waitemata Harbour cannot be seen beyond the city skyline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Waitemata Harbour; guests in the balcony suites watch it from inside, the city skyline blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Sky Tower, and for a second the whole city skyline appears white against the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the city, and the flakes drift past the Sky Tower until Waitemata Harbour disappears behind them.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, and the Sky Tower looks close enough to touch from the warm Executive Lounge.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Waitemata Harbour looks dark blue, and Albert Park is a block of green among the city buildings.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests in the suites step onto their balconies only for a moment to look at Waitemata Harbour shining beyond the city.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, Waitemata Harbour is bright blue behind the city towers, and Albert Park looks like a cool green place to be.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the Executive Lounge, guests take evening drinks and canapés as the low sun turns the Sky Tower and Waitemata Harbour gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over Waitemata Harbour orange, and the Sky Tower cuts a thin line through them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in the Executive Lounge look at the lit Sky Tower glowing against the low sky above the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the city lights this evening, and the glow of the Sky Tower spreads into the low cloud.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit Sky Tower is the clear point in the view, and Waitemata Harbour is only a dark space beyond the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the corner rooms see the city lights stop exactly where Waitemata Harbour begins.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and the Sky Tower stands alone above the empty streets with Waitemata Harbour behind it.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky is still bright over Waitemata Harbour, and the first lights come on along the Sky Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Hollywood Hills stand to the north under a clear sky, and the Hollywood Sign waits for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on The Terrace at Bar Lis, guests look across the rooftop pool to the city in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The Hollywood Sign stands on its hillside directly north, each letter easy to count under the clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Hollywood Hills this morning, and the Hollywood Sign goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From balcony rooms, guests watch clouds drift over the palm-lined city this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits low over the Hollywood Hills today, and the Hollywood Sign stands out below it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Hollywood Hills today, and the Hollywood Sign looks like faint chalk letters on the slope.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Hollywood Sign is not visible today; from the rooftop terrace, guests see only the nearer streets and palm trees.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and guests in rooms facing the Hollywood Hills see the Hollywood Sign slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Hollywood Hills, and for a second the Hollywood Sign shows clearly through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Hollywood Hills, and the Hollywood Sign fades behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: Guests on the 11 glass floors see the ridges of the Hollywood Hills sharp in the very cold air.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the rooftop pool lies still, and the city spreads out beyond its yellow umbrellas.
phrases.very_hot: By the rooftop pool, guests stay under the yellow umbrellas and look out at the city shimmering in the heat.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, swimmers rest at the edge of the rooftop pool and look out over the city rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Bar Lis, guests take their sunset cocktails while the low sun turns the Hollywood Hills gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the Hollywood Sign for a moment, like a stage light finding its star.
phrases.grey_evening: From Bar Lis on the rooftop, the city lights glow under a low cloudy sky this evening.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests stay dry under the glass ceiling of Bar Lis, and the city lights blur beyond it.
phrases.mild_night: From a soaking tub beside the windows, guests look over Hollywood's city lights under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: Guests at Bar Lis look out at the city skyline on a clear night, in no hurry to go down to one of the 190 rooms.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the streets of Hollywood are quiet below, and the Hollywood Hills are a dark line to the north.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind the Hollywood Hills as the first city lights come on below the rooftop terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the trees of Berlin Zoo are a dark mass under a clear sky, and the tower of Kaiser-Wilhelm Memorial Church is just beginning to show.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Neni Berlin, guests look down through the tall windows at the monkeys of Berlin Zoo in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the top-floor terrace shows Berlin in every direction, from the Tiergarten treetops to Kaiser-Wilhelm Memorial Church.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the animal enclosures of Berlin Zoo this morning, and guests in Neni Berlin follow them over breakfast.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the hammocks by the 3rd-floor lobby windows, guests watch the giraffes of Berlin Zoo while clouds drift across the afternoon sky.
phrases.overcast: Kaiser-Wilhelm Memorial Church stands against an even grey sky today, seen across the animal enclosures from Neni Berlin.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Tiergarten today, and from the top-floor terrace the treetops fade into the pale sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The city skyline is not visible from Neni Berlin today, but the enclosures of Berlin Zoo directly below remain clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Berlin Zoo; guests in zoo-facing rooms watch it from their hammocks, and the monkeys seem to mind it more.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the tower of Kaiser-Wilhelm Memorial Church for an instant, and guests follow the storm from behind the tall windows of the top floor.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the animal enclosures of Berlin Zoo, and guests in zoo-facing rooms watch the paths turn white from their hammocks.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and bright today, so guests keep to the lobby hammocks and look at Berlin Zoo from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the 1950s building look from the window seats of city-facing rooms at the tower of Kaiser-Wilhelm Memorial Church.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, people on the top-floor terrace look down at the flamingos of Berlin Zoo, who handle it with more style.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests take their drinks to the terrace of Monkey Bar and watch the animals of Berlin Zoo below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Tiergarten treetops gold, and guests in Monkey Bar watch it with a cocktail in hand.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud and catches the tower of Kaiser-Wilhelm Memorial Church, seen from the top-floor terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Berlin spread out around the top-floor terrace, and Berlin Zoo is a dark patch in the middle.
phrases.wet_evening: The windows of Monkey Bar are wet this evening, and the lights around Kaiser-Wilhelm Memorial Church blur behind the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests in Neni Berlin look across the unlit enclosures of Berlin Zoo to the city lights beyond.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and from Monkey Bar the lit tower of Kaiser-Wilhelm Memorial Church stands above the sleeping zoo.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests awake in the zoo-facing rooms look down at a silent Berlin Zoo, and most of the 149 rooms are just as quiet.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from Monkey Bar the first lights come on around Kaiser-Wilhelm Memorial Church.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Napa Valley Vineyards are only faint rows under a clear sky that still holds a few stars.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Napa Valley Vineyards row by row, and guests on the bungalow patios follow it across the agricultural fields.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Napa Valley Vineyards run in straight green lines towards the Carneros hills.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly over the Napa Valley Vineyards this morning, and the hills beyond the pools go from bright to dull and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace of Bear, guests watch patches of afternoon sun drift across the Carneros lowlands.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the Napa Valley Vineyards today, and the green of the rows looks deeper for it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies in the Napa Valley Vineyards, and from the pool deck the hills beyond the treeline are only a soft outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Carneros hills are not visible today; from the patios guests see the nearest agricultural fields and the first vineyard rows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Napa Valley Vineyards, and guests watch it darken the soil between the rows from their glass terrace doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Carneros lowlands, and each flash of lightning shows the Napa Valley Vineyards for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Napa Valley Vineyards, and the rows are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: Frost whitens the agricultural fields on this very cold day, and the Napa Valley Vineyards stand sharp in the clear air.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the pools lie still, and the hills behind them stand clear above the Napa Valley Vineyards.
phrases.very_hot: By the pool, under the blue umbrellas, guests look at the Napa Valley Vineyards through the shimmer of a very hot day.
phrases.warm: On this warm day guests on this 712-acre ranch stay by the pools and look across the vineyard rows to the hills.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun stretches long shadows between the rows of the Napa Valley Vineyards, and the Carneros hills turn the colour of honey.
phrases.partly_golden: On the terrace of Bear, guests watch the last sun slip under the clouds and light the Carneros lowlands.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening sky full of cloud, the Napa Valley Vineyards fade into the night and only the nearest rows can be made out.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests at Bear look past the wet terrace this evening, where the Carneros lowlands have gone into the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the Napa Valley Vineyards keep only their nearest rows in sight, grey under the low cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Napa Valley Vineyards tonight, and nobody on the villa terraces is counting grapes.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Napa Valley Vineyards lie still and almost unseen around this ranch resort, opened in 2022.
phrases.dusk: From the terrace of Bear, the sky is still bright over the Carneros hills while the lowlands below go slowly blue.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Marienplatz lies empty under a clear sky, and the tower of the New Town Hall is a dark shape above it.
phrases.clear_morning: From the suite with view, guests see the morning sun on the Glockenspiel and Alter Peter in the same window.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every spire of the New Town Hall stands sharp above Marienplatz.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Marienplatz this morning, and the living room windows show the New Town Hall in sun, then in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the wine lounge watch cloud shadows cross the New Town Hall and its Glockenspiel this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the New Town Hall turns a darker grey, and Marienplatz below takes the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the New Town Hall tower today, and the Glockenspiel seems to float above Marienplatz.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the terrace suite, the Frauenkirche towers are faint in the dull air today, while Alter Peter stays clear.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Marienplatz, and guests in the living room watch it run down the glass in front of the Glockenspiel.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the spires of the New Town Hall for a second, and guests in this hotel of 19 rooms count until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Marienplatz and settling on the ledges of the New Town Hall, while guests watch from the wine lounge.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests stay in the warm living room and study the Gothic facade of the New Town Hall.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the suite with view keeps Marienplatz and Alter Peter behind floor-to-ceiling glass, and guests stay on the comfortable side.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, people on Marienplatz look for shade, and guests look down at them from the cool living kitchen.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, Marienplatz fills with people who look up at the Glockenspiel, while guests simply look across at it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the New Town Hall gold, and guests watch the colour deepen from the living room designed by Nieto Sobejano Arquitectos.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights Alter Peter, while Marienplatz is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit New Town Hall fills the glass of the wine lounge, and guests there turn their chairs towards it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain makes the paving of Marienplatz shine this evening, and the lights of the New Town Hall appear a second time in the wet stone.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the low sky glows a little above the lit spires of the New Town Hall.
phrases.clear_night: From the suite with view, guests see the lit Glockenspiel and Alter Peter under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Marienplatz is quiet and almost empty, and the Glockenspiel waits for the day.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright behind Alter Peter, and the first lights come on around Marienplatz.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Spree lies still under a clear sky, and the towers of the Oberbaum Bridge are dark shapes above it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the red brick of the Oberbaum Bridge, and guests in river-view rooms see it clearly from their windows.
phrases.clear_midday: The giant Molecule Men stand in the Spree under a clear sky, their outline sharp in the midday light.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Spree this morning, while the first boats pass below the river terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the music lounge, 36 metres above the water, guests watch clouds and sunshine take turns over the Spree.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Spree takes the same colour, and the red brick of the Oberbaum Bridge is the one warm note.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Spree today, and the Molecule Men look like a pencil sketch above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Oberbaum Bridge shows only as a faint outline, and nothing beyond it can be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Spree with small rings, and guests watch them from the suite, which has a wide view of the river.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Friedrichshain, and from the music lounge guests see lightning flash above the Spree.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Spree, and guests in river-view rooms watch the towers of the Oberbaum Bridge turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Molecule Men stand sharp against the sky, and they do not seem to mind the cold water of the Spree.
phrases.cold: From the rooftop terrace, the Spree looks like cold steel today, and the boats on it move slowly.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the river terrace choose the shade and watch the boats pass on the Spree with a cold drink.
phrases.warm: Warm air brings guests up to the rooftop terrace, where the Spree shines below the wicker chairs.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights the Oberbaum Bridge, and its Neo-Gothic towers glow above the Spree.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Spree turn orange, and guests in Sergei Tchoban's building watch from the music lounge.
phrases.grey_evening: On a cloudy evening, pink lights from the riverfront reflect on the Spree, and the water carries them slowly.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the river this evening, and the reflections of the city lights on the Spree break into small pieces.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the Spree is a dark band between the lit banks, seen from the river-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lights of the opposite bank shine in long lines on the Spree.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Spree is quiet, with no boats, and the Molecule Men have the river to themselves.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Oberbaum Bridge, and the first lights come on along the Spree below the river terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Early guests in the Fitness Center watch Lake Michigan come slowly out of the dark.
phrases.clear_morning: Blue water and nothing else: Lake Michigan runs flat and bright to the horizon this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: In the Executive Suite, guests can count the towers of the skyline one by one in the clear midday light.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows slide across Lake Michigan like slow ships, leaving bright strips of water between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the bar, guests watch patches of sunlight move from one block of the city to the next.
phrases.overcast: The skyline keeps its shape under a flat grey cloud, with no shadows on any tower.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so Lake Michigan and the sky look like one pale wall.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the nearest part of the city is clear today; the far towers of the skyline are pale shapes.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the Executive Suite, and the skyline behind it looks like wet paint.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests at the bar stop talking each time lightning shows the whole city at once.
phrases.snow: Through the falling snow, Lake Michigan is only a band of grey water.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Fitness Center get warm on the machines while Lake Michigan lies bright blue and empty outside.
phrases.cold: With the skyline in front of them, guests in the Executive Suite see no reason to go out today.
phrases.very_hot: Lake Michigan lies still and pale blue in the heat, and the horizon shakes a little.
phrases.warm: Calm from shore to horizon, Lake Michigan makes guests think about a walk by the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Tower by tower, the skyline changes from glass to gold in the late sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and paints Lake Michigan in strips of pink and grey.
phrases.grey_evening: At the bar this evening, guests sit facing the lights of the city under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain makes every light in the city double tonight, once in the air and once on the wet streets.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in the Executive Suite leave the curtains open tonight and use the skyline as their night lamp.
phrases.clear_night: The city lights stop in a clean line tonight, and after that line Lake Michigan is completely black.
phrases.late_night: The city has gone quiet, and Lake Michigan is only a darker shape beyond the last streets.
phrases.dusk: Windows across the skyline come on one by one while Lake Michigan holds the last light of the day.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Arabian Gulf is still dark, and the first pale light grows slowly above the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: Seen from the private terraces, the Doha skyline stands in silhouette against the bright eastern sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Gulf Suite, the Arabian Gulf fills the horizon in turquoise under a cloudless midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Lusail Marina this morning, while the Arabian Gulf behind it stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Katara Hall terraces, guests see white clouds pile up this afternoon over the sea beyond Lusail Marina.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Arabian Gulf turns from turquoise to silver, and the curve of Lusail Marina stands out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the meeting of sea and sky today, so the Arabian Gulf seems to continue upward.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Doha skyline is not visible today; Lusail Marina below is clear, and the Arabian Gulf fades a short way out.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lusail Marina, and guests in the Crescent Suite watch the marina arc shine wet below their terrace.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Arabian Gulf, and for a second the whole of Lusail Marina shows in white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Lusail Marina, and guests at Acoustic Penthouse watch the flakes blur the Lusail skyline.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear today, and the Doha skyline looks sharp across the water.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests at Acoustic Penthouse look across the Lusail skyline with a warm drink in hand.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above Lusail Marina, and the Arabian Gulf beyond looks like the only cool thing in sight.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests linger on the Katara Hall terraces, in no hurry to leave Lusail Marina and the sea beyond.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light lies on the Arabian Gulf, and guests in the 132 suites see it from their private terraces.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds above the Lusail skyline, and guests at Acoustic Penthouse watch them change from gold to pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Lusail skyline glow, and guests at Acoustic Penthouse enjoy them with live music.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of Lusail Marina run in long reflections across the wet promenade.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Doha skyline is lit across the water, and the clouds above it glow faintly.
phrases.clear_night: From towers shaped like the crossed swords of Qatar, guests look down on the lit arc of Lusail Marina under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lusail Marina is quiet, and the Arabian Gulf beyond it is one wide darkness.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on around the curve of Lusail Marina.

phrases.clear_predawn: Early risers find the Burj Al Arab already in view, a dark shape waiting for the day.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast time, guests have the Burj Al Arab in plain view.
phrases.clear_midday: In the middle of the day the Burj Al Arab is in full light and plain to see.
phrases.partly_morning: All morning the clouds come and go, and the Burj Al Arab stays in view.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Burj Al Arab is sometimes in sun and sometimes in shade, and guests keep looking.
phrases.overcast: Under flat grey cloud, the Burj Al Arab is still the first thing guests look at.
phrases.fog_haze: Guests can still pick out the Burj Al Arab today, though the haze makes it pale.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: the Burj Al Arab shows only faintly, and little beyond it can be seen.
phrases.rain: Today the Burj Al Arab stands in the rain, and guests watch it from the dry indoors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay indoors and watch the thunderstorm pass over the Burj Al Arab.
phrases.snow: Snow and the Burj Al Arab in one view: guests stay indoors and look twice.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold, guests admire the Burj Al Arab from indoors.
phrases.cold: Nobody hurries outside today, since the Burj Al Arab can be seen just as well from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: However hot the day gets, the Burj Al Arab stays in view and does not seem to mind.
phrases.warm: Outside on a day like this, guests keep turning to look at the Burj Al Arab.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: As the sun gets lower, the Burj Al Arab takes on the warm light of late afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the light and the clouds change around the Burj Al Arab.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner time guests have the lit Burj Al Arab in view under the evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Through tonight's wet weather the Burj Al Arab still shows its lights, and guests watch from indoors.
phrases.mild_night: Lit under the night cloud, the Burj Al Arab is the first thing guests see when they look out.
phrases.clear_night: Nothing stands between guests and the lit Burj Al Arab on a night as clear as this.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, guests see the Burj Al Arab against a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the clear sky slowly grows lighter over the Aegean Sea, and the private terraces are the first place to see it.
phrases.clear_morning: At Meltemi, breakfast is served facing the Aegean Sea, bright blue under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Aegean Sea is a clear, even blue all the way to the horizon, with nothing between the southern shore and open water.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Aegean Sea this morning, and guests at breakfast in Meltemi watch them go.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Scattered clouds drift over the Aegean Sea this afternoon, framed by the open doors of the balcony rooms.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky the Aegean Sea turns grey-blue, and the sand of Elia Beach looks paler from the pool terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Aegean Sea seems to continue straight into the sky above Elia Beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far horizon is not visible today; from Eros Bar guests see Elia Beach and the nearest water of the Aegean Sea, nothing more.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Aegean Sea, and guests in the suites watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls across the southern shore, and each flash of lightning shows the Aegean Sea white with waves.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Elia Beach, and the Aegean Sea beyond the pool terrace fades into white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today; the Aegean Sea is a deep blue and Elia Beach lies empty beside it.
phrases.cold: A cold wind raises small white waves on the Aegean Sea, and guests are happy to count them from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat guests stay in one of the 3 pools and look across Elia Beach to the Aegean Sea.
phrases.warm: On the pool terrace, guests lie on loungers while the Aegean Sea shines turquoise beyond the sand of Elia Beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Eros Bar, guests raise a glass as the low sun turns the Aegean Sea gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink above the Aegean Sea, and guests at Eros Bar turn their chairs toward the water.
phrases.grey_evening: On the terrace of Celebrities, guests have dinner above an Aegean Sea that lies dark under the evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Aegean Sea this evening, so guests dine inside Celebrities and look out at the wet terrace and the water.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests on their private terraces look out at the Aegean Sea, black and calm below.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Aegean Sea, and Elia Beach is a faint curve of sand beside the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the pool terrace is quiet, and the Aegean Sea moves softly against the sand of Elia Beach.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set; from Eros Bar the Aegean Sea keeps a soft glow under the still-bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Space Needle is a thin outline above the quiet Belltown roofline.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of the Space Needle first, then moves down to the Belltown roofline.
phrases.clear_midday: The Space Needle stands sharp against a blue midday sky, every line of its top easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the corner-window rooms wake to clouds drifting past the Space Needle and patches of sun on the Belltown roofline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the Belltown roofline this afternoon, and the Space Needle moves in and out of the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Space Needle takes the same colour, and the Belltown roofline looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Space Needle today, so its legs seem to hold up the cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today; the Space Needle is only a faint grey figure, and the far end of the Belltown roofline cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the corner windows, and guests see the Space Needle slightly blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning brightens the clouds behind the Space Needle, and for a second the whole Belltown roofline shows clearly.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Belltown roofline, turning the roofs white while the Space Needle fades behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, and guests stay warm indoors while they study the Space Needle in the low light.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look out from the corner windows at the Space Needle, grey and still above the Belltown roofline.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Space Needle stands in bright white light, and the Belltown roofline shimmers below it.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the lounge look through floor-to-ceiling windows at the tree-lined terrace and the city buildings beyond.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Space Needle gold, and the Belltown roofs glow under it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights the Space Needle for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds sit low this evening, and the lit Space Needle glows softly above the lights of Belltown.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of the Space Needle spread into soft colours above the Belltown roofline.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the clouds above the Space Needle take a little of the city's glow.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Space Needle stands lit above the Belltown roofline like a lamp nobody wants to switch off.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Belltown is quiet, and the Space Needle stands still above the roofline, waiting for morning.
phrases.dusk: Through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the corner suite, guests watch the first lights come on around the Space Needle while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Central Park is a wide dark space below the corner rooms, and the sky behind the Manhattan skyline slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in MO Lounge on the 35th floor, guests look over Central Park and the Manhattan skyline in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: The lap pool is full of daylight at midday, and swimmers look out over the bright Hudson River.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Central Park this morning, while the Manhattan skyline stays in sunshine behind it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon Tea in MO Lounge has a slow second show today: clouds moving over Central Park and the city.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Hudson River takes the same colour, and the Manhattan skyline stands sharp against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Manhattan skyline today, and the far side of Central Park fades into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of Central Park is not visible today, but the nearest trees and the first towers of the Manhattan skyline still show clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows of MO Lounge, and guests watch Central Park turn a deeper green below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the corner rooms watch lightning flash behind the Manhattan skyline while thunder rolls over Central Park.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Central Park, and the paths show as thin white lines between the trees.
phrases.very_cold: From the Oriental Tea Lounge in the spa, guests hold a warm cup and look at the Hudson River under a freezing, bright sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the fitness centre stay warm on the treadmills and face the Manhattan skyline.
phrases.very_hot: Heat lies over the city, and people in Central Park keep to the shade of the trees far below the windows.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, Central Park is full of walkers and runners, and guests follow them from the rooms facing the park.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lies on the Hudson River, and the swimmers in the lap pool slow down to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Hudson River, and the glass of the Manhattan skyline shines orange.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in MO Lounge, guests see the lights of the Manhattan skyline glow under low cloud, with Central Park dark beside them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Manhattan skyline this evening, and the streets around Central Park shine wet.
phrases.mild_night: The clouds hold the glow of the city tonight, and Central Park lies dark and quiet under them.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the Manhattan skyline shines in every corner room, and Central Park is a dark rectangle in the middle.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Central Park is black and still, and the Hudson River can hardly be told from the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Manhattan skyline above the darker trees of Central Park.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear and already pale above the Mediterranean, while Barcelona still sleeps far below the ridge.
phrases.clear_morning: From their balconies, guests see the infinity pool, the Barcelona skyline and the Mediterranean in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the 37-metre pool seems to end where Barcelona begins, with the blue Mediterranean behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Barcelona this morning, and from the upper terrace they can be followed down to the Barceloneta coastline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The spires of the Sagrada Familia stand in a patch of afternoon sun while clouds drift over the rest of Barcelona.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the Mediterranean turns the same grey as the clouds, and Barcelona spreads out wide below the ridge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over Barcelona today, so the Sagrada Familia shows only as a faint outline from the upper terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Mediterranean is not visible today; from the upper terrace, guests see the nearer streets of Barcelona and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass walls of the gym, where guests look out at the wet gardens.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm moves over Barcelona, and guests watch the lightning above the city from behind their floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Tibidabo ridge, and Barcelona, 500 metres below, appears and disappears between the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear on the ridge, and the Barceloneta coastline draws a clean edge between the city and the Mediterranean.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the arched windows and look down on Barcelona from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across Barcelona to the Mediterranean.
phrases.warm: By the pool, sunbeds face Barcelona on this warm day, and few guests look at their phones for long.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight warms the spires of the Sagrada Familia, and from the upper terrace guests can follow the Barceloneta coastline along the sea.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Mediterranean turn pink and orange, and the infinity pool copies every colour.
phrases.grey_evening: From the terrace of Albarada at dinner time, guests look over the infinity pool while low cloud glows above Barcelona.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of Barcelona this evening into soft yellow patches, seen from the dry side of a balcony door.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, clouds hide the stars, and the lights of Barcelona trace the shape of the city down to the sea.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lights of Barcelona stretch to the black Mediterranean, the view Doctor Andreu chose for his hotel in the early twentieth century.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the terraces are empty, and the Mediterranean is only a darker space beyond Barcelona.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the first lights come on across Barcelona while the sky above the Mediterranean is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Alster Lakes lie still and grey-blue under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Alster Lakes, and guests in the lakeside rooms open their curtains to bright water.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Alster Lakes are deep blue, and the Heinrich Hertz Tower stands thin and sharp above the city buildings.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Alster Lakes this morning, and the water changes from silver to blue and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow a red ferry across the Alster Lakes this afternoon as it passes from sunlight into the shade of a cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Alster Lakes take the colour of steel, and the trees along the shore make a green border.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Alster Lakes today, so guests see the near shore and its trees, then only soft white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far shore of the Alster Lakes is not visible today, and the Heinrich Hertz Tower is missing from the skyline, while the near water stays clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Alster Lakes, and guests in the Presidential Suite watch thousands of small rings spread on the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Alster Lakes, and for a second guests see the whole water turn white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Alster Lakes, and guests in this 1909 hotel watch the trees on the shore turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and guests can pick out every tree along the shore of the Alster Lakes.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Alster Lakes look like dull metal, and guests are happy to study them from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, sailboats barely move on the Alster Lakes, and guests in the balcony rooms watch them from the shade.
phrases.warm: Small sailboats dot the Alster Lakes on this warm day, and guests lose count of the sails somewhere after twenty.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lies across the Alster Lakes, and the trees on the shore throw long shadows onto the water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Alster Lakes turn orange, and the water copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low evening cloud, the city lights make a soft glow around the Alster Lakes.
