phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the city lights stretch into long, shaking lines on the Alster Lakes.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the Alster Lakes hold a faint grey light, and guests can still tell water from shore.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests in the upper-floor suites look for stars above the Alster Lakes and find a few.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Alster Lakes are wide and still, and nothing moves on the water.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Alster Lakes is still bright, and guests count the first lights coming on along the shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: The park is still only dark shapes of trees before sunrise, while the lake is just starting to show.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Lake View rooms, guests open the curtains and find the lake already bright and flat.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests training at La Malpensata look up from their exercise and see the lake, blue from shore to shore.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Park View rooms, the trees of the park go from bright to dark and back again as the clouds pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Rooftop Grand Suite see the sun on the lake this afternoon, while clouds shade the park.
phrases.overcast: From the Terrace Garden Suite, the park looks a deeper green today and the lake lies calm and grey.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the far shore today, and guests in the Suite Greta see the lake fade slowly into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the Six suites at Villa Sola Cabiati, the Lake is clear near the shore today, but the far side is not visible in the dull air.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the park, and guests in the Park View rooms watch the trees shine wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole lake for a second at a time to guests in the Rooftop Front Suite.
phrases.snow: From the Sauna and steam room, guests stay warm and watch the snow fall on the lake.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay in their robes at the spa and look at the lake, sharp and still in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: Guests in the Park View rooms enjoy the park from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, swimmers stay in the pool and rest at its edge to look at the lake.
phrases.warm: Guests at T Beach lie in the sun with the lake right in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light crosses the lake and reaches the guests in the Signature Suite.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lights the park one group of trees at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: At La Terrazza Gualtiero Marchesi, guests have dinner facing a dark Lake Como and the soft lights of its shore.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain taps on the lake tonight, and guests in the Suite Emilia see the shore lights blurred through wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the Terrace Garden Suite looks out on the park as a dark mass of trees and the lake as a paler shape.
phrases.clear_night: From the Rooftop Corner Suite, the lights of the far shore lie in a thin line along the black lake.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Rooftop Grand Suite sleep between a silent park and a black lake.
phrases.dusk: The park goes dark first after sunset, while the lake still holds the brightness of the sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Cascais Bay lies still under a clear sky, and the air above the water slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light fills Cascais Bay, and the terrace where breakfast is served looks straight across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Cascais Bay is deep blue, and the boats in the marina are easy to count from the terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Cascais Bay this morning, and guests in the sea-view rooms follow their shadows across the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balconies of the Penthouse Suite, sun and cloud take turns over Cascais Bay and the coast towards Estoril.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Cascais Bay turns the colour of pewter, and the Atlantic beyond it looks wide and quiet.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Cascais Bay today, and the moored boats look like small marks on pale water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Cascais Bay is not visible today; guests see Praia dos Pescadores and the nearest boats clearly, then the water fades.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Cascais Bay, and guests in this 19th-century villa watch the sand of Praia dos Pescadores darken.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the Atlantic, and guests indoors see lightning brighten Cascais Bay for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Cascais Bay, and guests watch the flakes disappear as they touch the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and Cascais Bay shines sharp and blue beyond the empty terrace.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look out at Cascais Bay, where small waves reach Praia dos Pescadores under a pale sky.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests sit under the terrace umbrellas and look at Cascais Bay, where the water seems the only cool thing in sight.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the terrace watch swimmers at Praia dos Pescadores and small boats crossing Cascais Bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Cascais Bay gold, and the terracotta rooftops of the town glow beside the water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above Cascais Bay turn orange and pink, and the water copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Corleone Restaurant Al Mar, guests look out at the sea under a cloudy evening sky, with the lights of the town on the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows this evening, and the lights around Cascais Bay become soft, wet reflections.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the night sky, and the lights of the town draw the curve of Cascais Bay for guests in the 11 rooms.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, stars stand over the Atlantic, and Cascais Bay carries the lights of the marina on its surface.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Cascais Bay is quiet and almost black, and the moored boats barely move.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright above Cascais Bay, and the first lights come on along the coast to Estoril.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Pacific Ocean is a wide grey surface under a clear sky, and the first light slowly finds the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: From the upper rooms, guests see the Tillamook Head Lighthouse stand sharp on the northern horizon in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: The Pacific Ocean is deep blue at midday, and the wide sand of Cannon Beach looks almost white next to it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Cannon Beach this morning, while the open ocean beyond stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lawn next to the beach, the afternoon view is half blue sky and half cloud above the long Pacific waves.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the white tops of the waves show clearly on it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the northern horizon today, so the Tillamook Head Lighthouse is hidden and guests watch the nearest waves come out of the white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tillamook Head Lighthouse cannot be seen today; the view ends at the wet sand and the first rows of waves on Cannon Beach.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Cannon Beach, and guests watch it from behind the glass doors of their oceanfront rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Pacific Ocean for a second, then the storm closes over the water again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sand of Cannon Beach, and guests in the indoor hot tub watch it through the large windows.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Tillamook Head Lighthouse looks closer than usual on the northern horizon.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests look at the wide sandy shore of Cannon Beach from the indoor hot tub, and nobody is in a hurry to leave.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests take the lounge chairs on the lawn and look at the cool Pacific Ocean just beyond the sand.
phrases.warm: On the lawn, guests at the picnic tables keep turning to look at the people walking along Cannon Beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Captain's Quarters, guests watch the low sun put a gold path across the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes under the clouds and colours them orange above the ocean, a sunset guests have watched from this inn since 1987.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hide the stars this evening, and guests can see only the white edges of the waves on Cannon Beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain shines on the lawn chairs, and beyond them guests can just see the waves breaking on Cannon Beach.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, ocean and sky are one colour, and guests find the horizon by guessing.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the open ocean, all the way down to the horizon in the north.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests awake in the upper rooms see an empty Cannon Beach and the slow movement of the ocean.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just gone, and the sky over the Pacific Ocean stays bright while Cannon Beach turns blue-grey.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Dolomites stand as a dark line above the sleeping Adige Valley.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Dolomites first, then moves slowly down into the Adige Valley below the panoramic windows.
phrases.clear_midday: Through the glass of Panorama Restaurant, the Adige Valley lies clear at midday, with Merano small on the valley floor.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the vineyard slopes of the Adige Valley this morning, while the Dolomites stay bright behind them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace, the afternoon clouds drift slowly along the Adige Valley towards the Dolomites.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Dolomites lose their detail, and the Adige Valley turns a quiet green and grey.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze fills the Adige Valley today, and from the infinity pool Merano is only a soft outline far below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Dolomites are not visible today; guests at the panoramic windows see Merano and the near slopes of the Adige Valley.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass walls of Panorama Restaurant, and the Adige Valley behind it looks blurred and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Adige Valley, and guests watch the storm from behind the panoramic windows, glad of the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Adige Valley, and the flakes disappear past the edge of the infinity pool.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and every snowy ridge of the Dolomites looks sharp from the terrace.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass of Panorama Restaurant and look down on Merano in the Adige Valley.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool with their arms on the edge, looking down at Merano far below.
phrases.warm: On the terrace, guests sit in the warm air and look across the Adige Valley to the green ridges beyond.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills the Adige Valley late in the afternoon, and the vineyard slopes above Merano glow under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange and pink, and the infinity pool reflects them in front of the Dolomites.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Merano shine up from the Adige Valley, far below the edge of the infinity pool.
phrases.wet_evening: At dinner in Panorama Restaurant, guests watch the lights of Merano shine through the wet glass on every side.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so the streetlamps of the Adige Valley are the only lights in the dark beyond the terrace.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the 47 rooms see stars over the Dolomites and the lights of Merano below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Adige Valley is quiet and deep below the cliff, and the Dolomites merge with the night sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, Merano switches on its first lights in the Adige Valley while the sky above the Dolomites is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, China Zun is a tall dark shape against a clear sky, and the Liangma River below it is still black.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of China Zun first, then moves down across the Beijing skyline to the Liangma River.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 26th-floor executive lounge, guests can follow the Beijing skyline from one end to the other under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the rooftops of the Chaoyang District this morning, seen through the tall glass beside the indoor pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Ambassador suites watch clouds drift past China Zun this afternoon, with the Liangma River bright below.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Liangma River takes the colour of the cloud, and China Zun rises plainly above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze thins the Beijing skyline to soft outlines today, and China Zun fades towards its top.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests cannot see the far Beijing skyline today; the Liangma River and the nearest Chaoyang rooftops are still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Liangma River, and guests in the executive lounge watch the Beijing skyline blur behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Beijing skyline for a second at a time, and guests beside the indoor pool agree that this is the right side of the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftop terrace, and beyond it the Beijing skyline slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold, bright day, guests float in the indoor pool and look through the glass at the Chaoyang rooftops.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 2012 hotel stay behind floor-to-ceiling glass and look along the Liangma River towards China Zun.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Beijing skyline, and guests in the executive lounge study it calmly with a cold drink in hand.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit among the greenery of the rooftop terrace with the Beijing skyline in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns China Zun gold, and the Liangma River carries the same colour through Chaoyang.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds above the Beijing skyline, a view that the Terrace Suite extends onto its private terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Beijing skyline gives the low sky a soft glow beyond the rooftop terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the city lights spread across the wet windows of the Ambassador suites, and China Zun shines beyond them.
phrases.mild_night: From the executive lounge, the lights of Beijing stretch out under a mild, cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: The illuminated Beijing skyline is sharp under a clear night sky, and China Zun is the easiest tower to find.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who are still awake find the Liangma River quiet and the Beijing skyline at rest behind the glass.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky is still bright around China Zun while the first lights come on along the Liangma River.

phrases.clear_predawn: A thin line of light grows along the far edge of Lake Michigan while the Gold Coast is still dark.
phrases.clear_morning: Lake Michigan shines beyond the Gold Coast rooftops, with the sun still low over the water.
phrases.clear_midday: From the City-View Executive Suite, guests can pick out each tower of the city skyline in the clear midday light.
phrases.partly_morning: Patches of sun and shade drift over the Gold Coast, and Lake Michigan behind it is half blue, half grey.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds keep putting the Magnificent Mile in shade this afternoon, while Lake Michigan stays in the sun.
phrases.overcast: The John Hancock Building stands dark against the cloud, and Lake Michigan is the same grey all the way out.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today; from the City-View Executive Suite the towers look like pencil drawings.
phrases.rain: In the gym, guests exercise facing a Magnificent Mile turned grey and blurred by the rain.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is crossing Lake Michigan, and each flash shows the water for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is covering the Gold Coast rooftops, and Lake Michigan has almost disappeared behind the falling flakes.
phrases.very_cold: Guests keep to the warm side of the glass today, with Lake Michigan a cold bright blue beyond the Gold Coast.
phrases.cold: The John Hancock Building rises above the Gold Coast, with Lake Michigan pale and flat behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests are glad of the cool gym, where they watch the Magnificent Mile shimmer below.
phrases.warm: Lake Michigan lies wide and blue beyond the Gold Coast, a view that makes guests think about a swim.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light climbs the John Hancock Building, and Lake Michigan behind it slowly turns a darker blue.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests in the City-View Executive Suite watch the city skyline glow orange under the last broken clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low cloud, the lights of the Magnificent Mile run in a bright line through the city.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Gold Coast tonight, and Lake Michigan beyond them is completely black.
phrases.mild_night: The lights of the Gold Coast end in a clear line tonight, and beyond that line Lake Michigan is completely dark.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the John Hancock Building is lit from bottom to top, and guests can count its floors instead of sheep.
phrases.late_night: Guests who cannot sleep find the city still awake below and Lake Michigan black and silent behind it.
phrases.dusk: The first lights appear across the Chicago skyline while Lake Michigan still holds the last pale colour of the day.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky turns pale above Lake Geneva, and early guests at their windows wait for Mont Blanc to take shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun comes through the glass roof of the rooftop pool, and swimmers look out over a bright blue Lake Geneva.
phrases.clear_midday: The Jet d'Eau rises white against a clear blue sky, and Mont Blanc stands clear above Lake Geneva.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift across the Alps this morning, and Mont Blanc appears and disappears above Lake Geneva.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the terrace of the Mont Blanc Suite, cloud shadows move slowly across Lake Geneva.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Lake Geneva turns the colour of steel, and the Jet d'Eau is the one white mark on it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on Lake Geneva today, and from the rooftop pool the water below is a soft grey with no far shore.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Mont Blanc is not visible today; guests see the Jet d'Eau clearly and Lake Geneva fading into pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the rooftop pool, and swimmers watch Lake Geneva turn grey below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Lake Geneva, and guests at their windows watch lightning flash where Mont Blanc usually stands.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Lake Geneva, and guests in this 1834 hotel watch the far shore disappear behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Mont Blanc looks very near above Lake Geneva, and guests wisely admire it from behind warm glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests float in the heated rooftop pool and look down at a chilly Lake Geneva.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Jet d'Eau throws its spray high over Lake Geneva, and its mist looks very inviting from here.
phrases.warm: On the alfresco terrace, guests have a drink in the warm air and look past the street to Lake Geneva.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the snow on Mont Blanc gold, and Lake Geneva below takes a softer blue.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop terrace of Izumi, the last sun colours the clouds over Lake Geneva and catches the top of the Jet d'Eau.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Izumi, guests look out from the rooftop at the city lights reflected in Lake Geneva under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening lights across Lake Geneva, and their reflections stretch long over the water.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, Mont Blanc is hidden, and Lake Geneva is a wide dark space between the lights of its shores.
phrases.clear_night: From the Penthouse Suite on the rooftop level, guests look all around at Lake Geneva and the mountains under a sky full of stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Geneva is quiet and black, and nothing moves on the water.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Lake Geneva just after sunset, and the first lights come on along the far shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tramuntana Mountains are a dark outline above the valley, and the clear sky over them slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The first sun touches the top of the Tramuntana Mountains, then moves slowly down to the olive groves in the valley.
phrases.clear_midday: From the terraced gardens, the valley opens to the Tramuntana Mountains under a clear sky, and the Mediterranean shines blue beyond.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Tramuntana Mountains this morning, while the rooftops of Deià village stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Sheridan Suite look out at Deià village and the Tramuntana Mountains, where sun and cloud take turns this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the olive groves below the gardens turn a soft silver, and the Tramuntana Mountains stand clear across the valley.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze fills the valley today, and the Tramuntana Mountains seem to float above it, with the Mediterranean hidden somewhere beyond.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Mediterranean is not visible today; guests can see the olive groves and the lower slopes of the Tramuntana Mountains, and not much further.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the olive groves, and guests watch from balcony rooms as the Tramuntana Mountains fade to grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Tramuntana Mountains, and thunder rolls down the valley towards the olive groves.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Tramuntana Mountains, and the olive terraces below the gardens turn white row by row.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, every rock on the Tramuntana Mountains looks sharp, and the Mediterranean is a deep blue beyond the valley.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the upper-floor suites keep the doors closed and look through the glass at Deià village and the Tramuntana Mountains.
phrases.very_hot: By the pool, guests stay in the water and look over the olive trees to the Mediterranean, which shimmers in the heat.
phrases.warm: On the stone terrace, guests sit in the warm air above the rooftops of Deià village, with the Tramuntana Mountains rising behind.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the rooftops of Deià village gold, and the Tramuntana Mountains above them change from grey to orange.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Tramuntana Mountains turn pink, and guests in these 17th-century manor houses stop to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Deià village glow on the hillside, and the Tramuntana Mountains are only a darker grey above them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and from the Sheridan Suite guests see the lights of Deià village blurred on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the gardens are quiet, and the lights of Deià village show where the valley begins below the Tramuntana Mountains.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Tramuntana Mountains, and guests of this hotel, open since 1984, find the lights of Deià village small beneath them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the valley sleeps, and the Tramuntana Mountains are felt more than seen across the olive groves.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky is still bright above the Tramuntana Mountains, and guests watch the first lights come on in Deià village.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the Junior Suite Sea View rooms, the sea is a dark flat sheet waiting for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in The Delano Penthouse open the curtains to a sharp skyline and a blue sea.
phrases.clear_midday: The sea shows two colours at this hour, pale green near the beach area and deep blue further out.
phrases.partly_morning: Some towers of the skyline stand in sunshine this morning while others wait in the shade of a cloud.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the One Bedroom Suite Sea View rooms watch the sea change from blue to grey and back as the clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: The towers of the skyline keep their shapes clear against a flat grey ceiling of cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze has softened the skyline to pale outlines, while the sea below the pool stays easy to see.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From The Collins Suite, the Arabian Gulf is visible only a short way out today, and the horizon is not there at all.
phrases.rain: Rain dots the sea in front of the One Bedroom Terrace Suite Sea View rooms, and guests watch it from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: After every flash over the sea, guests in the Family Suite count the seconds until the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snowflakes vanish as they touch the sea, and guests in the Junior Suite Sea View rooms stay indoors to watch.
phrases.very_cold: The skyline is drawn in fine detail today, and the pool in front of it lies empty and perfectly still.
phrases.cold: Guests in the One Bedroom Suite Resort View rooms hold a hot drink and study their partial sea view from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: Swimmers stay in the pool up to their shoulders and look at the skyline from the water.
phrases.warm: Along the beach area, guests walk at the water's edge with the sea open beside them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the skyline to gold for guests looking out from The Delano Penthouse.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lays a bright path across the sea towards the beach area.
phrases.grey_evening: The lights of the skyline colour the low cloud tonight, while the sea beneath stays black.
phrases.wet_evening: Through the rain on the glass of The Delano Penthouse, guests see the skyline lights run in long coloured lines.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in The Collins Suite look out on an Arabian Gulf gone dark, its horizon lost under the night cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Nobody looking out from the pool tonight can say exactly where the black sea ends and the lit skyline begins.
phrases.late_night: Guests still awake in the One Bedroom Suite Sea View rooms see a dark, quiet sea with no boats moving on it.
phrases.dusk: The first lights come on across the skyline while the pool still holds the last colour of the day.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Rodeo Drive lies empty and quiet, and the Hollywood Hills are a dark shape at its far end.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests take breakfast on their suite balconies, with morning sun on the palm trees and the full length of Rodeo Drive.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Rodeo Drive runs in a straight line to the Hollywood Hills, with no cloud above them.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Hollywood Hills this morning, and their shadows cross the rooftops of Beverly Hills one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests look up Rodeo Drive this afternoon and find the Hollywood Hills half in sun, half under cloud.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Beverly Hills today, and the palm trees stand out green against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Los Angeles skyline today, and the Hollywood Hills look like a drawing in pale pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Hollywood Hills are not visible today; guests see the first blocks of Rodeo Drive clearly, then the street fades into pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the curved balcony windows, and guests in the suites watch Rodeo Drive shine wet below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Beverly Hills, and lightning shows the Hollywood Hills for a second before the rain hides them again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Rodeo Drive, and guests stop to stare as the Hollywood Hills turn white behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and guests see the Hollywood Hills in sharp detail beyond the far end of Rodeo Drive.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Rodeo Drive looks quiet under a pale sky, and the Los Angeles skyline stands in the distance.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the patio at THE Blvd watch Rodeo Drive shimmer and order something cold.
phrases.warm: On the patio at THE Blvd, guests watch Rodeo Drive go by, and Rodeo Drive looks back.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the suite balconies of this 1927 hotel, guests watch the low sun turn Rodeo Drive and the Hollywood Hills gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and the Hollywood Hills glow orange above the end of Rodeo Drive.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the shop lights of Rodeo Drive make a bright line, seen from the patio at THE Blvd.
phrases.wet_evening: Wet weather tonight doubles the lights of Rodeo Drive on the road, a show guests get for free.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the sky above Beverly Hills takes a soft glow from the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests on the balconies see the lights of the Los Angeles skyline spread to the horizon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Rodeo Drive is still, and guests who are awake have the whole street to themselves, at least to look at.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Hollywood Hills as the first lights come on along Rodeo Drive.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Boston Harbour is still and dark, and the sky over the Atlantic Ocean slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light catches the harbour channel, and guests in the southeast-facing rooms are the first to see it.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Boston Harbour is bright blue all the way out toward the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests watch cloud shadows cross Boston Harbour this morning, with patches of sun following them along the channel.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Seaport District this afternoon, and Boston Harbour changes from blue to grey and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Boston Harbour takes the colour of steel, and each boat leaves a white wake across it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Boston Harbour today, and guests see the harbour channel fade a short way from the shore.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Atlantic Ocean is not visible today; guests see Boston Harbour only as far as the middle of the channel.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Boston Harbour, and guests in the harbour view rooms watch the drops run down the large windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Boston Harbour, and for a second guests see the whole channel in white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Boston Harbour, and the flakes vanish as soon as they touch the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests stay inside and look across Boston Harbour toward a sharp, clear Atlantic horizon.
phrases.cold: Boston Harbour looks cold and calm today, a good reason to study it from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of a suite.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests step outside the lobby and look out from the World Trade Center Pier, where Boston Harbour shines.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests board a water taxi at the hotel's dock, with Boston Harbour ahead and city buildings behind.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the Seaport District, and Boston Harbour turns gold along the channel.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Boston Harbour turn pink, and guests on the higher floors see the colour reach the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Evening cloud hangs low over Boston Harbour, and the lights of the Seaport District glow beneath it.
phrases.wet_evening: Through the evening rain, guests see the city lights stretch into long, shaking reflections on Boston Harbour.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the sky is clouded, and Boston Harbour is a wide dark space edged by waterfront lights.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the city's office buildings glow, and the harbour channel carries their lights.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Boston Harbour is quiet, and guests who cannot sleep see the water move slowly in the channel.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Boston Harbour is still bright, and the first lights come on along the waterfront.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the private causeway curves across dark water to a man-made island 280 metres from the coastline.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light shows the whole position: a man-made island in the sea, 280 metres from the coastline.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests on the island look back across 280 metres of blue sea to the coastline.
phrases.partly_morning: This morning the sea between the island and the mainland is partly in sun and partly in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests arriving this afternoon cross the sea on the private curving causeway, with the island ahead of them.
phrases.overcast: Grey sea, grey sky, and between them the man-made island that appears to float above the water.
phrases.fog_haze: In today's haze the coastline 280 metres away looks pale, and the island appears to float more than ever.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the open sea fades out early, but the coastline 280 metres away is still easy to see.
phrases.rain: The curving causeway is wet with rain, and the sea on both sides of it has turned grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay indoors on the island while a thunderstorm passes over the sea and the causeway.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on a man-made island in the sea off Dubai, a view few guests expected to see.
phrases.very_cold: From indoors, guests look at the sea that separates the island from the mainland.
phrases.cold: Today the 280 metres of sea between the island and the coastline are for looking at, not for swimming.
phrases.very_hot: The island sits in the sea 280 metres from the coastline, and on a day this hot guests are glad of the water all around.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests outdoors have sea on every side and the mainland a curving causeway away.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late light falls on the island and on the curve of the causeway leading back to the mainland.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests end the day on an island that appears to float above the sea, under the last sun and some cloud.
phrases.grey_evening: After dark, the island lies 280 metres from the coastline, with only the private causeway connecting the two.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain falls on the sea around the island, and guests stay dry indoors, 280 metres from the coastline.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the man-made island keeps its distance from the mainland: 280 metres of dark sea.
phrases.clear_night: Guests go to sleep tonight on an island in the sea, connected to the mainland by a private curving causeway.
phrases.dusk: The sea is still bright in the few minutes after sunset, and the island appears to float above it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Aegean Sea lies still and grey-blue below the balconies, and Antiparos is only a low shape on the water.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Poseidon restaurant, guests look out over an azure sea under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the pool terrace, the Aegean Sea is deep blue under a clear sky, and Antiparos sits low on the water ahead.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Aegean Sea this morning, and guests on their verandas follow them toward Antiparos.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Aeolos Pool Bar, the sea changes between cobalt and grey as clouds pass over Golden Beach this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Aegean Sea takes the colour of slate, and Antiparos stays low and clear across the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Aegean Sea today, and from the pool terrace Antiparos is a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Antiparos is not visible from the pool terrace today, and the Aegean Sea fades into pale air a short way out.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Aegean Sea; guests watch it from their balcony doors, Antiparos slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Aegean Sea, and for a second Antiparos stands out sharply on the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Aegean Sea, and the flakes disappear the moment they touch the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, the Aegean Sea is a sharp dark blue, and every rock on Antiparos seems closer.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Poseidon Pool Bar still looks over the Aegean Sea, steel blue and empty beyond the floating pontoon.
phrases.very_hot: By the pool, guests leave the sunbeds for the water and look at the indigo Aegean Sea from there.
phrases.warm: On the pool terrace, in 45,000 m² of grounds, guests look across a warm, calm Aegean Sea toward Antiparos.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Poseidon Pool Bar, guests hold their cocktails and watch the low sun turn the Aegean Sea gold.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests in the private pool suites watch the clouds over the Aegean Sea turn pink and orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Poseidon restaurant goes on under a cloudy evening sky, with the sea dark grey beyond the tables.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Aegean Sea this evening, and from Poseidon Pool Bar the water is a dark surface moving behind it.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and guests at Poseidon Pool Bar hear the Aegean Sea beyond the pontoon more than they see it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Aegean Sea, and guests at the poolside tables of Poseidon restaurant look up between courses.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Aegean Sea is one wide darkness, and Antiparos cannot be told apart from the water.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Aegean Sea is still bright, and the first candles are lit on the pool terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Prague Castle is a dark shape above the rooftops of Malá Strana, under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights Prague Castle under a clear sky, and the red rooftops of Malá Strana glow below it.
phrases.clear_midday: From CODA Restaurant's rooftop terrace, Prague Castle, St. Nicholas Church and the rooftops of Malá Strana stand in one sweep under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Prague Castle this morning, and their shadows cross the red rooftops of Malá Strana.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Mozart Suite look down on the Vrtba Garden, where sun and cloud shadow take turns on the Baroque garden.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the green dome of St. Nicholas Church keeps its colour above the rooftops of Malá Strana.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Malá Strana today, and guests see Prague Castle as a soft pencil drawing above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Prague Castle is not clear in today's thick air; the dome of St. Nicholas Church and the nearest rooftops of Malá Strana are what guests can see.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Vrtba Garden; guests working out in the fitness center watch it and stay perfectly dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Prague Castle for a second, and guests count the seconds until the thunder rolls over Malá Strana.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Vrtba Garden, and guests in the Beethoven Suite watch the Baroque garden turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and guests who look out see Prague Castle sharp against the sky above Malá Strana.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the fitness center make their own heat while looking out at the Vrtba Garden.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on CODA Restaurant's rooftop terrace keep to the shade of the parasols and look across the bright rooftops at Prague Castle.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit with a cold drink on CODA Restaurant's rooftop terrace, the dome of St. Nicholas Church in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun falls on Prague Castle, and from CODA Restaurant's rooftop terrace the rooftops of Malá Strana turn a deeper red.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Prague Castle turn orange, and guests in this 51-room hotel stop to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, Prague Castle is lit above the rooftops of Malá Strana, a sight that CODA Restaurant's rooftop terrace has in full.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Prague Castle are blurred above the shining rooftops of Malá Strana.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit dome of St. Nicholas Church and Prague Castle glow softly over Malá Strana.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the Blues Suite look up through the ceiling windows at the stars, with the Vrtba Garden below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Malá Strana is quiet, and Prague Castle is only an outline above the rooftops.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Prague Castle and across Malá Strana.

phrases.clear_predawn: The golden sunset is a full day away; for now the Ayung River keeps its gentle rhythm in the dark.
phrases.clear_morning: At Sawah Terrace Restaurant, guests eat breakfast with a clear view of the Ayung River.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests at lunch in Sawah Terrace Restaurant watch the Ayung River keep its gentle rhythm in full sun.
phrases.partly_morning: The river keeps its gentle rhythm, in sun one minute and in shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Ubud's forest this afternoon, with enough open sky between them to promise a golden sunset.
phrases.overcast: Grey above, green all around: the lush jungle meets the Ayung River in soft, even light.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Ubud's forest today, and the golden sunset may turn a paler gold this evening.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Ubud's forest is only a pale shape in the thick air today, and the golden sunset may be a faint one.
phrases.rain: Through the rain, guests at Sawah Terrace Restaurant can still see the Ayung River.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Ubud's forest, while lightning flashes white on the Ayung River.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Ubud's forest, and the Ayung River keeps its gentle rhythm through the white.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing day the river keeps its gentle rhythm, and guests leave it to itself and stay inside.
phrases.cold: No one is out by the Ayung River today; it flows past the lush jungle with only the cold for company.
phrases.very_hot: The heat slows everything except the Ayung River, and the golden sunset is still hours away.
phrases.warm: Warm light fills the place where the lush jungle meets the Ayung River, a first hint of the golden sunset.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests at Ambar Ubud Bar watch the golden sunset begin under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The golden sunset arrives in pieces today, shining through the gaps between the clouds over Ubud's forest.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hid the sunset tonight, and guests at dinner in Sawah Terrace Restaurant face the Ayung River in the dark.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain took the golden sunset this evening, and now it falls on the dark Ayung River.
phrases.mild_night: Night has settled where the lush jungle meets the Ayung River, and the gentle rhythm of the river goes on under cloud.
phrases.clear_night: The golden sunset is long gone, and Ubud's forest stands black under a clear night full of stars.
phrases.late_night: The river never stops for the night; its gentle rhythm goes on past sleeping guests and the dark forest.
phrases.dusk: At Ambar Ubud Bar, the golden sunset is just over and guests look at a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the twin towers of the Frauenkirche stand unlit against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: On this clear morning, guests on the high floors can see the Frauenkirche, the Old Town and, far beyond them, the Alps.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Frauenkirche towers rise above the Old Town rooftops, every line sharp.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Old Town this morning, and the Frauenkirche goes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the Munich skyline toward Marienplatz.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Old Town rooftops lose their colour, while the Frauenkirche towers remain easy to find among them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Old Town today, and guests see the Frauenkirche towers as two soft grey outlines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today, and the Frauenkirche towers are the farthest thing guests can make out clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the central station below, and the Frauenkirche is blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Old Town, and for a second the Frauenkirche towers stand out clearly against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Munich, and guests watch the Old Town rooftops turn white around the Frauenkirche.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests in this 219-room tower look over the Old Town toward the Frauenkirche, glad to be indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look down on the central station and then across the rooftops to the Frauenkirche.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests in the terrace rooms step onto their private balcony only briefly, to look at the Munich skyline.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit on the 3rd-floor terrace, which seats 120, with a glass of wine and the rooftops of Munich in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Frauenkirche towers gold, and the Old Town rooftops around them glow warm.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests watch the last sun slip between the clouds and light the Frauenkirche towers one more time.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit twin towers of the Frauenkirche stand above the streets of Munich.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the city lights shine on the streets around the central station.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests on the high floors pick out the lit Frauenkirche among the lights of the Old Town.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the illuminated Frauenkirche towers stand above a wide field of Munich city lights.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the streets around the central station are still, and the Frauenkirche towers are only an outline over the Old Town.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the Old Town around the Frauenkirche.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Douro River is a dark band below the hillside, and Clérigos Tower stands still against the clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: In the clear morning light, Clérigos Tower and the Douro River share one window, both sharp and bright.
phrases.clear_midday: From the pool terrace, the Douro River shines under a clear midday sky, beyond Porto's terracotta rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Porto's terracotta rooftops towards the Douro River this morning, seen from the balcony rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Vila Nova de Gaia this afternoon, and the Douro River changes from blue to grey and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Douro River turns the colour of slate, and Clérigos Tower keeps its clear outline above the city.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Douro River today, and Clérigos Tower rises from the city like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far bank of the Douro River is not clear today, but guests can still find Clérigos Tower above the nearer roofs.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows, and guests see Clérigos Tower and the Douro River a little blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Douro River for a second, then Clérigos Tower disappears into the heavy rain again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Porto's terracotta rooftops, and Clérigos Tower fades in and out behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, Clérigos Tower looks close enough to touch, and nobody tests the infinity pool to check.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests swim in the indoor pool and look through its glass walls at the treetops and the city skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look over its edge at the Douro River.
phrases.warm: From the sun loungers on the pool terrace, guests look at the Douro River and Porto Cathedral, and their books wait.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Clérigos Tower golden, and guests in the Frida Kahlo Suite watch the city from the twin bathtub.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds turn orange above the Douro River, and the rooftops of Vila Nova de Gaia glow under them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under the evening cloud, the city lights spread down the hillside, and guests in this 49-room hotel follow them to the Douro River.
phrases.wet_evening: This wet evening, the lights along the Douro River blur into long streaks, and Clérigos Tower shows only faintly through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the clouds hold the glow of the city, and Clérigos Tower stands out above it.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Douro River carries the reflections of the city lights, seen from the pool terrace.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city is quiet, and the Douro River is a dark line below the sleeping rooftops.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Douro River, and guests watch the first lights come on around Clérigos Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean is a dark surface under a clear sky, with a first thin light along the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: From their balconies, guests see the morning sun on the Atlantic Ocean and the long sandy shoreline below.
phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic Ocean shows its teal colour under a clear midday sky, right in front of the oceanfront pool deck.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Atlantic Ocean this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Beyond the palm trees of the oceanfront tanning lawn, the Atlantic Ocean lies under patches of sun and cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns grey as well, and the waves draw white lines on the sand.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic Ocean and the sky look like one soft sheet.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the shoreline is not visible today; guests see only the nearest sand and the first waves.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Atlantic Ocean, and guests watch it through the floor-to-ceiling windows of their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests follow the storm from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sandy shoreline, and the Atlantic Ocean keeps rolling in as if nothing has changed.
phrases.very_cold: In the fitness center, guests stay warm on a freezing day and look out at the bright, cold Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the lounge chairs of the oceanfront pool deck sit in rows before the Atlantic Ocean, waiting for warmer weather.
phrases.very_hot: In the oceanfront pool, guests stay in the water up to their shoulders and look at the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.warm: On the oceanfront pool deck, guests lie on the lounge chairs with the Atlantic Ocean in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the sandy shoreline in the late afternoon, and the Atlantic Ocean turns a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Atlantic Ocean, in full sight of the oceanfront pool deck.
phrases.grey_evening: Around the oceanfront fire pit, the evening is cloudy and the Atlantic Ocean is a dark space beyond the flames.
phrases.wet_evening: The rain continues this evening, and the Atlantic Ocean is only a sound and a few white wave tops.
phrases.mild_night: From the balconies of the Royal Suite, guests look over the Atlantic Ocean under a mild, cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and the horizon is still easy to find.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the sandy shoreline is empty and the Atlantic Ocean is black to the horizon.
phrases.dusk: At dusk, the sky stays bright over the Atlantic Ocean while the first lights come on along the shoreline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky turns a soft pink behind Prague Castle, and the Vltava River is still grey.
phrases.clear_morning: From the River View Suite, guests see the morning sun reach Prague Castle first and Charles Bridge a little later.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every arch of Charles Bridge is easy to count above the Vltava River.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Vltava River this morning, while Prague Castle stays in sunshine on its hill.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the riverside rooms watch the afternoon clouds drift over Prague Castle, one slow group after another.
phrases.overcast: The Vltava River takes the grey of the sky today, and Charles Bridge crosses it in darker stone.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on the Vltava River, and Charles Bridge seems to stop halfway across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Prague Castle is not clear today; guests see Charles Bridge and the near side of the Vltava River well enough.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Vltava River, and guests in the River View Suite watch the wet stone of Charles Bridge turn darker.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Prague Castle for a second above the Vltava River, then the storm hides it again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Charles Bridge, and guests in this hotel, open since 2004, see the bridge slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests stay behind the glass and look at Prague Castle, sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Vltava River looks like steel below the stone arches of Charles Bridge.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Vltava River shines so brightly that guests half close their eyes to look at Charles Bridge.
phrases.warm: Guests in the suites with a castle view open the windows on this warm day and follow the Vltava River as far as Charles Bridge.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns Charles Bridge gold, and the River View Suite fills with the same warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above Prague Castle turn red, and the Vltava River copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Prague Castle glow above the Vltava River.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lamps of Charles Bridge blur into soft yellow circles on the window glass.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so guests look at the lights of Charles Bridge on the Vltava River instead.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the riverside rooms of this 69-room palace find Prague Castle bright on its hill.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Vltava River moves quietly under the arches of Charles Bridge.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind Prague Castle while the first lamps come on along Charles Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sydney Harbour Bridge stands as a dark arch against a sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the harbour-facing balconies, and guests watch the first ferries cross in front of the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every steel line of the Sydney Harbour Bridge is sharp above the blue water of Circular Quay.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Royal Botanic Garden this morning, and guests on the garden-facing balconies watch the lawns change colour.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Acapulco El Vista, guests look across the harbour this afternoon as clouds drift behind the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits low over Circular Quay, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge looks darker and heavier against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Sydney Harbour Bridge today, and the ferries seem to appear from nowhere on the pale water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Sydney Harbour Bridge is not clear today, but the ferries at Circular Quay below are easy to follow.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Sydney Harbour, and guests in the harbour view suites watch the Sydney Harbour Bridge blur behind wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the harbour, and for a second the whole arch of the Sydney Harbour Bridge shows white against the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow over Circular Quay is a rare sight, and guests stand at the windows to watch it fall past the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, so guests stay inside and count the ferries passing under the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the water at Circular Quay looks like steel, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge stands clear above it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the shade of their balconies and watch the ferries make their own breeze across Sydney Harbour.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests sit on the balconies refreshed in 2022 by Mel Porter Design and watch people walk along Circular Quay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the harbour gold, and guests on the balconies see the Sydney Harbour Bridge darken against the bright sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and guests at Acapulco El Vista watch the light move over Sydney Harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Sydney Harbour Bridge draw a bright curve above the dark water of Circular Quay.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of Circular Quay stretch into long reflections on the wet promenade this evening, with the Sydney Harbour Bridge glowing through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, guests stay out on the balconies, and the lit ferries below come and go like slow lanterns.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lit arch of the Sydney Harbour Bridge shines above the black water of the harbour.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the ferries have stopped, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge keeps watch over a still, empty Circular Quay.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind the Sydney Harbour Bridge as the first lights come on along Circular Quay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Santorini Caldera is a wide bowl of still water under a clear sky, with the volcano low in the middle.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast arrives on the suite terraces, and guests eat it facing the Santorini Caldera in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: From the infinity pool, the Santorini Caldera opens in front of swimmers, with the volcano fixed on the horizon under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Santorini Caldera this morning, and the volcano goes from dark to bright and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At Alali Restaurant, lunch guests look over the Santorini Caldera while clouds pass above the volcano.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Santorini Caldera turns the colour of slate, and the volcano looks darker than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Santorini Caldera today, and the volcano looks like a pencil drawing on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far cliffs of the Santorini Caldera are not visible today; guests see the volcano and the sea just below.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Santorini Caldera, and guests watch it from inside their suites, the volcano slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the Santorini Caldera, and lightning shows the volcano for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the Santorini Caldera, and the volcano fades behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and the Santorini Caldera shows every line of its cliffs around the volcano.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the Santorini Caldera lies wide and grey-blue below the cliff, and the volcano looks close enough to touch.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look at the volcano from the water.
phrases.warm: By the infinity pool, books stay closed in the warm air while guests look across the Santorini Caldera instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills the Santorini Caldera, and guests at the pool bar turn their chairs toward the volcano.
phrases.partly_golden: At Alali Restaurant the last sun colours the clouds over the Santorini Caldera, and conversation stops for a minute.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner guests at Alali Restaurant look out on the Santorini Caldera under evening cloud, with village lights along the far cliffs.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Santorini Caldera this evening, and the lights across the water shine softly through it.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests in the terrace suites sit outside facing the Santorini Caldera and the dark sea below.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the Santorini Caldera, and guests count them from the open-air spa tubs on their terraces.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Santorini Caldera is quiet, black water, and the volcano is only a darker shape in it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky above the Santorini Caldera stays bright, and the first lights appear along the cliffs from Fira to Oia.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sinai mountains are a dark line behind the coast, and the Red Sea below is still and grey.
phrases.clear_morning: From the upper floors, guests see the Red Sea below, the coastline bending south toward Ras Mohammed and the Sinai mountains behind, all clear in the morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: The midday sun lights the Red Sea clear to the horizon, and the water by the jetty, where the reef begins, is sharp in every detail.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Red Sea this morning, while the coastline toward Ras Mohammed stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the infinity pool, the Red Sea lies under a sky of scattered clouds, with the jetty reaching out into the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Red Sea loses its blue, and the coastline toward Ras Mohammed looks drawn in a single colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Sinai mountains today, and from the upper floors the Red Sea fades into the sky without a horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The coastline toward Ras Mohammed is not visible today; the Red Sea shows only as far as the jetty and a little beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Red Sea, and the Moorish arch by the terrace jacuzzi frames a grey, blurred horizon.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Sinai mountains, and for a second guests see the whole ridgeline above the coast.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Red Sea, and guests on the upper floors watch the Sinai mountains disappear behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and guests can follow the full ridgeline of the Sinai mountains behind the coast.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the curved floor-to-ceiling windows of the restaurant and look at the Red Sea from there.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool, one of 4 outdoor pools, and look across the beach at the Red Sea, which seems the better idea.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, swimmers set off from the jetty toward the reef close by, with the Red Sea open in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late in the afternoon, the low sun warms the colour of the Sinai mountains, and the Red Sea turns a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the coastline turn orange, and the infinity pool and the Red Sea beyond it take the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Red Sea is dark, and guests follow the lights of the coastline as it bends south toward Ras Mohammed.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the curved restaurant windows this evening, and guests see the Red Sea through it as a blur of dark water.
phrases.mild_night: No stars show through the cloud on this mild night, and from the beachfront restaurant terrace the Red Sea is a wide dark surface beyond the palm trees.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Red Sea tonight, and the Sinai mountains are a dark shape behind the coast.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Red Sea is quiet and black below the headland, and only the water moving at the jetty breaks the silence.
phrases.dusk: From the beachfront restaurant terrace, the Red Sea coastline holds the last light of the sky as the first lamps come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Venetian Lagoon lies still and grey-blue, and the Venice skyline waits across the water as a low dark line.
phrases.clear_morning: At Insieme Breakfast, guests take their coffee with the Venice skyline clear across the Venetian Lagoon in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The dome of Santa Maria della Salute and the palaces of the Grand Canal stand sharp across the Venetian Lagoon under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cross the sky this morning, and guests at Insieme Breakfast see the Campanile move in and out of sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace of Acquerello Fine Dining, guests watch boats come to the private dock while clouds drift over the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the Venetian Lagoon turns silver, and San Giorgio Maggiore stands out across it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Venetian Lagoon today, and from the outdoor pool the Venice skyline is only a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the terrace of Acquerello Fine Dining, the private dock and the near water are clear, but the Grand Canal palaces are not visible today.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Venetian Lagoon with small rings, and guests in the lagoon-facing rooms watch the Venice skyline turn soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: When lightning strikes, guests see the Venice skyline for a second across the Venetian Lagoon, and then the storm hides it again.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Venetian Lagoon, and guests in the San Clemente Signature Suite watch it through an almost complete wall of windows.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, the Campanile and the dome of Santa Maria della Salute look close enough to touch across the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the heated outdoor pool is quiet, and the city's profile stays in view across the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool and look across the water at the Venice skyline, which seems to tremble a little.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit on the terrace of Acquerello Fine Dining and follow the boats across the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Venetian Lagoon orange, and guests in the Tiepolo Royal Suite open the tall French doors to watch it go down.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lights the Grand Canal palaces one by one across the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening of cloud, the lights of Venice make a thin gold line across the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and the lights of the Venice skyline spread into soft spots on the dark Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.mild_night: From the island, whose church dates from 1131, guests look across the Venetian Lagoon to Venice, lit tonight under cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the Navigante Signature Suite look over the Venetian Lagoon towards the lights of Lido Island.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Venetian Lagoon is black and still, and even Venice across the water seems to sleep.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky stays bright over the Venetian Lagoon, and the first lights come on along the Grand Canal palaces.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlas Mountains are a dark shape under a clear sky, and the Koutoubia Mosque stands unlit above the sleeping Red City.
phrases.clear_morning: From the suites facing the Atlas Mountains, guests see every ridge clearly in the first sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in Rooftop Garden Restaurant & Sushi Bar, guests look across the Red City to the Atlas Mountains under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Atlas Mountains this morning, while the Koutoubia Mosque stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the private wraparound veranda of the Nobu Penthouse Suite, guests follow cloud shadows crossing the palm trees towards the Koutoubia Mosque.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Red City keeps its warm colour, and the Koutoubia Mosque stands out clearly against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Atlas Mountains today, and the Koutoubia Mosque looks like a pencil drawing above the palm trees.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Atlas Mountains are not visible today; from the rooftop garden pool deck, the eye stops at the Koutoubia Mosque and the nearer rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Red City, and guests in the suites facing the Koutoubia Mosque watch its tower turn darker.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm hides the Atlas Mountains, and each flash of lightning shows the Koutoubia Mosque for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Red City, and the Koutoubia Mosque slowly fades behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The cold air is very clear today, and the peaks of the Atlas Mountains are easy to count from Rooftop Garden Restaurant & Sushi Bar.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the rooftop garden pool deck shows the Atlas Mountains on one side and the Koutoubia Mosque on the other.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the cabanas of Rooftop Garden Restaurant & Sushi Bar, and the Atlas Mountains shimmer far beyond the circular pool.
phrases.warm: By the circular pool on the rooftop, books stay closed while guests look at the Atlas Mountains instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the rooftop garden pool deck, the Atlas Mountains and the Koutoubia Mosque share the same golden light as the sun goes down.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds above the Atlas Mountains, and the Koutoubia Mosque turns the same warm red as the city around it.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests at dinner in Rooftop Garden Restaurant & Sushi Bar see the lit Koutoubia Mosque above the lights of the Red City.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and the lights of the Red City shine on the rooftops around the lit Koutoubia Mosque.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Koutoubia Mosque glows above the Red City, and the Atlas Mountains are lost in the dark.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the 71 suites, and those on the Koutoubia Mosque side have the lit tower as their night view.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the palm trees and rooftops of the Red City lie quiet around the Koutoubia Mosque.
phrases.dusk: The DJ begins on the rooftop garden pool deck as the first lights come on around the Koutoubia Mosque, under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Alps are a dark line on the horizon, and Salzburg lies in shadow below the Tower Room.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Tower Room on the 6th floor, guests see Mirabell Palace across the river in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Alps stand sharp on the horizon beyond the rooftops of Salzburg.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Old Town this morning, while the Alps stay bright on the horizon.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of afternoon sun cross Salzburg between the clouds and move towards the Alps on the horizon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the church spires of the Old Town stand out clearly below the glass dome of The Glass Garden.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Salzburg today, and Mirabell Palace looks like a pale drawing across the river.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today; from the Tower Room, guests see the city below and Mirabell Palace across the river.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass dome of The Glass Garden, and the Old Town below is slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests under the glass dome of The Glass Garden watch lightning flash over the Old Town, with thunder close behind.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Salzburg, and guests in the Tower Room watch the city rooftops turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the Alps look close and sharp from the suite windows, and the city rooftops lie still below.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this castle hotel of 24 rooms stay behind the suite windows and look over Salzburg's rooftops to the distant mountains.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look over its edge at Salzburg below.
phrases.warm: By the infinity pool, books stay closed while guests look at the city and the Alps instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on Salzburg in the late afternoon, and the Alps on the horizon turn warm in colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Alps turn pink, and guests in the Tower Room have Salzburg at their feet.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in The Glass Garden, guests look through the glass dome at the lights of the Old Town under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Old Town shine through the drops on the glass dome of The Glass Garden.
phrases.mild_night: Salzburg's lights glow under a cloudy night sky, and the Alps have disappeared into the dark.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the Tower Room see the lights of Salzburg below and stars above the Alps.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Salzburg is quiet below the hill, and nobody is awake to count its rooftops.
phrases.dusk: The first lights come on in Salzburg just after sunset, while the sky behind the Alps is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Atlantic is a wide dark surface under a clear sky, and South Beach is empty sand beside it.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests step onto their private balconies to a clear morning, with South Beach bright below and the Atlantic blue to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Atlantic is turquoise close to South Beach and a deeper blue further out.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Atlantic this morning, while the sand of South Beach stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over South Beach and out across the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlantic loses its turquoise, and South Beach becomes the brightest thing in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic seems to end a little way beyond South Beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: guests see South Beach and the first waves clearly, but the far Atlantic is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on South Beach; guests watch the showers cross the Atlantic, which has turned grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic, and guests in this 19-floor tower watch the storm move across South Beach from behind glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on South Beach, and guests look twice as the flakes land on the palm trees and the sand.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Atlantic shows a sharp horizon beyond the empty sand of South Beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the palm-lined boardwalk is quiet, and the Atlantic rolls steadily onto South Beach.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests look down on sunbathers on South Beach and swimmers in the Atlantic.
phrases.warm: From the outdoor plunge pool of the Extreme WOW Suite, guests look out over the Atlantic and a busy South Beach on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the sand of South Beach gold, and the Atlantic beyond it is a calm, deep blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds above the Atlantic change from white to pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and guests see South Beach as a long grey band between the palm trees and the black Atlantic.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests on the private balconies watch rain sweep over South Beach toward the dark Atlantic.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the Atlantic shows only its white surf where it meets South Beach.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests on their private balconies see stars above the Atlantic and the pale sand of South Beach below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who are still awake find South Beach quiet and the Atlantic moving slowly beside it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright above the Atlantic, while South Beach slowly fades to a soft grey.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the clear sky turns pale over the Pacific, and Waikiki Beach slowly takes shape below it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Waikiki Beach, and from the balconies guests can count the sailboats on the blue Pacific.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Pacific is turquoise near Waikiki Beach and deep blue further out, under a sky with no cloud.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Pacific this morning, while Waikiki Beach stays bright between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The edge of the infinity pool lines up with the Pacific this afternoon, with white clouds above both.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pacific loses its blue, and the palm trees toward Waikiki Beach become the strongest colour in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the line between sea and sky today, and Waikiki Beach looks paler than usual.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the palm trees and Waikiki Beach are clear, but the Pacific horizon and Diamond Head are not.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and guests in the suites watch Waikiki Beach turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific, and for a second Waikiki Beach shows white under the storm clouds.
