phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Waikiki Beach, and the palm trees stand white-topped in front of a grey Pacific.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, so the Pacific horizon is a sharp line beyond Waikiki Beach.
phrases.cold: The heated infinity pool stays warm on this cold day, and beyond its edge the Pacific looks steel blue.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look out over the Pacific toward Waikiki Beach.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace, guests lie on striped sun loungers by the plunge pool, with the open Pacific in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Pacific gold, and guests on the Diamond Head Tower's upper floors see it through every floor-to-ceiling window.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink above Waikiki Beach, and the water of the infinity pool reflects them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights stretch toward Waikiki Beach, and the cloud above them picks up a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain blurs the city lights around Waikiki Beach, and the Pacific disappears into the dark behind them.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Pacific shows only where the city lights end at Waikiki Beach.
phrases.clear_night: With 552 ocean-facing suites, nobody has to share the stars tonight: they hang over the Pacific above Waikiki Beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pacific is black and quiet, and only the white edge of the surf marks Waikiki Beach.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky stays pink and purple over Diamond Head, and the first city lights appear along Waikiki Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Charles River is a dark curve under a clear sky, and Cambridge beyond it has not woken up yet.
phrases.clear_morning: From the river-facing rooms of this 356-room hotel, the Charles River is bright in the early sun, with Cambridge clear behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Charles River shines blue in front of Cambridge.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Boston Common this morning, while the Charles River stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Rooftop@Revere this afternoon, the sun comes and goes over the downtown towers, and the Charles River brightens each time it returns.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Charles River takes the colour of the clouds, and Cambridge sits quiet behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Charles River today, and guests looking for Cambridge find only a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: Cambridge cannot be seen, and the Charles River shows only its nearest curve.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the panoramic windows, and guests in rooms facing the Charles River see it grey and blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the Revere Club, guests watch lightning flash above the downtown towers, well out of the rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Boston Common, and guests in the rooms on that side watch it turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and guests can pick out single buildings in Cambridge across the Charles River.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay warm in the Revere Club and count the downtown towers instead of walking among them.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests at the rooftop pool keep to the water and look across at the Back Bay skyline.
phrases.warm: On a warm day at Rooftop@Revere, guests settle into the lounge seats, and the Charles River curves toward Cambridge in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Charles River gold, and from Rooftop@Revere the downtown towers and Cambridge glow with it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Back Bay turn orange, and the low light reaches the Charles River between them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the Back Bay skyline is lit, and the clouds above it take a soft glow from the city.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in the Revere Club see the lights of the downtown towers blur in the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the downtown towers keep their lights on, and the Charles River is a dark band in front of Cambridge.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the skyline view suites see the lights of Cambridge reflected in the Charles River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Charles River can hardly be seen, and the city around Boston Common is quiet at last.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Charles River, and from Rooftop@Revere the first lights appear in Cambridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the dome of St Stephen's Basilica stands unlit against a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the dome and towers of St Stephen's Basilica, and every detail of the stone is sharp from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the city skyline spreads in every direction around the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the facade of St Stephen's Basilica this morning, and the dome goes from bright to dull and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From High Note SkyBar, guests follow patches of afternoon sun as they cross the roofs of the city.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the dome of St Stephen's Basilica looks darker and seems closer to the rooftop terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far end of the city skyline today, while St Stephen's Basilica stays clear because it is so close.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant part of the city skyline is not visible today, so the view from the rooftop terrace ends at the dome and towers of St Stephen's Basilica.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the dome of St Stephen's Basilica and makes the old roofs around it shine.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the towers of St Stephen's Basilica for a second, then the storm turns them grey again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the dome of St Stephen's Basilica, and the city skyline behind it has almost gone white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the towers of St Stephen's Basilica stand out sharply and the city skyline seems cut from paper.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the dome of St Stephen's Basilica stands clear above the old roofs around this former bank building.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the rooftop terrace choose a seat in the shade and look across at the dome of St Stephen's Basilica.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the balconies facing the street look down at the historic facades and the people passing below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the facade of St Stephen's Basilica gold, and guests at High Note SkyBar stop talking to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights one tower of St Stephen's Basilica before the other.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the illuminated facade of St Stephen's Basilica fills the view directly ahead of High Note SkyBar.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lit dome of St Stephen's Basilica shines through the rain and the roofs below reflect its light.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, guests at High Note SkyBar look across at the lit dome of St Stephen's Basilica.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the city lights spread out behind St Stephen's Basilica, and guests at High Note SkyBar can follow them far across the skyline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the towers of St Stephen's Basilica stand quiet above the sleeping streets.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright behind St Stephen's Basilica, and the first lights come on across the city skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is a dark, quiet surface under a clear sky, and the horizon is just starting to show.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Café Amalfi, guests watch the morning sun spread across the Atlantic through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic is bright blue under a clear midday sky, and lunch at Café Amalfi has it in every window.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly over the Atlantic this morning, and the water changes from blue to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the oceanfront rooms see patches of sun and shade crossing the Atlantic this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Atlantic takes the same colour, and only the white tops of the waves stand out.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic seems to end a short way from the shore.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far Atlantic is not visible today; guests see the nearest waves along the Grand Strand and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows of Café Amalfi, and guests watch the Atlantic turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic, and guests watch the storm from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Grand Strand, and guests watch the flakes disappear into the grey Atlantic.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the horizon of the Atlantic looks sharp enough to cut paper.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests keep to the warm side of the glass in Café Amalfi and let the Atlantic do the shivering.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the private balconies look at the Atlantic and think only about getting into it.
phrases.warm: Guests in this 387-room hotel sit out on their balconies in the warm air, the Atlantic straight in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Atlantic a deeper blue, and the waves along the Grand Strand catch a golden light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Atlantic pink, and the sea below them slowly loses its blue.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and guests at dinner in Café Amalfi look out at the dark Atlantic through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Atlantic this evening, and the wet glass blurs the dark water into long soft streaks.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud hides the stars on this mild night, and the Atlantic keeps moving below it, dark and steady.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic tonight, and guests can follow the pale edge of each wave as it reaches the Grand Strand.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic is mostly a sound, with a little white showing where the waves break.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Atlantic is still bright, and the water darkens before it does.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky slowly pales over the Arabian Sea, and the curve of Marine Drive is empty beside it.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on the Arabian Sea, and the whole curve of Marine Drive is sharp from the pool deck.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Mumbai skyline stands clear across the bay from the pool deck, under a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the bay this morning, and their shadows move slowly along Marine Drive below the sea view rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun and shade cross the Arabian Sea this afternoon, and guests at Verandah follow them through the full-length windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Arabian Sea turns the same colour, and Marine Drive curves around it like a drawn line.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Mumbai skyline across the bay today, and Marine Drive fades halfway along its curve.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of Marine Drive is not visible today; from the pool deck guests see only the near part of the bay.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Arabian Sea, and guests at Verandah watch it through the full-length windows as Marine Drive shines wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Arabian Sea, and guests in the sea view rooms watch the storm cross the bay towards Marine Drive.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Marine Drive, and guests at the full-length windows of Verandah look twice at the white promenade.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold air the Mumbai skyline looks sharp across the bay, and guests admire it from behind the glass at Verandah.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Arabian Sea looks like steel, and Marine Drive curves clearly around the bay.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat the Arabian Sea shines white, and guests on the pool deck look at the skyline from under the umbrellas.
phrases.warm: On the pool deck, guests lie on the yellow sun loungers and look across the warm bay to the Mumbai skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests go up to the rooftop on the 35th floor as the sun drops towards the Arabian Sea, and gold light fills the full-length windows.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and colours the Arabian Sea, and the bay along Marine Drive turns orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the Queen's Necklace glow softly around the bay, seen from the pool deck.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights of the Queen's Necklace blur into one long golden curve.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the clouds over the bay take a soft glow from the lights of Marine Drive.
phrases.clear_night: In the ocean-view suites, the Queen's Necklace fills the room window and the bathroom window on this clear night.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Marine Drive lies quiet along the bay, and the Arabian Sea is wide and black beside it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still pink over the Arabian Sea, and from the ocean-view suites the first lights come on along Marine Drive.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Empire State Building stands as a dark shape over the quiet streets.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Manhattan skyline tower by tower, and guests in the sky view rooms watch it from bed.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Empire State Building stands sharp against the blue, easy to follow up to its spire.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Manhattan skyline this morning, and one tower after another takes its turn in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon guests watch clouds drift behind the Empire State Building, which makes the tower seem to move instead.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits flat over Midtown, and guests find the Empire State Building is the same calm colour as the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Empire State Building today, so guests can only guess where the spire ends.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Empire State Building is clear to see, but the far towers of the Manhattan skyline are not.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the sky view rooms, and the Manhattan skyline behind it looks soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Midtown, and guests watch from indoors as lightning shows the Empire State Building for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the sky view rooms, and the Manhattan skyline slowly fades to white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, bright day the Manhattan skyline looks as sharp as cut glass, and guests enjoy it from behind a warm window.
phrases.cold: The cold day keeps the air clean, and guests can count the floors of the Empire State Building if they have the patience.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests at ART NoMad hold cold drinks and look across at the Empire State Building in white sunlight.
phrases.warm: On this warm day guests step onto the glass Sky Walk at ART NoMad, with 31 stories of air under their shoes and the Manhattan skyline all around.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Empire State Building gold, and from ART NoMad on the 31st floor it seems close enough to touch.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and paints one side of the Manhattan skyline orange, leaving the other side in blue shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hangs over the city this evening, and the lit top of the Empire State Building colours the sky around it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the lights of the Manhattan skyline spread and shine in the drops on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lit Empire State Building stands over the rooftops like a lamp left on.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and guests count more lit windows in the Manhattan skyline than stars above it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the streets below the sky view rooms are almost empty, and the Manhattan skyline waits quietly for morning.
phrases.dusk: From ART NoMad, the first lights come on in the Empire State Building while the sky is still bright after sunset.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Guadarrama mountains are a dark line beyond the sleeping city.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Guadarrama mountains first, then the Paseo de la Castellana far below the skyline rooms.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Paseo de la Castellana runs straight through the city under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the fitness center watch cloud shadows move across the rooftops of Madrid this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Guadarrama mountains this afternoon, while the city below stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, guests at Volvoreta look out over a quiet, even-coloured Madrid.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Madrid today, and the Guadarrama mountains are only a faint outline behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Guadarrama mountains are not visible today; the Paseo de la Castellana and the nearer streets of the city still are.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Paseo de la Castellana shines wet far below.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the spa, guests watch lightning flash over the rooftops of Madrid while the storm passes.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Madrid, and guests at Celest Bar on the 32nd floor watch the rooftops slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air the Guadarrama mountains look sharp and close behind the city.
phrases.cold: On this cold day guests stay in the warm water of the spa and look out over the city through the glass.
phrases.very_hot: The city shimmers in the strong heat, and the Guadarrama mountains look pale and far away.
phrases.warm: On a warm day the tree-lined streets of Madrid show green between the rooftops, seen from the sauna window.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls along the Paseo de la Castellana, and guests at Celest Bar see the Guadarrama mountains turn orange.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Guadarrama mountains turn pink above the city.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Volvoreta, guests look down on the lights of Madrid under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the Paseo de la Castellana blur in the wet evening, seen from Celest Bar.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the ballroom look out at the lights of Madrid on every side.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and guests at Celest Bar follow the lights of the Paseo de la Castellana to the far end.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Paseo de la Castellana is nearly empty, and guests still awake in one of the 473 rooms look down on a quiet city.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights of Madrid come on below the skyline rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over San Francisco Bay, and Alcatraz Island is a small dark shape on the water.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun reaches the Golden Gate Bridge, and guests on the glass bridges that cross each floor stop to look at it.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Golden Gate Bridge stands clear from end to end, with Alcatraz Island alone in the blue bay beside it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across San Francisco Bay this morning, while Coit Tower stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Golden Gate Terrace Suite, guests watch afternoon clouds pass above the Golden Gate Bridge.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, San Francisco Bay turns the colour of metal, and the Bay Bridge crosses it in a long grey line.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers San Francisco Bay today, and guests look for the tops of the Golden Gate Bridge towers above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Golden Gate Bridge is not visible today; guests can see the Transamerica Pyramid and the nearest part of the bay.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows, and behind it the Transamerica Pyramid and San Francisco Bay are blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over San Francisco Bay, and for a second Alcatraz Island shows clearly through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the windows, and Alcatraz Island slowly disappears behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and guests stay behind the glass to study each cable of the Golden Gate Bridge.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests on the glass bridges that link each floor look across San Francisco Bay to Alcatraz Island.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, San Francisco Bay shines like glass, and guests on the bay view patio look for Alcatraz Island in the glare.
phrases.warm: It is warm on the downtown view patio, where guests stand in the open air and look across the city rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in the Golden Gate-View Corner Suite watch the low sun turn the Golden Gate Bridge a deep orange.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken clouds, and San Francisco Bay turns gold around Alcatraz Island.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Transamerica Pyramid stands close to the windows, with San Francisco Bay behind it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests watch the city lights spread into soft colours on the rainy glass above San Francisco Bay.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of the Bay Bridge make a bright chain across San Francisco Bay.
phrases.clear_night: From the glass bridge on the 48th floor, in a hotel first opened in 1986, guests follow the lights of the Golden Gate Bridge across the clear night.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who left their curtains open see San Francisco Bay as a wide black space beyond the city.
phrases.dusk: The sky over San Francisco Bay turns pink and purple after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Bay Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Santorini Caldera is a wide, still basin of dark blue water under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light fills the Santorini Caldera, and the volcanic islands in the middle show every fold of their rock.
phrases.clear_midday: Beyond the glass rail of the terrace, guests see the Santorini Caldera, bright blue under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Santorini Caldera this morning and move slowly over the water toward the volcanic islands.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the cave pool look out through its volcanic rock arch at the Santorini Caldera, where sun and cloud take turns on the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Santorini Caldera turns the colour of slate, close to the dark volcanic stone of the hotel walls.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Santorini Caldera today, and guests see the volcanic islands as if they were floating above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the Santorini Caldera is not visible today; the terrace looks out on the cliffs below and the nearer water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Santorini Caldera, and guests in the Signature Suite watch it mark the grey water from their windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests count the seconds between lightning and thunder as each flash shows the whole Santorini Caldera.
phrases.snow: Snowflakes drift past the glass-railed terrace and disappear into the Santorini Caldera far below.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air makes the Santorini Caldera look sharp today, and Skaros Rock stands clear against the cold sea.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to their suite windows, where the Santorini Caldera fills the frame with sea.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the plunge pools on their suite terraces and look over the edge at Skaros Rock and the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests lie on the terrace sun loungers and let the Santorini Caldera do all the work.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the highest point of the rim in Imerovigli, guests watch the low sun turn the Santorini Caldera gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange and pink above the Santorini Caldera, and the water below copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Santorini Caldera is a wide dark space, and the lights along its rim mark the curve.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain runs down the glass rail of the terrace, and the lights around the Santorini Caldera blur behind it.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud hides the stars on this mild night, and the Santorini Caldera lies black below a few scattered lights.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the Signature Suite turn their lights down and count the stars over the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Santorini Caldera goes quiet, with the cliffs asleep and the sea below left to itself.
phrases.dusk: The sun has gone, the sky over the Santorini Caldera is still bright, and the first lights come on along the cliffs.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Alster Lakes lie flat and grey beyond the rooftops, under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Alster Lakes first, then moves across the rooftops towards the upper floors.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, the city buildings stand sharp above the tree canopy under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Alster Lakes this morning, and the rooftops in between turn bright and dull in turn.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the park-facing rooms see Moorweidenpark half in sun and half in cloud shadow this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Alster Lakes take the same colour as the roofs in front of them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Hamburg skyline today, and the Alster Lakes are only a lighter band behind the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alster Lakes are not visible today; guests on the upper floors see the nearest rooftops and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the roofs of Hamburg, and guests in the Grande Suite watch it from behind the balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Hamburg skyline for a second at a time, and guests count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Rotherbaum rooftops, and the Alster Lakes fade into the white behind them.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests stay behind the glass and look across frosted rooftops to the Alster Lakes.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the wooden deck of the rooftop terrace is empty, and the city buildings show clearly beyond the trees.
phrases.very_hot: Guests on the rooftop terrace keep to the shade of the amber umbrellas and look out over the tree canopy in the heat.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the rooftop terrace look over the treetops at the city buildings, and nobody hurries back inside.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Rotherbaum rooftops gold, and the Alster Lakes shine behind them from the upper floors.
phrases.partly_golden: From the wrap-around balcony of the Penthouse Suite, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over the city and the park.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, city lights spread across the rooftops, and the Alster Lakes are a dark gap among them.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the city lights blur on the glass, and the rooftops towards the Alster Lakes shine with rain.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud holds the glow of Hamburg tonight, and the Alster Lakes lie dark below it.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests among the 510 rooms who look towards the Alster Lakes see city lights along the dark water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the rooftops are quiet and the Alster Lakes cannot be told apart from the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the rooftops in front of the Alster Lakes.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the CCTV Headquarters is a dark shape against a sky that slowly turns from black to deep blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the glass of the CCTV Headquarters, and the Beijing skyline behind it looks sharp and clean.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 6th-floor indoor pool, swimmers look up through the glass ceiling at a clear blue sky and the CCTV Headquarters.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the Beijing skyline this morning, and their shadows slide over the CCTV Headquarters one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the chaise lounges by the window follow the afternoon clouds as they pass behind the CCTV Headquarters.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the CCTV Headquarters takes the same colour, and its outline is still easy to read.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Beijing skyline today, and the CCTV Headquarters looks like a pencil drawing that is not finished yet.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far towers of the Beijing skyline are not visible today; guests see only the CCTV Headquarters and the nearest streets.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass ceiling above the 6th-floor indoor pool, and the city towers beyond it look blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the CCTV Headquarters, and for a second the whole Beijing skyline turns white in the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Beijing skyline, and guests watch the CCTV Headquarters turn pale behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air over Beijing is freezing and very clear, and every edge of the CCTV Headquarters stands out against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, swimmers in the heated indoor pool look out at the city towers under a pale sky.
phrases.very_hot: Heat makes the air shake above the rooftops of Chaoyang, so guests study the CCTV Headquarters from behind cool glass.
phrases.warm: Warm light fills the Beijing skyline today, and guests in this 283-room hotel look across it to the CCTV Headquarters.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the CCTV Headquarters gold, and the towers around it throw long shadows over the streets.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and guests on their chaise lounges see the CCTV Headquarters change from grey to orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit CCTV Headquarters and the city lights give the low clouds a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Beijing skyline spread into soft colours on the windows of the rooms facing the city.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the city lights of Chaoyang stretch out below the dark clouds.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests look from their floor-to-ceiling windows at the city lights around the CCTV Headquarters.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Beijing skyline is quiet, and the CCTV Headquarters stands still while the city sleeps.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the CCTV Headquarters begins to glow blue as the first city lights come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon lies still under a clear sky, with the first pale light at the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: From the hammock nets of the overwater villas, guests look straight down into the clear morning water of the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is bright turquoise all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the lagoon this morning, changing its turquoise to a deeper blue in patches.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Beyond the pool, the calm turquoise lagoon is visible under a sky of sun and cloud this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon changes from turquoise to a soft silver-green.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon and the sky look like one pale sheet.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the lagoon is not visible today; guests on the overwater villa decks see the clear shallow water close by.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon with thousands of small rings, and guests watch them from the covered decks of the overwater villas.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and for a second all the water turns white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and each flake disappears the moment it touches the water.
phrases.very_cold: In very cold, clear air, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon looks sharp and bright, with every ripple easy to see.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look at the turquoise lagoon from bed, which seems a sensible plan.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the pool and look across at the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, flat and shining.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on this 44-acre island walk along the beach beside the calm, clear Maldivian Atoll Lagoon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Seabar, guests watch the sun go down over the water while the clear sky turns gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lays orange bands across the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests at Seabar look down at reef sharks moving through the water close by.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the lagoon this evening, and the resort lights across the water become soft, blurred points.
phrases.mild_night: Under a mild, cloudy night sky, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is a soft grey surface moving slowly around the island.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear night sky over the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and the calm water gives some of them back.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the lagoon is almost black, and guests still awake can just see where the water meets the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the lagoon, and from the overwater bar terrace the first resort lights appear across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Geneva lies still under a clear sky, and the mountains beyond are a dark shape.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Le 17 Restaurant, guests look out over the Jet d'Eau under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Jet d'Eau rises white against a blue sky, directly across the water from the Bellevue Suite's private balcony.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Lake Geneva this morning, and the Jet d'Eau moves in and out of sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests taking afternoon tea in Le 17 Restaurant watch cloud shadows cross Lake Geneva.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Lake Geneva turns the same colour, and the Jet d'Eau stands out in white.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers Lake Geneva today, and the Jet d'Eau looks like a chalk mark on grey paper.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Mont Blanc is not visible today, and from the Bellevue Suite's private balcony guests see only the Jet d'Eau and the near water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lake Geneva, and guests watch it through the floor-to-ceiling glass of Le 17 Restaurant.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay behind the glass of the private wing of Le 17 Restaurant as the thunderstorm crosses Lake Geneva.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Lake Geneva, and the far shore fades to white behind the Jet d'Eau.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests stay behind the balcony doors of the Presidential Suite and look at the Jet d'Eau.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Mont Blanc shows beyond Lake Geneva, with the Jet d'Eau in front.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests envy anyone standing close to the Jet d'Eau, a tall column of cool water across the lake.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests stand on the Bellevue Suite's private balcony and look straight across the water at the Jet d'Eau.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light falls across Lake Geneva, and the Jet d'Eau turns from white to pale gold.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Alps turn pink above Lake Geneva.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Le 17 Restaurant, guests see city lights on Lake Geneva under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights blur and stretch on the dark water of Lake Geneva.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of the far shore make long reflections on Lake Geneva.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the city lights draw a bright curve around the black water of Lake Geneva.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Geneva is dark and quiet, and nobody is awake to check on the Jet d'Eau.
phrases.dusk: Guests in this 1872 hotel watch the first lights come on around Lake Geneva while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Eiffel Tower is a dark outline before sunrise, with the first pale light growing behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: Every line of the Arc de Triomphe is sharp this morning, and the garden is already in sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, guests can count the levels of the Eiffel Tower from its feet to its tip.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Arc de Triomphe this morning, and the garden goes from bright to dull and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Eiffel Tower turns grey under each passing cloud and brown again in the sun.
phrases.overcast: The Arc de Triomphe and the Eiffel Tower are both in view today, grey like the cloud above them.
phrases.fog_haze: In today's haze, guests can see the lower half of the Eiffel Tower, while the top is hidden.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the Eiffel Tower is only a faint shape and its details cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Wet and shining, the Arc de Triomphe looks newly washed as guests watch the rain from indoors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Between flash and thunder, guests count the seconds as the Arc de Triomphe stands dark under the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow falls around the Arc de Triomphe and covers the garden, and guests watch it from indoors.
phrases.very_cold: The stone of the Arc de Triomphe looks pale in the freezing air, and guests enjoy the view from indoors.
phrases.cold: Nobody is out in the garden today, and the Eiffel Tower stands clear behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests find shade in the garden and look across at the Arc de Triomphe in full sun.
phrases.warm: Jackets stay behind as guests go out for a longer look at the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Brown all day, the Eiffel Tower turns gold as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: A gap in the clouds lets the last sun through, and for a few minutes the Arc de Triomphe glows orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under this evening's cloud, the lit Arc de Triomphe is the brightest thing in view.
phrases.wet_evening: The lit Eiffel Tower is a soft gold blur in this evening's rain, and guests watch it from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Guests looking out tonight see the lit Arc de Triomphe, with the garden dark and quiet.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the lit Eiffel Tower shows every level, from the ground to the tip.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the Eiffel Tower starts to light up, and the Arc de Triomphe is still easy to see in the fading light.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Nybroviken lies still under a clear sky, and the Royal Dramatic Theatre is a quiet outline across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the restaurant, guests look over Nybroviken in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, Nybroviken, its ferries and Djurgården island stand out sharply under a blue midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Nybroviken this morning, while the Royal Dramatic Theatre on the far side stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the lobby sit by the tall arched windows and watch sun and cloud take turns over the harbour.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Nybroviken turns the colour of steel, and the white ferries stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on Nybroviken today, and the Royal Dramatic Theatre across the water is only a soft grey outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Djurgården island is not visible from the rooftop terrace today; the view ends at the ferries on Nybroviken.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Nybroviken, and guests in the lobby watch it through the arched windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Nybroviken, and guests in the Tower Suite watch lightning brighten the bay.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Nybroviken, and the Royal Dramatic Theatre fades to white behind it.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests in the sea view rooms look over Nybroviken toward the Royal Dramatic Theatre.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests keep to the lobby and look out at the harbour and the boats along the quay.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the rooftop terrace stay under the umbrellas and look down at the marina on Nybroviken.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the rooftop terrace follow the ferries across Nybroviken towards Djurgården island.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights the spires and rooftops of Stockholm, seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Nybroviken turn pink, and guests in the Sea Salon Suite look over the whole bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests at dinner in the restaurant look out at the harbour lights on Nybroviken.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights around Nybroviken blur on the lobby windows, and nobody hurries to leave the sofas.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the night sky, and the quay lights lie in long yellow lines on Nybroviken.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in this 1912 landmark look across Nybroviken at the lit Royal Dramatic Theatre.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Nybroviken is dark, and the ferries lie tied up along the quay.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Nybroviken is still bright, and the first lights come on at the Royal Dramatic Theatre.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Funchal Bay lies still and dark blue below the sea-view balconies, and the first light grows over the Atlantic.
phrases.clear_morning: From the three sundeck terraces on the cliff, the Atlantic is bright blue this morning and Funchal Bay is clear from end to end.
phrases.clear_midday: Funchal Bay shines under a clear midday sky, and the gardens of Avista on the promontory look over the sea and the bay.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Funchal Bay this morning, while the sundeck terraces on the cliff stay mostly in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Spa Suite, guests look at Funchal Bay and the sea under a sky of blue and white patches.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Funchal Bay turns silver, and the city of Funchal and its port show clearly from the bay-view balconies.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Funchal Bay today, and from the sundeck terraces the Atlantic horizon is difficult to find.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: from the hotel's viewpoints over Funchal, the near side of Funchal Bay shows, but the far side does not.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Funchal Bay, and behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of Il Gallo d'Oro the water looks grey and soft.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic, and guests on the 9th floor in the Peninsula Suite watch the storm cross Funchal Bay.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Funchal Bay, and from the Spa Suite guests watch the flakes disappear into the sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear today, and from Avista on its promontory the sea and Funchal Bay look sharp and close.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Funchal Bay is a deep blue from the hotel's viewpoints, and the city of Funchal shows clearly behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the three sundeck terraces look at the open Atlantic from under their parasols and think about jumping in.
phrases.warm: On the sundeck terraces, books stay closed in the warm air while guests look across the open Atlantic instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on Funchal Bay in the late afternoon, and guests in the Atlantic Suite watch the ocean change colour from the balcony.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds, and from the sundeck terraces the Atlantic turns gold in some places and grey in others.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening sky full of cloud, the lights of Funchal bend around Funchal Bay, seen from the hotel's viewpoints over the city.
phrases.wet_evening: At dinner in Il Gallo d'Oro, guests watch rain run down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the lights across Funchal Bay look blurred.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, low cloud glows above the city, and from the gardens of Avista the lights of Funchal are reflected in Funchal Bay.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of Funchal shine across Funchal Bay, and guests dining at Il Gallo d'Oro see them through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Funchal Bay is quiet and black below the promontory, and only the sound of the Atlantic comes up the cliff.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Funchal Bay is still bright, and from Avista the first lights of Funchal appear along the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: The yachts in Al Bateen Marina are still dark shapes on the water as the first light reaches their masts.
phrases.clear_morning: Al Bateen Marina starts the day in clear morning light, with the yachts lined up in rows on the water.
phrases.clear_midday: From The Annex rooftop, Al Bateen Marina is all white hulls and blue water at lunchtime.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests at breakfast look out at the yachts in Al Bateen Marina, some in sunshine and some under the shadow of a cloud.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Behind the yachts and the marina, the city skyline is partly in sun and partly under cloud this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: The yachts are the brightest thing in Al Bateen Marina today, white boats on grey water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Abu Dhabi Skyline today, so the nearest yachts in the marina become the whole view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Arabian Gulf cannot be seen in today's poor visibility, but the yachts in the marina are close and clear.
phrases.rain: The yachts in Al Bateen Marina are getting a good wash in the rain, and guests watch from indoors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Abu Dhabi Skyline for a second at a time, and the masts sway in the marina below.
phrases.snow: Guests stay inside and watch snow settle on the yacht decks of Al Bateen Marina.
phrases.very_cold: Guests keep their coats on and stay inside, looking out at empty yacht decks and the bright water of Al Bateen Marina.
phrases.cold: Guests stay in the warm today and look across the marina and the waterway to the city skyline.
phrases.very_hot: On the terrace, guests keep to the shade and watch the heat shimmer over Al Bateen Marina.
phrases.warm: Up on The Annex rooftop, guests are outside today, looking down on the yachts in Al Bateen Marina.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late in the afternoon, the yachts in Al Bateen Marina have golden masts and long shadows on the water.
phrases.partly_golden: Through a gap in the clouds, the last sun lights some of the yachts in Al Bateen Marina and leaves the others in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: This evening the terrace looks over Al Bateen Marina, where the lights of the yachts lie on dark water under cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain falls on Al Bateen Marina, and guests watch from indoors as the lights of the yachts blur on the water.
phrases.mild_night: The Abu Dhabi Skyline glows across the waterway tonight, with the yachts as dark outlines in front of it.
phrases.clear_night: Nobody needs to count sheep tonight, with so many yachts to count under the lights of Al Bateen Marina.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Al Bateen Marina is quiet, the yachts lying side by side on dark water.
phrases.dusk: Seen from the terrace, the first lights come on along Al Bateen Marina while the sky above the masts is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Stromboli and Panarea are two dark shapes on the Tyrrhenian Sea, seen from the room terraces.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on the Malvasia vineyard, and Stromboli and Panarea stand sharp across the Tyrrhenian Sea.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch on the restaurant terrace, guests look over a blue Tyrrhenian Sea to Stromboli and Panarea.
phrases.partly_morning: From the rooftop terrace, guests follow cloud shadows as they move across the open Tyrrhenian Sea this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pool, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift past the cone of Stromboli.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Tyrrhenian Sea turns the colour of slate, with Stromboli and Panarea darker behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Tyrrhenian Sea today, and Stromboli is only a faint triangle above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Stromboli and Panarea are not visible today; from the pool, guests see only the vineyard and the nearest strip of sea.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Malvasia vines, and from the room terraces Panarea is blurred across the grey sea.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Stromboli and Panarea for a second across the Tyrrhenian Sea, then the storm hides them again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Malvasia vineyard, and guests look from their room windows at a white sky where Stromboli usually stands.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, so guests can pick out the steep sides of Stromboli across the Tyrrhenian Sea.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the Tyrrhenian Sea is dark blue and empty, and it fills the view from the Clubhouse terrace.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the pool and look across the bright sea to Stromboli.
phrases.warm: Guests lie on the sun loungers by the pool in the warm air, with Panarea and Stromboli across the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light warms the rows of Malvasia vines, and guests with a glass in the aperitivo area look across to Stromboli and Panarea.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and colours the sea around Panarea, in front of guests on the restaurant terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner on the restaurant terrace, guests look past the small table lights to a cloudy sky over the dark Tyrrhenian Sea.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the sea this evening, and guests in the covered part of the restaurant look for Stromboli without success.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests on the 27 room terraces make out Panarea as a dark shape on the sea.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night guests on the restaurant terrace watch for the red glow of Stromboli's eruptions, a volcano that never asks for applause.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Malvasia vineyard is quiet and the Tyrrhenian Sea beyond it is a wide black space.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and Stromboli and Panarea turn dark blue above a pale Tyrrhenian Sea.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Haystack Rock is a dark shape against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light falls on Haystack Rock, and the sky above the Pacific Ocean is clear and blue.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Haystack Rock and The Needles stand sharp against the blue Pacific Ocean.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the beach this morning, while Haystack Rock stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, guests in the oceanfront rooms look across the beach to the Pacific Ocean under broken cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns the same colour, and Haystack Rock looks almost black.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the beach today, and Haystack Rock appears and disappears like a slow magic trick.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today, and guests see Haystack Rock only as a soft grey outline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the beach, and Haystack Rock looks blurred through the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second Haystack Rock stands out against the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach, and guests watch the flakes pass in front of Haystack Rock.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests stay indoors and see Haystack Rock in sharp detail above the empty beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look out at white waves breaking around The Needles.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, people on the beach walk to the water's edge, with Haystack Rock above them.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the private balconies look at people walking along the beach towards Haystack Rock.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests watch the low sun turn Haystack Rock gold, and nobody looks at a phone.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sunlight comes through the clouds and colours one side of Haystack Rock orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests can still find Haystack Rock, a little darker than the sky behind it.
phrases.wet_evening: This evening, rain hides most of the beach, and guests see only the nearest white surf.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests see white lines of surf moving towards the dark beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the Pacific Ocean, and Haystack Rock hides a few of them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the beach is dark and Haystack Rock is hardly visible from the balcony rooms.
phrases.dusk: Guests at this resort, founded in 1948, watch Haystack Rock turn dark against the bright sky after sunset.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Thames runs dark from Battersea to the South Bank, and the Eye is a still circle waiting for daylight.
phrases.clear_morning: The river is in full morning sun for guests waking up in the River View rooms.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows slide over the Eye one capsule at a time, while the Thames below stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the Natural History Museum Dinosaur Family Suite, guests watch patches of sun move along the Thames and across the Houses of Parliament.
phrases.fog_haze: From the River View Lounge, guests watch the fog sit low on the river until the far bank fades.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Thames is plain to see below today, but Battersea at the far end of the river view is not.
phrases.rain: Rain dots the Thames, and guests in the River View rooms watch the rings spread across the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Thames, and families in the Natural History Museum Dinosaur Family Suite count the seconds after each flash above the Houses of Parliament.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the Eye and disappears into the Thames, which carries on as usual.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold, guests choose the River View Lounge and watch the river from indoors.
phrases.cold: From the One Bedroom Suite with Kitchenette, guests see the day outside without needing a coat.
phrases.very_hot: The capsules of the Eye shine like glass beads above a slow, bright Thames.
phrases.warm: From Chino Latino, guests follow the Thames with their eyes as far as the Houses of Parliament.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Gold light catches the Eye first, then slides down to the Houses of Parliament and Big Ben.
phrases.partly_golden: In the River View rooms, guests watch the last sun find a gap in the clouds and turn the river copper.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night like this, guests in the Natural History Museum Dinosaur Family Suite see the Houses of Parliament lit above the River Thames.
phrases.late_night: In the River View rooms, guests still awake see the river dark and quiet below.
phrases.dusk: The first lights appear on the Eye while the Thames still holds the colour of the sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Nile is a wide dark band below the tower, and Gezira Island is a darker shape beyond it.

phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Nile turns the colour of steel, and the white wakes of the feluccas show more clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the far bank today, and Gezira Island looks like a green watercolour above the Nile.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The city beyond Gezira Island is not visible today; guests see the Nile below and the first line of trees.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Nile, and guests in the Nile-view suites watch the drops mark the whole surface of the river.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the city, and for a second the Nile and Gezira Island stand out clearly below the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Nile, and guests stand at the glass of the indoor pool to watch it land on the river.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold air, the Nile looks sharp and blue, and every tree on Gezira Island stands out.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look at the Nile from the warm indoor pool, where the river fills the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool and look down at the feluccas moving slowly on the Nile.
phrases.warm: On the Water Garden terrace, guests sit in the warm air and count the feluccas on the Nile; nobody agrees on the number.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Nile gold, and the feluccas cross it as small dark sails in front of Gezira Island.
phrases.partly_golden: From the outdoor pool, the last sun colours the clouds over Gezira Island and the Nile below them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the Nile catches the city lights differently on each bank.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights along both banks tonight, and the Nile carries them as long, soft lines of colour.
phrases.mild_night: From the rooftop suite of this 39-story tower, guests look down on the Nile and the lights of both banks under a cloudy night sky.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Nile is calm and empty of sails, and guests who cannot sleep have the whole river to themselves.
