phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Marina Mall this afternoon, while the Corniche stays in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Gulf turns the colour of steel, and the Corniche draws a clean edge between water and city.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens downtown Abu Dhabi today, and the towers along the Corniche look like a faded photograph.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Sandy air hides Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque today, so guests look closer in, to the Corniche and the beach just below.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and behind it the Corniche and the Gulf share one soft grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Gulf, and from the Abu Dhabi Suite, on the bridge between the two towers, guests see the storm on every side.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Corniche, and guests at Azura Panoramic Lounge look twice at the white flakes drifting over the Gulf.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, and guests can pick out Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque far beyond the Corniche.
phrases.cold: On this cold day guests stay behind the glass at Remède Spa, with the Corniche and the Gulf wide in front of them.
phrases.very_hot: In the fierce heat, guests at the Nation Riviera Beach Club stay under the parasols and look at the turquoise Gulf from the shade.
phrases.warm: By the pool, guests at Azura Panoramic Lounge look up from their drinks to the Corniche and the marina below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Azura Panoramic Lounge the sun goes down over the Abu Dhabi skyline, and the glass towers turn gold one by one.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and colours the Gulf orange, a show that guests in west-facing suites watch from the bathtub.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Corniche draw a long bright curve, seen from Azura Panoramic Lounge at the top of the hotel.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening lights of downtown Abu Dhabi, and the wet Corniche shines below guests in this 283-room hotel.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the city lights reach the horizon, where guests look for the glow of Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and guests in the 2012 Nation Towers see downtown Abu Dhabi lit to the far end of the Corniche.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Corniche is empty and the Gulf is still, and only sleepless guests are looking.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright over the Gulf, and the first lights come on along the Corniche.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is still and grey-blue, and Diamond Head slowly appears against the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Waikiki Beach, and from the 8th-floor infinity pool the Pacific Ocean is a clear blue.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests on the balconies of the 19th to 23rd floors can follow every ridge of Diamond Head.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Pacific Ocean this morning, while Waikiki Beach stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Grand Ocean Suite, guests watch white clouds pass over Waikiki Beach and the ocean beyond.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and Diamond Head still stands clear above the shoreline.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Diamond Head today, and the line between the Pacific Ocean and the sky disappears.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: Diamond Head is not visible, and only the near part of Waikiki Beach shows clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Waikiki Beach, and guests watch it cross the Pacific Ocean from their ocean-view balconies.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second guests see Diamond Head clearly through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Waikiki Beach, and guests in the ocean-view rooms take photos because nobody at home will believe them.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and Diamond Head looks close enough to touch above the empty shoreline.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the 8th-floor infinity pool is quiet, and the Pacific Ocean beyond its edge is a deep blue.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look out over the Pacific Ocean without moving much.
phrases.warm: At Poolside, guests take a cold drink and look past the infinity pool to the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Pacific Ocean gold, and the edge of the 8th-floor infinity pool seems to join it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange and violet over the Pacific Ocean, and Waikiki Beach glows below them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Waikiki shine below, and no stars show over the Pacific Ocean beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of Waikiki this evening, and the Pacific Ocean beyond Waikiki Beach is lost in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of Waikiki glow under the clouds, and Diamond Head is a dark shape beside the ocean.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show over the Pacific Ocean tonight, and guests in this 284-room hotel look out at the lights along Waikiki Beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pacific Ocean is black and quiet, and only the white line of the surf marks Waikiki Beach.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky over the Pacific Ocean is still bright, and the first lights come on along Waikiki Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Atlantic Ocean is a wide grey-blue surface under a clear sky, and the horizon is already sharp.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests open their balcony doors to a clear morning, and the Atlantic Ocean lies blue beyond the coastal road and the tree line.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Atlantic Ocean is a bright, even blue, and the sky above it has no cloud at all.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Atlantic Ocean this morning, and patches of water change from dark blue to silver.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the restaurant, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the Atlantic Ocean turns the colour of slate, and the horizon is a thin line between two greys.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the Atlantic Ocean today, so the water fades into the sky with no horizon to find.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far horizon is not visible today; guests see the coastal road, the tree line and only the nearest stretch of the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.rain: Rain sweeps in from the Atlantic Ocean, and guests watch the showers cross the water toward the coastal road.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the Atlantic Ocean, and guests stay behind their balcony doors to watch lightning flash over the dark water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the coastal road and the tree line, and beyond them the Atlantic Ocean is a grey blur.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the Atlantic Ocean is a deep blue today, all the way to the horizon.
phrases.cold: On this cold day guests in this 2017 hotel keep to the restaurant, where the Atlantic Ocean fills the windows and the wind stays outside.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat guests stay in the pool and look over the tree line to the Atlantic Ocean, which looks cooler than everything else.
phrases.warm: Guests on the poolside loungers face a calm Atlantic Ocean on this warm day, and nobody seems in a hurry to move.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light spreads across the Atlantic Ocean late this afternoon, and every one of the 101 balconies has the same gold water in front of it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Atlantic Ocean turn pink and orange, and the water copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: The cloudy evening leaves the Atlantic Ocean without stars, and from the rooftop bar only the lamps of the coastal road show where the land ends.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and guests in the restaurant see the Atlantic Ocean only as a darker space beyond the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night guests on their balconies look out at the Atlantic Ocean as one wide black space.
phrases.clear_night: From the rooftop bar on a clear night, stars are out above the Atlantic Ocean and the horizon is still a faint line.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Atlantic Ocean is quiet and dark, and the coastal road below is empty.
phrases.dusk: From the rooftop bar, the Atlantic Ocean keeps a band of light on the horizon just after sunset, while the sky above is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean is a dark shape beyond the beach, and the sky above it is clear and still.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Azure Oceanfront Dining, guests look over the pool deck to a bright Atlantic Ocean under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic Ocean is turquoise under the clear midday sky, and the golden sand of Daytona Beach Shores is bright beside it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic Ocean this morning, while the pool deck stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the oceanfront balconies, guests watch clouds drift over the Atlantic Ocean, the water changing from blue to grey and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Intracoastal Waterway takes the same colour, calm and wide below the waterway balconies.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Atlantic Ocean today, and the line between water and sky is difficult to find.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far horizon of the Atlantic Ocean is not visible today, but the beach and the first lines of surf are clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pool deck and the beach; guests in Azure Oceanfront Dining watch it blur the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests watch the storm from inside, behind the glass doors of the oceanfront rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sand of Daytona Beach Shores, and the palm trees by the pool turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and the sky is bright, so the Atlantic Ocean looks sharp and deep blue from Azure Oceanfront Dining.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the beach is quiet, and the Atlantic Ocean rolls in grey-blue beyond the empty pool deck.
phrases.very_hot: At Tiki Hut Barefoot Beach Bar, guests hold frozen drinks and look past the pool to the sand and surf in the heat.
phrases.warm: By the pool, guests in the shaded cabanas look past the palm trees to the Atlantic Ocean on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Oceanview Lounge, guests watch the surf turn gold in the late light under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Intracoastal Waterway, and the sunset view balconies have the front seats.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Atlantic Ocean turns dark, and guests in Oceanview Lounge can still pick out the beach in front of it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the dark beach tonight, and dinner guests in Azure Oceanfront Dining watch the wet pool deck shine.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the surf of the Atlantic Ocean shows as a pale line along the beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars hang over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and the beachfront fire pits glow at the edge of the sand.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic Ocean is black beyond the sand, and the palm trees on the pool deck are the only things moving.
phrases.dusk: At dusk the beachfront fire pits are lit, and the Atlantic Ocean turns soft blue under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlas Mountains are a dark shape beyond the golf course, and the palms in the gardens are only outlines.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights one side of the Atlas Mountains, and guests on their room terraces watch the colour turn from pink to gold.
phrases.clear_midday: From the pool terraces, the Atlas Mountains stand clear above the palms and olive trees under a blue midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the golf course this morning, while the Atlas Mountains come in and out of the sun behind it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at Le Sarba look across the terrace to the Atlas Mountains, where afternoon clouds sit on the highest peaks.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlas Mountains turn a darker grey, and the palms on the golf course keep their green.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Atlas Mountains today, and from the pool terraces the palms and olive trees look sharper than the peaks.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Atlas Mountains are not visible today; from the pool terraces, guests see the gardens, the palms and the first fairways.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pools and the olive trees, and guests in the lobby watch the palm-lined gardens through the tall windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm sits over the Atlas Mountains, and guests watch the lightning above the golf course from behind the lobby windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palms and olive trees, and the Atlas Mountains have disappeared behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the snow-capped Atlas Mountains look close behind the pool terraces and gardens.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the gym stay warm on the running machines and look out over the pool.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests stay in the pools and look over the water to the palms and the Atlas Mountains.
phrases.warm: By the pools, guests lie in the warm air with the Atlas Mountains in front of them above the palms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Atlas Mountains gold, and long palm shadows stretch across the fairways of the 18-hole golf course.
phrases.partly_golden: From balcony rooms, guests see the last sun colour the clouds orange over the golf course and the Atlas Mountains.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening sky is cloudy, and from the Le Sarba terrace the Atlas Mountains are no longer visible beyond the palms.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening the Atlas Mountains are lost in the dark, and guests see only rain falling on the nearest palms.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests on their room terraces can just see the palms against the sky, and the mountains not at all.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the pool terraces and the gardens, and the clear night sky ends where the Atlas Mountains begin.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the gardens and the golf course are dark and quiet, and the Atlas Mountains are hidden until morning.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the Atlas Mountains become silhouettes beyond the Le Sarba terrace, where the lanterns are starting to glow.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, N Seoul Tower is a thin dark shape on Namsan Mountain under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: In clear morning light, N Seoul Tower stands sharp above Myeongdong's dense skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: From selected upper floors, guests see N Seoul Tower against a blue midday sky, with Seoul's high-rises below it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past N Seoul Tower this morning, and their shadows move slowly across Seoul's high-rises.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow patches of sun across the Myeongdong skyline this afternoon, while N Seoul Tower goes in and out of cloud shadow.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Seoul's high-rises take the same colour, and N Seoul Tower stands as a thin line above them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Myeongdong skyline today, and guests look for N Seoul Tower as a faint pencil mark above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see the nearest high-rises of Myeongdong clearly but not N Seoul Tower.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the large windows, and guests watch Seoul's high-rises blur behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Myeongdong skyline for a second, and guests wait for the next flash to find N Seoul Tower.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Myeongdong, and N Seoul Tower fades behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the air is clear, and N Seoul Tower looks close enough to touch above the high-rises of Myeongdong.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 1,120-room hotel look across Seoul's high-rises to N Seoul Tower.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Myeongdong skyline, and N Seoul Tower seems to tremble a little above it.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests look across the high-rises to Namsan Mountain, where N Seoul Tower rises from the top.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of Seoul's high-rises gold, and N Seoul Tower catches the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds behind N Seoul Tower change from white to orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Myeongdong glow below, and guests find N Seoul Tower lit above them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights of Myeongdong spread into soft colours on the large windows.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the cloud holds the glow of Seoul's high-rises, and N Seoul Tower shines through it.
phrases.clear_night: From selected upper floors, guests count the lit windows of Seoul's high-rises, and N Seoul Tower always wins their attention.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Myeongdong skyline is quiet, and guests who cannot sleep have the high-rises to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset as the first lights come on across Myeongdong, with N Seoul Tower joining them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Napa Valley Vineyards lie grey and quiet, and the Mayacamas ridge is a dark line against the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Napa Valley Vineyards row by row, right below the balcony suites and their outdoor soaking tubs.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every row of the Napa Valley Vineyards is easy to count from the pool deck.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Napa Valley Vineyards this morning, while the Mayacamas ridge stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Acacia Lawn, guests look past the pool's glass panels to the Napa Valley Vineyards, where sun and shade take turns this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Napa Valley Vineyards keep their neat rows, and the Mayacamas ridge sits low and grey behind them.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies over the Napa Valley Vineyards, and from the pool only the nearest vine rows show clearly.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Mayacamas ridge is not visible today; from the pool, the view ends at the Napa Valley Vineyards next door.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Napa Valley Vineyards, and guests watch through floor-to-ceiling windows as the vine rows turn darker.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls along the Mayacamas ridge, and lightning shows the Napa Valley Vineyards for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Napa Valley Vineyards, and each vine row beyond the pool's glass panels slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: Guests keep to the warm side of the glass on this freezing day and look out at the Napa Valley Vineyards under a bright sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Napa Valley Vineyards run in still, tidy rows to the foot of the Mayacamas ridge.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the pool and look across the water at the Napa Valley Vineyards.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests in the balcony suites sit in their outdoor soaking tubs above the Napa Valley Vineyards, and nobody hurries to get out.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Napa Valley Vineyards gold, and the Mayacamas ridge behind them takes a warm colour too.
phrases.partly_golden: On the Acacia Lawn, guests watch the sun go down over the Napa Valley Vineyards as the clouds turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit pool is the brightest thing in sight, and the Napa Valley Vineyards rest quietly beyond its glass panels.
phrases.wet_evening: At dinner in Violetto Restaurant, guests in the 1907 farmhouse watch the rain fall where the Napa Valley Vineyards lie in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Napa Valley Vineyards are a dark shape, with the Mayacamas ridge barely visible above them.
phrases.clear_night: Stars come out above the Mayacamas ridge tonight, and guests can still make out the nearest rows of the Napa Valley Vineyards.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Napa Valley Vineyards are silent and unlit; only the grapes are still working.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Mayacamas ridge, and the Napa Valley Vineyards slowly lose their colour as the pool lights come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the first grey light shows the Andaman Sea beyond the lawn, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light crosses the uncluttered lawn, and the Andaman Sea shows blue from the main pool.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Andaman Sea turns turquoise beside the white sand of Mai Khao Beach, under a sky without a cloud.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move over the lawn this morning, while the Andaman Sea behind the trees stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace of a beachfront villa, guests see the Andaman Sea through the pines, with sun and cloud taking turns on the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Andaman Sea takes a quieter colour, and the lawn in front of it looks greener.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so from the main pool the Andaman Sea seems to fade into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today and the far horizon of the Andaman Sea is not visible; guests see the lawn, the trees and the near water.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the lawn and on the Andaman Sea beyond it, and guests in the ocean-view pool villas watch the two greys meet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning breaks over the Andaman Sea, and guests count the seconds before the thunder reaches the lawn.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Mai Khao Beach, and guests look twice as white flakes meet white sand at the edge of the Andaman Sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is bitterly cold and very clear, and the Andaman Sea shows a sharp blue line behind the pines.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the lawn is empty, which leaves nothing between the main pool and the Andaman Sea.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the main pool up to their shoulders and look across the lawn at the Andaman Sea.
phrases.warm: Guests practise yoga on the lawn in the warm air, with the turquoise Andaman Sea visible behind the shading trees.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late golden light falls across the lawn, and the Andaman Sea shines behind the long shadows of the trees.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Andaman Sea turn orange, and guests on beachfront villa terraces watch through the pines.
phrases.grey_evening: Evening cloud covers the stars, and the Andaman Sea is only a faint grey beyond the dark lawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and from the pool villas guests see the tropical garden shine wet while the sea is lost in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the pale sand of Mai Khao Beach marks where the lawn ends and the Andaman Sea begins.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over Mai Khao Beach, and the Andaman Sea lies wide and dark beneath them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, only the pines along Mai Khao Beach stand out against the Andaman Sea.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky stays bright over the Andaman Sea, and the first lights come on around the main pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Nile River lies wide and quiet below the Corniche, and Gezira Island slowly takes form across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From the teak terraces of the Corniche Suites, the Nile River runs directly below in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests in the fitness center follow the feluccas across the Nile River, their sails bright under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows drift across Gezira Island this morning, while the Cairo Tower stands in a patch of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the spa treatment room look out at the Nile River and the Cairo Tower as clouds pass over them this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Nile River turns grey too, and the Cairo skyline stands flat and even behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Cairo skyline today, and Gezira Island seems to float on the Nile River.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Pyramids of Giza are not visible today; guests see the Nile River and Gezira Island clearly, and the Cairo skyline only faintly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Nile River, and guests watch from indoors as Gezira Island turns grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Cairo skyline for a second, then the storm closes over the Nile River again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Nile River, and guests forget their plans for a while to watch Gezira Island turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The cold air is very clear today, and the Cairo Tower stands sharp above Gezira Island.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the arched windows of the restaurant and watch the Nile River and the Cairo skyline from there.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the teak terraces study the feluccas for any sign of a breeze on the Nile River.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the private balconies look across the Nile River to Gezira Island and the Cairo Tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Presidential Suites on floors 25 to 28, the Pyramids of Giza appear on the western horizon as the light drops.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, light slips between the clouds and colours the Cairo Tower and the sails on the Nile River.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening clouds over the Cairo skyline take a soft glow from the city lights, and the Nile River carries a little of it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Gezira Island blur in the rain and stretch in long lines across the Nile River.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the Cairo skyline is a row of lights behind the Nile River, under a sky with no stars.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests can follow the Nile River by the lights along both banks, far past Gezira Island.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Nile River keeps moving below the Corniche while Gezira Island sleeps.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky is still bright over Gezira Island, and the first lights appear along the Nile River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Positano Hillside is a quiet shape above the sea, and the sky behind it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast at Maestro, guests look over the bright sea to the Positano Hillside under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Li Galli islands sit sharp on the blue sea at midday, easy to pick out from the private terraces.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Positano Hillside this morning, and the sea below stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the gym, guests look up from their exercise to see sun and cloud take turns over the sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the sea turns the colour of slate, and the houses of the Positano Hillside keep their soft colours.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Li Galli islands today, and the Positano Hillside looks like a faded painting across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Li Galli islands are not visible today; guests can still see the Positano Hillside, but its houses are less clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the sea, and guests watch it from their balcony doors with the Positano Hillside slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the sea, and for a second the whole Positano Hillside shows white through the rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the sea, and the Positano Hillside slowly turns white behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, so guests in the lounge can make out each house on the Positano Hillside.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the sea is dark blue and empty, and the Positano Hillside stands out clearly beyond it.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in their plunge pools and look at the sea and the Positano Hillside from the water.
phrases.warm: On the loungers of the cliffside terrace, books stay closed while guests watch boats cross the sea towards Positano.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light warms the houses of the Positano Hillside, and guests in Franco Zeffirelli's former home get a fine stage set.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and turns the sea gold, with the Li Galli islands dark against it.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner at Maestro, guests face the sea and the lights of the Positano Hillside under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the sea this evening, and the lights of the Positano Hillside shine softly through it.
phrases.mild_night: From the terraces on this mild night, the Positano Hillside glows with lights under a sky of cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the sea, and the lights of the Positano Hillside seem to copy them lower down.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the sea is black and still, and the Positano Hillside sleeps across the water.
phrases.dusk: From Maestro, guests watch the first lights come on across the Positano Hillside while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Ko'olau range is a dark outline to the northeast under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun brings out the green of the Ko'olau range, and the Pacific lies blue and clear to the south.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Pacific is bright blue all the way to the horizon, without a cloud above it.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the upper-floor rooms watch cloud shadows move slowly across the Ko'olau range this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds sit on the ridges of the Ko'olau range this afternoon, while the Pacific to the south stays in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pacific turns the colour of steel, with the horizon still a clean line to the south.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Ko'olau range today, and guests see its ridges as light grey steps, one behind the other.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Ko'olau range is not visible today, and the Pacific fades into pale air before guests can find the horizon.
phrases.rain: Rain is crossing the Ko'olau range, and guests at the floor-to-ceiling windows watch the ridges disappear one by one.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Ko'olau range for a second at a time, and then the storm hides the mountains again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Pacific, and guests look twice before they believe it.
phrases.very_cold: In very cold, clear air, guests can count each ridge of the Ko'olau range to the northeast.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Pacific looks a darker blue, and the wind draws white lines across it.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat the Pacific shines like metal to the south, and guests look at all that cool water with longing.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests look from the blue Pacific in the south to the green Ko'olau range in the northeast and cannot choose.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Pacific gold, and the slopes of the Ko'olau range glow a warm green.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests in the upper-floor rooms see the last sun come through the clouds and light the Pacific in long bright strips.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Honolulu spread out below, and the Pacific is a wide dark space beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain blurs the lights of Honolulu into soft colours, and the Ko'olau range has disappeared behind it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night clouds hide the stars, and guests follow the lights of Honolulu towards the foot of the Ko'olau range.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Pacific tonight, and guests can just find where the black water meets the sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pacific is quiet and black to the south, and the Ko'olau range rests somewhere in the dark.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky over the Pacific is still bright, and the first lights of Honolulu come on below this 39-story tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky slowly pales above Lyon Cathedral, and the first roof shapes of Old Lyon appear below Fourvière Hill.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, guests in the Medici Suite see the façade of Lyon Cathedral and the Presqu'île spread out beyond it.
phrases.clear_midday: Under the glass roof of La Table de la Villa Florentine, the midday sky is clear and Lyon Cathedral stands sharp above the Old Lyon rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Old Lyon rooftops this morning, and Lyon Cathedral steps in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace rooms, guests follow patches of afternoon sun as they cross the city of Lyon from one roof to the next.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the terracotta rooftops of Old Lyon keep their warm colour, and Lyon Cathedral rises pale among them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over Lyon today, and from the panoramic pool Lyon Cathedral looks soft-edged above the nearest rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Presqu'île is not visible from the hill today; the view stops at Lyon Cathedral and the first rows of Old Lyon rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass roof of La Table de la Villa Florentine, and the Old Lyon rooftops shine wet below it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Fourvière Hill, and guests in this 17th-century former convent watch lightning flash above Lyon Cathedral.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Old Lyon, and the rooftops below the hill turn white one by one.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing, clear air, every roof of Old Lyon is sharp from the heated panoramic pool, and Lyon Cathedral looks close enough to touch.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the suites use the telescope to study Lyon Cathedral from the warm side of the window.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the panoramic pool and look at the Old Lyon rooftops from the water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests take their cocktails to the terrace of Segreto and look out over the panorama of Lyon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late golden sun deepens the colour of the Old Lyon rooftops, and the lounge chairs on the rooftop terrace all point the right way.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights Lyon Cathedral for a moment, as guests watch from the Medici Suite.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in La Table de la Villa Florentine, guests look down through the glass at Lyon Cathedral, lit under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights below Fourvière Hill blur into soft gold spots in the rain.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lit stone of Lyon Cathedral glows among the darker roofs of Old Lyon.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the glass roof frames the lit Lyon Cathedral and the lights of the Presqu'île beyond it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Old Lyon is quiet below the hill, its roofs close together in the dark around Lyon Cathedral.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on among the Old Lyon rooftops below the glass roof.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Alcatraz Island is a dark shape on the still water of San Francisco Bay.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the bay view rooms wake to a clear morning, with every cable of the Golden Gate Bridge sharp against a blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: San Francisco Bay is bright blue at midday, and Alcatraz Island stands clear across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Golden Gate Bridge this morning, while San Francisco Bay below stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Alcatraz Suite, guests watch cloud shadows slide over Alcatraz Island this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, San Francisco Bay turns the colour of steel, and the Golden Gate Bridge stays clear from end to end.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on San Francisco Bay today, and the Golden Gate Bridge comes and goes inside it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: Alcatraz Island shows as a faint outline, and the Golden Gate Bridge is not visible at all.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on San Francisco Bay; guests in this 1907 warehouse watch it from the large windows, with Alcatraz Island grey in the distance.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over San Francisco Bay, and for a second guests see the Golden Gate Bridge clearly through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over San Francisco Bay, and guests stop to watch the flakes drift past Alcatraz Island.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so Alcatraz Island looks close enough to touch across the bay.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Golden Gate Bridge stands sharp over the grey-blue bay, and Alcatraz Island looks even less welcoming than usual.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, San Francisco Bay glitters in the sun, and guests on the waterfront look across it to the Golden Gate Bridge.
phrases.warm: It is a warm day, and guests open their windows to the sea breeze, with Alcatraz Island across the bright water of San Francisco Bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Golden Gate Bridge gold, and the same light spreads across San Francisco Bay.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and colours them orange above the Golden Gate Bridge.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Golden Gate Bridge draw a thin line across the bay.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the lights of the Golden Gate Bridge shine softly through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and Alcatraz Island sits low between the lights around San Francisco Bay.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests can follow the lights of the Golden Gate Bridge from one side of the bay to the other.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, San Francisco Bay is quiet and almost black, and guests who are still awake can just make out Alcatraz Island.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on along the Golden Gate Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Below the dark Indian Ocean cliffs, the sandy beach cove is a pale curve waiting for first light.
phrases.clear_morning: From the infinity pool, every fold of the Indian Ocean cliffs shows clearly in the fresh morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests at Sundays Beach Club look out on a sandy beach cove with barely a shadow on it.
phrases.partly_morning: The Indian Ocean cliffs go from grey to gold and back as clouds pass over the Bukit Peninsula.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the beach club watch patches of shade drift over the sandy beach cove and out to sea.
phrases.overcast: Under grey cloud the sandy beach cove keeps its pale colour, while the Indian Ocean cliffs turn dark.
phrases.fog_haze: Seen from the infinity pool, the Indian Ocean cliffs fade into the haze one headland at a time.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the far Indian Ocean cliffs are lost in the thick air; only the sandy beach cove below shows clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain has emptied the sandy beach cove, and the Indian Ocean cliffs stand wet and dark above it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests count the seconds between flash and thunder as the storm moves along the Indian Ocean cliffs.
phrases.snow: Snow is turning the sandy beach cove white, and the Indian Ocean cliffs are grey shapes behind the falling flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the Indian Ocean cliffs stand sharp and clear above the open water.
phrases.cold: There are no footprints on the sandy beach cove today, only waves coming in from the Indian Ocean.
phrases.very_hot: Guests stay up to their shoulders in the infinity pool and study the Indian Ocean cliffs from the water.
phrases.warm: Guests at Sundays Beach Club walk barefoot down to the sandy beach cove and into the sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Orange light climbs the Indian Ocean cliffs as the sandy beach cove below slowly falls into shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: At the beach club, guests watch the Indian Ocean cliffs glow whenever the sinking sun finds a gap in the clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: After dark the Indian Ocean cliffs are only a black line, and guests at the beach club listen to the waves instead.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight's rain hides the sandy beach cove in the dark, and guests know it only by the sound of the surf.
phrases.mild_night: With no stars to look at, the white line of surf in the sandy beach cove gets all the attention.
phrases.clear_night: Stars hang over the Bukit Peninsula, and the Indian Ocean cliffs show as a darker shape against them.
phrases.late_night: At this hour the sandy beach cove is empty, and only the white edges of the waves move in the dark.
phrases.dusk: The first lights come on at Sundays Beach Club while the sandy beach cove still holds the glow of the evening.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Great Pyramid is a dark shape above the palm trees, and the sky around it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At first light, the Great Pyramid fills the windows of the pyramid view rooms, its shadow still crossing the plateau.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, both pyramids stand sharp above the heated outdoor pool, with every edge clean against the blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Great Pyramid this morning, framed by the arched railings of the breakfast balcony.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the plateau this afternoon, and from the gardens the two pyramids pass in and out of the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Great Pyramid loses its shadows, and its stones take the colour of the plateau around them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the plateau today, and from 139 Pavilion the two pyramids look like soft triangles drawn in pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today: the Great Pyramid is still clear from the pool, but the second pyramid is hardly visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the palm-lined lawns, and guests watch the Great Pyramid turn a darker brown through the restaurant's arched window.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the plateau, and each flash of lightning shows the Great Pyramid for a second from the suite windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees in the gardens, and guests stop at the windows to see white flakes drift in front of the Great Pyramid.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and from behind the glass guests can almost count the stones of the Great Pyramid.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the gardens are quiet, and the Great Pyramid stands alone above the palm-lined lawns.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the pool up to their shoulders and look at the Great Pyramid from the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the terrace look across the pool and the 40 acres of garden to both pyramids beyond the palm trees.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Great Pyramid gold, and guests at 139 Pavilion have both pyramids in one frame.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds turn pink above the plateau, and the Great Pyramid glows orange over the gardens.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low evening cloud, the illuminated Great Pyramid stands out beyond the lit garden paths.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the arched windows this evening, and the lights on the Great Pyramid look blurred behind the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests at 139 Pavilion look across the dark gardens to the lit Great Pyramid.
phrases.clear_night: Stars come out over the plateau tonight, and from the balcony rooms of this 331-room resort the Great Pyramid points straight at them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the plateau is quiet, and the Great Pyramid is only a darker triangle against the night sky.
phrases.dusk: At dusk, guests at 139 Pavilion look at both pyramids against a sky that is still bright, as the first garden lights come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Funchal Bay lies still and grey-blue under a clear sky, with the first light growing behind the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool, the open Atlantic is bright blue this morning, and the Desertas islands show clearly on the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: The midday sun stands high over Funchal Bay, and the water shines with small points of light.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Funchal Bay this morning, turning the water from blue to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Sky Bar, guests see the Desertas islands appear and disappear as clouds drift along the horizon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Funchal Bay takes the colour of metal, and the horizon is difficult to find.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the Atlantic today, and from the rooftop pool the Desertas islands are only a guess.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Desertas islands are not visible today; from Sky Bar, guests see the ocean fade into pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Funchal Bay, and guests in the Bay Suite watch the city grow soft behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the open Atlantic, and guests count the seconds until thunder rolls across Funchal Bay.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Funchal Bay, and guests stand at the windows to watch it meet the sea.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Funchal Bay looks sharp and clean, and every hillside house in the city is easy to see.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Atlantic is dark blue and restless, and white lines of foam cross Funchal Bay.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look over its edge at Funchal's coastline.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, guests lie in the warm air, their books closed, looking at the open ocean instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the hillside houses of Funchal gold, and guests watch from the sea-view rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lays long strips of orange light across Funchal Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights curve around Funchal Bay, and the sky above them glows faintly.
phrases.wet_evening: From Galáxia, guests see the city lights of Funchal blur and run on the wet glass this evening.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of Funchal's hillside climb from the bay until the cloud hides them.
phrases.clear_night: Guests at Galáxia find stars on both sides of the glass tonight, with the city lights of Funchal shining below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Funchal Bay is quiet and black, and only the sound of the Atlantic rises to the balconies.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Atlantic, and the first lights come on along Funchal Bay, in front of this hotel opened in 2019.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gulf of Thailand lies still and grey below the hillside villa decks, and the horizon is only starting to show.
phrases.clear_morning: At AHA Restaurant, guests have breakfast with the Gulf of Thailand bright blue under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the far edge of the horizon lap pool meets the Gulf of Thailand, and both are the same clear blue.
phrases.partly_morning: From the oceanfront boardwalk, cloud shadows move slowly across the Gulf of Thailand this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun and shade drift over the Gulf of Thailand this afternoon, in full sight of the beachfront sundeck.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the Gulf of Thailand is a calm grey sheet beyond the oceanfront boardwalk.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so from the oceanfront pool villas the plunge pool seems to run into the Gulf of Thailand and then straight into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is missing today, and from Sunset Bar guests see only the nearer water of the Gulf of Thailand before it fades into pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass walls of the villas, and guests watch the Gulf of Thailand turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Gulf of Thailand in front of AHA Restaurant, and thunder rolls across the island.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Gulf of Thailand, and from the horizon lap pool each flake disappears the moment it touches the water.
phrases.very_cold: In very cold, clear air, the Gulf of Thailand looks sharp from Tree at the island's southern end, every small wave easy to see.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Gulf of Thailand moves in small grey-blue waves in front of the empty loungers on the beachfront sundeck.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the horizon lap pool up to their shoulders and look out over the Gulf of Thailand.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the beach loungers look out to sea while kayaks cross the Gulf of Thailand in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Sunset Bar, guests on both levels turn toward the westerly Gulf of Thailand as the sun drops low and the water turns gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and on the 40 villa decks each plunge pool turns the same orange as the Gulf of Thailand.
phrases.grey_evening: At Tree, guests eat a Khmer dinner under a cloudy evening sky, with the Gulf of Thailand dark and quiet just past the tables.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Gulf of Thailand this evening, and from AHA Restaurant guests see only the nearest water, marked by the drops.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Gulf of Thailand is a soft dark surface beyond the oceanfront boardwalk, with no line between sea and sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above this 12-hectare island, and from the horizon lap pool the Gulf of Thailand is black and still.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Gulf of Thailand is a wide darkness around the oceanfront boardwalk, heard more than seen.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over the westerly Gulf of Thailand, and Sunset Bar keeps its name for a few minutes longer.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Melbourne Skyline stands as plain dark towers against a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Melbourne Skyline first, and the Yarra River below slowly brightens.
phrases.clear_midday: The Melbourne Skyline is sharp under a clear midday sky, and the spire of St Paul's Cathedral is easy to find among the towers.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Melbourne Skyline this morning, while the Yarra River stays bright between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony rooms, guests follow patches of afternoon sun as they cross Southbank and the Yarra River.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Yarra River takes the same colour and the Melbourne Skyline loses its reflections.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Melbourne Skyline today, and the towers behind the Yarra River look like paper cut-outs.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far towers of the Melbourne Skyline are not visible today; the Yarra River and the nearest buildings still show clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Yarra River, and the Melbourne Skyline is blurred behind the wet glass of the river-view suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Melbourne Skyline, and for a second each tower stands out above the Yarra River.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Yarra River, and the Melbourne Skyline fades to white behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so every edge of the Melbourne Skyline looks cut with a knife.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass and look across the Yarra River to the Melbourne Skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Melbourne Skyline shimmers in the distance, seen from the outdoor terrace at Jarrah Restaurant & Bar.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests step out on their private balconies and watch the sunlight move on the Yarra River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun turns the glass of the Melbourne Skyline to orange, seen from the outdoor terrace of Jarrah Restaurant & Bar.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights only a few towers of the Melbourne Skyline at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: At Jarrah Restaurant & Bar, guests have an evening drink on the outdoor terrace while low cloud glows above the lit Melbourne Skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: Wet weather sends terrace guests indoors at Jarrah Restaurant & Bar, where the lights of the Melbourne Skyline run down the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, cloud hides the stars, so the lit Melbourne Skyline does their job above the Yarra River.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of the Melbourne Skyline lie in long stripes on the Yarra River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Yarra River is black and still, and the Melbourne Skyline is quiet behind it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Melbourne Skyline and the Yarra River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Vieux-Port is still, and the boat masts stand as thin lines against a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: In the breakfast room, guests at the window tables eat Provençal produce and look out at the Vieux-Port in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: From the terrace, the Vieux-Port lies directly below under a clear midday sky, each boat sharp against the blue water.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Vieux-Port this morning, and the boats go from bright to dull as they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the upper-floor balcony suites, guests look straight down at the Vieux-Port as sun and cloud take turns over the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the water of the Vieux-Port turns the colour of slate, and the white boats stand out more clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the far side of the Vieux-Port today, and from the terrace the nearest boats are the clearest things in sight.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Vieux-Port is not visible today, so guests on the terrace look at the boats moored just below.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Vieux-Port, and guests in the breakfast room watch it mark the water between the boats.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Vieux-Port, and guests stay behind the windows as lightning shows the boats for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Vieux-Port, and the boat decks below the windows slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in this hotel of 73 rooms stay behind the glass on this freezing day, with the Vieux-Port bright and clear below.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Vieux-Port is quiet, and guests look at the rows of boats from the port-side windows of the breakfast room.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat the Vieux-Port shines like metal, and guests on the terrace keep to the shade as they look at it.
phrases.warm: On a warm day guests sit out on the terrace and look down at the busy Vieux-Port below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Vieux-Port gold, and guests on the upper-floor balconies see every boat lit from the side.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Vieux-Port turn pink and orange, and the water below copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: At Le Beauvau bar on the terrace, guests spend the evening above the Vieux-Port, where the quay lights shine under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The wet quays of the Vieux-Port reflect the evening lights, and guests watch the rain from the dry side of the windows.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the lights around the Vieux-Port lie in long lines on the dark water.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests at Le Beauvau bar look down at the lights of the Vieux-Port and the boats between them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Vieux-Port sleeps, and from the room windows the boats seem to sleep too.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky over the Vieux-Port is still bright, and the first lights come on along the quays.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Río de la Plata is a faint grey band beyond the Recoleta parks, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Le Mirador suites look from their French balconies at a clear morning over the Recoleta parks and the distant Río de la Plata.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Buenos Aires skyline shows sharply through the large windows of the indoor rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Recoleta parks this morning, while the Río de la Plata shines in the distance.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop deck, the Buenos Aires skyline stands under slow afternoon clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the marble roofs of the Recoleta cemetery turn the same grey as the clouds above them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Río de la Plata today, and the Recoleta parks fade into soft green beyond the French balconies.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Río de la Plata cannot be seen today, and from the 11th floor the Buenos Aires skyline ends a few streets beyond Alvear Avenue.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the large windows of the indoor rooftop pool, and swimmers see the Buenos Aires skyline blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Buenos Aires skyline, and guests in the Le Mirador suites watch the storm cross the Recoleta parks from behind closed balcony doors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over La Recoleta, and guests in the heated indoor pool watch the flakes pass the large windows.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, bright day, the Río de la Plata shows clearly beyond the Recoleta parks, blue and sharp-edged.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests look at the Buenos Aires skyline from the warm water of the indoor rooftop pool and stay in a little longer.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the Alvear SUSHI BAR terrace look over La Recoleta with a cold drink in hand.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop deck, guests lie on the loungers in the warm air and look across the Buenos Aires skyline, phones face down.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Alvear SUSHI BAR terrace, guests watch the low sun turn the roofs of La Recoleta gold.
phrases.partly_golden: At Alvear Roof Bar, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds above the Buenos Aires skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Buenos Aires skyline spread out in front of Alvear Roof Bar.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain makes Alvear Avenue shine tonight, and from Alvear Roof Bar its lights look doubled on the wet street.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Buenos Aires skyline glows under low cloud, and the Recoleta parks are a wide dark space below the Le Mirador suites.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in this 1932 hotel look down from Alvear Roof Bar at the long row of lights on Alvear Avenue.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Alvear Avenue lies quiet and almost empty below the 11th floor, with the Recoleta parks sleeping beyond.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from Alvear Roof Bar on the 11th floor the first lights come on along Alvear Avenue.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Estaiada Bridge and the Pinheiros River wait under a clear, dim sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Estaiada Bridge first, then the Pinheiros River below it, both clear from the north-facing suites.
phrases.clear_midday: Through the glass wall of the outdoor pool, the city stands sharp under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows drift across the green treetops this morning, seen from the tall windows of the fitness center.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds move over the city skyline this afternoon, and the Pinheiros River changes from bright to dull and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pinheiros River turns the same colour and the Estaiada Bridge stands out above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and the Estaiada Bridge looks like a pencil drawing over the river.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the city skyline is not visible today; the Pinheiros River and the nearer towers still are.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pinheiros River, and guests in the Presidential Suite see the Estaiada Bridge slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the city skyline, and for a second the Estaiada Bridge shows white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Pinheiros River, and the Estaiada Bridge fades behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold air, the city skyline looks sharp above the green treetops from the fitness center.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass and look at the Estaiada Bridge over the grey-green Pinheiros River.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, swimmers stay under the water and look out at the city through the glass wall of the outdoor pool.
phrases.warm: By the outdoor pool, guests on lounge chairs look across the city to the green hillside in the warm air.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights the cables of the Estaiada Bridge, and the Pinheiros River shines below them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and turns the city skyline orange above the outdoor pool.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights spread out below the glass pool wall and the sky above stays dull.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights of the Estaiada Bridge stretch into long wet lines.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit Estaiada Bridge glows over the dark Pinheiros River.
phrases.clear_night: From the Presidential Suite, guests see the lit Estaiada Bridge and the city lights together under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pinheiros River is a quiet dark band, and the city beside it has finally stopped talking.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the city skyline, seen from this hotel of 258 rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Venetian Lagoon lies still and grey-blue under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Venetian Lagoon, and guests in the lagoon-view rooms open their curtains to bright water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Venetian Lagoon shines under a clear sky, and the bell tower of San Giorgio Maggiore stands sharp across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Venetian Lagoon this morning, turning the water from green to silver and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they move over the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Venetian Lagoon takes the same colour, and the boats seem to move through the sky itself.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Venetian Lagoon today, and boats appear out of the white close to the Riva degli Schiavoni.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so San Giorgio Maggiore island is missing and the Venetian Lagoon fades out a short way from the shore.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Venetian Lagoon, and guests in the Exclusive lagoon-view damasco suite watch thousands of small rings spread on the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Venetian Lagoon, and for a second the whole stretch of water turns white before the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Venetian Lagoon and melts as it touches the water, while the terrace slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the Venetian Lagoon looks like polished steel, and guests admire it from behind warm glass.
phrases.cold: Cold air makes the Venetian Lagoon look clean and sharp today, and the few boats crossing it leave long white lines.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat the Venetian Lagoon shimmers, and guests on the terrace keep to the shade while they watch the boats pass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day guests stay out on the terrace, looking across the Venetian Lagoon to San Giorgio Maggiore island.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Venetian Lagoon gold, and from the roof terrace suite guests see the light reach right across the water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and colours the Venetian Lagoon orange, with pink edges on every cloud above it.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud the Venetian Lagoon is a wide black surface, crossed by the moving lights of the boats.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and the boat lights on the Venetian Lagoon stretch into long wet reflections.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night the Venetian Lagoon lies calm under low cloud, and no stars show above the water.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Venetian Lagoon tonight, and guests at their windows see them repeated faintly on the black water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Venetian Lagoon is quiet and empty, in front of a building that was once a convent.
phrases.dusk: From the candlelit terrace, guests watch the sky turn pink and purple over the Venetian Lagoon and San Giorgio Maggiore island.

phrases.clear_predawn: Early risers in the Junior Suite see the Eiffel Tower as a dark shape before the day begins.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast time finds the Eiffel Tower in clear morning light, every level easy to pick out.
phrases.clear_midday: Seen at midday, the Eiffel Tower shows every iron beam from its base to its tip.
phrases.partly_morning: The Eiffel Tower goes from bright to grey and back again as clouds cross the morning sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows climb the Eiffel Tower this afternoon, one level at a time.
phrases.overcast: Pale cloud makes a plain background today, and the Eiffel Tower's iron frame stands dark against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Eiffel Tower to a grey shape today, its top paler than its base.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, and the Eiffel Tower shows only as a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain falls across the Eiffel Tower, and guests in the Junior Suite watch it from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Storm clouds gather behind the Eiffel Tower, and guests stay in to watch the thunderstorm pass.
phrases.snow: Falling snow turns the Eiffel Tower pale, and guests watch it from the warmth indoors.
phrases.very_cold: Nobody needs gloves to enjoy the Eiffel Tower today; guests are watching it from indoors.

phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests choose the shade indoors and admire the Eiffel Tower from there.
phrases.warm: Guests heading out for the day take one more look at the Eiffel Tower before they go.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Eiffel Tower's iron frame to gold from the top down.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun finds gaps in the cloud, and the Eiffel Tower glows each time it comes through.
phrases.grey_evening: Under the evening cloud, guests see the Eiffel Tower lit from base to top.
phrases.wet_evening: This evening's rain blurs the lit Eiffel Tower into a soft golden glow.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in the Junior Suite leave the curtains open tonight for the lit Eiffel Tower.
phrases.clear_night: The lit Eiffel Tower stands sharp against the dark, each line of its frame easy to follow.
phrases.late_night: Sleepless guests in the Junior Suite find the Eiffel Tower still there, a dark outline in the night.
phrases.dusk: The first lights appear on the Eiffel Tower while there is still colour behind it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Indian Ocean lies deep blue under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the rooftops of uMhlanga, and the Indian Ocean shines behind them all the way to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: Beyond the heated rooftop pool, the Indian Ocean is open blue water under a cloudless midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Indian Ocean this morning, and the coastline stays bright between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the sea-facing rooms follow the coastline up and down this afternoon, with white clouds resting above the Indian Ocean.
phrases.overcast: Under a full cover of cloud, the Indian Ocean turns grey, and the horizon is a thin line between two similar colours.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Indian Ocean today, and the rooftops of uMhlanga fade little by little as the town runs downhill.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests see the nearer rooftops of uMhlanga and only a pale strip of the Indian Ocean.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the sea-facing rooms, and the Indian Ocean behind it is blurred and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Indian Ocean, and guests on the higher floors watch the storm move along the coastline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over uMhlanga, and the Indian Ocean disappears behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the Indian Ocean looks sharp and dark blue beyond the rooftops.

phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look over its edge at the Indian Ocean.
phrases.warm: On a warm day at Back Yard, drinks slowly lose their ice while guests look out over the Indian Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the rooftops of uMhlanga gold, and from Back Yard the Indian Ocean becomes a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds above the Indian Ocean, and from the 14-storey tower guests see the water darken below them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of uMhlanga run downhill and stop where the dark Indian Ocean begins.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening the town lights shine through the rain, and the Indian Ocean is lost in the darkness behind them.
phrases.mild_night: From Back Yard on this mild night, the lights of uMhlanga lead towards a black, cloud-covered Indian Ocean.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Indian Ocean tonight, and the lights of uMhlanga mark where the land ends.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Indian Ocean is a wide black space, and the town sleeps on the slope below.
phrases.dusk: At dusk the sky is still bright above the Indian Ocean, and from the rooftop pool the first lights come on in the town.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Table Mountain stands as a dark shape above the garden, and Lion's Head slowly appears beside it.
phrases.clear_morning: From the terrace rooms, guests see Table Mountain, Lion's Head and Signal Hill together in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop deck shows Lion's Head against a blue sky, with the Atlantic Ocean bright on the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the slopes of Table Mountain this morning, easy to follow from the rooftop deck.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift past Lion's Head this afternoon, while the city below the terrace rooms stays in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the flat top of Table Mountain looks even flatter, as if drawn with a ruler.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and Lion's Head seems to float above it from the rooftop deck.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Atlantic Ocean is not visible from the rooftop deck today, but Lion's Head and the near slopes of Table Mountain still show.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the cliffs of Table Mountain, and guests watch it from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the outline of Lion's Head for a second, then the storm hides it again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the city, and the cliffs of Table Mountain fade to white behind it.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Table Mountain looks sharp and close, and guests admire it from indoors with something hot.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the rooftop deck looks across the city to Signal Hill, clear in the cool air.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool and look up at the cliffs of Table Mountain from the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests rest by the pool with Lion's Head and the Atlantic Ocean in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests watch the low sun turn the cliffs of Table Mountain gold, and conversation stops for a while.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds around Lion's Head, and the private terraces of the terrace rooms face the changing sea and skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights spread below this hotel of 8 rooms, as far as the dark slope of Signal Hill.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the city lights this evening, and guests in the terrace rooms watch them shine on the wet streets below.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the rooftop deck looks over the lights of the city, with Lion's Head dark under the clouds.
phrases.clear_night: Stars sit above Table Mountain tonight, and the city lights answer them from below the rooftop deck.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city below the rooftop deck is quiet, and Lion's Head rests against the night sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright behind Lion's Head while the first city lights come on below the rooftop deck.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tyrrhenian Sea is a wide, quiet surface below the sea-view balconies, and the sky above it slowly turns pale.

phrases.clear_midday: At Restaurant Al Mare, lunch is served at sea level, where the Tyrrhenian Sea is clear blue under a cloudless sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Bay of Salerno this morning, and guests follow them from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the lobby.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop of Senzafine, the afternoon sea is a patchwork of blue and grey as clouds cross the Tyrrhenian Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Tyrrhenian Sea turns the colour of slate, and Amalfi town stands out in pale tones along the coast.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Amalfi Coast today, and from Glicine's veranda the sea and the sky seem to be one colour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From La Terrazza Bar, Amalfi town cannot be seen clearly today, and only the nearest cliffs and the water just below are in view.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Tyrrhenian Sea, and guests in the lobby watch it through the tall windows from a sofa.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Bay of Salerno, and guests watch the storm from their sea-view rooms, well above the waves.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Tyrrhenian Sea, and the flakes disappear the moment they touch the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, and the Amalfi Coast shows every cliff in sharp detail above a deep blue sea.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass of the fitness room and look at the Tyrrhenian Sea while they exercise.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the saltwater pool and look across the still Tyrrhenian Sea, which shines like metal.
phrases.warm: By the saltwater pool, guests lie on sun loungers at sea level, with Amalfi town in view along the rocky coast.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Tyrrhenian Sea gold, and guests on the sea-view balconies have a good excuse to do nothing.
phrases.partly_golden: From Senzafine on the rooftop, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds orange above the Tyrrhenian Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner at Glicine, guests look past the wisteria to the lights of Amalfi town under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain falls on the dark Tyrrhenian Sea, and from Glicine's veranda the lights of Amalfi town are blurred behind it.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from La Terrazza Bar Amalfi town glows in the distance above the black water.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the lights of Amalfi town are reflected in the Tyrrhenian Sea below Glicine's veranda.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Tyrrhenian Sea is a dark, quiet space beyond the balcony, and only the sound of waves gives it away.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from La Terrazza Bar the first lights of Amalfi town appear along the coast.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dallas skyline stands dark and sharp against a sky that is slowly turning blue.

phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the glass towers of the Dallas skyline turn the same grey, each one still clear from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Dallas skyline today, and from the rooftop pool the far towers look like a watercolour.

phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Dallas skyline for a second, and guests in this 22-story glass tower count until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Harwood District, and from the fitness center windows the buildings slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Dallas skyline looks close enough to touch from the rooftop pool deck.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the view from Pomelo is the Dallas skyline with sharp edges and nobody in the way.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the 75-foot infinity pool up to their shoulders and look at the Dallas skyline over the edge.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Pomelo, the glass towers of the Dallas skyline turn gold in the late sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and paints one part of the Dallas skyline orange, while the rest waits in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Dallas skyline give the low sky a soft glow above the rooftop terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the rooftop terrace tonight, and the lights of the Dallas skyline shine through it in long wet streaks.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Harwood District streets below are quiet, and the Dallas skyline stands still against the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over Uptown Dallas while the first lights come on in the towers.

phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Aegean is deep blue all the way from the superyacht berths to the horizon.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Yalikavak Bay, and the decks of the moored boats slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and guests in KITCHEN can follow the Aegean all the way to a sharp horizon.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the superyachts in Yalikavak Marina gold, and the Aegean behind them keeps its deep blue.
