phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in KITCHEN, guests look out on three sides to a cloudy evening and the lit boats of Yalikavak Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening outside KITCHEN, and the marina lights blur into long streaks on the wet bay.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Yalikavak Bay is quiet, and the boats rest at their berths with the open sea behind them.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the berths of Yalikavak Marina.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale behind the TV Tower, and Tiergarten waits for its colour.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights Tiergarten, and the Victory Column and the TV Tower stand sharp against the blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Presidential Suite, guests can pick out the Reichstag, the Brandenburg Gate and Berlin Cathedral under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Tiergarten this morning, while the TV Tower stays in sunshine.

phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Tiergarten keeps its colour, and the TV Tower stands thin against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the skyline today, and from the Library Lounge the TV Tower looks like a pencil line.

phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of the Library Lounge, and the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church is slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Tiergarten, and guests in the Presidential Suite watch the storm through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Tiergarten, turning the treetops white, and the TV Tower fades in and out behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, the TV Tower looks close enough to touch from the warm side of the glass.

phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests stay behind the glass and watch the city lights shine around the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church.

phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests find the lit TV Tower first and then work out the rest of Berlin from there.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Berlin is quiet below the windows, and Tiergarten sleeps without a sound.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on from the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church to the TV Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Acropolis is a dark shape above the sleeping city, and the sky behind it is just starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in The Grand, guests look across the rooftops to the Acropolis, sharp in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Parthenon stands pale and exact on the Acropolis, straight ahead of the 8th-floor rooftop pool.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Athens, and guests in the rooms facing the Acropolis watch the Parthenon turn white a little at a time.

phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in The Grand, guests look out at the Parthenon, lit up under a low, cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain keeps falling this evening, and the lit Parthenon still shines on the Acropolis, its light a little blurred at the edges.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lit Parthenon gives a soft glow to the low sky above the Acropolis.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Douro River is a dark band below a sky that is slowly turning blue.

phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Napa Valley Vineyards are half in sun and half in shade as the clouds drift over.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the Napa Valley Vineyards, and the green of the rows looks deeper below it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the hills today, and the Napa Valley Vineyards fade row by row into the white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant hills are not visible today; guests see only the nearest rows of the Napa Valley Vineyards.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Napa Valley Vineyards, and guests watch the rows turn dark and shiny.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the hills, and lightning shows the Napa Valley Vineyards for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Napa Valley Vineyards, and guests watch the rows slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and the Napa Valley Vineyards stand out sharply against the distant hills.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look across the quiet Napa Valley Vineyards to the hills beyond them.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the hilltop pool and look out over the Napa Valley Vineyards.
phrases.warm: By the hilltop pool, books stay closed while guests look at the Napa Valley Vineyards instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light fills the Napa Valley Vineyards, and each row draws a long shadow beside it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and turns the Napa Valley Vineyards gold in patches.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Napa Valley Vineyards are a wide dark field, with the hills only just visible behind.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and the Napa Valley Vineyards disappear into the wet dark beyond the hilltop.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests can just make out the Napa Valley Vineyards below the hilltop.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Napa Valley Vineyards, and the hills are a black edge below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Napa Valley Vineyards lie still and dark, and nothing moves among the rows.
phrases.dusk: The sun has set, and guests among these 100 cottages watch the sky turn pink above the Napa Valley Vineyards.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Central Park lies still below, and the sky above the Manhattan skyline slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Nougatine, guests look through the windows at Central Park in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Central Park's tree canopy stretches away from Columbus Circle, every edge sharp.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Central Park this morning, and guests in the park view suites follow them from one side to the other.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At Jean-Georges, the floor-to-ceiling windows show Central Park under a mixed sky of sun and cloud this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud sits low over the Manhattan skyline today, and Central Park lies calm beneath it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the far side of Central Park today, so the tree canopy seems to go on without end.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the near trees of Central Park are clear, but the Manhattan skyline behind them cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of Nougatine, and Central Park behind the glass looks soft and blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Central Park, and for a second guests in the park-facing rooms see every tree.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past all 52 floors and settles on Central Park, turning the tree canopy white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests stay warm at Nougatine and look out at Central Park in bright, cold light.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests at Jean-Georges look out at Central Park and are glad to be on this side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, Central Park's tree canopy looks cool and shady, and guests in the park view suites admire it from indoors.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit outside on the Mistral Terrace with Central Park in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Central Park's tree canopy gold, and the Manhattan skyline behind it catches the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Central Park turn orange, and the tree canopy below takes a little of that colour.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Nougatine, guests see Central Park as a dark field under the clouds, with the lit Manhattan skyline around it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests at Jean-Georges have dinner by the windows, and the lights of the Manhattan skyline shine weakly across Central Park.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight, cloud glows softly above the Manhattan skyline, and Central Park is a calm space in the middle.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lit towers of the Manhattan skyline stand around Central Park like a frame around a dark picture.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Central Park rests in silence, and even Columbus Circle seems to slow down.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Central Park is still bright, and the first lights come on around Columbus Circle.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Zurich lies still under a clear sky, and the Alps are a dark line far behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches the lake view rooms first, and Lake Zurich shines beyond the balcony doors.
phrases.clear_midday: At La Muña on the 6th floor, guests turn from Lake Zurich to the Alps and then to the historic centre.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Lake Zurich this morning, and the wooded hills on the far shore go from dark green to bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the roof terrace of La Muña, guests see clouds move over the historic centre while the Alps stay in sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Lake Zurich takes the same colour, and the sailboats are the only white on it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Lake Zurich today, and the far shore is gone behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today; guests see Lake Zurich clearly near the shore and only a faint far bank.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lake Zurich, and guests watch the drops mark the grey water from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Lake Zurich, and each flash of lightning shows the whole water for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Lake Zurich, and the flakes disappear the moment they touch the water.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is clear over Lake Zurich, and the Alps look sharp and white from the 6th floor.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests keep the balcony doors closed and look at Lake Zurich through the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on Rooftop Bar look down over the city rooftops at Lake Zurich and envy the swans.
phrases.warm: A warm day brings guests up to Rooftop Bar, where the city rooftops and Lake Zurich lie below their glasses.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lies across Lake Zurich, and the sailboats come back slowly over bright water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and Lake Zurich turns gold in some places and grey in others.
phrases.grey_evening: From La Muña this evening, the lights of the historic centre glow under low cloud, and Lake Zurich is dark beside them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows tonight, and the shore lights stretch into long wet lines on Lake Zurich.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests on balconies see the lights along the shore curve around Lake Zurich.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, Lake Zurich is black and calm, with the lights of the far shore in a row along its edge.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Zurich is quiet and dark, and nothing moves on the water.
phrases.dusk: At dusk, guests in this Philippe Starck-designed hotel see the first shore lights appear on Lake Zurich.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Higashiyama Mountains are a dark line above the Kamo River, seen from the river room balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: From Sky Forest Garden, the Kamo River shines in the clear morning light, with the Higashiyama Mountains behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: Kyoto Tower stands white against the blue midday sky, above the low rooftops of the city.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Higashiyama Mountains this morning, while the Kamo River below stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the corner window of the city rooms, guests see Kyoto Tower with clouds moving slowly behind it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Kyoto Tower is almost the same colour as the clouds, and the rooftops below look darker.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Higashiyama Mountains today, and from Sky Forest Garden the Kamo River looks pale and quiet.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Higashiyama Mountains are not visible today, but the Kamo River is still clear from Sky Forest Garden.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Kamo River, and guests in the river rooms watch the small circles spread on the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Kyoto Tower for a second above the rooftops, then the storm hides it again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the city rooftops, and Kyoto Tower is white on white behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests can count the ridges of the Higashiyama Mountains.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass and watch the Kamo River, with the Higashiyama Mountains behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests in Sky Forest Garden sit under the trees and look down at the Kamo River.
phrases.warm: On a warm day in Sky Forest Garden, guests lean on the railing and watch the birds on the Kamo River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Higashiyama Mountains gold, and from Sky Forest Garden the Kamo River shines below.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the city, and Kyoto Tower turns from white to soft orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Kyoto Tower is lit against the cloudy evening sky, a clear point of light above the low rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Kyoto Tower blur in the rain above the shining rooftops.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in the city rooms of this 19-room hotel fall asleep with Kyoto Tower lit in the corner window.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and Kyoto Tower glows above a city that keeps its rooftops low.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Kamo River is a quiet band between its banks, with nobody there to watch it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests in this 2022 townhouse watch Kyoto Tower start to glow.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Potomac River is a wide, quiet surface under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the waterfront view rooms, guests notice the first boats on the Washington Channel before they think about coffee.
phrases.clear_midday: The Washington Channel is bright blue under the midday sun, and every boat on it leaves a clean white trail.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Potomac River this morning, and the boats in the marina pass in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, guests follow the clouds as they drift over the Potomac River this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Potomac River turns the colour of steel, and the white boats in the marina stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on the Potomac River today, and boats on the Washington Channel appear slowly, one at a time.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The monuments are not visible from Whiskey Charlie today; the view stops at the Washington Channel and its nearest boats.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Washington Channel with small rings, and guests watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Potomac River, and guests in this 175-room hotel count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Potomac River, and the docked boats on the waterfront slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the Potomac River is bright and sharp in the light, and guests enjoy it from behind glass.
phrases.cold: The cold air is clear today, and from Whiskey Charlie on the roof the view runs across the water toward the monuments.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the rooftop terrace look at the Potomac River and envy everyone on a boat.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests at Whiskey Charlie follow the boat traffic along the Washington Channel with a cold drink in hand.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Whiskey Charlie, guests watch the low sun turn the water gold all the way toward the monuments.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink and orange above the Potomac River, and the water repeats them.
phrases.grey_evening: From the rooftop terrace this cloudy evening, the city skyline glows and the Potomac River lies black beside it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass tonight, and the waterfront lights stretch into long lines on the Washington Channel.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Potomac River reflects the soft glow of the city.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the waterfront view rooms see the lights of a late boat cross the Washington Channel.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Potomac River is still, and the boats have stopped moving for the night.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from Whiskey Charlie the first lights appear along the waterfront.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky grows lighter, and the mist above Horseshoe Falls slowly takes shape.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in The Rainbow Room, guests watch the morning sun light up American Falls and Horseshoe Falls.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear sky, mist rises white above Horseshoe Falls, and a tour boat moves slowly towards it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross American Falls this morning, while Horseshoe Falls stays bright behind its mist.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Over afternoon tea in Fallsview Tea Room, guests look through floor-to-ceiling windows at Horseshoe Falls and American Falls under a broken sky.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the white water of Niagara Falls stands out clearly from the Fallsview balconies.
phrases.fog_haze: From the brick terrace today, the fog and the mist of Horseshoe Falls are difficult to tell apart.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see the white edge of Niagara Falls but not the detail of the water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Niagara Falls, and guests behind their windows watch water meet water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows American Falls and Horseshoe Falls for a second, then heavy rain hides them again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Niagara Falls, and guests in this late-1920s hotel watch it disappear into the mist.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and the mist of Horseshoe Falls rises thick and white above the water.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the tall windows of Fallsview Tea Room and let Horseshoe Falls do the outdoor work.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the 12th-floor Fallsview balconies hope the wind brings them some mist from Niagara Falls.
phrases.warm: On the brick terrace, guests sit in the rattan chairs and watch the mist rise from Horseshoe Falls.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the mist above Horseshoe Falls gold, seen from the Fallsview balconies.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Niagara Falls turn pink, and the water below stays white.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Prime Steakhouse, guests look through the panoramic windows at American Falls and Horseshoe Falls, lit in blue under the clouds.
phrases.wet_evening: Wet weather blurs the blue lights on Niagara Falls this evening, and the falls become a soft glow.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the low clouds take some blue from the lights on Niagara Falls.
phrases.clear_night: American Falls and Horseshoe Falls shine blue under a clear night sky, filling the panoramic windows of Prime Steakhouse.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Niagara Falls is a pale shape in the darkness, still moving while guests sleep.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first blue lights appear on American Falls.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Llandudno Bay is a dark sheet of water under a clear sky, and the promenade below is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: In the restaurant, breakfast is served with Llandudno Bay bright and blue beyond the promenade.
phrases.clear_midday: From the terrace, guests look across the promenade to Llandudno Bay, sharp and blue under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Llandudno Bay this morning, and guests at breakfast in the restaurant watch the sea change colour.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the sea view balconies follow the clouds over Llandudno Bay towards the Great Orme headland.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Llandudno Bay turns the colour of slate, and the promenade curves pale along its edge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Llandudno Bay today, and the sea and the sky blend into one soft grey beyond the promenade.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Llandudno Bay is not visible today; the promenade and the nearest water are clear from the terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the promenade, and guests watch grey Llandudno Bay through wet French doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Llandudno Bay, and guests stay behind the glass to watch lightning over the dark sea.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the promenade, and Llandudno Bay fades into white a short way from the shore.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear today, and Llandudno Bay shines beyond the promenade as guests look out from the warm restaurant.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the terrace is quiet, and Llandudno Bay lies steel-blue beyond the promenade.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests sit on the terrace with cold drinks and watch Llandudno Bay shimmer.
phrases.warm: On a warm day the terrace fills up, and guests watch walkers on the promenade with Llandudno Bay behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns Llandudno Bay gold, and guests in the sea view rooms pick up the binoculars.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and patches of gold move across Llandudno Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the promenade lights curve along the edge of Llandudno Bay, and the water beyond them is dark.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the promenade lamps shine on the wet ground, and Llandudno Bay is lost in the dark beyond them.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests in this 1850s building look past the promenade lights to the black water of Llandudno Bay.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above Llandudno Bay tonight, and the lamps of the promenade trace the shore below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Llandudno Bay lies still and unlit beyond the quiet promenade.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Llandudno Bay as the first promenade lights come on in front of the terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral stands dark against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral first, and guests on the Penthouse terrace see it above the roofs.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Vienna State Opera shows every arch and statue to guests in the suites across the street.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the old town this morning, and St Stephen's Cathedral goes from shade to sun and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace suites, guests follow cloud shadows across the roofs towards St Stephen's Cathedral this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: The sky is flat and grey today, and the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral looks sharper against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the roofs of Vienna today, and St Stephen's Cathedral is only a faint grey spire beyond them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so guests see the Vienna State Opera across the street well, though not St Stephen's Cathedral.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Philharmonikerstrasse, and it runs down the front of the Vienna State Opera across the street.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the old town, and for a second lightning shows the whole spire of St Stephen's Cathedral.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Vienna State Opera, and guests in this 1876 hotel watch its roof turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests can pick out the stonework on the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the tall windows and look across at the Albertina Museum.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the Penthouse terrace stay in the shade and look across the roofs to St Stephen's Cathedral.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit out on the terrace of Restaurant Rote Bar with the Vienna State Opera in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the stone of the Vienna State Opera gold, and guests on the Penthouse terrace watch the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral catch the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud and colours one side of the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Vienna State Opera fills the windows of the Opera Penthouse Suite.
phrases.wet_evening: Wet streets shine below this evening, and the lights of the Vienna State Opera are reflected on Philharmonikerstrasse.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit spire of St Stephen's Cathedral rises above the dark roofs of the old town.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and from the Penthouse terrace the lit Vienna State Opera and St Stephen's Cathedral share one roofline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Philharmonikerstrasse is quiet, and the Vienna State Opera rests after its long evening on stage.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the front of the Vienna State Opera.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the North Shore Mountains are a dark shape under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the North Shore Mountains first, and every ridge is sharp from the corner suites above the 20th floor.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the North Shore Mountains stand in full detail behind the towers of downtown Vancouver.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift across the North Shore Mountains this morning, and their shadows move slowly over the slopes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pod-like chairs of Spa by JW on the 17th floor, guests look over Vancouver as afternoon clouds cross the sky.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the North Shore Mountains today, and the dome of BC Place looks almost the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the North Shore Mountains today, and from here they look like a faint drawing behind downtown Vancouver.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The North Shore Mountains are not visible today; the view ends at the towers of downtown Vancouver.
phrases.rain: Rain falls over Vancouver, and the North Shore Mountains are grey and blurred behind the towers of downtown.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over downtown Vancouver, and lightning shows the North Shore Mountains for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Vancouver, and the North Shore Mountains slowly disappear behind it.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the North Shore Mountains look close enough to touch, though guests wisely stay behind the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day guests in the Spa by JW pod chairs look out over Vancouver and feel no need to go outside.
phrases.very_hot: Heat lies over the city, and the North Shore Mountains shimmer a little above the downtown rooftops.
phrases.warm: A warm day gives the North Shore Mountains a soft green colour, and guests keep looking at them through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills the corner suites above the 20th floor, where the North Shore Mountains and the dome of BC Place share one frame.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the North Shore Mountains, and False Creek below takes on the same warm tones.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the Science World sphere glows beside False Creek while the North Shore Mountains fade into the dark.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in the corner suites see the city lights of Vancouver blur on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the North Shore Mountains tonight, so the city lights of downtown Vancouver have the view to themselves.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests can follow the top line of the North Shore Mountains above the city lights.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours downtown Vancouver is quiet, and the North Shore Mountains cannot be told apart from the sky above them.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind the North Shore Mountains, and the first lights come on across downtown Vancouver.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Penthouse looks over a Paris still asleep, the Eiffel Tower a dark line among the great monuments.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests at Edmond start the day with the Eiffel Tower in front of them, standing in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The Eiffel Tower stands against plain blue at this hour, in full view from the rooftop.
phrases.partly_morning: Junior Suite guests wake to an Eiffel Tower that moves in and out of the sun as the clouds pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Eiffel Tower catches a patch of sun this afternoon, seen from The Ranch as clouds cross the city.
phrases.overcast: No shadows fall on Paris today, only the Eiffel Tower standing dark against a pale, even cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: From the Penthouse, the great monuments are pale shapes in the haze, and guests pick out the Eiffel Tower by its outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the Eiffel Tower is only a faint shape from the rooftop, its details lost in the dull air.
phrases.rain: Guests in the Junior Suite watch the rain fall across Paris, the Eiffel Tower grey and blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Penthouse guests watch the thunderstorm pass over the great monuments, the Eiffel Tower dark under the clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow drifts past the Penthouse windows, and the Eiffel Tower comes and goes behind it.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Junior Suite study the Eiffel Tower from under the duvet, in no hurry to get dressed.
phrases.cold: Junior Suite guests leave their coats on the hook a little longer and look at the Eiffel Tower instead.
phrases.very_hot: Guests on The Ranch terrace find a seat and stay in it, the Eiffel Tower in front of them all afternoon.
phrases.warm: Up on the rooftop, guests in shirt sleeves photograph each other with the Eiffel Tower behind them
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late-afternoon light warms the Eiffel Tower, seen in full from The Ranch.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop, the Eiffel Tower stands dark against clouds lit orange by the last sun.
phrases.grey_evening: At Edmond this evening, guests look up from their plates to the Eiffel Tower lit under the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the Eiffel Tower spread and soften in tonight's rain.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud hides the stars tonight, so the Eiffel Tower is left to do the shining.
phrases.clear_night: Lit from base to tip, the Eiffel Tower is the first thing the eye finds in tonight's view.
phrases.late_night: Paris has gone quiet, and the Eiffel Tower is a tall dark shape above the last street lights.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the Eiffel Tower switches on its lights, seen from The Ranch against a still-bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Diamond Head is a dark shape against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights Waikiki Beach, and the sand looks almost white beside the turquoise water.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Diamond Head shows every ridge above the long curve of Waikiki Beach.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Fort DeRussy Park this morning, while Waikiki Beach stays bright beyond the palm trees.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Diamond Head this afternoon, and the Pacific Ocean changes from turquoise to deep blue below them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and Diamond Head stands clear above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Diamond Head today, and the far end of Waikiki Beach fades into the pale air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Diamond Head is difficult to make out today; guests see Fort DeRussy Park clearly and Waikiki Beach only in part.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Fort DeRussy Park, and guests watch it move along Waikiki Beach toward Diamond Head.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second Diamond Head appears sharply through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Waikiki Beach, and guests in the ocean-view suites take photographs because nobody at home will believe it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and Diamond Head looks close enough to touch above an empty Waikiki Beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the floor-to-ceiling windows and follow the waves along the Waikiki shoreline.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, swimmers fill the water off Waikiki Beach, and Diamond Head shimmers behind them.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on their balconies watch surfers and swimmers share the water off Waikiki Beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Diamond Head gold, and the palm trees in Fort DeRussy Park throw long shadows across the grass.
phrases.partly_golden: From the balcony rooms, guests watch the sun drop toward the Pacific Ocean between bands of orange cloud.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Waikiki shoreline curve toward Diamond Head, which is now only an outline.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights along the Waikiki shoreline this evening, and the Pacific Ocean beyond them is black.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and the lights along Waikiki Beach show where the sand meets the water.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Pacific Ocean tonight, and from this 38-story tower guests follow the lights of the Waikiki shoreline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Fort DeRussy Park is dark and quiet, and the Pacific Ocean beyond it is heard more than seen.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Pacific Ocean is still bright, and the first lights appear along Waikiki Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Plaza España lies quiet and nearly empty far below, under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light fills Gran Vía, and guests in the city-view rooms look down on the avenue as it gets busy.
phrases.clear_midday: At Somos, guests look through the full-height glass at Gran Vía under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Plaza España this morning, and the square turns bright again each time they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pool in the 8th-floor Wellness Area, swimmers watch white clouds drift over the Madrid skyline between lengths.
phrases.overcast: The red-tiled rooftops of Madrid keep their colour under an even grey sky, seen from the terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Madrid skyline today, and from the pool windows the far rooftops fade into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far edge of the city is not visible today, but Plaza España and Gran Vía remain clear just below.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the full-height glass at Somos, and Gran Vía shines wet behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Gran Vía, and guests in the city-view rooms watch the lightning above the avenue.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Plaza España, and guests in the suites with city views watch the square slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, clear day, guests in the heated pool look out at the Madrid skyline and feel no need to go outside.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps the terrace loungers empty, yet Madrid's red-tiled rooftops look sharp from up there.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests take the sun loungers on the terrace and look over red-tiled rooftops that shimmer in the sun.
phrases.warm: On this warm day Plaza España fills with people, who look like small moving dots from high in this 258-room tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills Gran Vía late in the afternoon, and the facades along the avenue glow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink over the Madrid skyline, and guests in the pool stop swimming to look.
phrases.grey_evening: At Somos, guests watch the lights of Gran Vía through the glass under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: This wet evening, guests in rooms designed by Jaime Hayón watch the lights of Gran Vía reflected on the wet street.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the clouds over Plaza España take a soft glow from the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, Gran Vía is a bright line of lights, the avenue known as Madrid's Broadway.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Gran Vía is finally quiet, and only a few cars cross Plaza España.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Gran Vía, as they do every night.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Elliott Bay lies quiet under a clear sky, and Puget Sound slowly turns from black to deep blue.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Goldfinch Tavern, guests look out over Elliott Bay under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 4th-floor infinity pool, the water seems to run straight into Elliott Bay under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Puget Sound this morning, and guests on the treadmills in the fitness centre follow them through the tall windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Great Wheel turns slowly beside Elliott Bay this afternoon, against a sky of sun and passing clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Puget Sound takes the same colour, and guests in the lobby look out across Elliott Bay.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits low on Elliott Bay today, and the Great Wheel is only a faint circle from the pool terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Olympic Mountains are not visible today, so the view from the pool terrace ends at the grey water of Elliott Bay.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Elliott Bay, and guests in the corner Elliott Bay suites watch the drops run down the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Puget Sound, and guests in the lobby watch lightning flash above Elliott Bay.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Elliott Bay, and guests watch the flakes disappear into the water from the fitness centre windows.
phrases.very_cold: Steam rises from the heated infinity pool in the freezing air, and Elliott Bay shines cold and bright behind it.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to the lobby, where the windows show Elliott Bay and the Olympic Mountains beyond.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look out over Elliott Bay.
phrases.warm: By the infinity pool, books stay closed on this warm day while guests look at Elliott Bay instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the infinity pool, guests watch the sun go down towards the Olympic Mountains, and Elliott Bay turns gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds over Puget Sound, and guests in the corner Elliott Bay suites see the water turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: The Great Wheel is lit against a cloudy evening sky, and its colours reach across Elliott Bay to the pool terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights along Elliott Bay tonight, and guests in this 2008 hotel watch from the dry side of the lobby windows.
phrases.mild_night: From the firepit on the pool terrace, the lights along Elliott Bay shine under a mild, cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Great Wheel glows above Elliott Bay, and Puget Sound stretches out dark behind it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Elliott Bay is still and dark, and guests in the 147 rooms have Puget Sound to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky over Puget Sound is still pink after sunset, and the first lights come on along Elliott Bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Victoria Harbour lies still and grey-blue under a clear sky, and the hills behind Kowloon slowly take shape.
phrases.clear_morning: From the harbour-view corner rooms, guests watch the morning sun rise over the eastern reaches of Victoria Harbour.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Victoria Harbour is bright blue, and every tower on the Kowloon skyline is easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Victoria Harbour this morning, while the Kowloon side stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the urban-view rooms see the towers of Taikoo Shing go from sun to shade as the afternoon clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: The sky is one sheet of cloud today, and Victoria Harbour turns the colour of steel below it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Victoria Harbour today, and the Kowloon skyline shows only its nearest towers.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the hills behind Kowloon are not visible, and Victoria Harbour fades out halfway across.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the harbour-view suites on the 30th floor, and Victoria Harbour blurs behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Kowloon, and for a second the whole of Victoria Harbour shows white.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Victoria Harbour, and guests in the harbour-view rooms leave everything to watch the flakes meet the water.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold, clear air, guests can see every ridge of the hills behind Kowloon above Victoria Harbour.
phrases.cold: The day is cold and Victoria Harbour looks cold too, a dark band of water between Quarry Bay and Kowloon.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests float in the outdoor pool and look up at the city towers around them.
phrases.warm: From a sunbed by the outdoor pool, guests see greenery in front and the towers of the cityscape behind, and nobody hurries.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Sugar opens its 32nd-floor deck in the late afternoon, and the first guests find Victoria Harbour already turning gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink over the hills, and at Sugar the cocktails wait while guests watch Victoria Harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: The clouds hang low this evening, and the lights of Kowloon colour them orange above Victoria Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the Kowloon lights stretch into long reflections on Victoria Harbour, and guests at Sugar watch from behind the glass barriers.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the outdoor deck at Sugar looks across Victoria Harbour to the lights of Kowloon.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the Kowloon skyline shines across Victoria Harbour, each tower with its copy in the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Victoria Harbour is quiet and almost black, and Kowloon rests on the far side.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Victoria Harbour is still bright, and from the terrace at Sugar the first lights appear along the Kowloon skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the CN Tower stands as a thin shape against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the CN Tower first, then moves down over the financial district.
phrases.clear_midday: From Writers Room on the 17th floor, guests look through floor-to-ceiling glass at the CN Tower under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past the CN Tower this morning, and their shadows cross the financial district below it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in south-facing suites see the CN Tower move in and out of sunlight as the afternoon clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the CN Tower and the towers of the financial district share one quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the top of the CN Tower today, so guests see only its lower half above the city.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, and the CN Tower is only a faint outline behind the nearer buildings.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of Writers Room, and the CN Tower looks blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay close to the glass as lightning flashes behind the CN Tower and thunder rolls over the financial district.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the city, and the CN Tower appears and disappears between the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, and guests can pick out every line of the CN Tower from their warm rooms.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in select rooms look down at the sharp glass edges of the Royal Ontario Museum.
phrases.very_hot: Heat makes the air shimmer over the financial district, and the CN Tower seems to tremble a little.
phrases.warm: On the terrace of Writers Room, guests sit in the warm air and look across the skyline to the CN Tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light warms the CN Tower and turns the glass of the financial district to copper.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds, and the CN Tower glows for a short while above the skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit CN Tower stands out above the financial district for guests on the 17th floor.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the CN Tower spread into soft colours on the glass of Writers Room.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in one of the 219 rooms and suites look out at the lit CN Tower under a mild, cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the CN Tower shines above the lights of the financial district.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who are still awake find the CN Tower tall and silent above the sleeping city.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still pink behind the CN Tower, and the first lights come on across the downtown skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the White House sits quiet behind the trees of Lafayette Square, under a sky that is still dark and clear.
phrases.clear_morning: From the private balconies, the White House North Lawn is bright under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Washington Monument stands sharp against the midday blue, directly behind the White House.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Lafayette Square this morning, while the White House stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the top floors follow the afternoon clouds as they drift past the Washington Monument.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the White House looks even whiter, and the Washington Monument takes the colour of the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Washington Monument today, so guests look at the White House and the trees of Lafayette Square instead.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Jefferson Memorial is not visible in the distance today, but the White House is close enough to stay clear across Lafayette Square.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the White House North Lawn, and guests watch it from the dry side of the balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Washington Monument for a second at a time, while thunder rolls over the White House roof.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Lafayette Square, and the White House slowly disappears into its own colour.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests stay behind the glass and look at the White House North Lawn, sharp in the cold light.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the trees of Lafayette Square stand still in front of the White House, and the Washington Monument rises pale behind them.
phrases.very_hot: The heat makes the air shimmer over Lafayette Square, and guests on the private balconies look at the White House from the shade.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace, guests stand in the warm air with the White House directly below and the Washington Monument above the treeline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Washington Monument gold, and from the rooftop terrace the colour moves slowly down the stone.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the spire of St. John's Church, seen from the private balconies.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the floodlit White House stands out from the rooms facing Lafayette Square.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows this evening, and the floodlit White House shines blurred across the wet square.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, the lit White House sits under low cloud in front of the private balconies.
phrases.clear_night: The Washington Monument stands lit against a clear night sky, with the White House glowing in front of it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lafayette Square is empty and still, and guests who cannot sleep look across it to the White House.
phrases.dusk: Guests in this 1928 hotel see the first lights come on at the White House, while the sky behind the Washington Monument is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Alcatraz Island is a low shape on the still water of San Francisco Bay.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Alcatraz Island directly ahead, and the Golden Gate Bridge stands clear to the left.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, San Francisco Bay is deep blue, and the Golden Gate Bridge crosses it on the left.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across San Francisco Bay this morning, and Alcatraz Island goes from bright to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift across San Francisco Bay.
phrases.overcast: San Francisco Bay takes the grey of the sky today, and Alcatraz Island sits in the middle of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers San Francisco Bay today, and only the tops of the Golden Gate Bridge towers show above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Golden Gate Bridge is not visible today; Alcatraz Island still shows, faint, across the near water of San Francisco Bay.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on San Francisco Bay, and guests in the bay view residences watch Alcatraz Island blur behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Alcatraz Island for a second, then San Francisco Bay disappears again behind the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over San Francisco Bay, and guests in this former chocolate factory watch Alcatraz Island turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Golden Gate Bridge looks very sharp, and guests admire it from beside the fireplace.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the lobby lounge look out at the waterfront and the grey-blue water of San Francisco Bay.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the rooftop terrace look for a breeze and find San Francisco Bay shining below.
phrases.warm: On the warm rooftop terrace, guests stay in their chairs and count the sailboats on San Francisco Bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Golden Gate Bridge a deeper red, and the water of San Francisco Bay turns gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds, and for a moment it lights only Alcatraz Island.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests on the rooftop terrace sit by the firepit and look at the lights around San Francisco Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the bay view residences tonight, and the lights along San Francisco Bay shine through it.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so the lights of the Golden Gate Bridge do the job over San Francisco Bay.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lights of the Golden Gate Bridge draw a thin line across the black bay.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours San Francisco Bay is quiet, and guests still awake can find Alcatraz Island straight ahead.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights appear along the Golden Gate Bridge and on Alcatraz Island.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Royal Palace of Stockholm is a long dark shape across the still water, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in The Veranda, guests look across the water to Gamla Stan in clear early sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Royal Palace of Stockholm shows every window of its facade across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Gamla Stan this morning, and patches of sun cross the old town one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the French balcony of the Royal Suite, guests watch cloud shadows slide over the Royal Palace of Stockholm just across the water.
phrases.overcast: The water takes the grey of the sky today, and Gamla Stan still shows in it as a clear reflection.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the water today, and the Royal Palace of Stockholm appears through it like a drawing half rubbed out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far waterfront is not visible today; the Royal Palace of Stockholm, directly opposite, is still clear enough to see.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of The Veranda, and guests watch Gamla Stan blur across the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the water, and each flash of lightning shows the Royal Palace of Stockholm for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Gamla Stan, and guests in The Veranda watch the old town turn white across the water.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing clear day, guests in this 1874 hotel stay indoors and look across the water at the Royal Palace of Stockholm, sharp in the cold light.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in The Veranda look at Gamla Stan across the water and leave their coats on the hook.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the terrace of the Terrace Suite sit in front of the Royal Palace of Stockholm and Gamla Stan, with bright water between.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, ferries come and go at the quay below, with Gamla Stan across the water behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the facade of the Royal Palace of Stockholm gold, and the water below copies the colour.
phrases.partly_golden: From the tower of the Flag Suite, guests turn full circle in the last hour of sun, with bright clouds over Gamla Stan and the Royal Palace of Stockholm.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in The Veranda, guests see the lit facade of the Royal Palace of Stockholm under a low cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of Gamla Stan stretch into long lines on the water.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the Rooftop Suite look over the lights of Gamla Stan.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit Royal Palace of Stockholm stands out across the dark water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Gamla Stan is quiet across the water, and the water in front of it barely moves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Gamla Stan across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, San Francisco Bay is a dark sheet under a clear sky, and Alcatraz Island is a low shape in the middle of it.
phrases.clear_morning: The Golden Gate Bridge stands sharp in the clear morning light, seen in part from Top of the Mark.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is clear, and guests at Top of the Mark count the boats crossing San Francisco Bay around Alcatraz Island.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across San Francisco Bay this morning, while Alcatraz Island stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the clouds drift over the Marin Headlands, and the Golden Gate Bridge goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, San Francisco Bay turns the colour of metal, and Alcatraz Island sits darker upon it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Golden Gate Bridge today, and guests wait to see if the towers will come out of it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Golden Gate Bridge and the Marin Headlands are not visible today; guests see the city skyline and the near edge of San Francisco Bay.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass at Top of the Mark, and Alcatraz Island is blurred in the grey San Francisco Bay.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows San Francisco Bay for a second, and guests in the upper-floor rooms watch the storm cross the city skyline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over San Francisco Bay, and Alcatraz Island slowly disappears behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold, clear air, guests stay behind the glass and see every line of the Golden Gate Bridge.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests on the 19th floor look north across San Francisco Bay to Alcatraz Island.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, San Francisco Bay shines like glass, and Alcatraz Island seems to float on it.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, small white sails dot San Francisco Bay, and guests follow them past Alcatraz Island.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights the Golden Gate Bridge from behind, and the Marin Headlands turn brown and gold beside it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds, and guests in the upper-floor rooms see the city skyline turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights spread below the 19th floor, and guests choose from the 100 Martinis menu while they look.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights smear across the windows of Top of the Mark, and San Francisco Bay is black behind them.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the low cloud over the city skyline glows with the light of the streets below.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lights of the Golden Gate Bridge draw a thin chain across the dark mouth of San Francisco Bay.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, San Francisco Bay is a wide black space beyond the streets, with Alcatraz Island somewhere inside it.
phrases.dusk: At dusk the sky is still bright over the Golden Gate Bridge, and guests in a lounge opened in 1939 watch the first lights come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: The view is still mostly dark, with a thin line of pale light growing where the day will start.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun reaches the view from one side, and every shape in it has a long shadow.
phrases.clear_midday: The sun is high, and the view is bright from end to end with almost no shadows.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass the sun this morning, and the view goes bright, then dull, then bright again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and shade take turns across the view this afternoon, and neither stays long.
phrases.overcast: Under an even layer of cloud, the view shows soft colours and no shadows at all.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs over the view today and gives everything in it a soft, pale edge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the near part of the view is clear today, and the distance behind it is pale and without detail.
phrases.rain: Rain crosses the view in grey lines today, and everything in it shines wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Each flash of lightning shows the whole view for a second before the thunderstorm darkens it again.
phrases.snow: Snowflakes drift across the view today, falling slowly and without a sound.
phrases.very_cold: The air is clear and the view is sharp today, right out to its far edge.
phrases.cold: The view keeps cool, quiet colours through this cold day.
phrases.very_hot: Heat makes the far part of the view tremble a little in the bright light.
phrases.warm: Warm air lies over the view today, and nothing in it seems to be in a hurry.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Long shadows return to the view as the low sun paints everything a warm gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights one part of the view orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under the evening cloud the view goes dark slowly, and its lights look brighter by the minute.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening dark, and every light in the view looks soft and blurred.
phrases.mild_night: With the stars behind cloud tonight, the only bright points in the view are its own lights.
phrases.clear_night: There are more stars than lights in the view tonight.
phrases.late_night: In the deep of the night the view is dark and quiet, with hours to go before first light.
phrases.dusk: The first lights come on in the view while there is still colour above it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Hudson River-facing rooms look out on calm grey water under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Beast & Butterflies, guests look down on Times Square in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Times Square lies below the rooftop terrace, every billboard sharp in the sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Hudson River this morning, and the water changes from grey to blue and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the fitness center window, guests on the bikes watch clouds and sun take turns over the buildings of Times Square.
phrases.overcast: The sky is flat and grey today, so the billboards of Times Square supply all the colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the edges of Times Square today, and from the rooftop terrace the billboards look like a watercolour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Hudson River is not visible in today's poor air, but Times Square, close below, is still clear to see.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the indoor glass perch at Beast & Butterflies, and Times Square below becomes a blur of wet colour.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Times Square, and guests in the rooms facing it watch the storm from behind soundproof windows.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the rooftop terrace and on Times Square below it, and the streets slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, bright day, the Hudson River looks like steel from the river-facing rooms on the higher floors.
phrases.cold: It is a cold day, and the indoor glass perch at Beast & Butterflies lets guests watch Times Square with their coats off.
phrases.very_hot: Heat rises from the streets of Times Square, and guests on the rooftop terrace watch it from above with a cold drink.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests stay out on the wrap-around terrace of Beast & Butterflies and watch the crowds in Times Square.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Hudson River gold, a calm sight on the quieter side of the hotel.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange above the Midtown skyscrapers, as seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: With cocktails at Beast & Butterflies, guests look down on the neon of Times Square under a grey evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the neon of Times Square shines twice, once on the billboards and once on the wet streets.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the clouds above Times Square glow pink and blue from the neon, as seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lights of Times Square are so bright that guests at Beast & Butterflies look for stars and find billboards.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who cannot sleep stand at the floor-to-ceiling windows and look down at the quiet streets of Times Square.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first neon signs of Times Square switch on below the rooftop terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Saltsjö Bay lies still and grey-blue, and the Djurgården shore slowly takes shape across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in SQ Bar & Restaurant, guests look out over bright water as the morning sun reaches Saltsjö Bay.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Djurgården shows its shoreline sharply across the blue water of Saltsjö Bay.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Stockholm's inlet this morning, and Djurgården turns bright and dull by turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the conference rooms, guests watch clouds drift over Djurgården and Stockholm city, and the meeting loses some attention.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Saltsjö Bay turns the colour of steel, and the Djurgården shoreline stays clear across it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on Saltsjö Bay today, and Djurgården is only a soft outline beyond the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the water of Saltsjö Bay is clear to see from the rooms facing it, but Djurgården is not visible beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of Stockholm's inlet, and guests in SQ Bar & Restaurant watch it from their tables.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Saltsjö Bay, and guests in this historic mill watch lightning flash above Djurgården.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Saltsjö Bay, and from the rooms facing the water Djurgården fades into white.
phrases.very_cold: The air above Stockholm's inlet is sharp and clear, and guests in SQ Bar & Restaurant study the Djurgården shore from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the conference rooms show Djurgården and Stockholm city in clean, cool light across the water.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the outdoor terrace of SQ Bar & Restaurant envy the ferries crossing the cool water of Saltsjö Bay.
phrases.warm: On the outdoor terrace of SQ Bar & Restaurant, drinks arrive and guests keep their eyes on the water toward Djurgården.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns Saltsjö Bay gold, and the Djurgården shore glows across the water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over Stockholm's inlet turn pink, and guests in the rooms facing the water stop unpacking to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Over dinner in SQ Bar & Restaurant, guests see the lights of Djurgården spread across dark water under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of Stockholm city blur on the wet surface of the inlet.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, guests in this 186-room hotel see the lights along Djurgården reflected in Saltsjö Bay.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear over Stockholm's inlet, and the city lights draw a bright edge along the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Saltsjö Bay is quiet, and from the sea-view rooms Djurgården rests as a low dark shape beyond it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Djurgården shore across Saltsjö Bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide grey sheet under a clear sky, and the first light grows along the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests swimming in the indoor magnesium pool look out over the resort and the Pacific Ocean in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: From the infinity edge of the outdoor pool, the Pacific Ocean is bright blue under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Pacific Ocean this morning, while the outdoor lagoon pool and the beach stay mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Presidential Suite on the 19th floor, guests watch cloud shadows cross the aquamarine water and the sandy beaches.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the white surf stands out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Pacific Ocean today, and guests on the treadmills in the fitness centre run towards a horizon that has gone missing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far horizon is not visible today; past the infinity edge of the outdoor pool, only the beach and the first lines of surf show.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pacific Ocean, and guests watch it from the indoor magnesium pool, already wet anyway.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the Pacific Ocean, and guests in the ocean residences above the 36th floor watch the lightning over the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach and into the Pacific Ocean, and guests in the ocean residences above the 36th floor stand at the windows to be sure.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and the sky is bright, and guests keep to the indoor magnesium pool, looking out at a sharp blue Pacific Ocean.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the fitness centre is a warm place to face the Pacific Ocean through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the water at the swim-up bar and look out over the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.warm: By the outdoor lagoon pool, guests lie under the palms and look past the infinity edge to the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Pool Bar, guests hold sunset spritzes while the Pacific Ocean takes on a golden light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds above the Pacific Ocean, and the infinity edge of the outdoor pool seems to run straight into the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the Pacific Ocean is a dark field, and the white surf still shows along the beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain hides the Pacific Ocean this evening, and guests at Lobby Bar look out at the wet resort instead.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests in the high-floor hinterland residences look over the city lights towards the Gold Coast Hinterland.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the Pacific Ocean on this clear night, and the surf draws a pale line along the beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pacific Ocean is dark and wide beyond the glass, and the surf keeps arriving on the empty beach.
phrases.dusk: Since 2022, guests here have watched dusk come to the Pacific Ocean, the sky still bright as the first lights come on along the coast.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Table Mountain is a flat black edge under a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches Table Mountain and Lion's Head, and guests in the mountain view rooms wake up facing both.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, Table Mountain stands sharp against a clear blue sky, its flat top like a line drawn with a ruler.
phrases.partly_morning: Small clouds drift past Lion's Head this morning, while Table Mountain stays in full sun above the Gardens rooftops.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the face of Table Mountain this afternoon, and guests follow them from one side to the other.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Table Mountain looks darker and closer, with palm trees and rooftops in front of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Table Mountain today, and guests see its outline more than its rock.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Table Mountain looks pale and flat, and Lion's Head is not visible at all.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites, and Table Mountain behind them is grey and blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Table Mountain, and guests count the seconds until the thunder reaches the Gardens rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the rooftops of Gardens, and guests look for Table Mountain through the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the air is clear, and Table Mountain shows every line of its rock face.
phrases.cold: A cold day makes the 113-year-old building feel warm inside, with Table Mountain filling the window.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the palm trees stand still and Table Mountain shimmers a little above the rooftops.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit in the balcony chairs and face Lion's Head and Table Mountain.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the rock of Table Mountain gold, and guests stop what they are doing to look.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above Table Mountain turn pink, and guests watch the colour change by the minute.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hide the stars this evening, but the lights of Gardens show guests where Table Mountain begins.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and guests see the street lights shine on wet roofs below a hidden Table Mountain.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, Table Mountain is a wide dark shape above the lights of the neighbourhood.
phrases.clear_night: Stars sit above Table Mountain tonight, and guests can follow its whole length across the clear sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the neighbourhood is quiet, and Table Mountain waits exactly where guests left it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind Table Mountain just after sunset, and the first lights come on across the rooftops below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide grey surface below the cliff, and the sky above it grows slowly lighter.
phrases.clear_morning: Over the free continental breakfast, guests look out at the Pacific Ocean and check the water for dolphins.
phrases.clear_midday: The Pacific Ocean is deep blue at midday, and from the oceanfront pool the horizon is a clean, straight line.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Shelter Cove this morning, and the Pacific Ocean changes from blue to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon clouds cross the Pacific Ocean, and the hot tub looks straight out at them.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the waves below the cliff show white.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Pacific Ocean today, and from the clifftop guests see only the nearest waves in Shelter Cove.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; the Pacific Ocean fades into pale air a short way beyond the coastal rocks.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pacific Ocean, and guests in the oceanfront rooms watch it through the glass of their balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Pacific Ocean for a second, and guests watching from the oceanfront rooms wait for the next flash.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the clifftop, and the flakes disappear into the grey Pacific Ocean below.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Pacific Ocean shows a sharp blue horizon beyond the coastal rocks.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Pacific Ocean looks darker, and guests watch it from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the oceanfront pool up to their shoulders and keep their eyes on the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.warm: On the sun deck, books stay closed while guests watch the Pacific Ocean for a dolphin's fin.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Pacific Ocean gold, and the coastal rocks beyond the oceanfront pool stand black against it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Pacific Ocean turn orange, and guests in the balcony rooms watch them change.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Pacific Ocean is almost black, and the white foam in Shelter Cove is the only thing that shows.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests in this 52-room clifftop hotel look out at a dark Pacific Ocean through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Pacific Ocean is a darker band under a sky without stars.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the Pacific Ocean tonight, and the horizon is only the place where they stop.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pacific Ocean below the cliff is more heard than seen, black water under a black sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays pink above the Pacific Ocean, and the first lights come on around the oceanfront pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear and Seville's spires stand as dark shapes above the rooftops around Terrace 1912.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun lights the 16th-century façade of the Ayuntamiento, and guests in the rooms facing Plaza San Francisco see every carved detail.
phrases.clear_midday: From Terrace 1912, guests look over Seville's spires and terracotta rooftops under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Plaza San Francisco this morning, and the Ayuntamiento façade turns bright and then dull again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At Terrace 1912, guests have tapas while clouds drift over the spires and tiled rooftops of Seville.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the terracotta rooftops keep their warm colour, and the spires stand clear above them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Seville's spires today, and from Terrace 1912 the far rooftops fade into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far spires are not visible from the rooftop today, so guests look at the near terracotta rooftops instead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Plaza San Francisco, and guests watch the wet paving shine from the Mercer Suite.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above Plaza San Francisco, and guests in the rooms facing the square watch the storm light the Ayuntamiento façade.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Plaza San Francisco, and the stone façade of the Ayuntamiento slowly turns white along its ledges.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and from the rooftop each spire of Seville stands sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the terrace of Bar Plaza still looks across Plaza San Francisco to the Ayuntamiento façade.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests sit in the rooftop plunge pool and look over Seville's spires and tiled rooftops.
phrases.warm: On the terrace of Bar Plaza, guests take a slow brunch and watch people cross Plaza San Francisco.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the 3 levels of Terrace 1912, guests watch the low sun turn Seville's spires and rooftops gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds, and the terracotta rooftops below the rooftop terrace glow orange for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening sky full of cloud, the street lamps of Plaza San Francisco light the Ayuntamiento façade from below.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Plaza San Francisco this evening, and the lights of the square shine back from the wet ground.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and Plaza San Francisco lies quiet under its lamps below the balcony suites.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in this hotel of 25 rooms look out on a clear night sky above the Ayuntamiento and Plaza San Francisco.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Plaza San Francisco is empty, and the Ayuntamiento stands silent across the square.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on among Seville's spires and rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Arno River is still and grey, and the Tuscan hills behind it slowly take shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches San Miniato al Monte on its hill, and the Arno River below is bright and calm.
phrases.clear_midday: From Empireo, guests can turn in a full circle under a clear sky and find the Duomo, the Arno River and the Tuscan hills.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the balcony rooms watch cloud shadows cross the Arno River and climb toward Piazzale Michelangelo.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Church of Santa Croce this afternoon, while the Arno River on the other side of the hotel stays in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Arno River looks like polished stone, and San Miniato al Monte stands pale on its hill above it.
