phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Tuscan hills today, and San Miniato al Monte looks like a faint drawing above the Arno River.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tuscan hills are not visible today; guests see the Arno River clearly, with Piazzale Michelangelo only faint above it.
phrases.rain: Rain dots the Arno River with small circles, and the hill of San Miniato al Monte turns grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the rooms facing the Church of Santa Croce watch lightning flash behind it and count the seconds to the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Arno River and disappears at once, while the hill of Piazzale Michelangelo slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests see every line of the far bank of the Arno River, up to Piazzale Michelangelo where the replica David stands.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Arno River runs quietly past the hotel, opened in 1860, and guests watch it from behind warm glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool at Empireo with a drink and look across at the Duomo.
phrases.warm: At Empireo, books stay open by the pool but nobody reads; the Arno River and San Miniato al Monte win.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests at Empireo, the rooftop built in 2014, watch the low sun turn the Duomo and the rooftops of Florence gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between clouds and lights San Miniato al Monte, while the Arno River is already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lamps of the Lungarno draw a yellow line along the Arno River.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the balcony rooms stay inside tonight and watch the lights along the Arno River shake in the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests see the Arno River carry the reflections of the city lights toward Ponte alle Grazie.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the Tuscan hills tonight, and guests pick out Piazzale Michelangelo by its lights across the Arno River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Arno River moves slowly past the sleeping city, and the hills behind it are only a dark shape.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Arno River is still bright, and guests at Empireo see the first lights of Florence come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Garda lies still and grey-blue below the suite terraces, and the limestone mountains wait for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun rises over Lake Garda, and guests in the Sky Suite watch it from bed with the blinds left open.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the infinity pool seems to float between blue Lake Garda and the limestone mountains.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Lake Garda this morning, and guests in the gym follow them through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests of this 2008 hillside resort look past olive groves to Lake Garda as clouds drift over the limestone mountains.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Lake Garda turns the colour of slate, and the panoramic sauna offers a warm glass seat above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog plays with the mountains around Lake Garda today, hiding one ridge and then giving it back.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far shore of Lake Garda cannot be seen today, and from the infinity pool only the near water and the wooded slopes below are clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lake Garda, and from the gym's floor-to-ceiling windows the mountains come and go behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls between the limestone mountains, and lightning shows Lake Garda far below the empty infinity pool.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the limestone mountains, and guests in the panoramic sauna watch the flakes drift down toward Lake Garda.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and through the glass wall of the fitness room every ridge around Lake Garda looks sharp.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of their suites and look down at a steel-blue Lake Garda.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across Lake Garda to the mountains.
phrases.warm: In the infinity pool, swimmers lose count of their laps because Lake Garda keeps taking their attention.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight warms the limestone mountains, and guests in the Royal Pool & Spa Suite see Lake Garda turn gold beyond their private infinity pool.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Lake Garda turn pink, and the Riviera dei Limoni below takes the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Riviera dei Limoni mark the shore, and Lake Garda is a wide dark space beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain taps on the large windows of the restaurant dining room this evening, and Lake Garda blurs behind the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the limestone mountains fade into the sky, and Lake Garda shows only as a paler surface far below.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over Lake Garda tonight, and the still infinity pool carries a few of them on its surface.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, nothing moves on Lake Garda, and the Riviera dei Limoni sleeps far below the hillside.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Lake Garda is still bright, and the first lights appear along the Riviera dei Limoni.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Reunion Tower is a tall outline behind the atrium glass, under a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun fills the 18-story atrium, and Reunion Tower stands sharp and clear behind the glass wall.
phrases.clear_midday: At Monduel's, guests look straight up through the colossal windows at Reunion Tower under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move behind Reunion Tower this morning, and from the atrium the tower itself seems to drift.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the treadmills in the fitness centre, guests watch cloud shadows cross the Dallas skyline this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Reunion Tower still fills the colossal windows at Monduel's under a flat grey sky.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Dallas skyline today, and from rooms facing it the towers look like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Dallas skyline is not visible today, but Reunion Tower, right beside the hotel, is still clear from the atrium.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass wall of the atrium, and guests watch Reunion Tower blur and return behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: From rooms facing the Dallas skyline, guests watch lightning show the downtown towers for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past Reunion Tower, and guests in the atrium watch the flakes cross the glass wall.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and from the fitness centre treadmills the Dallas skyline looks sharp in the cold light.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 1978 hotel see Reunion Tower through the atrium glass wall, no coat needed.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests in the rooftop pool float on their backs and look up at Reunion Tower.
phrases.warm: On the lounge chairs by the rooftop pool, guests leave their phones alone and look up at Reunion Tower in the warm air.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Reunion Tower gold, and guests at Monduel's watch the colour change through the colossal windows.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud and catches the glass of the Dallas skyline, seen from rooms facing it.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights of the Dallas skyline glow, and Reunion Tower rises above the guests at Monduel's.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain makes the city lights of the Dallas skyline run together on the fitness centre windows.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests on the top floors of the atrium look directly out at Reunion Tower.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and city lights spread out below the Dallas skyline for guests in rooms facing it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the atrium is quiet, and Reunion Tower stands alone behind the glass wall.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind Reunion Tower, and the first city lights come on as guests settle in at Monduel's.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the corner rooms, the Yodo River shows as a pale band under a clear sky before sunrise, with the Osaka skyline still grey beside it.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun lights the Osaka skyline tower by tower, a good reason for guests in the fitness center to stay on the treadmill a little longer.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in Jiang Nan Chun on the 37th floor, guests look up from their dim sum to the Osaka skyline under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Osaka this morning, while Osaka Castle stays in sunshine in the distance beyond the infinity pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the spa treatment rooms, the Osaka skyline sits under a mix of white cloud and blue sky this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, guests soaking in the ofuro baths on the 36th floor have the Osaka skyline in front of them, grey on grey.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the high-rise cityscape today, and from the fitness center the far towers look like pencil sketches.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Osaka Castle cannot be seen from the infinity pool today; only the nearer towers of the skyline are clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass behind the shoji screens of the GENSUI ryokan suites, and the Osaka skyline looks soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Osaka skyline, and guests in the private ofuro bath watch the storm through its glass walls.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Osaka, and swimmers in the infinity pool watch the flakes drift past the glass toward the city below.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the distant mountains stand sharp behind the Osaka skyline, and guests look at them from the hot ofuro baths.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the corner rooms stay by the glass, with the Yodo River on one side and the city on the other.
phrases.very_hot: Guests in the infinity pool on the 36th floor look down at Osaka in the heat and feel no need to go out there.
phrases.warm: A warm day brightens the Osaka skyline, and guests in this tower, opened in 2024, see it from the 37th floor at Jiang Nan Chun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the towers of the Osaka skyline gold, and guests in the infinity pool stop swimming to look.
phrases.partly_golden: At Bar Bota, guests watch the clouds over Osaka turn orange in the last hour of sun through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.grey_evening: At L'Abysse on the 37th floor, guests look out at the lights of Osaka glowing under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Wet weather streaks the floor-to-ceiling windows of Bar Bota this evening, and the city lights below blur into soft colours.
phrases.mild_night: Illuminated trains glide through Osaka under a cloudy night sky, and guests at Bar Bota follow them between the towers.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the city sparkles below Bar Bota, and guests compete politely for a seat by the glass.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the fitness center is still open, and a guest on the treadmill has the quiet, sleeping city of Osaka to look at.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright, and guests in the GENSUI ryokan suites on the 28th floor watch the first lights of Osaka come on through shoji screens.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Andaman Sea is a dark band beyond the gardens, and the clear sky above it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sky is clear, and the Andaman Sea is a clean blue behind the gardens and the pools.
phrases.clear_midday: The Andaman Sea is bright blue under the midday sun, and the sand of Mai Khao Beach looks almost white.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the gardens this morning, while the Andaman Sea beyond the palm trees stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pool villas, guests look past their private pool to Mai Khao Beach as clouds drift over the Andaman Sea this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Andaman Sea turns the colour of pewter, and the green of the gardens looks deeper.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Andaman Sea today, and guests find the line between water and sky difficult to see.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the horizon of the Andaman Sea is not visible, and guests see mainly the gardens, the pools and Mai Khao Beach.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pools and gardens; guests watch it from the suite terraces, the Andaman Sea grey behind the palm trees.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Andaman Sea, and guests follow the storm above the water from a dry seat indoors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees and on Mai Khao Beach, and guests look twice before they believe it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and the sky is clear, so the Andaman Sea looks sharp and blue beyond the empty gardens.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the pools lie still, and guests look over them from indoors to the Andaman Sea.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the adults-only pool and look out at the Andaman Sea.
phrases.warm: On a warm day at low tide, guests at the adults-only pool look across the sand of Mai Khao Beach to the Andaman Sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on Mai Khao Beach late in the afternoon, and the Andaman Sea shines behind the palm trees.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests on the suite terraces see the clouds over the Andaman Sea turn orange and pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds cover the evening sky, and the palm trees in the gardens stand still in front of the Andaman Sea.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening on the gardens, and guests hear the Andaman Sea more than they see it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the gardens below the suite terraces are quiet, and the Andaman Sea lies under a sky without stars.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear night sky over the Andaman Sea, and Mai Khao Beach is a pale line at the edge of the gardens.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the gardens and pools are silent, and the Andaman Sea is black beyond them.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky above the Andaman Sea is still bright, and the first lights come on around the pools.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Mount Etna is a dark shape above Taormina Bay, and the sky over the water slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Literary Terrace & Bar, the morning sun shows Mount Etna clearly at the centre of the panorama, with Taormina Bay below.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the stone columns of the Greek Theatre of Taormina stand sharp in front of Mount Etna from Ristorante Timeo.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the top of Mount Etna this morning, while Taormina Bay stays in sunshine beyond the pool terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the private terrace of the La Floresta Suite, cloud shadows move slowly across the island this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Taormina Bay turns the colour of slate, and Mount Etna keeps its full width on the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Taormina Bay today, and from the Literary Terrace & Bar Mount Etna is only a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Mount Etna is not visible today, so guests at Ristorante Timeo look at the nearer ruins of the Greek Theatre of Taormina instead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Taormina Bay; guests watch it from the balcony rooms, Mount Etna blurred behind the grey water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Taormina Bay for a second at a time, and then the storm clouds close over Mount Etna again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Taormina, and from Ristorante Timeo the columns of the Greek Theatre of Taormina turn white, one by one.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the air is very clear, and the snow on Mount Etna shines above the blue of Taormina Bay.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, Taormina Bay looks like steel from the Literary Terrace & Bar, and Mount Etna stands behind it.
phrases.very_hot: By the pool, guests stay in the water and look out over the Taormina coastline, which shimmers in the heat.
phrases.warm: At the Literary Terrace & Bar on this warm day, guests look at Mount Etna, which the painter Otto Geleng once admired from the hotel's terrace.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the columns of the Greek Theatre of Taormina gold, and from Ristorante Timeo Mount Etna fills the sky behind them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds around Mount Etna turn pink, and Taormina Bay takes the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights along Taormina Bay draw a long curve, seen from the Literary Terrace & Bar.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the coast lights blur for guests at Ristorante Timeo, and Mount Etna stays hidden in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the pool terrace the lights of Taormina's hillside town climb toward a sky without stars.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over Taormina Bay tonight, and guests in this hotel of 67 rooms can pick out the slope of Mount Etna against them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Taormina Bay is quiet and black, and Mount Etna can only be guessed at beyond it.
phrases.dusk: At Bar Timeo, guests hold their cocktails and watch the first lights appear along the coast under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Acropolis is a dark shape above the sleeping roofs of Athens.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Parthenon first, and guests in Acropolis view rooms see its columns turn from grey to gold.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Acropolis stands sharp above the city, its marble almost white from Première on the rooftop.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the rooftops of Athens this morning, while the Acropolis moves in and out of sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Première terrace, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift behind the Parthenon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Acropolis rock takes a darker tone, and the Parthenon stands pale on top of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Athens today, and the Parthenon looks like a pencil drawing above the roofs.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the Acropolis is only a faint outline and the columns of the Parthenon cannot be counted.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Athens; guests watch it from Acropolis view rooms, the Parthenon slightly blurred behind the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Athens, and for a second the Acropolis shows clearly against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Athens, and guests at the windows watch the Acropolis slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the air is sharp and the Acropolis looks close enough to touch from behind warm glass.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps guests inside Première, where the Acropolis fills the windows beside the tables.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the Première terrace keep to the shade and look at the Acropolis shimmering above the city.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests take a drink on the Première terrace and let the Acropolis do the talking.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Parthenon the colour of honey, and guests on the rooftop stop talking to look.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Acropolis turn pink and the marble glows beneath them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Acropolis glows above Athens, and guests at dinner in Première keep turning towards it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Acropolis blur into the rain beyond the windows of Première.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in a suite can see Lycabettus Hill lit against the dark sky of Athens.
phrases.clear_night: In a hotel that opened in 1982, guests look out on a clear night at the Acropolis, which is lit and rather older.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Athens is quiet, and the Acropolis rests as a dim form above the empty streets.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the rooftop guests see the first lights come on below the Acropolis.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Prague's rooftops show as a dark line under the first pale light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Prague's red rooftops, and guests in the Rudolf II Suite open a window over the Royal Gardens.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Prague's spires stand sharp above the red rooftops, almost easy enough to count to one hundred.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Prague this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the red rooftops.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Terasa U Zlaté studně, guests watch patches of afternoon sun travel from one red rooftop to the next.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Prague's red rooftops keep their colour, and the spires look darker above them.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies over Prague today; guests see the nearest red rooftops clearly, while the spires behind them fade one by one.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far part of Prague's skyline is not visible today, so the view stops at the Royal Gardens and the nearest red rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the red rooftops of Malá Strana, and guests watch it from the indoor terrace of Terasa U Zlaté studně.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests watch lightning flash over Prague's skyline, and for a second every spire stands out against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Prague, and the red rooftops turn white one by one below the windows of the Tycho de Brahe Suite.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air Prague's skyline is very clear, and guests study it from behind the glass at Terasa U Zlaté studně.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the garden-facing rooms look across the Royal Gardens to Prague's rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the red rooftops, and guests on the terraces of Terasa U Zlaté studně look out over Prague with cold drinks in hand.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in this former residence of Emperor Rudolf II open their windows over the green Royal Gardens.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Prague's red rooftops a deeper orange, and the spires throw long shadows across them.
phrases.partly_golden: From the three terraces of Terasa U Zlaté studně, guests watch the last sun slip between the clouds and touch the spires of Prague.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Prague glow below, and the rooftops become a field of small yellow windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Prague this evening, and the city lights shine back from the wet rooftops.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of Prague spread out beneath the spires of the skyline.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, stars sit above Prague's spires and the city lights fill the streets between the rooftops.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Prague is still, and its rooftops lie quiet under the night sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests watch the first lights come on across Prague's rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Edinburgh Castle stands unlit on its rock above Princes Street Gardens.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Edinburgh Castle first, then moves down the rock to Princes Street Gardens.
phrases.clear_midday: Edinburgh Castle stands sharp against a blue sky at midday, every wall and tower easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cross behind Edinburgh Castle this morning, and guests in the Caledonian Suite watch the light change on the rock.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows slide over Princes Street Gardens this afternoon, while Edinburgh Castle moves in and out of the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Edinburgh Castle takes almost the same colour as the rock below it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the foot of the rock today, so Edinburgh Castle seems to float above Princes Street Gardens.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor today, and Edinburgh Castle shows only as an outline, with no detail on its walls.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of Dean Banks at The Pompadour, and Edinburgh Castle looks blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind Edinburgh Castle, and for a second guests see every wall on the rock.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Princes Street Gardens, and Edinburgh Castle turns white along its walls.
phrases.very_cold: Frost stays on the lawns of Princes Street Gardens, and Edinburgh Castle looks very clear in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the castle-view windows and look at Edinburgh Castle from the warm side.
phrases.very_hot: In unusual heat, people lie on the grass in Princes Street Gardens, with Edinburgh Castle bright above them.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests in the Caledonian Suite look over the green lawns of Princes Street Gardens to Edinburgh Castle.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the stone of Edinburgh Castle gold, and guests at Dean Banks at The Pompadour stop talking to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud and lights one side of Edinburgh Castle, leaving the other in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit walls of Edinburgh Castle glow above the dark trees of Princes Street Gardens.
phrases.wet_evening: Over dinner at Dean Banks at The Pompadour, guests watch the lights of Edinburgh Castle shine through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and Edinburgh Castle shines on its rock under a low sky.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in this 1903 railway hotel look up at Edinburgh Castle, lit against a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Edinburgh Castle is a dark shape above Princes Street Gardens, and nothing moves below.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the walls of Edinburgh Castle.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear above Mount Etna, and the Ionian Sea below is still without colour.
phrases.clear_morning: From the pool, guests see Mount Etna above and the Ionian Sea below under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Ionian Sea is a strong blue below the vineyard terraces, and Mount Etna stands clear above them.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Mount Etna this morning, while the vineyards below stay mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, guests on the restaurant terrace watch cloud shadows move from Mount Etna down towards the Ionian Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Ionian Sea takes the same colour, and the vineyards are the only green in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Mount Etna today, and the Ionian Sea is only a lighter band below the vineyards.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Ionian Sea is not visible today; guests see the vineyards clearly and only the lower slopes of Mount Etna.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the vineyards, and guests in the rooms facing the volcano see Mount Etna slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Mount Etna for a second at a time, and thunder rolls down towards the Ionian Sea.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Mount Etna and on the vineyards, and the Ionian Sea has gone behind it.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests in the rooms facing the volcano can see every line of Mount Etna.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Mount Etna stands sharp above the vineyards, with the Ionian Sea grey-blue below.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the pool and look from Mount Etna down to the Ionian Sea without moving much.
phrases.warm: By the pool, books stay closed while guests look at Mount Etna and the Ionian Sea instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun warms the vineyards of this former winery, and Mount Etna turns gold above them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds around Mount Etna, and guests on the restaurant terrace watch them change.
phrases.grey_evening: From the restaurant terrace this evening, guests look down at the lights of the valley under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in the rooms facing the vineyards see the valley lights shine through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the top of Mount Etna tonight, and the lights of the valley shine below the vineyards.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Mount Etna tonight, and the valley lights below seem to answer them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Mount Etna is a dark shape above the estate, and the vineyards are completely still.
phrases.dusk: At dusk the sky is still bright behind Mount Etna, and the first lights come on in the valley below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tagus River is a wide grey band beyond the still rooftops of Alfama, seen from the rooms facing the river.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the dome of the National Pantheon stands white above the red rooftops of Alfama.
phrases.clear_midday: At Wine Bar & Terrace, guests share tapas at midday while the Tagus River shines blue beyond the Alfama rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Alfama slope this morning, and the Tagus River changes between silver and blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, guests follow patches of sun as they cross Alfama and reach the Church of São Vicente de Fora.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Tagus River loses its blue, and the red rooftops of Alfama become the only colour in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far bank of the Tagus River today, so guests at Wine Bar & Terrace study the nearer Alfama rooftops instead.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tagus River is not clear to see today; from the terrace, the eye stops at the Alfama rooftops and the Church of São Vicente de Fora.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tiled rooftops of Alfama, and guests in the rooms facing the river watch the Tagus River turn grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Alfama, and each flash of lightning shows the Tagus River for a second to guests inside Wine Bar & Terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the red rooftops of Alfama, and guests photograph it from Wine Bar & Terrace, once a photographer's apartment.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and the dome of the National Pantheon looks sharp above Alfama from the rooms facing the river.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the rooftop terrace is quiet, yet Alfama and the Tagus River are all still there below it.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the red pool and look over its edge at the Alfama rooftops and the blue Tagus River.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests settle in the alfresco lounges with Portuguese wine, and the Tagus River gets more attention than the conversation.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the white walls of Alfama, and the pool's red Bisazza tiles match the rooftops below.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the Church of São Vicente de Fora, while guests at Wine Bar & Terrace raise a cocktail to it.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Alfama glow on the slope, and the Tagus River is a dark band behind them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Alfama this evening, and from Wine Bar & Terrace the street lights shine on the wet rooftops.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud covers the sky tonight, and from the rooftop terrace the Tagus River shows only where the lights of Alfama end.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the rooms facing the river see the lights of Alfama run down to the Tagus River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Alfama sleeps on its slope, and the Tagus River moves quietly past with nobody watching.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Tagus River as the first lights come on across Alfama, seen from the terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Victoria Harbour lies still and dark blue, and the hills beyond Kowloon are just starting to show against the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Gallery, guests look out at Victoria Harbour in clear morning light, with Kowloon sharp on the far side.
phrases.clear_midday: From the infinity pool, Victoria Harbour is bright blue at midday, and the pool water seems to run straight into it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Victoria Harbour this morning, and the Kowloon skyline goes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In The Spa, guests look out from the treatment rooms at Victoria Harbour, where patches of sun and cloud take turns on the water.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, Victoria Harbour turns grey, and the red sails of a passing junk stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Victoria Harbour today, and from the Grand Harbour View Suites the Kowloon towers look like a soft pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The hills beyond Kowloon are not visible today; guests at the Nail Bar still see Victoria Harbour and the nearest boats on it.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the Grand Harbour View Suites, and Victoria Harbour and Kowloon blur behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Kowloon, and for a second the whole of Victoria Harbour shows white beyond the edge of the harbour-facing pool.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Victoria Harbour, and guests in the harbour-view rooms stand at the glass to watch Kowloon turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold, bright day, guests stay behind the glass of the Executive Club on the 45th floor and follow the boats on Victoria Harbour.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests sit by the windows in Gallery and watch the ferries cross Victoria Harbour, warm drink in hand.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across Victoria Harbour to Kowloon.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the sunbeds by the pool count the boats on Victoria Harbour and soon lose count.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Kowloon towers gold, and the corner Grand Harbour View Suites frame the full sweep of Victoria Harbour through floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Victoria Harbour turn orange, and the wrap-around balcony of the Executive Club faces all of it.
phrases.grey_evening: From a table in Lung King Heen, the first Chinese restaurant to win three Michelin stars, guests see the lights of Kowloon glow under low cloud across Victoria Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of Kowloon stretch into long bright lines on Victoria Harbour, seen from the windows of Lung King Heen.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud sits low over Kowloon tonight, and the city lights give it a soft glow above Victoria Harbour.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Kowloon skyline glitters across Victoria Harbour, and guests in the Executive Club find it difficult to go to bed.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Victoria Harbour is quiet, a wide dark space between Central and Kowloon.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Victoria Harbour is still bright, and the first lights come on along the Kowloon skyline, the ICC Tower among them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Nybroviken bay lies still and deep blue before sunrise, and the Royal Dramatic Theatre is a quiet shape across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the restaurant, guests look out at Nybroviken bay, bright and blue under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Royal Dramatic Theatre stands sharp and clear across Nybroviken bay at midday, with every detail of its front easy to see.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Nybroviken bay this morning, and the water changes from grey to blue and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests taking afternoon tea in the restaurant watch clouds drift over Nybroviken bay between one cup and the next.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Nybroviken bay takes the same colour, and the boats moored along Strandvägen barely move.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Nybroviken bay today, and guests in the sea-view rooms see the Royal Dramatic Theatre as a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Nybroviken bay is unclear today, so the Royal Dramatic Theatre is hidden and only the near water and Strandvägen can be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Nybroviken bay, and guests in the restaurant watch the drops mark the water outside.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Stockholm waterfront, and guests in the Dagmar Suite watch lightning flash above the harbour.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Nybroviken bay, and from the restaurant guests watch the far shore slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air above Nybroviken bay is sharp and clear in the freezing cold, and guests are happy to see it through glass.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this Art Nouveau house by architects Hagström and Ekman look out at a steel-coloured Nybroviken bay.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, people walk slowly along Strandvägen below the balcony rooms, and Nybroviken bay shines beside them.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests at lunch in the restaurant watch people walking beside the water of Nybroviken bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Nybroviken bay gold, and the Royal Dramatic Theatre glows warmly across the water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sunlight comes through broken clouds, and guests in the sea-view rooms see Nybroviken bay turn pink and grey.
phrases.grey_evening: At Andy's Cocktail Bar, guests look out at the harbour under evening cloud, with the waterfront lights reflected in the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Wet weather blurs the harbour lights this evening, and guests at Andy's Cocktail Bar find one more reason to order another drink.
phrases.mild_night: From Andy's Cocktail Bar, the harbour lights stretch along the Stockholm waterfront under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Royal Dramatic Theatre is lit across Nybroviken bay, a fine last picture for guests leaving Andy's Cocktail Bar.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Nybroviken bay is quiet, and the moored boats rest beside an empty Strandvägen.
phrases.dusk: The sky over Nybroviken bay is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Stockholm waterfront.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the towers of the Sagrada Família stand as a dark shape against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the towers of the Sagrada Família first, and guests on the penthouse terraces watch the light move down them.
phrases.clear_midday: From La Dolce Vitae, the Sagrada Família, Casa Batlló and the Glòries Tower are all sharp under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Sagrada Família this morning, while Passeig de Gràcia below stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the rooftops this afternoon, and from La Dolce Vitae guests follow them as far as the Glòries Tower.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the stone towers of the Sagrada Família take almost the same colour as the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and the Sagrada Família looks like a pencil drawing above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Glòries Tower is not visible from the rooftop today, and the Sagrada Família is only a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Passeig de Gràcia; guests in the rooms facing the boulevard watch umbrellas pass under the trees.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Sagrada Família, and for a second every tower stands out against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Passeig de Gràcia, and guests in the suites above the boulevard watch the pavements turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and from the rooftop terrace every tower of the Sagrada Família is easy to count.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Sagrada Família stands clear above the rooftops from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the Sagrada Família with only their heads above the water.
phrases.warm: On the La Dolce Vitae terrace, guests sit in the warm air and look down over the trees of Passeig de Gràcia.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Sagrada Família gold, and guests at La Dolce Vitae forget their glasses on the table.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and lights the towers of the Sagrada Família one at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit Sagrada Família glows above the dark rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: The wet pavements of Passeig de Gràcia shine under the street lamps this evening, and car lights draw long reflections on the boulevard.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, guests on the penthouse terraces look across the city lights to the lit Sagrada Família.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests look down on the lights of Passeig de Gràcia, the hotel's address since 1918.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Passeig de Gràcia is almost empty below, and only a few taxis pass along the boulevard.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the rooftop terrace guests see the first lights come on at the Sagrada Família.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky turns pale over the Caribbean Sea, and the golf course is still without colour.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Caribbean Sea in clear turquoise, and guests in the ocean-view suites have it straight in front of them.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, the midday view runs over the jungle canopy and the golf course to a bright blue Caribbean Sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the golf course this morning, while the Caribbean Sea behind it stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Behind the lobby bar, a wall of windows shows the mangroves under passing clouds and the Caribbean Sea in the distance.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Caribbean Sea loses its turquoise, and the green of the golf course becomes the strongest colour in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze blurs the horizon today, so from the beach the Caribbean Sea and the sky seem to be one pale sheet.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: from the rooftop pool guests see the golf course and the jungle canopy, but the far edge of the Caribbean Sea is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the wall of windows in the lobby bar, and the mangroves outside look greener for it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Caribbean Sea, and guests in the ocean-view suites watch the storm from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the golf course, and guests at the windows look twice before they believe the white fairway beside the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing, clear air, the Caribbean Sea stays sharp and blue beyond the empty golf course.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the beach stays empty, and the Caribbean Sea rolls in with nobody in front of it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the beach daybeds do very little except look at the Caribbean Sea, which is the right idea.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the beach watch kayaks and paddle boards cross the turquoise Caribbean Sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the golf course gold, and from the terrace suites guests see the Caribbean Sea go a deeper blue behind it.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop pool, the last sun colours the clouds orange and purple above the jungle canopy and the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars this evening, and from the rooftop pool the Caribbean Sea is a wide dark space beyond the golf course.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain falls on the pool below the lobby bar windows, and the Caribbean Sea behind it has disappeared into the night.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests in this 593-suite resort find the Caribbean Sea by the white of its waves on the beach.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lights of Isla Mujeres shine across the Caribbean Sea, and guests at the rooftop pool have stars above them as well.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the sky and the Caribbean Sea are almost the same black, and only the sand of the beach shows where the water begins.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Caribbean Sea, and the first lights of Isla Mujeres appear across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Brisbane River is still and dark under a clear sky, and Story Bridge slowly takes shape above it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Kangaroo Point Cliffs, and the Brisbane River below them is bright and calm.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 3rd-floor pool, Story Bridge stands sharp against a clear blue sky at midday.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Brisbane River this morning, while the Kangaroo Point Cliffs stay in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the 3rd-floor pool, white clouds drift over Story Bridge and the Brisbane River this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Brisbane River turns the colour of steel, and the green of the Botanic Gardens looks deeper beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Brisbane River today, and Story Bridge looks like a pencil drawing above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so guests see the Brisbane River below while the Kangaroo Point Cliffs are only faint.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Brisbane River, and guests in the gym watch Story Bridge through wet glass while the treadmills keep them dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Brisbane River, and for a second Story Bridge shows every line of its steel.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Brisbane River, and guests stand at the windows of all 252 rooms and suites to be sure of it.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing day, the Brisbane River is bright and sharp in the clear air, and every cable of Story Bridge is easy to see.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the gym look out through the tall windows at Story Bridge and the Brisbane River.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the water of the 3rd-floor pool and look across at Story Bridge.
phrases.warm: On the sun beds by the 3rd-floor pool, books stay closed while guests look at the Brisbane River instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Kangaroo Point Cliffs gold, and the Brisbane River below them takes the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: From the private terrace of the Plaza Suite, the last sun colours the clouds behind Story Bridge.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in La Boca Bar and Grill, guests look out at the Brisbane River, dark under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the three picture windows of the Story Bridge Suites, and the lights along the Brisbane River blur behind it.
phrases.mild_night: From the Stamford Suite, guests look down on the Brisbane River at night, with low cloud holding the glow of the city.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lights of Story Bridge lie in long lines on the Brisbane River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Brisbane River moves quietly past the Botanic Gardens, and nothing else seems awake.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Brisbane River, and the first lights come on along Story Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale behind Skeppsholmen Island, and Stockholms ström lies still and grey-blue below.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the sea view rooms watch the sun rise over Stockholms ström and Skeppsholmen Island.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Gamla Stan rooftops stand sharp from the balcony rooms, each ridge easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Stockholms ström this morning, while Skeppsholmen Island moves in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow a sailboat across Stockholms ström this afternoon as clouds drift over the Gamla Stan waterfront.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Stockholms ström turns the colour of steel, and the Gamla Stan waterfront keeps its warm red brick.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Gamla Stan rooftops today, and the farthest ones fade into the white sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Skeppsholmen Island is not visible today; the Gamla Stan waterfront and the nearest stretch of Stockholms ström stay clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Stockholms ström; guests watch the drops mark the water, the Gamla Stan waterfront shining wet below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Gamla Stan, and guests watch lightning flash above Stockholms ström.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Gamla Stan rooftops, and guests in the balcony rooms watch them turn white one by one.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the air is clear, and Skeppsholmen Island looks close enough to touch across Stockholms ström.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 1617 building look along the Gamla Stan waterfront to the grey water of Stockholms ström.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, Stockholms ström shines white in the sun, and guests look at the water with some envy.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests open the balcony doors and look over the Gamla Stan rooftops in the soft air.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the Gamla Stan rooftops, and the roofs glow orange against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and guests watch patches of light move across Skeppsholmen Island.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening of cloud, the lights of Gamla Stan reflect in Stockholms ström in long yellow lines.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests watch the lights of the Gamla Stan waterfront blur and shake on the dark water.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the Gamla Stan rooftops stand as dark shapes against a sky lit by the city.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above Stockholms ström tonight, and guests count them over Skeppsholmen Island, with mixed results.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, nothing moves on Stockholms ström, and the Gamla Stan waterfront is quiet.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights appear along the Gamla Stan waterfront.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Santorini Caldera is dark blue and still, and the volcano is a low shape on the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From the private verandas, guests see every fold of the volcano in the clear morning light on the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Aegean Sea is deep blue inside the Santorini Caldera, with the volcano sharp under a cloudless sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests watch cloud shadows cross the Santorini Caldera this morning, as the volcano goes from dark to bright and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The private infinity pools reflect passing clouds this afternoon, with the Santorini Caldera open beyond their edge.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Aegean Sea turns silver, and the volcano stands darker in the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Santorini Caldera today, and Thirassia island looks like a faint drawing across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the far side of the Santorini Caldera is not visible, and only the near cliffs and the water below are clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Santorini Caldera; guests watch it from their suites, the volcano blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm moves over the Santorini Caldera, and guests see the volcano appear for a second in each flash of lightning.
phrases.snow: Snowflakes fall past the cliff toward the Aegean Sea, and the volcano fades to grey in the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the volcano and the caldera cliffs look close enough to touch.
phrases.cold: The cold day makes the colours plain: a grey-blue Aegean Sea, a dark volcano, and the wide Santorini Caldera around them.
phrases.very_hot: At Miltos' Greek Table, guests sit against the caldera cliffs, which shimmer in the strong heat.
phrases.warm: In the warm air, guests in the 39 suites and villas leave their books closed and watch boats cross the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light warms the caldera cliffs, and the balcony of Lycabettus Restaurant waits for the evening with the volcano in front.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Santorini Caldera turn orange, and the Aegean Sea copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds cover the evening sky, yet guests at dinner at Lycabettus Restaurant still have the volcano in the frame, dark on the grey water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls into the dark Santorini Caldera this evening, and the volcano can only be guessed through the wet air.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hide the stars, and the Santorini Caldera is a wide, quiet space below the cliff.
phrases.clear_night: At Lycabettus Restaurant, guests have dinner under a starlit sky, and the Aegean Sea is so dark that the volcano needs some imagination.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Santorini Caldera is silent, and the volcano has the water to itself.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and from Lycabettus Restaurant guests see the volcano as a clear outline on the Aegean Sea.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Horseshoe Falls is a grey curve directly below, and the mist above it slowly takes the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Fallsview Regency Suite wake to Horseshoe Falls and American Falls together in one window under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, Horseshoe Falls is bright white directly below, and its mist rises straight into a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross American Falls this morning, while Horseshoe Falls stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows, guests watch clouds drift over Horseshoe Falls this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the white water of Horseshoe Falls stands out clearly against the dull river.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog and mist join over Niagara Falls today, and guests can only guess where one ends and the other begins.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: Horseshoe Falls is clear directly below, but American Falls is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass, and behind it Horseshoe Falls keeps pouring as if nothing had changed.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Niagara gorge, and guests high above watch the storm move across Horseshoe Falls.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Horseshoe Falls, and guests in the restaurant watch it through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the mist over Horseshoe Falls rises thick and white, and guests are glad to watch it from indoors.
phrases.cold: It is a cold day, and guests in falls-facing rooms of this 42-floor hotel look down on Horseshoe Falls from the warmth.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the mist rising from Horseshoe Falls looks cool, and guests admire it from behind the glass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests follow the white water from American Falls to Horseshoe Falls without leaving their seats.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the mist over Horseshoe Falls gold, and American Falls catches the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Niagara Falls change colour, and guests in the restaurant stop talking to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the nightly illumination lights up Horseshoe Falls and American Falls, and guests in rooms facing the falls leave the curtains open.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and the lit water of Horseshoe Falls still shines through it for guests high above.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests on the other side of the hotel look out at the lights of the city skyline.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, Niagara Falls is lit from end to end, and the mist above Horseshoe Falls glows.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Horseshoe Falls pours on below, with or without anyone awake to look.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset as the nightly illumination begins on Niagara Falls.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky grows pale above the columns of the Temple of Olympian Zeus, and the Acropolis waits for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on the Acropolis, and from the suite balconies the columns of the Temple of Olympian Zeus are easy to count.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Acropolis stands sharp and bright above the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Acropolis this morning, and their shadows cross Hadrian's Arch one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony suites this afternoon, guests find the Acropolis, Hadrian's Arch and the Temple of Olympian Zeus together under a half-cloudy sky.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the stone of the Acropolis looks paler, and guests notice its outline more than its colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Acropolis today, while Hadrian's Arch, only 100 m away, keeps its clear edges.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The hills beyond Hadrian's Arch are not visible today, but the arch itself and the Acropolis still show clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Acropolis; guests watch it from behind their balcony doors, the Temple of Olympian Zeus slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Plaka, and guests wait indoors for the next flash to show the Acropolis for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Acropolis, and guests in this hotel of 23 rooms watch Hadrian's Arch turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests can study every line of the Acropolis without opening a window.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps the rooftop terrace quiet, and the Acropolis stays in full sight above it.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the rooftop terrace look up at the Acropolis and feel glad they are not climbing it now.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit on the rooftop terrace among the olive plants and look across at the Acropolis.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Acropolis gold, and the columns of the Temple of Olympian Zeus throw long shadows.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Hadrian's Arch turn orange, and guests stop to look at the Acropolis glowing above Plaka.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds cover the evening sky, and the lit Acropolis glows under them above the streets of Plaka.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Acropolis shine through the rain, and guests see them again in the wet street below.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests look at the lit Acropolis and Hadrian's Arch, two landmarks that need no stars.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show in a clear sky tonight above the lit Acropolis and the columns of the Temple of Olympian Zeus.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Plaka is quiet, and the Acropolis is a dark outline above the roofs.
phrases.dusk: From the rooftop terrace, the Acropolis stands against a still-bright sky just after sunset, as the first lights of Plaka come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean is a wide dark surface under a clear sky, and the first light begins along the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun sits low over calm water, and guests on the oceanfront balconies look along the sandy shore.
phrases.clear_midday: From the higher floors, guests look past the surf break to the open Atlantic Ocean under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Atlantic Ocean this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the beach.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the oceanfront patio, guests see palm trees, beach umbrellas and the ocean under a partly cloudy sky.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns grey too, and the white surf break stands out clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic Ocean and the sky look like one soft grey sheet.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The open Atlantic Ocean is not visible today; guests see the beach and the first waves only.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Virginia Beach Boardwalk, and the wet sand and the grey waves take the same dull colour.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the Atlantic Ocean, and guests watch lightning above the dark water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach, and the sand turns white while the Atlantic Ocean stays dark grey.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the beach lies empty, and the Atlantic Ocean looks sharp and clear to the horizon.
phrases.cold: The Virginia Beach Boardwalk is quiet on this cold day, and guests look at long lines of surf from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the beach below is full of people, and the Atlantic Ocean looks like the only sensible place to be.
phrases.warm: On the oceanfront patio, guests sit by the palm trees and watch swimmers in the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the sand and the Virginia Beach Boardwalk, and the Atlantic Ocean turns a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests on the balconies stop talking for a moment.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening sky of cloud, the lights of the Virginia Beach Boardwalk run along the edge of the dark beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Virginia Beach Boardwalk this evening, and the ocean beyond them is black.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, guests see white surf appear from the dark and vanish again under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars hang over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and guests on the higher floors look far past the surf break.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the beach is empty, and only the white edge of the waves shows on the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests in this 2017 hotel see the first lights along the Virginia Beach Boardwalk.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the marina is a row of dark masts against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Sea View rooms, guests wake to a flat blue sea with the morning sun already on it.
phrases.clear_midday: At Pepper's Steakhouse, guests eat lunch with the marina shining white and blue outside.
phrases.partly_morning: The sea changes from blue to grey and back again as each cloud passes this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at Side Bar watch sun and shade take turns on the boats in the marina.
phrases.overcast: White boats stand out clearly in the marina today, with grey water below them and grey cloud above.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze has softened the sea today, and the far end of the marina fades into pale grey.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The nearest boats in the marina are clear today, but the open sea beyond them is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is drawing thousands of small circles on the sea, and the horizon has turned a soft grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Each flash of lightning shows every mast in the marina for a second to the guests watching from Side Bar.
phrases.snow: Behind the glass of the Sea View rooms, guests watch snowflakes disappear into the sea.
phrases.very_cold: No one is in a hurry to leave Pepper's Steakhouse today, where guests watch the marina from behind warm glass.
phrases.cold: Guests in the Sea View rooms keep their jumpers on and their eyes on a steel-blue sea.
phrases.very_hot: The sea lies flat and bright blue in the heat, with a pale line where it meets the sky.
phrases.warm: Guests at Side Bar sit with cold drinks, counting the boats that come and go in the marina.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Every mast in the marina draws a long shadow across the water as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lays an orange stripe across the sea.
phrases.grey_evening: Over dinner at Pepper's Steakhouse, guests look at the marina lights shining under a low, cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The marina lights stretch into long wet reflections tonight, and guests at Pepper's Steakhouse watch them through the rain over dinner.
phrases.mild_night: With no stars tonight, the sea is a wide dark space with a thin white line of waves at its edge.
phrases.clear_night: Stars reach all the way down to the horizon tonight, and the sea below them is completely black.
phrases.late_night: The sea is almost invisible now, only a faint line of white showing where the waves break.
phrases.dusk: At Side Bar, guests watch the marina switch on its lights one by one while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Early guests in the Clubhouse Suite can pick out the BT Tower before sunrise, a dark shape above the sleeping city.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the restaurant, guests look across to the Eye and The Shard, both sharp in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Lunch guests in the restaurant look out over Regent's Park, green and bright in full sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Studio Suite, guests watch the skyline change colour each time a cloud passes.
phrases.fog_haze: Canary Wharf has gone into the haze, and from the restaurant The Shard is only a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests in the Connecting Clubhouse Suite can see the BT Tower clearly today, but not much of the city beyond it.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the Clubhouse Suite, and the BT Tower stands grey above the wet city.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is moving over the panoramic skyline, and guests in the Studio Suite have put their books down to watch.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Clubhouse Suite stay warm behind the glass while the BT Tower stands sharp over the frosty city.
phrases.cold: Coats stay on their hooks in the Connecting Clubhouse Suite, where guests look out at the BT Tower over the city.
phrases.very_hot: At The Nest - Rooftop Bar, guests hold cold drinks and turn slowly to take in the 360-degree skyline.
phrases.warm: On a warm afternoon the tables at The Nest - Rooftop Bar fill up, with the 360-degree skyline open on every side.
phrases.partly_golden: Canary Wharf catches the last sun between the clouds, while the Eye is already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: In the restaurant, guests at dinner see the Eye lit against a cloudy evening.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the Eye spread into soft colours through the rain tonight.
phrases.mild_night: The BT Tower shines over the city tonight, and guests in the Clubhouse Suite leave the curtains open.
phrases.late_night: The city has gone quiet around the BT Tower, and guests in the Connecting Clubhouse Suite are still looking.
phrases.dusk: At The Nest - Rooftop Bar, guests watch lights come on across the 360-degree skyline while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Chao Phraya River lies quiet under a clear sky, and the first grey light shows on the water below the balconies.

phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Chao Phraya River this morning, and patches of sun and shade cross the water one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In Tea Lounge, guests take afternoon tea while cloud shadows drift over the lily pond and the Chao Phraya River behind it.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the Chao Phraya River turns the colour of milk tea, which suits the guests in Tea Lounge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Chao Phraya River today, and from Tea Lounge the far bank looks like a faint watercolour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far bank of the Chao Phraya River is unclear today, and guests in Côte by Mauro Colagreco see mainly the water close to the hotel.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Chao Phraya River, and guests in Côte by Mauro Colagreco watch the drops mark the whole surface.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the Chao Phraya River, and guests behind the floor-to-ceiling windows see the water turn white for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Chao Phraya River, and guests in Tea Lounge watch the flakes disappear as they touch the water.
phrases.very_cold: The Chao Phraya River looks sharp and bright in the freezing air, and guests admire it from the warm side of the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in Tea Lounge hold a hot cup and follow the slow water of the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across its edge at the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.warm: Guests rest in the cabanas by the infinity pool on this warm day, with the Chao Phraya River moving past just beyond.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Chao Phraya River to gold, and guests on the suite balconies raise a glass of Champagne to it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in long bands, and the Chao Phraya River changes from gold to pink beside the infinity pool.
phrases.grey_evening: From a dinner table in Côte by Mauro Colagreco, the Chao Phraya River glitters with city lights under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass at Côte by Mauro Colagreco this evening, and the lights on the Chao Phraya River stretch into long wet lines.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the 101 suites and villas step onto balconies and terraces to see the lights on the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.clear_night: The sky is clear tonight, and the Chao Phraya River carries the city lights in long reflections past the infinity pool.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Chao Phraya River flows on quietly past the villa gardens, and nothing else seems to move.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Chao Phraya River beyond the infinity pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Serra de Sintra is a dark outline above the golf course, and the sky behind it is just starting to turn pale.

phrases.partly_afternoon: From the covered driving range, guests look down a green fairway lined with trees as clouds drift over it this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: The tall gym windows frame the wooded Serra de Sintra under a flat grey sky, a good reason to rest between exercises.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Serra de Sintra today, and from the Sintra Suite terrace guests see only the monastery chapel below and the nearest trees.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far ridges of the Serra de Sintra are not visible today; the golf course and the nearest pines are still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the wooded hills of the Serra de Sintra, and the fairways below turn a deeper green.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Presidential Suite watch lightning flash over the Serra de Sintra while thunder rolls across the golf course.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Serra de Sintra, and the green fairways of the golf course are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, every tree on the Serra de Sintra looks sharp, and guests admire the forest from the warm side of the gym windows.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the infinity pool lies empty, and the green hillside of the Serra de Sintra seems to begin at its edge.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look across the water to the dense green forest of the Serra de Sintra.
phrases.warm: On the sun loungers by the infinity pool, guests keep their eyes on the forested hillside of the Serra de Sintra and forget their phones.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Cascais Suite terrace, guests watch the late sun turn the pines and the slopes of the Serra de Sintra gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the 14th-century monastery, with the Serra de Sintra already in shadow behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the Serra de Sintra is a darker band beyond the gardens, seen from the candlelit tables of the terrace bar.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain runs down the glass of the terrace bar, and guests see the wet gardens while the wooded hills disappear.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Serra de Sintra can hardly be told from the sky, and the golf course is a quiet open space below.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Serra de Sintra, and guests can still follow the top of the ridge against them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, nothing moves on the golf course, and the Serra de Sintra waits quietly for morning.
phrases.dusk: At the terrace bar, guests see the sky stay bright above the Serra de Sintra as the first candles are lit on the tables.

phrases.clear_predawn: Palm Jumeirah is still a dark shape on the water, with the Dubai skyline only an outline behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: Early guests walk down to the beach while the sand is still cool and the Dubai skyline stands clear behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: The beach is almost white at this hour, and the water around Palm Jumeirah is a deep blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Palm Jumeirah is half in sun and half in shade this morning as clouds pass over the beach.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At 101 Dining Lounge & Bar, guests watch cloud shadows move across the Dubai skyline this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey ceiling of cloud, Palm Jumeirah shows its whole shape without any glare.
phrases.fog_haze: The Dubai skyline has gone into the haze for now, and Palm Jumeirah is left pale and soft at the edges.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Dubai skyline is not visible in today's low visibility, and only the nearer part of Palm Jumeirah can be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain darkens the sand of the empty beach, and Palm Jumeirah fades to grey beyond it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Palm Jumeirah, and for a second the whole beach turns white.
phrases.snow: Snow on Palm Jumeirah is something nobody packed for, and it is falling on the beach right now.
phrases.very_cold: The beach is empty today, and every line of Palm Jumeirah stands out sharp and clear.
phrases.very_hot: Palm Jumeirah shimmers in the heat while guests on the beach stay close to the water.
phrases.warm: Today the beach access is busy, with guests walking down to the sand and Palm Jumeirah in front of them.
phrases.partly_golden: Each time a cloud crosses the sinking sun, Palm Jumeirah goes from warm orange to grey and back.
phrases.grey_evening: Evening guests at 101 Dining Lounge & Bar look across at the Dubai skyline, its lights soft under the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain blurs the lights of Palm Jumeirah into soft dots for guests staying dry in the Palm Manor Executive Suite.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight's cloud hides the stars, so the only lights to count are the ones on Palm Jumeirah.
phrases.clear_night: The Dubai skyline stands lit and sharp tonight, and the beach in front of it is dark and quiet.
phrases.late_night: Palm Jumeirah is quiet in the small hours, and the beach is left to the waves.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, lights switch on along Palm Jumeirah one by one while the Dubai skyline still stands against a bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Lake Como lies in a blue half-light, and the first colour of the day is only starting to show.
phrases.clear_morning: A cloudless morning puts clean, bright light on the whole of Lake Como.
phrases.clear_midday: Lake Como is at its brightest now, with the sun high and the colours strong.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over Lake Como this morning, and the sun returns between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over Lake Como this afternoon, and neither stays for long.
phrases.overcast: A full cover of cloud gives Lake Como a calm, silver-grey day.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist keeps hiding one part of Lake Como and showing another.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the air over Lake Como is not clear, and only the nearer part of the view can be seen.
phrases.rain: Lake Como turns grey and soft under the rain, and the far side of the view fades.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is crossing Lake Como, and each flash of lightning shows the dark water for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow falls quietly into Lake Como and disappears the moment it touches the water.
phrases.very_cold: Frozen air makes every line of Lake Como look clean and exact today.
phrases.cold: Lake Como has a cool, quiet look today, and the water lies dark and still.
phrases.very_hot: Heat hangs over Lake Como, and the water looks like the only cool thing in sight.
phrases.warm: Lake Como looks made for a swim today, its water calm and shining in the warm air.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Shadows grow long on Lake Como as the low sun gives everything a warmer colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and colours them orange and pink above Lake Como.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening of low cloud, the lights around Lake Como are reflected in the dark water.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain blurs the lights around Lake Como into soft spots of gold.
phrases.mild_night: No stars tonight, only the dark shape of Lake Como and a few lights along its edge.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above Lake Como tonight, and there is not a cloud to cover them.
phrases.late_night: At this late hour Lake Como is only a dark, quiet shape below the night.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the first lights appear around Lake Como while the sky still holds its colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Plaza de Catalunya lies almost empty before sunrise, its trees still dark under a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the top-floor balcony rooms open their blinds to the full breadth of Plaza de Catalunya, its fountains bright in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests on the higher floors catch a glimpse of the Port of Barcelona beyond the rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Plaza de Catalunya this morning, and the fountains move in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, guests watch clouds drift over the rooftops of Barcelona, with patches of blue between them.
phrases.overcast: Grey suits the old stone of Santa Anna Church, which guests see from the outdoor terrace of Nineteen.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the buildings around Plaza de Catalunya today, and the far side of the square looks like a faded photograph.
