phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the Port of Barcelona is hidden and the view stops at the trees and fountains of Plaza de Catalunya.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Plaza de Catalunya, and guests behind their balcony doors watch the fountains get some competition.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the rooftops of Barcelona, and for a second the whole of Plaza de Catalunya turns white.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the trees and paths of Plaza de Catalunya, and the square below turns white and quiet.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, and from the rooftop terrace guests can pick out each roof of the city.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the trees of Plaza de Catalunya stand still below, and the fountains keep running for nobody in particular.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the rooftop terrace stay under the umbrellas and look across the bright rooftops of Barcelona.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, people walk slowly between the fountains of Plaza de Catalunya, and guests watch them from above like a quiet film.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the buildings around Plaza de Catalunya gold, and guests watch it from their top-floor balcony rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lights the city rooftops one group at a time, seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: From the outdoor terrace of Nineteen, guests look over the medieval Santa Anna Church under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain makes the paving of Plaza de Catalunya shine this evening, and the lit fountains are reflected in it.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hold the glow of the city tonight, and the streets around Plaza de Catalunya stay bright below.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit fountains of Plaza de Catalunya shine between the dark trees.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Plaza de Catalunya is quiet, a wide open space between sleeping buildings.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the first lights come on around Plaza de Catalunya and the fountains begin to glow.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Prague Castle is a still outline above the sleeping roofs of New Town, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the top-floor rooms wake to the full silhouette of Prague Castle, sharp in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, every tower in the outline of Prague Castle stands out above the city.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move over the New Town roofs this morning, and Prague Castle goes from grey to bright and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the private dining room, guests see Prague Castle and the city skyline through the rooftop windows, with clouds drifting above.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Prague Castle keeps its full silhouette above the city, only with less colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over New Town today, and guests find Prague Castle as a faint outline floating above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the nearby roofs of New Town are clear, but Prague Castle cannot be seen from here.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the angled dormer skylights, and guests in the top-floor rooms see Prague Castle slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole of Prague Castle for a second, then the storm takes the skyline back.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the roofs of New Town, and guests watch Prague Castle slowly turn white in the distance.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests stay behind the glass and look at Prague Castle, sharp in the cold air.
phrases.cold: Guests in this early 20th-century Art Deco building look out on a cold day and find Prague Castle clear above the city skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the roofs of New Town shimmer, and Prague Castle seems to tremble a little above them.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests look across the bright roofs of New Town to Prague Castle, clear above the city.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Prague Castle gold, and guests in the Penthouse Suite watch it through the rooftop windows.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds behind Prague Castle turn pink, and guests stop to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Prague Castle glows above the city, and the low sky takes some of its light.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Prague Castle blur on the glass, and guests watch from the dry side.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests on the top floor see Prague Castle lit above the lights of New Town.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the lit towers of St. Vitus Cathedral stand above the city lights at Prague Castle.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city is quiet, and Prague Castle is only an outline above the roofs for guests still awake.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on along Prague Castle and the city skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Herengracht is still before sunrise, and the canal houses on the other bank are only outlines against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Herengracht, and each of the five windows of the Brentano Suite frames a different stretch of the canal.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, guests look over the canal houses of the Canal Ring under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cross the Canal Ring this morning, and the Herengracht turns from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests count the boats on the Herengracht this afternoon while cloud shadows move along the canal houses.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky, grey water: today the Herengracht matches the clouds, and the canal houses stand out between the two.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Herengracht, and guests see the nearest canal houses clearly while the next ones fade.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Herengracht and the houses across it are clear, but the further roofs of the Canal Ring cannot be seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Herengracht with small circles, and guests in the Brentano Suite have five windows to watch it from.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Canal Ring, and each flash of lightning shows the Herengracht white for a moment.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Herengracht and settles on the moored boats, and guests watch the Canal Ring turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and the Herengracht lies motionless in front of the six 17th-century canal houses.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass and follow a single boat along the Herengracht.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, boats full of people pass slowly on the Herengracht, and guests watch them from the shade of their canal-facing rooms.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the rooftop terrace look across the roofs of the Canal Ring and stay for one more hour.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the canal houses gold, and the Brentano Suite shows the long line of the Herengracht through its five windows.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and colours the Canal Ring as far as the Amstel River.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit windows of the canal houses lay yellow stripes on the Herengracht.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and guests watch the lights of the Canal Ring break up on the Herengracht.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests see the Herengracht as a quiet band of water between the lit canal houses.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Herengracht holds a second row of lights under the real one, and the copy in the water is almost as good.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Herengracht is empty and quiet, and the canal houses lean towards the street as they have since the 17th century.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Herengracht, and the first lamps come on in the canal houses across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale behind the Sagrada Família, and Passeig de Gràcia lies almost empty below.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches down Passeig de Gràcia, and the towers of the Sagrada Família stand sharp against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: On a clear midday, guests on the rooftop terrace can see past the city to the Mediterranean Sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly down Passeig de Gràcia this morning, while the Sagrada Família stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Mirador Casa Fuster, guests watch clouds drift over Tibidabo while the afternoon sun stays on Passeig de Gràcia.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Sagrada Família turns the same grey, and the trees of Passeig de Gràcia keep their green.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Sagrada Família today, and its towers look like a pencil drawing above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Tibidabo and the Mediterranean Sea are not visible today, but Passeig de Gràcia is still clear from the balcony suites.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Passeig de Gràcia, and guests in the balcony suites watch umbrellas move along the wet avenue.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Barcelona, and for a second the towers of the Sagrada Família stand out against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Passeig de Gràcia, and guests watch from their balcony doors as the treetops slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is clear today, and from the rooftop terrace Tibidabo shows every detail behind the city.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Sagrada Família stands clear on the horizon, far beyond the rooftops of Barcelona.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stand in the rooftop pool and look at the Sagrada Família with only their heads above water.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, guests leave their books closed and look across the rooftops to the Sagrada Família instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the stone of the Sagrada Família gold, and guests at Mirador Casa Fuster forget their drinks for a moment.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun breaks through the clouds and lights Passeig de Gràcia from end to end below the rooftop terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit towers of the Sagrada Família glow above the rooftops for guests at Mirador Casa Fuster.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain shines on Passeig de Gràcia this evening, and the street lamps draw long reflections on the wet pavement.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, guests on the rooftop terrace follow the lights of Passeig de Gràcia into the distance.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Sagrada Família is lit on the horizon, as if left on for guests on the rooftop.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Passeig de Gràcia is quiet, and only a few cars pass under the balconies Lluís Domènech i Montaner designed in 1908.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Passeig de Gràcia below Mirador Casa Fuster.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear and slowly growing pale, and the Parliament dome is a dark shape across the Inner Harbour.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in AURA, guests watch the first floatplanes of the morning land on the Inner Harbour under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, floatplanes land in their lanes between the water taxis, and the Parliament dome stands sharp across the Inner Harbour.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Inner Harbour this morning, and guests on their balconies follow a ferry as it turns at the point.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the tall windows of the lobby, enlarged in 2020, guests look out at the Inner Harbour under passing clouds, as if from the prow of a ship.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the Inner Harbour takes the same colour, and the water taxis keep crossing it all the same.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Inner Harbour today, and the city skyline looks like a faint drawing behind the boats.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Parliament dome is not visible across the water today; the view ends at the Japanese garden and the nearest boats on the Inner Harbour.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Inner Harbour with small circles, and a water taxi crosses it anyway.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Inner Harbour for a second, and guests at the lobby windows count until the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Japanese garden and its two ponds, and the Inner Harbour beyond looks white and quiet.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, bright day, guests on the indoor pool's outdoor terrace would be brave, so the Inner Harbour is watched from the lobby windows.
phrases.cold: In the cold air, the Victoria skyline looks sharp on every side of the Mayr's Suite bedroom.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests sit very still on their balconies and let the floatplanes do all the moving on the Inner Harbour.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit on the water-level terrace at AURA, close enough to the Inner Harbour to watch each boat pass.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Parliament dome gold across the water, and guests in the corner suites see the Inner Harbour on two sides.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud and lights the Parliament dome, while the day's final floatplanes come in to land.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at dinner in AURA look across the dark water to the lights of the Inner Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening lights of the Inner Harbour, and their reflections stretch across the water.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the city skyline glows across the Inner Harbour beneath low cloud.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests on the rooftop terrace see the lights of the city skyline in a row across the Inner Harbour, each with a twin in the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Inner Harbour is quiet, with no floatplanes and no ferries, only calm water around the point.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on around the Inner Harbour, one after another.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear over the Arabian Sea, and the long curve of Marine Drive is only a darker line beside the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From the seafront corner suites, guests look three ways along Marine Drive as the clear morning light reaches the promenade.
phrases.clear_midday: The Arabian Sea is bright blue under a clear midday sky, and the whole curve of Marine Drive is easy to follow from the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Arabian Sea this morning, and the promenade of Marine Drive goes from bright to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the bay windows look up from their desks this afternoon, as clouds drift over the Arabian Sea and work waits.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Arabian Sea turns the colour of the clouds, and the curve of Marine Drive stays clear along its edge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the bay today, and the far end of Marine Drive fades into the Arabian Sea.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of Marine Drive is not visible today; guests see the near promenade and a short stretch of the Arabian Sea.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Marine Drive, and guests watch it through the bay windows as the Arabian Sea turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Arabian Sea for a second, and guests in the seafront corner suites watch the storm cross the bay on three sides.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Marine Drive, and from the rooftop pool terrace the Arabian Sea is grey behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and from the rooftop pool terrace every art deco facade along Marine Drive stands out against the bay.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the Arabian Sea looks like steel from Dome, and the curve of Marine Drive is sharp against the water.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat guests stay in the rooftop pool, a few steps above Dome, and look out over the bright Arabian Sea.
phrases.warm: On this warm day guests rest by the rooftop pool, and books stay closed while the Arabian Sea fills the view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Dome, guests watch the sun go down towards the Arabian Sea in a clear sky, with Marine Drive turning gold below.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds over the Arabian Sea, and guests at Dome watch the water change from gold to pink.
phrases.grey_evening: The sky is cloudy this evening, but from Dome the lights of the Queen's Necklace still draw a clear curve around the bay.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Queen's Necklace this evening, and the wet promenade shines back under each lamp.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night the Queen's Necklace shines under low cloud, and its lamps reflect in the Arabian Sea below the rooftop pool terrace.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky the Queen's Necklace shines along the bay, and from the rooftop pool terrace each lamp is easy to count.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Marine Drive is quiet and almost empty, and the Arabian Sea is a wide black space beside it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Arabian Sea, and guests in this 59-room hotel watch the first lamps of the Queen's Necklace come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Melbourne Skyline is a group of dark towers behind the MCG, under a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on the Melbourne Skyline, the MCG and the trees of Fitzroy Gardens, all sharp from the Executive Lounge.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests in the Executive Lounge on the 18th floor can follow the Melbourne Skyline all the way to Port Phillip Bay.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the MCG this morning, while the Melbourne Skyline behind it stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass above the Melbourne Skyline this afternoon, and sun and shade take turns on the trees of Treasury Gardens.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Melbourne Skyline takes the same colour, and Fitzroy Gardens and Treasury Gardens keep their green.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Melbourne Skyline today, and the towers behind the MCG look like a drawing in grey pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Port Phillip Bay is not visible today and the Melbourne Skyline is faint, but guests in the Executive Lounge still see the MCG and Fitzroy Gardens clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the MCG; guests watch it from the Executive Lounge, the Melbourne Skyline slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Melbourne Skyline, and for a second every tower shows clearly above the MCG.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Fitzroy Gardens, and guests stand at the windows as the Melbourne Skyline turns white and soft.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, bright day, the air is clear, and Port Phillip Bay shows as a blue line beyond the Melbourne Skyline.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this hotel of 419 rooms stay behind the large windows and look across Treasury Gardens to the Melbourne Skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool and look at the parkland trees and the Melbourne Skyline beyond them.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, the lounge chairs by the outdoor pool fill, with the parkland trees and the towers of the Melbourne Skyline behind the umbrellas.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the Melbourne Skyline gold, and the MCG glows in front of it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests in the Executive Lounge watch the clouds over Port Phillip Bay turn orange and pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit towers of the Melbourne Skyline give the low sky a soft glow above Fitzroy Gardens.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Melbourne Skyline run down the glass, and guests in the Executive Lounge keep their seats.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests in the William Clarke Sky Villa look from the bath over the MCG to the lit Melbourne Skyline.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and Eureka Tower and Australia 108 stand lit above the rest of the Melbourne Skyline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city is quiet, and the MCG is a wide, still bowl in front of the Melbourne Skyline.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on in the Melbourne Skyline behind the MCG.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Venetian Lagoon lies still and grey-blue, and San Giorgio Maggiore waits across the water for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Terrazza Danieli, guests look across the bright Venetian Lagoon to the domes of San Giorgio Maggiore.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun turns the Venetian Lagoon a strong blue, and San Giorgio Maggiore stands sharp across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Venetian Lagoon this morning, and the gondolas along the Riva degli Schiavoni rock in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From their suite balconies, guests watch the afternoon clouds drift over San Giorgio Maggiore and the Venetian Lagoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Venetian Lagoon turns a dull silver, and the boats crossing it leave white lines behind them.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Venetian Lagoon today, and San Giorgio Maggiore seems to float, as it has for guests here since 1822.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today: the near water of the Venetian Lagoon is clear, but San Giorgio Maggiore cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Venetian Lagoon with small rings, and guests in the lagoon-facing rooms watch San Giorgio Maggiore blur behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Venetian Lagoon for a second, then San Giorgio Maggiore goes dark again until the next flash.
phrases.snow: Snow falls into the Venetian Lagoon and disappears, while the gondolas along the Riva degli Schiavoni slowly turn white beside the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: The cold makes the air very clear, and from the Presidential Suite on the 4th floor guests look over the Venetian Lagoon towards San Giorgio Maggiore.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass of Terrazza Danieli and let the boats cross the Venetian Lagoon without them.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Venetian Lagoon, and guests on the rooftop terrace envy every boat that makes its own breeze.
phrases.warm: On the open-air terrace of Terrazza Danieli, guests sit in the warm air with the Venetian Lagoon and the city's domes spread out around them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Venetian Lagoon gold, and from Terrazza Danieli St. Mark's Campanile catches the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights San Giorgio Maggiore, while the Venetian Lagoon around it is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Terrazza Danieli, the clouds hide the stars, so guests look at the lights around the Venetian Lagoon instead.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Venetian Lagoon this evening, and the lights across the water stretch into long wet reflections.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the Venetian Lagoon is calm, and a few lights near San Giorgio Maggiore sit low across the water.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Venetian Lagoon tonight, and guests in the lagoon-facing rooms leave the curtains open a little longer.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Venetian Lagoon is a quiet black surface, and almost no boat crosses it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky over the Venetian Lagoon is still bright, and the first lights come on along the water's edge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, early guests in the Tower Observatory see Horseshoe Falls as a grey curve under a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in IHOP on the 25th floor, guests look down at Horseshoe Falls in clear morning sun, and the pancakes wait a moment.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Horseshoe Falls and American Falls are both sharp and white from the Tower Observatory, and the Niagara River shines below them.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Niagara River this morning, and guests in the river-view rooms follow them through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over American Falls this afternoon, so the white water goes bright, then dull, then bright again.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the mist from Horseshoe Falls is the same colour as the clouds, and guests cannot tell where one ends and the other begins.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Niagara River today, and Horseshoe Falls appears and disappears behind it like a slow magic trick.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: Horseshoe Falls is visible from the rooms that face it, but American Falls and the far bank of the river are not.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in the rooms facing Horseshoe Falls watch water fall in two different ways.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Niagara River, and for a second guests see all of Horseshoe Falls lit white under the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the Tower Observatory, and guests watch the flakes drop 160 metres towards the Niagara River.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the mist above Horseshoe Falls rises thick and white, and guests are happy to watch it from behind glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay a little longer at the windows of IHOP, where Horseshoe Falls and its mist cloud fill the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In today's strong heat, guests look down from this 99-metre tower at the mist over Horseshoe Falls and feel a little cooler.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, visitors gather at Table Rock, small as dots from here, with Horseshoe Falls pouring beside them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the mist of Horseshoe Falls gold, and the Niagara River carries the same light past American Falls.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over American Falls turn pink, and the falling water below takes a little of the colour.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Sky Fallsview Steakhouse, guests watch the illumination on Horseshoe Falls and American Falls glow under a low, cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The wet evening blurs the windows of Sky Fallsview Steakhouse on the 26th floor, and the lit falls become soft patches of light.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the illumination on American Falls shows clearly, and the mist above it catches the light.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the rooms facing both falls leave the curtains open for the illumination on Horseshoe Falls and American Falls.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Tower Observatory stays open to guests, and Horseshoe Falls keeps falling with almost nobody watching.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights of the nightly illumination begin to show on Horseshoe Falls.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Prague Castle is a dark shape beyond the rooftops, and the clear sky behind it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balcony rooms, the roofs of Prague city centre shine in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests on the Penthouse Suite terrace look over the roofs of the city all the way to Prague Castle.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the roofs of the city this morning, and Prague Castle goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests look across Prague's low skyline this afternoon as white clouds drift slowly over Prague Castle.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Prague Castle looks serious today, as a president's official residence probably should.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the roofs of the city today, and Prague Castle looks like a pencil drawing behind them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see the nearest roofs of the city clearly, and Prague Castle stays out of sight.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the roofs of the city, and guests watch Prague Castle turn grey and blurred behind them.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the city, and for a second Prague Castle appears bright against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the roofs of the city, and guests watch Prague Castle slowly turn white behind them.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and guests admire a sharp Prague Castle from the warmth indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in this 1935 functionalist building look over the city centre roofs towards Prague Castle.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, Penthouse Suite guests sit in the outdoor bathtub on their terrace and look at Prague Castle.
phrases.warm: On the Penthouse Suite terrace, guests sit among the plants with drinks and look over Prague's low skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the roofs of the city gold, and Prague Castle glows on the skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights Prague Castle, while the roofs below are already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hide the stars this evening, but the lights of Prague Castle shine steadily above the dark roofs.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the city this evening, and guests see the lights of Prague Castle blur into soft marks.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests see a faint glow from the city lights on the clouds over Prague Castle.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the roofs of the city tonight, and guests look to the lit walls of Prague Castle.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and Prague Castle is only a long outline above the sleeping roofs.
phrases.dusk: From the Penthouse Suite terrace on the 7th floor, the sky is still bright behind Prague Castle as the first lights come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Acropolis is a dark shape above the sleeping city.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Acropolis first, and from the rooftop pool every column looks sharp against the blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Acropolis stands bright over the rooftops, with Lycabettus Hill beside it under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the city this morning, while the Acropolis moves in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Thea Pool Bar & Restaurant, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over Lycabettus Hill toward the Acropolis.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Acropolis takes a softer stone colour and the city around it looks calm.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Athens today, and the Acropolis seems to float above the rooftops like a drawing in chalk.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so from the rooftop pool the Acropolis is only a faint outline and Lycabettus Hill is difficult to find.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Athens, and guests in the Acropolis View Suite watch the Acropolis turn grey and blurred through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the city, and for a second the Acropolis shows clearly before the storm hides it again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Athens, and guests at the windows of the gym watch the cityscape slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, and from the rooftop terrace the Acropolis looks sharp over the city.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Acropolis looks close and sharp from the suites with sea and Acropolis views, and guests there can see the sea as well.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look across the water at the Acropolis.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, books stay closed on the loungers while guests look at the Acropolis and Lycabettus Hill instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Acropolis in the late afternoon, and guests at Thea Pool Bar & Restaurant turn their chairs toward it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and from the rooftop pool the Acropolis glows orange for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds cover the evening sky, and the lit Acropolis shines under them from the tables of Thea Pool Bar & Restaurant.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in rooms facing the Acropolis see its lights spread softly across the rainy windows.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the rooftop terrace the Acropolis glows above a carpet of city lights.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests with a late drink at Thea Pool Bar & Restaurant keep looking at the lit Acropolis.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and the Acropolis rests above the rooftops of Athens.
phrases.dusk: The sky turns purple and orange after sunset, and from the rooftop terrace the first lights come on at the Acropolis.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Zurich lies still and grey-blue, and the Alps slowly take shape against the clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the corner rooms above the 4th floor, guests see morning sun on Lake Zurich and the Alps clear behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch at Marguita, guests have Lake Zurich in front of them, bright blue under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Lake Zurich this morning, and the Alps appear and disappear between the clouds.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the fitness area, guests on the exercise bikes watch clouds drift over Lake Zurich and the Alps this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Lake Zurich turns the colour of slate, and the opposite shoreline stays easy to see.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog rests on Lake Zurich today, so the water and the sky become one soft white wall beyond the park trees.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today; guests see Lake Zurich clearly near the shore, then it fades into pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lake Zurich, and guests in the lakeside suites watch the drops mark the water beyond the wet park.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Lake Zurich, and from the fitness area guests see lightning flash where the Alps normally stand.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the park and Lake Zurich, and guests in this 1844 hotel watch the far shore disappear behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Alps look sharp and close across Lake Zurich, every snowy ridge clear.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay warm in the fitness area and look out at a steel-blue Lake Zurich.
phrases.very_hot: Heat makes the air shimmer over Lake Zurich, the Alps turn pale blue behind it, and the water looks very inviting.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests fill the lakeside terrace and look across the calm blue water of Lake Zurich.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Lake Zurich gold, and from the corner rooms above the 4th floor the Alps glow a soft pink.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and paints orange strips on Lake Zurich, while the Schanzengraben is already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner at Marguita, guests look out at Lake Zurich, dark and calm under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the shore stretch into long reflections on the dark water of Lake Zurich.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and Lake Zurich is a wide dark space ringed by the lights of the shore.
phrases.clear_night: Since 1844, guests here have ended clear nights the same way, looking at the lights around Lake Zurich under the stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Zurich is quiet and almost black, and the park trees in front of it stand still.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over Lake Zurich, and the first lights come on along the opposite shoreline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Tivoli Gardens lies dark and still below the park-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the trees and rides of Tivoli Gardens, and from Nimb Roof the Copenhagen skyline stands sharp behind them.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Tivoli Gardens shows every path and treetop to anyone looking down from Nimb Roof.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Tivoli Gardens this morning, and the park changes colour under them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon clouds drift over the rooftops of Copenhagen, seen from the lounge area on Nimb Roof.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Copenhagen today, and the green of Tivoli Gardens looks deeper under it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Tivoli Gardens today, and the far rides look like drawings in pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Copenhagen skyline is not visible from the rooftop pool today, so Tivoli Gardens just below is the whole view.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Tivoli Gardens, and guests watch the wet paths shine from their park-facing rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Copenhagen, and each flash of lightning shows Tivoli Gardens for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Tivoli Gardens, and guests in this 1909 Moorish-style palace watch the park slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and Tivoli Gardens looks sharp and still under the winter light.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the towers of Tivoli Gardens rise above the park's trees, seen from Nimb Roof.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look over Tivoli Gardens from the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests swim against the current in the rooftop pool, and Tivoli Gardens stays in the same place below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls across Copenhagen, and from Nimb Roof the sun sinks toward the city's rooftops.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and from Nimb Roof the Copenhagen skyline glows.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lanterns and carousel lights of Tivoli Gardens fill the park-facing windows.
phrases.wet_evening: It is a wet evening, and the lights of Tivoli Gardens blur and spread their colours across the park.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lanterns of Tivoli Gardens glow softly below the terrace suites.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear over Copenhagen, and the lights of Tivoli Gardens answer it from below Nimb Roof.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Tivoli Gardens rests quietly in the dark, and even the carousel takes a break.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across Tivoli Gardens and the city beyond Nimb Roof.

phrases.clear_predawn: The first grey light reaches the Nile before sunrise, and Cairo Tower slowly takes shape to the north.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the Jazz Bar, guests look over a blue Nile under a clear sky, with Cairo Tower sharp to the north.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests working out in the Fitness Centre see the Nile and the Cairo skyline in full midday light.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Cairo skyline this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the Nile below the balcony rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From The Rooftop, patches of sun and shade cross the Nile toward Cairo Tower.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Nile loses its blue, and the curve of the Garden City embankment is easy to follow from the Jazz Bar on the 10th floor.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Nile today, and Cairo Tower is only a thin outline to the north.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Cairo Tower cannot be seen today; the view from the Fitness Centre stops at the Nile and the Garden City embankment.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Nile, and guests in the Jazz Bar watch the drops mark the water while Cairo Tower blurs in the distance.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Cairo skyline, and for a second the whole Nile shows white from the river-facing suites.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Nile, and guests in the Fitness Centre slow down to watch the flakes vanish into the water.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold, clear air, Cairo Tower stands out sharply to the north of the Jazz Bar, and guests stay inside to look.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, The Rooftop is quiet, and the Nile below it runs steadily past the Garden City embankment.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the Nile from the water, which seems the sensible way to do it.
phrases.warm: On the sun loungers at The Rooftop, guests keep one eye on a book and the other on the Nile and the Cairo skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Nile gold, and guests in the balcony rooms watch Cairo Tower catch the last warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and from the rooftop pool the Nile shows strips of orange and grey.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in the Jazz Bar look out at Cairo Tower lit against a dull sky, while the Nile carries the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows this evening, and the lights of the Cairo skyline stretch into long lines on the wet Nile.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the open fires at The Rooftop burn in front of the lit Cairo skyline and the Nile.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in this 191-room hotel look from the Jazz Bar at Cairo Tower shining above the Nile.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Nile moves quietly past the Garden City embankment, and guests still awake in the river-facing suites have it to themselves.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Nile, and the first lights come on along the Garden City embankment.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Cathedral is a dark shape above the medieval rooftops, under a clear sky that slowly grows pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on the Palau Reial Major, directly opposite, and guests in the city view rooms open their curtains to it.
phrases.clear_midday: From Sunset Lounge Rooftop Bar on the 9th floor, the Gothic Quarter lies sharp and bright under a clear midday sky, with the Cathedral in the foreground.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the medieval rooftops this morning, and the Cathedral moves in and out of sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at Sunset Lounge Rooftop Bar watch the afternoon clouds drift over the historic centre, one patch of sun at a time.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the stone of the Palau Reial Major and the clouds above it are almost the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the historic centre today, and from the rooftop terrace the Cathedral looks like a faint drawing on grey paper.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far edges of the city are not visible today, so the view from the rooftop terrace is the Palau Reial Major and the nearest medieval rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain runs off the medieval rooftops, and guests in the city view rooms watch the Gothic Quarter turn dark and shiny.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Cathedral for a second above the Gothic Quarter, then thunder rolls across the rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the medieval rooftops, and guests on the upper floors watch the Cathedral turn white at the edges.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and from behind the glass of the city view rooms every line of the Cathedral is sharp.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, steam rises from the rooftop hot tub while the medieval rooftops stretch out below it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests sit in the rooftop hot tub and look over the medieval rooftops slowly, because nothing else moves fast today.
phrases.warm: Warm air sits over the Gothic Quarter, and guests on the sun loungers at Sunset Lounge Rooftop Bar look across to the Cathedral between sips of something cold.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the stone of the Palau Reial Major gold, directly opposite this neoclassical building on Via Laietana.
phrases.partly_golden: At Sunset Lounge Rooftop Bar, guests hold their cocktails and watch the last sun break through the clouds over the whole city.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Gothic Quarter glow below Sunset Lounge Rooftop Bar, and the Cathedral stands lit among them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and the lights of the Gothic Quarter shine on the wet medieval rooftops.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the clouds hold a soft glow from the city lights above the medieval rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are few above a city this bright, so guests on the rooftop terrace look down instead, at the lights of the historic centre.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the historic centre is quiet, and the Palau Reial Major stands dark and still directly opposite.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the historic centre below the rooftop hot tub.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Table Mountain slowly takes shape against a clear sky while the Atlantic is still dark.
phrases.clear_morning: From Tobago's, guests at breakfast look over an Atlantic that shines under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the infinity pool above Beach Road, Robben Island sits clear on the water and Table Mountain stands sharp on the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift across Table Mountain this morning, and guests in the gym at Amani Spa have a good reason to slow down and watch.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic this afternoon, and Robben Island goes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic turns the colour of steel, and guests watch the waves from the bar.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides Robben Island today, and from the infinity pool the Atlantic fades into white a short way out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Robben Island cannot be seen today and Table Mountain is only a faint outline, so the waves breaking below the terrace at Tobago's take over the view.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in the sea-facing rooms watch the Atlantic turn grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic, and guests at the bar count the seconds until the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Guests in the Presidential Suites watch snow fall over the Atlantic, where the white sky and the water are difficult to tell apart.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, Table Mountain shows every fold of its rock to the rooms facing the mountain.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests at Tobago's sit indoors, and the Atlantic waves still break just beyond the terrace.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across the water to Robben Island.
phrases.warm: Warm air brings guests out to the loungers by the infinity pool, where Table Mountain stands on the horizon behind the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun drops towards the Atlantic, and the terrace at Tobago's turns gold along with the water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the clouds orange above Robben Island, and guests in the balcony rooms see it all without leaving their chairs.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening sky full of cloud, guests at dinner in Tobago's hear the Atlantic more clearly than they see it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Atlantic this evening, and guests at the bar keep their seats facing the dark ocean.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the 24-hour gym look out at Table Mountain, now only a darker shape against the sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars come out over the Atlantic on this clear night, and from the edge of the infinity pool the water seems to continue into the sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the 175 rooms are quiet, and the Atlantic keeps moving in the dark beyond Beach Road.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky stays pink over the Atlantic, and Robben Island becomes a low dark shape on the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the spires and domes stand as dark shapes against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the tops of the spires and domes first, while Beethoven Park below is still in shadow.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests can pick out the Vienna Hills as a sharp line behind the spires and domes.
phrases.partly_morning: From the balcony rooms, guests watch cloud shadows move along the curve of the Ringstrasse this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the city rooftops this afternoon, and the domes go from bright to dull and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the city rooftops take the same colour, and only the spires stand out above them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the horizon today; from Atmosphere Rooftop Bar, the nearest spires are clear and the far domes look like pencil drawings.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Vienna Hills are not visible today; from Atmosphere Rooftop Bar, guests see only the nearer spires and domes.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Beethoven Park, and guests in the Symphony Suite watch it through the panoramic windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests count the seconds between the lightning above the spires and the thunder that rolls over the city rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Beethoven Park, and guests in the balcony rooms watch the Ringstrasse turn white along its curve.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Vienna Hills look close and sharp behind the spires, seen from Atmosphere Rooftop Bar on the 8th floor.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the Albertina Suite stay behind the glass and look over the balcony rail at the Ringstrasse.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests at Atmosphere Rooftop Bar hold cold glasses and count the domes, slowly.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, people walk under the trees of Beethoven Park, a small green scene beside the curve of the Ringstrasse.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the spires and domes gold, and the Vienna Hills behind them fade to a soft blue.
phrases.partly_golden: At Atmosphere Rooftop Bar, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds pink above the spires, and conversations stop for a moment.
phrases.grey_evening: This evening the Ringstrasse is a curve of lights beside the trees of Beethoven Park, under a sky with no stars.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lit spires and domes tonight, and the city rooftops shine wet under the street lights.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hang low over the city tonight, and guests in these four 19th-century palaces look out at lights spread to the horizon.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the city, and the lit spires stand bright against the black sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Ringstrasse is almost empty, and Beethoven Park is a dark shape beside it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests watch the first lights come on among the spires and domes, one at a time.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Mediterranean lies still and grey beyond the infinity pool, waiting for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the terrace rooms open their curtains to the Mediterranean at ground level, bright blue under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 60-yard infinity pool, the Mediterranean runs flat and blue to the horizon under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Mediterranean this morning, in sight from every hole of the East course.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony rooms, guests watch patches of sun and shade trade places on the Mediterranean this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky the Mediterranean turns the colour of slate, and the edge of the infinity pool almost disappears into it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Mediterranean today, and the water beyond the private beach fades into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests cannot see the far end of the 1.2 miles of private coastline today, though the Mediterranean in front of the main building is still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Mediterranean; guests watch it from the terrace rooms, the horizon slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the open Mediterranean, and guests count the seconds to the thunder from behind their sea-facing windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the infinity pool, and the Mediterranean behind it has turned pale grey.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and clear, and the Mediterranean looks deep blue from the empty fairways of the East course.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the private beach lies empty, and the Mediterranean rolls in grey-green with nobody in the way.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their chins and look straight out at the Mediterranean.
phrases.warm: Guests on the private beach look up from their loungers at the Mediterranean, blue and only a few steps away.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the hotel terrace, guests watch the low sun turn the Mediterranean gold.
phrases.partly_golden: At the beach bar, guests watch the last sun turn the clouds over the Mediterranean orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and the Mediterranean beyond the infinity pool is black and without stars.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening on the private beach, and the Mediterranean shows only the white edges of its waves.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Mediterranean is a wide dark space where the lights of the coast stop.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear night sky over the Mediterranean, and with no road before the beach, no headlights disturb them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Mediterranean is quiet and unlit, and the private beach is a pale strip beside it.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and the sky above the Mediterranean keeps its orange glow while the first lights come on along the coast.

phrases.clear_predawn: The towers of Dubai Marina are dark shapes against a sky that is only starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light falls evenly on Palm Jumeirah, and guests see it clearly from end to end.
phrases.clear_midday: In full midday sun, guests have a clear view of the Dubai Marina towers.
phrases.partly_morning: Dubai Marina's towers take turns in sun and shade as the clouds drift past.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon guests see Palm Jumeirah half in sun and half under cloud.
phrases.overcast: Palm Jumeirah lies in soft greys under a full cover of cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the tops of the Dubai Marina towers, and guests see the rest as soft grey shapes.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests can make out only part of Palm Jumeirah today; the rest is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain turns Dubai Marina into a grey outline, and guests watch it from indoors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Palm Jumeirah for a moment, then the storm closes over it again.
phrases.snow: Snow is a surprise in Dubai, and guests stay indoors to watch it fall in front of the Dubai Marina towers.
phrases.very_cold: Dubai Marina stands sharp in the cold bright air, and guests admire it from indoors.
phrases.cold: A cool day keeps guests indoors, where Palm Jumeirah is still in plain view.
phrases.very_hot: Guests stay in the shade today and look across at the Dubai Marina towers, a little blurred by the heat.
phrases.warm: A warm day brings guests outdoors, and Palm Jumeirah holds their attention.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Anwā, guests turn their chairs toward the sunset as the sun drops low and orange.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds turn pink and gold around the sunset, and guests at Anwā stop talking to watch.
phrases.grey_evening: Dubai Marina glows under the evening cloud, its lit towers standing close together.
phrases.wet_evening: Through the evening rain, guests see the lights of Palm Jumeirah soft and blurred.
phrases.mild_night: The lit towers of Dubai Marina shine below a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: On a night this clear, guests see the lights of Palm Jumeirah as small sharp points.
phrases.late_night: Guests still awake at this hour look out at Dubai Marina, tall and quiet in the night.
phrases.dusk: The first lights appear along Palm Jumeirah while the sky behind still holds the colour of the sunset.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Powder Tower stands unlit against a clear sky, seen from the upper floors.
phrases.clear_morning: The Powder Tower catches the first sun this morning, and guests on the upper floors see it above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, St. Henry's Tower and the Powder Tower rise sharply above the Prague rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Prague rooftops this morning, and the Powder Tower moves in and out of sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace of the Bohemia Suite, guests follow cloud shadows as they cross the surrounding rooftops this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Powder Tower looks darker than usual above the rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the towers and spires of Prague today, and St. Henry's Tower looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far spires of Prague are not visible today; guests on the upper floors still see the Powder Tower nearby.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Prague rooftops, and guests watch the Powder Tower through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the towers and spires of Prague for a second, then the storm hides them again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Prague rooftops, and the Powder Tower slowly gets a white cap.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests in the 78 rooms and suites look at the Powder Tower from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: Cold air makes St. Henry's Tower look sharp today, with every edge clear above the rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: The Prague rooftops shimmer in the heat today, and St. Henry's Tower stands still above them.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit out on the terrace of the Presidential Suite and count the towers and spires of Prague.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the terrace of the Presidential Suite, guests watch the sun go down over the towers and spires of Prague.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds, and the Powder Tower turns gold for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit towers and spires of Prague glow against a low grey sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lit towers and spires of Prague blur into soft points.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars on this mild night, so the lit towers and spires of Prague do the job instead.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the lit towers and spires of Prague stand against a dark sky above the rooftops.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Prague rooftops are quiet and the Powder Tower is only a dark shape.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on around the Powder Tower, seen from this 17th-century palace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Moorish Castle is a dark shape on the ridge above the sleeping old town.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast, guests see the National Palace towers through the window, bright against a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the two white chimneys of the National Palace stand sharp above the terracotta rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the green hills of Sintra-Cascais Natural Park this morning, and the old town roofs brighten between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the 2nd-floor suite, guests watch clouds move past the Moorish Castle above while the National Palace stays in sun below.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the white chimneys of the National Palace stand out against the dull roofs of the old town.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist has taken the Moorish Castle from the hilltop, and guests wait to see how long Sintra keeps it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Moorish Castle and the far hills of Sintra-Cascais Natural Park are not visible today; the National Palace below stays clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the terracotta rooftops of the old town, and guests watch the National Palace turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the ridge, and each flash shows the Moorish Castle walls for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Sintra, and guests in this 18-room hotel watch the roofs of the National Palace turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests can follow the line of the Moorish Castle walls along the ridge.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay by the window seat and look over the old town to the National Palace towers.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, the forested hills of Sintra-Cascais Natural Park look cool and dark behind the bright old town.
phrases.warm: Warm sunlight lies on the terracotta rooftops, with the green ridge of Sintra-Cascais Natural Park rising behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the National Palace gold, and from the 2nd-floor suite guests see the Moorish Castle in the same window.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lights the Moorish Castle first, then the old town below.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests look over the lights of the old town, with the National Palace in the middle.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the old town tonight, and the wet rooftops shine around the National Palace.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, low cloud hides the ridge, so the old town lights have the view to themselves.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the ridge tonight, and guests in the 2nd-floor suite find the National Palace below and the Moorish Castle above.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the old town is quiet, and the National Palace towers stand dark over the still roofs.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright behind the Moorish Castle while the first lights appear in the old town.

phrases.clear_predawn: A dark shape above the Paris rooftops, the Eiffel Tower waits for the first light of the day.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches the top of the Eiffel Tower first, then works its way down to the Paris rooftops.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests can pick out each level of the Eiffel Tower today, right up to the tip.
phrases.partly_morning: Breakfast-hour clouds move across the view, and the Eiffel Tower goes from bright to dull and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The top of the Eiffel Tower plays hide-and-seek with the afternoon clouds; guests keep checking who is winning.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Paris today, and the dark iron of the Eiffel Tower is easy to see against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Eiffel Tower to a pale outline above the Paris rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Detail is missing from the view today: the Eiffel Tower is a plain grey shape and the rooftops beyond the nearest streets do not show.
phrases.rain: Wet Paris rooftops shine below, and guests stay dry inside watching the rain fall across the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.thunderstorm: Each flash of lightning shows the Eiffel Tower for a second, then the storm takes it back.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the Paris rooftops, turning the view white one roof at a time.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air makes every line of the Eiffel Tower look sharp, and guests enjoy the view from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: From inside, guests take a long look at the Eiffel Tower before reaching for their coats.
phrases.very_hot: Even the Eiffel Tower seems to stand still in this heat, and guests watching it are happy to do the same.
phrases.warm: Guests are in no hurry today, lingering over the view of the Eiffel Tower above the Paris rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun colours the Paris rooftops gold, with the Eiffel Tower rising behind them.
phrases.partly_golden: Low sun slips under the clouds and lights the Eiffel Tower from the side for a few last minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: This evening the Eiffel Tower glows gold under low cloud, and guests keep turning to look at it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls across the view tonight, and the lights of the Eiffel Tower look softer through it.
phrases.mild_night: Paris rooftops lie dark under tonight's cloud, with the Eiffel Tower lit above them.
phrases.clear_night: With no cloud tonight, guests can see the Eiffel Tower lit from its base to its tip.
phrases.late_night: Paris rooftops lie still in the small hours, and the Eiffel Tower stands over them as a quiet outline.
phrases.dusk: Lights begin to show across the Paris rooftops, and the Eiffel Tower stands against a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Elliott Bay is a wide, still surface under a clear sky that is slowly turning from black to blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the water-view rooms start this clear morning with Puget Sound bright in the windows.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Elliott Bay is deep blue, and the port cranes stand sharp at its edge.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Puget Sound this morning, and guests can follow each one over the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests look past downtown Seattle to Elliott Bay this afternoon, where patches of sun and shade share the water.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Puget Sound today, and water and sky are almost one colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies on Elliott Bay today, and guests see the port cranes only as soft outlines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Puget Sound is not visible today; guests see Elliott Bay close to the city and little beyond it.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of the water-view rooms, and guests watch Elliott Bay turn grey and blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Puget Sound, and for a second guests see the whole of Elliott Bay in white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Elliott Bay, and the flakes disappear the moment they touch the water.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, bright day, Puget Sound looks like polished steel, and guests are happy to admire it from inside.
phrases.cold: A cold day is a good reason for a bath: guests in the water-view rooms watch Puget Sound from the warm tub.
phrases.very_hot: Heat makes the air shimmer over downtown Seattle, while Elliott Bay beyond the streets looks cool and very blue.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests look down on people walking along the waterfront, with Elliott Bay shining beside them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns Puget Sound gold late this afternoon, and guests in the Presidential Suite see the same light spread across Elliott Bay.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and bright bands of light cross Elliott Bay one after another.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of downtown Seattle glow, and guests see Elliott Bay as a quiet, unlit space beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of downtown Seattle this evening, and Elliott Bay behind them is lost in the wet night.
phrases.mild_night: Guests look out on a mild, cloudy night, with the city lights reflecting softly on the edge of Elliott Bay.
phrases.clear_night: The clear night shows Puget Sound as wide black water, with the lights of downtown Seattle bright in front of it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Elliott Bay is quiet and almost invisible, and guests who are still awake have it to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky over Puget Sound is still bright just after sunset, while the first lights come on in downtown Seattle.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and a thin band of light grows behind the towers of the São Paulo skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: In clear morning light, guests in the Park Suite look over the green tree tops of Trianon Park to the São Paulo skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the São Paulo skyline is sharp, each tower easy to tell from the next.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the São Paulo skyline this morning, and their shadows cross the trees of Trianon Park below.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From a treatment room at Anantara Spa, guests see afternoon clouds drift behind the red broadcast tower and the São Paulo skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the São Paulo skyline turns the colour of concrete from end to end.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken the tops of the towers, and guests see the São Paulo skyline end a few floors early.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the far part of the São Paulo skyline is not visible, and guests see only the nearest rows of towers.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling across the São Paulo skyline, and guests in the Presidential Suite watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole São Paulo skyline for a second, then the storm clouds close over the towers again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the São Paulo skyline, and guests in the city-view rooms watch the roofs of the towers turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold today, and guests stay behind the glass while the São Paulo skyline stands under a wide, bright sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the garden-view suites look down on the trees of Trianon Park and the traffic of 9 de Julho Avenue.
phrases.very_hot: Heat haze rises over the São Paulo skyline, and the glass towers flash in the strong sun.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the São Paulo skyline stands in soft light, and guests look down at people walking into Trianon Park.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the São Paulo skyline gold, and guests stop what they are doing to watch it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the São Paulo skyline turn orange and pink, and the towers below them fall into shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Seen Restaurant & Bar on the 23rd floor, guests see the lights of the São Paulo skyline glow under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: It is a wet evening, and from the bar of Seen Restaurant & Bar the lights of the São Paulo skyline blur into coloured streaks on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night with cloud overhead, guests at Seen Restaurant & Bar look through the arched windows at the lit São Paulo skyline.
phrases.clear_night: The São Paulo skyline shines to the horizon under a clear night sky, and at Seen Restaurant & Bar the sushi has to compete with it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the São Paulo skyline is quiet, and guests who are still awake see its towers as dark shapes against the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Avenida Paulista and across the São Paulo skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Long before the city wakes, the outline of Mount Fuji begins to separate from the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests waking in the Park Suite find Mount Fuji sharp and complete beyond the city.
phrases.clear_midday: Tokyo Tower and Mount Fuji are both in plain sight, so guests get two landmarks in one look.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds keep covering Mount Fuji and moving on again, so guests look for it more than once this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sunlight falls on Tokyo Tower for a few minutes, then moves on across the city.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud is hiding Mount Fuji today, but Tokyo Tower shows every detail in the flat light.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides Mount Fuji today and leaves Tokyo Tower as a soft outline over the city.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests looking for Mount Fuji will not find it today; the view ends at Tokyo Tower and the streets around it.
phrases.rain: From the Park Suite, guests watch the rain cross the city until it reaches Tokyo Tower.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city, and each flash shows Tokyo Tower for a second before the rain closes in again.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the rooftops, and guests in the Park Suite watch Tokyo Tower fade and return between showers.
phrases.very_cold: Mount Fuji looks close enough to touch in this freezing air, and guests enjoy it from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: Guests are in no hurry to go out today, with Mount Fuji and Tokyo Tower both on show from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: Tokyo Tower shimmers above the hot streets, and Mount Fuji is a faint blue shape behind the heat.
phrases.warm: Guests heading out for the day take one more look at Tokyo Tower and a pale Mount Fuji before they go.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Against a gold horizon, Mount Fuji becomes a dark cut-out that guests stop to photograph.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests watch the last hour of sun come and go on Tokyo Tower as the clouds pass.
phrases.grey_evening: Under the evening cloud, Tokyo Tower is lit and easy to find above the city.
phrases.wet_evening: Tokyo Tower stays lit through the evening rain, slightly blurred for guests looking out.
phrases.mild_night: Guests look out once more before bed and find Tokyo Tower lit in the mild night.
phrases.clear_night: Nobody needs to search for Tokyo Tower tonight, lit and sharp in the clear dark.
phrases.late_night: Jet-lagged guests find Tokyo Tower keeping them company, a tall quiet shape above the emptying streets.
phrases.dusk: As daylight fades, Tokyo Tower begins to light up before the city has gone dark.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Douro River is a wide dark band below the gardens, and the clear sky above it is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Palatium, the high windows fill with the Douro River under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the infinity pool and the Douro River share one blue, and it takes a moment to find where one ends.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Douro River this morning, and the 1st- and 2nd-floor rooms have the clearest sight of their shadows on the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the clouds leave moving patches of light on the Douro River below the gardens.
phrases.overcast: On a grey day, a light lunch in Nasoni Bar has the Douro River in every large window, the same colour as the sky.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on the Douro River today, and from the balcony suites the far bank comes and goes.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The hills beyond the Douro River are not visible today; from the gardens, guests see only the water and the near bank.
phrases.rain: Rain draws small circles on the Douro River, and guests in the Nasoni Suite watch them from behind dry glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole width of the Douro River for a second at a time, and guests in this 18th-century palace stay well behind the windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the gardens, and the Douro River takes every flake without changing colour.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and from the warm spa guests see the Douro River bright and still beyond the gardens.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests choose the fireplace room of Nasoni Bar and look at the Douro River through its large windows.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests keep to the shade at Casa do Lago by SOI Porto and look over the bright water of the Douro River.
phrases.warm: By the infinity pool, swimmers stop at the edge to watch a cruise boat pass on the Douro River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Douro River gold in front of Promenade Pool & Lounge, and the outdoor pool takes the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Douro River turn orange, and the gardens of Nicolau Nasoni's palace have the whole show.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Palatium, the high windows show the Douro River under low cloud, with the city lights beyond it.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests in Nasoni Bar watch rain run down the large windows, the lights on the Douro River blurred behind it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the infinity pool lies still, and the Douro River beyond its edge is wide and quiet under the low cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Douro River is black and smooth from the gardens, and every light along it appears twice.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Douro River is a quiet dark line beyond the gardens, and only its slow movement shows.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright over the Douro River, and the first lights come on along the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lion's Head is a dark shape against a clear sky, and Camps Bay beach lies empty below.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights Lion's Head, and guests on the sea-facing balconies look down on Camps Bay beach.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, the midday view runs from Table Mountain and the Twelve Apostles round to Lion's Head and the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Twelve Apostles this morning, while Camps Bay beach below the rooftop pool stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Atlantic Ocean this afternoon, and Lion's Head goes from bright to dull and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean takes the same colour, and Lion's Head stands clear above Camps Bay beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Camps Bay today, and Lion's Head looks like a pencil drawing above the beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far Atlantic Ocean is not visible today; guests on the rooftop see Camps Bay beach and a faint Lion's Head.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Camps Bay beach, and guests watch it through the glass, Lion's Head slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and for a second Lion's Head shows sharp against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Camps Bay, and Lion's Head fades behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear today, and from the mountain-facing balconies guests see every line of Table Mountain.
phrases.cold: On this cold day Camps Bay beach is almost empty, and guests look from the rooftop at white waves on the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look across crowded Camps Bay beach to Lion's Head.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, books stay closed on this warm day while guests look at Camps Bay beach and the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At the Baptiste rooftop pool bar, guests watch the sun drop towards the Atlantic Ocean, and Lion's Head turns gold.
