phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in long beams, and guests at Baptiste see the Atlantic Ocean shine in patches.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Camps Bay strip glow along the beach, and Lion's Head is a dark shape above them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Camps Bay strip this evening, and the Atlantic Ocean beyond the beach has gone black.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds cover the stars, and guests on the sea-facing balconies see the street lights curve around Camps Bay.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and the lights of Camps Bay reach up the lower slopes of Lion's Head.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Camps Bay beach is quiet, and only the white edges of the waves show on the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and from Baptiste on the rooftop of this 38-room hotel, guests see the first lights of Camps Bay under a still-bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Arabian Gulf lies dark and flat before sunrise, with only a thin pale line where the water ends.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches Caña Beach, and the sea beyond the sand is already a clear, bright blue.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Royal Suite, guests look out over the Arabian Gulf, blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: In The Lobby Lounge, guests look past the luscious resort gardens to a sea crossed by slow cloud shadows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun and shade drift across the Arabian Gulf, changing its colour from blue to green and back.
phrases.overcast: The sea off Caña Beach has taken the same soft grey as the clouds, and the line between them almost disappears.
phrases.fog_haze: Seen from the ocean-facing rooms, the Arabian Gulf fades into the haze long before it reaches the horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is missing today, and from The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge guests see only the nearer stretch of sea.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the resort's manicured gardens, and guests in the Family Suite watch the leaves shine wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in The Emirates Suite have a front-row seat as lightning flashes far out over the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.snow: Guests in the One Bedroom Club Suite watch snowflakes fall into the Arabian Gulf and disappear in the water.
phrases.cold: From The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge, guests watch the sea roll in slowly, wave after wave.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on Caña Beach stay close to the water and walk into the sea again and again.
phrases.warm: Guests stroll through the resort's manicured gardens on their way down to the sea, towels over their shoulders.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in the Royal Suite watch the Arabian Gulf turn gold as the sun gets lower.
phrases.partly_golden: Long orange stripes lie on the sea where the last sunlight finds gaps between the clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: No stars this evening over the Arabian Gulf, so guests in the ocean-facing rooms listen for the waves instead of looking.
phrases.wet_evening: In The Emirates Suite, guests end the evening watching rain fall into the dark Arabian Gulf.
phrases.mild_night: Beyond the dark shapes of the luscious resort gardens, the sea is a faint pale line under tonight's clouds.
phrases.clear_night: Stars over the Arabian Gulf keep guests in the One Bedroom Club Suite awake a little longer than planned.
phrases.late_night: While the resort sleeps, the sea keeps moving in the dark, one slow wave after another.
phrases.dusk: The Arabian Gulf holds the last pink of the sunset for a few minutes more, while the gardens below are already dark.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky grows pale above San Diego Bay, and Coronado Island slowly takes form across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: In the clear morning light, guests on the training floor of the wellness centre look straight out at San Diego Bay.
phrases.clear_midday: San Diego Bay is bright blue at midday, and every detail of Coronado Island is clear across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across San Diego Bay this morning, while Coronado Island stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the upper-floor rooms, guests follow patches of sun and shade as they cross the bay towards the Coronado Bridge to the south.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, San Diego Bay turns the colour of steel, and the Coronado Bridge draws a thin line across it to the south.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens San Diego Bay today, and Coronado Island seems to float a little above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: guests in the bay-facing rooms see the water near the Embarcadero, but Coronado Island is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on San Diego Bay; guests watch it from the suite windows, the marina slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over San Diego Bay, and for a second Coronado Island stands out clearly behind the rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the empty yoga terrace, and beyond it the flakes disappear into the grey water of San Diego Bay.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests stay behind the glass of the wellness centre and see Coronado Island sharp across the bay.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, San Diego Bay looks clean and still from the yoga terrace, with Coronado Island behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the 4th-floor pool and look over its edge at San Diego Bay.
phrases.warm: On the outdoor yoga terrace, guests hold their poses in the warm air and lose their balance looking at Coronado Island.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Vistal on the rooftop, the low sun turns San Diego Bay gold, and Coronado Island glows across the water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Coronado Island turn pink and orange, and San Diego Bay copies the colours.
phrases.grey_evening: At Vistal, dinner tables look over San Diego Bay under a cloudy evening sky, with the lights of Coronado Island beyond.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of Coronado Island stretch into long reflections on San Diego Bay.
phrases.mild_night: The clouds hold the glow of the city tonight, and San Diego Bay gives it back as a soft grey light.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests at Vistal see the lights of Coronado Island in a neat row across San Diego Bay.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, San Diego Bay is quiet and black, and Coronado Island is only guessed at across the water.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright above San Diego Bay, and from Vistal guests watch the first lights come on across Coronado Island.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Prague Castle is a quiet outline above the sleeping rooftops of the Old Town.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the red rooftops of the Old Town first, then Prague Castle on its hill.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests in the Powder Tower Suite on the 8th floor see Týn Church, Prague Castle and the red rooftops together.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the red rooftops this morning, while Prague Castle stays bright behind them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Powder Tower Suite, guests watch afternoon clouds drift past the Powder Tower itself, a name that needs no explanation.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the city today, yet the red rooftops keep their colour and Prague Castle stands clear on the skyline.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies over the Old Town, and guests see the two towers of Týn Church rising out of it like ship masts.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Prague Castle is not visible in today's thick air; guests see the near rooftops and Týn Church, and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the red rooftops of the Old Town, and guests see Prague Castle blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Old Town, and for a second guests see Prague Castle sharp against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Old Town, turning the red rooftops white while Prague Castle fades behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Prague Castle looks sharp and close, and guests admire it from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in this 1927 hotel look over the Old Town rooftops to Prague Castle.
phrases.very_hot: The red rooftops shimmer in the heat, and guests on the rooftop terrace look across them to the twin towers of Týn Church.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests sit out on the Castle Suite balcony with the Old Town and Týn Church in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the red rooftops a deeper orange, and guests see Prague Castle against a golden sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and guests watch the towers of Týn Church and Prague Castle catch it in turn.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests look across the lit rooftops of the Old Town to Prague Castle, glowing on its hill.
phrases.wet_evening: The wet rooftops shine in the evening rain, and the lights of Prague Castle look soft behind it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit walls of Prague Castle draw the eye above the Old Town rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and guests see lit Prague Castle beneath the stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Old Town rooftops are still, and the towers of Týn Church stand alone against the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the Powder Tower Suite guests watch the first lights come on around Týn Church.

phrases.clear_predawn: Early risers see Victoria Harbour still dark and calm, while the sky behind the Kowloon skyline slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At Café Causette, guests have breakfast by the floor-to-ceiling windows and watch the city start its day under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the wraparound balcony of the Tamar Suite looks over a bright blue Victoria Harbour, city and water in the same frame.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Kowloon skyline this morning, and their shadows cross Victoria Harbour one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Hong Kong Observation Wheel turns in front of Victoria Harbour this afternoon, in sun one minute and under cloud the next.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Victoria Harbour takes the colour of steel, and the towers of Central stand sharp against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits on Victoria Harbour today, and guests looking for the Kowloon skyline find only a faint drawing of it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Victoria Harbour is not visible today, so the view stops at the water and the nearest towers of Central.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of Man Wah, and Victoria Harbour below is grey and blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses Victoria Harbour, and guests in the Tamar Suite wisely watch the lightning from the living room, not the balcony.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Victoria Harbour, and the flakes vanish the moment they touch the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, clear day, guests in the harbour view suites study Victoria Harbour from a warm bath by the window.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests at Man Wah stay behind the glass and follow the wind as it roughens Victoria Harbour.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, Victoria Harbour shines white under the sun, and the Kowloon skyline trembles a little in the hot air.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests step out onto the wraparound balcony of the Tamar Suite and find Victoria Harbour on one side and the towers of Central on the other.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light falls on the glass towers that have grown around this 1963 hotel, and Victoria Harbour beyond them turns the same warm colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Victoria Harbour turn orange, and the water below them changes colour every few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Man Wah, guests look over Victoria Harbour, where the lights of Kowloon glow under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Victoria Harbour tonight, and the city lights spread into soft coloured patches on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit towers of Central colour the low cloud, and Victoria Harbour carries the same glow.
phrases.clear_night: Guests who look out on this clear night see the lights of the Kowloon skyline lying in long reflections across Victoria Harbour.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Victoria Harbour is quiet and black, a wide calm space between two sleeping shores.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Victoria Harbour is still bright, and guests watch the first lights come on in the Bank of China Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Giralda Tower is a dark shape against a clear sky that slowly turns pale behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of the Giralda Tower first, and from the rooftop pool the light can be followed down the stone.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Seville Cathedral and the Giralda Tower are reflected in the still water of the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Seville Cathedral this morning, while the Giralda Tower stays bright above the rooftops.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the top-floor terraces, the afternoon clouds drift slowly behind the Giralda Tower.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Seville Cathedral takes a darker tone, and every carved detail of its roofline is clear from the rooftop pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Giralda Tower today, and its upper levels look like a pencil drawing above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far rooftops of Seville are not visible today, but Seville Cathedral is close enough to stay clear from the rooftop pool.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Seville Cathedral, and guests in the top-floor rooms watch the wet stone darken beyond their terraces.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Giralda Tower for a second at a time, and thunder rolls over the rooftops of Seville.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Seville Cathedral, and from the rooftop the Giralda Tower is turning white at the edges.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, steam rises from the terrace jacuzzis, and the Giralda Tower stands sharp behind it.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the air is clear over the rooftops of Seville, and the Giralda Tower looks close enough to touch from the rooftop.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look across the water at the Giralda Tower.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop loungers, books stay closed while guests look at Seville Cathedral instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the stone of Seville Cathedral gold, and the rooftop pool holds the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds, and the Giralda Tower turns from gold to pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit Giralda Tower stands out above the dark rooftops of Seville.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and the lights of Seville Cathedral shine on the wet rooftops around it.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, Seville Cathedral is lit under the clouds, in plain sight from the rooftop of this hotel of 33 rooms.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the Giralda Tower tonight, and the terrace jacuzzis on the top floor face it directly.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Seville Cathedral is a quiet outline above the sleeping rooftops.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on at the Giralda Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Stadtpark is a wide dark shape below, and the Vienna skyline slowly separates from the clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests on the upper floors look down on the Strauss monument in clear morning light, with the Riesenrad small at the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Stadtpark shows its full geometry, and the Riesenrad stands at the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Stadtpark this morning, and the Strauss monument moves in and out of sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the upper floors of this hotel renovated in 2020, guests follow the line of the Ringstrasse beyond the park while clouds drift over the Vienna skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Vienna skyline takes the colour of the clouds, and the Stadtpark tree canopy looks darker below.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Vienna skyline today, so guests look closer in, to the Strauss monument just below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Riesenrad is not visible at the horizon today; the Stadtpark and the Ringstrasse beyond it are still easy to see.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Stadtpark, and guests in park-facing rooms watch it wet the Strauss monument below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Vienna skyline for a second at a time, and thunder rolls over the Stadtpark.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Stadtpark, and the Strauss monument below slowly gets a white coat.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Vienna skyline looks sharp, and guests are happy to study the Stadtpark from indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Ringstrasse runs beyond the Stadtpark, with the Vienna skyline standing behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, people look for shade under the Stadtpark trees, and guests watch them from above.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, walkers gather around the Strauss monument, small figures for guests looking down from the balcony rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Vienna skyline gold, and the Riesenrad stands clear at the horizon beyond the Stadtpark.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds turn orange over the Ringstrasse.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Ringstrasse mark the edge of the Stadtpark, which stays dark in the middle.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights beyond the Stadtpark blur in the rain, and guests are in no hurry to go out.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Vienna skyline glows under the low sky, and guests look across the Stadtpark towards it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars sit above the Vienna skyline tonight, and the city lights end where the Stadtpark begins.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Stadtpark is quiet below, and the Strauss monument has no audience at all.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Vienna skyline, and the first lights come on along the Ringstrasse.

phrases.clear_predawn: Mount Agung is a dark outline behind the bamboo forest, and the infinity pool lies still above the valley.
phrases.clear_morning: At The Puhu Restaurant, guests eat breakfast facing the sweeping tropical valley, every treetop clear this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: The infinity pool is bright blue at midday, with the green valley right behind its edge.
phrases.partly_morning: In the Family Suite, guests wake to patches of sun and shade moving across the garden and the valley.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At the bar, guests watch sun and shade take turns on the lush valley beyond.
phrases.overcast: Guests in the One-Bedroom Suite look out at the garden and the valley, both a soft green under the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Mount Agung is lost in haze today, and guests in the lounge have the lush bamboo forest to look at.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the Premier Club Pool View rooms, the infinity pool is clear today, while the far side of the valley and Mount Agung cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: The infinity pool is covered in small rings of rain, and the valley behind it has gone soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Safe inside the Two-Bedroom Suite, guests watch lightning show the garden and the valley for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is a surprise in Bali, and guests in the One-Bedroom Suite watch it fall on the garden and the valley.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay in the Payangan Lounge today, looking out at the lush garden in clear, icy light.
phrases.cold: Nobody is swimming today, so the infinity pool lies flat and mirrors the valley.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the pool fills with guests who stand in the water and look out over the valley.
phrases.warm: Between swims, guests rest their arms on the edge of the infinity pool and study the valley below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Two-Bedroom Suite, the garden and the valley turn gold together, treetop by treetop.
phrases.partly_golden: Between two clouds, the last sun reaches Mount Agung, and guests in the Premier Club Pool View rooms see it above the lush bamboo forest.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner guests at The Puhu Restaurant look out at the forest, now one dark shape in the evening.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests at the bar hear tonight's rain before they see it, falling into the lush valley beyond.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the garden and the valley are two shades of dark under the cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the garden and the valley tonight, and the valley floor is completely black.
phrases.late_night: Everyone is asleep in the Family Suite, and the garden and the valley outside are left to the night.
phrases.dusk: Just now the infinity pool is brighter than the valley behind it, which is already dark green.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Lake Ontario lies dark and calm below the lake-view rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun lights the Toronto Skyline, and the CN Tower stands sharp against a clear blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From Valerie, guests see Lake Ontario on three sides at midday, blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Lake Ontario this morning, and the Toronto Skyline stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Fitness Centre Gym on the 4th floor, guests see clouds drift over the Toronto Skyline and the CN Tower.
phrases.overcast: Lake Ontario turns grey under the grey sky, and the horizon is not easy to find today.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the CN Tower today, and Lake Ontario fades into white a short way from the shore.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Lake Ontario is not visible today, and the Toronto Skyline shows only its nearest towers.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass in a Guerlain Spa treatment room, and the marina and Lake Ontario look blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Lake Ontario, and guests at Valerie watch the storm cross the water from three sides.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Toronto Skyline, and the CN Tower comes and goes behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and guests in the Royal Suite see the Toronto Skyline and Lake Ontario in sharp detail.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, tennis players on the indoor courts stop between points to look at the city and Lake Ontario.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool on the 28th floor and look down at Lake Ontario.
phrases.warm: Guests lie on the white lounge chairs by the rooftop pool, and Lake Ontario shines beyond the glass railing.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Bi-Level Penthouse Suite terrace, guests see the Toronto Skyline turn gold in the late afternoon sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Lake Ontario turn orange and pink, and the water copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: The lights of the Toronto Skyline glow under low cloud this evening, and guests at Valerie look at them over dinner.
phrases.wet_evening: The CN Tower lights blur in the wet evening, and the Toronto Skyline glows softly behind the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the clouds hold the glow of the Toronto Skyline, and the CN Tower shines below them.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the lit CN Tower rises over the Toronto Skyline, and guests in this 30-story tower stay up to look.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Ontario is a wide black space beside the quiet city.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Toronto Skyline for guests at Valerie.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide dark surface under a clear sky, and Children's Pool Beach is still in shadow.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the patio, guests look across to the Pacific Ocean, blue and clear all the way out.
phrases.clear_midday: Children's Pool Beach lies bright below the 2nd-floor balconies, and the Pacific Ocean is deep blue to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pacific Ocean this morning, and the rooftop terrace is the place to follow them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From a 2nd-floor balcony, guests see the green lawn of Scripps Park in sun and the Pacific Ocean under passing clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pacific Ocean turns grey too, and the white waves at Children's Pool Beach stand out.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Pacific Ocean today, and from the rooftop terrace the water fades away a short way from the shore.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; from the rooftop terrace Children's Pool Beach is clear, then the Pacific Ocean fades into pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Pacific Ocean, and guests watch from their ocean-facing rooms as Children's Pool Beach turns dark and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm rolls in off the Pacific Ocean, and guests stay dry inside while lightning shows the waves for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Children's Pool Beach, and from the rooftop terrace it takes a second look to believe this is still the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: The cold air is very clear today, and from the rooftop terrace every wave on the Pacific Ocean has a sharp edge.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Pacific Ocean looks like steel, and the sand of Children's Pool Beach is empty.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests keep to the shade of the patio and look at the Pacific Ocean, which seems cooler every minute.
phrases.warm: Swimmers and walkers dot Children's Pool Beach on this warm day, and guests on the 2nd-floor balconies look down on it all.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun drops toward the Pacific Ocean in a clear sky, and the rooftop terrace turns gold together with the water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Pacific Ocean go orange and pink, and guests in this 30-room inn stop talking to look.
phrases.grey_evening: From the patio with its stone fireplace, the Pacific Ocean is almost black under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening on the coast road below, and the Pacific Ocean beyond it is more sound than sight.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the rooftop terrace the Pacific Ocean is a darker band under a dark sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Pacific Ocean on this clear night, and the rooftop terrace gives a wide view of both.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pacific Ocean is black, and only the foam at Children's Pool Beach shows where the water ends.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and the sky over the Pacific Ocean stays bright while Children's Pool Beach slowly loses its colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is still dark, and the clear sky above Cox Bay turns slowly from black to blue.
phrases.clear_morning: From Pettinger Point, at the end of the Sunset Trail boardwalk, guests see the first clear light reach the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Pacific Ocean is deep blue, and each wave in Cox Bay breaks in a bright white line.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Cox Bay this morning, and the surf turns from grey to green as each one passes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the communal hot tubs, the view this afternoon is of clouds drifting over the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean takes the same colour, and only the white surf marks where Cox Bay begins.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits low on Cox Bay today, so the waves appear from nowhere a few metres before they reach the sand.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; from the beach houses, guests see the sand and the nearest waves of the Pacific Ocean, and little beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Cox Bay; guests watch it from their suite windows, with the Pacific Ocean blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Pacific Ocean for a second at a time, with big waves breaking white along Cox Bay.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sand of Cox Bay, and the Pacific Ocean keeps sending in its waves as if nothing has changed.
phrases.very_cold: Behind the west-facing windows, guests look out at a Pacific Ocean made sharp and bright by the freezing air.
phrases.cold: From the beachfront fire pits, the surf of Cox Bay looks steel-grey on this cold day.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, surfers sit out past the break in Cox Bay, waiting for a wave, while the Pacific Ocean shines behind them.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the balconies watch surfers and beach walkers on Cox Bay, with the Pacific Ocean filling the rest of the picture.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Cox Bay faces almost due west, so the low sun lays a gold path across the Pacific Ocean straight towards the sand.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests at this 1972 resort see, from Pettinger Point, the last sun colour the clouds pink and orange over the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Pacific Ocean is a darker grey than the sky, and the line between them slowly disappears.
phrases.wet_evening: The wet evening hides most of the Pacific Ocean, and only the nearest surf of Cox Bay shows as faint white bands.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Pacific Ocean is black, and the breaking waves on Cox Bay are the only movement in sight.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Pacific Ocean tonight, right down to where the water of Cox Bay begins.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pacific Ocean still sends wave after wave into Cox Bay, with no one awake to count them.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Pacific Ocean stays bright orange, and the first flames show at the beachfront fire pits.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Lugano lies still and grey, and the Alps slowly take shape above it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Lake Lugano early, and guests in the lake suites wake to it through floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Lake Lugano is deep blue and the Alps stand sharp behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Lake Lugano this morning, and guests in the meeting rooms lose track of the agenda at the tall windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds sit on the Alps this afternoon while Lake Lugano stays in patches of sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Lake Lugano turns the colour of slate, and the Alps keep their outline above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog rests on Lake Lugano today, and the Alps appear only now and then above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today; from the glass doors of Le Rive, guests see Lake Lugano and little beyond the near water.
phrases.rain: Rain marks Lake Lugano with small rings, and guests watch it from behind floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Alps for a second, then Lake Lugano goes dark under the storm again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Lake Lugano, and the flakes disappear the moment they touch the water.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air lies over Lake Lugano, and guests stay indoors to look at the bright water and the Alps.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Lake Lugano looks like steel, and guests in this 2024 hotel stay at the glass doors of Le Rive to look at it.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool and look across Lake Lugano to the green hills.
phrases.warm: On the terraces of the south-facing lake suites, guests take their time while Lake Lugano shines in front of the Alps.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Alps gold, and Lake Lugano carries the same colour to the shore.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lays bright strips across Lake Lugano.
phrases.grey_evening: At Le Rive, dinner is served under a cloudy evening sky, with Lake Lugano dark and calm outside.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass at Le Rive this evening, and guests at dinner see Lake Lugano as a soft blur.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, Lake Lugano is a wide dark shape in front of the terraces of the 26 rooms.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Alps tonight, and Lake Lugano is still enough to hold a few of them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Lugano is black and silent, and it seems to be the only thing awake.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky above the Alps is still bright, and Lake Lugano turns from blue to silver.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Douro River is a dark band below the room terraces, and the sky above Porto begins to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the terrace, guests look over Porto's terracotta rooftops in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Dom Luís I Bridge and Porto's skyline share one frame above the edge of the infinity pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Porto's hillside this morning, while the Douro River below stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the 7th-floor Artist Suite, guests follow the clouds drifting over the Douro River and the historic city of Porto.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Douro River turns the colour of slate, and the Dom Luís I Bridge stands clear above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on the Douro River today, and only part of the Dom Luís I Bridge shows through it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests cannot see the far end of Porto's skyline today, though the Douro River and the nearer rooftops are still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Douro River; guests watch it from the indoor pool, behind the panoramic windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the Dom Luís I Bridge, and for a second the whole Douro River turns white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Porto's rooftops, and the Dom Luís I Bridge fades behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay behind the panoramic windows of the indoor pool on this freezing day, with Porto's skyline sharp across the Douro River.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests open the bathroom shutters and look at Porto from a deep, warm bathtub.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their chins and look across the Douro River to Porto.
phrases.warm: Guests on the loungers by the infinity pool keep turning their heads to the Dom Luís I Bridge on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Douro River and Porto's skyline, seen from the rooftop terrace late this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights one part of Porto's skyline at a time, like a slow lamp above the Douro River.
phrases.grey_evening: At The Yeatman Gastronomic Restaurant, guests dine facing the Douro River and the lights of Porto's historic centre under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights of Porto stretch into long streaks on the Douro River.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the infinity pool looks over Porto's illuminated skyline, and the clouds above take a soft glow.
phrases.clear_night: The Dom Luís I Bridge is lit against a clear night sky, and its lights are repeated in the Douro River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Porto is quiet across the water, and the Douro River moves slowly past the south bank.
phrases.dusk: From the rooftop terrace, guests see the first lights come on along the Dom Luís I Bridge under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Acropolis is a dark shape above the sleeping rooftops of Athens, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Acropolis first, then moves down over the city rooftops below it.
phrases.clear_midday: At St' Astra on the 9th floor, lunch is served with the Acropolis sharp against a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Pedion Areos Park this morning, and guests in the Presidential Suite follow them over the trees.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Lycabettus Hill this afternoon, while the Acropolis stays in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Acropolis keeps its pale stone colour above the rooftops of Athens.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and from the rooftop the Acropolis looks like a drawing in light pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Lycabettus Hill is not visible today, and the Acropolis is only a faint outline beyond the nearest rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites with an Acropolis view, and guests watch the Acropolis blur behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Acropolis for a second above the wet rooftops, then the storm clouds close over it again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Athens, and guests in the rooms facing the Acropolis watch the hill slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, and the Acropolis and Lycabettus Hill both show every detail above the city.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests choose a table behind the glass at St' Astra and keep the Acropolis in front of them.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look across the bright city to the Acropolis.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, guests on loungers see Athens on every side, so no one needs to fight for the best spot.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Acropolis gold, and guests at St' Astra put down their cocktails to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights Lycabettus Hill, while the rooftops of Athens turn pink.
phrases.grey_evening: In the lounge bar, floor-to-ceiling windows frame the lit Acropolis under a low, cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The lit Acropolis shines through the rain tonight, and the wet streets of Athens repeat the city lights.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Acropolis glows above the city, and the clouds over it take a little of its light.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in this hotel of 160 rooms look out on a clear night and find the Acropolis lit against a black sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Athens is quiet, and the Acropolis stands unlit on its hill above the city.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset as the first lights come on at the Acropolis, seen from St' Astra through open glass panels.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Buenos Aires skyline is a row of dark shapes under a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the gym at the top of the building, guests look through floor-to-ceiling windows at the Buenos Aires skyline in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the city panorama from the Art Executive Suite on the 15th floor reaches the Río de la Plata.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Buenos Aires skyline this morning, and guests follow them from the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Spa & Fitness Center see the afternoon clouds drift over the rooftops of Buenos Aires.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Buenos Aires today, and the towers of the skyline take the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Buenos Aires skyline today, and the far buildings fade into the white sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Río de la Plata is not visible today, and the city panorama ends at the nearer towers.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass roof of the rooftop pool, and the Buenos Aires skyline behind the windows looks blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Buenos Aires skyline, and guests watch the storm through the gym's floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Buenos Aires, and guests in the heated rooftop pool watch the skyline turn white through the glass.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and the skyline is sharp, so guests admire Buenos Aires from the warm water of the rooftop pool.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the gym's floor-to-ceiling windows show the Buenos Aires skyline clear in every detail.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the rooftops of Buenos Aires, and guests in the Spa & Fitness Center look across the skyline from the top of the building.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, swimmers stop at the end of the rooftop pool to look at the Buenos Aires skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun colours the towers of Buenos Aires, and guests in the Art Executive Suite look over them toward the Río de la Plata.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and turns the Buenos Aires skyline orange for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Buenos Aires spread out below the windows of the Spa & Fitness Center.
phrases.wet_evening: The city lights of Buenos Aires shine through wet glass tonight, each one a little wider than usual.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud glows faintly over Buenos Aires tonight, and the skyline shows as rows of lit windows.
phrases.clear_night: From the 15th floor of this 139-room hotel, guests see the lights of Buenos Aires run toward the Río de la Plata under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Buenos Aires is quiet below the high-floor windows, and the skyline rests against the night sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky over Buenos Aires is still bright, and the first lights come on across the skyline as guests look out from the rooftop pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Waitemata Harbour is a wide dark surface under a clear sky, and the Sky Tower stands grey beside it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of the Sky Tower first, then moves down to the city rooftops below.
phrases.clear_midday: From Bar Albert on the 38th floor, guests see the Sky Tower and Waitemata Harbour in one clear sweep under a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Waitemata Harbour this morning, while the Sky Tower stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in rooms facing the Sky Tower watch afternoon clouds drift past its mast one by one.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Waitemata Harbour takes the same colour, and the Sky Tower stands out sharply against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Waitemata Harbour today, and the Sky Tower looks like a pencil line drawn on grey paper.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Waitemata Harbour is not visible today, so guests look at the Sky Tower and the nearest city rooftops instead.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of Bar Albert, and the Sky Tower is slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests at Bar Albert watch the thunderstorm cross Waitemata Harbour, with lightning showing the Sky Tower for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the city, and the Sky Tower turns pale while Waitemata Harbour fades behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and guests stay behind the glass to study every detail of the Sky Tower.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Waitemata Harbour looks like grey steel, and guests enjoy it from the warmth of Bar Albert.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the city rooftops, and Waitemata Harbour looks cool and blue from the harbour-view rooms.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the Sky Tower stands in soft light, and Waitemata Harbour shines beyond the city rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills Bar Albert as the sun moves low over Waitemata Harbour, and conversations stop for a moment.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over Waitemata Harbour, and one side of the Sky Tower turns gold.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Sky Tower is lit against a dark sky, and the city lights spread out below Bar Albert.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests look down from their windows this wet evening at street lamps and headlights shining on the rainy streets, with the Sky Tower lit above.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud catches the glow of the city tonight, and the lit Sky Tower rises into it.
phrases.clear_night: From a hotel opened in 2022, guests look across the city lights to the lit Sky Tower under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Sky Tower stands quiet over empty streets, and Waitemata Harbour lies still beyond them.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Waitemata Harbour as the first city lights come on below the high-floor rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale behind São Jorge Castle, and the Tagus River is still a dark band to the south.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, São Jorge Castle stands sharp to the east, above the colourful rooftops of Lisbon.
phrases.clear_midday: At Limão Rooftop Bar on the 10th floor, guests look south over the Tagus River to the clear ridge of Serra da Arrábida.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Lisbon's terracotta rooftops this morning, while the Tagus River stays bright in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in rooms facing Avenida Duque de Loulé watch sun and shade take turns on the avenue below.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Tagus River turns silver-grey, and São Jorge Castle looks darker against the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Tagus River today, and Serra da Arrábida is only a faint outline from the rooftop.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Serra da Arrábida is not visible today, and from the rooftop guests see the city rooftops and São Jorge Castle but little of the Tagus River.
phrases.rain: From the covered area of Limão Rooftop Bar, guests watch rain fall on Lisbon's rooftops and blur the Tagus River.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows São Jorge Castle for a second, then the storm hides it again behind heavy rain.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the rooftop's blue-and-white tiles, and across the city São Jorge Castle slowly turns white too.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air makes everything sharp today, and from the rooftop Serra da Arrábida stands clear beyond the Tagus River.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, some guests keep to their rooms, where the windows show Lisbon's terracotta rooftops and the Tagus River.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests choose the covered side of Limão Rooftop Bar and look at the Tagus River shining to the south.
phrases.warm: On the open-air terrace, cocktails get warm while guests look across the colourful rooftops to São Jorge Castle.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Limão Rooftop Bar, guests hold a cocktail as the low sun turns São Jorge Castle and the rooftops gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the Tagus River in patches, with Serra da Arrábida behind.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights spread from the rooftop down to the Tagus River, and São Jorge Castle glows to the east.
phrases.wet_evening: From the windows of this 18th-century building, guests watch evening rain shine under the street lights of Avenida Duque de Loulé.
phrases.mild_night: The mild night sky is cloudy, but São Jorge Castle stays lit above the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests look from the rooftop over the lights of Lisbon to the dark Tagus River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Lisbon is quiet, and the Tagus River lies still beyond the sleeping rooftops.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright over the Tagus River, and the first lights come on around São Jorge Castle.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over the city center turns from black to deep blue, and Las Ramblas waits below for the day.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches La Isabela under a clear sky, and Las Ramblas below begins its day.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Las Ramblas runs bright below, and the city center shows in sharp detail.
phrases.partly_morning: From the terrace rooms on the 5th floor, guests watch cloud shadows move across the city center this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Las Ramblas this afternoon, and the street changes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the city center looks calm and even, with no shadows on Las Ramblas below.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city center today, and from La Isabela the far end of Las Ramblas fades into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the far parts of the city center cannot be seen, only Las Ramblas and the nearest streets.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Las Ramblas, and guests in the street-facing rooms watch the pavement shine below.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the city center, and lightning shows Las Ramblas for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Calle Xuclà and Pintor Fortuny, and guests in the street-facing rooms watch the streets turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and clear, and from La Isabela the city center shows every edge under a bright sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the terrace rooms keep their view over the city center, best enjoyed from behind the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool at La Isabela and look down at Las Ramblas from the water.
phrases.warm: On the sun loungers at La Isabela, guests look down at Las Ramblas, where the street noise does not reach them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the city center gold, and from La Isabela the shadows grow long over Las Ramblas.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the city center one street at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds cover the evening sky, and the lights of Las Ramblas glow below this building from 1881.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Las Ramblas are reflected in the street below.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of the city center give the low clouds a soft glow.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the city center is a field of lights, and Las Ramblas draws a line of lamps through it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, even Las Ramblas goes quiet, which guests looking down may not believe at first.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the city center, and the first lights come on along Las Ramblas.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over Burrard Inlet, and the tops of the North Shore Mountains are the first thing to show against it.
phrases.clear_morning: From the harbour view rooms, guests watch the morning's seaplanes lift off Burrard Inlet into a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Stanley Park is a green wall across Coal Harbour at midday, every treetop distinct against the blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the North Shore Mountains this morning, while the marina below the Juliet balconies stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Through the floor-to-ceiling windows of H2 Rotisserie and Bar, guests watch cloud shadows cross Coal Harbour between the boats.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Burrard Inlet turns the colour of slate, and from the outdoor pool each seaplane stands out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits low on Coal Harbour today, and the nearest boats in the marina are the only ones guests can count.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The North Shore Mountains cannot be seen today, and guests looking out find only the marina and the first trees of Stanley Park.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Coal Harbour and dots the water between the docks, with the trees of Stanley Park grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Burrard Inlet, and guests behind their sliding glass doors watch lightning flash above the masts of the marina.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the marina, whitening the docks and the boat decks, while Stanley Park fades behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the North Shore Mountains look close enough to touch across Burrard Inlet, and guests admire them from behind glass.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests keep to the windows of H2 Rotisserie and Bar, where Coal Harbour and its boats fill the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the circular outdoor pool and look up each time a seaplane crosses Coal Harbour.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the loungers by the outdoor pool look across the marina to the trees of Stanley Park.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lays gold on Coal Harbour below the private rooftop balcony of the International Suite.
phrases.partly_golden: From the edge of the outdoor pool, the last hour of sun turns the clouds over Burrard Inlet pink as a seaplane comes in to land.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the marina lights shine on the water below, and Stanley Park stays a dark shape beyond Coal Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the dock lamps stretch into long reflections on Coal Harbour, seen through the tall windows of H2 Rotisserie and Bar.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night the clouds hide the stars, but the lit boats in the marina give Coal Harbour a few of its own.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, stars show above Burrard Inlet, and guests can trace the outline of the North Shore Mountains against the sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the seaplanes rest and the boats in the hotel's own marina sit still on Coal Harbour.
phrases.dusk: At dusk, the first marina lights come on below the terrace lounge while the sky over Coal Harbour stays bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean is a wide dark surface beyond the balconies, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun lights Calheta Beach, and the sand turns gold below the pool terrace.
phrases.clear_midday: From the pool terrace, guests look over Calheta Beach to a bright blue Atlantic Ocean under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Calheta Bay this morning, while the marina jetty stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the mountain-view rooms watch clouds move over the green hills of Calheta this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean takes the same colour, and the sand of Calheta Beach looks paler.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Calheta Bay today, and the marina jetty looks like a pencil line on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; from the pool terrace, guests see Calheta Beach and the marina jetty, then only pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Calheta Beach, and guests watch it mark the sand from their balconies.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Calheta Bay, and guests on the sea-view balconies watch lightning above the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Calheta Beach, and the white flakes land on golden sand while guests look twice.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and the Atlantic Ocean shows a sharp horizon beyond the marina jetty.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Calheta Beach lies empty below the pool terrace, and the waves have the sand to themselves.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests stay in the pool and look over its edge to Calheta Beach and the bay.
phrases.warm: By the pool, books stay closed while guests look at swimmers on Calheta Beach below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls across Calheta Bay, and the marina jetty stands out clearly against the bright water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in this 72-room resort watch from their balconies.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the marina jetty shine on the dark water of Calheta Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the marina jetty this evening, and Calheta Bay is dark behind them.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hide the stars, and Calheta Bay is a dark surface with the marina jetty reaching into it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and guests count them from their balconies.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Calheta Beach is quiet and empty, and the waves reach the sand in slow lines.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Calheta Bay, and the first lights come on along the marina jetty.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide grey-blue surface under a clear sky, and Santa Monica Pier is only an outline above it.
phrases.clear_morning: At Coast, breakfast is served under a clear morning sky, and guests look across the sand to the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_midday: The Pacific Ocean is bright blue at midday, and Santa Monica Pier stands sharp and clear above the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pacific Ocean this morning, while Santa Monica Pier stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Beyond the pool deck, afternoon clouds drift over the Pacific Ocean, and patches of sun move on the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns silver, and Santa Monica Pier looks darker than usual from the ocean-view balconies.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Pacific Ocean today, and Santa Monica Pier seems to end halfway, as if someone forgot to finish it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests see the sand and the first waves of the Pacific Ocean, while Santa Monica Pier is faint.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the sand and the Pacific Ocean, and guests in the oceanfront rooms watch the waves turn grey behind the wet balcony rails.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second Santa Monica Pier appears white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sand and melting into the Pacific Ocean, while Santa Monica Pier turns white little by little.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests indoors at Coast see the Pacific Ocean sharp all the way to the horizon.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the beach is empty, and the Pacific Ocean rolls in grey-green with Santa Monica Pier alone above it.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the pool deck stay in the shade of the cabanas and look out at the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the balconies of the 3-story Beach House look over the sand, the lifeguard tower and the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At the bar at Coast, guests watch the sun go down toward the Pacific Ocean in a clear sky, the water turning gold.
phrases.partly_golden: At Living Room and Terrace, guests see the last sun colour the clouds orange above the Pacific Ocean and Santa Monica Pier.
phrases.grey_evening: At Living Room and Terrace, guests look out to the lights of Santa Monica Pier under a cloudy evening sky, the Pacific Ocean dark behind them.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain is falling, and the lights of Santa Monica Pier spread in soft circles over the wet sand and the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so the lights of Santa Monica Pier are the brightest thing above the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the Pacific Ocean tonight, and guests in this Michael S. Smith-designed hotel look from their balconies to the bright Santa Monica Pier.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pacific Ocean is heard more than seen, with only white lines of surf showing on the sand.
phrases.dusk: The sun is gone, the sky over the Pacific Ocean is still bright, and the first lights come on along Santa Monica Pier.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky grows pale above the Andaman Sea, and the mountains slowly take shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Andaman Sea, and guests on their private balconies see the water turn turquoise.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Andaman Sea is bright turquoise in the sandy cove and deep blue further out.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Andaman Sea this morning, while the forested headland stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow the clouds drifting over the mountains this afternoon, while the Andaman Sea shines in the gaps of sun.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the Andaman Sea changes from turquoise to grey-green, and the mountains look a deeper green.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the mountains today, and guests see the Andaman Sea fade into the sky with no clear horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far horizon of the Andaman Sea is not visible today; guests see the cove, the palm trees and the nearest hillside clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Andaman Sea; guests watch it through the sliding glass doors of their balcony rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Andaman Sea for a second at a time, and thunder rolls back from the mountains.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees and on the Andaman Sea, and guests check twice that this is still Phuket.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, bright day, the Andaman Sea is a sharp blue, and guests admire it from indoors.
phrases.cold: The air is cold today, the beach is empty, and the Andaman Sea moves quietly against the rocky headland.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the sun loungers of Merlin Beach look at the Andaman Sea and think only of getting in.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests walk the palm-lined lawn paths down to the beach, with the turquoise Andaman Sea ahead of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Andaman Sea gold, and guests stay on their private balconies until the colour fades.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the edges of the clouds, and the Andaman Sea below them turns pink and orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests see the Andaman Sea as a dark grey surface, with the mountains darker still behind it.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain hides the mountains, and guests see the Andaman Sea only as far as the first waves.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests on their balconies see no stars, only the faint white of small waves on the Andaman Sea.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the Andaman Sea tonight, and the mountains stand black against the clear sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Andaman Sea is almost invisible, and only the sound of the waves says where the water begins.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Andaman Sea, and the first lights come on among the palm trees.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky is slowly growing pale above the Royal Palace of Madrid, just across the rooftops.
phrases.clear_morning: In the clear morning light, the Royal Palace of Madrid looks almost white from the rooftop infinity pool.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the dome of Almudena Cathedral and the Royal Palace of Madrid stand sharp above the rooftops from the roof terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Royal Palace of Madrid this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the rooftops in front of it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the garden terrace rooms, guests watch sun and cloud take turns on the Royal Palace of Madrid just across the rooftops.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Royal Palace of Madrid keeps its pale stone colour, while the rooftops around it look darker.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Madrid skyline today; Torre de Madrid is only a faint shape from the rooftop pool deck, while the Royal Palace of Madrid stays clear at close range.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The open land beyond the city cannot be seen from the rooftop today; the Royal Palace of Madrid, close by, still can.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftops, and guests in the garden terrace rooms watch the Royal Palace of Madrid turn a wet grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Madrid, and lightning shows the Royal Palace of Madrid for a second beyond the rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Royal Palace of Madrid, and the rooftops between it and the 7th-floor pool deck are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the windows of the Royal Palace of Madrid look easy to count from the roof terrace.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the white pergola terrace is quiet, and Madrid's rooftops and church spires spread out in front of it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop infinity pool up to their shoulders and look at the Royal Palace of Madrid from the water.
phrases.warm: Warm weather fills the rooftop jacuzzi, where guests look across at the dome of Almudena Cathedral and the Royal Palace of Madrid.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the stone of the Royal Palace of Madrid gold, and the rooftop infinity pool frames it at close range.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop bar, the last sun comes through the clouds and colours the rooftops of Madrid.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the rooftop bar looks over the city lights, with the Royal Palace of Madrid lit close by.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the city lights this evening, and the lit Royal Palace of Madrid shines on the wet rooftops in front of it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the clouds over the Royal Palace of Madrid take a soft glow from the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: From a 19th-century palace, guests look at a much larger one: the Royal Palace of Madrid, lit under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the rooftops are quiet and the Royal Palace of Madrid is a dark shape across them.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on around the Royal Palace of Madrid across the rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the ocean is a wide dark surface under a clear sky, and the first light is starting to show along the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: On this clear morning, guests in the balcony rooms open their doors to an ocean that is bright with early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the ocean is deep blue from the sand to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the ocean this morning, with bright patches of water between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the restaurant terrace, guests see the afternoon clouds drift over the ocean beyond the wooden pergola.
phrases.overcast: The ocean and the sky share the same grey today, and only the white surf marks where the beach begins.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the horizon today, so guests on the balconies see the sandy beach and only the first few waves.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today; the beach and the near water are easy to see, but the far ocean and the horizon are not.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the ocean, and guests in the lobby watch it through the corridor doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the ocean, and guests in the oceanfront rooms watch the storm from behind closed balcony doors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach, and the sand turns white while the ocean stays grey behind it.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the ocean looks sharp and bright, and guests are happy to admire it from the warm lobby.
phrases.cold: The beach is empty on this cold day, and the ocean has its long lines of waves all to itself.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the beach is full of people, and the ocean looks like the only sensible place to be.
phrases.warm: On this warm day guests stand on their balconies and count the swimmers in the ocean straight ahead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight turns the sand gold, and the ocean beyond it takes a darker blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the ocean turn pink, and guests on the restaurant terrace stop talking to look.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner on the restaurant terrace, guests look out at an ocean that is almost black under the evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain is falling this evening, and guests in the oceanfront restaurant see only the nearest waves through it.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the night sky, and the white edges of the waves are the only part of the ocean that shows clearly.
phrases.clear_night: Guests look up from the dark ocean tonight to a clear sky full of stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the ocean keeps moving, and the surf draws a pale line along the empty beach.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky over the ocean is still bright, and the first lights come on along the beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the fairy chimneys of Göreme stand quiet under a clear sky that will soon fill with hot-air balloons.
phrases.clear_morning: Dozens of hot-air balloons drift directly over the rooftop terrace this clear morning, some low enough for guests to read their markings.
phrases.clear_midday: The morning's hot-air balloons are gone, and under a clear midday sky Uçhisar Castle stands sharp on the skyline beyond Göreme's rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Hot-air balloons slip in and out of the clouds above Göreme this morning, and guests of this cave hotel, open since 2002, count them over the rock-cut rooftops.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the valleys this afternoon, and from Sunset Café Uçhisar Castle goes from bright to dim and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the fairy chimneys of Göreme take the colour of the cloud, and Uçhisar Castle stands dark above them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze fills the valleys today, and from the rooftop terrace the nearest fairy chimneys are clear while Uçhisar Castle is only a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Uçhisar Castle is not visible on the skyline today; guests see Göreme's rock-carved houses and the closest fairy chimneys, and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Göreme's rock-cut rooftops, and guests in Nana Cappadocia watch the fairy chimneys turn a darker shade.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the fairy chimneys for a second at a time, and thunder rolls over the valleys where the hot-air balloons usually cross.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the fairy chimneys and on Göreme's rock-carved houses, and guests watch the valleys beyond turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, Uçhisar Castle looks close enough to touch above the rooftops of Göreme.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in this hotel of 36 rooms look out over fairy chimneys and quiet valleys, with a hot coffee doing half the work.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests sit with a cold drink at Sunset Café and look across the open valleys to Uçhisar Castle.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace, guests lie back on the cushions in the warm air, and the fairy chimneys get more attention than any book.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Nana Cappadocia Roof Top Bar, the low sun turns the fairy chimneys and the valleys gold under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes under the clouds and lights Uçhisar Castle, while the valleys the hot-air balloons crossed at dawn fall into shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Nana Cappadocia, guests look over the lights of Göreme under a cloudy sky, the fairy chimneys just visible among them.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of Göreme shine on wet rock-cut rooftops this evening, and guests follow the weather from a dry table in Nana Cappadocia.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of Göreme glow softly among the fairy chimneys below the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over Nana Cappadocia Roof Top Bar tonight, and the lit town of Göreme lies below among its fairy chimneys.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Göreme is still, its rock-cut rooftops and fairy chimneys barely separate from the night sky.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set over the valleys, the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on among Göreme's rock-carved houses below the rooftop terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the São Paulo skyline stands as a dark shape under a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the towers of the São Paulo skyline first, then the treetops of the Jardins neighbourhood below.
phrases.clear_midday: From the gym, guests on the treadmills look out at the São Paulo skyline under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Jardins treetops this morning, while the São Paulo skyline behind them stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the rooftop indoor pool watch afternoon clouds drift from one stone-framed window to the next above the São Paulo skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the towers of the São Paulo skyline take the same colour as the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the São Paulo skyline today, and the farthest towers look like pencil drawings.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the nearest high-rises of Jardins are clear today; the rest of the São Paulo skyline is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the four windows of the rooftop indoor pool, and the São Paulo skyline behind them is blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the São Paulo skyline, and guests in the rooftop indoor pool count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Jardins treetops, and guests at the full-height windows watch the São Paulo skyline turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and every tower of the São Paulo skyline has a sharp edge.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay in the warm rooftop indoor pool and look out at the São Paulo skyline.
phrases.very_hot: The São Paulo skyline shimmers in the heat, and the green treetops of Jardins look like the only cool place in the city.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests rest by the rooftop indoor pool while the São Paulo skyline fills the four tall windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the towers of the São Paulo skyline gold, and guests in the higher-floor suites watch the glass shine.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and paints the São Paulo skyline orange above the dark Jardins trees.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the São Paulo skyline give the low sky a soft orange colour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Jardins this evening, and the lights of the São Paulo skyline shine on the wet rooftops.
phrases.mild_night: Guests at the full-height windows of the higher-floor suites see the lit towers of the São Paulo skyline under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the São Paulo skyline has more lights than the sky has stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who cannot sleep find the São Paulo skyline quiet and still beyond the Jardins rooftops.
phrases.dusk: From this 2003 hotel, guests watch the first lights come on across the São Paulo skyline while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Intracoastal Waterway lies still and grey-blue below the balconies, and the sky above it is clear.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the oceanfront terrace of Tinta, guests look out at the Atlantic Ocean under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic Ocean is bright turquoise at midday, seen from the pool deck beyond the glass skywalk.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Intracoastal Waterway this morning, and the water changes from blue to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: With a coffee from Starbucks in hand, guests watch the clouds drift over the Atlantic Ocean this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Intracoastal Waterway takes the same colour as the clouds above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Intracoastal Waterway today, and the far bank is only a faint outline from the balconies.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the Atlantic horizon is missing and only the near part of the Intracoastal Waterway shows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Intracoastal Waterway, and guests watch the drops mark the water from their balconies.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in the oceanfront rooms follow the storm from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Intracoastal Waterway, a sight that guests in this 433-room resort photograph twice to be sure.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, and the Intracoastal Waterway shines sharp and blue under the low sun.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in WestinWORKOUT® Fitness Studio keep warm on the treadmills and look out at Fort Lauderdale Beach.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the lagoon pool and look across the pool deck to the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.warm: At Waves Bar & Grill, guests have lunch by the pool in the warm air, with the Atlantic Ocean in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The late sun turns the Intracoastal Waterway gold, and every boat wake draws a bright stripe on it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Intracoastal Waterway turn pink and orange, and the water copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, lights from the far bank lie in long reflections on the Intracoastal Waterway.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening lights along the Intracoastal Waterway into soft yellow spots on the dark water.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, boat lights move slowly along the Intracoastal Waterway under a sky without stars.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Intracoastal Waterway tonight, and the lights on the banks shine clearly on the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Intracoastal Waterway is quiet and black, with hardly a ripple on the water.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Intracoastal Waterway.

phrases.clear_predawn: Below the Valley Villa, the valley is still a dark shape waiting for the day.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests at breakfast in Plantation Restaurant face the valley, bright in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The Ayung River valley lies green and sharp beyond the edge of the Infinity pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows slide down into the Ayung River valley while the other side stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud shade take turns on the valley this afternoon, one part bright and the next dim.
phrases.overcast: The Terrace Tree Villa looks out on a forest of soft, even green under the cloud today.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze has softened the Ayung River valley, and the other side shows only as a pale outline.
