phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, and the valley fades from view before its other side can be seen.
phrases.rain: Steady rain blurs the valley, leaving only the nearest forest clear to see.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Ayung River valley for one second, then the rain hides it again.
phrases.snow: From indoors, guests watch snow fall into the Ayung River valley and whiten the forest.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Forest Edge Villa stay indoors today, in rooms that face out into the cold, bright day.
phrases.cold: Doors stay closed at the Terrace Tree Villa today, and guests enjoy the forest from inside.
phrases.very_hot: Up to their shoulders in the Infinity pool, swimmers look out over the Ayung River valley.
phrases.warm: From the pool, guests look across the Ayung River valley to the forest on the other side.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Gold light climbs the other side of the valley while the Ayung River below is already in shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights parts of the Ayung River valley.
phrases.grey_evening: After sunset the valley keeps its shape for a while under the cloud, then goes fully dark.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain covers the Ayung River valley, and the other side is gone from view.
phrases.mild_night: The valley is dark tonight, with no stars showing above it.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night the valley is one black shape, with the stars beginning where it ends.
phrases.late_night: Nothing moves in the Ayung River valley at this hour except the river itself.
phrases.dusk: The first lamps come on at the Valley Villa while the valley below still holds a little daylight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the São Paulo skyline stands as a dark shape against a sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun reaches the tops of the towers first, and the São Paulo skyline is sharp from the rooftop pool.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Jardins canopy lies green below the rooftop pool, with the São Paulo skyline behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the São Paulo skyline this morning, and the towers change from grey to bright and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at Pool Bar spend the afternoon watching clouds drift over the high-rise buildings of the city.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the São Paulo skyline today, and the towers take the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the São Paulo skyline today, and the farthest towers fade into the white air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests on the rooftop see the nearest towers clearly and the far skyline hardly at all.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Jardins canopy, and guests in the high-floor suites watch the São Paulo skyline blur behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the São Paulo skyline, and for a second every tower shows its outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the São Paulo skyline, and guests in the high-floor suites watch the towers turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and the São Paulo skyline shows every edge from the rooftop.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Jardins canopy lies still below the rooftop, and the towers rise behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the São Paulo skyline from the water.
phrases.warm: On the sun loungers by the rooftop pool, books stay closed while guests count the towers of the São Paulo skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light fills the glass of the towers, and the whole São Paulo skyline glows from the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_golden: At Pool Bar, guests watch the last sun slip between the clouds and the towers of the São Paulo skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the São Paulo skyline give the sky above the towers a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the high-floor suites look out this wet evening, and the city lights run down the glass with the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, guests on the rooftop of this 2023 hotel see the city lights spread out under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lit windows of the São Paulo skyline reach as far as guests on the rooftop can see.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the São Paulo skyline is quiet, a line of still towers under the night sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the São Paulo skyline, seen from the rooftop of this 20-floor hotel.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the moors are a dark shape above the gardens, and the sky behind them slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the woodland first, and the private pond beside the spa suites holds a clear blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Lake District moors stand sharp above the gardens, every fold of the hills easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the moors this morning, while the gardens below stay mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon tea at the Lake House is served in front of Knipe Tarn, where clouds and blue sky take turns on the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Knipe Tarn takes the same colour, and the woodland draws a darker edge around it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits low on the 21 acres of gardens, moors and woodland today, and the nearest trees look like pencil drawings.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Lakeland hills are not visible today; guests see the gardens and the first line of woodland, and little beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the private pond; guests in the spa suites watch the rings spread across the water from their windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the moors, and each flash of lightning shows the woodland for a second through the rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the gardens, and the moors behind them are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the mountains stand clear above the woodland, and guests are happy to study them from indoors.
phrases.cold: Guests keep to their armchairs on this cold day and look across the gardens to the moors.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests at the Lake House look across the still water of Knipe Tarn, and nobody hurries.
phrases.warm: On the decked gardens of the suites, books stay closed while guests look towards the moors, and sometimes a llama looks back.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights the tops of the Lakeland hills, and the woodland below them turns warm and bright.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and patches of gold move across Knipe Tarn and the grounds around it.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and the moors fade into it until only the near gardens can be seen.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in the 30-room hotel see the gardens close by through the rain and nothing of the moors behind.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the woodland is one dark shape beyond the pond.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the moors, and guests try to count them over the dark gardens.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Knipe Tarn lies quiet, and the woodland around it cannot be told from the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lit windows of the Lake House are reflected in the still water of Knipe Tarn.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pudong Skyline stands unlit against a clear sky, and the Huangpu River below is still almost black.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light spreads over the Pudong Skyline, and guests in river view rooms see the Huangpu River turn bright.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Oriental Pearl Tower stands sharp across the Huangpu River from Sir Elly's rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Huangpu River this morning, while the Oriental Pearl Tower stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, clouds drift past the top of Shanghai Tower, and guests looking out from Sir Elly's rooftop terrace wait for it to come back.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Huangpu River takes the same colour, and the Pudong Skyline stands pale above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Pudong Skyline today, and the Oriental Pearl Tower looks like a pencil sketch above the river.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see the Huangpu River and its near bank, but the tops of the Pudong towers are not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Huangpu River; guests watch it from their river view rooms, the Oriental Pearl Tower slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Pudong Skyline, and guests at the windows of the Astor Suite see each tower appear for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Huangpu River, and the Oriental Pearl Tower fades in and out behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Pudong Skyline stands sharp against the sky across the Huangpu River.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the large windows and look across the Huangpu River to the Pudong Skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Pudong Skyline shimmers above the Huangpu River, and guests on Sir Elly's rooftop terrace look for the shade.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the panoramic terrace of the Astor Suite look across the Huangpu River to the Pudong Skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights Jin Mao Tower, and from Sir Elly's rooftop terrace the whole Pudong Skyline glows.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the Oriental Pearl Tower turns pink, then gold, above the Huangpu River.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Pudong Skyline colour the low sky, and the Huangpu River carries their reflection.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in river view rooms see the lights of the Oriental Pearl Tower run in long colours down the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the lit Pudong Skyline spreads under a soft, cloudy sky from Sir Elly's rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Oriental Pearl Tower shines across the Huangpu River, and guests keep their curtains open.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Huangpu River is quiet, and the Pudong towers stand still on the far bank.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on along the Pudong Skyline, one tower at a time.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Royal Palace of Madrid is a long dark shape under a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on the Royal Palace of Madrid, and from the 12th floor its long facade looks sharp.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Debod Temple and the Royal Palace of Madrid spread below Ginkgo Sky Bar.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Madrid's historic spires this morning, and their shadows cross the rooftops toward the Royal Palace of Madrid.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop pool, patches of afternoon sun travel across the Royal Palace of Madrid and Almudena Cathedral.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, guests at the indoor pool look through floor-to-ceiling glass at a city of the same quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Royal Palace of Madrid today, and Debod Temple below Ginkgo Sky Bar is only a soft outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far rooftops are not visible today, but the Royal Palace of Madrid still shows clearly from the high-floor rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass by the indoor pool, and guests in the water watch the city turn wet and shiny.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Royal Palace of Madrid, and guests behind the glass count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Royal Palace of Madrid, and guests watch the rooftops around it turn white from their suite windows.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing clear day, guests stay behind the large suite windows and look at the Madrid skyline in sharp light.
phrases.cold: Cold air makes the spires and rooftops very clear today, with the Royal Palace of Madrid standing out among them.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the Royal Palace of Madrid from the water, which is the sensible way to sightsee.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the terrace of Ginkgo Sky Bar look out over Madrid's historic spires with a drink in hand.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Royal Palace of Madrid and Almudena Cathedral late in the afternoon, and Ginkgo Sky Bar begins to fill.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds turn orange above Debod Temple, and guests at Ginkgo Sky Bar forget their conversation.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at Ginkgo Sky Bar have cocktails above the lit Royal Palace of Madrid.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and from the rooms overlooking Gran Vía the lights of the buildings blur on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the city lights glow under the low sky, and the Royal Palace of Madrid is bright among them.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Royal Palace of Madrid shines below the 12th floor, and the rooftops around it are dark and still.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Madrid's rooftops are quiet, and the Royal Palace of Madrid rests as a pale shape against the sky.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on around the Royal Palace of Madrid.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Santorini Caldera lies quiet under a clear sky, and the volcano is a dark shape on the still water.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Santorini Caldera, and guests in the suites with a private pool have breakfast facing the blue Aegean Sea.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in the restaurant, guests look across the Aegean Sea, which is bright blue under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Santorini Caldera this morning, while the infinity pool stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pool bar, guests follow the clouds as they drift over the volcano in the middle of the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the infinity pool and the Aegean Sea take the same colour, and the edge between them is not easy to find.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Santorini Caldera today, and the volcano seems to float on the water without a base.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the Santorini Caldera is not visible today, and guests see the volcano only as a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Santorini Caldera, and guests in the cave suites watch the volcano turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Aegean Sea, and for a second the whole Santorini Caldera shows its cliffs.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the Santorini Caldera, and the volcano fades behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear today, and the volcano stands sharp against the blue water of the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Aegean Sea is steel blue, and the wind draws white lines across the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool, where the water seems to run straight into the Santorini Caldera, and nobody hurries to get out.
phrases.warm: Guests at the Lounge lie on sunbeds in the warm air, a cocktail in hand, and look out over the Aegean Sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Aegean Sea turns gold below the upper-level suites, and from there the Santorini Caldera is clear from edge to edge as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and colours the infinity pool orange, with the volcano darker behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in the restaurant, guests look out over the Aegean Sea, which is almost black under the evening clouds.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs over the evening sea, and guests watch from their suites as the Santorini Caldera disappears into the night.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Santorini Caldera is a wide, quiet space below the pool bar, with the volcano just visible.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the infinity pool is lit in blue, and the moonlit Santorini Caldera lies beyond it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Santorini Caldera is silent, and the infinity pool lies still at its edge above the dark Aegean Sea.
phrases.dusk: The sun has gone behind the Santorini Caldera, and from the Lounge the sky is still bright above the darkening volcano.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests on the balconies above the arches have Plaza Mayor at eye level and entirely to themselves.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Plaza Mayor, and the frescoes on Casa de la Panadería show every colour under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a blue midday sky, the terrace of Café de la Plaza looks straight at the mythological frescoes of Casa de la Panadería.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Plaza Mayor this morning, passing over the statue of Philip III in the centre.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Madrid this afternoon, and the rooftop gives a wide view of them above the city.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the painted façade of Casa de la Panadería keeps its colours over Plaza Mayor.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the far side of Plaza Mayor, and the statue of Philip III looks a little blurred in the middle.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the rooftop shows only the nearest streets of the historic centre, and the rest of Madrid stays out of sight.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Plaza Mayor; guests watch it from behind their balcony doors, the frescoes of Casa de la Panadería blurred by the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Plaza Mayor, and each flash of lightning shows Casa de la Panadería for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Plaza Mayor, and the square slowly turns white around the statue of Philip III.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests in the 17th-century building keep their balcony doors closed and look at Plaza Mayor through the glass.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, Carlos Franco's frescoes on Casa de la Panadería bring warm colours to Plaza Mayor.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool with only their heads above water, looking over Madrid's historic centre.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests fill the terrace of Café de la Plaza, with the painted façade of Casa de la Panadería in view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Madrid gold, and the rooftop bar looks over the city in that light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the Royal Suite, guests see the last sun slip between the clouds over the panorama of the historic centre.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, Plaza Mayor is lit, and Casa de la Panadería glows on its side of the square.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Plaza Mayor are reflected in the ground, doubled at no extra cost.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the terrace of Café de la Plaza looks onto a lit Plaza Mayor.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Plaza Mayor tonight, above the lit façade of Casa de la Panadería.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Plaza Mayor lies empty and silent, with the statue of Philip III alone in the centre.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over Plaza Mayor while the first lights come on around the square.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear over the Aegean Sea, and Kalafati Beach lies still and empty below.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun lights the Aegean Sea, and Naxos stands clear on the horizon beyond the infinity pool.
phrases.clear_midday: At The Balcony, guests have lunch above the pool with the Aegean Sea open in front of them.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Aegean Sea this morning, while Kalafati Beach below stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the open-air Terra Athletic Club, clouds move slowly over the Aegean Sea this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Aegean Sea turns the colour of slate, and the infinity pool matches it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides Naxos today, and the Aegean Sea fades into the sky a short way past Kalafati Beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Naxos is not visible today; guests see only the nearer water of the Aegean Sea beyond Kalafati Beach.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Aegean Sea, and guests in the sea-view villas watch it mark the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Aegean Sea, and thunder rolls across the dark water towards Kalafati Beach.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Kalafati Beach, and guests in the sea-view suites watch the flakes disappear into the Aegean Sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and Naxos stands sharp across the Aegean Sea.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the sea-view suites look down at Kalafati Beach and the empty Aegean Sea.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look across the bright Aegean Sea towards Naxos.
phrases.warm: Swimmers in the 130-metre seawater pool lose count of their lengths, because the Aegean Sea keeps taking their attention.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Aegean Sea gold, and the infinity pool takes the same colour along its whole length.
phrases.partly_golden: Seen from the open-air courts, the last sun colours the clouds above the Aegean Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud the Aegean Sea is a wide dark surface, with no stars above it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Aegean Sea this evening, and the water beyond Kalafati Beach disappears into the dark.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers the night sky, and guests can just make out where the Aegean Sea ends.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the Aegean Sea, and guests in the sea-view villas count them from their windows.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Aegean Sea is dark and quiet, and the only sound comes from Kalafati Beach below.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and guests watch the Aegean Sea turn copper-blue under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky is grey-blue over the Pacific Ocean, and La Jolla Cove waits below for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: In clear morning light, the rocks below La Jolla Cove stand out against the blue water.
phrases.clear_midday: From Birdseye at midday, guests see the Pacific Ocean run from La Jolla Cove to a clean horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Brunch at Birdseye has moving shade this morning, as clouds cross the sky above La Jolla Cove and the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows drift across the Pacific Ocean this afternoon, and guests in the balcony rooms follow them toward the horizon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the rocks below La Jolla Cove look darker.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the Pacific Ocean today, so guests at Birdseye see La Jolla Cove clearly and must guess where the horizon is.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today, and the Pacific Ocean fades into pale air a little beyond La Jolla Cove.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on La Jolla Cove, and guests in the upper-floor rooms watch it cross the Pacific Ocean through their windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm moves over the Pacific Ocean, and each flash of lightning shows La Jolla Cove for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over La Jolla Cove, and guests photograph the white flakes above the Pacific Ocean because nobody at home will believe them.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests see every rock below La Jolla Cove and the exact place where the Pacific Ocean meets the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look at La Jolla Village and the Pacific Ocean through the glass doors of their balcony rooms.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, people gather by the water at La Jolla Cove, and guests at Birdseye watch them from above with a cold drink.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the Pacific Ocean shines blue beyond La Jolla Village, and small figures walk beside La Jolla Cove.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun is low and golden over the Pacific Ocean, and guests at Birdseye, on the roof of this 26-room hotel, turn their chairs toward it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange above the Pacific Ocean, and La Jolla Cove glows for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars this evening, so guests at Birdseye look at the lights of La Jolla Village and the black Pacific Ocean beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of La Jolla Village blur while the Pacific Ocean stays dark behind them.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the balcony rooms see where the streets of La Jolla Village end and the Pacific Ocean begins.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Pacific Ocean tonight, and the horizon is still easy to find.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, nothing moves at La Jolla Cove, and the Pacific Ocean is only a darker space beyond it.
phrases.dusk: The sun has gone, the sky over the Pacific Ocean is still bright, and the first lights come on in La Jolla Village.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Oudezijds Voorburgwal lies still under a clear sky, and the canal houses on the far side are only outlines.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Oudezijds Achterburgwal, where the balconies of the Canal House Suites hang directly above the bright water.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Canal Ring shows every detail: the brick bridge, the parked bicycles, the sunlit water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cross the Canal Ring this morning, and guests watch their shadows move along the Oudezijds Voorburgwal.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the dining room, guests look through large windows at the canal as sun and cloud take turns on the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Oudezijds Achterburgwal takes the colour of slate between the brick houses.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Canal Ring today, and the brick bridge appears only when guests look for it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Amstel River stays out of sight and guests see only the nearest stretch of the Oudezijds Voorburgwal.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Oudezijds Voorburgwal with small rings, and guests in the suites facing the canal count them from dry seats.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Canal Ring, and guests in the dining room watch lightning flash on the canal through the large windows.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the brick bridge and the parked bicycles, and the Canal Ring turns white and quiet.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the Amstel River and the canals shine under a bright sky, and guests admire them from behind warm glass.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps guests indoors, where the dining room's large windows frame the canal.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests in the Canal House Suites stay on their balconies above the Oudezijds Achterburgwal, where the water looks tempting.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, bicycles roll along the Oudezijds Voorburgwal, and guests watch the Canal Ring go by on two wheels.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the brick houses on the Oudezijds Voorburgwal a warm orange, and their reflections lie along the canal.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between clouds over the Canal Ring, and guests watch the water change from gold to grey.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, lit windows along the Canal Ring double themselves in the dark water.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests watch the lights of the Oudezijds Voorburgwal blur and shake on the canal.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests in the 17th-century Canal House Suites see the lights of the Oudezijds Achterburgwal below their balconies.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the Amstel River tonight, and the canal lights make a second row below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Oudezijds Voorburgwal lies quiet, and the Canal Ring finally has the water to itself.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky above the Oudezijds Achterburgwal is still bright, and the first lights appear on the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky grows pale above the city rooftops, and the Basilica is a dark shape to one side.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast under the glass dome, guests get clear morning light from above, Erzsébet Square below and the Basilica to one side.
phrases.clear_midday: The midday sun stands high over Erzsébet Square, and every tree in the park below throws only a small shadow.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cross above the glass dome during breakfast, so the light on the tables changes while Erzsébet Square moves between sun and shade below.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony rooms, guests follow cloud shadows as they move across Erzsébet Square this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Basilica keeps its clear outline, and the trees of Erzsébet Square look darker than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today; from the Skyline Suite, the Basilica looks like a drawing in grey pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far rooftops of the city are not visible today, but Erzsébet Square below and the Basilica nearby remain clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass dome, and guests under it look at the wet paths of Erzsébet Square below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the glass dome, and guests under it see lightning show the Basilica for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Erzsébet Square, and the trees and paths below slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The cold air makes everything sharp today, and guests see every line of the Basilica from the warm side of the windows.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look at Erzsébet Square from under the glass dome, where the daylight still comes in and the wind does not.
phrases.very_hot: Heat lies over Erzsébet Square, and people in the park below move slowly from one tree's shade to the next.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the balcony rooms stand outside and look at the people in Erzsébet Square.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Basilica gold, and the trees of Erzsébet Square throw long shadows across the park.
phrases.partly_golden: From the private balcony of the top-floor Chairman Suite, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over the city rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights around Erzsébet Square glow softly, and the Basilica stands to one side.
phrases.wet_evening: The wet evening doubles the lights of Erzsébet Square, each one repeated on the ground below.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hide the stars, so the city lights around Erzsébet Square do the job instead.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in this 199-room hotel look up tonight: the sky is clear above the Basilica, and a few stars show over the city lights.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Erzsébet Square is almost still, and the city beyond it sleeps.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on around Erzsébet Square.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Atlantic is a quiet, dim surface, and the horizon slowly appears as the sky grows lighter.
phrases.clear_morning: From the 3rd-floor terrace, guests look at the Atlantic under a clear morning sky, unbroken all the way to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Atlantic is a strong blue, and the wide sandy beach looks almost white beside it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic this morning, and guests on ocean-facing balconies follow them toward the beach.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The afternoon clouds break the Atlantic into bright and dull patches as far as the horizon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlantic turns grey as well, and the horizon is only a thin join between the two.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Atlantic today, and from the 3rd-floor terrace guests see the sandy beach fade into it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests see the beach and the first waves of the Atlantic, then a blur.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic, and guests watch it from behind their balcony doors as the sand darkens.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic, and guests in the ocean-facing rooms have a dry seat for the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sandy beach, and the Atlantic behind it stays a deep grey.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the Atlantic is sharp and clear to the horizon, and the beach lies empty.
phrases.cold: The 3rd-floor terrace is cold today, yet the Atlantic seen from it runs clean to the horizon.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the beach stay under their umbrellas and look at the Atlantic as if it were a cold drink.
phrases.warm: On this warm day guests sit on the 3rd-floor terrace and watch the swimmers and the long waves of the Atlantic.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight turns the sandy beach gold, and the Atlantic beyond it becomes a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun the clouds over the Atlantic turn pink, and guests on the 3rd-floor terrace keep their eyes on them.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening is cloudy, and the Atlantic shows only as white edges of waves on the beach under a dark sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening guests see water run down the balcony glass and, past it, the white foam of the Atlantic.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and the Atlantic is a wide dark space beyond the beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Atlantic on this clear night, and the horizon is where they stop.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the beach is empty, and the Atlantic keeps moving, one slow wave after another.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky over the Atlantic is still bright, and the sandy beach fades to a soft grey.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Arabian Gulf is dark and still, and the sky above it is clear from the 7th-floor rooftop pool.

phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Arabian Gulf lies flat and turquoise in front of the private beach.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning clouds drift over the Arabian Gulf, and their shadows move slowly across the water below the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the private beach, the West Bay glass towers rise across the water, where clouds and sun take turns this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Arabian Gulf takes the same colour, and the Corniche curves along its edge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Arabian Gulf today, and the West Bay towers look like faint pencil lines above the beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the bay is not visible today; the Corniche and the near water of the Arabian Gulf are still clear to see.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Arabian Gulf, and guests watch it mark the water from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Arabian Gulf, and guests in the sea-view rooms follow the storm from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Arabian Gulf, and guests in this 2005 hotel watch it meet the water along the Corniche.
phrases.very_cold: In very cold, clear air, the Arabian Gulf looks sharp and bright from the 7th-floor rooftop pool.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the private beach is empty, and the Arabian Gulf lies calm beyond the sand.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Arabian Gulf, and the Doha skyline glows across the bay from the private beach.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Arabian Gulf turn orange, and the water copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit Doha skyline shines beyond the rooftop terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights along the Corniche this evening, and the Arabian Gulf behind them is black.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the low clouds over the Arabian Gulf take a soft glow from the city.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Arabian Gulf is quiet and dark beyond the balconies of the sea-view rooms.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky over the Arabian Gulf is still bright, and the first lights come on along the Corniche below the rooftop pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale above the Garda Prealps, and Lake Garda is still and without colour.
phrases.clear_morning: Lake Garda lies blue and calm below the breakfast terrace this clear morning, with the Garda Prealps sharp behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: From the terrace at midday, Lake Garda is a clear blue, and the rock cliffs drop straight into it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cross the Garda Prealps this morning, and guests at breakfast in the indoor dining room watch their shadows move over Lake Garda.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Sky Presidential Suite on the top floor watch clouds drift slowly over Lake Garda this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Lake Garda turns the colour of slate, and the cypress trees in the park look greener.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Garda Prealps today, and from the terrace the mountains across Lake Garda are only faint shapes.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The peaks of the Garda Prealps cannot be seen today, and Lake Garda is visible only close to the shore.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the outdoor pool and the rocky mountains behind it; guests watch from the indoor pool, warm behind the glass walls.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the cliffs above Lake Garda for a second, and guests behind the glass and steel walls added in 2011 count to the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Garda Prealps and on the cypress trees of the park, and Lake Garda lies grey beneath it.

phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, Lake Garda is quiet, and the Garda Prealps are difficult to separate from the sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests awake early in the One-Bedroom Premier Ocean Villa see Jimbaran Bay still dark under a clear sky.

phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the ocean, and guests in the Three-Bedroom Imperial Villa have the whole show from indoors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Jimbaran Bay, and guests in the Two-Bedroom Royal Villa watch it from indoors.
phrases.very_cold: Jimbaran Bay looks sharp and clear in the freezing air, and guests in the One-Bedroom Premier Ocean Villa stay inside to look at it.
phrases.cold: On this cool day, guests in the Three-Bedroom Imperial Villa watch the ocean from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the pool and look out at panoramic ocean views.

phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the pool looks out over a wide, dark ocean.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the bay is dark, and even the fishing boats seem asleep.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and guests in the One-Bedroom Premier Ocean Villa stay to watch Jimbaran Bay hold the last light.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before the sun is up, the Eiffel Tower is a dark outline over the Paris rooftops, with the first pale light behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Terrace Junior Suite, guests open the curtains and find the Eiffel Tower already in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Every iron beam of the Eiffel Tower shows clearly at this hour, high above the Paris rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: The garden wakes up in patches this morning, one corner in sun and the next still in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the bar look out on the garden, where the light changes every few minutes.
phrases.overcast: The Eiffel Tower matches the colour of the clouds today, yet its outline stays sharp over the Paris rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits in the garden today, and guests at the bar watch its far end fade to grey.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Paris rooftops are easy to see and the Eiffel Tower is only a faint shape behind them.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Paris rooftops, and the Eiffel Tower looks a little blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Eiffel Tower for a second at a time, and guests in the Terrace Junior Suite count the gap before the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the garden, and guests at the bar watch the green slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Coats stay on the hook while guests admire the Eiffel Tower from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: The garden has no visitors today; guests at the bar prefer to enjoy it from their seats.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the garden is the cool green corner of the view, and the Paris rooftops shimmer beyond it.
phrases.warm: This afternoon, guests in the Terrace Junior Suite sit outside facing the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Paris rooftops gold, and the Eiffel Tower glows the same colour above them.
phrases.partly_golden: For a few minutes the clouds behind the Eiffel Tower turn pink, and guests stop what they are doing to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests look out this evening at the lit Eiffel Tower, standing bright in front of grey cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain softens the lights of the Eiffel Tower, and the Paris rooftops below it are dark and wet.
phrases.mild_night: Nobody needs a map to find the Eiffel Tower tonight, lit from top to bottom above the dark Paris rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: The lit Eiffel Tower stands sharp in the clear night, and the Paris rooftops are dark below it.
phrases.late_night: Guests still awake in the Terrace Junior Suite see the Eiffel Tower as a tall dark shape at this late hour.
phrases.dusk: Guests watch the Eiffel Tower begin to light up, while there is still some daylight left behind it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Nabq Bay lies still under a clear sky, and the empty sand runs down to the Red Sea.
phrases.clear_morning: From their room windows, guests see palm trees, beach umbrellas and the Red Sea in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the terrace of Salt Seafood shows the full 180-degree arc of Nabq Bay.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Nabq Bay this morning, and the Red Sea changes from bright blue to darker blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the curved pool complex, the Red Sea shows beyond the palm trees, where sun and cloud take turns this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the Red Sea turns grey-blue, and the palm trees along the beach stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Nabq Bay today, and the line between the Red Sea and the sky is not easy to find.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far ends of Nabq Bay are not visible today; guests see the beach, the palm trees and the nearest stretch of the Red Sea.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Red Sea, and guests watch the drops mark the water of Nabq Bay from their room windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole of Nabq Bay for a second, then the Red Sea goes back behind the storm rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees and on the sand, and guests stare from their windows at the white flakes over the Red Sea.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, guests behind the glass walls of the teppanyaki restaurant see palm trees and the Red Sea, clear and bright beyond the empty beach.
phrases.cold: A cold day leaves the beach umbrellas closed, and the Red Sea shows in the gaps between the palm trees.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the red sun loungers at the pool barely move, except to look up at the Red Sea beyond the palms.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the beach look across Nabq Bay from under the umbrellas, the Red Sea a few steps away.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the sand gold, and the terrace of Salt Seafood opens onto the long curve of Nabq Bay.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Nabq Bay turn pink, and the Red Sea takes the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner on the sand at Mangal, guests see the open fire in front of them and the Red Sea three metres away under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the palm trees drip along the beach, and the Red Sea moves darkly beyond them.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the terrace of Salt Seafood looks down on the dark water of Nabq Bay.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests at Mangal eat dinner at tables on the sand and look past the open fire to the black Red Sea.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the beach is empty, and the Red Sea is a quiet sound more than a sight.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Nabq Bay is still bright, and the Red Sea holds the last light.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale over the Mediterranean, and from their balconies early guests see the Bey Mountains slowly take form.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests at AkraFit begin this clear morning with a sharp blue sea view, which makes the exercise feel shorter.
phrases.clear_midday: From Asmani Restaurant on the 10th floor, the whole Gulf of Antalya lies open under a cloudless midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Mediterranean this morning, and the Bey Mountains go in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Panora Restaurant, guests see the Mediterranean in two colours this afternoon, bright blue in the sun and darker under the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Gulf of Antalya turns the colour of steel, and Asmani Restaurant still shows all of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Bey Mountains today, so the infinity pool seems to end directly in the Mediterranean.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Bey Mountains are not visible today; from Asmani Restaurant, guests see only the near part of the Gulf of Antalya.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Gulf of Antalya, and guests at Asmani Restaurant watch grey showers cross the water one after another.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Gulf of Antalya, and guests count the seconds to the thunder from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Mediterranean, and from Asmani Restaurant the Gulf of Antalya fades into white.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing, clear air, every ridge of the Bey Mountains stands out across the Mediterranean.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in this hotel, renovated in 2025, look from Panora Restaurant at a quiet, empty Mediterranean.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the platform beach look across the water to the Bey Mountains before they go into the sea again.
phrases.warm: By the infinity pool, guests look up from their loungers and find the Mediterranean and the Bey Mountains in one picture.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Bey Mountains gold, and the Mediterranean below the platform beach takes the same warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: At Asmani Restaurant, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over the Gulf of Antalya orange and pink.
phrases.grey_evening: From the city-view rooms, guests see the lights of Antalya glow under low evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain runs down the windows of Panora Restaurant, and the Mediterranean beyond them is a dark blur.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Gulf of Antalya is dark, and the lights along the coast show where the land ends.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Mediterranean tonight, and the Bey Mountains are a dark shape against the sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests awake in their balcony rooms find the Mediterranean black and quiet, with no boat moving.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright above the Mediterranean just after sunset, and the first lights appear along the coast.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Douro River is still and dark, and the outline of the Dom Luís I Bridge grows clearer as the sky turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the river-facing rooms have breakfast with the Dom Luís I Bridge in the window and clear morning light on the Douro River.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Douro River is bright blue, and the Dom Luís I Bridge throws its shadow on the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Serra do Pilar Monastery this morning, and their shadows slide across the Douro River below.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lounge's large windows, guests see the Douro River change from grey to blue each time the sun comes out this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Douro River turns the colour of slate, and the Dom Luís I Bridge stands out clearly above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Douro River today, and the Dom Luís I Bridge seems to start on one bank and end in the air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: the Dom Luís I Bridge is still easy to see, but the Infante Bridge and the far stretch of the Douro River are lost from view.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Douro River with small circles, and guests watch it from the river-facing rooms, the Dom Luís I Bridge shining wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls along the Douro River, and each flash of lightning shows the Dom Luís I Bridge for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Douro River, and guests behind the lounge's large windows watch the Dom Luís I Bridge turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Guests look out on a freezing, bright day, and the Dom Luís I Bridge stands clear over a steel-coloured Douro River.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the river-facing rooms are the place to be, with the Douro River and Serra do Pilar Monastery in the window.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, the Douro River looks cool and slow, and the shade under the Dom Luís I Bridge looks even better.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the private balconies watch a rabelo boat pass slowly on the Douro River toward the Dom Luís I Bridge.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Baxatola Rooftop Bar, the low sun turns the red roofs and the Douro River gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds, and from Baxatola Rooftop Bar the Dom Luís I Bridge and Infante Bridge frame an orange Douro River.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights lie in long yellow lines on the Douro River, and the Dom Luís I Bridge glows above them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests stay inside and watch the lights of the Dom Luís I Bridge break into pieces on the rainy Douro River.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lit Dom Luís I Bridge gives the low sky over the Douro River a soft glow.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests look for stars above the Dom Luís I Bridge and find its lights doubled in the Douro River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Douro River moves quietly past, and the Dom Luís I Bridge is a still shape over the water.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the first lights come on along the Dom Luís I Bridge, seen from Baxatola Rooftop Bar under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, St Mawes Harbour lies quiet under a clear sky, and the first light begins behind the moored boats.
phrases.clear_morning: From the grand sea-view rooms, guests watch the morning sun rise over St Mawes Harbour and sparkle on the water.
phrases.clear_midday: Fishing boats and yachts cross St Mawes Harbour under a clear midday sky, in full view of the waterside terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: At breakfast in The Reef Knot Restaurant, guests look through large windows at cloud shadows moving over the moored sailboats.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over St Mawes Harbour this afternoon, and the wooded hillside across the water changes colour each time.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the harbour water turns grey too, and guests in the harbour-view rooms of the cottage count the boats.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens St Mawes Harbour today, and from the terrace the yachts look like sketches on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The wooded hillside across the harbour is not visible today; guests on the terrace see only the nearest moored boats.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on St Mawes Harbour, and guests watch it from the window seats of the grand sea-view rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over St Mawes Harbour, and guests in The Reef Knot Restaurant watch lightning flash above the masts.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on St Mawes Harbour, and the moored boats slowly turn white outside the windows of The Reef Knot Restaurant.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the air over St Mawes Harbour is very clear, and every mast shows sharply from the terrace.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 19-room hotel stay in their sea-view rooms and watch the ferry cross St Mawes Harbour.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the terrace stay under the parasols and watch the yachts lie almost still on St Mawes Harbour.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests dine on the waterside terrace, with the fishing boats of St Mawes Harbour in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on St Mawes village and the wooded hillside, and guests on the terrace watch the fishing boats cross the harbour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the sails in St Mawes Harbour turn gold and then grey again.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of St Mawes village shine across the harbour to the terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: At dinner in The Reef Knot Restaurant, guests see the harbour lights blur in the rain on the large windows.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the village lights of St Mawes lie in long lines on the harbour water.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over St Mawes Harbour tonight, and the mooring lights below nearly match them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours St Mawes Harbour is still, and only the tide moves against the rocks below the windows.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over St Mawes Harbour is still bright, and the first village lights come on across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Yarra River is a dark band below, and the sky behind Eureka Tower is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Yarra River and the Southbank side under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Port Phillip Bay shows blue beyond the towers, and the Yarra River shines below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Southbank this morning, and their shadows cross the Yarra River one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Fleet Rooftop Bar, guests watch afternoon clouds drift behind the towers of the Melbourne skyline.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the city, and the Yarra River takes the same colour all the way past Southbank.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Yarra River today, and the top of Australia 108 fades into the white sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Port Phillip Bay is not visible today; the Yarra River and the nearest Southbank buildings are still clear enough.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Yarra River, and guests watch the drops run down the tall windows with Southbank blurred behind.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind Eureka Tower and Australia 108, and guests watch the storm cross the Yarra River from indoors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Yarra River, and guests stand at the glass to watch Southbank turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the Yarra River looks like cold steel under a bright sky.
phrases.cold: The air is cold and clear, so Eureka Tower and Australia 108 stand sharp above the Yarra River.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests on the private balconies of the river rooms look down at the Yarra River and think about the indoor pool.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests step out onto the river room balconies and look along the Yarra River to Southbank.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of Eureka Tower gold, and guests at Fleet Rooftop Bar see the whole skyline glow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun breaks through the clouds and colours the Yarra River orange, with Port Phillip Bay bright in the distance.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at Fleet Rooftop Bar look across the lit city skyline, a drink in hand.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the Southbank lights stretch into long reflections on the Yarra River.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hang low over the city tonight, and the lit windows of Australia 108 climb into them above the Yarra River.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the corner rooms see the lights of Southbank shine twice, once on land and once in the Yarra River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Yarra River moves quietly below, and guests who cannot sleep have Southbank to themselves.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over Port Phillip Bay, and the first lights come on along the Yarra River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Aegean Sea is a wide dark surface below the villa terraces, and the sky above it is just starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At Nouveau, breakfast is served in golden morning light, and guests look out over the Aegean Sea.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the infinity pool and the Aegean Sea behind it are almost the same blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Aegean Sea this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the water below the terraces.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the tables at Cabbanes, guests watch patches of sun and shade cross the Aegean Sea this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: The Aegean Sea turns silver-grey under a covered sky, and Elia Beach is a quiet strip of sand below.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Aegean Sea today, and from the infinity pool the horizon is difficult to find.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far part of the Aegean Sea is not visible today; guests on the terraces see Elia Beach and the water close to shore.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Aegean Sea, and guests in the sea-view suites watch it mark the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Aegean Sea, and guests follow the storm from behind the glass doors of their villas.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Elia Beach, and the Aegean Sea stays dark grey behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing, bright day, the Aegean Sea is a sharp blue, and Elia Beach lies empty below the terraces.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Aegean Sea looks cool and clear from the terrace suites.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across the Aegean Sea.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, sunbeds fill on Elia Beach, and guests on the terraces above look out over the open Aegean Sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At the Infinity pool bar, guests hold their cocktails and watch the sun go down over Elia Beach.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink above the Aegean Sea, and the infinity pool copies every one of them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the infinity pool is lit and bright, and the Aegean Sea is dark beyond it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this rainy evening, guests in Villa Ornos watch the rain fall on the dark Aegean Sea.
phrases.mild_night: From the villa terraces on this mild night, guests hear the Aegean Sea more than they see it under the clouds.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the Aegean Sea, and guests on their private terraces stop counting quite early.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Aegean Sea is black and quiet below the terraces, and Elia Beach is hidden in the dark.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Aegean Sea is still bright, and the infinity pool lights begin to show.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Aegean Sea lies still and grey-blue in front of the empty beach of Agioi Anargyroi.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the bay of Agioi Anargyroi, and the shallow water in front of the infinity pool turns clear blue.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in Rada Restaurant, guests look up from their plates to a bright blue Aegean Sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the bay of Agioi Anargyroi, and the fine sand of the beach goes from pale to gold and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terraces of the private pool suites, guests follow patches of sun and shade crossing the Aegean Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Aegean Sea turns silver-grey, and the pale sand of Agioi Anargyroi stays bright beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Guests looking out from Rada Restaurant find no line between sea and sky today, because haze makes the bay seem endless.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests see the beach and the near water of the bay clearly today, but the open Aegean Sea fades from sight beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of the bay with small circles, and guests watch it through the open doors of their suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole bay of Agioi Anargyroi for a second, then thunder rolls in over the sea.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach of Agioi Anargyroi, and the white flakes vanish as they touch the Aegean Sea.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the Aegean Sea is a deep, sharp blue, and the sand of Agioi Anargyroi lies empty in front of it.
phrases.cold: A cool day keeps the sea terraces quiet, and the bay of Agioi Anargyroi shows its blue colours with nobody in the water.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across its edge at the bay.
phrases.warm: By the infinity pool, guests put down their smoothies to look at the turquoise water of Agioi Anargyroi, and the smoothies wait.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun drops towards the Aegean Sea, and a gold path of light runs across the water to the beach of Agioi Anargyroi.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests at Rada Restaurant see the last sun colour the clouds orange above the Aegean Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Rada Restaurant, guests look out at the bay of Agioi Anargyroi, where the sea is slate grey under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain falls into the infinity pool and the bay behind it, and the two dark waters look like one.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, and from the suite terraces guests can just see small waves breaking white on the beach.
phrases.clear_night: Guests looking up from the sea terraces find stars over the bay of Agioi Anargyroi and a calm, black Aegean Sea below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the bay is silent, and only the sound of the water tells where the Aegean Sea begins.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set in the Aegean Sea, and the sky above the bay is still bright pink and orange while the first lamps come on by the pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Zurich lies still below the Adlisberg hillside, and the Alps slowly take shape against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Lake Zurich first, and guests on the private balconies follow the light as it moves up to the Alps.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Lake Zurich is a wide blue band below the hillside, with the Alps sharp behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Lake Zurich this morning, while the city of Zurich on its shore stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace around the Carezza Suite, guests watch afternoon clouds drift from the city of Zurich towards the Alps.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Lake Zurich turns the colour of slate, and the Alps keep their heads in the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills the valley today, and guests on the Adlisberg hillside find Lake Zurich showing only in patches.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today; the city of Zurich and the near shore of Lake Zurich are what guests can see.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lake Zurich; guests watch it from their suite windows, the far shore slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Lake Zurich, and guests step back from the balconies to watch the storm through the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the hillside, and from the outdoor infinity pool Lake Zurich fades slowly into white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the outdoor infinity pool steams, and Lake Zurich and the Alps stand clear behind the rising mist.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests keep to the warm side of the glass and look down the hillside to Lake Zurich.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests in the outdoor infinity pool stay up to their shoulders in water and look over Lake Zurich to the Alps.
phrases.warm: Warm air brings guests out onto the private balconies, where Lake Zurich and its bay spread out below the hillside.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Lake Zurich gold, and from the tower terrace of the Maestro Suite the Alps glow a soft pink.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lays long strips of light across Lake Zurich and the city of Zurich.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the city of Zurich mark the shore of Lake Zurich.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, rain blurs the city lights around Lake Zurich, as if someone had smudged them.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the city lights follow the edge of Lake Zurich, and the water between them stays dark.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the glass wings Norman Foster added in 2008 look down at the city lights around Lake Zurich.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Zurich is a wide dark space below the hillside, quiet under the night sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright above the Alps while the first lights come on along Lake Zurich.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the North Shore Mountains are a dark shape under a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the snow-capped North Shore Mountains stand sharp behind the downtown towers.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 34th floor, guests see the city skyline and the North Shore Mountains through glass on all sides, under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit on some peaks of the North Shore Mountains this morning, and guests in corner suites watch them through glass walls.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the Pacific Ocean this afternoon, while the North Shore Mountains stay in the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific Ocean takes the same colour, and the snow on the North Shore Mountains stays white above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the North Shore Mountains today, and the nearest downtown towers stand alone in the white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The North Shore Mountains are not visible today; guests see the downtown towers and only a little of the ocean beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch the city skyline blur behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the 34th floor, guests watch lightning over the city skyline, and the North Shore Mountains appear for a second with each flash.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the city, and guests at the indoor lap pool watch it pass the city buildings outside the glass.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the North Shore Mountains look sharp and white, and guests are happy to see them from behind glass.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the high-floor lounge look across English Bay to the North Shore Mountains from a warm seat.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, the Pacific Ocean shines, and the North Shore Mountains look cool and far away.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests step out on the 34th-floor patio and look over the city skyline in the open air.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the downtown towers gold, and the North Shore Mountains glow behind them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests in ocean-facing rooms watch the clouds over the Pacific Ocean turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights fill the 34th-floor glass, and the North Shore Mountains are lost in the dark.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the city lights spread into soft colours on the wet glass of the 746 rooms.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the clouds hold the glow of the city lights, and guests see the skyline bright against them.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the city lights lie below the two towers, and the North Shore Mountains draw a dark line under the stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city is quiet, and the North Shore Mountains wait, as mountains do, for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first city lights come on below the North Shore Mountains.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the ocean is a wide dark surface under a clear sky, and the beach below is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lies bright on the ocean, and from the ocean-view balconies guests look down on smooth, clean sand.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the ocean is deep blue to the horizon, and the beach is a wide strip of bright sand.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the ocean this morning, and guests at the restaurant windows follow them over the sand and the boardwalk benches.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Through the tall windows of the indoor pool, swimmers see coastal shrubs and a sky half blue, half cloud.
phrases.overcast: The ocean is grey under a grey sky today, and the beach looks wider and quieter than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the ocean seems to end a short way past the beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far ocean is not visible today; guests see the boardwalk, the beach and the first rows of waves.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the boardwalk, and from the restaurant windows guests watch the wet benches and the grey ocean behind them.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole ocean for a second, and guests watch the storm from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach, and the sand turns white while the ocean stays dark grey.
phrases.very_cold: The beach is empty in the freezing air, and the ocean seen from the restaurant windows is sharp all the way to the horizon.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep their balcony doors closed, and the ocean still fills the glass.
phrases.very_hot: The beach is busy in the heat, and most people are standing in the ocean rather than lying on the sand.
phrases.warm: On the balconies, guests take one photo of the beach and the ocean, then another, then one more.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun gives the sand a warm colour, and the ocean turns a deeper blue behind the boardwalk.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the ocean, and guests at the restaurant windows watch the beach slowly lose its light.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud the ocean has gone dark, and the boardwalk lights show the benches and the edge of the beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain shines under the boardwalk lights this evening, and beyond them the ocean is lost in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the night sky, and the white edges of the waves are the only part of the ocean that shows.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the ocean on this clear night, and the boardwalk lights draw a bright line along the beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the boardwalk is empty and the ocean is a slow movement in the darkness.
phrases.dusk: The sky over the ocean is still bright, and the first lights come on along the boardwalk.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Royal Palace of Madrid is a dark shape under a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Royal Palace of Madrid, and guests on the 27th-floor terrace see its stone turn bright.
phrases.clear_midday: On the glass-floored sky bridge, guests look down at the street between their shoes, then across to the Royal Palace of Madrid.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the rooftops of Madrid this morning, and the Royal Palace of Madrid moves in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Vertigo platform, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the Royal Palace of Madrid.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Royal Palace of Madrid still stands out clearly among the rooftops of Madrid.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the rooftops of Madrid today, and the Royal Palace of Madrid looks like a faint drawing on the near horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far skyline of Madrid is not visible today; from the 27th-floor terrace, the Royal Palace of Madrid on the near horizon still is.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Royal Palace of Madrid, and guests in the rooms with city views watch the rooftops shine with water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Presidential Suite watch lightning flash over the rooftops of Madrid.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Madrid, and the Royal Palace of Madrid slowly turns white as guests look on from the rooms with city views.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, the Royal Palace of Madrid looks sharp on the near horizon from the 27th-floor terrace.
phrases.cold: Guests keep their coats on at 360º Rooftop Bar, and the Royal Palace of Madrid stands clear in the cold light.
phrases.very_hot: Guests cool off in the 21st-floor pool and look out at the skyline of Madrid shimmering in the heat.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests rest by the 21st-floor pool, where the city skyline is the only thing to read.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Royal Palace of Madrid gold, and guests at 360º Rooftop Bar stop talking for a moment.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and guests on the sky bridge see the rooftops of Madrid turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Madrid spread out in every direction around the 27th-floor terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: Through the wet evening, guests in the rooms with city views see the lights of Gran Vía shining on the rain-soaked street.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, guests at Gastrobar El Edén on the 26th floor have the lights of Madrid at their feet.
phrases.clear_night: The Royal Palace of Madrid marks the near horizon tonight, with the city lights spread around it under a clear sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Royal Palace of Madrid rests quietly on the near horizon, and Gran Vía far below is almost empty.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Gran Vía, far below the 27th-floor terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Santorini Caldera lies quiet and grey-blue below the cliffs, and the volcano slowly takes shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Santorini Caldera, and the pool of the infinity pool suite seems to pour straight into the Aegean Sea.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Santorini Caldera is deep blue, and the volcano sits in the middle like an island on a map.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Santorini Caldera this morning, and their shadows cross the Aegean Sea faster than any boat.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun take turns over the Aegean Sea this afternoon, and the volcano moves in and out of shadow.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Santorini Caldera turns the colour of steel, and the white walls of the pool terrace look brighter against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies on the Aegean Sea today, and the volcano seems to float above the water of the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far cliffs of the Santorini Caldera are not visible today, and the volcano shows only as a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Santorini Caldera, and from the infinity pool suite guests watch it mark both the pool and the sea.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls around the Santorini Caldera, and lightning shows the volcano for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Santorini Caldera, and the volcano fades behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and every fold of the volcano stands out across the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the lift does the climbing, and guests arrive at their level with the Santorini Caldera already in front of them.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across the Santorini Caldera to the volcano.
phrases.warm: At the spa, an alfresco massage faces the Santorini Caldera, and few guests keep their eyes closed for all of it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Panorama Balcony, guests watch the low sun turn the Aegean Sea gold.
phrases.partly_golden: From the infinity pool suite, guests see the last sun slip between the clouds and light the volcano in the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.grey_evening: At Petra Restaurant, dinner is served by the pool under a cloudy sky, with the Santorini Caldera and the volcano beyond the candles.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Santorini Caldera this evening, and the lights along the cliff look blurred through it.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and the Santorini Caldera is a wide dark space below the lit pool.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the sky over the Santorini Caldera, and the volcano is a dark shape on the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Santorini Caldera lies black and still below the plunge pools of the honeymoon suites.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over the Santorini Caldera, and the white village of Oia begins to glow along the cliff.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide dark surface below the room windows, and the sky above it is just starting to turn grey.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at The Penthouse on the 18th floor has the Pacific Ocean on one side and the Los Angeles skyline on the other, both under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Pacific Ocean is a strong blue all the way to the horizon, and the Santa Monica coastline curves along its edge.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Pacific Ocean this morning, while the Malibu Mountains stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Malibu Suites, guests follow the Malibu coastline this afternoon as patches of sun and cloud shade pass along it.
