phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the horizon is only a thin line between two greys.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Pacific Ocean today, and the Malibu Mountains look like a faint pencil drawing above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Malibu Mountains and the Los Angeles skyline are not visible today; guests see the Santa Monica cityscape and the nearest strip of the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of The Penthouse, and behind it the Pacific Ocean is a blurred grey field.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Presidential Suite on the 17th floor watch lightning flash over the Pacific Ocean while thunder rolls across Santa Monica.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Santa Monica, and guests at the windows watch the flakes disappear into the grey Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and from The Penthouse lounge guests can follow the Santa Monica coastline right up to the Malibu Mountains.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Pacific Ocean looks darker, with white lines of waves moving towards the Santa Monica coastline.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Santa Monica cityscape, and from the lounge of The Penthouse the Pacific Ocean looks like the only sensible place to be.
phrases.warm: Lunch at The Penthouse goes slowly on a warm day like this, because guests keep turning from their plates to the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests take their seats early in The Penthouse lounge, where the low sun lays a gold path across the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and colours them orange above the Pacific Ocean, with the Malibu Mountains turning purple beside it.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the Pacific Ocean is completely black, and the lights of the Santa Monica coastline mark where the land ends.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at The Penthouse continues behind wet glass tonight, with the Los Angeles skyline reduced to soft spots of light in the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of the Santa Monica cityscape glow below the windows, and the Pacific Ocean beyond them is a wide area without a single light.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in this 18-floor hotel see the lights of the Los Angeles skyline on one side and the unlit Pacific Ocean on the other.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Santa Monica cityscape is quiet below, and the Pacific Ocean is only a deeper darkness beyond the last streets.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just gone, the sky over the Pacific Ocean is still pink, and the first lights come on along the Santa Monica coastline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the tall trees of the Gherardesca Garden stand still under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the garden terrace beside Il Palagio, which looks past lemon trees in planters to the old trees of the Gherardesca Garden.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, the Duomo rises above the terracotta rooftops of Florence under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Gherardesca Garden this morning, and their shadows cross the clipped hedges and the central fountain.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the garden-view suites watch sun and shade take turns on the treetops this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Gherardesca Garden keeps its many greens, and the small Ionic temple stands quietly among the trees.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city seen from the rooftop terrace today, and the Duomo looks like a drawing in soft pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far rooftops of Florence are not visible from the rooftop terrace today, so guests look instead at the nearby trees of the Gherardesca Garden.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Gherardesca Garden, and guests in the historical suites watch it drip from the leaves while they sit under frescoed ceilings.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Florence, and from the suite windows each flash of lightning shows the garden's tall trees for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the hedges and fountains of the Gherardesca Garden, a white picture for the suites of this 15th-century palazzo.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the terracotta rooftops of Florence look sharp and clear from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the 4.5 hectares of the Gherardesca Garden are quiet, and only the sculptures by Bjørn Okholm Skaarup keep the old trees company.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool at the heart of the Gherardesca Garden and look up at the tall trees around it.
phrases.warm: By the pool, guests on white loungers look past the hydrangeas to the hedges and old trees of the garden.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun comes through the old trees of the Gherardesca Garden and lays long shadows across the hedges.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop terrace, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds above the Duomo and the rooftops around it.
phrases.grey_evening: Evening cloud hangs low over Florence, and from the rooftop terrace the city lights give it a faint glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain falls on the Gherardesca Garden, and its wet trees shine in the light from the palazzo.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Gherardesca Garden is a wide green shadow between the palazzo and the former convent.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of Florence spread out below the rooftop terrace, and the Duomo rises above them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Gherardesca Garden sleeps, and even the fountains seem to keep their voices down.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the rooftop terrace, and the first lights of Florence come on across the rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Victoria Harbour lies still under a clear sky, and the Hong Kong skyline waits on the far side for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: From the harbour-view rooms, guests see the Hong Kong skyline sharp in the morning sun across Victoria Harbour.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in The Legacy House, guests look over Victoria Harbour, bright blue under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Victoria Harbour this morning, and the towers of the Hong Kong skyline take turns in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the infinity pool deck, Victoria Harbour changes between silver and blue as the afternoon clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Victoria Harbour turns the colour of steel, and the Hong Kong skyline stands clear beyond it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Hong Kong skyline today, and its towers look like a pencil drawing above Victoria Harbour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see the near water of Victoria Harbour but not the Hong Kong skyline beyond it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Victoria Harbour, and from the Grand Ballroom guests watch the water turn grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Hong Kong skyline, and guests in the harbour-view rooms watch the storm cross Victoria Harbour.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Victoria Harbour, and the Hong Kong skyline slowly turns white behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The cold air makes the Hong Kong skyline very sharp today, and guests count its towers from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the infinity pool deck is quiet, and the Hong Kong skyline stands across the water with nobody to look back.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look across Victoria Harbour, which shines almost white.
phrases.warm: On the daybeds of the infinity pool deck, guests lie in the warm air and let the Hong Kong skyline do all the work.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the towers of the Hong Kong skyline gold, and Victoria Harbour carries the same colour below.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Victoria Harbour turn orange, and guests in the Presidential Suite watch from their private pool on the 57th floor.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in The Legacy House, guests see the lights of the Hong Kong skyline glow under low cloud, each one doubled in Victoria Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening lights of the Hong Kong skyline, and Victoria Harbour looks like wet paint.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the clouds above Victoria Harbour take a soft glow from the Hong Kong skyline.
phrases.clear_night: From the Presidential Suite, the Hong Kong skyline shines across Victoria Harbour under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Victoria Harbour is dark and quiet, and the Hong Kong skyline rests against the night sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights of the Hong Kong skyline appear on Victoria Harbour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale behind the city skyline, and Plaza Rodríguez Peña is still a patch of shadow below.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Sarmiento Palace and the trees of Plaza Rodríguez Peña under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 14th-floor suites, guests look straight down on Plaza Rodríguez Peña, where the palm trees throw short midday shadows.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the city skyline this morning, while the rooftop pool stays in sunshine a little longer.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the balconies watch clouds drift over the Sarmiento Palace as the plaza below goes from bright to shaded.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Sarmiento Palace keeps its place beside Plaza Rodríguez Peña, and the city's buildings take the same grey colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and from the rooftop pool the far buildings look like pencil sketches.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far skyline is not visible today, so guests look at what is near: Plaza Rodríguez Peña and the Sarmiento Palace.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and behind it the trees of Plaza Rodríguez Peña shine wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the city skyline for a second, and guests in the 14th-floor suites wait for the next flash.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Plaza Rodríguez Peña, and guests stay at the windows to watch the trees turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is clear and very cold, and every roof of the city skyline shows sharply from the rooftop pool.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 113-room hotel stay indoors and look down on the Sarmiento Palace.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the rooftop pool and look at the city skyline from there.
phrases.warm: Warm air, white loungers and the city skyline: guests at the rooftop pool are in no hurry to leave.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Sarmiento Palace gold, and long tree shadows stretch across Plaza Rodríguez Peña.
phrases.partly_golden: From the 14th-floor suites, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds above the city skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights glow softly, and guests look down on the Sarmiento Palace across the plaza.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the city are reflected in the streets around Plaza Rodríguez Peña.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests look out over the lit city skyline, with Plaza Rodríguez Peña quiet under its trees below.
phrases.clear_night: A clear night sky sits above the city skyline, and the lit windows easily outnumber the stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Plaza Rodríguez Peña is empty and still, and the Sarmiento Palace stands quietly beside it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first street lamps come on around Plaza Rodríguez Peña.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Llandudno Bay is a dark, quiet sheet of water under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the sea-facing rooms take their first coffee with Llandudno Bay bright and blue in front of them.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Llandudno Bay is blue from the pebble beach to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Llandudno Bay this morning, and the Great Orme headland goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow patches of afternoon sunlight as they cross Llandudno Bay between the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Llandudno Bay turns the colour of the pebbles on the beach below.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Llandudno Bay today, and guests see the promenade and the first metres of the pebble beach, then only white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Llandudno Bay is not visible today; guests see the pebble beach and the near water clearly, and little beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the bay window of a sea-facing room, and guests watch Llandudno Bay turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole curve of Llandudno Bay for a second, and guests count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the promenade, and guests watch the flakes disappear as they touch Llandudno Bay.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the air is very clear, and guests see every line of the Great Orme headland beside Llandudno Bay.
phrases.cold: Guests in this Grade II listed Victorian house look out at a cold, steel-coloured Llandudno Bay and its short white waves.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, Llandudno Bay lies flat and shining, and guests watch swimmers walk slowly over the pebble beach to the water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day the promenade fills with walkers, and Llandudno Bay lies calm behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Great Orme headland gold, and Llandudno Bay takes the same warm colour.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests watch the last sun paint the clouds over the Great Orme headland gold, with Llandudno Bay already darker below.
phrases.grey_evening: Llandudno Bay and the evening cloud share one dark grey, and guests look for the line where the water ends.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the seafront lights shine on the wet promenade, with Llandudno Bay black beyond.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night there are no stars, and guests see only the white edge of Llandudno Bay where it meets the pebble beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over Llandudno Bay tonight, and guests in the sea-facing rooms leave the curtains open a little longer.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Llandudno Bay is still, with only slow water moving against the beach.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky over Llandudno Bay is still bright, and guests see the first lights come on along the seafront.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky grows pale behind El Ángel de la Independencia, and the gold on the column has not woken up yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun reaches El Ángel de la Independencia before traffic builds on Paseo de la Reforma, and guests in Reforma-facing rooms can read the detail of the golden column.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the golden statue on top of El Ángel de la Independencia shines above Paseo de la Reforma.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Paseo de la Reforma this morning, and the golden column of El Ángel de la Independencia goes bright, then dull, then bright again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the restaurant, guests sit by the floor-to-ceiling windows and watch afternoon clouds move behind El Ángel de la Independencia.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky takes some shine off the gold today, yet El Ángel de la Independencia is still close enough for guests to study the column.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the glass towers along Paseo de la Reforma, while El Ángel de la Independencia, directly outside, keeps its shape.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of Paseo de la Reforma cannot be seen today, and only El Ángel de la Independencia and the nearest towers show clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Paseo de la Reforma; guests watch from their suite windows as the golden column of El Ángel de la Independencia turns wet and darker.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Paseo de la Reforma, and each flash of lightning shows El Ángel de la Independencia white instead of gold.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past El Ángel de la Independencia, and guests in Reforma-facing rooms watch the avenue below turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, so every detail of the golden column of El Ángel de la Independencia looks sharp from the restaurant.
phrases.cold: A cold day makes Paseo de la Reforma look grey, but the gold on El Ángel de la Independencia stays warm in colour.
phrases.very_hot: The golden statue of El Ángel de la Independencia flashes in the strong sun, and guests admire it from the cool side of the glass in the restaurant.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, people walk slowly along Paseo de la Reforma, and the gold of El Ángel de la Independencia shines above them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the column of El Ángel de la Independencia a deeper gold, and guests in Reforma-facing rooms see the monument and the avenue in one frame.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Paseo de la Reforma turn orange, and the golden statue of El Ángel de la Independencia matches them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the car lights on Paseo de la Reforma run in two lines past El Ángel de la Independencia.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Paseo de la Reforma shine twice, once in the air and once on the wet road around El Ángel de la Independencia.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so the lights of Paseo de la Reforma do the job, with El Ángel de la Independencia standing above them.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests look down on the lights of Paseo de la Reforma and up at the golden statue of El Ángel de la Independencia.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Paseo de la Reforma is finally quiet, and El Ángel de la Independencia has the avenue almost to itself.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind El Ángel de la Independencia, and the first lights come on along Paseo de la Reforma.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the tower of Porto Cathedral is a dark shape above the sleeping rooftops.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the tiled rooftops of Porto first, then the stone of Porto Cathedral, seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Porto Cathedral stands sharp above the terracotta rooftops, every chimney easy to count.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the rooftops of Porto this morning, and from the rooftop terrace Porto Cathedral goes from grey to gold.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace suites, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they pass behind the cathedral tower.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Porto today, and the red roof tiles are the strongest colour in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the skyline of Porto, and from the rooftop terrace only the nearest rooftops and a faint cathedral tower can be seen.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the skyline is not visible today; Porto Cathedral and the closest rooftops are still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the roof tiles of Porto, and guests look at the wet cathedral tower from their room windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the tower of Porto Cathedral for a second, then thunder rolls over the old rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftops of Porto, and guests in the terrace suites see the red tiles slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the tower of Porto Cathedral looks close enough to touch from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, swimmers in the indoor pool look out at the yellow Baroque building and its red-tiled roof.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat the terracotta rooftops seem to shimmer, and guests on the rooftop terrace look for shade before they look at Porto Cathedral.
phrases.warm: Guests stay on the rooftop terrace in the warm air, with Porto Cathedral ahead and the old rooftops all around.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on Porto Cathedral and the historic rooftops, a slow change of colour seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the cathedral tower, while the rooftops below are already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the old city glow between the rooftops, and Porto Cathedral rises above them.
phrases.wet_evening: City lights shine on the wet rooftops of Porto this evening, and the cathedral tower is blurred by the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests look from their windows over the lit skyline of Porto to the cathedral tower.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Porto tonight, and the skyline with its cathedral tower is clear against the night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the rooftops of Porto are quiet, and only the outline of the cathedral tower marks the skyline.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights come on among the rooftops below Porto Cathedral.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Porta Nuova skyline stands in grey outline against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the panoramic terrace, guests watch the morning light catch the Porta Nuova skyline under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Porta Nuova skyline stands sharp against a blue sky, each tower easy to tell from the next.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Porta Nuova skyline this morning, and guests on the panoramic terrace watch the towers change from bright to grey.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Principe Terrace suite, guests look down on Piazza della Repubblica as sun and shade take turns on it this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the glass of the Porta Nuova skyline takes the same colour as the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Porta Nuova skyline today, and only the lower parts of the towers show from the panoramic terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the Porta Nuova skyline is only a faint outline and its details are not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Piazza della Repubblica; guests in the Principe Terrace suite watch it from behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Porta Nuova skyline, and guests in the fitness centre watch the storm through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Milan, and the Porta Nuova skyline slowly turns white behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing day, guests swim in the heated pool and look out at the Porta Nuova skyline in the clear air.
phrases.cold: The cold day keeps guests indoors at the fitness centre, where the treadmills look out on the Porta Nuova skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the glass towers of the Porta Nuova skyline shine so brightly that guests on the panoramic terrace reach for sunglasses.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests stay out on the panoramic terrace between the trimmed topiaries, looking across at the Porta Nuova skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the glass of the Porta Nuova skyline gold, and guests on the panoramic terrace stop to watch.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Porta Nuova skyline turn pink and the towers shine orange below them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit towers of the Porta Nuova skyline give the low clouds a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests at the heated pool look out at the blurred lights of the Porta Nuova skyline.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the lights of the Porta Nuova skyline shine under a sky with no stars.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in this 1927 hotel look out at the lit Porta Nuova skyline under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Porta Nuova skyline is quiet and still, and Milan sleeps around it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on across the Porta Nuova skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Chao Phraya River lies grey and calm under a clear sky that is just starting to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests step onto the balconies of the State Rooms and find the Chao Phraya River directly below, bright in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Chao Phraya River shines so strongly that guests at Terrace Rim Naam narrow their eyes to look at it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Chao Phraya River this morning, so one bank is bright while the other waits its turn.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Riverside Terrace, the Chao Phraya River changes from silver to grey each time a cloud passes.
phrases.overcast: The sky is one even grey today, and the Chao Phraya River has taken the same quiet colour from bank to bank.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Chao Phraya River, and from the river-view rooms the far bank looks like a soft drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The city skyline cannot be seen today, and the Chao Phraya River is clear only close to the hotel's bank.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the whole surface of the Chao Phraya River, and guests in the river-view suites watch it through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Chao Phraya River white for a second, then the thunder comes and the water goes dark again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Chao Phraya River, and guests in this 1876 hotel film it from behind the windows of Terrace Rim Naam.
phrases.very_cold: The air is sharp and very clear, and the Chao Phraya River shows every small wave in the cold light.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass of the State Rooms and watch the Chao Phraya River move slowly past.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests in the poolside lounge look past the red loungers and the tropical garden to a city skyline that shakes in the hot air.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit at the open tables of Riverside Terrace with the Chao Phraya River and the city skyline in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Chao Phraya River gold, and the hotel's shuttle boat leaves a bright line behind it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in pieces, and guests at Terrace Rim Naam see orange patches on the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Le Normandie, guests look down at the Chao Phraya River, where the city lights lie soft under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of Le Normandie this evening, and the lights along the Chao Phraya River blur into long streaks.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the Chao Phraya River carries the glow of the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and from Riverside Terrace the illuminated Thai architecture beside the Chao Phraya River stands out sharply.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Chao Phraya River is a wide dark band, so quiet that it seems to be resting too.
phrases.dusk: From Le Normandie, the Chao Phraya River still holds the brightness of the sky as the first lights come on along its banks.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Hollywood Hills are a dark shape under a clear sky, seen from the suite balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Hollywood Hills first, and guests at the rooftop pool on the 10th floor see every house and palm tree clearly.
phrases.clear_midday: The Los Angeles basin spreads south under a clear midday sky, flat and wide all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Hollywood Hills this morning, while the Los Angeles basin to the south stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop pool, guests look north to the Hollywood Hills under passing clouds and south to the city skyline in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Los Angeles basin takes the same colour, and the city skyline stands a little darker above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Los Angeles basin today, and the city skyline looks like a light pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the Los Angeles basin is not visible today; guests see the nearer streets and the lower slopes of the Hollywood Hills.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Los Angeles basin, and guests watch the streets shine from their balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the ridges of the Hollywood Hills for a second, then thunder rolls over the Los Angeles basin.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Hollywood Hills, and guests stand at their balcony doors to be sure of what they see.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, every ridge of the Hollywood Hills shows in sharp detail from the 10th-floor rooftop pool.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Hollywood Hills look close and clear above the palm trees.
phrases.very_hot: Guests stay in the rooftop pool in this heat, looking at the Los Angeles basin as it shimmers below.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, books stay closed while guests look from the Hollywood Hills to the city skyline and back.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Hollywood Hills gold, and the houses on the slopes shine one by one.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange over the Los Angeles basin, seen from the south-facing suite balconies.
phrases.grey_evening: Under the evening clouds, the lights of the Los Angeles basin give the sky a soft glow above the city.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Los Angeles basin this evening, and the wet streets carry long lines of colour.
phrases.mild_night: From the balconies of this 226-suite hotel, the lit houses of the Hollywood Hills shine under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the Los Angeles basin is a wide field of lights, and the streets run in bright lines to the horizon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Hollywood Hills are quiet, and their ridges are difficult to separate from the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still orange over the Los Angeles basin as the first city lights appear beyond the fire pit on the rooftop terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over Paseo de la Castellana is clear and deep blue, and the boulevard waits for the day to begin.
phrases.clear_morning: At Las Brasas de Castellana, guests at breakfast look across the terrace to the gardens in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Paseo de la Castellana fills the windows of the boulevard-facing rooms with light and movement.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly along Paseo de la Castellana this morning, and the boulevard changes from bright to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop suites, guests watch clouds drift over Madrid this afternoon, with patches of sunlight moving across the city.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the gardens around the terrace of Las Brasas de Castellana stay the one strong colour in view.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Paseo de la Castellana today, and the far end of the boulevard fades into pale grey.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far parts of Madrid are not visible today; guests see Paseo de la Castellana below and little beyond it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Paseo de la Castellana, and guests in suites facing the boulevard watch the wet road shine.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Madrid, and each flash of lightning shows Paseo de la Castellana for a second in white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Paseo de la Castellana, and guests watch the boulevard turn white, flake by flake.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, so every line of Paseo de la Castellana looks sharp to guests behind warm glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the gardens beyond the terrace of Las Brasas de Castellana are a view to enjoy from behind the restaurant's tall windows.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests keep to the shade on the terrace of Las Brasas de Castellana and rest their eyes on the green gardens.
phrases.warm: A warm day brings guests out to the terrace of Las Brasas de Castellana, and the gardens around it get more attention than the menu.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun falls along Paseo de la Castellana, and guests in this hotel redesigned by Ramón de Arana watch the boulevard glow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Madrid turn orange and pink, and the rooftop suites have the whole sky above the city to look at.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars this evening, but the lights of Paseo de la Castellana are bright enough for guests looking down.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Paseo de la Castellana are reflected in the road, and guests see each one twice.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of Madrid give the low sky over the city a soft orange colour.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests follow the lights of Paseo de la Castellana far into the distance, with stars above the city.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Paseo de la Castellana is almost silent, and a guest who cannot sleep has the whole boulevard to look at alone.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Madrid is still bright while the first lights come on along Paseo de la Castellana.

phrases.clear_predawn: The first pale light shows the Eiffel Tower as a dark outline, with the city below still asleep.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests opening their curtains find the Eiffel Tower in full morning sun, sharp from legs to tip.
phrases.clear_midday: Nothing hides the Eiffel Tower at this hour, and its iron stands clear against the blue from base to tip.
phrases.partly_morning: One moment the Eiffel Tower is in sun and the next in shade, as clouds move over Paris this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests can watch a patch of sunlight climb the Eiffel Tower and slide off again as the clouds move on.
phrases.overcast: Under even grey light, the ironwork of the Eiffel Tower looks like a fine pencil drawing.
phrases.fog_haze: The top of the Eiffel Tower disappears into the fog today, and guests are left guessing how tall it really is.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the outline of the Eiffel Tower shows through the thick air today, and the city behind it cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Guests stay dry and watch the rain sweep past the Eiffel Tower in grey curtains.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Paris, and the Eiffel Tower stands dark against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Guests stay in the warm and watch the Eiffel Tower turn pale behind the falling snow.
phrases.very_cold: Guests keep their slippers on and enjoy a sharp, bright Eiffel Tower from indoors.
phrases.cold: A hot drink in hand, guests take their time looking at the Eiffel Tower from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: The Eiffel Tower shimmers a little in the heat today, as if the iron itself were warm.
phrases.warm: Guests heading out in short sleeves take one more look at the Eiffel Tower before they go.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Eiffel Tower glows warm orange on one side, and long shadows stretch across the roofs below it.
phrases.partly_golden: Pink clouds gather behind the Eiffel Tower, and guests reach for their cameras.
phrases.grey_evening: The Eiffel Tower is lit this evening, and its top fades into the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests watch the evening rain fall in front of the lit Eiffel Tower.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud over Paris tonight takes a soft glow from the lit Eiffel Tower.
phrases.clear_night: Nothing stands between the view and the Eiffel Tower tonight, its lights bright in the clear dark.
phrases.late_night: The city has gone quiet, and the Eiffel Tower stands as a tall dark shape above the sleeping roofs.
phrases.dusk: While the day fades, guests wait to see the Eiffel Tower light up.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the inner harbor lies still and grey-blue, and Knippels Bridge is a plain outline against the clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the inner harbor, and from the upper floors Knippels Bridge holds the full width of the view.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the inner harbor is deep blue, and boats pass one after another under Knippels Bridge.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Christianshavn's rooftops this morning, and the canal below turns bright and dull in turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From ROOF, guests follow patches of sun moving across the Copenhagen skyline in every direction.
phrases.overcast: The sky is grey from edge to edge today, and Knippels Bridge and the inner harbor take the same quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the inner harbor today, and guests can find the Royal Library only as a soft grey block beyond the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the windmills on the horizon are missing and the view ends at Christianshavn's rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain marks Christianshavn's canal with small rings, and guests in the canal-side rooms watch Knippels Bridge shine wet above it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the inner harbor, and in each flash of lightning guests see Knippels Bridge clearly for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Knippels Bridge and on Christianshavn's canal, and the water takes every flake without a sound.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in this 1962 building keep to the warm side of the glass, looking at Knippels Bridge in the freezing, clear air.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Copenhagen skyline stands sharp against the sky from ROOF.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, locals dive straight into the harbor in front of the hotel, and guests watching from above start to envy them.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit outside at ROOF with a cocktail and look over the Copenhagen skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lies on the city's spires and rooftops, and at ROOF guests have reserved their tables for exactly this.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and turns the inner harbor copper, with Knippels Bridge drawn across it.
phrases.grey_evening: The cloud glows faintly above the city this evening, and guests on the upper floors look across the lit inner harbor to Knippels Bridge.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Knippels Bridge run in long broken lines across the inner harbor.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from ROOF the city lights glow under a low sky.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Royal Library mirrors the harbor in its glass facade, so the water appears twice.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, most of the 394 rooms are dark, and the inner harbor outside lies quiet under Knippels Bridge.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Knippels Bridge and Christianshavn's canal.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Brisbane River is a wide dark band below South Bank Parklands, and the sky behind the city is turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop infinity pool, guests look across South Bank Parklands and the Brisbane River to the city in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: From The Terrace on the 21st floor, the Brisbane River shines blue under a clear midday sky, with South Bank Parklands green below.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across South Bank Parklands this morning, while the Brisbane River stays bright in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the gym on the 21st floor, guests look out at Mount Coot-Tha as afternoon clouds pass over it.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Brisbane River turns the colour of steel, and the trees of South Bank Parklands look darker.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city across the Brisbane River today, and the towers look like a drawing in light pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the city is not clear today, so guests on The Terrace see mainly South Bank Parklands and the near bank of the Brisbane River.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Brisbane River, and guests watch it from river-facing suites, the city blurred behind the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the city, and for a second the Brisbane River shows white below The Terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on South Bank Parklands, and guests on the 21st floor watch the flakes drift down towards the Brisbane River.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and from river-facing suites guests see every tower of the city standing sharp above the Brisbane River.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Brisbane River looks calm and grey-blue below The Terrace, with South Bank Parklands green beside it.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop infinity pool and look over its edge at the Brisbane River shining white in the sun.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop infinity pool, books stay closed while guests look at South Bank Parklands and the Brisbane River instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills the Brisbane River in the late afternoon, and the glass towers of the city shine above it.
phrases.partly_golden: From the patio of a poolside suite, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over the Brisbane River and the city.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the city lights shine on the Brisbane River, and guests at The Terrace look down on South Bank Parklands.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening the city lights run in long streaks on the Brisbane River, seen through wet glass from the 21st floor.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the Brisbane River carries the lights of the city in soft yellow lines.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in this 2018 hotel stop at the edge of the rooftop infinity pool to look at the lit city above the Brisbane River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Brisbane River moves quietly below, and South Bank Parklands rests under the night sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright over the Brisbane River, and the first lights come on along Kurilpa Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky turns pale over the Indian Ocean, and the uMhlanga Lighthouse slowly stands out against the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on The Ocean Terrace, guests look across a bright blue Indian Ocean under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Lunch on The Ocean Terrace has the uMhlanga Lighthouse on the horizon, red and white against a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Indian Ocean this morning, and guests at The Oyster Bar watch the water change from blue to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace of The Lighthouse Bar, guests look down on the uMhlanga Lighthouse while clouds drift over the open water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Indian Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the red top of the uMhlanga Lighthouse is the brightest thing seen from the pool deck.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the uMhlanga Lighthouse seems to stand at the edge of the world beside the pool deck.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far Indian Ocean is not visible today; guests in the Clock Library see the uMhlanga Lighthouse clearly and only the nearest waves behind it.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the arched windows of the sea-facing suites, and the uMhlanga Lighthouse stands wet and striped in front of a grey Indian Ocean.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Indian Ocean, and guests in the Clock Library watch the storm from leather armchairs, the uMhlanga Lighthouse in front of them.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Indian Ocean, a surprise for guests at The Oyster Bar, and the waves fade to white behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, and from the Presidential Suite the coastline and the Indian Ocean show in sharp detail.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this hotel of 86 rooms stay indoors and watch the Indian Ocean surf break behind the uMhlanga Lighthouse.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the pool and look past the uMhlanga Lighthouse to the flat, shining Indian Ocean.
phrases.warm: By the pool, guests on sun loungers have the uMhlanga Lighthouse, built in 1954, between them and the Indian Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late golden light warms the red and white stripes of the uMhlanga Lighthouse, and guests at The Lighthouse Bar raise a cocktail to it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink above the Indian Ocean, and the terraces of the sea-facing suites share the show with the uMhlanga Lighthouse.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner on The Ocean Terrace, the light of the uMhlanga Lighthouse shines under low cloud, and the Indian Ocean is heard more than seen.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and guests at The Oyster Bar see the Indian Ocean only as moving grey beyond the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, yet the light of the uMhlanga Lighthouse still marks where the Indian Ocean begins.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests on the rooftop terrace of The Lighthouse Bar see stars above the Indian Ocean and the lit uMhlanga Lighthouse below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Indian Ocean is black beyond the sea-facing balconies, and only the white surf shows where the waves break.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from The Lighthouse Bar guests watch the lamp of the uMhlanga Lighthouse come on over the Indian Ocean.

phrases.clear_predawn: Lake Michigan is still dark, with a thin pale line growing where the water ends.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Junior Suite, guests open the curtains on a city skyline already bright with morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun flashes off the glass of the Chicago Skyline, floor after floor.
phrases.partly_morning: Lake Michigan changes from grey to blue and back again as each cloud moves on.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Half the Chicago Skyline is in sun and half in shade, and the two halves keep swapping.
phrases.overcast: The towers of the Chicago Skyline look darker today, and every roof is easy to see against the pale cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog wraps the Chicago Skyline, and the towers come and go like a slow magic trick.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Lake Michigan shows only its near water today; the horizon is not visible.
phrases.rain: Guests in the Junior Suite watch the rain blur the city skyline into soft grey shapes.
phrases.thunderstorm: Each flash of lightning shows Lake Michigan for a second, then the storm takes it back.
phrases.snow: Snow thins the Chicago Skyline to pale outlines, and guests are happy to watch it from indoors.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Junior Suite stay close to the glass and far from the wind, with the city skyline sharp in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: Nobody is hurrying outside today, with Lake Michigan lying grey-blue and wide behind the glass.
phrases.very_hot: Guests look at Lake Michigan today the way people look at a cold drink.
phrases.warm: Lake Michigan is calm and blue all the way to the horizon, and guests keep looking up from their books to check it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Lake Michigan deepens to dark blue while the low sun still warms the city beside it.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds over the Chicago Skyline turn pink at the edges, and guests stop what they are doing to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud over downtown Chicago glows with the city's own light, the Chicago Skyline bright beneath it.
phrases.wet_evening: From the Junior Suite, guests see the lit city skyline shining through tonight's rain.
phrases.mild_night: The city lights stop in a clean line tonight, and everything beyond that line is the dark water of Lake Michigan.
phrases.clear_night: Guests count lit windows in the Chicago Skyline tonight and give up long before the top floors.
phrases.late_night: Lake Michigan is quiet and black now, and the few guests still awake have it to themselves.
phrases.dusk: Windows in the Chicago Skyline switch on floor by floor while Lake Michigan holds the last blue.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a quiet grey surface beyond the rooftops of La Jolla Village, under a clear sky.

phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the North Shore Mountains this morning, and their shadows move slowly across Burrard Inlet.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A cruise ship glides along Burrard Inlet this afternoon, passing from cloud shadow into sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Burrard Inlet turns the colour of steel, and the seaplanes are the brightest things on it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies over Burrard Inlet today, and the North Shore Mountains are almost hidden above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The North Shore Mountains are not visible today; from the indoor pool, guests see the harbour and little beyond it.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows of the indoor pool, and Lion's Gate Bridge looks blurred beyond the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the North Shore Mountains, and guests watch the storm cross Burrard Inlet from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Burrard Inlet, and the North Shore Mountains fade into white as guests watch from the warm whirlpool.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing today, and the North Shore Mountains stand sharp and clear above the still water of Burrard Inlet.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay in the whirlpool a little longer and look across the harbour to the North Shore Mountains.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, Burrard Inlet is bright and glaring, and the North Shore Mountains look soft and blue behind it.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, seaplanes come and go on Burrard Inlet, and guests stop to watch each take-off.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun warms the slopes of the North Shore Mountains, and the harbour view suites fill with the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and turns Burrard Inlet gold, with the North Shore Mountains already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests in the rooms facing Vancouver Lookout see the tower shining among the lit downtown buildings.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights shine softly through the weather, and Burrard Inlet is a black space beyond them.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the city lights reach as far as the dark water of Burrard Inlet.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests look past the city lights and across Burrard Inlet to the black outline of the North Shore Mountains.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Burrard Inlet is quiet and dark, with no seaplanes and no cruise ships on the move.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the suite windows guests watch the first lights appear in the downtown towers and along the harbour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, St Stephen's Cathedral stands unlit across Stephansplatz, its spire sharp against a clear, paling sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the tiled roof of St Stephen's Cathedral, seen at close range from the Dome Suite terraces.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in DO & CO Restaurant on the top floor, guests look straight across at St Stephen's Cathedral under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Stephansplatz this morning, and the stone of St Stephen's Cathedral turns from light to dark and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From ONYX restaurant on the 6th floor, guests watch clouds drift behind the Gothic spire of St Stephen's Cathedral.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the diamond pattern on the roof of St Stephen's Cathedral still stands out above Stephansplatz.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the spire today, so St Stephen's Cathedral seems to end halfway up, just across the square.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the city centre is lost today, but St Stephen's Cathedral, just across Stephansplatz, stays clear in every detail.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the cathedral-facing suites, and St Stephen's Cathedral looks slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral for a second, sharp and white above Stephansplatz.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Stephansplatz and settling on the steep roof of St Stephen's Cathedral, white on every ledge of the stone.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, every carved detail of St Stephen's Cathedral looks sharp from the warm side of the glass at ONYX restaurant.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the rooms above Graben look down the long pedestrian street from behind the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, people cross Stephansplatz slowly, and guests watch them from DO & CO Restaurant with St Stephen's Cathedral behind.
phrases.warm: From their own balcony, guests in the balcony suites stand in the warm air and look along Kärntner Strasse over the heart of Vienna.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the stone of St Stephen's Cathedral a warm yellow, close enough to read from across the square.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights the spire of St Stephen's Cathedral, while Stephansplatz below is already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in DO & CO Restaurant, guests see St Stephen's Cathedral lit against a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The lit walls of St Stephen's Cathedral are reflected in the wet ground of Stephansplatz tonight, and guests at ONYX restaurant watch over a cocktail.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the low clouds above St Stephen's Cathedral take a soft glow from the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in this hotel of 43 rooms have one very large neighbour: St Stephen's Cathedral, lit under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Stephansplatz is empty and St Stephen's Cathedral is a quiet dark shape across the square.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind St Stephen's Cathedral as the first lights come on around Stephansplatz.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Canton Tower is a thin dark shape against a sky that slowly turns pale behind the Sky Lobby glass.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in The Market Café, guests look up from the dim sum to find the Canton Tower sharp in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Sky Lobby on the 22nd floor, the Canton Tower, the IFC and the CTF Finance Centre stand in one clear frame under a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Huacheng Square this morning, and guests in park-facing rooms follow them over the trees.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift past the top of the CTF Finance Centre this afternoon, while the Canton Tower stays in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the glass towers of Zhujiang New Town take the same colour, and the Canton Tower stands slim among them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Canton Tower today, and from the Sky Lobby its top seems to fade into the white sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: guests in the Sky Lobby can see the nearer office towers, but the Canton Tower is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows by the indoor pool, and swimmers see the city towers blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Canton Tower, and guests in the Sky Lobby stop talking to watch the storm cross Zhujiang New Town.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Guangzhou, and guests on the treadmills in the gym slow down to watch the flakes drift past the city towers.
phrases.very_cold: The cold air is very clear today, and the Canton Tower stands sharp against the bright sky from top to base.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay by the floor-to-ceiling windows of their rooms with a cup of tea, looking over the park and its trees.
phrases.very_hot: The heat shimmers over Huacheng Square, and guests are glad to watch the city towers from the cool water of the indoor pool.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, people walk under the trees in the park, small figures seen from the rooms facing Huacheng Square.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the IFC and the CTF Finance Centre gold, and the Canton Tower catches the same warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun breaks through the clouds and lights the Canton Tower, a show that guests in this 2008 hotel still stop for.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low evening cloud, the lit Canton Tower colours the sky around it, and the towers of Zhujiang New Town fill with lights.
phrases.wet_evening: From the gym's treadmills, the lit skyline shines through the wet glass this evening, and nobody minds running indoors.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the Canton Tower shines through thin cloud, and guests in the suites leave the curtains open.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lit Canton Tower, the IFC and the CTF Finance Centre stand bright against a black sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Zhujiang New Town is quiet, and the Canton Tower is a tall dark line over the sleeping city.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset as the first lights come on along the Canton Tower, framed by the Sky Lobby.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the downtown skyline is a group of towers under a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the downtown skyline, and the Great Wheel shows beyond the towers from the outdoor terrace.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Mount Rainier shows above the city from the 8th-floor lounge.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Elliott Bay this morning, and guests in the bay-view rooms follow the ferries crossing to Bainbridge Island.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move slowly across the downtown skyline this afternoon, tower by tower.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the lobby lounge windows show downtown streets and mid-rise buildings in the same soft colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the tops of the downtown towers today, and the Great Wheel is only a faint circle.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Mount Rainier is not visible today, and guests in the 8th-floor lounge see only the nearest downtown towers.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and the downtown skyline behind it looks slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the downtown skyline, and guests watch the storm from behind the glass of the 8th-floor lounge.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over downtown, and the Great Wheel fades in and out behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and Mount Rainier stands white and sharp behind the city.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay inside the 8th-floor lounge and look out at the downtown towers.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the outdoor terrace find a seat in the shade and look across the downtown skyline.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit out on the outdoor terrace with the downtown skyline all around them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights the glass of the downtown towers, and Elliott Bay shines behind the Great Wheel.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and turns the downtown skyline a warm orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hang low this evening, and the lit downtown skyline gives them a soft glow above the outdoor terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Great Wheel shine through the rain on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the lit downtown skyline and the Great Wheel glow beyond the terrace fireplaces under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: From rooms facing Lake Union in this 45-floor tower, guests see city lights reach the lake under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the downtown towers stand still and quiet, and nobody is awake to count them.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the downtown skyline and on the Great Wheel.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the gulf of Parikia lies still and grey-blue below the hillside, and the sky slowly turns pale above it.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Coeli Restaurant, guests look out over a clear blue Aegean Sea in the first sunshine.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the infinity pool seems to pour straight into the blue bay below.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the bay this morning, and the water changes from blue to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the loungers of Olvia Spa, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the Aegean Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Aegean Sea turns the colour of slate, and the town of Parikia stands out across the bay.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the bay today, and the town of Parikia looks like a chalk drawing on the far shore.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the bay is not clear today; from the pool, Krios Beach and the near water are visible, and little beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the gulf of Parikia, and guests watch it mark the grey water from behind the windows of Coeli Restaurant.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the gulf of Parikia, and each flash of lightning shows the whole bay for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the bay, and guests at their windows watch the flakes disappear into the Aegean Sea.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, guests stay behind the glass and see every house in Parikia sharply across the bay.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the pool terrace is quiet, and the bay below has the sea wind all to itself.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their chins and look down at the bright bay from the water.
phrases.warm: By the pool, books stay closed on this warm day while guests look at the sailboats moored in the bay instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the town of Parikia, seen across the bay from the private pool suites.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Aegean Sea, and guests watch the sunset with a cocktail in hand.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Parikia shine across the dark bay, seen from the dinner tables of Coeli Restaurant.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening the lights of Parikia blur across the bay, and guests watch them from their suite windows.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the town lights of Parikia lie in a low curve along the far side of the bay.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the gulf, and the lights of Parikia answer them from the far shore.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the bay is quiet and black below the hillside, and only the sound of the sea reaches the 56 rooms.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset; the infinity pool glows blue, and the first lights come on in Parikia across the bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the city skyline stands in grey outline beyond the still infinity pool.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the sky gardens first, then moves across the city skyline behind the infinity pool.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the city skyline stands sharp against a blue sky, seen from the rooftop gym.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the city skyline this morning, while Hong Lim Park stays in sunshine below the rooms that face it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Orchid Club, guests watch cloud shadows cross the city skyline through the afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the sky gardens keep their green and the city skyline turns the colour of the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and the towers beyond the infinity pool look like pencil drawings.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far towers of the city skyline are not visible today, so the sky gardens on the terraces fill the view instead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the sky gardens, which are watered by rainwater, and guests watch the leaves shine from their room windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the city skyline for a second at a time, and guests watch the storm from Orchid Club on the rooftop.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sky gardens, a sight nobody expected, and the city skyline turns white behind it.
phrases.very_cold: In this sharp cold the city skyline is clear in every detail, and guests look at it from the warm rooftop gym.
phrases.cold: On a cold day guests stay behind the glass in the skyline-view rooms, where the city skyline fills the windows.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look at the city skyline from the water.
phrases.warm: By the infinity pool, books stay closed while guests look across the water at the city skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun warms the terraced sky gardens that WOHA designed, and the city skyline glows behind them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud, and guests at Orchid Club watch the city skyline change colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the city skyline shine softly beyond the infinity pool.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening guests at Orchid Club watch the lights of the city skyline blur through the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night under cloud, guests in the rooms facing Hong Lim Park see its trees as a quiet dark space among the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lit city skyline is doubled in the water of the infinity pool.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the 15,000 square metres of sky gardens are still, and the city skyline waits quietly for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests in the rooftop gym see the first lights come on across the city skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: River North is still dark, and the Chicago skyscrapers show as black shapes against the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Presidential Suite, guests open the curtains to a Chicago Skyline already bright with sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Glass and steel flash across the Chicago Skyline, every tower sharp at the edges.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests at breakfast see the Chicago skyscrapers go from bright to grey and back as the clouds pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun and shade move slowly across the Chicago Skyline this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: The Chicago Skyline keeps its outline today, grey towers against a paler grey.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze turns the Chicago Skyline into soft shapes, with only the nearest River North blocks fully clear.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the closer skyscrapers show clearly today; the rest of the Chicago Skyline is faint behind them.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on River North, and the Chicago Skyline stands grey and blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over River North, and each flash picks out the skyscrapers for a second.
phrases.snow: Guests in the Presidential Suite watch snow drift past the Chicago Skyline from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_cold: Steam rises from the rooftops of River North, and the Chicago Skyline stands sharp behind it.
phrases.cold: The Chicago Skyline stands clear above River North, each tower easy to tell from the next.
phrases.very_hot: The glass towers of the Chicago Skyline throw the sunlight back in white flashes over River North.
phrases.warm: On the terrace of Twenty Six by LM Restaurant Group, guests sit outside and look over Chicago's River North neighborhood.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: One side of every skyscraper turns gold, and the Chicago Skyline looks freshly polished.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds over the Chicago Skyline go pink at the edges as the glass towers hold the day's final light.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low cloud, the lit Chicago Skyline gives the evening a soft orange glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight's rain blurs the lights of the Chicago Skyline, and River North shines wet below.
phrases.mild_night: The Chicago skyscrapers stand close together in the night, their tops fading into cloud above River North.
phrases.clear_night: Guests can try to count the lit floors of the Chicago Skyline tonight, though most give up early.
phrases.late_night: In the Presidential Suite, a guest who cannot sleep finds River North quiet and the skyscrapers mostly dark.
phrases.dusk: Windows switch on one by one along the Chicago Skyline while the sky behind is still pale blue.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Singapore skyline stands quiet and dark against a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun fills the floor-to-ceiling windows of the President Suite, where the Singapore skyline stands sharp against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, the city skyline stands under a clear midday sky, every tower easy to tell apart.
phrases.partly_morning: White clouds sit above the Singapore skyline this morning, and from the rooftop pool the sky looks half blue, half busy.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, clouds pass behind the three towers of Marina Bay Sands, which stand out on the far skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the city towers take the same colour, and the trees along Orchard Road are the brightest thing in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Guests looking for the far towers find only haze today, while the nearer skyline shows in soft outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The three towers of Marina Bay Sands are not visible today; the view stops at the nearer towers and the trees of Orchard Road.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Royal Suite, and guests watch the skyline turn soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests see the whole Singapore skyline for a second when lightning flashes, then the storm closes over the towers again.
phrases.snow: Snow falls between the city towers and whitens the trees along Orchard Road, a surprise for everyone watching.
phrases.very_cold: The rooftop pool lies empty in the very cold air, while the city skyline around it stands sharp in the clear light.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the towers of the skyline stand clear above Orchard Road, where the hotel has stood for more than 3 decades.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look at the city skyline from the water.
phrases.warm: By the lap pool, guests lie under the palm trees on this warm day, with city towers rising just behind the greenery.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the towers of the Singapore skyline gold, and the rooftop pool catches the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests in the Ambassador Suite watch the clouds turn orange above the city skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the city glow against the low sky, and Orchard Road draws a bright line through the trees.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests watch the wet evening from indoors, as the city lights blur in the rain and Orchard Road shines below.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the clouds hold the glow of the city, and guests see the skyline lit from below and from above.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in city-facing rooms see the three towers of Marina Bay Sands lit above the skyline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Orchard Road lies quiet under its trees, and the towers of the skyline wait for morning.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on in the towers along Orchard Road.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Aliados Avenue lies quiet under a clear sky, and the Cathedral ridge is a dark shape beyond it.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Astória, guests look out over Liberdade Square under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a cloudless midday sky, Aliados Avenue is bright from end to end, and the Cathedral ridge shows above the historic centre.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Liberdade Square this morning, and the Cathedral ridge goes from bright to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From balcony rooms, guests watch patches of sun travel up Aliados Avenue between the afternoon clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Liberdade Square takes the same quiet colour, seen through the glass of Astória.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Cathedral ridge today, and Aliados Avenue fades a little more with each block.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Cathedral ridge is not visible today; the view stops at Aliados Avenue and Liberdade Square, which stay clear enough.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Liberdade Square, and guests in Astória watch the wet paving shine from their tables.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Cathedral ridge for a second, then thunder rolls down Aliados Avenue.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Aliados Avenue, and guests stand at their room windows to watch the boulevard turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air makes the historic city crisp today, and guests in the Cardosas Bar look at it through the large windows, glad of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in this 18th-century palace look down Aliados Avenue from their room windows.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over Liberdade Square, and guests on the Astória terrace look at it slowly, cold drinks in hand.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit out on the Astória terrace and follow the life of Liberdade Square.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Aliados Avenue gold, and the Cathedral ridge glows beyond the boulevard.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between clouds and lights the Cathedral ridge, while Aliados Avenue is already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: After dark, guests in the Cardosas Bar watch the lights of the historic city under low cloud, a glass of port in hand.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Liberdade Square shine twice, once in the air and once on the ground, as guests at dinner in Astória look on.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the street lights of Aliados Avenue draw two long rows up the boulevard.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights on the Cathedral ridge shine above the historic centre, with a few stars over them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Aliados Avenue is still, and the few guests awake among the 113 rooms have the boulevard to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lamps come on along Aliados Avenue one by one.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Caribbean Sea is a wide dark surface under a clear sky, with the first light still to come.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the seafront rooms watch the sun rise over the Caribbean Sea from their balconies.
phrases.clear_midday: From The Caribe Bar & Grill, guests look at a turquoise Caribbean Sea over a lunch of ceviche.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Caribbean Sea this morning, while the white private beach stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The round pool and its blue umbrellas sit in sun, then in shade, with the Caribbean Sea behind them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Caribbean Sea loses its turquoise today, and the white private beach looks brighter than the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Caribbean Sea today, and it is not easy to say where the water ends and the sky begins.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; only the white private beach and the nearest part of the Caribbean Sea can be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Caribbean Sea and on the private beach, where the white sand turns darker.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Caribbean Sea for a second, and guests count the seconds from their rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the white private beach, and for once it is not easy to tell it from the sand.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the Caribbean Sea is a sharp blue, and the horizon is a clean line.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the private beach is empty, and the Caribbean Sea looks darker than usual.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests at The Caribe Bar & Grill keep to the shade and look at the bright Caribbean Sea.
phrases.warm: Swimmers circle the round pool on this warm day, and the Caribbean Sea shows beyond the palm trees.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At D-Lounge, guests watch the sun go down in a clear sky, a cocktail in hand.
phrases.partly_golden: In The Club Lounge, guests watch the last sun turn the clouds gold.
phrases.grey_evening: At Casitas, guests have dinner on the beach under a cloudy sky, with the dark Caribbean Sea a few steps away.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the private beach this evening, and the Caribbean Sea is heard more than seen.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, guests look from their balconies at the white lines of waves on the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Caribbean Sea, and guests at the beach tables of Casitas look up between courses.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Caribbean Sea is black and quiet, and all 363 rooms have a balcony above it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Caribbean Sea, and the first lights come on around the round pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic lies dark and calm off South Beach, and the horizon is starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the oceanfront balcony rooms, guests watch the sun rise out of the Atlantic into a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Atlantic turns turquoise close to the sand of South Beach.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across South Beach this morning, and the Atlantic changes from turquoise to deep blue beneath them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the oceanfront balconies follow the afternoon clouds as they drift out over the Atlantic.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers South Beach today, and the Atlantic has taken the same quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic seems to end a short way beyond South Beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: guests see the sand and the first waves of South Beach, but the Atlantic horizon is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on South Beach, and guests watch it mark the empty sand and the grey Atlantic.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic, and for a second guests see every wave off South Beach.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on South Beach, and guests in this 1950s building look twice at white flakes landing on white sand.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Atlantic horizon draws a sharp line beyond the empty sand of South Beach.
