phrases.cold: On this cold day South Beach is nearly empty, and guests look from indoors at the long waves of the Atlantic.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the shade of the striped beach cabanas and look out at the turquoise Atlantic.
phrases.warm: From the beach cabanas, guests look across the warm white sand to the Atlantic, and nobody is in a hurry to move.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the sand of South Beach gold, and the Atlantic becomes a deeper blue behind it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sunlight colours the clouds above the Atlantic pink, while South Beach slowly loses its shadows.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in the suites see the lit city skyline through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain blurs the lights along South Beach, and the Atlantic beyond them is lost in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the waves draw white edges along South Beach, and guests follow them in the dark.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests on the oceanfront balconies see stars above the Atlantic and the lights of South Beach below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours South Beach is quiet, and the Atlantic keeps moving for nobody in particular.
phrases.dusk: The sky over the Atlantic is still bright after sunset, and the first lights appear along South Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a dark, calm surface, and the first grey light shows where Surfers Paradise Beach begins.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Pacific Ocean, and guests in the upper suites see it through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Surfers Paradise skyline stands sharp against a blue sky, each tower easy to tell from the next.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pacific Ocean this morning, while Surfers Paradise Beach stays mostly bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests looking inland this afternoon see clouds gathering above the hinterland ranges and patches of sun on the Nerang River.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the white sand of Surfers Paradise Beach stands out more.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Surfers Paradise skyline today, and guests see the towers fade one behind another.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The hinterland is not visible today, and guests see only the nearer towers of the Surfers Paradise skyline.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the ocean-facing suites, and guests watch Surfers Paradise Beach turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second guests see the whole Surfers Paradise skyline in white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Surfers Paradise Beach, and guests look twice to be sure it is not sand in the wind.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the sun is bright but gives no warmth, and the Pacific Ocean shines beyond Surfers Paradise Beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests follow the lines of waves coming in from the Pacific Ocean to Surfers Paradise Beach.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests see swimmers crowd the water's edge at Surfers Paradise Beach while the skyline shimmers behind them.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, small figures walk along Surfers Paradise Beach, and the Pacific Ocean breaks gently beside them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the Surfers Paradise skyline gold, and the Pacific Ocean deepens to a darker blue.
phrases.partly_golden: From a river-facing balcony, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds above the hinterland and the Nerang River.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Surfers Paradise skyline glow on the low sky, and the Pacific Ocean beside them is black.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain blurs the lights of the Surfers Paradise skyline, and guests see each tower as a soft column of colour.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the white surf along Surfers Paradise Beach is easier to see than the horizon.
phrases.clear_night: From the suites of this 238-room resort, guests see the Surfers Paradise skyline lit against a clear night sky, with stars above the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pacific Ocean is quiet and wide, and Surfers Paradise Beach lies empty beside it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Surfers Paradise skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Arabian Sea is a wide dark surface beyond the bay windows, and the curve of Marine Drive is quiet under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the pool deck, the Arabian Sea is a clean blue this morning, flat and bright under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in Ziya, guests look out over the Arabian Sea, bright blue under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Arabian Sea this morning, and guests in The Champagne Lounge follow them through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over Marine Drive this afternoon, and the long curve of the bay changes colour every few minutes.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Arabian Sea turns the same grey, and Marine Drive draws a clear curve along its edge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the far end of Marine Drive today, and the Arabian Sea fades into the sky without a clear horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of Marine Drive is not visible today; guests see the near part of the curve and the Arabian Sea just beyond it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Marine Drive, and guests in The Champagne Lounge watch the Arabian Sea turn grey behind the wet floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Arabian Sea, and guests in one of the 237 rooms and suites watch the storm from behind the bay windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Marine Drive, and the Arabian Sea is pale and dim behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and the Arabian Sea looks sharp and bright from the ocean view suites.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to The Champagne Lounge, where the floor-to-ceiling windows hold the whole Arabian Sea.
phrases.very_hot: The Arabian Sea shines white in the strong heat, and guests on the pool deck look at it from the shade.
phrases.warm: On the pool deck, guests in the warm air leave their books closed and look at the Arabian Sea instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun puts a gold path across the Arabian Sea, and the path seems to end at the outdoor deck of The Eau Bar.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds over the Arabian Sea, and the curve of Marine Drive takes the same warm light.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Marine Drive curve along the bay, and guests at dinner in Ziya look out over the dark Arabian Sea.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of Marine Drive into a soft gold curve this evening, with the Arabian Sea black beside it.
phrases.mild_night: The Queen's Necklace glitters under a cloudy night sky, and guests in the Golconda Suite look down on its whole curve.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lights of Marine Drive form the Queen's Necklace along the bay, and from The Eau Bar the Arabian Sea is black and calm.
phrases.late_night: Long after midnight, Marine Drive is almost empty, and the Arabian Sea keeps to its side of the long curve.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Arabian Sea, and the first lights of Marine Drive come on one by one, like a necklace being fastened.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide, dark surface under a clear sky, and the palms are still.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the palms first and then the Pacific Ocean, which turns a clean blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Pacific Ocean is bright blue under an empty sky, and the horizon is sharp from Sunset Terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Pacific Ocean this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony of the Oceanfront Signature Suite, guests watch afternoon clouds pass over the palms and the open ocean.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean takes the same colour, and the palms stand out in dark green.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Pacific Ocean today, and the palms in front of it look like drawings on grey paper.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; from Sunset Terrace, only the palms and the nearest stretch of the Pacific Ocean show.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pacific Ocean, and guests in the 70 suites watch it run down the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second each palm shows clearly against the storm sky.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palms, and guests stay at their suite windows to watch it meet the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear today, and the Pacific Ocean is a deep blue behind the palms.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the palms and the green lawn lie quiet in front of the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on Sunset Terrace look down at the Pacific Ocean and think seriously about swimming in it.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit on the blue sofas of Sunset Terrace and look over the glass railing at the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden hour arrives on Sunset Terrace, and the low sun turns the Pacific Ocean to gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in long beams, and the Pacific Ocean shines in patches below Sunset Terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: At La Monique, dinner guests look out at the Pacific Ocean, now a deep grey under the evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: The wet evening blurs the windows of La Monique, and the Pacific Ocean beyond them is only a darker shade of night.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Pacific Ocean is black beyond the palms, and no stars show above it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Pacific Ocean tonight, and guests on their balconies can see the faint line where water meets sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pacific Ocean is one wide darkness beyond the palms, and nothing moves on it.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and from the windows of La Monique, open since 2025, guests see a bright sky over the Pacific Ocean.

phrases.clear_predawn: Salgados Beach is still an empty pale line, and the Atlantic Ocean beside it is slowly turning from black to deep blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light lies flat on the Atlantic Ocean, and every wave reaching Salgados Beach has a bright edge.
phrases.partly_morning: Shadows of small clouds cross the beach one after another and continue out to sea.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Atlantic Ocean has two colours, bright blue in the sun and dark green under the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Guests see the Atlantic Ocean and the clouds in the same soft grey today, with only the white surf to separate them.
phrases.fog_haze: With haze over the water, the Atlantic Ocean seems to end just behind the first waves.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the beach is easy to see but the far part of the Atlantic Ocean is hidden.
phrases.rain: From Marluso, guests watch the rain darken the sand of the beach.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls in from the Atlantic Ocean, and each flash shows the waves white for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach, and guests take photos of it from indoors to show people at home.
phrases.very_cold: Today the beach stays empty, and guests admire the bright Atlantic Ocean from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: Wave after wave from the Atlantic Ocean reaches the sand, each one leaving a shining wet line.
phrases.very_hot: On Salgados Beach, guests look out over a flat, shining Atlantic Ocean, and the water looks very inviting in this heat.
phrases.warm: Guests lying on Salgados Beach have the Atlantic Ocean right at their feet and no reason to move.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The beach turns the colour of honey, and the Atlantic Ocean carries a long path of light towards the sunset.
phrases.partly_golden: At Cusco Bar, guests watch the sunset turn the clouds orange.
phrases.grey_evening: The beach is a pale band under the evening cloud, and guests at dinner in Marluso can still see it.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests finish dinner slowly tonight, listening to the rain and watching the white surf on the dark beach.
phrases.mild_night: The Atlantic Ocean is heard more than seen tonight, a soft sound behind a faint white line of surf.
phrases.clear_night: Stars reach all the way down to the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and guests can see where the dark water begins.
phrases.late_night: The beach is dark and empty now, with only thin white lines of surf moving along the sand.
phrases.dusk: A band of pink stays low over the Atlantic Ocean, while the beach is already turning blue-grey.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the towers of downtown Los Angeles stand as a dark outline against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Hollywood Hills, and guests in the rooms facing them can pick out each ridge.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, the downtown Los Angeles skyline stands sharp under a blue midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the city this morning, and the Wilshire Corridor goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop pool, downtown Los Angeles shows across the city, and clouds drift behind its towers this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the towers of the Wilshire Corridor and downtown Los Angeles take the same quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the city today, and downtown Los Angeles looks like a faint sketch from the rooftop pool.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Downtown Los Angeles is not visible today; guests see Sunset Boulevard below and the nearest slopes of the Hollywood Hills.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the city-facing windows, and guests watch the downtown Los Angeles skyline blur behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Wilshire Corridor, and guests in the 10th-floor balcony suite watch the storm from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Sunset Boulevard, and guests watch in some surprise as the Hollywood Hills turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and every tower of downtown Los Angeles is easy to count from the rooftop pool.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Hollywood Hills look close and clear above Sunset Boulevard.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at downtown Los Angeles from the water.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, guests in the warm air put their phones down and look at the downtown Los Angeles skyline instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Oleander on the rooftop, guests hold seasonal cocktails as the sun goes down over West Hollywood.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun turns the clouds above the Hollywood Hills pink, then orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights spread out to downtown Los Angeles, and the low cloud holds some of their glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of Sunset Boulevard shine twice, once in the air and once on the wet road.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, guests in this hotel of 149 rooms look out at the lit towers of the Wilshire Corridor.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lights of the city run in straight lines all the way to the downtown Los Angeles towers.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Sunset Boulevard lies quiet below the balcony suites, and the Hollywood Hills merge with the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Sunset Boulevard and in downtown Los Angeles.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Manhattan Skyline is a row of grey towers across the East River, waiting for the first colour in the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, guests take breakfast in their balcony rooms, with the Manhattan Skyline bright across the East River.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every tower of the Manhattan Skyline is sharp, and the East River shines blue in front of it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the East River this morning, and the Manhattan Skyline goes from bright to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At Westlight, guests turn the binoculars on the Manhattan Skyline as clouds drift over its towers.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the East River looks like steel, and the Manhattan Skyline stands calm behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Manhattan Skyline today, and its towers look like paper cut-outs beyond the East River.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Williamsburg rooftops are clear and the East River is faint, but the Manhattan Skyline is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch the Manhattan Skyline blur across a grey East River.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the East River, and each flash of lightning shows the Manhattan Skyline for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Vale Park, and beyond its white lawns the Manhattan Skyline fades into the grey.
phrases.very_cold: It is freezing outside, so the balcony doors stay shut and guests enjoy the Manhattan Skyline from behind the glass.
phrases.cold: A cold wind marks the East River with small waves, while the Manhattan Skyline does not move at all.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Manhattan Skyline shimmers above the East River as if it were melting a little.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit on the open lawns of Vale Park with the Manhattan Skyline in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the wraparound terrace of the Gotham Corner Suite, guests watch the sky turn gold behind the Manhattan Skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: At Westlight, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over the Manhattan Skyline and the East River.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Manhattan Skyline glow across the East River, and guests at Westlight share small plates in front of them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Manhattan Skyline spread into soft colours across the East River.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the clouds take a soft glow from the Manhattan Skyline, a sight this hotel has had since 2016.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night at Westlight, the Manhattan Skyline is lit from end to end, and the Williamsburg rooftops lie quiet below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the East River is still, and the Manhattan Skyline keeps watch over a sleeping Williamsburg.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from Westlight on the 22nd floor guests watch the first lights come on in the Manhattan Skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Ornos Bay lies still and grey-blue under a clear sky, and the hills around it are only outlines.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light fills Ornos Bay, and guests on their private terraces can see every boat on the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in ena Restaurant, guests look over Ornos Bay, bright blue under a cloudless midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Ornos Bay this morning, and the water changes from blue to green and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pool terrace, the Aegean Sea shows patches of light and shade as clouds drift over this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, Ornos Bay turns the colour of pewter, and the sand of Ornos Beach looks paler beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Ornos Bay today, and the far shore fades before it reaches the open sea.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The open sea beyond Ornos Bay is not visible today; guests see Ornos Beach and the nearest water clearly, and little further.
phrases.rain: Rain marks Ornos Bay with small rings, and guests in the Vista Suite watch it from behind the glass, Ornos Beach slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Ornos Bay, and for a second the whole curve of the water turns white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Ornos Bay, and the flakes vanish as they touch the sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the line between Ornos Bay and the sky looks sharp enough to cut paper.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Ornos Beach is empty, and guests at ena Restaurant have Ornos Bay to themselves.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in their plunge pools up to the chin and watch Ornos Bay shimmer in front of them.
phrases.warm: On the pool terrace, guests sip cold drinks and look out over the Aegean Sea, and nobody is in a hurry to move.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Kove Sunset and Lounge Bar, guests watch the low sun turn the clear sky orange, glass in hand.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the clouds from below in red and gold, the fiery sunset that Kove Sunset and Lounge Bar is named for.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in ena Restaurant, the lights around Ornos Bay glow under a cloudy evening sky, and the water between them stays black.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Ornos Bay this evening, and the shore lights stretch into long wet reflections on the water.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so the lights along Ornos Beach are the only points to follow around the bay.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Ornos Bay tonight, and the mast lights of the moored yachts add a few more near the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Ornos Bay is a wide dark space, and the sea shows only where it moves.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky above Ornos Bay is still bright, and the first lights come on along Ornos Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Oriental Pearl Tower stands unlit against a clear sky that slowly turns from black to deep blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Pudong Skyline first, and guests in the 41st-floor pool swim towards the Oriental Pearl Tower.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Oriental Pearl Tower shows every sphere in sharp detail from the jade-tiled infinity pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests at breakfast in the Regent Club Lounge watch morning clouds drift past Shanghai Tower and the nearby skyscrapers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Pudong Skyline this afternoon, and the Oriental Pearl Tower turns bright, then dull, then bright again.
phrases.overcast: The Oriental Pearl Tower keeps its clear outline under a flat grey sky, and the glass towers around it take the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Pudong Skyline today, and from the 41st-floor pool the Oriental Pearl Tower looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Pudong Skyline is not visible today, but the Oriental Pearl Tower is near enough to stay in sight.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests see the Oriental Pearl Tower slightly blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the Pearl River View Suite, guests watch lightning flash behind the Oriental Pearl Tower while thunder rolls over the Pudong Skyline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the 41st-floor windows, and swimmers in the indoor pool watch it drift down over the Pudong Skyline.
phrases.very_cold: From the hot tub on the 41st floor, guests look out at the Pudong Skyline under a bright, very cold sky and feel no need to go outside.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the Regent Club Lounge look out at Shanghai Tower and the surrounding skyscrapers.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Pudong Skyline shimmers outside, and guests look at it from the cool water of the 41st-floor pool.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, the Oriental Pearl Tower stands bright above the financial district, seen from FLARE Spa on the 41st floor.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light warms the Oriental Pearl Tower late this afternoon, and the mirrored ceiling above the pool shows the tower a second time.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds turn orange behind the Oriental Pearl Tower, and guests in the hot tub stay a little longer.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit Oriental Pearl Tower colours the low clouds above the Pudong Skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Oriental Pearl Tower spread across the glass in the Pearl View Presidential Suite.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in this 187-room hotel end a mild, cloudy night at their windows, with the Pudong Skyline glowing under the clouds.
phrases.clear_night: The Oriental Pearl Tower shines in full colour under a clear night sky, and the Pudong Skyline sparkles around it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pudong Skyline is quiet, and the Oriental Pearl Tower is a tall dark shape above the empty streets.
phrases.dusk: From the 41st-floor pool, guests in this hotel opened in 2012 see the first lights come on along the Oriental Pearl Tower under a still-bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Delos is a dark shape across the still water.
phrases.clear_morning: Delos stands sharp across the water this clear morning, in line with every sea-view room.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Aegean Sea is deep blue all the way across to Delos.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning clouds drift over Delos, and their shadows move slowly across the Aegean Sea.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Althea Spa Retreat, guests follow patches of afternoon sun moving over the Aegean Sea towards Delos.
phrases.overcast: The Aegean Sea turns grey under a full cover of cloud, with Delos a darker grey beyond it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Aegean Sea today, and Delos is only a faint outline across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Delos is not visible across the water today; guests see only the near part of the Aegean Sea.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Aegean Sea, and guests in the sea-view rooms see Delos blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Delos for a second across the dark Aegean Sea, then the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Aegean Sea, and Delos slowly disappears behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, guests look out from the sea-view rooms at Delos, every ridge sharp.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests at Althea Spa Retreat look across the water at Delos from the warmth inside.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay on the cabana beds by the pool, the Aegean Sea bright in front of them.
phrases.warm: By the infinity pool, guests leave their books closed and look at the Aegean Sea and Delos instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sunlight lies across the Aegean Sea, and Delos glows warm on the far side of the water.
phrases.partly_golden: At the Althea Spa Retreat, guests watch the last sun turn the clouds orange above Delos.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Aegean Sea is almost black, and guests can only just make out Delos.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the sea-view rooms listen to the evening rain on the Aegean Sea, with Delos lost in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Aegean Sea lies dark and quiet all the way to Delos.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Aegean Sea, and Delos sits low and black beneath them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Aegean Sea is quiet, and Delos, birthplace of Apollo, is left in the dark.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and from the infinity pool terrace Delos darkens against it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Marina Bay is still and dark blue, and the sky behind the Singapore Flyer slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Marina Bay, and guests in the Skyline Suites see the water turn bright under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is clear, and from the Pacific Club Lounge on the 38th floor guests can count the capsules of the Singapore Flyer.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Marina Bay this morning, and the water changes from grey to blue and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Pacific Club Lounge, guests watch white clouds drift behind Marina Bay Sands this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Marina Bay takes the colour of steel, and the towers of the city skyline stand clear around it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Marina Bay today, and from the Skyline Suites the far shore looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: Marina Bay is clear near the hotel, but the far towers of the city skyline cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Marina Bay, and guests in the Pacific Club Lounge watch the drops run down the tall windows with the Singapore Flyer blurred behind.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Marina Bay, and for a second the whole city skyline shows white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Marina Bay, a sight that John Portman surely never planned for when he designed this hotel.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, so guests in the Pacific Club Lounge see every line of Marina Bay Sands from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Marina Bay lies quiet and grey-blue under the wide sky.
phrases.very_hot: The heat makes the air shimmer over Marina Bay, and guests choose the cool Pacific Club Lounge to look at the Singapore Flyer.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the balcony rooms sit outside and look over Marina Bay to the city skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Marina Bay gold, and the towers of the city skyline shine above the water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the Skyline Suites, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over Marina Bay orange and pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Marina Bay Sands glow, and guests in the Pacific Club Lounge see them repeated on the water of Marina Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and the lights around Marina Bay spread into soft colours on the rainy glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the low clouds over Marina Bay take a soft glow from the city below.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the city skyline draws a bright border of lights around the dark water of Marina Bay.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Marina Bay is quiet, and guests who cannot sleep find the calm water good company.
phrases.dusk: The sky over Marina Bay is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the city skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the terrace, the Bukit Peninsula cliffs are a dark line above the Indian Ocean, still waiting for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Bukit Peninsula cliffs first, and the Indian Ocean below them is already a clear blue.
phrases.clear_midday: From the infinity pool, the water seems to run straight into the Indian Ocean, blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Seen from the lounge, Uluwatu goes from shade to sun and back again as clouds drift in from the Indian Ocean.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Lunch guests at Il Ristorante – Niko Romito follow cloud shadows moving slowly across the Indian Ocean.
phrases.overcast: From the spa, guests watch white lines of waves roll in below the Bukit Peninsula cliffs of Uluwatu.
phrases.fog_haze: Today the Bukit Peninsula cliffs are soft outlines in the haze, and the Indian Ocean fades out before the horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the terrace today, the Indian Ocean shows only its nearest waves, and the far end of Uluwatu is not visible.
phrases.rain: Guests in the lounge watch the rain move across Uluwatu like a grey curtain being pulled shut.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is crossing the Indian Ocean, and guests in the spa count the seconds between flash and thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is a surprise in Uluwatu, and guests stay inside the lounge to watch it fall over the Indian Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: Guests keep to the warm side of the spa today, with Uluwatu sharp and bright in front of them.
phrases.cold: Today the Indian Ocean is best watched from indoors, and the seats in the lounge fill up early.
phrases.very_hot: Up to their shoulders in the infinity pool, guests look across Uluwatu to the Indian Ocean.
phrases.warm: On the terrace, guests stretch out facing Uluwatu, with no plans beyond the next swim.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Bukit Peninsula cliffs the colour of honey above a glittering Indian Ocean.
phrases.partly_golden: From the infinity pool, Uluwatu glows orange wherever the last sun gets past the clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner guests at Il Ristorante – Niko Romito look out on a dark Indian Ocean with no moon or stars above it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass at Il Ristorante – Niko Romito, where dinner guests look out at a wet, dark Uluwatu.
phrases.mild_night: Beyond the lights of Uluwatu, the Indian Ocean is one wide dark space tonight.
phrases.clear_night: The lights of Uluwatu have competition tonight from the stars over the Indian Ocean.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Uluwatu is quiet and the Indian Ocean lies dark all the way to the horizon.
phrases.dusk: The first lights come on across Uluwatu while the Indian Ocean still holds the colour of the sunset.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Pacific Ocean is a calm grey-blue, and Crystal Pier stands out against a sky that is just starting to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Pacific Ocean in clear blue, and guests on their balconies follow each wave as it rolls in beside Crystal Pier.
phrases.clear_midday: At a table in JRDN, guests look straight out at the Pacific Ocean, bright blue under a cloudless midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pacific Ocean this morning, and Crystal Pier passes from shade to sunshine and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Surf Pad rooms look squarely at the water this afternoon, where patches of sun travel over the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns silver, and the white lines of surf show clearly along Pacific Beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the water today, so Crystal Pier seems to walk out into the Pacific Ocean and vanish halfway.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests see Crystal Pier and the nearest waves, and the Pacific Ocean fades into pale air beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pacific Ocean, and the drops dot the water around Crystal Pier.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second Crystal Pier shows sharp and black against the white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sand of Pacific Beach, and guests stand at their glass doors to watch the flakes disappear into the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear, and the Pacific Ocean shows a sharp horizon behind Crystal Pier.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests choose a table in JRDN and watch the Pacific Ocean break around the legs of Crystal Pier.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Pacific Ocean looks cool, and guests can see swimmers and surfers in the waves off Pacific Beach.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, Pacific Beach fills with towels and surfboards, and the Pacific Ocean behind it stays a steady blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on their balconies watch the sun drop toward the Pacific Ocean, with Crystal Pier turning gold in the foreground.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange and pink over the Pacific Ocean, and JRDN has the same show at table level.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars this evening, and guests in JRDN see the Pacific Ocean as moving bands of white surf in the dark.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass at JRDN this evening, and guests at their tables watch the Pacific Ocean through it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Pacific Ocean and the sky share the same deep colour, and Crystal Pier stands between them.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Pacific Ocean tonight, and Crystal Pier reaches toward them across the black water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pacific Ocean keeps working, sending waves to Pacific Beach with nobody there to count them.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just gone, the sky over the Pacific Ocean is still bright, and Crystal Pier becomes a dark outline in front of it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sky Tower is a tall grey column against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of the Sky Tower first, then moves slowly down to the roofs below.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Sky Tower stands so close that guests can follow its full structure in detail.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift behind the Sky Tower this morning, and for a moment the tower itself seems to move.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From The Churchill Bar on the 20th floor, guests watch cloud shadows cross the Auckland rooftops this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Sky Tower takes almost the same colour, and only its outline stands out.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Sky Tower today, so guests see a tower that ends in cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far edges of Auckland are not visible today, but the Sky Tower is near enough to stay clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass in the Sky Tower rooms, and the tower behind it looks slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Auckland skyline, and guests in the tower-facing suites see the Sky Tower turn white for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Auckland, and guests stop to watch the flakes pass in front of the Sky Tower.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear, and every edge of the Sky Tower looks sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass and study the Sky Tower from the warm side.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the Auckland rooftops shimmer below The Churchill Bar, where guests look out over the city with cold drinks.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests at The Churchill Bar look across the city roofline to the Sky Tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Sky Tower gold on one side, and its long shadow falls across the city roofs.
phrases.partly_golden: At The Churchill Bar, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds behind the Sky Tower.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the Sky Tower glows above the lit windows of the Auckland skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the city this evening, and the lights of the Sky Tower spread softly across the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud catches the glow of the city tonight, and the lit Sky Tower rises into it.
phrases.clear_night: From the 20th floor, guests at The Churchill Bar see the city lights of Auckland spread out under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city is quiet, and the Sky Tower stands alone above the sleeping roofs.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Sky Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the meadows of Phobjikha Valley are still grey, and the farmhouses below show only as small dark shapes.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Vista, guests look over the valley floor as the sun reaches the meadows and farmhouses.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear sky, the full width of Phobjikha Valley is open from the terrace, from the glacial meadows to the pine ridge.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the meadows this morning, and the farmhouses go in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the private balconies, patches of sun move across the pasture toward the crane sanctuary.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits low over Phobjikha Valley, and the fire at Chang Lounge & Bar burns beside windows full of meadow.
phrases.fog_haze: From the terrace, mist covers the valley floor, and only the roofs of the nearest farmhouses show above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The pine ridge across the valley is not visible today; the near meadows and the closest farmhouses still are.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the meadows, and guests in the 35 rooms watch it through floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole valley for a second, meadows, farmhouses and pine ridge, then the rain closes it again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Phobjikha Valley, and the meadows and farmhouse roofs slowly turn white behind the glass at Vista.
phrases.very_cold: In winter cold like this, black-necked cranes work the wet ground below the farmhouses, and guests count them from indoors.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the meadows and farmhouses look sharp and still from the windows of Chang Lounge & Bar.
phrases.very_hot: The sun is strong on the open pasture today, and guests on the terrace look across to the shade of the pine-forested mountains.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit out on the terrace above the pasture and scattered farmhouses, and nobody hurries.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light crosses the glacial meadows, and guests in the hot stone bath look over the valley as the day ends.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the valley turns pink under broken cloud, and swimmers in the indoor pool stop mid-lap to look.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Vista, Bhutanese dishes arrive in front of a valley that has gone dark under the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows at Chang Lounge & Bar this evening, and the valley beyond the fireplace is nearly black.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud hides the stars tonight, and from the balconies the valley is a wide dark space with the pine ridge above it.
phrases.clear_night: With almost no lights in Phobjikha Valley, the clear sky above the bonfire spot is crowded with stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the valley is silent and unlit, and the floor-to-ceiling glass holds only the outline of the ridge.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, candles are lit on the terrace, and the sky is still bright over the pine-forested mountains.

phrases.clear_predawn: The mountains are still dark shapes above Lake Como, and the water waits for its first colour.
phrases.clear_morning: Fresh morning sun lies on the lake, and the mountains behind it stand sharp.
phrases.clear_midday: Seen from the Infinity pool, Lake Como is a clear blue and every line of the mountains is sharp.
phrases.partly_morning: Patches of sun move across the lake between the clouds, and the mountains go light and dark in turn.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Bar and lounge area see the lake half in sun and half in shade this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Lake Como is one calm silver-grey sheet today, with the mountains a darker grey behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Today's haze has taken the mountains away, and Lake Como ends in a soft white line.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From The Darsena Listening Suite, guests see the near water of Lake Como clearly today, but the mountains stay hidden.
phrases.rain: From the spa, guests watch the rain draw small rings all over the lake.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the mountains for a second, then Lake Como goes grey again under the storm.
phrases.snow: Guests in the Bar and lounge area watch snowflakes vanish into the lake one by one.
phrases.very_cold: In The Darsena Listening Suite, guests stay warm inside while Lake Como shines in the cold air.
phrases.cold: From the spa, guests look at the lake in their dressing gowns and feel no need to go out.
phrases.very_hot: Guests stay in the Infinity pool up to their shoulders, looking over Lake Como to the mountains.
phrases.warm: Guests by the pool keep putting their books down, because Lake Como and the mountains are right in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Al Tramonto, guests wait for the sunset over Torno while the lake slowly turns gold.
phrases.partly_golden: Gold stripes lie across the lake where the low sun finds gaps in the cloud.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner guests at Al Tramonto look out on the lake, now a dark sheet under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Over dinner at Al Tramonto, guests watch tonight's rain make the lake shiver.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night the lake is dark and still, and the mountains are only a deeper black behind it.
phrases.clear_night: The rooms of The Penthouse face out, so guests there get the clear night without leaving bed.
phrases.late_night: Long after the last guest has gone to bed, the lake goes on moving quietly in the dark.
phrases.dusk: The sunset over Torno has just finished, and the first lights appear along the lake under a bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the KL Tower stands as a dark shape against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop infinity pool, the KL Tower rises over the KLCC Park canopy in clean morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Petronas Twin Towers show their side to the rooftop, bright and easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift behind the KL Tower this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the KLCC Park canopy.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop infinity pool, guests watch afternoon clouds slide past the top of the KL Tower.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the KL Tower still stands clear above the dark green treetops of KLCC Park.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Kuala Lumpur skyline today, and the Petronas Twin Towers look like a faint drawing beside the KL Tower.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Petronas Twin Towers are not visible from the rooftop today; the KL Tower shows only as a faint outline above the trees.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the KLCC Park canopy, and guests in rooms facing the KL Tower watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the KL Tower, and guests follow the storm from their floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Kuala Lumpur, and from the rooftop the KL Tower turns white above the KLCC Park canopy.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the KL Tower looks sharp against the sky, and guests study it from behind the glass of their rooms.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the KL Tower rises above the treetops of KLCC Park, a steady sight from the rooftop.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay up to their shoulders in the rooftop infinity pool and look at the KL Tower from the water.
phrases.warm: Guests rest on lounge chairs by the rooftop infinity pool, with the KL Tower and the city skyline in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Man Tao Bar, guests take the first cocktails of the afternoon while golden light warms the KL Tower.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds behind the Petronas Twin Towers, seen at an angle from Man Tao Bar.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit KL Tower glows above the dark trees, and guests at Man Tao Bar turn their chairs towards it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the KL Tower tonight, and the wet rooftop terrace shines with their reflection.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, low clouds catch the city glow, and the Petronas Twin Towers shine at an angle beyond the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_night: The KL Tower shines against a clear night sky, and guests on the 20th floor see it from their beds.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the rooftop is empty and the KL Tower stands quietly above the sleeping city.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the KL Tower, seen from the rooftop terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dolomites stand as a dark outline across the valley, and the sky behind them slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Odle peaks, and guests swimming in the indoor pool see them through the tall glass.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every ridge of the Dolomites is sharp above the forested valley.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past the Peitlerkofel this morning, while the Odle peaks stay in full sunshine across the valley.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move slowly over the forests this afternoon, and guests at the restaurant tables follow them towards the Dolomites.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Dolomites take the same colour as the dolomite stone that lines the pools.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist lies over the forests today, and from the indoor pool the Odle peaks appear and disappear again.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Dolomites are not visible across the valley today; from the south-facing suites, the eye stops at the first forested slopes.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the restaurant, and the forests look a darker green while cloud covers the Dolomites.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Odle peaks for a second, and guests watch the storm from behind the glass walls of their suites.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the forests, and from the indoor pool guests watch the Dolomites fade behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is so clear that the Peitlerkofel looks close enough to touch, though guests prefer to check from behind the restaurant glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the stone terrace is the viewpoint, and the Dolomites are in full sight from its benches.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool up to their shoulders and study the Dolomites from the water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, swimmers pass from the indoor pool to the outdoor one, and the Odle peaks stay in front of them all the way.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Dolomites gold, and each stepped table in the restaurant has its own share of the scene.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and colours the Odle peaks, seen in full from the rooftop pool of the Penthouse.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars this evening, and the Dolomites are a darker band between the sky and the forested valley.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and guests in the 62 suites see wet treetops in the lamp light while cloud covers the Dolomites.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night under cloud, the valley is quiet, and the Dolomites can just be traced above the forests.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, stars fill the sky above the Odle peaks, and the jagged ridge hides the lowest ones.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Dolomites keep their place across the quiet valley while the forest sleeps.
phrases.dusk: From the stone terrace, the Dolomites stand against a still-bright sky just after sunset, and the first lamps come on indoors.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Danube River is dark and quiet before sunrise, while the sky above the green hills slowly turns from black to blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, Buda Castle stands sharp above the Danube River.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Danube River shines under a clear sky, and guests at their windows see Chain Bridge draw a clean line across it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Danube River this morning, while Matthias Church stays in the sun on the far side.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the corner suites, guests follow the clouds along the Danube River, from Chain Bridge to Elisabeth Bridge.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Danube River takes the same colour, and the Castle District sits quietly above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Danube River today, and guests see the Castle District as a faint outline across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Danube River is clear below, but the green hills beyond it cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Danube River, and guests watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows with Elisabeth Bridge slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Danube River, and for a second guests see every ripple on the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Danube River, and guests at Liz and Chain Sky Lounge watch the far bank turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the Danube River and Matthias Church look close enough to touch.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Danube River moves slowly past, and guests find that a river is good company from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the 9th-floor terrace of Liz and Chain Sky Lounge look down at the Danube River and envy the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests stand on their balconies and look across the Danube River to Buda Castle.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Castle District in the late afternoon, high above the Danube River.
phrases.partly_golden: At Liz and Chain Sky Lounge, guests watch the last sun slip between clouds over the Danube River, and conversations stop for a moment.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, illuminated Buda Castle glows above the Danube River, and guests need no other lamp.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, city lights run in long streaks across the Danube River.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests see the Danube River as a wide ribbon between two lit banks.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests at Liz and Chain Sky Lounge on the 9th floor look across the Danube River to the lit Castle District.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Danube River keeps moving past the sleeping city, in no hurry at all.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright over the Danube River, and the first lights come on along Elisabeth Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Two dark towers mark Tower Bridge while the Thames waits for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the One Bedroom Riverview Suite wake to a River Thames already bright with morning sun.
phrases.partly_morning: In the Riverview Studio Suite, guests open the curtains to a Thames that is half in sun and half in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Up at 12th Knot, guests watch the skyline go bright, then grey, then bright again.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud sits over Tower Bridge, and the Thames below takes the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Only a pale outline of Tower Bridge comes through the haze, with the Thames soft below it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Thames and Tower Bridge are in view today, but the skyline beyond them is not.
phrases.rain: Raindrops run down the glass of the Riverview Balcony Suite, and guests watch the Thames from the dry side.
phrases.thunderstorm: Between lightning and thunder, guests in the One Bedroom Riverview Suite count the seconds over a dark Thames.
phrases.snow: Through the falling snow, Tower Bridge is a grey shape above the dark Thames.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Riverview Studio Suite stay behind the glass and watch the Thames shine in the cold.
phrases.cold: At 12th Knot, guests hold a hot drink and pick out the towers of the City across the Thames.
phrases.very_hot: Guests on the balcony of the Riverview Balcony Suite wait for a breeze off the Thames, and the ice in their glasses is not lasting long.
phrases.warm: Tower Bridge stands over a slow River Thames, and nothing in the view is in a hurry today.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Tower Bridge turns gold in the low sun, and the Thames carries the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, lighting Tower Bridge for a moment before the Thames goes grey.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low cloud, the city lights stretch across the Thames, and Tower Bridge glows beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: Tower Bridge shines twice in tonight's rain, once above the Thames and once in it.
phrases.mild_night: With the curtains left open, guests in the Riverview Balcony Suite fall asleep to the skyline lights on the Thames.
phrases.clear_night: Lit from end to end, Tower Bridge draws a clear line of light over the dark Thames.
phrases.late_night: The Thames keeps moving through the small hours, sliding quietly past the dark shape of Tower Bridge.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, guests in the Riverview Studio Suite see the first lights appear along the Thames.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Tivoli Gardens lies quiet below, and the spires of Copenhagen stand against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests on the upper floors start the day with clear morning light on the city rooftops and on Tivoli Gardens just below.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests can count the spires of Copenhagen one by one above the rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the rooftops this morning, and Tivoli Gardens goes from bright to dim and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in this 1960 tower by Arne Jacobsen look out at a wide afternoon sky, with clouds drifting over the spires.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits low over Copenhagen today, and the rooftops and spires look calm in the even light.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the spires today, and Tivoli Gardens just below is the clearest thing in sight.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant spires are not visible today; guests see the nearer rooftops and Tivoli Gardens below, and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows, and guests watch the rooftops of Copenhagen shine wet around Tivoli Gardens.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the city, and for a second every spire stands out sharply above the rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Tivoli Gardens, and the rooftops around it are turning white one by one.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay warm behind the glass while the freezing air makes every rooftop and spire look sharp.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look down at Tivoli Gardens and feel no hurry to go outside.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the rooftops, and guests on the upper floors look down at people walking slowly near Tivoli Gardens.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests watch small figures move along the paths of Tivoli Gardens below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the rooftops gold, and the spires throw long shadows across the city.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests watch the last sun slip between the clouds and light one spire, then another.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the park lights of Tivoli Gardens glow below, and guests on the upper floors have them all in sight.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of Tivoli Gardens spread into soft spots of light on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the night sky, but Tivoli Gardens gives guests its own lights to look at instead of stars.
phrases.clear_night: Guests look over a clear night in Copenhagen, with stars above the spires and the lights of Tivoli Gardens below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests still awake in this tower of 22 floors see the rooftops and spires as dark shapes against the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first park lights come on in Tivoli Gardens below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Washington Monument is a plain grey column against a sky that is just starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Washington Monument, and guests in the Jenny Lind Suite can watch it from the soaking tub.
phrases.clear_midday: The Washington Monument stands white and still against a clear blue sky under the high midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move behind the Washington Monument this morning, so the stone looks bright one minute and grey the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests watch cloud shadows cross Pennsylvania Avenue this afternoon, then look up at the Washington Monument in a patch of sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Washington Monument is almost the same colour as the clouds behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Washington Monument today, and guests see its top fade into the pale air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see Pennsylvania Avenue clearly while the Washington Monument is only a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass in the Jenny Lind Suite, and from the soaking tub the Washington Monument looks blurred and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Washington Monument, and for a second guests see the whole column against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Pennsylvania Avenue, and guests watch the Washington Monument turn faint behind the white flakes.

phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over Pennsylvania Avenue today, and guests look at the sunlit Washington Monument from the cool side of the glass.

phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in the Jenny Lind Suite see the lit Washington Monument stand out against a dull sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of Pennsylvania Avenue shine back from the wet road for guests looking down.

phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lit Washington Monument fills the windows of suites that face it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Pennsylvania Avenue is nearly empty, and the Washington Monument waits quietly for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Pennsylvania Avenue as the Washington Monument turns grey-blue.

phrases.clear_predawn: Dawn is close, and the pine forest shows as a dark line behind the gardens.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests waking up this morning find the gardens green and bright, with the deep blue sea behind them.
phrases.clear_midday: From the beach access via suspension wooden bridge, the pine forest is bright green and the cliff stands clear beside it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are moving over the pine forest this morning, and its green goes from bright to dark and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sunlight and cloud shadow take turns on the gardens this afternoon, while the pine forest changes from bright green to dark.
phrases.overcast: Under grey cloud the pine forest is a darker green, and the gardens keep all their colour.
phrases.fog_haze: The sea is lost in haze today, so guests look at the gardens and the nearest pines instead.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the gardens are clear, the pine forest is pale, and the cliff cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the gardens and the pine forest, and both look a deeper green for it.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the thunderstorm, the pine forest shows for a second in each flash of lightning and then goes dark again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the gardens and the pine forest, a rare sight that guests watch from indoors.
phrases.very_cold: The gardens are empty today, and guests stay indoors to look at them and at the deep blue sea beyond.

phrases.warm: Guests take their time in the gardens today, with the pine forest behind them and the deep blue sea in front.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun warms the cliff and the tops of the pines, as seen from the beach access via suspension wooden bridge.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests watch the last sunlight come and go on the pine forest as clouds move over the gardens.
phrases.grey_evening: The gardens grow dim after sunset, and the pine forest behind them becomes a single dark shape under the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain is falling on the gardens this evening, and guests watch the wet paths shine below the dark pine forest.
phrases.mild_night: The gardens are quiet tonight, and the pine forest is a dark band under a sky without stars.
phrases.clear_night: Guests looking out before bed see stars above the black tops of the pines.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the gardens are empty and still, and the pine forest is a darker shape against the night.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale behind the Cagarras Islands, and Copacabana Beach lies empty and quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, guests in the sea-view rooms see Copacabana Beach curve all the way to Leme Mountain.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Atlantic Ocean is deep blue, and the Cagarras Islands stand sharp on the horizon beyond Copacabana Beach.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Copacabana Beach this morning, while Leme Mountain stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift out towards the Cagarras Islands, leaving Copacabana Beach bright again.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns silver, and the sand of Copacabana Beach looks paler than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Leme Mountain today, and guests can make out the Cagarras Islands only as faint shapes on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Cagarras Islands are not visible today, and Copacabana Beach fades from sight before it reaches Leme Mountain.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Copacabana Beach; from the upper floors, guests watch grey waves roll in under it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and for a second guests see the whole length of Copacabana Beach.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Copacabana Beach, and guests watch the sand turn white all the way to Leme Mountain.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests see every rock of the Cagarras Islands clearly across a bright, cold ocean.

phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights along Copacabana Beach draw a bright curve towards Leme Mountain.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening lights along Copacabana Beach, and wet Avenida Atlântica shines below.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hide the stars, and guests watch the waves break white on Copacabana Beach.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests on the upper floors of this 1923 building see stars above the Atlantic Ocean and Copacabana Beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Copacabana Beach is a wide pale band between Avenida Atlântica and the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Copacabana Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Manhattan Skyline stands as a dark shape against a clear sky, and the Hudson River is still.

phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Manhattan Skyline this morning, tower by tower, while the Hudson River stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace of the Heaven Over Hell Penthouse Suite, afternoon clouds can be seen drifting over the Manhattan Skyline and the Hudson River.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Hudson River turns the colour of steel, and the Manhattan Skyline looks like a drawing in pencil.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the tops of the Manhattan Skyline today, so only the lower floors of the towers are left to count.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far bank of the Hudson River is not visible today, and the Manhattan Skyline shows only its nearest towers.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Hudson River, and guests watch the grey water from their river-facing rooms.

phrases.snow: Snow falls across the Manhattan Skyline, and the rooftop terrace and the roofs below slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air makes the Manhattan Skyline very sharp today, and guests admire it from the warm side of the glass.

phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights of the Manhattan Skyline spread into soft coloured spots.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Hudson River is a wide dark band beside the lights of the Manhattan Skyline.

phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Hudson River, and the first lights come on in the Manhattan Skyline.

phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Alps this morning, while the Old Town and the River Rhône stay mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the rooftops of the Old Town this afternoon, while the Alps stay bright behind them.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the River Rhône takes the same colour, and the Old Town looks calm above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Old Town today, and the Alps are only a faint outline behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today; guests see the River Rhône and the nearer rooftops of the Old Town.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftops of the Old Town, and the River Rhône runs dark between its white banks.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air makes the Alps look close today, each ridge clear above the Old Town.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over Lake Garda this afternoon, and the water below the infinity pool changes from silver to blue and back.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Lake Garda, and from the heated infinity pool the flakes disappear into the grey water far below.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Edinburgh skyline, and guests watch St. Giles' Cathedral slowly turn white.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Swan River is a wide, quiet stretch of dark water below this 2019 hotel.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Praiano's centre sleeps and the Tyrrhenian Sea is one wide darkness beyond the empty rooftop.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Indian Ocean is still dark, and a thin band of light grows on the horizon beyond New Pier.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Brasserie Restaurant, guests look out at a bright Indian Ocean under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Golden Mile lies in full midday sun, with New Pier running straight out into the surf.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across North Beach this morning, while the Golden Mile beyond stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop pool, guests follow the clouds as they drift over the Golden Mile and out to sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Indian Ocean turns the colour of steel, and New Pier stands out clearly against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Golden Mile today, and the ships waiting for the port look like pencil marks on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today, so the view ends at North Beach, the surf and New Pier.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Golden Mile, and guests in Brasserie Restaurant watch the promenade shine with water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Indian Ocean, and guests watch the storm from the sea-facing rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Golden Mile, and guests in this 1911 Art Deco hotel watch the palm crowns turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and every container ship on the horizon is easy to count from the rooftop.
phrases.cold: On this cold day guests stay behind the glass of Brasserie Restaurant and watch the waves roll onto North Beach.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat guests stay in the rooftop pool and look down at swimmers in the surf on North Beach.
phrases.warm: The Golden Mile is busy with walkers on this warm day, and guests watch them from the balcony rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests bring sundowners to the rooftop pool as the low sun turns the Golden Mile golden.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Indian Ocean, seen clearly from the rooftop pool.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the Golden Mile run along the edge of the dark Indian Ocean.
phrases.wet_evening: At dinner in Brasserie Restaurant, guests watch rain fall across the lights of the promenade.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the rooftop, 7 floors up, guests see the Golden Mile lit below.
phrases.clear_night: The lights of waiting ships dot the horizon under a clear night sky, far beyond the lit Golden Mile.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Golden Mile is quiet, and only the white surf moves on North Beach.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Golden Mile and New Pier.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Eiffel Tower is a dark shape against the first pale light, with the Seine still black below it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of the Eiffel Tower first, and guests watch it move down towards the Seine.
phrases.clear_midday: The Seine carries a bright strip of sunlight through the middle of the view.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests looking out this morning see the Seine go from grey to silver each time a cloud moves on.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the Seine this afternoon, and the Eiffel Tower moves in and out of the sun.
phrases.overcast: Grey iron against grey cloud, yet guests still pick out the Eiffel Tower at once.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the far bank of the Seine, and the Eiffel Tower shows only as a pale outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests can follow the Seine only a short way today, and the Eiffel Tower is a faint shape beyond it.
phrases.rain: Raindrops dot the whole surface of the Seine, and guests watch them from indoors, perfectly dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over the river now; guests count the seconds between each flash and the thunder above the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the banks of the Seine while the river itself stays dark and moving.
phrases.very_cold: From indoors, guests see the Eiffel Tower standing over a Seine that looks far too cold to touch.
