phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, the Seine looks in no hurry to leave the Eiffel Tower behind.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Eiffel Tower throws a long shadow now, and its iron has turned the colour of honey.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests catch the Seine turning copper for a few minutes before the clouds close over the sun.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests at dinner time look out on the lit Eiffel Tower, its lights reflected in the dark Seine.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lit Eiffel Tower this evening, and the Seine below it has gone dark.
phrases.mild_night: Guests still up tonight find the Eiffel Tower glowing into the cloud above it.
phrases.clear_night: Nothing hides the Eiffel Tower tonight, lit from top to bottom above the black Seine.
phrases.late_night: The Seine runs on through the small hours, dark and quiet, with almost nobody watching.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the Eiffel Tower switches on, while the Seine still holds the last brightness.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky is clear and turning pale before sunrise, and the Manhattan Skyline stands in outline against it.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the corner rooms have breakfast by the windows while the morning sun reaches One World Trade Center.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Hudson River is blue beyond the rooftops, with the New Jersey skyline sharp on the far side.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Manhattan Skyline this morning, and guests on the treadmills in the 17th-floor fitness centre follow them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Jimmy on the 18th floor, guests watch clouds drift over the Hudson River, with patches of sun on the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Hudson River turns the colour of steel, and One World Trade Center rises above the other towers.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of One World Trade Center today, and the Manhattan Skyline looks shorter than usual.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the Hudson River is only a faint band and the city's bridges cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the corner rooms, and the Manhattan Skyline behind it looks soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay behind the glass at Jimmy while lightning flashes over the Hudson River and thunder rolls across the rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the rooftops of SoHo, and guests watch it from Jimmy, where the fire is lit for winter.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air makes the Manhattan Skyline very sharp, and each window on One World Trade Center seems easy to count.
phrases.cold: From the Gallery Penthouse, the Manhattan Bridge and the East River look clear and still on this cold day.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the Hudson River from the water.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop pool deck, guests lie on the loungers facing One World Trade Center, and nobody hurries back inside.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Hudson River gold, and the glass of One World Trade Center shines with the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests at Jimmy watch the clouds over the Hudson River turn orange and pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Manhattan Skyline glow on the low sky, and guests at Jimmy watch over a cocktail.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lit tower of One World Trade Center is blurred, and guests watch it from the soaking tub by their suite windows.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the city's bridges are strings of lights behind the towers.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the lights of the Manhattan Skyline reach from One World Trade Center to the towers of Midtown.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Hudson River is a quiet dark band, and the Manhattan Skyline waits for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the Manhattan Skyline, one floor at a time.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Lugano lies still and grey-blue beyond the palm trees of the park, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Lake Lugano, and guests on the lake-view balconies look over the park to the bright water.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Lake Lugano is deep blue, and Monte San Salvatore stands sharp above the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Lake Lugano this morning, easy to follow from the lakeside terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the three balconies of the Monte Bré Suite, guests follow patches of sun and shade crossing the park and Lake Lugano.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Lake Lugano turns the colour of pewter, and the green mountains behind it look darker.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Lake Lugano today, and Monte San Salvatore is only a faint outline behind the palm trees.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The mountains across Lake Lugano are not visible today, and the view from the lakeside terrace ends at the near water.
phrases.rain: Rain marks Lake Lugano with thousands of small rings, and guests watch them from the dry side of a loggia.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning turns Lake Lugano white for a second, then thunder rolls over the water and the park.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees of the park, and Lake Lugano fades into white behind them.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, and Lake Lugano shines a cold blue below the park of this 1885 villa.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the lakeside terrace is quiet, and Lake Lugano has the whole stage to itself.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests at the private lido stay close to Lake Lugano, and the water looks more inviting every minute.
phrases.warm: Guests rest in the subtropical park on this warm day and let Lake Lugano hold their eyes through the palms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the 5th floor, guests in the San Salvatore Suite watch the low sun turn Lake Lugano gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and Lake Lugano shows bands of orange and grey from the lakeside terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Arté al Lago, guests look over Lake Lugano under a cloudy evening sky, with shore lights reflected on the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Lake Lugano this evening, and from the dinner tables of Arté al Lago the lights on the water look blurred.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and Lake Lugano carries only the lights of the shore.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over Lake Lugano on this clear night, and Monte San Salvatore is a dark shape against them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Lugano is a wide, quiet surface, almost black beyond the still park.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over Lake Lugano, and from the water's edge at Arté al Lago the first lights appear along the shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Prague Castle stands unlit above Malá Strana, its spires clear against a sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Prague Castle, and the spires of St. Vitus Cathedral shine above the red-tiled rooftops.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, guests look across red-tiled rooftops to Prague Castle under a clean blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Prague Castle this morning, and the St. Vitus Cathedral spires go from bright to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in castle view rooms watch the afternoon clouds drift behind the spires of St. Vitus Cathedral.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Prague Castle looks like a pencil drawing above the roofs of Malá Strana.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the hill today, and from the rooftop terrace only the lower walls of Prague Castle can be made out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so Prague Castle is only a faint outline and the St. Vitus Cathedral spires are not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and behind it Prague Castle and the dome of St. Nicholas Church look soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Prague Castle for a second at a time, and guests count the St. Vitus Cathedral spires between flashes.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Malá Strana, turning the red-tiled rooftops white while Prague Castle fades behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, every spire of Prague Castle looks sharp, and guests enjoy the sight from behind the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this former 14th-century monastery look up at Prague Castle from behind large glass windows.
phrases.very_hot: On the rooftop terrace, guests on the wicker loungers look at Prague Castle through the heat and decide to visit it tomorrow.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the walls of Prague Castle gold, and the red-tiled rooftops below glow in the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and lights the St. Vitus Cathedral spires one at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit Prague Castle gives the low clouds above it a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests watch the lights of Prague Castle shine on the dark rooftops of Malá Strana.
phrases.mild_night: Prague Castle is lit under a cloudy night sky, and from the rooftop terrace the dome of St. Nicholas Church shows lit below it.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Prague Castle is a quiet outline on the hill, and Malá Strana sleeps below it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the rooftop terrace the first lights come on at Prague Castle.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Prinsengracht lies still under a clear sky, and the canal houses on the far side are only outlines.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the gables along the Keizersgracht, and the water below shows them a second time.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in Jansz., guests look over the Keizersgracht, where the midday sun lies bright on the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Canal Ring this morning, and the Westerkerk tower stands in sun one minute and in shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace, cloud shadows cross the canal-house rooftops this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Prinsengracht turns grey too, and the moored boats become the brightest things in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on the Keizersgracht today, and guests in the canal view rooms see the houses opposite as soft grey fronts.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the near stretch of the Prinsengracht is clear, while the far canal houses and the Westerkerk tower are not in sight.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Keizersgracht with small rings, and guests in the Art Collector's Suite watch them spread across the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Canal Ring, and each flash of lightning shows the Prinsengracht and its gables for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the salon boat moored below, built in 1909, and on every other boat along the Prinsengracht.
phrases.very_cold: On this bright, freezing day, the Keizersgracht hardly moves, and guests prefer to study it through the glass of the canal suites.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the semi-private dining area of Jansz. watch boats pass on the Keizersgracht from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the trees along the Prinsengracht shade the water, and the boats below pass slowly, as if they feel it too.
phrases.warm: On the canal-side terrace of Jansz., guests sit in the warm air and watch the boats of the Canal Ring go by.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun colours the gables along the Prinsengracht, seen from windows spread across 25 canal houses.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Canal Ring turn pink, and the Keizersgracht copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: At Pulitzer's Bar, guests sit by the fireplace and look out at the lit canal under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of Pulitzer's Bar this evening, and the canal lights outside stretch into long streaks.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lamps along the Prinsengracht make a soft double row on the water.
phrases.clear_night: From Pulitzer's Bar, guests see the lights of the canal houses shine on the Keizersgracht under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Canal Ring is quiet, and the salon boat moored below sits alone on the dark water.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Prinsengracht as the first lamps come on along the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Boston Harbour lies still under a clear sky, and the downtown skyline stands grey across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Harborside Grill, guests look through the windows at Boston Harbour and the downtown skyline in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Boston Harbour is deep blue, and every tower of the downtown skyline is easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the downtown skyline this morning, and their shadows move slowly across Boston Harbour.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A water taxi crosses Boston Harbour under a sky of sun and passing cloud, with the downtown skyline behind it.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Boston Harbour takes the same colour, with the downtown skyline a darker grey above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over Boston Harbour today, and the downtown skyline looks like a soft pencil sketch above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today; guests see Boston Harbour near the shore, while the downtown skyline is only a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Boston Harbour, and guests in harbour-view rooms watch the downtown skyline blur behind wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the downtown skyline, and guests in this 270-room hotel watch the storm cross Boston Harbour.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Boston Harbour, and the downtown skyline fades in and out behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests stay behind the windows of Harborside Grill and look at a sharp, bright downtown skyline across Boston Harbour.

phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the waterfront lawn look across a shining Boston Harbour to a downtown skyline that shimmers a little.
phrases.warm: On the Harborside Grill patio, lunch goes slowly on this warm day, because guests keep looking at Boston Harbour and the downtown skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the towers of the downtown skyline gold, and Boston Harbour carries the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud, and patches of gold move over Boston Harbour below the downtown skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Harborside Grill, guests look out at the lights of the downtown skyline glowing under low cloud across Boston Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the downtown skyline spread into long soft streaks across Boston Harbour.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Boston Harbour is quiet and black, and nothing moves on the water.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the waterfront lawn the first lights come on in the downtown skyline across Boston Harbour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Danube River is still dark, and the Chain Bridge stands as a clear outline against the first pale sky.

phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Danube River turns the same grey, and the Chain Bridge crosses it in a slightly darker shade.

phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above Buda Castle, and for a second the whole hill is bright over the rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Chain Bridge, and the Danube River below takes each flake without a trace.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Buda Castle looks sharp on its hilltop, and the Danube River moves slowly under a pale sky.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light falls on the Pest side, and the Danube River turns gold beneath the Chain Bridge.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above Buda Castle turn orange, and guests on Leo Rooftop turn round to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Chain Bridge draws a bright line across the Danube River towards Pest.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, Buda Castle glows through the rain on its hill, its lit walls soft at the edges.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the clouds hang low over the Pest side, and the city lights colour them from below across the Danube River.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Danube River runs quietly past the Chain Bridge, and the city is calm on both banks.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Chain Bridge and across the Pest side.

phrases.clear_midday: Brighton Palace Pier stretches into a blue English Channel at midday, every detail sharp from the sea view rooms.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palapa umbrellas and the white sand, and the Caribbean Sea lies grey behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, Isla Mujeres and Isla Contoy look sharp on the horizon beyond the empty beach.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the view from the open-air lobby is a dark Caribbean Sea with a white edge of surf.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the North Shore Mountains are a dark shape above the downtown rooftops, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches the city blocks below, and English Bay glitters beyond the downtown rooftops.
phrases.clear_midday: From the outdoor pool, the downtown skyline stands under a clear midday sky, framed by the North Shore Mountains.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the North Shore Mountains this morning, while the downtown towers below stay mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move slowly across the city blocks this afternoon, and English Bay stays bright beyond them.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, English Bay takes the same colour, and the downtown towers stand out in front of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the downtown towers today, and the North Shore Mountains are only a faint outline behind them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The North Shore Mountains are not visible today; guests see the nearest downtown towers and the streets below.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows, and guests watch the downtown towers turn grey and blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the downtown towers, and for a second the city blocks below turn bright.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over downtown, and from the balcony rooms the green rooftop and the street below are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: The North Shore Mountains stand sharp in the freezing air, clear above the downtown rooftops.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, steam rises from the heated outdoor pool, and the downtown skyline stands clear behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water at the outdoor pool and look up at the downtown towers.
phrases.warm: By the outdoor pool, books stay closed while guests look at the skyline and the North Shore Mountains.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun reaches the West End towers, and guests in balcony rooms watch the glass turn orange.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights English Bay, with the city blocks already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit windows of the downtown towers fill the view from the outdoor pool.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights blur in the rain, and the streets below shine.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests in this tower of 119 rooms look across at lit downtown offices.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the city lights spread below the terrace suites, and the North Shore Mountains stand black behind them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the streets below are almost empty, and the downtown towers stand quiet around them.
phrases.dusk: From the fitness room, guests see the first lights come on along Thurlow Street under a still bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the spires of Milan Cathedral stand unlit above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the spires of Milan Cathedral first, then the terracotta rooftops below them.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Duomo terrace suite, guests see Milan Cathedral in full midday light, every spire sharp against the blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the glass roof of Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II this morning, and the arches go from bright to shaded.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Montenapoleone terrace suite watch cloud shadows cross the rooftops towards Milan Cathedral this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the marble of Milan Cathedral looks almost white above the terracotta rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken the tops of the spires today, and Milan Cathedral seems to end halfway up.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today; Milan Cathedral shows only as an outline, and the rooftops beyond it are not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass roof of Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, and guests in the Galleria-facing rooms watch it from their windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the spires of Milan Cathedral for a second, then the storm closes over them again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Milan Cathedral, and guests at the windows watch the terracotta rooftops slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and guests stay behind the glass to study the stonework of Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 1870 building look out at the arches of Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II from the warm side of the window.
phrases.very_hot: From the private plunge pool of the Duomo terrace suite, guests look at Milan Cathedral through the heat, and nobody is in a hurry to get out.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests take a table on the Dehors terrace at MioLab and look across at Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the spires of Milan Cathedral gold above the terracotta rooftops, and for a while the whole skyline looks expensive.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and catches the facade of Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests at MioLab look from the Dehors terrace at the lit arcade of Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II shine through the rain on the windows.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and Milan Cathedral glows pale under its lights above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: The lit spires of Milan Cathedral stand out against a clear night sky, each one easy to pick out.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the arches of Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II are quiet and empty of shoppers at last.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Passeig de Gràcia is almost empty, and La Pedrera waits across the street as a grey stone shape under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: In the clear morning light, guests in the balcony rooms can read Gaudí's stone detail on La Pedrera across the street.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, the city centre spreads out roof after roof under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Passeig de Gràcia this morning, and their shadows cross the stone facade of La Pedrera one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Alaire, La Pedrera sits in the afternoon sun while a cloud passes over the Sagrada Familia further away.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the stone of La Pedrera takes almost the same colour, and the trees of Passeig de Gràcia give the only green.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Sagrada Familia from the rooftop today, but La Pedrera is just across the street and stays clear.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far parts of the city cannot be seen from the rooftop pool today, though the nearer roofs of the city centre still show.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the stone of La Pedrera, and guests watch it from the rooms facing Passeig de Gràcia.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above Passeig de Gràcia, and for a second guests see La Pedrera turn white before the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the trees of Passeig de Gràcia, and guests watch La Pedrera through the falling flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so from the terrace overlooking Passeig de Gràcia every line of La Pedrera looks sharp.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass of their balcony rooms, and La Pedrera is still close enough to study.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look over the city centre from the water's edge.
phrases.warm: On the solarium, guests lie in the warm air with the city centre in front of them, and nobody hurries down to the street.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light warms the stone of La Pedrera, and from this house of 1872 guests look straight across Passeig de Gràcia at it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Sagrada Familia turn orange, seen from Alaire on the 8th floor.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the illuminated facade of La Pedrera glows across the street, and Alaire looks straight at it.
phrases.wet_evening: The wet pavement of Passeig de Gràcia shines with the evening lights, and La Pedrera is lit behind the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests on their balconies look at the lit La Pedrera, which Gaudí seems to have left on for them.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of the city centre spread around the rooftop, with the Sagrada Familia among them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Passeig de Gràcia is quiet, and La Pedrera stands as a dark shape across the empty street.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the first lights come on along Passeig de Gràcia and on the facade of La Pedrera.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tyrrhenian Sea is still and grey-blue, and Lipari slowly takes shape across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From the room terraces, guests see Lipari, Salina and Filicudi standing clear across the Tyrrhenian Sea in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The infinity pool and the Tyrrhenian Sea share the same blue at midday, with the sea stacks of Lipari rising beyond the edge.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the water this morning, and Salina moves in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the covered terrace lounge, guests follow the clouds drifting over the sea stacks of Lipari this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Tyrrhenian Sea turns the colour of slate, and Lipari, Salina and Filicudi keep their clear outlines above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides Filicudi today and turns Salina into a faint outline, while Lipari stays close across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: Salina and Filicudi cannot be seen, and only the nearest sea stacks of Lipari show beyond the infinity pool.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Tyrrhenian Sea; guests watch it from the covered terrace lounge, with Lipari blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the archipelago, and with each flash of lightning guests see Lipari for a second across the dark sea.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Tyrrhenian Sea, and the sea stacks of Lipari show only faintly through the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear, and Filicudi stands sharp on the horizon beyond Salina.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the infinity pool lies still, and Lipari rises beyond it across the Tyrrhenian Sea.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look over its edge to the Tyrrhenian Sea and Lipari.
phrases.warm: Guests who arrived by hydrofoil or ferry now sit on their room terraces in the warm air and count the islands: Lipari, Salina, Filicudi.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the terrace of the Basiluzzo Suite, guests see the volcano of Stromboli across the sea in the golden light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and turns the sky red over the Aeolian Islands, seen from the room terraces.
phrases.grey_evening: Under the evening cloud, Lipari is a dark shape across the Tyrrhenian Sea.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls into the dark Tyrrhenian Sea this evening, and the islands disappear behind it.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and beyond the infinity pool the sea and the sky merge into one.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Tyrrhenian Sea tonight, and Salina and Lipari show as dark shapes below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Tyrrhenian Sea is quiet and the islands of the archipelago are almost unseen on the horizon.
phrases.dusk: The sun has gone and the sky is still bright, and guests in the covered terrace lounge watch the sea stacks of Lipari darken against it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Prague Castle stands as a dark shape above the rooftops of Malá Strana.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is served facing Prague Castle, and this morning the castle stands sharp against a clear blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: St. Nicholas Church stands clear above the red rooftops of Malá Strana in the midday light, seen from the terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests at breakfast look up at Prague Castle while cloud shadows move slowly across its walls.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Malá Strana this afternoon, and the red rooftops change from bright to dull and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the red rooftops of Malá Strana keep their colour, and St. Nicholas Church rises pale above them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens St. Nicholas Church today, and the rooftops of Malá Strana fade a little more with each street.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see the nearest red rooftops clearly while St. Nicholas Church is only a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Malá Strana, and the red rooftops shine wet below St. Nicholas Church.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay behind the windows while thunder rolls over Prague Castle and lightning shows the rooftops for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Malá Strana, and guests watch the red rooftops turn white one by one.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests look through the glass at St. Nicholas Church, with frost on the rooftops around it.
phrases.cold: Cold air sharpens the rooftops of Malá Strana today, and every chimney is easy to count.
phrases.very_hot: On the terrace, guests find a seat in the shade and look over the hot red rooftops to St. Nicholas Church.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit on the terrace with St. Nicholas Church and the rooftops of Malá Strana in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the red rooftops of Malá Strana a deeper orange, and St. Nicholas Church glows above them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds turn pink above Prague Castle while the rooftops below stay warm red.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests in the city-view rooms look over amber lights on the rooftops and churches of Prague.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of Prague blur in the rain this evening, and the wet rooftops below the city-view rooms shine amber.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the clouds hang low over Malá Strana, and St. Nicholas Church stands lit among the dark rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the city-view rooms see Prague lit in amber under a clear night sky, every church easy to pick out.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the rooftops of Malá Strana lie quiet below, and St. Nicholas Church waits for morning with them.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests in this 1620 building watch the first lights come on across Malá Strana.

phrases.clear_predawn: The beach lies empty and dark, with the lake only a shade paler beside it.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Grand Suite wake to a lake already bright with morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At this hour the beach is a pale, bright strip, with the lake flat and blue in front of it.
phrases.partly_morning: At the Infinity pool, the lake ahead is half in sun and half under cloud.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Yeast Side, guests watch the water turn from blue to silver each time a cloud passes.
phrases.overcast: The beach keeps its pale colour today, while the lake beyond it has gone as grey as the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: The beach is clear today, but the lake in front of it fades into haze a short way out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests in the Junior Suite can see the near half of the lake today, and no further.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the empty beach and making small rings all over the lake.
phrases.thunderstorm: In the Grand Suite, guests watch lightning flash over the lake and count the seconds to the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is turning the beach white, right down to the edge of the dark lake.
phrases.very_cold: From the Junior Suite, guests look out at a lake so clear and still that it seems made of glass.
phrases.cold: No footprints mark the beach today, and the lake beside it is still.
phrases.very_hot: Swimmers at the Infinity pool rest their arms on the edge and look straight out over the lake.
phrases.warm: Books lie open and unread beside the pool, because the guests keep looking up at the lake.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the pool, the lake shows one long path of low sun running towards the shore.
phrases.partly_golden: For a few minutes the beach turns gold as the last sun comes through a gap in the clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: The beach is a pale strip in the evening dark, and the lake beyond it is one colour with the clouds.
phrases.wet_evening: At Yeast Side tonight, guests listen to the rain and watch it fall on the black water.
phrases.mild_night: A pale line in the dark is all that shows of the beach, with the lake moving quietly against it.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the beach is only a faint grey line, and the lake beside it lies black and calm.
phrases.late_night: The Infinity pool lies still at this hour, its edge lost against the dark lake.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the beach holds the last light, while the lake slowly turns dark blue.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Forbidden City is a low dark shape under a clear sky, seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at Café Zi has the Forbidden City in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Forbidden City lies under a clear blue sky, and guests at Café Zi look across it over lunch.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Forbidden City this morning, and the Premier Suite has an open sightline to follow them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the Forbidden City this afternoon, seen from the garden terrace of Mandarin Grill.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Forbidden City spreads wide and quiet below the rooftop garden.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Forbidden City today, and from the rooftop garden the far halls fade into the white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see the near side of the Forbidden City and the Beijing skyline behind it is missing.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Forbidden City, and guests watch it from the Premier Suite through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Beijing, and each flash of lightning shows the Forbidden City for a second through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Forbidden City, and guests at Café Zi watch the palace roofs turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, bright day, the Forbidden City looks sharp from the warm side of the glass at Café Zi.
phrases.cold: Guests take afternoon tea at Café Zi on this cold day, and the Forbidden City looks still in the cool light.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat the Forbidden City shimmers a little, and guests on the private terrace of the Oriental Suite look at it from the shade.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun reaches the Forbidden City, and guests at MO Bar came for exactly this view from the outdoor terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Forbidden City turn orange above the MO Bar terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Over dinner at Mandarin Grill, guests look from the garden terrace to the Forbidden City under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights of Beijing blur in the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Forbidden City lies beyond them.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and at MO Bar the cocktails wait while guests look out at the Forbidden City.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Forbidden City lies low and wide beyond the MO Bar terrace, with the city lights of Beijing around it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who are still awake find the Forbidden City resting in the dark beyond the glass.
phrases.dusk: At dusk the sky is still bright over the Forbidden City, and from the rooftop terrace of this 2019 hotel the first lights of Beijing come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Koutoubia Mosque minaret is a tall shape above the sleeping medina rooftops, in line with the still rooftop pool.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Koutoubia Mosque minaret, seen through the palms from the rooftop pool.
phrases.clear_midday: From the roof terrace at midday, the Koutoubia Mosque stands close and sharp above the red-and-white parasols.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the rooftop bar look past the palm trees to the Koutoubia Mosque, now in sun, now in shade.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Koutoubia Mosque keeps its warm stone colour above the medina rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the medina rooftops today, and the Koutoubia Mosque minaret seems to float above them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Atlas Mountains are not visible from the roof terrace today, but the Koutoubia Mosque is still clear beyond the palms.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop pool and on the medina rooftops, and the Koutoubia Mosque stands grey and blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the rooftops of Marrakech, and each flash of lightning shows the Koutoubia Mosque minaret for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the medina rooftops, and the Koutoubia Mosque fades in and out behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, every detail of the Koutoubia Mosque minaret shows from the roof terrace.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the rooftops of Marrakech spread out below the roof terrace, with the Koutoubia Mosque close behind them.
phrases.very_hot: Guests stay in the rooftop pool in this heat and look straight along the water to the Koutoubia Mosque minaret.
phrases.warm: On the day beds by the rooftop pool, guests lounge in the warm air with the Atlas Mountains as a backdrop.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Koutoubia Mosque gold, and guests on the 1,300 square metre roof terrace choose their seats for sunset.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop bar, guests watch the last sun slip between clouds over the palm trees and the Atlas Mountains.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city is lit up below the rooftop bar and the Koutoubia Mosque glows above the medina.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain shines on the medina rooftops tonight, and the lights of the Koutoubia Mosque minaret blur in the wet air.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, guests on the couches of the roof terrace look down at the lights of Marrakech.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the medina, and the lit Koutoubia Mosque minaret stands above the dark rooftops.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the rooftops of Marrakech are quiet, and the Koutoubia Mosque minaret keeps watch over the medina alone.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind the Koutoubia Mosque, and the first lights come on across the rooftops of Marrakech.

phrases.clear_predawn: In the Fitness centre, guests training before sunrise see Green Park slowly come out of the dark.
phrases.clear_morning: Green Park is bright this morning, and the London Eye turns slowly in the distance under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The London Eye is sharp against the blue at midday, with Hyde Park and Green Park both in full sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Hyde Park goes from sun to shade and back this morning as the clouds pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon guests see the London Eye in sunshine one minute and in cloud shadow the next.
phrases.overcast: The London Eye turns as usual under the cloud, and Green Park is still green.
phrases.fog_haze: Today's haze makes the London Eye look pale, and The Shard is almost gone from the skyline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: With visibility low, Hyde Park and Green Park are easy to see, but the London skyline is not.
phrases.rain: In the Fitness centre, guests train in the dry and watch the rain fall on Hyde Park.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay in and watch the storm over Green Park, with the London Eye appearing in each flash of lightning.
phrases.snow: Guests watch from inside as snow settles on Hyde Park and hides the London Eye.
phrases.very_cold: Nobody in the Fitness centre feels the cold, though Green Park outside looks frozen.
phrases.cold: The paths of Hyde Park are almost empty today, and the trees stand still along Park Lane.
phrases.very_hot: At Terrace dining, guests sit with a cold drink and look over at the shade in Green Park.
phrases.warm: Guests stay long at Terrace dining today, with Hyde Park green in front of them and the London Eye turning in the distance.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Green Park looks warmer by the minute in the late sun, with The Shard shining far away.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests catch the London Eye in the last sun of the day, between two bands of cloud.
phrases.grey_evening: After dark Hyde Park becomes one wide shadow, with Park Lane bright along its side.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lit London Eye this evening, and Green Park is dark and wet.
phrases.mild_night: Guests go to sleep tonight with the London Eye lit under the cloud and Green Park dark.

phrases.late_night: Hyde Park and Green Park are two dark shapes at this hour, and the city around them is quiet.
phrases.dusk: The first lights come on along Park Lane, while the trees of Hyde Park turn dark under a bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Gulf of Thailand lies still and grey-blue before sunrise, and the first light draws the outline of Koh Bong.

phrases.clear_midday: Under the midday sun, the Gulf of Thailand is bright turquoise around the timber footbridge, and the forested islet stands sharp across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows drift across the Gulf of Thailand this morning, and guests in the overwater villas watch them move toward Koh Bong.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the double-swing seats at Vista, guests watch patches of sun and shade trade places on the Gulf of Thailand.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Gulf of Thailand takes the colour of the cloud, and the forested islet stands darker across the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Gulf of Thailand today, and the distant boats seem to float without a horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far islands are not visible today; the Gulf of Thailand ends in a pale blur a short way from the shore.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Gulf of Thailand with thousands of small rings, and guests watch them from under the thatched roof of Vista.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Gulf of Thailand, and for a second Koh Bong appears clearly from the Royal Villa before the thunder rolls in.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Gulf of Thailand, a sight so unlikely here that guests in the ocean view villas keep checking it is real.
phrases.very_cold: The air is bitterly cold and very clear, and the Gulf of Thailand shows a sharp horizon behind the forested islet.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay wrapped up inside Vista and watch small waves cross the Gulf of Thailand below them.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests of the 24 villas stay in their infinity pools, where the far edge seems to join the Gulf of Thailand.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests rest in the outdoor massage pavilion, open to the turquoise Gulf of Thailand and the forested islet.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Vista, guests swing gently in the double-swing seats over the sea while the sun drops toward the Gulf of Thailand.
phrases.partly_golden: With the island's clocks set an hour ahead of the mainland, the sun still breaks through the clouds over the Gulf of Thailand in front of Driftwood's tables in the sand.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Gulf of Thailand is dark and calm around Vista, with only the lights of distant boats on it.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain drums on the dark Gulf of Thailand, and guests watch it run off the thatch in silver threads.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Gulf of Thailand moves softly below the timber footbridge, a little lighter than the sky.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, stars fill the sky over the Gulf of Thailand, and some of them shine back from the calm water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Gulf of Thailand lies quiet around the island, and the only movement is the tide.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the Gulf of Thailand holds the orange of the sky, and Koh Bong turns into a silhouette.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Atlantic Ocean is a wide dark surface under a clear sky, and the horizon slowly begins to show.

phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic Ocean meets the clear sky in one sharp line at midday, with the sandy beach bright below.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic Ocean this morning, and guests can follow them all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests look out at an Atlantic Ocean of two colours this afternoon, blue in the sun and grey-green under the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the Atlantic Ocean turns the colour of slate, and guests can pick out each wave on it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic Ocean seems to fade into the sky a short way from the beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests can see the sandy beach and the first waves today, but the far Atlantic horizon is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic Ocean; guests watch it from the oceanfront suites, the horizon blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests behind the glass count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sandy beach, and guests watch the flakes disappear into the grey Atlantic Ocean.

phrases.warm: Guests on the balconies watch families walk along the sandy beach below, with the Atlantic Ocean stretching out behind them.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Atlantic Ocean keeps moving in the dark, and the beach in front of it is empty.
phrases.dusk: The sky above the Atlantic Ocean is still bright just after sunset, while the water below is already turning grey-blue.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the twin towers of the Frauenkirche stand as dark shapes against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the trees of the Alter Botanischer Garten, and guests in the garden-view rooms open their French balconies to look at them.
phrases.clear_midday: Through the floor-to-ceiling windows of Florio, guests look onto the Alter Botanischer Garten, bright under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Old Town this morning, and their shadows cross the two Frauenkirche towers one after the other.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the top-floor sundeck of the Royal Suite Montforte, guests follow patches of afternoon sun as they move across the Old Town roofs around the Frauenkirche.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Frauenkirche towers stay sharp above Old Town, and the Alter Botanischer Garten keeps its quiet colours.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits in the Alter Botanischer Garten today, and from Florio guests see the nearest trees clearly while the far ones fade into the grey.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the Frauenkirche towers are faint and the Old Town roofs around Marienplatz cannot be made out.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows of Florio, and guests watch the paths of the Alter Botanischer Garten shine with water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Frauenkirche towers for a second above Old Town, then the storm clouds close over them again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Alter Botanischer Garten, and guests in Florio watch the trees and paths turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the two Frauenkirche towers stand in fine detail above Old Town, best enjoyed from behind glass.

phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit out on the top-floor sundeck of the Royal Suite Montforte, with Old Town and the Frauenkirche spread out in front.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Frauenkirche towers a warm gold, and the Old Town roofs around Marienplatz glow beneath them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and lights the treetops of the Alter Botanischer Garten one group at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Frauenkirche towers rise over Old Town, and the cloud above them takes a little of the city's glow.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests in Florio look out at the dark Alter Botanischer Garten through glass covered in shining drops.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the Alter Botanischer Garten is a dark shape below, and the lights of Old Town shine beyond it.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests see the lit Frauenkirche towers sharp against a black sky, above the lights of Old Town.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Old Town is quiet, and the Frauenkirche towers are only just visible against the night sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across Old Town below the Frauenkirche.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific is a wide dark blue beyond Coronado Beach, and the sand is still grey.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the white sand of Coronado Beach, as it has for guests here since 1888, and the Pacific horizon runs unbroken behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: From Veranda at midday, the Pacific is a clear blue under an empty sky, right to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Pacific this morning while Coronado Beach stays bright in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the ocean-view rooms watch patches of afternoon sun move over the Pacific between the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific turns the colour of steel, and Coronado Beach looks even whiter beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Pacific today, and from Veranda the waves seem to arrive from nowhere onto Coronado Beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Pacific horizon is not visible today; guests see Coronado Beach and the first rows of waves, then a pale blur.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Coronado Beach, and guests in the Victorian rooms watch the Pacific turn grey behind wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific in the thunderstorm, and for a second every wave off Coronado Beach is white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Coronado Beach, and the Pacific keeps rolling in as if nothing unusual is happening.
phrases.very_cold: From the lounge, guests look through the doors at a sharp Pacific horizon in the very cold, clear air.

phrases.warm: On the private terraces of the Beach Village villas, guests sit in the warm air with the Pacific horizon in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the sand of Coronado Beach gold, and each wave on the Pacific carries a line of light.
phrases.partly_golden: At Veranda, guests watch the clouds over the Pacific turn orange in the last hour of sun.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Pacific and the sky become one dark grey, and the horizon disappears.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests at the windows of this National Historic Landmark watch evening rain fall on Coronado Beach, the Pacific lost in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the Pacific is mostly a sound, with a faint band of surf along Coronado Beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Pacific tonight, and the horizon is a thin edge between two kinds of dark.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Coronado Beach is empty and the Pacific moves quietly in the dark.
phrases.dusk: The sky over the Pacific is still bright after sunset, while Coronado Beach slowly loses its colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Uluwatu Temple is still only a dark outline, waiting for the first light of the day.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests who are up early this morning have a clear view of Uluwatu Temple in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Nothing stands between guests and Uluwatu Temple at this hour, the view open all the way.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Uluwatu Temple this morning, and the view changes between shade and sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon guests see Uluwatu Temple partly in sun and partly under passing clouds.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud sits over Uluwatu Temple today, and the whole view is quiet under it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the view today, and Uluwatu Temple shows only as a pale shape.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling across the view of Uluwatu Temple, and guests watch it from indoors.
phrases.very_cold: Wrapped up indoors, guests still have Uluwatu Temple sharp and bright in front of them.

phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the houses of the Positano Hillside keep their pastel colours, and Spiaggia Grande lies quiet below the sunset terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Positano Hillside today, and from the infinity pool the houses look like a faded painting.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Positano Hillside, and from the sea-view rooms the roofs turn white above a grey sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and clear, and from the edge of the infinity pool the Positano Hillside stands sharp above an empty Spiaggia Grande.

phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Promenade des Anglais draws a pale line between the city and the deep blue sea.

phrases.very_cold: The beach is empty in the freezing air, and the ocean looks sharp and blue from behind the pool area windows.
