phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass at Harbour Society tonight, and the lights along Waitemata Harbour blur behind dinner.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hang low over Waitemata Harbour, and guests at HI-SO see the city lights on the water.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in this former Reserve Bank building now look at another kind of gold, the city lights on Waitemata Harbour under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Waitemata Harbour is calm and almost empty, a wide dark space beyond the sleeping city.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright above Waitemata Harbour, and the first lights come on across the Auckland skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is a wide dark surface under a clear sky, and the sand of the Grand Strand is only just visible.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Atlantic, and from the oceanfront balconies guests follow the Grand Strand in both directions.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Atlantic is a strong blue behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of the restaurant, with no cloud in the sky above it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic this morning, while the beach below the covered terrace stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the covered pool, patches of sun and shade cross the sandy beach and the Atlantic beyond.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlantic turns the same colour, and the surf is the only white along the Grand Strand.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so from the bar windows the Atlantic seems to end a short way past the beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far ends of the Grand Strand are not visible today; guests on the oceanfront balconies see the nearest stretch of sand and the first waves.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the restaurant, and the Atlantic behind them is grey and blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Atlantic for a second at a time, and the Grand Strand turns white below the storm before going dark again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Grand Strand, and guests in this 2019 tower watch the flakes disappear into the Atlantic.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and from the covered terrace the Atlantic runs all the way to a sharp horizon.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the beach is almost empty, and the Atlantic waves have the Grand Strand to themselves.
phrases.very_hot: From the covered terrace, guests in the shade look over the busy pool deck to the Atlantic.
phrases.warm: On this warm day the Grand Strand fills with people, and guests at the bar look past them to the Atlantic.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the colour of the sand, and from 27 floors of balconies guests look along the Grand Strand as the shadows grow long.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Atlantic turn pink above the pool deck, seen from the covered terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and the lights along the Grand Strand show where the land ends and the Atlantic begins.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests at the bar see the lights of the Grand Strand shining through the drops on the windows.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, cloud hides the stars, and guests on the oceanfront balconies look down at the Atlantic moving in the dark.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Atlantic tonight, and the lights of the Grand Strand run along the coast in both directions.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Atlantic is black and quiet, and the Grand Strand lies empty beside it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky over the Atlantic is still bright, and the first lights appear along the Grand Strand.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Burj Khalifa stands as a dark outline above the city while the sky slowly grows pale before sunrise.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests start the day with a clear view of the Burj Khalifa, rising above the other skyscrapers in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Al fresco terraces, guests can see every skyscraper in the city clearly from bottom to top.
phrases.partly_morning: The Infinity pool faces a city of sun and shade this morning, as clouds pass over the skyscrapers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Burj Khalifa stays in the sun while cloud shadows cross the city below it.
phrases.overcast: The city looks quiet under grey cloud today, with the Burj Khalifa rising above the other skyscrapers.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and from the pool the skyscrapers show as pale shapes, one behind another.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Burj Khalifa is only a faint shape and the far parts of the city cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Today's rain blurs the Burj Khalifa to a grey line, and guests watch the city shine wet below it.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over the city, and guests watch from indoors as lightning shows the Burj Khalifa for a moment.
phrases.snow: Snow hides the top of the Burj Khalifa, and guests keep indoors to watch the city turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The Infinity pool lies still and empty today, with the whole city spread out beyond its edge.
phrases.cold: Guests stay indoors today and look out at the Burj Khalifa, which stands clear above the city.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay shoulder-deep in the Infinity pool and let the city shimmer in front of them.
phrases.warm: Guests take their time on the Al fresco terraces, with the city laid out before them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Burj Khalifa gold, and the skyscrapers around it slowly take the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: Orange light and grey shade take turns on the city as clouds cross the low sun.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit Burj Khalifa stands over a city full of lit windows.
phrases.wet_evening: This evening's rain softens the city lights, and guests watch the lit Burj Khalifa through it.
phrases.mild_night: The city lights spread out beyond the pool tonight, and the low cloud above them glows faintly orange.
phrases.clear_night: Guests can follow the lights of the Burj Khalifa all the way up to its tip tonight.
phrases.late_night: Late in the night, the Burj Khalifa still stands above the city for any guest who is awake.
phrases.dusk: Minutes after sunset, the Burj Khalifa begins to light up against a still-bright sky, and the city follows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, São Jorge Castle is a dark shape on its hill, and the sky behind it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the terrace of the Miradouro Penthouse, guests look over the São Pedro de Alcântara viewpoint to São Jorge Castle in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch at Lumi Rooftop Bar and Restaurant, the Tagus River shines on one side and São Jorge Castle stands on the other.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Bairro Alto rooftops this morning, while São Jorge Castle stays in sunshine on its hill.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the 5th floor terrace, guests watch the clouds drift towards the Tagus River and guess which rooftop gets the sun next.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Tagus River turns the colour of metal behind the terracotta rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the hill across the street today, and São Jorge Castle looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tagus River is not visible today, and the eye stops at the nearest Bairro Alto rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the São Pedro de Alcântara viewpoint, and guests in the Glória Suite watch it from their large windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Tagus River, and for a second every Lisbon rooftop shows clearly.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Bairro Alto rooftops, and São Jorge Castle fades behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and São Jorge Castle stands sharp on its hill beyond the glass railing.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests at Lumi Rooftop Bar and Restaurant watch the Tagus River, grey-blue beyond the bell tower.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the terracotta rooftops shimmer, and guests on the terrace look towards the Tagus River and hope for a breeze.
phrases.warm: On the terrace of Lumi Rooftop Bar and Restaurant, guests stand at the glass railing and look across the warm rooftops to São Jorge Castle.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns São Jorge Castle gold, and the 18th-century palace has a front-row seat.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and colours the Tagus River pink, while the rooftops below are already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, São Jorge Castle shows in the distance above the lit Lisbon hillside.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests at Lumi Rooftop Bar and Restaurant watch the city lights blur in the rain towards the Tagus River.
phrases.mild_night: From their private terraces, penthouse guests look over the lit streets of Bairro Alto under a soft, cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lights of the Lisbon hillside climb towards São Jorge Castle.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Bairro Alto rooftops are quiet, and the Tagus River is only a darker band beyond them.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests on the terrace watch the first lights come on below São Jorge Castle.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the private bay is still and grey-blue, and the sky above the Arabian Gulf grows lighter by the minute.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the white sand of the private beach, and the Arabian Gulf beyond it is a clear turquoise.
phrases.clear_midday: From the balconies of the sea-view rooms, guests look at the Arabian Gulf under a cloudless midday sky, blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the private bay this morning, turning the water from turquoise to dark blue and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: White clouds drift over the Arabian Gulf this afternoon, and their slow progress is easy to follow from the waterfront terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky the Arabian Gulf turns silver-grey, and the marina shows clearly against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the private bay today, and the far side of the marina is only a soft outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon of the Arabian Gulf is not visible today; guests can see the 1.3-kilometer private beach and the near water, and little beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Palace gardens, and guests in the garden-view rooms watch the green of the palms grow darker.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Arabian Gulf, and for a second the whole private bay is as bright as day.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the private beach, and guests stand at the sea-view windows to watch white flakes land on white sand.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear today, and from the waterfront terrace the Arabian Gulf looks sharp all the way to the horizon.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the private beach is empty, and the Arabian Gulf rolls in quietly on the white sand.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the waterfront terrace stay under the shade sails and look out at the glittering Arabian Gulf.
phrases.warm: On the private beach, guests leave their books closed and look at the turquoise water of the bay instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Royal Suite, guests look through the palms at the Arabian Gulf as the low sun turns the water gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the waterfront terrace has a wide view of the Arabian Gulf turning orange and pink.
phrases.grey_evening: From the dining terrace, the Abu Dhabi skyline shows its lit towers under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain blurs the lights of the marina, and the private bay beyond them is almost black.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and the Arabian Gulf is a wide dark space beyond the pale sand of the private beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Arabian Gulf tonight, and the marina lights make short gold lines on the water of the private bay.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the private bay is quiet and dark, with only a thin white edge where the Arabian Gulf meets the sand.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky over the private bay is still bright, and the first lights come on around the marina.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gothic stonework of St Stephen's Cathedral shows grey against a clear sky from the cathedral view rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Café Giacomo Aragall, guests look out on Stephansplatz as the square fills with morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, the tile roof of St Stephen's Cathedral shows its diamond pattern under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Stephansplatz this morning, and guests at Café Giacomo Aragall follow them over their breakfast.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The tile roof of St Stephen's Cathedral changes from bright to dull as clouds pass this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the stone of St Stephen's Cathedral shows its carved detail without any glare.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of St Stephen's Cathedral today, and only the lower stonework shows across Stephansplatz.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the tile roof of St Stephen's Cathedral looks faded from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the Gothic stonework of St Stephen's Cathedral, and guests in the cathedral view rooms watch it darken.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows St Stephen's Cathedral for a second at a time, and guests in the Top Tobias Suite stay behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Stephansplatz, and the tile roof of St Stephen's Cathedral turns white as guests look on.
phrases.very_cold: St Stephen's Cathedral stands sharp in the freezing air, and most guests choose to admire it from Café Giacomo Aragall.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, Stephansplatz looks quiet from Café Giacomo Aragall, where guests sit with a Viennese coffee.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the rooftop terrace keep a cold drink close and look across the roof of St Stephen's Cathedral.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the terraces of the cathedral suites sit outside with St Stephen's Cathedral in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the stonework of St Stephen's Cathedral gold, and guests stop talking to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights one side of St Stephen's Cathedral, seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, St Stephen's Cathedral is lit, and guests in this 1950s building look across at it.
phrases.wet_evening: The wet paving of Stephansplatz shines with the lights of the square, seen from Café Giacomo Aragall on a rainy evening.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the rooftop terrace looks across the lit roof of St Stephen's Cathedral to Stephansplatz below.
phrases.clear_night: St Stephen's Cathedral stands lit under a clear night sky, and Stephansplatz glows below the rooftop terrace.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Stephansplatz is nearly empty, and St Stephen's Cathedral is the only company for guests still awake.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Stephansplatz in front of St Stephen's Cathedral.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Elliott Bay is a wide, quiet stretch of dark water beyond the market roofs.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests bring their morning coffee up to the rooftop terrace and look across Elliott Bay to the Olympic Mountains.
phrases.clear_midday: Elliott Bay is bright blue at midday, and the boats leave white streaks across it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Pike Place Market sign this morning, and their shadows cross Elliott Bay one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, guests follow a ferry across Elliott Bay as the afternoon sun comes and goes.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Elliott Bay turns the colour of steel, and the red Pike Place Market sign looks even redder.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Elliott Bay today, and guests on the rooftop terrace see the Pike Place Market sign and little beyond it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Olympic Mountains are not visible today; Elliott Bay and the Seattle waterfront still show clearly below.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Elliott Bay, and guests in the water view rooms watch the ferries cross it from a dry chair.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Elliott Bay, and lightning shows the whole width of the water for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the roofs of Pike Place Market, and Elliott Bay is a soft grey behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Olympic Mountains stand sharp beyond Elliott Bay.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stand at the floor-to-ceiling windows and count the boats on Elliott Bay.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the rooftop terrace turn their chairs towards Elliott Bay and wait for a breeze from the water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests stay on the rooftop terrace for hours, with the busy market below and Elliott Bay in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on the rooftop terrace watch the low sun turn Elliott Bay gold, a glass of wine in hand.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and colours them orange above Elliott Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: The Pike Place Market sign glows red under the cloudy evening sky, with Elliott Bay a darker band behind it.
phrases.wet_evening: From the water view rooms, guests see the red letters of the Pike Place Market sign shine through the wet evening, with Elliott Bay black behind.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, guests in this 79-room inn look out at the waterfront lights spread along Elliott Bay.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of the Seattle waterfront shine on the black water of Elliott Bay.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the market below is silent, and Elliott Bay lies still and dark beyond its roofs.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the Pike Place Market sign lights up in red, and Elliott Bay behind it still holds the pale sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Arno River lies still and grey below the hotel, and Ponte Vecchio waits for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests at breakfast in the old frescoed ballroom look out at the Arno River, bright in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop bar, guests see the Duomo sharp against a clear blue sky, with Palazzo Vecchio also in sight.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Arno River this morning, and from the 4th-floor terrace Ponte Vecchio moves in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, guests watch clouds drift over the Florentine hills while the Duomo stays in sunlight.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Arno River looks like dull metal below Ponte Vecchio.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Florentine hills today, and from the rooftop bar the Duomo looks like a faded fresco.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests on the rooftop terrace cannot see the Florentine hills today, but the Duomo and Palazzo Vecchio are near enough to see clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Arno River with small circles, and guests in the front rooms watch it fall on Ponte Vecchio.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Arno River, and for a second Ponte Vecchio appears clearly through the storm rain.
phrases.snow: Snow falls softly on Ponte Vecchio and disappears as it touches the Arno River.
phrases.very_cold: From the rooftop terrace, the Florentine hills look close in the freezing air, and the Duomo stands against a cold sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Arno River runs dark past the walls of this 13th-century convent, with Ponte Vecchio just along the water.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the rooftop terrace find a chair, a cold drink and the Duomo, in that order.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit on the rooftop terrace among the red flowers and look across at the Vasari Corridor and Palazzo Vecchio.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Ponte Vecchio gold below the 4th-floor terrace, the view filmed in 1985 for A Room with a View.
phrases.partly_golden: At the rooftop bar, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds above the Duomo.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at the rooftop bar look across the lit city to the Vasari Corridor and Palazzo Vecchio.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, rain blurs the lights of Ponte Vecchio, and the Arno River carries them in broken pieces.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hang low over the city, and the lit Duomo rises towards them above the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of Ponte Vecchio lie still on the Arno River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Arno River moves quietly under Ponte Vecchio, and the city around it sleeps.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests on the 4th-floor terrace see the first lights come on along Ponte Vecchio.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Kyoto Tower waits above the quiet tiled roofs for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the tiled roofs first, and Kyoto Tower stands white and sharp about two kilometers away.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests in the city-view rooms look across treetops and tiled roofs to the Higashiyama hills.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move over the treetops this morning, while Kyoto Tower stays in sunshine on the horizon.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop lounge, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift across the low skyline towards Kyoto Tower.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the white spire of Kyoto Tower almost matches the clouds, so the tiled roofs take the attention.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and Kyoto Tower looks like a faint pencil line above the roofs.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Kyoto Tower and the Higashiyama hills are not visible today, and guests in the rooftop lounge see only the nearest treetops and tiled roofs.
phrases.rain: Rain makes the tiled roofs shine, and guests behind floor-to-ceiling glass see Kyoto Tower a little blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city, and each flash of lightning shows Kyoto Tower as the one tall thing on the skyline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the treetops and tiled roofs, and Kyoto Tower, already white, is slowly disappearing into it.
phrases.very_cold: From the rooftop lounge, each ridge of the Higashiyama hills is easy to follow in the clear, freezing air.
phrases.cold: A cold light lies on the tiled roofs today, and the Higashiyama hills stand clear beyond the city.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above the tiled roofs, and guests in the rooftop lounge look at Kyoto Tower through the trembling air.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit on their balconies with tea and look over the garden to Kyoto Tower and the Higashiyama hills.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the rooftop lounge on the 4th floor, guests watch the low sun turn the tiled roofs gold around Kyoto Tower.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colors the clouds pink above the city and the Higashiyama hills, and nobody in the rooftop lounge looks at a phone.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the low city glows softly, and Kyoto Tower marks where the skyline ends.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows tonight, and the city lights spread into soft spots of color around Kyoto Tower.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers the night sky, but the lights of the low city reach all the way to the foot of Kyoto Tower.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in this hotel opened in 2024 look over the dark tiled roofs to the lights around Kyoto Tower.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and Kyoto Tower is only a thin shape above the roofs.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first city lights appear below Kyoto Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Table Mountain is a dark shape against a sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests step onto their balconies to a clear morning, with Table Mountain sharp against the blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Atlantic is deep blue from the rooftop pool, and Lion's Head stands clear on the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the top of Table Mountain this morning, while Lion's Head stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the rooftop pool this afternoon, cloud shadows travel over DHL Stadium and on towards Table Mountain.
phrases.overcast: The sky is grey from end to end today, and the Atlantic has copied it; Lion's Head stands darker than both.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Table Mountain today, and from the rooftop pool it looks like a painting left unfinished.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so DHL Stadium is plain to see from here while Table Mountain is only a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Beach Road and the Atlantic, and guests in the Penthouse Suites watch it from the living area, Lion's Head blurred behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Atlantic, and each flash of lightning shows Lion's Head for a second through the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the Atlantic today, and Table Mountain fades to white behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, and Lion's Head shows every edge against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Atlantic looks dark blue from the rooftop bar, and Table Mountain stands clear above it.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look across DHL Stadium to Table Mountain.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit out on their balconies, one for each of the 34 rooms, and look from the Atlantic to Lion's Head.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns Table Mountain gold, and the rooftop pool holds the same colour on its surface.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, light breaks through the clouds on the side of Camps Bay and Lion's Head.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights come on below Table Mountain, and the heated rooftop pool glows above them.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain runs down the glass, and the city lights below Table Mountain turn into soft spots of colour.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the city lights spread out below Lion's Head.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Atlantic on this clear night, and the outline of Table Mountain is easy to follow against them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic is more a sound than a sight, and Table Mountain waits in the dark for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and at the rooftop bar the first cocktails arrive as Table Mountain darkens above the Atlantic.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean is a wide dark surface beyond the rocking chairs on the veranda, with the first light low on the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the oceanview rooms wake to the sun low over the Atlantic Ocean and a bright path of light on the water.
phrases.clear_midday: From the zero-entry pool, the Atlantic Ocean is a strong, clear blue under a sky with no clouds.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic Ocean this morning, and from the veranda the water changes between blue and grey.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop PURE Spa, guests look down on the Atlantic Ocean, bright blue this afternoon under tall white clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlantic Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the white foam of the waves stands out along the private beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so from the veranda the Atlantic Ocean and the sky look like one soft sheet.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon of the Atlantic Ocean cannot be seen from the rooftop PURE Spa today; the water is clear only near the private beach.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the private beach, and from the veranda it can be seen meeting the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Atlantic Ocean for a second at a time, and guests in the Pure Suite count the seconds before the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sand of the private beach, and guests in the ballrooms watch the flakes disappear into the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: From a table at OCEAN2000, guests look at the Atlantic Ocean, sharp and bright in the very cold air.
phrases.cold: A cold wind puts white tops on the waves of the Atlantic Ocean, and the 500-foot private beach lies empty beside them.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the zero-entry pool and look over its edge at the Atlantic Ocean, which shines almost white.
phrases.warm: On the veranda, the rocking chairs move slowly while guests look at the swimmers and umbrellas on the private beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight warms the colour of the sand on the private beach, and the Atlantic Ocean turns a deeper blue behind it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Atlantic Ocean turn pink, and guests in the balcony suites watch the colour spread.
phrases.grey_evening: The lights of the Fort Lauderdale skyline glow under low cloud this evening, while the Atlantic Ocean stays dark and quiet.
phrases.wet_evening: This rainy evening, guests in the ballrooms look out at rain falling over a black Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the veranda the Atlantic Ocean shows as slow bands of foam coming to the sand.
phrases.clear_night: From the Sky Suite on the 12th floor, the clear night shows stars over the Atlantic Ocean.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Nybroviken, and the roofs along Strandvägen are turning white one after another.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and every roof and tower on the Stockholm skyline has a sharp edge today.

phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit outside at Le Hibou and look along Strandvägen to the water of Nybroviken.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the facades of Strandvägen gold, and guests on the rooftop terrace arrive before dark to see it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and colours the Stockholm skyline orange, one tower at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Strandvägen draw a bright curve along the dark water of Nybroviken.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the city this evening, and from Le Hibou the lights of Strandvägen shine double on the wet quay.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, guests at Le Hibou, a top-floor bar in a hotel opened in 2018, look down at the lights around Nybroviken.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of Strandvägen are reflected in Nybroviken, and guests on the rooftop terrace count both rows.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Stockholm skyline is quiet, and Nybroviken lies still and dark below the rooftops.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Strandvägen while guests look out from the rooftop terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Ortigas skyline is a group of quiet towers under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.

phrases.grey_evening: The lights of the Ortigas skyline shine under a cloudy evening sky, all around Vu's Sky Bar and Lounge on the 45th floor.

phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights of the Ortigas skyline come on beyond the glass of the indoor infinity pool.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Marina Bay Sands gold, and the Esplanade domes shine beside the water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Marina Bay turn orange, and the city skyline glows below them.
phrases.grey_evening: At the Fairmont Gold Lounge, guests take evening cocktails while the lights of Marina Bay glow under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the upper-floor bar tonight, and the lights of Marina Bay Sands spread into soft colours.
phrases.mild_night: Marina Bay Sands stays lit across Marina Bay on this mild night, under a sky with no stars.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the lit skyline of Marina Bay fills the frame from the balconies facing the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Marina Bay is quiet, and Marina Bay Sands is a dark shape against the sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Arno River is a quiet grey band, and Ponte Vecchio slowly takes shape above it.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests take breakfast in the lobby under a clear sky, with Ponte Vecchio straight ahead in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Rooftop Terrace Suite, the midday sky is clear all the way round, from the Duomo to the Arno River.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Arno River this morning, and from the breakfast terrace their shadows can be seen crossing the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At Picteau Lounge, guests look up from an afternoon negroni to watch sun and cloud take turns on the Arno River.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Arno River loses its reflections and Ponte Vecchio keeps all the attention.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits on the Arno River today, and from the lobby Ponte Vecchio looks like a soft drawing of itself.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today and the Duomo cannot be seen, while the Arno River and Ponte Vecchio, much closer, remain clear.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Arno River with small rings, and from the river-facing tables of Borgo San Jacopo Ponte Vecchio looks darker.
phrases.thunderstorm: Behind the windows of Picteau Lounge, thunder rolls along the Arno River and lightning whitens the water.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Arno River and melts at once, while the roof of Ponte Vecchio slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and from the warm lobby Ponte Vecchio stands sharp above the Arno River.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the Picasso, Bueno and Cocteau suites keep the windows shut and the Arno River in front of them.
phrases.very_hot: The heat makes the air shimmer over the Arno River, and Ponte Vecchio seems to float a little above the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day the dining terrace looks over the Arno River to Ponte Vecchio, and guests there are in no hurry to leave.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Ponte Vecchio gold, and the tables at Borgo San Jacopo that face the Arno River get the full colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests in the Rooftop Terrace Suite watch the clouds above the Duomo turn pink, then orange.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Borgo San Jacopo, guests face the Arno River and a lit Ponte Vecchio under a low cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The weather is wet tonight, and guests in Borgo San Jacopo watch the blurred lights of Ponte Vecchio shake on the Arno River.
phrases.mild_night: The Arno River is soft and dark under a mild cloudy sky tonight, in front of this former Medici palace.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lights of Ponte Vecchio lie doubled in the Arno River, and guests in Picteau Lounge count them over a last drink.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Arno River runs quietly past 65 sleeping rooms, with Ponte Vecchio a black outline above it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on one by one along Ponte Vecchio above the Arno River.

phrases.clear_predawn: The steps of the Tegallalang Rice Terraces are just starting to show in the valley as the night thins.
phrases.clear_morning: Low morning sun picks out every level of the Tegallalang Rice Terraces across the valley.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday shows the lush tropical forest in full colour to guests in the Luxury Pool Villa.
phrases.partly_morning: Sun and shade take turns on the Tegallalang Rice Terraces this morning, one level at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The tropical forest behind the pool goes from bright green to dark green and back as the clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: Under grey cloud the Tegallalang Rice Terraces turn a deeper green, and every curve is easy to follow.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist hangs in the valley, and the Tegallalang Rice Terraces appear step by step with the highest ones faint.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Campuhan Ridge is not visible today; the view ends at the forest and the nearest steps of the Tegallalang Rice Terraces.
phrases.rain: In the Royal Pool Villa, guests watch the rain fall on the forest.
phrases.thunderstorm: Each flash of lightning shows the Tegallalang Rice Terraces for a second, then the valley goes dark again.
phrases.snow: From inside the Luxury Pool Villa, guests watch snow fall on the lush tropical forest.
phrases.very_cold: The Tegallalang Rice Terraces stand clear across the valley, each step easy to count.
phrases.cold: Guests in the Royal Pool Villa keep warm inside today, with the forest in view.
phrases.very_hot: The pool is the place to be today, and guests cool off there with the tropical forest in view.
phrases.warm: On the Private Deck, guests stay outside with the rainforest in view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light climbs the Tegallalang Rice Terraces level by level as the valley floor falls into shade.
phrases.partly_golden: The Private Deck looks onto a rainforest lit by the last sun between the clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: Tonight the forest seen from the Royal Pool Villa is one dark shape under the clouds.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain is heard more than seen from the Luxury Pool Villa, where the lush tropical forest has become a dark wall.
phrases.mild_night: The Tegallalang Rice Terraces are dark tonight, and only the lines of the nearest steps can still be seen.
phrases.clear_night: The pool lies still tonight under a full field of stars, with the tropical forest black behind it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Tegallalang Rice Terraces lie quiet and dark across the valley.
phrases.dusk: The line of Campuhan Ridge stays sharp against the bright sky for a few minutes while the forest below turns dark.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the dome of Florence Cathedral is a dark shape against a slowly paling sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the balcony rooms open the curtains, and the dome of Florence Cathedral is right there in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The dome of Florence Cathedral stands against a clear blue sky at midday, close enough to study in detail.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move behind Giotto's Bell Tower this morning, while sun and shade take turns on Florence Cathedral.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests sit in the reading room on the 1st floor this afternoon and watch cloud shadows cross Via dei Calzaiuoli.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the rooftops today, and the dome of Florence Cathedral is the one thing that stands out.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the dome of Florence Cathedral today, and the rooftops of the historic centre fade behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see the Bargello and the nearest rooftops clearly, while the far rooftops are not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Via dei Calzaiuoli, and guests in the reading room choose a book and the view of the wet street instead of a walk.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the rooftops, and guests in rooms facing the Bargello watch lightning flash behind the medieval building.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the small tables of the balcony rooms, and the dome of Florence Cathedral turns white directly ahead.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests stay behind the glass and look at Florence Cathedral under a sharp, clear sky.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps guests in the reading room, looking down at the pedestrian Via dei Calzaiuoli.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the dome of Florence Cathedral is bright against the sky, and guests look at it from the shade indoors.
phrases.warm: Warm light falls on Orsanmichele today, and shoppers fill Via dei Calzaiuoli.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the dome of Florence Cathedral gold, and guests stop what they are doing to look.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds glow above the rooftops of the historic centre, and Giotto's Bell Tower catches the light.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and the shop lights of Via dei Calzaiuoli brighten the view from the reading room.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain turns Via dei Calzaiuoli into a mirror for its own lights, and guests watch from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the dome of Florence Cathedral stands large above the dark rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above Florence Cathedral tonight, and guests take one more look before closing the curtains.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Via dei Calzaiuoli is empty and quiet, and the Bargello stands over the sleeping rooftops.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright behind the dome of Florence Cathedral while the first lights come on along Via dei Calzaiuoli.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Higashiyama Mountains are a dark shape above the Kamogawa River, and the clear sky is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Kamogawa River, and guests having breakfast in their rooms look across the water to the Higashiyama Mountains.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Kamogawa River shines below, and every ridge of the Higashiyama Mountains is sharp.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Higashiyama Mountains this morning, while the Kamogawa River below stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At The Lobby Lounge, afternoon tea is served with the Kamogawa River behind the glass and clouds drifting over it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Kamogawa River turns the colour of slate, and the Higashiyama Mountains are a darker green behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Higashiyama Mountains today, so the far bank of the Kamogawa River becomes the edge of the picture.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Higashiyama Mountains are not visible today; guests in The Lobby Lounge still see the Kamogawa River and its far bank.
phrases.rain: Rain draws small rings on the Kamogawa River, and the Higashiyama Mountains fade behind the falling water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Higashiyama Mountains for a second, then thunder rolls over the Kamogawa River.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Kamogawa River, and the Higashiyama Mountains are turning white little by little.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the Higashiyama Mountains look very clear, and guests enjoy the Kamogawa River from the warm side of the glass in The Lobby Lounge.
phrases.cold: In a building of only 5 storeys, guests stay close enough to the Kamogawa River to see every ripple on this cold day.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Higashiyama Mountains shimmer, and the Kamogawa River looks cool and inviting below.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the balcony suites sit outside above the Kamogawa River, with the Higashiyama Mountains in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Higashiyama Mountains gold, and the Kamogawa River carries the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Higashiyama Mountains turn pink, and guests in the Kamogawa Suite have the river below them too.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the far bank lie in broken lines on the Kamogawa River.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the Kamogawa River is heard as much as seen, and the lights across the water blur.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Higashiyama Mountains disappear into the sky, and the Kamogawa River keeps a soft shine.
phrases.clear_night: From the Tsukimi Suite, guests look for the moon above the Higashiyama Mountains; its deck was made for exactly that.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Kamogawa River is the only thing moving, flowing past a bank that Japanese nobles favoured in the 17th century.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Higashiyama Mountains, and the first lights appear along the far bank of the Kamogawa River.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky is clear and still dark before sunrise, and the Santa Monica Pier is a quiet outline on the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Orla by Michael Mina, guests look out at Santa Monica Beach and a clear blue Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_midday: The Pacific Ocean is bright blue at midday, and the Santa Monica Pier stands sharp against the clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Santa Monica Beach this morning, while the Santa Monica Pier stays in sunshine below the ocean-facing rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the 4th-floor Azure Pool, the beach below is a mix of sun and shade as clouds drift over the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns the same grey, and guests in the Titan Room find the horizon by guessing.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Pacific Ocean today, and the far end of the Santa Monica Pier fades into it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Malibu coastline is not visible today, and the Pacific Ocean ends in a pale blur a short way past the Santa Monica Pier.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Santa Monica Beach, and guests at Orla by Michael Mina watch the Pacific Ocean turn grey through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second the whole Santa Monica Pier shows from the ocean-facing rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Santa Monica Pier, and guests stand at their oceanfront windows to watch it meet the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear, and from the Santa Monica Suite the Pacific Ocean runs sharp to the horizon.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Azure Pool deck is a quiet place to look at the Pacific Ocean and Santa Monica Beach beyond the palm trees.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the water at the Azure Pool and look past the palm trees to the Pacific Ocean, which looks even cooler.
phrases.warm: Santa Monica Beach is busy with people on this warm day, and the Santa Monica Pier reaches into the Pacific Ocean beyond them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The coast turns gold in the late sun, and guests at Orla by Michael Mina put down their glasses to look at the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes in under the clouds and lights the Santa Monica Pier, seen from the fire pits beside the Azure Pool.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at dinner in Orla by Michael Mina see the Pacific Ocean go black while the Santa Monica Pier stays lit.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain is falling this evening; the lights of the Santa Monica Pier blur on the glass, and the Pacific Ocean beyond is lost in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in this 167-room resort, opened in 2024, look out tonight on a cloudy sky and the lit Santa Monica Pier.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the Pacific Ocean on this clear night, and the Santa Monica Pier is lit below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Santa Monica Pier is quiet, and the Pacific Ocean is a wide darkness with a thin white edge of surf.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still pink over the Pacific Ocean, and the first lights come on along the Santa Monica Pier.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky turns pale over the sea, and the coastline toward Praiano slowly takes shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the half-moon pool, and Praiano stands out clearly along the coast.
phrases.clear_midday: From the fitness center, guests look over a bright blue sea under a cloudless midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Mediterranean Sea this morning, while the cliffs of the Amalfi Coast stay in sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Terrace Bar, guests see Positano in patches of sun and shade as clouds cross the afternoon sky.
phrases.overcast: Under grey cloud the sea turns the colour of slate, and from the half-moon pool Praiano still shows across the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the coastline today, and from the terraces facing Positano the islands of Li Galli seem to float on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Capri is not visible today, and from the private terraces the sea fades into pale air a short way out.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the sea, and guests at Zass watch it through the windows as the coastline blurs.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the cliffs of the Amalfi Coast for a second, then the storm cloud closes over the sea again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the cliff and disappears into the grey sea far below.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, and guests in the fitness center see the sea horizon as a sharp line.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the sea is a deep blue, and the coastline toward Praiano is drawn in clean detail.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the half-moon pool and look at Praiano from the water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day guests lie by the pool and look out over the open sea to the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Terrace Bar, guests watch the low sun turn the houses of Positano gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights Capri and Li Galli, seen from the terraces facing Positano.
phrases.grey_evening: With mobile phones not allowed at Zass, dinner guests look at the cloudy evening sea and the lights along the coast instead.
phrases.wet_evening: From the Virginia Suite, guests watch evening rain fall on the sea, the lights of Praiano blurred.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and the lights of the coast curve toward Praiano above a black sea.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the sea, and the lights of Praiano are small and sharp across the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the sea below the cliff is a wide darkness, and only the line of the coast can be made out.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests at Terrace Bar see the first lights of Positano come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean is a wide dark surface under a clear sky, and the first light begins at its edge.
phrases.clear_morning: At Riviera, guests have breakfast with Fort Lauderdale Beach in front of them under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From Aqua Lounge on the 5th floor, guests see the Atlantic Ocean on one side and the marina on the other, both bright at midday.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic Ocean this morning, and the sand of Fort Lauderdale Beach turns light and dark below the 5th-floor pool deck.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the marina-view rooms watch the afternoon clouds drift over the marina channel.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns pale green, and the palm trees along Fort Lauderdale Beach stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Atlantic Ocean today, and guests on the 5th-floor pool deck see the horizon fade into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today; guests still see Fort Lauderdale Beach and the nearest water, while the far Atlantic Ocean is missing.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Fort Lauderdale Beach, and guests in the oceanfront rooms watch it through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and the open walls of Riviera frame the storm above the palm trees.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Fort Lauderdale Beach, and guests stare at white flakes landing on palm trees and sand.
phrases.very_cold: The Atlantic Ocean is a sharp blue in the freezing air, and Fort Lauderdale Beach lies empty beside it.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look from the 5th-floor pool deck at the Atlantic Ocean, and the sun loungers stay free.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the 5th-floor pool and look down at the blue umbrellas on Fort Lauderdale Beach.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, books stay closed while guests look over Fort Lauderdale Beach and the swimmers in the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Aqua Lounge, guests turn their backs on the Atlantic Ocean for once and watch the low sun turn the marina gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud over the marina, and guests in the balcony rooms on that side step outside to see it.
phrases.grey_evening: The marina lights show under a cloudy evening sky, and guests at Aqua Lounge see the Atlantic Ocean go dark on the other side.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights along Fort Lauderdale Beach blur in the wet evening, and the Atlantic Ocean behind them is black.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the lights of the marina reflect in the still water of the channel.
phrases.clear_night: From the large balcony of the Maren Suite, guests look at stars over the Atlantic Ocean on this clear night.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic Ocean is a quiet dark space beyond the sand of Fort Lauderdale Beach.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in this hotel of 141 rooms see the first lights come on along Fort Lauderdale Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: The lush tropical rainforest is still one dark shape as the first pale light shows above its treetops.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun reaches the resort's own rice fields first, then moves down into the tropical forest valley.
phrases.clear_midday: At Seneng Kitchen, guests eat lunch with a clear view of the lush tropical rainforest.
phrases.partly_morning: Over breakfast at Seneng Kitchen, guests watch the lush tropical rainforest turn bright and then dull as clouds pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the sloping rice fields and coconut groves this afternoon, while the tropical forest valley stays mostly in sun.
phrases.overcast: The tropical forest valley looks a deeper green today, with no shadows anywhere on the slope.
phrases.fog_haze: From the Family Suite, guests see the lush tropical rainforest fade into fog a few trees at a time.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the Campuhan river valley cannot be seen today; the tropical forest valley shows only its nearer trees.
phrases.rain: Rain drums on the lush tropical rainforest, and guests in the One Bedroom Pool Villa watch it come down the slope.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole tropical forest valley for a second, and guests in the Family Duplex Pool Villa wait for the thunder.
phrases.snow: Guests in the Bisma Suite stay indoors and look twice at the snow lying on the lush tropical rainforest.
phrases.very_cold: Every tree in the tropical forest valley stands out clearly today, and guests in the Family Suite admire it from indoors.
phrases.cold: Guests in the Two Bedroom Pool Villa keep their jumpers on and watch the lush tropical rainforest from inside.
phrases.very_hot: Not a leaf moves in the tropical forest valley, and guests of the One Bedroom Pool Villa stay outside only in the shade.
phrases.warm: Outside the Family Duplex Pool Villa, guests sit facing the resort's own rice fields and the lush tropical rainforest.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late golden light turns the tropical forest valley warm, with long shadows between the sloping rice fields and coconut groves.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through a gap in the clouds and lights one strip of the lush tropical rainforest.
phrases.grey_evening: At Seneng Kitchen tonight, guests eat dinner facing a lush tropical rainforest gone dark under cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner guests at Seneng Kitchen hear tonight's rain on the lush tropical rainforest more than they see it.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in the Family Suite look out at the tropical forest valley, now just a darker shape in a dark night.
phrases.clear_night: The Campuhan river valley lies black below the slope, and the tropical forest valley shows only its treetops against the night.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Two Bedroom Pool Villa are asleep, and the lush tropical rainforest outside is completely dark.
phrases.dusk: The tropical forest valley darkens from the bottom up, while the sky above it is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dolomites stand as a dark outline against a clear sky, seen from the room balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Dolomites first, and the glass front of the Sky Pool holds the whole line of peaks.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every ridge of the Dolomites is sharp, and the terrace has them all in a row.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the valley floor this morning, in plain sight through the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the gym look up from the machines as sun and shade trade places on the Dolomites.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Dolomites take the colour of the cloud, and the meadow shows through the window in the Sky Pool floor, 12 metres down.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Dolomites today, and the ridges look like layers of grey paper.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Dolomites are not visible today; from the room terraces, guests see only the nearest meadows and the pine forest.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the valley, and guests behind the glass front of the relax room at Heaven & Hell watch the Dolomites come and go.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Dolomites for a second at a time, and guests in the quiet room count the seconds to the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the meadows, and guests watch the flakes dance against their room windows while the Dolomites fade to white.
phrases.very_cold: Steam rises from the heated Sky Pool into the freezing air, and beyond its glass front the Dolomites stand sharp and clear.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests settle in at Panorama Bar and look out over the wide landscape toward the Dolomites.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, swimmers float to the far end of the Sky Pool, where only a glass front stands between them and the Dolomites.

phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the summits this evening, and guests at Panorama Bar see the Dolomites as a darker band under the grey.
phrases.wet_evening: At dinner in the restaurant, guests watch rain run down the floor-to-ceiling glass, the valley floor below lost in the wet night.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the Dolomites merge with the sky, and from the terrace only the nearest ridge can be made out.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours the valley is quiet, and the Dolomites keep their place for any guest who cannot sleep.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright behind the Dolomites, and guests at Panorama Bar watch the peaks slowly lose their colour.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens El Ángel de la Independencia today, while the Diana the Huntress Fountain stays clear directly below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far towers of the skyline are not visible today; guests on the upper floors still see El Ángel de la Independencia at close range.

phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Paseo de la Reforma, and for a second each flash of lightning shows El Ángel de la Independencia clearly.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Diana the Huntress Fountain directly below, and guests in this César Pelli tower stop to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: The cold air is very clear today, and El Ángel de la Independencia looks close enough to touch from the warm side of the glass.

phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink and purple over Paseo de la Reforma, and El Ángel de la Independencia stands in front of them.
phrases.grey_evening: At the bar, guests sit by floor-to-ceiling windows and look at the lit skyscrapers under a low evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: From the indoor pool this wet evening, guests see the city lights repeated on the shining streets below.

phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on in the Old Town below hu:goes14.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Han River is a dark band between the sleeping districts of Seoul.

phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Han River shines blue, and guests can count its bridges one by one.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Seoul skyline this morning, while the Han River stays bright between them.

phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Han River turns the colour of steel, and the Seoul skyline looks quiet around it.

phrases.reduced_visibility: The mountains are not visible today, but the Han River and the nearer part of the Seoul skyline still show clearly.

phrases.grey_evening: At Bar 81, on the 81st floor, guests hold a glass of champagne above the lit city, under a low evening sky.

phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit bridges draw bright lines across the Han River.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours Seoul is quiet, and the Han River is a wide dark path through the city.

phrases.clear_predawn: Puget Sound is quiet and grey before sunrise, and the Olympic Mountains slowly take shape under a clear sky.

phrases.clear_midday: At brunch in Six Seven Restaurant, guests look down at Puget Sound, bright blue under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Elliott Bay this morning, and the passing boats go from sunshine to shade and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lobby lounge, guests see the Olympic Mountains come and go between afternoon clouds above Puget Sound.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, Puget Sound turns the colour of steel, and the Olympic Mountains are a darker grey above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Puget Sound today, and guests watch boats appear out of it one by one, close to the pier.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Olympic Mountains are not visible today, so the view stops at the grey water of Elliott Bay and the nearest boats.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Puget Sound, and guests in the lobby lounge watch it through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole width of Elliott Bay for a second, then thunder rolls over the water.

phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Olympic Mountains stand sharp across Puget Sound, every ridge clear.

phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Six Seven Restaurant, guests look out at Puget Sound under evening cloud, with boat lights moving slowly across the dark water.

phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Puget Sound tonight, and the Olympic Mountains make a dark line below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Puget Sound is dark and almost empty, and the water moves quietly under the pier.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Olympic Mountains is still bright, and the first boat lights appear on Puget Sound.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Tagus River is still and dark, and the sky above it slowly turns from black to deep blue.
phrases.clear_morning: The Tagus River lies directly ahead of the 1st-floor river view balcony rooms, bright blue under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Tagus River is wide and blue under a clear sky, with sharp light on every small wave.

phrases.partly_afternoon: The Tagus River changes colour all afternoon, blue under the open sky and grey-green under each passing cloud.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits low over the Tagus River today, and the water fades softly into the sky with no clear edge.

phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Tagus River, and each flash of lightning shows the rough water for a second.

phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright over the Tagus River, and guests watch the first lights appear along the waterfront.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific is a wide grey surface, and the breaking waves are the first thing to show clearly.

phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pacific this morning, while the sandy shore below stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the Pacific this afternoon, and the water changes from blue to silver and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific turns the colour of steel, and the white surf stands out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Pacific today, and guests watch the nearest waves arrive out of the white one by one.

phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pacific, and guests in the Las Nubes Penthouse watch it run down every window.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific, and for a second each wave is lit white before the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Pacific, and the flakes disappear the moment they touch the grey waves.

phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit on their balconies with the Pacific surf and the beach walkers below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late in the afternoon, the low sun turns the Pacific gold across every window of the Las Nubes Penthouse.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes under the clouds and colours the breaking waves pink and orange for guests looking out to the Pacific.
