phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Ornos Bay, and guests in the sea-view suites watch the Aegean Sea turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Aegean Sea, and lightning shows Delos for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Ornos Bay, and the white flakes disappear as they touch the grey Aegean Sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and Delos looks sharp across the Aegean Sea.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep the glass doors closed and look through them at Ornos Bay and its rocky hillside.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in their private pools and look across Ornos Bay to Delos from the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests lie by the private pools, all 25 of them turned towards Delos.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests gather at Aloni Sunset Lounge while the low sun turns the Aegean Sea gold around Delos.
phrases.partly_golden: From the terrace of the Apollon Villa, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over the Aegean Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner at Pere Ubu, guests look out at the Aegean Sea, dark and calm under an evening sky full of cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Aegean Sea this evening, and guests at Pere Ubu watch it over dinner.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, a few boat lights in Ornos Bay show where the Aegean Sea begins.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Aegean Sea tonight, and Delos lies low and dark on the water below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Ornos Bay is quiet and dark, and the Aegean Sea is only a darker space beyond it.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and from the fire pit at Aloni Sunset Lounge guests look at Delos under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Kyoto Tower is a pale column across the station forecourt, and the mountain ridgelines are just showing behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Granvia Lounge on the 15th floor, guests look across the low rooftops of Kyoto to mountains sharp in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests can pick out the Yasaka Pagoda far away among the Higashiyama rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the low rooftops this morning, while Kyoto Tower stays white in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the tower view rooms, guests watch clouds drift behind Kyoto Tower and over the stacked mountain ridgelines this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Kyoto Tower stands white against a flat grey sky, and the mountains behind it turn a darker grey.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the mountains today, so Kyoto Tower has the skyline to itself.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Yasaka Pagoda and the far ridgelines are not visible today; Kyoto Tower, just across the station forecourt, is still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the tower view rooms, and guests see Kyoto Tower slightly blurred across the wet forecourt.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the mountain ridgelines for a second, then the storm closes over the rooftops of Kyoto again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the low rooftops of Kyoto, and white Kyoto Tower nearly disappears into it.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing, bright day, guests stay warm in Granvia Lounge and look over the rooftops to the clear mountain ridgelines.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the 541 rooms between the 7th and 15th floors see Kyoto as a plain of low rooftops running to the mountains.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the rooftops of Kyoto, and Kyoto Tower looks like a white lighthouse above a bright sea of low roofs.
phrases.warm: People cross the station forecourt in the warm air, and Kyoto Tower rises white above them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests return to the tower view rooms before sunset, when low golden light falls on Kyoto Tower and the ridgelines behind it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds above the mountain ridgelines, and Kyoto Tower turns from white to gold.
phrases.grey_evening: At Sky Lounge Southern Court on the 15th floor, guests have dinner while lit Kyoto Tower glows under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Cocktails at Sky Lounge Southern Court suit a wet evening, as the lights of Kyoto Tower shine through the rain on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, city lights spread across the low rooftops, and the lit deck of Kyoto Tower sits above them.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests at Sky Lounge Southern Court look across at the lit observation deck of Kyoto Tower.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the rooftops of Kyoto are quiet, and Kyoto Tower waits across the forecourt for morning.
phrases.dusk: For about thirty minutes after sunset the sky stays bright, and guests watch the observation deck of Kyoto Tower light up.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the West Bay skyline is a row of dark towers under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the West Bay skyline, and guests see every tower sharply from their floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_midday: From Sora on the 21st floor, guests look over Souq Waqif and the Corniche to the West Bay skyline under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the low roofs of Souq Waqif this morning, while the West Bay skyline stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift above the Corniche this afternoon, and the West Bay skyline changes between bright and grey as they pass.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the towers of the West Bay skyline take the same colour as the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the West Bay skyline today, and the towers look like a faint drawing behind the Corniche.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The West Bay skyline is not clear today, so guests at the window seats look at the nearer rooftops of Msheireb instead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Souq Waqif and the Corniche, and the West Bay skyline is blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the West Bay skyline, and for a second each tower shows clearly against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Souq Waqif, and guests stay at their window seats to watch the West Bay skyline fade behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and the West Bay skyline looks sharp beyond the Green Mosque and the Doha Palace.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass at Sora and look out at the Corniche and the West Bay skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the West Bay skyline shimmers above the Corniche, and guests are happy to admire it from inside.
phrases.warm: On the Sora terrace, guests sit in the warm air and look across Souq Waqif to the West Bay skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the West Bay skyline gold, and the spiral minaret of the Fanar Islamic Cultural Center glows in front of it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and one tower after another on the West Bay skyline turns orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Over dinner at Sora, guests see the lit West Bay skyline under low cloud, a good excuse to order one more dish.
phrases.wet_evening: In tonight's wet weather, the lights of the West Bay skyline run together on the glass, and the Corniche shines below.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hang above the lit West Bay skyline and catch some of its glow.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit West Bay skyline stands above the dark water of the Arabian Gulf, seen from the 21st floor.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Souq Waqif is quiet below, and guests who cannot sleep find the West Bay skyline waiting at the window.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the West Bay skyline, seen from the Sora terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky turns pale behind the San Gabriel Mountains to the east, and guests in the upper-floor rooms see the ridge appear.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the Club Lounge on the 23rd floor, guests look out over the Los Angeles landscape under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool on the 26th floor, the Downtown skyline stands sharp to the north under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Sun and cloud take turns over the city this morning, and guests on the fitness center treadmills run toward a wide spread of city rooftops.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Hollywood Hills this afternoon, while the Downtown skyline stays in sunshine for guests in the suites.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Downtown skyline turns the same grey, and the water of the rooftop pool reflects both.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Downtown skyline today, and from the 26th-floor sun deck the towers look like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The San Gabriel Mountains to the east are not visible today; from the rooftop pool, only the Downtown skyline shows clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of the upper-floor suites, and guests watch the Downtown skyline blur behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Los Angeles, and lightning shows the Downtown skyline for a second at a time through the upper-floor windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Los Angeles, and guests at the fitness center windows forget their workout to watch the city rooftops turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and the San Gabriel Mountains stand out to the east from the 26th-floor sun deck.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass of the Club Lounge and look across the wide Los Angeles landscape.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look north at the Downtown skyline shimmering in the hot air.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests at Blue Rooftop Pool Bar hold a cold cocktail and look over the Downtown skyline from the 26th-floor sun deck.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the 26th-floor jacuzzi, the glass of the Downtown skyline turns gold in the low sun.
phrases.partly_golden: At Corteza at Sendero, guests watch the clouds above the Downtown skyline turn pink in the last hour of sun.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Sendero on the 24th floor, guests see the lights of the Downtown skyline glow under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: From The Agave Library, guests watch rain fall across the city lights this evening, a good reason to stay for one more tasting.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the clouds over Los Angeles carry a soft glow from the city, and the Downtown skyline stays lit to the north.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lights of the Downtown skyline look close enough to count floor by floor from this tower of 123 guest rooms.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the streets below are quiet, and the Downtown skyline stands still against the sky to the north.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the first lights come on across the Downtown skyline while the sky above the rooftop pool is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Petronas Twin Towers are two tall grey outlines beyond the still water of the outdoor pool.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Petronas Twin Towers, seen across the lap lanes of the outdoor pool.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Petronas Twin Towers stand sharp above the city skyscrapers.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift behind the Petronas Twin Towers this morning, and both towers stay clear to see from the outdoor pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Spectacular Twin Towers rooms, guests watch cloud shadows climb the Petronas Twin Towers through the afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Petronas Twin Towers turn the same grey as the clouds above them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Petronas Twin Towers today, and their tops fade into the white sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the Petronas Twin Towers show only as outlines and the farther skyscrapers are not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the bar lounge, and the Petronas Twin Towers look blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the EWOW suite watch lightning flash behind the Petronas Twin Towers from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Kuala Lumpur, and guests at the windows watch the flakes cross the Petronas Twin Towers in disbelief.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold air, the Petronas Twin Towers stand clear against the sky, and guests look at them from behind the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the outdoor pool lies empty, and the Petronas Twin Towers stand alone above the still water.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the water of the outdoor pool and look up at the Petronas Twin Towers.
phrases.warm: Swimmers in the outdoor pool stop at the end of each lap to look at the Petronas Twin Towers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Petronas Twin Towers gold, and guests in the fitness centre watch the city skyscrapers change colour beyond the treadmills.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and one side of the Petronas Twin Towers glows orange.
phrases.grey_evening: At the outdoor pool this cloudy evening, the lit Petronas Twin Towers shine under the low sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests in the bar lounge watch the lights of the Petronas Twin Towers shine through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: From the rooftop dining terrace, guests see the lit Petronas Twin Towers through the glass panels on a mild, cloudy night.
phrases.clear_night: From the private pool of the EWOW suite on the top floor, the Petronas Twin Towers shine against a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who cannot sleep find the Petronas Twin Towers still standing outside the window.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Petronas Twin Towers.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Llandudno Bay is quiet and grey-blue, and the pier is only a thin dark shape at one side of the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights Llandudno Bay from end to end, and the pier stands clear at one side of it.
phrases.clear_midday: From the sea-view rooms, guests look across the whole width of Llandudno Bay under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Llandudno Bay this morning, and the pier goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the bay window seats follow the clouds over the promenade and Llandudno Bay this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Llandudno Bay turns the colour of slate, and the pier closes the view on one side.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over Llandudno Bay today, so the pier looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Llandudno Bay is not visible today; guests see the promenade, the beach and the nearest water.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Llandudno Bay, and guests in the sea-view rooms watch the promenade shine with water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Llandudno Bay, and guests watch the lightning above the sea from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the promenade, and Llandudno Bay looks darker behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: From the Snowdon and Mostyn Penthouse Suites, guests see Conwy Mountain and Snowdonia sharp in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this Victorian building stay inside and look out at the long curve of Llandudno Bay.
phrases.very_hot: The beach is busy in the heat, and Llandudno Bay shines so brightly that guests reach for sunglasses.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, people walk slowly along the promenade, and Llandudno Bay stays calm behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the pier golden, and the water of Llandudno Bay takes a warmer colour.
phrases.partly_golden: From the 3rd-floor dormer windows, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds above Llandudno Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the promenade lights follow the edge of Llandudno Bay, and the sea beyond them is dark.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain blurs the promenade lights along Llandudno Bay, and the sea behind them is almost black tonight.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers the night sky, and Llandudno Bay shows only where the promenade lights touch the water.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Llandudno Bay tonight, and guests count them from the bay window seats.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the promenade is empty and Llandudno Bay is a wide, quiet darkness beyond it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Llandudno Bay is still bright, and the first lights come on along the promenade.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, São Jorge Castle is a dark shape above Bairro Alto's rooftops, under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches São Jorge Castle under a clear sky, and guests on the piano nobile balcony see it in a direct line above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, São Jorge Castle stands sharp on its hill above Bairro Alto's rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Bairro Alto's rooftops this morning, and São Jorge Castle goes in and out of the sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over São Jorge Castle and its hill, one patch of blue at a time.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, São Jorge Castle and the rooftops below it take the same quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens São Jorge Castle today, and guests see its hill as a faint outline beyond the nearest rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so São Jorge Castle is difficult to make out, and the view stops at Bairro Alto's rooftops and chimneys.
phrases.rain: Rain runs off Bairro Alto's rooftops, and guests watch São Jorge Castle turn grey and blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Lisbon, and each flash of lightning shows São Jorge Castle on its hill for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Bairro Alto's rooftops, and guests look twice before they find São Jorge Castle behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, São Jorge Castle looks close enough to touch, though guests prefer to check this from indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep the balcony doors closed and look through the glass at São Jorge Castle above the rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the air trembles over Bairro Alto's rooftops, and São Jorge Castle seems to float above them.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests step out onto the main balcony of the 18th-century palace and stay there, facing São Jorge Castle.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns São Jorge Castle gold, and the Lisbon rooftops below it glow in the same warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests on the piano nobile balcony watch the clouds over São Jorge Castle turn pink.
phrases.grey_evening: This cloudy evening, city lights mark the rooftops, and guests pick out São Jorge Castle on its hill above them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the rooftops shine under the city lights, and São Jorge Castle is a blur beyond them.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of Lisbon spread below the hill of São Jorge Castle.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, São Jorge Castle stands across the rooftops from the palace that architect João Federico Ludovice built.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Bairro Alto's rooftops are quiet, and São Jorge Castle waits on its hill for morning.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on across Bairro Alto's rooftops below São Jorge Castle.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Madrid rooftops lie still under it, with no light yet on Puerta del Sol.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the Dani Brasserie rooftop, guests look over the Madrid rooftops under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The midday sky is clear, and the Madrid rooftops spread out in sharp detail below the 7th-floor terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over central Madrid this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the rooftops.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the terrace suite's private terrace, guests watch sun and cloud take turns over Puerta del Sol.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Madrid rooftops lose their colour, and the city centre spreads out in quiet tones of grey.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and the far rooftops of Madrid fade into the pale sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far edge of the city is not visible today, so guests see only the nearest Madrid rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Madrid, and guests watch the rooftops shine with water from the arched windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is passing over Madrid, and lightning shows the rooftops for a moment before the thunder follows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Puerta del Sol, and the Madrid rooftops slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and guests behind the arched windows can pick out each chimney on the Madrid rooftops.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Madrid skyline looks crisp, and most guests enjoy it from behind the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat the Madrid rooftops shimmer, and guests on the rooftop stay in the shade to look at them.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, lunch on the Dani Brasserie rooftop is slow, because the Madrid skyline keeps guests at the table.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Madrid rooftops gold, and long shadows reach towards Puerta del Sol.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Madrid turn pink and orange above the rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner on the Dani Brasserie rooftop, guests see the city lights of Madrid glow under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Madrid this evening, and the lights around Puerta del Sol blur in the rain.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of central Madrid give the low clouds a soft glow.
phrases.clear_night: The lights of the Madrid rooftops spread out below the balcony rooms under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who are still awake find Puerta del Sol quiet below their windows.
phrases.dusk: From the Dani Brasserie rooftop, designed by Martin Brudnizki, guests watch the first lights come on across Madrid under a still bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the towers of Osaka stand quiet under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Atmos Dining, guests look out over the Osaka skyline under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in C Grill, the telescopes find Osaka Castle easily, far across the city under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Osaka's rooftops this morning, and guests in the lobby stop at the curving wall of windows to follow them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Executive Lounge, guests watch sun and cloud take turns on the Osaka skyline this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Tosabori and Dojima rivers turn the colour of steel, and the elevated expressways loop between the towers.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Osaka skyline today, and the far towers fade one by one into the white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Osaka Castle and the mountains are not visible today; from C Grill, guests see the nearer towers and the two rivers.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch the Osaka skyline blur from their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Osaka skyline, and guests in the 40th-floor lobby have a wide, dry view of the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the pool windows, and swimmers watch Osaka's rooftops slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, clear day, the mountains beyond Osaka stand out sharply, and guests look at them from the warm side of their room windows.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests on the gym treadmills run towards the Osaka skyline and never get any closer.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the streets of Osaka far below, while guests swim laps in the indoor pool and look out at the towers.
phrases.warm: From the spa treatment rooms, guests see the Osaka skyline bright and sharp on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light reaches across Osaka, and through the C Grill telescopes Osaka Castle glows in the distance.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and guests in their deep round bathtubs see the towers of Osaka turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Kura, the lights of Osaka spread out under a cloudy evening sky beyond the teppanyaki counter.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests at the C Grill counter watch the lights of Osaka shine through the rain on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: From 40 Sky Bar & Lounge, guests look at a cloudy night sky that glows softly above the lights of Osaka.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests in the 164 rooms, all from the 33rd floor up, see the lights of Osaka spread to the horizon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Tosabori and Dojima rivers flow quietly past both sides of the island, far below.
phrases.dusk: The sky over Osaka is still pink and blue as the first office lights come on, and guests in the lobby watch the city change.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear over Burle Marx Park, and the tall palm trees slowly take shape as the first light arrives.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on a room balcony faces the Atlantic rainforest of Burle Marx Park, bright green in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the tall palm trees of Burle Marx Park stand over the lawns in full sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the 11 hectares of Burle Marx Park this morning, and the treetops change from dark green to light green.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Behind the arches of the outdoor pool, the forest canopy rises green under a sky of sun and passing clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the rainforest of Burle Marx Park keeps its deep green, and the palm trees stand out against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits in Burle Marx Park today; the nearest palm trees are clear, and the trees behind them fade into grey.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far trees of Burle Marx Park cannot be seen clearly today, while the gardens just below the windows are still sharp.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic rainforest of Burle Marx Park, and guests watch the leaves shine from their room windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Burle Marx Park, and each flash of lightning shows the palm trees moving in the wind.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees of Burle Marx Park, and guests in this 6-floor hotel look twice to be sure.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, bright day, guests stay indoors and look out at the empty lawns of Burle Marx Park in sharp, clear light.
phrases.cold: The outdoor pool is quiet on this cold day, and the forest canopy behind its arches moves a little in the wind.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the outdoor pool and look up at the deep shade of the forest canopy.
phrases.warm: By the outdoor pool, guests on the white loungers face a wall of green forest, and their phones stay face down.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the private terrace of the Grand Suite São Paulo, guests see the gardens directly below turn gold in the late sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the tops of the palm trees in Burle Marx Park, while the lawns are already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the rainforest of Burle Marx Park is a dark mass of trees, quiet in the middle of São Paulo.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain falls on the gardens of Burle Marx Park, and the nearest palm leaves shine wet in the light from the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the trees of Burle Marx Park are black against a slightly lighter sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above Burle Marx Park tonight, and guests in this 141-room hotel look out on the same quiet forest.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Burle Marx Park is still and without light, and guests who are awake can barely see the palm trees.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright behind the palm trees of Burle Marx Park, and the first lights come on around the gardens.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Andaman Sea is a dark sheet below the hillside, and the jungle around the villas is still black.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Andaman Sea, and the infinity pools on the hillside show the same clear blue.
phrases.clear_midday: From Chom Talay Restaurant at the top of the hill, guests look over the bright Andaman Sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the jungle hillside this morning, while the Andaman Sea beyond stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the infinity pools, white clouds can be followed as they drift over the Andaman Sea this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Andaman Sea turns silver, and the tropical hills look a deeper green.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Andaman Sea today, and the palms below the pools fade into it one by one.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon over the Andaman Sea is not visible today; guests see the jungle slope and the nearer water.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the jungle hillside, and from Chom Talay Restaurant guests see the Andaman Sea turn grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Andaman Sea, and guests in the hillside villas count the seconds to the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the tropical jungle and on the Andaman Sea below, which guests may want to photograph twice.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the Andaman Sea looks sharp and clear from Chom Talay Restaurant at the top of the hill.

phrases.very_hot: In this heat guests stay in the infinity pools, facing the Andaman Sea through the palms.

phrases.partly_golden: From Charm Thai Restaurant on the hilltop, guests see the sun drop between clouds towards the Andaman Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: Over dinner at Charm Thai Restaurant, guests look out at a cloudy evening sky above the dark Andaman Sea.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain hides the Andaman Sea; from the indoor tables at Charm Thai Restaurant guests see the wet jungle slope.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, and the Andaman Sea is only a darker band beyond the jungle.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Andaman Sea, and the jungle treetops below the hillside are black.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the 55 villas are quiet, and the Andaman Sea lies dark beyond the jungle.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays pink and orange over the Andaman Sea, and the treetops below the hill turn dark.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Aegean Sea is still and grey-blue, and Naxos is only a dark shape at the far end of it.

phrases.clear_midday: At Pool Bar, guests look over a bright blue Aegean Sea under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the scrubland this morning, while the Aegean Sea below stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Beyond the edge of the infinity pool, clouds drift over Naxos this afternoon, and patches of sun move across the Aegean Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky the Aegean Sea turns the colour of slate, and Naxos sits quietly on the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Aegean Sea today, and Naxos looks like a faint watermark where the water ends.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Naxos is not visible today; guests see the scrubland clearly and the Aegean Sea for a short distance before it fades.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the scrubland and the Aegean Sea, and guests watch it from the doors of their private terraces.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Naxos for a second across the Aegean Sea, then the storm hides the island again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the scrubland and vanishing into the grey Aegean Sea below.
phrases.very_cold: In very cold, clear air, Naxos stands sharp across the Aegean Sea, and guests admire it from indoors with a coat nearby.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, KOA / Kitchen of Aegean gives guests a wide look over the pool to the Aegean Sea and Naxos.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across the Aegean Sea to Naxos.

phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Aegean Sea and the sky share one deep grey, and guests can no longer find the horizon.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain falls over the scrubland, and guests see the Aegean Sea only as a darker band below the wet sky.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests on their private terraces look down over the scrubland to a black, quiet Aegean Sea.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Aegean Sea tonight, and guests try to find where Naxos ends and the night begins.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the scrubland is silent, and the Aegean Sea below is one wide darkness as far as Naxos.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright over the Aegean Sea, and the water at the edge of the infinity pool seems to join it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky above Manila Bay slowly turns from black to deep blue, and the water follows.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Manila Bay, and guests in the bay-side rooms see the water turn from grey to blue.
phrases.clear_midday: Manila Bay shines under a clear midday sky, and the horizon is a sharp, straight line.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Manila Bay this morning, and guests follow them over the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Tall white clouds stand over Manila Bay this afternoon, and guests watch them grow.
phrases.overcast: Under a full cover of cloud, Manila Bay is grey and calm, and The Fountain below takes the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Manila Bay today, and the water fades into a white sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon over Manila Bay is not visible today; guests see the near water and The Fountain below.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Manila Bay, and guests watch from the bay-side rooms as it marks the surface of The Fountain below.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses Manila Bay, and each flash of lightning shows the whole water for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Manila Bay, and guests stop what they are doing to watch white flakes land on the sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so Manila Bay looks sharp and bright to guests who look at it from indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Manila Bay is steel blue, and The Fountain below the private balconies looks colder still.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, Manila Bay glitters white, and guests are glad to look at it from the shade.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Manila Bay gold, and guests in this 993-room resort stop to watch.

phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, Manila Bay goes dark, and The Fountain glows blue below.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the lights of The Fountain this evening, and Manila Bay disappears in the dark behind it.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests look down at the lit jets of The Fountain, while Manila Bay stays black.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand above Manila Bay on this clear night, and The Fountain adds its own light below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Manila Bay is a wide, quiet space, and guests who cannot sleep find it calm to look at.
phrases.dusk: The sky above Manila Bay is still bright after sunset, and the lights of The Fountain begin to come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: A dark Eiffel Tower waits above the Parisian rooftops as the first pale light arrives.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of the Eiffel Tower first, then works its way down to the Parisian rooftops.
phrases.clear_midday: The Eiffel Tower rises above the Parisian rooftops in full midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests opening the curtains in the Eiffel Tower View rooms find the Eiffel Tower half in sun and half in cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Parisian rooftops turn from grey to bright and back again as clouds pass this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Parisian rooftops and the Eiffel Tower share almost the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: The Parisian rooftops fade one row after another into the haze, and the Eiffel Tower is a soft grey shape.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the outline of the Eiffel Tower shows today, and the far Parisian rooftops are not visible.
phrases.rain: From the Eiffel Tower View rooms, guests watch the rain turn the Parisian rooftops dark and shiny.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is passing over the Parisian rooftops, and guests watch the Eiffel Tower from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the Parisian rooftops, and guests stay warm inside watching the Eiffel Tower fade behind the flakes.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: The iron of the Eiffel Tower turns from brown to gold as the afternoon ends.

phrases.late_night: At this late hour, the Eiffel Tower is only a tall shadow over the sleeping Parisian rooftops.
phrases.dusk: The Parisian rooftops go dark before the sky does, and the Eiffel Tower stands sharp against the last brightness.

phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, guests see every tile of the Old Town roofline under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Old Town roofline this morning, and their shadows cross the Parroquia de San Pedro Apóstol Tower one at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and shade take turns on the Old Town roofline this afternoon, seen from the rooftop pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Old Town roofline loses its shadows, and the Parroquia de San Pedro Apóstol Tower looks closer than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Old Town roofline today, and the Parroquia de San Pedro Apóstol Tower is a pale outline above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Old Town roofline is not visible today, but guests on the rooftop still see the Parroquia de San Pedro Apóstol Tower nearby.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Old Town roofline, and the tiles around the Parroquia de San Pedro Apóstol Tower shine with water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Parroquia de San Pedro Apóstol Tower for a second, then the storm takes it back.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Old Town roofline, and guests in this 16th-century building watch the Parroquia de San Pedro Apóstol Tower turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests see the Parroquia de San Pedro Apóstol Tower in sharp detail against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the rooftop pool lies still and empty, and the Old Town roofline looks clean and sharp behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look at the Parroquia de San Pedro Apóstol Tower from the water.

phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain falls on the Old Town roofline, and the city lights shine on the wet tiles.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hang low over the Old Town roofline, and city lights colour them from below.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the Parroquia de San Pedro Apóstol Tower tonight, and the rooftop pool reflects the clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Old Town roofline is quiet, and the Parroquia de San Pedro Apóstol Tower is a dark shape above it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind the Parroquia de San Pedro Apóstol Tower, and guests in this 16th-century monument watch the first lights come on along the Old Town roofline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before the day begins, the Fountain of the Naiads and the Basilica di Santa Maria degli Angeli are dark shapes under a slowly paling sky.
phrases.clear_morning: The Basilica di Santa Maria degli Angeli stands in clear morning sun, seen from the infinity pool on the rooftop.
phrases.clear_midday: The water of the Fountain of the Naiads flashes in the middle of Piazza della Repubblica, and the Basilica di Santa Maria degli Angeli stands in full sun.
phrases.partly_morning: At Seen by Olivier, guests watch the morning clouds drift past the towers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A patch of sun travels across Piazza della Repubblica and stops for a moment on the Fountain of the Naiads.
phrases.overcast: Under grey cloud, guests look across Piazza della Repubblica to the Fountain of the Naiads, its white water easy to pick out.
phrases.fog_haze: Today's haze turns Rome's skyline pale, and the Basilica di Santa Maria degli Angeli shows in soft outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: With low visibility today, Rome's skyline is missing from the view, and the Fountain of the Naiads holds the eye instead.

phrases.thunderstorm: The storm breaks over Piazza della Repubblica, and guests indoors see the Basilica di Santa Maria degli Angeli appear with each flash of lightning.
phrases.snow: Guests stay indoors and watch the snow fall on the Fountain of the Naiads and the ancient Roman ruins.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Basilica di Santa Maria degli Angeli glows in the low golden sun, and the spray of the Fountain of the Naiads catches the same light.

phrases.grey_evening: Over dinner at Seen by Olivier, guests look out at the towers under a low evening cloud.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Basilica di Santa Maria degli Angeli is a dark outline above the quiet Piazza della Repubblica.
phrases.dusk: Lamps come on around Piazza della Repubblica while the Basilica di Santa Maria degli Angeli still stands against the last brightness of the day.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over the Atlantic Ocean turns from black to deep blue, and the horizon slowly begins to show.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests slide open the floor-to-ceiling glass doors and watch the sun climb out of the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Atlantic Ocean is bright blue all the way to a sharp horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the wide sandy beach this morning, and the Atlantic Ocean shows patches of blue and grey.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balconies, guests follow white clouds drifting out over the Atlantic Ocean this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the white surf is the brightest thing in sight.

phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Atlantic Ocean is dark, and the lights of the boardwalk draw a line along the sand.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening on the boardwalk, which shines under its lights, and the Atlantic Ocean is black beyond it.

phrases.clear_night: Stars hang over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and the horizon is hidden where dark sky meets dark water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the beach is empty and still, and only the breaking waves move on the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Atlantic Ocean is still bright, and the first lights come on along the boardwalk.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Edinburgh Castle, and the city rooftops in front of it are slowly turning white.

phrases.grey_evening: Guests at dinner in One Square look out at Edinburgh Castle, lit against a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening the lights of Edinburgh Castle blur behind the glass, and guests stay at One Square to try another of its 100 gins.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the clouds hang low over the city, and Edinburgh Castle glows under them above the lit streets.
phrases.clear_night: From the Edinburgh Grand Suite, guests see Edinburgh Castle lit on its rock under a clear night sky, with the city lights below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the streets are quiet, and guests still awake in the castle view rooms have Edinburgh Castle for company.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Edinburgh Castle and the rooftops below it.

phrases.warm: Swimmers and sunbathers fill the sandy curve of Nai Harn Beach on this warm day, seen from the private balconies above.

phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights around Nai Harn Bay show where the beach ends and the water begins.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Nai Harn Bay is still and dark, with only the sea and the hills around it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Ko Man island just after sunset, and the first lights appear along Nai Harn Bay.

phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and under the big roof of the open-air lobby guests look out at the wet pool levels and the black Caribbean beyond.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, guests on their balconies look over Mamitas Beach to the Caribbean, a shade darker than the clouds.

phrases.reduced_visibility: The far fells are not visible today; from the Cocktail Bar, guests see the gardens clearly and only the nearer water of Lake Windermere.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lake Windermere, and guests in the hotel lounge watch it sweep across the water beyond the wet gardens.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls around the fells, and lightning flashes above Lake Windermere while guests in the Lakes Terrace count the seconds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the gardens and trees, and the fells around Lake Windermere fade into white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the air is clear, and the fells stand sharp above Lake Windermere from the 12 hot tub balconies.
phrases.cold: Guests keep to the velvet chairs of the hotel lounge on this cold day and look out at the gardens and the lake.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the hot tub balconies look at Lake Windermere and wonder which water is the better idea.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the hot tub balconies watch the whole southern reach of Lake Windermere shine in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun warms the fells late this afternoon, and Lake Windermere shines below them from the Lakes Terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests in the Cocktail Bar watch the clouds turn orange above the lake and the gardens.
phrases.grey_evening: From Mizumi this cloudy evening, guests see the gardens fade and the lake become a dark shape beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: It is a wet evening over the gardens, and guests with a signature cocktail in the Cocktail Bar watch Lake Windermere darken beyond them.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, Lake Windermere is quiet and almost black, with the fells just visible above it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the fells tonight, and the clear sky leaves a faint shine on Lake Windermere.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the gardens and Lake Windermere rest in darkness, and only the outline of the fells remains.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and Lake Windermere holds its light while the gardens in front of the hotel lounge grow dim.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Arabian Gulf is a dark, flat surface beyond the Corniche, and the sky above it is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Mr. & Mrs. Hawker on the 3rd floor, guests look from the enclosed terrace to the Arabian Gulf under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Arabian Gulf is turquoise at midday, and the sea-view rooms have it in their floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Arabian Gulf this morning, while the Corniche stays in bright sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Above the rooftop pool, the glass towers of West Bay catch the clouds passing this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Arabian Gulf turns the colour of steel, and the Corniche is easy to follow along its edge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the towers of West Bay today, and the Arabian Gulf fades into the sky with no clear horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Corniche is clear from the sea-view rooms, but the Arabian Gulf disappears a short way out.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the enclosed terrace at Mr. & Mrs. Hawker, and guests watch the city towers turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Arabian Gulf for a second at a time, and guests in the sea-view suites count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Corniche, and guests on the enclosed terrace of Mr. & Mrs. Hawker watch in surprise as it meets the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.very_cold: The cold air is very clear today, and every tower of West Bay has sharp edges against the sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests sit on the enclosed terrace of Mr. & Mrs. Hawker and look out at the city and the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look up at the towers of West Bay shining above them.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests rest by the rooftop pool with the glass towers of West Bay rising beside it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the towers of West Bay gold, and the Arabian Gulf below them is a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Arabian Gulf turn orange, and guests across the 26 floors stop to look.
phrases.grey_evening: At Mumble Jungle on the rooftop, guests sit with the lights of the West Bay skyline glowing under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Corniche stretch into long reflections, and guests watch them from the dry side of the glass at Mr. & Mrs. Hawker.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lit towers of West Bay surround Mumble Jungle, where the jazz has competition.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lights of the Corniche draw the edge of the Arabian Gulf, and the water beyond is black.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Arabian Gulf and the sky are the same deep colour, and the Corniche lies still between the city and the water.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Corniche and in the towers of West Bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Twelve Apostles are a dark shape above Camps Bay, and the Atlantic is still grey below them.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun rises over the mountains, and from the pool deck guests watch the light reach the Atlantic.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear sky, the Atlantic is deep blue in front of Camps Bay, and Lion's Head stands sharp above it.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests on the balconies watch cloud shadows move across the Twelve Apostles this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Lion's Head this afternoon, while the infinity pool and the Atlantic beyond it stay in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic takes the same colour, and the rollers break white on the beach at Camps Bay.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Camps Bay today, and the Twelve Apostles look like a pencil drawing behind the beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Twelve Apostles are not visible today; from the pool deck, guests see the beach and the first waves of the Atlantic.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Camps Bay; guests in the sea-facing rooms watch it cross the Atlantic towards the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Twelve Apostles for a second, then the storm takes them back.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Camps Bay, and guests watch the flakes disappear into the Atlantic rollers.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and guests can try to count all of the Twelve Apostles behind the empty beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Lion's Head stands clear above Camps Bay, and the Atlantic rollers come in with white tops.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look over its edge at the beach and the Atlantic.
phrases.warm: Camps Bay is full of beach towels today, and guests on the pool deck look at the Atlantic between two pages of a book.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the Twelve Apostles gold, and guests watch from their balconies above Camps Bay.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Lion's Head turn pink, and the Atlantic turns the colour of copper.
phrases.grey_evening: Under the evening cloud, the lights of Camps Bay shine along the shore, and the Atlantic is black beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass of this hotel of 17 rooms tonight, and the lights of Camps Bay blur behind it.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and guests in the sea-facing rooms can still see the white foam of the Atlantic rollers.
phrases.clear_night: Stars sit above Lion's Head tonight, and the lights of Camps Bay follow the curve of the beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Camps Bay is quiet, and the Atlantic keeps rolling in below the Twelve Apostles.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Atlantic, and the first lights come on along Camps Bay below Lion's Head.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky over Copenhagen Harbour slowly grows pale, and Nyhavn Canal waits for its first boat.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lands on Nyhavn Canal, and guests in the canal-facing rooms see the painted townhouse facades light up across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the painted facades along Nyhavn Canal show every colour, each one repeated in the water below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Copenhagen Harbour this morning, and patches of sun move across the water towards Nyhavn Canal.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow the canal tour boats this afternoon as they leave Nyhavn Canal under a sky of sun and cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Nyhavn Canal turns the colour of slate, so the painted townhouse facades do all the colour work today.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Copenhagen Harbour, and guests see the Inner Harbour Bridge fade halfway across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Copenhagen Harbour is not visible today; guests still see Nyhavn Canal and the moored boats below clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Nyhavn Canal; guests watch from the suites facing the water as the drops break up the reflections of the painted facades.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Copenhagen Harbour, and each flash of lightning shows the Inner Harbour Bridge for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Nyhavn Canal, settling on the decks of the tied fishing boats and blurring the painted facades.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests in this 1805 warehouse stay behind the glass and look at Nyhavn Canal shining in the clear light.
phrases.cold: The air is cold over Nyhavn Canal, and the tied fishing boats sit quietly in front of the townhouse facades.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests look down on a busy quay, where people sit in the sun along Nyhavn Canal.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, boat traffic keeps Nyhavn Canal moving, and guests count the canal tour boats from the harbour-view rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the painted facades of Nyhavn Canal, and the water below carries the same gold.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests see the clouds over Copenhagen Harbour turn pink above the Inner Harbour Bridge.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening of cloud, the lights of the quay lie in long reflections on Nyhavn Canal as the boat traffic ends.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the quay lights of Nyhavn Canal blur through the drops on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the sky stays cloudy, and Nyhavn Canal is calm enough to hold the lit townhouse facades upside down.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests look across Copenhagen Harbour, where the lights of the far shore sit on black water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Nyhavn Canal is quiet at last; the fishing boats barely move on the water.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over Nyhavn Canal, and guests watch the first lamps come on along the quay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dallas skyline is a group of dark towers under a clear sky, seen from the private balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun reaches the Dallas skyline, and guests in the balcony rooms step outside to look at it.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, the Dallas skyline stands sharp against a clear blue sky at midday.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Dallas skyline this morning, and the rooftop pool deck is the place to follow them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the cabanas on the rooftop terrace, guests see the Dallas skyline turn bright, then dull, as clouds pass this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the Dallas skyline today, and the glass towers take the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Dallas skyline today, and from the rooftop pool the towers look like a faded photograph.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so only the nearer Uptown buildings and the treetops are plain to see from the fitness centre windows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the corner suite, and the Dallas skyline behind it is blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Dallas skyline, and guests watch the storm from indoors, at the fitness centre windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Uptown, and the Dallas high-rises show faintly through it from the fitness centre windows.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the Dallas skyline looks very sharp, and guests admire it through the glass rather than from the balcony.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests on the treadmills look out over the treetops to the Dallas high-rises.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look across the water at the Dallas skyline.
phrases.warm: On the white loungers by the rooftop pool, books stay closed while guests look at the Dallas skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the Dallas skyline gold, and the rooftop pool deck catches the same warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests on the rooftop terrace see the clouds above the Dallas skyline turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit Dallas skyline glows behind the glass railing of the rooftop terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the Dallas skyline shine through the wet evening, and guests look at them from the dry side of the window.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, low clouds hang above the lit Dallas skyline, seen from the hot tub deck.
phrases.clear_night: From the private balconies, guests see the lit Dallas skyline under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the rooftop terrace is empty, and the Dallas skyline stands still beyond the glass railing.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still deep blue above the rooftop terrace, and the first lights come on across the Dallas skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the North Shore Mountains are a dark outline above the downtown towers, and the sky behind them slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the 2nd-floor restaurant, guests look through floor-to-ceiling windows at the downtown street in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The North Shore Mountains stand sharp beyond the downtown grid under a blue midday sky, and guests in mountain view rooms can follow every ridge.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit on the tops of the North Shore Mountains this morning, while the downtown towers below the Regency Club lounge catch the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows slide across the glass of the downtown towers this afternoon, seen from beside the 4th-floor outdoor pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the North Shore Mountains turn the same flat colour as the downtown towers in front of them.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken the North Shore Mountains today, so guests in the Regency Club lounge look at downtown towers that fade out floor by floor.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The North Shore Mountains cannot be seen today; from the city view rooms, the view ends at the nearest downtown towers.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the downtown towers, and guests in the fitness center watch it between exercises.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the North Shore Mountains for a second at a time, and guests in the Presidential Suite watch the storm cross the harbor to the north.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling between the downtown towers and landing around the 4th-floor outdoor pool, while the North Shore Mountains are hidden behind white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, every downtown tower looks sharp from the Regency Club lounge, a good reason to stay indoors.

phrases.very_hot: In the heat, swimmers in the 4th-floor outdoor pool look up at the downtown towers and are in no hurry to get out.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit out on their balconies and look across the downtown towers to the North Shore Mountains.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the downtown towers gold, and the North Shore Mountains behind them take a warm colour too.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the North Shore Mountains turn pink and orange, and the downtown grid below is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in the restaurant, guests look out at the lit downtown buildings under a low, cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the downtown towers this evening, and the North Shore Mountains are lost somewhere behind the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the lit downtown towers give guests in this hotel of 644 rooms plenty to look at.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the North Shore Mountains are a black shape under the stars, with the lights of downtown spread out in front.
phrases.late_night: Guests who cannot sleep find the 24-hour fitness center open and the downtown towers standing quiet outside.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the first lights come on in the downtown towers, and the North Shore Mountains darken against a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Empire State Building stands unlit against a clear sky, tall in the Empire view rooms' floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_morning: The Empire State Building catches the clear morning light, and the Midtown skyline around it is sharp in every detail.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Empire State Building stands sharp against the blue sky, close above the open terrace of Spyglass Rooftop Bar.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift behind the Empire State Building this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the Midtown skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Spyglass Rooftop Bar on the 22nd floor, guests watch sun and cloud take turns on the Chrysler Building.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Empire State Building turns the same grey, every setback still clear from the rooftop.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Empire State Building today, so guests at the rooftop count only the lower floors.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far Midtown skyline is not visible today, but the Empire State Building is near enough to stay in sight.

phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Midtown skyline, and guests watch the storm pass the Empire State Building from behind floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the windows of the Empire view rooms, and the Empire State Building fades to a soft grey outline.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and the Empire State Building shows every line to guests behind the rooftop's glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day guests keep to the covered side of the rooftop, and the Chrysler Building is still in sight.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the rooftop terrace look for shade, and the Empire State Building shimmers above the hot streets.
phrases.warm: On a warm day guests sit out on the terrace of Spyglass Rooftop Bar, facing the Empire State Building.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Empire State Building gold, and guests at Spyglass Rooftop Bar put down their cocktails to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the Chrysler Building, and guests at the rooftop watch it fade.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Empire State Building glows above the rooftop, so close that guests feel they could touch it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the Empire State Building's lights blur in the rain beyond the covered rooftop.
phrases.mild_night: The Empire State Building glows under a cloudy night sky, a night light for guests in the Empire view rooms.
phrases.clear_night: The Empire State Building shines against a clear night sky, seen from a rooftop 22 floors above Midtown.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Midtown skyline is quiet, and the Empire State Building rises as a tall dark shape.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on up the Empire State Building, seen from Spyglass Rooftop Bar.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Michigan is a dark, flat line beyond the sleeping city.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Infinity Suite, guests open the curtains to a city already bright in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The Chicago River shines between the towers under a midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Lake Michigan changes colour every few minutes this morning as clouds pass over it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and shade take turns on the Chicago River this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Lake Michigan lies grey and calm today under a sky of the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Lake Michigan today, and only the water close to the shore can be seen.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Lake Michigan fades out early today, but the Chicago River below is still plain to see.

phrases.thunderstorm: From the Regent Suite, guests watch lightning flash above the city.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Chicago River, and the skyline behind it looks pale.
phrases.very_cold: Lake Michigan looks like steel today, and guests are happy to admire it from indoors.
phrases.cold: Guests stay indoors today and still see the Chicago River, Lake Michigan and the skyline around them.
phrases.very_hot: On a day this hot, guests keep looking at Lake Michigan and its cool blue water.
phrases.warm: The Chicago River slides past in bright light, with the skyline standing sharp behind it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the Regent Suite, guests see the city turn gold one building at a time.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds over Lake Michigan catch the last pink light as the day ends.
phrases.grey_evening: City lights lie on the Chicago River tonight under a low ceiling of cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Infinity Suite look out at a wet city, its lights blurred by the evening rain.
phrases.mild_night: Lake Michigan is a wide dark space tonight, with the lit city stopping at its edge.
phrases.clear_night: Skyline lights lie on the Chicago River tonight, sharp in the clear air.
phrases.late_night: Guests still awake at this hour see the Chicago River lying dark and quiet.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, Lake Michigan darkens first while the skyline switches on its lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide, quiet surface under a clear sky, seen from the private balconies.

phrases.clear_midday: The Pacific Ocean is bright blue at midday, and every seat at Splashes Bar looks straight at it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Pacific Ocean this morning, and their shadows cross the water in slow patches.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Lobby Lounge follow the Southern California coastline as sun and cloud take turns on the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pacific Ocean turns grey too, and only the white surf shows where the beach begins.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so from Bella Vista Terrace the Pacific Ocean seems to end early.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far coastline is not visible today; guests see the sand and the first few lines of waves.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Pacific Ocean, and guests at Splashes watch the drops mark the water just below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Pacific Ocean for a second, and guests behind their glass doors wait for the next flash.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sand, and guests watch the flakes disappear the moment they touch the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and the Pacific Ocean shows a sharp, bright horizon from the Lobby Lounge.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 167-room resort keep their coffee warm and their eyes on the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_hot: By the pool, guests in the shade of the cabanas look out at a calm Pacific Ocean in the heat.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the pool deck look across the sand to the turquoise water of the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Splashes Bar, guests see the afternoon light turn golden over the Pacific Ocean, and conversations grow slower.
phrases.partly_golden: The low sun colours the clouds orange and pink, and the Pacific Ocean copies them below Bella Vista Terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening is cloudy and the Pacific Ocean is nearly black beyond the fire pits of Bella Vista Terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests at dinner in Splashes look through wet glass at a dark Pacific Ocean while the rain keeps falling.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, and from the balconies the Pacific Ocean is known mostly by its white surf.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Pacific Ocean, and guests on Bella Vista Terrace look up as often as out.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pacific Ocean is black and wide, and the horizon is lost where water meets sky.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and the sky over the Pacific Ocean stays bright from the Lobby Lounge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lumpini Park is a wide patch of darkness below the room windows, and the clear sky above it is just starting to pale.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests taking afternoon tea in the 39th-floor Club lounge look out at the Bangkok skyline, half in sun and half under cloud.
phrases.overcast: The sky is flat and grey today, yet Lumpini Park keeps its green and fills the six-metre windows designed by André Fu Studio.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over Bangkok today, so from Spire Rooftop Bar the towers fade one row after another above the soft green of Lumpini Park.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far skyline is not visible from the infinity pool today; the view stops at the trees of Lumpini Park and the nearest towers.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lumpini Park, and guests watch it from the window daybeds as the tree canopy turns a deeper green.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Bangkok skyline, and guests at 1970 Bar watch the storm from behind floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Lumpini Park, and nobody in the 39th-floor Club lounge is looking at anything except the tree canopy turning white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold today, and from Spire Rooftop Bar the Bangkok skyline stands sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass of the 39th-floor Club lounge and look down at the treetops of Lumpini Park.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the infinity pool and look across at the trees of Lumpini Park.
phrases.warm: A warm day brings guests to the loungers by the infinity pool, where the tree canopy of Lumpini Park spreads out beyond the water's edge.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the terrace of the 39th-floor Club lounge, the low sun turns the glass towers beyond Lumpini Park gold.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Lumpini Park turn orange, and the window daybeds are the seats to have.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights give the sky a soft glow, and guests at 1970 Bar look out at the lit Bangkok skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Bangkok skyline blur on the glass of the 39th-floor Club lounge, where guests sit over evening cocktails.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Porto Cathedral is a dark shape above the city, and the clear sky over the rooftops slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the tiled façade of the Church of Saint Ildefonso, and from the top-floor balconies guests see its pattern clearly.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in A Brasileira Bistrô, the arched windows show a tree-lined street in full sun under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the city rooftops this morning, and Porto Cathedral goes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests look across the city this afternoon as clouds drift over Porto Cathedral, leaving the Church of Saint Ildefonso in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the tiled façade of the Church of Saint Ildefonso keeps its colour while the rooftops around it take the grey of the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies over the city today, and guests wait for Porto Cathedral to appear and disappear again in the white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the tiled façade of the Church of Saint Ildefonso is still easy to find, but the far rooftops of the city cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the city, and guests in the rooms facing Porto Cathedral watch it through wet glass, the stone darker than usual.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city, and each flash of lightning shows Porto Cathedral for a second before the sky closes again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the city, and guests look out in surprise as the rooftops around the Church of Saint Ildefonso turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and Porto Cathedral stands sharp against the sky, every edge of it easy to follow.
phrases.cold: Cold air sits over the city today, and guests in this hotel of 89 rooms admire the tiled façade of the Church of Saint Ildefonso from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the city rooftops, and guests step onto the top-floor balconies only briefly to look at Porto Cathedral.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests stand on the top-floor balconies with Porto Cathedral and the Church of Saint Ildefonso side by side before them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the stone of Porto Cathedral gold, and the city rooftops around it glow in the same warm colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the city turn pink, and guests watch the light leave the Church of Saint Ildefonso tile by tile.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in A Brasileira Bistrô, guests look through the arched windows at the tree-lined street, its trees dim under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and guests watch the lights of the city blur on the glass, with Porto Cathedral somewhere behind them.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds carry the glow of the city lights, and guests can still find the Church of Saint Ildefonso among the rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show over the city tonight, and Porto Cathedral stands among a wide field of lights.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and any guest still awake has Porto Cathedral and the sleeping rooftops all to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the city under the outline of Porto Cathedral.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the clear sky slowly turns pale above the Dom Luís I Bridge, and the Douro River is still dark beneath it.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Renata, guests see the Ribeira District in clear morning light across the Douro River.
phrases.clear_midday: The Dom Luís I Bridge stands sharp against a blue midday sky, and guests in the river-view rooms can follow it from one bank of the Douro River to the other.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Ribeira District this morning, while the Douro River below stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Roxo, guests look over Porto and Gaia as clouds and sun take turns above the Douro River.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Dom Luís I Bridge and the Arrábida Bridge stand out clearly over the Douro River.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Douro River today, and the Dom Luís I Bridge seems to start on one bank and end in nothing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Arrábida Bridge and the far Porto skyline are not visible today; the Douro River and the nearest part of the Ribeira District still are.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Douro River; guests watch it from the floor-to-ceiling windows of Renata, the Ribeira District slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Dom Luís I Bridge for a second at a time, and guests in the Signature Suite watch the storm cross the Douro River.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Ribeira District, and guests in the balcony rooms watch the flakes disappear into the Douro River.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and from Roxo guests see the Porto skyline in fine detail above the Douro River.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Pool Terrace is quiet, yet it still looks over the Douro River to Serra do Pilar.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests at the rooftop pool stay in the water and look across at the rooftops of Porto under a bright sky.
phrases.warm: On the Pool Terrace, cocktails arrive and guests forget them for a while, looking at the Douro River and Serra do Pilar.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Ribeira District gold, and the Douro River below it takes the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between clouds and lights Serra do Pilar and the Douro River in patches, seen from the Pool Terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: In the Renata dining room designed by Nini Andrade Silva, guests at dinner look across the Douro River to the lit Ribeira District under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: From Roxo this wet evening, the lights of Porto and Gaia shine through the rain, and the Douro River between them is black.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hold the glow of the city tonight, and the lit Dom Luís I Bridge stands bright above the Douro River.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in this hotel of 119 rooms see the lit Ribeira District doubled in the Douro River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Ribeira District across the Douro River is asleep, which is rare enough to be worth a look from the terrace rooms.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on along the Ribeira District and the Dom Luís I Bridge.
