phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Garda lies still and grey-blue below the balcony rooms, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: On the breakfast terrace, guests watch the morning sun draw its first reflections on Lake Garda.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the outdoor pool and Lake Garda share one blue, and the edge between them is not easy to find.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Lake Garda this morning, while the terrace of Osteria Il Pescatore stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lakeside lawn, guests follow the clouds as they move over Lake Garda and the mountains this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Lake Garda takes the same colour, and the headland is a darker shape across the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Lake Garda today, and the lakeside village beyond the palm trees looks like a pencil sketch.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The small island on the horizon is not visible today; from the balcony rooms, Lake Garda simply fades into pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lake Garda, and guests watch it from the Winter Garden on the Lake at Aqva Spa.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Lake Garda, and lightning flashes on the dark water beyond the park.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the park, and Lake Garda shows grey and quiet beyond the white stone balustrade.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and the mountains stand sharp above Lake Garda beyond the windows of Aqva Spa.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Lake Garda is steel blue behind the stone balustrade, and the lakeside lawn is empty.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool, with Lake Garda shining just beyond its edge.
phrases.warm: At La Terrazza, guests sit over cool drinks on this warm day, with the water of Lake Garda bright beside them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls across the lakeside lawn, and Lake Garda turns warm and bright beyond the cream umbrellas.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds turn pink above Lake Garda, and the outdoor pool takes the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, Lake Garda lies black beside the terrace of Osteria Il Pescatore, where dinner is served.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests at Bistrò 1888 catch glimpses of Lake Garda, dark behind the rain in the garden.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in this 1888 hotel step onto their balconies in the mild night air, with Lake Garda dark under the clouds.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, Lake Garda is dark and calm in front of the park, and stars show above the mountains.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Garda is a wide, quiet darkness at the foot of the park.
phrases.dusk: Guests in the new lake-view suites, opened in 2025, see the sky still bright over Lake Garda as the first lights come on in the lakeside village.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale above the Serra de Sintra, and Pena Palace waits for the first light on its hilltop.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Pena Palace on its hilltop first, while the lawns below are still in shade.
phrases.clear_midday: From the balcony of the Royal Suite, guests see the Moorish Castle and Pena Palace under the same clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Serra de Sintra this morning, while Pena Palace stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the suites facing the Sintra valley follow the clouds all the way to the Atlantic Ocean this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the forest of the Serra de Sintra looks greener, and Pena Palace keeps its place on the hilltop.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Serra de Sintra today, and Pena Palace appears and disappears above the cypress trees.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Pena Palace is only a faint outline today, and the Atlantic Ocean beyond the Sintra valley is not visible at all.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the lawns and the cypress trees, and guests look for Pena Palace through it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls around the Serra de Sintra, and each flash of lightning shows Pena Palace on its hilltop for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Serra de Sintra, and guests in this 1787 palace watch the lawns turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and the Moorish Castle shows sharply from the balcony of the Royal Suite.
phrases.cold: The cold keeps the lawns empty today, and Pena Palace stands clear above the forested hills.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests keep to the shade near the cypress trees and look up at Pena Palace from there.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit on the lawns facing the Serra de Sintra, and nobody hurries to leave.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Pena Palace gold, and from the Royal Suite balcony the Moorish Castle catches the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the Serra de Sintra one slope at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and the Serra de Sintra is a dark mass above the gardens.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain keeps falling this evening on the gardens, and the Serra de Sintra holds the low cloud on its slopes.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests can just make out the top of the Serra de Sintra over the trees.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Serra de Sintra, and guests try to find the hilltop of Pena Palace below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the gardens are silent, and the Serra de Sintra and the sky are almost the same black.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and Pena Palace stands out against it above the darkening forest.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide grey surface under a clear sky, and the first light shows the line of the coast.
phrases.clear_morning: The Pacific Ocean is bright blue this morning, and from the oceanfront rooms guests can follow the coastline to the north.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Pacific Ocean fills the horizon from the SeaMist terrace, with nothing between the white deck chairs and the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Pacific Ocean this morning, and Pismo Pier stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the four terraces, guests watch the afternoon clouds drift over the Pacific Ocean and the sun come back between them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the waves draw white lines along the shore.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Pacific Ocean today, and from the balcony rooms Pismo Pier fades away halfway along its length.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far coastline is not visible today; guests see the nearest waves of the Pacific Ocean and a short stretch of sand.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pacific Ocean, and guests watch from their balconies as the water and the sky become the same grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the Pacific Ocean, and each flash of lightning shows the waves for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Pacific Ocean, and the flakes vanish as they touch the waves.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, and the Pacific Ocean shows a sharp horizon to guests who stay behind the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Pacific Ocean looks darker, and guests in the bay window seats watch the waves from the warm side.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the heated pool and look across the water to the Pacific Ocean beyond the palm trees.
phrases.warm: Guests lie by the pool on this warm day, and the Pacific Ocean behind it makes a second, much larger blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the white deck chairs on the SeaMist terrace, guests watch the sun go down towards the Pacific Ocean in a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange over the Pacific Ocean, and guests on the SeaMist terrace turn their chairs towards it.
phrases.grey_evening: Under the evening clouds the Pacific Ocean is a dark surface, and from every terrace guests can still see the white waves reach the sand.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain hides the Pacific Ocean this evening, and guests see only the nearest white waves from their patios.
phrases.mild_night: After more than 60 years on this bluff, the night view is still simple: clouds above, the Pacific Ocean below.
phrases.clear_night: Stars come out over the Pacific Ocean tonight, and guests by the firepit on the SeaMist terrace look up more than they talk.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pacific Ocean is a wide black space, and only the white of the breaking waves shows where it begins.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays bright over the Pacific Ocean for a few minutes after sunset, and the firepit on the SeaMist terrace begins to glow.

phrases.clear_predawn: Palm Jumeirah lies dark on the water before sunrise, its shape just showing as the sky turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests see every frond of Palm Jumeirah sharp in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Dubai Marina stands clear from top to bottom, each tower easy to pick out against the blue.
phrases.partly_morning: This morning the clouds leave some fronds of Palm Jumeirah in shade and others in full sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross Dubai Marina, and guests watch the towers go from bright to shaded and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under the cloud, Palm Jumeirah still shows its full shape, a dark palm tree lying on a grey sea.
phrases.fog_haze: The far end of Palm Jumeirah fades into the haze today, so the island seems to stop halfway out to sea.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the nearer towers of Dubai Marina show today; Palm Jumeirah is a faint outline and the horizon is not visible at all.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Dubai Marina, and guests watch the towers turn grey and blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Each flash of lightning shows the towers of Dubai Marina for a second, then the storm hides them again.
phrases.snow: Through the falling snow, guests indoors can only just make out the shape of Palm Jumeirah.
phrases.very_cold: Palm Jumeirah looks sharp in the freezing air, and guests admire it from behind the glass.
phrases.cold: From indoors, guests take their time over Dubai Marina, tower by tower.
phrases.very_hot: Heat makes the towers of Dubai Marina shimmer, and the water below them looks very inviting.
phrases.warm: The long curve of Palm Jumeirah leads guests' eyes out to sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun paints Palm Jumeirah gold, and the sea around it turns to copper.
phrases.partly_golden: The Dubai Marina towers catch orange light on one side, and the clouds above them catch the rest.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests at dinner look out at the lit towers of Dubai Marina, their tops close under tonight's cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of Palm Jumeirah tonight, and guests see them as soft dots on the dark sea.
phrases.mild_night: The lights of Palm Jumeirah trace the island's shape on the black water under tonight's cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Before bed, guests take one more look at the lit towers of Dubai Marina.
phrases.late_night: Guests who cannot sleep find Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah both in view, side by side in the night.
phrases.dusk: Dubai Marina switches on window by window while the sky behind it is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Eye stands dark and still before sunrise, with the sky slowly turning pale around it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the towers of the City skyline, and each one stands out clearly.
phrases.clear_midday: Each capsule of the Eye shows clearly now, slowly climbing and coming down again.
phrases.partly_morning: In the Suite Sky View rooms, guests wake to a city half in sun and half in cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and shade take turns on the City skyline while the Eye keeps turning.
phrases.overcast: The City skyline keeps its outline in flat, even light, every tower the same quiet grey.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze makes the City skyline pale today, and the towers farther away are difficult to see.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the Junior Suite Sky View rooms, guests see the nearer parts of the city today, but the far skyline is not visible.
phrases.rain: The Eye turns on through the rain, its capsules blurred and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the City skyline, and for a moment every tower is easy to see.
phrases.snow: Guests in the Suite Sky View rooms stay warm inside and watch snow settle over the city, roof by roof.
phrases.very_hot: The towers of the City skyline look soft in the heat today.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the City skyline to gold, tower after tower.
phrases.partly_golden: The Eye glows in the last sun between long bars of cloud.
phrases.grey_evening: At Waterloo Sky Bar, evening guests have the lit skyline spread out below a low cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: In the Suite Sky View rooms, guests watch the city lights blur into soft colours behind tonight's rain.
phrases.mild_night: The skyline glows under low cloud, and nobody at Waterloo Sky Bar seems in a hurry to leave.
phrases.clear_night: The City skyline is lit window by window tonight, and the Eye adds one bright ring.
phrases.late_night: Guests still awake in the Junior Suite Sky View rooms have the sleeping city to themselves.
phrases.dusk: One by one the windows of the City skyline switch on, while the Eye starts to glow against a still bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Victoria Harbour lies quiet under a clear sky, and the towers of Hong Kong Island wait for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Victoria Harbour, and guests in the harbour-view rooms open the curtains to the Hong Kong Island skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, Victoria Harbour is deep blue, and each skyscraper on the far shore is easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Victoria Harbour this morning, and swimmers in the pool watch them between laps.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From a treatment room at The Peninsula Spa, guests see sun and cloud take turns over Victoria Harbour this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Victoria Harbour turns the colour of steel, and the skyscrapers across the water stand plainly against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits on Victoria Harbour today, and from the Peninsula Suite terrace the skyline across the water looks like a faded photograph.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the near water of Victoria Harbour is clear from the pool, but the skyscrapers on the far side cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Victoria Harbour, and guests in the indoor pool watch it and get wet only by choice.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Victoria Harbour, and the skyline of Hong Kong Island appears and disappears behind the storm rain.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Victoria Harbour, and guests in the harbour-view treatment rooms of The Peninsula Spa watch the flakes disappear into the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and from the warm side of the floor-to-ceiling glass in the Peninsula Suite, Victoria Harbour looks sharp and blue.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the pool terrace stays empty, yet Victoria Harbour is in full sight from the pool inside.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests step out to the pool terrace for a few minutes, look at the glare on Victoria Harbour, and go back to the water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests rest on the pool terrace and look over Victoria Harbour to the Hong Kong Island skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Victoria Harbour gold, a sight that guests here have watched since 1928.
phrases.partly_golden: At Felix, the last sun comes through broken cloud and lights Victoria Harbour in patches.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, dinner at Felix has the lit skyline and Victoria Harbour for company, in a room designed by Philippe Starck.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the tall windows at Felix this evening, and the lights across Victoria Harbour blur into soft colours.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the neon of the city reflects on Victoria Harbour, and guests in the harbour-view rooms leave the curtains open.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests at Felix look across Victoria Harbour to the lit skyscrapers, and the menus have to wait.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Victoria Harbour is calm, a wide stretch of quiet water between the hotel and the sleeping city.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from Felix the first lights come on along the Hong Kong Island skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Mekong River is only just visible beyond the rooftops, and the sky above it starts to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun rises beyond the Mekong River, and guests in the river-facing rooms see the water shine across the full width of the window.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Mekong River runs across the whole horizon of Phnom Penh, seen from Sora's terrace on the 37th floor.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly over the rooftops of Phnom Penh this morning, while the Mekong River stays bright behind them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the gym's rowing machines row towards the city skyline all afternoon, and the clouds above it move faster than they do.
phrases.overcast: The sky is grey from edge to edge today, and from the private dining suites the Mekong River is a quiet silver strip beyond the rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over Phnom Penh today, and the far bank of the Mekong River fades into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From Sora's terrace the Mekong River cannot be seen today; only the nearer streets and rooftops of Phnom Penh are clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the indoor pool, and swimmers see the city blurred beyond the tall windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Mekong River, and guests in the corner suites watch the storm cross the city from behind floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Phnom Penh, and from 188 metres up guests watch the flakes drift down towards the Mekong River.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, and from the Mekong Suites the Mekong River shows sharp and bright beyond the rooftops.
phrases.cold: Sora's terrace is cold and quiet today, and beyond its edge the Mekong River lies broad and calm.
phrases.very_hot: The heat makes the rooftops shimmer, and guests cool off in the indoor pool with the city spread out beyond the glass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day guests stand at the edge of Sora's terrace and follow the Mekong River from one side of the horizon to the other.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the rooftops of Phnom Penh gold, and the Mekong River beyond them catches the same warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun the clouds over the Mekong River turn pink, and guests at Sora forget their cocktails for a moment.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in Whisky Library look out at the lit skyline of Phnom Penh, a glass of single malt in hand.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the city this evening, and from the private dining suites the lights along the Mekong River blur on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of Phnom Penh glow below the clouds as far as the Mekong River.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests in the corner suites see the city lights stop at the edge of the Mekong River, where the water makes a wide dark band.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and the Mekong River is a wide, silent space beyond the rooftops.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights of Phnom Penh come on in front of the Mekong River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Dolomites are a jagged outline far down the Pustertal, under a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the ridges of the Dolomites first, and guests watch it arrive from their balconies.
phrases.clear_midday: From the outdoor infinity pool, the Dolomites stand sharp on the horizon under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move along the Pustertal this morning, while the Dolomites stay in sunshine at the far end.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the adults-only rooftop pool, guests see the Pustertal open below and clouds drift across the Dolomites.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pustertal loses some colour, and guests can still follow the jagged ridges of the Dolomites on the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Pustertal today, and the Dolomites are only a faint outline far down the valley.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Dolomites are not visible today; from the balconies guests see the gardens, the village and the nearer part of the Pustertal.
phrases.rain: Rain dots the private infinity pools of the pool suites, and beyond them the Pustertal is grey and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls up the Pustertal, and guests see the ridges of the Dolomites one lightning flash at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the edge of the rooftop pool, and the Pustertal below is turning white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the Dolomites look close enough from the outdoor infinity pool to count every ridge.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps the air clear over Brunico, and the town is easy to read from 950 metres up.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the outdoor infinity pool up to their shoulders and look at the Dolomites on the horizon.
phrases.warm: On a warm day guests float in the adults-only rooftop pool and look down the valley to the Dolomites.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Dolomites gold, and the water of the outdoor infinity pool takes the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop pool, the last hour of sun colours the clouds over the Pustertal, with the jagged ridges far off to the right.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening of cloud, guests on their balconies look down at the lights of Brunico in the Pustertal.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of Brunico this evening, and the Dolomites have disappeared into the night.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night the Pustertal is a chain of small lights running towards the Dolomites.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Dolomites tonight, and from the rooftop pool guests see the lights of Brunico below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pustertal is quiet, and the Dolomites wait at the end of it for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind the Dolomites, and the first lights come on in Brunico below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Boston Harbour lies still under a clear sky, and the masts in the marina stand without moving.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast arrives at the room, and guests on the private patios eat it facing Boston Harbour in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: The Custom House Tower rises across the water under a clear midday sky, in plain sight from the private patios.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Boston Harbour this morning, and their shadows cross the marina one dock at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the wraparound balcony of the Harbor Loft, guests see the Boston skyline and the marina under a half-clouded afternoon sky.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, Boston Harbour turns grey, and the yachts in the marina sit still at their docks.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Boston Harbour today, and East Boston across the water is only a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: East Boston is not visible across Boston Harbour today; guests see the marina and the nearest stretch of water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Boston Harbour, and guests watch it through the windows as the Custom House Tower blurs across the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Boston Harbour, and guests stay behind the glass to watch lightning flash above the marina.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Boston Harbour, and the docks of the marina turn white while the water stays dark.
phrases.very_cold: In the gym, guests stay warm on the machines while Boston Harbour shines in the freezing air outside the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep the patio doors closed and watch boats cross Boston Harbour from inside their rooms.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests sit out on the private patios and watch sailboats come and go on Boston Harbour.
phrases.warm: Warm air brings guests out to the patio tables, where the Custom House Tower stands across the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Custom House Tower late in the afternoon, and guests on the private patios see its colour deepen.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun breaks through the clouds and lights Boston Harbour in patches, seen from the decks of the Harbor Loft.
phrases.grey_evening: City lights glow under low cloud this evening, and guests see the Boston skyline reflected in the water of the marina.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the marina this evening, and the lights of the Boston skyline run in long streaks across the wet docks.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lights of East Boston shine across Boston Harbour in a low row.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the lit Custom House Tower stands sharp across the water from the private patios.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Boston Harbour is quiet, and the yachts in the 100-slip marina rest at their docks.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Boston Harbour is still bright, and the first lights come on along the Boston skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Back Bay skyline stands quiet under a clear sky beyond the 12th-floor rooftop pool.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the brick townhouses of the South End, and guests see each row clearly through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool on the 12th floor, the Back Bay skyline looks close enough to touch under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Prudential this morning, and their shadows cross the South End rooftops one street at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the rooftop bar watch patches of sun and shade slide across the Back Bay skyline this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the red brick of the South End townhouses is the strongest colour in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Back Bay skyline today, and from the rooftop pool the towers look like a drawing half rubbed out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the skyline is not visible today; guests see the Prudential and the nearest South End streets only.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the South End's brick townhouses turn a darker red behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Prudential, and guests follow the storm over Back Bay from their rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the South End, and the roofs of the brick townhouses turn white while guests watch from inside.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear today, so every edge of the Back Bay skyline looks sharp from the rooftop.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the tree-lined streets of the South End lie still below, and the Prudential rises above them.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the Back Bay skyline with only their heads above the water.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, guests lie on lounge chairs under the umbrellas while the Back Bay skyline stands all around them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun warms the red brick buildings of the South End, and the tree-lined streets between them fall into shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests at the rooftop bar hold their cocktails and watch the last sun turn the clouds over Back Bay pink and orange.
phrases.grey_evening: The lit windows of Back Bay glow under low cloud this evening, seen from the rooftop bar on the 12th floor.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the pool-facing suites watch the rain fall on the rooftop deck, with the city lights blurred behind it.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the cloud above the Prudential catches the glow of the city, and the South End streets shine below.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests look down from the floor-to-ceiling windows at the lit streets of the South End.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the South End's townhouses are rows of dark roofs, and nothing moves in the streets between them.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on in the Back Bay streets below the rooftop pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the arch of Sydney Harbour Bridge stands grey against a clear sky, and Sydney Harbour lies still below it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Sydney Harbour, and the private decks of the balcony suites look straight onto the blue water.
phrases.clear_midday: At Pier Bar, a long lunch moves slowly, because Sydney Harbour is bright blue beside every waterfront table.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows slide over Walsh Bay this morning, while the steel of Sydney Harbour Bridge goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at Pier Bar take an afternoon drink by the water and watch clouds drift above Sydney Harbour.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Sydney Harbour Bridge looks heavier and closer, its iron arch right above this pier from 1912.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Sydney Harbour today, and the North Sydney skyline across the water is only a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far shore of Sydney Harbour is not visible today; Sydney Harbour Bridge is clear near the pier and fades halfway across.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of Walsh Bay, and guests watch it from the bridge view rooms, with Sydney Harbour Bridge grey above the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Sydney Harbour, and for a second the lightning shows every beam of Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the arch of Sydney Harbour Bridge and vanishes as it touches the water around the pier.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, guests stay behind the glass of the Admiral Suite and see Sydney Harbour in sharp detail.
phrases.cold: A cold wind pushes small waves across Sydney Harbour, and Sydney Harbour Bridge stands sharp above them.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests sit under the umbrellas of the waterfront terrace and look at Sydney Harbour, which seems cooler than anything on the menu.
phrases.warm: A warm day brings guests out to the waterfront tables at Pier Bar, where Sydney Harbour Bridge fills the sky above the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests stay on at Pier Bar towards sunset, as the low sun turns Sydney Harbour gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over Walsh Bay, and each of the 189 rooms gets its own piece of harbour or bridge.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests at dinner in Pier Dining look out at the lit arch of Sydney Harbour Bridge under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the terrace this evening, so guests at Pier Dining take the indoor tables and watch the harbour lights blur on the wet water.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of the North Sydney skyline lie in long lines on Sydney Harbour.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the terrace of Pier Dining sits out over Sydney Harbour, and the lit Sydney Harbour Bridge is reflected in the water beside it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Sydney Harbour lies quiet and almost empty, with Sydney Harbour Bridge a dark shape above the pier.
phrases.dusk: From the open-air terrace of Pier Dining, the sky is still bright behind Sydney Harbour Bridge while the first lights come on across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale above the quadriga, and the Brandenburg Gate is still a dark shape.
phrases.clear_morning: From the upper front rooms, clear morning light shows the quadriga on the Brandenburg Gate at eye level.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in Brasserie Quarré, guests look across Pariser Platz to the Brandenburg Gate under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests with a morning coffee at Adlon To Go watch cloud shadows move across the Brandenburg Gate.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Unter den Linden this afternoon, and rooms facing the boulevard look along its lines of trees.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Brandenburg Gate keeps its sharp outline for guests inside Brasserie Quarré.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs over Pariser Platz today, and the quadriga on the Brandenburg Gate seems to float above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of Unter den Linden is lost in the dull air today, but the Brandenburg Gate is close enough to stay clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Pariser Platz, and the Brandenburg Gate stands wet and grey behind the drops on the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Pariser Platz, and each flash of lightning turns the Brandenburg Gate white for a moment.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Brandenburg Gate, and guests in the upper front rooms watch the quadriga turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests look at the Brandenburg Gate from inside Adlon To Go, behind glass and a hot coffee.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests of this 385-room hotel look out from Brasserie Quarré at Pariser Platz and the Brandenburg Gate.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests sit outside Adlon To Go and look at the Brandenburg Gate through the shimmering air.
phrases.warm: On the terrace of Brasserie Quarré, guests stay at their tables longer than planned, because the Brandenburg Gate is right in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Brandenburg Gate gold, and the quadriga glows above Pariser Platz.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds, and guests in the front rooms watch the Brandenburg Gate catch it.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Lorenz Adlon Esszimmer, guests look at the lit Brandenburg Gate under a low, cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in Brasserie Quarré see the lights of the Brandenburg Gate reflected on the ground of Pariser Platz.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky tonight, and the lit Brandenburg Gate stands out against them above Pariser Platz.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear over Pariser Platz, and the lit quadriga on the Brandenburg Gate shows every detail against the black sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Pariser Platz is empty and the Brandenburg Gate has the square to itself.
phrases.dusk: In the few minutes after sunset, the first lights come on at the Brandenburg Gate while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Paradeplatz lies quiet under a clear sky, and the rooftops around it are still without colour.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Old Town rooftops first, then moves slowly down into Paradeplatz.
phrases.clear_midday: From 1838, the rooftops of the city spread out sharp and bright under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Paradeplatz this morning, and guests in the balcony rooms watch the square turn bright and dim again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the historic rooftops this afternoon, and patches of sun move from one roof to the next.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Paradeplatz keeps its calm order, and the rooftops around it take the same grey.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Alps today, so the view from 1838 ends at the nearest rooftops of the Old Town.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today; guests looking over Paradeplatz see the square clearly and the far rooftops only faintly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Paradeplatz, and guests watch it from their suite windows with a book left open.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the city during the thunderstorm, and for a second every rooftop shows against the sky.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Paradeplatz, and the rooftops around the square turn white one by one.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air makes every line clear today, and the rooftops above Paradeplatz stand out sharply against the sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay by their windows in this hotel of 80 rooms and look down on Paradeplatz.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the rooftop terrace of 1838 stay under the umbrellas and look over the city rooftops to Lake Zurich.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the balconies lean out over the historic rooftops, in no hurry to go back inside.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At 1838, guests watch the low sun turn the rooftops gold while the Alps appear beyond the city.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and colours the Old Town rooftops pink for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds cover the Alps tonight, but the lights of Paradeplatz glow under the low sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Paradeplatz shine twice, once on the buildings and once on the wet ground.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the city rooftops fade into the sky, and the lit square of Paradeplatz holds the eye.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests at 1838, in a hotel that reopened in 2023, look over the lit rooftops under the stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Paradeplatz is empty and still, a square taking a short rest from business.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from 1838 guests see the Alps above the first lights of Paradeplatz.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Aegean Sea below the private verandas is still and grey-blue under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun lights the Aegean Sea, and the saltwater pool seems to run straight into it.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the Aegean Sea is a bright blue from the terraces of Olvo Restaurant.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Aegean Sea this morning, beyond the edge of the saltwater pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the outdoor bar, the rocky islets go from sunlit to shaded as clouds cross the Aegean Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Aegean Sea takes the same grey colour beyond the saltwater pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Aegean Sea today, and the rocky islets look like faint pencil marks on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The rocky islets are not visible today; guests see the cove, the rocky coastline and a short stretch of the Aegean Sea.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Aegean Sea, and guests watch it from their sea view suites, the cove slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Aegean Sea, and guests indoors count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Aegean Sea, and the white flakes vanish as they touch the cove.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the rocky islets stand out sharply on the Aegean Sea, and guests look at them from indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Aegean Sea is a deep blue, and white lines of foam mark the rocky coastline.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the saltwater pool up to their shoulders, their eyes on the Aegean Sea.
phrases.warm: By the saltwater pool, books stay closed while guests look at the turquoise cove instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light spreads across the Aegean Sea, and from the outdoor bar the rocky islets turn to amber.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and paints the Aegean Sea orange, seen from the tiered terraces of Olvo Restaurant.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner at Olvo Restaurant, guests look past the candlelit tables to a dim Aegean Sea under an evening of cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: The Aegean Sea is hidden by a wet evening, and guests in the sea view suites hear it more than they see it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the Aegean Sea is a soft shadow beyond the 44 suites, under a sky without stars.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Aegean Sea, and the saltwater pool reflects a few of them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Aegean Sea is only a darker band beneath the sky, with nobody awake to check.
phrases.dusk: The horizon turns pink over the Aegean Sea, and the pendant lights of the outdoor bar begin to glow.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sydney Harbour Bridge is a dark arch over still water, and Darling Harbour waits for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, Darling Harbour is bright blue and the Sydney Harbour Bridge stands sharp beyond it.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Sydney Harbour Bridge stands clear against a blue sky, every line of its arch easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the Jewel Suites watch cloud shadows move across Pyrmont and the Sydney skyline this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Sydney Harbour Bridge this afternoon, and patches of sun cross Darling Harbour one after another.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Darling Harbour turns the colour of steel, a good match for the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Sydney skyline today, and guests see the Sydney Harbour Bridge as a faint arch.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Sydney Harbour Bridge is not visible today; guests see Darling Harbour clearly and only the nearest towers of the Sydney skyline.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Darling Harbour, and guests watch the Sydney Harbour Bridge fade and return between showers.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Penthouses watch lightning flash over the Sydney skyline through wraparound windows while thunder rolls across Darling Harbour.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Darling Harbour, and guests watch the flakes drift past the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the Sydney skyline looks sharp, and guests can count the floors of the towers across Darling Harbour.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look across the quiet water of Darling Harbour to the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests in rooms facing the pool look down on swimmers in the 25-metre pool and soon go down to join them.
phrases.warm: On a warm day Darling Harbour shines in the light, and guests look from the water to the Sydney Harbour Bridge and back.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Sydney skyline gold, and the glass towers throw the light back onto Darling Harbour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the Stellar Suites, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over Balmain and Glebe.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Sydney skyline lie in long reflections on Darling Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the city lights tonight, and Darling Harbour holds them as soft streaks of colour.
phrases.mild_night: Guests look out on a mild, cloudy night as the clouds above the Sydney skyline glow from the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the Sydney Harbour Bridge is lit, and guests can picture the New Year's Eve fireworks above it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Darling Harbour lies still, and guests who cannot sleep have the dark water for company.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset as the first lights come on along Darling Harbour and the Sydney skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over Vienna is clear, and the first grey light shows the rooftops one by one.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast at the Grand Étage on the 8th floor, guests look over the Ringstrasse in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, the Ringstrasse runs directly below under a blue sky, its historic facades sharp in the midday light.
phrases.partly_morning: From the rooftop terrace, cloud shadows move slowly across the rooftops of Vienna this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in rooms overlooking the Schubertring watch sun and cloud take turns on the tree-lined boulevard.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the rooftops of Vienna spread out from the rooftop pool in quiet shades of slate.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Vienna today, and from the terrace suites the Kahlenberg is only a faint shape.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far rooftops of Vienna cannot be seen from the rooftop today, so guests look down at the Ringstrasse instead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Ringstrasse; guests watch the wet tram tracks shine from the windows above the Schubertring.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm rolls over Vienna, and guests in the Ferdinand Suite see lightning flash above the city's rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Ringstrasse, and from the heated rooftop pool the boulevard below slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and from the Grand Étage the church spires stand sharp over the rooftops of Vienna.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay indoors at the Grand Étage and look down on the Ringstrasse and its passing trams.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look down on the Ringstrasse.
phrases.warm: On the striped loungers by the rooftop pool, guests look over the city skyline, and nobody hurries back down.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the historic facades of the Ringstrasse gold, seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights St. Charles's Church, which guests can see from the rooftop.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner at Limón, guests look across the rooftops of Vienna to St. Stephen's Cathedral under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: From Limón, the city lights below blur into soft colours in the evening rain.
phrases.mild_night: City lights and the tree-lined Ringstrasse glow under a cloudy night sky, seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear over Vienna, and guests on the 8th floor of this listed building pick out lit church spires above the rooftops.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Ringstrasse lies almost empty, and only the long rows of trees mark the boulevard.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Ringstrasse below the rooftop terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Gran Vía lies quiet below the suite windows, and Casa de Campo is still a dark shape under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the rooftop, guests look down on Gran Vía in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Sky Pool on the 14th floor, the theaters of Gran Vía and the church spires of Malasaña stand sharp under a blue midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Plaza de España this morning, while Casa de Campo behind it stays green in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop restaurant, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the Madrid skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the church spires of Malasaña look darker and closer than usual from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Madrid skyline today, and from the rooftop terrace the church spires of Malasaña look like pencil drawings.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Casa de Campo is not visible today, but Plaza de España and Gran Vía remain clear from the rooftop.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Gran Vía, and guests at the rooftop restaurant watch the Madrid skyline turn grey and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the Madrid skyline, and guests follow the lightning from the windows of the rooftop restaurant.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Gran Vía, and from the rooftop terrace the church spires of Malasaña slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Madrid skyline is very clear, and guests enjoy it from behind the windows of the rooftop restaurant.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the suites look out at the Royal Palace and Plaza de España.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the water of the Sky Pool and look over the theaters of Gran Vía from there.
phrases.warm: By the Sky Pool, books stay closed while guests count the church spires of Malasaña instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light reaches the theaters along Gran Vía, and guests in the rooftop restaurant wait for the sunset.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and colours the Royal Palace, seen from the high-floor rooms.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Gran Vía make a bright line below the rooftop restaurant.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the theater lights of Gran Vía shine on the wet street, far below the rooftop.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, the clouds over the rooftop terrace take a soft glow from the city lights of the Madrid skyline.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of Madrid spread in every direction around the 14th-floor rooftop.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Gran Vía is almost empty below the rooms that look onto it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright behind the church spires of Malasaña, and the first lights come on along Gran Vía below the Sky Pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: The clear sky grows pale behind the Higashiyama hills, and the Yasaka Pagoda slowly takes shape above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in French Dining TOP OF KYOTO, morning light reaches the Higashiyama hills, and the Yasaka Pagoda stands clear above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the five storeys of the Yasaka Pagoda are easy to count above the Higashiyama rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Higashiyama rooftops this morning, and the Yasaka Pagoda goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the window seats of French Dining TOP OF KYOTO, guests see Toji Temple and Nishi Honganji Temple under a sky of sun and passing cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Kyoto Tower rises close and clear, and the Yasaka Pagoda keeps its outline above the Higashiyama rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Higashiyama hills today, and the Yasaka Pagoda looks like a small ink drawing above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Higashiyama hills and the Yasaka Pagoda are not visible today; Kyoto Tower and the trains near the station still are.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of French Dining TOP OF KYOTO on the 14th floor, and guests watch Kyoto Tower pass slowly, a little blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Higashiyama hills for a second, and guests in east-facing rooms look for the Yasaka Pagoda in each flash.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Higashiyama rooftops, and the Yasaka Pagoda slowly turns white, one roof at a time.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the Higashiyama hills look sharp and near, and the Yasaka Pagoda stands out clearly in front of them.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in east-facing rooms follow the trains to and from Kyoto Station, with the Yasaka Pagoda far behind them.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the city rooftops today, and guests look out from the cool side of the glass at the Yasaka Pagoda.
phrases.warm: Guests have looked east from here since 1969, and on this warm day the Yasaka Pagoda still stands above the Higashiyama rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Higashiyama hills gold, and the Yasaka Pagoda glows in front of them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds, and from French Dining TOP OF KYOTO guests see it light Toji Temple, then Kyoto Tower.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in French Dining TOP OF KYOTO, guests watch the orange glow of Kyoto Tower under the clouds and wait for it to come around again.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the evening city, and the orange light of Kyoto Tower spreads across the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the city lights reach to the foot of the hills, and the Yasaka Pagoda is a thin lit silhouette.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests in east-facing rooms see Kyoto Tower in orange and the lit Yasaka Pagoda small above Higashiyama.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Higashiyama hills and the Yasaka Pagoda are only dark shapes, and the city below is quiet.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first orange light appears on Kyoto Tower while the Higashiyama hills turn blue.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the forested hills of Sintra stand black against a sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Lawrence's Restaurant, guests look through wide windows at the green Sintra hills under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From Esplanada Floresta, the Sintra forest is bright green at midday, every tree clear under the blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the valley this morning, and the forest changes from dark green to light.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony suites, sun and cloud take turns over the wooded valley this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Sintra forest looks darker and deeper from the garden terrace at Esplanada Floresta.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills the valley today, and from the balcony suites only the nearest treetops stand out of it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far hills are not visible today; guests see the garden trees and the near side of the valley.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Sintra forest, and guests in Lawrence's Restaurant watch the green hills through wet windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole valley for a second, then the forest goes back behind the heavy rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Sintra hills, and guests at the windows of Lawrence's Restaurant watch the forest turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the forested hills look sharp and clear from the windows of Lawrence's Restaurant.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look out from the balcony suites at a quiet valley and its tall trees.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests sit in the shade at Esplanada Floresta and look into the cool green of the forest.
phrases.warm: A light lunch at Esplanada Floresta goes slowly on a warm day, because the Sintra forest keeps taking guests' attention.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the treetops gold across the valley below this hotel, open since 1764.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds, and the hills of Sintra glow above the garden.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Lawrence's Restaurant, the Sintra hills are a soft shadow under the cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain taps on the windows of Lawrence's Restaurant tonight, with the wet forest lost in the dark behind it.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the valley and its trees can just be made out from the suite balconies.
phrases.clear_night: Stars hang over the valley tonight, above the forested hills of Sintra.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the valley is a deep pool of darkness, and the forest cannot be told from the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright above the Sintra hills while the forest below loses its colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky turns pale above the Kowloon hills, and Victoria Harbour lies quiet below.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Victoria Harbour, and guests in the harbour view rooms can follow each ferry across to Kowloon.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Victoria Harbour and the Kowloon hills spread wide beyond the 56th-floor roof garden.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Victoria Harbour this morning, while Kowloon stays bright on the far side.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Shangri-La Suite, guests see clouds resting on the mountain line beyond Victoria Harbour this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Victoria Harbour turns the colour of steel, and the Kowloon skyline stands clear behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Victoria Harbour today, and from the roof garden Kowloon looks only half drawn.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Kowloon hills are not visible today; Victoria Harbour and the nearest towers are what guests see from the roof garden.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Victoria Harbour, and guests watch it from Horizon Club while Kowloon fades to grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses Victoria Harbour, and lightning shows the Kowloon hills for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Victoria Harbour, and guests in the harbour view rooms take a second look to be sure.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and sharp today, and from the 56th-floor roof garden every ridge of the Kowloon hills is easy to see.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests high in a tower of 56 floors stay behind glass and watch boats cross Victoria Harbour.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool and look up at the Bank of China Tower.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests walk in the roof garden with Victoria Harbour and Kowloon in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Victoria Harbour gold, and the Kowloon skyline shines on the other side.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Kowloon hills turn orange, and Victoria Harbour copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: From Petrus on the 56th floor, guests look over the city lights under a low evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights of Kowloon stretch into long lines on Victoria Harbour.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud hides the stars tonight, so the lights around Victoria Harbour do the job instead.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Shangri-La Suite shows the lights of Kowloon and, above them, the mountain line beyond Victoria Harbour.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Victoria Harbour is wide and quiet, and guests who cannot sleep have it to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights of Kowloon appear along Victoria Harbour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the IJ River lies dark and calm under a clear sky, and the first boats have not yet started.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sky is clear, and guests in their rooms watch the morning boats cross the IJ River.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the IJ River shines blue and every boat on it is easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Amsterdam's city centre this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the IJ River.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the restaurant, guests look over the water to the city skyline on the other bank, half in sun and half in cloud shadow.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the IJ River takes the same colour, and the boats become the brightest things in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the IJ River today, and boats appear out of it slowly, one at a time.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far bank of the IJ River is not visible today; guests see only the near water and the boats that pass close.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the IJ River, and guests watch the drops mark the water from their room windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the IJ River, and for a second the whole width of the water turns white.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the IJ River and disappears the moment it touches the water.
phrases.very_cold: The air over the IJ River is freezing and clear, and guests are happy to follow the boats from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the IJ River looks like steel, and the few boats on it move without hurry.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the IJ River shines almost white, and guests on the upper floors watch the boats cut slow lines through it.
phrases.warm: A warm day brings more boats onto the IJ River, and guests count them from the restaurant tables.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the IJ River gold, and the city skyline across the water glows with it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Amsterdam's city centre turn pink and the IJ River copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the boats slide along the IJ River like a slow parade.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in the restaurant watch the boat lights on the IJ River blur behind the rain on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the boats on the IJ River carry their lights past every floor.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the suites look across the black water of the IJ River to the lights of Amsterdam's city centre.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the IJ River is nearly empty, and a single late boat has the whole water to itself.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first boat lights are starting to show on the IJ River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Chapultepec Forest is a wide dark shape under a clear sky, and Reforma is only a faint curve.
phrases.clear_morning: From the corner rooms on the 15th floor and above, guests see Chapultepec Forest, the Auditorio Nacional rooftop and Reforma together in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is clear, and the city skyline stands sharp behind the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Chapultepec Forest this morning, while the Auditorio Nacional rooftop stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop pool, the city skyline shows in patches of sun and shade this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Chapultepec Forest keeps its deep green, and guests can still follow the wide arc of Reforma.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Chapultepec Forest today, and the Auditorio Nacional rooftop looks like a pale sketch.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of Reforma is not visible today; guests see the nearer trees of Chapultepec Forest and the Auditorio Nacional rooftop.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Chapultepec Forest, and guests watch it from the corner rooms as Reforma turns shiny.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Auditorio Nacional rooftop for a second, then the storm hides it again behind the rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Chapultepec Forest, and nobody leaves the windows while the treetops turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the Auditorio Nacional rooftop and the trees of Chapultepec Forest show in sharp detail.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the rooftop pool is quiet, and the city skyline behind it has the place to itself.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the city skyline from the water.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, guests on lounge chairs forget their books and study the city skyline instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the canopy of Chapultepec Forest gold, and the Auditorio Nacional rooftop catches the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds above the wide arc of Reforma turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, Reforma is an arc of lights, and Chapultepec Forest is the one part of the scene with none.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Reforma blur on the glass of the corner rooms on the 15th floor and above.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud holds the glow of the city tonight, and guests can trace Reforma by its lights.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and from the rooftop pool the city skyline is a long row of lights.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Chapultepec Forest is a large patch of stillness, and even Reforma seems to rest.
phrases.dusk: Guests in this 1996 hotel watch the first lights come on along Reforma while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Story Bridge is a dark outline against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the city skyline first, and from the rooftop pool every tower looks sharp.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop, the Story Bridge shows its whole frame under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the city skyline this morning, and guests in the suites with balconies follow them from one tower to the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Iris, guests watch clouds drift over the Story Bridge this afternoon, with sunny gaps opening above the high-rises.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits flat over the city skyline, and the high-rises and older buildings take the same quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and the Story Bridge looks like a pencil drawing from the rooftop.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far towers of the city skyline are not visible today, but the Story Bridge can still be seen from the rooftop pool.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in the corner rooms see the city skyline slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city skyline, and each flash of lightning shows the Story Bridge for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the city skyline, and guests stand at their suite windows to watch the Story Bridge turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the Story Bridge stands out sharply from the rooftop.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the city skyline looks clear and close from Iris.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the 15-metre rooftop pool and look at the Story Bridge from the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests rest in the cabanas by the rooftop pool, with the city skyline and the Story Bridge in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Story Bridge late this afternoon, and guests at Iris turn their chairs toward it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds above the city skyline, and the high-rises turn orange one by one.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights give the sky above the skyline a soft glow, seen from Iris.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the city lights spread into soft colours on the suite windows.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit windows of the high-rises fill the view from the rooftop pool.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and from Iris the city skyline is a wall of small lights under a black sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Story Bridge stands still and quiet beyond the rooftop.
phrases.dusk: At Iris, named best hotel bar in Australia in 2022, guests watch the first city lights come on under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Intracoastal Waterway lies still and dark below the west-facing balconies, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun crosses the Atlantic Ocean and reaches the 7th-floor sundeck, where the horizon is a clean blue line.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Atlantic Ocean shines bright blue beyond the pool on Sea la Vie Sundeck.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Intracoastal Waterway this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Club Lounge on the 8th floor, guests see sun and cloud take turns over the Atlantic Ocean on one side and the Intracoastal Waterway on the other.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Intracoastal Waterway turns the colour of pewter and the Atlantic Ocean matches it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Intracoastal Waterway today, and its far bank looks like a soft pencil line.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible from the 7th-floor sundeck today; the Atlantic Ocean fades into pale air a short way out.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Intracoastal Waterway, and guests watch the drops dot the water from behind floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in the Club Lounge watch the storm through the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Intracoastal Waterway, and guests in this 182-room hotel stand at the windows to see it melt into the water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear today, and the Intracoastal Waterway shows a sharp, bright blue under the cold sun.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the spa look out at a steel-blue Atlantic Ocean from the warmth inside.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests in the poolside cabanas look out at the Atlantic Ocean and do very little else.
phrases.warm: On Sea la Vie Sundeck, books stay closed while guests look at the Atlantic Ocean instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Intracoastal Waterway gold, and guests in the Club Lounge watch it sink.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lays orange stripes across the Intracoastal Waterway.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, lights along the Intracoastal Waterway shine on the dark water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights along the Intracoastal Waterway this evening, seen from the dry side of the Club Lounge windows.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the Presidential Suite step onto their balconies to look at the Atlantic Ocean and the Intracoastal Waterway.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Intracoastal Waterway carries long reflections of the lights on its banks.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Intracoastal Waterway is quiet and black, and the Atlantic Ocean is only a darker space beyond the beach.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright over the Intracoastal Waterway, and the first lights come on along the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the waterhole is a dark shape in front of the verandas, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the breakfast deck, guests look over the Timbavati bushveld in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Elephant herds walk in to drink at the waterhole at midday, in full view of the rim-flow pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Timbavati bushveld this morning, while the waterhole stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the sun deck, guests watch the waterhole change from bright to grey as clouds cross the afternoon sky.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the waterhole takes the same colour, and kudu are easy to see against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Timbavati bushveld today, and the trees behind the waterhole fade into grey.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far bushveld is not visible today; the waterhole and its nearest trees are still clear from the sun deck.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the waterhole, and guests watch the surface from the glass-fronted cottages.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Timbavati bushveld for a second at a time, and thunder rolls over the waterhole.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Timbavati bushveld, and guests watch the waterhole turn white at its edges from the glass-fronted cottages.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and every tree around the waterhole looks sharp from the sun deck.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests look through the glass fronts of the 20 cottages at the bushveld trees.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, buffalo stand at the waterhole for a long time, and guests watch them from the rim-flow pool.
phrases.warm: By the rim-flow pool, books stay closed while guests look at the kudu drinking at the waterhole.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the waterhole late in the afternoon, and guests on the sun deck see every ripple.
phrases.partly_golden: In the outdoor lounge, guests hold sundowners and watch the last sun turn the clouds over the waterhole orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the waterhole is a pale patch in front of the Timbavati bushveld.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain hides most of the bushveld this evening, and only the nearest edge of the waterhole still shows.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the waterhole shows only where the water moves.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the waterhole shines a little, and the unfenced bushveld behind it is black.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the waterhole lies still, and the Timbavati bushveld around it disappears into the night.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays bright for a few minutes after sunset, and the waterhole holds that light longer than the bushveld around it.

phrases.clear_predawn: In the Tower Bridge View rooms, early risers find Tower Bridge standing dark against the first pale light.
phrases.clear_morning: From Vicinity, Tower Bridge and The Shard stand clear in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The River Thames shines under Tower Bridge, and every line of the bridge is sharp.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows slide across the River Thames while Tower Bridge stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At Vicinity, guests look up as The Shard catches the sun between passing clouds.
phrases.overcast: From the Bridge View rooms, Tower Bridge looks solid and calm under a flat grey sky.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the London skyline, and from VU only Tower Bridge keeps a clear outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far London skyline is not visible today; the River Thames and Tower Bridge still are.
phrases.rain: Guests in the Tower Bridge View rooms watch Tower Bridge through rain-streaked glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the River Thames, and Tower Bridge shows sharply with each flash of lightning.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Tower Bridge, and guests in the Bridge View rooms watch it from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay warm inside VU and look out over the River Thames and the London skyline.
phrases.cold: Guests in the Tower Bridge View rooms stay in a little longer today and look out at Tower Bridge.
phrases.very_hot: On The Lawn, guests choose the shade and watch the River Thames move slowly past.
phrases.warm: Guests sit out on The Lawn with the River Thames beside them and nowhere else to be.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Terrace at Vicinity, the sun drops behind Tower Bridge and turns it into a dark outline.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lays a gold stripe on the River Thames.
phrases.grey_evening: At Vicinity, guests have dinner while Tower Bridge stands lit under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: At VU, guests watch tonight's rain blur the lights of the London skyline over the River Thames.
phrases.mild_night: The lights of Tower Bridge lie on the River Thames tonight like a second bridge.
phrases.clear_night: From VU, the lights of the London skyline run along the River Thames on this clear night.
phrases.late_night: Guests who cannot sleep in the Bridge View rooms have Tower Bridge for company.
phrases.dusk: Tower Bridge begins to light up just after sunset, and the River Thames below is still pale.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Dale Head, Great Gable and Glaramara are black shapes against a sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the top of Great Gable first, then moves down toward the lawns.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the full outline of Dale Head, Great Gable and Glaramara is easy to follow from the lawn.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Glaramara this morning, while the lawns below stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the clouds move over Dale Head and Great Gable, and from the terrace the light keeps changing on the slopes.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits low over Borrowdale, and Great Gable looks darker and closer beyond the lawns.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist fills the Borrowdale valley today, and from the terrace the fells are only faint grey outlines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Great Gable and Dale Head are not visible today; the lawns, the hedged lane and the nearest fields are.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the lawns and the woodland, and guests watch it from the bay window of the sitting room, the wooded hillside blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls around the Borrowdale fells, and lightning shows Glaramara for a second before the rain hides it again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the lawns, and Great Gable disappears and returns behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: Frost covers the lawns, and in the freezing air every line of Dale Head and Great Gable looks sharp.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests keep to the sitting room and look through its bay window at the wooded Borrowdale hillside.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests sit in the shade on the lawn and look across at Great Gable, glad that someone else is climbing it today.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests take tea on the lawn in front of this house built around 1840 and look across the valley to Glaramara.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun colours the slopes of Glaramara, and long tree shadows stretch across the lawns.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above Dale Head turn pink and gold, and from the terrace the colour fades slowly.
phrases.grey_evening: On a cloudy evening, the fells around Borrowdale merge into the sky, and only the trees at the edge of the lawns stand out.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the fells are lost in the dark, and from the window seats guests see only rain falling on the lawns.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud hides the stars tonight, and from the terrace Great Gable can only just be made out above the valley.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the sky above Borrowdale fills with stars over Dale Head and Great Gable.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Borrowdale valley lies dark and still below Dale Head, Great Gable and Glaramara.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright behind Dale Head and Great Gable, while the lawns below slowly lose their colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the karst formations of Phang Nga Bay stand as dark shapes against a clear, slowly paling sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light spreads across Phang Nga Bay, and from the private terraces Rang Yai and Coconut islands stand out clearly above the jungle canopy.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Phang Nga Bay turns turquoise below the infinity pool, with the limestone karsts sharp on the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows drift over Phang Nga Bay this morning, so Rang Yai Island is green one minute and grey the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon clouds are building behind the karst formations, and patches of sun move slowly across Phang Nga Bay.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, Phang Nga Bay turns silver-grey, and guests can still count the islands one by one.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Phang Nga Bay today, and the karst formations look like faint brush strokes above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far karst formations are not visible today; guests see Rang Yai and Coconut islands and the near water of Phang Nga Bay.
