phrases.rain: Rain crosses Phang Nga Bay in grey curtains, and guests watch from behind the glass doors as the islands fade and return.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Phang Nga Bay, and for a second guests see every karst formation outlined against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the jungle canopy of Cape Yamu, and guests look twice before they find Phang Nga Bay behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold, clear air, guests looking out from the summit of Cape Yamu see the karst formations of Phang Nga Bay in sharp detail.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Phang Nga Bay lies calm below the cape, and the green jungle canopy is the only warm colour in sight.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across Phang Nga Bay to Coconut Island.
phrases.warm: On the private terraces, guests sit out in the warm air with Phang Nga Bay and its islands spread below them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the karst formations gold, and Phang Nga Bay goes a deeper blue below the private terraces.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Phang Nga Bay turn soft orange, and guests leave their phones alone for once.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, Phang Nga Bay is a wide stretch of deep grey, and guests can only just pick out Rang Yai Island.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the jungle canopy this evening, and Phang Nga Bay has disappeared into the night beyond it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests hear the jungle more than they see it, while Phang Nga Bay shows faintly below.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Phang Nga Bay tonight, and the islands sit black on the water beneath them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Phang Nga Bay lies still below Cape Yamu, and the jungle canopy and the water are almost one colour.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky stays bright over Phang Nga Bay, and the infinity pool holds the same pink as the water beyond it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Aegean Sea lies still and grey-blue below the wooden deck, and the mountains across the water are only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: In clear morning light, the wooden jetties reach into a bright blue Aegean Sea, with the mountains sharp across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: From the infinity pool, guests look at midday across an open Aegean Sea, blue all the way to the mountains on the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: From the windows of the balcony suites, guests watch cloud shadows cross Torba Bay this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds sit on the mountains across the water this afternoon, while the Aegean Sea in front of the infinity pool stays in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Aegean Sea turns silver-grey, and the wooden jetties look darker against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the mountains today, so from the seaside terrace the Aegean Sea seems to have no far side.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the rooftop terrace, guests cannot see the mountains across the water today; only the wooden jetties and the near water of Torba Bay are visible.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of the infinity pool and the Aegean Sea beyond it, and guests watch from the balcony suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests watch from indoors as lightning flashes over the Aegean Sea and, for a second, the mountains across the water show through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the wooden jetties and melting into the Aegean Sea, a view nobody has booked, because the hotel is closed for winter.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing clear day in the closed season, the Aegean Sea is deep blue, the jetties are empty, and the mountains stand sharp across the water.
phrases.cold: Cold air makes the mountains look closer across the Aegean Sea, each ridge clear above the water of Torba Bay.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look over its edge at the open Aegean Sea.
phrases.warm: On the wooden jetties, guests sit with their feet above the warm Aegean Sea and look at the mountains across Torba Bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the seaside terrace, guests watch the low sun turn the Aegean Sea gold around the wooden jetties.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop terrace, the clouds above the mountains turn pink in the last hour of sun, and the Aegean Sea copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Aegean Sea is black beyond the lit rooftop terrace, and the mountains have disappeared into the night.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the lights of the seaside terrace this evening, and the Aegean Sea beyond is heard more than seen.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the balcony suites look down at the lit infinity pool, with the Aegean Sea dark beyond it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Aegean Sea tonight, and the wooden jetties point out toward the dark shape of the mountains.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Aegean Sea is quiet and dark, and only the wooden jetties show where the land ends.
phrases.dusk: The pool lights come on under a still-bright sky, and the infinity pool glows in front of the darkening Aegean Sea.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide dark surface, and Santa Monica Pier shows only as an outline above it.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the oceanfront rooms wake to a clear morning, with the Pacific Ocean blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: Santa Monica Pier stands sharp over the Pacific Ocean at midday, its whole length easy to follow from the beach to its end.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Santa Monica Beach this morning, while Santa Monica Pier stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests looking along the coast this afternoon see clouds resting on the Santa Monica Mountains and sun on the Malibu coastline.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and Santa Monica Pier is the only strong line on it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has come in from the Pacific Ocean, and guests can see only the nearest part of Santa Monica Pier.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Malibu coastline is not visible today; Santa Monica Pier and the nearest water of the Pacific Ocean still are.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Ocean Avenue, and guests in the First Lady Suite watch Santa Monica Pier blur behind the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second guests see all of Santa Monica Pier in white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Santa Monica Beach, and guests stop everything to look at white flakes over the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: Santa Monica Beach lies empty in the freezing air, and guests keep to the warm side of the glass to look at the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 1933 Art Deco hotel look at a quiet Santa Monica Pier and a pale Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_hot: The heat makes the air shake above Santa Monica Beach, where the crowd looks small from the 8th-floor suites.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests try to count the people on Santa Monica Beach and soon give up.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Pacific Ocean gold, and guests in the Harlowe Suite have a front seat for it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in long rays, and Santa Monica Pier stands black against the bright water.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the lights of Santa Monica Pier shine clearly over the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and guests watch the lights of Santa Monica Pier turn soft and wide through it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Pacific Ocean is hidden, and the lights of Santa Monica Pier mark where it begins.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the penthouse suites look over the lights of Santa Monica Pier to a Pacific Ocean black under the stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Ocean Avenue is empty, and beyond it the Pacific Ocean can hardly be told from the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just gone, the sky over the Pacific Ocean is still orange, and the first lights come on along Santa Monica Pier.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky brightens slowly above Hohensalzburg Fortress, and Mirabell Gardens lie quiet below.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the walls of Hohensalzburg Fortress, and Mirabell Gardens are bright below.
phrases.clear_midday: At Restaurant Mirabell, guests look through tall windows at the park gardens, bright under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Hohensalzburg Fortress this morning, and their shadows cross Mirabell Gardens one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the ETAGE7 Rooftop Lounge, guests watch patches of sun move across the city roofs towards Hohensalzburg Fortress.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Hohensalzburg Fortress stands out pale on its wooded hill above the city.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Hohensalzburg Fortress today, and from the Sky Suites it looks like a drawing in pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today; Hohensalzburg Fortress is only a faint form, while Mirabell Gardens below stay clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the park gardens; guests watch it from Restaurant Mirabell, the trees dripping outside.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city, and guests at their suite windows see lightning flash above Hohensalzburg Fortress.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Mirabell Gardens, and Hohensalzburg Fortress slowly disappears behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, every wall of Hohensalzburg Fortress is sharp against the sky, and guests wisely admire it from indoors.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 70-room hotel look from the 7th floor across Mirabell Gardens to Hohensalzburg Fortress.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, visitors in Mirabell Gardens look for shade under the trees, and guests watch them from above.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests step out onto the balconies of the Sky Suites, with Mirabell Gardens below and Hohensalzburg Fortress directly ahead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Warm afternoon light falls on Hohensalzburg Fortress and on the green domes of Salzburg Cathedral below it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests at ETAGE7 Rooftop Lounge see the clouds turn orange above Hohensalzburg Fortress.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights spread out below the ETAGE7 Rooftop Lounge, and guests stay to look a little longer.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the city lights tonight, and the wet paths shine in Mirabell Gardens below.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests on the 7th floor look over the dark trees of Mirabell Gardens to the lights of the city.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above Hohensalzburg Fortress tonight, and the city lights below answer them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city is asleep, and Hohensalzburg Fortress keeps its place above the quiet roofs.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the ETAGE7 Rooftop Lounge the first city lights appear below Hohensalzburg Fortress.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Sugarloaf Mountain is a dark shape at the end of Copacabana Beach, and the sky behind it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the full arc of Copacabana Beach, and guests in the ocean-facing suites follow it all the way to Sugarloaf Mountain.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, 39 floors up, Copacabana Beach is a bright curve between the avenue and the blue sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly along Copacabana Beach this morning, while Sugarloaf Mountain stands in full sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop bar terrace, guests watch clouds gather around Corcovado while Copacabana Beach stays bright below.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlantic Ocean turns grey too, and the long curve of Copacabana Beach stands out in the dining room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Sugarloaf Mountain today, and from the rooftop terrace it looks like a drawing left half finished.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Sugarloaf Mountain is not visible today; guests on the rooftop terrace see the near half of Copacabana Beach and then only pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Copacabana Beach, and guests watch it through the dining room's floor-to-ceiling windows as the sea loses its colour.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Sugarloaf Mountain for a second at a time, and guests in the upper-floor suites watch the storm cross Copacabana Beach.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Copacabana Beach, and guests at the dining room windows check twice before they believe it.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, so every line of Sugarloaf Mountain is sharp from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.cold: On a cold day Copacabana Beach is quiet, and guests in the ocean-facing suites study its whole length from behind warm glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look down at the crowds along Copacabana Beach.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, guests lie on lounge chairs with Copacabana Beach far below and Sugarloaf Mountain at the end of it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the rock of Sugarloaf Mountain gold, and the rooftop pool, here since 2017, catches the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop terrace, guests watch the sun drop behind clouds over the Atlantic Ocean and its rocky islands.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Avenida Atlântica draw the curve of Copacabana Beach for guests on the rooftop bar terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass tonight, and the lights along Copacabana Beach become a long blurred chain.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hang low over Sugarloaf Mountain tonight, and the lights of Copacabana Beach glow softly under them.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the upper-floor suites can follow the lights of Copacabana Beach to the dark outline of Sugarloaf Mountain.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, only the white edge of the waves moves along the sand of Copacabana Beach.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky is still bright over Sugarloaf Mountain, and the first lights appear along Copacabana Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Sand River is a pale line between two dark banks, and the bush beyond it has no colour yet.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning is clear, and from Tree Camp's deck on stilts the Sand River and its riverbed are sharp in every detail.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Sand River shines below the Varty Camp chalets, on the site of the first 1926 camp.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the bush this morning, and the Sand River goes from bright to dull and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the open-air lounge under its thatched roof, guests follow patches of afternoon sun as they drift over the bush.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Sand River loses its shine, and the green of its banks looks deeper from Tree Camp's deck.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the far bank of the Sand River today, and the trees behind it fade into the grey.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today; the Sand River is clear in front of the camps, and the bush further back cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Sand River, and guests in the Pioneer Camp suites watch the drops mark the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Sand River and its banks for a second at a time, and thunder rolls over the bush in between.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Sand River, and the flakes settle on both banks while the water stays dark.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the thin winter bush lets the eye travel far along the Sand River.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the outdoor decks stay empty, and the Sand River flows past with only the bush for company.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the plunge pool on the deck and watch the bush beyond the railing for elephants.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit on Tree Camp's deck above the Sand River and wait for wildlife to pass below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills the Sand River, and guests in the Private Granite Suites look over it from their outdoor baths.
phrases.partly_golden: Seen from the open-air lounge, the last sun finds gaps in the clouds and turns parts of the bush gold.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening is cloudy and starless, and the Sand River is a faint grey band beyond the lanterns of the camp.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and guests in the Varty Camp chalets watch it blur the near bank of the Sand River.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars on this mild night, and the Sand River shows only as a soft gleam below Tree Camp's deck.
phrases.clear_night: Only 64 beds in five camps share this clear night sky, full of stars above the Sand River and the bush.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Sand River keeps moving in the dark, and the bush on both banks is still.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the Sand River holds that light while the bush around it darkens.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear over South Beach, and the Atlantic Ocean is still a dark surface beyond the oceanfront pool.
phrases.clear_morning: From the oceanfront balconies, guests look over the white sand of South Beach to a turquoise Atlantic Ocean under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Atlantic Ocean is bright turquoise in front of the oceanfront pool, with no cloud above South Beach.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning clouds drift over South Beach, and their shadows move slowly across the Atlantic Ocean in front of the oceanfront pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the oceanfront suites watch sun and cloud take turns over South Beach this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns the colour of steel and the white sand of South Beach looks paler.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens South Beach today, and from the oceanfront pool the Atlantic Ocean fades into the sky with no clear horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far horizon is not visible today; guests at the oceanfront pool see the sand of South Beach and the first waves only.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on South Beach, and guests watch it cross the Atlantic Ocean from behind the windows of the oceanfront rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and for a second the whole of South Beach turns white under the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on South Beach, and white flakes land on white sand in front of the oceanfront pool.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air makes the horizon sharp today, and South Beach lies empty beside a deep blue Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Atlantic Ocean is dark blue with white wave tops, and the sand of South Beach is quiet.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the oceanfront pool and look out at a shining Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.warm: On this warm day the teal umbrellas are open on South Beach, and guests lie under them facing the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the sand of South Beach gold, and the Atlantic Ocean in front of the oceanfront pool becomes a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Atlantic Ocean pink and orange, and guests at this 1941 hotel watch from the oceanfront pool.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and South Beach is a pale band between the garden palms and the black Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on South Beach this evening, and the Atlantic Ocean is only a sound behind the wet palms.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, cloud hides the stars, and guests on the oceanfront balconies see white lines of surf along South Beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and the sand of South Beach is faintly grey below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours South Beach is empty, and the Atlantic Ocean moves quietly in the dark beyond the sand.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Atlantic Ocean just after sunset, and the first lights come on along South Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the tallest Brisbane skyscrapers stand as dark towers against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool, guests see the tallest Brisbane skyscrapers sharp and bright under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The CBD skyline stands in full midday light, each glass tower easy to tell apart from the rooftop.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift behind the Brisbane skyscrapers this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the glass towers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From a private balcony on the top floor, guests in the Valley Suite watch clouds pass over the CBD this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the CBD towers take the same colour as the clouds above them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Brisbane skyline today, and the tallest skyscrapers look like a faint drawing from the rooftop.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far towers of the CBD are not clear today; from the rooftop, guests see only the nearest high-rises of the city.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the CBD; guests in the Valley Suite watch it from inside, the towers slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Brisbane skyscrapers, and guests watch the storm cross the city from the Rock Star Suites.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Brisbane, and the tallest skyscrapers slowly turn white behind the glass balustrade of the rooftop.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the city skyline looks very sharp from the rooftop, every tower edge clear against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look at the CBD panorama from inside the Valley Suite and leave the balcony for later.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look at the city skyline from the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day at the rooftop pool, books stay closed while guests look at the tallest Brisbane skyscrapers instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the Brisbane skyscrapers gold, and guests at ABOVE watch the colour change.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights a few CBD towers at a time, like a slow roll call.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit windows of the city skyline glow beyond the rooftop's glass balustrade.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Brisbane skyscrapers run together on the glass balustrade of the rooftop.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, low cloud carries the glow of the city, and the lit towers stand bright beyond the rooftop pool.
phrases.clear_night: The tallest Brisbane skyscrapers shine against a clear night sky, and guests at ABOVE count the lit floors.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the CBD skyline is quiet and still, a row of tall towers above the sleeping Valley.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright behind the city skyline, and the first tower lights come on beyond the rooftop pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the waterhole is a still grey shape below the private suite decks, and the bush around it is only starting to show.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the waterhole, and guests in the villa kitchen watch it over their first coffee.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the waterhole lies flat and bright in front of the gazebo.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the bush this morning, and the waterhole goes from silver to brown and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of afternoon sun move slowly over the waterhole, easy to follow from the main pool deck.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the waterhole and the bush take the same soft colour, and guests in the gazebo look for any shape that moves.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze thins the bush to a soft outline today, and the waterhole is the clearest thing in sight.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far bush is not visible today; through the lounge's glass walls, guests see the nearest trees and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the waterhole, and guests under the gazebo's thatch watch small rings spread across it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the bush for a second at a time, and guests in the lounge watch the storm through the glass walls.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the bush, and guests in the spa treatment room watch the flakes through its open walls.
phrases.very_cold: In very cold, clear air, the waterhole looks sharp and close from the main pool deck.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the villa lounge keep the waterhole in sight without stepping onto the deck.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests cool off on the main pool deck and look across to the waterhole, where the animals have had the same idea.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests in the suites overlooking the waterhole sit in their plunge pools and watch who comes to drink.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light lies on the waterhole, and with at most 24 guests here, nobody in the gazebo has to share the front row.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud, and the sky turns pink over the waterhole and the bush.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening sky of cloud, the lit thatch of the main lodge is reflected in the dark waterhole.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and guests in the lounge see the wet bush shine just beyond the glass walls.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the waterhole is a dark shape beyond the gazebo, and guests listen as much as they look.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the riverbed, the same watercourse where dinner is sometimes laid at night.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the waterhole lies black and quiet, with 14,000 hectares of unfenced bush around it.
phrases.dusk: From the deck with the fire bowl, the trees turn to silhouettes against a still-bright sky as the first lanterns are lit.

phrases.clear_predawn: Day has not started yet, and the London Eye waits beside the Thames under a clear sky that is only beginning to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Early risers in the One Bedroom Suites open the curtains to find the London Eye and Big Ben already in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At ICHI Sushi & Sashimi Bar, guests eat lunch with Big Ben clear in the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Over coffee in the Executive Lounge, guests watch Big Ben go from shade to sun and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: One patch of sunlight travels along the London Eye, lighting a few capsules at a time.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud sits over the London Eye today, and the wheel keeps turning slowly beneath it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze makes the London Eye look pale today, and Big Ben is only a soft shape behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today leaves the London Eye as a grey outline, and the Houses of Parliament cannot be seen clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the London Eye, and guests in the One Bedroom Suites watch it turn through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Executive Lounge look up from their cups as lightning shows Big Ben sharp against the dark clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the London Eye, and the Houses of Parliament are almost lost in the white.
phrases.very_cold: The London Eye stands sharp and clear in the freezing air, each capsule easy to count.
phrases.cold: On a cold day like this, guests in the Executive Lounge stay inside with a hot drink and a view of Big Ben.
phrases.very_hot: The London Eye turns slowly in the strong sun, and Big Ben stands in a light heat haze.
phrases.warm: Guests in the One Bedroom Suites start this warm day with a look at the London Eye and Big Ben.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Big Ben becomes a dark tower against gold light as the sun drops behind the Houses of Parliament.
phrases.partly_golden: For a few minutes the upper capsules of the London Eye glow orange while the clouds keep the rest in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at ICHI Sushi & Sashimi Bar has Big Ben for company this evening, lit against the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain on the glass turns the lights of the London Eye into soft circles tonight for guests in the One Bedroom Suites.
phrases.mild_night: The London Eye is lit tonight, a bright ring in the dark, with the Houses of Parliament glowing further back.
phrases.clear_night: Nobody at dinner in ICHI Sushi & Sashimi Bar needs a watch tonight, with Big Ben standing in the clear night across the Thames.
phrases.late_night: While the city sleeps, the London Eye stands still beside the Thames, like a big toy put away for the night.
phrases.dusk: Lights begin to come on along the Houses of Parliament just after sunset, while the sky behind them is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Arabian Gulf is a wide stretch of deep blue under a clear sky, and the horizon is just starting to lighten.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lies flat on the Arabian Gulf, and guests in gulf-facing rooms see open water right to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: From Koo Madame, the Arabian Gulf is bright blue along the waterfront under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows drift across the Arabian Gulf this morning, while the Lusail skyline on the other side stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Beyond the edge of the infinity pool, the Arabian Gulf changes from blue to grey and back as clouds pass this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Arabian Gulf turns silver, and the Lusail skyline stands clear against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Lusail skyline today, and the towers fade one behind another like a drawing half rubbed out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon of the Arabian Gulf is not visible today; from the rooftop terrace, the sea is clear only close to the shore.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the marina, and guests in the Reef Suite watch the Lusail skyline blur behind wet windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Arabian Gulf, and guests high in the 37- and 40-floor towers watch the storm cross the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the marina, and the Lusail skyline turns white and faint behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear today, and from the rooftop terrace the Arabian Gulf shows a sharp blue horizon.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests at Koo Madame look out at the Arabian Gulf, steel blue along the waterfront.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across the Arabian Gulf, which shimmers almost white.
phrases.warm: Guests on the sun loungers by the infinity pool look past the water's edge to the calm, warm Arabian Gulf.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Seen from the rooftop terrace, the calm Arabian Gulf turns gold in the low afternoon sun.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests in rooms facing the Lusail skyline see the last sun catch the towers while the clouds above turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: At Stoke & Stoker, guests look over the Arabian Gulf, dark under the evening cloud, with a cocktail for company.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass tonight, and the lights of the Lusail skyline spread into soft colours across the wet marina.
phrases.mild_night: Guests look out on a mild, cloudy night as the lit Lusail skyline gives the low clouds a soft glow.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Lusail skyline is fully lit on one side, and the Arabian Gulf lies dark and quiet on the other.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Arabian Gulf is black and still, and the sea and the sky become one.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and the first lights come on along the Lusail skyline while the Arabian Gulf still holds the bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Charles Bridge is a row of dark arches over the Vltava River, and the sky behind Prague Castle is still deep blue.
phrases.clear_morning: From the CottoCrudo terrace, clear morning light shows the Vltava River in front and Prague Castle on the hill beyond.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests in river-facing rooms can count the arches of Charles Bridge one by one.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Prague Castle this morning, while the Vltava River below stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of afternoon sun cross the Vltava River toward Prague Castle, a slow show seen from the CottoCrudo terrace.
phrases.overcast: The Vltava River turns the same grey as the sky today, and Charles Bridge stands darker above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on the Vltava River today, and only the nearest arches of Charles Bridge show through it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Prague Castle is difficult to make out today; guests see Charles Bridge and the near bank of the Vltava River clearly, and little beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Vltava River with small circles, and guests watch Charles Bridge shine wet from their river-facing rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Prague Castle for a second at a time, and thunder rolls over the Vltava River before the next flash.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Charles Bridge, and guests watch it turn the old stone white above the grey Vltava River.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Prague Castle looks sharp and close above the Vltava River, every roof clear against the sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the CottoCrudo terrace is quiet, yet the Vltava River and Prague Castle are as clear as ever from there.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests on the CottoCrudo terrace choose the shade and look out at the Vltava River, which seems to move as slowly as they do.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests stay long after lunch on the CottoCrudo terrace, looking across the Vltava River to Prague Castle.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills the floor-to-ceiling windows of the river-facing rooms as the sun goes down behind Prague Castle and Charles Bridge.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud and colours the Vltava River orange under Charles Bridge.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests at MIRU on the rooftop look across to the lit walls of Prague Castle.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of Charles Bridge stretch into long reflections on the Vltava River.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so the lights of Prague Castle and Charles Bridge do the work instead.
phrases.clear_night: From MIRU, the rooftop restaurant with only four tables, guests see Prague Castle and Charles Bridge lit under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Vltava River runs dark and quiet, and guests in the Royal Suite have Charles Bridge to themselves.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lamps come on along Charles Bridge for guests in this hotel of 4 joined buildings.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Avenida dos Aliados lies quiet and empty below, under a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests on the suite balconies start the day looking down on Avenida dos Aliados in clean morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands over Avenida dos Aliados, and every stone facade along the boulevard looks sharp and bright.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Porto this morning, and their shadows cross Avenida dos Aliados one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony of the Tower Duplex Suite on the 5th floor, guests follow patches of sun and cloud across Porto.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the stone buildings of Avenida dos Aliados take the same quiet colour as the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills Avenida dos Aliados today; guests looking down see the near side clearly and guess at the rest.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the far end of Avenida dos Aliados is not visible and only the nearest blocks are clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Avenida dos Aliados; from the Porto Suite, guests watch it run down the glass and soften the boulevard.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Porto, and each flash of lightning shows Avenida dos Aliados white for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Avenida dos Aliados, and guests watch the boulevard slowly turn white from above.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing, bright day, guests stay in the warmth and look down at Avenida dos Aliados in sharp winter light.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the rooms with city views look out over Porto from behind closed windows.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, Avenida dos Aliados shimmers below, and guests watch people cross the boulevard looking for shade.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, the balcony of the Avenida Suite is a good seat for watching people walk along Avenida dos Aliados.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the stone of Avenida dos Aliados gold, and guests in this 1923 building look down on it from above.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lights Avenida dos Aliados one facade at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Avenida dos Aliados glow below, and the low sky holds some of that glow.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Avenida dos Aliados are doubled in the shining pavement below.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests look down at Avenida dos Aliados, lit and calm under a sky without stars.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above Porto tonight, though the lit boulevard of Avenida dos Aliados wins the contest easily.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Avenida dos Aliados is nearly empty, and the boulevard looks even wider than by day.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Avenida dos Aliados.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Table Mountain is a flat dark shape above the quiet marina, and the sky above it is starting to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Flint & Fennel, the wide picture windows show the harbour in clear morning light, with boats already moving in and out.
phrases.clear_midday: Table Mountain stands sharp against a blue midday sky, its flat top easy to trace from the mountain-facing terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud lies over the top of Table Mountain this morning like a cloth on a table, while the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront below stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon tea at Flint & Fennel has competition today, as cloud shadows cross the harbour beyond the picture windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean and the harbour take the same flat colour, and the white yachts in the marina stand out.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken the top of Table Mountain today, so the lobby's tall windows frame the masts and quays of the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront instead.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Table Mountain is not visible today; from Club InterContinental, guests see the harbour and the nearest piers clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the marina, and guests in the mountain-facing rooms watch Table Mountain turn grey behind the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the outline of Table Mountain for a second, and guests in Flint & Fennel watch the storm cross the harbour.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront, and guests in the lobby watch the quays and the moored boats slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, clear day, guests stay on the warm side of the Club InterContinental windows, where the city and the harbour look sharp in the cold air.
phrases.cold: The day is cold, and from the sea-facing rooms the Atlantic Ocean looks dark blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests lie on loungers set in the shallows of the pool and look out over the harbour and the open water.
phrases.warm: At Solandra, pizza arrives beside the pool on this warm day, and guests look over the Granger Bay precinct between slices.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the cliffs of Table Mountain gold, and in the Table Mountain Suite the mountain fills the glass, as the name promised.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud and lights the harbour in patches below the pool deck.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in Club InterContinental take their canapés by the windows and look across the lit city and harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the picture windows of Flint & Fennel this evening, and the harbour lights beyond them blur into long streaks.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the city lights glow below Table Mountain, which is only a darker shape against the sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above Table Mountain tonight, and the lights of the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront shine on the still water of the marina.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the marina is still, the yachts do not move, and the 306 rooms have the harbour to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The first lights come on around the marina under a bright sky after sunset, in front of a hotel that Nelson Mandela opened in 1997.

phrases.clear_predawn: Msheireb Town Square is empty and still before sunrise, and the sky behind the Doha skyline is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Msheireb Town Square, and guests in Baraha Lounge watch it over a first coffee.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, the low roofs of Msheireb Downtown look bright and sharp under the clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Msheireb Town Square this morning, easy to follow from the Baraha Suites.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon tea in Baraha Lounge has a panoramic view of Msheireb Town Square, where sun and cloud take turns.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Doha skyline loses its shine, and the towers stand in one even colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Doha skyline today, and from Aqua on the rooftop the city seems to fade at its edges.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Doha skyline is not visible from the Baraha Suites today, so Msheireb Town Square below gets all the attention.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Msheireb Town Square, and guests in Baraha Lounge watch the paving turn dark and shiny.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Doha skyline, and guests in the Baraha Suites watch the storm from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Msheireb Town Square, and guests in Baraha Lounge put down their cups to look at it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and from the rooftop pool every roof of Msheireb Downtown has a clean edge.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, Baraha Lounge is a warm seat for looking over Msheireb Town Square.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look over the low roofs of Msheireb Downtown from the water.
phrases.warm: At Aqua on the rooftop, guests sit with a cold drink and look across the city in the warm air.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights the Doha skyline, and the towers shine as if they were polished for the occasion.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over Msheireb Downtown, and from Aqua the roofs below turn gold for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the city glow below Aqua, and the low sky holds some of that glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lamps of Msheireb Town Square tonight, and Baraha Lounge keeps its guests dry behind the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lit Doha skyline stands out against a sky without stars.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of Msheireb Downtown spread out below the rooftop pool.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Msheireb Town Square is quiet, with nobody crossing it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the suite terraces the first lights appear along the Doha skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the CN Tower stands as a tall dark shape against a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the 18th-floor Fairmont Gold Lounge, guests look out at the CN Tower in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: The CN Tower rises to the southwest under a clear midday sky, every line of it sharp from the 18th-floor lounge.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move past the top of the CN Tower this morning, and their shadows cross the Financial District below.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in south-facing rooms watch the afternoon clouds drift behind the CN Tower.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the CN Tower turns the same grey, and the Financial District towers stand quiet around it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the CN Tower today, so guests see only its lower half above the downtown streets.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today; the CN Tower is a faint outline, and the far towers of the Financial District cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of the 18th-floor lounge, and the CN Tower looks slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay close to the window as lightning flashes behind the CN Tower and thunder rolls over the Financial District.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Financial District, and the CN Tower fades in and out behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests keep to the warm side of the glass and study the CN Tower in very clear air.
phrases.cold: The cold air makes the CN Tower look close and exact from the south-facing rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the downtown roofs, and the CN Tower stands in a pale, bright sky.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in this 1929 hotel look out at the CN Tower above the busy downtown streets.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the Financial District gold, and the CN Tower throws a long shadow across the city.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day comes through broken clouds and lights one side of the CN Tower.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit CN Tower glows softly, and guests enjoy it with evening canapés in the Fairmont Gold Lounge.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the CN Tower spread into soft colours on the wet evening glass.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud catches the glow of the city tonight, and the lit CN Tower climbs into it.
phrases.clear_night: The CN Tower is lit against a clear night sky, and the Financial District shines in every direction from the 18th-floor lounge.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who cannot sleep find the CN Tower still standing over the quiet downtown streets.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on in the Financial District towers around the CN Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Hohensalzburg Fortress is a dark shape above the sleeping Old Town.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in IMLAUER Sky Bar & Restaurant, guests see Hohensalzburg Fortress and the mountains in clear morning light through the panoramic windows.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Hohensalzburg Fortress and Salzburg Cathedral share the same frame on the Old Town skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Tower Suite, guests watch cloud shadows move across the city towards Hohensalzburg Fortress this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift past this afternoon, and Hohensalzburg Fortress goes in and out of sunshine on its hillside.
phrases.overcast: The sky is flat and grey today, yet Hohensalzburg Fortress stays easy to find above the Old Town.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Old Town today, and Hohensalzburg Fortress seems to float with no hill under it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The mountains are not visible today; from IMLAUER Sky Bar & Restaurant guests still see Hohensalzburg Fortress and Salzburg Cathedral.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the panoramic windows of IMLAUER Sky Bar & Restaurant, and Hohensalzburg Fortress looks slightly blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city, and guests in the Tower Suite watch lightning flash behind Hohensalzburg Fortress.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Old Town, and Hohensalzburg Fortress turns white a little at a time.
phrases.very_cold: From the sauna terrace, Salzburg's local mountains stand sharp in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the panoramic windows on the 6th floor and look across at Hohensalzburg Fortress.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the sauna terrace look at Salzburg's local mountains and happily skip the sauna.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the rooftop terrace look over the Old Town to Hohensalzburg Fortress and the Alps beyond.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the walls of Hohensalzburg Fortress gold, and Salzburg Cathedral catches the same light beside it.
phrases.partly_golden: With a sundowner in hand, guests watch the sun slip between the clouds and behind the mountain peaks.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in IMLAUER Sky Bar & Restaurant, guests look at the lit Hohensalzburg Fortress under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and through the streaked windows of the Tower Suite the lit Hohensalzburg Fortress still shows clearly.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lit Hohensalzburg Fortress stands out against the low sky.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests in this 192-room hotel find Hohensalzburg Fortress lit on its hillside, with stars over it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Old Town is quiet, and Hohensalzburg Fortress is only an outline on the skyline.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on in the Old Town below Hohensalzburg Fortress.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky turns pale behind the Melbourne skyline, and Port Phillip Bay is still a sheet of grey.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests at breakfast in the Club Lounge look over the Melbourne skyline in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Port Phillip Bay is bright blue from the indoor infinity pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Melbourne skyline this morning, and the Yarra River shines between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Yarra Suite, guests follow the Yarra River through the city while afternoon clouds drift above it.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Port Phillip Bay takes the colour of the clouds, and the towers of the Melbourne skyline stand out in front.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Melbourne skyline today, and the Yarra River fades into it a short way from the city.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Port Phillip Bay is not visible today; the view stops at the nearer towers of the Melbourne skyline and the Yarra River below.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass by the indoor infinity pool, and swimmers see the Melbourne skyline blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Club Lounge watch lightning flash over Port Phillip Bay while thunder rolls across the Melbourne skyline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Melbourne skyline, and guests at the windows reach for their phones before their coats.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, clear day, guests swim in the indoor infinity pool and look far across Port Phillip Bay.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests on the gym treadmills warm up with the city and Port Phillip Bay in front of them.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Melbourne skyline, and Port Phillip Bay looks cool and inviting from behind the glass.
phrases.warm: Warm light fills the harbour view rooms, where guests look down on Victoria Harbour and out to Port Phillip Bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass towers of the Melbourne skyline gold, and guests in the indoor infinity pool stop swimming to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and lights the Yarra River, while the Dandenong Ranges turn deep blue far away.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low evening cloud, the lights of the Melbourne skyline glow, and guests in the Club Lounge watch them over a drink.
phrases.wet_evening: From Atria, the lights of the Melbourne skyline shine through wet glass this evening, and the Yarra River becomes a ribbon of reflections.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the clouds above the Melbourne skyline glow softly with the light of the city.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in all 257 rooms have the lit Melbourne skyline below them and the stars above.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Port Phillip Bay is a wide dark space beyond the city, and the Yarra River runs quietly towards it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Port Phillip Bay as the first lights come on across the Melbourne skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky turns pale behind Frenchman Mountain, and the Strip waits for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Strip under a clear sky, and guests can follow it toward the distant mountains.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Sphere stands round against Frenchman Mountain, and every ridge behind it is sharp.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly along the Strip this morning, covering one block and then the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the east-facing suites see clouds drift over Frenchman Mountain this afternoon while the Sphere stays in the sun.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits low over the Strip today, and the Sphere looks like the one round thing in a city of straight lines.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Strip today, and Frenchman Mountain is only a faint outline behind the Sphere.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Frenchman Mountain is not visible today; guests see the Sphere and the nearer part of the Strip, and the rest fades into pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch the Strip turn shiny and wet below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Frenchman Mountain, and for a second guests see the whole Strip in white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Strip, and guests stop what they are doing to watch the flakes pass the Sphere.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold, clear air, Frenchman Mountain looks close enough to touch behind the Sphere.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look out at the Strip from at least 720 square feet of warm suite and feel no need to go down.
phrases.very_hot: The Strip shimmers in the strong heat, and from above the seven pools look full of guests cooling off.
phrases.warm: The Strip lies in warm light today, busy with people walking from one end to the other.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Frenchman Mountain gold, and guests watch the Sphere catch the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Strip turn orange, and guests look up from their phones.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Strip colour the sky, and the Sphere glows in front of the dark shape of Frenchman Mountain.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the lights of the Strip twice, once in the air and once on the wet road.
phrases.mild_night: Guests on the upper floors watch the Sphere change its display tonight, with the cloud above it lit by the Strip.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the Sphere's display burns against Frenchman Mountain, and guests find it difficult to close the curtains.
phrases.late_night: The Strip grows quiet in the small hours, and guests who are still awake look down on a nearly empty road.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the Sphere's display comes on, and the first lights appear along the Strip.

phrases.clear_predawn: Guests who wake early find Tower Bridge still a dark outline above the Thames.
phrases.clear_morning: At the Coffee bar at the entrance, guests take their first coffee with the city already bright outside.
phrases.partly_morning: Over breakfast, guests watch the Thames turn from silver to brown each time a cloud covers the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and shade take turns on Tower Bridge this afternoon, and the Thames changes colour with them.
phrases.overcast: Tower Bridge and the Thames share the same quiet grey today, like an old photograph.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze has taken the top of The Shard today, leaving Tower Bridge as the clearest shape in the view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests can see Tower Bridge and the Thames well today, but the skyline further off is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain keeps guests a little longer at the Coffee bar at the entrance, watching umbrellas cross the city outside.
phrases.thunderstorm: Dark storm cloud sits low on The Shard, and guests count the seconds between flash and thunder.
phrases.snow: Tower Bridge turns white at the edges as snow falls into the Thames, and guests watch from indoors, in the warm.
phrases.very_cold: Tower Bridge looks close enough to touch in the freezing air, though no guest is going outside to try.
phrases.very_hot: On the rooftop, guests look for shade and gaze down at the cool Thames running under Tower Bridge.
phrases.warm: Guests go up to the rooftop in shirt sleeves and stay a while, with Tower Bridge and the skyline in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the towers of Tower Bridge a warm yellow, and the Thames below takes the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests watch the glass of The Shard turn orange in the last sun while clouds keep the rest of the skyline grey.
phrases.grey_evening: Before dinner, guests take a last look at Tower Bridge, lit now under a low ceiling of cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: City lights tremble on the wet Thames tonight, and guests are glad to watch the rain from indoors.
phrases.mild_night: Across the Thames, The Shard is a tall column of lights tonight, its top hidden in cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the rooftop looks straight at a lit Tower Bridge, with the Thames dark beneath it.
phrases.dusk: Guests watch the first lights of the city come on while the sky above the skyline is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear, and the Gulf of Thailand slowly separates from it along the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: At Sunrise Pool and Bar, the morning light lies on the Gulf of Thailand, right on time for a bar with that name.
phrases.clear_midday: From a villa balcony, guests see three clear layers at midday: green forest, a band of beach, then the Gulf of Thailand.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows drift across the Gulf of Thailand this morning, and the tables of Phirom Terrace look straight out at them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the two outdoor pools, guests watch clouds move over the Gulf of Thailand while the forest around them stays bright green.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Gulf of Thailand turns the colour of slate, and the beach is a light band in front of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Gulf of Thailand seems to fade into the sky beyond the beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far horizon is not visible today; from Phirom Terrace, guests see the forest, the beach and only the nearest water of the Gulf of Thailand.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Gulf of Thailand, and guests watch it from their villa balconies as the forest drips in front of them.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Gulf of Thailand, and for a moment the whole surface of the water turns white beyond the forest.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Gulf of Thailand, and guests on their villa balconies watch the flakes settle on the forest canopy.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Gulf of Thailand looks sharp and deep blue from Phirom Terrace, and the sand in front of it is empty.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the two outdoor pools lie still, and the Gulf of Thailand beyond them is a cool grey-blue.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the outdoor pools and look over the beach at the flat, bright Gulf of Thailand.
phrases.warm: Guests on the warm sand look out at the Gulf of Thailand, which lies on every side of the island, so there is no wrong way to face.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the forest around the 24 villas, and the Gulf of Thailand beyond the beach turns from blue to gold.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests at Phirom Terrace see the clouds turn orange above the Gulf of Thailand.
phrases.grey_evening: Under the evening cloud, the Gulf of Thailand is a dim grey from the pool edge, a little lighter than the forest around it.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain makes rings on the pool water, and beyond it the Gulf of Thailand disappears into the wet night.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests on a villa balcony see the Gulf of Thailand as a wide, starless dark beyond the forest.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the Gulf of Thailand, and with no building taller than the trees, nothing competes with them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Gulf of Thailand is quiet and nearly black beyond the sleeping forest.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Gulf of Thailand, and the forest in front of it becomes a dark outline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Río de la Plata is a wide dark band beyond the sleeping city, and the sky above it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Tower Suites, guests watch the clear morning light reach the top of the Buenos Aires skyline and move down towards the streets.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Río de la Plata stretches flat to the horizon, and every building on the Buenos Aires skyline stands sharp.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Buenos Aires skyline this morning, and guests can follow them all the way out to the Río de la Plata.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the city this afternoon, and the Río de la Plata changes between silver and grey as they pass.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Río de la Plata and the clouds take the same colour, and only the Buenos Aires skyline stands out.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Buenos Aires skyline today, and guests high in the tower see the Río de la Plata only as a faint brightness.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Río de la Plata is not visible today; guests see the nearer buildings of the city clearly, and the skyline fades behind them.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the city; from the Tower Suites guests watch it sweep across the skyline and blur the Río de la Plata.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Río de la Plata, and for a second the whole Buenos Aires skyline shows against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the city, and guests stand at the windows as the flakes slowly hide the Buenos Aires skyline.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, so the Buenos Aires skyline shows every edge and the Río de la Plata shines beyond it.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep the windows closed and look across the city to the wide Río de la Plata.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the room balconies use the outdoor shower, then look over the city from their sun loungers.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests look past the Buenos Aires skyline to where the Río de la Plata fills the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in this 1929 tower see the late sun turn the Río de la Plata gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and lights the Buenos Aires skyline from the side, one building after another.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud holds the glow of the city this evening, and the Buenos Aires skyline shines under it.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and through the streaming glass the lights of the Buenos Aires skyline spread into soft spots.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests at the top of the 20-floor tower look across the lights of the Buenos Aires skyline towards the Río de la Plata.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show over the Río de la Plata tonight, though the lit Buenos Aires skyline gives them serious competition.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and nothing moves on the Río de la Plata beyond the last buildings.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the Tower Suites guests watch the first lights come on across the Buenos Aires skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale above the Arpoador rocks, and the sand of Ipanema Beach is still grey.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Ipanema Beach under a clear sky, and from the rooftop pool the Two Brothers Mountain looks close enough to count its trees.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the sea off Ipanema Beach and the water of the rooftop pool are almost the same blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Two Brothers Mountain this morning, while Ipanema Beach below stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From their sea-facing balconies, guests watch cloud shadows cross Ipanema Beach and move out over the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the sea off Ipanema Beach turns the colour of steel, and the Arpoador rocks stand out darker at one end.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Ipanema Beach today, and the Two Brothers Mountain looks like a pencil drawing behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Corcovado does not show from the rooftop pool today, and only the nearer sand of Ipanema Beach and the first waves are clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Ipanema Beach, and guests in the oceanfront suites watch it wet the sand and the palm trees along the avenue.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm moves over the sea, and each flash of lightning shows the Arpoador rocks for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Ipanema Beach, and from the rooftop pool the Arpoador rocks fade behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day, the air is sharp, and the Arpoador rocks and the Two Brothers Mountain show every edge above Ipanema Beach.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the oceanfront rooms stay behind the glass and watch the waves roll onto an almost empty Ipanema Beach.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look down at the crowded sand of Ipanema Beach.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, books stay closed while guests look along Ipanema Beach to the Arpoador rocks instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Pool Bar on the 8th floor, guests watch the sun go down over Ipanema Beach, and here they really do applaud.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun turns the clouds orange above the Two Brothers Mountain, and the rooftop pool takes the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lamps along the avenue draw a curve of light beside Ipanema Beach.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests watch from their balconies as rain falls through the lights along the Ipanema waterfront.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lights of the waterfront follow Ipanema Beach all the way to the foot of the Two Brothers Mountain.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Two Brothers Mountain is a black outline against the stars, and white lines of surf show on Ipanema Beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Ipanema Beach lies empty and quiet, a wide band of sand beside the black sea.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright above the rooftop of this 2007 Philippe Starck design, and the first lights appear along Ipanema Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Lake Como is still dark below the Lake View rooms, and only its edge has begun to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Presidential Rooftop Suite wake to a clear morning over Como's western shore.
phrases.clear_midday: The Rooftop infinity pool and Lake Como share the same blue at this hour, with only a thin edge between them.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Decked roof terrace, the lake changes from grey to silver and back as the clouds pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Lake Como is half in sun and half in shade this afternoon, seen from the Lake View rooms.
phrases.overcast: From Terrazza 241, the lake looks soft and grey under today's clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze has made Lake Como pale, and from the pool the water seems to go on without an end.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests in the Lake View rooms see the near part of Lake Como clearly today, while the far water fades into pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Rooftop infinity pool and on Lake Como behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Como's western shore, and guests in the Presidential Rooftop Suite watch the storm from inside.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the Decked roof terrace, and the lake beyond it has turned a deep grey.
phrases.very_cold: Lake Como looks sharp and bright from the Lake View rooms today, and guests enjoy it from inside.
phrases.cold: The pool has no swimmers today, so Lake Como beyond it gets all the attention.
phrases.very_hot: Guests cool off in the Rooftop infinity pool, looking across the water to Lake Como.
phrases.warm: Guests stay long on Terrazza 241 today, facing the lake in the warm air.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lays a warm gold across the lake below the Decked roof terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: From Terrazza 241, the lake catches the last sun in pieces wherever the clouds allow it.
phrases.grey_evening: Seen from Terrazza 241 this evening, the lake is a wide dark surface under a sky full of cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain covers the lake this evening, and guests in the Presidential Rooftop Suite look out at it from indoors.
phrases.mild_night: The lake is a dark, calm surface tonight, and the mild air makes the Decked roof terrace a good place to see it from.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the Presidential Rooftop Suite look out on a clear night over Como before going to sleep.
phrases.late_night: The lake lies dark in these small hours, and the quiet neighbourhood on Como's western shore sleeps beside it.
phrases.dusk: The pool holds the last brightness of the day, and beyond it Lake Como slowly turns from silver to dark blue.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the rooms on the east side, guests see the clear sky turn pale behind the mountains before sunrise.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in La Veduta on the 12th floor, guests see the first sun on the towers of the Osaka skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: The midday sun stands high in a clear sky, and every tower on the Osaka skyline is easy to pick out from the 12th-floor lobby.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Osaka skyline this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the rooftops.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the gym, guests on the machines watch sun and cloud take turns over the Osaka skyline.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits low over Osaka today, and the towers of the skyline are almost the same colour as the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Osaka skyline today, and from the 12th-floor lobby the far towers fade into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The mountains beyond the city are not visible today, and guests see only the nearer buildings of the Osaka skyline.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the large windows of La Veduta, and the Osaka skyline behind them is blurred and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Osaka skyline, and guests in the top-floor Royal Suite watch the storm cross the city.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Osaka, and guests in the 12th-floor lobby watch the rooftops of the skyline turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Osaka skyline is sharp at every edge, and guests look at it from behind warm glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests warm up in the gym, with the Osaka skyline beyond the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.very_hot: Over lunch in La Veduta, guests look at the Osaka skyline in the strong heat and are glad of the glass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the Osaka skyline fills the windows of all 160 rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the towers of the Osaka skyline gold, and the mountains behind the city show clearly.
phrases.partly_golden: From the Matsu Suite on the top floor, guests watch the last sun light the edges of the clouds over the Osaka skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in La Veduta, guests look at the lights of the Osaka skyline under a low, cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Osaka this evening, and the lights of the skyline shine softly through it.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in this 2010 tower look out at clouds glowing softly above the lights of the Osaka skyline.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lights of the Osaka skyline reach as far as guests can see from the 12th-floor lobby.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Osaka skyline is a row of dark shapes, and the city finally looks quiet.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the private dining room guests see the first lights come on in the city towers.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Cascais Bay is still and dark blue, and the Atlantic horizon slowly appears beyond it.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests open their balcony doors to a clear morning over the Atlantic Ocean, blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: From the terrace, the Atlantic horizon is a sharp blue line beyond the stone balustrade at midday.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Cascais Bay this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the sea-facing restaurants, guests watch patches of sun and shade cross the Atlantic Ocean this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Cascais Bay turns the colour of pewter, and the waves show white against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Cascais Bay today, and the place where the Atlantic meets the sky is anyone's guess.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Atlantic horizon is not visible from the terrace today; only the near water of Cascais Bay is clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Cascais Bay, and from the wet terrace the water and the sky share one grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests behind their balcony doors watch lightning flash above the dark water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Cascais Bay, and guests in the sea-facing restaurants watch the flakes disappear into the water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear today, and Cascais Bay shines deep blue in the sunlight.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay in the sea-facing bars and watch white waves run across Cascais Bay.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests sit under the white umbrellas on the terrace and look at the Atlantic Ocean, which looks much cooler.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the rooftop terraces of the Majestic and Royal penthouses see Cascais Bay from end to end.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in this former home of Italy's King Umberto II watch the late sun turn the Atlantic Ocean gold.
phrases.partly_golden: From the terrace, the last sun slips between the clouds and lays an orange path across the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights around Cascais Bay reflect softly on the dark water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of Cascais Bay this evening, and guests in the sea-facing bars are in no hurry to leave.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and the Atlantic Ocean is a wide darkness beyond the terrace.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, stars stand over Cascais Bay, and the water below is black and calm.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Cascais Bay is quiet and black, and only the white of the waves shows.
phrases.dusk: The sky over Cascais Bay is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over Phang Nga Bay, and the limestone karsts stand as dark shapes on still water.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in The Living Room, guests look over the beach to Phang Nga Bay under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the hilltop infinity pool, the midday sun shows every limestone karst in Phang Nga Bay, with the Andaman Sea blue between them.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Phang Nga Bay this morning, and the karsts take turns in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the villas with a bay view, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift between the limestone islands.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Andaman Sea turns grey too, and the karsts of Phang Nga Bay stand out darker from The Hilltop.
phrases.fog_haze: In the haze, the far karsts of Phang Nga Bay fade one behind another like layers of grey paper, seen from the hilltop infinity pool.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Phang Nga Bay is not visible today; from The Living Room, guests see the beach and the nearest limestone islands.
phrases.rain: Rain is crossing Phang Nga Bay, and guests in the hillside villas watch the karsts disappear and return behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Phang Nga Bay, and guests at The Hilltop see the limestone karsts flash white with each strike.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Phang Nga Bay, a sight nobody packed for, and the jungle below the hilltop infinity pool is turning white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, the sun loungers by the hilltop infinity pool are empty, and the karsts of Phang Nga Bay look sharp.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay inside their villas and look through the open blinds at the Andaman Sea and the limestone islands.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the hilltop infinity pool up to their chins and look at the karsts of Phang Nga Bay from there.
phrases.warm: On the private beach, guests lie under white umbrellas in the warm air, with limestone karsts rising from Phang Nga Bay in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the limestone of Phang Nga Bay gold, and from The Hilltop the jungle below glows green.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Phang Nga Bay turn pink, and the karsts below them go from gold to grey.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner at The Hilltop, guests look out at a cloudy evening sky, with the karsts of Phang Nga Bay just visible under it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Phang Nga Bay this evening, and guests in The Living Room see only the wet beach and the first metres of water.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the villas with a bay view the karsts are dark shapes on a slightly lighter sea.
