phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over Phang Nga Bay, and the still water of the hilltop infinity pool holds a few of them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Phang Nga Bay is quiet and black below the hillside, and the karsts wait for morning to show again.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky over Phang Nga Bay is still bright, and the first candles are lit at The Hilltop.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Mount Etna is a dark shape against a sky that slowly turns pale above Taormina Bay.
phrases.clear_morning: At Terrazza, breakfast is served in clear morning light, with Taormina Bay bright blue below the tables.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests at lunch in Bellevue look over Taormina Bay to Mount Etna.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Taormina Bay this morning, while Mount Etna keeps its summit in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop bar, guests follow the clouds drifting along the Calabrian coast, with the Ionian Sea blue in some places and grey in others.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Taormina Bay turns the colour of steel, and Mount Etna stands plain behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Calabrian coast today, and from the rooftop bar Mount Etna is only a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Mount Etna and the far end of Taormina Bay are not visible today, so guests in the sea-view suites see only the near water of the Ionian Sea.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Taormina Bay; guests watch it from the Presidential Suite, where Mount Etna has gone behind the cloud.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Ionian Sea, and for a second the whole curve of Taormina Bay shows white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Taormina Bay, and guests in this 18th-century palazzo watch the flakes disappear into the grey Ionian Sea.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold, clear air, every ridge of Mount Etna is sharp from the rooftop bar.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the balcony rooms keep the doors shut and still have Taormina Bay in front of them.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their chins, eyes level with the Ionian Sea.
phrases.warm: At the pool bar, guests sit with a cold drink on this warm day and look over Taormina Bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Aperitivo at the rooftop bar arrives together with the golden light, which runs from the Calabrian coast to Mount Etna.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lights Mount Etna in pieces, as guests at Bellevue can see.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights along Taormina Bay draw the shore, and guests at dinner in Bellevue follow them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights around Taormina Bay blur into soft yellow spots.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the coast lights curve around Taormina Bay, and the Ionian Sea beyond them is black.
phrases.clear_night: From the rooftop bar, the lights of the Calabrian coast show clearly across the Ionian Sea on this clear night.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Taormina Bay is quiet and dark, and Mount Etna can only be guessed at behind it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright behind Mount Etna while the first lights appear around Taormina Bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Cayuga Lake lies still under a clear sky, and the far bank is only a dark line.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests on the Aurora Inn balconies drink their first coffee above Cayuga Lake while the water turns a clear blue.
phrases.clear_midday: From the guests-only waterfront, Cayuga Lake shines blue at midday under a sky without a cloud.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Cayuga Lake this morning, and guests at breakfast on the veranda of 1833 Kitchen & Bar follow them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From The Spa on the hill, guests look over the treetops to Cayuga Lake, where sun and cloud share the afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Cayuga Lake takes the same colour, and the far bank is a thin green band.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Cayuga Lake today, and from the balconies of the Aurora Inn the water fades away a short distance from the shore.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far bank of Cayuga Lake is not visible today; from the waterfront, guests see only the water near the shore.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Cayuga Lake, and guests watch the drops mark the water from the veranda of 1833 Kitchen & Bar.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Cayuga Lake, and guests in this 1833 inn watch from the balcony rooms as lightning shows the far bank.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Cayuga Lake, and guests at the indoor pool of The Spa watch it through the tall windows.
phrases.very_cold: Cayuga Lake looks sharp and bright in the freezing air, and guests admire it from behind the tall windows of The Spa.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the hot soaking pools at The Spa look through the steam to Cayuga Lake.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests step into Cayuga Lake from the waterfront, and others keep the blue water in sight from the Lakeside Tent.
phrases.warm: Guests push off in kayaks from the waterfront on this warm day, and from out on Cayuga Lake the village is a row of porches.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls across Cayuga Lake late this afternoon, and the lakeside veranda of 1833 Kitchen & Bar glows with it.
phrases.partly_golden: The low sun colours the clouds orange over Cayuga Lake, and guests at The Spa watch the water do the same.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner on the veranda of 1833 Kitchen & Bar, guests look out at Cayuga Lake, dim and grey under the evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Cayuga Lake this evening, and from the veranda of 1833 Kitchen & Bar the water is heard more than seen.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, Cayuga Lake is a wide, quiet darkness under the clouds, with no star above the far bank.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over Cayuga Lake tonight, too many to count from the waterfront.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Cayuga Lake is black and silent, and the empty waterfront is the only edge it has.
phrases.dusk: The sky over Cayuga Lake stays orange after sunset, and from the waterfront the far bank slowly loses its detail.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Empire State Building stands unlit against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Empire State Building, and guests in the rooms facing it watch the tower turn bright.
phrases.clear_midday: The Empire State Building rises into a clear blue sky at midday, each row of windows easy to count.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift behind the Empire State Building this morning, and its spire moves in and out of the sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows slide slowly down the Empire State Building this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Empire State Building turns the same grey, its outline still clear.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Empire State Building today, and guests see only its lower floors.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the Empire State Building is a soft outline and its spire is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the retractable glass roof at Refinery Rooftop, and the Empire State Building looks blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay under the glass roof at Refinery Rooftop while lightning flashes behind the Empire State Building.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the Empire State Building, and guests watch it from the brick-walled room at Refinery Rooftop.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the Empire State Building looks sharp in the clear air, and guests watch it from their warm rooms.
phrases.cold: The cold air is clear today, and the Empire State Building shows every line from base to spire.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests sit on the outdoor terrace at Refinery Rooftop and look across at the Empire State Building.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests fill the outdoor terrace tables, and most chairs seem to face the Empire State Building.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Empire State Building gold, and the colour grows deeper as the afternoon ends.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds behind the Empire State Building turn pink and orange.
phrases.grey_evening: The lit top of the Empire State Building colours the low cloud this evening.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests drink cocktails under the glass roof at Refinery Rooftop, the lit Empire State Building shining through the drops.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky on this mild night, and the lit Empire State Building stands out against them.
phrases.clear_night: The Empire State Building is lit against a clear night sky, seen from a hat factory built in 1912.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Empire State Building is a tall, quiet shape in the room window.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still deep blue after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Empire State Building.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Empire State Building stands as a dark shape against a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Empire State Building, and guests in the west-facing rooms see it clearly from top to bottom.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, the Manhattan skyline is sharp under a clear midday sky, with the Empire State Building rising above it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Manhattan skyline this morning, and the Chrysler Building shines whenever the sun finds it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From 21 floors above Cooper Square, guests watch clouds drift behind One World Trade Center this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Empire State Building takes the colour of the clouds, yet its outline stays clear from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Manhattan skyline today, and the Empire State Building looks like a drawing on grey paper.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: guests can see the Empire State Building, but One World Trade Center and the Chrysler Building are missing from the Manhattan skyline.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in the corner rooms watch the Manhattan skyline turn soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Empire State Building, and guests in The Penthouse watch the storm cross the Manhattan skyline.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the Manhattan skyline, and the top of the Empire State Building disappears into the white sky.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, the Chrysler Building stands out sharply in the Manhattan skyline.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay warm behind the glass of the west-facing rooms and look across to the Empire State Building.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the rooftop terrace lie back while the Manhattan skyline shimmers in front of them.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace, guests take photos of each other in the warm air, and the Empire State Building gets into every picture.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun goes down behind the Manhattan skyline, and golden light fills the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Empire State Building turn orange and pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the Manhattan skyline give the low clouds a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Empire State Building blur on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit top of the Empire State Building takes the place of the moon.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests count the lit towers of the Manhattan skyline, from the Empire State Building down to One World Trade Center.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Manhattan skyline is quiet, and the Empire State Building is a tall outline above the sleeping streets.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright behind the Empire State Building while the first lights appear across the Manhattan skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale above Lake Geneva, and the outline of the Alps slowly appears.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests on the upper lake-facing floors of this 228-room hotel start the day with the Jet d'Eau white against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests watch the Jet d'Eau rise above the blue of Lake Geneva, each fall of spray easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: From the restaurant, guests follow the cloud shadows that cross Lake Geneva this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over Lake Geneva this afternoon, and the Jet d'Eau changes from white to grey and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Lake Geneva turns the colour of slate, and the Jet d'Eau stands out white against it.
phrases.fog_haze: From the outdoor pool, the Jet d'Eau is only a faint white column in the haze over Lake Geneva.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today, but Lake Geneva and the Jet d'Eau remain clear from the high-floor suites.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of Lake Geneva, and guests watch from the floor-to-ceiling windows as the Jet d'Eau fades into the grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Lake Geneva, and lightning shows the water and the far shore for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Lake Geneva, and guests in the restaurant watch the flakes disappear into the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, bright day, the Alps look sharp behind Lake Geneva, and guests admire them from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: The cold air leaves the outdoor heated pool to itself, and Lake Geneva lies wide and steel-blue beyond it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool and swim with the Jet d'Eau in view across Lake Geneva.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the pool loungers count the sailboats on Lake Geneva and keep losing count.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Alps gold, and the Jet d'Eau catches the same light above Lake Geneva.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and Lake Geneva turns pink and gold for a short while.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the restaurant look out at the shore lights, which draw a long curve around Lake Geneva under the evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the shore lights blur and stretch into long reflections on Lake Geneva.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers the stars tonight, and the city lights give the surface of Lake Geneva a soft glow.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests look across the dark water of Lake Geneva to the lights of the far shore.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Geneva lies dark and quiet, a wide open space where the city stops.
phrases.dusk: Seen from the outdoor pool, the sky stays bright after sunset while the first shore lights appear on Lake Geneva.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Adriatic Sea is a still band on the eastern horizon, and the sky above it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the villa roof terraces, guests see the Adriatic Sea lying flat and blue above the rooftops in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: From the golf clubhouse, guests look east over the greens at midday to an unbroken blue line of Adriatic Sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the San Domenico Golf fairways this morning, while the Adriatic Sea beyond them stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the upper balconies of La Corte watch clouds drift out over the Adriatic Sea this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Adriatic Sea turns dull silver past the fairways, and the low coast at Savelletri is easy to follow.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze blurs the place where the Adriatic Sea meets the sky today, and the fairways seem to end in soft white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Adriatic Sea is not visible from the villa roof terraces today; the view stops at the rooftops and the nearest fairways.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the greens, and guests in the golf clubhouse watch the Adriatic Sea turn grey behind them.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is crossing the Adriatic Sea, and lightning shows the fairways and the rocky shore for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the tufo battlements and the fairways, and the Adriatic Sea is only a grey band behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, the Adriatic Sea looks deep blue and very close across the empty fairways.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the golf clubhouse is the comfortable seat, with the greens in front and the Adriatic Sea behind them.
phrases.very_hot: At Cala Masciola, guests leave the sun loungers and take the ladder down into the Adriatic Sea, which is the sensible view today.
phrases.warm: Under the pergola of the terrace restaurant, guests look out at the olive grove on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the pale stone rooftops, and guests on the 28 villa roof terraces look over them to a deep blue Adriatic Sea.
phrases.partly_golden: At Cala Masciola, the last sun colours the clouds above the rocky cove, and the Adriatic Sea turns pink and grey.
phrases.grey_evening: No stars tonight; from this village designed by Pino Brescia, guests see the Adriatic Sea as a dark band under the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain shines on the stone rooftops under the lanterns, and the Adriatic Sea is lost in the dark beyond them.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests climb one flight of stairs and find the Adriatic Sea, dark and calm past the fairways.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Adriatic Sea tonight, and the horizon is a clean edge between two kinds of dark.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the fairways are empty and silent, and the Adriatic Sea lies black and still beyond them.
phrases.dusk: The light leaves the stone slowly after sunset, and the blue band of the Adriatic Sea is the last thing to go dark.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the spires of the Cathedral of Barcelona stand grey above the quiet rooftops of the Gothic Quarter, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool on the 7th floor, the clear morning shows the city all the way from the Sagrada Familia to Montjuïc.
phrases.clear_midday: Brunch at Terraza de Vivi has a clear blue sky today, and the Cathedral of Barcelona stands sharp above the Gothic Quarter rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Gothic Quarter this morning, and from the private balcony the Cathedral of Barcelona goes from bright to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the corner terrace of Suite de Vivi, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the city rooftops.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Cathedral of Barcelona takes the colour of the clouds above the Gothic Quarter rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today; from Terraza de Vivi the Cathedral of Barcelona is still clear, while the Sagrada Familia is only an outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Montjuïc and the Sagrada Familia are not visible today, so the view from the rooftop stops at the nearby rooftops and the Cathedral of Barcelona.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the old streets of the Gothic Quarter, and guests in the balcony rooms watch it from behind their French windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the spires of the Cathedral of Barcelona, and for a second every rooftop in the Gothic Quarter is visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Gothic Quarter, and the rooftops around the Cathedral of Barcelona slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, and from the rooftop the Sagrada Familia looks close enough to count its towers.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the terrace suites still have their view of the Gothic Quarter, best enjoyed with the door closed and a hot coffee.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look across the rooftops to the Cathedral of Barcelona.
phrases.warm: On a warm day at Terraza de Vivi, guests choose a lounge chair and look over the rooftops, squares and streets of central Barcelona.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the spires of the Cathedral of Barcelona gold, and guests at Terraza de Vivi turn their chairs towards them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Montjuïc turn orange, and the city rooftops below slowly lose their light.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Cathedral of Barcelona stands out above the Gothic Quarter, and the city lights colour the sky above it.
phrases.wet_evening: It is a wet evening, and the lights of the Gothic Quarter shine back from the rooftops and the narrow streets.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lit Sagrada Familia shows above the city rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lit spires of the Cathedral of Barcelona stand against a black sky, with the lights of the city all around.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Gothic Quarter is quiet, and the Cathedral of Barcelona is a dark shape above the rooftops.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on around the Cathedral of Barcelona, seen from Terraza de Vivi.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Boston Harbour lies still and dark, and the downtown skyline is a quiet outline across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in rooms facing downtown open the curtains to a clear morning over Boston Harbour, the skyline sharp on the far side.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Boston Harbour is bright blue and every tower of the downtown skyline is easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Boston Harbour this morning, and the downtown skyline goes in and out of sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the corridor with floor-to-ceiling windows, guests see the downtown skyline above the green grounds, under an afternoon sky of cloud and blue.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits low over Boston Harbour today, and the water and the downtown towers share one colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Boston Harbour, and the downtown skyline across the water shows only as a faint grey shape.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: guests can see the near water of Boston Harbour, but the downtown skyline on the other side is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch Boston Harbour turn grey and rough behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Boston Harbour, and for a second the whole downtown skyline shows through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Boston Harbour, and the downtown skyline fades a little more with each minute.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, so the downtown skyline looks close enough to touch across Boston Harbour.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass and watch planes move slowly across the Logan Airport tarmac.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Logan Airport tarmac, while on the city side Boston Harbour looks cool and flat.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, sailboats cross Boston Harbour in front of the downtown skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the suite with windows on two sides, guests have the golden light twice: once on Boston Harbour and once on the downtown skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and patches of warm light travel across Boston Harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of downtown Boston glow across Boston Harbour, and the low sky takes some of their colour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Boston Harbour this evening, and the city lights stretch into long wet reflections on the water.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in harbour-view rooms leave the curtains open for the lit downtown skyline.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the downtown skyline stands lit above Boston Harbour, its reflection lying on the black water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Boston Harbour is quiet, and even the Logan Airport tarmac seems to be sleeping.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights of the downtown skyline come on across Boston Harbour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Early risers find the Mura Serviane as a dark line of old stone, still waiting for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: From the terrace, the whole panorama of Rome stands sharp and bright this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop, St. Peter's dome stands clear above Rome's city buildings.
phrases.partly_morning: Sun and shade take turns on the old stones of the Mura Serviane this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The panorama of Rome is a patchwork this afternoon, with some city buildings in sun and others under passing cloud.
phrases.overcast: The Mura Serviane sit calm and pale under a flat grey sky.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the far side of Rome's panorama today, but the Mura Serviane are still easy to see.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Poor visibility hides St. Peter's dome from the rooftop today, but the Mura Serviane and the nearer city buildings are easy to see.
phrases.rain: Guests in the Junior Suite watch the rain fall on the ruins in the garden.
phrases.thunderstorm: Each flash of lightning shows the panorama of Rome for a second before the storm darkens it again.
phrases.snow: From the Junior Suite, guests watch snow slowly cover the ruins in the garden.
phrases.very_cold: Guests look at the Mura Serviane from indoors today, the old stones sharp in the icy air.
phrases.cold: The panorama of Rome spreads out behind the Mura Serviane, with the gold dome of the bell tower easy to find.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the panorama of Rome shimmers a little, and the Mura Serviane look like the only thing not melting.
phrases.warm: Guests stay out on the terrace in short sleeves, in no hurry to leave the panorama of Rome.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The gold dome of the Roman church bell tower shines in the late light, with the city buildings glowing around it.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop, St. Peter's dome turns dark against the last orange light between the clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: Over dinner, guests look out at the panorama of Rome under a low evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Behind the wet glass of the Junior Suite, guests see the lights of the city beyond blur and the ruins in the garden shine.
phrases.mild_night: Before going to bed, guests take one more look at the Mura Serviane and the panorama of Rome behind them.
phrases.clear_night: In the Junior Suite, guests switch off the lamps to see the ruins in the garden and the lights of the city beyond.
phrases.late_night: Guests still awake find Rome's panorama down to a few scattered lights, with the ancient Roman ruins only shapes in the dark.
phrases.dusk: Seen from the terrace, the panorama of Rome picks up its first lights while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gulf of Salerno lies calm and grey-blue under a clear sky, and the fishing harbour of Conca dei Marini is still asleep below.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests take breakfast on the terrace of Il Refettorio, with the Gulf of Salerno bright and blue under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool and the Gulf of Salerno share the same strong blue, and the pool's edge seems to end in the sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Gulf of Salerno this morning, while the coast towards Amalfi stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace suites, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they move across the Gulf of Salerno towards Amalfi.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Gulf of Salerno turns the colour of slate, and the Conca dei Marini fishing harbour stays clear below.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Gulf of Salerno today, and the coast towards Amalfi fades a little more with each headland.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Amalfi does not show today; the view stops at the Conca dei Marini fishing harbour and the nearest water of the Gulf of Salerno.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Gulf of Salerno, and guests in this 17th-century monastery watch it from their sea-facing windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Gulf of Salerno, and guests watch the storm cross the water from inside Bar la Brocca.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Gulf of Salerno, and guests watch the white flakes disappear into the grey sea from their windows.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and clear, and the coast towards Amalfi shows sharply across the Gulf of Salerno.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Gulf of Salerno is a deep blue, and guests look at it from behind the glass at Bar la Brocca.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look straight down from its edge to the Gulf of Salerno.
phrases.warm: Guests lie beside the infinity pool on this warm day, with the Gulf of Salerno wide and open below the cliff.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Gulf of Salerno late this afternoon, and guests at Bar la Brocca watch it with an aperitif.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Gulf of Salerno, and guests on Convivio Terrace stop talking to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests dine on the terrace of Il Refettorio under a cloudy evening sky, with the lights of the coast shining around the Gulf of Salerno.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights around the bay this evening, and guests at Bar la Brocca watch them from the indoor seats.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, guests take a last drink outside at Bar la Brocca, with the lights of the bay under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Gulf of Salerno, and the lights of Amalfi shine along the coast.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Gulf of Salerno is wide and quiet, and guests who wake find it beyond their windows.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Gulf of Salerno, and the first lights come on along the coast towards Amalfi.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Eiffel Tower is a dark outline against a slowly paling sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From La Comtesse Café, guests see the Tour Eiffel clear in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Each level of the Eiffel Tower is easy to pick out in the midday light.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift behind the Eiffel Tower this morning, and the sun keeps finding it again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows slide up and down the Eiffel Tower this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: The Eiffel Tower looks darker than usual under today's grey cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Through the haze, the Eiffel Tower looks like a pencil drawing today.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Eiffel Tower is only a faint shape today, and the city behind it is not visible.
phrases.rain: The Eiffel Tower stays in view through the rain, grey on grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests at La Comtesse Café watch the thunderstorm pass over the Tour Eiffel.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling across the view, and the Eiffel Tower stands pale behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In today's freezing air, every iron line of the Eiffel Tower shows clearly.
phrases.cold: Guests at La Comtesse Café sit facing the Tour Eiffel today, in no hurry to leave.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the Eiffel Tower stands in full sun with no shade anywhere on it.
phrases.warm: Guests in the four rooms at the bottom of the V look out at the Eiffel Tower this afternoon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun lays a warm gold on one side of the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the Eiffel Tower for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the rooms at the bottom of the V end the evening with the Eiffel Tower in front of them, under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls across the Eiffel Tower this evening, and guests watch it from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers the night over Paris, and the Eiffel Tower is still easy to find.
phrases.clear_night: Nobody in the four rooms at the bottom of the V needs to search for the Eiffel Tower on a night this clear.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Eiffel Tower is a tall dark shape over a sleeping city.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the Eiffel Tower stands dark against a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the cliff wall of Canyon Malacara is a dark shape above the garden under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Hot-air balloons inflate on the lawn beside the cabins this clear morning, with the Malacara escarpment behind them.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the rocky cliffs of Canyon Malacara stand sharp against a blue sky above the garden trees.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests take breakfast in the Malacara Cabin while cloud shadows move slowly across the canyon wall.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the flat top of the escarpment this afternoon, and the forest below changes from bright to dark green.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the wall of Canyon Malacara looks darker, and the garden lawn seems greener in front of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist covers the mountains today, and guests behind the glass fronts see the cliffs of the Southern Brazil Canyons come and go.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The canyon wall is not clear today; guests see the garden, the trees and only a faint outline of the escarpment.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and the cliff wall of Canyon Malacara turns grey behind the wet garden.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Malacara escarpment for a second at a time, and guests watch the storm from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the garden, and guests in the 3 cabins watch the canyon wall turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests stay by the fireplace and look out at the clear, sharp cliffs of Canyon Malacara.
phrases.cold: The air is cold and the escarpment looks close, each rocky ledge easy to see from the garden.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests sit in the deck tub and look straight at the cliff wall of Canyon Malacara.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit on their private patios and look across the garden to the mountains and canyons.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late in the afternoon, the cliff wall of Canyon Malacara stands clear across the garden under a cloudless sky.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds above the escarpment turn pink and orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Night has come under a cloudy sky, and the Malacara escarpment is only a darker edge above the garden.
phrases.wet_evening: This wet evening, guests look out from the fireside at rain on the deck and the black canyon wall beyond.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and guests can only just make out the long flat top of the Southern Brazil Canyons.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above Canyon Malacara, and the top of the cliff cuts a straight edge under them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the garden is quiet, and the Southern Brazil Canyons are hidden in the night.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright behind the escarpment, and guests in the Índios Coroados Cabin watch the canyons darken.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear over the hilltop, and the Tagus River is a faint grey band beyond the sleeping rooftops.
phrases.clear_morning: From the terrace, guests see the Tagus River, the Santa Justa Lift and the Carmo Convent together in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: The Tagus River shines blue at midday, and from the terrace the Santa Justa Lift stands sharp among the rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests at breakfast in the winter garden of Black Pavilion watch cloud shadows cross the city this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds move over the city this afternoon, and the Tagus River changes from blue to silver and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Tagus River turns grey too, and the Carmo Convent looks paler from the terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and from the terrace the Santa Justa Lift looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tagus River is not visible today; from the terrace the view stops at the nearer rooftops and the Carmo Convent.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftops of Lisbon, and guests in the winter garden of Black Pavilion watch the city turn shiny.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Tagus River for a second at a time, and guests count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the cypress trees around the pool, and the Tagus River has disappeared behind the white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, the Carmo Convent and the Santa Justa Lift stand out from the terrace, with the Tagus River bright behind them.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the pool terrace is quiet, and the Tagus River looks sharp and close beyond the rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat guests stay in the panoramic pool, where the cypress trees frame the city rooftops and the Tagus River.
phrases.warm: Guests lie by the panoramic pool on this warm day, and their books lose to the rooftops and the Tagus River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Tagus River gold, and the terrace of the Dom João II Suite frames it together with the Carmo Convent.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the Carmo Convent, while the Tagus River turns pink behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: The sky is cloudy this evening, and guests at dinner in the winter garden of Black Pavilion look out on the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass of the winter garden at Black Pavilion tonight, and the city lights blur into soft colours.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, low cloud holds the glow of the city above the rooftops, and the Tagus River lies beyond them.
phrases.clear_night: From a 1900s palace on a hilltop, guests look down at the bright city and the dark Tagus River under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city below the hilltop is quiet, and the Tagus River is hidden in the dark.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the terrace of the Dom João II Suite the first lights appear near the Santa Justa Lift.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Canton Tower stands unlit and thin against the first grey light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the private terraces of the Signature Loft Suites, where Canton Tower stands in a direct line ahead.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Canton Tower rises above the city, sharp from its base to its top.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Zhujiang New Town this morning, and guests at Chinserie Restaurant watch their shadows slide across the towers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From The Lounge, guests follow patches of afternoon sun as they move across the city skyline between the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the city takes the same colour, and Canton Tower draws a thin line through it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and Canton Tower and the Pearl River show only as faint outlines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so Canton Tower cannot be seen clearly, and the view stops at the nearest towers of Zhujiang New Town.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass at Chinserie Restaurant, and the city skyline behind it turns soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the city, and for a second Canton Tower stands out white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Zhujiang New Town, and guests in The Lounge watch the flakes pass in front of the city skyline.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing, clear air, Canton Tower stands sharp beyond the private terrace of a Signature Loft Suite, and guests admire it from behind the glass.
phrases.cold: Cold air keeps the sky sharp today, and Canton Tower stands clear above the rooftops of the city.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests at Al Fresco Dining & Bar hold a frozen cocktail and let the skyline shimmer on its own.
phrases.warm: On the sunlit terrace of Bar On Six, guests sit with a cocktail and look across the towers of the city.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Canton Tower gold, straight ahead of the private terraces of the Signature Loft Suites, set across 2 floors.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights one side of the city skyline, seen from the terrace of Bar On Six.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, Canton Tower is lit from base to top, bright against the grey sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and guests at Chinserie Restaurant watch the city lights blur over dinner.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the city lights spread wide below The Lounge, and the low clouds glow faintly above them.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and Canton Tower shines over the city, a tall bright column that needs no pointing out.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and Canton Tower stands still above the sleeping streets.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and beyond the open terrace of the Pearl Suite the first city lights come on under a still-bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, under a clear sky, the five tiers of Yasaka Pagoda slowly separate from the mountains behind.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the tiled machiya roofs, and guests in the pagoda-view rooms can count the tiers of Yasaka Pagoda from bed.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Kyoto Tower and Yasaka Pagoda are both sharp above the Higashiyama townscape.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the tiled rooftops this morning, while Yasaka Pagoda takes the sun one tier at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in this hotel of 70 rooms look across the afternoon townscape, where clouds drift over Yasaka Pagoda and Kyoto Tower.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the tiled roofs of Higashiyama turn the same colour, and Yasaka Pagoda stands darker above them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the mountains today, so Yasaka Pagoda seems to stand alone above the nearest rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Kyoto Tower and the mountains are not visible today; guests still see Yasaka Pagoda above the nearby tiled roofs.
phrases.rain: Rain runs off the tiled machiya roofs, and guests watch it from the picture windows with Yasaka Pagoda slightly blurred behind.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Higashiyama, and through the panoramic glass wall at Yasaka lightning shows Yasaka Pagoda and the wet rooftops for a moment.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the tiled rooftops, and each tier of Yasaka Pagoda holds a thin white edge.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, and Kyoto Tower and the mountains on the horizon stand sharp beyond the tiled rooftops.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the Ninenzaka House suite look through floor-to-ceiling windows at Yasaka Pagoda in the distance.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the tiled rooftops, and guests are happy to study Yasaka Pagoda from the cool side of the glass.
phrases.warm: The warm day brightens the Higashiyama townscape, and guests can pick out Kyoto Tower past the tiled roofs.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Bar Kohaku on the 4th floor, guests watch the low sun turn the whole city amber around Yasaka Pagoda.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and guests at the early seating at Yasaka see Yasaka Pagoda as a silhouette against a golden sky.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at the teppan counter in Yasaka faces a cloudy evening sky, with the illuminated Yasaka Pagoda glowing above the rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: The glass wall at Yasaka is wet this evening, and the illuminated Yasaka Pagoda shines through it over the wet roofs.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the city lights spread out beyond the illuminated Yasaka Pagoda.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests in the pagoda-view rooms see the lit Yasaka Pagoda from bed, framed left of centre.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the townscape is quiet, and Yasaka Pagoda is a dark shape above the sleeping rooftops.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the private dining room guests see the first lights come on at Yasaka Pagoda.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over the Strip, and Frenchman Mountain is a dark line where the first light will come.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun rises clear behind Frenchman Mountain, and guests in the east-facing suites see the Sphere in sharp outline before it.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Strip runs straight and bright, every tower along it easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly along the Strip this morning, and guests can follow them from one hotel tower to the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Frenchman Mountain this afternoon, while the Strip below stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, guests see the Strip in softer colours, with Frenchman Mountain grey behind the Sphere.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Strip today, and Frenchman Mountain is only a faint outline behind the Sphere.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Frenchman Mountain is not visible today, so guests see the Strip and the Sphere at about 400 metres, and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Strip; guests watch the wet road shine, with the Sphere slightly blurred through the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the Strip, and for a second guests see Frenchman Mountain clearly before the storm hides it again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Strip, and guests in this 1999 resort watch the flakes drift past the Sphere.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so Frenchman Mountain looks close behind the Sphere today.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look along the Strip, where the light is thin and clean.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above the Strip, and guests in the suites facing the Sphere are glad to see it through cool glass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests look down at the crowds walking the Strip, small and slow from this height.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Frenchman Mountain a warm gold, and the Sphere stands out round in front of it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Strip turn orange, and the hotel towers catch the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Strip colour the sky, and the Sphere glows below it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening lights of the Strip into long bands of colour, and the Sphere's display shows round among them.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight guests in the east-facing suites watch the Sphere's LED display change under a sky without stars, Frenchman Mountain lost in the dark behind it.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the Sphere's display rises against Frenchman Mountain, and the Strip is a long line of light beside it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Strip is quieter, and guests still awake have its long road almost to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Frenchman Mountain as the Sphere begins its display and the first lights come on along the Strip.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lianhuashan Park is a dark shape under a clear sky, and the Futian towers behind it wait for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, Lianhuashan Park is bright green, and the Futian skyline stands sharp behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: From the south-facing rooms, guests look across the border to Hong Kong, clear at midday under a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Over breakfast in the Executive Club Lounge, guests watch cloud shadows move across the Futian skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Lianhuashan Park this afternoon, and the green of the trees changes shade by the minute.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the towers of Futian turn the same grey, and Lianhuashan Park keeps the only colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Futian skyline today, and the far trees of Lianhuashan Park fade into it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Hong Kong is not visible across the border today; from rooms on the south side, guests see only the nearer towers of Futian.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Futian skyline behind it looks slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Futian skyline, and guests watch the storm from behind floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Lianhuashan Park, and guests stand at the floor-to-ceiling windows to watch the trees turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is clear today, and from the corner suites Lianhuashan Park shows its full width with the city behind it.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay warm in the Executive Club Lounge and look out over the city from there.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests in the 26-floor hotel look at the trees of Lianhuashan Park through glass and leave the walking for later.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, people walk in Lianhuashan Park, small figures among the trees with the city rising behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Futian towers gold, and guests in the Executive Club Lounge look over the city as the light changes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Lianhuashan Park turn orange while the trees below grow darker.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in the Executive Club Lounge sip cocktails and count the lit floors on the Futian skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the Futian towers reflect in the wet streets below this evening, doubling the skyline.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the clouds hold the glow of the city, and Lianhuashan Park is the one dark patch in the middle of the lights.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the lights of Hong Kong show across the border for guests in the south-facing rooms.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests still awake in this 266-room hotel see a quiet Futian and the trees of Lianhuashan Park.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on in the Futian towers behind Lianhuashan Park.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Waitemata Harbour is a wide, still surface under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, guests in the harbour view suites see Waitemata Harbour bright blue from end to end.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is clear, and Waitemata Harbour stretches wide beyond the rooftops of Auckland's CBD, with no shadow on the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Waitemata Harbour this morning, and guests can follow them from one shore to the other.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, guests on the upper floors look north across Waitemata Harbour as sun and cloud take turns on the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Waitemata Harbour takes a silver colour, and the city rooftops stand darker against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Waitemata Harbour today, and guests see the far shore only as a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: guests see the rooftops of Auckland's CBD clearly, but the far side of Waitemata Harbour is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and Waitemata Harbour turns grey and blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Grand Presidential Suite, on the 20th and 21st floors, watch lightning flash over Waitemata Harbour while thunder rolls across the city.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Auckland's CBD, and guests watch it drift slowly towards Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and every edge of the city skyline stands sharp in front of Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep warm indoors while Waitemata Harbour shows a steel-blue colour beyond the city rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, Waitemata Harbour shines like polished metal, and guests are happy to admire it from behind cool glass.
phrases.warm: Waitemata Harbour looks inviting on this warm day, and guests in the harbour view rooms may forget their plans in the city.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Waitemata Harbour gold, and the glass of the city skyline catches the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Waitemata Harbour turn pink and orange, and guests stop to look.
phrases.grey_evening: This evening, the low clouds over Waitemata Harbour take a soft glow from the city lights below.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the city lights spread into soft colours on the glass, with Waitemata Harbour dark behind them.
phrases.mild_night: From a hotel of 312 rooms high above the streets, guests look over the lights of Auckland's CBD to Waitemata Harbour under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the city lights draw the edge of Waitemata Harbour for guests in the harbour view suites.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Waitemata Harbour is quiet and wide, and the few guests still awake have it to themselves.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky above Waitemata Harbour is still bright while the first lights come on across Auckland's CBD.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear, and Canton Tower stands unlit above a still Pearl River.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Canton Tower first, then moves down to the Pearl River below.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 25-metre indoor pool, swimmers see Canton Tower through the glass wall, sharp against a blue midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pearl River this morning, while Canton Tower stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the gym, guests look over the Guangzhou skyline as afternoon clouds drift above the towers.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pearl River takes the same colour, and Canton Tower rises pale above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Canton Tower today, and its thin waist looks like a pencil sketch from the pool's glass wall.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far bends of the Pearl River are not visible today; Canton Tower still shows, a little faded.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass wall of the indoor pool, and Canton Tower looks blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind Canton Tower, and guests in the lounge watch the storm cross the Pearl River.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Guangzhou, and guests in the lounge watch the flakes drift past Canton Tower.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day, Canton Tower stands sharp in the clear air above the Pearl River.
phrases.cold: Cold air keeps the Guangzhou skyline crisp today, and guests in the gym look at it from the treadmills.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Pearl River shines like metal, and guests on the rooftop terrace look across to Canton Tower.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests at the rooftop bar look past the wooden pergola to Canton Tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun colours Canton Tower, and swimmers in the 25-metre pool stop between lengths to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights one side of Canton Tower above the Pearl River.
phrases.grey_evening: Canton Tower glows in rainbow colours under the evening clouds, seen from the rooftop bar on the 70th floor.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Pearl River this evening, and the colours of Canton Tower spread across the wet windows.
phrases.mild_night: From the corner suite, guests see the Pearl River curve one way and Canton Tower shine the other under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: From the rooftop terrace, Canton Tower shines in many colours against the clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pearl River is a quiet band between the sleeping towers of Guangzhou.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first pink and purple lights appear on Canton Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Mediterranean lies dark and calm below the sea-facing rooms, and the sky above it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun rises over the Mediterranean, and guests who left the curtains open watch it from bed, if they wake in time.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear sky, Barceloneta Beach and the blue Mediterranean lie open below the WET Deck.
phrases.partly_morning: In the fitness centre, guests run on the spot while the clouds move freely along Barcelona's coastline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross Barcelona Harbour this afternoon, and guests at Eclipse on the 26th floor follow them towards the city.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Mediterranean turns the colour of steel behind the glass of the Living Room.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Barceloneta today, and the ships leaving Barcelona Harbour fade soon after they pass the tower.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The mountains behind Barcelona are not visible today, and guests on the upper floors see only as far as Barceloneta and Barcelona Harbour.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass at Eclipse, and Barcelona Harbour below looks grey and blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Mediterranean, and guests in the Living Room watch the storm from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Barceloneta Beach, and from the sun deck above the WET Deck the sand slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, guests at Eclipse see Barcelona's skyline in sharp detail from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the terrace of Bravo 24 still looks over the sea, where a few ships cross slowly.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool, where the edge of the water seems to join the Mediterranean.
phrases.warm: Barceloneta Beach is full of people today, and guests on the WET Deck watch them from their daybeds, drink in hand.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light spreads over Barceloneta late this afternoon, and the terrace suites look straight onto it.
phrases.partly_golden: At Eclipse, guests with a cocktail watch the sun go down behind the clouds over the city.
phrases.grey_evening: Under the evening cloud, the city lights of Barcelona glow behind Barceloneta, seen from Eclipse.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of Barceloneta tonight, and from the Living Room the Mediterranean is only a black space beyond the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of Barcelona Harbour reflect in the water, and the Mediterranean beyond stays black.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lights of Barcelona spread behind the tower, and ships show as small moving lights on the Mediterranean.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Barceloneta Beach is empty and quiet, and only the white line of the waves moves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights appear around Barcelona Harbour, as they have below this sail-shaped tower since 2009.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Sabie River is a dark band below the private wooden decks, with the first grey light showing above the far bank.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Sabie River, and from the lounge deck at River Lodge guests look straight down onto the water.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Sabie River runs bright between its reeds, and the sandbanks of Kruger National Park look almost white.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Sabie River this morning, while guests at breakfast look over the water from their tables.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the two pools at River Lodge, guests follow the patches of sun and shade that cross the Sabie River this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Sabie River turns the colour of clay, and the reeds along its banks look greener.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Sabie River today, and the trees on the far bank look like a faded drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so guests on the lounge deck see the Sabie River clearly but not the bush far behind it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Sabie River, and guests in the glass-walled suites at Ivory Lodge watch the drops mark the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Sabie River, and each flash of lightning shows the sandbanks of Kruger National Park for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Sabie River, and from the lounge deck at River Lodge the far bank turns pale behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day, guests stay behind the glass at Ivory Lodge and look across the Sabie River to the Kruger sandbanks.
phrases.cold: The Sabie River moves slowly under a cold sky, and the reeds on its banks bend in the wind.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the plunge pools of the River Suites and look at the Sabie River from the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests lie on sun loungers by the pool, their books closed, and look at the Sabie River instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Sabie River, and guests on the lounge deck wait for the elephants that come down to drink.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the Sabie River turns gold in some places and grey in others.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests at dinner face the Sabie River, now a darker band between the two banks.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Sabie River this evening, and guests at dinner indoors watch the drops hit the dark water.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night with no stars, guests on their private wooden decks can just make out the Sabie River below.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the Sabie River, and guests on the 18 riverside decks at River Lodge look up as often as down.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Sabie River is almost invisible, a strip of deeper black between the two banks.
phrases.dusk: Guests by the boma look over the Sabie River as the sky stays bright after sunset, on a riverbank bought in 1933.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Adriatic Sea lies grey-blue below the private terraces, with the first light on the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Adriatic Sea, and the water under the cliff turns a clear turquoise.
phrases.clear_midday: From the cave restaurant, the arch of rock frames a bright blue Adriatic Sea under a cloudless midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Adriatic Sea this morning, and the water changes from turquoise to dark blue and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At Casanova, the sea is visible from every corner, and this afternoon guests watch clouds drift slowly over it.
phrases.overcast: From the panoramic terrace of Palazzo del Suono del Mare, the Adriatic Sea is the colour of slate under a full grey sky.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Adriatic Sea and the sky look like one pale sheet.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The coast of Polignano a Mare is not visible far along today; guests see only the nearest stretch of the Adriatic Sea.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of the Adriatic Sea, and guests in the balcony rooms watch it from the doorway.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Adriatic Sea for a second at a time, and guests in the terrace suites stay behind the glass to watch.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling into the Adriatic Sea, and guests stand at the large windows to see the flakes vanish in the water.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and the Adriatic Sea ends in a sharp horizon.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Adriatic Sea is steel blue, and white waves break on the limestone cliffs.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests in the cave restaurant keep to the shade of the rock and look out at the glittering Adriatic Sea.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, small boats pass below the cave restaurant, where guests have looked out at the Adriatic Sea since the 1700s.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the limestone gold, and from the cave restaurant the Adriatic Sea shines like metal.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink above the Adriatic Sea, a wide show from the panoramic terrace of Palazzo del Suono del Mare.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in the cave restaurant, the Adriatic Sea is a dark space beyond the rock arch, under a sky without stars.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows at Casanova tonight, and the Adriatic Sea beyond them is black and restless.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, and the Adriatic Sea is a soft dark surface below the cliff.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Adriatic Sea tonight, and the water carries a faint shine all the way to the horizon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests hear the Adriatic Sea against the rock more than they see it.
phrases.dusk: The lights of the cave restaurant come on while the Adriatic Sea still holds the last blue of the sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Eiffel Tower is a dark outline, and the sky behind it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: First sun reaches the tip of the Eiffel Tower, then works its way down the ironwork level by level.
phrases.clear_midday: Every crossbar of the Eiffel Tower is easy to pick out at midday, right up to the antenna.
phrases.partly_morning: At breakfast time the Eiffel Tower is in sun one minute and in cloud shadow the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Eiffel Tower goes from bright to dull and back again as clouds cross in front of the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Eiffel Tower is a plain dark shape, and guests can see it from top to bottom.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Eiffel Tower to a grey outline today, its top fading first.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the lower half of the Eiffel Tower shows clearly today; the top is pale and the city beyond it is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Paris, and guests see the Eiffel Tower grey and a little blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is passing over Paris, and guests watch the Eiffel Tower stand dark under the heavy clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Paris, and the Eiffel Tower turns pale behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The Eiffel Tower stands sharp and clear today, and guests look at it from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On a day for coats and scarves, guests stay inside and count the levels of the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests are in no hurry to go out and look at the Eiffel Tower from the cool indoors.
phrases.warm: The Eiffel Tower shows every line of its ironwork today, from the wide base to the narrow top.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the iron of the Eiffel Tower a warm gold.
phrases.partly_golden: Between two clouds, the last sun of the day reaches the Eiffel Tower for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, guests look at the Eiffel Tower, lit against a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Through tonight's rain, guests see the lights of the Eiffel Tower soft and blurred.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight's clouds stay above the Eiffel Tower, and its lights show clearly from base to top.
phrases.clear_night: Nothing stands between guests and the lit Eiffel Tower on this clear night.
phrases.late_night: Guests who are still awake at this hour find the Eiffel Tower as a tall dark shape in the night.
phrases.dusk: The Eiffel Tower begins to light up while the sky behind it is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Speicherstadt rooftops are still dark blocks, and the clear sky above Hamburg Harbour slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Speicherstadt rooftops one row at a time, under a sky without a cloud.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests can count the port cranes along the Elbe from the porthole-style windows.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Hamburg Harbour this morning, and the Speicherstadt rooftops go from bright to dull and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the HafenCity skyline sits half in sun and half in shade as clouds drift over the Elbe.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Hamburg Harbour turns the colour of steel, and the Speicherstadt rooftops look darker.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies over the Elbe today, so guests see the nearest Speicherstadt rooftops and have to guess at the rest of the harbour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the HafenCity rooftops below are clear, but the far side of Hamburg Harbour cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Hamburg Harbour; guests in harbour-facing rooms watch Speicherstadt turn soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above Hamburg Harbour, and for a second every Speicherstadt rooftop stands out against the storm sky.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Speicherstadt rooftops, and guests watch them turn white one by one.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is clear today, and Hamburg Harbour looks sharp in every detail, from the water to the Speicherstadt rooftops.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps guests indoors, where the Elbe and the HafenCity skyline fill the windows of all 244 rooms.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stand on their balconies and watch Hamburg Harbour shimmer under the sun.
phrases.warm: Warm light lies on Hamburg Harbour today, and guests look at the Speicherstadt rooftops longer than they planned.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Hamburg Harbour gold, and the Speicherstadt rooftops throw long shadows.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds over the Elbe turn orange while Speicherstadt slowly loses its light.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at the rooftop bar look across the lit skyline to the St. Nikolai church spire.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the skyline run together on the glass of the rooftop bar, and nobody hurries to leave.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hang low over HafenCity tonight, and the city lights give them a soft glow above Speicherstadt.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the lights of Hamburg Harbour repeat themselves on the Elbe.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Speicherstadt is quiet, and the Elbe moves slowly past it.
phrases.dusk: At the rooftop bar, guests watch the first lights come on across the skyline while the sky behind the St. Nikolai church spire is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Shenzhen skyline lies quiet below the top floors of Kingkey 100.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun reaches the Shenzhen skyline, and guests can see clearly south toward Hong Kong.
phrases.clear_midday: At Elba Restaurant, lunch is Italian, while the Shenzhen skyline fills the glass under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: From the treadmills in the gym, guests watch cloud shadows cross the dense Shenzhen skyline this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift past the skyline rooms this afternoon, with the Shenzhen skyline and the nearby mountains in sun between them.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the towers of the Shenzhen skyline take the same colour all the way to the mountains.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Shenzhen skyline today, and guests see the nearer towers more clearly than the far ones.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The nearby mountains and the way south toward Hong Kong are not visible today; the closest towers of the Shenzhen skyline still are.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass at Elba Restaurant, and the Shenzhen skyline behind it turns soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Shenzhen skyline for a second at a time, and guests on the top floors of Kingkey 100 watch the storm at eye level.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the panoramic windows of the upper-floor lounge, and the Shenzhen cityscape below slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and guests stay behind the glass to look at the nearby mountains beyond the Shenzhen skyline.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the yoga studio is a warm place to look over the dense Shenzhen skyline.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Shenzhen skyline, and guests look at it from the cool side of the gym's floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.warm: A warm day brightens the nearby mountains, which stand green behind the towers of the Shenzhen skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the glass towers of the Shenzhen skyline gold, and guests in the upper-floor lounge stop talking to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds, and guests in the yoga studio hold the pose a little longer for the orange Shenzhen skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs low this evening, and guests at dinner in Elba Restaurant look down on the lights of the Shenzhen skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of the Shenzhen skyline spread and blur in the panoramic windows of the upper-floor lounge.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of the Shenzhen skyline put a soft glow on the sky above them.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lights of the Shenzhen skyline run south toward Hong Kong, 30 kilometres away.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Shenzhen skyline is still and dark beyond the glass, and most guests are asleep above it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the Shenzhen skyline, seen from a tower Terry Farrell designed.

phrases.clear_predawn: The ocean is dark before the day begins, and the garden is still in shadow.
phrases.clear_morning: The ocean is bright and clear this morning for guests eating breakfast at Cire.
phrases.clear_midday: The edge of the Main infinity pool and the ocean beyond it are almost the same blue at this hour.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the One-Bedroom Pool Villa open their doors to a garden where sun and shade keep changing places.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At lunch in Cire, guests watch cloud shadows move slowly across the ocean.
phrases.overcast: The green of the garden stands out today against a pale grey ocean.
phrases.fog_haze: Seen from the Main infinity pool, the ocean looks soft and pale under today's haze.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The garden is clear today, but the ocean fades into grey and the horizon cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Guests in the One-Bedroom Pool Villa watch the rain make every leaf in the garden shine.
phrases.thunderstorm: With each flash of the thunderstorm the ocean turns white for a second, then goes dark again.
phrases.snow: The garden is turning white under snow, watched from inside by guests in the One-Bedroom Pool Villa.
phrases.very_cold: Bright light on the ocean and nobody in the garden: guests are looking at both from indoors.
phrases.cold: From the One-Bedroom Pool Villa, guests look out at the garden and keep the doors closed.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool and look out at the ocean.
phrases.warm: At the Viewpoint behind the hotel, guests stand outside in the warm air and look over the vista.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Sunset Cabana Bar earns its name now, as guests there watch the sun drop lower and turn gold.
phrases.partly_golden: Gaps in the clouds let the low sun through, turning parts of the ocean orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner guests at Cire look out on a dark ocean under a cloudy evening.
phrases.wet_evening: The small Balinese temple shines wet in tonight's rain, and the garden drips in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the ocean is a wide dark space under the cloud, and the garden is darker still.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the pool tonight, and the ocean beyond it is wide and dark.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the Main infinity pool holds the last bright colour, while the ocean behind it is already turning dark.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Marina Bay is still, and Marina Bay Sands stands quiet against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Marina Bay Sands and the Esplanade, and the pool deck holds both in one frame.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the shaded pool deck looks out at Marina Bay Sands and the Marina Bay skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Marina Bay this morning, and their shadows cross the water in front of the Esplanade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Ebb6 lap pool faces Suntec City, where clouds and sun take turns on the towers this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Marina Bay turns the colour of steel, and Marina Bay Sands stands clear above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Marina Bay skyline today, and guests can just make out the Singapore Flyer as a faint circle.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: guests see the Esplanade and the near side of Marina Bay, but Gardens by the Bay is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Marina Bay, and guests in the suites facing the bay watch Marina Bay Sands blur behind the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Marina Bay, and for a second Marina Bay Sands stands sharp against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Marina Bay, a sight nobody packed for, and Marina Bay Sands fades to white behind it.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing, clear air, Flow18 Sky Garden shows the city skyline with every edge sharp.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, nobody lingers in Ebb6 Sky Garden, yet the city panorama there is as wide as ever.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the shaded pool on the 18th floor and look at Marina Bay Sands from the water.
phrases.warm: On the pool deck loungers, drinks get warm while guests look at the Singapore Flyer and Marina Bay Sands.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Marina Bay Sands gold, and guests in the corner suites see Gardens by the Bay in the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Marina Bay turn orange, and the Esplanade catches the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: From Lord Norman Foster's 2015 towers, guests see the lights of Marina Bay Sands glow under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and guests watch the lights of the Esplanade and Marina Bay spread into soft colours.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers the night sky, and the lit Marina Bay skyline keeps the water bright below it.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the suites facing Marina Bay see Marina Bay Sands and the Esplanade lit above the dark water.
