phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Marina Bay is quiet and dark, and Marina Bay Sands is only a tall outline beyond the water.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the pool deck the first lights come on along the Marina Bay skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear over the Atlantic, and Mawgan Porth beach is a pale curve below the cliffs.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balconies, guests look down at Mawgan Porth beach in clean morning light, with surf running in from the Atlantic.
phrases.clear_midday: On the terrace, lunch is served under a blue sky, and guests look out over the Atlantic and the sandy arc of Mawgan Porth beach.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the green headland this morning, while the sand of Mawgan Porth beach stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon tea in Scarlet Restaurant looks out on the coast, where patches of sun move across the Atlantic.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the view from the barrel sauna is still Mawgan Porth beach and its rocky headland.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the headland cliffs today, and the Atlantic fades into the sky with no clear horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far horizon of the Atlantic is not visible today, but Mawgan Porth beach and the nearest cliffs remain clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic, and guests watch it through the glass walls of the indoor pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic, and guests follow the storm from behind floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the clifftop, and the Atlantic below looks darker behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the headland cliffs look sharp, and steam rises from the clifftop hot tubs above the Atlantic.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the glass walls of the indoor pool frame the Atlantic, and the swimmers stay warm.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests sit on the rocks beside the natural pool and look at the coastal cliffs and the calm sea.
phrases.warm: Guests linger on the terrace on this warm day, watching small figures cross the sand of Mawgan Porth beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the clifftop hot tubs, the sun drops towards the Atlantic, and the headland cliffs turn gold.
phrases.partly_golden: In the rooftop pod rooms, guests wait for the last sun to colour the clouds amber over the Atlantic.
phrases.grey_evening: After sunset under cloud, guests at dinner in Scarlet Restaurant see the Atlantic fade to deep grey beyond the coast.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass at Scarlet Restaurant this evening, and the surf below shows white through the wet dark.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the balconies of these 37 rooms look down on faint white surf on Mawgan Porth beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars hang over the Atlantic on this clear night, and the headland stands black against the sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic is mostly a sound, with only a little white foam showing where the waves break.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky stays bright over the Atlantic while the sand of Mawgan Porth beach turns grey.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Han River lies dark and still below the corner suites.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests at breakfast in the Executive Lounge on the 37th floor look down on the Han River under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Han River shines blue at midday, and N Seoul Tower stands sharp against the clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Han River this morning, and guests in PULSE8 follow them through the glass walls.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At afternoon tea in 37 Bar, guests watch clouds drift over the Han River and the Seoul skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Han River turns the colour of steel, and N Seoul Tower stays clear above the city.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Seoul skyline today, and the far bank of the Han River looks like a watercolour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: N Seoul Tower is not visible today; guests see the Han River and the nearest buildings of the skyline.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the Penthouse on the 36th floor, and the Han River below turns grey and blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Seoul skyline, and guests in the corner suites watch the storm cross the Han River.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Yeouido, and guests in the banquet hall watch it drift down between the towers.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and swimmers in the heated indoor pool look out at the city through tall windows.
phrases.cold: On this cold day guests sit by the fireplace in the Executive Lounge and look out over the Han River.
phrases.very_hot: The Han River shimmers in strong heat, and guests look down on it from the cool Executive Lounge.
phrases.warm: The Han River is bright in the warm light today, and N Seoul Tower is easy to find beyond the Seoul skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls across the Han River late this afternoon, and the treadmills in PULSE8 slow down a little.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Han River, and guests in the Executive Lounge watch the water turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: From SUT. The Butcher's Edge, guests see the lit Seoul skyline under low cloud beyond the Han River.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the Seoul skyline blur in the wet windows of 37 Bar, and the Han River shines below.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and the Han River carries the city lights below 37 Bar.
phrases.clear_night: From 37 Bar, at the top of this 38-floor hotel, guests see the lit Han River and the outline of N Seoul Tower.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Han River is a wide, quiet band of dark water far below the bedroom windows.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests in 37 Bar count the first lights on the Han River bridges.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale above the downtown skyline, and the Charles River is still a dark band below it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun falls on Boston Public Garden under a clear sky, and the Charles River shines in the distance.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Charles River is a blue strip between the Beacon Hill rooftops and the Cambridge skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the corner rooms, with glass on almost every side, watch cloud shadows move across the downtown skyline and the Charles River this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Zakim Bridge this afternoon, while the State House dome catches the sun between them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Charles River turns the colour of slate, and the downtown skyline looks drawn in the same pencil.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Charles River today, and the towers of the downtown skyline lose their tops in it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests cannot see the Cambridge skyline today, but the Charles River and the Beacon Hill rooftops still show clearly enough.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests on the higher floors see the Charles River as a grey blur.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the downtown skyline, and for a second the Charles River shows white under the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Boston Public Garden, and the Charles River slowly disappears behind the white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the air is clear, and guests pick out the Zakim Bridge and the State House dome from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the penthouse lounge stay indoors and look across the downtown skyline.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Beacon Hill rooftops today, and the Charles River looks like the only cool place in Boston.
phrases.warm: Boston Public Garden fills with people on this warm day, and guests above the 10th floor see them as small moving dots.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Charles River gold, and the Cambridge skyline glows beside it.
phrases.partly_golden: From the penthouse lounge, guests watch the last sun slip between clouds and colour the glass of the downtown skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: At Bar Moxy, guests hold their drinks and look out at the lit downtown skyline under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: From Bar Moxy tonight, guests watch the city lights of the downtown skyline spread into soft colours in the rain.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hang low tonight, and the lit State House dome stands out among the darker Beacon Hill rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the corner rooms see city lights on almost every side and the Charles River running dark between them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and the Charles River is only a wide dark shape between Boston and Cambridge.
phrases.dusk: At dusk the sky is still bright over the Charles River, and the first lights come on along the downtown skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Elliott Bay lies still and dark blue, and the Olympic Mountains begin to show against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, guests in the water-view suites see Elliott Bay and the Olympic Mountains through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_midday: Elliott Bay is bright blue at midday, and a ferry crosses it slowly toward the islands of Puget Sound.
phrases.partly_morning: At breakfast in Conversation, guests look through wall-to-wall windows at the downtown streets under a sky of sun and passing clouds.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across Elliott Bay this afternoon, and the Seattle Great Wheel turns in and out of the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Elliott Bay turns the colour of steel, and the port cranes stand out clearly against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Elliott Bay today, and the Pike Place roofline is the last thing guests can still see clearly.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Olympic Mountains are not visible today; guests see Elliott Bay as far as the nearest piers and no further.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Elliott Bay, and guests in a Penthouse Suite watch the drops run down the glass in front of the grey water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Puget Sound, and for a second Elliott Bay shows white before the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Pike Place roofline, and Elliott Bay behind it has almost disappeared in white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, clear day, the Olympic Mountains look sharp and close across Elliott Bay.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the floor-to-ceiling windows with a coffee and follow the boats on Elliott Bay.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, Elliott Bay glitters in the sun, and guests on the rooftop terrace of The Nest look out over the water with a cold drink.
phrases.warm: On this warm afternoon, the glass doors of The Nest stand open, and guests look straight out at Elliott Bay and the port cranes.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From The Nest on the 13th floor, guests watch Elliott Bay change colour as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds, and patches of gold move across Elliott Bay toward the Pike Place roofline.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Seattle Great Wheel is lit above the water, and Elliott Bay is dark around it.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests in this Olson Kundig glass building see the waterfront lights blur on Elliott Bay.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and the lights of a ferry move slowly across Elliott Bay.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the water-view suites see city lights along the edge of Elliott Bay and a black sky over Puget Sound.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Elliott Bay is a wide, quiet darkness, and even the ferries seem to be asleep.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and from The Nest guests see the first lights come on along the Pike Place roofline while Elliott Bay still holds the bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the spires of Milan Cathedral stand as a dark shape above the rooftops, under a clear sky slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Presidential Suite on the 12th floor, guests see the morning sun on Milan Cathedral with nothing in the way.
phrases.clear_midday: Milan Cathedral stands sharp under a clear midday sky, and each Gothic spire is easy to pick out above the rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the rooftops this morning, while Milan Cathedral stays in a patch of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the restaurant, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the skyline between Milan Cathedral and Torre Velasca.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Milan Cathedral takes almost the same colour as the clouds, its spires drawing a fine line above the roofs.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the rooftops today, and Milan Cathedral looks like a pencil drawing that someone has half rubbed out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far edge of the city is not visible today; guests in the restaurant still see Milan Cathedral and Torre Velasca, a little less sharp than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftops; guests in the Duomo Suite watch it through the glass, Milan Cathedral slightly blurred in the frame.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city, and each flash of lightning shows the spires of Milan Cathedral for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Milan, and the rooftops turn white one by one while Milan Cathedral fades behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, guests in the restaurant see every spire of Milan Cathedral, glad to be on the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps guests inside, where the tall windows frame Milan Cathedral above the rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the rooftops, and Milan Cathedral seems to tremble slightly in the bright air.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the Presidential Suite look across the whole city to Milan Cathedral.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns Milan Cathedral gold, and the rooftops in front of it take on a warm amber colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests in this 165-room hotel watch the clouds turn pink behind the spires of Milan Cathedral.
phrases.grey_evening: At the restaurant, guests sit by the windows and look at Milan Cathedral, lit under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the skyline blur on the restaurant glass, and Milan Cathedral glows softly through the drops.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hang low over the city tonight, and the lit spire of Milan Cathedral rises pale above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: From the Presidential Suite, guests count the city lights all the way to Milan Cathedral, lit against a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and Milan Cathedral is a still outline beyond the sleeping rooftops.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights come on around Milan Cathedral beyond the rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Melbourne skyline stands as a dark outline beyond Albert Park, under a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Woods Restaurant, guests look across the parklands to the Melbourne skyline under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Melbourne skyline stands sharp against a blue midday sky, with the green of Albert Park spread out in front of it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the city this morning, and their shadows cross the towers of the Melbourne skyline one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony rooms, guests watch patches of afternoon sun travel across Albert Park towards the Melbourne skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the lake in Albert Park takes the colour of the cloud, and the Melbourne skyline looks like cut paper behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Melbourne skyline today, and the towers seem to float above the trees of Albert Park.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The towers of the Melbourne skyline are not visible today, and the view stops at the trees of Albert Park.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Albert Park, and guests in Woods Restaurant watch the Melbourne skyline blur behind the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Melbourne skyline, and for a second every tower shows clearly through the storm rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Albert Park, and the Melbourne skyline fades to grey behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, clear day, guests in the City View Suite on the 9th floor count the towers of the Melbourne skyline from behind warm glass.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps guests indoors, where the windows of Woods Restaurant frame the parklands and the Melbourne skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Melbourne skyline shimmers above Albert Park, and few people cross the open grass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the balconies follow the small figures on the sports courts of Albert Park, with the Melbourne skyline behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the Melbourne skyline gold, and guests in the balcony rooms have a good excuse to open something cold.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Melbourne skyline turn pink, and Albert Park grows darker below them.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Woods Restaurant, guests see the lights of the Melbourne skyline glow under low evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass tonight, and the lights of the Melbourne skyline spread into soft coloured spots beyond the dark park.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the cloud above the city catches the glow of the Melbourne skyline, and Albert Park lies quiet in between.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit towers of the Melbourne skyline stand in a bright row beyond the darkness of Albert Park.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Albert Park is a wide area of darkness, and the Melbourne skyline rests quietly beyond it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, guests see the first lights come on across the Melbourne skyline while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the towers of the Sagrada Família stand unlit above the Eixample roofline, under a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Solarium, the morning sun shows every tower of the Sagrada Família above the Eixample roofline.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Rooftop Garden has clear views across Barcelona in every direction, with the Sagrada Família rising on the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Eixample rooftops this morning, and the Sagrada Família goes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop pool, the spires of the Gothic Quarter stand over the city rooftops, in sun one minute and in shade the next.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the towers of the Sagrada Família look darker than usual from the Solarium.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Eixample today, and from the Rooftop Garden the Sagrada Família looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the nearest Eixample rooftops are clear from the Solarium, but the Sagrada Família is only a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the French balconies, and guests watch the wet city rooftops from their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Barcelona skyline for a second, and guests in the Joséphine Baker Suite watch the storm from a dry armchair.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Rooftop Garden, and the Sagrada Família shows only now and then through the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and from the Solarium each tower of the Sagrada Família looks sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 1919 hotel stay behind the glass of the French balconies and look across the city rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the Gothic Quarter spires from the water.
phrases.warm: On the open-air terraces of the Rooftop Garden, guests sit in the warm air and count the towers of the Sagrada Família.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun turns the Sagrada Família gold, and guests watch it from the Solarium, where only hotel guests may come up.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and lights the Eixample rooftops in patches, one street block at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hide the stars this evening, but the lit Sagrada Família stands clearly over the lights of Barcelona.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the city this evening, and from the Ronnie Wood Suite the lights of Barcelona blur on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the city lights colour the low sky, and the Sagrada Família glows above the Eixample roofline.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Rooftop Garden tonight, and the lit towers of the Sagrada Família stand on the horizon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Eixample is quiet, and the Sagrada Família is a tall shape above the sleeping rooftops.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Sagrada Família and across the Eixample.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale over the Strait of Messina, and Mount Etna is a dark shape above the quiet coast.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the terrace faces Mount Etna, the Strait of Messina and Taormina Bay together under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Taormina Bay is bright blue at midday, and every ridge of Mount Etna is clear from the infinity pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests at breakfast on the terrace watch cloud shadows cross Taormina Bay while Mount Etna stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds gather around the top of Mount Etna this afternoon, while Taormina Bay below stays in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Strait of Messina turns the colour of steel beyond the smaller pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Taormina Bay today, and Mount Etna is only a faint outline behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Mount Etna is not visible today; from the terrace, guests see the rooftops of Taormina and the near edge of Taormina Bay.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Taormina Bay; guests watch it from their balcony rooms, with Mount Etna hidden in cloud.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Strait of Messina, and guests in the terrace suites count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the terrace, and Mount Etna fades to white behind it while Taormina Bay stays grey below.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, Mount Etna looks close enough to touch from the balcony rooms.
phrases.cold: The cold air is clear today, so guests in this 17-room hotel follow the coast from Taormina Bay to the Strait of Messina.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look across Taormina Bay to Mount Etna.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests by the smaller pool look out to the Strait of Messina and forget their drinks.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun drops low beside Mount Etna, and the terrace turns gold above Taormina Bay.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests at the infinity pool watch the last sun colour the clouds over Mount Etna orange and pink.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner at Incanto, guests look over the lights around Taormina Bay under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the coast lights along Taormina Bay this evening, and Mount Etna is lost in the wet dark.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars on this mild night, and from the terrace the lit rooftops of Taormina lead down to Taormina Bay.
phrases.clear_night: Mount Etna stands black against the stars, and if it erupts tonight, guests are handed binoculars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests awake in the Rooftop Suite find Taormina Bay silent below and Mount Etna resting in the dark.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind Mount Etna, and the first lights come on along Taormina Bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide grey surface under a clear sky, and Pillar Point Harbor is still.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Pillar Point Harbor, and from the penthouse balconies guests see ocean, harbor and mountains in a single frame.
phrases.clear_midday: The Pacific Ocean is deep blue at midday, and the boats in Pillar Point Harbor are easy to count.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Santa Cruz Mountains this morning, while Pillar Point Harbor stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the Pacific Ocean this afternoon, easy to follow from the outdoor terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean takes the same colour, and the boats in Pillar Point Harbor stand out in white.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Pacific Ocean today, and from the penthouse balconies guests can see only the nearest boats in Pillar Point Harbor.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Santa Cruz Mountains are not visible today, and the Pacific Ocean fades into pale air a short way past Pillar Point Harbor.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Pillar Point Harbor; guests watch it from their suite windows, the boats slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and thunder follows as the storm crosses Pillar Point Harbor.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Pillar Point Harbor, and the flakes disappear as they land on the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and the Santa Cruz Mountains show every ridge above the blue Pacific Ocean.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, steam rises from the hot tub, and the Pacific Ocean spreads out behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool and look over the iron fence at the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.warm: By the pool, books stay closed on this warm day while guests look at the Pacific Ocean instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns Pillar Point Harbor gold, and from the penthouse balconies of this 54-suite hotel guests see every mast catch the light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds, and the Pacific Ocean below the outdoor terrace turns orange and grey.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars this evening, and the lights of Pillar Point Harbor shine on the black water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights of Pillar Point Harbor turn into soft yellow spots.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and Pillar Point Harbor shows only as a few lights beside the black Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Pacific Ocean, and the lights of Pillar Point Harbor line the water's edge.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pacific Ocean is black and wide, and nothing moves in Pillar Point Harbor.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Pacific Ocean, and from the oceanfront patio the water turns from blue to silver.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Mediterranean is a wide dark surface below the infinity pool, and the sky turns pale at the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests on the sea-view balconies look down at the harbour in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool and the Mediterranean share the same blue, and the line between them is difficult to find.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Mediterranean this morning, seen from the outdoor fitness area above the bougainvillea.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns on Amalfi town this afternoon, just below the terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Mediterranean turns the colour of slate, and the harbour below stays clear in every detail.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the infinity pool seems to run straight into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant mountains are not visible today, and the terrace hot tub looks over only Amalfi town and the nearest water.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the harbour, and guests watch it from the sea-facing rooms of this 13th-century monastery.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows over the Mediterranean, and guests count the seconds from the windows of the Prior's Suite.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the terrace pergola, and the Mediterranean behind it is grey and quiet.
phrases.very_cold: In the cold clear air, the distant mountains stand sharp beyond Amalfi town, seen from the terrace.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps the terrace loungers empty, and the coastal cliffs have the whole sea to themselves.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat guests stay in the infinity pool, 80 metres above Amalfi, and look at the Mediterranean from the water.
phrases.warm: On the terrace loungers, guests under the wooden pergola look at the sea more than at their books.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the coastal cliffs, and guests on the terrace watch them change colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and puts a bright path on the Mediterranean, straight toward the terrace hot tub.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Amalfi town shine below the terrace, and guests look down at them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the harbour lights tonight, and guests watch them from the dry side of the balcony doors.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, so the village lights below the outdoor fitness area do the work instead.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Mediterranean tonight, and the lights of the harbour answer from below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Mediterranean is a wide darkness below the terrace, and the horizon is gone until morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first village lights appear below the infinity pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before the first light, Snoopy rock is a dark outline against a slowly paling sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light shows every layer of the Red Rock Formations in clear detail.
phrases.clear_midday: In the Two Bedroom Suite King/Queen/Queen, guests look out at the Red Rock Formations standing sharp against the blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests opening their curtains find the Red Rock Formations patched with sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Light and shade take turns on the Red Rock Formations this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under grey cloud, the Red Rock Formations look a darker, deeper red.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Red Rocks today, and Snoopy rock is a pale shape that guests must look for.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the nearest Red Rock Formations are clear today; the farther ones cannot be seen from the hotel.
phrases.rain: Guests in the Two Bedroom Suite King/Queen/Queen watch rain run down the glass with the Red Rock Formations blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls between the Red Rocks, and guests stay inside counting the seconds after each flash.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the Two Bedroom Suite King/Queen/Queen, where guests stay warm and watch the Red Rocks turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay indoors today and look out at the Red Rock Formations in the bright, cold air.
phrases.cold: From inside, guests study the partial Red Rock views with no hurry to step out.
phrases.very_hot: The Red Rock Formations seem to shimmer in the heat, and guests outside keep to the shade.
phrases.warm: Guests spend the afternoon outdoors, looking up at the Red Rock Formations.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At the Scenic Overlook, guests arrive early to wait for the sunset.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds turn orange and pink over the Sunset Vista overlook as the sunset begins.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests at dinner tonight can still see the dark shapes of the Red Rock Formations under the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain taps on the windows tonight, and the Red Rocks are only darker shapes in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: No stars tonight, only the dark shapes of the Red Rock Formations under the cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight guests can count the stars above the dark Red Rock Formations.
phrases.late_night: The Red Rocks stand dark and silent around the sleeping guests.
phrases.dusk: The sunset is over, yet the Red Rock Formations still stand out against a bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, under a clear sky, the Marina Bay Sands towers stand as a dark shape above the still water of Marina Bay.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balcony rooms, Marina Bay Sands stands straight ahead in clear morning light, with Marina Bay bright below it.
phrases.clear_midday: At SKAI on the 70th floor, guests at lunch look past Marina Bay Sands to the islands of Indonesia on the clear horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests having breakfast in L65 Lounge watch cloud shadows move across Marina Bay and the Padang.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Marina Bay this afternoon, and from JAAN by Kirk Westaway the skyline shows sun in one place and shade in the next.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Marina Bay turns the colour of steel, and Marina Bay Sands stands plain above it, seen from L65 Lounge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Marina Bay today, and from SKAI the Marina Bay Sands towers look drawn in grey chalk.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The islands of Indonesia and Malaysia are not visible from the upper floors today, but Marina Bay Sands still stands straight ahead across Marina Bay.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Marina Bay, and guests in the balcony rooms watch from behind the glass as Marina Bay Sands turns grey and soft.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Marina Bay, and guests in L65 Lounge watch the lightning from the 65th floor.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Marina Bay, and from the balcony rooms the Marina Bay Sands towers fade slowly into white.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, bright day, guests at JAAN by Kirk Westaway stay warm at one of its 35 seats and look out at the skyline all around.
phrases.cold: The pool is empty on this cold day, and Marina Bay Sands rises in plain view behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, swimmers in the pool keep only their heads above water, all turned towards Marina Bay Sands.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests stand on their balconies in robes and look straight across at Marina Bay Sands and the waterfront.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In L65 Lounge, guests leave their drinks on the table to photograph the gold light on Marina Bay Sands.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud and lights the ArtScience Museum and the water of Marina Bay, seen from SKAI.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in L65 Lounge see Marina Bay Sands lit in blue across the water, with the Esplanade bright beside it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of Marina Bay spread into soft colours on the wet glass of L65 Lounge.
phrases.mild_night: Open since 1986, the tower looks down on a mild night, with low cloud above and the lights of Marina Bay Sands below.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the city lights circle Marina Bay, and Marina Bay Sands shines straight ahead.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Marina Bay lies quiet, and Marina Bay Sands is a tall outline beyond the water.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests at SKAI watch the first lights come on along Marina Bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Waitemata Harbour lies dark and still around the wharf, under a clear sky that is only starting to turn grey.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast, guests look through floor-to-ceiling windows at Waitemata Harbour, bright under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Lunch at FISH faces Waitemata Harbour directly, and the midday light makes the water shine.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Waitemata Harbour this morning, and guests on the harbour-facing balconies watch them move over the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lounge chairs by the floor-to-ceiling windows, guests watch the moored vessels as sun and cloud take turns over Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Waitemata Harbour takes the same colour on all three sides.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over Waitemata Harbour today, and the moored vessels near the lounge windows look soft at the edges.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Waitemata Harbour is not visible today; guests see the water close to the wharf and the nearest moored vessels.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Waitemata Harbour, and the drops mark the water outside the windows of FISH.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Waitemata Harbour, and guests in the lounge watch the storm through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Waitemata Harbour, and guests stand at the lounge windows to watch the flakes disappear into the water.
phrases.very_cold: Waitemata Harbour is sharp and bright in the freezing air, and guests enjoy it from the warm side of the lounge windows.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests keep to the lounge and look out at Waitemata Harbour and its moored vessels.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, swimmers in the slender outdoor pool look along the water, which seems to run straight into Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.warm: On the balcony sun loungers, books stay closed while guests look at Waitemata Harbour instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns Waitemata Harbour gold, and from the waterfront suites the Sky Tower catches the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud, and bright patches cross Waitemata Harbour beside the wharf.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in FISH, guests look out at Waitemata Harbour, where the lights of the waterfront shine under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of FISH this evening, and the lights on Waitemata Harbour blur behind it.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers the night sky, and the city skyline throws a soft glow across Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the waterfront suites see the lit Sky Tower above the dark water of Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Waitemata Harbour is quiet on three sides, and guests still awake can feel they are aboard a ship.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights begin to show along the edge of Waitemata Harbour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky grows pale behind the Gangnam towers, and the Seoul skyline slowly takes shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the glass towers of Gangnam, and guests in south-facing rooms watch Teheran-ro fill with traffic.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Seoul skyline spreads wide across Gangnam, each tower sharp against the blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Sun and cloud take turns over Bongeunsa this morning, and guests in north-facing rooms look down on the temple grounds.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the 34th floor watch clouds drift over the Seoul skyline, their shadows sliding across Gangnam.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the glass towers along Teheran-ro take the same colour, and the avenue runs straight between them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Seoul skyline today, and the towers of Gangnam fade one row at a time.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant city is not visible today; guests see only the nearer Gangnam towers and the temple grounds of Bongeunsa.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Teheran-ro, and guests watch the traffic move slowly between the wet towers of Gangnam.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Seoul skyline, and from the 34th floor guests watch the storm cross Gangnam.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the temple grounds of Bongeunsa, and they slowly turn white among the towers.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, pale winter light lies on the Seoul skyline, and Gangnam looks very still from above.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look across Gangnam from the upper floors, where the towers stand clear in thin light.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over Teheran-ro, and guests look down on the avenue from the cool side of the glass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the temple grounds of Bongeunsa make a calm open space among the Gangnam towers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in this 550-room hotel watch the late sun turn the glass towers of Gangnam gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and colours one side of the Seoul skyline, while the other side waits in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: On the 34th floor, guests choose a wine with the sommelier while the lights of Seoul glow under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows this evening, and the lights of Teheran-ro blur into long coloured lines.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hold the glow of the city tonight, and the Gangnam towers shine below them.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests look across the lit Seoul skyline and wonder if anyone in Gangnam's offices has gone home.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Teheran-ro is nearly still, and guests who cannot sleep count the few cars passing below.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on in the towers along Teheran-ro.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Horseshoe Falls is a pale curve in the dark, and the clear sky behind it is just starting to lighten.
phrases.clear_morning: At Terrapin Café, the breakfast buffet has competition: Horseshoe Falls and American Falls stand in clear morning light outside the windows.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, American Falls and Horseshoe Falls are both sharp, and white mist rises above them.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests at Terrapin Café take breakfast slowly this morning, as cloud shadows cross Horseshoe Falls one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds move over Niagara Falls this afternoon, and the mist turns from white to grey and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Horseshoe Falls keeps its own white, and guests in falls-view rooms on the 21st floor can follow its full curve.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Niagara Falls today; guests see the near edge of Horseshoe Falls and trust that the rest is still there.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see Niagara Falls in soft outline and nothing of the land beyond it.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of the falls-view rooms, and guests watch Horseshoe Falls add its own water below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Niagara Falls, and each flash of lightning shows Horseshoe Falls and American Falls for a moment.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Niagara Falls now, and the white mist and the white flakes are difficult to tell apart.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests stay behind the glass on the 21st floor and look at the mist of Horseshoe Falls rising into the cold air.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, American Falls shows clearly beside the wide curve of Horseshoe Falls.
phrases.very_hot: The heat is strong today, and the mist over Horseshoe Falls looks like the only cool thing in sight.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests with a falls-view room leave the curtains open, and Niagara Falls fills the window.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the mist over Horseshoe Falls gold, and guests stop what they are doing to look.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Niagara Falls catch the colour first, then the mist over American Falls follows.
phrases.grey_evening: At Morton's Grille, guests at the window tables have dinner with Horseshoe Falls and American Falls under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and from a window table at Morton's Grille, Canada's first of the name, guests watch it blur Niagara Falls.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the mist of Horseshoe Falls still shows, a soft white patch above the dark water.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests at Morton's Grille look up from their plates to the stars above Horseshoe Falls.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Niagara Falls keeps falling in the dark, whether or not any guest is awake to look.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky above Niagara Falls is still bright, and the first lights come on around it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Kitayama ridgelines show as a dark line beyond the sleeping Okazaki district.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in RAQOU, guests look over the Okazaki district to the mountains under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun falls onto the Japanese gardens, and beyond them the low roofs of Okazaki reach to the Kitayama ridgelines.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Okazaki district this morning, while the Higashiyama mountains stay bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the north-facing rooms, guests watch clouds drift over the Kitayama ridgelines, with patches of sun on the gardens below.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the green of the garden designed by Ogawa Jihei VII looks deeper from AOI-DEN.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Kitayama ridgelines today, so the panorama from RAQOU ends softly at the roofs of Okazaki.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far mountains are not visible today; guests in the Heian-kyo View suites see the gardens and the nearest streets of Okazaki.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Japanese gardens, and guests at Spa KACHO watch it from the warm Keage onsen.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Higashiyama mountains, and guests in RAQOU see lightning flash above the low city.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Japanese gardens, and guests in the north-facing rooms watch the trees turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, the Kitayama ridgelines look sharp behind the city from the windows of Dominique Bouchet Kyoto Le Teppanyaki.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Keage onsen at Spa KACHO is the comfortable place to look at the gardens.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the roofs of Okazaki, and guests choose the cool side of the glass in RAQOU to study the mountains.
phrases.warm: Guests walking in the Japanese gardens on this warm day look up at the wooded Higashiyama slopes.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light crosses the Okazaki district and warms the Kitayama ridgelines at the far edge.
phrases.partly_golden: From AOI-DEN, guests see the last sun colour the clouds above the Higashiyama mountains.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests on this hillside, held since 1890, look down on the lights of Okazaki glowing under evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Okazaki district tonight, and the Japanese gardens shine wet below the north-facing rooms.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the mountains tonight, so guests in the Heian-kyo View suites look over a low field of city lights with no towers in it.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, stars sit above the Kitayama ridgelines, and the lights of Okazaki spread quietly below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Okazaki district is quiet, and the mountains behind it are only a darker edge to the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the low Okazaki district beyond the gardens.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Table Mountain is a flat dark shape above the still masts of the yacht marina.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of Table Mountain first, and guests on the rooftop room balconies watch it move down to the yacht marina.
phrases.clear_midday: Beyond the pool, the yacht marina shines under a clear sky, with Table Mountain rising sharp behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Small clouds cross Signal Hill this morning, while the yacht marina below stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows slide across Table Mountain this afternoon and then over the yachts in the marina.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the working harbour turns the colour of steel, and its boats stand out clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Table Mountain today, so the masts in the yacht marina become the clearest lines in sight.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Table Mountain is not visible today; from the private quay, guests see the yacht marina and the nearest Victoria & Alfred Waterfront buildings.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the yacht marina, and guests in the rooftop rooms watch the decks shine while Table Mountain fades.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Table Mountain for a second at a time, and thunder rolls over the working harbour.
phrases.snow: Snow drifts over the yacht marina, and Table Mountain turns white and faint behind the falling flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The heated pool lies still on the private quay in the freezing air, with Table Mountain clear and sharp behind it.
phrases.cold: Relaunched in 2024, Bascule Bar gives guests a cold-day seat with Table Mountain as the backdrop.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the pool up to their shoulders and look across the yacht marina to Table Mountain.
phrases.warm: On a warm day at Pool Bar, guests hold a cocktail and count the yachts in the marina, with Table Mountain behind.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the rock face of Table Mountain gold, and the rooftop room balconies face it directly.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between clouds and lights Signal Hill, then the hulls in the yacht marina.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront glow on the water of the working harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront tonight, and Table Mountain, the usual backdrop at Bascule Bar, is lost in the wet dark.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the terrace of the Waterfront Penthouse Suite looks over the lit Victoria & Alfred Waterfront.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the yacht marina lights repeat on the water, and Table Mountain stands black above them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the ship-shaped building rests on its quay like one more boat among the quiet yachts of the marina.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright behind Table Mountain while the first lights come on around the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Koutoubia Mosque minaret stands unlit above the sleeping medina rooftops, under the last stars.
phrases.clear_morning: From the roof terraces, the morning sun reaches the Koutoubia Mosque minaret first, then the medina rooftops below it.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Atlas Mountains show every peak behind the medina from the roof terraces.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the medina this morning, and their shadows cross the rooftops towards the Koutoubia Mosque minaret.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the roof terraces watch the afternoon clouds gather over the Atlas Mountains while the medina stays bright.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Koutoubia Mosque minaret keeps its warm stone colour above the medina rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the medina today, and the Koutoubia Mosque minaret looks like a pencil sketch above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Atlas Mountains are not visible today, but the Koutoubia Mosque minaret, less than 400 meters away, still shows clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the medina rooftops, and guests watch the Koutoubia Mosque minaret turn a darker shade through it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the medina, and for a second the Koutoubia Mosque minaret stands out sharply against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the medina rooftops, and the Koutoubia Mosque minaret fades behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Atlas Mountains stand sharp and clear beyond the medina rooftops.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests climb to the roof terraces for a short look at the Koutoubia Mosque minaret and the Atlas Mountains.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests cool off in the plunge pools on the roof terraces, with the Koutoubia Mosque minaret shimmering beyond the rooftops.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests rest on the roof terraces, looking past date palms to the Koutoubia Mosque minaret.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Koutoubia Mosque minaret gold, and the medina rooftops glow a deep ochre around it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the Koutoubia Mosque minaret, while the rooftops below are already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests on the roof terraces see the illuminated Koutoubia Mosque minaret rise above the medina rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the illuminated Koutoubia Mosque minaret glows softly through the rain above the shining medina rooftops.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, guests stay late on the roof terraces, where no one else can share their view of the illuminated Koutoubia Mosque minaret.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the 53 riads, and the illuminated Koutoubia Mosque minaret rises above the medina rooftops.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the medina rooftops lie quiet and still around the Koutoubia Mosque minaret.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still blue over the medina, and guests on the roof terraces watch the first lights come on around the Koutoubia Mosque minaret.

phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Seoul's skyscrapers first, then the low rooftops of Hongdae below the rooftop pool.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 22nd-floor rooftop pool, guests look across Seoul's skyscrapers under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the low roofs of Hongdae this morning, seen from the city-view rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the restaurant watch sun and cloud take turns over Seoul's dense skyline through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Seoul today, and the skyline of Hongdae takes the same quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Seoul's skyscrapers today, and from the rooftop pool the far towers look drawn in pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant skyscrapers of Seoul are not visible today; from the rooftop pool, guests see only the nearer roofs of Hongdae.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Seoul cityscape behind them turns soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the city-view suite watch lightning flash over the Seoul skyline while thunder rolls across Hongdae.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Hongdae, and guests watch the low roofs of Seoul turn white from their room windows.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and every tower on Seoul's skyline looks sharp from the 22nd floor.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows and look out over the roofs of Seoul.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the rooftop pool and look at Seoul's skyscrapers from there.

phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the city lights of Seoul spread out around the rooftop pool and the bar beside it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Hongdae this evening, and the city lights of Seoul shine blurred through the wet windows of the rooms.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hang low on this mild night, and they hold a soft glow from the lights of Seoul.
phrases.clear_night: From the 22nd floor, guests look over the city lights of Seoul under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Seoul's skyline stands quiet around the 22nd floor, and the streets of Hongdae finally rest.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright blue above Hongdae, and the first lights come on across the Seoul streetscape below.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky is clear and slowly turns pale before sunrise, and the Atlantic Ocean begins to separate from it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in the ocean view rooms see it from the bed before they get up.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the water off Gigi Beach is turquoise, exactly the colour the sun-loungers were placed to face.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Miami skyline this morning, and their shadows cross the buildings one at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Atlantic Ocean shows two colours, bright where the sun gets through and darker under the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean takes the same grey, and the white sand of the beach looks brighter beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Miami skyline today, and the buildings look like a row drawn in light pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Miami skyline cannot be seen, and the Atlantic Ocean shows only its first waves near the beach.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic Ocean, and guests watch it from the window seats of the ocean view rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Atlantic Ocean, and with each flash of lightning guests see the waves for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the white sand and the Atlantic Ocean, and guests take a photo before anyone doubts them.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, bright day, the Atlantic Ocean is a sharp blue and the beach in front of it is empty.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look at the Miami skyline through cool, clean air and can count its buildings.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the sun-loungers at Gigi Beach look at the turquoise water and then walk into it.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in this 1947 hotel lie by the ground-floor pool and look past the palms to the Art Deco buildings beyond.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Under a clear sky, guests watch the late afternoon light turn the Miami skyline gold, one building after another.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Miami skyline turn pink and orange, and the buildings darken beneath them.
phrases.grey_evening: This evening the sky is grey and without stars, so the lights of the Miami skyline do the work instead.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights of the Miami skyline spread into soft coloured spots.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Atlantic Ocean shows only as white wave tops arriving on the beach.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and from the Penthouse Suites the Miami skyline is a long row of lights.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic Ocean is one dark shape, and the foam at the edge of the beach is all that moves.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and guests in the city view rooms watch the first lights come on across the Miami skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the bay of Saint-Tropez lies still and grey-blue below the terrace suites, and the sky over the water slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the terrace is served beside a calm blue sea this morning, with the bay of Saint-Tropez clear to the far shore.
phrases.clear_midday: From the terrace, lunch guests look over a bright blue sea, and the midday light makes the water of La Ponche cove clear.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the bay of Saint-Tropez this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the sea in front of the pontoon.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the village rooftops this afternoon, and the sea beyond them changes from blue to grey and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the bay of Saint-Tropez takes the colour of the clouds, and the sea in La Ponche cove stays calm.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the bay of Saint-Tropez today, and from the terrace the far shore is only a faint mark above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the bay of Saint-Tropez is not visible today; guests on the terrace see La Ponche cove and the near water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on La Ponche cove, and guests watch the drops mark the grey sea from the sea-view rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the bay of Saint-Tropez, and guests in the sea-view rooms watch lightning flash above the dark water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the bay of Saint-Tropez, and the village rooftops slowly turn white in front of a grey sea.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the bay of Saint-Tropez is sharp and blue in the cold air, and the terrace by the sea looks straight onto it.
phrases.cold: The sea is a cold blue today, and the pontoon in La Ponche cove stands empty above the clear water.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, swimmers leave the pontoon for the sea, and La Ponche cove shines almost white under the sun.
phrases.warm: On the pontoon, guests lie in the warm air and look across La Ponche cove to the open sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Citadel and the sea, and guests on the terrace by the water stop to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and turns the bay of Saint-Tropez gold, while the village rooftops glow orange for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner on the terrace is served beside a dark, quiet sea tonight, and cloud hides the stars over the bay of Saint-Tropez.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the sea this evening, and guests on the covered terrace look out at the wet, dark cove.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the terrace the bay of Saint-Tropez is a wide dark space with a few lights on the far shore.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the bay of Saint-Tropez tonight, and guests look at them from the terrace beside the sea, as Bardot once did.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the village rooftops are quiet, and the sea beyond them is black and still.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the bay of Saint-Tropez just after sunset, and the first lights appear along the far shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Lugano is a grey sheet below the hillside, and the Alps stand clear against the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Lake Lugano, and guests on the south-facing balconies see the Alps sharp behind the water.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Lake Lugano shines blue between the forested hills below the outdoor pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Malcantone mountains this morning, while Lake Lugano stays bright in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Through the lake-facing windows of Radici Gourmet, guests follow the clouds drifting over Lake Lugano towards the Alps.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Lake Lugano turns the colour of slate, and the forested hills around it look a darker green.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Lake Lugano today, and from the terrace of Radici Gourmet the Alps fade to a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today; guests at the DOT Spa pool see only the nearer hills and a pale Lake Lugano.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lake Lugano, and guests watch it from behind the panoramic windows of Radici Gourmet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Malcantone mountains, and for a second Lake Lugano shows white far below the balconies.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the hillside, and Lake Lugano appears and disappears between the flakes beyond the outdoor pool.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air makes the Alps look sharp above Lake Lugano, and guests admire them from the warm side of their balcony doors.

phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool up to their shoulders and look over its edge at Lake Lugano.
phrases.warm: Guests sit in the outdoor whirlpool on this warm day, with Lake Lugano and the forested ridges spread out below them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lies across Lake Lugano, which fills the view from the terrace jacuzzi of the Bella Vista Suite.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Alps turn pink, and Lake Lugano takes the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Radici Gourmet, guests look through the windows at the lights around Lake Lugano under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the hillside this evening, and the lights around Lake Lugano blur into soft yellow dots.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, Lake Lugano is a dark shape between the hills, with a few lights on its shore.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the hillside is silent, and Lake Lugano lies quiet far below.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests 850 metres up the hillside see the first lights appear along Lake Lugano.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Pacific Ocean is a wide, quiet surface under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The Pacific Ocean is bright blue this clear morning, and each wave shows as a white line moving to the shore.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Pacific Ocean shines so strongly that guests on the balconies reach for sunglasses.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning clouds drift over the Pacific Ocean and leave moving patches of shade on the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Pacific Ocean changes between silver and blue as the clouds pass over it.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean takes the same colour, and only the white waves stand out.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Pacific Ocean today, and guests see the nearest waves come out of the white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the Pacific Ocean fades away before the horizon and the coastal hills are not in sight.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pacific Ocean, and guests watch it through the glass of their balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second guests see every wave in the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Pacific Ocean, and guests look twice to be sure of it.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold air the Pacific Ocean looks sharp and deep blue, and the horizon is a clean line.
phrases.cold: On this cold day guests stay behind the glass and follow the long waves of the Pacific Ocean.

phrases.warm: On this warm day guests sit on the ocean-view balconies and watch people walk along the Pismo Beach shoreline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun lays a gold path across the Pacific Ocean, and the wet sand shines beside it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun the clouds over the Pacific Ocean turn orange and pink, and the water copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening sky is covered, and the Pacific Ocean is a dark surface with soft white edges near the shore.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the Pacific Ocean is mostly hidden, with only the nearest waves showing through the wet glass.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pacific Ocean is almost black, and only the breaking waves are still in sight.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky over the Pacific Ocean is still bright, and guests in the upper-floor suites watch the water turn violet.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dallas skyline is a row of quiet towers under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the glass of Fountain Place, and guests in the upper-floor corner suites see the tower shine.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 32nd floor, the Dallas skyline spreads wide under a clear midday sky, every tower sharp.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Dallas skyline this morning, and Fountain Place changes from bright to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the corner suites follow the clouds this afternoon as they pass above the Margaret Hunt Hill Bridge.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the glass of Fountain Place takes the colour of the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Dallas skyline today, and from the 32nd floor the farther towers look like pencil drawings.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the Margaret Hunt Hill Bridge is missing from the view and only the nearer towers of the Dallas skyline show.

phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, the Dallas skyline looks sharp in the cold air, and guests are happy to look at it from indoors.

phrases.warm: On the 32nd floor, where the indoor pool is, guests look out at the Dallas skyline on a warm day.

phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hang low this evening, and the lights of the Dallas skyline give them a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in the bar lounge see the lit Dallas skyline through glass that the weather keeps washing.

phrases.thunderstorm: From the Sky Lounge on the 24th floor, guests watch lightning flash behind the 25 de Abril Bridge while thunder rolls over the low rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Lisbon, and the Águas Livres Aqueduct and the trees of Monsanto Forest Park slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is clear, and guests in the Sky Lounge hold warm cups and look north to the Águas Livres Aqueduct.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Águas Livres Aqueduct stands clear to the north, and behind it Monsanto Forest Park stays green.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the 25 de Abril Bridge shimmers in the south, and guests are happy to watch it from indoors in the Sky Lounge.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours Lisbon is quiet, and the 25 de Abril Bridge is only a dark shape to the south above the sleeping rooftops.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky turns purple, and the first lights come on along the Águas Livres Aqueduct and the 25 de Abril Bridge.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, only the white surf shows where the sand ends and the Atlantic Ocean begins.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Atlantic Ocean, and the first lights come on along the coast toward South Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Andaman Sea lies calm and grey-blue off Panwa Beach under a clear sky.

phrases.clear_night: Guests dining at a table on Panwa Beach have a clear night sky full of stars over the Andaman Sea.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Panwa Beach is empty and the Andaman Sea is quiet and black.
