phrases.partly_golden: Guests in the Executive King Sea View rooms watch the last sun slip between clouds and colour the Mediterranean Sea pink.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner on Le 3e Restaurant Terrace, guests look out at an ocean gone dark under the evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: From the Prestige Sea View rooms, the Mediterranean Sea is a dark blur behind this evening's rain.
phrases.mild_night: The Promenade des Anglais stays bright under tonight's cloud, and the Bay of Angels lies dark beside it.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the Executive King Sea View rooms look out on a Mediterranean Sea lying dark under the stars.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Penthouse Suite sleep in rooms that face out, and the Bay of Angels keeps the night shift.
phrases.dusk: Mont Alban turns to a dark outline as the first lights appear along the Promenade des Anglais.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky over Victoria Harbour slowly turns from black to deep blue, and the water is still.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the WET Deck on the 76th floor, and Victoria Harbour lies clear and blue below it.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests on the treadmills of the FIT fitness centre look out over Victoria Harbour under a clear midday sky, and nobody checks the distance run.
phrases.partly_morning: Part sun, part cloud this morning: the Hong Kong Island skyline across Victoria Harbour is bright one minute and grey the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Victoria Harbour this afternoon, and boats cross patches of sun and shade on the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Victoria Harbour turns the colour of steel, and the skyline behind it stands sharp against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Victoria Harbour today, and the skyline behind it looks like a faint pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the near water of Victoria Harbour is clear to see, while Hong Kong Island on the far side is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in the harbour-view rooms watch Victoria Harbour turn grey and blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the indoor pool watch lightning over Victoria Harbour, safe behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Victoria Harbour, and the skyline behind it fades to white, flake by flake.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing, clear day, guests sit in the warm spa hot tub and look across Victoria Harbour to the skyline.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the loungers on the WET Deck stand empty, and Victoria Harbour and the ICC building have the terrace to themselves.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests stay in the WET Deck pool up to their shoulders and look down on Victoria Harbour shining in the sun.
phrases.warm: A warm day brings guests to the loungers on the rooftop pool terrace, where the skyline rises behind Victoria Harbour.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Victoria Harbour gold, and guests watch the boats cross it from a soaking tub beside the window.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Victoria Harbour turn orange, and the water below takes the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in a Bliss Spa treatment room look out at the lit Hong Kong Island skyline across Victoria Harbour under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Victoria Harbour this evening, and the skyline lights across the water run together on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the clouds above Victoria Harbour take a soft glow from the city lights below them.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the Extreme Wow Suite have the lit skyline and Victoria Harbour in front of the bar, the dining room and even the aquarium fish.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Victoria Harbour lies quiet far below, its water black between the two shores.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the WET Deck glows pink and purple under a still-bright sky, and the first lights come on along Victoria Harbour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before the day begins, the Eiffel Tower is a dark outline against a slowly paling sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Eylau Paris Rooftop, the Eiffel Tower stands sharp in the morning sun, every iron beam easy to follow.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday light falls straight onto the Eiffel Tower, and its iron lattice is clear from base to tip.
phrases.partly_morning: Seen from La Bulle d’Eylau, the Eiffel Tower moves in and out of sunlight as the morning clouds pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift past the top of the Eiffel Tower this afternoon, with patches of sun sliding down its iron sides.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Eiffel Tower stands dark and clear, like a drawing in pencil.
phrases.fog_haze: Only the lower half of the Eiffel Tower is clear from La Bulle d’Eylau, the top fading into the mist.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Distant rooftops are lost in the thick air today, and the Eiffel Tower shows only as a pale grey shape.
phrases.rain: Through the rain, the Eiffel Tower turns a darker grey and its top goes soft at the edges.
phrases.thunderstorm: Storm clouds hang dark and low over the Eiffel Tower, and guests stay indoors to watch the weather pass.
phrases.snow: Falling snow turns the Eiffel Tower into a faint grey outline, and guests watch it from indoors.
phrases.very_cold: Guests admire the Eiffel Tower from indoors today, in no hurry to put their coats on.
phrases.cold: The Eiffel Tower stands crisp and still today, and guests enjoy it from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: Guests on the Eylau Paris Rooftop look for shade first and the Eiffel Tower second.
phrases.warm: On La Bulle d’Eylau, guests sit in short sleeves facing the Eiffel Tower and are in no hurry to go anywhere.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Brown iron turns gold on the Eiffel Tower as the afternoon comes to an end.
phrases.partly_golden: A gap in the clouds lets the last sun through, and the Eiffel Tower glows orange for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: A soft glow from the lit Eiffel Tower reaches the low cloud above it, in full view of the Eylau Paris Rooftop.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass tonight, and guests see the Eiffel Tower's lights stretched into long gold streaks.
phrases.mild_night: Gold against the dark, the Eiffel Tower is the last thing guests look at before closing the curtains.
phrases.clear_night: Guests who planned an early night are still up, watching the Eiffel Tower shine in the clear dark.
phrases.dusk: Phones come out as the Eiffel Tower starts to light up against a still-bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale above São Jorge Castle, and the Tagus River slowly takes shape.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the 24th-floor Club Lounge, guests watch the morning sun light São Jorge Castle and the Tagus River.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Tagus River shines blue beyond the rooftops, and Christ the King stands clear above it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Eduardo VII Park this morning, while São Jorge Castle stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the south-facing rooms on the upper floors, guests follow patches of sun as they move across the city towards the Tagus River.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Tagus River turns silver-grey, and São Jorge Castle keeps its place on the hill.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Lisbon today; from the Club Lounge, São Jorge Castle is a faint outline and the Tagus River fades into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Christ the King and the Tagus River cannot be seen, but São Jorge Castle still shows above the nearer rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain drums on the tower known as Lisbon's eighth hill, and São Jorge Castle looks blurred across the wet rooftops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Club Lounge watch lightning flash over the Tagus River, safe and dry behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Lisbon, and guests on the upper floors watch São Jorge Castle slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air makes every line sharp today, and guests pick out the walls of São Jorge Castle from the warm Club Lounge.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Tagus River looks like steel, and Eduardo VII Park lies green below the tower.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, the Tagus River shimmers white, and guests choose a cold drink at Panorama Bar with Lisbon spread out below.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests in river-facing rooms open the window and let São Jorge Castle and the Tagus River in with the air.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Tagus River gold, and the 25 de Abril Bridge draws a thin line across it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights Christ the King, then São Jorge Castle, like a lamp moving across Lisbon.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars tonight, so guests with a drink in the Club Lounge look down at the city lights running to the Tagus River instead.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass of Panorama Restaurant, and guests over a meal watch the evening lights of Lisbon through the drops.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit walls of São Jorge Castle glow above the rooftops, and the Tagus River lies black beyond them.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and guests on the upper floors see the lights of Christ the King and the 25 de Abril Bridge shining over the Tagus River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lisbon is quiet below, and the Tagus River is a wide stripe of darkness between its two banks.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on around São Jorge Castle while the Tagus River holds the last colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a dark surface under a clear sky, and the Pismo Beach Pier is only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches the Pismo Beach Pier, and the Pacific Ocean behind it turns from grey to blue.
phrases.clear_midday: From Cypress Beach House on the rooftop, guests look along the coastline and down to the Pacific Ocean under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pacific Ocean this morning, and the Pismo Beach Pier goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Corner Ocean View Suite walk around their balcony this afternoon and find the Pacific Ocean under a different cloud at each corner.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the Pacific Ocean is the same grey as the clouds, and the Pismo Beach Pier stands out clearly against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Pacific Ocean today, and the far end of the Pismo Beach Pier fades into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests on the balconies see the Pismo Beach Pier and the first waves of the Pacific Ocean, and little beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pacific Ocean, and guests watch it wet the boards of the Pismo Beach Pier from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Pacific Ocean for a second, and guests count the seconds to the thunder from their ocean view rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Pismo Beach Pier, and guests look twice before they believe it, as the flakes disappear into the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Pacific Ocean looks sharp and very blue, and guests admire it through the glass with a hot drink.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Pacific Ocean is rough and white along the beach, and the rooftop terrace looks straight out over it.
phrases.very_hot: Guests stay in the rooftop splash pool in this heat and look out over the rail at the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop pool deck, guests lie on the lounge chairs with the Pacific Ocean in front of them and no plans at all.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls across the Pacific Ocean in the late afternoon, and the palm trees and the Pismo Beach Pier turn dark against it.
phrases.partly_golden: At Cypress Beach House, guests hold their cocktails and watch the sun drop between the clouds towards the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests at dinner at Cypress Beach House look down on the lights of the Pismo Beach Pier under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of the Pismo Beach Pier shine on the wet evening, and the Pacific Ocean behind them is lost in the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the Pacific Ocean is black beyond the balconies, and the lights of the Pismo Beach Pier reflect on the water.
phrases.clear_night: Stars hang over the Pacific Ocean on this clear night, and the lights of the Pismo Beach Pier point straight out to sea.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pacific Ocean is more heard than seen, and only the white of the breaking waves shows from the 104 rooms.
phrases.dusk: The sky over the Pacific Ocean is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Pismo Beach Pier.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Garda lies still and grey-blue under a clear sky, with the cypress trees of the park black against it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches Lake Garda under a clear sky, and from the 3rd-floor terrace suites the water stretches directly ahead.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch under the pergola of Al Molo Grill & Bar, guests look across the bright, flat water of Lake Garda.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Lake Garda this morning, and guests on the lake-facing balconies watch them move over the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Lake Garda this afternoon, and the water changes from blue to silver and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Lake Garda takes the same colour, and the green of the park's cypress trees stands out in front of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Lake Garda today, and from the private pier the water seems to have no far side.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far part of Lake Garda is not visible today; guests see the water near the pier and the trees of the park.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lake Garda, and guests watch the drops mark the water from the windows of the lake view rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses Lake Garda, and each flash of lightning shows the whole water for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Lake Garda, and the park's cypress trees turn white while the water stays dark behind them.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Lake Garda looks sharp and clear from the Belvedere, right to its far shore.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Lake Garda is a steel blue, and the empty private pier points straight into it.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the sun loungers of the private pier look at Lake Garda and think about jumping in.
phrases.warm: On the 500-square-metre private pier, guests lie on sun loungers while Lake Garda shines all around them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light covers Lake Garda as the sun gets lower, and the terrace of Le Gardenie looks towards it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds over Lake Garda, and guests in the west-facing suites of this 19th-century villa see the water turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner on the terrace of Le Gardenie, guests look over Lake Garda as it goes dark under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, Lake Garda fades into rain and darkness beyond the end of the private pier.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the night sky, and Lake Garda is a wide, quiet surface seen from the Belvedere.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests at a candlelit table on the Belvedere look out over Lake Garda, and the food has to wait a little.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Garda is a wide black space beyond the trees of the park.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still pink over Lake Garda, and the lanterns of the Belvedere begin to glow above the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Huangpu River is a quiet grey band, and the Oriental Pearl Tower stands plain against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests wake to a clear morning, with the Oriental Pearl Tower sharp above the Huangpu River.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Premier River View Suite, guests see the Oriental Pearl Tower and the Huangpu River together under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move along the Huangpu River this morning, and the Bund is in sun one minute and in shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At afternoon tea in Riviera Lounge, guests look out at the river promenade while clouds and sun take turns outside.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Huangpu River takes the same colour, and the Bund looks like an old photograph.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Huangpu River today, and the Oriental Pearl Tower fades towards its top.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests can see the Huangpu River today, but the Bund is not visible in the dull air.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and behind it the Oriental Pearl Tower looks slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Oriental Pearl Tower for a second, then the storm closes over the Huangpu River again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Huangpu River, and guests in the Premier River View Suite watch the Bund slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, bright day, guests can count the buildings along the Bund from indoors.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests keep to the sofas in Riviera Lounge and watch the river promenade through the glass.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Huangpu River, and the Oriental Pearl Tower seems to tremble a little in the bright air.
phrases.warm: From Riviera Lounge, guests watch walkers on the river promenade enjoy the warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the Premier River View Suite, guests watch the late sun turn the Huangpu River gold beside the Oriental Pearl Tower.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the Oriental Pearl Tower turns pink for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Oriental Pearl Tower colour the sky above the Huangpu River.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Bund stretch into long reflections on the Huangpu River.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests in this hotel of 4,000 artworks look at one more picture: the lit Bund on the Huangpu River.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the Oriental Pearl Tower shines in full colour over the Huangpu River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Huangpu River keeps moving quietly, and the Bund rests beside it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Bund and on the Oriental Pearl Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is a wide, quiet surface under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the multilevel pool deck, the Atlantic is bright blue this morning, with clear sky down to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sand of the Grand Strand is very bright under the clear sky, and the Atlantic beside it is deep blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic this morning, and guests follow them from their private balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The wooden deck looks over sea oats and sandy dunes to the Atlantic, where sun and cloud take turns this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic takes the same colour, and only the white of the breaking waves stands out.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Atlantic today, and seen from the pool deck, sea and sky become one pale surface.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Grand Strand is not visible today; guests see the dunes and the nearest waves of the Atlantic, and little beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic, and guests watch it from the oceanfront villas, the waves grey behind wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Atlantic, and lightning shows the waves for a second at a time through the balcony doors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sandy dunes and the sea oats, and the Atlantic behind them looks darker than usual.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the pool deck stands empty in front of a sharp blue Atlantic.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Grand Strand is a long, empty stretch of sand, and guests are happy to look at it from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: In the poolside cabanas, guests stay in the shade and look out at the Atlantic shining in the strong heat.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the pool deck keep turning from the water in the pool to the bigger water just beyond it, the Atlantic.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun gives the sea oats and dunes a golden colour, and the Atlantic beyond them turns a softer blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Atlantic turn pink, and guests in the 152 villas have a balcony to see it from.
phrases.grey_evening: After sunset under cloud, the Atlantic and the sky become one dark space, and the fire pits on the pool deck give the only warm colour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and from The Back Porch Pool Bar the Atlantic is more a sound than a sight.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Atlantic is a wide dark surface with no horizon, and the dunes are a paler band in front of it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Atlantic on this clear night, and the Grand Strand runs away into the dark on both sides.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Atlantic keeps moving while the resort sleeps, and each wave leaves a faint white edge on the sand.
phrases.dusk: At the open-air bar, with sand for a floor, guests look at the Atlantic while the sky is still bright after sunset.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is a grey sheet under a clear sky, and Fistral Beach lies empty below the sea-view rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at Dune Restaurant has competition this morning: clear light on Fistral Beach and clean lines of Atlantic surf.
phrases.clear_midday: From the terrace, Fistral Beach is bright sand under a clear midday sky, with the Atlantic blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Fistral Beach this morning, and guests in the sea-view balcony rooms watch the sand change from gold to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon tea at Bay Bar has a slow show today, as patches of sun and shade move over Fistral Beach.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic turns the colour of slate, and the white breakers on Fistral Beach stand out more clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the waves seem to arrive from nowhere onto Fistral Beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of Fistral Beach is not visible today, but the nearest waves still show clearly from the sea-view rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the large windows of Dune Restaurant, and Fistral Beach beyond them is a blur of sand and white water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests at Bay Bar watch the stormy seas today, as lightning flashes over the Atlantic and the breakers hit Fistral Beach.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Fistral Beach, and guests in the indoor hot tub watch the flakes vanish into the sea beyond the large window.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and the Atlantic is sharp blue, so guests choose the indoor hot tub and its large window on the sea.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, Bay Bar is a place to cosy up with a coffee and watch the breakers roll onto Fistral Beach.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the terrace sit with cold drinks and look at the Atlantic, which is turquoise near the sand.
phrases.warm: Guests sit on the terrace in the warm air, and below them Fistral Beach is busy with surfers and their boards.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights each wave on Fistral Beach, and from the private hot tub of The Suite the whole beach is in sight.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the cloud, and gold patches move across the Atlantic below the terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Dune Restaurant, guests look out at a cloudy evening, where only the white surf still shows on Fistral Beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain beats on the windows of Bay Bar this evening, and guests with cocktails watch the dim white surf on Fistral Beach.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the Atlantic is black beyond the sea-view balcony rooms, and the waves on Fistral Beach are only just visible.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic tonight, and the surf on Fistral Beach shows as faint white lines.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Fistral Beach is dark and empty, and only the white edges of the waves can be seen from The Suite.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Atlantic is still bright, and the wet sand of Fistral Beach shines with its colours.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lion's Head is a dark shape on the right of the balconies, and Camps Bay below is still quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the sand of Camps Bay, and the Atlantic Ocean is deep blue from the balcony rooms.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop pool looks over a bright Atlantic Ocean, with the rocky shoreline sharp below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past Lion's Head this morning, while the sun terrace and Camps Bay stay mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Atlantic Ocean this afternoon, seen from the sun loungers on the sun terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns the colour of steel, and Lion's Head stands clear above Camps Bay.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Camps Bay today, and Lion's Head looks like a pencil drawing against the pale sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon over the Atlantic Ocean is not visible today, but the boulders and palm trees of Camps Bay are clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Camps Bay; guests watch it from their balcony doors, with Lion's Head slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the Atlantic Ocean, and lightning briefly shows the outline of Lion's Head from the sea-facing suites.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Camps Bay, and the palm trees on the promenade turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, every line of Lion's Head looks sharp above Camps Bay.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Atlantic Ocean shows white lines of surf along the rocky shoreline of Camps Bay.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and watch the Atlantic Ocean from the water.
phrases.warm: On the sun terrace, books stay closed while guests in the sun loungers look at Camps Bay instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the sun terrace, guests watch Lion's Head turn gold as the sun gets low over the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and colours the Atlantic Ocean orange in front of the rooftop pool.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Camps Bay promenade shine below the sun terrace, with the Atlantic Ocean dark beyond.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain wets the Camps Bay promenade this evening, and its lights shine on the wet ground beside the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds cover the stars over Camps Bay, and Lion's Head is a darker outline against the sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above Lion's Head tonight, and the lights of Camps Bay follow the curve of the shore.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Camps Bay is asleep, and only the white surf of the Atlantic Ocean moves.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky over the Atlantic Ocean is still bright, and the first promenade lights come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Osaka skyline is a still outline under a clear sky that slowly grows lighter over the distant hills.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Table36, guests look through floor-to-ceiling windows at the Osaka skyline in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At Table36 on the top floor, the lunch buffet has competition, because the whole Osaka skyline lies clear under a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the roofs of Namba this morning, and the skyline behind them stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in north-facing rooms watch sun and cloud take turns over the Ebisu Tower Ferris Wheel this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the towers of Osaka take the same colour, and the streets of Namba run between them like lines on a map.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Osaka skyline today, and the distant hills are missing from the panorama at Table36.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the city is not visible today; from the suite windows, guests see Namba clearly before the skyline fades.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of Table36, and the Osaka skyline behind them looks slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses Osaka, and guests in this 36-storey tower watch lightning flash over the skyline from their city-view rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Namba, and the rooftops below turn white while the far skyline disappears behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and the distant hills behind the Osaka skyline show sharp edges.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass at Table36 and look across the Osaka skyline without needing a coat.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the roofs of Namba, and the Osaka skyline seems to tremble a little in the strong light.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, the streets of Namba lie far below in bright light, and the city spreads out towards the hills.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the towers of Osaka gold, and long shadows stretch across Namba below.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Strip is quiet below the west side, and Wynn Golf Club is all darkness on the east.

phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility hides the far mountain today, so guests in the garden-facing rooms look at the botanical gardens instead.

phrases.thunderstorm: Guests count the seconds between each flash of lightning over the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon and the thunder that follows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, each flake gone the moment it touches the turquoise water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold over Olhuveli Island today, yet the lagoon keeps its clear turquoise under a bright sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay in the ocean-facing treatment rooms of Six Senses Spa and look out at the open sea.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the overwater deck look down at the lagoon and think about the shortest way into it.
phrases.warm: On the lounge chairs in the sand by the pool, guests face the ocean and forget which page they were on.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon gold, seen from the overwater deck all the way to the open horizon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the lagoon turn orange and pink, and the water copies each colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Evening cloud hides the stars, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon around Olhuveli Island shows almost no colour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the dark lagoon this evening, and guests in the overwater villas watch it from their doorways.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lagoon shows only a faint grey where the water meets the white sand beach.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night the stars are out above the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and the calm water holds a few of them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the lagoon is quiet and dark, and the house reef keeps its night life to itself.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky stays bright over the lagoon, and the palms along the white sand beach become dark shapes.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Mediterranean is a calm grey sheet beyond the private beach, and the pier reaches out into it unlit.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Mediterranean, and guests on the sea-view balconies look straight out over it.
phrases.clear_midday: The Mediterranean is deep blue under a clear midday sky, and the pier draws a straight line into it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Mediterranean this morning, and guests at the beachfront pavilion follow them over the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Poseidon, one of 8 à la carte restaurants here, guests see a Mediterranean half in sunshine and half under cloud this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the Mediterranean turns grey-green, and the pier stands out clearly against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Mediterranean seems to end just past the tip of the pier.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests on the sea-view balconies see the pier and the near water, then only pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Mediterranean, and guests at Barbeque watch it mark the grey water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows over the Mediterranean, and guests behind their balcony doors count the seconds before the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Lara Beach, and the flakes disappear the moment they touch the Mediterranean.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and clear today, and guests at Poseidon see the Mediterranean sharp and blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.cold: The private beach is empty on this cold day, and guests at Barbeque watch the waves come in from the Mediterranean.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the pier look down into the clear Mediterranean water and think about jumping in.
phrases.warm: At the beachfront pavilion, guests sit through the warm day with phones face down, looking across the sand to the Mediterranean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Mediterranean and the pier late in the afternoon, and long shadows cross the beach lounge.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Mediterranean, and guests on the sea-view balconies stay outside to see it go.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the illuminated pier glows blue above the dark Mediterranean.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the pier this evening, and guests at Poseidon watch them shake on the wet Mediterranean.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lantern light of the beach lounge reaches just as far as the first waves of the Mediterranean.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show over the Mediterranean on this clear night, while the illuminated pier offers some competition from below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Mediterranean is a wide dark space beyond the sand, with only the white edges of the waves showing.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the pier turns blue with light, and the lanterns of the beach lounge start to glow on the sand.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Brisbane River is a dark curve below the apartments, and the sky above it is just starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Brisbane River, and guests in the upper-floor apartments follow its bend from the living room.
phrases.clear_midday: From the indoor pool on level 66, guests look down on the Brisbane River and South Bank under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Brisbane River this morning, and South Bank goes from bright to dim and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests look out at an afternoon of broken cloud, with patches of sun travelling along the Brisbane River.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Brisbane River turns the same grey and curves quietly through the city.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and the Brisbane River fades away before its far bend.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far part of the city is not visible today; guests see the Brisbane River clearly only on its nearest stretch.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Brisbane River below looks blurred and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the city skyline, and for a second the Brisbane River shines white below the apartments.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Brisbane River, and guests stand at the glass to watch this rare sight.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing day, guests stay in the warm indoor pool on level 66 and look at the Brisbane River through the glass.
phrases.cold: The cold air is clear today, and the Brisbane River shows a sharp edge along South Bank.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Brisbane River shines like metal, and guests look at it from the cool indoor pool.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests leave their books closed and look down at South Bank and the Brisbane River instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Brisbane River gold, and guests watch the colour move along the bend.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the cloud and lights the Brisbane River in orange pieces.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights glow softly, and the Brisbane River carries their reflections through the middle.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the city lights spread into soft colours on the glass, with the Brisbane River dark between them.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the clouds sit low over the city, and the lights of South Bank shine beside the Brisbane River.
phrases.clear_night: From the indoor pool on level 66, guests swim above a clear night of city lights and the black curve of the Brisbane River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Brisbane River lies still and quiet below, and guests who cannot sleep have it to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along South Bank and the Brisbane River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over the English Channel, and St Paul's Parish Church tower is a dark shape above the roofs.
phrases.clear_morning: The first sun reaches St Paul's Parish Church tower, and the English Channel is bright blue behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: From the top-floor terrace, guests see the horizon of the English Channel clearly under a cloudless midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Brighton rooftops this morning, while St Paul's Parish Church tower stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the English Channel is blue in some places and grey in others, as clouds pass over the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the English Channel takes the same colour, and St Paul's Parish Church tower stands darker in front of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the English Channel and the sky look like one sheet behind St Paul's Parish Church tower.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The English Channel is not visible today; from the top-floor terrace, guests see St Paul's Parish Church tower and the nearest rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Brighton rooftops, and guests in the sea-view suites watch the English Channel turn grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay behind the glass and watch lightning over the English Channel, with thunder rolling across the city rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Brighton rooftops, and St Paul's Parish Church tower slowly turns white at the top.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests can see every stone edge of St Paul's Parish Church tower, with the English Channel sharp behind it.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look from their sea-view balconies at a steel-coloured English Channel, then go back to the kettle.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the top-floor terrace look over the shimmering roofs to the cooler blue of the English Channel.
phrases.warm: On the top-floor terrace of this aparthotel on the site of Brighton's former ice rink, guests sit in the warm air and look out at the English Channel.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on St Paul's Parish Church tower late this afternoon, and the English Channel shines behind it.
phrases.partly_golden: The low sun colours the clouds pink and orange over the English Channel, and St Paul's Parish Church tower glows for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the city lights of Brighton shine across the rooftops and the English Channel is black beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: The city lights of Brighton blur in the wet evening, and guests see the rooftops shine below their balconies.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the night sky, and guests look across the lit streets of Brighton towards the dark English Channel.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the English Channel tonight, and the city lights of Brighton stop where the dark water begins.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the rooftops of Brighton are quiet, and the English Channel is only a darker band beyond them.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the English Channel just after sunset, and the first lights come on across the Brighton rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear and slowly turning pale, and the copper rooftops of the Latin Quarter are still without colour.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the copper rooftops first, and guests in the upper-floor rooms watch it move down to the cobblestone streets.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the red-tiled rooftops seen from the rooftop terrace look sharp and bright.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the cobblestone streets of the Latin Quarter this morning, and the copper rooftops shine again each time the sun returns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the sky above the rooftop terrace is half blue and half white, with the city's historic spires standing up between the two.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the copper rooftops and the cobblestones below take on the same soft colour, a calm picture of the Latin Quarter.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Latin Quarter today, and from the rooftop terrace the red-tiled rooftops fade a little more with every street.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far skyline is not visible today, so guests look at the near things: the copper rooftops and the cobblestone street below.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the wide windows of this 1928 building, and guests watch the cobblestones of the Latin Quarter shine below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the spires and rooftops of the Latin Quarter for a second, then thunder rolls over them.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Latin Quarter, and guests watch the copper rooftops turn white one by one.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing light lies on the copper rooftops, and guests in the Hazel Terrace House enjoy the skyline from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the cobblestone streets below look bare, and the red-tiled rooftops are the warmest colour in sight.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat guests sit still on the rooftop terrace, and the red-tiled rooftops seem to shimmer in front of them.
phrases.warm: Guests in the balcony rooms lean on the rail in the warm air and look over the city rooftops to the spires.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the copper rooftops of the Latin Quarter gold, while the cobblestone streets below are already in shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds turn pink above the rooftop terrace and the spires stand dark against them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit windows of the Latin Quarter make a warm pattern among the dark rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening the street lights are reflected in the cobblestones, so the Latin Quarter seems to have two sets of lights.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the city lights give the rooftops and spires a soft glow.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the rooftop terrace tonight, and the city lights of the Latin Quarter spread out below it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the cobblestone streets are empty, and the rooftops of the Latin Quarter are quiet above them.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on in the streets of the Latin Quarter below the rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the São Paulo skyline is a row of dark towers under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Skye Restaurant, guests look over Ibirapuera Park to the São Paulo skyline in clean morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the São Paulo skyline stands sharp behind the green trees of Ibirapuera Park.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Ibirapuera Park this morning, while the towers of Paulista Avenue stay in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lounge at Skye Restaurant & Bar, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the skyline of Paulista Avenue.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the red pool on the rooftop is the brightest colour in front of the São Paulo skyline.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the São Paulo skyline today, and the far towers fade into the white sky one by one.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The skyline of Paulista Avenue is not visible today; from the rooftop, guests see only Ibirapuera Park and the nearest streets of Jardins.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the round windows, and the green streets of Jardins look like a painting left out in the wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the São Paulo skyline, and guests watch the storm from the dry side of the windows in Skye Restaurant.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the red pool and on Ibirapuera Park, and guests at the round windows keep checking that it is real.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, every tower of the São Paulo skyline is easy to pick out from the windows of Skye Restaurant.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the green of Ibirapuera Park fills the view from the lounge at Skye Restaurant & Bar.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the red pool up to their shoulders and look at the São Paulo skyline from the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests sunbathe by the red pool, the São Paulo skyline open all around the rooftop.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light falls on the towers of Paulista Avenue, in full sight from the private terrace of the Oasis Suite and its red jacuzzi.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and colours the São Paulo skyline orange, one group of towers at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit São Paulo skyline glows in front of Skye Bar.
phrases.wet_evening: The city lights of São Paulo shine through the rain tonight, and guests at dinner in Skye Restaurant see them blurred on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the clouds over the São Paulo skyline take a soft glow from the city lights below.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit São Paulo skyline spreads wide behind the rooftop pool, which Gilberto Elkis designed in red.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city behind the round windows of this 2002 building is as quiet as an aquarium.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the São Paulo skyline beyond the rooftop pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Marina Bay lies still under a clear sky, and the water is only a little darker than the air above it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun fills the octagonal bathroom windows, and Marina Bay shines blue beyond the bathtub.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Club Lounge at the top of the hotel, guests look over a bright skyline under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Marina Bay this morning, and their shadows cross the water one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the octagonal bathroom windows on the other side, guests watch sun and cloud take turns over the Kallang River this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Marina Bay takes the colour of the cloud, and the skyline stands quietly behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Marina Bay today, and the towers of the skyline look like a drawing half rubbed out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Marina Bay is not clear today; guests see the near water well and the skyline only as faint outlines.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the octagonal bathroom windows, and guests watch Marina Bay turn grey from the bathtub.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Marina Bay, and for a second the whole skyline appears white behind the rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Marina Bay, and guests stand at the octagonal bathroom windows to watch the flakes land on the water.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing, bright day, guests stay in the warm bathtub and look at Marina Bay through the octagonal window.
phrases.cold: In the cold air, Marina Bay looks sharp and clean, and guests study the skyline from the Club Lounge.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, Marina Bay turns white with glare, and the skyline seems to shake a little above the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests in rooms facing Marina Bay watch people walk slowly along the waterfront below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the skyline gold in the late afternoon, and Marina Bay holds the same colour in its water.
phrases.partly_golden: Kevin Roche gave every bathroom here an octagonal window in 1996, and in the last hour of sun each one frames pink clouds over Marina Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs low over Marina Bay this evening, and the city lights give its underside a soft orange colour.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests in the Club Lounge watch the skyline lights blur and run behind the rain.
phrases.mild_night: Guests take a late bath on a mild night, with the lights of Raffles Place bright in the octagonal window under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of the skyline lie in long coloured lines on Marina Bay.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Marina Bay is quiet and almost empty, and guests who cannot sleep have the water to themselves.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Marina Bay is still bright, and the first lights come on along the skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over the Atlantic, and Fistral Beach is a grey strip slowly taking shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the Newquay Golf Course is bright green, with Fistral Beach beyond it and the Atlantic behind.
phrases.clear_midday: From the restaurant of this family-run hotel, open since 1983, guests look out at the Atlantic swell, blue under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Newquay Golf Course this morning, while Fistral Beach stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the balcony rooms watch clouds drift over Fistral Beach this afternoon, with patches of sun on the Atlantic.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic turns the colour of slate, and the white waves on Fistral Beach stand out more.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Fistral Beach today, and the Atlantic horizon is missing behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Atlantic horizon is not visible today; guests see the Newquay Golf Course clearly and Fistral Beach only faintly.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Newquay Golf Course, and guests in the restaurant watch the Atlantic waves through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Storm watching is the plan in the balcony rooms: guests stand behind the floor-to-ceiling glass as lightning flashes over the Atlantic.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Newquay Golf Course, and the greens turn white while the Atlantic stays dark grey behind them.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing, bright day, guests stay inside the restaurant with a hot coffee and watch the Atlantic waves roll in.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Atlantic is a deep blue-grey, and the waves on Fistral Beach break in clean white rows.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the surfers on the Atlantic swell seem to have the right idea, and guests in the restaurant watch them over a cold drink.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests take their coffee out on the balconies and look over the Newquay Golf Course to Fistral Beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Atlantic gold, and the waves rolling onto Fistral Beach catch the light one by one.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and guests in the restaurant watch the Atlantic change from gold to pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars this evening, and guests with a cocktail in the restaurant can just make out the white surf on the Atlantic.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and beyond it the Atlantic is heard more than seen.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, Fistral Beach is a faint pale line between the Newquay Golf Course and the darker Atlantic.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic tonight, and the Newquay Golf Course lies black and quiet below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic keeps working on Fistral Beach, wave after wave, with nobody keeping count.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky above the Atlantic is still orange, and the Newquay Golf Course is fading into shadow.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Aegean Sea is a wide dark surface below the terraces, and Elia Beach is only a faint curve at its edge.
phrases.clear_morning: At LATITUDES, breakfast is served in clear morning light, with Elia Beach and the blue Aegean Sea below the tables.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the infinity pool and the Aegean Sea seem to share one blue surface.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Aegean Sea this morning, while Elia Beach stays bright below the hillside.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Pavilion Restaurant, guests watch patches of sun and shade cross the Aegean Sea through the afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Aegean Sea turns the colour of slate, and the sand of Elia Beach looks paler beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Aegean Sea today, and the yachts anchored off Elia Beach look like small white marks on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; from the infinity pool, guests see Elia Beach and the nearest water, then only pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Aegean Sea, and guests watch it from Pavilion Restaurant while Elia Beach lies wet and empty below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Aegean Sea, and for a second each time Elia Beach shows clearly from the suite terraces.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Elia Beach, and the flakes disappear as they touch the grey Aegean Sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, and the Aegean Sea is a sharp blue below the terraces.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Aegean Sea is a deeper blue, and from the hillside 100 metres above, Elia Beach looks quiet.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look out over the bright Aegean Sea.
phrases.warm: At THE POOL CLUB, drinks get warm while guests count the yachts anchored on the Aegean Sea below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the rocky hillside above Elia Beach, and the Aegean Sea slowly turns from blue to gold.
phrases.partly_golden: From THE POOL CLUB, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds pink and orange above the Aegean Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Aegean Sea is one dark surface, and a few lights mark the shore at Elia Beach.
phrases.wet_evening: From the dinner tables at Pavilion Restaurant, guests look out at a wet evening, with the Aegean Sea lost behind the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the dark Aegean Sea and the dark sky are almost one from the villa terraces.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the private terraces, and the Aegean Sea lies black and calm below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Aegean Sea is only a darker area below the terraces, and Elia Beach is hard to pick out.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays bright over the Aegean Sea for a few minutes after sunset, and the first lights appear along Elia Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Passeig de Gràcia lies almost empty under a clear sky, and Casa Batlló waits across the street for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Casa Batlló across the street, and guests on their balconies watch Passeig de Gràcia fill with people.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is clear, and from the rooftop pool the whole length of Passeig de Gràcia runs straight through the city.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Passeig de Gràcia this morning, and their shadows cross the front of Casa Batlló one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Terrat, guests watch the afternoon clouds drift over the Barcelona skyline and Passeig de Gràcia below.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Casa Batlló keeps its colours, and guests in the balcony rooms have them directly across the street.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Passeig de Gràcia today, and the far end of the avenue fades into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The skyline is not clear from the rooftop terrace today, so guests look down at Passeig de Gràcia instead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Passeig de Gràcia, and guests watch the umbrellas pass in front of Casa Batlló from their windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Passeig de Gràcia, and each flash of lightning shows Casa Batlló clearly for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Passeig de Gràcia, and from the rooftop terrace the avenue slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so every detail of Casa Batlló is sharp from the rooftop terrace across the street.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the rooftop terrace is quiet, and Passeig de Gràcia runs below it in the pale light.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look down at Passeig de Gràcia from the water.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, books stay closed while guests look along Passeig de Gràcia in the warm air.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light falls along Passeig de Gràcia, and guests at Terrat watch the Barcelona skyline change colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds, and from the rooftop terrace the skyline and Passeig de Gràcia glow for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening sky full of cloud, the lights of Passeig de Gràcia draw a bright line below the rooftop terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of Passeig de Gràcia shine twice, once in the air and once on the wet pavement.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the terrace suites look down at the lights of Passeig de Gràcia.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear above the former bank reimagined by Patricia Urquiola, and Casa Batlló shines across Passeig de Gràcia.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Passeig de Gràcia is quiet at last, and the avenue lies almost empty below the rooftop terrace.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the rooftop terrace guests watch the first lights come on along Passeig de Gràcia.

phrases.clear_predawn: Church domes stand as dark shapes above the Tiber, waiting for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the church domes first, then comes down the classical facades to the River Tiber.
phrases.clear_midday: At the restaurant on the rooftop, guests eat lunch with a clear view of the River Tiber.
phrases.partly_morning: The baroque dome keeps losing the sun and getting it back, while the River Tiber below changes colour with it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun travel along the Tiber embankment and over Rome's classical facades this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: The River Tiber turns a soft grey today, and the domed basilica stands pale above the embankment.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the church domes into pale outlines, while the Tiber embankment stays a clear line across the view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the far church domes are missing from the view, but the River Tiber and its embankment are clear to see.
phrases.rain: Raindrops dot the whole surface of the River Tiber, and the Basilica dei Santi Ambrogio e Carlo al Corso stands blurred behind them.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls along the Tiber, and guests at Alto count the seconds until the Eternal City flashes white again.
phrases.snow: From Oliva Restaurant, guests watch snowflakes disappear into the water while the city centre slowly turns white.
phrases.cold: From the rooftop bar, guests follow the River Tiber through the city with a warm drink in hand.
phrases.warm: Guests on the rooftop terrace stay out a little longer, looking over the River Tiber.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light warms the baroque dome and lies on the River Tiber as it passes the embankment.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lands on the domed basilica, leaving the Tiber in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: After sunset, the lit domed basilica stands over the dark River Tiber and the lamps along its embankment.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain breaks up the embankment lights on the River Tiber tonight, and the lit baroque dome shines through it.
phrases.mild_night: The Mausoleum of Augustus is a dark round shape among the lights, and the Tiber slides past under soft cloud.
phrases.late_night: The River Tiber moves slowly past the empty embankment, and the church domes stand dark above it.
phrases.dusk: Lights come on one by one along the Tiber embankment while the church domes still stand against a bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky grows pale behind St Mary's Cathedral before sunrise, while Hyde Park below is still dark and quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: The hotel faces east, so the park view rooms get the sunrise over Hyde Park and St Mary's Cathedral first.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Hyde Park, St Mary's Cathedral and the Sydney Tower fit together in a single park view window.
phrases.partly_morning: At breakfast in the club lounge on the 21st floor, guests watch cloud shadows move across the trees of Hyde Park.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift past the Sydney Tower this afternoon, and patches of sun come and go on the green canopy of Hyde Park.
phrases.overcast: The spires of St Mary's Cathedral stand sharp against a flat grey sky, and Hyde Park stays green in front of them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the top of the Sydney Tower today, so guests at Sydney Common look at the nearer trees of Hyde Park instead.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The harbour beyond St Mary's Cathedral is not visible today, but the cathedral and Hyde Park are still clear from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Hyde Park, and from The Conservatory Bar the trees look blurred behind the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows St Mary's Cathedral for a second at a time, and guests in the park view rooms stay by the glass to watch the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the trees of Hyde Park, and guests in the club lounge leave their seats to look at the white park.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, swimmers in the heated indoor rooftop pool look at the city skyline through tall windows, quite happy to stay in the water.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, a seat in the club lounge is a warm place to look over Hyde Park to St Mary's Cathedral.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, the shade under the trees of Hyde Park looks inviting from Sydney Common, where guests stay cool behind the glass.
phrases.warm: Guests in the balcony rooms sit outside in the warm air, with the green canopy of Hyde Park below them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The late sun turns St Mary's Cathedral gold, and the rooftop terrace faces it across Hyde Park.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange over Hyde Park, and the Sydney Tower catches the light a little longer than the trees.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hang low over the city this evening, and guests at The Conservatory Bar look out towards Hyde Park with a glass of wine.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of St Mary's Cathedral this evening, and the wet trees of Hyde Park shine in front of it.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the clouds over Hyde Park glow a little from the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lit St Mary's Cathedral stands beyond the dark trees of Hyde Park, and city lights shine around the park.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Hyde Park is a quiet dark shape, and St Mary's Cathedral waits for morning on its far side.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the lights of St Mary's Cathedral come on, and guests in the club lounge put down their glasses to look.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Sugarloaf Mountain is a dark shape against the clear sky, and Copacabana Beach lies quiet below the sea-view rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Alloro al Miramar, guests look through floor-to-ceiling windows at Copacabana Beach and its palm trees in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, Copacabana Beach curves in full sun towards Sugarloaf Mountain under a clear blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Copacabana Beach this morning, while Sugarloaf Mountain stays bright in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the balcony suites watch clouds drift over the sea this afternoon, with Copacabana Beach half in sun and half in shade below.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the sea off Copacabana Beach turns the colour of steel, and Sugarloaf Mountain stands clear above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Sugarloaf Mountain today, and guests at the rooftop pool see it like a drawing in light pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Sugarloaf Mountain is not visible today, but Copacabana Beach and the first line of waves still show clearly from the rooftop pool.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Copacabana Beach and blurs Sugarloaf Mountain, and the wet pavement of Avenida Atlântica shines below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the sea, and for a second guests at the sea-view windows see all of Copacabana Beach in white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Copacabana Beach, and guests on the balconies of the suites watch the white flakes settle on the sand.
phrases.very_cold: The air is sharp and very clear, and from the rooftop every line of Sugarloaf Mountain shows above an empty Copacabana Beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests sit behind the tall windows of Alloro al Miramar and look out at the palm trees and Copacabana Beach.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the rooftop pool, with the sea ahead and Sugarloaf Mountain shimmering beyond Copacabana Beach.
phrases.warm: Copacabana Beach is busy on this warm day, and from the 15 floors above, the umbrellas look like coloured dots on the sand.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Sugarloaf Mountain gold, and the rooftop pool reflects the same colour above Copacabana Beach.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the edges of the clouds over the sea, and guests in the balcony suites watch Copacabana Beach turn pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Avenida Atlântica draw the long curve of Copacabana Beach, and Sugarloaf Mountain fades into the grey.
phrases.wet_evening: At dinner in Alloro al Miramar, guests watch the wet evening through the tall windows, the lights of Copacabana Beach blurred on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and beyond the lights of Copacabana Beach the sea is one dark field with no horizon.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the lights along Copacabana Beach lead the eye to Sugarloaf Mountain, outlined against the stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Copacabana Beach lies empty and quiet, and only the white surf moves on the sea.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights come on along Copacabana Beach below Paola Ribeiro's 200 rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Bay of Angels is still dark, and the long line of the Promenade des Anglais is only just showing beside it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Promenade des Anglais, and guests can see the Bay of Angels clear and blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: The Bay of Angels is a strong, even blue at this hour, with the Promenade des Anglais running pale along its edge.
phrases.partly_morning: Patches of sun and shade move along the Promenade des Anglais this morning, and guests can watch them reach the Bay of Angels.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Bay of Angels changes colour every few minutes this afternoon, from deep blue to green and back.
phrases.overcast: Silver and calm today, the Bay of Angels makes the long line of the Promenade des Anglais stand out clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: The far end of the Promenade des Anglais fades into the haze, so the seafront seems to go on forever.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests can follow the Promenade des Anglais for only a short stretch today, and the far side of the Bay of Angels is not visible.
phrases.rain: The Promenade des Anglais shines wet under the rain, with the Bay of Angels grey and blurred beyond it.
phrases.thunderstorm: With every flash of lightning, guests see the Bay of Angels turn white for a second under the thunderstorm.
phrases.snow: White flakes drift across the Promenade des Anglais and vanish the moment they reach the Bay of Angels.
phrases.very_cold: The Bay of Angels looks sharp and bright today, and guests can enjoy every detail of it from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: The long line of the Promenade des Anglais is quiet today, and guests looking out have the Bay of Angels almost to themselves.
phrases.very_hot: Heat makes the air shimmer above the Promenade des Anglais, and the Bay of Angels looks cooler than anything else in view.
phrases.warm: Guests looking out today see the Promenade des Anglais busy with walkers along the edge of the Bay of Angels.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Bay of Angels turns from blue to gold as the sun gets lower, and guests get to see the whole change.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds its way under the clouds and colours the Bay of Angels pink and orange for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Under this evening's cloud, the lamps of the Promenade des Anglais draw a bright line for guests to follow into the distance.
phrases.wet_evening: This evening's rain turns the Promenade des Anglais into a shining strip, and the Bay of Angels disappears into the dark beside it.
phrases.mild_night: A soft glow from the Promenade des Anglais is what guests see tonight, with the Bay of Angels dark beside it.
phrases.clear_night: The Bay of Angels is one wide dark shape tonight, with the lit Promenade des Anglais showing where it ends.
phrases.late_night: Hardly anything moves on the Promenade des Anglais at this hour, and the Bay of Angels lies dark next to it.
phrases.dusk: For a few minutes after sunset the Bay of Angels stays bright, and guests see the first lamps appear along the Promenade des Anglais.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the CBD towers stand as dark shapes against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the tops of the CBD towers first, while Hay Street below is still in shadow.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every tower of Perth's skyline is easy to tell apart above the CBD roofline.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move above Hay Street this morning, and from the Level 1 pool deck patches of blue show between the city high-rises.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the CBD roofline this afternoon, and guests in the upper-floor rooms follow them from one tower to the next.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud sits flat over Perth's skyline today, and the glass towers of the CBD take the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the CBD towers today, and from BAHA Poolside Bar the far end of Hay Street fades into it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far towers of Perth's skyline are not visible today; guests see only the nearest city high-rises and Hay Street below.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in the upper-floor rooms see the CBD towers slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the CBD towers, and guests count the seconds to the thunder from behind floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Hay Street, and the CBD roofline turns white one roof at a time.
phrases.very_cold: In very cold, clear air, guests on the upper floors see sunlight flash on the glass of the CBD towers.
phrases.cold: This cold day keeps the Level 1 pool deck quiet, but the city high-rises around it stand clear against the sky.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water on the Level 1 pool deck and look up at the city high-rises from there.
phrases.warm: At BAHA Poolside Bar, guests hold cold drinks and look over Hay Street to the city on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls over the CBD late this afternoon, and the glass towers of Perth's skyline turn orange one by one.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and from the Level 1 pool deck the city high-rises are lit on one side only.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and the lit windows of the CBD towers give Perth's skyline its shape.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Hay Street this evening, and below BAHA Poolside Bar the city lights shine on the wet road.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the clouds above the CBD glow a little from the city lights below them.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the lit towers of Perth's skyline stand bright above the CBD roofline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Hay Street is almost empty, and the CBD towers wait quietly for morning.
phrases.dusk: From the pool deck of this 250-room hotel, the first lights come on along Hay Street under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Story Bridge is a dark steel shape from the rooftop, with the first grey light behind the city skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun reaches the city skyline, and from the rooftop every tower stands sharp against a clear blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the steel frame of the Story Bridge shines under a clear sky, each beam easy to follow from the rooftop bar.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the city skyline this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the Story Bridge.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the sun comes and goes, so the Story Bridge turns from bright silver to grey and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Story Bridge and the city skyline take the same colour and look like one long drawing.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and the Story Bridge looks like a pencil sketch from the rooftop.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far towers of the city skyline are missing and only the Story Bridge shows clearly from the rooftop.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on New Farm, and from the rooftop bar the Story Bridge is slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the city skyline, and for a second the whole Story Bridge appears in white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the city skyline, and from the rooftop the flakes drift across the steel frame of the Story Bridge.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Story Bridge and the city skyline look close enough to touch from the rooftop.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Story Bridge stands sharp from the rooftop bar, with the city skyline grey behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In this strong heat, guests at the rooftop bar hold cold cocktails and watch the city skyline tremble in the hot air.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests of this 17-suite hotel stay long at the rooftop bar, their chairs turned towards the Story Bridge.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the city skyline gold, and the steel of the Story Bridge glows warm from the rooftop.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Story Bridge turn orange and pink over the rooftop bar.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hide the stars this evening, but the lit Story Bridge and the city skyline glow under them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Story Bridge and the city skyline spread into soft colours through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the low clouds take a soft glow from the city skyline.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Story Bridge is lit from end to end, and the rooftop bar has the city skyline shining behind it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the rooftop is empty and quiet, and the Story Bridge still stands across the horizon.
phrases.dusk: At dusk the sky is still bright, and from the rooftop bar the first lights come on along the Story Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Giralda Tower is a quiet outline against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on the Giralda Tower and Seville Cathedral, and every rooftop in between looks sharp from the top-floor infinity pool.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the rooftop terrace looks over the white rooftops of Seville, with the Giralda Tower rising above them.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the white rooftops this morning, while the Giralda Tower stays in sunshine a little longer.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From cathedral-view rooms, guests watch afternoon clouds drift slowly behind the Giralda Tower and Seville Cathedral.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Seville Cathedral looks heavier, and the colourful roof of the Santa María Magdalena church stands out next door.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the old town today, and the Giralda Tower seems drawn in light pencil above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far skyline is not visible today, so from the rooftop terrace guests see the nearest rooftops and a faint Giralda Tower.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the cathedral-view rooms, and guests see the Giralda Tower slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the old town, and each flash of lightning shows Seville Cathedral and the Giralda Tower for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the white rooftops, and the Giralda Tower fades softly behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold air, the church towers and the Giralda Tower stand clear against the sky beyond the rooftop hot tub.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 1929 hotel look from their rooms towards Seville Cathedral, its stone pale under the sky.
