phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the top-floor infinity pool up to their shoulders and study the Giralda Tower over the edge.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the sun loungers of the rooftop terrace look across white rooftops to Seville Cathedral.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun warms the stone of the Giralda Tower, and guests in terrace rooms with a private whirlpool have it right in front of them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lights the Giralda Tower, then the church domes, along the longest side of the top-floor infinity pool.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit top-floor infinity pool glows, and beyond it the lights of the old town spread towards Seville Cathedral.
phrases.wet_evening: On this rainy evening, the lights of the old town shine on wet rooftops, and the Giralda Tower shows through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests look from the top floor, named after Goya, at the city lights around Seville Cathedral.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Giralda Tower rises above the lights of the old town, with stars over Seville Cathedral.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the old town is quiet, and the Giralda Tower is only a tall shape above the sleeping rooftops.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright behind Seville Cathedral, and the first lights come on across the old town below the rooftop terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Eiffel Tower is a dark shape against a clear and slowly brightening sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Early risers find the Eiffel Tower already in full sun, every iron line sharp.
phrases.clear_midday: At this hour the Eiffel Tower throws almost no shadow, and the city around it lies bright and clear.
phrases.partly_morning: One cloud after another passes behind the Eiffel Tower, and guests getting ready keep stopping to look.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests back for a short rest find the Eiffel Tower in sun one minute and in shade the next.
phrases.overcast: Dark iron against pale cloud: the Eiffel Tower looks like a pencil drawing today.
phrases.fog_haze: In today's haze the Eiffel Tower is a soft grey outline, and the city behind it fades away.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the city is not visible today, so the view ends at the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.rain: Rain blurs the Eiffel Tower for a few minutes at a time, and guests wait for it to come back.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the city makes guests count the seconds, with the Eiffel Tower dark against the storm.
phrases.snow: Snowflakes cross the view, and guests stay warm inside while the Eiffel Tower turns pale behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay indoors a little longer today and look at the Eiffel Tower, clear in the cold air.
phrases.cold: Scarves are on and coats are buttoned, but guests take one more look at the Eiffel Tower before leaving.
phrases.very_hot: The city shimmers in the heat, and guests wait for the cooler hours before walking out into it.
phrases.warm: A day for short sleeves: guests take a last look at the city and head out to explore it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Gold light moves slowly up the Eiffel Tower as the afternoon ends.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a way between the clouds and lands on the top of the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.grey_evening: The city lights are on under a cloudy evening sky, and guests look out at them before going down to dinner.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain is falling on the city this evening, and its lights look soft and blurred.
phrases.mild_night: City lights spread out below a cloudy night sky, and guests stop for one more look before bed.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night the city lights are sharp, and guests can pick out single windows far away.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the view over the city is at its calmest, and guests who cannot sleep have it to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The first lights come on across the city while the day is still bright behind them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Brisbane River is a dark band below the city skyline, and the sky behind the towers slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the city skyline first and then the Brisbane River, and guests on floors 17 to 26 see both.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Brisbane River shines between the towers, and the historic clock tower is easy to pick out in the city skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the city skyline this morning, while the infinity pool at Hibiscus Bar & Terrace stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the river-view rooms, guests watch patches of sun and shade cross the Brisbane River all afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Brisbane River takes the same colour, and the city skyline stands out clearly above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and the Brisbane River looks like a pale ribbon between the towers.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests cannot see the far end of the city skyline today, but the Brisbane River and the nearest towers remain clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Brisbane River; guests watch it from the floor-to-ceiling windows, the city skyline slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the city skyline, and guests count the seconds before the thunder rolls over the Brisbane River.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Brisbane River, and the city skyline fades to grey behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, every tower of the city skyline has a sharp edge, and the Brisbane River shines below.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the 20-metre heated infinity pool lies empty and blue below the city skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look over its edge at the city skyline.
phrases.warm: At Hibiscus Bar & Terrace, guests with cold drinks look past the pool to the Brisbane River and the city skyline on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the city skyline gold, and the Brisbane River carries the same colour past the towers.
phrases.partly_golden: From Hibiscus Bar & Terrace, guests watch the last sun light the clouds above the city skyline and the Brisbane River.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs over the city this evening, and the lit skyline throws a soft glow onto the Brisbane River.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows tonight, and the lights of Queen Street Mall and the city skyline blur into soft colours.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Brisbane River reflects the city lights, and the clouds above the skyline glow faintly.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lit city skyline stands sharp above the Brisbane River, with Queen Street Mall bright on the other side.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Brisbane River moves past the sleeping city, and Queen Street Mall is quiet at last.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests at Hibiscus Bar & Terrace see the first lights appear along the Brisbane River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale behind Barceloneta, and Barcelona Harbour waits below, calm and silent.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun fills the balcony rooms, and guests step out to see Barcelona Harbour bright and blue across Passeig de Colom.
phrases.clear_midday: Lunch at La Terrassa del Duquesa is served under a clear sky, with Barcelona Harbour and the sea spread out beyond the tables.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Barceloneta this morning, and their shadows cross the water of Barcelona Harbour one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From La Terrassa del Duquesa, guests watch sun and cloud take turns on the baroque dome of the Basílica de la Mercè.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Barcelona Harbour turns silver, and the sailboats of Port Vell marina stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Barceloneta today, and the far side of Barcelona Harbour looks like a watercolour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The open sea is not visible today; the palm trees of Passeig de Colom and the nearest boats in Barcelona Harbour remain clear.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Passeig de Colom, and guests in the balcony rooms watch Barcelona Harbour turn grey behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Barcelona Harbour, and lightning shows the masts of Port Vell marina for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Passeig de Colom, where the palm trees look a little surprised, and Barcelona Harbour fades into white behind them.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, every mast in Barcelona Harbour looks sharp from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the 1850 building faces a quiet Barcelona Harbour, and guests look towards Barceloneta from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look over the edge at Barcelona Harbour shining below.
phrases.warm: On the sun deck, guests choose between the dome of the Basílica de la Mercè and Barcelona Harbour, and many turn their sun lounger twice.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the water of Barcelona Harbour gold, and guests at La Terrassa del Duquesa stop talking to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over Barceloneta pink, and the boats in Port Vell marina catch the same light.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the lights of Barceloneta draw a bright line along the edge of Barcelona Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain keeps falling this evening, the lights of Passeig de Colom shine on the wet road, and Barcelona Harbour is a blur of reflections beyond.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of Port Vell marina lie in long lines on the still water.
phrases.clear_night: The sky is clear tonight, and stars show above the dark water of Barcelona Harbour and the roofs of Barceloneta.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Barcelona Harbour is still, and the boats in Port Vell marina hardly move.
phrases.dusk: At dusk, candles are lit at La Terrassa del Duquesa, and the first lights appear around Barcelona Harbour under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Madrid skyline is a quiet outline of rooftops and domes under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Makáá, guests look through the floor-to-ceiling windows at the city rooftops in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The infinite edge of the rooftop pool seems to meet the Madrid skyline under a clear blue midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the city center this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the terracotta rooftops below the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun and shade cross the roofs above Gran Vía this afternoon, just beyond the edge of the rooftop pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the city center rooftops keep their terracotta colour, and guests in Makáá see them through the glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Madrid skyline today, and from the rooftop terrace the farthest church domes fade into the pale air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far edge of the Madrid skyline is not visible today, and the rooftop terrace shows only the nearer roofs around Puerta del Sol.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the city center, and guests in Makáá watch the wet rooftops shine behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Madrid skyline, and guests in the rooms with city views count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the roofs of the city center, and guests in the Penthouse, at the top of this 10-floor hotel, watch them turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear today, so every dome and church spire on the Madrid skyline stands out sharply from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the warm side of the glass at Makáá is a good place to look at the Madrid skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the rooftop pool and look at the Madrid skyline from the infinite edge.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, the open-air yoga session has the Madrid skyline in front of every mat.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light warms the terracotta rooftops of the city center, and the water of the rooftop pool takes the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Madrid turn orange, and the whole skyline changes colour in front of the Thompson Terrace Suite.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the city center glow below the 7th-floor terrace suites.
phrases.wet_evening: At dinner in Makáá, guests see the lights of the city blurred by rain on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the roofs above Gran Vía sit under a low sky that keeps some of the city's light.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the illuminated city center shines below the rooftop of this hotel, opened in 2022.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the rooftop terrace is empty, and the city center around Puerta del Sol rests below it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the city center, and the first lights come on below the rooftop terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Heinrich Hertz Tower is a tall dark shape against a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Heinrich Hertz Tower first, and the Elbphilharmonie shows sharply in the distance.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop of Green Beanie, Hamburg's skyline spreads out under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move behind the Heinrich Hertz Tower this morning, and the Elbphilharmonie goes in and out of sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the rooftop of Green Beanie, cloud shadows cross Hamburg's skyline this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Heinrich Hertz Tower and the Elbphilharmonie take the same quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Hamburg's skyline today, and the Elbphilharmonie is only a faint outline in the distance.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Elbphilharmonie is not visible today, so guests look at the Heinrich Hertz Tower, which is much closer.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows, and guests in the rooms facing the Heinrich Hertz Tower see it slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests on top of this WWII bunker watch lightning flash behind the Heinrich Hertz Tower, with thunder rolling over Hamburg's skyline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftop greenery, and the Heinrich Hertz Tower fades into the white sky behind it.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Heinrich Hertz Tower stands out clearly, and guests are happy to admire it from indoors.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass and study Hamburg's skyline through the rooftop greenery.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, Hamburg's skyline shimmers a little, and guests on the rooftop of Green Beanie look for shade first.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests relax on the rooftop of Green Beanie with Hamburg's skyline in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sunlight colours the Elbphilharmonie in the distance, and the Heinrich Hertz Tower throws a long shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds turn orange behind the Elbphilharmonie.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Hamburg's skyline give the low sky a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights shine on wet roofs, and the lit Elbphilharmonie shows faintly far away.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, guests look out at the lit Heinrich Hertz Tower, its top touching the cloud.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and guests in one of the 134 rooms can pick out the lit Elbphilharmonie in the distance.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Hamburg's skyline is quiet, and the rooftop greenery frames a sleeping city.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights come on along Hamburg's skyline below the Heinrich Hertz Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Giralda Tower stands unlit against a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of the Giralda Tower first, and guests in the terrace suites see it at eye level.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool at El Mirador de Querencia, Seville Cathedral shows every Gothic spire under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift behind the Giralda Tower this morning, while the roofs of Seville Cathedral stay mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the roofs of Seville Cathedral this afternoon, while the Giralda Tower stays in the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the stone of Seville Cathedral looks darker, and its outline is still sharp from El Mirador de Querencia.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Seville Cathedral today, and the Giralda Tower looks like a drawing in pale pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far city rooftops are not visible today, but guests still see Seville Cathedral and the Giralda Tower close by.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Seville Cathedral; guests watch it from their room windows, the Giralda Tower slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Giralda Tower, and for a moment the storm lights every spire of Seville Cathedral.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Seville Cathedral, and its roofs are slowly turning white below the Giralda Tower.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, every detail of the Giralda Tower is clear against the sky above Seville Cathedral.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests see Seville Cathedral in clean light from the terrace suites, with the Giralda Tower above it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool at El Mirador de Querencia and look at the Giralda Tower from the water.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop loungers, books stay closed while guests look at the Giralda Tower and Seville Cathedral instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Giralda Tower gold, and guests at El Mirador de Querencia have Seville Cathedral and the city all around them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink above Seville Cathedral, and the Giralda Tower glows in front of them.
phrases.grey_evening: The Giralda Tower is lit under a cloudy evening sky, and guests with cocktails at El Mirador de Querencia face it.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of Seville Cathedral shine through the wet evening, and the lit Giralda Tower is blurred above them.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so the lit Giralda Tower is the brightest thing in sight above Seville Cathedral.
phrases.clear_night: After dark, guests on the rooftop of this former bank building, reopened in 2022, have Seville Cathedral and the city lights all around them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Seville Cathedral is a quiet mass of stone across the square, with the Giralda Tower above.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind the Giralda Tower, and the first lights come on along the walls of Seville Cathedral.

phrases.clear_predawn: The clear sky turns pale before sunrise, and the streets of downtown Los Angeles slowly take shape far below the room windows.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Dekkadance on the 69th floor, guests look across Los Angeles under a clear morning sky, all the way to the ocean.
phrases.clear_midday: The Hollywood Sign stands in the distance under a clear midday sky, small but easy to find from the 70th-floor Sky Lobby.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over downtown Los Angeles this morning, and guests in the Sky Lobby watch the towers go from bright to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over Beverly Hills this afternoon, and guests in the rooms facing that side follow the changing light.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Los Angeles spreads out in every direction below the Sky Lobby, its streets drawn in long straight lines.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Los Angeles today, and from Dekkadance the Hollywood Sign is only a faint mark in the distance.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Catalina Island and the ocean cannot be seen today, but the downtown towers near the hotel stay clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and guests in the Presidential Suite see the downtown skyline blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm moves over Los Angeles, and guests in this 73-floor tower watch lightning flash above the whole city.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over downtown Los Angeles, and guests in Attitude Fitness stop their exercise to watch it drift between the towers.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and from Dekkadance every downtown tower shows a sharp edge against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the open-air Spire 73 still shows Los Angeles in every direction, and its fire pits suddenly look useful.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the 7th-floor pool and look up at the downtown towers around them.
phrases.warm: Warm air reaches the open-air Spire 73, where guests stand near the edge and look for Catalina Island out on the ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Spire 73, the low sun on this clear afternoon colours the city gold as far as the ocean.
phrases.partly_golden: The clouds over Los Angeles turn orange in the last hour of sun, and Spire 73 has the whole sky around it.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights give the sky a soft glow, and guests in the Sky Lobby look out at the lit towers of downtown.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the city this evening, and from Dekkadance the street lights far below look doubled on the wet roads.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of Los Angeles reach the horizon beyond the soaking tub of the Presidential Suite.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the city lights spread in a wide grid around Spire 73, the open-air bar on the 73rd floor.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the 24-hour Attitude Fitness is quiet, and the downtown towers stand close outside its glass.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on across the city below Spire 73.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Bosphorus Strait is a quiet grey band below Maçka Hill, with the Asian shore just visible behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Bosphorus Strait, and the palace domes and white minarets below stand out clearly.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Bosphorus Strait is deep blue from the floor-to-ceiling glass of the Signature Lofts.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Bosphorus Strait this morning, while the white minarets below stay bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Bosphorus-view corner rooms, guests follow patches of afternoon sun as they cross the Bosphorus Strait towards the Asian shore.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Bosphorus Strait turns the colour of steel between its two shores.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Bosphorus Strait today, and the Asian shore is only a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Asian shore is not visible today; guests see the palace domes below and the near edge of the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Bosphorus Strait, and guests watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows, the minarets slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Bosphorus Strait, and for a second the palace domes below show sharply.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Maçka Hill, and guests in this hotel of 567 rooms and suites watch the Bosphorus Strait fade behind it.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests stay behind the glass and look down at a sharp, clear Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.cold: Cold air keeps the outline of the Asian shore sharp across the Bosphorus Strait today.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on loungers by the outdoor pool look past the trees to the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the Bosphorus Strait shines beyond the white umbrellas of the outdoor pool, where guests swim.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At 16 Roof, guests hold sunset cocktails while the low sun turns the Bosphorus Strait gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and guests at 16 Roof watch the Bosphorus Strait change colour by the minute.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Asian shore make a thin bright row beyond the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in Bosphorus-view rooms see the shore lights of the Bosphorus Strait run down the glass.
phrases.mild_night: From 16 Roof on this mild night, guests look over the lit Istanbul skyline to the Bosphorus Strait under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lit Dolmabahçe Clock Tower stands on the shoreline below, with the Bosphorus Strait black behind it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Bosphorus Strait lies still and dark below Maçka Hill, and nobody is counting ships.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along both shores of the Bosphorus Strait.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over the Atlantic turns from black to deep blue, and the coast toward South Beach slowly takes shape.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the Aguasal terrace, guests look at a bright Atlantic under a sky without a single cloud.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch on the Aguasal terrace, the midday sun turns the Atlantic turquoise and the sand toward South Beach almost white.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic this morning, while the sand toward South Beach stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the 10th-floor gym deck, guests watch white clouds drift over the Atlantic and the long coast toward South Beach.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlantic loses its turquoise, and the coast toward South Beach is a strip of sand between grey water and grey cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Atlantic today, and the coast toward South Beach fades little by little into the white air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: from the oceanfront balconies guests see the beach and the first waves, but South Beach is not visible down the coast.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic; from the relaxation lounge of Ondara Spa, guests watch the grey ocean under it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic, and for a second the whole coast toward South Beach appears.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees of the pool deck, and the white sand toward South Beach is, for once, white with snow.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear, and through the windows of the oceanfront suites guests see the Atlantic in sharp blue far along the coast.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the relaxation lounge of Ondara Spa look at the Atlantic and an empty beach, and stay where they are.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the pool and look past the palm trees to the Atlantic, which looks cooler than the air.
phrases.warm: Guests lie on the white sand under umbrellas, with the turquoise Atlantic in front of them and South Beach further down the coast.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the pool deck and its palm trees, and the Atlantic beyond turns a deeper blue toward South Beach.
phrases.partly_golden: From the Aguasal terrace, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over the Atlantic pink and orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the coast run toward South Beach, and the Atlantic beside them is black.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights along the coast toward South Beach blur into soft yellow dots.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and the lights of South Beach glow low along the edge of the Atlantic.
phrases.clear_night: From the oceanfront balconies, stars show over the Atlantic and the lights of the coast lead toward South Beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic is a wide darkness beyond the white sand, and the coast toward South Beach is quiet.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, guests in the suites facing the Miami skyline watch its lights come on while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Atlantic Ocean is a wide dark surface beyond South Beach, and the sky above it starts to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun rises over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in oceanfront rooms see South Beach turn from grey to gold.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Atlantic Ocean is bright blue behind the white sand of South Beach.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests on the pool deck watch cloud shadows cross South Beach this morning while the Atlantic Ocean stays bright further out.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds move over the Miami Skyline this afternoon, and guests on the west side see the towers go from bright to grey and back.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over South Beach today, and the Atlantic Ocean takes the same quiet colour all the way to the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Atlantic Ocean today, and from the pool deck South Beach fades into white a short way along the shore.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Miami Skyline is not visible from the west side today, and guests see only the nearest roofs of the Art Deco Historic District.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on South Beach, and guests watch it from their rooms while the Atlantic Ocean turns grey and rough.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests watch the storm cross South Beach from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on South Beach, and guests in balcony rooms stare at white flakes landing on the sand and the palm trees.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing today, and the Atlantic Ocean looks sharp and deep blue behind the empty sand of South Beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the pool deck is quiet, and South Beach lies almost empty beside a calm Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the pool deck look over the palm trees at swimmers cooling off in the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.warm: By the pool, books stay closed while guests look past the palm trees at the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in balcony rooms see the low sun turn the sand of South Beach gold while the Atlantic Ocean becomes a darker blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the edges of the clouds over the Miami Skyline, and guests on the west side watch the towers turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the Miami Skyline shine to the west and colour the low clouds above them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights of the Miami Skyline become soft and blurred for guests on the west side.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in the Presidential Suite look across Biscayne Bay tonight at the lights of the Miami Skyline under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: From a hotel of 790 rooms, guests on the west side look at the Miami Skyline lit against a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Art Deco Historic District is quiet, and the Atlantic Ocean is only a sound beyond the dark sand of South Beach.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests see the first lights come on across the Art Deco Historic District and the Miami Skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Chao Phraya River is a wide band of dark water under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Riva del Fiume, guests watch barges move slowly along the sunlit Chao Phraya River.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the pool's infinity edge seems to pour straight into the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Chao Phraya River this morning, and guests in the lobby follow them through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the river-view rooms, guests see the Chao Phraya River bend toward the towers of Sathorn, with clouds building above them.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Chao Phraya River takes the same colour, and the cargo boats keep working all the same.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the far bank of the Chao Phraya River today, and the long-tail boats seem to appear from nowhere.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The towers of Sathorn are missing from the skyline today, but the Chao Phraya River and its nearest boats remain clear from the pool.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of the Chao Phraya River, and guests watch it from the dry side of the lobby glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Chao Phraya River, and from the Riverfront Penthouse guests see the whole stretch of water light up for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Chao Phraya River, and guests in this 2020 hotel gather in the lobby to check that it is real.
phrases.very_cold: The very cold air makes the Chao Phraya River look sharp and bright, and every boat on it is easy to pick out.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass of the river-view rooms and watch the shuttle boat cross the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the water at the pool's edge and look along the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.warm: On the river-front terraces, guests sit outside in the warm air and count the barges on the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Chao Phraya River, and the first sunset cruise boats pass beyond the pool's infinity edge.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and colours the Chao Phraya River beside the riverside tables of Riva del Fiume.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Riva del Fiume, guests watch lit cruise boats pass on the Chao Phraya River under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Chao Phraya River this evening, and the boat lights look blurred from the dinner tables of Riva del Fiume.
phrases.mild_night: City lights from the far bank lie on the Chao Phraya River tonight, under a sky with no stars.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of the Sathorn towers shine above the bend of the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the cruise boats are gone and the Chao Phraya River flows quietly past the private pier.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Chao Phraya River below the pool terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Alster Lakes lie still under a clear sky, and the first light grows slowly behind the far shore.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun fills the indoor pool, and swimmers look out through the glass at the Alster Lakes and the city skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, the Alster Lakes shine blue at midday, and the church spires stand clear on the far shore.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Alster Lakes this morning, and the water changes from silver to blue and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the fitness center, guests follow the clouds drifting past the Heinrich Hertz Tower on the Hamburg skyline and forget to count their repetitions.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Alster Lakes turn the colour of pewter, and the old trees on the shore look darker.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Alster Lakes today, and the 320-degree view from the Fontenay Bar has lost its far shore.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The church spires across the Alster Lakes are not visible today; the near water and the trees by the shore are still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Alster Lakes with thousands of small circles, and guests watch it from behind their floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole of the Alster Lakes for a second, then the water disappears behind the heavy rain again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Alster Lakes, and guests in the 5th-floor Fontenay Suite watch the flakes vanish into the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: The air over the Alster Lakes is sharp and bright today, and swimmers in the indoor pool look at the cold water from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: A cold wind ruffles the Alster Lakes, and guests in this Jan Störmer building watch the small waves from the Fontenay Bar.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the shade of their private balconies and watch the boats move slowly over the Alster Lakes.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace, guests sit in the warm air and look across the Alster Lakes to the far shore.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Alster Lakes gold, and guests at Fontenay Bar see the bright water on almost every side.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lays orange bands across the Alster Lakes, seen from the Alster Suite.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, city lights make a thin glowing ring around the Alster Lakes, and guests follow it from the Fontenay Bar.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain blurs the lights of the city skyline, and their reflections stretch in long lines across the Alster Lakes.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the Alster Lakes hold a soft glow from the city, and the clouds above carry the same colour.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Alster Lakes tonight, and the city skyline draws a row of lights along the far edge of the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Alster Lakes are quiet and black, and nothing moves on the water.
phrases.dusk: The sky over the Alster Lakes is still bright after sunset, and the first lights appear along the shore as the Fontenay Bar fills.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky grows pale above the Bay Bridge, and the Golden Gate Bridge waits for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Golden Gate Suite on the 23rd floor, guests pick up the binoculars and follow the clear morning from the Golden Gate Bridge to Alcatraz Island.
phrases.clear_midday: The Golden Gate Bridge stands sharp against a blue midday sky, its towers clear above San Francisco Bay.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross San Francisco Bay this morning, and Alcatraz Island moves in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony suite in the main building, guests watch afternoon clouds drift past the Transamerica Pyramid.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, San Francisco Bay turns the colour of steel, and the Bay Bridge draws a long line across it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of the Golden Gate Bridge today; guests look for the tops of its towers above the white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: Alcatraz Island is a faint outline in San Francisco Bay, and the Golden Gate Bridge cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on San Francisco Bay; guests watch Alcatraz Island fade to grey and come back between showers.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over San Francisco Bay, and for a second the Bay Bridge and Coit Tower stand out from the storm cloud.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over San Francisco Bay, and guests in the Golden Gate Suite need the binoculars to find Alcatraz Island through the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing, bright day, guests stay indoors and name what they see: the Transamerica Pyramid, Coit Tower, Salesforce Tower.
phrases.cold: Cold air keeps the outline of the Golden Gate Bridge sharp today, with San Francisco Bay grey-blue below it.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, San Francisco Bay shines like metal, and guests find that looking at the water around Alcatraz Island feels almost like a swim.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit in the garden courtyard and look over the city roofs to San Francisco Bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last clear light, the Golden Gate Bridge turns the colour of its name, and guests stop to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud and lights Alcatraz Island, while the rest of San Francisco Bay waits in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in this 1907 landmark look down on the city lights under low evening cloud, with Salesforce Tower rising into the grey.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain blurs the city lights, and the Transamerica Pyramid shows as a soft glow through the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lights of the Bay Bridge reflect in San Francisco Bay, and the clouds above the city glow faintly.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, San Francisco Bay is quiet and wide, and Alcatraz Island is only a dark shape on it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on around the Transamerica Pyramid and along San Francisco Bay.

phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the North Shore Mountains, and Burrard Inlet below them is calm and blue.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, guests see Burrard Inlet and the North Shore Mountains under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the North Shore Mountains this morning, while Stanley Park stays green and bright in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At Oceans 999, guests look out at the North Shore Mountains, where cloud shadows cross the slopes this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Burrard Inlet takes the same colour, and Stanley Park stays deep green along the shore.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Burrard Inlet today, and guests at the floor-to-ceiling windows see cruise ships appear slowly out of the white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The North Shore Mountains are not visible today; guests can see Burrard Inlet and the nearest trees of Stanley Park.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Burrard Inlet, and guests at Coal Harbour Bar watch the passing ships through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the North Shore Mountains, and thunder rolls across Burrard Inlet a few seconds later.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Burrard Inlet, and the trees of Stanley Park turn white while guests watch.
phrases.very_cold: Guests keep close to the warm side of the glass and look at the North Shore Mountains, sharp and white in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, steam rises from the heated rooftop pool, and behind it the North Shore Mountains stand clear above Burrard Inlet.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the saltwater pool up to their shoulders and watch the ships cross Burrard Inlet.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, books stay closed on this warm day while guests look at the North Shore Mountains instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun reaches Stanley Park and the cruise ships below, and guests in the top-floor rooms see it all.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun turns the clouds orange above Stanley Park, and Burrard Inlet shines with the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: At Coal Harbour Bar, guests hold their cocktails and watch the lights of ships move across Burrard Inlet under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Through the wet evening windows of Oceans 999, the North Shore Mountains are hidden, and only the nearest harbour lights shine on Burrard Inlet.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, low cloud covers the tops of the North Shore Mountains, and ship lights cross the dark water of Burrard Inlet.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the North Shore Mountains, and guests in the 503 rooms look down at the lights on Burrard Inlet.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Burrard Inlet is quiet and black, and Stanley Park is a darker line beside it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind Stanley Park after sunset, and the first lights come on along Burrard Inlet.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over Los Angeles, and the towers of Downtown Los Angeles stand as dark shapes against the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the rooftop pool, and the city lies clear from Downtown Los Angeles to Santa Monica.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Downtown Los Angeles skyline looks sharp from the rooftop pool, each tower easy to tell apart.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly over the Hollywood Hills this morning, while Sunset Boulevard below stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, clouds drift across the city, and from the rooftop the Downtown Los Angeles skyline passes from sun to shade.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the city takes the same colour all the way from Downtown Los Angeles to Santa Monica.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and the towers of Downtown Los Angeles look like pencil marks on the horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Downtown Los Angeles skyline is not in sight, and guests look at Sunset Boulevard and the nearer streets instead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Sunset Boulevard, and guests in the skyline-view suites watch the Hollywood Hills turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is crossing Los Angeles, and guests stay behind the glass to watch lightning flash over the Downtown Los Angeles skyline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Sunset Boulevard, and guests look twice from their windows as the Hollywood Hills turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, and from the rooftop Santa Monica shows plainly at the far end of the city.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the balcony suites keep the doors closed and look at the Hollywood Hills through the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the rooftop pool and look at the Downtown Los Angeles skyline from there.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool on this warm day, books stay closed while guests look across the city towards Santa Monica.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Hollywood Hills gold, and guests in the panoramic suites see the whole of Los Angeles in the same warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Santa Monica turn orange and pink, and the rooftop pool has a full view of the show.
phrases.grey_evening: At Harriet's, guests sit under a cloudy evening sky and look at the lights of the Los Angeles skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Sunset Boulevard shine on the road, and the Hollywood Hills disappear into the dark behind them.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, low cloud glows above the city, and guests at Harriet's see the lights of Los Angeles spread out below it.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and guests at Harriet's can follow the city lights from Downtown Los Angeles to Santa Monica.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Sunset Boulevard is quiet at last, and the Hollywood Hills are a dark line above it.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky is still bright over Santa Monica, and guests at Harriet's watch the first lights come on across Los Angeles.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide grey surface beyond the treetops, and the terraced gardens below are still.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the red-tile roofs first, then the Pacific Ocean turns blue between the palm trees.
phrases.clear_midday: From the pool deck, guests see the Pacific Ocean in clear blue layers between the treetops and rooflines below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Pacific Ocean this morning, and their shadows cross the water beyond the garden palms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the hillside terrace look over the tropical garden to a Pacific Ocean marked with sun and cloud shadow.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific Ocean takes the same colour, and the red-tile roofs stand out below.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Pacific Ocean today, and from the pool deck the palm trees look sharper than the sea behind them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Catalina Island is not visible today; guests in the ocean-view patio rooms see only the nearer Pacific Ocean.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the terraced gardens, and guests watch the Pacific Ocean turn grey from their balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the Pacific Ocean, and guests in the Bungalow Suite watch the lightning from the living room.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees and red-tile roofs, and the Pacific Ocean is a grey band behind it.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold air, the Pacific Ocean is a clear blue beyond the empty pool deck and the garden palms.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the pool deck is quiet, and the Pacific Ocean shows between the treetops in a steel blue.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay under the blue-striped umbrellas by the pool and look down at the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.warm: By the pool, guests leave their books closed and look at the Pacific Ocean between the palm trees instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Pacific Ocean gold, and from the pool deck the treetops and rooflines below stand out against it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds, and the Pacific Ocean changes colour in patches beyond the hillside terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening is cloudy, and from the pool deck the Pacific Ocean is a wide darkness beyond the garden.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and guests on this 1920s hillside watch from indoors as the Pacific Ocean disappears into the dark.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hide the stars, and the Pacific Ocean is felt more than seen beyond the black treetops.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Pacific Ocean tonight, and the palm trees make black shapes against the sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the terraced gardens are quiet, and the Pacific Ocean beyond them cannot be told from the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, guests on the hillside terrace watch the Pacific Ocean hold the last light of the sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Prague Castle is a dark shape above the Vltava River, and the sky behind the Old Town rooflines slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the spires of St. Vitus Cathedral stand sharp above Prague Castle, every detail easy to pick out.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the floor-to-ceiling windows of Zlatá Praha show Prague Castle, the towers of the Charles Bridge and the Old Town rooflines in one sweep.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Vltava River this morning, and guests in the river view rooms watch the opposite bank go light and dark.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Prague Castle this afternoon, while the red rooftops of the Old Town stay in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Vltava River takes the same colour, and the towers of the Charles Bridge stand darker against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Vltava River today, and from Zlatá Praha guests see the spires of St. Vitus Cathedral rising out of it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Prague Castle is not in sight, and the view ends at the nearest Old Town rooflines.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of the Presidential Suite, and guests watch the river and Prague Castle blur behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Old Town, and guests at Zlatá Praha watch lightning flash behind the towers of the Charles Bridge.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Old Town rooflines, and Prague Castle slowly turns white above the Vltava River.
phrases.very_cold: From the rooftop terrace, the Gothic spires stand sharp in the freezing air above the red rooftops.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps guests behind the glass at Zlatá Praha, where Prague Castle and the Old Town rooflines are reason enough to stay.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, the Vltava River shines below the river view rooms, and guests look at the water from the cool side of the window.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace this warm day, guests hold a glass and count the Gothic spires above the red rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in this hotel, opened in 2025, watch the low sun warm the spires of St. Vitus Cathedral.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the towers of the Charles Bridge one after the other.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Prague Castle glow above the Vltava River, and the low sky holds some of that glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of the Old Town spread across the wet glass of the Presidential Suite.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lit towers of the Charles Bridge and the Týn Church stand out above the Old Town roofs.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, Prague Castle is lit above the river, and its lights repeat on the Vltava.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Old Town is quiet, and Prague Castle is a still outline beyond the Vltava River.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset as the first lights come on at Prague Castle, seen from the tables of Zlatá Praha.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the hills above Beverly Hills are a dark shape under a clear sky with a few last stars.
phrases.clear_morning: The Hollywood Sign stands white above Beverly Hills this clear morning, each letter easy to read from the upper floors.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Los Angeles skyline is sharp from the pool deck, with palm trees in front of it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the hills this morning, and the Hollywood Sign goes from bright to dull and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Director Suite, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they pass over the Hollywood Sign.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the white letters of the Hollywood Sign still stand out on the hills.
phrases.fog_haze: The Hollywood Sign appears faintly through the Los Angeles haze today, like a word half erased above Beverly Hills.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Hollywood Sign is not visible today; guests see the rooftops of Beverly Hills and the nearer part of the skyline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Beverly Hills, and guests watch from behind their balcony doors as the Los Angeles skyline turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the hills for a second during the storm, then the Hollywood Sign is gone again behind the rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Beverly Hills, and guests take photos as proof while the Hollywood Sign fades behind it.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay inside on this freezing day and find the Hollywood Sign very clear in the cold air.
phrases.cold: The pool deck is quiet on this cold day, and the palm trees stand alone against the Los Angeles skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests float in the pool and look at the city skyline through the palm trees.
phrases.warm: By the pool on this warm day, sunglasses point at the Los Angeles skyline more often than at any book.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the hills gold, and guests in the California Suite watch Beverly Hills change colour from its balconies.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the hills turn pink and the Hollywood Sign takes a little of the colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Los Angeles spread out beyond the rooftops and give the low sky a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the lights of Beverly Hills blurred by the rain on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the hills are a dark line above the lights of Beverly Hills.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and guests in this 1987 hotel look across the lights of Los Angeles to the hills where the Hollywood Sign stands.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the streets of Beverly Hills are empty and still, and the Hollywood Sign waits for morning like everyone else.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Piazza della Repubblica is empty, and the Duomo waits under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Irene, renovated in 2025, guests watch the morning sun move across Piazza della Repubblica.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Duomo stands sharp above the terracotta rooftops, its dome clear in every detail.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Piazza della Repubblica this morning, and their shadows cross the square in front of Irene's windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Presidential Suite, guests follow patches of sun and shade as they move over the Duomo and Giotto's Bell Tower.
phrases.overcast: The sky is grey from edge to edge today, and the dome of the Duomo is easy to pick out against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Duomo today, and its dome looks like a watercolour painted above the city.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Duomo is only a faint outline, but Piazza della Repubblica remains clear from Irene.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Duomo, and guests in the suites that look at it watch the dome slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, and the Duomo looks close enough to touch from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay inside Irene and watch coats and scarves hurry across Piazza della Repubblica.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the terrace sit in the shade with a cold drink and watch Piazza della Repubblica slow down.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the terrace tables fill up, and guests watch the carousel turn in Piazza della Repubblica.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Duomo golden, and guests in the suites that face it leave the curtains wide open.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the Duomo for a few minutes, while the rooftops below are already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low evening cloud, the lit carousel glows in Piazza della Repubblica, and guests at dinner in Irene watch it turn.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Piazza della Repubblica shine back from the stones, and Irene's windows frame the whole scene.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the carousel has stopped, Piazza della Repubblica is quiet, and the Duomo keeps watch over the sleeping city.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over Piazza della Repubblica, and the carousel lights come on in front of the terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Around the Rooftop infinity pool the city is still dark, and the sky above it is just starting to turn pale.

phrases.clear_midday: The city lies in full sun now, with short shadows in the streets between the roofs.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the city this morning, one district in sun and the next in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pool, the city keeps changing colour as clouds pass in front of the sun.
phrases.fog_haze: The far edge of the city fades into haze today, while the nearest streets stay sharp.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests see only the first rows of city roofs today, because the air is too thick to show the rest.
phrases.rain: City roofs shine wet in today's rain, a view guests take in from indoors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the roofs of the city for a moment, then the thunderstorm turns them dark again.
phrases.snow: Warm indoors, guests watch snow turn the city roofs white.
phrases.very_cold: The city looks sharp and bright in the freezing air today, and guests enjoy it from the warm indoors.
phrases.cold: Nobody swims in the Rooftop infinity pool today, and its water lies flat in front of the city.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests keep cool in the Rooftop infinity pool with the whole city in front of them.
phrases.warm: Guests swim in the pool today and rest at its edge to look out over the city.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun gives the whole city a warm golden colour at this hour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and lights a few parts of the city.
phrases.grey_evening: The city lights glow on the low cloud tonight, so the view stays bright long after dark.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the city this evening, and its lights look soft and blurred on the wet roofs.
phrases.mild_night: The city lights spread out in every direction from the pool tonight.

phrases.late_night: Only a few windows are still bright in the city at this late hour.
phrases.dusk: The city lights begin to come on while the sky is still bright, and guests stop to look.

phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move over the Canal Ring this morning, while the IJ in front of it stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the lobby, guests look up from their laptops when a patch of sun crosses the IJ and reaches Centraal Station.
phrases.overcast: The sky is a flat grey today, yet the historic silhouette of the Canal Ring stays sharp across the IJ.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the IJ, and guests at the lobby windows see the ferry disappear halfway to Centraal Station.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: Centraal Station is clear across the water, but the Canal Ring behind it and the Amstel River are not visible.

phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Canal Ring, and for a second the whole Amsterdam skyline shows across the IJ.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the IJ, and the Centraal Station roofline slowly turns white across the water.

phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Canal Ring today, and the IJ in front of it shines almost white in the sun.
phrases.warm: Guests on the A'DAM Lookout observation deck turn a full circle on this warm day and find the Amstel River and the Canal Ring in soft light.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the bar, guests sit by the tall windows as the Amsterdam skyline turns gold across the IJ.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the Canal Ring in patches, a show that needs no ticket.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Canal Ring glow across the IJ, and guests in the bar have them with their cocktails.
phrases.wet_evening: It is a wet evening, and the lights of Centraal Station stretch into long reflections on the IJ.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the clouds above the Canal Ring take a soft glow from the city lights.

phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Sky Tower and Waitemata Harbour share one colour, and the tower is still easy to find.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Auckland skyline today, and from the Club Lounge the Sky Tower looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Waitemata Harbour is not visible today, but the Sky Tower still stands clear above the nearer rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the Club Lounge, and guests watch the Sky Tower blur and sharpen again.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Sky Tower, and guests in rooms facing it count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Auckland, and guests in the Club Lounge watch the flakes drift past the Sky Tower.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so every line of the Sky Tower stands sharp above Waitemata Harbour.

phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the city rooftops, and Waitemata Harbour beyond them looks cool enough to envy.
phrases.warm: On the private terrace of the Chairman Suite, guests sit outside in the warm air and look at the Sky Tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Waitemata Harbour gold, and the Sky Tower glows against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests in the Club Lounge stop talking for a moment as the last sun colours the clouds above the Sky Tower.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs low over the city this evening, and the lit Sky Tower gives it a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain spreads the city lights across the wet glass, with the Sky Tower a bright line in the middle.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of the Auckland skyline shine below a sky with no stars.

phrases.reduced_visibility: From SEEN, the Vieux-Nice terracotta rooftops are clear today, but the hills beyond the Old Town are not visible.

phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Promenade des Anglais today, and guests keep warm indoors with the Bay of Angels pale behind the flakes.

phrases.very_hot: Guests at Rooftop Bar SEEN escape the heat upstairs, facing the endless horizon of blue water.
phrases.warm: Guests stroll under the palms of the Promenade des Anglais today, with the Bay of Angels blue beside them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At SEEN, guests watch the low sun warm the Vieux-Nice terracotta rooftops and the hills beyond the Old Town.
phrases.partly_golden: A gap in the clouds lets the last sun lay a gold stripe across the Bay of Angels.

phrases.late_night: Guests go to sleep with the Bay of Angels quiet and the Promenade des Anglais almost empty.

phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches Marina Bay, and guests in the bay view rooms find Marina Bay Sands filling their floor-to-ceiling windows.

phrases.partly_morning: On the treadmills in the fitness centre, guests watch morning clouds move over the city skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross Marina Bay this afternoon, and the three towers of Marina Bay Sands go from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Marina Bay turns the colour of steel, and Marina Bay Sands stands clear across the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Marina Bay today, and Marina Bay Sands looks like a pencil drawing above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests looking for Marina Bay Sands today find only a faint outline across Marina Bay, and the skyline behind it is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Marina Bay, and guests in the Presidential Suite watch the city skyline blur behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests count the seconds between lightning and thunder as the storm lights up Marina Bay and the three towers of Marina Bay Sands.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Lantern, the low sun turns the glass of Marina Bay Sands gold above Marina Bay.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and patches of gold move across Marina Bay and up the towers of Marina Bay Sands.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Marina Bay Sands glow on the low clouds, and Lantern looks straight at them across the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain on Marina Bay tonight turns the lights of Marina Bay Sands into long streaks on the water.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night with cloud overhead, the city skyline keeps its lights on around Marina Bay, and the water doubles them.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, Lantern faces the lit towers of Marina Bay Sands, and Marina Bay carries their reflection all the way back.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests still awake in the bay view rooms look down at Marina Bay, dark and quiet under a hotel built over the water.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from Lantern the first lights come on along Marina Bay Sands and the Esplanade.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Royal Palace of Stockholm is a quiet block above the still harbour.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Royal Palace of Stockholm, and the harbour below it is bright and calm.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftops of Gamla Stan stand sharp against a blue sky, each chimney easy to count.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Gamla Stan this morning, while the Royal Palace of Stockholm stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, cloud shadows move slowly across the harbour and up the long front of the Royal Palace of Stockholm.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the harbour takes the same colour, and the Royal Palace of Stockholm looks heavier above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Gamla Stan today, and its rooftops look like pencil marks above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see the harbour clearly but only a faint outline of the Royal Palace of Stockholm.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the harbour; guests in the palace-view rooms watch the Royal Palace of Stockholm slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the harbour, and each flash of lightning shows the rooftops of Gamla Stan for a second.

phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests stay behind the glass and look across the harbour to the Royal Palace of Stockholm.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the harbour is quiet, and the Royal Palace of Stockholm stands clear above the water.

phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests in this 46-room hotel open their windows to the harbour and Gamla Stan.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Royal Palace of Stockholm a warm gold, and the harbour below carries the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Gamla Stan turn pink above the darkening rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Royal Palace of Stockholm make long reflections on the harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests watch the lights of Gamla Stan run and shake on the harbour water.

phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Royal Palace of Stockholm.

phrases.clear_midday: From the lagoon pool, the Swan River and the Perth skyline sit in the same line of sight under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Swan River this morning, and the Perth skyline goes in and out of the sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the wrap-around balconies of the suites follow the clouds as they drift from the Perth skyline over the Swan River this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Swan River turns the colour of steel, and Matagarup Bridge still stands out clearly above the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Swan River today, and the Perth skyline behind it looks like a faded photograph.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Swan River gold, and the glass towers of the Perth skyline shine above it under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop terrace, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over the Swan River and the Perth skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Perth skyline glow on the low sky, and the Swan River carries them as long reflections.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass tonight, and the lights of the Perth skyline spread into soft colours over the Swan River.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hide the stars, but the Perth skyline stays lit beyond the black water of the Swan River.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Swan River is quiet and almost black, and Matagarup Bridge is a faint line across it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the lagoon pool of this 2016 hotel the first lights of the Perth skyline appear across the Swan River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear over Retiro Park, and the trees are still one dark mass.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the treetops of Retiro Park first, under a sky with no cloud in it.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Prado Museum stands in full light, its facade clear from the suites above Plaza de la Lealtad.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Retiro Park this morning, and the treetops change from bright green to dark green and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, cloud shadows cross Retiro Park slowly, one patch of trees at a time.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Retiro Park keeps its green, the only strong colour in sight today.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Retiro Park today, and the far trees fade into the pale sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so guests see the near trees of Retiro Park and little of the park behind them.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Retiro Park, and guests watch the treetops turn a darker, shining green.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole of Retiro Park for a second, then guests count until the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Retiro Park, and the treetops turn white while guests watch.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and guests can pick out each branch in Retiro Park.
phrases.cold: On a cold day like this, guests in this Belle Époque palace stay behind the glass and look across to the Prado Museum.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests look at the green treetops of Retiro Park with some envy.

phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, Retiro Park is a wide dark space with the city lights around it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see Plaza de la Lealtad shining under its street lamps.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Retiro Park lies still and silent below the higher-floor rooms.

phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, clouds drift over the Pinheiros River, and the towers beyond it change from bright to grey and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the São Paulo skyline turns the colour of concrete, all the way to the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the São Paulo skyline today, and the far towers fade into the white air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see the nearest towers of Vila Olímpia and the Pinheiros River below, not the far skyline.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the São Paulo skyline, and guests stand at the lounge windows to watch the towers turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and from the lounge windows every tower of the São Paulo skyline has a sharp edge.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the glass towers of the São Paulo skyline, and the Pinheiros River shines below them.

phrases.grey_evening: Over dinner at L40 Cozinha de Latitude, guests see the lights of the São Paulo skyline glow under a low, cloudy sky.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Chapultepec Park, and guests in the gym stop their machines to watch the treetops turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear, and the mountains behind the Mexico City skyline show their ridges today.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Marina Bay skyline today, and the towers fade one behind the other like layers of paper.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Marina Bay is not clear today; from the balcony rooms, guests see the near water well and the towers only as outlines.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch from their rooms as Marina Bay turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Marina Bay, and for a second the whole skyline appears white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Marina Bay, and from the Collection Club Lounge the skyline slowly disappears behind the white flakes.

phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool up to their shoulders and look across at the Marina Bay skyline shining in the sun.
