phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds behind the Manchester Unity Building turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the city lights give a soft glow to the low cloud above St. Paul's Cathedral.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Collins Street shine on the road below the Manchester Unity Building.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, guests look across at the Manchester Unity Building, its top fading into the cloud.
phrases.clear_night: The spire of St. Paul's Cathedral points into a clear night sky, and guests can count a few stars above it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, St. Paul's Cathedral is a quiet dark shape, and Collins Street is almost empty.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright behind St. Paul's Cathedral while the first lights come on along Collins Street.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gulf of Salerno is a still, grey-blue surface below the terraces, and the mountains are just beginning to show.
phrases.clear_morning: From the dining terrace, the cliffs of the Amalfi Coast stand sharp in the clear morning light above a blue sea.
phrases.clear_midday: The infinity pool mirrors a cloudless sky at midday, and its edge seems to join the Gulf of Salerno far below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the mountains this morning, and the infinity pool shows each one a second time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony rooms, guests follow cloud shadows as they move slowly across the Tyrrhenian Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Gulf of Salerno turns the colour of slate, and Maiori shows clearly on the coast below.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Amalfi Coast cliffs today, and guests in the gym exercise facing a sea they can only just see.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the Gulf of Salerno is not visible today; guests see the valleys just below and the nearest stretch of coast.
phrases.rain: Rain falls into the valleys below, and guests watch from their suite windows as it crosses the Gulf of Salerno.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Gulf of Salerno, and guests in this 11th-century palace watch the storm from indoors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the mountains around the Gulf of Salerno and on the terraces, which are closed for the season.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the mountains around the Gulf of Salerno stand clear above a dark blue sea.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the wellness centre look out at the cliffs of the Amalfi Coast during a massage.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across at the green mountains.
phrases.warm: Guests resting by the infinity pool look past the water's edge to the terraced hillside village and the mountains beyond.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Villa Margherita, the sea turns gold in the late sun beyond the edge of the private infinity pool.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests at the infinity pool, 365 metres above the sea, watch the clouds turn pink over the mountains.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Minori and Maiori are the brightest things guests see from the terrace suites.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the coast lights this evening, and the Gulf of Salerno beyond them is completely black.
phrases.mild_night: With clouds hiding the stars tonight, guests look down instead, to the lights along the Amalfi Coast.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Gulf of Salerno, and the mountains make a dark line beneath them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the valleys below are quiet, and the Tyrrhenian Sea is one wide, dark surface.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays bright for a few minutes after sunset, and the first lights come on along the coast at Minori and Maiori.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon lies still, and the first grey light shows where the Indian Ocean horizon begins.
phrases.clear_morning: The Maldivian Atoll Lagoon turns turquoise in the morning sun, and the Indian Ocean horizon is clear behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is bright turquoise near the jetty, and the Indian Ocean beyond it is deep blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon this morning, and guests in the ocean-facing treatment rooms of COMO Shambhala Retreat watch the water change from turquoise to dark blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Tai Restaurant, built on stilts above the water, guests see sunny and shaded patches move across the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon keeps a soft green colour, and the Indian Ocean horizon is a thin line.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze blurs the Indian Ocean horizon today, so the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon seems to continue straight into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Indian Ocean horizon is not visible today; only the near part of the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon shows, still turquoise.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon with thousands of small rings, and guests watch them from inside the overwater villas.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Maldivian Atoll Lagoon for a second, then the storm closes over the Indian Ocean again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, a sight no guest packed for, and the flakes vanish as they touch the water.
phrases.very_cold: In this unusual cold, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon stays clear and turquoise under a bright sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day here, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon looks sharper than usual, and the Indian Ocean horizon is a clean blue line.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in their plunge pools on the overwater villa decks and look over the bright Maldivian Atoll Lagoon.
phrases.warm: On the overwater decks, books stay closed while guests look at the turquoise Maldivian Atoll Lagoon instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Tai Restaurant on its stilts, guests watch the sun go down over the open Indian Ocean in a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in long rays, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon below Tai Restaurant turns gold in patches.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Tai Restaurant, guests look down at the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, black and calm under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon this evening, and guests at Tai Restaurant watch it hit the water below the stilts.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon shows only as dark moving water.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and guests of the 65 villas see them reflected in the still water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is quiet and black, with no line between sea and sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky above the Indian Ocean is still orange, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon slowly turns from turquoise to silver.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over Formentor Bay, and the pine forest is still a dark shape above the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches Cala Formentor beach, and the water of Formentor Bay turns turquoise.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool and Formentor Bay are the same bright blue under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cross the forested peninsula this morning, and their shadows move slowly over Formentor Bay.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Beyond the yoga platforms in the terraced gardens, the Mediterranean lies under a sky of sun and passing cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Formentor Bay loses its turquoise, while the pine forest stays dark green above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Formentor Bay today, and the mountains around it are only faint outlines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The mountains around Formentor Bay are not visible today; from the private terraces, guests see the pine trees and the near water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pine forest, and guests at the Four Seasons Spa watch it through the grand windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Formentor Bay, and guests watch the lightning above the water from behind their terrace doors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the pine forest today, and from the Formentor Suite guests see the Mediterranean go grey behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and the limestone cliffs stand sharp above Formentor Bay.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the grand windows of the Four Seasons Spa show the pine forest standing still in the cool light.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look across Formentor Bay without moving much.
phrases.warm: Guests on the white sand of Cala Formentor beach look across calm turquoise water to the pine-covered peninsula.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the pine trees gold beside the infinity pool, and the bay beyond it is calm.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud, and the limestone cliffs above Formentor Bay turn warm in colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, Formentor Bay is dark and quiet below the pine forest.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Formentor Bay this evening, and the pine forest behind it disappears into the wet dark.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, cloud hides the stars, and the Mediterranean moves quietly below the terraced gardens.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Mediterranean tonight, and guests in this 1929 resort look at them from their private terraces.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Mediterranean is black beyond the terraced gardens, and the pine forest cannot be told from the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright above the infinity pool, and Formentor Bay slowly turns from blue to silver.

phrases.clear_predawn: St Peter's Basilica stands as a dark shape above the Roman rooftops while the city still sleeps.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Dolce Vita Suite, guests open the curtains to St Peter's Basilica in clean morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun flattens the Roman rooftops, and the Vittoriano stands out among the church domes.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the La Dolce Vita Suite watch cloud shadows slide over the aristocratic Palaces towards the Vittoriano Monument.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Roman rooftops, and St Peter's Basilica is in the sun for now.
phrases.overcast: The Pantheon, the Quirinal Palace and the church domes all sit under the same grey lid today.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Roman rooftops, and from the terrace St Peter's Basilica is a pale outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Vittoriano Monument is lost in the murk today; guests in the La Dolce Vita Suite still see the aristocratic Palaces clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of the Dolce Vita Suite, where guests see St Peter's Basilica slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Roman rooftops, and each flash shows St Peter's dome for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the church domes, and guests in the Dolce Vita Suite watch St Peter's Basilica turn white from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_cold: The terrace stays empty today, and St Peter's Basilica stands sharp-edged over the Roman rooftops.
phrases.cold: Guests in the La Dolce Vita Suite keep to the warm side of the glass and count the aristocratic Palaces on the way to the Vittoriano Monument.
phrases.very_hot: Shade is the first thing guests look for on the terrace, and St Peter's Basilica the second.
phrases.warm: Guests linger on the terrace in short sleeves, facing St Peter's Basilica across the Roman rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the fronts of the aristocratic Palaces, and guests in the La Dolce Vita Suite see the Vittoriano Monument glow too.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lands on St Peter's Basilica.
phrases.grey_evening: The city's lights come up under the cloud, and the Vittoriano and the Quirinal Palace stand lit among the Roman rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Dolce Vita Suite watch tonight's rain fall through the lights around St Peter's Basilica.
phrases.mild_night: Rome's church domes are easy to count tonight, with St Peter's dome the largest among the city's lights.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the Dolce Vita Suite leave the curtains open tonight, with St Peter's Basilica lit above the dark rooftops.
phrases.late_night: The square has emptied, and St Peter's Basilica is only an outline over the sleeping city.
phrases.dusk: The first lights come on across the city while the Pantheon and the church domes still stand against a bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Guests who wake before sunrise see the dark shape of the Burj Khalifa against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the spire of the Burj Khalifa first, then works its way down the glass.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests try to count the floors of the Burj Khalifa in the midday light and lose their place somewhere near the middle.
phrases.partly_morning: The Burj Khalifa keeps changing this morning, bright one minute and in cloud shadow the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests watch small clouds drift behind the spire of the Burj Khalifa, which makes the tower itself seem to move.
phrases.overcast: Grey on grey today: the Burj Khalifa stands the colour of steel under a full cover of cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: In today's haze the Burj Khalifa looks pale and far away, and its spire is difficult to see.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests can see the lower floors of the Burj Khalifa today, but the spire is lost in the dusty air.
phrases.rain: Guests watch rain drift across the Burj Khalifa, the top of the tower hidden in low cloud.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Burj Khalifa, and for a second the whole tower stands out black against the storm.
phrases.snow: Guests stay warm inside and watch snow drift past the Burj Khalifa, the tower white and soft at the edges.
phrases.very_cold: Every edge of the Burj Khalifa is sharp in the cold air today, right up to the tip of the spire.
phrases.cold: Guests stay inside today and watch the Burj Khalifa through the glass.
phrases.very_hot: The Burj Khalifa shimmers in the heat, its glass throwing back white light.
phrases.warm: Guests follow the Burj Khalifa slowly with their eyes, from the wide base up to the thin spire.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Floor by floor, the glass of the Burj Khalifa turns gold as the afternoon ends.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests watch the Burj Khalifa glow orange on one side while the clouds behind it turn pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Tonight the lit Burj Khalifa climbs into low cloud, its top floors glowing softly inside it.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests watch the lit Burj Khalifa through the evening rain, its lights running together like wet paint.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud hangs around the top of the Burj Khalifa tonight, catching the glow of the tower's lights.
phrases.clear_night: Guests draw the curtains late tonight, with the lit Burj Khalifa standing sharp against the dark.
phrases.late_night: While most guests sleep, the Burj Khalifa stands tall and still above the quiet city.
phrases.dusk: The first lights come on along the Burj Khalifa while the sky behind it is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Manhattan skyline stands still and grey across the East River, under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The first sun reaches the towers of the Manhattan skyline, and guests in the Penthouse Loft watch it through two walls of glass.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the East River shines blue and every tower of the Manhattan skyline is easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Manhattan skyline this morning, so one group of towers is bright while the next waits its turn.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At Bar Blondeau on the 6th floor, guests watch clouds drift over the Manhattan skyline, a slow show for a slow afternoon.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits low over the Manhattan skyline, and the East River takes on the colour of steel.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Manhattan skyline today, and from across the East River the towers look like a drawing half rubbed out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the East River is clear to see, but the far towers of the Manhattan skyline are missing from the picture.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the East River, and guests in the Penthouse Loft see the Manhattan skyline blurred behind wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Manhattan skyline, and for a second each tower stands out black above the East River.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the East River and the Manhattan skyline turns white and faint, as if someone turned the city's volume down.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the air is sharp, and the Manhattan skyline looks close enough to touch across the East River.
phrases.cold: Built in 1901, the brick walls keep the cold out while guests look across the East River to the Manhattan skyline.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the East River, and guests on the private terrace of the Penthouse Loft see the Manhattan skyline tremble in the bright air.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests of the loft with its own rooftop terrace climb the stairs and look out over the East River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The late sun turns the glass of the Manhattan skyline to gold, and at Bar Blondeau the cocktails take the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Manhattan skyline turn pink and orange, and the East River copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Manhattan skyline glow on the low sky, and guests at Bar Blondeau see them from six floors up.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Manhattan skyline stretch in long coloured lines across the East River.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, cloud hides the tops of the tallest towers, and the rest of the Manhattan skyline shines on over the East River.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the Manhattan skyline shows thousands of lit windows across the East River, far too many for the 69 rooms here to count.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the East River moves quietly past, and the Manhattan skyline rests on the other side, its day finished.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on across the Manhattan skyline, the Empire State Building among them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Prague Castle is a quiet outline under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Prague Castle, and guests in the rooms facing it open their tall arched windows to look.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Prague Castle stands in sharp detail against the blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Prague Castle this morning, and their shadows move across the red-tiled rooftops.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow the patches of sun this afternoon as they cross Prague Castle one after another.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Prague Castle, and the red-tiled rooftops give the scene its only colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs over Malá Strana today, and guests can make out only the soft form of Prague Castle.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today; Prague Castle is still in sight, but the details of St. Vitus Cathedral are lost.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall arched windows, and guests watch Prague Castle turn blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Prague Castle, and guests in this former Augustinian monastery count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the red-tiled rooftops, and Prague Castle turns white little by little.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Prague Castle looks sharp and close, and guests are happy to admire it from behind glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look across the rooftops to Prague Castle under a pale sky.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above the red-tiled rooftops, and Prague Castle seems to tremble a little in the bright light.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests leave a window open, and Prague Castle fills the frame.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Prague Castle gold, and guests stop what they are doing to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights St. Vitus Cathedral, while the rest of Prague Castle waits in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Prague Castle glow softly, and guests see them beyond the dark rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of Prague Castle shine through it beyond the wet rooftops of Malá Strana.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, low cloud above Prague Castle takes a faint colour from the lights below.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in buildings that date from the 13th century look at Prague Castle, lit under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Prague Castle rests in the dark above the sleeping rooftops of Malá Strana.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights appear on Prague Castle.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Pacific Ocean is a wide grey-blue field beyond the empty Venice Beach Boardwalk.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches the sand first, and the Pacific Ocean turns from grey to blue behind the palm trees.
phrases.clear_midday: From the penthouse bungalows, guests look down on the Venice Beach Boardwalk and out to a bright blue Pacific Ocean.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Venice Beach this morning, while the Pacific Ocean stays bright further out.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sailboats cross the Pacific Ocean this afternoon, moving between patches of sun and cloud shadow.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific Ocean and the sand of Venice Beach take almost the same pale colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Pacific Ocean seems to end just behind the palm trees.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far part of the Pacific Ocean is not visible today; guests see the boardwalk, the sand and the first waves.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Venice Beach Boardwalk, and guests in the penthouse bungalows watch the Pacific Ocean turn grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Pacific Ocean for a second, then the storm closes over Venice Beach again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees of Venice Beach, and guests check the window twice before they believe it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and every wave on the Pacific Ocean shows sharply beyond the empty sand.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the large windows and follow the grey-blue Pacific Ocean from inside.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, the sand of Venice Beach shines white, and guests watch swimmers cool down in the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.warm: Roller-skaters and walkers fill the boardwalk on this warm day, and the Pacific Ocean shines behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in the Clara Bow Suite look along the promenade as the low sun turns the Pacific Ocean gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in orange bands, and the Pacific Ocean carries the same colour to the beach.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Pacific Ocean is one dark field, and the lamps of the boardwalk shine below.
phrases.wet_evening: Wet weather makes the boardwalk shine under its lamps tonight, and white lines of surf mark the Pacific Ocean beyond.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in this 1915 brick building look past the boardwalk lights to a soft, cloudy night over the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_night: In the Charlie Chaplin Suite, guests turn the standing telescope to the stars above the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the boardwalk is empty at last, and the Pacific Ocean lies black and quiet beyond the sand.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays bright over the Pacific Ocean for a few minutes more, and the first lights appear along the boardwalk.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Hudson River is dark and quiet, and the Statue of Liberty is a small figure against the first grey of the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Jersey City skyline, and guests in the river-view suites watch the Hudson River turn blue.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests can follow the Hudson River all the way to the Statue of Liberty, small and sharp at the end.
phrases.partly_morning: At ATRIO Wine Bar & Restaurant, guests have breakfast with the city in the windows while clouds move over the rooftops.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the Hudson River this afternoon, and the ferries pass in and out of the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Hudson River looks like steel, and the Statue of Liberty keeps its place in the distance.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Hudson River today; guests at the suite windows look for Jersey City and find only its nearest towers.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Statue of Liberty is not visible today, and the Hudson River fades out well before New York Harbor.
phrases.rain: Rain turns the Hudson River grey, and guests in the river-view suites watch the drops run down the glass in front of Jersey City.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Jersey City skyline for a second, then the storm closes over the Hudson River again.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Battery Park, and the Hudson River behind it almost disappears in white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and the Statue of Liberty looks closer than usual across the water.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Hudson River runs grey-blue past Battery Park, and Jersey City stands on the far side.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests at Leonessa choose the shade and watch the Hudson River shine all the way to the Statue of Liberty.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the 16th floor at Leonessa take an Italian aperitivo above the Hudson River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Hudson River gold, and from Leonessa the Statue of Liberty stands dark against the light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds over Jersey City, and the Hudson River below changes from orange to pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Jersey City glow across the Hudson River, in full view from Leonessa.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Jersey City stretch in long blurred lines across the Hudson River.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the clouds over the Hudson River take a soft glow from the Jersey City lights.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night the Statue of Liberty stands lit beyond the dark Hudson River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Hudson River is almost empty, and guests who cannot sleep have Battery Park and the water to themselves.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky over New York Harbor is still bright, and from Leonessa the first lights of Jersey City come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Manhattan skyline stands grey and still across the East River under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Empire State Building under a clear sky, and guests in the Manhattan view rooms watch it from bed.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every tower of the Manhattan skyline is sharp across the East River.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Manhattan skyline this morning, and the Empire State Building moves in and out of their shadow.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop, guests follow cloud shadows as they cross the Brooklyn rooftops towards the Williamsburg Bridge.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the East River, and the Manhattan skyline takes the same quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Manhattan skyline today, and the Empire State Building looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Manhattan skyline is not visible today, but guests can still make out the Empire State Building.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests see the Manhattan skyline slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay behind the glass while lightning flashes above the Empire State Building and thunder rolls over the East River.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the East River, and the Manhattan skyline fades to white behind it.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests choose the warm side of the glass and study the Manhattan skyline from there.
phrases.cold: Cold air makes the Empire State Building look very clear today from this former water tower factory.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the Manhattan skyline shimmers across the East River while guests on the rooftop reach for cold drinks.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the open-air rooftop of Laser Wolf look up from their plates at the Manhattan skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Manhattan skyline late this afternoon, and guests at Laser Wolf watch its towers change colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Empire State Building turn orange and pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at dinner at Laser Wolf watch the lights of the Manhattan skyline glow against the low sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Manhattan skyline spread into soft colours on the rain-covered glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit Empire State Building shines above the other towers across the East River.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of the Manhattan skyline are bright in the Manhattan view rooms of this 175-room hotel.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Manhattan skyline keeps guests company if they cannot sleep in the Manhattan view rooms.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright and the first lights come on along the Manhattan skyline.

phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Altitude Restaurant, guests look out at the Sydney Opera House under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 36th floor, the midday sun shows the Sydney Opera House, the Sydney Harbour Bridge and, far away, the Blue Mountains.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Darling Harbour this morning, while the Sydney Harbour Bridge stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests taking high tea in Altitude Restaurant watch afternoon clouds pass behind the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Sydney Opera House stands out pale against the grey harbour water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Darling Harbour today, and the far shore fades into the grey.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Blue Mountains are not visible today, but the Sydney Harbour Bridge and the Sydney Opera House remain clear below.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows of Altitude Restaurant, and the Sydney Opera House looks slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the harbour, and for a second the Sydney Harbour Bridge stands out against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the harbour-view rooms, and guests watch the Sydney Harbour Bridge turn pale behind it.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold air, guests stay behind the glass and study the sharp outline of the Sydney Opera House.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests take the leather window seats in the harbour-view rooms and watch the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.very_hot: The water of Darling Harbour shines in the strong heat, and guests look down on it from the cool of their rooms.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the water around the Sydney Opera House is bright, and small figures walk along the shore.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests at Blu Bar on 36 watch the low sun turn the Sydney Harbour Bridge gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink above the Sydney Opera House, and guests at Blu Bar on 36 forget their cocktails.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Sydney Harbour Bridge and the lights of Darling Harbour fill the windows of Blu Bar on 36.
phrases.wet_evening: At dinner in Altitude Restaurant, guests see the lights of the Sydney Harbour Bridge shine through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lights of Darling Harbour reflect in the water far below.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lit Sydney Opera House and Sydney Harbour Bridge face each other across black water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, nothing moves on Darling Harbour, and the water lies still below the tower.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Sydney Harbour Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Sydhavnen lies still under a clear sky, and the first grey light shows on the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light fills the harbor-facing rooms, and Sydhavnen shines blue below them.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the harbor is bright blue, and a bridge and the city spires stand sharp beyond it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Sydhavnen this morning, and the brick buildings across the water go from dull to bright and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at a corner window seat follow a canal ferry across the harbor while clouds drift over the city skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the broad curve of Sydhavnen turns the colour of steel.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the harbor today, and the buildings across the water look like a soft pencil sketch.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of Sydhavnen is not visible today; guests see the near water and the closest brick buildings, and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Sydhavnen, and guests at Restaurant Midtown Grill watch the drops mark the harbor water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole curve of Sydhavnen for a second, then the harbor disappears again behind heavy rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the harbor, and guests in the sauna watch it through the arched window, pleased to be on the warm side.
phrases.very_cold: From the upper harbor-facing floors, guests see Sydhavnen sharp and still in the freezing air, and nobody hurries to go out.
phrases.cold: In the barrel sauna, guests look through the arched window at the cold harbor and the historic buildings on the waterfront.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the Pier 5 Bar & Lounge terrace sit over the harbor canal and look at the water as if it could cool them.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the Pier 5 Bar & Lounge terrace fills up, and Sydhavnen sits right at table level.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun warms the brick buildings across the water, and the corner window seats look straight at them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes in under the clouds and turns the copper spires and the harbor water the same warm colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the waterfront stays lit and busy, and guests at Restaurant Midtown Grill see its lights doubled in the harbor.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests stay behind the glass and watch the waterfront lights run in long streaks across the harbor.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lit waterfront of Sydhavnen gives the low sky a soft glow.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests in the harbor-facing rooms see the waterfront lights lying steady on the black water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Sydhavnen is quiet, and the harbor water moves slowly for the one guest who cannot sleep.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Sydhavnen, and the first lights come on along the waterfront.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Herengracht lies still under a clear sky, and the water is darker than the sky above it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Herengracht, and guests in the canal-facing rooms see the water turn bright below them.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Herengracht runs toward the Golden Bend, every ripple sharp in the light.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cross the Canal Ring this morning, and their shadows move over the water of the Herengracht one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From a balcony, guests watch patches of sun and shade pass over the canal houses along the Herengracht.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Herengracht takes the same grey, and the Canal Ring looks calm.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits low on the Herengracht today, and the far side of the canal looks like a faded drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the Herengracht is clear only close by and the Golden Bend is not in sight.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Herengracht with small circles, and guests in the Master Suite watch them spread across the canal.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Canal Ring, and each flash of lightning turns the Herengracht white for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Canal Ring, and guests watch the flakes disappear as they touch the Herengracht.
phrases.very_cold: The Herengracht looks sharp and still in the freezing air, and guests check the edges of the water for a first skin of ice.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests watch a tram pass beside the canal, while the water of the Canal Ring stays dark and calm.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Herengracht shines like metal, and guests look at the water and think about jumping in.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on a balcony look down at the Herengracht through the leaves of the tall green trees.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lies on the Canal Ring, and the Herengracht carries the colour toward the Golden Bend.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the Amstel River turn orange, and guests see the same colour arrive on the canal water.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening sky of cloud, the lights of the Canal Ring are on, and the Herengracht holds each one on its surface.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights along the Herengracht stretch into long lines on the water, and guests watch them shake.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests see the lit canal houses of the Herengracht repeated upside down in the water.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Canal Ring tonight, and guests look from the clear sky to the lit Herengracht and back.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Canal Ring is asleep, and only the late guests are left to watch the quiet water of the Herengracht.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Amstel River is still bright, and the first lights come on along the Canal Ring.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Öresund Strait is a wide dark surface beyond the runway, and the sky above Sweden is just starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun spreads across the Öresund Strait, and the Swedish coastline is clear on the horizon beyond the runway.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in The Social Bar & Bistro, guests look out at the Öresund Strait, blue under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move over the runway this morning, while the Öresund Strait behind it stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the floor-to-ceiling windows follow a plane along the runway, then look further out to the Öresund Strait and its patches of sun and shade.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the Öresund Strait turns the colour of steel, and the runway below is almost the same shade.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Swedish coastline today, so the Öresund Strait seems to have no far side.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Sweden is not on the horizon today; guests see the runway clearly and only the nearest water of the Öresund Strait.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch the runway shine wet in front of a grey Öresund Strait.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Öresund Strait, and guests behind triple-glazed glass see the storm more than they hear it.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the runway, and the Öresund Strait fades to white behind it.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the air is very clear, and guests see the Swedish coastline as a firm line across the Öresund Strait.
phrases.cold: A cold light lies on the Öresund Strait, and guests in The Social Bar & Bistro stay warm inside with the water in sight.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above the runway, and guests look past it to the Öresund Strait as if it were a cold drink.
phrases.warm: Warm light fills the scene in three stripes: the runway, then the Öresund Strait, then Sweden on the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Öresund Strait gold, and the Swedish coastline glows low on the horizon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds over the Öresund Strait turn pink while a plane lifts off the runway below.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in The Social Bar & Bistro, guests keep an eye on the Öresund Strait as it darkens under the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Runway lights blur in the evening rain, and guests in The Social Bar & Bistro watch the Öresund Strait disappear behind wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests look down at the runway lights, with the Öresund Strait black behind them.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the runway lights draw straight rows towards the Öresund Strait, and guests can follow each landing plane down to them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who cannot sleep still have the runway below and the Öresund Strait beyond it for company.
phrases.dusk: The sky over the Öresund Strait is still bright after sunset, and the first runway lights come on below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the clear sky slowly turns pale over the Vieux-Port, and Notre-Dame de la Garde is a dark shape on the skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the rooftop terrace has the Vieux-Port in clear morning sun, with Fort Saint-Jean beyond the masts.
phrases.clear_midday: Notre-Dame de la Garde stands sharp on the skyline under a clear midday sky, high above the boats of the Vieux-Port.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Vieux-Port this morning, while Notre-Dame de la Garde stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Dantès Skylounge on the top floor, the clouds drift over the skyline from the MUCEM to Notre-Dame de la Garde.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the water of the Vieux-Port turns the colour of slate, and the white boats stand out more.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Vieux-Port today, and Notre-Dame de la Garde is a faint outline above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so Notre-Dame de la Garde is missing from the skyline and only the nearer quays of the Vieux-Port show.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Vieux-Port; guests in the top-floor suites watch it through the glass, the masts slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Notre-Dame de la Garde for a second above the Vieux-Port, then the storm hides it again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Vieux-Port, and the boat decks slowly turn white under the masts.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, so guests behind the tall windows of the bar lounge can pick out each wall of Fort Saint-Jean across the harbour.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Vieux-Port is quiet, and guests in the Opera Suite study Notre-Dame de la Garde from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat the Vieux-Port shines white, and guests on the top-floor terrace decide that looking at the water is exercise enough.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the port-facing terrace of Le Carré Bistromanie watch boats come and go in the Vieux-Port.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Notre-Dame de la Garde gold, and Dantès Skylounge has the Vieux-Port spread below at cocktail time.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the masts of the Vieux-Port one row at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Les Trois Forts, guests look down on the lights of the Vieux-Port under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights of the Vieux-Port stretch into long reflections on the wet quays.
phrases.mild_night: From the top-floor terrace suites, Notre-Dame de la Garde glows on the skyline under low cloud tonight.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, Dantès Skylounge has the lit Vieux-Port below and Notre-Dame de la Garde shining above it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, any guest still awake among the 134 rooms sees the Vieux-Port as rows of still masts on black water.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set; the sky is still bright over the Vieux-Port, and the first lights appear along the quays.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlas Mountains are a dark shape under a clear sky, seen from the south-facing balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the south-facing terrace is served in clear morning light, with the Atlas Mountains across the whole horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: From the elevated pool deck, nothing stands between guests and the Atlas Mountains under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit on some Atlas Mountains peaks this morning, and guests on the breakfast terrace watch them move along the range.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the Atlas Mountains this afternoon, and the elevated pool deck is a good place to follow them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlas Mountains stay in sight from the elevated pool deck, grey above the green of the palm gardens.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Atlas Mountains today, and from Zest the range is a faint blue outline beyond the palms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Atlas Mountains are not visible today; from the room balconies the view stops at the palm gardens.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the palm gardens, and guests watch from their villa terraces as the Atlas Mountains disappear behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Atlas Mountains for a second at a time, and guests count the gaps from their balcony doors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling, and the low pink pavilions and the palm gardens turn white while the Atlas Mountains stay hidden.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear today, and the snowcapped Atlas Mountains look sharp from the south-facing breakfast terrace.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Atlas Mountains stand clear to the south of the elevated pool deck, and the loungers are left empty.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the water on the elevated pool deck, and the Atlas Mountains shimmer beyond the palms.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Zest, guests watch the tops of the Atlas Mountains take a golden colour as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and turns the Atlas Mountains purple, seen from the rooftop terrace above the palm trees.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Atlas Mountains are gone from the horizon, and guests at Zest look over the lit gardens of the resort.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the resort this evening, and the garden lights shine on wet palms while the Atlas Mountains stay out of sight.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the Atlas Mountains cannot be seen, and the garden lights show only the nearest palms.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the 16 hectares of gardens, and they stop where the Atlas Mountains begin.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlas Mountains keep their place to the south, whether anyone is awake to check or not.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright behind the Atlas Mountains, and the first lights come on among the palms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Shenzhen Bay lies still and grey-blue below the south-facing rooms, and the sky slowly grows lighter over the Hong Kong ridgeline.
phrases.clear_morning: From the gym in the 77th-floor Wellness Club, guests on the morning machines see Shenzhen Bay bright and blue in a wide half-circle.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Shenzhen Bay shines far below, and the Hong Kong ridgeline stands sharp across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Shenzhen Bay this morning, and their shadows cross the water like slow ships.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From west-facing rooms, guests look far down at the Shahe Golf Course greens, where sun and cloud shadow take turns this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the sky today, and Shenzhen Bay below is a calm sheet of silver-grey water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Shenzhen Bay today, and the Hong Kong ridgeline is only a faint outline on the far side.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Hong Kong ridgeline is not visible today; from the Wellness Club gym, guests see Shenzhen Bay fade into pale air before the far shore.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the high-floor lounge, and the Shenzhen skyline and the hills behind it turn soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Shenzhen Bay, and guests in the south-facing rooms watch the storm from high above the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the Wellness Club gym, and Shenzhen Bay shows only in grey glimpses between the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and guests stay in the indoor pool while they look out at the hills and the water.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in north-facing rooms look down on the OCT Mangrove Ecological Park, a protected wetland far below.
phrases.very_hot: The heat outside is heavy, so guests train in the Wellness Club gym and let Shenzhen Bay shimmer on the other side of the glass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the high-floor lounge look over the Shenzhen skyline to the green hills beyond.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Shenzhen Bay gold, and the Hong Kong ridgeline glows warm across the water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests at the hotel bar watch the clouds over the city turn orange through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at the hotel bar look out at the city lights, which give the low sky a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Shenzhen Bay this evening, and the lights on the shore reach guests as blurred points through wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, Shenzhen Bay is a wide dark space below, edged with city lights.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in this 2024 hotel look across Shenzhen Bay on a clear night and see the black water meet the Hong Kong ridgeline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Shenzhen Bay is quiet and black, and guests who cannot sleep have 272 rooms' worth of silence above the water.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over Shenzhen Bay while the first lights come on along the shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Acropolis is a dark shape above the sleeping rooftops, and the sky behind it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Acropolis early, and guests in the 9th-floor suites see the hill come out of shadow.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Acropolis stands sharp above the rooftops of Athens, with the Parliament in the same line of sight.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Syntagma Square this morning, while the Acropolis stays in sunshine beyond it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun move across the city rooftops toward the Acropolis, a slow show seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Acropolis loses its shadows, and guests can study the hill in even, quiet light.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Acropolis today, and the city rooftops in front of it fade into one pale colour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Saronic Gulf is not visible from the Presidential Suite today; the view ends with the rooftops of Athens.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Syntagma Square; guests watch umbrellas cross it, with the Parliament grey behind them.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Acropolis, and for a second the whole hill shows white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Athens, and guests look twice to be sure that the white hill is still the Acropolis.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the Acropolis looks closer than usual from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the rooms facing Syntagma Square watch the square from behind warm glass, the Parliament beside it.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the rooftop terrace sit still and watch the Acropolis shimmer above the hot rooftops.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests step out on their balconies and find the Acropolis above the rooftops, the Greek flag moving on top.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Acropolis gold, and the Parliament below takes the same warm colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Acropolis turn pink, a change of colour seen in full from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Acropolis glows above the city, and the low sky takes some of its light.
phrases.wet_evening: This rainy evening, the lights of Syntagma Square shine on the wet ground, and the Parliament stands lit beside it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit Acropolis seems to float above the dark rooftops of Athens.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in this hotel of 159 rooms and 21 suites look at the same thing: the lit Acropolis under the stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Syntagma Square is almost empty, and the Acropolis rests as a quiet outline above the city.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the first lights come on at the Acropolis, seen directly from the rooftop terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Arabian Gulf is a dark band behind Al Bateen Marina, slowly turning grey.

phrases.clear_midday: From the infinity pool, the water seems to run straight on into Al Bateen Marina under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests wake to the Abu Dhabi skyline half in sun and half in cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Marina Bar looks over Al Bateen Marina this afternoon, where the yachts brighten and dim as clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey light settles on Al Bateen Marina, and the Arabian Gulf beyond is the same colour as the clouds.

phrases.thunderstorm: The thunderstorm darkens Al Bateen Marina, and each flash of lightning shows the yachts for a moment.
phrases.snow: Snow drifts down over Al Bateen Marina, and guests watch it from inside Marina Bar.
phrases.very_cold: Guests count the towers of the Abu Dhabi skyline from indoors, each one clear in the freezing air.

phrases.very_hot: In the infinity pool, guests cool off facing the yachts of Al Bateen Marina.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Gold light runs along the glass of the Abu Dhabi skyline, and the yachts in Al Bateen Marina take the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds over the Abu Dhabi skyline turn orange in the last hour of sun, and the towers below them darken.
phrases.grey_evening: From Marina Bar this evening, guests see the lit Abu Dhabi skyline under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Through the evening rain, the lights of Al Bateen Marina stretch into long lines on the wet water.
phrases.mild_night: The city glows behind the pool tonight, its lights spread wide under the cloud.
phrases.clear_night: The infinity pool is a dark mirror tonight, with the lights of the Abu Dhabi skyline standing right behind its edge.
phrases.late_night: Nothing moves among the yachts in Al Bateen Marina while the hotel sleeps.
phrases.dusk: Lights come on across the Abu Dhabi skyline, and the water of Al Bateen Marina is still bright from the sunset.

phrases.clear_predawn: The towers of the Sagrada Família stand dark against a sky that is only starting to turn pale.

phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the Sagrada Família is lit and easy to find from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls over the city tonight, and the lit Sagrada Família shows through it.
phrases.mild_night: The city lights stretch out below La Galana terrace on this mild night.
phrases.clear_night: The rooftop pool faces the lit towers of the Sagrada Família in the clear night.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Manhattan skyline stands as a dark outline under a clear sky that slowly turns pale.

phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Empire State Building stands sharp above the Manhattan skyline, every edge easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the Manhattan skyline this morning, and their shadows slide over the Empire State Building one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon clouds drift behind One World Trade Center, and the rooftop terrace has a wide look at the Manhattan skyline between them.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, guests still find the Empire State Building at once, its shape clear above the Manhattan skyline.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Empire State Building today, and the Manhattan skyline fades floor by floor into white.

phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the Manhattan skyline looks sharp from the rooftop terrace, and the Empire State Building shows clean detail.

phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests in the terrace rooms look for shade first and One World Trade Center second.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop terrace, guests take the lounge chairs and look across the brick parapet at the Manhattan skyline.

phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange behind the Manhattan skyline, and the rooftop terrace faces the whole scene.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Empire State Building gives the low sky a soft glow above the Manhattan skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the lights of the Manhattan skyline blur and spread into soft colours.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of the Empire State Building reach up into the low cloud.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests can count the lit floors of the Empire State Building, though nobody finishes.
phrases.late_night: A guest still awake in the small hours finds the Manhattan skyline quiet and the streets below almost still.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and guests see the first lights come on across the Manhattan skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Victor Emmanuel II Monument stands pale and quiet under a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the rooftop, guests see the Victor Emmanuel II Monument bright in the early sun through the floor-to-ceiling windows.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon clouds drift slowly behind the Victor Emmanuel II Monument, and its shape changes with every patch of sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, guests can still pick out Trajan's Column standing straight above the Imperial Forums.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Imperial Forums today, so the ruins look like a faded old drawing.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Imperial Forums, and the ruins slowly lose their edges under a thin white layer.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, bright day, guests behind the rooftop's floor-to-ceiling windows look at Trajan's Column in clear light above the Imperial Forums.

phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights around the Victor Emmanuel II Monument are reflected on the wet street below.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Imperial Forums lie still, and Trajan's Column is a dark shape above the ruins.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on around the Victor Emmanuel II Monument.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Río de la Plata is a wide grey band beyond the Ecological Reserve, seen from the river-side balconies.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours Puerto Madero is quiet, and the port cranes are tall, still shapes above the docks.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Buenos Aires skyline, and the first lights come on in Puerto Madero.
