phrases.dusk: In the few minutes after sunset, guests see the first lights come on along the Hong Kong skyline while the sky over Victoria Harbour is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the masts of Port Vell stand still under a clear sky, and the Mediterranean Sea behind them slowly turns from black to blue.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun rises over the masts of Port Vell, and guests in the marina-view suites watch it from their balconies.
phrases.clear_midday: The rooftop pool gathers the midday light, and Port Vell below it is full of white sailboats under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Port Vell this morning, and the palm trees along Rambla de Mar move in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Rooftop, guests follow the clouds as they drift from the Gothic Quarter rooftops out over the Mediterranean Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the water of Port Vell turns the colour of steel, and the white boats stand out more clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the Mediterranean Sea today, and from the Rooftop the far masts of Port Vell look like thin pencil lines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The sea horizon is not visible today, so the view from the Rooftop ends at the boats of Port Vell and the palms of Rambla de Mar.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Port Vell, and guests behind the double windows of their balcony rooms watch the boat decks shine with water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Mediterranean Sea, and for a second every mast in Port Vell stands out white against the dark clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Port Vell, and guests at the windows of the Grand Suite Mediterraneo watch the boat decks turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear today, and from the Rooftop the line between the Mediterranean Sea and the sky is sharp.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Rooftop looks over a quiet Port Vell, with Barceloneta clear behind the rows of masts.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look over its edge at Port Vell and the Mediterranean Sea.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the rooftop loungers look past the pool at Port Vell and the palms of Rambla de Mar.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Port Vell turns golden in the late sun, and guests on the Rooftop see what Picasso saw from his studio here in 1896.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and colours the Gothic Quarter rooftops, while guests on the Rooftop watch with a cocktail in hand.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Port Vell and Barceloneta shine on the dark water below the Rooftop.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests at dinner in Informal watch the lights of Port Vell blur in the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hide the stars, and the lamps along Rambla de Mar draw a bright path across the harbour.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of Barceloneta line the far side of the harbour, and the Mediterranean Sea beyond them is black.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Port Vell is quiet, and the boats rest side by side on the still water.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on around Port Vell below the Rooftop of this hotel of 28 rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the traveller's palms in the tropical gardens stand still under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the tropical gardens, and guests on the suites' private terraces watch the traveller's palms turn bright green.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 3rd-floor pool, the city skyline stands sharp against a clear blue sky above the garden trees.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the city skyline this morning, while the 3rd-floor pool and the gardens below stay mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the tropical gardens this afternoon, and the traveller's palms go from bright to dark green and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the tropical gardens keep their colour, and the green of the traveller's palms looks even deeper.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and from the 3rd-floor pool the towers look like a faint drawing behind the trees.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The city skyline is not clear from the 3rd-floor pool today, so guests look at the tropical gardens close by instead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the tropical gardens; guests watch from the suites' private terraces as water runs off the traveller's palms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the city, and lightning shows the traveller's palms for a second before the gardens go dark again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the tropical gardens, a strange guest here, and it settles white on the traveller's palms.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day, the tropical gardens look out of season, and guests study the traveller's palms from behind closed doors.
phrases.cold: The air is cold today, and the city skyline stands clear from the 3rd-floor pool, where nobody is in the water.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the 3rd-floor pool and look at the city skyline from there.
phrases.warm: By the 3rd-floor pool, books stay closed on this warm day while guests look across the gardens to the city skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sunlight comes through the traveller's palms and lays long shadows across the tropical gardens.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds above the tropical gardens, and guests in the garden view studios watch the palms turn gold.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening sky of cloud, the city lights glow behind the dark crowns of the traveller's palms.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights are blurred by the rain, and the tropical gardens shine below the terraces.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the tropical gardens lie dark and still, and the low cloud holds the glow of the city beyond.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the city skyline shines beyond the gardens of a hotel that reopened in 2019 with 115 suites.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the tropical gardens are quiet, and the traveller's palms are the only shapes against the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first city lights come on behind the traveller's palms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gulf of Saint-Tropez lies still and grey-blue below the hill, and the Massif des Maures is a dark outline beside it.
phrases.clear_morning: From the gym, guests look out at the Mediterranean, bright blue under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From Le Belrose, the Gulf of Saint-Tropez shines under the midday sun, with the green slopes of the Massif des Maures beyond it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Gulf of Saint-Tropez this morning, and the Massif des Maures changes from dark green to light.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony of the Suite Belrose, guests follow the clouds from Sainte-Maxime to the Esterel Massif and on to the Alps.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Mediterranean turns the colour of steel, and the Massif des Maures stands dark green above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Gulf of Saint-Tropez today, and Sainte-Maxime on the far shore is only a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps and the Esterel Massif are not visible today; the Gulf of Saint-Tropez below the hill is still clear to see.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Gulf of Saint-Tropez, and guests at the panoramic windows of Le Belrose watch the far shore fade.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Massif des Maures, and each flash turns the Gulf of Saint-Tropez white for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the hill in Gassin, and the Gulf of Saint-Tropez disappears behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, and from the Suite Belrose the Alps stand sharp beyond the bay.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Mediterranean is a deep blue, and the sea-view terraces stay empty above it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pools and look at the Gulf of Saint-Tropez from the water.
phrases.warm: On the sea-view terraces, books stay closed on the sunbeds while guests look at the Gulf of Saint-Tropez instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Massif des Maures, and the sailboats on the Gulf of Saint-Tropez throw long shadows on the water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in patches, and the Gulf of Saint-Tropez turns from grey to gold and back again.
phrases.grey_evening: From Le Belrose this evening, guests look out at the marina lights along the Gulf of Saint-Tropez under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of Le Belrose this evening, and the lights around the bay blur into soft yellow dots.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hide the stars, but the lights of Sainte-Maxime shine across the dark water of the bay.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lights around the Gulf of Saint-Tropez draw the shape of the bay below the hill.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Gulf of Saint-Tropez is quiet and dark below the hill.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first marina lights come on around the Gulf of Saint-Tropez.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear over Shark's Bay, and the first light picks out Tiran Island on the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Red Sea, and guests on their balconies look across Shark's Bay to Tiran Island.
phrases.clear_midday: From Mezzaluna's window tables, guests look straight out at Tiran Island across a flat arc of deep-blue water under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Shark's Bay this morning, while Tiran Island stays in sunshine on the horizon.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the infinity pool, the Red Sea changes colour this afternoon as clouds pass over Shark's Bay.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the Red Sea turns the colour of slate, and Tiran Island sits low on the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Shark's Bay today, and Tiran Island is only a faint shape above the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Tiran Island is not visible today; from the sea-view balconies guests see the private beach, the jetty and the near water of Shark's Bay.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Shark's Bay, and guests at Mezzaluna's window tables watch the Red Sea blur.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Red Sea, and each flash shows Shark's Bay and the private jetty for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Shark's Bay, and the Red Sea shows grey between the flakes, to the surprise of every guest.
phrases.very_cold: In very cold, clear air Tiran Island looks close enough to touch, and the Red Sea is deep blue below it.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the private beach is quiet, and the Red Sea lies flat and blue inside Shark's Bay.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look out over the Red Sea from the water.
phrases.warm: On the pool deck, guests on sunloungers look past the palm trees to the Red Sea and Tiran Island.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight turns Tiran Island gold above the Red Sea, and Mezzaluna's windows frame it like a painting.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the Red Sea inside Shark's Bay changes from blue to copper.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Red Sea is a dark surface beyond the palm trees and the lit pool.
phrases.wet_evening: At dinner in Mezzaluna, guests watch rain run down the windows, with the Red Sea dark behind it.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests on the balconies of this 325-room resort look down at the palm trees and the dark Red Sea.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Shark's Bay tonight, and the Red Sea shows black and calm below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Shark's Bay is still, and the Red Sea and the sky above it are the same colour.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays bright for a few minutes after sunset, and Tiran Island turns to a soft outline above the Red Sea.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Estaiada Bridge stands as a dark shape above the Pinheiros River.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Estaiada Bridge, and guests in the corner suites look at it from their panoramic bathtubs.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is blue, and every cable of the Estaiada Bridge is easy to follow above the Pinheiros River.
phrases.partly_morning: At breakfast in the Grand Club on the 20th floor, guests watch cloud shadows move across the São Paulo skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the city this afternoon, and the Pinheiros River turns bright and then dull as they pass.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, guests in the Grand Club see the São Paulo skyline in one soft colour from end to end.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the São Paulo skyline today, and the cables of the Estaiada Bridge look like thin pencil lines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far part of the skyline is not visible today; the Estaiada Bridge and the Pinheiros River, directly across from the hotel, still are.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the corner windows of the Diplomatic Suite, where guests see the Estaiada Bridge and the Pinheiros River a little blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over São Paulo, and for a second guests see the Estaiada Bridge white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Pinheiros River, and the Estaiada Bridge shows faintly through the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so the São Paulo skyline looks sharp from the warm side of the Grand Club glass.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests carry their coffee across the Grand Club and stay a while with the city skyline.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the city, and guests in the bridge-facing suites choose a cool bath with the Estaiada Bridge in front of them.
phrases.warm: In the warm air, guests stay longer at their windows and follow the Pinheiros River until it disappears into the city.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the cables of the Estaiada Bridge gold, and the Pinheiros River carries the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over São Paulo turn orange, and the skyline below them slowly darkens.
phrases.grey_evening: At happy hour in the Grand Club, guests watch the city lights glow under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Estaiada Bridge spread across the glass, and the river below is lost in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, with no stars above São Paulo; the lit windows of the skyline do that job instead.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Estaiada Bridge is lit above the Pinheiros River, with the skyline lights far behind it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and the Pinheiros River is a dark line below the Estaiada Bridge.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Estaiada Bridge and the Pinheiros River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Melbourne skyline stands still under a clear sky, and Port Phillip Bay waits for the first colour.
phrases.clear_morning: Eureka Tower catches the clear morning light, and guests in the skyline-facing rooms see it through floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_midday: From the infinity pool on the 27th floor, guests look over the Southbank roofline to a bright blue Port Phillip Bay.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Melbourne skyline this morning, while Australia 108 stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the gym bikes pedal nowhere this afternoon, yet the Melbourne skyline keeps changing as the clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Port Phillip Bay takes the same grey colour past the Southbank roofline.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Melbourne skyline today, and the top of Eureka Tower fades into the white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Port Phillip Bay is not visible today; guests in the bay-facing rooms see the Southbank roofline and little more.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall glass by the infinity pool, and swimmers see the Melbourne skyline through the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind Eureka Tower and Australia 108, and guests watch the storm from their floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Melbourne, and guests in the heated infinity pool watch the flakes drift past the Melbourne skyline.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, so Port Phillip Bay shows a sharp blue edge to the south.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay in the heated infinity pool and study the Southbank roofline from warm water.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Southbank roofline, and Port Phillip Bay looks like the coolest place in sight.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the day beds beside the infinity pool let the Melbourne skyline do all the work.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights the glass of Australia 108, and Eureka Tower takes the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests in the bay-facing rooms watch broken clouds turn pink over Port Phillip Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Melbourne skyline give the low sky a soft orange glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening lights of Eureka Tower, and guests in the gym watch the wet city shine from the bikes.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit towers of the Melbourne skyline shine, Australia 108 among them.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests count the lit floors of Eureka Tower and soon give up.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Melbourne skyline is quiet, and Port Phillip Bay cannot be told from the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the Melbourne skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Guests awake before sunrise find the Burj Khalifa dark and tall in the first pale light.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast time, and guests have the whole Burj Khalifa in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Every floor of the Burj Khalifa is sharp against the blue at this hour, right up to the spire.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass behind the Burj Khalifa this morning, and the tower stays in plain view.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This is an afternoon for looking at the Burj Khalifa, with a few clouds moving slowly across the sky behind it.
phrases.overcast: Rising into a grey sky today, the Burj Khalifa is still the first thing guests look for.
phrases.fog_haze: Today's haze makes the Burj Khalifa look paler and softer than usual.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The view is short today, and the Burj Khalifa is only faintly visible through the thick air.
phrases.rain: Guests watch the rain come down over Dubai, with the Burj Khalifa grey and blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder and lightning take over the view today, with the Burj Khalifa standing dark in the middle of the storm.
phrases.snow: It is snowing in Dubai, and guests watch from indoors as the flakes fall across the view of the Burj Khalifa.
phrases.very_cold: Indoors and warm, guests have a clear look at the Burj Khalifa on a freezing day.
phrases.cold: No coat is needed to enjoy the Burj Khalifa today; guests look at it from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: The Burj Khalifa stands in full sun, and guests are happy to admire it without moving much.
phrases.warm: Guests keep looking up at the Burj Khalifa, and the tower keeps going.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Burj Khalifa turns a warm gold as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests watch the last sun of the day on the Burj Khalifa, with coloured clouds behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner time the Burj Khalifa is lit against a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and guests look through it at the lights of the Burj Khalifa.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, so the lit Burj Khalifa does their job.
phrases.clear_night: Guests end the day with the lit Burj Khalifa standing in a clear night.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Caribbean Sea lies wide and dark under a clear sky, and the horizon is only starting to show.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun lights the Caribbean Sea from the horizon to the beach, with no neighboring towers in the way.
phrases.clear_midday: From the infinity pool, the turquoise Caribbean Sea begins just beyond the sandy beach under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Caribbean Sea this morning, and guests follow them from their balcony soaking tubs.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, clouds turn the Caribbean Sea into patches of turquoise and deeper blue beyond the freeform pools.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Caribbean Sea turns grey-green, and the white umbrellas on the pool deck stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Caribbean Sea and the sky look like one pale sheet beyond the palm trees.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: guests see the beach and the first waves, but the far Caribbean Sea is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Caribbean Sea, and guests watch it through the floor-to-ceiling windows of their oceanfront rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the open Caribbean Sea, and with no neighboring towers, guests indoors see the whole storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees and the Caribbean Sea, and guests keep checking that they are really seeing it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold today, yet the Caribbean Sea stays bright blue behind the glass of the oceanfront suites.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the pool deck is quiet, and the Caribbean Sea beyond it looks a deeper blue.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look over its edge at the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.warm: On a warm day on these 100 acres of coast, guests on the beach look at the open Caribbean Sea and nothing else.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Malpeque, the late sun turns the terrace gold, and the Caribbean Sea in front of it becomes a softer blue.
phrases.partly_golden: From the terrace of Malpeque, guests watch the last hour of sun colour the clouds over the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Caribbean Sea in front of Malpeque is a deep grey, with no tower lights on either side.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Caribbean Sea this evening, and guests at dinner at Malpeque watch it from their dry tables.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, and the Caribbean Sea shows only where the waves break white on the beach.
phrases.clear_night: With no neighboring towers to light the sky, guests in the 173 rooms see stars above the Caribbean Sea from their balconies.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Caribbean Sea is black and wide, and the only movement is the surf on the sand.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear and the Porta Nuova Skyline stands as a dark shape above the rooftops of Brera.

phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Brera streets this morning, while Milan Cathedral stays in sunshine beyond the rooftops.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the Brera streets this afternoon, and the towers of the Porta Nuova Skyline catch the sun between them.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Milan Cathedral looks almost the same colour as the clouds behind its spires.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Porta Nuova Skyline today, and the towers look like pencil marks above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see the nearby rooftops of Brera but not Castello Sforzesco or the Porta Nuova Skyline.

phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Porta Nuova Skyline, and guests watch the storm pass over the rooftops of Brera.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftops of Brera, and Milan Cathedral slowly turns white behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, guests can count the spires of Milan Cathedral above the rooftops of Brera.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look over the rooftops of Brera and pick out Castello Sforzesco in the city.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the marble of Milan Cathedral looks almost white in the sun above the rooftops of Brera.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests look across the rooftops of Brera to the towers of the Porta Nuova Skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Milan Cathedral gold, seen from the Imperial Suite terrace across the rooftops of Brera.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the towers of the Porta Nuova Skyline, one after another.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, Milan Cathedral is lit above the rooftops, bright against the grey sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Porta Nuova Skyline shine softly above the wet rooftops of Brera.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in this hotel of 54 rooms and 41 suites see the lit Porta Nuova Skyline above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the lit spires of Milan Cathedral stand sharp against it beyond the dark rooftops of Brera.

phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Giralda Tower stands against a clear blue sky, and guests can follow every level of it from here.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Seville Cathedral this morning, while the Giralda Tower stays in sunshine above them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace rooms, guests follow the clouds drifting behind the Giralda Tower this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Giralda Tower and Seville Cathedral take a quieter stone colour above the rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Giralda Tower today, and from the rooftop terrace it looks like a drawing in pale pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the far skyline is missing and the Giralda Tower shows only as a soft outline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Seville; guests in the Reales Alcazares Suite watch the Giralda Tower, slightly blurred through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind Seville Cathedral, and for a second guests see the Giralda Tower clearly through the storm rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Seville, and guests at their windows watch the flakes pass in front of the Giralda Tower.
phrases.very_cold: From the rooftop terrace, guests find the Giralda Tower sharp-edged in the very cold, clear air.
phrases.cold: The cold day keeps the sky pale, and Seville Cathedral stands out in grey stone above the city roofs.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the rooftop terrace keep to their lounge chairs and look at the Giralda Tower without moving much.
phrases.warm: From the balcony rooms, guests sit out in the warm air and look over the city's treetops and skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Giralda Tower and the stone of Seville Cathedral a warm gold under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds behind the Giralda Tower turn pink, and the rooftop terrace has the front seat.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs low over the evening city, and the lit Giralda Tower glows against it.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain makes the rooftops shine, and the lights of the Giralda Tower spread a little in the wet air.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and Seville Cathedral shows as a long lit mass beside its tower.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and the Giralda Tower is only a tall dark shape over the sleeping roofs.
phrases.dusk: From the loggia, the sky is still blue and pink just after sunset, and the first city lights come on below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Royal Palace of Madrid is a quiet outline under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the 10th-floor terrace, guests see the Royal Palace of Madrid in clean morning light, with Almudena Cathedral beside it.
phrases.clear_midday: The Royal Palace of Madrid stands in full light under a clear midday sky, with Almudena Cathedral easy to pick out next to it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the terracotta rooftops this morning, and the Royal Palace of Madrid goes from bright to grey to bright again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the terrace rooms on the 9th floor look down at Gran Vía this afternoon, where sun and cloud take turns on the buildings.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Royal Palace of Madrid looks paler than usual, and the dome of Almudena Cathedral sits darker next to it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Royal Palace of Madrid today, and the terracotta rooftops fade a little more with each street.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so guests on the 10th-floor terrace see the nearest rooftops well and the Royal Palace of Madrid only faintly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the terracotta rooftops, and guests watch it from their balcony doors as the city turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the city, and for a second the Royal Palace of Madrid and Almudena Cathedral stand out sharply against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Madrid, and guests see the terracotta rooftops turn white one by one in front of the Royal Palace of Madrid.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and guests can count the windows of the Royal Palace of Madrid from the 10th-floor terrace.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Royal Palace of Madrid looks sharp and pale above the rooftops, with Almudena Cathedral close by.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool, in use since 1948, and look across at the Royal Palace of Madrid from the water.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, guests keep turning their chairs towards the Royal Palace of Madrid and Almudena Cathedral.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Royal Palace of Madrid a warm gold, and the terracotta rooftops in front of it glow almost orange.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in patches, lighting Almudena Cathedral first and then the Royal Palace of Madrid.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests on the terrace see the Royal Palace of Madrid and Almudena Cathedral lit against the grey clouds.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests with balconies watch the lights of Gran Vía shine twice, once on the buildings and once on the wet street.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, clouds hang low over the city, and the Royal Palace of Madrid glows in its lights beyond the dark rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Royal Palace of Madrid stands lit above the rooftops, and Almudena Cathedral shines just beside it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Gran Vía is nearly empty below the balconies, a rare sight on a street that is usually full of traffic.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the 10th-floor terrace guests watch the first lights come on at the Royal Palace of Madrid.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Milan Cathedral stands grey and still above the sleeping rooftops, under a clear sky slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Penthouse Suite terrace, Milan Cathedral stands bright in the morning sun above the city roofs.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Milan Cathedral shows every edge of its roofline above the city.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Milan this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the rooftops towards Milan Cathedral.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests looking out this afternoon see Milan Cathedral go from sunlit to shaded and back as the clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the rooftops of Milan lose their shadows, and Milan Cathedral looks pale against the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken most of the city today, and guests search for Milan Cathedral in the place where it usually stands.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the nearest rooftops are clear and Milan Cathedral is only a faint outline behind them.
phrases.rain: Rain runs off the rooftops of Milan, and guests watch from the Penthouse Suite as Milan Cathedral turns a darker grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Milan Cathedral for a second at a time, and guests behind the glass count the seconds to the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Penthouse Suite terrace on the 5th floor, and Milan Cathedral beyond is turning white with the roofs.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and guests stay behind warm windows to look at Milan Cathedral in sharp detail.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in this 15th-century convent look over the chilly rooftops to Milan Cathedral with a hot drink in hand.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above the rooftops of Milan, and Milan Cathedral seems to tremble slightly in the bright air.
phrases.warm: On the Penthouse Suite terrace, guests sit out in the warm air with Milan Cathedral in front of them and no reason to go inside.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns Milan Cathedral gold in the late afternoon, and the rooftops around it follow one by one.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above Milan Cathedral turn pink, and guests keep their cameras out a little longer than planned.
phrases.grey_evening: Under an evening of low cloud, the lit Milan Cathedral gives the sky above it a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights shine on soaked rooftops, and Milan Cathedral glows through the wet air.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests looking out find the lights of Milan spread around the bright form of Milan Cathedral.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above Milan tonight, though the lit Milan Cathedral easily wins the attention of guests.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and Milan Cathedral rests as a dark shape above the roofs.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and guests see the first lights come on around Milan Cathedral.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear over the Thornybush bushveld, and the waterhole in front of camp is a still grey mirror.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the waterhole in front of the main pool deck, where every track in the mud is easy to see.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the bushveld around the waterhole lies bright and still, with shade only under the trees.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Thornybush bushveld this morning, and guests on the main pool deck follow them past the waterhole.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the bath in the spa, guests look over the bush this afternoon as clouds and sun take turns above it.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky the bushveld turns one soft shade of green and brown, and the waterhole in front of camp looks like dull silver.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the bushveld today, and from the main pool deck the trees behind the waterhole look like pencil drawings.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far bushveld is not visible today, so guests on the main pool deck look at the waterhole and the nearest trees.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Thornybush bushveld, and guests watch it from the thatched gazebos on their suite decks.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole bushveld for a second at a time, and guests at their suite doors wait for the next flash.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the bushveld today, and guests look twice at the white thorn trees around the waterhole.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day the air is sharp over the bushveld, and every bare branch around the waterhole stands out.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the waterhole in front of camp lies still, and the bushveld behind it is quiet.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests in the Royal Suites stay in their private pools and look out over the wilderness.
phrases.warm: On the main pool deck, books stay closed on this warm day while guests look at the waterhole instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the dry grass of the bushveld gold, and guests watch from the private decks of this lodge that sleeps just 20.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud, and the waterhole in front of the main pool deck shines orange for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: At the Masiya Bar this evening, guests look past the lamps to the bushveld, which lies black under a sky with no stars.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the bushveld this evening, and from the Masiya Bar guests see only the wet leaves that the lamps reach.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night under cloud, the bushveld around the waterhole is a black wall, with only the nearest trees showing.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Thornybush bushveld tonight, and guests on their suite decks can see the treetops against them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the bushveld around the waterhole is black and still, and no light shows anywhere in it.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset the sky above the bushveld is still bright, and the first lamps come on along the main pool deck.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Sydney Harbour lies still below the east-facing rooms, and the sky behind the Royal Botanic Garden slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Sydney Opera House, and swimmers in the glass-walled indoor pool watch it between lengths.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Sydney Harbour Bridge stands sharp against a blue sky, its arch easy to follow from Club InterContinental.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Sydney Harbour this morning, and the Royal Botanic Garden changes from bright green to deep green and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Aster on the 32nd floor, guests follow the clouds as they drift over the Sydney Harbour Bridge this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Sydney Opera House looks whiter than usual against the dull water of Sydney Harbour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over Sydney Harbour today, and from the harbour-facing rooms the Sydney Harbour Bridge looks like a soft pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Sydney Harbour is not visible today, but the Sydney Opera House and the Royal Botanic Garden remain clear below.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass walls of the indoor pool, and swimmers see Sydney Harbour grey and blurred beyond them.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Sydney Harbour, and each flash of lightning shows the Sydney Harbour Bridge for a second through the suite windows.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Sydney Harbour, and guests at Club InterContinental watch the Sydney Opera House fade behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: From Aster, the 180-degree panorama runs from the Sydney Opera House to the Sydney Harbour Bridge under a freezing, clear sky.
phrases.cold: A cold day is no problem in the indoor pool, where guests swim behind glass and look out at the Sydney Opera House.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, Sydney Harbour shines almost white, and guests look at the Sydney Opera House from the cool side of the glass.
phrases.warm: On the terrace at Aster, guests sit in the warm air with the Sydney Opera House and the Sydney Harbour Bridge both in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Sydney Opera House gold, and at Aster the cocktails wait while guests look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud and lights the Sydney Harbour Bridge in pieces, while Sydney Harbour turns orange below.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars tonight, so the lit Sydney Opera House and the city lights on Sydney Harbour do the work instead.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and from Aster the lights of the Sydney Harbour Bridge spread across the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of the Sydney Harbour Bridge reflect in Sydney Harbour, and guests in the harbour-facing rooms leave the curtains open.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit Sydney Opera House stands above black water, and the Royal Botanic Garden is a dark shape beside it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Sydney Harbour is quiet, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge is a dark line across it.
phrases.dusk: From the former Treasury Building, guests watch the first lights come on along the Sydney Harbour Bridge under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Acropolis is a quiet outline against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the rooftop restaurant, guests look across to the Acropolis and the Parthenon in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the columns of the Temple of Olympian Zeus stand directly below the 7th-floor terraces.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Lycabettus Hill this morning, while the Temple of Olympian Zeus stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the Acropolis this afternoon, and the Parthenon goes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Parthenon takes the same pale colour, high on the Acropolis.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Acropolis today, and the Parthenon looks like a drawing in light pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The sea and its islands are not visible today, but the Acropolis is close enough to stay clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Temple of Olympian Zeus; guests watch it from behind the glass of the rooftop restaurant.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the Temple of Olympian Zeus, and guests in the rooftop restaurant agree that the owner seems to be home.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Acropolis, and guests in the rooftop restaurant watch the Parthenon slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Acropolis shows sharp edges from the 7th-floor terraces.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look at Hadrian's Arch and the Temple of Olympian Zeus from the warm side of the glass.

phrases.warm: On the outdoor terrace of the rooftop restaurant, guests sit in the warm air between the Temple of Olympian Zeus and the Acropolis.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Parthenon gold on the Acropolis, and the sea is visible in the distance to the south-west.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the huge columns of the Temple of Olympian Zeus one by one.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in the rooftop restaurant, guests see the lit Acropolis glow under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass of the rooftop restaurant this evening, and the lit Parthenon shines through the drops.
phrases.mild_night: The lit Temple of Olympian Zeus and Lycabettus Hill stand out under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the Acropolis is lit above the rooftops, and the Parthenon is easy to pick out, column by column.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city is quiet and the Acropolis rests above it as a dark shape.
phrases.dusk: From the suite's wraparound terrace, guests see the first lights come on at the Temple of Olympian Zeus at one end and the Acropolis at the other.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Chao Phraya River is a quiet dark band below, and the sky above it is just starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Chao Phraya River, and from the river-facing balconies between the 51st and 59th floors guests can follow every boat.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Chao Phraya River shines in the strong light, and Bangkok's skyline stands sharp against the blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Chao Phraya River this morning, one patch of water bright and the next one grey.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over Bangkok's skyline this afternoon, and the towers stand in sun and shade by turns.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits low over Bangkok, and the Chao Phraya River takes the same quiet colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Bangkok today, and the Chao Phraya River fades into it a short way downstream.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of Bangkok's skyline is not visible today, but the Chao Phraya River below is still clear to see.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Chao Phraya River, and guests watch it from their suite windows as the far bank turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Bangkok's skyline, and for a second the Chao Phraya River shows white below the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Chao Phraya River, and guests keep looking down to make sure it is real.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, so guests can follow the Chao Phraya River a long way through the city.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Chao Phraya River looks steel grey, and the boats on it leave long white lines.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the Chao Phraya River shines like metal, and guests look at it from the shade.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests stand on their river-facing balconies and count the boats on the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the river-facing balconies, guests watch the low sun turn the Chao Phraya River gold.
phrases.partly_golden: At Sirocco, the last sun comes through the clouds and lights Bangkok's skyline tower by tower.
phrases.grey_evening: At Sirocco, guests have dinner under a cloudy sky, with the lights of Bangkok's skyline all around them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights along the Chao Phraya River this evening, and the boats become small moving glows.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the city lights give the clouds a soft glow, and the Chao Phraya River runs black between them.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Chao Phraya River is quiet, and only a few slow boats move on it.
phrases.dusk: From Sky Bar, guests see the sky still pink over Bangkok while the first city lights come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Empire State Building stands unlit against a clear sky that slowly turns pale behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Empire State Building first, and guests in the rooms facing it watch the light move down its side.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests on the higher floors pick out the Statue of Liberty beyond Downtown Manhattan.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past the top of the Empire State Building this morning, while the Manhattan skyline below stays in patchy sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge on the 36th floor, guests watch cloud shadows cross the rooftops of Manhattan.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Empire State Building takes the same colour as the clouds and looks even closer.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Downtown Manhattan today, and the Empire State Building fades floor by floor towards its top.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Statue of Liberty is not visible today, so the Empire State Building, close and clear, takes all the attention.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests see the Empire State Building slightly blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests watch the storm from their rooms as lightning flashes behind the Empire State Building and thunder rolls over Manhattan.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the windows of this 2022 tower, and the Empire State Building turns white and faint behind it.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, guests stay behind the glass and pick out every edge of the Empire State Building.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge keep a warm cup in hand and look over Manhattan.
phrases.very_hot: The heat lies heavy over Downtown Manhattan, and the Statue of Liberty shimmers a little in the bright light.
phrases.warm: In the warm daylight, guests in The Ritz-Carlton Suite look across Downtown Manhattan to the Statue of Liberty.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills Nubeluz on the 50th floor, and guests turn from their glasses to the Manhattan skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and paints one side of the Empire State Building orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit Empire State Building glows close by, and the clouds above it catch the colour.

phrases.mild_night: Guests in the penthouse residences look out on a mild night, with the lights of Manhattan bright under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: From Nubeluz, 500 feet up, the Manhattan skyline shines on three sides under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Empire State Building is a quiet neighbour, and guests who cannot sleep have good company.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the Empire State Building switches on its lights, and Manhattan follows window by window.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean is a dark surface under a clear sky, and the first light shows low on the horizon.

phrases.clear_midday: From the infinity pool, the Atlantic Ocean is clear all the way to the horizon under a blue midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic Ocean this morning, while the sand at the edge of the water stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Lunch at The Abalone has a moving background this afternoon, as clouds cross the sky above the beach and the ocean.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns grey too, and the white lines of the waves stand out on the sand.

phrases.reduced_visibility: The far ends of the beach are not visible today; guests see the sand and the first lines of waves below.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Daytona Beach, and guests stand at the floor-to-ceiling windows to watch it meet the waves.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and the horizon of the Atlantic Ocean is a sharp line from The Abalone.

phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool and look across the bright sand to the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.warm: At Breakwater Pool Bar, guests take their time over a drink and watch the beach on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight turns the beach gold, and from the upper floors of this 27-floor tower guests see its full arc.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds above the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in the corner suites have two balconies to watch from.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the Atlantic Ocean is dark, and dinner guests at The Abalone see pale waves reach the beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass at The Abalone this evening, and beyond it the beach and the ocean are almost lost in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the fire pits of the Abalone Outdoor Dining Deck glow beside the dark beach and the sound of the waves.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and guests on the balconies can count more of them than waves.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the beach is empty and the Atlantic Ocean is a wide dark space beyond the sand.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Atlantic Ocean is still bright, and the first lights come on along the beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the San Francisco skyline is a row of still towers under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.

phrases.clear_midday: From the heated infinity pool, the San Francisco skyline stands sharp against a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the city rooftops this morning, and their shadows cross the San Francisco skyline one tower at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the corner Metropolitan Suite watch afternoon clouds drift above the San Francisco skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the glass towers of the San Francisco skyline take the same grey, and the hills behind them look darker.

phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the top-floor Presidential Suite watch lightning flash behind the San Francisco skyline while thunder rolls over SoMa.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling across the San Francisco skyline, and the city rooftops below are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and every edge of the San Francisco skyline looks freshly cut.

phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the heated infinity pool and look at the San Francisco skyline from the water.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of Salesforce Tower gold, and the rest of the San Francisco skyline follows.

phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit towers of the San Francisco skyline give the low sky a soft glow.

phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the San Francisco skyline is quiet, and nothing moves on the city rooftops below.

phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the green-tiled rooftop pool, and the Madrid skyline stands sharp against a clear blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunchtime on the Picos Pardos rooftop, guests look down at Calle Velázquez under a cloudless midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Madrid skyline this morning, and their shadows cross the rooftops one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop pool, guests follow patches of sun and shade moving across the Madrid skyline this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Calle Velázquez looks calm, and the Madrid skyline keeps to quiet colours.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Madrid skyline today, and the far rooftops fade into the pale sky.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Calle Velázquez, and guests in the Picos Pardos igloos watch the street turn white below them.

phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Madrid glow below the Picos Pardos rooftop, where guests take their time over dinner.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Picos Pardos igloos this evening, and the lights of Calle Velázquez blur into soft colours for the guests inside.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of Calle Velázquez shine in a long, bright row below the Picos Pardos rooftop.
phrases.clear_night: At Picos Pardos, guests have dinner under the stars, with the lights of Calle Velázquez shining below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Calle Velázquez is almost empty, and even Madrid seems to have gone to bed.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Madrid skyline, and guests on the rooftop count the first city lights coming on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Tyrrhenian Sea is still and grey-blue under a clear sky, and the main beach below is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast under the bougainvillea ceiling, guests look out over the main beach and the sea in the first clear light.
phrases.clear_midday: The Bay of Positano is bright blue under a clear midday sky, and the anchored boats sit almost still on it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Tyrrhenian Sea this morning, while the main beach stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace suites, guests follow patches of sun and shade as they cross the Bay of Positano this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Tyrrhenian Sea turns the colour of slate, and the main beach looks paler than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Bay of Positano today, and the anchored boats seem to float in the air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the bay is not visible today, so guests look at the main beach and the nearest boats instead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Bay of Positano, and guests watch it from behind the arched glass doors of their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Tyrrhenian Sea for a second, then the storm closes the bay in again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Bay of Positano, and guests watch the flakes meet the grey sea.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the Tyrrhenian Sea looks sharp and deep blue, and guests admire it from behind glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the main beach lies empty below, and the sea beyond it is a darker blue.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the terrace loungers hardly move, and the Tyrrhenian Sea shines white in the strong light.
phrases.warm: On the terrace loungers, books stay closed while guests watch the boats in the Bay of Positano.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From their private terraces in this 1930s hotel, guests watch the low sun turn the Tyrrhenian Sea to gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the Bay of Positano changes from gold to pink as guests watch.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner on the terrace, guests look down at the lights of Positano under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the village this evening, and the sea beyond them is lost in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so the lights of Positano draw the shape of the bay.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the Tyrrhenian Sea tonight, and guests can try to count them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Bay of Positano is quiet and dark, and the sea and the sky look like one.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the sea at dusk, and the first lights come on in the village of Positano.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Andaman Sea lies still and grey under a clear sky, and Kata Noi Beach is a strip of empty sand.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the Andaman Sea shows emerald beyond the edge of the infinity pool.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Andaman Sea is bright turquoise, and from the private pools of the seaview villas the sand of Kata Noi Beach looks almost white.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Andaman Sea this morning, while Kata Noi Beach stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the gym windows, guests on the treadmills watch clouds drift over Kata Noi Beach, which makes the afternoon run feel shorter.
phrases.overcast: From the Wedding Chapel, guests look out over an Andaman Sea turned steel grey under the overcast sky.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Andaman Sea today, and from the infinity pool the horizon has disappeared.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the bay is not visible today; Kata Noi Beach and the nearest water of the Andaman Sea are still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Kata Noi Beach; guests watch it from their seaview villas, the Andaman Sea blurred behind the trees.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Kata Noi Beach, and each flash of lightning shows the Andaman Sea white with rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Kata Noi Beach, and the Andaman Sea is a grey sheet behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Andaman Sea looks sharp and blue from the gym windows above Kata Noi Beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Kata Noi Beach lies empty, and guests look at the Andaman Sea from the terraces of their seaview villas.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look at the Andaman Sea over the water's edge.
phrases.warm: From the private pool on each seaview villa terrace, guests look down on Kata Noi Beach, where swimmers dot the warm water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun drops toward the Andaman Sea, and guests in the infinity pool watch the bay turn gold.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Andaman Sea turn orange, and Kata Noi Beach glows below the Wedding Chapel.
phrases.grey_evening: At The Harbor, guests have dinner above Kata Noi Beach, where the white surf still shows under the cloudy night sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Andaman Sea this evening, and guests at The Harbor watch it sweep across Kata Noi Beach.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the Andaman Sea is a dark, moving surface beyond the lit edge of the infinity pool.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Andaman Sea tonight, and the surf draws a white edge along Kata Noi Beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Kata Noi Beach is silent, and the Andaman Sea moves slowly in the dark.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and the sky over the Andaman Sea is still bright while the first lights appear around the infinity pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky turns pale blue over Osaka, and the city below is still a field of grey roofs.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the corner suite on the 53rd floor wake to a clear sky and Osaka spreading out in every direction.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in Restaurant "ZK", about 270 metres above the ground, guests look down on Osaka under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the roofs of Osaka this morning, and the sun follows them street by street.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the high-floor lounge, guests watch the city skyline go from sun to shade as clouds pass this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Osaka becomes one wide grey map, with streets drawn across it in every direction.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Osaka today, and the far edge of the city fades into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far districts of Osaka are not visible today; from the floor-to-ceiling windows, guests see only the nearer streets and towers clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Osaka, and the streets far below shine wet between the grey buildings.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the city skyline, and for a second all of Osaka shows white under the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Osaka, and from floors 38 to 57 guests watch the roofs below slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, clear day, Osaka looks sharp and still from behind the glass, every roof with a clean edge.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay in the high-floor lounge and follow the city skyline from one side of the glass to the other.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the roofs of Osaka, and the far streets seem to move in the bright air.
phrases.warm: Warm light lies over Osaka today, and guests on the gym treadmills run toward a city skyline that never gets closer.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the towers of Osaka gold, and long shadows stretch across the streets below.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests in the high-floor lounge watch the clouds over the city skyline turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in the teppanyaki dining room, guests look over the lit city grid of Osaka under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests at dinner in Restaurant "ZK" see the city lights of Osaka blurred through the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hang low over Osaka tonight and take a soft glow from the city lights below.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the corner suite on the 53rd floor see the city lights of Osaka from the bathtub.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Osaka is quiet far below, and a guest who cannot sleep has the whole city for company.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the street grid of Osaka.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over the Atlantic Ocean turns from black to deep blue, and the beach below is still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balcony rooms, guests watch the morning sun climb over the Atlantic Ocean and light the breaking waves.
phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic Ocean is bright blue at midday, and the sandy shore below the pool deck looks almost white.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic Ocean this morning, and guests on the rooftop lawn watch them reach the beach.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At Cast & Crew, guests look up from their table to see clouds drift over the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns grey too, and only the white of the waves stands out.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic Ocean and the sky look like one soft sheet from the rooftop lawn.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests see the beach and the first lines of waves, then the Atlantic Ocean fades out.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the beach, and guests at Cast & Crew watch the Atlantic Ocean turn dull and rough.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in this former Plaza Ocean Club building watch the storm from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sandy shore, a rare sight here, and the Atlantic Ocean keeps rolling in under it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and from the pool deck the Atlantic Ocean shows a sharp blue horizon.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the beach is quiet, and guests look at the long empty sand from Cast & Crew.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the pool and look over the deck at swimmers in the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.warm: On the pool deck, books stay closed while guests watch people walk along the beach below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the sand gold, and the Atlantic Ocean in front of the rooftop lawn becomes a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sunlight colours the clouds above the Atlantic Ocean pink, and guests watch from the oceanfront patio.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud the Atlantic Ocean is almost black, and from the oceanfront patio only the white of the nearest waves shows.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests at Cast & Crew watch the rain fall on the dark Atlantic Ocean this evening.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the breaking waves draw pale lines on the dark water in front of the pool deck.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and guests on their balconies can count them down to the horizon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the beach is empty, and the Atlantic Ocean is only a darker space beyond the sand.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the calm Atlantic Ocean turns pink and purple, and the oceanfront patio has the front seats.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the bay of Amalfi lies still below the balcony rooms, and the first light is just starting to show the cliffs.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is served on the terrace this morning, and guests look across the gulf under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, the Amalfi Coast runs sharp and clear under a midday sky without a cloud.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the bay of Amalfi this morning, while the beach below stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the two balconies of the Master Suite watch clouds drift along the Amalfi Coast this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the sea in the bay of Amalfi turns the colour of slate, and Amalfi port stands out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the gulf today, and from the terrace the cliffs of the coast fade one after another.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Amalfi Coast is not visible from the rooftop pool today; Amalfi's beach and the nearest cliffs are clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the bay of Amalfi, and guests in this early-1900s building by the sea watch the drops mark the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the gulf, and lightning shows the cliffs of the Amalfi Coast for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Amalfi's beach, and the flakes disappear the moment they touch the sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and clear over the rooftop pool, and every cliff along the coast shows its edges.
phrases.cold: The terrace is quiet on this cold day, and the gulf beyond it seems happy to perform without an audience.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the Amalfi Coast from the water.
phrases.warm: Swimmers and sunbathers fill Amalfi's beach on this warm day, and guests on the terrace follow it all with a cold drink.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the cliffs of the Amalfi Coast gold, and guests at the rooftop pool put their phones down, then pick them up again.
phrases.partly_golden: From the private solarium of the Amalfitana Suite, guests see the last sun slip between clouds and light the coast in patches.
phrases.grey_evening: Candles burn on the tables at Terrazza 17 under a cloudy evening sky, with the lights of Amalfi port in front.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain shines on Amalfi port this evening, and its lights stretch into long reflections on the water.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of the town curve around the bay of Amalfi below the 34 rooms and suites.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the gulf tonight, and the lights along the Amalfi Coast shine on the dark water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the sea is a wide dark field beyond Amalfi's beach, and the bay is silent.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights of the town come on below the terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is a wide grey sheet under a clear sky, and the horizon is just beginning to show.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests step onto their ocean-facing balconies this clear morning and find the Atlantic bright and blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Atlantic shows two blues, lighter near the sand and darker far out.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Atlantic this morning, and guests can follow them from one side of the horizon to the other.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the covered oceanfront terrace, guests see palm trees, the sandy beach and an Atlantic patched with sun and cloud this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Atlantic takes the same grey, and only the white edge of the waves marks where the beach begins.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic seems to end a short way past the breaking waves.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; guests see the beach and the first waves clearly, but the far Atlantic and the horizon are not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic; guests watch it from behind the balcony doors, the waves grey and the sand dark.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay on the dry side of the glass while lightning flashes over the Atlantic and shows the white waves for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sandy beach, and the Atlantic behind it stays dark grey and keeps moving.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear today, and the line between the Atlantic and the sky looks drawn with a ruler.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look out at a wide, quiet beach and an Atlantic with rows of white-topped waves.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests in the shade of the covered oceanfront terrace watch swimmers cross the hot sand to the Atlantic.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit out on their balconies and watch the beach fill with towels and the Atlantic with swimmers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight warms the sand to gold, and the Atlantic beyond it turns a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Atlantic turn pink and the water copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: This cloudy evening, the Atlantic is nearly black, and only the white of the nearest waves shows.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests look past their dripping balconies to a dark Atlantic with faint white waves.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Atlantic shows no horizon, only waves arriving out of the dark.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests look out from their balconies at stars above the Atlantic.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic is a wide dark space, and the breaking waves are the only thing moving.
phrases.dusk: From the covered oceanfront terrace, guests watch the sky stay bright over the Atlantic for a few minutes while the palm trees turn to dark outlines.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Porto Cathedral is a dark shape above the historic roofline, and the sky behind it is just starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the historic rooftops, and guests on the corner balconies see Porto Cathedral bright against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, guests look over Porto's historic facades and tree canopies under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the historic city roofline this morning, and Porto Cathedral goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the dining area look through green-framed windows at Porto's rooftops, where patches of sun and shade change places all afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the roofs of the historic centre look darker, and Porto Cathedral stands clearly above them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the historic roofline today, and Porto Cathedral looks like a pencil drawing behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Porto Cathedral is not visible today; guests on the rooftop terrace see the nearest historic facades and tree canopies, and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the historic rooftops, and guests watch it from behind their balcony doors, Porto Cathedral slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the historic centre, and each flash of lightning shows Porto Cathedral for a second above the roofs.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Porto's historic rooftops, and guests in the dining area turn in their seats to watch the roofs turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, every roof on the historic roofline looks sharp, and Porto Cathedral seems closer than usual.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep their balcony doors closed and look at the historic rooftops through the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the rooftop terrace choose a stool, sit very still and let their eyes do the walking across the historic facades.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests stay out on the corner balconies and look at Porto Cathedral above the historic roofline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light falls across the historic roofline, and Porto Cathedral glows above it.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop terrace, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds above the historic facades and tree canopies.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the city lights give the clouds a soft glow above the historic roofline.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the lamplight this evening, and the wet roofs of the historic centre shine under the city lights.
phrases.mild_night: No stars show on this mild, cloudy night, and lit windows are scattered across the historic centre below Porto Cathedral.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, stars sit above Porto Cathedral, and the lights of the historic centre spread out below it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the historic centre is quiet, and Porto Cathedral keeps its place above the sleeping roofs.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lamps come on along the historic facades below the rooftop terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Diamond Head is a dark shape at the far end of Waikiki Beach, and the Pacific is still grey.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light moves across the water off Waikiki Beach, and guests in the oceanfront suites follow it all the way to Diamond Head.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Pacific is turquoise near the sand of Waikiki Beach and deep blue further out.
phrases.partly_morning: From the patio of Voyager 47 Club Lounge, guests at breakfast look out over the Pacific while clouds drift past Diamond Head.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross Waikiki Beach this afternoon, and Diamond Head goes from bright to shaded and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific loses its turquoise, but the outline of Diamond Head stays sharp beyond Waikiki Beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Diamond Head today, so the crater looks like a watercolour at the end of Waikiki Beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Diamond Head is not visible today; what can be seen is the palm trees and the first waves on Waikiki Beach.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Waikiki Beach, and guests in balcony rooms watch it blur Diamond Head.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Pacific and Diamond Head for a second, then the storm hides them again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Waikiki Beach, and guests look twice at the white flakes landing on the palm trees in front of Diamond Head.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and the sky is clear, so Diamond Head stands sharp above an empty Waikiki Beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests at Hula Grill look at the ocean and the palm trees and leave the sand to the waves.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay under the beachfront cabanas and look past the palm trees at the bright Pacific.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, swimmers and walkers fill Waikiki Beach, with Diamond Head behind them in every photo.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Diamond Head gold, and guests in the oceanfront suites, renovated in 2021, see a wide sweep of the Pacific in the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: The sun drops through broken clouds over the Pacific, and guests on the patio of Voyager 47 Club Lounge watch the water, half hoping for a whale.
phrases.grey_evening: At Duke's Waikiki, dinner guests look at the dark ocean and the palm trees under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Waikiki Beach this evening, and the lights along the shore shine on the wet sand towards Diamond Head.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, guests in balcony rooms see the lights of Waikiki Beach reflected on the water.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Pacific tonight, and Diamond Head is a black outline below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Waikiki Beach is empty, and the Pacific is only a little moving white on the sand.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Pacific is still bright, and the first lights come on along Waikiki Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Singel lies still and black under a clear sky, and the canal houses along it are only outlines.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Royal Palace first, and from the WET Deck pool on the 6th floor every window of its front is clear.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Royal Palace stands sharp against a blue sky, and Dam Square spreads out below the WET Deck pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Canal Ring this morning, and the Singel turns from silver to blue and back again.
