phrases.partly_afternoon: From W Lounge, guests follow cloud shadows across the roofs of the canal district as far as Westerkerk.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Singel takes the same colour, and the canal houses stand in a quiet row above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the canal district today, and from W Lounge the tower of Westerkerk is only a faint grey shape.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far roofs of the Canal Ring are not visible today, so the view from the canal-facing rooms ends at the houses across the Singel.
phrases.rain: Rain makes small rings on the Singel, and guests in the canal-facing rooms watch them spread and disappear.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Dam Square, and each flash of lightning shows the Royal Palace white for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the roof of the Royal Palace and whitens Dam Square below the WET Deck pool.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the heated water of the WET Deck pool steams, and the Royal Palace stands clear behind it.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the fitness centre at AWAY Spa run in the warm and look out at the canal.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, swimmers in the WET Deck pool rest at the edge and look across Dam Square at the Royal Palace.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the WET Deck count the people crossing Dam Square and are glad to be high above them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the stone of the Royal Palace gold, and guests in the rooms facing it stop to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the tower of Westerkerk, seen from W Lounge above the canal roofs.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the canal district spread out below W Lounge, and Westerkerk rises among them.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lamps along the Singel shine twice, once on the quay and once in the water.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lit front of the Royal Palace glows softly over Dam Square.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of the Canal Ring follow the curve of the water, seen from W Lounge.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Dam Square is almost empty, and the Royal Palace keeps watch over a few late bicycles.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Canal Ring, and the first lamps come on along the Singel below this address of 238 rooms and suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Kampot River lies still and grey under a clear sky, and the Bokor ridge is a dark shape behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Arvi, guests watch fishing boats cross the Kampot River under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the main pool, guests see the Kampot River shining at eye level under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly over the Bokor ridge this morning, while the Kampot River stays bright below it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the dock, guests follow the fishing boats on the Kampot River as clouds drift over the town on the far bank.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Kampot River takes the same colour as the 25 sandstone villas among the mangroves.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides most of the Bokor ridge today, and the boats on the Kampot River look like small grey marks.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Bokor ridge is not visible today; guests on the riverfront platform see the Kampot River and little beyond the far bank.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the whole surface of the Kampot River, and guests watch it from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the gym.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Bokor ridge for a second, then the storm closes over the Kampot River again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Kampot River, and guests in Arvi stop talking to watch it melt on the water.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold air, the Bokor ridge stands sharp and clear beyond the Kampot River.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep behind the gym windows and look out at the Kampot River and its palm trees.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the main pool, and the fishing boats on the Kampot River pass just beyond its edge.
phrases.warm: On the private beach, guests lie in the warm air and watch the calm water of the Kampot River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Kampot River, and guests at the pool bar watch the sun go down towards the Bokor ridge.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Bokor ridge turn orange, and guests on the dock stay to watch.
phrases.grey_evening: Over dinner at Arvi, guests look out at the Kampot River, dark and quiet under the evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the dark Kampot River this evening, and guests at dinner in Arvi watch it cross the water.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of Kampot town shine across the river from the far bank.
phrases.clear_night: The sky is clear tonight, and stars show above the Bokor ridge on the far side of the Kampot River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Kampot River moves quietly past the empty dock.
phrases.dusk: From the spa terrace, guests see the calm Kampot River under a sky that is still bright, as the first lights come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Atlantic is a wide dark surface, and a thin band of light begins to open along the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: At Ocean's on 82nd, guests have breakfast looking at a clear, bright Atlantic.
phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic is deep blue at midday, and the horizon is a clean straight edge under a cloudless sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Atlantic this morning, and the Grand Strand stays bright between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the oceanfront pool, the Atlantic changes from blue to grey-green as clouds drift over it this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: The sky is fully grey today, and the Atlantic matches it, with only the white surf marking the edge of the Grand Strand.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic and the sky become one pale sheet beyond the Grand Strand.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far Atlantic horizon is not visible today; guests on the oceanfront balconies see the sand and the first lines of waves.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic, and guests at Ocean's on 82nd watch it sweep over the grey sea.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic, and guests in the balcony rooms watch the storm from behind their glass doors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Grand Strand, and the flakes disappear the moment they touch the Atlantic waves.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, and the Atlantic shows every wave crest sharply all the way to the horizon.
phrases.cold: On this cold day guests choose a table at Ocean's on 82nd and look at the Atlantic from the warm side.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the oceanfront pool and look across at the Atlantic, which shimmers in the bright light.
phrases.warm: On this warm day guests walk along the Grand Strand, small figures between the wide sand and the Atlantic.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight turns the Grand Strand gold, and the Atlantic beyond it becomes a darker, calmer blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun the clouds over the Atlantic turn pink, and guests among the 405 rooms step onto their balconies to look.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Ocean's on 82nd, the cloudy evening leaves the Atlantic almost black, with white surf showing near the shore.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and the lights of the oceanfront pool shine on the wet deck in front of a black Atlantic.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the night sky, and the Atlantic shows only as faint surf rolling onto the Grand Strand.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic tonight, and guests on the oceanfront balconies can follow them down to the horizon.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Atlantic keeps moving in the dark, and the Grand Strand lies empty beside it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky above the Atlantic is still bright, and the first lights come on around the oceanfront pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Willis Tower is a dark shape over the city of Chicago.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Suite of Presidents, guests see the morning sun cross Grant Park and reach Lake Michigan.
phrases.clear_midday: Willis Tower rises clear above the city, with nothing between it and the blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the Lake View rooms follow cloud shadows along Michigan Avenue, from Navy Pier all the way to Soldier Field.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Willis Tower goes from bright to grey and back again as the clouds move over the city.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Chicago coastline draws a clear line between the city and Lake Michigan.
phrases.fog_haze: Today's haze hides the top of Willis Tower, leaving guests to guess how high it goes.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Navy Pier is still clear, but Soldier Field and the far end of the Lake Front are not visible today.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the Smoke Filled Suite, and guests see Lake Michigan and the Chicago coastline blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city of Chicago while Willis Tower disappears and returns between the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: In the Suite of Presidents, guests watch the snow slowly cover Grant Park in white.
phrases.very_cold: From the Smoke Filled Suite, guests study a steel-blue Lake Michigan and are glad to be behind glass.
phrases.cold: At the very top of the building, guests in the Heaven Suite & Sky Suite stay inside and enjoy the view out from their rooms.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests in the Lake View rooms look at the blue of Lake Michigan and think about swimming.
phrases.warm: People are out along the Lake Front today, small figures between the city and Lake Michigan.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light from the low sun lies on Willis Tower and on the city around it.
phrases.partly_golden: The clouds over Lake Michigan turn pink and orange, and the water below takes the same colours.
phrases.grey_evening: Willis Tower is lit tonight, its top glowing faintly into the low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Lake Michigan tonight, and the lights of Michigan Avenue shine on the wet road from Navy Pier to Soldier Field.
phrases.mild_night: Lake Michigan is dark under the clouds tonight, and the lights of Navy Pier mark where the water begins.
phrases.clear_night: The lights of Willis Tower stand high over the city tonight, bright in the clear dark.
phrases.late_night: Guests still awake in the Lake View rooms see Lake Michigan as one wide dark shape beyond a quiet Michigan Avenue.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind Willis Tower as its first lights come on, and Lake Michigan slowly loses its colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Huangpu River shows as a grey curve between the quiet Bund and the towers of Lujiazui.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Bund, and guests at the infinity pool on the 85th floor look across the Lujiazui skyline to the Huangpu River.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is clear, and from 100 Century Avenue on the 91st floor guests at lunch follow the Huangpu River past the Bund.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly over the Lujiazui skyline this morning, while the Oriental Pearl Tower stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Dining Room on the 87th floor, guests watch patches of afternoon sun and cloud cross the Huangpu River.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Huangpu River turns the colour of steel, and the Bund draws a pale line along its far bank.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Bund today, and from the infinity pool the boats on the Huangpu River look like small pencil marks.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the Bund is missing from the view and guests see only the nearest towers of Lujiazui.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of 100 Century Avenue, and the Huangpu River below is a blurred grey band.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Oriental Pearl Tower for a second at a time, and guests watch the storm from the infinity pool, safely behind glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the windows of the Bund View Suite, and the Bund fades to white on the far side of the Huangpu River.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and guests at Park Salon on the 86th floor can count the towers of the Lujiazui skyline.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the infinity pool is a comfortable place to look down at the grey Huangpu River.
phrases.very_hot: Heat makes the air shimmer over the Huangpu River, and guests look at it from the loungers by the windows at Water's Edge.
phrases.warm: On this warm day the boats on the Huangpu River look like toys from the 91st floor, and the Bund is a thin line beside them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Huangpu River gold, and guests at the infinity pool stop swimming to look at the Bund.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and colours the Oriental Pearl Tower pink, with the Shanghai Tower beside it already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at dinner in 100 Century Avenue look down on the lit Bund and the dark Huangpu River.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening the lights of the Bund run together on the glass, and guests at Dining Room watch them over dinner.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud glows above the city tonight, and the lit Oriental Pearl Tower shines beside the Huangpu River.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests in the Bund View Suite see the whole lit Bund reflected in the Huangpu River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Huangpu River is a dark curve through the sleeping city, and only a few boats still move on it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Bund and on the Oriental Pearl Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Diamond Head is a dark shape against the clear sky, and the Pacific below it is still.
phrases.clear_morning: From their balconies, guests watch the morning sun light the Pacific and the long ridge of Diamond Head.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, the Pacific is a clear turquoise under the midday sun, all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the water off Waikiki Beach this morning, while Diamond Head stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the corner Beachcomber Suite see clouds drift over the Pacific this afternoon, with blue sky between them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific turns a soft grey-blue, and Diamond Head keeps its clear outline beyond the high-rises.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Diamond Head today, and the water off Waikiki Beach fades into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests see the palm trees and the near water of Waikiki Beach, and Diamond Head only faintly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Kalakaua Avenue, and guests in the ocean rooms watch it blur the Pacific.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific, and for a second Diamond Head stands out against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Waikiki Beach, and guests look twice as the flakes land on the palm trees.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear, so every fold of Diamond Head shows sharply beyond Waikiki Beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look at Waikiki Beach between the buildings opposite, and the Pacific beyond is a darker blue.
phrases.very_hot: At the rooftop pool, guests stay in the water in this heat and look out at the Pacific from there.
phrases.warm: Guests dry off by the rooftop pool on this warm day and keep their eyes on the blue Pacific.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Diamond Head gold, and guests in this hotel of nearly 500 rooms see it from their balconies.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop pool, the last sun comes through the clouds and colours the Pacific orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Waikiki glow below, and the Pacific is a wide dark space beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and guests see the lights of Kalakaua Avenue shine on the wet street below.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the Honolulu skyline is bright, and Waikiki Beach is marked by its lights.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests pick out the outline of Diamond Head beyond the lights of Waikiki.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Kalakaua Avenue is quiet below, and guests still awake look over Waikiki Beach toward the Pacific.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along Kalakaua Avenue and Waikiki Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Fistral Beach is a quiet grey curve below the front-facing rooms, and the sea is only starting to show.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Cove Restaurant, guests look out over Fistral Beach under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The midday sun turns the sea off Fistral Beach turquoise, and Fistral headland stands sharp against the blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Fistral Beach this morning, and guests in the lounge follow them over the sand.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the hotel garden, the sea shows between the picnic tables, with clouds drifting above it this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the surf at Fistral Beach keeps its turquoise colour below the balcony rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Fistral headland today, and the waves seem to arrive on Fistral Beach from nowhere.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Cribbar point is not visible on the horizon today, and guests see Fistral Beach only as far as the first lines of surf.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Fistral Beach, and guests watch it from the ocean-facing tables of Cove Restaurant.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Fistral Beach, and guests in the lounge watch lightning flash above the sea.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Fistral Beach, and guests in Cove Restaurant watch the flakes meet the waves.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests keep to the lounge and look at the sea from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: The sea off Fistral Beach looks sharp and clean in the cold air, and Fistral headland is clear behind the sand.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the sand of Fistral Beach is crowded, and guests in the lounge watch the swimmers and surfers in the sea.
phrases.warm: From the garden picnic tables, guests watch the sea in the warm air while children play beside them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light covers Fistral Beach late this afternoon, and the wet sand shines below the sea view rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Fistral headland turn orange, and guests in the lounge stop talking to look.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Cove Restaurant, guests look out at a cloudy evening sky over the darkening sea.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of Cove Restaurant this evening, and the sea beyond the dinner tables is almost lost in the dark.
phrases.mild_night: No stars show over Fistral Beach on this mild night, and the sea moves quietly under low cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Stars hang over Fistral Beach tonight, and guests step onto their private balconies to look up.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Fistral Beach lies empty and dark, and only the white edges of the waves show.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Fistral Beach just after sunset, and Fistral headland turns to a dark shape beside it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Ipanema Beach lies empty and blue-grey, with Two Brothers Mountain dark against the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Janeiro Restaurant, guests look through the big windows at a bright sea and the Cagarras Islands.
phrases.clear_midday: From the marble infinity pool on the 18th floor, Ipanema Beach is a long strip of pale sand under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Ipanema Beach this morning, and Two Brothers Mountain goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, clouds drift over the Cagarras Islands this afternoon, and the sea changes from blue to green.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the sea off Ipanema Beach turns the colour of steel, and the Cagarras Islands sit low on the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Ipanema Beach today, and Two Brothers Mountain is only a faint outline from the infinity pool.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Cagarras Islands are not visible today; from the oceanfront suites, guests see the sand of Ipanema Beach and the nearest waves.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the sea, and guests in Janeiro Restaurant watch through the big windows as the Cagarras Islands fade.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the oceanfront suites watch lightning over the sea, which shows the Cagarras Islands for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the marble edge of the infinity pool, and beyond it Ipanema Beach is white where the sand used to be.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and Two Brothers Mountain stands sharp above Ipanema Beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests take a table by the windows of Janeiro Restaurant and watch the Atlantic Ocean roll in.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across Ipanema Beach to the bright sea.
phrases.warm: Ipanema Beach is full of sunbathers on this warm day, and from the daybeds on the rooftop terrace the sand looks dotted with people.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At the Little Pool Bar, guests hold a caipirinha and watch the low sun turn the sea and Two Brothers Mountain gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds peach above Two Brothers Mountain, and the water of the infinity pool takes the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Janeiro Restaurant, the windows show a dark sea under cloud and the lights along the shore.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and guests in the seafront rooms see the lights along Ipanema Beach blur into soft lines.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight under cloud, the rooftop of this hotel, opened in 2019, faces a dark sea, and the lights of Ipanema Beach draw a bright line beside it.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and from the rooftop the lights of Ipanema Beach run towards Two Brothers Mountain under a sky of stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who are still awake see from their windows the dark sand of Ipanema Beach and the white of the waves.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky is still bright behind Two Brothers Mountain, and the first lights come on along Ipanema Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sydney Opera House shells are grey shapes across the quiet water, and the sky behind them is turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in The Dining Room by James Viles, guests face the Sydney Opera House, white in the early sun beyond the glass walls.
phrases.clear_midday: The Sydney Harbour Bridge throws its shadow across the rooftop pool at midday, while the Sydney Opera House stays bright across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Circular Quay this morning, and the balcony rooms look across Sydney Harbour to the Sydney Opera House.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In The Living Room, guests look up from their plates each time the sun comes back onto Sydney Harbour.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Sydney Opera House shells stay pale on the harbour, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge arch looks dark above the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Sydney Opera House today, and the Sydney Harbour Bridge arch fades towards its far end.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The city skyline behind Circular Quay is missing today; the Sydney Opera House, directly across the water, is still plain to see.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass walls of The Dining Room by James Viles, and the Sydney Opera House across the harbour looks slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests watch the storm from behind floor-to-ceiling windows as lightning shows the Sydney Harbour Bridge arch for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Sydney Harbour, and guests in The Living Room leave their coffee to watch the flakes meet the water.
phrases.very_cold: On the treadmills in the gym, guests look out at Dawes Point Park under the Sydney Harbour Bridge and are glad to be running indoors.
phrases.cold: From The Guest House at the end of the building, the Sydney Opera House and Sydney Harbour look sharp in the cold air.
phrases.very_hot: Above the hotel's 4 floors, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and watch the ferries come in and out of Circular Quay.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop sun loungers, guests have the Sydney Opera House in front and the Sydney Harbour Bridge behind, so heads keep turning.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun warms the shells of the Sydney Opera House, and from the Sydney Suite terrace they share one frame with the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
phrases.partly_golden: The clouds above the Sydney Harbour Bridge turn orange in the last hour of sun, and the arch darkens under them.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in The Dining Room by James Viles, guests see the lit Sydney Opera House under low cloud through the glass walls.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Sydney Opera House stretch across the harbour, and guests in The Living Room watch them shake in the rain.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the balcony rooms look onto the lit Sydney Opera House and the city lights around Circular Quay.
phrases.clear_night: The Sydney Opera House is lit white against a clear night sky, and its reflection lies on Sydney Harbour.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Sydney Harbour is quiet, with no ferries crossing between here and the Sydney Opera House.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Sydney Harbour Bridge and around Circular Quay.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Atlantic is still dark before sunrise, with the first pale light just starting above the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Grand staircase, guests on their way to breakfast see the Atlantic blue and bright in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: From the top of the cliff, the Atlantic is blue all the way to a sharp, clear horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Atlantic this morning, with bright blue water between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the Grand staircase watch the Atlantic change colour as clouds pass in front of the sun.
phrases.overcast: The Atlantic is grey and calm under a full cover of cloud today.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the Atlantic today, and the line between water and sky has gone soft.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Atlantic shows only its nearest waves today; the far water and the horizon are not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Atlantic, and guests watch from indoors as grey water meets grey sky.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Atlantic lights up the waves for a moment, and guests watch the storm from indoors.
phrases.snow: Snowflakes fall into the grey Atlantic today, and guests watch from indoors.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay indoors today and watch the waves of the Atlantic roll in white, one after another.
phrases.cold: White lines of waves cross the Atlantic far below the cliff, and guests follow them from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: The Atlantic shimmers so brightly today that guests reach for their sunglasses before looking at it.
phrases.warm: Guests take the Grand staircase slowly today, with the Atlantic spread wide in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun lays a path of gold across the Atlantic late this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests on the Grand staircase see the last sunlight come through the clouds and turn parts of the Atlantic gold.
phrases.grey_evening: After sunset the Atlantic becomes one dark shape under the clouds, and guests on their way to dinner stop for a look.
phrases.wet_evening: The Atlantic almost disappears behind tonight's rain, leaving only the nearest dark water in view.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the night, and the Atlantic and the sky join into one wide darkness.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the cliff tonight, and the Atlantic below is heard more than seen.
phrases.late_night: While guests sleep at the top of the cliff, the Atlantic keeps moving in the dark below.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the Atlantic turns pink and silver while the sky above it is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Night is fading behind the Eiffel Tower, and its iron shape grows sharper by the minute.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast-hour sun falls on the Eiffel Tower, and guests look at it before they look at anything else.
phrases.clear_midday: The Eiffel Tower stands clear in the midday sun, and guests can follow its iron lines all the way to the top.
phrases.partly_morning: The Eiffel Tower goes from grey to bright and back again while guests get ready for the day.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cameras come out each time the sun returns to the Eiffel Tower this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: From feet to tip, the whole Eiffel Tower stays in view under today's even grey.
phrases.fog_haze: Through the mist the Eiffel Tower looks like a pencil drawing, grey and soft from base to tip.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Little can be seen behind the Eiffel Tower today, but the tower itself remains in view.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass, and guests watch the Eiffel Tower through it from the dry side.
phrases.thunderstorm: Storm clouds sit dark above the Eiffel Tower, and guests stay in to watch the thunderstorm pass.
phrases.snow: The Eiffel Tower turns pale behind the falling snow, and guests indoors are in no hurry to go out.
phrases.very_cold: Guests admire the Eiffel Tower with both hands around a hot drink, happy to leave the walk for later.
phrases.cold: Most guests take a long first look at the Eiffel Tower from indoors today before reaching for a coat.
phrases.very_hot: Nobody hurries towards the Eiffel Tower in this heat; guests admire it first and walk later.
phrases.warm: Jackets stay behind as guests stroll out towards the Eiffel Tower, in sight the whole way.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: For an hour or so the Eiffel Tower looks more gold than iron, and guests keep going back for one more look.
phrases.partly_golden: Pink-edged clouds pass behind the Eiffel Tower in the last hour of sun, and guests stop to look.
phrases.grey_evening: The Eiffel Tower is lit this evening, and its glow reaches the low cloud above it.
phrases.wet_evening: The lit Eiffel Tower shines through tonight's rain, its glow broken into drops on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Guests switch off their own lamps tonight and let the lit Eiffel Tower do the work.
phrases.clear_night: Lit from base to tip, the Eiffel Tower fills the view tonight against a clear black sky.
phrases.dusk: The Eiffel Tower switches on while the sky behind it is still bright, and guests look up from what they were doing.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale over the Gulf of Saint-Tropez, and the water below the infinity pool slowly takes its first grey light.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the restaurant room, guests look out to a bright sea under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the edge of the infinity pool, the Gulf of Saint-Tropez stretches blue to the open horizon under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Sainte-Maxime this morning, and their shadows cross the gulf towards Bouillabaisse Beach.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From their balconies, guests watch sun and cloud take turns over the umbrella pines of the 2-hectare park and the bay.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Gulf of Saint-Tropez turns silver, and Sainte-Maxime stays clear on the far shore.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the gulf today, and from the rooftop terrace Sainte-Maxime is only a faint outline across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps and the bay of Saint-Raphaël are not visible today; from the rooftop terrace the view ends at Bouillabaisse Beach and the near water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Gulf of Saint-Tropez; guests in the gulf-view rooms watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Gulf of Saint-Tropez, and for a second Sainte-Maxime appears sharply on the other side.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the umbrella pines and the palm trees, and the Gulf of Saint-Tropez fades to grey behind it.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, bright day, the rooftop terrace gives a sharp view across the bay, with the snow-capped Alps far behind.
phrases.cold: The air is cold today, so guests in the restaurant room watch the sea from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look out over the Gulf of Saint-Tropez.
phrases.warm: By the pool, guests on the daybeds look past the palm trees to a calm bay, and nobody seems in a hurry.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the rooftop terrace, the late sun turns the bell tower of Saint-Tropez gold above Bouillabaisse Beach.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights strips of the gulf, seen from the balcony of Villa Wood.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner at Moloko, guests look over a bay under cloud, with the lights of Sainte-Maxime in a row on the far shore.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of Saint-Tropez village this evening, and the gulf beyond them is almost black.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, no stars show over the Gulf of Saint-Tropez, and from the rooftop terrace the water is a soft dark sheet.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in this resort of 70 rooms see a clear night sky over the gulf and small lights all around the bay.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Gulf of Saint-Tropez is a wide, quiet space beyond the palm trees of the garden.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the gulf is still bright, and the first lights come on in Sainte-Maxime across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Martinhal islands are still dark shapes on the sea.
phrases.clear_morning: From O Terraço, the ocean is blue this morning and all of Martinhal Beach is in sun.
phrases.clear_midday: As Dunas looks onto the beach, bright under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: This morning the Martinhal islands are in shade one minute and in sun the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Terrace Room, guests watch cloud shadows move across the sea this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Grey clouds cover Martinhal Beach and the Martinhal islands today, and the sea has taken the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the sea today, and the Martinhal islands show only as soft grey outlines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: Martinhal Beach is easy to see, the Martinhal islands are faint, and the rocky cliffs of Sagres are not visible.
phrases.rain: Guests in the Beach Suite stay dry and watch the rain fall on the ocean.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean and, for a moment, shows the Martinhal islands.
phrases.snow: Guests in the Beach Room stay warm inside and watch snow fall over the sea.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Beach Suite stay in the warm today and watch the ocean from there.
phrases.cold: Martinhal Beach is for looking at today, not for lying on.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool and look out at the golden beach.
phrases.warm: At the WaterSports Centre, guests get ready to go out on the water, with Martinhal Beach in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun gives Martinhal Beach a warm gold colour, and the Martinhal islands glow out on the water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day finds gaps in the clouds and lights Martinhal Beach in patches.
phrases.grey_evening: The beach in front of As Dunas goes slowly dark this evening under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Martinhal Beach tonight, and from O Terraço the ocean behind it is dark.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight Martinhal Beach is a pale line between the dark land and the dark sea.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the Martinhal islands are easy to pick out as black shapes on the Atlantic waters.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the waves keep coming in on Martinhal Beach with nobody there to count them.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sea is still bright and the Martinhal islands are already dark against it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dolomites stand as a dark line along the south, above the still Pustertal.
phrases.clear_morning: Curtains open on a clear morning, and guests see the Pustertal meadows below and the Dolomites behind them.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Peitlerkofel and the Prags peaks show their pale rock faces across the valley.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the wooded rim of the Pustertal this morning, while the Dolomites stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop pool, cloud shadows cross the Dolomites this afternoon, and Kronplatz rises close behind.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Dolomites lose their pale colour, and the meadows of the Pustertal become the brightest thing in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills the Pustertal today, and the Dolomites wait behind it, somewhere to the south.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Dolomites are not visible today; guests see the Pustertal meadows and the first line of forest, and little beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pustertal; guests watch it through floor-to-ceiling glass, the wooded slopes grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls along the Pustertal, and lightning shows the Dolomites for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the meadows, and guests in the Finnish outdoor sauna watch the mountains turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The rooftop pool steams in the freezing air, and beyond the steam the Dolomites stand sharp against the sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the sauna's panoramic windows give guests the meadows and forested hills without the chill.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and study the Dolomites from the water.
phrases.warm: By the outdoor pool, guests lie on sunlit loungers and look up at the forested mountains.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the pale rock of the Peitlerkofel gold, a sight that all 97 rooms share from a balcony or terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Prags peaks turn pink, and the water of the rooftop pool takes their colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud the Dolomites are gone, and guests behind Matteo Thun's tall glass see only the lights of the Pustertal.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and the lights of the Pustertal look blurred above the wet meadows.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the wooded rim of the Pustertal is difficult to tell from the sky above it.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, stars sit above the Dolomites, and guests can pick out the Peitlerkofel against them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pustertal is quiet, and the Dolomites are a dark shape that guests know is there.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright above the Dolomites, and the rooftop pool has Kronplatz close behind it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the castle hills stand dark against a clear sky, and the Tagus River is a faint grey band behind them.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the trees of Eduardo VII Park first, then the castle hills, then the Tagus River beyond.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Sky Pool Lounge, guests see Eduardo VII Park in the foreground under a clear sky and the Tagus River shining far to the south.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Eduardo VII Park this morning, while the Tagus River stays bright in the distance.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the upper-floor suites watch clouds drift over the castle hills through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Tagus River takes the colour of the clouds, and the green of Eduardo VII Park stands out more.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the castle hills today, and the Tagus River is only a soft glow behind them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tagus River is not visible today; the view ends at Eduardo VII Park and the nearest rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Eduardo VII Park, and guests watch it from their suite windows as the castle hills fade to grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the castle hills for a second, and then the storm hides the Tagus River again.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the terracotta rooftops, and the Tagus River disappears behind the white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, so guests behind the glass see the castle hills and the Tagus River in sharp detail.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Eduardo VII Park lies quiet below, and the Tagus River is a still, grey-blue band beyond the hills.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water at the Sky Pool Lounge and look over the rooftops to the Tagus River.
phrases.warm: On this warm day at the Sky Pool Lounge, guests rest under the pergola and follow Eduardo VII Park down towards the castle hills.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the terracotta rooftops orange, and from the Sky Pool Lounge the Tagus River looks like polished copper.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and colours the castle hills pink, with the Tagus River shining gold behind them.
phrases.grey_evening: From KŌJI on the 12th floor, guests look over the city lights under a low, cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the upper-floor suites tonight, and the city lights stretch into long lines.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hold the glow of the city tonight, and Eduardo VII Park is a wide unlit space among the bright streets.
phrases.clear_night: With 379 rooms and suites there are many windows here, and tonight the clear sky lets the city lights run all the way to the Tagus River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and the Tagus River waits unseen beyond the sleeping hills.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first city lights appear between Eduardo VII Park and the Tagus River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon lies flat and grey beside the empty beach.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunrise reaches the bedroom glass and the pool terrace together, and the open ocean fills one whole side of the villa.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is bright turquoise, and guests at the main pool see the beach right in front of them.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon this morning, and the water changes from turquoise to deep blue and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The afternoon sky is half cloud and half blue, and the white sand beside the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is bright whenever the sun comes out.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon keeps a little of its turquoise close to the white sand.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the line between sea and sky today, so the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon seems to go on without an end.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The open ocean is not clear today; guests see the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon near the beach and little beyond it.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and guests watch it through the floor-to-ceiling glass of their villas.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows over the open ocean, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon turns dark grey under the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and guests look twice to be sure.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold over the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, but the water keeps its turquoise colour under the bright sky.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the main pool is quiet, and the beach and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon beyond it are empty.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the main pool and look over the beach to the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon.
phrases.warm: On the main pool loungers, books stay closed while guests look at the beach and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the overwater villa decks, guests watch the sun go down over the open ocean in front of them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon, and the water below them turns gold.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening sky is cloudy, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is a wide dark surface beyond the beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain is falling this evening, and only the nearest water of the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon shows beyond the beach.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night there are no stars, and the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon shows only as a faint shine near the sand.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon tonight, and the calm water gives back a little of their light.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Maldivian Atoll Lagoon is black and still, and the white sand of the beach is the only pale thing in sight.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky stays bright over the open ocean, and guests in these villas, opened in 2021, watch it through the glass.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Edinburgh Castle is a dark shape on its rock, and the sky behind Arthur's Seat begins to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in SUSHISAMBA Edinburgh, guests look out over the city rooftops under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From W Deck on the 12th floor, Edinburgh Castle, Arthur's Seat and the Georgian rooftops fit in one frame under a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Georgian rooftops this morning, while Edinburgh Castle stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on W Deck turn from Calton Hill to the Firth of Forth as clouds move across the afternoon sky.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Edinburgh Castle and the Georgian rooftops take almost the same stone colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Arthur's Seat today, and Edinburgh Castle looks like a pencil drawing above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Firth of Forth is not visible from W Deck today, but Calton Hill and the nearer rooftops are still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Georgian rooftops, and guests watch it from the heated igloos on W Deck.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the castle view rooms watch lightning flash behind Edinburgh Castle while thunder rolls over the city.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Georgian rooftops, and Edinburgh Castle slowly turns white on its rock.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Arthur's Seat looks sharp and close above the Georgian rooftops.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests on the 11th floor look across the city from W Lounge and keep their coats off.
phrases.very_hot: On W Deck, guests keep to the shade and look at the Firth of Forth, which seems cooler than the city.
phrases.warm: Guests sit on the sofas of W Deck in the warm air, and Arthur's Seat rises green above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Georgian rooftops gold, and Edinburgh Castle darkens against the bright sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds, and the Penthouse Suite terrace looks over rooftops that are half gold and half grey.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in this 2022 building see Edinburgh Castle lit above the city under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: At dinner in SUSHISAMBA Edinburgh, guests watch the city lights blur behind the rain on the windows.
phrases.mild_night: The city lights spread out under the clouds on this mild night, and Calton Hill is a dark shape above them.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the castle view suites see Edinburgh Castle lit on its rock under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Georgian rooftops are quiet and dark, and only the outline of Arthur's Seat shows beyond them.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind Edinburgh Castle, and the first lights come on across the Georgian rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky above the Asian shore slowly turns pale, and the Bosphorus Strait changes from black to grey.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Bosphorus Strait from the Old City domes to both bridges, and guests in rooms facing the water open the curtains early.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests having lunch in Atölye Restaurant look out over a Bosphorus Strait that is deep blue under the clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Bosphorus Strait this morning, while the Old City domes stay in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Bleu Lounge, guests watch the afternoon clouds pass over the Bosphorus Strait as the water changes from blue to silver.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Bosphorus Strait turns the colour of steel, and the two bridges draw thin lines across it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Bosphorus Strait today, and the Asian shore looks like a watercolour left unfinished.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Old City domes and the far bridge are not visible today, so guests look at the nearer water of the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Bosphorus Strait; guests at Bleu Lounge watch it through the glass, the far shore slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Bosphorus Strait for a second, and guests in the Presidential Suite watch the storm from inside while rain hits the terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Bosphorus Strait, and from Atölye Restaurant guests watch the far shore slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Bosphorus Strait is sharp and bright all the way to both bridges, a view guests enjoy from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Atölye Restaurant, Michelin-listed since 2023, keeps guests warm while they look over the grey-blue Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the infinity pool at The Roof and look across the Bosphorus Strait with only their heads above water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the sunbathing terrace at The Roof look past the pool edge to the Bosphorus Strait and the Asian shore.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Bosphorus Strait gold, and the Old City domes stand out against the bright sky.
phrases.partly_golden: From the Nobu Suite terrace, the last sun colours the clouds above the Bosphorus Strait in pink and orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests dining in Atölye Restaurant follow the lights along the Bosphorus Strait, and the low sky glows faintly above the city.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening at Nobu Istanbul, the lights of the Bosphorus Strait run down the windows with the rain, and nobody hurries to leave.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Bosphorus Bridge glows pink over the Bosphorus Strait, and guests in this hotel refurbished in 2018 leave the curtains open.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and from Bleu Lounge guests see both bridges lit above the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Bosphorus Strait lies still between its two sleeping shores, and only the water asks to be looked at.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along both shores of the Bosphorus Strait.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Aegean Sea lies grey-blue and still below the hillside, under a sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the sea-view suites wake to early sun on the Aegean Sea, with Naxos clear on the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Aegean Sea is deep blue and Naxos shows sharply on the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Aegean Sea this morning, and Naxos slips in and out of the sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests look past the dry scrubland to the Aegean Sea, where afternoon clouds leave patches of light and shade.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Aegean Sea turns the colour of slate, and the bare Cycladic hillside looks paler against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides Naxos today, and the Aegean Sea fades into the sky with no clear horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Naxos is not visible today; guests see the scrubland below and the nearer water of the Aegean Sea, then only white.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Aegean Sea, and guests watch from behind the sliding glass doors of their suites as the water turns dull.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Aegean Sea, and guests count the seconds after each flash above the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the hillside, and guests watch the flakes disappear into the grey Aegean Sea.
phrases.very_cold: The cold air is very clear today, and guests can pick out the outline of Naxos across the Aegean Sea.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Aegean Sea is a darker blue, and the scrubland on the hillside shows every shade of brown and green.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests sit in their private pools and hot tubs and look out at the Aegean Sea.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests rest on their panoramic terraces with their eyes on the Aegean Sea rather than on their books.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the scrubland gold, and Naxos stands clear across a calm Aegean Sea.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests see the last sun colour the clouds pink above the Aegean Sea, while Naxos turns soft blue.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Aegean Sea and the sky become one dark grey, and Naxos is no longer in sight.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain hides the horizon, and guests see only the nearest dark water of the Aegean Sea.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, and the Aegean Sea is a wide dark space below the hillside above Kalo Livadi.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests look up at the stars over the Aegean Sea, far more of them than the 14 suites on this hillside.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Aegean Sea is black and quiet below the hillside, with nothing moving on it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over the Aegean Sea, and guests see Naxos turn into a dark shape on the horizon.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Han River is a wide dark band, and Namsan Tower is only a thin outline against the clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning is clear, and guests in the top-floor rooms see the Han River and Namsan Tower at once.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Han River shines blue and Namsan Tower stands sharp above the city skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Seoul skyline this morning, while the Han River keeps catching patches of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow the clouds as they drift past Namsan Tower this afternoon, and the Han River changes from silver to blue.
phrases.overcast: The sky is flat and grey today, and the Han River takes the same colour all the way across the city.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Seoul skyline today, and Namsan Tower is a faint needle above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: guests can see the Han River, but Namsan Tower and the distant mountains are not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the wide windows of the penthouses, and the Han River behind it looks grey and blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Seoul, and guests watch lightning flash above the Han River from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Han River, and guests see Namsan Tower fade in and out behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so Namsan Tower and the distant mountains stand out sharply against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay indoors and look at the Han River moving slowly through the city.
phrases.very_hot: Heat lies over the Han River today, and guests are happy to look at it from a cool room.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the corner rooms get the widest angle on the Han River and Namsan Tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Han River gold, and Namsan Tower glows against the clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests watch the last sun colour the clouds orange above the Seoul skyline, and the Han River copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights reflect on the Han River, and Namsan Tower is lit above the skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening lights of Seoul, and guests see Namsan Tower as a soft glow beyond the Han River.
phrases.mild_night: From one of 379 rooms above Shinsegae Department Store Gangnam, guests look at the night lights of the Seoul skyline under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lit Namsan Tower shares the frame with the lights along the Han River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who cannot sleep find the Han River still there, quiet and wide.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests see the first lights come on along the Han River and on Namsan Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Waitemata Harbour is a calm dark sheet beyond the still city skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the treetops of Albert Park first, then Waitemata Harbour turns blue behind the city skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: From the balcony apartments, guests see the city skyline and Waitemata Harbour together under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Waitemata Harbour this morning, while the trees of Albert Park stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests swimming in the 25-metre indoor pool see city buildings through the windows, with clouds drifting above them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Waitemata Harbour takes the colour of steel, and the green canopy of Albert Park stands out more.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and Waitemata Harbour fades into the sky behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Rangitoto Island is not visible today; the view ends at the port cranes and the near edge of Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Albert Park; guests watch it from the harbour-view rooms, Waitemata Harbour grey behind the wet skyline.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Waitemata Harbour, and for a second guests see the port cranes clearly against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the trees of Albert Park, and Waitemata Harbour has almost disappeared behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, guests in the Penthouse see Rangitoto Island sharply across Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the indoor pool is a warm place for guests to look out at the city buildings.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the outdoor terrace sit under the umbrellas and look at city buildings through the mature trees.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, balcony doors stay open, and guests look over the Albert Park canopy to Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests see the late sun turn the towers of the city skyline gold, with Waitemata Harbour shining behind them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over Waitemata Harbour pink, and the treetops of Albert Park catch a little of it.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the city skyline glow, and Waitemata Harbour is a dark band beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the city skyline this evening, and Waitemata Harbour is lost in the dark behind them.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, low cloud holds the glow of the city above the skyline, and Albert Park is quiet below.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show over Waitemata Harbour tonight; the lights of the city skyline compete with them and win.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who are still awake find Waitemata Harbour and the trees of Albert Park in deep night.
phrases.dusk: From the outdoor terrace, the first lights of the city buildings appear through the trees while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Edinburgh Castle is a dark shape on its rock above the Grassmarket, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights Edinburgh Castle, and guests in the balcony rooms watch the rock grow brighter.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every wall and window of Edinburgh Castle is easy to pick out from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Edinburgh Castle this morning, and guests in the castle view rooms keep looking up to check on it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, guests see sun and cloud take turns on Edinburgh Castle through the afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Edinburgh Castle and its rock take almost the same colour, like one piece of stone.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of Edinburgh Castle today, and only the rock shows clearly above the Grassmarket.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see the outline of Edinburgh Castle but not the detail of its walls.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass at Metro Bar & Brasserie, and Edinburgh Castle looks slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Old Town, and each flash of lightning shows Edinburgh Castle sharp on its rock for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Edinburgh Castle, and the ledges of the rock are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: Guests keep their balcony doors closed today and look at Edinburgh Castle through the glass, clear in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, Edinburgh Castle stands sharp above the Grassmarket, and its stone looks colder than the sky.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot for Edinburgh, and guests on the rooftop terrace look for shade without taking their eyes off Edinburgh Castle.
phrases.warm: Guests stay out on their balconies in the warm air, with Edinburgh Castle on its rock in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the walls of Edinburgh Castle gold above the Grassmarket in the last hours of the day.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and lights Edinburgh Castle one part at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: At Metro Bar & Brasserie, guests have dinner with Edinburgh Castle in view, lit against a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: From Metro Bar & Brasserie, guests watch the lights of Edinburgh Castle shine through a wet evening over the Grassmarket.
phrases.mild_night: Low clouds over the Old Town catch some of the light from Edinburgh Castle on this mild night.
phrases.clear_night: Edinburgh Castle is lit against a clear night sky, and guests at Metro Bar & Brasserie have it in full view over their drinks.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Grassmarket is quiet, and Edinburgh Castle is a dark outline high above it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind Edinburgh Castle, and the first lights come on along its walls.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, São Jorge Castle is a dark shape on its hill, and the sky above it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests at breakfast in the Rossio Room have a clear morning view of the Santa Justa Elevator and São Jorge Castle.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, São Jorge Castle faces the terrace of Rossio Gastrobar, and the Tagus River shines on the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Rossio Square this morning, while São Jorge Castle stays in sunshine on its hill.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony rooms of this 1950 building, guests watch the afternoon clouds drift over Restauradores Square.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the walls of São Jorge Castle look darker, and the Tagus River is a thin silver band on the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Tagus River today, and São Jorge Castle seems to float above the rooftops of Baixa.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tagus River is not visible today, but Rossio Square and São Jorge Castle are still clear from the terrace of the Grand View Suite.
phrases.rain: Rain wets the paving of Rossio Square, and guests at Rossio Gastrobar watch it through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows São Jorge Castle for a second, then the storm closes over the hill again.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the rooftops of Baixa, and São Jorge Castle fades to grey behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests in rooms facing São Jorge Castle can follow every line of its walls.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay inside Rossio Gastrobar and look across Rossio Square to São Jorge Castle through the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the terrace of Rossio Gastrobar look at the Tagus River on the horizon and think of cold water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit outside on the 7th floor terrace of Rossio Gastrobar, with Rossio Square below and São Jorge Castle ahead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the walls of São Jorge Castle gold, and guests with a drink at Rossio Gastrobar forget to drink it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Tagus River turn pink, and the ruins of the Carmo Convent catch the light.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, São Jorge Castle is lit on its hill, and the lamps of Rossio Square glow below.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of Avenida da Liberdade blur in the windows of the rooms that face it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of Bairro Alto cover the hillside, and São Jorge Castle glows on its own hill.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lit walls of São Jorge Castle stand above the city lights, and the Tagus River is dark beyond them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Rossio Square is quiet, and São Jorge Castle keeps watch over it alone.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Tagus River, and the first lights come on around Rossio Square.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the United States Capitol is a dark outline against a sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the dome of the United States Capitol, and guests in the Capitol-view rooms see it through floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the United States Capitol stands white against a clear blue sky, with the busy boulevard in front of it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move behind the United States Capitol this morning, and its dome changes from bright white to soft grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, guests follow cloud shadows as they cross the avenue and move toward the United States Capitol.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the dome of the United States Capitol is almost the same colour as the clouds behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the lower part of the United States Capitol today, so its dome seems to float above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the United States Capitol is only a faint outline and the city beyond it cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Capitol-view rooms, and the United States Capitol blurs behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city, and each flash of lightning shows the dome of the United States Capitol for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the avenue, and the white dome of the United States Capitol slowly disappears into it.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing, clear air the United States Capitol looks sharp enough to cut paper, and guests in this 225-room hotel admire it from indoors.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps the rooftop terrace empty, and the United States Capitol has the whole sky to itself.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the air shimmers above the avenue and the United States Capitol seems to tremble a little.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests take their coffee out to the balcony and look over the busy boulevard to the United States Capitol.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the dome of the United States Capitol gold, and the glass of the Capitol-view rooms frames it like a painting.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and colours the United States Capitol pink for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: At AC Lounge, guests with craft cocktails look out at the city lights under low evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain makes the avenue shine tonight, and car lights draw red and white lines toward the lit United States Capitol.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit dome of the United States Capitol glows against the low sky.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit United States Capitol shines white above the rooftops, and the stars have competition.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the avenue below is nearly empty, and the United States Capitol waits quietly for morning.
phrases.dusk: From the rooftop terrace, guests see the lights of the United States Capitol come on while the sky is still pink and purple.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide grey-blue field beyond the empty sand of Santa Monica Beach.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at Terrazza is served beside tall windows, with the Pacific Ocean bright and blue beyond the palm trees.
phrases.clear_midday: From the oceanfront rooms, guests look straight out over the sand to a Pacific Ocean that shines under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Pacific Ocean and Santa Monica Beach this morning, in full sight from the pool deck.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in Lobby Lounge look out at a Pacific Ocean that is part silver and part blue under the afternoon clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the white lines of the waves stand out more clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has come in over Santa Monica Beach, and from the Terrazza windows the Pacific Ocean fades away a short distance past the first waves.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Palos Verdes and Malibu are not visible from the upper floors today; guests see only the nearer part of the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows of Terrazza, and behind it the Pacific Ocean is a grey, moving blur.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and guests in the Penthouse Suites have the whole storm in front of them.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Santa Monica Beach, and guests stand at the windows to watch it disappear into the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear today, and from the upper floors the Pacific Ocean coast is sharp all the way from Palos Verdes to Malibu.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to the Terrazza window tables and look out at a quiet Santa Monica Beach and the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool and look over its edge at the crowded sand and the cool blue Pacific Ocean.
phrases.warm: From the hot tub, guests watch the walkers on Santa Monica Beach, and the Pacific Ocean waves roll in behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In Lobby Lounge, guests share tapas and watch the sun go slowly down toward the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds, and guests in this 1926 building see the Pacific Ocean turn gold in long bands.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Terrazza goes on under a cloudy evening sky, with the lights of the Santa Monica Pier bright beside the black Pacific Ocean.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Santa Monica Pier reach the Terrazza windows as soft, shaking colours in the rain.
phrases.mild_night: There are no stars tonight, yet the white edges of the waves on the Pacific Ocean still show from the ocean view rooms.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Pacific Ocean, and guests in Lobby Lounge can still make out the breaking waves below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pacific Ocean is black and wide, and only the moving foam marks the place where Santa Monica Beach begins.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky over the Pacific Ocean is still orange, and the first lights come on along the Santa Monica Pier.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Bay of Angels is still dark before sunrise, and the Promenade des Anglais below is quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: Early risers among the guests see the first sun reach the Bay of Angels and the turquoise water by the beach across the street.
phrases.clear_midday: The Bay of Angels lies blue and wide at midday, with the turquoise water of the beach just across the street.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows drift over the Bay of Angels this morning while the Promenade des Anglais stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests look along the Promenade des Anglais this afternoon as patches of sun cross the Mediterranean.
phrases.overcast: The Bay of Angels is grey under the clouds today, and the Promenade des Anglais follows its curve.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the Bay of Angels today, and the far end of the Promenade des Anglais looks soft and pale.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Bay of Angels is not visible today; the Promenade des Anglais and the beach across the street remain clear.
phrases.rain: The Promenade des Anglais is wet with rain, and guests watch from inside as the Bay of Angels turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is crossing the Bay of Angels, and guests stay inside to watch the lightning over the Mediterranean.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Promenade des Anglais, and guests keep warm indoors while it disappears into the Bay of Angels.
phrases.very_cold: The Bay of Angels looks sharp and bright today, a view that guests enjoy from indoors with a hot drink.
phrases.cold: Guests stay indoors today and watch the waves of the Mediterranean reach the beach across the street.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the Private beach go straight into the Mediterranean.
phrases.warm: Guests on the Private beach lie facing the Mediterranean, with nothing to decide except when to swim.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Bay of Angels gold and warms the whole length of the Promenade des Anglais.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights one strip of the Mediterranean at a time, watched by guests on the seafront.
phrases.grey_evening: The street lamps are on along the Promenade des Anglais this evening, and the Bay of Angels is dark beside them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and guests see the lights of the Promenade des Anglais reflected on the wet pavement.
phrases.mild_night: The Bay of Angels is a dark shape tonight, edged by the lights of the Promenade des Anglais.
phrases.clear_night: Guests end the night looking at the Bay of Angels, black beyond the lit Promenade des Anglais.
phrases.late_night: The Promenade des Anglais is almost empty in the small hours, with the Mediterranean dark beside it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the Bay of Angels still holds the light while the first lamps come on along the Promenade des Anglais.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide grey surface under a clear sky, and the white of the waves shows first.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, guests in the balcony rooms drink coffee and watch the Pacific Ocean send long waves into Cox Bay.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the full curve of Cox Bay fills the floor-to-ceiling windows of The Great Room.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Cox Bay this morning, and the Pacific Ocean changes from blue to grey between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Between the afternoon clouds, sunlight reaches the Pacific Ocean, and the spray above the break in Cox Bay shines white.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean takes the same colour, and only the breaking waves stay white.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Cox Bay today, and the waves of the Pacific Ocean appear out of it one at a time.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Cox Bay is not visible today; guests see the nearest waves of the Pacific Ocean and the sand below.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of The Great Room, and behind it the Pacific Ocean keeps sending in grey waves.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the armchairs of The Great Room, guests watch the storm break up the waves in Cox Bay while the glass takes the spray.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the sand of Cox Bay, and the flakes disappear when they touch the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, and every wave on the Pacific Ocean has a sharp white edge.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind their balcony doors and watch the Pacific Ocean roll white into Cox Bay.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests at the gas fire pits leave the fires alone and look at the cool blue Pacific Ocean.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests at The SandBar Bistro watch surf lessons begin at the edge of the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Pacific Ocean gold, and the forested headland at the end of Cox Bay grows darker against it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Cox Bay turn pink and the wet sand below copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Over dinner in The Great Room, guests look out at a cloudy evening and the pale lines of surf in Cox Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests sit by the river-stone fireplace in The Great Room and watch the rain blow in from the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the Pacific Ocean is mostly a sound, with faint white lines where the waves break.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Pacific Ocean tonight, and guests in this 2002 lodge can still see the surf moving below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pacific Ocean is black beyond the balconies, and only the foam on the sand shows.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Cox Bay is still bright, and the Pacific Ocean holds a little of its pink.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and Canton Tower stands unlit above a still Pearl River.
phrases.clear_morning: In clear morning light, the Pearl River shines and Canton Tower rises above it.
phrases.clear_midday: From the terrace, guests follow the Pearl River under a clear midday sky, with Canton Tower sharp against the blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past the top of Canton Tower this morning, and their shadows cross the Pearl River below.
