phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the south-facing rooms watch patches of afternoon sun move along the Pearl River.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Pearl River turns the same colour, and Canton Tower rises in a darker grey above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Pearl River today, and Canton Tower fades towards the top like an unfinished drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far bank of the Pearl River is not clear today, and guests see only the lower half of Canton Tower.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pearl River; guests watch it from the full-height windows, with Canton Tower slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind Canton Tower, and guests in the fitness center stop mid-exercise to watch the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Pearl River, and guests stand at the windows as the flakes drift past Canton Tower.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and guests stay indoors to look at every line of Canton Tower.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the terrace is quiet, and the Pearl River runs steel-coloured below it.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above the Pearl River, and guests on the terrace look for shade before they look at Canton Tower.
phrases.warm: Guests take their time on the terrace in the warm air, looking out over the Pearl River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Pearl River gold, and Canton Tower throws a long thin shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights one side of Canton Tower, while the Pearl River is already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the private dining room look out at Canton Tower, lit in colour under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Wet glass spreads the colours of Canton Tower tonight, and the Pearl River shines with rain below.
phrases.mild_night: From a suite bathtub by the window, guests watch Canton Tower change colour against the cloudy night.
phrases.clear_night: Canton Tower glows in colour against a clear night sky, and the Pearl River carries its reflection.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pearl River is a wide dark band, and the outline of Canton Tower rises quietly beyond it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the first lights come on along Canton Tower, and guests in the fitness center look up.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale above the Adriatic Sea, and the limestone coves toward Castro slowly take shape.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun comes up out of the Adriatic Sea, and guests on the private rooftop terraces watch it with coffee at the railing.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch on La Terrazza sul Mare, the Adriatic Sea is a clear blue under a sky with no clouds.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Adriatic Sea this morning, while the rocky coves below stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the two pools, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the rocky shoreline and out to sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Adriatic Sea turns the colour of the dry-stone walls that cross the olive slope.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Adriatic Sea today, and the coves toward Castro fade one after another into the white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far coves toward Castro are not visible today; guests see the olive trees and the nearest stretch of the Adriatic Sea.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the olive trees and the Adriatic Sea, and the water turns grey all the way to the horizon.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Adriatic Sea, and guests count the seconds until thunder rolls back across the coves.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the olive trees and the dry-stone walls, and the Adriatic Sea lies dark grey behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and the Adriatic Sea shows a sharp blue beyond the bare stone walls.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look from the rooftop terraces across the olive trees to a steel-blue Adriatic Sea.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the hydromassage pool and look over the olive trees at the bright Adriatic Sea.
phrases.warm: On the loungers by the pool, books stay closed while guests look at the rocky coves and the Adriatic Sea instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight turns the limestone coves a warm gold, and the Adriatic Sea beyond them slowly deepens to dark blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink above the Adriatic Sea, and guests in these 25 suites step out to their terraces.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner on La Terrazza sul Mare, guests look out at the Adriatic Sea, now a wide dark space under the clouds.
phrases.wet_evening: The Adriatic Sea disappears into the wet dark this evening, and the nearest olive trees shine with rain.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hide the stars, and the Adriatic Sea shows only as a darker band below the sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Adriatic Sea, and guests on the rooftop terraces have good reason to stay up late.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Adriatic Sea and the sky are difficult to tell apart beyond the still olive trees.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Adriatic Sea, and the first lights come on along the coves.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the mangrove waterways lie still and grey under a clear sky, and the first birds begin to move.
phrases.clear_morning: On this clear morning, guests in the lagoon-side rooms watch the mangrove waterways come alive with birds.
phrases.clear_midday: The Caribbean Sea is bright turquoise under the midday sun, with white sand and palm trees in front of it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Caribbean Sea this morning, turning the turquoise water darker in patches.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From their terraces, guests in the beach-side rooms follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the Caribbean Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the Caribbean Sea loses its turquoise, and the palm trees stand out green against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the mangrove waterways today, and the far bank is only a faint green line.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon over the Caribbean Sea is not visible today; guests see the beach, the palm trees and the nearest water.
phrases.rain: Rain makes small rings on the mangrove waterways, and guests watch them spread from the lagoon-side terraces.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay indoors as lightning flashes over the Caribbean Sea and thunder rolls across the beach.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees and the white sand, and guests look twice at the Caribbean Sea behind it.
phrases.very_cold: In very cold air the Caribbean Sea looks sharp and clear, and guests admire it from behind the glass doors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the beach is empty, and the Caribbean Sea rolls in below the rooms with balconies.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests keep to the shade of the palm trees and look out at the bright Caribbean Sea.
phrases.warm: On this warm day guests walk along the white sand, with the turquoise Caribbean Sea beside them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the mangrove waterways late in the afternoon, and the green of the leaves turns warm.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests watch the clouds over the Caribbean Sea turn orange and pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud the Caribbean Sea is dark, and guests can just make out the white of the waves on the sand.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests listen to the rain on the palm trees, and the Caribbean Sea is lost in the darkness.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the mangrove waterways are black and quiet beside this hotel of 182 rooms.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Caribbean Sea tonight, and guests on the beach-side terraces look up at them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the mangrove waterways are dark, and nothing moves on the water.
phrases.dusk: The sky over the Caribbean Sea is still bright just after sunset, and the palm trees turn to black outlines.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Aegean Sea is a calm grey sheet below the private terraces, and the sky above it is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches Megali Ammos Beach, and the Aegean Sea beyond the private terraces is a clear blue.
phrases.clear_midday: The Aegean Sea turns turquoise under the midday sun, and from the infinity pool the water seems to run straight into it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Aegean Sea this morning, and the water changes from dark blue to turquoise as they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Mykonos windmills are in sunshine one moment and under a passing cloud the next, seen from the pool terraces.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Aegean Sea takes a silver colour, and the small rocky islet stands out clearly on the horizon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Aegean Sea today, and it is difficult to tell where the water ends and the sky begins.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today, but Megali Ammos Beach and the near water of the Aegean Sea stay clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Aegean Sea, and guests watch it through the open French doors of their sea-view suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Aegean Sea, and for a second each flash lights the water white off Megali Ammos Beach.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Megali Ammos Beach, and the Aegean Sea behind it is dark grey.
phrases.very_cold: The Aegean Sea is deep blue in the freezing, clear air, and the horizon is a sharp line.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Aegean Sea shows a darker blue, and the white chapel with its golden cross is bright against it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look out over the bright Aegean Sea.
phrases.warm: By the infinity pool, books stay closed while guests look at the Aegean Sea instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Sunset Lounge, guests hold their cocktails and watch the sun go down towards the Aegean Sea.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange over the Aegean Sea, and guests at Sunset Lounge turn their chairs towards it.
phrases.grey_evening: At Sunset Lounge this cloudy evening, guests look over an Aegean Sea that has turned almost black.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening on Megali Ammos Beach, and the Aegean Sea beyond it has gone dark.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and the Aegean Sea off Megali Ammos Beach is one dark surface under them.
phrases.clear_night: Real stars shine over the Aegean Sea tonight, and the fibre optic lights of the pool copy them just below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Aegean Sea is a wide dark space beyond the private terraces of this hotel of 30 rooms.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Aegean Sea just after sunset, and the first fibre optic lights appear in the infinity pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dom Luís I Bridge is a dark shape over the Douro River, and the sky behind it is only beginning to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun lights the iron Dom Luís I Bridge, and the Douro River shines below it.
phrases.clear_midday: From the upper-floor rooms, guests look over terracotta rooftops to the Dom Luís I Bridge under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Porto's rooftops this morning, while the Dom Luís I Bridge stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the Douro River and the Dom Luís I Bridge.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Douro River turns the same colour, and the iron Dom Luís I Bridge stands out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Dom Luís I Bridge today, and the terracotta rooftops fade one row at a time towards the Douro River.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far bank of the Douro River is not visible today; guests can still make out the Dom Luís I Bridge.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Douro River; guests in the upper-floor rooms watch it, the Dom Luís I Bridge slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Dom Luís I Bridge for a second, then the storm closes over the Douro River again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the terracotta rooftops, and guests watch the Dom Luís I Bridge slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, and the Dom Luís I Bridge looks sharp above the Douro River.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the upper-floor windows and let the Douro River do the moving.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the balconies sit in the shade and look over the palm trees to Porto's rooftops.
phrases.warm: Warm air settles over the Douro River, and guests take their time looking at the Dom Luís I Bridge.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Dom Luís I Bridge gold, and the Douro River carries the same colour below.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests in this 19th-century villa watch the last sun slip between clouds and touch the Dom Luís I Bridge.
phrases.grey_evening: City lights glow under the evening cloud, and guests can trace the Douro River by the lights on its banks.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights along the Douro River spread across the wet glass, and the Dom Luís I Bridge shines through.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the night sky, but the lights of Porto keep the Dom Luís I Bridge easy to find.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests look at the Dom Luís I Bridge and its reflection in the Douro River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Porto's rooftops are still, and a guest who cannot sleep has the Dom Luís I Bridge to look at.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Douro River below the Dom Luís I Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Andaman Sea is a calm dark surface beyond the coconut palms, and Pansea Beach lies empty.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Lomtalay Restaurant, guests look out over a clear blue Andaman Sea.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in Sunset Restaurant, guests look across the pool to a bright turquoise Andaman Sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Pansea Bay this morning, and the water changes from turquoise to deep blue and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the cottages on the hillside, guests watch clouds drift over the Andaman Sea between the treetops.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Andaman Sea turns silver, and the white sand of Pansea Beach looks brighter beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over Pansea Bay today, and the coconut palms on the beach look like soft grey drawings.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon of the Andaman Sea is not visible today; the pool, the palms and the first waves on Pansea Beach remain clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Pansea Beach; guests in the beach suites watch it through open doors as the Andaman Sea turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole of Pansea Bay for a second, then the Andaman Sea goes back behind the rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the coconut palms of Pansea Beach, and guests watch the flakes disappear into the Andaman Sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and from Sunset Restaurant the Andaman Sea shows a sharp blue horizon behind the pool.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the hexagonal pool lies still, and beyond it white waves run onto Pansea Beach.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the pool up to their chins and look out at the palms and the Andaman Sea.
phrases.warm: At Beach Bar, guests sit with cold drinks and look along the soft sands of Pansea Beach to the sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Sunset Restaurant, guests watch the low sun turn the pool and the Andaman Sea gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in orange bands over Pansea Beach, a show guests here have watched since 1982.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the black tiles of the pool reflect the lights, and the Andaman Sea beyond is a wide dark space.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Pansea Beach this evening, and guests at dinner in Sunset Restaurant watch it cross the lit pool.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, and from the pool villas guests look down through the palms towards Pansea Bay.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Andaman Sea tonight, and the white sand of Pansea Beach stays pale under them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Pansea Bay is quiet, and only the white edge of the waves shows on the sand.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Andaman Sea after sunset, and the first lights come on along Pansea Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: In the Suite 1755 – Vacheron Constantin, early risers find the Burj Khalifa as a dark outline against the first pale light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun catches the Burj Khalifa, and every edge of the tower shows from here.
phrases.clear_midday: The Burj Khalifa stands clear from base to tip, bright silver in the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows slide down the Burj Khalifa this morning and leave it bright again in seconds.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Suite 1755 – Vacheron Constantin watch the Burj Khalifa go from shade to sunshine and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey ceiling of cloud, the Burj Khalifa rises above the city in the same quiet grey.
phrases.fog_haze: In the haze, the Burj Khalifa shows only as a pale shape with the city below it almost gone.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility keeps the view short today, and the Burj Khalifa is only a faint line in the pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain is running down the glass, and the Burj Khalifa stands grey and blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Burj Khalifa for a second, then the storm takes it back.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling across the view, and the Burj Khalifa fades to a faint white shape behind it.
phrases.very_cold: Seen from indoors, the Burj Khalifa is sharp in the cold air, every line of the tower clear.
phrases.cold: From inside, guests take their time tracing the Burj Khalifa from its base to its tip.
phrases.very_hot: Heat makes the city shimmer, and the Burj Khalifa seems to tremble slightly above it.
phrases.warm: Counting the floors of the Burj Khalifa is a slow game, and guests usually lose their place halfway up.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Shadows grow long across Dubai as the Burj Khalifa's glass goes from silver to warm amber.
phrases.partly_golden: The clouds behind the Burj Khalifa turn pink first, and the tower follows a few minutes later.
phrases.grey_evening: The lit Burj Khalifa glows into the low cloud this evening, its top soft and pale.
phrases.wet_evening: This evening the rain turns the city lights into soft blurs around the lit Burj Khalifa.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in the Suite 1755 – Vacheron Constantin end the day facing the lit Burj Khalifa under a cloudy night.
phrases.clear_night: The lit Burj Khalifa stands sharp in the clear night, a thin line of light above the city.
phrases.late_night: Dubai is quiet in the small hours, and the last guests awake have the dark outline of the Burj Khalifa to themselves.
phrases.dusk: One by one the lights of the Burj Khalifa come on while the horizon behind it is still orange.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Railway Bridge is a quiet outline above the Náplavka riverbank, under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light fills the rooftop fitness centre, and the Prague skyline is sharp through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Railway Bridge and the Náplavka riverbank lie in full sun, with every detail easy to see.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the red-tiled rooftops this morning, and guests on the rooftop terrace follow them over the Prague skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Náplavka riverbank goes from sun to shade this afternoon as clouds drift over the Railway Bridge.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, guests in the rooftop fitness centre look over city rooftops and green trees.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Railway Bridge today, and the Náplavka riverbank fades into grey beyond it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Prague skyline is not visible today; from the rooftop fitness centre, guests see only the nearer city rooftops and green trees.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Náplavka riverbank, and guests watch it through their windows, the Railway Bridge slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Prague skyline, and guests follow the storm from behind the floor-to-ceiling glass of the rooftop fitness centre.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Railway Bridge, and the Náplavka riverbank is turning white below it.
phrases.very_cold: The Railway Bridge stands sharp in the freezing air, and the Náplavka riverbank below it is bright and empty.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay on the warm side of the glass in the rooftop fitness centre and look across the Prague skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the terraces of the terrace rooms sit back and look across Prague's cityscape.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests step out onto the rooftop terrace and look over Prague's red-tiled rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun warms the red-tiled rooftops, and guests on the rooftop terrace pick out the Gothic church spires among them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and catches the Railway Bridge, with the Náplavka riverbank already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the Prague skyline spread out beyond the glass of the rooftop fitness centre.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the city lights shimmer around the Railway Bridge, and the Náplavka riverbank shines below it.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hang low over the Railway Bridge tonight, and the city lights give the Náplavka riverbank a soft glow.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in this 1907 former printing house look out at the Railway Bridge and the lights along the Náplavka riverbank.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Náplavka riverbank lies still and the Railway Bridge is a dark shape above it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on among the rooftops and Gothic church spires below the rooftop terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a dark surface under a clear sky, with a faint band of light where the day will begin.
phrases.clear_morning: The level 34 sky pool faces east, so the morning sun comes straight across the Pacific Ocean to the water's edge.
phrases.clear_midday: The Pacific Ocean is a clean blue at midday, and the horizon runs straight across every water view balcony.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pacific Ocean this morning, and the Gold Coast coastline stays bright between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the wrap-around balconies of the sub-penthouses, guests follow the afternoon clouds drifting from the Pacific Ocean towards the Hinterland.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the white surf marks the Gold Coast coastline.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Gold Coast coastline today, and the Pacific Ocean fades into the sky without a clear horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: guests see the Broadbeach skyline and the nearest surf, but not the Hinterland or the far end of the coastline.
phrases.rain: Rain crosses the Pacific Ocean in grey curtains, and guests watch it reach the Gold Coast coastline from behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second the whole Gold Coast coastline shows white below the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Broadbeach, and the flakes disappear into the grey Pacific Ocean beyond the skyline.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the Hinterland stands out sharply, and guests look at it through the glass before stepping onto a balcony.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Pacific Ocean looks darker, and the sand of the Gold Coast coastline is pale and empty beside it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat guests stay in the level 34 sky pool up to their shoulders and look east over the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.warm: By the level 34 sky pool, guests lie on the sun loungers and look out at the open Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Broadbeach skyline gold, and the towers lay long shadows towards the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink over the Pacific Ocean, while the Gold Coast coastline slowly loses its light.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud the lights of the Broadbeach skyline glow, and the Pacific Ocean beyond them is black.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass tonight, and the lights of the Broadbeach skyline blur into soft yellow spots.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests on the top three floors of this 34-storey tower look down on the lit Gold Coast coastline.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky the lights of the Gold Coast coastline curve away, with stars above the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pacific Ocean and the sky are one darkness, and the Gold Coast coastline sleeps beside them.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the first lights come on across the Broadbeach skyline, and the Pacific Ocean still holds some of the day's blue.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Intracoastal Waterway lies still and grey beneath a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool terrace, the Atlantic Ocean shines in the clear morning light, open all the way to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Intracoastal Waterway is bright blue under a clear sky, and every boat on it is easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Intracoastal Waterway this morning, with bright water between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Sky Deck, the Atlantic Ocean shows darker patches where afternoon clouds pass over the blue water.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Intracoastal Waterway takes the same colour, calm from bank to bank.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Intracoastal Waterway today, and the far bank is only a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon over the Atlantic Ocean is not visible today, and from the rooftop pool terrace guests see only the nearer water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Intracoastal Waterway, and guests watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows in their suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in this 24-floor tower watch the storm from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Intracoastal Waterway, and the flakes disappear as they touch the water.
phrases.very_cold: The Intracoastal Waterway is sharp and bright on this very cold day, and the air above it is clear.
phrases.cold: A cold day keeps guests indoors, where the fitness center treadmills look out on the Atlantic Ocean and the palm trees.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests stay in the pool on the Sky Deck and look out at the Atlantic Ocean from the water.
phrases.warm: On the Sky Deck, guests at Spinnaker Pool Grill look up from their plates at the Atlantic Ocean on this warm day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lies across the Intracoastal Waterway, and guests in the suites on that side stop to watch.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Intracoastal Waterway turn orange and the water copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Intracoastal Waterway is a wide dark band with lights along both banks.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights along the Intracoastal Waterway are blurred and soft.
phrases.mild_night: From the terrace suites, the Atlantic Ocean is a wide dark space under the cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, lights from the banks lie in long lines on the Intracoastal Waterway.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Intracoastal Waterway is quiet and dark, and nothing on it is in a hurry.
phrases.dusk: The sky over the Intracoastal Waterway is still bright after sunset, and the first lights appear along the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Guests waking early in the Kayon River Suite see the river as a grey line under a sky just starting to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Premier Pool Villa, the verdant forest canopy is bright green in the first full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The river shines in the midday sun, and the verdant forest canopy is a strong green.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Kayon Garden Suite, guests watch the garden go bright and then soft again as clouds pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows drift over the verdant forest canopy this afternoon, and the river goes from bright to dull and back.
phrases.overcast: The verdant forest canopy stays green under today's grey cloud, with the river running below it.
phrases.fog_haze: In today's haze, the forest canopy fades in layers towards the far side of the river valley.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests in the Royal Jacuzzi Pool Villa can see the nearest trees of the tropical forest today, but not the ones further back.
phrases.rain: At The Yoga Pavilion, the sound of falling rain mixes with the sound of the river.
phrases.thunderstorm: Inside the River Edge Pool Villa, guests watch the thunderstorm pass over the river.
phrases.snow: From inside the Premier Pool Villa, guests watch snow settle on the verdant forest canopy.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay inside the Kayon River Suite today and watch the river from there.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the verdant forest canopy looks just as green from inside the Premier Pool Villa.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, swimmers in the pool look across the jungle valley towards the river.
phrases.warm: Guests linger on Canyon Jetty, looking from the stone cliff to the river and back.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The verdant forest canopy turns gold in the late sun, and the river picks up the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests in the River Edge Pool Villa watch the last sunlight come and go on the river between clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening is cloudy and quiet at Puspaka Chapel, where guests can hear the river.
phrases.wet_evening: From the Kayon Garden Suite, guests watch the evening rain fall on the garden.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the forest canopy is a single dark shape above the river.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the Royal Jacuzzi Pool Villa look out at the enchanting tropical forest, black against a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: While guests in the River Edge Pool Villa sleep, the river keeps running in the dark.
phrases.dusk: The forest canopy darkens first after sunset, while the sky above the river is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky grows pale over the Pacific, and Diamond Head slowly takes shape at one end of the shore.
phrases.clear_morning: From the oceanfront rooms, the morning panorama runs clear from Diamond Head to Koko Head Crater.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Pacific turns turquoise near the beach, and Diamond Head stands sharp against the blue.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Ko'olau Mountains this morning, while Diamond Head and the sandy beach stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At The Veranda, afternoon tea is served with an ocean view, and today white clouds drift across the Pacific sky.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific loses its turquoise, while Diamond Head keeps its clear outline above the shore.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Diamond Head today, and guests at The Veranda see the ocean fade into the sky with no clear horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Koko Head Crater is not visible today, and Diamond Head is only a faint outline beyond the beach.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pacific, and guests watch it from the open-air shelter of The Veranda while Diamond Head turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific, and for a second guests in the oceanfront rooms see the whole coast as far as Diamond Head.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach and the palm trees, and Diamond Head turns white beyond them, a view nobody packed for.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear today, so Diamond Head looks sharp-edged, and guests admire the Pacific from indoors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the beach is empty, and the Pacific rolls in below Diamond Head with nobody in the way.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests float in the calm water off the private beach and look along the shore to Diamond Head.
phrases.warm: By the lagoon on this warm day, guests divide their attention between the dolphins and the ocean beyond the palms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests at Plumeria Beach House watch the sun sink toward the ocean horizon, and the water turns gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Pacific, an ocean view that has drawn guests to The Veranda since 1964.
phrases.grey_evening: At Hoku's, dinner guests look out at the ocean under a cloudy evening sky, the water a shade darker than the clouds.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the ocean this evening, and guests at Hoku's watch the white surf show through the dark.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, and from the oceanfront rooms guests see Diamond Head as a dark shape at the end of the shore.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear night sky over the Pacific, and a thin line of surf shows where the private beach begins.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests still awake in this 1964 hotel see only the faint white of surf on the dark Pacific.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky is still bright over the Pacific, and Diamond Head darkens as the first lights come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Table Mountain is a dark shape above the sleeping city, and the sky behind it slowly turns lighter.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Table Mountain first, and guests in the mountain-facing rooms watch the light move down to the city.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the flat top of Table Mountain draws a straight line above the city roofs.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Table Mountain this morning, and their shadows cross the city below the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, white clouds rest on the flat top of Table Mountain, and the rock below them stays in the sun.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits low over Table Mountain today, and the rock face looks darker above the city.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Table Mountain today, and from the rooftop terrace the city below looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Table Mountain is only a faint outline today, and from the rooftop terrace mostly the nearer city streets are visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and Table Mountain comes and goes behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests watch lightning show Table Mountain for a second at a time, while thunder rolls over the city.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the city, and Table Mountain turns pale behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and every line of rock on Table Mountain looks sharp above the city.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests look at Table Mountain from behind double-glazed windows and feel no need to climb it.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, Table Mountain seems to shake a little in the bright air above the city.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit on the rooftop terrace with Table Mountain in front of them and the city below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Table Mountain golden, and guests in the mountain-facing rooms stop what they are doing to watch.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above Table Mountain turn orange, and from the rooftop terrace the colour is seen above the city roofs.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, city lights shine below the rooftop terrace, and Table Mountain stands black behind them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, rain blurs the city lights, and Table Mountain is hidden somewhere behind them.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, cloud covers the top of Table Mountain, and the city lights give the cloud a soft glow.
phrases.clear_night: Stars sit above the flat top of Table Mountain tonight, and the city shines below it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and Table Mountain keeps watch over this building from 1896.
phrases.dusk: At dusk, Table Mountain glows amber from the rooftop terrace, and the first city lights come on below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Petronas Twin Towers stand quiet against a clear sky, seen from the Twin Towers view suites before the city wakes.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Petronas Twin Towers, and guests at breakfast in Traders Club Lounge look straight at both spires.
phrases.clear_midday: From the indoor pool on the 33rd floor, swimmers see the Petronas Twin Towers under a clear blue sky through the big windows.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift behind the Petronas Twin Towers this morning, while guests on the treadmills in the fitness centre keep their eyes on the spires.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross KLCC Park this afternoon, and the lake below the Petronas Twin Towers changes from bright to dull and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Petronas Twin Towers take the colour of the clouds, and KLCC Park stays green at their feet.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Petronas Twin Towers today, and from SkyBar the two spires fade a little towards the top.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far skyline of Kuala Lumpur is not visible today, but the Petronas Twin Towers are close enough to stay clear from the indoor pool windows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of the Twin Towers view suites, and guests watch the Petronas Twin Towers turn soft and grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Petronas Twin Towers, and guests in Traders Club Lounge count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over KLCC Park, and guests at the indoor pool windows watch the Petronas Twin Towers disappear and return between the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, so guests stay behind the fitness centre windows, where the Petronas Twin Towers look sharp in the sunlight.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the paths of KLCC Park are quiet, and the Petronas Twin Towers rise above the trees in pale light.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the walkers in KLCC Park keep to the shade, and guests watch them from the cool side of the glass with the Petronas Twin Towers above.
phrases.warm: On the patio of On The Go, guests sit in the warm air and look across to the trees of KLCC Park.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Petronas Twin Towers gold, and guests in Traders Club Lounge hold their drinks and forget to drink them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds turn orange behind the Petronas Twin Towers, and the mosque beside KLCC Park catches the same light.
phrases.grey_evening: At SkyBar, the cabanas by the windows are angled towards the Petronas Twin Towers, which glow under the evening clouds.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the evening city, and diners at Bara On Six see the lights of the Petronas Twin Towers shine through the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: Guests at SkyBar listen to live music tonight, with the lit Petronas Twin Towers straight across KLCC Park under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: In this 571-room hotel, guests in the rooms facing the Petronas Twin Towers leave the curtains open to the lit spires and the clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, KLCC Park is dark and still, and the Petronas Twin Towers stand as two tall shapes above it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the first lights come on in the Petronas Twin Towers, seen straight on from SkyBar.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky slowly turns pale, and guests who wake early see the round outline of the Budapest Eye appear.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, sunlight falls on St. Stephen's Basilica and the Budapest Eye next to it, both seen from the suite balconies.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Budapest Eye and St. Stephen's Basilica stand sharp and bright above the city rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the city rooftops this morning, and guests see St. Stephen's Basilica pass from shade to sun and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the BiBo rooftop bar, the afternoon view is a wide panorama of Budapest rooftops under moving clouds, with the Budapest Eye among them.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, St. Stephen's Basilica and the Budapest Eye keep their clear outlines above the rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and guests see the Budapest Eye as a faint circle near St. Stephen's Basilica.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the wide panorama from the BiBo rooftop bar ends early, and only the nearer rooftops and the Budapest Eye show.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Budapest; guests in the balcony suites watch it through the glass, with the Budapest Eye a little blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the city, and each flash of lightning brightens the sky behind St. Stephen's Basilica.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the rooftops, and guests watch the Budapest Eye slowly lose its sharp edges behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests staying warm indoors see every line of St. Stephen's Basilica.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Budapest Eye and St. Stephen's Basilica share the frame from one balcony, and most guests enjoy the pair from behind the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the city rooftops shimmer below the BiBo rooftop bar, and guests look across them to the Budapest Eye.
phrases.warm: On a warm day at the BiBo rooftop bar, drinks lose their ice while guests count the cabins of the Budapest Eye.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the city rooftops gold, and from the BiBo rooftop bar the wide panorama of Budapest glows under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above St. Stephen's Basilica turn orange, and guests see the Budapest Eye catch the low light.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in these three historic buildings see the lit Budapest Eye turn slowly near St. Stephen's Basilica.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of the Budapest Eye spread into soft colours on the wet glass of the suite windows.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests see the lit Budapest Eye glow against the low sky.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, St. Stephen's Basilica is lit above the dark rooftops, and the Budapest Eye shines close by.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city is quiet, and St. Stephen's Basilica and the Budapest Eye wait together for the morning.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and the first lights come on along the Budapest Eye while the sky behind St. Stephen's Basilica is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Brisbane River is still, and the sky behind the Story Bridge slowly turns from black to pale blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Brisbane River, and guests in the balcony rooms see the Story Bridge in clear light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Fiume rooftop pool has the Story Bridge on one side and the CBD towers on the other.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Brisbane River this morning, while the Story Bridge stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Brisbane River changes from blue to grey and back again as afternoon clouds pass over the CBD.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Story Bridge and the Brisbane River below it take almost the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Brisbane River today, and the CBD towers look like a faint drawing behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the CBD towers are difficult to see, while the Story Bridge and the Brisbane River remain plain.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Brisbane River; guests in the river rooms watch it through the glass, the Story Bridge slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Story Bridge for a second above the Brisbane River, and guests count until the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Brisbane River, and guests stay at the windows to watch the flakes drift past the Story Bridge.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and from the Fiume rooftop pool the Story Bridge looks sharp above the Brisbane River.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in this 103-room hotel stay behind the glass and look at the Brisbane River and the CBD.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the water of the Fiume rooftop pool and look at the Story Bridge from there.
phrases.warm: On this warm day guests rest on the sun loungers at the Fiume rooftop pool, with the Story Bridge beside them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Brisbane River gold, and the glass of the CBD towers shines in the low light.
phrases.partly_golden: At the Fiume rooftop bar, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over the CBD and the Brisbane River.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the CBD give the low sky a soft glow above the Brisbane River.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of the Story Bridge stretch into long reflections on the Brisbane River.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the Story Bridge is lit, and the Brisbane River carries its lights.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the CBD towers shine, and the Brisbane River repeats their lights on the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Brisbane River is quiet, and the Story Bridge is a dark shape above the water.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights appear on the Story Bridge and in the CBD across the Brisbane River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean lies dark and calm under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the ocean-view rooms open the curtains to a clear morning and a bright blue Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Atlantic Ocean is a strong blue, and the waves draw white lines along the beach.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Atlantic Ocean this morning, and their shadows cross the water one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon clouds drift out over the Atlantic Ocean, which begins just behind the edge of the Beach Club infinity pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns grey too and looks wider and quieter than on a sunny day.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Atlantic Ocean today, so the glass walls of the Beach Club lounge show the pool terrace clearly and a soft white behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; from the ocean-view rooms, the Atlantic Ocean shows only its first waves near the beach.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic Ocean, and the drops make the water near the beach look rough and dull.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and for a second every wave is white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in this 1927 landmark watch the flakes disappear over the grey water from the ocean-view rooms.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Atlantic Ocean ends in a sharp blue horizon.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to the ocean-view rooms, where the Atlantic Ocean looks the colour of steel.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the Beach Club infinity pool up to their shoulders and look straight out at the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.warm: On the pool terrace, guests sit in the warm air and count the waves of the Atlantic Ocean, then lose count.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late golden light falls on the Beach Club infinity pool, and the Atlantic Ocean behind it turns a softer blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Atlantic Ocean pink, and the pool terrace is a good seat for it.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds hide the stars this evening, and from the Beach Club lounge the Atlantic Ocean is a dark shape beyond the pool terrace.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain covers the Atlantic Ocean like a curtain, and guests in the Beach Club lounge hear the water more than they see it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Atlantic Ocean is almost black, and the foam of the waves marks where the beach begins.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and across Atlantic Avenue the water is black and wide.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic Ocean is quiet and almost without colour, and the beach is empty.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky over the Atlantic Ocean is still bright, and the first lights come on around the pool terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the North Shore Mountains stand as a dark shape above Burrard Inlet under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the North Shore Mountains, and every ridge shows clearly above Burrard Inlet.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Burrard Inlet is bright blue and the downtown towers shine like glass, which they are.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift across the North Shore Mountains this morning, and their shadows move slowly over the slopes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, guests see the downtown towers going in and out of cloud shadow this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Burrard Inlet turns the colour of steel, and the North Shore Mountains look darker beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Burrard Inlet today, and the downtown towers fade one behind another.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The North Shore Mountains are not visible today; guests see the downtown towers clearly and a pale Burrard Inlet.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch Burrard Inlet turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Burrard Inlet, and for a second the North Shore Mountains appear out of the storm cloud.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the downtown towers, and the North Shore Mountains have disappeared into a white sky.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the North Shore Mountains look sharp and close, and guests admire them from behind warm glass.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests on the higher floors look over the downtown skyline from a freestanding soaker tub.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests step onto their private balconies and look toward Burrard Inlet, hoping for ocean air.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests stand at the glass railings of the rooftop terrace with the downtown towers all around them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the downtown towers gold, and the North Shore Mountains take a warm colour too.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the North Shore Mountains turn pink, and Burrard Inlet copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the downtown towers shine in rows, and Burrard Inlet lies dark beside them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in Arthur Erickson's twisting tower see the downtown lights blurred by the weather.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud hides the North Shore Mountains tonight, so the lit downtown skyline has the guests' full attention.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the downtown skyline is full of lit windows, and the North Shore Mountains rise black against the stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who cannot sleep find the downtown towers quiet and Burrard Inlet still.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over the North Shore Mountains while the first lights come on in the downtown towers.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Neyphu Valley is still and grey-blue, and the pine forest shows only its outline against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the rice terraces of the Neyphu Valley first, then the apple orchards lower down.
phrases.clear_midday: From the indoor pool, guests look through floor-to-ceiling glass doors at the mountains and the valley under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the rice fields this morning, while Eutok Goenpa monastery stays in sunshine across the valley.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows watch clouds cross the pine forest of the Neyphu Valley this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the pine forest turns a deeper green, and the rice terraces lie pale below it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Neyphu Valley today, and the far slopes fade one behind another like layers of paper.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The snow-topped mountains are not visible today, so guests look at the nearer rice fields and apple orchards instead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rice terraces, and guests watch it through the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay behind the glass doors of the indoor pool while lightning shows the mountains and the valley for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Neyphu Valley, and Eutok Goenpa monastery comes and goes behind the white.
phrases.very_cold: The snow-topped mountains stand sharp in the freezing air, and guests admire them from inside the heated indoor pool.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this dzong-style sanctuary look across the Neyphu Valley through timber-framed glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the deck chairs of the pool terrace look out at the mountains and do very little else.
phrases.warm: Lunch on the restaurant's stone terrace is slow today, because guests keep looking down at the apple orchards.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun crosses the Neyphu Valley and lights the walls of Eutok Goenpa monastery on the far slopes.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and turns the rice terraces gold, while the pine forest above is already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: From the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows, guests at dinner see the Neyphu Valley as a wide darkness under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows this evening, and the Neyphu Valley beyond is dark and wet.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and from the balcony rooms the slopes of the Neyphu Valley are quiet black shapes.
phrases.clear_night: From the balcony rooms, guests look up at a sky full of stars over the dark Neyphu Valley.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Neyphu Valley is fully dark, and the pine forest is only a deeper black below the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright above the ridges, and the rice terraces of the Neyphu Valley slowly lose their colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide grey surface under a clear sky, and Pismo Beach Pier slowly takes shape above it.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balcony of the Pacific Suite, guests see the morning sun on Pismo Beach and a clear blue Pacific Ocean behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: The Pacific Ocean is bright blue at midday, and from Star Bar & Pool every post of Pismo Beach Pier is easy to see.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pacific Ocean this morning, and guests at Pequín Coastal Cocina follow them towards the horizon.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the fire pit terrace, Pismo Beach Pier is in sunshine one minute and under a cloud the next, with the Pacific Ocean changing colour behind it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the breaking waves stand out white against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Pacific Ocean today, and from the pool deck Pismo Beach Pier seems to end halfway out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests in the balcony rooms see Pismo Beach, the first waves and little of the Pacific Ocean beyond them.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pacific Ocean, and guests at Pequín Coastal Cocina watch the grey water and the wet sand of Pismo Beach.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Pacific Ocean for a second, then the storm takes it back, and guests in the oceanfront rooms wait for the next flash.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Pismo Beach, and guests watch the flakes disappear as they touch the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Pacific Ocean shows a sharp horizon behind Pismo Beach Pier.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Pacific Ocean looks dark blue from the fire pit terrace, and Pismo Beach lies empty in front of it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests at Star Bar & Pool look from the pool to the Pacific Ocean and wonder which water is cooler.
phrases.warm: Guests on Pismo Beach sit under the umbrellas of this 124-room resort, their chairs turned towards the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Pacific Ocean gold, and Pismo Beach Pier stands black against the light.
phrases.partly_golden: From Star Bar & Pool, the last sun colours the clouds orange above the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.grey_evening: On a cloudy evening, guests at Pequín Coastal Cocina look out at a Pacific Ocean without stars, darker than the sky above it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening on the lit pool deck, and beyond it guests see the pale edge of the Pacific Ocean on the dark sand.
phrases.mild_night: From 3 floors of ocean-facing windows, guests see low clouds drifting through a soft night over the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky tonight, and from the fire pit terrace they reach all the way down to the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pacific Ocean is black and wide, and the only movement is the surf arriving on Pismo Beach.
phrases.dusk: The sky above the Pacific Ocean is still bright after sunset, and the lit pool begins to glow on the deck in front of it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Brisbane River is still and the Story Bridge is an unlit outline against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of the Story Bridge first, then spreads over the Brisbane River below the bridge-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_midday: From Motion Dining's river-side tables, guests see the Story Bridge sharp against a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Brisbane River this morning, while the Story Bridge stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop dining area, patches of afternoon sun move along the Brisbane River towards the Story Bridge.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Brisbane River takes the same colour, and the Story Bridge stands clear above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Brisbane River today, and from the terrace the Story Bridge looks like a faint sketch.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Story Bridge is not visible today; riverside rooms still have the Brisbane River and the nearer span.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Brisbane River with small circles, and guests at Motion Dining watch it from dry river-side tables.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Brisbane River, and each flash of lightning shows the Story Bridge for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Story Bridge and the Brisbane River, and guests at Motion Dining's river-side tables turn their chairs to the window.
phrases.very_cold: The very cold air makes everything sharp, and guests in the gym can count the beams of the Story Bridge.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this hotel, renovated in 2019, watch the Brisbane River from the warm side of the glass in the bridge-facing rooms.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the Brisbane River shines like metal, and guests in the indoor pool look at it through the glass walls.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests by the rooftop pool look across to the sandstone of St John's Anglican Cathedral among the city towers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the club lounge, guests watch the city skyline turn gold as the sun gets low.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun breaks through the clouds and turns the Brisbane River orange below the terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the LED lights of the Story Bridge colour the Brisbane River, and Motion Dining's river-side tables have the front row.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows tonight, and the Story Bridge's LED colours blur across the wet Brisbane River.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Story Bridge changes colour and the Brisbane River copies it a moment later.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the bridge-facing rooms leave the curtains open for the lit Story Bridge.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Brisbane River moves quietly past, and the Story Bridge is only a dark frame above it.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the first LED lights come on along the Story Bridge, and the Brisbane River is still bright below the rooftop dining area.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the olive grove is still dark, and a thin band of grey light shows where the Adriatic Sea lies.
phrases.clear_morning: From bed, guests look through the full-height glass at olive trees, then clear sky, then a narrow blue strip of the Adriatic Sea.
phrases.clear_midday: The saltwater infinity pool points straight at the Adriatic Sea, a clear blue strip beyond the olive trees at midday.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the olive grove this morning, while the distant strip of the Adriatic Sea stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the covered terrace, guests see the infinity pool, the olive groves and the Adriatic Sea under a sky of passing clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Adriatic Sea turns grey too, a thin seam between the olive crowns and the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Adriatic Sea today, so the olive trees beyond the infinity pool fade into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Adriatic Sea is not visible today; from the rooftop terrace the olive grove is clear, and the plain beyond it fades out.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the olive grove; guests watch it through the full-height glass, the Adriatic Sea lost in grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Adriatic Sea for a second beyond the olive trees, then the storm hides it again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the olive trees, and the Adriatic Sea has disappeared behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, the Adriatic Sea draws a sharp blue line beyond the olive grove.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the infinity pool lies still, its edge lined up with the distant Adriatic Sea.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat guests stay in the saltwater infinity pool, looking over its edge at the Adriatic Sea.
phrases.warm: On the sun loungers under the old olive tree, guests forget their books and look for the blue horizon of the Adriatic Sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests climb to the rooftop terrace late in the day, where low sun turns the olive crowns gold before the Adriatic Sea.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Adriatic Sea, and guests watch from the rooftop terrace above the olive trees.
phrases.grey_evening: After sunset under cloud, guests on the rooftop terrace see no town and no shore road, only dark countryside reaching towards the Adriatic Sea.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening guests in the 6 apartments watch rain run down the glass, the olive grove and the Adriatic Sea gone into the dark.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, no stars show above the olive grove, and the Adriatic Sea stays hidden beyond the trees.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the olive grove, and the Adriatic Sea is a darker band below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the countryside is silent, and the Adriatic Sea is somewhere out in the dark beyond the olive trees.
phrases.dusk: At dusk the infinity pool lights come on, and the horizon over the Adriatic Sea stays orange and pink for a few minutes.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the North Shore Mountains are a dark shape above the quiet water of Burrard Inlet.
phrases.clear_morning: From the fitness centre, guests look out at Stanley Park and the North Shore Mountains under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Burrard Inlet is bright blue at midday, and Stanley Park is a wide band of green beyond it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the North Shore Mountains this morning, while Stanley Park stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From ARC Restaurant, guests watch cloud shadows cross Burrard Inlet this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Burrard Inlet turns grey too, and Stanley Park stays dark green beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the North Shore Mountains today, and from the rooftop pool only the nearest water of Burrard Inlet shows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The North Shore Mountains are not visible today; guests can see Burrard Inlet and the faint trees of Stanley Park.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Burrard Inlet, and guests watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows, Stanley Park blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the North Shore Mountains for a second, then the storm closes over Burrard Inlet again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Burrard Inlet, and Stanley Park slowly turns white on the far side.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the North Shore Mountains look sharp and close across Burrard Inlet.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the harbour-view rooms stay behind the glass and study the North Shore Mountains.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look across Burrard Inlet from the water.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, guests lie in the warm air and look up at the North Shore Mountains.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns Burrard Inlet gold, and from the Signature Harbour View Suite terrace guests watch cruise ships manoeuvre directly below.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds above the North Shore Mountains, and Stanley Park begins to darken.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, lights along the harbour reflect in Burrard Inlet, and Stanley Park is one dark shape.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Burrard Inlet tonight, and from ARC Restaurant guests watch the lights along the water spread into soft colours.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight cloud covers the tops of the North Shore Mountains, and their lower lights still reach across Burrard Inlet.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the harbour-view suites see lights across Burrard Inlet below the North Shore Mountains.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Burrard Inlet lies still and black, and Stanley Park cannot be told from the water.
phrases.dusk: At ARC Restaurant, the sky is still bright over Burrard Inlet while the first lights come on along the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, a thin band of pale sky grows above the Indian Ocean, seen from the balconies that face it.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun has risen out of the Indian Ocean, and guests on their balconies see the Whalebone Pier black against the orange sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear sky, the uMhlanga Lighthouse shows its red top and white base sharply against the blue Indian Ocean.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows drift across the Indian Ocean this morning, and from the Vista Terrace a cargo ship can be followed on its way toward Durban.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the Indian Ocean this afternoon, and the water changes from blue to grey and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the uMhlanga Lighthouse is the one bright thing in sight, its red top clear above the rocks.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the cargo ships seem to float in the air above the Indian Ocean.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon and its ships are not visible today; from the Vista Terrace, only the uMhlanga Lighthouse and the nearest surf are clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Indian Ocean, and guests watch it from The Sugar Club, where the dining room looks over the grey water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Indian Ocean, and behind the balcony doors guests count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the uMhlanga Lighthouse, and guests in The Sugar Club watch the flakes disappear into the Indian Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear, and every line of white surf on the Indian Ocean stands out from the Vista Terrace.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Indian Ocean looks like steel, and guests in this 1964 hotel watch the waves break around the uMhlanga Lighthouse.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool at the water's edge and look out at the Indian Ocean with only their heads above the surface.
phrases.warm: On the lawn by the pool, guests lie on the loungers under the umbrellas, with the uMhlanga Lighthouse and the Indian Ocean in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight warms the white base of the uMhlanga Lighthouse, and the Indian Ocean behind it turns a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Indian Ocean turn pink, and dolphins sometimes pass in the surf below the Vista Terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the light of the uMhlanga Lighthouse shines over the Indian Ocean, seen from the Vista Terrace at cocktail time.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in The Sugar Club look through streaked glass at the Indian Ocean, dark beyond the uMhlanga Lighthouse.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers the stars on this mild night, and the lights of cargo ships mark where the horizon of the Indian Ocean is.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Indian Ocean, and all 89 balconies have the same seat for the show.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Indian Ocean is quiet, and only the white surf moves on the rocks below.
phrases.dusk: The sky over the Indian Ocean is still bright after sunset, and the uMhlanga Lighthouse has just switched on its light.

phrases.clear_predawn: Jimbaran Bay is still dark before sunrise, and the first light is only starting to reach the water.
phrases.clear_morning: At Rumari, guests start the day facing Jimbaran Bay in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Jimbaran Bay lies wide and blue under the midday sun, with the Indian Ocean open beyond it.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Purnama Honeymoon Bale, the ocean below shows patches of shade and patches of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows drift over Jimbaran Bay this afternoon, and guests at Rumari watch them go by.
phrases.overcast: Under a full cover of cloud, Jimbaran Bay and the Indian Ocean are the same soft grey today.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze has turned Jimbaran Bay pale today, and guests at The Writers Bar look out over it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Jimbaran Bay shows only its near water today, and the Indian Ocean beyond it cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: At Rumari, guests listen to the rain and watch it draw grey lines across Jimbaran Bay.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Jimbaran Bay, and guests watch the storm from indoors.
phrases.snow: Jimbaran Bay disappears and returns behind the falling snow, and guests watch from indoors.
phrases.very_cold: The Indian Ocean shows a clean line where it meets Jimbaran Bay, a view guests enjoy from indoors today.
phrases.cold: Guests stay indoors today and watch slow waves roll into Jimbaran Bay.
phrases.very_hot: Guests take cover in the Purnama Honeymoon Bale and look down at the ocean below, which seems cooler by the minute.
phrases.warm: Two guests sit in the Purnama Honeymoon Bale with Jimbaran Bay spread in front of them, and neither is in a hurry to leave.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At The Writers Bar, guests pick their seats for the sunset while Jimbaran Bay turns gold.
phrases.partly_golden: Sunset arrives in pieces at The Writers Bar this evening, orange between the clouds and Jimbaran Bay glowing underneath.
phrases.grey_evening: Evening guests at The Writers Bar look out over Jimbaran Bay, dark and quiet under the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner guests at Rumari look out at Jimbaran Bay, dark and blurred by tonight's rain.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud hides the stars tonight, and Jimbaran Bay is a dark curve of water below the hillside.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over Jimbaran Bay tonight, and the Indian Ocean beyond it is a wide dark space.
phrases.dusk: The sunset has just ended over Jimbaran Bay, and the water still holds some of its colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Diamond Head is a dark shape at the end of Waikiki Beach, and the sky behind it is just starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the sand of Waikiki Beach, and Diamond Head stands clear against a blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Pacific Ocean is turquoise near Waikiki Beach and deep blue further out.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Diamond Head this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the crater.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From their lanais, guests look down at the orchid in the pool, made of 1.2 million glass tiles, and then out to Waikiki Beach under passing clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns silver, and Diamond Head keeps its clear outline at the end of Waikiki Beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Diamond Head today, and the line between the Pacific Ocean and the sky is difficult to find.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Diamond Head is not visible today; guests see the near part of Waikiki Beach and the first lines of waves.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Waikiki Beach; guests in the suites facing Diamond Head watch the crater turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second Diamond Head appears sharp against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Waikiki Beach, and guests watch from behind glass as Diamond Head turns white, hardly believing it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so every ridge of Diamond Head is easy to count from here.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, Waikiki Beach is nearly empty, and Diamond Head has the whole shore to itself.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the oceanfront pool and look at the Pacific Ocean from the water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, swimmers and surfboards fill the water off Waikiki Beach, with Diamond Head behind them all.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At House Without A Key, guests watch the sun drop toward the Pacific Ocean in a clear golden sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange and pink above the Pacific Ocean, and House Without A Key has the front seats.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights along Waikiki Beach curve toward Diamond Head, and the Pacific Ocean beside them is one wide grey field.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of Waikiki Beach shine blurred through the wet windows of the Royal Suite.
phrases.mild_night: From the lanais of the suites overlooking Waikiki Beach, guests follow the lights along the shore under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Pacific Ocean tonight, and Diamond Head stands black against them above the lights of Waikiki Beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Waikiki Beach is quiet, and only the faint white of the waves shows where the Pacific Ocean begins.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and from House Without A Key the sky over the Pacific Ocean is still bright while the first lights come on along Waikiki Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Ridge after ridge, the mountains show dark to the horizon as the first pale light arrives.
phrases.clear_morning: From SERRA, the Algarve mountains stand clear this morning, every slope easy to see.
phrases.clear_midday: At Pizzaria Serra, guests have the Algarve mountains in front of them, bright in the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: One ridge is in sun and the next in shade, all the way along the mountains to the horizon.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the Mezzanine Bar follow cloud shadows across the magnificent mountain scenery.
phrases.overcast: The Algarve mountains lie under one even layer of grey cloud today, with no shadows on them.
phrases.fog_haze: Each mountain is paler than the one in front of it today, as haze thins them out to the horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the Panoramic Balcony Suite, the farthest horizon is not visible today; guests see only the nearer mountains.
phrases.rain: Rain is crossing the Algarve mountains, and guests at SERRA watch it from their table.
phrases.thunderstorm: Each flash of lightning lights up the mountains to the horizon during this thunderstorm.
phrases.snow: Behind the glass of the Panoramic Terrace Suite, guests watch snow fall between them and the endless horizon.
phrases.very_cold: Guests keep warm in the Mezzanine Bar and look out at the magnificent mountain scenery in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: Too cold for outdoors, so guests at Pizzaria Serra admire the Algarve mountains from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: Guests cool off in the pool today and look up at the surrounding mountains.
phrases.warm: On a day like this, guests in the Panoramic Terrace Suite stay outside and look toward the endless horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Algarve mountains turn gold slope by slope as the sun gets lower.
phrases.partly_golden: Under the clouds, a last band of sun lights the mountains to the horizon, and guests in the Suite Monchique stop to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Seen from the tables of SERRA, the Algarve mountains are a darker shape under the evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: At Pizzaria Serra, guests stay dry tonight while rain falls on the dark Algarve mountains.
phrases.mild_night: The mountains run to the horizon as one long dark line tonight, with no stars above them.
phrases.clear_night: By starlight, guests in the Suite Monchique can still follow the mountains to the horizon.
phrases.late_night: The mountains to the horizon lie dark and still while the hotel sleeps.
phrases.dusk: The Algarve mountains become blue outlines while the sky behind them is still bright.
