phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over the Tagus River changes from black to deep blue, and the Vasco da Gama Bridge slowly takes shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the east-facing rooms open the curtains to the sun rising above the Vasco da Gama Bridge.
phrases.clear_midday: From 120 metres above the Tagus River, the full span of the Vasco da Gama Bridge is clear under a blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests exercising in the fitness centre watch cloud shadows move across the Tagus River and the Vasco da Gama Bridge.
phrases.partly_afternoon: White clouds drift over the Tagus River this afternoon, and the wide estuary changes between blue and silver.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Tagus River turns the colour of steel, and the Vasco da Gama Bridge crosses it as a thin pale line.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Tagus River today, and the Vasco da Gama Bridge seems to start in the water and end in nothing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far bank of the Tagus River is not visible today, and only the nearest part of the Vasco da Gama Bridge shows from the rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the fitness centre while guests look out at a grey Tagus River.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Tagus River, and for a second the whole Vasco da Gama Bridge stands out white against the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the windows of SAYANNA Wellness & Spa on the 23rd floor and disappears into the Tagus River far below.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing, bright day, guests warm up in the SAYANNA Wellness & Spa sauna and look through its glass wall at the Tagus River estuary.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass of their river-facing rooms and follow the Vasco da Gama Bridge across the Tagus River.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above the Tagus River, and the far end of the Vasco da Gama Bridge seems to melt into the sky.
phrases.warm: On a warm day the Tagus River shines in the light, and guests in the fitness centre find it difficult to keep their eyes on the workout.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in the jacuzzi at SAYANNA Wellness & Spa watch the low sun turn the Tagus River and the Lisbon waterfront gold.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Tagus River turn pink, and the calm water below copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: From a treatment room at SAYANNA Wellness & Spa, guests see the lights of the Lisbon waterfront glow under low evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the evening lights of the Vasco da Gama Bridge, and they stretch into long reflections on the Tagus River.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lit Vasco da Gama Bridge is a chain of lights across the dark Tagus River.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the east-facing rooms count the lights of the Vasco da Gama Bridge instead of sheep.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Tagus River is wide and still, and nothing moves on the water below the tower.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Tagus River, and the first lights appear along the Vasco da Gama Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Victoria Harbour is a band of dark water between Kowloon and Hong Kong Island, and the sky above it is starting to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the 103rd-floor reception, guests look over Kowloon and Victoria Harbour in clear morning light, and the Pearl River Delta shows beyond.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is clear, and guests in the harbour-view suites turn the room telescope towards the Pearl River Delta.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Kowloon this morning, while Victoria Harbour stays bright below the Club Lounge.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at The Lounge & Bar watch patches of sun and shade cross Victoria Harbour this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Victoria Harbour turns the colour of steel, and the Hong Kong Island skyline stands sharp behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Victoria Harbour today, and from the 103rd-floor reception the towers of Kowloon fade one by one into white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Pearl River Delta is not visible today; Victoria Harbour and the nearer streets of Kowloon still show clearly below.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch Victoria Harbour turn grey and blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over Kowloon, and from floors 102 to 118 of the tower guests watch lightning flash above Victoria Harbour.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the 103rd-floor reception, and Victoria Harbour is a faint grey shape behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, so guests in the harbour-view rooms point their telescopes at the hills behind the city skyline.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass of The Lounge & Bar and follow the grey-blue water of Victoria Harbour.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over Kowloon today, while guests look down on Victoria Harbour from the cool of the 103rd-floor reception.
phrases.warm: Victoria Harbour lies far below on this warm day, and from high in the 484-metre tower the whole of Kowloon looks like a model city.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Victoria Harbour gold, and the hills beyond the city skyline glow in the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests in the Club Lounge see the clouds over Victoria Harbour turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights of Kowloon spread out below, and guests at The Lounge & Bar take their cocktails facing Victoria Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain is falling this evening, and the lights across Victoria Harbour look soft through the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the suites look from the bathtub at the lit skyline around Victoria Harbour.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lights of Kowloon and Hong Kong Island frame the black water of Victoria Harbour.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Victoria Harbour is quiet and far below, and guests who cannot sleep have a telescope to pass the time.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on along both sides of Victoria Harbour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the CN Tower stands unlit against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale behind the downtown towers.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the glass towers along University Avenue, and the CN Tower rises clear above them.
phrases.clear_midday: The CN Tower stands sharp against a blue midday sky, high above the downtown skyscrapers.
phrases.partly_morning: Swimmers in the 20-metre pool look up between lengths at clouds moving over the city skyline this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the downtown towers this afternoon, and the CN Tower moves in and out of the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the glass towers along University Avenue take the same colour as the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the CN Tower today, and the downtown towers below it fade into grey.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so guests see the nearest towers on University Avenue and only a faint CN Tower.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the CN Tower looks blurred behind the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the CN Tower, and guests watch the storm cross the downtown towers from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on University Avenue, and the CN Tower shows only now and then through the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear, so guests in the warm 20-metre pool see every line of the city skyline.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the glass and follow University Avenue north to Queen's Park.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests sit on the terrace with wicker chairs and look across to the CN Tower among the skyscrapers.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the city skyline fills the floor-to-ceiling windows beside the pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last hour of light, guests in the suites watch the glass towers change colour from a deep soaking tub.
phrases.partly_golden: Low sun slips between the clouds and turns one side of the CN Tower gold above the darker towers.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds sit low over the city this evening, and the lit CN Tower glows softly through them.
phrases.wet_evening: From the yoga studio in the Health Club, guests watch the rain fall across the lit city skyline this evening.
phrases.mild_night: From the balcony of the presidential suite on the 17th floor, guests look over the lights of downtown under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the CN Tower is lit up, and guests in the suites see it from both bedroom and living room.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, University Avenue is quiet and almost empty below, a long straight line running south toward the CN Tower.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright behind the CN Tower, and guests in this 202-room hotel watch the first lights come on in the downtown towers.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Intracoastal Waterway lies still under a clear sky, and the yachts in the marina are quiet outlines.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Intracoastal Waterway, and guests at Garni start the day with breakfast and coastal views.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Intracoastal Waterway is bright blue and every boat in the marina is easy to count.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the marina this morning, and guests in the 3rd-floor fitness center watch their shadows cross the boats and palm trees.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move slowly along the Intracoastal Waterway this afternoon, and the white yachts turn bright again each time the sun returns.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Intracoastal Waterway takes the same colour, and the white yachts stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Intracoastal Waterway today, and the masts in the marina look like pencil lines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The city skyline is not visible today; guests see the marina below and the near part of the Intracoastal Waterway.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Intracoastal Waterway, and guests in rooms facing the marina watch the decks of the yachts shine.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Intracoastal Waterway, and for a second every yacht in the marina shows white under the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the marina, and guests watch the flakes disappear into the Intracoastal Waterway.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, the Intracoastal Waterway is sharp and bright, and guests look at the marina from behind warm glass.
phrases.cold: The Intracoastal Waterway looks clean and clear on this cold day, with only a few boats moving past the marina.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the shade and watch the Intracoastal Waterway shine white around the yachts.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests look out over the marina, where boats move slowly along the Intracoastal Waterway.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From waterway-view suites, guests watch the low sun turn the Intracoastal Waterway to gold around the marina.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests at Pier Top watch orange clouds over the Intracoastal Waterway as the 17th-floor lounge turns.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at Pier Top watch the city lights and the Intracoastal Waterway pass slowly by the windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows at Pier Top this evening, and the lights of the marina blur as the lounge turns.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the marina lights make long reflections on the Intracoastal Waterway.
phrases.clear_night: At Pier Top, guests need only one cocktail and a little patience: under a clear night sky, the Intracoastal Waterway comes around again.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Intracoastal Waterway is dark and calm, and the yachts in the marina do not move.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from Pier Top, reopened in 2024, guests watch the first lights come on in the marina.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Ringstrasse lies quiet, and the roof of the Vienna State Opera slowly takes shape against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the facade of the Vienna State Opera, and guests on the 5th and 6th-floor balconies find St Stephen's Cathedral beyond the roofline.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the green copper roof of the Vienna State Opera is bright under a clear sky, every detail sharp from across the street.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the gym run this morning with the Vienna State Opera in front of them, while clouds move across its roof.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the Ringstrasse this afternoon, and the Vienna State Opera facade and the equestrian statue go from bright to grey and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the stone facade of the Vienna State Opera takes a quieter colour, and its copper roof looks greener.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so St Stephen's Cathedral is only a faint shape while the Vienna State Opera stays close and clear.
phrases.reduced_visibility: St Stephen's Cathedral is not visible beyond the roofline today, and guests look instead at the Vienna State Opera across the street.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Ringstrasse, and guests watch it run down the copper roof of the Vienna State Opera.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Vienna State Opera roof for a second, and thunder rolls along the Ringstrasse below.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Vienna State Opera, and guests watch its green roof turn white, flake by flake.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, St Stephen's Cathedral stands clear on the horizon beyond the roofline, and guests look at it from indoors.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the gym is a warm place to look at the Vienna State Opera, and running is optional.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests look across the Ringstrasse at the Vienna State Opera, bright under the sun.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit on the 5th and 6th-floor balconies, where the Vienna State Opera fills the view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the facade of the Vienna State Opera golden, and the St Stephen's Cathedral silhouette stands on the horizon behind it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds, and guests on the rooftop balcony see it catch the green copper cupola and its Austrian flag.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit Vienna State Opera glows across the street, and car lights follow the curve of the Ringstrasse.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Vienna State Opera shine on the Ringstrasse below, and guests watch from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in this 1884 building look out tonight at the lit Vienna State Opera under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: The Vienna State Opera is lit against a clear night sky, and guests in the Opera Suites see every arch of its facade.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Ringstrasse is nearly empty, and the Vienna State Opera stands quiet across the street.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind St Stephen's Cathedral, and the first lights come on along the facade of the Vienna State Opera.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Bosphorus Strait is a quiet band of dark water below Gümüşsuyu Hill, and the sky above the Asian shore is only starting to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Bosphorus-view rooms open the curtains to a clear morning, with the Bosphorus Strait bright blue below the hill.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop Istanbul Terrace Restaurant, the Bosphorus Strait curves under a clear midday sky, and every ship on it is easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Bosphorus Strait this morning, while the Asian shore stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at Hezarfen S Lounge watch patches of sun and shade take turns on the Bosphorus Strait this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the Bosphorus Strait turns the colour of steel, and a ship moves through it without hurry.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Bosphorus Strait today, and the suspension bridge fades in and out of it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Asian shore is not visible today; guests see the near water of the Bosphorus Strait and little beyond it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Bosphorus Strait, and guests at Hezarfen S Lounge watch it blur the far side of the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Bosphorus Strait, and for a second guests at the windows see the whole curve of water in white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Gümüşsuyu Hill, and guests in the terrace suites watch the flakes drift down towards the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, so the Bosphorus Strait looks sharp and the Asian shore seems closer than usual.
phrases.cold: On this cold day guests keep their seats at Hezarfen S Lounge, where the Bosphorus Strait stretches out below them.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Bosphorus Strait, and guests on the rooftop terrace look at the water from under the red umbrella.
phrases.warm: On this warm day guests sit in the open air at Istanbul Terrace Restaurant and look across the Bosphorus Strait to the Asian shore.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Bosphorus Strait gold, and from Istanbul Terrace Restaurant the suspension bridge stands out against the clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lays orange stripes on the Bosphorus Strait, and a cargo ship sails across them.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Istanbul Terrace Restaurant has a cloudy sky tonight, but the lights along the Bosphorus Strait shine clearly below.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening the lights of the Asian shore blur and stretch across the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in this hotel of 453 rooms look out on a mild, cloudy night, with the Bosphorus Strait holding the glow of the city.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky the suspension bridge is lit above the Bosphorus Strait, and guests at dinner at Istanbul Terrace Restaurant keep turning towards it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Bosphorus Strait is quiet, and a guest awake at the window finds the water dark and still.
phrases.dusk: On the site of the old Park Hotel, guests watch the first lights come on along the Bosphorus Strait under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Taurus Mountains form a dark shape across the still Mediterranean Sea.
phrases.clear_morning: The Mediterranean Sea is bright blue this morning, and the Taurus Mountains stand clear across the bay.
phrases.clear_midday: From LANTHE, perched above the water, lunch guests look over the Mediterranean Sea to the Taurus Mountains under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly over the Mediterranean Sea this morning, while the Taurus Mountains stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the deck, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they gather over the Taurus Mountains across the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Mediterranean Sea turns the colour of slate below the limestone cliffs.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Mediterranean Sea today, and the Taurus Mountains are only a faint outline across the bay.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Taurus Mountains are not visible today; guests see the Mediterranean Sea below the cliffs and the nearest rocky coves.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Mediterranean Sea, and guests at LANTHE watch the Taurus Mountains disappear behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the Taurus Mountains, and guests watch the storm cross the Mediterranean Sea from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Mediterranean Sea, and the Taurus Mountains are hidden behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the snow on the Taurus Mountains shines across the blue water.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look from the balcony rooms at the Mediterranean Sea, with the Taurus Mountains sharp behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In the cabanas at Lanthe Beach, guests stay in the shade and look out at the green-blue Mediterranean Sea.
phrases.warm: At Lanthe Beach, guests lie in the sun with the green-blue Mediterranean Sea right in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Mediterranean Sea gold, and the Taurus Mountains glow across the bay from the terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and guests on the deck see the Taurus Mountains turn pink.
phrases.grey_evening: Over dinner at LANTHE, guests look out at the Mediterranean Sea, almost black under the evening clouds.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows at LANTHE this evening, and the Mediterranean Sea is only a dark space behind it.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Mediterranean Sea shows only as a faint movement below the cliffs.
phrases.clear_night: From the rooftop terrace of a Grace Penthouse, guests see stars above the Mediterranean Sea on this clear night.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Mediterranean Sea is quiet and dark below the limestone cliffs.
phrases.dusk: From the rooftop hot tub of a Grace Penthouse, guests see the Taurus Mountains go dark against the bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky begins to pale above Palazzo Pisani-Moretto, and the Grand Canal below this 19th-century palazzo waits for its first boat.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast in the wood-panelled breakfast room has a quiet view this clear morning, with sunlight on the side canal outside its windows.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests at American Bar count the gondolas passing on the Grand Canal.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Grand Canal this morning, and their shadows cross the front of Palazzo Pisani-Moretto one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony suites, guests follow the Grand Canal as sun and cloud take turns on the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Grand Canal takes the colour of the clouds, and only the passing boats add colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Grand Canal today, and Palazzo Pisani-Moretto on the other bank looks like a drawing half rubbed out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the far bends of the Grand Canal are not visible, and guests see only the water and the palaces nearest to them.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Grand Canal with small rings, and guests in the canal-facing rooms watch them from behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Grand Canal for a second, and guests in the canal-facing rooms wait at the window for the next flash.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Grand Canal and melts as it touches the water, while the roofs across the canal slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the bar terrace stays empty, but the Grand Canal beside it is sharp and bright in the cold air.
phrases.cold: A cold day suits the windows of American Bar, where guests keep warm and watch the water buses work along the Grand Canal.
phrases.very_hot: Guests on the small bar terrace sit right at the edge of the Grand Canal, where the strong heat makes the water glitter.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests take the tables on the bar terrace, and gondolas go by on the Grand Canal beside them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light lies along the Grand Canal, and from the balcony suites guests watch it warm the palaces towards the Rialto Bridge.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and patches of gold move across the Grand Canal between the boats.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and guests at American Bar watch the lights of Palazzo Pisani-Moretto shake on the Grand Canal.
phrases.wet_evening: It is a wet evening on the Grand Canal, and the lights of the far bank blur into long lines on the water.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the suites facing the Grand Canal leave the curtains open for the lamps along the water.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the Grand Canal on this clear night, and a late water bus crosses the reflections of the palace lights.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Grand Canal goes quiet, and the water lies flat and black between the sleeping palaces.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lamps come on along the Grand Canal outside the leaded windows of American Bar.

phrases.clear_predawn: The first pale light of the day shows the Eiffel Tower as a thin black outline.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Eiffel Tower Suite wake to the tower standing sharp in the early light.
phrases.clear_midday: The Eiffel Tower shows every beam and platform in the clear light of midday.
phrases.partly_morning: Sun and shade take turns on the Eiffel Tower this morning as the clouds move on.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the Cambronne Suite, guests see the afternoon light come and go as clouds pass outside.
