phrases.dusk: From the American Bar at dusk, the distant lights along the lakeshore seem to rest upon the water of Lake Garda.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Guanabara Bay is a calm grey sheet below the hilltop, and the first light is only a thin band above it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the rooftops of Santa Teresa first, then spreads across Guanabara Bay below the hilltop.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Guanabara Bay is bright blue beyond the neighbourhood rooftops and the spire of the Santa Teresa de Jesus Church.
phrases.partly_morning: Over breakfast at Térèze, guests watch cloud shadows cross the treetops of Santa Teresa through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the mountains this afternoon, while the city and Guanabara Bay stay in patches of sun below the Pool Lounge.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Guanabara Bay turns the colour of slate, and the neighbourhood rooftops stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers Guanabara Bay today, so the church spire and the nearest rooftops are the clearest things in sight from the pool.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guanabara Bay is not visible from the hilltop today; the view stops at the rooftops and treetops of Santa Teresa.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of Térèze, and the treetops of Santa Teresa shine dark green behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Guanabara Bay for a second at a time, and guests watch the storm cross the city from behind glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftops of Santa Teresa, and guests at the pool watch it drift down towards Guanabara Bay.
phrases.very_cold: The air is sharp and very clear on the hilltop, and every rooftop between the pool deck and Guanabara Bay stands out.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the tall windows of Térèze and look out at the treetops of Santa Teresa.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool up to their shoulders and look out over the city to Guanabara Bay.
phrases.warm: By the pool, books stay closed while guests look down at the rooftops of Santa Teresa and Guanabara Bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At the Pool Lounge, guests hold late-afternoon drinks while the low sun turns the city and Guanabara Bay gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in long beams, and the rooftops and Guanabara Bay change colour minute by minute.
phrases.grey_evening: From the pool area, city lights spread down the hillside under a cloudy evening sky, and Guanabara Bay beyond them has gone dark.
phrases.wet_evening: At dinner in Térèze, guests see the city lights through wet windows, each one blurred by the rain.
phrases.mild_night: From the room terraces, the lights of the neighbourhoods below shine under a mild, cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the city lights reach the edge of Guanabara Bay, sharp and bright from the pool area.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the hillside of Santa Teresa is quiet outside the windows, and Guanabara Bay cannot be told from the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Guanabara Bay just after sunset, and the first lights come on among the neighbourhood rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Santorini Caldera is a wide dark bowl of water, and the volcano in the middle is only a shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Santorini Caldera, and the water turns bright blue around the volcano.
phrases.clear_midday: The volcano stands sharp in the middle of the Santorini Caldera at midday, every fold of its rock clear across the open water.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Santorini Caldera this morning, and the volcano goes from dark to light as they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace of the Mill Haven Suite, set in a traditional windmill, guests look over Oia and the Santorini Caldera under passing clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Santorini Caldera turns the colour of slate, and the volcano looks darker than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Santorini Caldera today, and the volcano seems to float with no water under it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: the near water of the Santorini Caldera is visible, and the volcano across it is faint.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Santorini Caldera; guests watch it from the open doors of their suites, the volcano blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Santorini Caldera for a second, the volcano included, and then the thunder rolls across the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Santorini Caldera, and the flakes disappear into the grey water far below the cliffs.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear, and the cliffs of the Santorini Caldera show every layer of their rock.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Santorini Caldera lies still under the cliffs, and the volcano sits alone across the open water.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the infinity pool, with only their heads above water, facing the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the open terrace by the pool leave their books closed and look at the volcano in the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light fills the Santorini Caldera, and the white terraces of the 42 suites and villas turn warm with it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in bands, and guests on their private terraces watch it cross the Santorini Caldera.
phrases.grey_evening: At Lure Restaurant, dinner is served above the Santorini Caldera, where clouds hide the stars and village lights mark the cliffs.
phrases.wet_evening: At Lure Restaurant, guests watch the evening rain fall over the Santorini Caldera, and the lights on the far cliffs shine through it in small wet points.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Santorini Caldera lies dark below the cliff, with a few lights around its edge.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the sky over the Santorini Caldera tonight, and guests look for the volcano, a black island on black water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Santorini Caldera is silent and almost invisible, and the volcano keeps its own counsel.
phrases.dusk: From Lure Restaurant, guests watch the sky stay bright over the volcano while the first lights appear around the Santorini Caldera.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Karon Noi bay is quiet and grey-blue, and the Andaman Sea beyond is only a little lighter than the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Karon Noi beach, and guests in upper-floor rooms see the whole bay turn turquoise.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Andaman Sea is turquoise near the sand and deep blue further out.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Karon Noi bay this morning, while the forested headland stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace, the afternoon clouds drift slowly out over the Andaman Sea, with patches of sun on the water between them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Karon Noi bay loses its turquoise, and the sand of the beach is the brightest thing in sight.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the line between the Andaman Sea and the sky today, so Karon Noi bay seems to end in white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The open Andaman Sea is not visible today; from the terrace, only Karon Noi beach and the near water of the bay can be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Karon Noi bay; guests watch it from upper-floor rooms as the sea turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Andaman Sea, and guests stay indoors to watch the storm cross Karon Noi bay.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Karon Noi bay, and guests look twice as white flakes land on the palm trees.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Andaman Sea shows a sharp horizon beyond the empty Karon Noi beach.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in balcony rooms keep the doors closed and look at Karon Noi bay through the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on Karon Noi beach stay under the palm trees and look out at the bright, still Andaman Sea.
phrases.warm: On the terrace, guests lie on the loungers above the sand, with Karon Noi bay and the forested headland in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Andaman Sea gold, and guests in upper-floor rooms see the light reach right across Karon Noi bay.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Andaman Sea turn orange and pink, and the water of Karon Noi bay copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the Andaman Sea is black, and the resort lights show the pale edge of Karon Noi beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and from the terrace guests watch it shine in the resort lights above Karon Noi bay.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, and Karon Noi bay is a quiet curve of dark water below the resort.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the Andaman Sea tonight, and guests look for the horizon without finding it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Karon Noi bay is still, and only the white of small waves marks where the beach begins.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky above the Andaman Sea is still bright, and the first lights come on around Karon Noi bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Melbourne skyline is a row of dark towers under a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the glass towers of the Melbourne skyline, clear in every detail from the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_midday: From the gym, guests on the treadmills look out at the city towers under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Melbourne skyline this morning, and one tower after another comes back into the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the skyline view rooms stand close to the glass this afternoon to catch a glimpse of the Yarra River between cloud shadows.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Melbourne skyline turns the same grey, and Eureka Tower stands a little darker than the rest.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Melbourne skyline today, and the far towers look like faint pencil drawings.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The nearest towers of the Melbourne skyline are clear today, but the parklands and the distant bay cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch the Melbourne skyline blur behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Melbourne skyline, and for a second every tower stands out sharp and white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Melbourne, and guests stand at the glass to watch the flakes drift past the city towers.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear today, and every edge of the Melbourne skyline looks sharp from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the gym warm up on the treadmills with the city towers in front of them.
phrases.very_hot: Heat lies over the city today, and from the rooftop pool the towers of the Melbourne skyline shimmer in the hot air.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the skyline view rooms on the top floor show the city, the parklands and the distant bay in bright light.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At The Q on the 28th floor, guests watch the low sun turn the Melbourne skyline gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds, and from The Q guests see the city towers turn orange one by one.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit windows of the Melbourne skyline glow, and the low clouds take some of their colour.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests keep to the indoor seats at The Q and look at the city lights through the rain on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hang low over the Melbourne skyline tonight, and the tops of the lit towers reach up into them.
phrases.clear_night: The Melbourne skyline shines under a clear night sky, and guests can count the lit floors of each tower.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Melbourne skyline is quiet, and guests who cannot sleep have all its towers to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and guests in this 2021 hotel watch the first lights come on across the Melbourne skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Corniche lies almost empty below, its long curve just showing against the dark Arabian Gulf.
phrases.clear_morning: In the King View rooms, guests open the curtains to a blue Arabian Gulf and the Presidential Palace in full morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: The Corniche is clear from end to end at this hour, with the city skyline in the distance behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the King Palace View rooms watch cloud shadows slide across the Abu Dhabi skyline, one tower at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Emirates Palace goes in and out of the sun this afternoon, while the Corniche below stays bright.
phrases.overcast: From the King View rooms, guests see the Presidential Palace standing pale under a low grey ceiling of cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: The towers of the Corniche skyline fade one by one into the haze, the nearest still clear.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests in the King Palace View rooms can make out the nearest towers today, but the rest of the Abu Dhabi skyline is not visible.
phrases.rain: Wet and shining, the Corniche curves away below the glass while rain blurs the Arabian Gulf beyond it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the King View rooms have a front seat for the storm, with lightning breaking over the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Corniche, turning the long curve of the road white beside a grey Arabian Gulf.
phrases.very_cold: Qasr Al Watan stands sharp in the cold, clear air, a view to enjoy from behind the glass.
phrases.cold: Guests in the King View rooms are happy to stay in today, with the Arabian Gulf and the Presidential Palace both in view from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, swimmers at the pool stay in the water and look out over the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.warm: Walkers fill the Corniche below, small as dots from this height, with the Arabian Gulf beside them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Gold light climbs the towers of the Corniche skyline, and the Arabian Gulf beside them turns to copper.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests in the King Palace View rooms see the Abu Dhabi skyline turn pink where the last sun gets through the clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: Emirates Palace is lit for the evening, and the Corniche below has become a ribbon of lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain is falling on the Corniche this evening, and its street lights shine back from the wet road.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the lights of the Corniche lead towards the city skyline in the distance.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Corniche looks like a necklace of lights laid along the edge of the black Arabian Gulf.
phrases.late_night: A few cars still pass along the Corniche, and the Arabian Gulf beyond it is dark and still.
phrases.dusk: The Corniche switches on lamp by lamp, while the Arabian Gulf still holds the last brightness of the day.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sky Tower is a thin dark shape against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of the Sky Tower first, and guests in the Club Lounge watch the light move down it.
phrases.clear_midday: The Sky Tower stands sharp against a clear blue sky, straight to the north of the balcony suites.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift behind the Sky Tower this morning, and from the Club Lounge it seems to be the tower that moves.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the city skyline this afternoon, while the Sky Tower stays in the sun above them.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Sky Tower is almost the same colour as the clouds behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Sky Tower today, so guests in the Club Lounge see a tower with no end.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; the Sky Tower is still easy to see, but the far city skyline behind it is not.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the city skyline; guests in the Club Lounge see the Sky Tower through it, slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Club Lounge watch lightning flash behind the Sky Tower, safely on the dry side of the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling around the Sky Tower, and guests stay close to the glass to watch the flakes pass it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Sky Tower shows every line against the bright sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the balcony suites keep the doors closed and look at the Sky Tower from the warm side.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Sky Tower shines white against the sky, and the city skyline below it shimmers.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the balcony suites sit outside with the Sky Tower directly in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns one side of the Sky Tower gold, and guests in the Club Lounge stop talking to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights the Sky Tower, while the city skyline is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Sky Tower gives the low sky a soft glow above the city skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of the Sky Tower stretch into long streaks on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests in the balcony suites see the lit Sky Tower rise into the low cloud.
phrases.clear_night: The Sky Tower is lit against a clear black sky, a bright line standing above the city skyline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and the Sky Tower stands alone against the night sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset as the first lights come on along the Sky Tower and the city skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Osaka Bay is a wide, still surface under a clear sky, and the first grey light shows where the water ends.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Osaka Bay under a clear sky, and guests in the Sky Floor rooms can follow the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge along the western horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: Osaka Bay lies bright blue under the midday sun, open all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Osaka Bay this morning, and guests at the high-floor restaurant windows watch them drift towards the skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From 51 floors up, guests see the afternoon sun break through the clouds and brighten one part of Osaka Bay at a time.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Osaka Bay turns the colour of steel, and the city skyline stands sharp against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over Osaka Bay today, and the horizon fades into it long before guests can find it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Akashi Kaikyo Bridge is not visible today; guests see the near water of Osaka Bay and the closest streets of the city.
phrases.rain: Rain crosses Osaka Bay in grey curtains, and guests watch each one arrive at the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Osaka Bay, and for a second guests see the whole water surface lit white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Osaka Bay, and guests in the Sky Floor rooms watch the flakes drift past the glass towards the water.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests stay behind the glass and look across Osaka Bay to the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge in the west.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the high-floor restaurant is a warm place to look over the city skyline to the distant mountains behind it.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the city, and Osaka Bay looks cooler than any street between here and the water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the Sky Floor rooms look over the dense cityscape to the open water of Osaka Bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns Osaka Bay gold, and the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge draws a thin line on the western horizon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over Osaka Bay turn orange and red, and guests at the high-floor restaurant put down their phones only after the photo.
phrases.grey_evening: At the bar, guests look through floor-to-ceiling windows at the city lights of Osaka glowing under a low cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at the high-floor restaurant has a wet view tonight, with the port lights of Osaka Bay blurred through the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, so the port lights around Osaka Bay do the job instead.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night 200 m above the ground, guests see the city lights spread out to the dark edge of Osaka Bay.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Osaka Bay is quiet and black, and guests who are still awake have the wide water to themselves.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Osaka Bay is still orange-red, and the first port lights begin to reflect on the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Las Ramblas lies almost empty, and the Church of Bethlehem waits in grey light on the adjacent corner.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the stone front of the Church of Bethlehem, seen directly across Las Ramblas from the 6th-floor balconies.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop infinity pool, the roofs of the old city spread out under a clear sky, with the Cathedral of Barcelona standing above them.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Gothic Quarter this morning, and their shadows cross the rooftops one after another below the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and shade take turns on the Cathedral of Barcelona this afternoon, as seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Church of Bethlehem shows every detail of its stone entrance to the rooms that face it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the roofscape today, and from the rooftop the Cathedral of Barcelona looks like a pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far rooftops are not visible from the rooftop terrace today, so the view ends at the nearest roofs of the Gothic Quarter.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Las Ramblas, and guests on the 6th floor watch a slow river of umbrellas pass the Church of Bethlehem.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the old city, and each flash of lightning shows the Church of Bethlehem across Las Ramblas for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Las Ramblas, and it settles lightly on the Church of Bethlehem across the street.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the rooftops of the Gothic Quarter look sharp and clear from the rooftop terrace, and nobody is in the pool.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, people on Las Ramblas walk fast in their coats past the Church of Bethlehem.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stand in the rooftop infinity pool with their arms on the edge and look across the roofs to the Cathedral of Barcelona.
phrases.warm: At the rooftop tapas bar, guests sit in the warm air and look over the roofs of the Gothic Quarter.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Church of Bethlehem golden, and guests on the 6th-floor terraces look at it across Las Ramblas.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and catches the Cathedral of Barcelona, while the rooftop pool is already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the street lamps of Las Ramblas light the crowd in front of the Church of Bethlehem.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain keeps falling this evening, and the lights of Las Ramblas shine back from the wet pavement.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, late walkers on Las Ramblas still pass the Church of Bethlehem in small groups.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit Cathedral of Barcelona rises above the dark roofs around the rooftop terrace.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Las Ramblas is finally quiet, and the Church of Bethlehem has the street corner almost to itself.
phrases.dusk: From the rooftop of El Regulador, a building of 1850, guests see the first lights come on across the roofs under a still bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Mediterranean Sea is flat and grey-blue below the rooftop sun deck, and the sky grows pale above the Taurus Mountains.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the snow on the Taurus Mountains, clear above the treeline from the rooftop sun deck.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop sun deck, the open Mediterranean Sea runs to a clean horizon under a blue midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Taurus Mountains this morning, while the Mediterranean Sea stays bright in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Mediterranean Sea this afternoon, easy to follow from the terrace with the red woven chairs.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Mediterranean Sea turns the colour of steel, and the pier stands out clearly against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Mediterranean Sea today, and water and sky share one colour where the horizon should be.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Taurus Mountains are not visible today; the view from the rooftop sun deck ends at the treeline and the near Mediterranean Sea.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Mediterranean Sea, and guests in the sea-view rooms watch grey water blur into grey sky.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Mediterranean Sea, and guests watch the storm cross the water from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the beach, and guests watch the flakes disappear into the grey Mediterranean Sea.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, so the snowfields of the Taurus Mountains look close enough to count.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the wooden loungers on the rooftop sun deck stand empty before a calm Mediterranean Sea.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the beach loungers stay under the umbrellas and look out at the turquoise Mediterranean Sea.
phrases.warm: On the rooftop sun deck, books stay closed while guests on the wooden loungers look from the Mediterranean Sea to the Taurus Mountains.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Mediterranean Sea gold, and the sandy coastline glows below the curved rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds turn pink above the Mediterranean Sea, and the snow on the Taurus Mountains takes the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening is cloudy, and the Mediterranean Sea is a wide dark surface beyond the lights of the beach.
phrases.wet_evening: The wet evening hides the horizon, and guests hear the Mediterranean Sea from their balconies more than they see it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds cover the stars and the Mediterranean Sea shows only a faint line of white where waves reach the sand.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Mediterranean Sea tonight, and guests with a balcony hot tub have the warmest seat for them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Mediterranean Sea is black and quiet, and the beach lies empty beside it.
phrases.dusk: A few minutes after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Mediterranean Sea, and the first lights come on along the beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Amstel River is a quiet band between the rooftops, seen from the high-floor rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Amstel River first, and the church towers of Amsterdam stand sharp against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Amstelkanaal, the Rembrandt Tower and the Munttoren share one frame.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the roofs of De Pijp this morning, and the Amstel River shines between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the high-floor rooms watch sun and cloud take turns over the Amstel River this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Amstelkanaal takes the same colour, and the Rembrandt Tower stands above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Amsterdam today, and from Twenty Third Bar the church towers look like pencil marks.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far edge of the city is not visible today, but guests can still follow the Amstel River below.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Amstelkanaal, and guests watch the drops run down their floor-to-ceiling suite windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses Amsterdam, and lightning shows the Rembrandt Tower for a second above the wet rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the rooftops of De Pijp, and the Amstelkanaal draws a dark line through the white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, guests stay warm on the 23rd floor and study the Amstel River from above.
phrases.cold: Cold, clean air makes the Munttoren easy to find today among the church towers of Amsterdam.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the Amstel River looks cool from above, and guests count the boats on it.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, small boats move along the Amstelkanaal, and guests follow them from 23 floors up.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Amstel River gold, and the church towers of Amsterdam throw long shadows over the roofs.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over De Pijp turn pink above the Amstelkanaal.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at Twenty Third Bar look over the lights of Amsterdam with a drink in hand.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights along the Amstel River blur in the windows of Twenty Third Bar.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the city lights follow the Amstelkanaal, and low cloud glows above De Pijp.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night at Twenty Third Bar, drinks wait while guests trace the Amstel River through the city lights.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who cannot sleep find the Amstel River still and De Pijp quiet below.
phrases.dusk: At dusk, the first lights come on along the Amstel River and repeat themselves in the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Elliott Bay is still and dark, with Smith Tower and Columbia Center as two tall outlines on either side.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Elliott Bay, and guests waking beside the wall-to-wall window see the water before anything else.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Elliott Bay is bright blue between Smith Tower and Columbia Center.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Elliott Bay this morning, while the port stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests look up from their tablets as patches of sun and shade cross Elliott Bay this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Elliott Bay turns the colour of steel, and Columbia Center stands darker beside it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits low on Elliott Bay today, and guests see Smith Tower fade slowly into it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Elliott Bay is not visible today; guests see the near water, the port and the two towers.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the wall-to-wall window, and behind it Elliott Bay is a soft grey blur.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Elliott Bay, and for a second Smith Tower and Columbia Center stand out sharply against the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Elliott Bay, and guests watch the flakes disappear into the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, clear day, Elliott Bay looks sharp and blue, and guests are happy to admire it from a warm bed by the window.
phrases.cold: From the lobby, guests look through floor-to-ceiling windows at a cold day on the Pioneer Square streetscape.
phrases.very_hot: Heat makes the air shimmer above Elliott Bay, and guests look at the water with some envy.
phrases.warm: Warm light lies on Elliott Bay today, and the water looks calm all the way to the port.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Elliott Bay gold, and guests stop what they are doing to look.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Elliott Bay turn pink and orange, and the port glows below them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit windows of Columbia Center shine above a dark Elliott Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Elliott Bay this evening, and guests see the lights of the port blur at the water's edge.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests see the glow of the city reflected in the clouds over Elliott Bay.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear over Elliott Bay, with Smith Tower lit on one side and Columbia Center on the other.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Elliott Bay is quiet and black, and guests who cannot sleep have the water for company.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over Elliott Bay is still bright, and guests in the lobby see the first lights come on in the Pioneer Square streetscape.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Table Mountain is a flat-topped outline against a clear sky that is just starting to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the cliffs of Table Mountain, framed since 2009 by the triple-height windows of the lobby.
phrases.clear_midday: Table Mountain stands sharp against a clear midday sky, and guests crossing the lobby stop to look before they reach the desk.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift across the top of Table Mountain this morning, while the yachts in the marina stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests take afternoon tea at Vista Bar & Lounge while cloud shadows move slowly across Table Mountain.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Table Mountain turns the colour of slate, and the water of the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront lies flat and silver below.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Table Mountain today, and from Vista Bar & Lounge its cliffs look like a watercolour behind the glass.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Table Mountain is hidden today; guests see the marina and the nearest buildings of the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront, and little beyond them.
phrases.rain: Guests in the lobby watch rain run down the tall windows, with Table Mountain grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in Vista Bar & Lounge watch lightning flash over Table Mountain, safely on the dry side of the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront, and Table Mountain fades in and out behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and every ridge of Table Mountain shows above the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront.
phrases.cold: Guests in the Table Mountain Suite watch the cold day from the bathtub, which faces the mountain through oversized glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests in the island suites sit in the shade of their terraces, the marina bright beyond the palms.
phrases.warm: On a warm day the balconies fill up, and guests sit outside with the marina below and Table Mountain ahead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: On Vista Deck, guests hold a glass of champagne as the sun dips behind Table Mountain.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun turns the clouds above Table Mountain orange, and the marina water below copies them.
phrases.grey_evening: Evening cloud sits low over Table Mountain, and guests at Vista Bar & Lounge turn from it to the lights of the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront this evening into long streaks on the wet marina.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy; Table Mountain has vanished into the sky, and the lit Victoria & Alfred Waterfront has the view to itself.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the seven-storey crescent of the building faces Table Mountain, a black block under the stars with the city lights at its foot.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront is quiet, the yachts sit still in the marina, and Table Mountain waits for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind Table Mountain just after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before the sun is up, the Burj Khalifa shows as a dark needle above the Dubai skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: At Il Caffè, breakfast guests face a marina already bright with sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Lunch guests at Il Ristorante Niko Romito look over the marina, its water flat and blue at this hour.
phrases.partly_morning: A few small clouds drift past the top of the Burj Khalifa while the Arabian Gulf below stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Hōseki, guests at lunch watch patches of sun and shade move across the Dubai skyline.
phrases.overcast: The Burj Khalifa rises into grey cloud today, above a sea of the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Only a pale outline of the Burj Khalifa shows through the haze over the Arabian Gulf today.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Burj Khalifa is not visible in today's dull air, so the view ends at the beach and the sea.
phrases.rain: At The Bulgari Bar, guests watch the rain make rings on the marina water.
phrases.thunderstorm: For a second at a time, lightning draws the Burj Khalifa against the storm clouds over the Gulf.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach, and guests indoors take photos to show friends at home.
phrases.very_cold: Empty beach, bright sea, and the Burj Khalifa sharp on the far side: a view best enjoyed from indoors today.
phrases.cold: Nobody at Hōseki hurries to leave, with the Dubai skyline spread out beyond the glass.
phrases.very_hot: Swimmers cool off in the Arabian Gulf while the Burj Khalifa shimmers across the water.
phrases.warm: Guests on the beach keep turning from the sea to look at the Burj Khalifa.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The glass of the Burj Khalifa shines gold in the late sun, high above the rest of the Dubai skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: At The Bulgari Bar, the marina turns pink as the last sun slips between the clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner guests at Il Ristorante Niko Romito see the marina lights doubled in the still water.
phrases.wet_evening: At Hōseki, dinner guests see the lights of the Dubai skyline run together in tonight's rain.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the lit Burj Khalifa disappears into low cloud partway up, leaving guests to guess the rest.
phrases.clear_night: Guests see the Burj Khalifa as one bright line above the Dubai skyline tonight.
phrases.late_night: While most guests sleep, the Burj Khalifa keeps watch as a tall dark shape across the sea.
phrases.dusk: Lights come on around the marina while the water still holds some pink from the sunset.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, St. Mark's Campanile is a dark shape above the Venetian rooftops, and the sky behind it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the upper-floor rooms wake to St. Mark's Campanile under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is clear blue, and St. Mark's Campanile stands sharp above the Venetian rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: From the spa's gold mosaic pool, guests watch morning clouds drift over the Venetian rooftops.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the Venetian rooftops this afternoon, and St. Mark's Campanile goes from bright to dull and back again.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, St. Mark's Campanile still rises clearly above the Venetian rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken the top of St. Mark's Campanile today, and guests on the upper floors see only the nearest rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: the nearest Venetian rooftops are easy to see, but St. Mark's Campanile is only a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the Venetian rooftops, and guests watch it from the gold mosaic pool, already wet and quite happy about it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows St. Mark's Campanile for a second above the rooftops, then the storm hides it again.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the Venetian rooftops, and St. Mark's Campanile looks grey behind the falling flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing day, guests look over the Venetian rooftops from the spa's gold mosaic pool and feel no need to go outside.
phrases.cold: In the cold air, every line of St. Mark's Campanile is easy to follow above the Venetian rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat the Venetian rooftops seem to shimmer, and guests in the gold mosaic pool watch them without hurry.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests open their terrace doors onto the heart of Venice, with St. Mark's Campanile above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun turns St. Mark's Campanile gold, a good match for the mosaic pool where guests are watching the rooftops.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights St. Mark's Campanile, while the rooftops below are already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Venice glow across the rooftops, and St. Mark's Campanile rises among them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening the Venetian rooftops shine under the city lights, and guests watch from the windows of a 1929 building.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and St. Mark's Campanile stands quietly over the Venetian rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Venice tonight, and guests can still find St. Mark's Campanile above the rooftops.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Venetian rooftops are still, and St. Mark's Campanile keeps watch over a sleeping city.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, the first lights appear across the Venetian rooftops, and St. Mark's Campanile darkens against it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Bangkok skyline is a row of dark towers behind the still water of the 18th-floor infinity pool.
phrases.clear_morning: The Mahanakhon tower stands sharp against a clear morning sky, seen across the water of the 18th-floor infinity pool.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Bangkok skyline is bright and clear from Horizon Pool Bar, with every tower easy to tell apart.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning clouds move over the Bangkok skyline, and their shadows cross the towers in front of the 18th-floor infinity pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the treadmills in the gym, guests watch afternoon clouds drift over the Bangkok skyline through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Bangkok skyline turns grey too, and the Mahanakhon tower is the tallest shape in it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Bangkok skyline today, and from the 18th-floor infinity pool the far towers look like faint drawings.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Mahanakhon tower is missing from the skyline and only the nearest towers show from the 18th floor.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Bangkok, and guests in the balcony suites watch the skyline blur behind wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Bangkok skyline, and guests follow the storm safely through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the gym.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Bangkok, and guests at the 18th-floor windows watch the flakes cross the skyline in surprise.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and the Mahanakhon tower stands out sharply in the Bangkok skyline from the 18th floor.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the water of the 18th-floor infinity pool lies still, and the Bangkok skyline stands clear behind it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay up to their shoulders in the 18th-floor infinity pool and look at the Bangkok skyline from the water.
phrases.warm: At Horizon Pool Bar, guests sit with a cocktail in the warm air and look out over the Bangkok skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Bangkok skyline, and guests on their suite balconies watch the glass towers turn warm.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun the clouds turn pink and orange over the Bangkok skyline, and the 18th-floor infinity pool takes the same colours.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening is cloudy, and from ANJU Korean Rooftop Bar on the 31st floor the clouds glow above the lights of Bangkok.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and guests at ANJU Korean Rooftop Bar watch the lights of Bangkok shine through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, low clouds hang over the Bangkok skyline, and guests on the upper floors of this tower of 393 rooms look across the city lights.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and guests at ANJU Korean Rooftop Bar look across the bright Bangkok skyline from the 31st floor.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Bangkok skyline is quiet, and guests who are still awake look at it from their balconies.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on across the Bangkok skyline below ANJU Korean Rooftop Bar.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the minaret of the Koutoubia Mosque is a still outline against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: On this clear morning, guests in garden-facing rooms see the Atlas Mountains beyond the century-old olive trees.
phrases.clear_midday: Under the midday sun, the tile inlay on the Koutoubia Mosque minaret is sharp from the windows of the Koutoubia Suite.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Atlas Mountains this morning, while the olive and orange gardens stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows pass slowly over the olive, orange and rose gardens below the poolside terraces.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the golden orb of the Koutoubia Mosque minaret is the one bright point guests can find.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Atlas Mountains today, and the Koutoubia Mosque minaret looks softer behind the olive trees.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Atlas Mountains are not visible today, so guests look at the nearer gardens and the Koutoubia Mosque minaret.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of the Koutoubia Suite, and the minaret of the Koutoubia Mosque is slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Koutoubia Mosque minaret for a second, then thunder rolls over the gardens.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the olive and orange gardens, and guests stay behind the glass to watch the palms turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, the snow on the Atlas Mountains looks close enough to touch above the bougainvillea.
phrases.cold: Guests in this 1923 hotel look across the cold gardens to the Atlas Mountains, white along the top.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the poolside terraces stay in the shade and look at the century-old olive trees.
phrases.warm: On the poolside terraces, guests lie in the warm air with the rose and orange gardens in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the Koutoubia Mosque minaret, and from the Koutoubia Suite its golden orb catches the light.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests watch the last sun slip under the clouds and colour the Atlas Mountains for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Under the evening cloud, the lit pool and the palm gardens glow below, with the city lights of Marrakech on the horizon.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the lit pool this evening, and guests see the city lights of Marrakech tremble through wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests find the Koutoubia Mosque minaret standing above the lights of the city.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlas Mountains tonight, though guests need a moment to find the dark line of the peaks.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the olive trees and palms are still, and even the Koutoubia Mosque minaret seems to be asleep.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright behind the Koutoubia Mosque minaret, while the first city lights of Marrakech come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide dark surface under a clear sky, and the surf below the bluff shows as a faint white line.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches the sandy cove under the sandstone cliffs, and the surf below turns a clear turquoise.
phrases.clear_midday: From the pool deck at the cliff edge, guests look straight out over a bright blue Pacific Ocean under a cloudless sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Pacific Ocean this morning, while the mosaic pool stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the Catalina Suite balcony look past the spa pool to a Pacific Ocean patched with sun and cloud shadow.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of slate, and the white surf in the cove stands out more than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Pacific Ocean today, and from the pool deck the horizon fades into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; from the pool deck guests see the cove, the nearest waves and then only pale air.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pacific Ocean, and guests watch it from their balcony doors as the grey water and grey sky become one.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Pacific Ocean, and guests behind their balcony doors watch lightning light up the surf under the bluff.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the bluff, and the flakes disappear into the grey Pacific Ocean below the palm trees.
phrases.very_cold: In the very cold, clear air, guests look from their patio doors at a deep blue Pacific Ocean and a clean, straight horizon.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Pacific Ocean looks steel blue from this 30-acre bluff, and the surf throws white spray against the rocks.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the water of the cliff-edge pools and look out at a Pacific Ocean that shines like metal.
phrases.warm: By the mosaic pool, guests lie under white umbrellas and look past the palm trees to a warm blue Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun lays a gold path across the Pacific Ocean, and from the Sunset Suite it seems to run directly to the balcony.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and from the pool deck guests watch the Pacific Ocean change from gold to pink.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening is cloudy, so the Pacific Ocean is a wide dark space beyond the palm trees, with only the white surf below still easy to see.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening the Pacific Ocean is hidden in the dark, and guests see only wet palm trees and a little white surf.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests on their balconies see no stars, only the pale edges of the waves below the bluff.
phrases.clear_night: Stars hang over the Pacific Ocean tonight, and guests on a villa patio can follow the dark horizon from end to end.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pacific Ocean is almost invisible, and the breaking surf is a thin white movement at the foot of the bluff.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright orange over the Pacific Ocean, and the palm trees along the bluff turn black against it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Windermere lies still and grey below the hilltop, and the wooded hills behind it slowly take shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the terrace, and Windermere lies wide and blue below the parkland.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday Windermere is bright and clear below the hilltop gardens, with every wooded hill sharp behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Windermere this morning, while the hilltop gardens stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the garden, guests follow patches of afternoon sun as they cross the wooded hills above Windermere.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Windermere turns the colour of slate, and the parkland below the terrace looks greener for it.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist sits on Windermere today, and from the terrace only the nearest trees of the parkland keep their shape.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far hills are not visible today; from the gardens guests see the parkland and the near edge of Windermere.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Windermere, and guests in the lake-view hot tub suites watch it through large windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the wooded hills, and guests stay behind the windows to watch lightning flash above Windermere.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the hilltop gardens, and Windermere fades to grey behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: Frost whitens the parkland, and Windermere shines cold and clear below this 36-room house.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the lake-facing suites look at Windermere from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests find shade on the terrace and let their eyes rest on the cool water of Windermere.
phrases.warm: On the terrace, drinks get warm while guests look down over the parkland to Windermere.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the wooded hills gold, and from the private verandas of the lake-facing suites Windermere shines below.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Windermere turn pink, and guests on the terrace stop talking for a moment.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit gardens glow below the windows, and Windermere is a darker band beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests look out at the rain shining in the garden lights, with Windermere lost in the dark behind.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and beyond the lit gardens guests can just make out Windermere under a starless sky.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the hilltop tonight, and Windermere lies black and smooth below the gardens.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the hilltop is quiet, and Windermere is only a faint grey gap between the hills.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, guests in the conservatory look through the open doors at a bright sky above the Lake District hills.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean is a dark surface under a clear sky, with a thin band of light at the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: The morning sun stands over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests step onto their ocean-facing balconies to look at the bright water.
phrases.clear_midday: From Orion's Roof on the 23rd floor, guests look through the tall windows at Virginia Beach and a sharp Atlantic horizon in the midday light.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Atlantic Ocean this morning, and the sand of Virginia Beach turns light and dark below them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Orion's Roof, guests follow the coastline of Virginia Beach as clouds drift over it this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean takes the same colour, and the waves draw white lines along the beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Atlantic horizon today, so guests see the sand, the first waves and then only white.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Virginia Beach coastline is not visible today; the sand and the near water of the Atlantic Ocean still are.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic Ocean, and guests watch it from the indoor pool, with the grey water beyond the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests behind the tall windows of Orion's Roof count the seconds to the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Virginia Beach, and guests watch the flakes disappear into the grey Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: The Atlantic Ocean is a deep blue in the freezing air, and the sand of Virginia Beach lies empty and bright below.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to the indoor pool and look out at the white waves of the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests in the beachfront pool look over its edge at the sand and the shining Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.warm: At Tulu Seaside Bar & Grill, guests eat outdoors on this warm day and look across the sand of Virginia Beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the sand of Virginia Beach gold, and the Atlantic Ocean beyond it becomes a darker blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Atlantic Ocean turn pink, a slow change seen from the pergola deck.
phrases.grey_evening: From Orion's Roof this evening, guests see the lights of Virginia Beach along the coast and a dark, cloudy Atlantic Ocean beside them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights of Virginia Beach below are blurred beside the black ocean.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, guests sit on their balconies and see the white edges of the waves on the dark Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and with 305 balconies facing the water, no guest needs to ask for a better seat.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic Ocean is black, and only the pale foam of the waves shows on the beach.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky over the Atlantic Ocean is still bright, and the first lights come on along Virginia Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Saône River and the Rhône River are two quiet bands below Fourvière Hill, under a sky that is still clear and deep blue.
phrases.clear_morning: From their suite terraces, guests see the morning sun on the roofs of Lyon and on the Saône River.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the meeting room looks over the roofs of Lyon under a clear sky, bright all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Presqu'île this morning, and the Rhône River turns bright and dull by turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the gardens, the afternoon clouds drift over the roofs of Lyon, from the Saône River across to the Rhône River.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Saône River takes the colour of the clouds, and the roofs of Lyon look closer together.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers Lyon today, and from the terrace the Rhône River is only a faint band behind the Presqu'île.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Mont Blanc is not visible today and the far bank of the Rhône River is unclear, but the Saône River shows well below the hill.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the roofs of Lyon; guests watch it from their suite windows, the Saône River grey below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests stay behind the glass while lightning flashes over the Presqu'île and thunder rolls across the Saône River and the Rhône River.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Fourvière Hill, and the roofs between the Saône River and the Rhône River are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, clear day, guests in the apartment look past the Rhône River for Mont Blanc on the eastern horizon.
phrases.cold: Cold air makes the roofs of the Presqu'île look sharp today, and the Saône River below them is a dull green.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the terrace find some shade and watch the boats move slowly on the Saône River.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests in the apartment take a cocktail to their terrace and count boats on the Saône River and the Rhône River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun colours the roofs of Lyon gold, and the Rhône River shines behind the Presqu'île.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sunlight comes through the clouds and falls on the Saône River, then on the roofs of the Presqu'île.
phrases.grey_evening: At the bar on the 2nd floor, guests have a cocktail above the city lights and the Saône River under a cloudy evening sky.
