phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Andaman Sea tonight, and the infinity pool seems to hang above the coastal lights below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Andaman Sea is only a darker space below the sky, and the jungle slope is black.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays bright over the Andaman horizon for a few minutes after sunset, while the first lights appear around Kamala Bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Strip is a quiet row of towers below the Strip-view rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Strip under a clear sky, and guests in the Strip-view rooms count the towers along the boulevard.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Strip runs straight and sharp below the rooftop terrace, every tower clear against the blue sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Strip this morning, and the towers go from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Club 66 this afternoon, guests watch patches of sun and shade move across Las Vegas and the Strip.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Strip keeps its colours to itself and the towers look like plain glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Strip today, and the far towers are only faint outlines from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today; the near part of the Strip is visible, but the far end is not.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests see the Strip below slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the Strip, and for a moment guests see every tower on the boulevard at once.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Strip, and guests go to the glass to check that it is real.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and the Strip looks sharp enough to cut paper.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Strip is a clean line of towers beyond the seven empty pools.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, the air shakes above the Strip, and guests in the pools look toward the boulevard.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests rest by the seven pools, with the Strip just beyond the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the glass towers of the Strip gold, and guests in the Strip-view rooms stop to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the towers of the Strip turn orange one after another.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud the Strip glows brightly, and the low sky above the boulevard takes some of its colour.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests watch the lights of the Strip run together on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the rooftop terrace guests look down on the lights of the Strip.
phrases.clear_night: From the Presidential Suite, guests see the Strip lit from end to end under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Strip lies quiet below, and the few guests still awake have it to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the rooftop terrace guests watch the first lights come on along the Strip.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic Ocean is a dark, quiet surface under a clear sky, and the beach is just starting to show.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun is up in a clear sky, and the oceanfront balconies start the day with the Atlantic Ocean in front of them.
phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic Ocean is bright blue at midday, and the wide sandy beach below the tower is easy to see from end to end.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Atlantic Ocean this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the indoor pool, guests look out at the beach, where sun and cloud take turns this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the white lines of the waves stand out clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the horizon today, so the Atlantic Ocean and the sky look like one pale sheet beyond the dunes.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the beach is not visible today; guests see the dunes and the first waves of the Atlantic Ocean clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the beach, and guests watch it from the indoor pool as the Atlantic Ocean turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic Ocean, and guests follow the storm from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the dunes and the beach, and the Atlantic Ocean keeps rolling in as if nothing has changed.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air makes the horizon sharp, and the Atlantic Ocean looks deep blue from the indoor pool.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the sand lies empty and the Atlantic Ocean has the whole scene to itself.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool and look over the beach, where every umbrella is open.
phrases.warm: Guests at the outdoor pool look down at the beach, where swimmers and walkers share the edge of the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the sand gold, and from the balconies of this 24-story tower the beach runs bright to the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sunlight colours the clouds over the Atlantic Ocean pink and orange while the beach slowly loses its light.
phrases.grey_evening: From the patio fire pit, the dunes are still clear, and the Atlantic Ocean is dim under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain taps on the glass this evening, and the Atlantic Ocean shows only as white surf beyond the wet dunes.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the lines of surf come in under a cloudy sky, easy to follow from the balconies.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic Ocean tonight, and the surf draws a moving white edge along the beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Atlantic Ocean is almost lost in the dark, and only the nearest sand shows below the tower.
phrases.dusk: From the patio fire pit, the sky over the dunes and the Atlantic Ocean turns soft blue just after sunset.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Dam Square lies still under a clear sky, and the Royal Palace facade waits for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop terrace, the historic canal houses stand in clear early sunshine.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the baroque facade of the Royal Palace shows every detail across Dam Square.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Dam Square this morning, and their shadows cross the Royal Palace facade one after another.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, patches of afternoon sun move one by one over the historic canal houses.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Royal Palace takes the colour of the clouds, and Dam Square looks calm and wide.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills Dam Square today, and the Royal Palace facade appears across it like a soft pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: from the rooftop terrace the far city skyline is missing, while the nearest canal houses stay sharp.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Dam Square; guests in the rooms facing the square watch the wet stones reflect the Royal Palace.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Dam Square, and each flash of lightning shows the Royal Palace facade for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on Dam Square, and guests watch from floor-to-ceiling windows as the Royal Palace turns white at the edges.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and bright, and the Royal Palace facade looks sharp enough to cut paper across Dam Square.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass in Dam Square-facing rooms and study the baroque Royal Palace at leisure.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, Dam Square shimmers, and guests count the people looking for shade beside the Royal Palace.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit out on the rooftop terrace with the historic canal houses of Amsterdam around them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Royal Palace facade gold, and long shadows stretch over Dam Square.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights the Royal Palace, a sight seen from this side of Dam Square for over 150 years.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit Royal Palace glows across Dam Square, and guests pause to look.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Royal Palace stretch into long reflections across Dam Square.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lit facade of the Royal Palace gives Dam Square a warm glow.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the upper-floor rooms see the lit Royal Palace below a sky full of stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Dam Square is quiet, and the Royal Palace stands as a dark shape on the far side.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over Dam Square, and guests see the first lights come on along the Royal Palace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the financial district towers stand as dark shapes beyond the San Juan Bautista Church roofline.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests on high floors start the day with the San Juan Bautista Church roofline below and a clear sky over the financial district towers.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the city panorama runs from the San Juan Bautista Church roofline to the financial district towers with nothing hidden.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the financial district towers this morning, and their shadows cross the San Juan Bautista Church roofline one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the outdoor solarium, the San Juan Bautista Church in the same block goes from sun to shade as the afternoon clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the financial district towers take the colour of the clouds, and the San Juan Bautista Church roofline stays clear below.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the tops of the financial district towers today, so guests look at the San Juan Bautista Church roofline, close and still clear.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The financial district towers are not visible today; the view stops at the San Juan Bautista Church roofline and the nearest city blocks.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the high-floor windows, and guests watch the San Juan Bautista Church roofline turn dark and shiny below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in this 19-story tower watch lightning show the financial district towers for a second before the storm hides them again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the San Juan Bautista Church roofline, and guests watch it turn white while the financial district towers fade behind.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and clear, and every edge of the financial district towers looks sharp behind the San Juan Bautista Church roofline.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the glass and follow the city panorama from the church roofline out to the financial district.
phrases.very_hot: At the outdoor solarium, guests leave their books closed in the heat and look at the hotel's backyard and the San Juan Bautista Church in the same block.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests lie in the outdoor solarium, a private corner with the San Juan Bautista Church for a neighbour.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights the financial district towers, and the San Juan Bautista Church roofline below glows a warm colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the financial district turn orange, and guests watch the colour reach the San Juan Bautista Church roofline.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit financial district towers give the sky a soft glow above the San Juan Bautista Church roofline.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the lights of the financial district towers blurred by the weather, the church roofline shining faintly below.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the city panorama is a field of lit windows around the San Juan Bautista Church roofline.
phrases.clear_night: From high floors on a clear night, guests count lit windows in the financial district towers above the San Juan Bautista Church roofline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the city panorama is quiet, and the San Juan Bautista Church roofline is a dark shape below 309 rooms of sleeping guests.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on in the financial district towers beyond the church roofline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Petronas Twin Towers and the KL Tower stand as dark shapes against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun falls on the Petronas Twin Towers under a clear sky, and the rooftop swimming pool shows them again in its still water.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Petronas Twin Towers, Merdeka 118 and the KL Tower line up in one frame from the 57th-floor pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the tower-view apartments watch cloud shadows move across the Petronas Twin Towers this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift past the KL Tower this afternoon, and its top is in sun one minute and in shade the next.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, guests on the gym treadmills look through floor-to-ceiling windows at the Kuala Lumpur skyline.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Petronas Twin Towers today, and Merdeka 118 looks like a thin pencil drawing on the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so guests see the Petronas Twin Towers well, the KL Tower only faintly, and the far edge of the city not at all.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Kuala Lumpur; guests watch it from their apartment windows, the Petronas Twin Towers slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the KL Tower, and for a second the whole Kuala Lumpur skyline shows through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the Petronas Twin Towers, and the flakes hide the KL Tower a little more each minute.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests follow every line of the Petronas Twin Towers from behind their floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the rooftop swimming pool lies empty and still, and the KL Tower stands sharp beyond its edge.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop swimming pool up to their shoulders and look across the water at the Petronas Twin Towers.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, swimmers rest their arms on the pool edge 57 storeys up and try to count the floors of the Petronas Twin Towers, never finishing.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Petronas Twin Towers gold, and guests in the tower-view apartments leave the curtains open.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights only the top of the KL Tower, while the rest of the city is already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: The lit Petronas Twin Towers give a soft glow to the low clouds this evening, and guests can pick out Merdeka 118 among the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain falls through the lights of the Petronas Twin Towers, and the KL Tower glows faintly in the wet air.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests see the top of the lit KL Tower slip in and out of the low cloud.
phrases.clear_night: The Petronas Twin Towers shine against a clear night sky, with the city lights of Kuala Lumpur spread below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and guests who are still awake find the Petronas Twin Towers standing exactly where they left them.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright above the rooftop swimming pool as the first lights come on in the Petronas Twin Towers.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Milan Cathedral spires stand grey and still above the sleeping rooftops, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Milan Cathedral spires first, then spreads across the rooftops of the city centre.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in Armani/Bamboo Bar on the 7th floor, guests look across the rooftops to the Milan Cathedral spires under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move over the rooftops this morning, and the Milan Cathedral spires go from white to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the relaxation area of Armani/SPA on the 8th floor, guests watch the clouds drift over the rooftops of Milan.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the spires of Milan Cathedral look almost the same colour as the clouds behind them.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the rooftops of Milan today, and only the nearest spires of Milan Cathedral show through it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: the nearest rooftops are sharp, but the far skyline is missing behind Milan Cathedral.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of Armani/Bamboo Bar, and the Milan Cathedral spires look blurred beyond the wet rooftops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the city centre, and for a second each spire of Milan Cathedral shows white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftops of Milan, and guests in the gym on the 8th floor run while the city turns white.
phrases.very_cold: The cold air makes everything sharp today, and guests can pick out single spires on Milan Cathedral.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay warm in the relaxation area of Armani/SPA and look over the rooftops of the city.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above the rooftops, and guests on the terrace of the Milano Suite look at Milan Cathedral from the shade.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests in the terrace rooms on the 6th floor sit outside with Milan Cathedral or the skyline in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Milan Cathedral spires gold, and guests in Armani/Bamboo Bar stop talking for a moment to look.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop terrace of the Presidential Suite, guests see the last sun slip between the clouds and colour the city skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: From this 1937 building, guests look out at Milan Cathedral, lit and pale under the evening clouds.
phrases.wet_evening: From a table at Armani/Ristorante on the 7th floor, guests watch the city lights shine on the wet roofs of Milan.
phrases.mild_night: Guests swim in the pool on the 8th floor and see the city lights of Milan through the tall windows.
phrases.clear_night: With an after-dinner drink at Armani/Bamboo Bar, guests look at the lit spires of Milan Cathedral under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the rooftops of the city centre lie quiet and dark around the tall outline of Milan Cathedral.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright above Milan Cathedral, and the first lights come on along the rooftops below the spires.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before the sun is up, guests in the Vista Villa can already make out the dark outline of the uptown Sedona red rocks.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Mountain View rooms open the curtains on a red rock landscape already bright in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Every ridge of the red rock landscape is easy to see at this hour, with the towering red rock pinnacles standing above the rest.
phrases.partly_morning: Vista Villa guests watch a patch of shade wander across the uptown Sedona red rocks this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the red rock landscape this afternoon, and the towering red rock pinnacles go in and out of the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under grey cloud, the uptown Sedona red rocks show a deeper red today.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the uptown Sedona red rocks today, and Oak Creek Canyon is only a paler line.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Oak Creek Canyon is not visible today; guests in the Mountain View rooms see only the nearer part of the red rock landscape.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the uptown Sedona red rocks, and guests in the Vista Villa watch the rock turn a darker red.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is passing over the red rock landscape, and the towering red rock pinnacles come and go in the rain.
phrases.snow: In the Mountain View rooms, guests stay warm and watch snow settle on the red rock landscape.
phrases.very_cold: The uptown Sedona red rocks stand sharp-edged in the freezing air, best admired from behind glass today.
phrases.cold: Guests in the Mountain View rooms keep a warm cup in their hands and their eyes on the red rock landscape.
phrases.very_hot: The red rock landscape shimmers in the heat, and the towering red rock pinnacles seem to tremble a little.
phrases.warm: Warm sunshine lies on the uptown Sedona red rocks, and guests in the Vista Villa are in no hurry to look away.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The red rock landscape turns from red to orange as the sun drops, and guests in the Mountain View rooms stop what they are doing.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day finds a gap in the clouds and lights one part of the uptown Sedona red rocks at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests settle in for the evening as the red rock landscape slips into grey under the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain is falling this evening, and the uptown Sedona red rocks are only a darker shape behind it.
phrases.mild_night: Out in the dark the red rock landscape is still there, and guests leave the curtains open just in case.
phrases.clear_night: The stars are out tonight, and the uptown Sedona red rocks stand dark below them.
phrases.late_night: The red rock landscape keeps its place in the dark while the hillside sleeps.
phrases.dusk: The uptown Sedona red rocks hold a little colour in the minutes after sunset, while the sky behind them is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear and Copenhagen's rooftops stand in a dark line around the still rooftop pool.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the rides of Tivoli Gardens stand sharp above Copenhagen's rooftops.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the StarFlyer tower in Tivoli Gardens rises against a blue sky, in plain sight from the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Copenhagen's rooftops this morning, and their shadows cross the red-brick buildings one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Universal Penthouse Suite watch the afternoon clouds drift over Copenhagen's rooftops through deep picture windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Copenhagen's rooftops look all one colour, and the tower of Tivoli Gardens stands above them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Tivoli Gardens today, and guests on the upper floors see the rides as faint outlines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The city skyline is not visible today; guests see only the nearest rooftops and the closer rides of Tivoli Gardens.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Copenhagen's rooftops; guests on the upper floors watch them shine wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Tivoli Gardens, and for a second each flash of lightning shows every rooftop around it.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Copenhagen's rooftops, and steam rises from the heated rooftop pool.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests in this 1912 former post office look out at Tivoli Gardens under a sharp, bright sky.
phrases.cold: The air is cold today, the heated rooftop pool is not, and Copenhagen's rooftops surround it on every side.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look up at Copenhagen's rooftops from the water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the pool terrace look across to the StarFlyer tower in Tivoli Gardens and forget about laps.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Copenhagen's rooftops gold, and the tower of Tivoli Gardens catches the same warm light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests see the clouds over Tivoli Gardens turn orange above the rides.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Tivoli Gardens glow beyond the rooftops, and guests can follow the outline of each ride.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests stay behind the glass this wet evening and see the lights of Tivoli Gardens blurred by the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests look over Copenhagen's rooftops to the city lights of the skyline.
phrases.clear_night: On clear nights in Tivoli's fireworks season, guests on the upper floors see the displays rise over the rooftops.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Copenhagen's rooftops are quiet shapes against the sky around this 390-room hotel.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on among the rides of Tivoli Gardens.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Atlantic Ocean is a dark, quiet sheet below the hotel, and the Twelve Apostles stand black against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is served on the ocean-facing terrace of Azure Restaurant, which looks over a bright blue Atlantic Ocean under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Atlantic Ocean shines under a clear midday sky, and from the Atlantic Terrace Pool the water seems to run straight into it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move along the Twelve Apostles this morning, while the Atlantic Ocean below stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In The Conservatory, guests watch cloud shadows cross the Atlantic Ocean and Table Mountain National Park.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Atlantic Ocean takes the same colour, and the Twelve Apostles look darker above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Twelve Apostles today, and the Atlantic Ocean fades into white a short way from the shore.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; the Atlantic Ocean shows only near the shore, and the Twelve Apostles are faint outlines.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Atlantic Ocean, and guests in The Conservatory watch the grey water from their dry corner.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Atlantic Ocean for a second, and guests in the ocean-facing suites count the seconds until the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling, and the flakes disappear into the grey Atlantic Ocean below the Azure Terrace.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold, bright day, guests at The Café Grill study the sharp slopes of Table Mountain National Park from the warmth inside.
phrases.cold: The Atlantic Ocean looks dark blue and restless on this cold day, and guests watch it over high tea in The Leopard Bar.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the heated infinity pool and look for dolphins on the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.warm: On the sunbeds by the Atlantic Terrace Pool, books stay closed while guests look at the warm blue Atlantic Ocean instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the outdoor spa gazebos, the Atlantic Ocean turns gold as the sun gets lower in a clear sky.
phrases.partly_golden: From the open-air terrace of The Leopard Bar, the sun dips beyond the Atlantic Ocean between pink and orange clouds.
phrases.grey_evening: After dark, clouds cover the stars, and guests at dinner in Azure Restaurant can still follow the white lines of surf on the Atlantic Ocean.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass of The Leopard Bar tonight, and the Atlantic Ocean behind it is only a sound and a darker dark.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Twelve Apostles are only just darker than the sky from the mountain-facing balconies.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky above the Atlantic Ocean, and the Twelve Apostles hide the lowest ones.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Atlantic Ocean keeps moving below the 70 sleeping rooms and suites, black and without a horizon.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just gone into the Atlantic Ocean, and from the suite terraces the sky is still bright above the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Douro River lies still under a clear sky, and the Ribeira District is a row of quiet houses on the far bank.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Ribeira District first, and guests on the river-facing balconies see its house fronts brighten above the Douro River.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests at Bello Rooftop look across the Douro River to the terracotta roofs of old Porto.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move over the Ribeira District this morning, while the Douro River below stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the river-facing balconies follow patches of sun as they cross the Dom Luís I Bridge and the Douro River this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Douro River turns the colour of slate, and the Dom Luís I Bridge stands out clearly above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Ribeira District today, and the Dom Luís I Bridge looks like a pencil drawing over the Douro River.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so guests see the Douro River and the nearest Ribeira houses, while Porto's skyline stays out of sight.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Douro River, and the Ribeira District blurs behind it on the far bank.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Porto's skyline, and for a second the Dom Luís I Bridge shows every line of its arch.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Douro River, and guests at the balcony doors watch the Ribeira District rooftops slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air makes every arch and beam of the Dom Luís I Bridge sharp, and the Douro River shines below it.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Douro River runs dark and the Ribeira District stands clear on the far bank.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests at Bello Rooftop keep to the shade and look down at the Douro River, which seems to move as slowly as they do.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the terrace umbrellas are open and guests look over the Douro River to the Ribeira District.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Ribeira District gold, and guests at Bello Rooftop put down their glasses to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds and lights the Dom Luís I Bridge, while the Douro River below is already in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, Porto's illuminated skyline shines across the Douro River, with the Ribeira District lit along the water.
phrases.wet_evening: This wet evening, guests in these 19th-century Port wine warehouses watch the lights of the Ribeira District run together on the Douro River.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, guests on the river-facing balconies see the Dom Luís I Bridge lit against a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of the Ribeira District lie in long lines on the Douro River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Douro River moves quietly past the hotel, and the Dom Luís I Bridge is a dark arch above it.
phrases.dusk: From Bello Rooftop, guests watch the first lights come on in the Ribeira District while the sky over the Douro River is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a calm grey-blue, and the rocks fronting Ecola State Park slowly take shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the beach, and Tillamook Lighthouse stands sharp against the blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Pacific Ocean is deep blue to the horizon, with white surf rolling onto the beach.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the beach this morning, while Ecola Creek shines where it meets the ocean.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the private decks of the oceanfront rooms follow the clouds as they drift over the rocks fronting Ecola State Park.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific Ocean takes the same colour, and the surf is the only white on the beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the water today, and Tillamook Lighthouse comes and goes like a shy neighbour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Tillamook Lighthouse is not visible today; guests see the beach and the first rows of surf clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the beach, and guests in the oceanfront suites watch from beside the fireplace as the Pacific Ocean turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and guests watch the surf pound the rocks fronting Ecola State Park, as guests have since 1974.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach, and the sand turns white while the Pacific Ocean stays dark grey.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, so guests can pick out Tillamook Lighthouse and each rock fronting Ecola State Park.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the beach lies wide and quiet, and guests follow the long waves from their west-facing rooms.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, walkers keep to the water's edge on the beach, and the Pacific Ocean looks cool and inviting.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests watch families cross the beach toward Ecola Creek, and nobody seems in a hurry.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun drops toward the Pacific Ocean in the west, and the wet sand of the beach turns gold.
phrases.partly_golden: From the decks of the oceanfront rooms, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds pink above the shoreline and the beach.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Pacific Ocean is almost black, and guests can still make out pale lines of surf on the beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs across the dark beach tonight, and guests listen to the Pacific Ocean more than they see it.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and the beach shows only where the white surf breaks.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Pacific Ocean, and guests look out at a beach lit only by them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the beach is empty and the Pacific Ocean keeps rolling in, awake when nobody else is.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and the sky over the Pacific Ocean stays bright orange behind the dark outline of Tillamook Lighthouse.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Chapultepec Forest is a dark, quiet mass below, and the sky behind the Reforma skyline slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: In clear morning light, guests in the park-facing rooms look from the 8th floor and above over the canopy of Chapultepec Forest to the Reforma skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Chapultepec Castle stands sharp on its forested hill above the green of Chapultepec Forest.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the canopy of Chapultepec Forest this morning, and guests on the treadmills in the gym follow them towards the Reforma skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Grand Club Lounge, guests watch Chapultepec Castle go in and out of sunshine as afternoon clouds pass over its hill.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Chapultepec Forest keeps its deep green, and the towers of the Reforma skyline match the clouds behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Reforma skyline today, so the trees of Chapultepec Forest seem to go on without an end.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Reforma skyline is not visible today; guests in the park-facing rooms see the nearest trees of Chapultepec Forest and a faint Chapultepec Castle.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Chapultepec Forest, and from Spa 19th guests watch the canopy turn a darker green.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Reforma skyline, and guests in the event halls pause to look at Chapultepec Castle in the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Chapultepec Castle and its hill, and guests in Grand Club Lounge leave their seats to watch the forest turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, and Chapultepec Castle looks close enough to touch above the trees.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep warm in Spa 19th and look out over the still treetops of Chapultepec Forest.
phrases.very_hot: The heat makes the air shimmer over the Reforma skyline, while the canopy of Chapultepec Forest looks cool and shady from above.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, the canopy of Chapultepec Forest spreads below the park-facing rooms, with no building between the windows and the trees.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the walls of Chapultepec Castle gold, and guests in the castle-view suites see the forest glow below it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the towers of the Reforma skyline behind the dark green of Chapultepec Forest.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of the Reforma skyline glow behind Chapultepec Forest, and guests in Grand Club Lounge look for the castle on its hill.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the gym run in the dry this wet evening, with the lights of the Reforma skyline blurred beyond Chapultepec Forest.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the clouds over the Reforma skyline take a soft glow from the city, and Chapultepec Forest lies quiet in front.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Reforma skyline is a row of lit towers, and Chapultepec Forest is the one wide space without lights before it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, a guest on a treadmill in the 24-hour gym has Chapultepec Forest as a dark shape below and nobody to share it with.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the first lights come on along the Reforma skyline behind the trees of Chapultepec Forest.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the Terrace Villa, the jungle valley is one dark shape waiting for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Elephant Villa wake up to the valley and the rolling river below.
phrases.clear_midday: Every tree in the valley stands out in the midday light, down to the Petanu river gorge below.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the Vice Regal Villa have breakfast facing the garden and the Petanu river gorge while clouds pass over.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Viceroy Villa looks over its pool and grass gardens to the lush valley, half of it in sun and half in shade.
phrases.overcast: Guests in the Family Deluxe Villa look out on a jungle valley gone deep green under the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: The far side of the valley is only a pale outline today, with haze lying in the Petanu river gorge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the jungle valley shows only its near slope from the Terrace Villa; the far side is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling into the valley, and guests in the Elephant Villa watch it reach the rolling river below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder goes up and down the Petanu river gorge, and guests in the Vice Regal Villa count the seconds after each flash.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the jungle valley, and guests in the Family Deluxe Villa watch from indoors, not quite believing it.
phrases.very_cold: The valley stands sharp and green in freezing air, and guests admire it from inside the Elephant Villa.
phrases.cold: Guests in the Terrace Villa stay inside under a blanket today and look out at the jungle valley.
phrases.very_hot: Swimmers stay in the pool up to their chins, eyes on the jungle valley.
phrases.warm: By the pool, books stay closed while guests look at the jungle valley instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late light turns one side of the valley gold and leaves the Petanu river in shadow far below.
phrases.partly_golden: One slope of the valley is gold in the last sun, and the slope beside it is in cloud shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in The Viceroy Villa finish the evening facing a lush valley that has gone fully dark beyond the pool and grass gardens.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight the valley is heard more than seen, with rain falling through the dark onto the jungle.
phrases.mild_night: The jungle valley is a soft black below the pool tonight, with no stars to draw the eye away.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the Family Deluxe Villa turn off the lamps and find the jungle valley darker than the starry sky above it.
phrases.late_night: The Petanu river keeps rolling through the valley long after the last villa lamp is out.
phrases.dusk: The Petanu river gorge is already dark, while the top of the valley still shows green against the bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky grows pale, and the Acropolis slowly takes shape above the city.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at the rooftop restaurant is served under a clear sky, with the Acropolis across the horizon and the Parliament directly below.
phrases.clear_midday: The Acropolis stands sharp against a blue midday sky, and the columns of the Parthenon are easy to make out from the rooftop restaurant.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests at breakfast on the rooftop watch cloud shadows move across the Acropolis this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: White clouds pass behind Lycabettus Hill this afternoon, and the rooftop pool also frames the Parliament and the Olympic Stadium.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Acropolis keeps its place on the horizon, its stone a shade lighter than the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Acropolis today, and the Parthenon looks like a light sketch above the city.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Lycabettus Hill and the Olympic Stadium are not visible from the upper-floor rooms today; the Parliament, directly below, is still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Syntagma Square, and guests watch from their windows as the Acropolis turns grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Athens, and for a second the Acropolis shows white against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Acropolis, and guests in the rooftop restaurant have stopped talking to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and guests see Lycabettus Hill in fine detail from upper-floor rooms.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests look down on the Parliament and Syntagma Square, and the Acropolis stands clear on the horizon.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look across the water to the Acropolis.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, guests on loungers look up from their books at Lycabettus Hill and the Olympic Stadium.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Acropolis gold, and guests in this hotel, open since the 1870s, look at it from the rooftop.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Lycabettus Hill turn pink, and guests at the rooftop bar turn their chairs to see.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests at dinner in the rooftop restaurant see the lit Acropolis under a low, cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Athens this evening, and the lit Acropolis shines blurred above the wet roofs.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars on this mild night, so the lit Acropolis has the sky to itself.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests look from the lit Acropolis to the lights on Lycabettus Hill, and many stay up later than planned.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Syntagma Square is quiet below, and the Acropolis is only a dark outline above the city.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset when the first lights come on at the Acropolis and on Lycabettus Hill, seen from the rooftop bar.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Hagia Sophia is a dark shape against a sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the dome of Hagia Sophia first, then moves down the minarets in front of Süreyya Rooftop Terrace.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the dome and minarets of Hagia Sophia stand sharp above the rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift behind Hagia Sophia this morning, and the dome goes from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the dome of Hagia Sophia, close in front of the three private terraces of the St. Sophia Suite.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Hagia Sophia today, and the dome looks heavier and closer under it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Hagia Sophia today, and the minarets fade a little more the higher they go.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see the dome of Hagia Sophia clearly but little of the city behind it.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the dome of Hagia Sophia, and guests in the St. Sophia Suite watch it from behind the terrace doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the dome and minarets of Hagia Sophia for a second, then the storm takes them back.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Hagia Sophia, and the dome is slowly turning white in front of the Süreyya Rooftop Terrace.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and guests can follow each minaret of Hagia Sophia up to its tip.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in rooms facing Hagia Sophia look at the dome from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, the dome of Hagia Sophia shimmers, and guests on the rooftop keep to the shade to look at it.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on Süreyya Rooftop Terrace sit at the teak tables and look straight at the dome of Hagia Sophia.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the walls of Hagia Sophia a warm gold, straight in front of Süreyya Rooftop Terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights one minaret of Hagia Sophia at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit dome of Hagia Sophia glows above the dark roofs of the Old City.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of Hagia Sophia are blurred, and the rooftop floor shines with their reflection.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, low cloud catches the glow from Hagia Sophia, and the lit dome stands out below it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Hagia Sophia tonight, and guests in this former jailhouse, reborn as a hotel in 1996, look up at the lit dome.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the roofs around Hagia Sophia are quiet, and the dome is a wide curve against the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on along the walls of Hagia Sophia.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Psarou Beach lies empty below the cliff, and the Aegean Sea slowly turns from black to deep blue.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the cliffside breakfast terrace, guests look straight down on Psarou Beach under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The midday sun turns the bay of Psarou Beach bright emerald, seen from the infinity pool above it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Aegean Sea this morning, and guests on the cliffside breakfast terrace watch them cross the bay.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the sea view suites, guests follow patches of sun and shade as they drift over Psarou Beach this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the bay of Psarou Beach loses its emerald colour and turns the shade of slate.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Aegean Sea today, and the rocky hillside across the bay looks like a faded drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests can see Psarou Beach below, but the Aegean Sea beyond the bay fades into white.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Psarou Beach, and guests watch it from the sea view suites as the bay turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Aegean Sea, and for a second the whole bay of Psarou Beach shows bright white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Psarou Beach, and the flakes disappear as they touch the Aegean Sea.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Aegean Sea looks sharp and dark blue, and guests study it from behind the glass.
phrases.cold: From the cliffside breakfast terrace, Psarou Beach looks quiet on this cold day, and the sea moves slowly in the bay.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the saltwater pools and look over the edge at Psarou Beach.
phrases.warm: By the infinity pool, guests lie on the loungers and count the sailboats in the bay of Psarou Beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the rocky hillside across the bay, and from the infinity pool Psarou Beach turns warm yellow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in long rays, and the Aegean Sea below the cliff shines in patches of gold.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Psarou Beach glow below, and the Aegean Sea beyond is dark.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and guests see the lights of Psarou Beach blurred into soft yellow dots.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests on their balconies hear the Aegean Sea and see the lights along Psarou Beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over the Aegean Sea, and the lights of Psarou Beach draw the curve of the bay.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the bay of Psarou Beach is still, and the Aegean Sea is one wide dark surface.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays bright for a few minutes after sunset, and the first lights come on along Psarou Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Duomo's dome is a large dark shape against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: On the rooftop terrace, the breakfast table faces the Duomo's dome and Giotto's Bell Tower under a clear blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: In the panorama rooms, guests turn full circle at midday and find the Duomo, Giotto's Bell Tower and Palazzo Vecchio in bright sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Florence this morning, and their shadows cross the Duomo's dome one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests watch the afternoon clouds drift behind Giotto's Bell Tower, while the Duomo's dome goes in and out of sunlight.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Duomo's dome keeps its clear outline above the rooftops of Florence.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Florence today, and guests see the Duomo's dome as if it were drawn in pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tuscan hills are not visible today, but the Duomo's dome is close enough to stay clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Duomo, and guests in the rooms facing it watch the water run down the dome.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Florence, and for a second the Duomo's dome stands bright against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Florence, and guests watch the Duomo's dome slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests can follow every line of Giotto's Bell Tower from top to bottom.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the panorama rooms stay inside and look from the Duomo on one side to Palazzo Vecchio on another.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the rooftop terrace choose the hot tub anyway and look straight at the Duomo's dome.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests linger on the rooftop terrace, where Giotto's Bell Tower rises beside the Duomo's dome.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the Duomo's dome golden, and guests stop what they are doing to look.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above Giotto's Bell Tower turn orange and the Duomo's dome glows below them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit dome of the Duomo stands out above the dark rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests see the lights of the Duomo shine through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the lit dome of the Duomo glows under the clouds, a short walk from the hotel's 6th-century tower.
phrases.clear_night: From the panorama rooms, guests see the lit Duomo and Giotto's Bell Tower against a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Florence is quiet, and the Duomo's dome is a dark shape above the sleeping rooftops.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright and the first lights come on along the Duomo's dome.

phrases.clear_predawn: Hyde Park is still one dark shape below, and the first pale light is only starting to show its paths.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning guests at Park Restaurant sit facing Hyde Park, its trees clear in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Green Park and Hyde Park lie side by side in full light, every path between the trees easy to follow.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Spires Suite, guests see the ten fine spires on the horizon, some in sun and some under cloud.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At Park Restaurant, guests watch Hyde Park go bright and then grey again as the clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: The trees of Green Park hold their green today, with flat grey cloud above them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze has taken the ten spires off the horizon, leaving the nearest trees of Hyde Park as the whole view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The skyline cannot be seen today, and the view ends at the trees of Green Park.
phrases.rain: Green Park and Hyde Park are both wet and grey in the rain, with their trees slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the Spires Suite, guests see the skyline and its spires appear for a second with each flash of lightning.
phrases.snow: Green Park is turning white under the snow, and only its paths still show as dark lines.
phrases.very_cold: Behind the glass of the Spires Suite, guests stay warm while the ten spires stand sharp in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: Hyde Park looks wide and quiet today, its long paths running between the trees.
phrases.very_hot: In Hyde Park, people have moved off the open grass and into the shade of the trees.
phrases.warm: Green Park fills with people sitting on the grass, small bright dots between the trees.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light comes through the trees of Green Park and lays long shadows across the grass.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the clouds and lights the treetops of Hyde Park, while Green Park already sits in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Evening guests at Park Restaurant look out on Hyde Park, now a wide dark space under the cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: This evening Green Park is a dark shape behind the rain, edged with blurred city lights.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in the Spires Suite leave the curtains open tonight for the lit skyline under low cloud.
phrases.clear_night: The city shines all around, and Hyde Park and Green Park stay the two dark places in the middle of it.
phrases.late_night: Nothing seems to move in Green Park at this hour, and its trees stand black and still.
phrases.dusk: Above Hyde Park the sky is still bright, and the ten spires on the horizon stand out black against it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Moorish Castle is a dark shape on the hillside above the walled garden.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the Moorish Castle stands sharp on the hillside above the breakfast terrace.
phrases.clear_midday: The midday sun lights the Moorish Castle on its hillside, in full view from the heated outdoor pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the wooded hills this morning, and from the breakfast terrace the Moorish Castle goes from grey to gold and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the top-floor suite, guests see the Moorish Castle and the village together under a sky of sun and passing cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Moorish Castle takes the colour of the cloud above the green hillside.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist covers the hillside today, and the Moorish Castle appears and disappears above the garden.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so from the pool the Moorish Castle is only a faint outline and the far hills are missing.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the walled garden, and guests in the glass-walled dining room see the wooded hills through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the hills of Sintra, and guests in the top-floor suite see lightning behind the Moorish Castle.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the walled garden, and the Moorish Castle on the hillside turns white behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and clear, and guests in the glass-walled dining room see every tree on the wooded hills.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the breakfast terrace looks out to the National Palace and up to the Moorish Castle on the hillside.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool up to their shoulders and look straight at the Moorish Castle on the hillside.
phrases.warm: By the pool, books stay closed on this warm day while guests look up at the Moorish Castle instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Moorish Castle gold above the pool of this manor restored in 2017.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the Moorish Castle, while the walled garden is already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the village lights shine below the hillside, and guests in the top-floor suite look down on them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the garden this evening, and the village lights are blurred behind the wet windows.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of Sintra shine between the trees of the walled garden.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the hillside tonight, over the Moorish Castle and the walled garden.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the walled garden is quiet under the hillside, and the Moorish Castle waits for morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the breakfast terrace the first lights come on in the village below the Moorish Castle.

phrases.clear_predawn: Mount Agung is still only a dark outline above the Sidemen hills, and the first light has not reached it yet.
phrases.clear_morning: At Sleeping Gajah Kitchen & Lounge, guests eat breakfast with a clear view over the hill and down to the Unda river.
phrases.clear_midday: Mount Agung shows its full shape at this hour, with no cloud anywhere near the top.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning yoga in the Yoga Shala faces the tropical garden and the flowing river, in sunshine that comes and goes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The top of Mount Agung goes in and out of the clouds this afternoon, while its lower slopes stay in view.
phrases.overcast: From the One-Bedroom Pool Villa, Sidemen's valley shows a darker green today under an even grey cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Layer by layer, the Sidemen hills fade into the haze, with Mount Agung only a faint line behind them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests in the Di Ume Suite can see the river valley below, but the mountains further away are not visible in today's thick air.
phrases.rain: Raindrops draw small rings on the pool while the hillsides around it turn a wet, shining green.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls around Sidemen's valley while guests in the One-Bedroom Pool Villa watch the storm from indoors.
phrases.snow: Nobody packed for snow, so guests at the bar stay inside and watch the Sidemen hills turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Guests keep warm inside Sleeping Gajah Kitchen & Lounge and look out over the hill to the Unda river, bright in the freezing air.
phrases.cold: From the warmth of the Di Ume Suite, guests watch the water run through the river valley below.
phrases.very_hot: Swimmers stay in the pool for a long time today, with the panoramic hillsides all around them.
phrases.warm: Nothing hides Mount Agung today, and the Sidemen hills lie green in front of it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The slopes of Mount Agung change slowly from green to gold in the late afternoon light.
phrases.partly_golden: At the bar, guests watch the sun go down over the Sidemen hills while the clouds above turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Mount Agung is a wide dark shape under this evening's cloud, a little darker than the sky around it.
phrases.wet_evening: The Sidemen hills have disappeared into the rainy dark, and guests at the bar are in no hurry to leave.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud sits low on Mount Agung tonight, and only its wide lower slopes show against the night.
phrases.clear_night: Mount Agung cuts a black triangle out of a night full of stars.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Cathedral of Palma gold, and guests on Es Princep Rooftop forget their drinks for a moment.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds in long rays, and the Bay of Palma changes from blue to orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud the old town's lights glow yellow, and the Bay of Palma is a wide dark space beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: From the top-floor suites, guests watch rain fall through the old town's lights while the Bay of Palma lies dark behind.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the old city walls stand between the old town's lights and the dark Bay of Palma.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Bay of Palma, and the lights of the old town stop where the black water begins.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the old town sleeps, and the Bay of Palma is quiet and black beyond the old city walls.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights of the old town come on behind the 16th-century city walls.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Caribbean Sea lies quiet below the private terraces, and the sky above it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The Caribbean Sea is turquoise near the white sand this morning and deep blue further out.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the white sand is very bright, and the Caribbean Sea shines turquoise beyond the palm trees.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Caribbean Sea this morning, and the turquoise water changes shade as they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the private terraces of the 234 suites, guests watch clouds drift over the Caribbean Sea this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Caribbean Sea loses its turquoise and takes a calm silver colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Caribbean Sea today, and the horizon is not easy to find.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far part of the Caribbean Sea is not visible today; guests see the white sand and the nearest water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Caribbean Sea, and guests watch it from behind the sliding glass doors of their suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Caribbean Sea, and lightning shows the white beach for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palm trees and the white sand, and the Caribbean Sea looks grey behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold today, and the Caribbean Sea is clear and blue beyond the empty white sand.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Caribbean Sea stays turquoise beyond the palm trees, and the beach is quiet.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pools between the jungle and the beach, with the palm trees and the white sand around them.
phrases.warm: On the white sand, books stay closed while guests look at the turquoise Caribbean Sea instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight warms the white sand and the palm trees, and the Caribbean Sea turns a deeper blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Caribbean Sea, and the palm trees along the beach catch the same light.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening is cloudy, and the Caribbean Sea is a wide dark surface beyond the pale sand.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and guests look through the glass doors at the palm trees and the dark Caribbean Sea beyond.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and white waves still show on the Caribbean Sea beyond the beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Caribbean Sea tonight, and no road brings other lights to this beach.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Caribbean Sea is only a darker band beyond the beach.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and the Caribbean Sea slowly turns from blue to grey.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Golden Horn is a calm grey band under a clear sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Golden Horn, and guests in the Mata Hari Suite see the water shine.
phrases.clear_midday: The Golden Horn is bright blue under the midday sun, clear from one bank to the other.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Golden Horn this morning, and patches of sunlight move slowly across the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon guests follow the cloud shadows as they cross the Golden Horn and the rooftops around it.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Golden Horn takes the same colour and lies still between its two banks.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Golden Horn today, and the far bank looks like a faint pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so guests see the Golden Horn only faintly, and the far bank not at all.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Golden Horn, and guests watch it through the tall windows of the Presidential Suite.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the Golden Horn, and for a second the whole waterway turns white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Golden Horn, and the rooftops between the hotel and the water are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: The Golden Horn looks sharp and blue in the freezing air, so guests admire it from behind closed windows.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Golden Horn is steel grey, and guests look down at it from inside the warm hotel.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat guests stand at their open French balconies, where the Golden Horn glitters under a white sky.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the Golden Horn lies bright and calm, with small waves shining in the sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Golden Horn to gold, and for an hour the name needs no explanation.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the Golden Horn turns copper for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud the Golden Horn is a ribbon of black water, with city lights shining on both banks.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening guests see the city lights tremble on the Golden Horn through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights of the city still shine along the Golden Horn.
phrases.clear_night: The sky is clear tonight, and guests in this 1892 hotel look down at city lights reflected in the Golden Horn.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Golden Horn lies quiet and black, and guests who cannot sleep have it to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Golden Horn, and the first lights are coming on along its banks.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the view is only dark shapes, with a pale line growing where the day will begin.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests who open their curtains this morning find the whole view already in full daylight.
phrases.clear_midday: At this hour nothing in the view is hidden, and guests can follow every detail out to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: One moment bright and the next in shade, the view keeps changing with the clouds this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests watching the view this afternoon see it brighten and dim as the clouds pass.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the view today, and its colours are quieter than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the far half of the view today, and the near half looks pale.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the far part of the view cannot be seen, and only the nearer part is clear.
phrases.rain: Guests watch the view through the rain today, its colours darker and its edges blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: For a second the storm lights the whole view, then guests wait for the thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is a rare sight in the Algarve, and guests stay indoors to watch it fall across the view.
phrases.very_cold: Every line of the view stands out clearly today, right to its far edge.
phrases.cold: Guests stay indoors today and look at the view from there.
phrases.very_hot: Nothing in the view moves today except the air, which trembles over it.
phrases.warm: Guests have a full, bright view today and no reason to hurry away from it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The colours of the view grow deeper and warmer as the afternoon ends.
phrases.partly_golden: The clouds turn orange and pink over the view as the sun goes down behind them.
phrases.grey_evening: The view has gone dark blue and grey this evening, and guests see it settle into night.
phrases.wet_evening: It is raining this evening, and the few lights in the view look blurred.
phrases.mild_night: Under cloud tonight, the view is dark and soft, with no sharp edges anywhere.
phrases.clear_night: Guests who look out tonight find the view dark and a great many stars above it.
phrases.late_night: At this late hour the view is asleep, and it will stay dark until morning.
phrases.dusk: Guests watch the view lose its colours one shade at a time while the sky above stays bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide grey surface below the bluff, and the sky above it grows slowly lighter.
phrases.clear_morning: From the private balconies, guests look down on a blue Pacific Ocean under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Pacific Ocean shines below the oceanfront pool at midday, bright blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pacific Ocean this morning, and Shell Beach below the bluff lies in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the tables at Marisol, guests watch patches of sun and shade cross the Pacific Ocean this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the horizon is a thin line.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Pacific Ocean today, and from the bluff guests see only the nearest waves at Shell Beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; the Pacific Ocean fades into pale air a short way out from the bluff.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pacific Ocean, and guests watch it through the arched windows of the lobby lounge.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and guests at Marisol follow the storm from the indoor tables facing the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Pacific Ocean, and guests in oceanfront suites watch the flakes disappear into the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, and guests in the spa look out at a sharp horizon on the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to the lobby lounge and look at the Pacific Ocean through its arched windows.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the oceanfront pool and look out over the Pacific Ocean from the cliff's edge.
phrases.warm: By the oceanfront pool, books stay closed on this warm day while guests look at the Pacific Ocean instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Marisol, the bar rings its daily bell as the sun drops toward the Pacific Ocean, and guests look up from their tables.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and turns the Pacific Ocean gold below the heated oceanfront pool.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Pacific Ocean is a dark surface beyond the pool, with no line between water and sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests at Marisol watch the rain fall where the Pacific Ocean disappears into the dark.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests in the balcony rooms see the lit pool at the cliff's edge and the Pacific Ocean without stars behind it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars hang over the Pacific Ocean tonight, and the private balconies have 100 feet of dark air below them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pacific Ocean is black below the bluff, and only the white of breaking waves shows.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Pacific Ocean just after sunset, and the water keeps a little of the colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky turns pale above the river first, and Puerto Madero waits for its colours.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches Puerto Madero, and from the skyline view rooms the river and the city share one frame.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Ecological Reserve spreads out below, with the river open behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Puerto Madero this morning, crossing from the city skyline to the river.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the skyline view rooms see the Ecological Reserve below in patches of sun and shade this afternoon, with the river beyond it.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Puerto Madero today, and the river beyond the Ecological Reserve is the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Buenos Aires skyline today, and guests can only guess where the river ends and the sky begins.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The river is not visible today; guests see the Ecological Reserve below and the nearer buildings of Puerto Madero, and little beyond.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Puerto Madero; guests watch it from a window seat between red velvet drapes, the city skyline blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Buenos Aires skyline for a second at a time, and thunder rolls over Puerto Madero.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Puerto Madero, and the Ecological Reserve below slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests in the converted El Porteño building can follow the city skyline all the way to the river.
phrases.cold: Cold air keeps the rooftop terrace quiet, and the city skyline stands clear beyond its empty chairs.
phrases.very_hot: By the pool, guests lie on red loungers in the heat and look up at the brick buildings around them.
phrases.warm: At Poolbar, guests hold a cold drink in the warm air and look over the pool to the buildings of Puerto Madero.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Poolbar, guests watch the sun go down over the Buenos Aires skyline, and the drinks wait a moment.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the city, and guests in the skyline view rooms have the whole horizon in front of them.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs low over Puerto Madero this evening, and the city lights give it a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening is wet, and the lights of the Buenos Aires skyline reach guests through running water on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy; the lights of Puerto Madero stay bright while the Ecological Reserve below keeps to the dark.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the city lights stop at the edge of the Ecological Reserve, and the stars take over above the river.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Puerto Madero is quiet, and the river is a wide dark space beyond the Ecological Reserve.
phrases.dusk: From the rooftop terrace, the first lights come on along the city skyline under a still-bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Abu Dhabi skyline is a dark outline before sunrise, with the Arabian Gulf turning pale grey beside it.
phrases.clear_morning: From the fitness center with Gulf views, early guests see the Arabian Gulf turn from grey to blue.
phrases.clear_midday: At Eclipse Terrace, the Abu Dhabi skyline stands sharp across the water, every tower easy to count.
phrases.partly_morning: The marina goes in and out of shade this morning, while the Abu Dhabi skyline stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Fitness centres lose count of their repetitions while patches of light cross the water.
phrases.overcast: The Arabian Gulf and the clouds are the same soft grey today, with the Abu Dhabi skyline drawn darker against them.
phrases.fog_haze: From Eclipse Terrace, the Abu Dhabi skyline is a row of pale towers in the haze, fading floor by floor.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the waterway and the near edge of the Arabian Gulf show today; the far water is not visible.
phrases.rain: Guests in the fitness center with Gulf views run on while rain turns the Arabian Gulf into a grey blur.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Fitness centres stop mid-exercise as lightning turns the water white for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is a rare sight over the Arabian Gulf, and today the flakes make the Abu Dhabi skyline look faint.
phrases.very_cold: The Abu Dhabi skyline looks sharp and bright today, and guests in the Royal Suite enjoy it from inside.
phrases.cold: The waterway lies still and empty, and the Arabian Gulf is a flat winter blue.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the terrace move slowly and look out over a bright, glittering Arabian Gulf.
phrases.warm: Sunglasses on, guests at Eclipse Terrace follow the line of the Abu Dhabi skyline from one end to the other.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The towers of the Abu Dhabi skyline turn gold one by one, and the Arabian Gulf picks up the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: From the terrace, the last sun finds gaps in the clouds and lays strips of orange on the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.grey_evening: Every lit tower of the Abu Dhabi skyline has a reflection in the water tonight.
phrases.wet_evening: Wet glass turns the lights of the Abu Dhabi skyline into long streaks this evening, and the Arabian Gulf disappears behind the rain.
phrases.mild_night: Small lights mark the marina tonight, and beyond them the Arabian Gulf is completely dark.
phrases.clear_night: Seen from the terrace, the Abu Dhabi skyline stands lit in the clear night, its lights lying in long lines on the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.late_night: At this late hour the marina is quiet, and the Arabian Gulf is only a darker space past the waterfront.
phrases.dusk: Eclipse Terrace catches the short moment when the Abu Dhabi skyline switches on and the Arabian Gulf still holds the daylight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Andaman Sea is a wide dark surface below the hillside, and Patong Beach is only a faint curve beside it.
phrases.clear_morning: From their private balconies, guests see Patong Bay, Kalim Beach and the Andaman Sea together under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Andaman Sea is bright blue at midday, and every boat in Patong Bay is easy to pick out from the balconies.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Patong Bay this morning, while Kalim Beach stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patong Beach shines between passing clouds this afternoon, and the Andaman Sea changes from blue to grey and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Andaman Sea turns the colour of steel, and Patong Beach is a lighter band at its edge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Patong Bay today, and the far end of Patong Beach fades into the white air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon of the Andaman Sea is not visible today; guests see Kalim Beach below and only the near water of Patong Bay.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Patong Bay, and guests watch it cross the water from the shelter of their balconies.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Andaman Sea, and for a second all of Patong Bay shows white below the hillside.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Patong Bay, and the flakes disappear into the grey Andaman Sea beside Patong Beach.
phrases.very_cold: The air is sharp and very cold above Patong today, and the Andaman Sea looks clear all the way to the horizon.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the jacuzzi suites keep to the warm water and look out at the Andaman Sea through the window.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the pool with ocean views and look across the shimmering Andaman Sea.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, swimmers rest at the edge of the pool and look out over the Andaman Sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills Patong Bay as the sun goes down towards the Andaman Sea, the daily show on this 20-acre hillside.
