phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds orange above the Andaman Sea, and Patong Beach turns gold below them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Patong follow the curve of Patong Beach around the bay.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights along Patong Beach this evening, and they shine on the wet surface of Patong Bay.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lights of Patong Beach glow under low cloud beside the black water of Patong Bay.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Andaman Sea, and the lights of Patong Beach draw a bright arc along the edge of the bay.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Patong Bay is quiet and black below the hillside, and the Andaman Sea is felt more than seen.
phrases.dusk: From the pool with ocean views, the sky still glows over the Andaman Sea as the first lights appear on Patong Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Bosphorus Strait lies still and grey-blue below the balconies, and the wooded Asian hills are only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Bosphorus Strait, and the wooded hills of the Asian shore stand clear and green across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At Olea & Bar, lunch is served under a clear sky, with the Bosphorus Strait bright blue beside the tables.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Bosphorus Strait this morning, and the 15 July Martyrs Bridge goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Bosphorus Lounge Cabanas, guests follow a passing yacht on the Bosphorus Strait while clouds drift over the Asian hills.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Bosphorus Strait turns the colour of steel, and the 15 July Martyrs Bridge stays sharp above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Bosphorus Strait today, so guests in the Royal Bosphorus Suite have soft white on three sides and water only near the shore.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today: the Bosphorus Strait is clear near the shore, but the Asian hills and the 15 July Martyrs Bridge cannot be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Bosphorus Strait, and guests in Bosphorus Lounge Cabanas watch the drops mark the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls along the Bosphorus Strait, and lightning shows the wooded Asian hills for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Bosphorus Strait, and from behind the balcony doors guests see the flakes disappear into the water.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day the Bosphorus Strait is a sharp, deep blue, and guests enjoy it from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in Bosphorus Lounge Cabanas look across the Bosphorus Strait to the wooded Asian hills, as they can in every season.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests of this 100-room hotel sit out on their balconies, metres from the Bosphorus Strait, and look at the cool water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day at Olea & Bar, guests sit among the olive trees and look out over the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Bosphorus Strait gold, and at Olea & Bar guests turn their chairs towards the water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink above the Bosphorus Strait, and the Asian hills take a warm orange light.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at Olea & Bar look at the Bosphorus Strait, where the lights of the far shore lie on the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain blurs the lights of the Asian shore, and the Bosphorus Strait shines black below Bosphorus Lounge Cabanas.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the 15 July Martyrs Bridge glows across the Bosphorus Strait, a lit line between two continents.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear at Olea & Bar, with stars above the Bosphorus Strait and the lights of the Asian shore across it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Bosphorus Strait is quiet and black, and the Asian hills can hardly be told from the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights of the 15 July Martyrs Bridge come on above the Bosphorus Strait.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear over the Atlantic, and Tolcarne Beach lies empty between the cliffs.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights Tolcarne Beach, and guests in the balcony rooms look straight down at sand and clear water.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Atlantic turns turquoise beyond the wide sand of Tolcarne Beach.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests at breakfast in the Colonial watch cloud shadows move across Tolcarne Beach towards the cliffs.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the Atlantic this afternoon, and the cliffs change colour each time.
phrases.overcast: The sky is grey and so is the Atlantic, but the waves still break white on Tolcarne Beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the cliffs today, and guests see the Atlantic fade away a little beyond the breaking waves.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests see Tolcarne Beach, the nearest waves and only part of the cliffs.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Tolcarne Beach, and guests in the beach suites watch the Atlantic through wet windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Atlantic, and guests have front-row seats as big waves roll onto Tolcarne Beach.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Tolcarne Beach, and guests watch the flakes disappear into the grey Atlantic.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and the sky is bright, so guests stay behind the glass and look out at the cliffs and the sea.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep their coffee inside the Colonial and watch the Atlantic waves from the warm side of the window.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests in the Hot Tub Beach Suite stand barefoot in their private beach garden and look over the Atlantic.
phrases.warm: Tolcarne Beach is busy on this warm day, and guests watch the swimmers from the sea-facing terraces.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light covers the sea and the cliffs, and from the Colonial guests watch Tolcarne Beach glow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the Atlantic turns gold in patches in front of the Colonial.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the stars this evening, and guests at dinner in the Colonial see the white surf on the dark beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the dark Atlantic this evening, and from the Colonial guests can just make out the cliffs.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the sea and the sky are one colour, and only the surf marks the beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Atlantic, and the cliffs on each side of Tolcarne Beach stand out against the clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Atlantic keeps moving in the dark, and the cliffs stand quiet on both sides of the sand.
phrases.dusk: The sun has set and the sky stays bright over the Atlantic, as the wet sand of Tolcarne Beach holds the last colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Aegean lies still and grey-blue beyond the private beach, and Naxos is a dark shape across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Sea Salt, guests look across a bright blue Aegean to Naxos under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the infinity pool of this 40-room hotel, the Aegean runs flat and blue to the horizon under the midday sun.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Aegean this morning, and guests in the sea view suites follow them towards Naxos.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the restaurant terrace, guests see clouds gather over the mountains of Naxos while the sea below stays in sunshine.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Aegean turns the colour of slate, and Naxos sits low across it from the private beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Aegean today, and from the restaurant terrace Naxos looks like a faint drawing on the horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Naxos is not visible today; guests on their suite terraces see only the Aegean, fading into pale air a short way out.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Aegean, and guests watch it from behind the glass doors of Sea Salt, Naxos blurred to a grey outline.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the mountains of Naxos for a second at a time, and guests watch the storm cross the Aegean from their sea view suites.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Aegean and hiding Naxos, though the hotel is closed for the winter and the private beach is empty.
phrases.very_cold: Cold, clear air shows every mountain of Naxos across the Aegean, sharp enough to count from the shore.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests keep to their sea view suites and look across a dark blue Aegean to Naxos.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stand in the infinity pool up to their shoulders and look at the Aegean, which seems to begin at the pool's edge.
phrases.warm: From the loungers on the private beach, guests look across clear, warm water to the mountains of Naxos.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun goes down behind the hotel, so from the infinity pool guests watch its last golden light land on Naxos instead.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Naxos turn pink and the Aegean below the restaurant terrace goes from blue to silver.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Sea Salt, guests look out at a cloudy evening sky and an Aegean that has turned almost black.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the dark Aegean this evening, and the lights of Naxos come and go behind it.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night the Aegean is black, and the lights of Naxos mark where the island begins.
phrases.clear_night: Stars stand over the Aegean on this clear night, and the infinity pool lies still in front of the sea.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Aegean is heard more than seen, and Naxos is a darker line where the sea stops.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky over the Aegean is still bright, and the first lights appear on Naxos across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clear sky slowly turns pale above Piazza del Popolo, seen from the Popolo Suite.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop terrace, guests see clear morning light spread across Rome's historic skyline, roof by roof.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Santa Maria in Montesanto stands sharp and bright at the edge of Piazza del Popolo.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Rome this morning, and from the rooftop terrace guests follow their shadows as they slide across the old rooftops.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over Santa Maria in Montesanto this afternoon, and the church's stone changes shade each time.
phrases.overcast: Guests on the Popolo Suite terrace look down on a calm Piazza del Popolo, its wide paving the same grey as the sky.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Rome's skyline today, and guests at the rooftop terrace see the far rooftops fade into a soft outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of Rome's skyline is not visible from the rooftop terrace today, but the nearest roofs and umbrella pines remain clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Piazza del Popolo, and the wet paving turns dark below Santa Maria in Montesanto.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Rome's rooftops, and guests in the Popolo Suite watch lightning flash above Santa Maria in Montesanto.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Piazza del Popolo, the square redesigned by Giuseppe Valadier, who also designed this hotel, and its lines slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Rome's skyline looks very sharp from the rooftop terrace, with every roof clearly drawn.
phrases.cold: The cold air is clear today, and the umbrella pines stand dark green above the Roman rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the rooftop terrace stay under the red-striped parasol and look out over Rome's bright skyline.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests sit outside on the Popolo Suite terrace and watch Piazza del Popolo fill with life.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Santa Maria in Montesanto a warm gold, and Piazza del Popolo glows beside it.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop terrace, guests watch the last sun slip between the clouds and colour Rome's skyline pink and orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of Piazza del Popolo make a soft glow around Santa Maria in Montesanto.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of Rome's skyline blur in the damp air beyond the rooftop terrace.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests at the rooftop terrace see the lit rooftops of Rome spread out quietly below the low sky.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, Santa Maria in Montesanto stands lit beside Piazza del Popolo, with stars above the square.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Piazza del Popolo finally has no audience, and Santa Maria in Montesanto keeps watch alone.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests at the rooftop terrace count the first lights coming on across Rome's skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Brisbane River lies still and grey under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the river view apartments watch the Brisbane River turn bright under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Brisbane River shines between the city rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Suncorp Stadium this morning, seen directly below the outdoor pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests watch the Brisbane River change from silver to green as clouds pass over it this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Brisbane River takes the same colour, and the city skyline stands out clearly above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and the Brisbane River looks like brushed metal.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the far suburbs are not visible and only the nearest stretch of the Brisbane River is clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Brisbane River behind them is blurred into a wide grey stroke.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Brisbane River for a second at a time, and guests on the upper floors of this 30-plus-level tower follow the whole storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Brisbane River, and the flakes disappear the moment they touch the water.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, guests see the Brisbane River sharply, and each tower of the city skyline stands out against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the outdoor pool is left to itself, and Suncorp Stadium lies still and clear below it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool up to their shoulders and look down at Suncorp Stadium from the water.
phrases.warm: On the loungers by the pool, guests look across to the city skyline and let the warm day pass.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Brisbane River gold, and the glass of the city skyline catches the same light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Brisbane River turn pink, and the water turns pink with them.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights reflect on the Brisbane River in long, soft stripes.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and the lights along the Brisbane River spread into blurred spots of colour.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud holds the glow of the city tonight, and the Brisbane River carries a paler copy of it.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the city skyline is fully lit beyond the pool terrace, and Suncorp Stadium sits below like a wide bowl.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Brisbane River is a dark band between sleeping streets, and almost nothing moves.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, guests watch the first lights come on across the city skyline while the sky over the Brisbane River is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Grand Canal is quiet before sunrise, and the dome of Santa Maria della Salute shows against a clear sky that slowly grows lighter.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Gio's Restaurant, guests watch the gondolas pass on the Grand Canal under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The midday sun lights the Grand Canal, and the domes of Santa Maria della Salute stand sharp across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over San Giorgio Maggiore's bell tower this morning, while the Grand Canal stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace of the Monet Suite, guests follow the cloud shadows as they cross the Grand Canal toward Santa Maria della Salute.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Grand Canal turns grey too, and the striped mooring poles in front of the waterfront terrace give the only colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Grand Canal today, and Santa Maria della Salute is a soft outline that Monet would have liked to paint.
phrases.reduced_visibility: San Giorgio Maggiore's bell tower is not visible today, but the Grand Canal and Santa Maria della Salute remain clear from the waterfront terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Grand Canal with small circles, and guests in Gio's Restaurant watch the water taxis pass from their indoor tables.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Grand Canal, and guests in rooms facing the water watch lightning flash behind Santa Maria della Salute.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Grand Canal and melts as it touches the water, while the domes of Santa Maria della Salute slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and Punta della Dogana and San Giorgio Maggiore's bell tower look close enough to touch across the water.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the covered and heated terrace of Gio's Restaurant keeps guests warm while they watch the boats on the Grand Canal.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests sit under the flower-covered pergolas of the waterfront terrace and watch the gondoliers do all the work on the Grand Canal.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, a singing gondolier passes on the Grand Canal, and guests on the waterfront terrace get the concert for free.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Since 1895, guests here have watched the late sun turn Santa Maria della Salute gold across the Grand Canal.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a way between the clouds and lights the Grand Canal in front of the private terrace of the Monet Suite.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Gio's Restaurant, guests look across the dark Grand Canal to the lights of the far bank under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Grand Canal this evening, and the lights along the water stretch into long wet reflections.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Grand Canal carries the lights of the last water taxis past the waterfront terrace.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in rooms facing the Grand Canal leave the curtains open for the lights on the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Grand Canal is nearly empty, and the water moves quietly against the mooring poles at the hotel's dock.
phrases.dusk: From the rooftop terrace, the dome of Santa Maria della Salute stands against a sky that is still bright, as the first lights appear along the Grand Canal.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Zurich lies still below the hill, and the Alps slowly take shape against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Lake Zurich, and guests in the balcony rooms see the Alps clear behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Lake Zurich is a wide blue band below the terrace, with the Alps behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Lake Zurich this morning, while the city rooftops below stay in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the clouds hide some peaks of the Alps and leave others free above Lake Zurich.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Lake Zurich turns the colour of steel, and the city rooftops stand out below the terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies over the city today, and guests on this hill look down as Lake Zurich shows through like a mirror.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Alps are not visible today, and Lake Zurich is only a pale surface beyond the nearest rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling over Zurich; guests watch from their room windows as Lake Zurich fades to grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Lake Zurich, and for a second the whole city below the hill is visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the terrace and the lawns, and Lake Zurich almost disappears behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing, clear day, the Alps look close behind Lake Zurich, and guests in this 1900 building enjoy them from behind glass.
phrases.cold: The cold keeps the air clear today, and the forested hills around Lake Zurich show their outline clearly.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay under the yellow parasols on the terrace and look down at Lake Zurich with some envy.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit in the garden with Lake Zurich and the city spread out below them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Lake Zurich gold, and guests in the balcony rooms put their books down to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes out under the clouds, and from the terrace Lake Zurich shines beyond the green lawns.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Zurich glow below the hill, and Lake Zurich is the dark space between them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the city lights around Lake Zurich blur into soft spots of colour.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights along the shore show guests in the balcony rooms where Lake Zurich begins.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the lights of Zurich reach down to Lake Zurich, and from the hill each one is sharp.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Zurich rests below the hill, waiting for the Alps to come back with the day.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and the first city lights appear around Lake Zurich while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Mediterranean is calm and grey-blue, and the Frioul Islands slowly take shape out at sea.
phrases.clear_morning: From the terrace, the Mediterranean is deep blue in the clear morning light, and Château d'If stands sharp out at sea.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Panoramic Suite, the southern bay of Marseille runs from the Maïre Islands to Château d'If under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Mediterranean this morning, and the Frioul Islands change from grey to white as they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At the gastronomic restaurant, guests look out to a horizon where clouds and patches of blue share the afternoon sky.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Mediterranean turns the colour of slate, and Château d'If stands pale against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Mediterranean today, and the Frioul Islands look like a faint drawing on the horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Frioul Islands and Château d'If are not visible today; from the terrace, only the rocky coastline and the nearest stretch of sea can be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Mediterranean, and guests watch it from the gastronomic restaurant while the horizon disappears into grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Mediterranean, and for a second the Frioul Islands appear sharp and white before the thunder arrives.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the terrace and vanishing into the Mediterranean, a rare sight that guests follow from their sea-facing rooms.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and very clear, and every rock of the Frioul Islands looks close enough to count.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the floor-to-ceiling glass of their suites and look at white wave crests on the Mediterranean.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the seawater pool and look over its edge at the Mediterranean, which is only a few steps further.
phrases.warm: By the pool on a warm day, books stay closed while guests look across the Mediterranean to Château d'If.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the rocky coastline in the late afternoon, and the Frioul Islands turn the colour of honey.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Mediterranean turn pink and orange, and the terrace has a front-row seat.
phrases.grey_evening: At Le 1917, guests have dinner under a cloudy evening sky while the Mediterranean darkens and the Frioul Islands fade from sight.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass at the gastronomic restaurant tonight, and dinner guests look out at a wet, black Mediterranean.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the Mediterranean is a wide dark surface below the terrace, and the Frioul Islands can just be made out.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Mediterranean tonight, and from the terrace the Frioul Islands are a low dark shape on the horizon.
phrases.late_night: A house by the sea since 1917, and in the small hours the Mediterranean is still there below the windows, dark and quiet.
phrases.dusk: At Le 1917, guests hold a cocktail and look over the sea to Château d'If and the Frioul Islands while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Bay of Palma lies still and grey-blue below the fortress walls, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the gazebos of the suites in the old gun embrasures, guests watch boats sail across the Bay of Palma in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Mediterranean is deep blue from the fortress walls to the horizon, with no cloud above it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Bay of Palma this morning, and the water changes from dark blue to light blue and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace of the El Cabo Suite, guests have the whole Bay of Palma below them, part in sun and part under cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Mediterranean turns grey too, and the horizon almost disappears.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies on the Bay of Palma today, and the boats seem to float in the air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the Bay of Palma is not visible today; guests see only the water close to the headland.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Bay of Palma, and guests in this 19th-century fortress watch it from inside the stone walls.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the whole Bay of Palma for a second, then thunder rolls over the fortress walls.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling into the Mediterranean, and the Bay of Palma is grey behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Bay of Palma shines a sharp blue below the headland.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Mediterranean is quiet and pale blue around the headland.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests look for shade on their terraces, and the Mediterranean looks cooler with every minute.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, boats cross the Bay of Palma slowly, and guests on the fortress walls count sails instead of hours.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the cliff-edge terraces of the Sentinel rooms, guests watch the low sun turn the Mediterranean gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lays orange paths on the Bay of Palma below the headland.
phrases.grey_evening: On summer evenings La Fortaleza moves to the fortress roof, and diners look out at the Mediterranean under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Bay of Palma this evening, and the water and the sky become one dark wall off the headland.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Bay of Palma is a wide dark space with the sound of water below.
phrases.clear_night: At La Fortaleza on the roof in summer, every dinner table has the Mediterranean in sight, tonight under a clear sky full of stars.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Bay of Palma is black and quiet, and only the sea moves below the headland.
phrases.dusk: The drawbridge goes up at sunset, and the Bay of Palma belongs to the guests while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Horseshoe Falls show as a grey curve under a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Milestones on the Falls, guests at the window tables look out over green treetops to Niagara Falls in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the water going over the Horseshoe Falls is bright turquoise along the whole wide crest.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Horseshoe Falls this morning, and the turquoise water changes shade as they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the two-story lofts on the 22nd floor, guests follow patches of afternoon sun as they cross the Canadian and American cascades.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the white water of the Horseshoe Falls stands out clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides part of the Horseshoe Falls today, and the crest comes and goes behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: the Horseshoe Falls are still in sight, and the American cascade is not.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the two-story lofts, and guests watch the Horseshoe Falls keep pouring through it, slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Niagara Falls, and for a second the whole crest of the Horseshoe Falls turns white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Horseshoe Falls, and the flakes drift down toward the water.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the turquoise water of the Horseshoe Falls keeps moving, and guests look at it from indoors.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the window tables at Milestones on the Falls let guests look at Niagara Falls for as long as they like without a coat.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests look at the cool turquoise water falling over the Horseshoe Falls.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, the treetops below are green and Niagara Falls shine white and turquoise behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Horseshoe Falls gold along the crest, and guests in the fallsview rooms stop what they are doing to look.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Canadian and American cascades turn pink and the water below takes some of the colour.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in Milestones on the Falls, guests at the window tables see the Horseshoe Falls lit up under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lit Horseshoe Falls glow through the drops on the glass of Milestones on the Falls.
phrases.mild_night: The illuminated Horseshoe Falls stand out against a cloudy night sky, and the low clouds catch a little of the glow.
phrases.clear_night: From the 22nd floor, guests in the two-story lofts have the illuminated Horseshoe Falls in full frame under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who are still awake find the Horseshoe Falls still pouring in the dark.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright and the first lights come on across the Horseshoe Falls.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Taormina Bay lies still under a clear sky, and the two rocky promontories are only just visible.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Bay of Sirens, and the water under the room balconies turns clear turquoise.
phrases.clear_midday: From the restaurant terrace, guests look along the Ionian coast between the two rocky promontories under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across Taormina Bay this morning, while the cove below stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds gather over the green hillsides this afternoon, and from the terraces guests still find Taormina Bay blue below them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Taormina Bay loses its turquoise and takes a quiet silver colour instead.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Taormina Bay today, and the far promontory looks like a drawing left half finished.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of Taormina Bay is not visible today; the cove and the nearest rocks are still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Bay of Sirens, and guests watch the drops mark the water from their balconies.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the two rocky promontories for a second, then Taormina Bay goes back to rain and thunder.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Taormina Bay, and the flakes disappear the moment they touch the sea.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the air over Taormina Bay is very clear, and guests admire the water from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the cove is quiet, and Taormina Bay keeps its blue colour in the pale light.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests on the floating sea platform look down through the clear turquoise water of Taormina Bay before jumping in.
phrases.warm: At Kori Beach Bar, guests hold a Sicilian granita and look at the sea a few steps away.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Kori Bar, guests look over the sea as the late sun turns the rocks around the cove golden.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds gaps in the clouds, and from the restaurant terrace the Ionian coast is lit piece by piece.
phrases.grey_evening: On the restaurant terrace, guests have dinner while Taormina Bay turns from grey to black under the evening clouds.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and Taormina Bay is a blur of water above and water below.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hide the stars, and guests on their balconies listen to Taormina Bay more than they see it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill the clear sky over Taormina Bay, and the two rocky promontories stand black on either side of the cove.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, nothing moves on Taormina Bay except the sea against the rocks.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over Taormina Bay, and the first lights appear along the Ionian coast.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Empire State Building stands as a quiet outline over the sleeping roofs of SoHo.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun pours through the oversized windows, and the Empire State Building and the Chrysler Building stand sharp against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Manhattan skyline is clear from end to end, and guests pick out the Chrysler Building at once.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Lower Manhattan rooftops this morning, while One World Trade Center catches the light.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests follow the clouds as they drift over the Manhattan skyline, putting the Empire State Building in shade and then back in sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Empire State Building and the Chrysler Building keep their shapes clearly, like two cut-outs on plain paper.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Manhattan skyline today, and guests see the Empire State Building as a pale tower that fades towards the top.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Chrysler Building is not in sight and the Empire State Building only just shows beyond the SoHo rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows, and guests watch the Empire State Building blur behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests watch the storm cross the Manhattan skyline, with lightning flashing behind the towers and thunder following a few seconds later.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over SoHo, and the Manhattan skyline slowly fades to white behind it.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing, clear air, guests can see every edge of the Empire State Building, and nobody is in a hurry to go outside.
phrases.cold: A cold day gives the Manhattan skyline a still, clean look, with the Chrysler Building standing among the Midtown towers.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the Manhattan skyline shimmers, and the Empire State Building seems to stand in moving air.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests in the balcony rooms sit out on their private terraces above SoHo, with the Manhattan skyline in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Empire State Building gold, and guests stop what they are doing to watch.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Manhattan skyline turn orange, and guests watch the colour reach the Chrysler Building.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Empire State Building glows gold, and the lights of Midtown spread out around it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Manhattan skyline run together, and guests can still find the Empire State Building by its glow.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit downtown skyscrapers stand beside the Manhattan Bridge, and the cloud above them holds the glow of the city.
phrases.clear_night: Open since 2011, and on clear nights guests still go to bed late, because the lit Empire State Building keeps them watching.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Manhattan skyline is quiet and still, and the few guests still awake have the Empire State Building to themselves.
phrases.dusk: From the terrace at dusk, the first lights come on across the Manhattan skyline and the Manhattan Bridge under a deep blue sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear over Val Casies, and the Dolomites show as a grey outline at the end of the valley.
phrases.clear_morning: The first sunlight reaches the pale rock of the Dolomites, in plain sight from the south-facing balconies.
phrases.clear_midday: The rooftop infinity pool points straight down Val Casies today, with wooded slopes on each side and the Dolomites clear at the far end.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the pastures in front of the panoramic outdoor pool this morning, and the Dolomites behind them go in and out of sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The rooftop yoga and meditation platform has mountains on every side this afternoon, some in sun and some under cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Dolomites keep their pale colour above the dark wooded slopes of Val Casies.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze fills Val Casies today, and from the rooftop infinity pool the Dolomites are only a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Dolomites are not visible today; only the green valley floor and the nearest wooded slopes can be seen from the rooftop infinity pool.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Val Casies, and guests in the Dolomites Bio Sauna watch the wooded slopes blur behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls along Val Casies, and guests behind the glass of the Dolomites Bio Sauna watch lightning show the mountains for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Val Casies, and from the Dolomites Bio Sauna guests watch the wooded slopes turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air the Dolomites stand sharp against the sky, and guests look at them from the warm side of the Dolomites Bio Sauna glass.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the Dolomites look close in the clean air, and guests admire them from behind the balcony doors of the Wellness Suite.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests stay up to their shoulders in the outdoor infinity sport pool and look along the green valley to the Dolomites.
phrases.warm: On the sunbathing lawn, books stay closed while guests look at the mountains around Val Casies.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun warms the pale rock of the Dolomites, and guests in the rooftop infinity pool watch the colour deepen at the end of the valley.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights one Dolomite summit at a time above the wooded slopes.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the Dolomites this evening, and only the dark wooded slopes of Val Casies remain in sight.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in this house that began in 1950 as a 7-room inn stay behind the balcony glass tonight while wet weather covers Val Casies.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, and a few warm lights mark the floor of Val Casies between the mountains.
phrases.clear_night: A clear sky full of stars hangs over the mountains tonight, seen from the private roof terrace of the Sky Loft & SPA Suite.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Val Casies lies dark and quiet between its wooded slopes, with the Dolomites out of sight until morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays bright behind the Dolomites for a few minutes after sunset, while the valley below turns blue and its first lights appear.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before the sun is up, the Thames runs dark and quiet past the still London Eye.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Big Ben view room open the curtains to find the clock tower bright across the Thames.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the London Eye turns slowly beside the river with every capsule easy to count.
phrases.partly_morning: From the River rooms, guests watch patches of sun travel down the river between the clouds.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The London Eye goes grey, then white again, as clouds pass over the Thames this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Palace of Westminster looks like a pencil drawing across the Thames.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Thames, and the London Eye shows only its lower half.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The London Eye is only a pale outline today, but the Thames just below is still easy to see.
phrases.rain: Rain blurs the London Eye while its capsules carry on turning above the wet Thames.
phrases.thunderstorm: In the Big Ben view room, guests count the seconds between lightning and thunder over the Thames.
phrases.snow: Guests in the River rooms stay warm and watch the snow disappear into the river.
phrases.very_cold: Every spoke of the London Eye shows clearly above the Thames on this freezing day.
phrases.cold: From the Big Ben view room, guests check the time on Big Ben without stepping out into the cold.
phrases.very_hot: The London Eye turns lazily in the heat, and the Thames below it looks tempting.
phrases.warm: The Thames is full of light today, and Westminster Bridge crosses it with Big Ben at the far end.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Houses of Parliament turn honey-coloured across the Thames as the afternoon ends.
phrases.partly_golden: A gap in the clouds lights the top of the London Eye while the river below is already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the River rooms see the evening lights lying in long lines on the river.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight's rain turns the lit London Eye into a soft ring of colour above the Thames.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in the Big Ben view room can read the time on the lit face of Big Ben before they sleep.
phrases.clear_night: The Thames shows the lit London Eye a second time tonight, upside down on the water.
phrases.late_night: The London Eye has stopped for the night, but the Thames keeps moving past it.
phrases.dusk: Guests in the River rooms watch the first lamps come on along the river while the sky is still pale.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the cliff of Paro Taktsang is a dark shape above the forest, and the sky behind it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From a table at Vista, guests see Paro Taktsang clear on its rock face in the first sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Paro Taktsang stands out sharply on its cliff, with nothing but protected forest in front of it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud takes Paro Taktsang this morning and gives it back a few minutes later, while guests at Vista wait with their coffee.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the indoor heated pool, swimmers watch cloud shadows move across the surrounding ranges.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the forested hills turn a darker green, and Paro Taktsang stays visible on its cliff from the room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has covered the cliff today, so guests at Vista look at the nearest trees of the forest and wait for Paro Taktsang to return.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: the peaks are hidden, and Paro Taktsang is difficult to find on its cliff.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Paro Valley, and guests watch from their rooms as Paro Taktsang blurs behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls around the ranges, and lightning shows the cliff of Paro Taktsang for a second through the windows of Vista.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the forest, and from the indoor heated pool the surrounding ranges turn white behind the glass.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, the snow-capped peaks look close, and guests study Paro Taktsang from an armchair indoors.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the lobby's floor-to-ceiling windows frame the valley hills, and nobody hurries to go outside.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the terrace keep to the shade and look across the forested hills to the snow-capped peaks.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests back from the climb sit at Vista and look for the exact ledge at Paro Taktsang where they stood.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight turns the rock face gold, and Paro Taktsang holds the light longer than the forest below it.
phrases.partly_golden: From the 45 rooms and suites, guests watch the last sun find gaps in the cloud and light the peaks one at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at Vista look out to the cliff where Paro Taktsang hides until morning.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and guests at their room windows see the forested hills only as a darker band behind it.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the warm-glowing pavilions and water features are the brightest things below the mountains.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, stars fill the sky above the Paro Valley, and the ridge of the Taktsang mountain cuts a clean edge under them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the valley is quiet and unlit, and Paro Taktsang waits on its cliff, 6 km away, for the first light.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky turns violet and pink over the forested mountains, while the fire pit is lit below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Zurich lies still under a clear sky, and the wooded hills beyond are only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast, a lakeside window frames Lake Zurich in clear morning light, and the croissants have to compete for attention.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Lake Zurich turns turquoise, and the moored sailboats show white against it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the wooded hills this morning, and their shadows move slowly across Lake Zurich.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the wraparound terrace of the Tower Suite, guests follow patches of sun and shade along the full stretch of Lake Zurich this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Lake Zurich looks like polished metal under the overcast sky, and the tree-lined promenade draws its edge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the hills today, so guests see Lake Zurich as water without a far shore.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of Lake Zurich is not visible today; guests still see the near water, the promenade trees and the closest sailboats.
phrases.rain: Rain marks Lake Zurich with thousands of small rings, and guests in the lake-view rooms watch it from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows guests the whole of Lake Zurich for a second, then the storm closes over the water again.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Lake Zurich, and from the top-floor terrace of the Tower Suite the hills beyond turn white little by little.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Lake Zurich is a sharp blue, and guests can pick out every wooded hill beyond it.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in this 1928 Art Deco building look out over Lake Zurich, where the sailboats rest at their moorings.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, Lake Zurich looks cool and turquoise, and people keep to the shade under the promenade trees.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, walkers fill the tree-lined promenade, and Lake Zurich shines behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lays a gold path across Lake Zurich, and the masts of the sailboats throw long shadows on the water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Lake Zurich turn pink, and the water copies them without shame.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, Lake Zurich goes black, and the city lights glow along its edge.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Lake Zurich this evening, and the city lights reflect in broken lines on the wet promenade.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests in a hotel that opened in 1932 look out on a calm Lake Zurich.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above Lake Zurich on this clear night, and the still water holds a few of them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Lake Zurich lies quiet and unlit beyond the promenade trees.
phrases.dusk: From the Tower Suite terrace, guests see the city skyline switch on its first lights while Lake Zurich still holds the bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Adriatic Sea is a dark band beyond the olive grove, and the sky above it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the terraces, guests see white parapets, then silver olive trees, then the Adriatic Sea, all sharp in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: On the platform at the San Domenico a Mare cove, lunch at La Nassa is served with the open Adriatic Sea at table level.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the olive grove this morning, while the Adriatic Sea behind it stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terraces, guests follow the clouds as they drift over the olive rows and out over the Adriatic Sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Adriatic Sea turns the colour of the olive leaves in front of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Adriatic Sea today, and the far end of the olive grove seems to fade into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Adriatic Sea is not clear from the terraces today; guests see the olive grove and then only a pale blur.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the olive grove, and guests watch from the balcony suites as the Adriatic Sea turns grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Adriatic Sea for a second beyond the olive grove, and thunder rolls in over the trees.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the olive trees, and guests at the balcony doors can only just see the Adriatic Sea through it.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, the Adriatic Sea looks closer than usual from the terraces, a deep blue beyond the still olive trees.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests stay behind the balcony doors of their suites and look over the olive grove to the Adriatic Sea.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests at the San Domenico a Mare cove stay under the white umbrellas and look at the Adriatic Sea from the shade.
phrases.warm: On the warm sand of La Fonte beach, books stay closed while guests look at the Adriatic Sea instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the olive grove gold, and beyond the white parapets of the terraces the Adriatic Sea becomes a darker blue.
phrases.partly_golden: On the stone terrace under the reed pergola, guests watch the last sun colour the clouds over the Adriatic Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: This cloudy evening, the Adriatic Sea is a wide dark space beyond the olive grove, with no stars above it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the olive grove this evening, and guests in the balcony suites see only a few wet trees in front of the dark Adriatic Sea.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests can just see where the black olive grove ends and the Adriatic Sea begins.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests look for the Adriatic Sea beyond the olive grove, as the Knights of Malta did from the 15th-century tower.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the olive grove is black and still, and the Adriatic Sea beyond it cannot be told from the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright over the Adriatic Sea, and guests in this hotel opened in 1996 watch the olive grove darken first.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sailboats in Viaduct Harbour are still, their masts thin lines against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Viaduct Harbour, and from the marina-facing balconies guests can count the sailboats one by one.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch in La Marée, guests look out at the blue water of Viaduct Harbour and the white hulls of the sailboats under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Viaduct Harbour this morning, and the moored sailboats go from bright to grey and back again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the waterfront terrace, guests watch patches of sun cross the moored yachts this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the water of Viaduct Harbour turns the colour of steel, and the white boats stand out more clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Viaduct Harbour today; the nearest sailboats are clear, while the city skyline behind them is only a soft outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The city skyline is not visible today, so the view stops at the sailboats and the waterfront promenade below.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Viaduct Harbour, and guests watch it mark the water from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Viaduct Harbour, and the masts of the sailboats sway while lightning brightens the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Viaduct Harbour, and the decks of the moored sailboats slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and clear; guests stay behind the glass of La Marée and look at the sailboats in sharp light.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the waterfront promenade is quiet, and the sailboats pull gently at their ropes in Viaduct Harbour.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests on the waterfront terrace choose the shade and watch yachts that look too lazy to move.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, people walk along the waterfront promenade, and guests on the marina-facing balconies have both them and the sailboats to watch.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the masts in Viaduct Harbour gold, and the water between the boats shines the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Viaduct Harbour turn orange, and guests at their balcony doors stop to look.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in La Marée, revamped in 2023, guests look at the promenade lights on the water under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass at La Marée this evening, and the lights of Viaduct Harbour blur into long streaks on the water.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lamps of the waterfront promenade make a soft glow around the sailboats.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the city skyline is lit behind Viaduct Harbour, and its lights lie doubled in the still water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Viaduct Harbour is quiet, and the sailboats rest side by side on black water.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset the sky is still bright over Viaduct Harbour, and the first lights come on along the waterfront promenade.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Prague Castle stands unlit against a clear sky, and the Vltava River below is still and grey.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on Prague Castle, and every tower stands sharp above the Vltava River.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests in castle-view rooms can follow the full line of Prague Castle along its hill.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Vltava River this morning, while the Rudolfinum stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests watch clouds drift behind Prague Castle this afternoon, and the castle walls change from bright to dull and back.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Vltava River turns the colour of slate, and Prague Castle keeps its grey to match.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on the Vltava River today, and Prague Castle seems to float above it with no hill underneath.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: guests can make out the Vltava River and the Rudolfinum, but Prague Castle is only a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Vltava River, and guests watch it from their balcony doors, Prague Castle blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Prague Castle, and each flash of lightning shows the castle walls for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the red rooftops of Malá Strana, and Prague Castle turns white little by little.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, Prague Castle looks sharp enough to cut paper, and the Vltava River shines below it.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Vltava River looks like steel, and the Rudolfinum stands quiet beside it.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests on the balconies look for a breeze from the Vltava River and find Prague Castle instead.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests with balcony rooms stay outside and look from the Rudolfinum across to the castle walls.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests watch the low sun turn the castle walls gold, while the Vltava River below carries the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Prague Castle turn pink, and guests forget what they were doing.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, Prague Castle is lit, and its glow reaches the low sky above it.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights along the Vltava River break into small pieces on the water.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, guests find Prague Castle lit under the clouds, with the Vltava River a dark band below.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit towers of Prague Castle stand above the Vltava River, and guests count the stars above them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Vltava River is quiet and Prague Castle rests on its hill, and guests who cannot sleep have good company.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and guests see the first lights come on along the Vltava River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific Ocean is a wide dark surface under a clear sky, and the first light is only a thin band on the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun rises over the Pacific Ocean, and its light reaches Surfers Paradise Beach and the Broadwater Parklands below.
phrases.clear_midday: From suites between levels 25 and 55, guests look down on the green Broadwater Parklands and out to a bright blue Pacific Ocean.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Broadwater Parklands this morning, while the Surfers Paradise skyline stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the outdoor pool and spa, guests look over the Broadwater marina as clouds drift past the Surfers Paradise skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pacific Ocean turns the colour of steel, and the Surfers Paradise skyline stands out clearly against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Surfers Paradise skyline today, and the towers look like a row of pencil lines above the Broadwater marina.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Pacific horizon is not visible today; the Broadwater Parklands below are clear, and the Surfers Paradise skyline is only a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Broadwater Parklands, and guests watch it from their suite windows with the Surfers Paradise skyline slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second the whole Surfers Paradise skyline shows through the rain.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Broadwater Parklands, and guests watch the Surfers Paradise skyline fade behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air is sharp and very clear today, and every tower of the Surfers Paradise skyline is easy to count beyond the Broadwater Parklands.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests stay behind the large windows and follow the white lines of surf along Surfers Paradise Beach.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool and look across the Broadwater marina to the Surfers Paradise skyline.
phrases.warm: By the outdoor pool, books stay closed while guests look at the Broadwater marina and the Surfers Paradise skyline instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the towers of the Surfers Paradise skyline, and guests on their balconies watch the sun drop towards the hinterland.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Pacific Ocean turn pink, and Surfers Paradise Beach below them takes the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lights of the Surfers Paradise skyline glow beyond the Broadwater Parklands.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass this evening, and the lights of the Surfers Paradise skyline spread into soft colours.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, guests in the ocean balcony suites look at the lit Surfers Paradise skyline under a cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Surfers Paradise skyline shines beside a black Pacific Ocean, and the Broadwater Parklands lie quiet below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Broadwater Parklands are still and Surfers Paradise Beach is empty beside the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.dusk: From the ocean suites above the 53rd floor, guests watch the first lights come on along the Surfers Paradise skyline under a sky that is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the rooftop, the Tokyo Skytree stands dark against the first light before sunrise.
phrases.clear_morning: From the restaurant, guests have a clear view of the Tokyo Skytree this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Mt Fuji is in sight today, a quiet shape far beyond the city.
phrases.partly_morning: Sun and shade take turns on Kaminarimon Gate across the road this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the city this afternoon, while the Tokyo Skytree stands above it all.
phrases.overcast: The Tokyo Skytree and the cloud are nearly the same grey today, but guests in the restaurant can still tell them apart.
phrases.fog_haze: Seen from the rooftop, the Tokyo Skytree is a pale outline in today's haze.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Kaminarimon Gate across the road is as clear as ever, though the far city and Mt Fuji cannot be seen today.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the restaurant, and guests see the Tokyo Skytree grey and soft behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Storm clouds sit over the city, and guests in the restaurant watch the Tokyo Skytree between flashes of lightning.
phrases.snow: Across the road, snow is settling on Kaminarimon Gate while guests watch from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_cold: Every line of the Tokyo Skytree is sharp in today's freezing air, and guests count its decks from behind glass.
phrases.cold: The Tokyo Skytree stands over the city today, and guests are content to study it from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: Guests on the rooftop take a quick photo of the Tokyo Skytree in the heat and head back inside.
phrases.warm: Nobody on the rooftop is in a hurry this afternoon, and guests take one more photo of the Tokyo Skytree.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light lies on the city now, and Mt Fuji shows as a clear outline far away.
phrases.partly_golden: The Tokyo Skytree catches the last sun through a gap in the clouds while the city below is already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests this evening see the Tokyo Skytree lit under cloud, with the city bright below it.
phrases.wet_evening: Through tonight's rain, guests see the Tokyo Skytree as a soft column of light.
phrases.mild_night: The city stays bright under tonight's cloud, and guests take a last look at the Tokyo Skytree before sleep.
phrases.clear_night: City lights spread wide tonight, and the lit Tokyo Skytree stands well above them.
phrases.late_night: The city is quiet now, and the Tokyo Skytree keeps its place above the rooftops for guests who cannot sleep.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the Tokyo Skytree stands against a sky that is still bright while the city begins to light up.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky over Ürgüp is clear and still without sun, and its western side, toward Göreme, waits for the first hot-air balloons.
phrases.clear_morning: Hot-air balloons lift over Göreme into a clear western sky and drift across the valleys, in full sight from the private patios.
phrases.clear_midday: The hot-air balloons over Göreme landed hours ago, and from the heated panoramic pool the Ürgüp panorama is now sharp under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests count the hot-air balloons over Göreme from their suite windows this morning, losing a few each time a cloud passes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace of Revithia, cloud shadows move slowly across Ürgüp and the surrounding valleys this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Ürgüp and its valleys take the colour of the stone, a calm panorama from the heated panoramic pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze fills the valleys today, and guests see Ürgüp below as soft outlines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: guests can see Ürgüp below the hillside, but the far valleys toward Göreme are not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Ürgüp, and guests in these 18th- and 19th-century cave houses watch the wet town through their windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm crosses the valleys, and lightning shows the Ürgüp panorama for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Ürgüp, and guests watch the town and the valleys turn white, flake by flake.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and guests can follow each valley where the hot-air balloons over Göreme drift on flying mornings.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the heated panoramic pool stays warm, and the Ürgüp panorama lies open in front of it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the heated panoramic pool hardly needs its heating, and guests look over Ürgüp from the water.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit on their private patios with the Ürgüp panorama in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the Ürgüp hillside gold, and the western sky over Göreme, where the balloons fly at sunrise, is now empty and bright.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the valleys, and guests look across Ürgüp from this neighbourhood of 43 rooms, suites and mansions.
phrases.grey_evening: On the terrace of Manzara Bistro, the fireplace is lit, and the Cappadocia valley lies dim under evening cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls this evening, and the lights of Ürgüp look blurred from the terrace of Revithia.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests look down on the lights of Ürgüp spread across the valley.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the valleys tonight, and the lights of Ürgüp shine below the hillside under a clear sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Ürgüp is quiet, and the valleys around it can barely be told from the sky.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright above the valleys, and the first lights of Ürgüp come on, seen from the heated panoramic pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Duomo is a dark shape above the sleeping rooftops of Florence, seen from the panoramic terrace.
phrases.clear_morning: From the breakfast terrace, the Italian garden and the Duomo stand sharp under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Duomo rises clear above the terracotta rooftops, and guests at lunch in Da Giacomo al Salviatino keep turning to look.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the rooms facing the Duomo watch cloud shadows cross the rooftops of Florence this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the panoramic terrace, the Tuscan landscape is a patchwork of sun and shade this afternoon, with the Duomo in the middle of it.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the terracotta rooftops of Florence look darker, and the Duomo still stands above them.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over Florence today, and from the pool the Duomo looks like a soft pencil drawing above the city.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tuscan hills behind Florence are not visible today; from the panoramic terrace guests see the Duomo and the nearest rooftops only.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Italian garden, and guests in the Sala Affresco watch the Duomo turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Fiesole hills, and each flash of lightning shows the Duomo for a second to the suites that face it.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the cypress trees and olive groves below the villa, and the Duomo almost disappears behind the white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is cold and very clear, so guests in the Sala Affresco can pick out the Duomo and the hills far behind Florence.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the heated pool lies still in the park, and the Florence skyline beyond it has no swimmers to share it with.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the pool up to their shoulders and look over the edge at the Tuscan hills.
phrases.warm: At the Pool Bar, guests sit with a caffe shakerato and look over the herb garden and the green vegetation all around.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the terrace of Rosa Bar, the low sun turns the Florentine hills gold, and the Duomo with them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes under the clouds and lights the Duomo alone, while the rooftops around it are already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Da Giacomo al Salviatino faces the lights of Florence tonight, glowing softly under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the 15th-century villa, and the lights of Florence become blurred points behind the glass.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the dome of St Peter's Basilica is a dark shape on the horizon under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the rooftops of Rome first, then the dome of St Peter's Basilica on the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: From Cielo Bar on the rooftop, guests see St Peter's Basilica clearly at midday, far beyond the Spanish Steps.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the rooftops of Rome this morning, while St Peter's Basilica stays in the light.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the two terraces of the Suite de la Ville, guests watch clouds drift over the rooftops of Rome.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the dome of St Peter's Basilica keeps its clean outline above the rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Rome today, and St Peter's Basilica looks like a pencil drawing on the horizon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: St Peter's Basilica is not visible on the horizon today; the rooftops around the Spanish Steps still are.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftops of Rome, and guests in the balcony rooms watch the tiles shine.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the dome of St Peter's Basilica for a second, then the storm hides it again.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the rooftops above the Spanish Steps, and guests watch Rome turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and St Peter's Basilica looks closer than it is.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the Suite de la Ville look across the rooftops to St Peter's Basilica from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests at Cielo Bar stay under the red-striped umbrellas and look out at St Peter's Basilica.
phrases.warm: On a warm day at Cielo Bar, drinks arrive and guests still look at St Peter's Basilica first.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the skyline of Rome gold, and guests at Cielo Bar face St Peter's Basilica.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights the dome of St Peter's Basilica for a few minutes.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights spread below the rooftop, and the lit dome of St Peter's Basilica marks the horizon.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests watch the rain blur the lit dome of St Peter's Basilica and the city lights below it.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the lights of Rome glow below the terraces of the Suite de la Ville.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the lit dome of St Peter's Basilica stands sharp above the rooftops.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Rome is quiet around this 18th-century palazzo above the Spanish Steps, and the rooftops are in shadow.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright above St Peter's Basilica, and the first lights come on across Rome's rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Space Needle stands as a dark shape against a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: On a clear morning, guests on the upper floors see the Space Needle and Lake Union in the same window, with the mountain range behind both.
phrases.clear_midday: The Space Needle stands sharp against a blue midday sky, and guests can follow every line of it from top to base.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning clouds move over Lake Union, while the Space Needle stays in sunshine for now.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At ALTITUDE Sky Lounge, guests look over the Seattle skyline as cloud shadows cross it this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Lake Union takes the same colour, and the Space Needle looks darker in front of the cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Space Needle today, and guests at the windows wait for it to come back.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The mountain range is not visible today, but the Space Needle and the nearer city rooftops are still clear to see.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass ceiling of ALTITUDE Sky Lounge, and the Space Needle looks slightly blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Space Needle, and guests watch the storm from behind floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling across the Seattle skyline, and the Space Needle shows only faintly through the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing, clear air, the Space Needle has clean edges, and guests admire it from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests on the 16th floor stay indoors at ALTITUDE Sky Lounge and look out at the Seattle skyline.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, guests on the terrace of ALTITUDE Sky Lounge find that the Space Needle looks best from a seat in the shade.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests sit on the terrace of ALTITUDE Sky Lounge with the Space Needle and the Seattle skyline in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun colours the Space Needle, and the water of Lake Union shines beside it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and lights the Space Needle from one side.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Space Needle is lit, and guests can pick it out easily among the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests look through the wet glass and see the lights of the Seattle skyline as soft spots of colour.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the lit Space Needle stands in front of the low clouds.
phrases.clear_night: With cocktails at ALTITUDE Sky Lounge, guests look out at the lit Space Needle under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, guests who are still awake find the tall outline of the Space Needle above the quiet rooftops.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright behind the Space Needle while the first city lights come on below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky over Seoul's high-rises is clear and deep blue, and the towers stand grey and still.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the tops of Seoul's high-rises first, then moves slowly down the glass.
phrases.clear_midday: From C'café on the 27th floor, the Seoul skyline is sharp under a clear midday sky, tower after tower.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the fitness center look through floor-to-ceiling windows as morning clouds drift over the Seoul skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the Seoul skyline this afternoon, and each high-rise takes its turn in the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, Seoul's high-rises turn the same grey, and the skyline looks like a quiet drawing.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Seoul's high-rises today, and the far towers fade a little more with each row.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests see only the nearest high-rises clearly today; the far side of the Seoul skyline is not visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of C'café, and the Seoul skyline behind it looks slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests watch from their city-view rooms as lightning flashes over Seoul's high-rises and thunder follows across the rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Seoul skyline, and the rooftops of the high-rises are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: Guests stay behind the glass on this freezing day and look at a Seoul skyline with very clean edges.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests on the treadmills in the fitness center keep warm with Seoul's high-rises in front of them.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above the rooftops of Seoul today, and guests study the high-rises from their cool city-view rooms.
phrases.warm: Warm light sits on the Seoul skyline today, and the glass towers shine back at the windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of Seoul's high-rises gold, and guests on the 27th floor watch the colour move from tower to tower.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests see the last sun slip between the clouds and light a few of Seoul's high-rises, while the others wait in shadow.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, guests in C'café look across the lit office towers of Seoul.
phrases.wet_evening: The lights of Seoul's high-rises spread and blur in the wet evening, and every window pane carries small bright drops.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night, guests look from their city-view rooms at lit office towers under low cloud.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and from the fitness center the lit Seoul skyline fills the glass, which makes the treadmill feel shorter.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the high-rises of Seoul stand quiet around this 27-floor tower, and the city finally seems to rest.
phrases.dusk: From the rooftop terrace restaurant, guests watch the first lights come on across the Seoul skyline while the sky is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Waitemata Harbour is a wide, still surface under a clear sky that is only beginning to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches Waitemata Harbour, and the first ferries leave white lines on the blue water.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, yachts cross Waitemata Harbour, and guests in the ocean-view rooms can follow each one to the North Shore.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Waitemata Harbour this morning, and the ferries pass from shade into sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lounge windows, guests look at the city skyline and Waitemata Harbour under a sky of mixed cloud and blue.
