phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Waitemata Harbour turns silver, and the white ferries stand out more than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over Waitemata Harbour today, and the yachts appear and disappear like slow ghosts.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The North Shore is not visible today; guests see the near part of Waitemata Harbour and the ferries closest to the waterfront.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Waitemata Harbour, and guests watch the ferries continue their crossings through the grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Waitemata Harbour, and for a second the whole stretch of water turns white.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Waitemata Harbour, and the flakes vanish as they touch the grey water.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, Waitemata Harbour looks sharp and bright, and guests stay behind the glass to enjoy it.
phrases.cold: The cold air is clear over Waitemata Harbour, and from the rooftop terrace the city skyline and the historic clock tower stand out in detail.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, Waitemata Harbour shines like metal, and guests on the balconies look at the yachts with some envy.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit on the rooftop terrace and look over the city skyline to the historic clock tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns Waitemata Harbour gold, and guests in this hotel, rebranded in 2022, watch the sails catch the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through broken cloud, and patches of orange light travel across Waitemata Harbour with the ferries.
phrases.grey_evening: At dinner in BODA on the 13th floor, guests look down on Waitemata Harbour, where ferry lights move under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of BODA this evening, and the lights on Waitemata Harbour blur into soft colours.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the city lights reflect on Waitemata Harbour, and a late ferry draws a bright trail.
phrases.clear_night: Guests at a dinner table in BODA see the lights of the North Shore across Waitemata Harbour under a clear night sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Waitemata Harbour is quiet and almost empty, and the water barely moves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over Waitemata Harbour, and the first lights appear on the North Shore across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is still dark above the crystal dome, and the arcade below is quiet and empty.
phrases.clear_morning: On a clear morning, guests at Párisi Passage Café drink coffee and look up at the Moorish ceiling.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests stop on the historic staircase to look at the stained glass windows by Miksa Róth.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over Ferenciek Square this morning, seen from the windows of the Pollack Suite.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the city this afternoon, while guests in the arcade try to count the patterns in the majolica tiles.
phrases.overcast: The sky is flat and grey today, so the colour is inside, in the stained glass and the Moorish ceiling.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the old city streets outside, but inside the passage every detail of the arcade stays sharp.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far roofs of the city are not visible from the city-view rooms today; only the nearest historic buildings can be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Budapest, and guests at Párisi Passage Café look up at the crystal dome and order another coffee.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city, and in the passage guests keep their eyes on the Moorish ceiling, which does not move.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Franciscan church, and guests in the corner suites watch the street below turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Outside the air is freezing under a bright sky; inside, guests walk the arcade and study its mosaics without a coat.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests take a table at Párisi Passage Café, where the passage itself is the thing to look at.
phrases.very_hot: The city is very hot today, and the crystal dome is the only sky that guests in the passage want to see.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests cross the lobby slowly, because the Moorish ceiling asks for a second look.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the terraces of the Budapest Presidential Suite, on the top level, guests watch the sun go down over the city below.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, with clouds over the city, the stained glass windows hold the attention of guests in the passage.
phrases.grey_evening: On a cloudy evening, guests at Párisi Passage Restaurant eat Hungarian dishes with the arcade and its crystal dome above them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the city this evening; at Párisi Passage Restaurant, the Moorish ceiling is the view between courses.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the passage, restored and reopened in 2019, is still the view guests come down to see.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear over Budapest, and inside the passage the majolica tiles keep guests looking.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the passage is empty, and the historic staircase has no audience.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright at dusk, and the first lamps come on in the arcade beneath the Moorish ceiling.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Potomac River lies still and grey, and the Lincoln Memorial waits for the first light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Washington Channel, and the Jefferson Memorial stands clear across the water from the rooftop infinity pool.
phrases.clear_midday: From the treadmills in the gym, guests look through floor-to-ceiling windows at the marina and the Potomac River under a clear midday sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Potomac River this morning, while the Lincoln Memorial stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop, guests pick out the U.S. Capitol dome between passing clouds this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Potomac River turns the same colour, and the yachts in the marina stand out against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Potomac River today, and the Virginia treeline across the water looks like a faint pencil line.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Lincoln Memorial is not visible today; guests in the waterfront rooms see the marina and the near water of the Washington Channel.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Washington Channel, and guests in the Presidential Suite watch it cross the Potomac River from wall-to-wall windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Potomac River, and each flash of lightning shows the Jefferson Memorial for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the marina, and the docked yachts turn white one deck at a time while the Potomac River fades behind them.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, so guests indoors see the Lincoln Memorial and the Potomac River in sharp detail.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the gym is a warm place to look over the Potomac River, and the treadmills there are optional.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop infinity pool up to their shoulders and look across the Washington Channel to the Jefferson Memorial.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests on the room balconies watch boats cross the Washington Channel, with the Potomac River wide behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls across the Potomac River, and from the WAVES rooftop bar the Jefferson Memorial glows with it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips under the clouds, and guests in the waterfront rooms see the Potomac River turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Jefferson Memorial lines up with the rooftop infinity pool across the Washington Channel.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the marina tonight, and the Potomac River beyond them is black.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, boats still move on the Washington Channel, and the Lincoln Memorial is lit in the distance.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in this 278-room hotel see the marina lights doubled in the Potomac River.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the marina is quiet, and the Potomac River is a wide dark space beyond the yachts.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky stays bright over the Potomac River while the first lights come on at the Lincoln Memorial.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky is clear and slowly turning pale before sunrise, and the Canton Tower stands unlit above the quiet Pearl River.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the Club Lounge, guests see the Canton Tower and the Pearl River together under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Pearl River shines in the midday sun, and the Canton Tower rises sharp against the blue sky above it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pearl River this morning, while the top of the Canton Tower stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Club Lounge, guests follow the clouds as they drift past the Canton Tower this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pearl River turns the colour of steel, and the Canton Tower is a slim grey figure above it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city skyline today, and the Canton Tower looks like a pencil drawing above the Pearl River.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: guests can see the Pearl River below, but the top of the Canton Tower and the distant skyline are faint.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in the river view rooms watch it fall on the Pearl River.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Canton Tower, and the Pearl River turns dark under the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Pearl River, and guests watch the Canton Tower fade into white from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and very clear, so the Canton Tower stands out in fine detail above the Pearl River.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep their tea warm in the Club Lounge and look out at the Pearl River and the Canton Tower.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the Pearl River today, and the Canton Tower seems to tremble a little in the bright air.
phrases.warm: By the outdoor pool on this warm day, guests count the glass skyscrapers around them instead of counting laps.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Canton Tower gold, and guests at afternoon tea in the Club Lounge watch the Pearl River take the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Pearl River turn orange, and the Canton Tower stands dark in front of them.
phrases.grey_evening: At The Churchill Bar, guests hold a single malt and look at the city lights glowing under low cloud.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Pearl River this evening, and the lights of the Canton Tower are soft and blurred behind it.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, clouds hang low over the city, and the lit Canton Tower gives them a soft colour.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the rooms with Pearl River views see the lit Canton Tower reflected in the water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pearl River is a quiet dark band under a sky without lights, and the Canton Tower stands unlit beside it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright, and guests in this hotel of 350 rooms see the first lights come on along the Canton Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Hep Five Ferris Wheel stands still against a clear sky that is slowly turning pale over Umeda.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in Club Lounge on the 33rd floor see the Hep Five Ferris Wheel brighten in the morning sun above Umeda.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the city of Osaka spreads out in sharp detail below the top-floor suites on the south side.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the rooftops of Umeda this morning, and the Hep Five Ferris Wheel passes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the corner suites, guests follow the afternoon clouds across two large windows, with the Osaka skyline below them.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Umeda today, and the Hep Five Ferris Wheel is the one round shape among all the straight ones.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Osaka skyline today, and from Club Lounge the Hep Five Ferris Wheel looks like a faint pencil circle.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far edge of the city of Osaka is not visible today, but the Hep Five Ferris Wheel and the nearby streets of Umeda remain clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of Club Lounge, and guests see the Hep Five Ferris Wheel slightly blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests watch lightning flash over the Osaka skyline, and for a second every tower in Umeda shows clearly through the storm.
phrases.snow: Guests watch snow falling over Umeda as the Hep Five Ferris Wheel fades to a grey circle behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, every building on the Osaka skyline has a sharp edge today.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep warm in Club Lounge and look down at the quiet pocket of Umeda below.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers over the rooftops of Umeda, and guests are happy to look at the Hep Five Ferris Wheel from behind cool glass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, the Osaka skyline stands bright in the daylight, and the streets of Umeda look busy from above.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun lights one side of the Hep Five Ferris Wheel, and guests in Club Lounge on the 33rd floor put their cups down to look.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Osaka skyline, and the towers of Umeda hold the warm light a little longer.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Hep Five Ferris Wheel glows above Umeda, and the low sky takes a little of its colour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Umeda this evening, and the city lights of Osaka spread into soft spots on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: In rooms with a window by the bath, guests soak in warm water and look at the lights of Osaka under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the lit Hep Five Ferris Wheel is a bright ring above Umeda, with the Osaka skyline shining behind it.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Umeda is quiet below, and the Hep Five Ferris Wheel rests until morning.
phrases.dusk: The sky over Umeda is still bright, and the first lights appear on the Hep Five Ferris Wheel one by one.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tagus River is a wide grey band beyond Praça do Comércio, and the clear sky above it slowly grows lighter.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Luzzi on the 6th floor, guests look across Praça do Comércio to the Tagus River under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The Rua Augusta Arch stands sharp against a blue sky at midday, and the Tagus River shines behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Praça do Comércio this morning, while the Tagus River behind the square stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the terracotta roofs toward São Jorge Castle this afternoon, and the Tagus River changes between silver and blue.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Patricia Urquiola's rooftop keeps its bright colours, and beyond it the Tagus River turns the colour of slate.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze blurs the Tagus River today, so guests in the arch-view suites study the Rua Augusta Arch instead.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Tagus River fades into the pale air beyond Praça do Comércio today, and São Jorge Castle cannot be seen at all.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Praça do Comércio, and guests at the window seats of Luzzi watch the Tagus River turn grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Tagus River, and each flash shows the Rua Augusta Arch against the dark sky.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the Rua Augusta Arch, and guests in the rooms facing it watch the flakes drift toward the Tagus River.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Tagus River looks sharp and blue below Praça do Comércio.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the cosy alcove in the rooftop bar is the place to sit, with the Rua Augusta Arch in its window.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat, the Tagus River glitters below Praça do Comércio, and the square itself lies bright and still.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests linger on the rooftop terrace, where the Rua Augusta Arch frames the Tagus River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests take their sundowners at the window seats of Luzzi as the low sun turns Praça do Comércio and the Tagus River gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and warms the terracotta roofs that climb toward Lisbon Cathedral and São Jorge Castle.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in the arch-view suites look down on the street lights of Rua Augusta and the arch beside them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of Luzzi at dinner, and the lights of Praça do Comércio shine on the wet square in front of the Tagus River.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the Tagus River is a dark band beyond the lamps of Praça do Comércio.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests with a Negroni in Bar Z look over the roofs to the lit São Jorge Castle.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Tagus River keeps moving past Praça do Comércio while the hotel sleeps.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Tagus River as the first lights come on around Praça do Comércio, seen from the balcony rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Danube is a dark band below the upper floors, and the sky to the east is just starting to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the glass towers of the Vienna International Centre, and guests in the high-floor restaurant watch them brighten.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the view runs from the Donauturm all the way to the Steffl on the western horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Donaupark this morning, while the Danube stays bright in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the high-floor lounge, guests follow the clouds drifting over the Vienna Hills this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: The Danube turns the same grey as the sky today, and the glass towers of the Vienna International Centre almost match it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Vienna Hills today, and the Donauturm rises out of it like a needle in cotton wool.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Steffl and the Vienna Hills are not visible today; guests on the upper floors see the Danube and the nearer towers of the DC Tower skyline.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the high-floor lounge, and the Danube behind them looks soft and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in this high-rise watch lightning flash behind the DC Tower skyline, and the Danube shows for a second each time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Donaupark, and the top of the Donauturm disappears into the white sky.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Vienna Hills look sharp and close, and guests are happy to study them from behind glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the high-floor restaurant look down at the Danube, grey-blue below the DC Tower skyline.
phrases.very_hot: The heat makes the air shimmer over the Danube, and guests on the upper floors look at the water with some envy.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests look down at the Donaupark and count the small figures walking its paths.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun drops towards the Vienna Hills in the west, and the glass of the DC Tower skyline turns gold.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Vienna Hills turn orange, and guests stop talking to look.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the lit windows of the Vienna International Centre shine across to guests in the high-floor lounge.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, rain blurs the city lights on the glass, and the Danube is a dark line between them.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud takes on the glow of the city tonight, and guests can still follow the Danube by the lights along its banks.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, the lights of the city spread out from the Danube towards the Vienna Hills, and the Donauturm stands clear against the sky.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and the Danube moves slowly past below a guest who cannot sleep.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, the sky is still bright, and the first lights come on along the Danube and in the DC Tower skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the downtown Dallas towers stand as plain grey blocks under a clear sky that is slowly growing pale.
phrases.clear_morning: The Dallas skyline is sharp against a clear morning sky, and guests in the corner rooms see it through floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_midday: From Vincent's Skybar on the 11th floor, the downtown Dallas towers stand clear in the midday light, every window easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the Dallas skyline this morning, and their shadows slide over the Arts District below.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the treadmills in the fitness center watch afternoon clouds pass behind the downtown Dallas high-rises.
phrases.overcast: The glass towers of downtown Dallas copy the grey sky today, seen through the floor-to-ceiling windows of JW Steakhouse.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Dallas skyline today, and from the rooftop pool the farthest towers look like pencil sketches.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so guests see the Arts District streets clearly but not the far towers of the Dallas skyline.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the Museum Suites, and the Dallas skyline behind it looks slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the downtown Dallas towers, and guests watch the storm from indoors, well away from the open terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Arts District, and the downtown Dallas towers fade to white behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear today, and guests in the upper corner rooms see every edge of the Dallas skyline from behind the glass.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the heated rooftop pool has the downtown Dallas towers all to itself.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the downtown Dallas towers from the water.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests at Vincent's Skybar sit in the open air with downtown Dallas spread out around them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the glass towers of downtown Dallas gold, a sight seen in full from the open terrace of Vincent's Skybar.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds pink above the Dallas skyline, while the Arts District below is already in shade.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud holds the glow of the city tonight, and the lit Dallas skyline fills the corner windows of this hotel, opened in 2023.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the Arts District this evening, and the lights of downtown Dallas spread into soft colours on the wet glass.
phrases.mild_night: From the open terrace of Vincent's Skybar, the lit towers of downtown Dallas shine under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear, and the Dallas skyline draws its own line of lights above the Arts District.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Arts District streets are quiet, and the downtown Dallas towers stand still behind them.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first office lights come on in the downtown Dallas towers, seen from Vincent's Skybar.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests in the balcony rooms look down on a still, grey Chao Phraya River and wait for the first colour in the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the western bank, guests in the Thai Suite watch the sun rise behind the Bangkok skyline and light the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Chao Phraya River shines beyond the pool, with the Bangkok skyline sharp behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Chao Phraya River this morning, and from the lobby the Thai river homes on the far bank go in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the riverside terrace, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift over the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.overcast: The sky is one sheet of cloud today, and the Chao Phraya River below the lounges takes on the same soft grey.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Bangkok skyline today, so from the 36th-floor Thai Suite the towers across the Chao Phraya River look like a faded drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far towers of the Bangkok skyline are not visible today; from the lobby, guests see the Chao Phraya River and the Thai river homes on the opposite bank.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Chao Phraya River with thousands of small circles, and guests count them from the dry seats of the lounges.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the Bangkok skyline, and guests in the Thai Suite see the storm cross the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Chao Phraya River, and guests in the lobby stop to watch the flakes vanish into the water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and clear today, so the far bank of the Chao Phraya River stands sharp from the riverside terrace.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to the lounges and look out over the Chao Phraya River to the Thai river homes across the water.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the pool up to their shoulders and study the Chao Phraya River from there.
phrases.warm: At the riverside bar, guests sit in the warm air and watch boats pass on the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the towers of the Bangkok skyline gold, and the Chao Phraya River in front of the pool carries the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Chao Phraya River turn pink and orange over the riverside terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky, the low roof of the riverside bar frames the dark Chao Phraya River and the lights of passing boats.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the evening, and from the lobby the city lights across the Chao Phraya River blur into long streaks of colour.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests at the riverside bar see neon from the far bank reflected in the Chao Phraya River.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the black Chao Phraya River carries the lights of the far bank past the riverside terrace.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the few guests still awake in this hotel of 370 rooms have the quiet Chao Phraya River to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the pool the first lights come on along the Bangkok skyline across the Chao Phraya River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Nile is a wide, quiet band below the Nile-view suites, and the sky slowly pales over the Cairo skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches the tree canopy of the Giza Zoo, and guests on the zoo-side balconies look over the green to the Pyramids in the distance.
phrases.clear_midday: From Zoé aboard the First Nile Boat, the Nile shines under a clear midday sky, with the Cairo skyline sharp behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Nile this morning, and the circular arched window in the spa treatment room frames each one as it passes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pool terrace, patches of sun and shade move along the Nile and over the Cairo skyline this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Nile turns the colour of pewter in the spa's circular window, calm and wide.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Pyramids today, so the botanical gardens and the Giza Zoo treetops become the far end of the scene from the balconies.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Pyramids are not visible today and the Cairo skyline is faint, but the Nile remains clear from the pool terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Nile, and from the spa treatment room guests watch the drops dot the water through the circular arched window.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes above the Cairo skyline, and guests in the Nile-view suites watch the storm cross the river from behind the glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Nile, and from Zoé the flakes vanish the moment they touch the water.
phrases.very_cold: The air is bitterly cold and very clear, and the Pyramids stand out sharply beyond the zoo treetops.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests choose the spa treatment room as the warm place to look at the Nile, round window and all.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay under the cabanas on the pool terrace and look out at the Nile shimmering below.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, swimmers at the 4th-floor pool pause at the edge to look across the Nile to the Cairo skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Nile gold below the pool terrace, and the Cairo skyline glows across the water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds turn orange behind the Pyramids, and guests have a clear look at them over the Giza Zoo.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests at Zoé on the First Nile Boat look along the Nile to the lit Cairo skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the city lights across the Nile this evening, and the river carries their colours in long wet streaks.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the clouds above Cairo take a soft glow from the city, while the zoo and botanical gardens stay one quiet patch of darkness.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and guests in this 262-room hotel see the lights of the Cairo skyline doubled in the Nile.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Nile moves slowly past and the trees of the Giza Zoo are still; even the animals seem to be asleep.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the Pyramids are silhouettes against an orange-pink sky while the first city lights come on below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lion's Head is a dark shape above Camps Bay, and the Atlantic below is still without colour.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is served in the dining area facing the ocean, and this morning Camps Bay is blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: From the terrace, Lion's Head stands sharp against a clear sky, with the Atlantic bright below it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Lion's Head this morning, while Camps Bay stays in sunshine below the balcony rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pool deck on the 3rd floor, the clouds drift from the mountains out over the Atlantic.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Atlantic takes the same colour, and Lion's Head looks darker above Camps Bay.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Camps Bay today, and from the terrace Lion's Head is only a pale outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; the rocky Camps Bay shore is clear, with little of the ocean beyond it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Camps Bay, and guests watch it cross the Atlantic from the lounge with sea views.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the lounge, guests watch lightning over the Atlantic, and the thunder reaches Camps Bay a few seconds later.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Camps Bay, and guests in the lounge watch it disappear into the grey Atlantic.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing day, guests keep to the lounge, and its sea view shows a clear and very cold Atlantic.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the hot tub is the warm seat for looking at the mountains and the sea of Camps Bay.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the outdoor pool on the terrace and look at Lion's Head from the water.
phrases.warm: On the pool deck, books stay closed on the sun loungers while guests look at Camps Bay instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The staff bring drinks to the terrace as the sun moves down towards the Atlantic and the light turns gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Atlantic, and from the balcony of the Seahorse Suite Lion's Head turns orange.
phrases.grey_evening: The evening sky is cloudy, and from the lounge with sea views guests see the lights of Camps Bay stop where the Atlantic begins.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass tonight, and the lights of Camps Bay are blurred from the balcony rooms.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars on this mild night, and the lights of Camps Bay follow the edge of the Atlantic.
phrases.clear_night: From the top-floor balcony of the Seahorse Suite, guests see stars above Lion's Head and a black Atlantic below.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Camps Bay is quiet, and Lion's Head keeps watch over the sleeping Atlantic.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just gone into the Atlantic; the sky stays bright above Camps Bay, and the first lights come on along the shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the North Shore Mountains are a dark shape above Burrard Inlet, and the sky behind them slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the north-facing balconies, guests see morning sun on Burrard Inlet and every ridge of the North Shore Mountains.
phrases.clear_midday: Burrard Inlet is bright blue at midday, and the North Shore Mountains stand clear behind the downtown towers.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the North Shore Mountains this morning, while Burrard Inlet below stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the 3rd-floor pool deck, the white dome of BC Place shows under a sky of sun and passing cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Burrard Inlet turns the colour of steel, and the North Shore Mountains lose their tops in cloud.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Burrard Inlet today, and guests see the North Shore Mountains only in pieces above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The North Shore Mountains are not visible today; guests see the downtown towers and only the near edge of Burrard Inlet.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Burrard Inlet; guests watch it from their suite windows, the North Shore Mountains blurred behind.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the North Shore Mountains, and thunder rolls across Burrard Inlet toward the downtown towers.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over downtown, and from the pool deck the white dome of BC Place almost disappears into the white sky.
phrases.very_cold: The North Shore Mountains carry white snow in the freezing air, and Burrard Inlet lies still and blue below them.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in the 206 suites look at the North Shore Mountains from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the saltwater pool and look at the city towers from the water.
phrases.warm: On the pool deck, guests dry in the warm air while BC Place and the city towers fill the skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the North Shore Mountains gold, and guests on the north-facing balconies see Burrard Inlet shine below them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun finds a gap in the cloud and lights the Vancouver Lookout tower, with the North Shore Mountains turning pink behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Downtown lights glow under low evening cloud, with Burrard Inlet and the North Shore Mountains quiet beyond the towers.
phrases.wet_evening: Evening rain falls through the city lights, and the downtown towers shine wet all the way toward Burrard Inlet.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the city towers stay bright, and the North Shore Mountains hide in the cloud above Burrard Inlet.
phrases.clear_night: The night sky is clear over Burrard Inlet, and the North Shore Mountains stand black against the stars beyond the city lights.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the North Shore Mountains can barely be told from the night sky above Burrard Inlet.
phrases.dusk: At dusk, the white dome of BC Place begins to glow behind the pool deck, and the city lights come on one by one.

phrases.clear_predawn: Guests already awake in the Ocean Suites look out over Seminyak Beach and a dark Indian Ocean waiting for sunrise.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast guests at the restaurant look out over Seminyak Beach to a bright blue Indian Ocean.
phrases.clear_midday: Seminyak Beach runs pale and wide beside the Indian Ocean, and every palm tree stands on its own small shadow.
phrases.partly_morning: Seminyak Beach goes in and out of the sun this morning as clouds pass over the Indian Ocean.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Seminyak Beach today, and the Indian Ocean beyond has taken the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: In the Ocean Suites, guests see the Indian Ocean fade into haze not far beyond the first waves.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the nearer stretch of Seminyak Beach shows today; the far end and the Indian Ocean horizon are lost in the dull air.
phrases.rain: Rain blurs the palm trees on Seminyak Beach and turns the Indian Ocean grey behind them.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Seminyak Beach while lightning flashes above the Indian Ocean.
phrases.snow: Guests in the Ocean Suites stay inside and look twice at the snow falling on Seminyak Beach and its palm trees.
phrases.very_cold: The Indian Ocean looks warmer than it is today, and guests in the restaurant are happy to watch it from their tables.
phrases.cold: From indoors in the Ocean Suites, guests watch the Indian Ocean send its waves to Seminyak Beach on this cool day.
phrases.very_hot: Nobody in the infinity pool is in a hurry to get out, with Seminyak Beach and the Indian Ocean in front of them.
phrases.warm: Swimmers in the infinity pool look straight out at the Indian Ocean and the waves coming in on the sandy beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The water of the infinity pool and the Indian Ocean behind it take on the same gold colour late this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: Between the clouds, the low sun lights Seminyak Beach and the palm trees for the last hour of the day.
phrases.grey_evening: At the restaurant, guests eat dinner facing the white lines of waves that still show on the dark Indian Ocean.
phrases.wet_evening: The Indian Ocean has gone black behind the evening rain, leaving only the nearest line of surf in view.
phrases.mild_night: White lines of surf cross the dark Indian Ocean and break on the sandy beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Indian Ocean tonight, and Seminyak Beach is a pale line below them.
phrases.late_night: Most guests are asleep, and the ocean waves have Seminyak Beach to themselves.
phrases.dusk: Seminyak Beach keeps a little pink on its wet sand while the Indian Ocean has already turned dark blue.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over Vieux-Port, and Notre-Dame de la Garde is a dark shape on its hill.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast on the 1st-floor balcony, guests watch the boats of Vieux-Port under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch on the terrace of Le Relais 50, Notre-Dame de la Garde stands clear against the blue sky above the harbour.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning clouds pass behind Notre-Dame de la Garde, while the boats in Vieux-Port stay in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony of the La Notre Dame Suite, guests see cloud shadows cross Vieux-Port towards Notre-Dame de la Garde this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the water of Vieux-Port turns grey too, and the white boats look brighter against it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Notre-Dame de la Garde today, and the masts in Vieux-Port look like pencil lines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: guests see the boats of Vieux-Port well, but Notre-Dame de la Garde is only a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Vieux-Port; guests watch it from behind their balcony windows, with Notre-Dame de la Garde slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind Notre-Dame de la Garde, and guests stay inside to watch the storm cross Vieux-Port.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the boats of Vieux-Port, and Notre-Dame de la Garde is almost hidden behind the white flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, guests in this 1954 hotel look through their bay windows at Notre-Dame de la Garde, sharp on its hill.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the terrace of Le Relais 50 is quiet under its olive trees, with Notre-Dame de la Garde in plain sight.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests keep to the shade of the olive trees at Le Relais 50 and look out at the bright harbour.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests sit out on their balconies and try to count the boats in Vieux-Port, without much success.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on Notre-Dame de la Garde late this afternoon, and the masts of Vieux-Port shine below it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above Notre-Dame de la Garde turn pink, and Vieux-Port reflects them.
phrases.grey_evening: From the terrace of Le Relais 50, Notre-Dame de la Garde is lit on its hill under a cloudy evening sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the harbour lights stretch in long reflections across the water of Vieux-Port.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the night sky, and the lights around Vieux-Port draw a bright line along the quays.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, Notre-Dame de la Garde glows on its hill above the masts of Vieux-Port.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Vieux-Port is still, and the boats rest in rows on the dark water.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the sky is still bright behind Notre-Dame de la Garde, and the first lights come on around Vieux-Port.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the rooftop terrace looks across quiet roofs to the dome of Florence Cathedral.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is served on the terrace of The Kitchen & The Bar, with the marble front of the Basilica of Santa Maria Novella in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, Florence Cathedral's dome stands sharp against a blue sky, with the hills around the city behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Basilica of Santa Maria Novella this morning, and from the terrace of The Kitchen & The Bar the marble front changes shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the rooftops this afternoon, while the dome of Florence Cathedral moves in and out of the sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the red dome of Florence Cathedral is the one strong colour above the tiled roofs.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and from the rooftop terrace Florence Cathedral's dome looks like a watercolour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The hills beyond Florence Cathedral are not visible today, but the dome itself still shows from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain wets the roof tiles of Florence, and guests in the Duomo Rooftop Loft watch it fall around the cathedral dome.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the city, and lightning shows the dome of Florence Cathedral for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the rooftops of Florence, and the dome of Florence Cathedral turns from red to white.
phrases.very_cold: Guests keep warm in the Duomo Rooftop Loft's raised bathroom, where the bathtub faces Florence Cathedral under a freezing sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests inside The Kitchen & The Bar look across the piazza to the Basilica of Santa Maria Novella.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, the roof tiles of Florence shimmer below the rooftop terrace, and the cathedral dome glows red.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests on the rooftop terrace look past Florence Cathedral's dome to the hills that circle the city.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the terrace of The Kitchen & The Bar, the Basilica of Santa Maria Novella turns gold in the low sun, right at cocktail hour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds and lights Florence Cathedral's dome, a free show from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the dome of Florence Cathedral is lit above the dark roofs, seen from this 20-room house.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Piazza Santa Maria Novella this evening, and guests dining at The Kitchen & The Bar see the lit basilica shine on the wet stones.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the rooftop terrace looks over the lights of Florence to the lit cathedral dome.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Florence, and the lit dome of Florence Cathedral rises above the roofs, seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the rooftops are still, and the dome of Florence Cathedral stands as a dark shape above them.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on around Florence Cathedral's dome, seen from the rooftop terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Positano hillside is a quiet grey above a sea that has only begun to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the church dome of Santa Maria Assunta, and guests in the sea-view terrace rooms see both the dome and Spiaggia Grande.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Positano hillside shows every colour of its houses above the blue sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Positano hillside this morning, while the sea stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pergola at Il Tridente, guests follow patches of sun and shade crossing the Positano hillside this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, guests at Il Tridente still pick out the church dome of Santa Maria Assunta easily.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Positano hillside today, and the sea and sky share one pale colour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today, so guests look at the closer houses of the Positano hillside.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Spiaggia Grande; guests in the Liliana Suite watch it from the bed through the glass railing.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the sea, and each flash of lightning shows the Positano hillside for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Positano hillside, and the church dome of Santa Maria Assunta turns white flake by flake.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing clear air, the mountains around Positano stand sharp above the hillside and the sea.
phrases.cold: On this cold day Spiaggia Grande lies empty, and the sea below the Positano hillside moves slowly.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the pool among the carob trees and look out at the Positano hillside and the sea.
phrases.warm: By the pool, guests on sun loungers count the sailboats on the sea instead of reading.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the private terrace of the WOW! Suite, guests see the late sun turn the Positano hillside gold above the blue sea.
phrases.partly_golden: At the cocktail bar of Il Tridente, guests watch the last sun slip between clouds and light the Positano hillside.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Il Tridente is served under the pergola, with the lights of the Positano hillside glowing under a cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Positano hillside shine blurred through the rain above Spiaggia Grande.
phrases.mild_night: Three generations of the Aonzo family have known this night view: the lit Positano hillside under a soft, cloudy sky.
phrases.clear_night: From the Rooftop Suite, guests see stars over the sea and the lights of the Positano hillside on this clear night.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Positano hillside is quiet, and the sea is a wide dark space below it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the Positano hillside.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Manhattan Skyline is a row of quiet towers under a clear sky that is slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the towers of Lower Manhattan first, then moves down to the rooftops below them.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Empire State Building is easy to pick out in the Manhattan Skyline from the terrace suites.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Brooklyn this morning, while Lower Manhattan stays in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop bar, guests follow the afternoon clouds as they drift from Lower Manhattan towards Brooklyn.
phrases.overcast: The sky is flat and grey today, and the Manhattan Skyline shows every tower in the same calm tone.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Manhattan Skyline today, and guests at the large windows count fewer towers than yesterday.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Brooklyn is not visible from the rooftop bar and only the nearer blocks of Lower Manhattan show.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Lower East Side, and guests watch the Manhattan Skyline turn soft and grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Manhattan Skyline, and guests in the Design Suite see each tower clearly for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Lower East Side, and the Manhattan Skyline fades behind it, tower by tower.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear, and the Manhattan Skyline stands sharp against the sky from this 1912 building.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests follow Lower Manhattan block by block until Brooklyn begins.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests take their drinks slowly at the rooftop bar, with Lower Manhattan shimmering in front of them.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests in the terrace suites sit among the ivy on their terraces and face the Manhattan Skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of Lower Manhattan gold, and the rooftop bar has the whole show in front of it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Brooklyn turn pink, and guests forget their conversations for a moment.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Lower Manhattan give the sky a soft glow above the rooftop bar.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, the lights of the Manhattan Skyline blur in the rain, and guests look at them a little longer.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, guests look from the lights of Lower Manhattan to the lights of Brooklyn and back again.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the Manhattan Skyline shows thousands of lit windows from the rooftop bar.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the few guests still awake have the Manhattan Skyline to themselves.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across the Manhattan Skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Hollywood Hills are a dark shape under a clear sky, and the Hollywood Sign is only just visible.
phrases.clear_morning: The Hollywood Sign stands white on the hills this clear morning, each letter easy to read from Skyline Sundeck.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Hollywood Sign is bright on the green hills, and the Downtown skyline rises sharp on the opposite side.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Hollywood Hills this morning, while the Hollywood Sign stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from The Scene, the afternoon clouds drift from the Hollywood Hills towards the Downtown skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Hollywood Sign still reads clearly against the darker hills behind it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Hollywood Hills today, and the Hollywood Sign looks like chalk letters half rubbed out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Downtown skyline is not visible from Skyline Sundeck today, but the nearer Hollywood Sign can still be seen.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the picture windows, and guests in rooms facing the Hollywood Sign see its letters slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Hollywood Hills, and for a second the Hollywood Sign shows white through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Hollywood Hills, and guests take photos of the Hollywood Sign as proof.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air is very clear, and from Skyline Sundeck the Hollywood Sign shows in sharp detail.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests in suites facing the Hollywood Sign stay by the window, the letters clear on the hills.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests at The Scene stay in the cabanas and look out at the Hollywood Hills from the shade.
phrases.warm: On Skyline Sundeck, guests on the loungers turn one way for the Hollywood Sign and the other for the Downtown skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun warms the Hollywood Hills, and the Hollywood Sign turns from white to soft gold.
phrases.partly_golden: Seen from The Scene, the last sun colours the clouds above the Hollywood Hills and the Downtown skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the Hollywood Hills fade into the sky, and house lights mark the slopes below the Hollywood Sign.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in suites facing the Downtown skyline look at its lights shining through the rain.
phrases.mild_night: From The Scene, the Downtown skyline glows under a cloudy night sky, and the Hollywood Hills lie dark behind.
phrases.clear_night: From this hotel of 216 rooms, guests see either the dark Hollywood Hills or the bright Downtown skyline on this clear night.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Hollywood Hills are quiet and black, and the Hollywood Sign waits somewhere in them for morning.
phrases.dusk: At dusk the sky is still bright behind the Hollywood Sign, and the first lights come on along the Downtown skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the towers of the Sagrada Família stand grey against a sky that slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Sagrada Família first, and guests on 173 Rooftop Terrace watch the light move across the city.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Montjuïc cable car cabins cross slowly, easy to follow from the rooftop pool deck.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Torre de Collserola this morning, while the Sagrada Família stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony suites, guests watch cloud shadows move across the city towards Tibidabo.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Sagrada Família is still simple to find from 173 Rooftop Terrace, taller than everything around it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the city today, and the Sagrada Família looks like a pencil drawing above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the Torre de Collserola is missing and the Sagrada Família is only a faint outline.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the city, and guests watch it from a room facing the Sagrada Família, the towers slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the city, and for a second the towers of the Sagrada Família show clearly through the storm.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the city, and the Sagrada Família slowly turns white behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, the Torre de Collserola stands sharp on its hill and the Sagrada Família shows every tower.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, the Cathedral of Barcelona is easy to find among the roofs from the rooftop pool deck.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the Sagrada Família from the water.
phrases.warm: By the rooftop pool, guests lie in the warm air and count the towers of the Sagrada Família, then count again.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Sagrada Família gold, and the whole city in front of 173 Rooftop Terrace takes a warm colour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and lights the National Art Museum of Catalonia, seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit towers of the Sagrada Família glow above the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: On a wet evening, guests look through a panoramic room window at the city lights and the Sagrada Família shining in the rain.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from 173 Rooftop Terrace guests see the Sagrada Família lit above the dark roofs.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the city lights spread in a full circle around the rooftop, with the Sagrada Família bright among them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the city is quiet, and the Sagrada Família is only a tall shape above the sleeping streets.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and from the rooftop terrace guests watch the first lights come on around the Sagrada Família.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Bosphorus Strait lies still and grey-blue, and the Asian shore is a dark line under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at The Lobby begins with the sunlit Bosphorus Strait in front of its waterfront terrace and the domes of the historic skyline beyond.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests on a balcony find the Maiden's Tower in the Bosphorus Strait with the binoculars.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Golden Horn this morning, while the ferries on the Bosphorus Strait cross in and out of sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon tea at The Lobby has moving company today: cloud shadows crossing the Bosphorus Strait beyond the terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Bosphorus Strait turns the colour of steel, and guests follow the tankers moving slowly along it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the far side of the Bosphorus Strait today, and the minarets of Hagia Sophia look drawn in pencil.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Asian shore is not visible today; guests in the rooms facing the Bosphorus Strait see the near water and the ferries crossing it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Bosphorus Strait, and the ferries cross it with the old city blurred behind them.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Bosphorus Strait for a second at a time, and the Maiden's Tower appears and disappears with it.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Golden Horn, and the domes and minarets across the water fade to white behind it.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing, clear air, the turrets of Topkapi Palace look close across the water where the Golden Horn meets the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.cold: On this cold day the Abelia Pool is quiet, and the Bosphorus Strait runs wide and cold beyond it.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests stay in the water of the Abelia Pool and watch the ferries cross the Bosphorus Strait just beyond its edge.
phrases.warm: On the terrace of The Lobby, guests sit in the warm air and watch the local fishermen try their luck in the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Bosphorus Strait gold, and from a suite balcony the Maiden's Tower glows against the Asian shore.
phrases.partly_golden: From Topside Bar, under the 1937 clock tower, guests watch the last sun slip behind the city skyline as the clouds turn pink.
phrases.grey_evening: At Gallada on the roof terrace, dinner is served in front of the lit domes and minarets of the skyline under a low, cloudy sky.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the far shore run in long streaks across the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit minarets of the Blue Mosque stand out across the Golden Horn.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and the Maiden's Tower is a small point of light in the Bosphorus Strait.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Bosphorus Strait is nearly empty, with one late ship moving slowly through the dark water.
phrases.dusk: In the few minutes after sunset, the first lights come on along the Golden Horn while the sky above it is still bright.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the Duomo is a quiet dark shape above the sleeping rooftops of Florence.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Duomo, and from the rooftop pool it stands at eye level with nothing in between.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests in the upper-floor suites see every stripe of the marble façade of Santa Maria Novella.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Florence this morning, and their shadows cross the terracotta rooftops below the rooftop terrace one by one.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns on the Duomo this afternoon, seen from the rooftop pool that Carlo Scarpa added in 1958.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Duomo stands out clearly above the rooftops of Florence from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Florence today, and guests in rooms facing the Duomo see the dome like a soft pencil drawing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far rooftops of Florence are not visible today, but the Duomo is close enough to stay in sight from the rooftop.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Piazza Santa Maria Novella, and guests watch the marble façade of the basilica shine wet from their suite windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Florence, and guests watch from inside as each flash of lightning shows the Duomo for a second.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the rooftops of Florence, and from the rooftop terrace the Duomo slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: In freezing, clear air, guests stay at the windows of rooms facing the Duomo, where every line of the dome is sharp.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the gym keep warm on the machines while the panoramic view shows the historic centre of Florence.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, guests look at the Duomo from the water of the rooftop pool and see no reason to get out.
phrases.warm: On a warm day, guests at the terrace tables of La Buona Novella face the piazza and the marble façade of Santa Maria Novella.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At the pool bar, guests hold a Terrace Negroni while the low sun turns the Duomo gold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun slips between the clouds, and the rooftops of Florence glow all around the rooftop pool.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the evening sky, and from the pool bar the city lights spread in every direction around the Duomo.
phrases.wet_evening: It is a wet evening in Florence, and the city lights shine back from the wet rooftops below the rooftop terrace.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night without stars, the Duomo is still easy to find from the rooftop terrace, large above the city.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over Florence tonight, and the Duomo stands under them, straight across from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours Florence is quiet, and the Duomo waits in the dark for morning like everyone else.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across Florence below the 6th-floor rooftop.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Pacific Ocean is a dark sheet beyond the sand, and only the white of the breaking waves shows.
phrases.clear_morning: The Pacific Ocean is clear blue this morning, and the pier stands sharp above the waves.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Pacific Ocean shines under a clear sky, with the whole length of the pier in sight.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the Pacific Ocean this morning, and the pier goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on their private balconies watch patches of sun and shade cross the Pacific Ocean this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific Ocean takes the same colour and the waves draw white lines on the sand.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Pacific Ocean today, and the pier fades away halfway along its length.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is not visible today; guests see the beach, the first waves and the near part of the pier.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pacific Ocean, and guests watch it mark the sand from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific Ocean, and for a second the whole pier appears in white light.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the beach, a strange sight for guests who watch the flakes vanish into the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: The air is icy and the Pacific Ocean is bright, so guests watch the waves from beside their in-room fireplaces.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the Pacific Ocean is steel blue and the beach is empty as far as the pier.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the Pacific Ocean looks inviting, and swimmers already fill the shallow water beside the pier.
phrases.warm: Guests look down from their balconies at the warm sand, where walkers follow the edge of the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the top-floor SeaVenture Restaurant, guests at dinner watch the sun go down over the Pacific Ocean and the pier.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Pacific Ocean, a wide show from the deck of SeaVenture Restaurant.
phrases.grey_evening: The Pacific Ocean is dark under the clouds this evening, and guests at SeaVenture Restaurant see the pier lights instead.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the picture windows of SeaVenture Restaurant tonight, and the lights of the pier blur over the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars on this mild night, and the Pacific Ocean moves slow and grey beyond the beach.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Pacific Ocean tonight, and the lights of the pier reach out across the black water.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Pacific Ocean is heard more than seen, a dark space beyond the pale sand.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright over the Pacific Ocean, and guests in this 1986 hotel watch the pier's first lights come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Early risers see the dark outlines of Canary Wharf against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Canary Wharf stands in clear morning sun, each tower easy to tell from the next.
phrases.clear_midday: At BOKAN 38-39, guests can count the towers on the skyline one by one in the midday light.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests start the day watching cloud shadows drift along the Thames.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds keep crossing the sun this afternoon, and Canary Wharf brightens each time they pass.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Canary Wharf today, and the Thames in the background is the same colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze has taken the far end of the Thames today, and Canary Wharf shows only as pale shapes.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The skyline is missing from the view today, and Canary Wharf is as far as guests can see.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Canary Wharf, and guests watch the towers go soft and grey behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Canary Wharf for a second at a time, and guests wait indoors for the next flash.
phrases.snow: Guests stay indoors and watch snow fall between them and the towers of Canary Wharf.
phrases.very_cold: No one hurries outside today; guests look at Canary Wharf from indoors, where it is warm.
phrases.cold: Coats stay on their hangers today while guests watch the Thames pass Canary Wharf from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: The glass of Canary Wharf throws the sunlight back, and the Thames suddenly looks inviting.
phrases.warm: Guests stroll out to the riverside today, with the Thames on one side and Canary Wharf rising on the other.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests end the afternoon watching the low sun warm the towers of Canary Wharf.
phrases.partly_golden: Canary Wharf catches the last sun of the day between passing clouds.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of Canary Wharf this evening, and guests are glad to be watching from indoors.
phrases.mild_night: Canary Wharf stays lit under tonight's cloud, with the dark Thames in the background.
phrases.late_night: For guests who cannot sleep, Canary Wharf stands still beside the dark Thames.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the São Paulo Skyline is a row of dark towers under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the São Paulo Skyline, and guests in the Club Lounge on the 23rd floor see it from end to end.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the São Paulo Skyline stands sharp under a blue sky, with every tower easy to tell apart.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across the São Paulo Skyline this morning, so one group of towers is bright while the next is grey.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Waverley Suite spend the afternoon watching clouds drift over the São Paulo Skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the São Paulo Skyline loses its shine and the towers take the colour of the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the São Paulo Skyline today, and the far towers look like pencil drawings on grey paper.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so guests see only the nearer towers of the São Paulo Skyline and the far ones are missing.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the Club Lounge, and the São Paulo Skyline behind it looks slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the São Paulo Skyline, and guests in the Club Lounge watch the storm from behind glass.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the São Paulo Skyline, and guests stand at the windows to watch the rooftops turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day the air is clear, and the São Paulo Skyline looks sharp from behind the glass of the Mayflower Suite.
phrases.cold: On a cold day, guests in the top-floor suites stay behind glass and look across the São Paulo Skyline.
phrases.very_hot: By the outdoor pool, guests lie under umbrellas in the heat and look past the trees to the São Paulo Skyline.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, swimmers in the outdoor pool can see the São Paulo Skyline rising above the trees.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden sun reaches the São Paulo Skyline, and the glass towers shine back at the Club Lounge.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the São Paulo Skyline turn orange, and the towers below them catch the same colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs low over the São Paulo Skyline this evening, and the city lights give it a soft orange glow.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the São Paulo Skyline spread and shake in the drops on the suite windows.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests on the top floors of this 25-floor hotel see the São Paulo Skyline lit below a starless sky.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the São Paulo Skyline has thousands of lit windows, and nobody in the Club Lounge tries to count them.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the São Paulo Skyline is quiet, a line of still towers for any guest who is awake.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright just after sunset, and guests in the Club Lounge watch the first lights come on across the São Paulo Skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before the sun is up, the Burj Khalifa is a tall grey shape with the sky slowly turning pale behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: In the Royal Penthouse, guests open the curtains to the Burj Khalifa already bright in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Outdoor Lap Pool, the Arabian Gulf is a flat blue line beyond the city.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows slide across the skyline in front of Noia by the Pool, one tower at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows climb the Burj Khalifa this afternoon, and the tower keeps coming back into the light.
phrases.overcast: The Arabian Gulf lies pale silver beyond the pool, almost the same colour as the cloud above it.
phrases.fog_haze: The Burj Khalifa is only a soft grey outline in today's haze, and the Arabian Gulf has gone from view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Arabian Gulf is not visible from the Outdoor Lap Pool today, and the far end of the skyline fades into dusty air.
phrases.rain: Guests in the Royal Penthouse watch the top of the Burj Khalifa disappear into the rain cloud.
phrases.thunderstorm: Each flash of lightning shows the whole Burj Khalifa for a second, then the storm takes it back.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the Burj Khalifa today, and guests in the Royal Penthouse stay behind the glass to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: Nobody swims in the pool today, and the Arabian Gulf beyond it is sharp and clear.
phrases.cold: Guests in the Royal Penthouse try to count the floors of the Burj Khalifa and lose their place around the middle.
phrases.very_hot: Swimmers in the Outdoor Lap Pool rest between lengths with the Arabian Gulf shining in the distance.
phrases.warm: At Noia by the Pool, guests sit out in the warm air and look across the skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: One side of the Burj Khalifa turns gold as the sun gets lower.
phrases.partly_golden: From the pool, the Arabian Gulf glows orange under a few last clouds.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lit Burj Khalifa tonight into a soft column of light.
phrases.mild_night: The top floors of the lit Burj Khalifa are hidden in cloud tonight.
phrases.clear_night: Guests on their way to bed stop for one more look at the lit Burj Khalifa.
phrases.late_night: Most of the skyline has gone dark by now, leaving a few scattered lights around the tall shape of the Burj Khalifa.
phrases.dusk: The skyline begins to glitter one window at a time while the Arabian Gulf still holds the last colour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Aegean Sea is a wide dark surface below the terraces, and the sky above it is clear.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches the pool deck, and the Aegean Sea is a clear blue all the way to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: From the pool deck at midday, guests look over bright blue Aegean water under a sky with no cloud.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Aegean Sea this morning, and their shadows move slowly across the water below the balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From George’s bar, guests watch patches of sun and shade cross the Aegean Sea through the afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the Aegean Sea turns grey as well, calm and wide below the pool deck.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Aegean Sea today, and the horizon is difficult to find from the pool deck.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so guests on the private terraces see only the nearer part of the Aegean Sea.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Aegean Sea, and guests watch it from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is crossing the Aegean Sea, and lightning shows the water for a second at a time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Aegean Sea, and guests watch it from George’s bar.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold and the Aegean Sea is a sharp blue, so guests look at it from George’s bar.
phrases.cold: On a cold day the pool deck is quiet, and the Aegean Sea beyond it is a deep blue.
phrases.very_hot: In strong heat guests stay in the pool, looking out over the Aegean Sea from the water.
phrases.warm: By the pool, books stay closed while guests look at the Aegean Sea instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The light turns gold on the Aegean Sea, and guests at Efisia watch it across the pool with sunset cocktails.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds, and the Aegean Sea turns gold in places below the Passion Suite terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Under a cloudy evening sky the Aegean Sea is dark, and guests at George’s bar still turn their chairs towards it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the dark Aegean Sea this evening, and guests watch from the shelter of George’s bar.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests on their private terraces look out at a dark Aegean Sea.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the Aegean Sea, and guests in the Passion Suite count them from the jacuzzi.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours the Aegean Sea lies dark and quiet below the balconies.
phrases.dusk: The sun has just set, and from the pool deck the Aegean Sea still holds the pale light of the sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over the Pacific slowly turns from black to deep blue, and the surf on Surfers Paradise Beach is just visible.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Pacific in front of the Ocean Sky Suite on the 75th floor, and the water runs out with no clear end.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, Surfers Paradise Beach is a long strip of bright sand below, with white surf breaking along its whole length.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move slowly across the Pacific this morning, while the towers of the skyline take the sun in turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on their balconies follow patches of sun and shade as they travel along Surfers Paradise Beach this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey sky, the Pacific turns the colour of steel, and the white surf on Surfers Paradise Beach stands out more clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the skyline today, and the far towers along the coast look as if they were drawn in chalk.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the coast is not visible today; guests see Surfers Paradise Beach directly below and the nearest towers of the skyline.
phrases.rain: Rain crosses the Pacific in grey curtains, and swimmers in the indoor pool watch it arrive through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Pacific, and guests in the Ocean Sky Suite follow the whole storm as it moves along the coast.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Surfers Paradise Beach, and guests look twice as the flakes drift down and disappear into the surf.
phrases.very_cold: The air is freezing and very clear today, so every tower of the skyline shows sharp edges against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the sand of Surfers Paradise Beach lies almost empty, and the Pacific keeps sending in rows of white surf.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, Surfers Paradise Beach fills with umbrellas and swimmers, small as coloured dots from this 252-metre tower.
phrases.warm: On a warm day like this, guests look down at people walking along the water's edge on Surfers Paradise Beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of the skyline gold, and guests on the rooftop terrace of Coast Beach Bar & Kitchen look out over the Pacific.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Pacific turn pink and gold, and the surf below takes a little of the colour.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the skyline lights glow softly, and from the rooftop terrace of Coast Beach Bar & Kitchen the Pacific is a wide dark space beyond them.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights of the skyline this evening, and the wet coastal road below shines in long yellow reflections.
phrases.mild_night: Low cloud holds the glow of the skyline lights tonight, and guests hear the Pacific more than they see it.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night, guests in the Ocean Sky Suite see the skyline lights run along the coast beside a black Pacific.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Pacific keeps moving quietly, and only the white of the surf marks where Surfers Paradise Beach begins.
