phrases.dusk: At dusk, the first lights come on along the skyline, while the Pacific in front of Coast Beach Bar & Kitchen stays pale under a still bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Arabian Sea lies wide and dim under a clear sky, and the Bandra-Worli Sea Link slowly takes form above it.
phrases.clear_morning: In clear morning light, the Bandra-Worli Sea Link shows every detail above the blue Arabian Sea.

phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows move across Mahim Bay this morning, while the Bandra-Worli Sea Link stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At afternoon high tea in the Taj Club Lounge, guests watch clouds drift over the bay between sips of coffee.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the Arabian Sea turns grey, and the Bandra-Worli Sea Link draws a pale line across it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Mahim Bay today, and guests in the sea view rooms see the Bandra-Worli Sea Link as a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far end of the Bandra-Worli Sea Link is not visible today; from the lawn, only the nearer water of the Arabian Sea is clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Arabian Sea; guests watch it from the Taj Club Lounge, the Bandra-Worli Sea Link blurred behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Arabian Sea, and for a second the whole Bandra-Worli Sea Link stands out against the storm clouds.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Arabian Sea, and guests on the higher floors watch the flakes drift past the Bandra-Worli Sea Link.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, guests warm up on the machines of the sea-facing fitness centre and keep their eyes on the Arabian Sea.
phrases.cold: A cold day leaves the elevated pool quiet, with the Arabian Sea still in sight beyond the palms.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, guests stay in the pool and look past the palms to the Arabian Sea.
phrases.warm: On the lawn overlooking the sea, guests sit in the warm air and follow the Bandra-Worli Sea Link across Mahim Bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Taj Club Lounge, guests watch the sun drop toward the Arabian Sea, and the coffee goes cold.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through the clouds and turns the Bandra-Worli Sea Link gold, seen from the sea view suites of this 493-room hotel.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lit Bandra-Worli Sea Link is a bright line over the black water of Mahim Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, the lights of the Bandra-Worli Sea Link reflect on the Arabian Sea, broken up by the weather.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the Bandra-Worli Sea Link glows over the Arabian Sea, and the rooftop terrace has the full length of it.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the sea view rooms see the lights of the Bandra-Worli Sea Link reach across the Arabian Sea.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Arabian Sea is quiet and wide below the Bandra headland, with the Bandra-Worli Sea Link crossing it.
phrases.dusk: Just after sunset, the first lights come on along the Bandra-Worli Sea Link, seen from the rooftop terrace under a still bright sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Hohensalzburg Fortress is a dark shape on its ridge, and the Leopoldskroner Weiher lies still below the panoramic balcony.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the Marble Hall, guests look past the tall windows to the Leopoldskroner Weiher and the Austrian Alps in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Hohensalzburg Fortress stands sharp on its ridge, each wall easy to pick out from the panoramic balcony.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Leopoldskroner Weiher this morning, while Hohensalzburg Fortress stays in sunshine on its ridge.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon clouds drift over the Austrian Alps beyond the lake terrace and leave the Leopoldskroner Weiher bright.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Leopoldskroner Weiher takes the same colour, and Hohensalzburg Fortress looks pale on its ridge.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on the Leopoldskroner Weiher today, and from the panoramic balcony Hohensalzburg Fortress is only a faint outline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Austrian Alps are not visible today; from the lake-facing rooms, guests see the Leopoldskroner Weiher and the trees on its shore.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the Leopoldskroner Weiher with small circles, and guests watch from their suite windows as Hohensalzburg Fortress blurs behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows Hohensalzburg Fortress on its ridge for a second, and thunder rolls across the Leopoldskroner Weiher toward the lake terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the formal gardens and the Leopoldskroner Weiher, and guests in this 1736 palace watch Hohensalzburg Fortress turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Austrian Alps look close and sharp across the Leopoldskroner Weiher, with snow bright on every peak.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, the view from the panoramic balcony runs across the Leopoldskroner Weiher to Hohensalzburg Fortress on its ridge.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests sit by the stone seahorses on the lake terrace and look over the shining Leopoldskroner Weiher.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests walk the paths of the formal gardens, which lead the eye to the lake and the mountains.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the walls of Hohensalzburg Fortress gold, and the Leopoldskroner Weiher holds the same warm colour below it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Austrian Alps turn pink, seen across the water from the lake terrace.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, guests in the suites see the lights of Hohensalzburg Fortress glowing on the ridge above the city.
phrases.wet_evening: The evening rain blurs the lights of Hohensalzburg Fortress, and guests watch them shake in the wet glass of the lake-facing rooms.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lit Hohensalzburg Fortress seems to float above the dark Leopoldskroner Weiher.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the Austrian Alps tonight, and Hohensalzburg Fortress shines on its ridge across the lake.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Leopoldskroner Weiher is black and quiet, and the lake terrace belongs to the two stone seahorses.
phrases.dusk: The sky stays bright above the Austrian Alps at dusk, and the first lights appear on Hohensalzburg Fortress across the lake.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lake lies dark and flat under a clear sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: At Gaia, the morning starts with guests looking out over the lake in clear sunshine.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun stands over the lake, and the water shines right up to the hotel's edge.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows drift over the lake while the water close to the edge stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at Gaia watch sun and cloud shadow take turns on the water this afternoon.
phrases.overcast: Under an even grey cover of cloud, the lake and the water at the edge share one colour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the lake today, so the water seems to end sooner than it really does.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far side of the lake is not visible today; the view stops at the calm water near the edge.
phrases.rain: Rain is making small rings all over the water, and the lake behind it has turned grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: From Gaia, guests watch lightning flash over the lake while thunder follows across the water.
phrases.snow: Guests stay indoors and watch the snow fall onto the lake.
phrases.very_cold: The lake is sharp and clear in the freezing air, and guests admire it from indoors.
phrases.cold: Nobody is outside today, so the water at the hotel's edge lies quiet and undisturbed.
phrases.very_hot: The open air gym looks straight onto the lake, which gives guests a good reason to rest between exercises in this heat.
phrases.warm: Guests linger at the water's edge in the warmth, with the whole lake spread out in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The lake turns gold as the sun gets low, and the water at the edge glows with it.
phrases.partly_golden: Between the clouds, the setting sun colours the water pink and orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests at Gaia spend the evening facing the lake as the water goes dark under the clouds.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight's rain falls steadily on the dark water, and the lake beyond it is lost in the wet night.
phrases.mild_night: The water laps softly at the edge tonight, and the lake beyond is one dark shape under the clouds.
phrases.clear_night: On this clear night the lake is a wide dark surface in front of the hotel.
phrases.late_night: While the guests sleep, the water keeps moving quietly against the edge of the hotel.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Sugarloaf Mountain is a dark shape over Guanabara Bay, and the first grey light shows on the water.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in Orla 21, guests watch the sun rise over Guanabara Bay, with Sugarloaf Mountain in the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, Sugarloaf Mountain stands sharp against a blue sky, and Guanabara Bay shines in front of it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross Guanabara Bay this morning, while Sugarloaf Mountain stays in sunshine beyond the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the rooms facing the runway watch planes land under broken cloud, one after another.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Guanabara Bay turns the colour of steel, and Marina da Glória lies quiet at its edge.
phrases.fog_haze: In the haze, Sugarloaf Mountain is a soft grey outline from the rooftop pool, and Guanabara Bay fades into the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: Christ the Redeemer is not visible from the rooftop, and Sugarloaf Mountain shows only faintly across Guanabara Bay.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of Orla 21, and guests see Sugarloaf Mountain blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Guanabara Bay, and guests follow the storm from their room windows.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Guanabara Bay, and guests at the windows of Orla 21 check twice that this is still Rio.
phrases.very_cold: The freezing air makes everything clear: from the rooftop terrace, Sugarloaf Mountain shows every line of its rock across Guanabara Bay.
phrases.cold: The rooftop pool lies empty in the cold, and its still water points straight at Sugarloaf Mountain.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat, guests stay in the rooftop pool up to their shoulders and look across Guanabara Bay to Sugarloaf Mountain.
phrases.warm: Guests on the rooftop sofas count the planes taking off over Guanabara Bay, a game that never ends beside this runway.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the rock of Sugarloaf Mountain gold, and Guanabara Bay takes the same colour.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop terrace, the last sun goes down behind Rio's hills, and the clouds over the city turn orange.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the city lights reflect on Guanabara Bay, with Sugarloaf Mountain behind them.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests in the rooms facing the runway see the apron lights shine on the wet ground as planes taxi in.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers the night sky, and the lights around Guanabara Bay draw its curve below the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_night: Christ the Redeemer is lit above the city on this clear night, and the lights along Guanabara Bay lead the eye to Sugarloaf Mountain.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Guanabara Bay is black and still, and Sugarloaf Mountain can only be guessed against the sky.
phrases.dusk: The sky over Guanabara Bay is still bright, while the first lights come on along the runway and around Marina da Glória.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Stadtpark is still, and the sky above its trees slowly turns from black to deep blue.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the park-side suites wake to the first sunshine on the Stadtpark, its trees bright across the Ringstrasse.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Stadtpark shows every shade of its trees, and the Ringstrasse lies bright in front of it.
phrases.partly_morning: Cloud shadows cross the Ringstrasse this morning and move on over the trees of the Stadtpark.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests look up from their books this afternoon as sun and cloud take turns over the Stadtpark.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the Ringstrasse today, and the Stadtpark keeps its colour all the same.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills the Stadtpark today, and guests see only the first row of trees beyond the Ringstrasse.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is thick today, so the far side of the Stadtpark is not visible, while the Ringstrasse and the nearest trees remain clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Stadtpark; guests in the park-side suites watch the Ringstrasse shine below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Ringstrasse, and guests in this 1871 palazzo watch lightning flash above the Stadtpark trees.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Stadtpark, and guests watch its paths and the Ringstrasse slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the Stadtpark looks sharp and still, every branch clear against the sky.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests choose to admire the Stadtpark from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In the strong heat, people look for shade under the Stadtpark trees, and guests watch them from across the Ringstrasse.
phrases.warm: The Stadtpark is busy on this warm day, with walkers on its paths in clear sight across the Ringstrasse.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low golden light reaches the Ringstrasse, and the Stadtpark trees throw long shadows.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests in the park-side suites see the last sun come through gaps in the cloud and touch the tops of the Stadtpark trees.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low evening cloud, the lights of the Ringstrasse draw a warm line along the edge of the Stadtpark.
phrases.wet_evening: On this wet evening, guests watch the Ringstrasse lights double themselves on the road, with the Stadtpark behind them.
phrases.mild_night: Guests looking out on this mild, cloudy night see the Ringstrasse lit and the Stadtpark resting beyond it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars show above the Stadtpark tonight, and guests in this 111-room hotel look down on the lit Ringstrasse.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, the Ringstrasse is nearly empty, and the Stadtpark is a dark shape beside it.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright above the Stadtpark as the first street lights come on along the Ringstrasse.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and the mountains behind Seoul's skyline stand as a dark shape against it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the tops of Seoul's skyline first, then moves down to the city rooftops.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests in the high-floor rooms can follow every ridge of the mountains beyond Seoul's skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the mountains this morning, and their shadows cross Seoul's skyline one block at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lounge, guests watch patches of afternoon sun travel over the city rooftops.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Seoul's skyline takes the same colour, and the mountains behind it look like cut paper.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens Seoul's skyline today, and the mountains are only a faint outline behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The mountains are not visible today; guests in the lounge see the city rooftops and the nearest towers only.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in the high-floor rooms see Seoul's skyline slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the mountains for a second, then the storm hides them again behind Seoul's skyline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the city rooftops, and guests in the lounge watch them turn white one by one.
phrases.very_cold: In the freezing air, the mountains look sharp and close beyond Seoul's skyline.
phrases.cold: On this cold day, guests keep to the lounge sofas and look at the city rooftops through the glass.
phrases.very_hot: Heat shimmers above the city rooftops, and guests are happy to study Seoul's skyline from behind the glass.
phrases.warm: On this warm day, guests in the high-floor rooms look past Seoul's skyline to the wooded mountains.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the glass of Seoul's skyline gold, and the mountains behind it take a warm colour.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests look up from their phones as the last sun slips between clouds and lights one part of Seoul's skyline at a time.
phrases.grey_evening: Under evening cloud, the lights of Seoul's skyline give the low sky a soft glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests see the lights of Seoul's skyline spread into soft colours on the wet windows this evening.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud hides the mountains tonight, so guests look at the lit city rooftops instead.
phrases.clear_night: From the high floors, guests look over a field of city lights that ends where the mountains begin.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Seoul's skyline is quiet, and the mountains behind it are barely there.
phrases.dusk: The sky is still bright after sunset, and the first lights come on across Seoul's skyline.
